action figure.text:
Rex was a brave plastic warrior. He had a shiny blue armor and a big knife. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of fragrant flowers and tall trees. Rex loved to explore the garden, but one morning he got lost.

He ended up in a maze made of red and pink roses. The roses were beautiful, but they confused him. He couldn’t understand where he had been put by someone. He tried to go forward, to turn right, to turn left, but every path seemed the same. Rex felt a little sad.

“Oh no!” said Rex. “I’m lost! I need to get back to my place.” He hurried and tried to find his way. But the roses tricked him. He didn’t know where the dollhouse was, where it was hidden.

Rex took a deep breath and shouted with all his might: “Help! Someone find me!” His shout echoed in the garden. A little blue bird, sitting on a branch, was listening to him. The bird flew towards Rex and pointed with its beak at the dollhouse.

Rex followed the bird and, finally, he arrived at the dollhouse! It was right there, hidden behind a flower pot. He felt relieved and happy. His place had been found. Rex sat down on the bench of the dollhouse, ready for new adventures in the Secret Garden. Perseverance had guided him home.

plan.problema: Rex got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his way back.
plan.svolta: He decided to call for help, shouting as loud as he could, 'Help! Someone find me!'
plan.finale: A little bird pointed at him with its beak, guiding him to the dollhouse where he was hidden.

Rex was a brave warrior, made of plastic and shiny details. He loved to be on the wooden table in the secret garden. There were his companions, other action figures, ready for a thousand adventures. But one day, Rex found himself lost. The tall, green plants surrounded him on all sides. He couldn’t understand where he had ended up.

“Oh no!” said Rex, with his metallic voice. “I can’t find my place! I’m lost among these leaves!” He tried to move, but it was too difficult. The roots of the plants blocked him.

Rex tried a bold solution. He started jumping on a wooden bench, hoping to reach the table. But when he made a jump, his accessories – his helmet and his sword – fell to the ground! “Oops!” exclaimed Rex, upset.

A small brown squirrel was watching everything from a tree. His name was Pippo, and he was very curious. He saw Rex in trouble and ran to help him. With his little paws, Pippo picked up Rex’s helmet and brought it back. Then, with an agile jump, he pointed to the table.

Rex followed Pippo’s gesture, and, thanks to the help of the little squirrel, he finally returned among his action figures. He immediately sat in his place, happy to be home. Rex realized that even a friend can make a difference. Together, the toys were even stronger.

Rex was a brave warrior. He was a lion action figure, with a shiny sword and a red armor. He lived in a secret garden, full of tall plants and colorful flowers. The garden was his kingdom.

---

One day, while playing to protect the flowers from invisible monsters, Rex got lost. He had gone too far among the green leaves and thick roots. He couldn’t find his table anymore, where his friends were sitting: a bear, a dinosaur, and a knight.

---

Rex desperately looked for his place. He was a little scared. The plants all looked the same, tall and green. He didn’t know where he had ended up. He shouted as loud as he could: “Help! I’m lost!”. But nobody answered. Nobody heard him among the thick vegetation.

---

Rex thought he had to do something more. Then he had a brilliant idea! He took his shiny sword and started pushing the biggest flowers. He pushed with strength, creating a small path through the garden. The roots moved, the leaves fell down, but Rex didn’t give up.

---

He kept pushing and pushing until he finally found his table. It was next to his group of friends! The bear, the dinosaur, and the knight welcomed him with enthusiasm. Rex smiled happily. His determination had saved him. 

---

Rex returned to his place, ready for new adventures in the secret garden. A brave lion always knows how to overcome obstacles.

He tried to call his toy friends: Pippo the dinosaur and Stella the pink doll. But nobody answered. Nobody heard him. Rex was all alone. He felt a little sad. He didn’t understand where he had disappeared to.

The sun was starting to set. A ray of sunshine hit Rex’s sword. The sword shone! And Rex saw something: a small bench, just like the one where he usually sat. It was near the big slide.

Rex ran to the bench and sat down right away. He felt relieved. He had found his place again. A little bird sang on top of the castle. Rex relaxed. 

With patience, Rex had found the way to go home. Perseverance had helped him solve the problem and to find his peace in the playground. Now he knew that even when things seem difficult, you must never give up.

A little toy robot, Uncle Zip, came up to Rex. “Maybe,” said Uncle Zip, “you just need to be patient. Arrange the figures, one at a time.”

Rex closed his eyes and took a deep breath. He thought about the original scene, the monster he had to face. Then, slowly, he began to group the figures in an orderly way. The warrior stood in front, ready for action. The pirate was farther away, the princess next to him, and the dinosaur in defense.

Rex felt much better. He was finally in his place! Everything was perfect and calm. Rex realized that order makes everything easier and happier. 
Now Rex knew exactly where he belonged.

Leo was a very soft teddy bear. He lived in Tommaso’s bedroom. He was always there, sitting on the bed, or leaning against the crib. But Leo felt lonely. No one was hugging him anymore.

Tommaso played with his trains and built towers of building blocks. Leo watched him, but no one touched him.

Leo longed for a warm hug so much. He wanted to feel the warmth of a hand on him. He felt sad and a little lost. “I just wish someone would hug me,” Leo thought. 

Then, Leo made a decision. He decided to dance! His favorite song was the one with the happy music and the jumping. Leo started to move his little bear paws, trying to get attention. But Tommaso was too busy with his train. No one listened to him.

Leo kept dancing, louder, faster. The music filled the room, but no one stopped to watch him. It was frustrating!

Suddenly, Mom came into the room to help Tommaso put on his pajamas. She saw Leo dancing all by himself. She smiled and ran to him. She took him in her arms, hugged him tight, and said, “I love you, Leo!”

Leo felt happy right away. His bear heart was full of joy. It was nice to be cuddled and loved. It was exactly what he needed to feel complete. Affection is good.

plan.problema: Leo felt lonely because no one hugged him.
plan.svolta: He decided to dance his favorite song to get attention, but nobody listened.
plan.finale: Suddenly, Mom came into the room and hugged him tight, saying, 'I love you, Leo!'

Bear Bruno had a great idea! He decided to try talking to his toys. “Hello!” he said to a snowman. “I’d like to play with you!” The snowman stayed still, without moving a hair. Bear Bruno tried with the soldiers, but they didn’t answer either.

He felt even sadder. Then he looked at his building box and had another idea. He started to build a giant fortress for himself. He used the colorful blocks to create walls and towers. He was so much fun!

Blocks Happy smiled. He knew that even the most difficult jobs become easy if you put in effort and patience. The secret garden was even happier with all the blocks in their place.

Sofia was a rag doll. She lived in a little girl’s bedroom, among the books and toys. She loved to be there, watching the world around her. But today she wasn’t happy. She felt a little lost.

The bedroom was full of clothes scattered on the floor. Shirts, trousers, t-shirts… Sofia had gotten lost among the colorful fabrics! She desperately searched for her favorite dress: the one with pink butterflies and shimmering tulle, perfect for dancing. But she couldn’t find it anymore.

Sofia turned over, slumped down, and curled up. She was really frustrated. “Oh no!” she thought. “I can’t find it!”

Just at that moment, she heard a gruff voice: “What’s wrong, Sofia?” It was Bruno, the teddy bear, sitting on the bed. Bruno was her best friend.

“I’ve lost my dancing dress,” replied Sofia, with a sigh. Bruno got up and looked at her carefully. Then he pointed with a paw at the pile of clothes. “Look here, Sofia. Instead of jumping around everywhere, why don’t you tidy up the clothes a little? You might be able to see everything more clearly.”

Sofia followed Bruno’s advice. She grouped the clothes by color and size. And there, right under a pile of blue t-shirts, she saw it: her dress with the pink butterflies!

Sofia started to dance happily with Bruno. Imaginary music filled the bedroom. She was so happy to have found her favorite dress again. Order always helps when you’re looking for things.

plan.problema: Sofia got lost among her clothes and couldn't find her favorite dancing dress.
plan.svolta: She decided to ask for help from her teddy bear, Bruno, who showed her the best way to organize the mess.
plan.finale: Sofia found her dress right away and started dancing happily with Bruno.

Sofia was a porcelain doll. She lived in the flower room, a room full of colors and the scent of roses. Sofia loved her room, but sometimes she felt lonely. There was no one to talk to. “I wish I had a friend,” thought Sofia, sitting on her little stool.

The cushion was soft and cozy, the notebook full of colorful drawings, and the wool ball was fluffy and warm. But nobody seemed interested in Sofia. She felt sad and quiet.

One day, Sofia had an idea! “I’ll have a party!” she said out loud. She decided to invite the cushion, the notebook, and the wool ball. She said to them, “Come here, I want to have tea!”

The cushion snuggled next to her, the notebook opened its pages to draw new stories, and the wool ball rolled happily around the imaginary table. Together, they sipped flower tea and talked. Sofia told them about her days in the flower room, the cushion listened carefully, the notebook took notes, and the wool ball gave silly answers.

Everyone joined the tea party and Sofia didn’t feel lonely anymore. Laughter filled the flower room. They discovered that sharing a cup of tea could do wonders. Sofia understood that friendship begins when you share something, even just a moment of chatting.

Lila was a stuffed doll. She lived in a little girl’s bedroom. She loved to play with her fluffy friends and build blanket castles. But today Lila had a problem. She couldn’t find her favorite dress, the one with the colorful butterflies! She had put it somewhere and now she didn’t know where it was.

“Oh no!” said Lila, making her button eyes roll. “I can’t play if I don’t have my favorite dress!” She looked around in the bedroom: between the piles of books, under the rocking chair, among all the stuffed animals that surrounded her. Nothing!

Lila decided to take a trip. She took her little blue umbrella and set off. “Maybe there’s a clue somewhere,” she thought. She looked under the table, behind the mirror, even inside the toy box. No dress!

Then she had an idea: “Maybe I moved!” Lila headed towards the crib where the little girl slept. She curled up there to rest for a moment and looked carefully. And right there, under the soft blanket of the crib, she saw her dress with the butterflies!

“I did it!” exclaimed Lila happily. She ran back immediately to her bedroom. It had been a long search, but in the end, she had found everything. The little girl woke up and smiled seeing Lila with her new dress. 

Lila realized that sometimes it’s necessary to be a little patient to find what you’ve lost. And patience can lead to big discoveries.

plan.finale: She found the dress under the crib, where she had curled up to rest after a long day of playing!
plan.morale: Patience is useful for finding things.

Sofia was a porcelain doll. She lived in Luna’s bedroom, a little girl who loved to draw and read. But Sofia felt lonely. Every day, after Luna went to bed, she was all alone in that room. No one told her stories. No one stroked her hair and said, “Goodnight, Sofia.”

Sofia longed for a friend so much. She dreamed of hearing a gentle voice that whispered secrets and adventures to her. She watched Luna sleeping, but she couldn’t move to talk to her. She felt sad and a little scared.

One day, Sofia made a decision. She decided to try to sing a cheerful little song that she had learned from Luna. It was a simple song about a little bird flying in the sky. She sang softly, hoping someone would listen.

Silence. No one answered. Sofia felt even more lonely. Then, suddenly, she heard a small movement beside her. A teddy bear, Bruno, slowly approached. Bruno sat down on the rug and began to listen to Sofia carefully.

Sofia continued to sing her little song, and Bruno watched her with his button eyes. It was an unexpected company, but very pleasant. She felt happy for the first time in a long time. The room seemed brighter and cozier. 

Sofia realized that even a small listener could bring joy to her heart. Luna’s bedroom had become the perfect place to share special moments. And Sofia, the porcelain doll, didn’t feel lonely anymore.

plan.finale: A small teddy bear came closer and began to listen to her carefully.

Sofia was a stuffed doll. She lived in a little girl’s bedroom, but the bedroom was all she knew. It was full of colors and toys scattered on the floor. Sofia loved to be there, sitting on the rocking chair, watching the world.

One day, while she was tidying up in the closet, Sofia got lost. The shelves were full of clothes: t-shirts, pants, hats. It had become dark and confusing. She couldn’t find her favorite dress, the one with the red flowers.

Sofia was scared. She tried to pull out an arm to touch something, but everything was too tight. “Help!” she cried, but no one answered. Then, Sofia decided to do something different. She started to talk out loud. “I’m here! I’m inside the closet!”

Her voice, shy at first, began to echo in the room. Suddenly, a little teddy bear came out of the closet. “Sofia!” said the teddy bear with his sweet voice. “I’ll guide you to your dress.”

The teddy bear pointed to one of the shelves, and Sofia, following his instructions, finally found her favorite dress. It was right there, hidden among the blue pants. She felt relieved and happy. The teddy bear smiled.

Sofia sat back down on the rocking chair, next to the teddy bear. She realized that even when you feel lonely and lost, talking can help you find your way.

plan.problema: Sofia got lost in her closet and couldn't find her favorite dress.
plan.svolta: She decided to call for help, starting to speak out loud to try to find her way.
plan.finale: Finally, her voice echoed and a small toy teddy bear came out of the closet to guide her to the dress.

Berta loved her favorite dress very much, a little blue flower that her grandmother had made for her. That day, however, the little blue flower wasn’t there. Berta looked everywhere for it. She looked under the crib, inside the toy basket, behind the wardrobe. But the blue dress wasn’t there anymore.

Berta felt sad. She didn’t want to play without her favorite little blue flower. Then she decided to ask for help. She saw Leo the teddy bear lion sitting on the carpet. Leo was a kind friend and always ready to help. “Leo, I’ve lost my dress! It’s a little blue flower,” said Berta with a worried voice.

Leo listened to her carefully. Then, he started to look around the bedroom. Together, they looked under the bed, behind the boxes and among the books. Finally, Leo noticed something blue that had rolled down, right under the rocking chair. It was the little blue flower! Berta ran to the dress and put it on right away.

She was so happy! She thanked Leo for helping her. She sat back on the rocking chair, smiling. The sun was coming in through the window and lit up the bedroom. Berta felt calm and peaceful. Her patience in looking for the dress had rewarded her with a big smile.

“I wish I had a friend,” thought Berta. She tried to talk to the teddy bears, but the teddy bears didn’t answer. She tried to move her arms, but she was too heavy to dance. She was very sad.

One day, Berta had an idea! She decided she would have a party. “It will be the most beautiful party in the room!” she exclaimed. She took her colorful clothes: the pink dress, the polka dot hat, a blue dress with butterflies, and a yellow dress with flowers. She used them to make invitations.

She drew pictures on the clothes and hung them on the chair. “Come and have fun!” said Berta. After a while, many toy friends arrived: Leo the stuffed lion, Stella the plastic star, and Pippo the teddy bear.

Berta and her friends played hide-and-seek under the table and had a very long walk on the rug. Berta had so much fun! She was happy! Finally, she had lots of friends to share her time with. 

The room was full of laughter and games. Berta became the happiest doll in the room, surrounded by her friends. The company of other toys made every moment special.

Lilla was a porcelain doll. She lived in the bedroom, between the bunk bed and the wardrobe full of clothes. Lilla had a sweet smile and blonde hair. But Lilla felt very lonely. No one spoke to her anymore. There was no one to hug or play with.

Lilla longed to have someone to talk to. She looked out the window at the world, but she couldn't move. She was always sitting on the rocking chair. It seemed to her that she was the only doll in the world.

One day, Lilla made a decision. She decided that she would tell stories to herself! She used her arms to make the characters. Her face turned into so many different faces. She created a brave prince, a kind princess, and even a funny dragon. Lilla invented fantastic adventures, and she laughed all by herself.

After a while, she heard a small sound. A snail, named Stella, lived on the bedside table. Stella listened to Lilla’s stories with great attention. Lilla and Stella became friends. They talked for hours, Lilla told stories and Stella listened patiently to her.

Lilla felt happy. Even alone, she could have so many adventures and a new friend. She was happy with her bedroom and her stories. And so, Lilla continued to smile, knowing that even a smile can light up the world.

plan.problema: Lila felt lonely because no one spoke to her.

plan.finale: After a while, a little snail that lived on the bedside table listened to her stories and became her friend.
plan.morale: You can be happy all by yourself.

Her friend, a small teddy bear, watched her with shining eyes. Lila told stories to her too. Finally, she didn't feel sad anymore. The bedroom seemed like a magical place, full of laughter and imagination.

One day, Lilla made a decision. She felt a little shy, but she wanted to try. She began to sing a sweet and simple song that her mother had sung. Her voice was as delicate as the sound of a bell.

Suddenly, a movement attracted Lilla’s attention. It was Milo, the boy’s black cat. Milo slowly approached and sat next to Lilla. His curious gaze shone. Lilla smiled. That smile was so bright that Milo came even closer.

robot giocattolo.text:

Suddenly, sunlight came through a window in the secret laboratory. A beam of light hit Robby’s sensors directly. A golden glow surrounded him completely, and suddenly, Robby’s arms moved again! He could spin, jump, and reach out his hands.

“I did it!” said Robby happily. Dr. Leo smiled. Robby felt perfect again.

plan.problema: Robby got stuck and couldn’t move his arms anymore!

robot giocattolo.text:

Rudy tried to reset himself. He tapped his head with a small mechanical arm. But instead of a regular buzz, he made only a strange and unpleasant noise. “Ugh!” said Rudy. “It doesn’t work!”

A little ladybug, Lila, came up to him. “What’s wrong, Rudy?” asked Lila with her gentle voice.

Rudy explained his problem to her. Lila thought for a little while and then saw a drop of orange juice fall from a fruit nearby. Rudy had an idea! He drank the orange juice with his little straw.

Immediately, his motors reactivated. Rudy’s arms started to move and he went around Lila. “I did it!” he exclaimed happily. 

Rudy realized that sometimes, even a small thing can make a difference. The secret garden seemed even more beautiful when he could explore it freely.

plan.problema: Rudy got stuck and couldn't move his arms anymore!

Robby was a toy robot. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Robby loved to explore that magical place. He could move quickly, turn himself around, and do lots of other fun movements.

gioco da fare all'aperto.text:
Field was a giant playground in Rose Park. He loved to see the children laugh and run on him. It was made of green grass and winding paths. Field had a strong and happy voice, but that morning he seemed sad.

“They can’t run,” he said to himself. “The path is too narrow! The friends can’t pass.” The children were running fast, but every time they had to take a step back because the path was full of rocks. It was frustrating for Field. He wanted everyone to have fun.

Field decided to do something. He moved with all his strength, pushing one rock after another. The rocks were big and heavy, but Field didn’t give up. He kept pushing and lifting, little by little. It was a long and tiring job.

After a long time, finally all the rocks were moved. The path was free! The children ran on it right away, happy and fast. They laughed and jumped, they ran back and forth. Field felt a great joy. He was happy to have helped everyone have fun. 

The sun shone brightly in the sky of Rose Park. Field rested a little, knowing that he had done a good job. Patience had brought him happiness.

plan.problema: He couldn't make his friends run through the winding path.
plan.svolta: He decided to tidy up the rocks that were blocking his way, moving them with all his strength.
plan.finale: Finally, all the children could run happily and quickly along his path.

gioco da fare all'aperto.text:
Field was a big playground. He loved to see the children running and jumping around him. It was full of swings, slides, and lots of sand. But Field had a little problem. His toy friends, the red and blue cars, were all stuck! They were trapped between the slide and the tunnel. They couldn’t move.

Field felt sad for them. He wanted them to have fun. He thought, “I must do something!” He moved slowly, trying to push the cars with his big base. But it was too difficult. The cars were too tight.

Then Field decided to go around the sandbox. He moved slowly, towards the side of the playground where there was a small bush. He was looking for a clear path for his toy cars. He looked carefully under the slide and then behind the slide.

Finally, Field found a little hole! It was just a tiny hole of dirt, but it was big enough to free the cars. With one last effort, he pushed the dirt and the cars could come out of the hole. 

The red and blue cars started to run happily around Field right away. They jumped and zoomed, making a cloud of dust. Field smiled. He was happy to have helped his friends. He felt proud of having solved the problem with patience. Everything has its solution if you wait a moment.

plan.problema: He couldn’t make his friends run, they were all stuck!
plan.svolta: He decided to go around the sandbox, looking for a clear path for the other toys.
plan.finale: Finally he found a small hole and freed his fellow players, who immediately started running happily.

gioco da fare all'aperto.text:
Palla Gialla was happy at the playground. He loved to run and roll on the grass. He had lots of friends: the swings, the wooden castle, and the slides. That morning, however, Palla Gialla had gotten lost! He had ended up among the slides, a tangle of plastic and sand. He couldn't find his friends.

“Oh no!” thought Palla Gialla. “I want to go back with everyone!” He tried to roll forward, but every time he got close to a slide, he ended up getting stuck! He felt frustrated and a little sad.

A boy was sitting on a bench watching the games. He seemed bored. Palla Gialla decided to do something different. He concentrated all his strength and started to roll with energy under the nearest slide. “Rum, rum, rum!” he heard his sound as he moved quickly.

The boy looked up and looked under the slide. He saw Palla Gialla rolling with force. He smiled and picked up Palla Gialla. He brought him back to the group of friends. All his companions were happy to see him again. Palla Gialla joined the run, happy and content. 

After a lot of rolling, Palla Gialla realized that you should never give up, even when things seem difficult. And so, thanks to his determination, he found the way to return to play with his friends.

plan.problema: The yellow ball got lost between the slides and couldn't find her friends.
plan.svolta: She decided to roll with force under each slide, but she always ended up getting stuck!
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to her funny noise, she attracted the attention of a child who brought her back to the happy group.

gioco da fare all'aperto.text:
Field was a big playground, full of colors and fun in Rose Park. He loved to see the children running and jumping around him. He was happy when he heard their laughter. But today Field felt a little sad.

The problem was the path! Lots of stones were scattered everywhere, making it difficult for his friends to run quickly. Every time someone tried to run, they tripped and fell. “Oh no!” thought Field. “I can’t let anyone get hurt!”

Field decided to do something. He started to pick up the stones one by one. It was hard work, but Field didn’t give up. A little squirrel, Leo, noticed what he was doing and helped him sweep away the last stones. Together, they collected all the stones from the path.

After so much work, the path became smooth and perfect! The children ran to try it out right away. They jumped, ran, and laughed happily. Field felt really happy. Seeing his friends have fun was the best thing in the world. 

All his friends, happy and fast, ran around Field under the warm sun of Rose Park. Field realized that when we work together, even the most difficult things become easy and fun.

plan.problema: He couldn't make his friends run through the path!
plan.svolta: He decided to tidy up the stones on the path, creating a smoother and more fun route.
plan.finale: Finally, all the friends could run happily and quickly, laughing in the sun.

gioco da fare all'aperto.text:
Ball Gig was a big, red toy. He loved to play at Star Park. He liked to roll, jump, and be thrown in the air. That day, the sun was shining high in the sky. Ball Gig was near Leo, a boy who he liked very much.

Suddenly, Leo started to run with Ball Gig. Ball Gig flew away fast! Then, everything became dark. Ball Gig had fallen among the trees of Star Park. He couldn’t hear Leo’s voice anymore. He was just a little bit scared.

“Leo? Leo!” shouted Ball Gig, but nobody answered. He decided to do something. He focused and started to roll down the hill of the park. He rolled fast, fast, fast! He tried to hear the sound of Leo’s laughter.

Finally, he saw Leo. The boy was laughing happily while he jumped and ran. Ball Gig ran towards him. He stopped next to Leo and hit him with force. Leo laughed even louder.

“It’s so nice to play together!” said Leo. Ball Gig was happy. He was happy to be back with Leo. Together, they continued to play, throwing balls and laughing under the sun of Star Park.

plan.problema: The ball had gotten lost among the trees and couldn't find its friend, the boy Leo.
plan.svolta: It decided to roll down the hill, hoping to meet the boy while he was playing.
plan.finale: Finally, it saw Leo laughing happily, and it ran to him to play together even more strongly.

gioco da fare all'aperto.text:
Field was a big playground, full of colors and slides. He lived in Rose Park, a beautiful place with lots of fragrant flowers. Field loved to jump on his building blocks, but he had a little problem. The little flowers around Field didn't want to jump with him! They were too shy and hid behind the roses when he came near.

Field felt a little frustrated. He wanted to play with all the little flowers, but they seemed to ignore him. “I need to do something,” thought Field. He sat down on a small slide and thought about it. A little green crocodile was watching everything from a leaf.

Then he had an idea! Field decided to make a big noise with his shutter. He did it loud, loud, loud! The sound echoed through Rose Park. The insects, who were hiding before, came out of their hiding place to see what was happening.

Field kept jumping and making noise. The little flowers, curious about the sudden movement and the very loud noise, started to jump happily around Field. They jumped near Field, then moved away to watch the insects.

Field realized that just getting close to the flowers wasn't enough. He had to be interesting! He had learned that sometimes you need to be patient and try new things to get what you want. Field continued to play with the little flowers, and together they had lots of laughter in Rose Park.

plan.problema: He couldn't make the little flowers jump, they were too shy!
plan.svolta: He decided to make a big noise with his snap and scare the insects to attract their attention.
plan.finale: The little flowers, curious about the sudden movement, began to jump happily around the play area.
plan.morale: Patience is the key to success.

gioco da fare all'aperto.text:
Ball Bounce was a happy, yellow game to play outside. He loved to play in the playground. Every day he ran, jumped, and rolled on the soft grass.
Today, though, things went differently. While he was jumping with excitement, he ended up falling into a deep hole!

It was a big, dark hole, full of dry leaves. Ball Bounce couldn’t move. He was stuck! He felt a little sad. A little bird was sitting on a branch nearby and watched Ball Bounce with curiosity.

Ball Bounce tried to roll along the side of the hole, but he always stopped halfway. The ground was too slippery. He tried to push himself upwards, but he was too heavy. “Oh no!” thought Ball Bounce.

Then he had an idea! He saw a strong branch that had fallen near the hole. It was strong enough to be used as a lever. With lots of strength, Ball Bounce climbed onto the branch and used it to push himself out of the hole. Slowly, very slowly, he managed to reach the edge of the playground!

Ball Bounce rolled happily on the grass, near the little bird. He was happy to be free and to have overcome the difficulty. Ball Bounce understood that even when things seem difficult, with a little effort, you can always find a solution.

plan.problema: The ball had fallen into a deep hole and couldn’t get out.

gioco da fare all'aperto.text:
Field of Play was a big playground, right in the heart of the city park. It was made of golden sand and lots of colorful things: red slides, blue swings, and a yellow tower. But Field of Play felt very lonely. Days went by and no one touched him, no one laughed around him. He was sad, just like a flower without sunshine.

Sometimes, someone passing by would look at him, but then they hurried on quickly. No one stopped to play with him. Field of Play really wanted to have someone to run with, someone who would throw him the ball.

“Oh no,” thought Field of Play, “I have to do something!” So, he decided to roll energetically, up and down, back and forth. He tried to be as fun as possible, hoping someone would notice him. The sun shone brightly in the city park sky, but Field of Play didn’t care. He just wanted to play!

Suddenly, a boy ran towards him. His name was Tommaso and he had eyes full of joy. “What a wonderful playground!” exclaimed Tommaso. He picked up the red ball and started kicking it with force. He ran around Field of Play, laughing happily.

Field of Play felt much happier right away. It was fantastic to have a friend to play with. Tommaso spent the hours in the city park, and Field of Play was no longer alone. His golden sand shone with joy. A big smile lit up his face. Tommaso’s laughter filled the air, making everything even more beautiful.

Field of Play realized that playing with a friend is the most wonderful thing in the world.

plan.problema: The playground felt lonely and sad, without anyone to play with.
plan.svolta: It decided to roll around energetically, hoping someone would notice!
plan.finale: Suddenly, a boy ran towards it, ready to play football and run happily.

gioco da fare all'aperto.text:
Ball Yellow loved the Rose Park. It was a fun place outside with green lawns and lots of fragrant rose bushes. Ball Yellow loved to roll, jump, and play with his friends. Especially, he wanted to play with Pip, the white bunny.

One day, while playing ball on the lawn, something went wrong. Ball Yellow rolled too far and got stuck between the prickly branches of a red rose. He couldn't get back! He was lost!

Ball Yellow rolled uselessly on the lawn, but he couldn't get out. He felt sad because he knew Pip was waiting for him. The sun was shining brightly in the sky and the bees were buzzing around the flowers. Ball Yellow had an idea. He started using his many yellow dots to draw a long path on the tall grass. He drew a yellow line, then another, and another, trying to show the way to the lawn where Pip was playing.

Pip saw the yellow dots on the ground. He carefully followed the drawing made by Ball Yellow. He arrived at the lawn and hugged Ball Yellow tight. The two friends snuggled under a big tree, happy to see each other again. 

Ball Yellow realized that even when things seem difficult, with a little patience and creativity, you can always find the solution. And sometimes, friendship is worth more than any game.

plan.problema: The yellow ball got lost among the roses and can't get back to its friend, the bunny, Peter.
plan.svolta: After rolling uselessly across the lawn, the yellow ball decided to use its yellow spots to draw a path to the tall grass.
plan.finale: Peter followed the path drawn by the ball and they hugged happily under the trees.

gioco da fare all'aperto.text:
Palla Dorata was a very happy toy to play with outside. He loved to roll in the playground, chase the children, and make them laugh. One day, Palla Dorata was playing with lots of other plastic friends. Suddenly, he lost his balance! He rolled down the hill, as fast as a lightning bolt. 

When he stopped, he realized he couldn’t get back. He was stuck at the bottom of the hill, and the top seemed very far away. Palla Dorata was a little sad. He wanted to go back to the center of the playground, where all his friends were waiting for him. 

Then he had an idea! He decided to use the wind to push himself up. He let the wind carry him, but it was too strong! Palla Dorata was flying away, and he couldn’t control the direction. He was getting higher and higher, but he wasn’t getting closer to the top.

A little bird, a sparrow named Pippo, saw Palla Dorata in trouble. He flew close to him and said, “Don’t give up! Try again!” Palla Dorata listened to the sparrow and with all his strength, he made one last push upwards.

Finally, thanks to his effort, he reached the top of the hill! Palla Dorata rested happily, looking at the playground from up there. He was happy he had managed it. Perseverance had paid off.

plan.problema: She rolled down the hill and couldn’t get back up.
plan.svolta: She decided to use the wind to push herself up, but the wind was too strong!
plan.finale: Finally, with one last push, she reached the top of the hill and rested happily.

gioco da tavolo.text:
The Board was a little sad. He lived in the Bright Room, among the wooden blocks and colorful books. Every day he waited for someone to use him to play. But today there was no one. “Oh no,” said The Board, “the game is over!”

He quickly noticed that something was wrong. The dice, the red, blue, and yellow ones, were gone! There were no more numbers to show where to go. The Board felt frustrated. He couldn’t continue to play without his dice.

Then he had an idea. He began to move slowly across his squares. He passed by the pictures of flowers, animals, and colorful houses. “Look here,” said The Board, “a beautiful meadow full of daisies! Maybe the dice are attracted to the colors.”

He moved towards the square with a smiling lion. Then he stopped in front of the red house. He continued to move slowly, creating a new path in the Bright Room. His friend, a stuffed doll named Stella, watched him curiously.

Suddenly, a red die slid from under the nightstand and then another blue one fell from the rug. Then, a yellow one finally arrived on The Board! One after another, the dice returned to The Board, happy to be back in their place.

gioco da tavolo.text:
Living Gameboard was a very special game. It lived in Grandma Rosa’s Garden, among the fragrant flowers and ancient trees. Each square on its gameboard told a different story. One day, a furious storm suddenly arrived. The wind blew hard and the rain fell heavily. Living Gameboard felt itself sliding away, getting lost in the tall grass.



When it finally stopped moving, it realized that its pieces were gone! They were scattered everywhere in the garden: a red tower, a golden knight, and a green dragon. Living Gameboard was very sad. It didn’t know what to do.



Then it had an idea. It used its blue squares to draw a long, bright path on the lawn. The squares shone with their own light, attracting the attention of butterflies and squirrels. Nobody seemed to notice it, though.



Just as it was giving up, a kind boy, Marco, approached the garden. He saw the bright path and became curious. He carefully picked up Living Gameboard and brought it back to the middle of the garden. As Marco gently placed it down, the missing pieces magically reappeared!



Living Gameboard was finally reunited with all its companions. Grandma Rosa smiled happily. The boy left to go home, carrying with him a smile and a special memory. Every time Living Gameboard moved, it remembered the importance of always being willing to help those in need.

plan.svolta: He decided to use his squares to create a bright path, hoping to attract the attention of passersby.
plan.finale: A kind boy picked it up carefully and brought it back to the middle of the garden, where it finally rejoined with its pieces.

gioco da tavolo.text:
Quadrati Magici was a special board game. It lived in Luca’s bedroom, among his books and his toys. It was made of colorful wood and had lots of squares with nice pictures. Quadrati Magici loved to play, but sometimes he felt lonely.

One day, the squares got mixed up! All the other squares had ended up in the wrong place. Nobody knew how to move to win anymore. Luca tried to put them back in order, but it was too complicated. It seemed like nobody knew where to go.

Quadrati Magici thought about what to do. “I need to change the rules!” he exclaimed. Then, he started to turn his board. He turned and turned the squares in a strange and unexpected way. The green squares ended up next to the blue squares, the squares with stars found themselves near the squares with animals.

It was a total mess! But then, slowly, the squares began to find their right place. They lined up one after the other, as if they knew what to do. Luca smiled and continued to play. Finally, Luca won! He was happy and Quadrati Magici felt very happy too. 

Luca looked at Quadrati Magici with a big smile. He understood that sometimes, to solve problems, you have to think in a new and creative way.

gioco da tavolo.text:

One day, Living Gameboard noticed a problem. It had gotten lost! Its squares were scattered among the other squares in the garden. It couldn’t follow its drawn path anymore. It was sad and confused. It didn’t know how to get back to the center of the garden.

“Oh no!” said Living Gameboard. “I need to find the right way to complete my journey.” So, it made a decision. It decided to spin the dice wheel many times. It spun, spun, spun. Every time it spun, the squares moved a little.

A little squirrel, called Hazelnut, was watching it. Hazelnut was curious and friendly. He saw Living Gameboard spinning the dice with so much determination. “Maybe you need some help,” said Hazelnut.

Living Gameboard thanked Hazelnut and continued to spin the dice. Finally, the wheel stopped on a square right in the center of the garden. Living Gameboard found itself back in its right place, next to the fountain. It was happy!

Hazelnut smiled. Living Gameboard understood that even when things seem difficult, continuing to try can lead to wonderful results. And so, the Living Gameboard continued to live happily in its secret garden, always ready for a new adventure.

gioco da tavolo.text:
Table Talking was a very special game. It lived in the Flower Garden, under the shade of a big apple tree. Table Talking loved to play with the other games in the garden, but he had a problem. His dice were scattered everywhere! They were under the roses, behind the lavender bush, and even inside the geranium pot.

“Oh no!” said Table Talking with a deep voice. “I can’t let anyone play if my dice are lost.” The sun was shining in the garden, the birds were singing, but Table Talking was sad. He just wanted everyone to have fun.

Then he had an idea! He took the game cards and started to make a path. He drew lines and lines, showing where the dice should be hidden. “If the dice is here,” said Table Talking, pointing to a small wooden house, “then the dice must be right there.”

Sofia, the butterfly who loved to fly around Table Talking, came closer. “Can I help?” asked Sofia. Together, they picked up the dice one by one, following the path drawn by Table Talking. Other games in the garden joined in the operation and everyone worked together to put the dice back in order.

Finally, all the dice were back in their place, in perfect order. Table Talking smiled. He was happy! The garden was full of laughter and fun again. All the games in the Flower Garden sat around Table Talking for another game. It was nice to work together to solve a problem.

plan.finale: All the blocks were put in order and the Talking Table smiled, happy to have brought joy back to the garden.

It couldn’t find the starting point, the center of the Jolly Room.

“Oh no!” said Living Gameboard with a wobbly voice. “I don’t know where I am! Everything is so confusing.” A little star, Luna, had fallen from the ceiling. She came closer. “Maybe you should look at the pictures,” suggested Luna with a smile.

Living Gameboard listened to the advice. It began to slowly turn its pieces. The squares shone, some more than others. Living Gameboard followed the brightest path, with patience. It turned slowly, watching each square. 

After a while, it felt a strange feeling. The squares lined up! The center of the Jolly Room was right in front of it. Living Gameboard found its perfect position in the center, ready for new adventures. Luna jumped happily around it.

Living Gameboard understood that even when things seem difficult, stopping for a moment and concentrating can help you find the right way.

Living Game Board thought for a moment. Then he had an idea! He decided to double the number of dice rolls. He rolled the dice three times, then another three times. Every time the dice fell, Living Game Board moved one square. It was tiring, but he didn't give up.

“I can’t move the players anymore!” he shouted. “I’m lost among my squares! I don’t know where to go!” The red, blue, green, and yellow playing pieces were stuck in strange places. A car was on the flower field, a sun was under the moon, and a star was inside the castle.

The Dancing Board tried to spin all the squares quickly, hoping to restore order. But the chaos was too big! The playing pieces moved randomly and the players didn’t know what to do. A little teddy bear, Leo, watched him with a worried look.

“Maybe,” thought the Dancing Board, “I need to create a clear path.” He took his colorful playing pieces and started arranging them in a row. First the red piece, then the blue one, then the green one, and finally the yellow one. He made a precise line to follow.

“There!” exclaimed the Dancing Board. “Now the players know where to go! Following a path helps everyone.” The players followed the new path carefully and finally they could play happily. 

The Dancing Board felt happy again, because he had restored order in the Bright Room. It was nice to know that when things are in order, everyone can have fun.

gioco da tavolo.text:
Tabletop lived on the dusty attic. He was a wooden game board, a little faded and full of small cracks. The attic was full of tall, narrow boxes. Tabletop loved the attic, even though sometimes he felt lonely.

One day, while a gust of wind raised dust, Tabletop realized he was missing! He had ended up in a maze of boxes. He couldn't see his board anymore and didn't know how to get out. “Oh no!” he said, his voice a small rustle of wood.

Tabletop tried to move, but every time he ended up in the same square. He rolled the dice, hoping it would show him the right path, but it was useless. Each throw always brought him back to the same point. He felt frustrated and a little sad.

Then, suddenly, Tabletop had an idea! He thought about the squares around him. He began to move them gently, one at a time. He tried to create a different path, but it didn't work.

Finally, with a flash of brilliance, he understood what to do: he started to rearrange the squares to form a spiral! He moved slowly, following the spiral he created. With each turn, he moved away from the boxes and reached the edge of the maze.

In the end, with one last turn, Tabletop got out of the maze! He was free and happy to return to living on the dusty attic. The dust seemed less annoying than before.

gioco da tavolo.text:

Living Board made a decision: it turned the colored wheel. It hoped that this simple action would help it change its path. But instead of the pawns moving a little, the pawns slid away, ending even further into the maze! It felt frustrated.

Suddenly, a small stream gurgled nearby. The water was clear and inviting. Living Board had an idea: “Maybe if I let myself be swept away, I’ll return to my place!” And so it happened. A wave of water took it by the shoulder and carried it away, towards its starting point.

Living Board returned exactly where it had been before getting lost. It was happy! The Secret Garden seemed even more beautiful. The birds sang and the butterflies flew around it. Living Board realized that sometimes, one small step at a time, with calmness and patience, you can always find the right way.

gioco di imitazione.text:
Mimì was a special toy. He was a teddy bear who could do lots of things! When someone touched him, Mimì would respond and do the same actions. But Mimì had a little problem. He lived at the playground and all the other animals seemed so good at everything!

The bunnies were jumping up and down, doing somersaults. The little fish were swimming in the swing, as if they were in a blue sea. Mimì wanted to do the same, but he was so scared of making a mistake. Every time he tried to jump, he fell to the ground. Every time he tried to swim, he got soaked right away!

“I can’t do it,” said Mimì, sitting down on a red bench. A little jay, Penelope, looked at him curiously. “Why don’t you try to watch?” she suggested. “The bunnies jump naturally, and the little fish swim without forcing.”

Mimì followed Penelope’s advice. He watched carefully the bunnies jumping. He saw how they moved lightly and agilely. Then he looked at the little fish swimming in the swing. He noticed how they moved gently, as if they were light. Mimì began to imitate their movements. He jumped slowly, and he swam gently.

Now Mimì was having fun! It didn’t matter if he wasn’t perfect. It mattered to try new things. He realized that learning is a beautiful game. And Mimì realized that every attempt was a step forward. 
Finally Mimì understood that he didn’t have to be perfect to have fun.

plan.svolta: She decided to watch the bunnies jumping and the fish swimming carefully, imitating their movements patiently.
plan.finale: Mimi learned to have fun trying new things without worrying about being perfect!

But he couldn’t do it very well! No one at the playground found him funny. The children laughed, but only because Mimì made funny sounds. Mimì felt sad. He wanted to be a good imitation toy.

Then Mimì decided to do something different. He sat down near a group of children who were playing with sand. He watched the children carefully. He saw how they smiled, how they made funny faces when they built sandcastles, and how they jumped happily.

Mimì realized that to imitate an animal, you didn’t just have to make the sound. You also had to move and make the right face! So Mimì started to try. He bent down, he stretched out, he made silly faces. He imitated the children while they were playing.

And it worked! The children laughed with delight when Mimì made a “Meow!” with his nose moving and a big smile. When he imitated a dog running, he jumped up and down. He had become the most fun imitation toy at the playground. Mimì was happy!
