disney princess.text:
Princess Disney was in Candy Castle, a castle made of cotton candy and meringue. It was a beautiful place, but lately something wasn't right. The castle wasn't shining as brightly as before. Princess Disney noticed that her glitter was gone! All of her glitter, the ones that made the castle sparkle.

She was very sad. Without the glitter, Candy Castle looked a little gray and faded. “Oh no!” said Princess Disney. “I must find my glitter!” She started looking for them everywhere: between the gingerbread towers, under the whipped cream beds, but there wasn't a single glitter anywhere.

She decided then to ask for help from the wind. She ran to the big window of the castle and shouted: “Wind, Wind! Did you see my glitter?” But the wind was too fast. It scattered the clouds and whispered among the trees without listening to Princess Disney.

Suddenly, Princess Disney had an idea. She saw a bag of cotton candy lying on the floor. She picked it up and used it as a net to catch the scattered glitter everywhere. The bag was full of colorful glitter! Princess Disney collected all the glitter and gently spread it around the castle. Immediately, Candy Castle shone brighter than ever.

A little fairy, Lila, watched in amazement. “That was a very clever way, Princess Disney!” she exclaimed. Princess Disney smiled happily. She realized that even when things seem difficult, finding a solution takes time and patience. Returning to her place among the castle walls, Princess Disney felt happy and peaceful.

plan.problema: The Princess has lost all her glitter, and without it the castle doesn’t shine anymore!
plan.svolta: She decided to ask for help from the wind, but the wind was too fast to listen to her.
plan.finale: The Princess used a bag of cotton candy to catch the scattered glitter and bring the light back to the castle.

disney princess.text:
Principessa Disney was in Toy Castle. It was a beautiful castle, full of rooms and hallways made entirely of wood. But today the castle was very sad. Its towers weren’t shining anymore and its floors weren’t echoing with laughter.

“Oh no!” said Princess Disney. “My sparkly crown is missing! And without my crown, the castle loses all its magic.”

The Monkey King, a little stuffed monkey who lived in the castle, came up to Princess Disney. “Don’t worry, Princess,” said the Monkey King. “We’ll try to find it!”

Princess Disney thought for a little while. Then she had an idea. “I have to follow my rosy cheeks!” she exclaimed. “Maybe they will show me the way to the crown.”

So Princess Disney moved slowly, following the blush on her cheeks. She moved back and forth in the main hall, then she explored the bedroom where she slept. Finally, she stopped in front of a big cushion shaped like a princess.

Princess Disney lifted the cushion gently. And there, hidden under the soft down, was her sparkly crown!

The whole castle burst into a celebration of colors and sounds. The towers shone like stars, the floors echoed with laughter, and the Monkey King jumped for joy. Princess Disney quickly put the crown on her head. 

The princess smiled. She had found her crown thanks to patience and observation. And now everything was perfect again in Toy Castle. The search for something lost takes time, but with calmness you always manage to find it.

plan.problema: The Princess had lost her sparkling crown and the castle became very sad.
plan.svolta: She decided to follow her rosy cheeks, hoping they would guide her to the lost crown.
plan.finale: She found the crown hidden under a princess-shaped cushion and the castle shone with joy again.

disney princess.text:
Princess Disney was in the Doll Castle. It was a beautiful castle full of rooms full of clothes and doll accessories. Princess Disney loved to play there, but today she had a problem. She was lost! She was desperately looking for her sparkly ballgown, because tonight there was a big party in the castle.

“Oh no, oh no!” exclaimed Princess Disney. “I can’t find my dress anymore! It’s so important for the party.” She looked around, but she couldn’t see it among the lace and sequins. It was all too confusing.

Princess Disney decided to ask for help. She climbed up a spiral staircase to the tallest tower of the castle. There lived Bruno, a big teddy bear with one eye that he had lost as a little boy. Bruno was very wise and always ready to help.

“Bruno, please, can you help me?” asked Princess Disney. “I’m lost and I can’t find my ballgown.” Bruno raised his head and looked down carefully. With his sharp sight, he pointed Princess Disney towards a chest hidden behind a red curtain.

Princess Disney ran to the chest and opened it. Inside was her sparkly ballgown! It was exactly what she was looking for. The Princess smiled happily. “Thank you, Bruno!” she said. 

The Doll Castle rang with laughter and music all night long, and Princess Disney danced with the other toys. Kindness can open doors to unexpected solutions.

plan.problema: The Princess was lost among so many clothes and couldn't find her ballgown for the event!
plan.svolta: She decided to ask for help from the big teddy bear Bruno, who lives in the tallest tower of the castle.
plan.finale: Bruno, with his sharp sight, pointed the Princess towards a hidden chest where she found her sparkling gown!

disney princess.text:
Princess Disney was in her Crystal Castle. It was a beautiful castle, made of colorful glass that reflected the sunlight. But Princess Disney wasn’t happy. She had lost all her sparkly clothes! All the shimmering dresses, silk gowns, and dresses with sequins were gone. She didn’t know where they had gone and couldn’t make her kingdom’s people happy.

The kingdom had become a little sad. The flowers in the garden didn’t look so colorful, the lake didn’t sparkle like before, and even the tallest tower seemed a little dull. Princess Disney felt very worried. She wanted to make her kingdom shine again.

Then she had an idea! She decided to make new clothes. She used fragrant flowers, light feathers, and colorful stones that she found in the garden. She called for help the garden birds, sparrows, and tits. The little birds flew around Princess Disney, carrying the prettiest feathers and helping her tie the flowers.

They worked together for hours. Princess Disney created wonderful clothes, full of color and light. The birds surrounded her, happy to help her. The kingdom began to shine again. The flowers became brighter, the lake sparkled with a thousand reflections, and the towers seemed to dance in the sun.

Princess Disney smiled. She solved the problem with her imagination and her creativity. With a new dress made of flowers, her people were happy again. The Princess understood that even when things seem difficult, you just need to use your imagination to always find a solution.

plan.problema: The Princess has lost all her glittering clothes and doesn’t know how to make her kingdom happy.
plan.svolta: She decided to create new clothes using flowers, feathers, and colorful stones, seeking the help of the garden birds.
plan.finale: The kingdom returned to splendor thanks to her clothes made with love and creativity.

disney princess.text:
Princess Disney was sitting on her throne in Doll Castle. The castle was gray and quiet. Her sparkling crown wasn't there anymore! It was gone. Princess Disney was very sad. Without her crown, the castle didn't seem like a happy place.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Princess Disney. “Where could it be?” She called her plush friends, but none of them knew anything. Prince Gianni, who often played with her, was worried. "We have to find the crown!" he said.

Princess Disney had an idea. She decided to organize a treasure hunt! She found little pieces of paper and hid them in secret places in the castle. One clue was under the tea table, another was behind the bookshelf full of stories. Princess Disney followed the clues carefully.

The little teddy bear Bruno helped her to look. Together, they checked every corner of Doll Castle. Finally, Princess Disney found the last clue: a small golden star. And there, under her throne, her sparkling crown was shining!

Princess Disney took it and put it right on her head. The castle immediately became colorful and full of music. Bruno was jumping for joy. Princess Disney smiled. Everything was perfect again. The princess realized that even when things seem lost, with a little patience, you can always find the solution.

plan.problema: The princess had lost her sparkling crown and the castle became sad.
plan.svolta: She decided to organize a treasure hunt, leaving clues all over the room!
plan.finale: She found the crown under her throne, reviving the joy in the castle.

disney princess.text:
Princess Disney was sad. She lived in Dollhouse Castle and the castle seemed very dull. She had lost her sparkling crown, the one with so many colorful gems! Without her crown, Dollhouse Castle wasn't a happy place anymore. Her towers looked faded and her floors had become gray.

Princess Disney decided to do something. She started to look everywhere. She looked behind the shiny furniture and inside the rooms full of treasures. But the crown wasn't there! Then she had an idea: she followed a path made of pink glitter and bouncy candies. The path was bright, but she got lost very quickly!

She found herself in a maze full of dolls. There were dancing dolls, cuddling dolls, and dolls that looked like they were smiling. Princess Disney desperately searched for her crown, but she couldn’t find the exit. Suddenly, she heard a little sound: “Tick-tock, tick-tock.”

A small fairy with iridescent wings appeared in the castle garden. The fairy had a magic key. With the key, she opened a small box and inside was the sparkling crown! Princess Disney jumped for joy. Dollhouse Castle shone like before.

Princess Disney thanked the fairy and the castle filled with music and laughter. The princess realized that even when things seem difficult, if you never give up, you always find a solution. And in the end, perseverance brings happiness.

plan.problema: The Princess had lost her sparkling crown and the castle became very sad.
plan.svolta: She decided to look for clues following a path of glitter and sweets, but she was lost in a maze of dolls.
plan.finale: She managed to find the crown thanks to the help of a little fairy who lived in the castle garden.

disney princess.text:
Princess Disney was in the Doll Castle. It was a beautiful castle, full of rooms and hallways. But lately, Princess Disney wasn’t happy. Her sparkly dress was dull. The embroidery was faded. The whole castle seemed sad.

Princess Disney had lost all her glitter! The Princess loved to shine so much. Without glitter, the Doll Castle was like a star without light. It was a really big problem.

“Oh no!” said Princess Disney, with her sweet voice. “I must find my glitter!”

Princess Disney ran to ask for help from the dolls who lived in the castle. There was Queen Charlotte, the porcelain doll, and Pippa, the rag doll. “Have you seen any glitter?” asked Princess Disney. Queen Charlotte and Pippa shook their heads. “No, Princess Disney,” they replied. “We haven’t seen any glitter.”

Princess Disney felt more and more down. Then, she had an idea! She remembered an old cookie box that she had in her favorite corner. Carefully, Princess Disney opened the box. And there, hidden among the old cookies, were all the glitter!

Princess Disney picked them up and spread them carefully over her dress. The Doll Castle shone brighter than ever before. It was a castle full of light and joy. Princess Disney smiled happily. 

The Princess arranged herself among her rooms, now sparkling, reflecting her calm determination. Sometimes, to find what is missing, you just need a little patience.

disney princess.text:
Princess Disney was in the Dollhouse Castle. It was a beautiful place, full of rooms and hallways made entirely of wood. The walls were decorated with pictures of fairies and knights. Princess Disney loved to explore the castle, but this time she had made a mistake. She was lost!

She had arrived in a complicated labyrinth, with many turns and narrow corners. She was looking for her crown, a golden crown with little colored gems. She had lost the crown somewhere. Princess Disney felt sad and a little scared. She couldn’t find the exit.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Princess Disney. “I must call for help!” Then, she began to sing a sweet melody, a melody that only princesses knew. It was a song full of hope and kindness.

A little doll prince, Prince Charming, approached Princess Disney. Then others followed: Snow White, Cinderella, and Aurora. All the doll puppets of the Dollhouse Castle responded to the Princess Disney’s singing with a harmonious chorus. Their singing was sweet and clear.

Princess Disney followed the sound of the puppets and finally, she saw it! Her sparkling crown lay on a small wooden throne. Princess Disney ran to grab it. She was so happy! All the puppets in the castle thanked her.

Princess Disney felt happy and safe in the Dollhouse Castle. Kindness, in that magical place, always had a way.

disney princess.text:
Princess Disney was in her doll castle. It was a beautiful castle, full of rooms and hallways made entirely of wood. Princess Disney loved to play there, but today she was very sad. She had lost her sparkly crown! The crown was made of colorful crystals that shone in the sunlight. No one knew where it had gone.

“Oh no, oh no, oh no!” exclaimed Princess Disney, wiggling. “My crown is missing and I don’t know what to do!”

The doll castle seemed much quieter without the sparkle of her crown. Princess Disney felt a little lonely. Then she thought of her friend, Bear Bruno. Bruno was soft and fluffy and was always ready to help.

“Bruno, Bruno!” called Princess Disney. “I need your help! My crown is lost.”

Bruno quickly came to Princess Disney. With his soft nose he began to search among the pillows of the bed. He sniffed under the carpets and behind the chairs. He searched with determination. After a while, Bruno wagged his tail happily! Under a pile of stuffed animals, he found the sparkly crown.

Princess Disney jumped up and down with joy. “I found it! I found it!” she said, taking her crown and putting it right on her head. She smiled happily. Bruno gave her a big fluffy hug. 

Princess Disney realized that even when things seem difficult, if you keep looking with effort, you always find a solution in the end.

plan.problema: The Princess has lost her sparkling crown and no one knows where she went.

plan.finale: Finally, they found the crown under a pile of plush toys and the Princess smiled happily.

disney princess.text:
Princess Disney was in the Dollhouse Castle. It was a castle full of toys! There were teddy bears, toy cars, soldiers, and so many other friends. Princess Disney loved to explore her kingdom, but this time something went wrong. She got lost!

She was surrounded by mountains of plush toys and oceans of Lego buildings. She couldn’t find her way to the castle towers. “Help!” cried Princess Disney, but no one answered. No one seemed to hear her. Her voice was too small to be heard among all the toys.

Princess Disney felt a little sad. Then she had a brilliant idea! She started to dance. She danced fast and happy, with her arms moving like butterfly wings. Her song was a sweet and carefree melody.

Suddenly, a little plush teddy bear began to move its ears. Then a red toy car started to zoom back and forth. Even the soldiers joined the dance! All the toys in the Dollhouse Castle followed Princess Disney.

The music and movement guided Princess Disney to the castle towers. Finally, she found her place next to the throne. All her toy friends surrounded her happily. The princess smiled. She was happy to be home. 

She realized that even if you sometimes get lost, having friends ready to help makes everything easier and more fun.

plan.problema: The Princess was lost among so many toys in the castle!
plan.svolta: She tried to call for help, but no one seemed to hear her.
plan.finale: Then she had an idea: she started to dance a happy song and all the toys followed her until she found her way.

doll.text:
Stella was a stuffed doll, soft and a little faded from the sun. She lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of fragrant flowers and lush plants. Stella loved her butterfly, Lila, who visited her almost every day.

---

One afternoon, Lila arrived with her graceful flight and settled on Stella’s arm. Suddenly, Lila disappeared! Stella looked around among the bushes of red and white roses. She was lost. She couldn’t find her friend. The roses were so many, so fragrant, but she couldn’t see Lila anywhere.

---

Stella tried to call: “Lila, Lila! Where are you?” But nobody answered. Only the singing of the little birds and the rustling of the leaves. Then Stella decided to take a long walk among the colorful flowers: yellow tulips, blue violets, tall sunflowers. She walked through the whole garden, looking for Lila everywhere.

---

Finally, she heard a slight flutter of wings. She saw her! Lila was perched on the petal of a white daisy, happy to be found. Stella ran to her and the two friends hugged under the big apple tree. It was a moment of joy and peace.

---

Stella realized that sometimes finding someone just takes a little patience and a good look around. The sun was setting, painting the sky pink and orange. Stella and Lila knew that friendship is a precious treasure to always cherish.

plan.problema: Stella got lost among the roses and couldn't find her friend the butterfly.
plan.svolta: She tried to call the butterfly, but nobody answered, so she decided to take a long walk among the colorful flowers.
plan.finale: Finally, the butterfly arrived, happy to be reunited with Stella under the big tree.

doll.text:
Berta was a stuffed doll, soft and a little faded. She lived in the secret garden, a place full of fragrant flowers and lush plants. She loved to be there, watching the bees buzz and the birds sing. But one morning, Berta had gotten lost among the red and pink roses.

She had found herself surrounded by soft petals, but her smile had disappeared. She didn’t understand why she felt so sad. Her cheeks had become dark and her glass eyes seemed dull. Berta couldn’t find her joy.

“Oh no,” thought Berta, “I must do something!” Then she made a decision. She decided to dance! She began to move her arms and legs in a silly way, as if she were following an invisible melody. She jumped, bent, and twirled, making funny faces.

A little garden gnome, Pipino, watched her curiously. He smiled seeing Berta so happy. Berta continued to dance with energy, hoping that her movement would lead her home.

Suddenly, the sun lit up a hidden path among the plants. Berta followed the beam of light and found herself in front of a crystal-clear stream. The reflection of the sun on the surface of the water showed Berta her smile. Berta smiled too, happy to be back home. Joy is found in playing.

plan.problema: Berta got lost among the roses and couldn't find her smile.
plan.svolta: She decided to dance a silly dance, hoping her energy would guide her home.
plan.finale: The sun lit up a hidden path and Berta found her smile reflected in a stream.

doll.text:
Berta was a porcelain doll. She lived in a secret garden full of fragrant roses. The roses were big and red, some white and others pale pink. Berta loved that garden, but one morning something wasn't right.

Berta had gotten lost among the roses. She couldn't find her smile. Usually, when children held her tight, she would smile of stone, with a small, barely noticeable smile. But today, her smile was gone. She felt sad and lonely.

A little gnome of the earth, Bruno, was picking berries near Berta. “What’s wrong, Berta?” Bruno asked with his raspy voice. “I can’t find my smile!” Berta replied, lowering her head slightly. 

Berta realized she had to do something. She decided to sing a cheerful song that she knew well. She began to sing a sweet and lively tune. “Sing, Berta, sing!” Bruno encouraged.

The music echoed in the secret garden. A ray of sunshine hit the roses. Berta looked up at the blue sky. The sun shone brightly and warmly. Suddenly, her bright smile returned to illuminate her porcelain face. 

Bruno smiled at the doll. “See, Berta? The joy was already inside you!” he said. Berta felt happy and complete. The secret garden was even more beautiful than before. Every flower seemed to dance under the sun. Berta knew that even when things seem difficult, happiness can always be found inside.

plan.problema: Berta got lost among the roses and couldn't find her smile.
plan.svolta: She decided to sing a cheerful song to attract the attention of the other flowers.
plan.finale: The sunshine made her smile, and she immediately found her bright smile again.

doll.text:
Bambolina Sofia was sitting among the roses in the secret garden. She was a special doll, because she could talk and move on her own. She loved this garden full of colors and scents very much. But today she wasn’t happy. She had gotten lost! The roses were so many, so beautiful, that she had gotten lost among their stems.

Sofia desperately searched for her favorite dress, the one with colorful butterflies. She had left it there just before and now she couldn’t see it anymore. “Oh no!” said Sofia, clutching her lace dress tightly. “I can’t find it!”

Doll Sofia decided to do something. She focused her blue little eyes and began to look around among the rose stems. She was trying to see something familiar, a piece of silk, a piece of colorful fabric. She looked up, she looked down, but there was nothing.

A little squirrel, Leo, was watching her from a distance. He approached Sofia and whispered to her: “Look there!” He pointed with a paw at a ray of sunshine filtering through the branches.

And indeed, the ray of sunshine illuminated Doll Sofia’s favorite dress! It was hanging gently on a branch full of blackberries. Sofia ran to hug it and held it tightly. It had taken her a little while to find it, but in the end, she had succeeded.

Doll Sofia felt happy again in her secret garden. She sat down again among the roses, satisfied with her patient search. The sun continued to shine and the butterflies flew around her. Patience always has its reward.

plan.problema: Sofia had gotten lost among the roses and couldn't find her favorite dress anymore.
plan.svolta: She decided to use her little eyes to peek among the stems, trying to see something familiar.
plan.finale: Finally, a ray of sunshine illuminated the dress that Sofia found hanging on a blackberry branch.

doll.text:
Berta was a stuffed doll. She had a painted smile and two big blue eyes. She lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and soft grass. Berta loved her pink dress with butterflies very much. It was her favorite!

One day, while she was playing hide-and-seek among the lilies, Berta got lost. She couldn’t find her way out of the garden anymore. She felt a little sad and confused. She looked everywhere, but she couldn’t find her pink dress.

Berta decided to call all the flowers. “Mr. Lily, Mrs. Rose, have you seen my dress?” she asked. The lilies whispered, “No, Miss Berta.” The roses replied, “We haven’t seen it!” Nobody knew where her dress had gone.

Just when Berta was about to lose hope, a little squirrel, named Ribbon, ran towards her. “I saw something under a bush full of roses!” exclaimed Ribbon. Berta ran quickly and… there it was! Her pink dress! It had fallen among the thorns.

Berta thanked Ribbon for helping her. She quickly put her dress on and went back to playing in the Secret Garden, happy to be home again. Berta realized that even when you get lost, with a little patience and help, you can always find the right way.

plan.problema: Berta got lost in the garden and couldn't find her favorite dress.
plan.svolta: She decided to call all the flowers, asking if they had seen it, but none of them knew where it had gone.
plan.finale: Finally, a little squirrel showed her the way under a bush full of roses and Berta found her dress!

doll.text:
Bambolina Rosa lived in the Secret Garden. She was a doll made of lace and silk, with a smile always ready. She loved to play among the flowers, but this time she had gotten lost. The roses were so fragrant and so many, that Bambolina Rosa got lost among their branches.

She couldn’t find her favorite dress: a blue tunic with lots of star embroidery. She had left it there, near the pond, and now she couldn’t see it anymore. She was very sad. She looked under the big sunflowers, behind the lavender bushes, but nothing. The dress had disappeared!

Bambolina Rosa tried to call for help with her loud voice. “Help! I’m lost!” she shouted loudly, but no one answered. Only the wind whispered among the leaves. She felt alone and a little scared.

Then she had a brilliant idea! She started to dance. She danced up and down, she turned around the rose bush. She sang a happy song that she liked very much, a song about the sun and the flowers.

Suddenly, she heard a chirp. A little bird, a yellow finch, perched on a branch nearby. She looked at Bambolina Rosa with her black eyes and then flew away, returning to point with her beak at something under a bush.

Bambolina Rosa ran towards the bush and there she saw it! Her blue dress with the stars shone in the sun. It was right there, hidden among the leaves. Bambolina Rosa jumped for joy. The little bird watched her happily.

With a smile, Bambolina Rosa put on her favorite dress and continued to dance in the Secret Garden. Perseverance can lead to the solution of any problem.

plan.problema: The Ragdoll Pink was lost among the roses, unable to find her favorite dress.
plan.svolta: She tried to call for help with her loud voice, but no one heard her.
plan.finale: Then she had an idea: she started to dance and sing a cheerful song, attracting the attention of a little bird who pointed her to the dress under a bush.

doll.text:
Berta was a stuffed doll. She had red hair and a dress with flowers. She lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of fragrant roses and lush plants. Berta loved the garden, but one morning something wasn't right. She had gotten lost among the red and white roses. She couldn't smile anymore. Her smile, usually so bright, was gone.

Berta looked around. The roses were beautiful, but she couldn't find it. She was sad and a little scared. She tried to move her arms, but nothing seemed to work. She didn't know how to go back.

Then Berta made a decision. She decided to sing. She opened her little doll beak and began to sing a cheerful song that she knew very well. “Jump, jump, dance, dance, joy is always here!” sang Berta with all her voice.

A little blue bird listened carefully. He was sitting on a rose branch and watching Berta. When he finished singing, the bird flew to her and pointed with his beak at a path among the plants. The sun was shining at the beginning of the path.

Berta followed the bird. She walked quickly and soon found her place in the Secret Garden, near the pond. Her smile began to shine brighter than ever before. Berta realized that joy isn't just found in toys or beautiful places, but inside of her.

plan.problema: Berta got lost among the roses and couldn't find her smile.
plan.svolta: She decided to sing a happy song, hoping her voice would guide her.
plan.finale: A little bird, attracted by the melody, pointed to the path towards the sun and Berta found her bright smile again.

doll.text:
Ballerina Stella was a soft stuffed doll with a smile always on her face. She lived in a secret garden, full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. It was her favorite place in the whole world! One day, while dancing among the red roses, she got lost. She didn’t recognize anything anymore. Everything seemed huge and confusing.

Ballerina Stella was scared. She tried to go back, but every path looked just like the other. She sat down on a lavender bush and cried. “Oh no,” she said, “I’m lost!” She didn’t know where her home was, her secret corner under the big tree.

Then Ballerina Stella made a decision. She started to sing a happy song that she loved very much. It was a sweet and a little silly melody. The flowers around moved slightly, as if they were listening to her voice.

A little squirrel, with a bushy and curious tail, approached Ballerina Stella. “What are you singing?” asked the squirrel with a cheerful tone. Ballerina Stella explained her problem to him. The squirrel smiled and said, “Follow the poppy path, then turn right after the leaf waterfall.”

Ballerina Stella followed the squirrel’s instructions and in just a few minutes she arrived at her secret corner under the tree. It was just as she remembered it! She settled among the dry leaves, happy to be home. Ballerina Stella realized that even when you feel alone and scared, asking for help can lead to wonderful surprises.

plan.problema: Doll Stella is lost in the garden and can’t find her home.
plan.svolta: She decided to call for help, starting to sing a happy song to attract the attention of the flowers.
plan.finale: A little squirrel showed her the way to her secret corner under a tree.

doll.text:
Stella was a stuffed doll. She had a dress with flowers and big blue eyes. She lived in the Secret Garden, a magical place full of roses, sunflowers, and bells of Ireland. Stella loved her garden very much, but that morning she had gotten lost.

It was so fragrant! The colors of the flowers confused her. She had wandered away from the lawn where the other toys were lying: Leo the teddy bear and Nina the wooden princess. Stella couldn’t find her place anymore. She was sad and a little scared.

“Oh no!” said Stella, trying to speak loudly. “I can’t find the lawn! I’m lost among the flowers.” She sat down on a lavender bush, with her arms crossed over her chest.

Then she had an idea. She used her arms to make a little gesture, as if she wanted to invite a ray of sunshine to look at her. Stella concentrated, trying to point to her place among the other toys.

The sun, smiling, shone a bright ray. The ray followed Stella and guided her through the fragrant flowers. After a few minutes, Stella saw the lawn! She was happy and ran to her friends. Leo the teddy bear greeted her with a big hug. Nina the wooden princess smiled at her.

Stella settled back among the other toys, feeling finally at home. She realized that even when you get lost, with a little patience and a small gesture, you can always find the right way.

plan.problema: Stella got lost among the flowers and couldn't find her place in the meadow.
plan.svolta: She decided to use her arms to wave at a ray of sunshine, hoping it would guide her home.
plan.finale: The sun, smiling, lit up the path and Stella happily returned to her place among the other toys.
plan.morale: Patience helps to find the solution.

doll.text:
Berta was a stuffed doll. She had a dress with flowers and big blue eyes. She lived in a secret garden, a magical place hidden behind the old oak tree. It was her world, full of colors and smells. But one morning, Berta had gotten lost. She didn’t understand how she had gotten there, completely alone.

Berta was looking for Sofia, the little girl she loved so much. Sofia had made her a new pink dress and promised to read her a story. Berta felt sad and scared. She just wanted to find her girl.

Then Berta decided to ask for help. “Flowers, flowers,” she called with a sweet voice, “did you see Sofia?” The red tulip answered with a whisper: "No, I didn't see her." The white rose nodded: "Neither did I, little Berta.” The sunflowers, tall and smiling, shook their heads: "Nothing!".

Berta was desperate. Then, she heard a delicious smell. A sweet smell of freshly baked cookies! She followed the smell, stretching out her stuffed arms, and arrived under a big apple tree. There was Sofia, waiting for Berta with a smile.

“Berta!” exclaimed Sofia, running to hug the doll. “I looked for you everywhere!”. Berta felt happy. She had found Sofia thanks to her favorite smell. Berta’s patience had helped her to find her friend.

plan.problema: Berta got lost in her secret garden and couldn't find her favorite little girl, Sofia.
plan.svolta: She decided to call all the flowers in the garden, asking if they had seen Sofia, but nobody had seen her.
plan.finale: Berta, following the smell of her sweet cookies, finally found Sofia who was waiting for her under a big tree.

fairy.text:
Fairy Lila loved the Secret Garden. It was a magical place full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. Lila could dance among the lilies, whisper secrets to the violets, and play with the water lilies. But one morning, Lila noticed a terrible problem: her sparkling wings were gone!

Lila couldn’t fly anymore. Her wings were made of stardust and rainbow crystals, and without them, she was just a little toy on the ground. She was very sad. “I must find them!” thought Lila.

So, Fairy Lila flew (or rather, ran) towards the meadow where the butterflies lived. She asked for help from the most beautiful butterflies: “Have you seen my sparkling wings? I lost them!” But no butterfly knew where the lost wings had gone. The butterflies only said that they had seen a strong wind the night before.

Lila continued to search, examining every corner of the garden. Then, she noticed a very fragrant rose bush. She approached carefully and… surprise! Her sparkling wings were lying right among the soft petals of the roses!

With patience, Lila picked up her wings and attached them to her body again. Immediately, she felt a feeling of lightness and could fly again. She was happy! Fairy Lila smiled, satisfied with her little victory. Perseverance, even for a toy, can lead to wonderful results.

plan.problema: Lila has lost her sparkling wings and can’t fly anymore!
plan.svolta: She tried to ask for help from the butterflies, but none of them knew where the lost wings were.
plan.finale: Then, Lila discovered they had fallen into a rose bush and she recovered them patiently.

fairy.text:
Fairy Stella was a very special fairy. She lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. She was a fairy made of shimmering silk and peacock feathers. Sometimes she flew lightly among the petals, sometimes she sat on a giant sunflower.

One day, Fairy Stella was playing hide-and-seek with the daisies. She had so much fun that she didn’t notice the time. When she tried to return to her soft and bright cloud, she realized she was lost. The flowers were so many and all so alike! She couldn’t find her way back home anymore.

Fairy Stella was a little sad. She sat down on a red rose and began to cry tears of sparkling dust. She really wanted to go back to her cloud. Then she had an idea: to call for help!

She approached a little green caterpillar eating a leaf. “Little caterpillar,” said Fairy Stella, “can you help me? I’ve lost the way to my cloud.” Then she turned to a busy bee. "And you, busy bee, can you help me?" She offered them every drop of sparkling dust she had. The insects were very happy and promised to help her.

A friendly ladybug, with bright black spots, approached Fairy Stella. "I will guide you," said the ladybug with a sweet voice. They flew together through the flowers, until the soft and bright cloud where Fairy Stella finally found her place. She was so happy! 

Fairy Stella understood that asking for help from others is the right thing to do when you are in trouble. And this time, she had found a new friend.

plan.problema: Stella got lost among the flowers and can’t find her place in the cloud anymore.
plan.svolta: She decided to call all the little insects in the garden to ask for help, offering them a drop of glittering dust.
plan.finale: A friendly ladybug gently guided her to her soft and bright cloud.

fairy.text:
Fairy Stellina lived in the Secret Garden. She was a tiny and delicate fairy, made of shimmering fabric and covered in lots of colorful glitter. She loved to fly among the flowers and play with the butterflies. One day, while she was having fun dancing near a rose bush, Stellina got lost!

She found herself in a maze of red and pink roses, tall and fragrant. She couldn’t find her flower house anymore, where she lived. She was very scared. “Oh no!” said Stellina, with a trembling voice. “I don’t know how to get home!”

Stellina tried to follow the sweet scent of the flowers, but it was too confusing and mixed with that of the other roses. She tried to ask for help from a ladybug, but the ladybug was too busy eating a leaf to talk. Stellina was desperate.

Then, suddenly, Stellina had an idea! She looked at her wings and noticed that her glitter was very bright. With great care, she started to sprinkle her glitter everywhere. A shimmering glow lit up the rose maze!

Thanks to her glow, Stellina finally managed to see the path and find her flower house. She quickly entered and immediately organized a party for all her friends: the butterflies, the squirrels, and the other toys of the Secret Garden. Everyone danced and had a lot of fun.

With a shimmering glow, Stellina returned to her flower house and organized a party for all her friends. The perseverance of Fairy Stellina helped her to find the right way.

plan.problema: Stellina got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find her way home.
plan.svolta: After trying to follow the scent of honey, Stellina realized she had to use her glitter to light the way!
plan.finale: With a sparkling glow, Stellina returned to her flower house and organized a party for all her friends.

fairy.text:
Fairy Lucente lived in the Secret Garden. She was a beautiful fairy, made of fabric and glitter. Her wings were covered in shimmering feathers that sparkled in the sun. Fairy Lucente loved to fly among the flowers, dance with the wind, and play with the butterflies.

One day, Fairy Lucente noticed that something wasn’t right. She looked at her wings and saw that the feathers were missing! There were no more of her bright colors, nor the sparkle. “Oh no!” she exclaimed. “I can’t fly anymore!” She was very sad.

Fairy Lucente decided to go on a big search. She called for help from the bees of the garden. The bees were small and busy, but very good at finding lost things. Then she called the ladybugs, who knew every corner of the Secret Garden. "Please help me!" Fairy Lucente repeated.

The bees and the ladybugs began to look everywhere. They looked under the trees, among the blackberry bushes, and near the pond. Finally, a ladybug found something: shimmering feathers hidden under a rose bush!

Fairy Lucente collected her feathers and attached them back to her wings. The wings returned to shining as before. Fairy Lucente took flight, happy and grateful. She flew up and down, thanking the bees and the ladybugs for their help.

Fairy Lucente realized that together they could do great things. And so, the fairy continued to fly in the Secret Garden, always ready to help her new friends.

plan.problema: Fairy Lucente has lost her shimmering feathers and can’t fly anymore.
plan.svolta: She decided to organize a big search, asking for help from the bees and ladybugs of the garden.
plan.finale: Thanks to their help, Fairy Lucente found her hidden feathers under a rose bush and started flying happily.

fairy.text:
Fairy Stella lived in the Secret Garden. She was a fairy made of silk and glitter, always ready to play. But today she wasn’t happy. The fireflies in the garden had disappeared! There were no bright lights among the flowers. Fairy Stella felt very sad.

“Oh no, oh no!” she said. “Where have my fireflies gone?” She looked everywhere: under the roses, behind the big apple tree, even inside the vase with the bluebells. But she couldn’t see a single firefly.

Fairy Stella tried to call them with her sweetest voice. “Lights, lights, come here!” but the fireflies didn’t answer. They didn’t come to light up the garden. It was all dark.

A little snail, Leo, came up to Fairy Stella. “Maybe they are tired,” said Leo with his slow voice. “They flew so much last night.”

Fairy Stella had an idea! She used her little bucket to collect drops of sparkling dew from the lilac flower. Then, carefully, she poured the dew onto a small stone in the center of the garden. She made a little relaxing bath.

The fireflies, attracted by the light and the cool water, began to return one at a time. One, two, three… soon the Secret Garden was full of bright lights. Fairy Stella smiled. The fireflies were happy! 

Fairy Stella felt full of joy again. The garden was lit up and everything was shining again. Kindness brings back smiles.

plan.problema: Fairy Stella has lost all her fireflies and doesn’t know how to light up the garden.
plan.svolta: She tried to call them with her sweetest voice, but the fireflies didn’t come.
plan.finale: Then she discovered that the fireflies were too tired and she prepared a little sparkling dew bath for them.

fairy.text:
Fairy lived in a secret garden full of fragrant roses and tall trees. She was a cloth fairy, soft and colorful, but she could also talk and move! She loved to dance among the flowers, but for a few days now she couldn't fly anymore. Her sparkling wings had disappeared!

Fairy was very sad. Without her wings, she couldn't flutter in the air like before. She looked everywhere, under the lily stems and among the fern leaves, but nothing. “Oh no!” said Fairy, “Where did my wings go?”

Then she decided to ask for help from the butterflies that lived in the secret garden. The butterflies flew from one place to another, but none of them knew where her sparkling wings were. "I haven't seen them," said the butterflies. "Maybe they fell in a corner?"

Fairy was more and more desperate. Suddenly, she heard little footsteps. A little squirrel, called Noce, approached Fairy. Noce saw that Fairy was very sad. Carefully, he started to rummage through the petals of a big blue flower. And there, hidden under the flower, he found Fairy’s sparkling wings!

Noce happily returned Fairy’s wings to her friend. Fairy could fly again immediately and thanked Noce for his help. From that day on, Fairy and Noce became good friends. Their friendship helped everyone to smile.

plan.problema: Fairy has lost her sparkling wings and can’t fly anymore.
plan.svolta: She decided to ask for help from the butterflies, but none of them knew where her wings were.
plan.finale: A little squirrel, seeing Fairy’s sadness, found the hidden wings under a flower and returned them to his friend.

fairy.text:
Fairy was a sparkly fabric fairy. She lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of fragrant flowers and green plants. Fairy loved to dance among the roses, but sometimes she got lost.

---

One day, Fairy found herself in the middle of a rose maze. The roses were so many, so fragrant! She couldn’t find the water path that led to the fountain. She was a little scared. She wanted to go home.

---

Fairy tried to follow the colorful butterflies. The butterflies flew away, without stopping to look at Fairy. “Oh no!” said Fairy. “How do I find the path?”

---

Then, Fairy did something special. She started to tinkle her little bells. *Ting! Ting!* The sound was sweet and clear. She hoped someone had heard her.

---

A little squirrel, Leo, was collecting nuts near the maze. He heard the tinkle of Fairy’s bells. He approached cautiously. “What are you doing, little fairy?” asked Leo.

---

Fairy explained her situation: she was lost and couldn’t find the water path. Leo listened carefully. Then, he pointed with his tail towards a sparkling stream. “Follow this stream,” said Leo. “It will take you to the fountain!”

---

Fairy thanked Leo with a big smile and followed the stream. Soon, she arrived at the fountain! She was happy. 

---

The kindness of Fairy, expressed through her tinkling, had found its way.

plan.problema: The Fairy is lost in the maze of roses and cannot find the water path.
plan.svolta: After trying to follow the butterflies, which flew away, she decided to call for help with a sweet tinkling of her bells.
plan.finale: A small squirrel, listening to her melody, led her to the sparkling stream.

fairy.text:
Fairy Luna lived in the Secret Garden. She was a special fairy, made of crystal and stardust. She loved to dance among the flowers and play with the butterflies. But one day, Fairy Luna noticed that something wasn't right. Her light, usually bright and colorful, was dimmed. The Secret Garden was becoming darker and darker.

Fairy Luna tried to sing, to twirl, even to hop. Nothing! Her light didn't light up at all. She was very sad. A little squirrel, Niffo, watched her with concern. “What’s happening, Fairy Luna?” he asked.

Fairy Luna thought, thought, and thought. Then she had an idea! The golden leaves of the trees had fallen everywhere. They were like little pieces of sunshine. Fairy Luna began to collect all the golden leaves. Carefully, she piled them up in a small stack under the sunbeam. She created a natural filter to catch the shining rays.

Slowly, patiently, Fairy Luna worked. The leaves shone in the sun and the light began to return. First a little glimmer, then a color, finally a thousand colors! Fairy Luna’s light returned to shine, illuminating the entire Secret Garden. The flowers turned pink, the grass became emerald green, and the butterflies shimmered like gems. 

Fairy Luna danced happily, her light was more beautiful than ever. She had learned that even when it seems like everything is lost, with perseverance you can always find a solution. And so, in the Secret Garden, Fairy Luna’s light continued to shine forever.

plan.problema: Fairy Luna can’t make her light shine, and the garden is becoming dark.
plan.svolta: She decided to collect all the fallen golden leaves from the trees to create a natural sun filter.
plan.finale: Fairy Luna’s light returned to shine, illuminating the whole garden with a thousand colors.

fairy.text:
Fairy Stellina lived in the Secret Garden. She was a pink silk fairy, with sparkling wings and a dotted dress. She loved to play among the fragrant roses and colorful flowers. One day, while flying around the big apple tree, she noticed she was lost. She didn’t know how to get back to her little wooden house under the wisteria.

Fairy Stellina looked everywhere. She looked behind the bluebells, under the big leaves of the lily, and among the lavender bushes. But she couldn’t find her magic mirror. The mirror was special: thanks to its reflection, Fairy Stellina could go back to the exact moment she got lost.

“Oh no!” said Fairy Stellina, with a little sigh. “I must find it!” She decided to do something. She sang a sweet and gentle song, a song that her fairy grandmother had taught her. “Sing, Stellina, sing!” she thought. But nobody seemed to hear her. Only the wind whispered through the leaves.

Suddenly, a little toy crocodile, named Rocco, came up to Fairy Stellina. Rocco was a blue crocodile with big smiling eyes. He took Fairy Stellina’s hand and gently led her through the garden. They flew among the flowers and plants until they saw something that was shining: the magic mirror! It sparkled in the sunlight.

Fairy Stellina ran to the mirror and looked inside. In an instant, she found her little house under the wisteria again. Thanks to her kindness, Rocco had helped her find her way. Fairy Stellina thanked Rocco for saving her, and she realized that even a small friendly hand can do great things.

plan.problema: Stellina got lost in the garden and couldn't find her magic mirror.
plan.svolta: She decided to sing a sweet song to call for help, but nobody seemed to hear her.
plan.finale: A little toy crocodile took her hand and gently led her to the sparkling mirror.

fairy.text:
Fairy Stella lived in the Secret Garden. She was a crystal fairy, full of colors and glitter. She loved to dance among the daisies and play with the wind. But one day, something had changed. Stella felt strange, empty. Her sparkle, her special light, was gone!

She had gotten lost among the red roses and the lilac bushes. The leaves all looked the same. Fairy Stella couldn’t find her way to shine anymore. She was sad and a little scared. “Oh no!” she thought, “Where have I ended up?”.

She decided she had to ask for help. She called all her insect friends in the garden: the cockroach Arturo and the ladybug Camilla. “Arturo, Camilla,” Stella said, “will you help me find my sparkle?”. She offered them a drop of sweet honey. “It’s a special honey,” she explained, “that helps you remember!”.

Arturo and Camilla started to work right away. Arturo found sparkles left among the dry leaves and Camilla, with her shiny eyes, spotted hidden reflections of light among the petals. Together, they found small pieces of crystal that Stella used to recreate her sparkle.

Finally, Fairy Stella’s light began to shine brighter than ever! Stella danced happily in the Secret Garden, surrounded by her insect friends. It was a dance full of joy and of colors. Fairy Stella realized that even a little help can make a difference. And so, working together, everyone could return to playing happily.

plan.problema: Stella got lost among the roses and couldn't find her sparkle.
plan.svolta: She decided to call all her insect friends for help, offering them a drop of sweet honey.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of the beetles and ladybugs, Stella found her bright light and returned to dance in the garden.

gatto con gli stivali.text:
Gatto Stivali was in his secret garden. He was a special cat, because he wore brown and red boots. The boots made him a real adventurer! The garden was full of fragrant roses and tall trees. But Gatto Stivali had a little problem.

---

He had lost his favorite hat, a star-shaped hat. He had been looking for it for hours, but he couldn't find it among the roses. “Oh no!” meowed Gatto Stivali, upset. “Where has it gone?”

---

generic lego figure.text:
Brick was a little Lego soldier. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and lush plants. Brick loved to play there, but this time he had gotten lost. There were so many other Lego figures: princesses, pirates, animals... so many that Brick couldn’t find his friend, the red truck.

The red truck was his best friend. Together they had so many adventures in the Secret Garden. Brick was very worried. He didn’t know where the truck was and how to reach it. He felt lonely and a little scared.

Brick had an idea! He decided to build a little bridge to reach the red truck. He started to collect Lego bricks, one after another. But when he tried to make the bridge fall, it immediately collapsed! Brick was disappointed. The bricks were too fragile.

Brick didn’t give up. He collected even more bricks and started to rebuild the bridge. This time, he made bigger bricks and lined them up carefully. The new bridge was much stronger. Brick crossed it slowly, step by step. Finally, he arrived at the red truck!

“Brick! I’m so happy to see you!” exclaimed the red truck. Brick smiled happily. He was back with his friend and together they continued to play in the Secret Garden. Brick learned that even when things seem difficult, with patience and effort, you can always find a solution.

plan.problema: Brick had gotten lost among so many other figures and didn’t know how to rejoin his friend, the red truck.
plan.svolta: He decided to build a small bridge with the building blocks to try to reach the truck, but the bridge collapsed immediately!
plan.finale: Brick, with patience, rebuilt the bridge more solidly and finally reached the red truck, happy to be together again.

ghost.text:
Spirito was a very small and blue ghost. He lived in the playroom. He loved to play with his friends – toy cars, building blocks, and stuffed animals. But Spirito especially liked to play little tricks. Sometimes he would make the toy cars fly, or he would move the building blocks.

One day, Spirito got very excited. He decided to play a game: to go into the maze of shelves and toys. It was full of books, boxes, and dolls. Spirito had a lot of fun moving around the objects, but then… he got lost! He couldn’t find his way out anymore. Everything looked the same, gray and confusing.

Spirito tried to shout for help, but nobody heard him. Nobody could see him. He was just a little ghost in a big maze. He felt sad and a little scared. He tried to move, but he kept getting stuck. 

Then, Spirito had an idea. He used his special power: he could disappear! He did, becoming invisible. Then, he went up to a teddy bear that was sitting on a shelf. Spirito scared the teddy bear so much that it fell to the ground. The teddy bear was right in front of the way out of the maze.

Spirito smiled. He had solved his problem! Now he knew how to find his way when he got lost. He slowly walked away from the maze, happy to be back in the playroom. 

Spirito realized that sometimes, even when you are in trouble, you need to stay calm and look for a solution with patience.

plan.problema: Spirit is lost in the maze of shelves and toys!
plan.svolta: He tried to shout for help, but no one could hear him.
plan.finale: Spirit used his power to disappear to scare a teddy bear pointing the way out.

ghost.text:
Spirito was a toy ghost. He lived in Leo’s bedroom. He was a little blue ghost, made of soft fabric. He loved his favorite spot very much, under the lamp with the star. There he would relax, watching the clouds drawn on the ceiling.

One day, Spirito found himself lost. He wasn’t anymore under the lamp. He looked, he looked, but he couldn’t find it. “Where am I?” he whispered. He was very worried. The bedroom seemed big and a little scary without his special corner.

Spirito tried to shout loudly. “Help! I’m lost!” But nobody heard him. Nobody was in the room. So, Spirito decided to do something different. He started to float very slowly. He moved slowly, slowly, like a light cloud. He wanted to explore the room without rushing.

He looked at the rug with the dinosaurs, the rocking chair, and the cradle that Leo used when he was little. He floated near the window, watching the rain. Then, suddenly, he felt a familiar feeling. It was warm! And there was the star light.

Spirito found himself right under the lamp with the star, exactly where he had been forgotten. He curled up happily, glad to be home. His slow and patient floating had brought him back to his favorite place. Spirito smiled. He was always so happy there.

plan.problema: The Spirit had gotten lost in his favorite corner, and couldn’t find him anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to shout loudly, but no one could hear him, so he decided to float more slowly to explore the room.
plan.finale: Thanks to his slow and patient movement, the Spirit ended up exactly where he had been forgotten, happy as always.

ghost.text:
Spirit lived in the dusty cellar. He was a toy ghost, soft and blue. He loved to make sparkles, but lately he couldn't shine anymore. His light was out, just a little whisper of color. Spirit felt sad.

The cellar was full of old forgotten things. There was an old rocking chair, a rusty trunk, and lots of dusty boxes. Spirit tried to make his sparkle, but nothing. He moved slowly around the room, trying to understand what had happened.

Suddenly, Spirit noticed something. On the floor dust there were little shiny balls. They were his light balls! He had lost them all and hadn't realized it.

Spirit began to pick up the balls one by one. He picked them up carefully, holding them in his hands. Each ball was a little ray of hope. He collected the balls and then tried to make his sparkle again.

Slowly, as he collected the last balls, Spirit’s light began to grow. It became brighter and brighter, stronger and stronger! Finally, Spirit shone so much that he lit up the whole dusty cellar. He was the brightest ghost of all! Spirit felt happy and full of energy. Perseverance had done good for him.

plan.problema: Spirit can’t manage to make his glow shine!
plan.svolta: He notices that he’s lost his light balls and begins to collect them one by one.
plan.finale: Finally, with all the balls gathered, Spirit shines brighter than ever!

ghost.text:
Spirito was a little blue ghost. He lived in Grandma and Grandpa’s room. He loved that room because it was full of old and fragrant things. His favorite place was next to the big wardrobe. There, he could watch Grandma and Grandpa while they read their magazines.

One day, Spirito got lost. He wandered inside the wardrobe and now he couldn’t find his corner anymore. He looked everywhere, but everything seemed the same. “Oh no!” thought Spirito. “I don’t know where I am!”

Spirito tried to push the clothes that were piled up on the wardrobe. He pushed hard, but only the clothes stuck to the wood! He couldn’t move. He was frustrated. He turned around and saw Grandma sitting in the armchair reading. “Grandma,” he called, “I’m lost!”

Grandma smiled kindly. “Spirito, maybe if you try to take a little jump…” she suggested. Spirito closed his eyes and jumped. He jumped again! And again! Then… surprise! He was right next to his soft cushion. The cushion was exactly where he was waiting for it.

Spirito snuggled up on the cushion, happy. He had solved the problem. He realized that sometimes you have to be a little patient when you’re looking for something you want. It was important not to get in a hurry and to look for things calmly.

plan.problema: Spirit has gotten lost in the big closet and can’t find his favorite spot.
plan.svolta: He tried to push the clothes, but they just stuck!
plan.finale: Spirit had an idea to take a little jump and found his soft pillow right where he was waiting.
plan.morale: Patience is the key to solving every problem.

ghost.text:
Spirito was a ghost, a very special ghost. He lived in a dusty attic, full of old chests and forgotten furniture. He was made of white cloth and had a red hat with autumn leaves stuck to it. But today, Spirito had a problem. The leaves wouldn't want to fall! He held them tight in his hat, but when he tried to make them slide off, they grabbed on again. “Oh no!” thought Spirito, and he wiggled a little.

Spirito tried to blow really hard, but the leaves stayed there. He tried to jump, but it didn't help at all. He was very frustrated. The dust in the attic seemed to be stopping him from working. An old grandfather clock was leaning against a table nearby. Its pendulum moved slowly, back and forth. Spirito watched it carefully. 

“Maybe,” thought Spirito, “if I push the clock, the movement will help me make the leaves fall!” So, with all his ghostly energy, he pushed the clock’s pendulum. The pendulum began to swing faster and faster. The leaves in Spirito’s hat began to move. They fell one at a time, with a gentle rustle.

Spirito smiled. He was so happy! He had solved his problem. The clock and the leaves worked together perfectly. Spirito relaxed and let himself be rocked by the rhythm of the pendulum. It was a very nice feeling. 

Time passed quietly in the dusty attic, and Spirito understood that sometimes, even the hardest jobs just need a little patience to be finished.

plan.problema: Spirit can’t anymore make the autumn leaves fall from his hat.
plan.svolta: He decided to try pushing the old grandfather clock, hoping the movement would help him move the leaves.
plan.finale: The pendulum began to swing and the leaves fell with a gentle rustle, making Spirit smile.

ghost.text:
Spirito was a toy ghost. He lived in the Quiet Library. He was a blue ghost, soft and a little bit wobbly. He loved the library because there were so many stories there – lots and lots and lots! But lately, Spirito had a problem. He couldn’t make the pages of the books move anymore. The pages stayed still, like statues made of paper.

The Quiet Library had become too quiet. There used to be the sound of pages turning, the whispers of lovers sitting in the armchairs, and the ticking of the clock. Now… nothing. Just silence. Spirito tried to push the pages with his little wings, but nothing happened. He felt a little bit sad.

Then, he had an idea. He decided to try to whisper stories to the books. “I’m going to tell you about the starry sky,” he whispered to an astronomy book. “And a little rabbit hiding carrots.” He whispered about fluffy clouds and green meadows. He whispered about his dreams, and his little fears.

Suddenly, the books began to vibrate gently. The pages moved slowly. First one book, then another. The Quiet Library filled with the sound of pages turning again. Spirito smiled. He was happy! A little librarian, Marco, noticed the strange activity and smiled at Spirito.

Spirito realized that even just a small, kind gesture could do great things. And so, the stories continued to flow in the Quiet Library, thanks to the blue ghost and his whispers. The library was full of life again, just like he loved it.

plan.problema: The spirit can no longer turn the pages of the books, and the library has become too quiet.
plan.svolta: He decided to try whispering stories to the books, telling them his most beautiful thoughts.
plan.finale: The books began to vibrate gently and turn slowly, filling the library once again with the sound of pages turning.

ghost.text:
Spirito was a very curious ghost. He lived in the Quiet Library and loved to watch the books. Every book had a special place, right behind Mr. Rossi’s bookcase. But today Spirito had gotten lost! He couldn’t find his corner anymore.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Spirito, trying to move between the tall, narrow shelves. “I don’t know where I am! I can’t find my place.” Spirito floated slowly, but he kept getting lost. He tried to go fast, hoping to find Mr. Rossi’s bookcase, but only he got even more confused.

“Maybe if I move faster…” thought Spirito. So he started to float faster and faster. But suddenly he was everywhere! He saw books and books, shelves and shelves. He was so confused that he couldn’t understand where he really was.

The old lady Emilia, the librarian, noticed the little lost ghost. “Spirito,” she said with a kind smile, “sometimes, when we are scared or confused, we have to slow down.” Spirito listened carefully. Mrs. Emilia explained that he could focus on the smell of the books: old paper and ink.

Spirito closed his eyes and took a deep breath. He breathed in the smell of old wood and fantastic stories. Slowly, Spirito began to float calmly. Soon he found himself right behind Mr. Rossi’s bookcase, in his special place. He was happy to be back home. Calmness had helped Spirito find his way.

plan.problema: Spirit got lost among the shelves and can’t find his special place anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his powers to float faster, but that only confused him even more!
plan.finale: Thanks to the advice of the old librarian, Spirit learned to calm down and focus on the smell of the books.
plan.morale: Calm helps to find the solution.

ghost.text:
Specter lived in the Quiet Library. He was a toy ghost, made of white cloth and with big green eyes. Specter loved the library more than anything. His job was to scare the books! He whispered, buzzed, and moved quickly to make them jump.

But one morning, something wasn’t right. Specter tried to buzz with his voice, but no sound came out. He tried to move, but he was heavy like a sack of lead. He couldn’t scare the books anymore! He was very sad. The librarian, Mr. Rossi, looked at him with concern. “Maybe he just needs rest,” he said.

Specter decided to try to take a quick spin between the shelves. He pushed himself between the piles of books, climbed onto a chair, and then slid down. He tried to move with energy, hoping that the movement would lift him up. But nothing!

Suddenly, a light laugh filled the library. It was a sweet and playful laugh. Specter felt lighter and started to whisper. Then, he began to dance between the books, moving quickly and scaring a little bit of the pages. His voice buzzed again!

Mr. Rossi smiled. “Good job, Specter,” he said. “You found the way to go back to doing what you love.”

Specter continued to dance, happy to be back at his job. After a while, he stopped and looked at the books with his big green eyes. He was happy to be able to scare the books again in the Quiet Library.

plan.problema: Specter can’t make his voice buzz anymore and can’t scare the books!
plan.svolta: He decided to try to take a quick trip between the shelves, hoping the movement would help him.
plan.finale: Suddenly, a light laugh filled the library and Specter returned to whisper and dance among the books.

ghost.text:
Spirito was a very silly ghost. He lived in the quietest room of the house, Leo’s bedroom. He was made of white cloth and had two big black eyes. Spirito liked to play hide-and-seek among the furniture, but that evening he couldn’t find his shape.

He had disappeared into the dark under the bed! Spirito felt small and confused. He couldn’t see if he was still a speedy ghost or just a cloud of cloth. He tried to move, but nothing, he couldn’t get back to normal.

Spirito decided to do a big wiggle, hoping to find his shape again. He moved quickly, but he found himself even more confused! He floated out of control in the dark room. He was scared and wanted to be a speedy ghost again right away.

Suddenly he heard a little giggle coming from the lamp next to the window. Spirito focused, and with his little smile, he finally found the courage. He started to sing a sweet melody. The music was so beautiful that the room lit up!

Right away Spirito became speedy and clear, ready to play again. Leo, waking up from the sound of the song, smiled seeing his friend ghost return to his normal shape. Spirito understood that even when you are scared, a little bit of courage can do miracles.

plan.problema: Spirit got lost in the dark of the room and couldn't find his shape again.
plan.svolta: He decided to do a big wiggle and try to float faster, but he got even more confused.
plan.finale: Thanks to his little smile, Spirit finally found the courage to call for help with a sweet melody and returned quickly and clearly.

ghost.text:
Spirito was a very small, blue ghost. He lived in Luca’s bedroom. His favorite place was the library, full of colorful books. Every night, after Luca went to sleep, Spirito would sit among the books, ready to dream of adventures.

But that night something didn't go as usual. While he was looking at the stars drawn on the ceiling, a gust of wind lifted him up and rolled him towards the darkness under the bed. Spirito found himself lost in the dark! He couldn’t find his place on the bookshelf. He was scared.

“Help!” shouted Spirito, but his voice was too quiet to be heard. Nobody answered. He felt more and more alone and confused. “I can’t find my home!” he thought.

Spirito calmed down a little. He decided to try something different. He focused all his energy and tried to shine. At first, his light was very faint, almost invisible. But Spirito didn’t lose hope. He kept shining brighter and brighter.

And then, it happened! His faint light illuminated the library. The books seemed to shine together with him. With a little jump, Spirito returned to his place among the books, happy to be finally home. 

The bright moon shone through the window, watching Spirito as he rested. Spirito’s perseverance had made all the difference.

plan.problema: The spirit was lost in the dark of the room and couldn't find its place on the bookshelf.
plan.svolta: He tried to shout, but no one could hear him, so he decided to try to shine his own light.
plan.finale: Its faint light illuminated the bookshelf, allowing it finally to return to its place among the books.

gormiti.text:
Gormiti lived in a secret garden. He was a very silly rubber gnome and he loved to laugh. Every time someone laughed at him, he would become contagious too. But today Gormiti couldn’t laugh! He had lost his favorite rubber tummy, the red one with white stripes that he liked so much.

Gormiti was very sad. Without his tummy, he didn’t know why to laugh. He tried to jump up and down, but nothing. He tried to clap his hands really, really loudly, but nothing. He was a rubber gnome without laughter! A little green crocodile, Leo, came up to Gormiti. “What’s wrong, Gormiti?” asked Leo.

“I’ve lost my tummy!” said Gormiti with a worried tone. “And I don’t know how to laugh anymore!” Gormiti looked everywhere under the roses and near the pond. But his rubber tummy was gone. 

Suddenly, Gormiti had an idea! He started to roll down the lawn, fast, fast, as if he wanted to chase something. He rolled through the yellow flowers and the green leaves. And then, suddenly, he felt something soft underneath him. Gormiti stopped and pulled out his rubber tummy! It was there, right under a bush full of fragrant thyme.

Gormiti started to laugh with delight. A big, loud laugh that filled the whole secret garden. The laugh seemed so beautiful and happy to him. Gormiti realized that sometimes joy is found in small things, like a red and striped rubber tummy.

plan.problema: Gormiti has lost his favorite bouncy tummy and doesn’t know how to laugh!
plan.svolta: He tried to jump, to clap his hands, but nothing, he still couldn’t laugh.
plan.finale: Suddenly, Gormiti started to roll down the lawn and, with a loud laugh, he found his bouncy tummy under a bush!
plan.morale: Joy is found in small things.

gormiti.text:
Gormiti lived in a secret garden. He was a special gormiti, very nice and always ready to smile. Gormiti loved to make his faces, those that made his eyes shine. But today he couldn't do it anymore!

“Oh no!” said Gormiti. “I’ve lost my favorite rubber tummy!” His tummy was soft and yellow, full of colorful glitter. Without it, Gormiti couldn't make faces. He was very sad.

Gormiti decided to look for his tummy. He started to sniff every flower in the secret garden. He sniffed the fragrant jasmine, the red rose, and the tall sunflower. Then he listened to the chirping of the little birds. “Chiu-chiu! Chiu-chiu!” sang the birds. Maybe one of them knew where Gormiti’s tummy was.

Gormiti continued to look, walking among the plants and under the trees. The sun shone brightly in the sky. At one point, he heard a movement among the rose bushes. Gormiti approached carefully and… he saw it! His rubber tummy was there, hidden under the roses. It was full of colorful glitter as always.

Gormiti quickly picked up his tummy and made a big face. Then, he smiled happily. He realized that searching patiently had led to the solution of his problem. Gormiti went back to making his faces, happy and joyful in his secret garden. Patience can help you find even the most lost things.

plan.problema: Gorby has lost his favorite bouncy tummy and can’t do his funny faces anymore!
plan.svolta: He decided to look for clues, sniffing every flower and listening to the birds’ chirps.
plan.finale: Finally, he found the tummy under a rose bush, full of colorful glitter!

gormiti.text:
Gormiti lived in a secret garden. He was a plastic toy, green with big blue eyes and a smile always ready. But today, his smile had disappeared! It seemed faded, sad, and gray. Gormiti didn’t understand why.

The secret garden was full of wonderful flowers. There were red roses, yellow tulips, purple violets, and golden sunflowers. A little squirrel, Pipì, watched him curiously. “What’s happening, Gormiti?” Pipì asked, jumping on a bush.

Gormiti felt down. He tried to smile, but he couldn’t do it. He thought that maybe, if he did something nice, his smile would come back. Then he had an idea! He decided to collect all the colorful flowers in the garden.

With patience, Gormiti picked the most beautiful flowers and lined them up next to each other. He created a bright rainbow around himself, with all those bright colors. The colors shone in the sun. Pipì watched him in amazement.

When the last flower was placed, the rainbow shone with a thousand colors. And just at that moment, Gormiti’s smile returned brighter than ever! It was a big, happy smile. Gormiti felt so good, surrounded by so much beauty and color. 

Gormiti realized that doing good things for others helps you feel better. A kind gesture can bring so much joy.

plan.problema: His smile had disappeared and he didn't know how to smile again.
plan.svolta: He decided to collect all the colorful flowers in the garden to create a rainbow around himself.
plan.finale: When the rainbow shone, his smile returned brighter than ever!

gormiti.text:
Gormiti was a wooden gnome who was very happy. He lived in the Flower Garden, among the tulips and daisies. He loved to explore every corner of the garden, but one morning something wasn't right. Gormiti had found himself in a total confusion! He had ended up inside the maze of red roses. The roses were tall and fragrant, but also very tricky.

Gormiti tried to turn around, to take a step forward, then another. But every time he ended up in the same place. “Oh no!” said Gormiti, with a slightly sad voice. He didn't know how to get out of that complicated place. The roses were driving him crazy!

Gormiti decided to do something. He started to sing a cheerful melody, the one he liked so much. “Sing, Gormiti, sing!” he thought. His voice echoed among the roses. Suddenly, a little bee, with golden wings, landed on him.

The bee was very kind and followed Gormiti as he moved. It flew back and forth, pointing out the right way. After a while, Gormiti saw a bright light: the sun! The bee led him out of the maze, towards the warm sun.

Gormiti felt very happy. He had escaped from the maze of roses! He sat down on the most beautiful daisy in the garden and watched the bee fly away. Gormiti realized that even when things seem difficult, you shouldn't give up and keep looking for a solution. In the end, everything always gets solved.

plan.problema: Gorffi got lost in the rose maze!
plan.svolta: He decided to call for help and started to sing a cheerful melody to attract attention.
plan.finale: Suddenly, a little bee led him out of the maze towards the sun.

gormiti.text:
Gormiti lived in a secret garden. He was a plastic toy, colorful and full of silly shapes and sparkling eyes. Gormiti loved to play among the roses and wildflowers. But one day, something had changed. Gormiti couldn’t smile anymore. His sparkle, that special light that made him happy, had gone out.

Gormiti tried to make funny faces. He tried to move his arms and legs. But nothing! He couldn’t even make a little smile. He was sad and a little worried. The secret garden seemed much grayer without his smile.

A little rabbit, Leo, came up to Gormiti. “What’s wrong?” Leo asked. “Why don’t you smile?”

Gormiti tried to jump. He jumped up and down, but his sparkle didn’t light up again. It was really hard to be happy again. Then, he thought, “Maybe I need to do something different!”

Gormiti closed his eyes and began to sing a happy little song that he knew very well. A song with lots of verses and a lively rhythm. As he sang, his body began to vibrate slightly. And suddenly… his sparkle shone again! It became brighter and stronger. Gormiti smiled again, a big, sincere smile.

Gormiti realized that even when you are sad, happiness can come back. And that day, the secret garden was full of colors and laughter again.

plan.problema: Gorby has lost his sparkle and can’t smile anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to jump, but the sparkle didn’t come back on. Then he decided to sing a happy little song.
plan.finale: The song made his body vibrate and suddenly the sparkle was shining again!

gormiti.text:
Gormiti was a very cheerful rag doll gnome. He lived in the Flowery Garden, a place full of red roses, yellow tulips, and white daisies. Gormiti loved to play among the flowers, but sometimes he had too much fun!

One day, while eating his favorite sweets, Gormiti got lost. The many colorful flowers had swallowed him up. He couldn’t see his friend Croco, the gentle crocodile anymore. “Croco! Croko!” Gormiti shouted, but no one answered.

Gormiti was worried. He felt lonely and a little scared. Then he decided to ask for help. He saw some white butterflies fluttering around the flowers. “Butterflies,” said Gormiti, “I’m lost! Could you help me find Croco?”

The butterflies replied, “Follow the scent of your sweets!” and they flew away, leaving a sweet trail behind them. Gormiti followed the strong scent of chocolate and candies. The scent led him through the big flowers and the small flowers.

Finally, he heard a happy sound: “Gormiti! Here I am!” It was Croco, who was having fun playing with a daisy. Gormiti ran to him and offered him another sweet. “Thank you, Croko!” said Gormiti smiling.

Croco and Gormiti remained friends forever in the Flowery Garden. Gormiti’s kindness helped him find his friend.

plan.problema: Gormi got lost among the many colorful flowers and couldn't find his crocodile friend, Croco, anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the butterflies, who guided him following the scent of his favorite sweets.
plan.finale: Gormi finally found Croco, happy, and offered him another sweet to thank him.

gormiti.text:
Gormiti lived in a secret garden. He was a special toy, made of colorful plastic and with lots of sparkling eyes. Gormiti loved to play among the roses and flowers. Usually, his light was very bright, so bright that it made everything around him sparkle.

But one day, Gormiti noticed something strange. His light was no longer bright. He couldn't smile anymore! He had become gray and dull. “Oh no!” thought Gormiti. “I’m not happy anymore.”

Gormiti tried to do many things to find his joy again. He jumped up and down, and spun around the fountain. But nothing, his light remained off. Princess Iris, a blue butterfly, flew close to him. “What’s happening, Gormiti?” she asked in a sweet voice.

Gormiti explained his problem: he couldn't shine anymore. Princess Iris listened carefully and then said, “Try to be in the sun!”

Gormiti positioned himself right under the sunbeam that filtered through the trees. A ray of light struck him directly in the eyes. Immediately, his light returned to shining! Gormiti smiled again, brighter and happier than before. His voice echoed in the secret garden: “How wonderful!”

Gormiti realized that even small things, like a sunbeam, could bring so much joy. And happiness is often found where you least expect it.

plan.problema: Gormiti has lost his sparkle and can’t smile anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to jump and run around a lot, but his light was still out.
plan.finale: A ray of sunshine hit him and Gormiti immediately started to shine with joy!
plan.morale: Happiness is found in small things.

gormiti.text:
Gormiti lived in the Secret Garden. He was a wooden gnome who was very happy and loved to dance in circles. Every time he danced, his bell tinkled sweetly. Gormiti loved his bell so much.

---

One day, Gormiti noticed that something wasn't right. His bell was gone! He couldn't dance in circles anymore. “Oh no!” said Gormiti, with a sigh. He looked everywhere: under the rocks, among the rose bushes, but the bell wasn't there.

---

Gormiti decided to look among the daisies. There were so many, white and fragrant. He crouched down to look closely, but the bell was too small! It was hidden in the meadow. He couldn't see it.

---
