Suddenly, Gormiti noticed a giant flower, a huge sunflower that stood up to the sky. He approached carefully and… there, right next to the sunflower stem, was the bell! The sun shone brightly and it lit it with golden light.

---

Gormiti quickly took the bell in his hands. He made it tinkling: “Ting-ting!” Gormiti smiled happily. Then he started to dance in circles, faster than ever. The bell tinkled with joy and Gormiti was very happy. 

---

The Secret Garden filled with joy. Gormiti continued to dance, satisfied with his found bell.

plan.problema: Gorby lost his favorite bell and can’t do his circle anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to look among the daisies, but the bell was too small to see.
plan.finale: He found the bell under a giant flower, lit by the sun, and started his circle again happily.

gormiti.text:
Gormiti was a very happy wooden gnome.
He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees.
He loved to play among the plants, but sometimes he got lost.

One day, Gormiti found himself completely lost.
He was surrounded by huge, huge, huge roses!
The roses were so tall that Gormiti couldn't see his place under the apple tree anymore.

Gormiti was a little scared.
He didn't know how to go back.
He sat down on a green leaf and thought, “Oh no, I’m really lost!”

Then, Gormiti did something important.
He pressed his bell.
The bell rang loudly: “Ding dong!”

The sound of the bell reached the ears of a little squirrel jumping between the branches.
The squirrel came up to Gormiti and listened carefully.
“Ding dong! Ding dong!” Gormiti repeated.
The squirrel understood right away what Gormiti wanted to say.

The squirrel ran down the tree and pointed to the road for Gormiti.
Gormiti followed the squirrel with joy.
Finally, they arrived under the apple tree.
The squirrel helped Gormiti get back to his place.
Gormiti settled down among the dry leaves and smiled.

He was happy to be back home.
The secret garden seemed even more beautiful now that Gormiti was there again.
Gormiti understood that even when you get lost, asking for help can lead to rescue.

plan.problema: Gormiti got lost among the big roses in the garden!
plan.svolta: He decided to call for help, ringing his bell that says 'ding dong!'
plan.finale: A little squirrel found Gormiti and brought him back to his place under the tree.

gormiti.text:
Gormiti was a very happy wooden gnome. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and big plants. It was his nest, his perfect little world. One day, Gormiti was exploring among the fragrant roses. The roses were so beautiful and tall!

Gormiti had gone too far. Suddenly, he couldn't find his nest anymore. He felt a little sad and confused. He looked around, but all the roses seemed the same. He couldn't understand where it had gone. He was lost!

Gormiti decided to do something. He raised his arms and began to sing a happy song that he liked so much. He sang about flowers, the sun, and friends. “Sing, Gormiti, sing!” he thought. He hoped his voice would guide him home.

While he was singing, a little red bird landed on a nearby rose. The bird looked at Gormiti with its bright little eyes and then flew forward, pointing with its beak along a path between the plants.

Gormiti followed the bird. The path was narrow and full of green leaves. Finally, he saw his nest among the roses! He was happy to be back home. The bird made a little waving sound. Gormiti snuggled into his nest, happy to be safe. The kindness of the bird had helped Gormiti find his way back.

plan.problema: Gorby got lost among the roses and couldn't find his nest.
plan.svolta: He decided to sing a happy song, hoping his voice would guide him home.
plan.finale: A little friendly bird showed him the way, happy to have found him.

hulk.text:
Hulk was a big green Hulk. He lived in the playground. He loved to play and to be strong. But one day, something strange happened. Hulk became grayer and grayer. He wasn't as bright green as before. Nobody of the children laughed when they saw him. Hulk felt sad.

“I can’t make anyone smile anymore,” said Hulk with a low voice. “And I love to make people smile!”

Hulk looked at the children playing on the swing and the slide. It seemed that his sadness was affecting them. He wanted to be a happy Hulk again. So, Hulk decided to do something. He took his big foot and started to make lots and lots of circles with his foot on the grass. He turned and turned, fast and slow. He was trying to find his strength, his green energy.

“Maybe if I try so hard, my colors will come back!” thought Hulk. But he kept making the circles, without success. The grass was full of gray circles. 

Suddenly, a warm ray of sunshine hit Hulk. It was a special ray of sunshine! And instantly, Hulk became bright green again. A lively and bright color. The children started to laugh. Hulk was happy! He had found his strength and his colors.

Hulk huddled under the shade of a tree, watching the children play. He realized that real joy wasn’t just in being strong, but in sharing that smile with others. Happiness is always inside of us.

plan.problema: Hulk has lost all his colors and can't make the children smile anymore.
plan.svolta: He started making lots and lots of circles with his foot, hoping to find his strength and his colors again!
plan.finale: Suddenly, a ray of sunshine hit Hulk and he became bright green again!

hulk.text:
Hulk was a big, green Hulk. He was at the playground and wanted to play. He saw lots of children having fun. There was a carousel with a red ball. The ball was high and he couldn't make it come down! Hulk tried, tried, but the ball stayed stuck on the circle.

A little boy, Marco, came up to Hulk. “Come on Hulk, try to push!” said Marco. Hulk tried to push with his huge arms, but the ball kept spinning. Suddenly, with a big push, the ball rolled away, ending up under a swing.

Hulk got a little angry. Then he thought, “I need to be patient.” So, Hulk slowly walked towards the ball. He gently pushed, with all his strength, but the ball kept running away!

Finally, with a small, controlled push, Hulk was able to bring the ball back to the carousel. All the children around started to laugh. It was a happy, joyful laugh. Hulk felt happy. He learned that even if things are difficult, with patience and a little bit of strength, you can always find a solution. Perseverance is the key to overcoming every obstacle.

plan.problema: Hulk can’t get the ball down from the ride!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his huge arms to gently push the ball, but he rolled it away!
plan.finale: With patience and a little bit of strength, Hulk brought the ball back into the ride and all the children laughed happily.

hulk.text:
Hulk loved the playground. He really liked to jump on the knight’s ride. Every time he tried to make the highest jump possible. But today he couldn’t. It was frustrating! Hulk felt a little bit angry, just like when he’s really Hulk!

He went closer to the ride and tried to jump again. “Ugh!” he said. The springs under the ride were too rusty. They didn’t let Hulk bounce well. None of his jumps were high enough. The other children were laughing seeing Hulk getting angry.

Hulk thought for a little while. Then he had an idea! Near the ride there was a fountain. Hulk ran to the fountain and started to collect the water with his huge hands. Slowly, he began to wet the rusty springs. It was a patient job. Hulk was careful not to break the springs.

After a long time, the springs were clean and shiny. Hulk tried to jump again. “Wow!” he exclaimed. The springs were working perfectly! Hulk bounced higher than he had ever bounced before. A little boy was watching him with wide eyes.

Hulk kept jumping, happy and pleased. He had solved the problem with patience and a little bit of water. The other children were clapping. Hulk understood that even when things are difficult, it takes time to find the right solution. And Hulk knew that a good idea can do miracles.

plan.problema: Hulk can't bounce on the carousel because the springs are too rusty!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his strength to gently take apart the springs and clean them with the fountain water.
plan.finale: The springs, once cleaned, worked perfectly again, and Hulk could bounce higher than ever!

hulk.text:
Hulk was in the playground. He was a big Hulk, a very big Hulk! The other children were laughing and playing around him, but Hulk could only watch. Suddenly, Hulk started to grow. He grew faster and faster, becoming enormous, enormous, enormous! He couldn't stop. His arms stretched out, his feet became gigantic. He had become too fast.

Hulk tried to calm down. He tried to think of something quiet, like a green field or a blue sky. But it didn't work! He stayed giant and Hulk was worried. No one could help him to become small again.

“I must do something!” thought Hulk. An idea popped into his mind: he would make a big jump into the air! He went to the edge of the little slide and prepared. “Here I go!” shouted Hulk, and he jumped down.

Hulk landed with a thud. He didn't become small right away, but he was a little smaller than before. He was still big, but not as big as before. A boy, Leo, ran towards Hulk to see if he was okay. “You’re fantastic, Hulk!” said Leo.

Hulk sat down and calmed down. He understood that his anger had made him grow too quickly. To become small, he had to be calmer and more focused. He gently stroked his arm. He had learned an important lesson.

plan.problema: Hulk transformed too quickly and now can’t get back to his normal size.
plan.svolta: He decided to make a big jump into the void, hoping the impact would return him to his original state.
plan.finale: The jump made him shrink, but only slightly; Hulk realized he needed more calm and concentration.

hulk.text:
Hulk was very angry. He was in the playground, right next to the red swing. Hulk had an important job to do: to build the tallest Lego tower in the world! He had all the bricks, or at least he thought he did. But when he tried to build the tower, he noticed something was wrong. His Lego bricks had disappeared!

“Oh no!” roared Hulk. “Where did they go? I can’t build the tower if the bricks are missing!” He looked everywhere: under the swing, behind the sandcastle, even inside the playhouse. But none of the Lego bricks were anywhere. Hulk was starting to feel really frustrated.

Then, a boy sitting on the friend swing came closer. “Maybe,” said the boy, “you can use your arms to collect all the scattered bricks!”

Hulk thought about it. His arms were huge and strong! Instead of getting even angrier, Hulk started to move. Using his giant arms, he collected every single Lego brick that he found on the playground. He brought them one by one to the place where he wanted to build the tower.

With patience and lots of strength, Hulk rebuilt the tower. It became taller and taller, taller than before! Finally, it became taller than the previous tower, becoming the tallest Lego structure the playground had ever seen. All the children in the playground applauded. Hulk felt happy and proud. And he understood that even with a big problem, if you are patient and persistent, you can always find a solution. The tower was so tall, because Hulk didn’t give up.

plan.problema: Hulk has lost all his Lego pieces and can’t build the tallest tower!
plan.svolta: Instead of getting angry, Hulk uses his huge arms to collect every small brick scattered around the playground.
plan.finale: With patience and a little bit of strength, Hulk rebuilds the tallest tower ever, making all the children happy.

hulk.text:
Hulk was a giant green in the playground. Once he was full of bright colors, but now he was gray like a stone. Hulk didn't know why, but all his colors had disappeared! He was sad because he saw so many children crying and he didn’t want to make them smile.

“Oh no,” said Hulk, with a loud voice. “I don’t know what to do. If I’m gray, nobody wants to play with me.” He saw a boy sitting all by himself on the swing and he felt even worse.

Hulk decided to do something. He started to run fast, jump, and clap his hands. He was trying to let out his frustration, hoping that this would help him to become colorful again. But every time Hulk moved more, he got bigger and bigger! He became so tall that he touched the height of the swing.

A little boy, Leo, was watching everything with wide eyes. “Wow, Hulk you’re getting huge!” he exclaimed.

Hulk stopped, slowing down and trying to calm himself. Then, suddenly, Hulk started to laugh. A loud laugh, full of joy. As he laughed, Hulk felt a warmth spreading through his whole body. His colors slowly came back: bright green, yellow, blue… Hulk was full of life again!

Hulk realized that real strength wasn’t in his size, but in his smile. And as he smiled, Leo started to laugh too, and all the other children joined the party. Hulk’s laughter spread like a wave, filling the playground with happiness.

plan.problema: Hulk has lost all his colors and doesn’t know how to make the other children smile anymore.
plan.svolta: He started to do a big workout to release his frustration, but it only made him even bigger!
plan.finale: He realized that real strength lay in his smile and started to laugh with delight, regaining his vibrant colors.

hulk.text:
Hulk was a big, green Hulk. He lived in the playground. He loved to run between the water games and the swings. But today Hulk had a big problem. He had lost all his colorful blocks! They were red, blue, yellow, and green. He had scattered them everywhere: under the bench, behind the swing, even inside the sandcastle.

Hulk got angry! “I must find them!” he shouted, trying to grab the blocks with his big hands. He looked and looked, but the more he looked, the more dust he spread. Every time Hulk took a step, the ground became red or blue because of the dust from his feet. It was really frustrating!

Then, Hulk saw a little hedgehog. The hedgehog was sitting next to his nest and was holding a bright red block in his hand. “Look, I have collected all your blocks!” said the hedgehog with a sweet voice. Hulk felt relieved. The hedgehog had put all the blocks, one by one, in his little nest.

Hulk thanked the hedgehog a thousand times. He was happy to have his blocks back. Together, Hulk and the hedgehog built a very tall tower with all the colorful blocks. The sun was setting in the playground. Hulk realized that even a little friend can help a lot. 

Hulk and the hedgehog were good friends, and together they knew how to do wonderful things.

plan.problema: Hulk has lost all his colorful blocks!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his strength to look for the scattered shapes, but he only spread more dust.
plan.finale: He managed to find the blocks thanks to his friend the hedgehog, who had collected them carefully.

hulk.text:
Hulk was a very big and green Hulk. He was sitting on the wood of the playground, right next to the tall tower that he loved to build. He had lots of plastic blocks, but he had lost many of them! The tower almost didn’t reach the sun. Hulk was getting angry. He really wanted to finish his tower.

Hulk started to look for the blocks. He looked under the slides, behind the swings, and among the sandboxes. He looked everywhere! But the blocks were too many. They were scattered all over the playground. Hulk was feeling more and more frustrated. He couldn’t collect them all.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Hulk, “I never manage to finish anything!” He sat down on the ground, with his arms drooping. He just wanted to complete the tower. He thought that maybe if he called someone, perhaps a child, he could help him. But there was no one around.

Suddenly, Hulk heard small movements among the trees. He saw a group of squirrels! The little squirrels had small boxes full of wooden blocks. “We can help you, Hulk!” said the squirrels.

Hulk smiled. He took the wooden blocks and used them to build his tower. The tower became even taller! The squirrels watched him happily as Hulk finished his work. Together, they had built a fantastic tower. Hulk realized that sometimes, even an unexpected friend can make a difference. And Hulk, with his new squirrel friends, felt very happy.

plan.problema: Hulk has lost all his building blocks and can’t build the tallest tower!
plan.svolta: He tried to collect every single piece, but there were too many and scattered everywhere.
plan.finale: Suddenly, a group of squirrels offered him their little wooden blocks to help him finish the tower!

hulk.text:
Hulk was a big, green Hulk. He was sitting in the middle of the playground, right next to the little children’s ride. The other toys looked at him with curiosity. The ride wasn’t moving. No one of the children wanted to play because the ride was still.

Hulk frowned. He had to do something! He was a strong Hulk, and children loved rides that moved. He tried to pull the cord with all his strength, but nothing. The ride didn’t want to move. 

“I’ll do it myself!” thought Hulk. He walked up to the ride and started pushing with his huge arms. He pushed, pushed, pushed! The ride moved quickly, too quickly. With a big “CRACK!”, the ride broke into a thousand pieces.

Hulk was worried. Something terrible had happened! He sat down, thinking. He had to be gentle. He started to look at the pieces scattered on the ground. He took his fist and, very carefully, he started to straighten the biggest pieces. He did it slowly, slowly, slowly.

A little girl, Alice, came up to Hulk. “You’re good!” she said. Hulk smiled. With one last little punch of his fist, the ride went back to working! It was turning slowly, making the children happy. 

Hulk realized that even the most difficult things can be solved with calm and patience. And the ride continued to turn, showing that a little effort can do great magic.

plan.problema: Hulk can't make the ride go for the children.
plan.svolta: He decides to use his huge arms to push the ride, but he does it too hard and everything breaks!
plan.finale: With great care and calm, Hulk uses his fist to gently straighten the broken pieces of the ride, making it work again.

hulk.text:
Hulk was a giant of green rubber in the playground. He loved to run and jump with the children. Today, however, he did something wrong! He was transforming too quickly! His energy was enormous and he moved at incredible speed.

Suddenly, Hulk realized that the new swing was gone. Its pieces were scattered everywhere on the lawn. It was a disaster! The other children were watching with their parents, some smiling. Hulk felt he had made a big mistake.

Hulk decided to put the swing back together. He used his huge fists to grab the wooden pieces. He tried to put them together quickly, but he was too strong! The fists hit with too much force and the pieces fell even further away. Hulk felt frustrated.

A little boy, Leo, approached Hulk. “Maybe you should be more careful,” said Leo. Hulk thanked the boy with a smile. Then, Hulk took a deep breath. He calmed down. He took the pieces one by one and put them back together very carefully.

Hulk worked slowly, trying not to use too much force. Finally, the swing was ready again! Hulk smiled, a huge and sincere smile. He was happy to have solved the problem. Hulk realized that sometimes, to do things well, you have to slow down. 

Hulk sat on the swing and gently made it swing. Calmness is the key to solving any difficulty.

plan.problema: Hulk transformed too quickly and accidentally disassembled the new swing.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his enormous fists to put it back together, but he made them fall even further!
plan.finale: With a lot of patience and care, Hulk reassembled the swing with a big smile.

ironman.text:
Ironman was in the playground. He was a shiny metal toy, ready for an adventure. The other children were running and laughing, but Ironman preferred to watch everything. Suddenly, he heard little whimpers. He saw a huge tangle of toy cars trapped under a bench. The wheels were stuck and the cars weren’t moving anymore.

Ironman approached carefully. “What a mess!” he thought. A boy, Leo, was trying to free the cars with his hands, but it was too difficult. The cars were falling to the ground. Ironman decided to do something.

He concentrated. He used his repulsor beam, a powerful blast of energy that could lift light objects. Slowly, gently, Ironman lifted each single car. One by one, he took them away from the tangle, without letting them fall. It was a patient and precise job.

Leo watched him with wide eyes. “Wow, Ironman you’re fantastic!” he exclaimed.

After a while, all the cars were free. Leo took his favorite red car and started running happily. The other children joined the game, laughing and playing. Ironman smiled. He had solved the problem with patience and skill. He was happy to see everyone playing together. 

Ironman stayed there, still, watching the children have fun. He realized that sometimes, even the most complicated problems can be solved if you take the time to think about them carefully.

plan.problema: The toy cars are tangled and nobody can free them!
plan.svolta: Ironman uses his repulsor beam to gently lift the cars, one at a time, without letting them fall.
plan.finale: All the toy cars are freed and the children start to play happily!

ironman.text:
Ironman was in the playground, sitting on the swing. The sun was shining and the children were laughing around him. Ironman loved to watch the games and the cars running on every surface. Suddenly, he heard a big commotion.

A group of children were trying to play with their red, blue, and yellow cars. But there was a huge problem! All the cars were tangled in a giant mess. No one could free them. The cars were stuck between the games, between the seats, and between the slides. It was a disaster!

Ironman thought for a moment. “I have to do something,” he said to himself. Then, he used his repulsor beam. He pointed the beam at one of the stuck cars. Carefully, he lifted it gently out of the tangle. Then, he placed it safely next to the race track.

Ironman continued like this, one car at a time. He was patient and precise. He lifted each car carefully, avoiding letting them fall. The children watched him in amazement. After a while, all the cars were free! They were back to being free and ready to run.

The children in the playground applauded Ironman! They shouted: “Good job, Ironman!” Ironman smiled. He was happy to have helped everyone. Then, he let go of the swing, with a gentle movement. Everything has its time and finding the right solution requires calmness and concentration.

plan.problema: The toy cars are tangled in a giant mess, and no one can free them!
plan.svolta: Ironman has the idea of using his repulsor beam to lift the cars one at a time, very carefully.
plan.finale: All the toy cars are back free and the children at the playground applauded Ironman!

ironman.text:
Ironman was in the playground. The sun was shining bright and the children were laughing happily. Ironman loved to watch them play. A little Leo was trying to have races with his red and blue cars. Suddenly, the cars got tangled! It was a complicated mess, full of curves and obstacles. Leo tried to free them, but nothing worked. “Oh no!” said Ironman. “I need to help.”

Ironman went to the cars. He used his magnetic beam, the one he used to collect metal. The beam worked! The cars separated and Leo made them race happily. But then, a little accident! The magnetic beam, too powerful, flew away all the colorful balloons hanging from the tree. The children cried.

Ironman felt bad. “I can’t let them be like this,” he thought. Carefully, he picked up one by one the balloons. He put them back in a line carefully, just like before. Then, he freed the cars and, finally, all the children could play again. Leo thanked Ironman smiling.

Ironman felt happy. He solved the problem and he also brought the joy back to the playground. The other children looked at him with admiration. Ironman realized that helping others, even if sometimes it makes a little mess, is always the right thing to do.

plan.problema: The toy cars got tangled in a too complicated mess to be freed.
plan.svolta: Ironman used his magnetic beam to separate the cars, but he accidentally made all the balloons fall down!
plan.finale: He carefully collected the balloons and then released the cars, bringing smiles to all the children.
plan.morale: Helping others is always the best solution.

ironman.text:
Ironman was in the playground. He was a metal toy, shiny and blue, with a big smile printed on his face. But today the playground wasn’t happy. All the toys were sad. The red ball, the yellow train, the teddy bear… no one was smiling anymore. The whole playground seemed to be turned off.

“What’s happening?” asked Ironman. “Why are you all so down?”

The little teddy bear, Bruno, answered: “Nobody plays with us anymore. They don’t make us laugh.”

Ironman decided to do something. He used his repulsor beam, the one that shoots a powerful force, to try to make the toys smile. “Come on, smile!” shouted Ironman. But instead of laughter, the playground balls flew away very fast! They disappeared among the trees and on the swings.

Ironman realized that wasn’t the right way to help. He stopped, thought a little, and then did something different. He gathered all the sad toys. He gently took them in his hands and hugged them tight, tight, tight. 

“You’re not alone,” said Ironman. “We’re here with you.”

Slowly, slowly, the toys started to smile. The yellow train started to go around the track, the red ball rolled happily, and the teddy bear curled up into a cuddle. 

Ironman realized that it wasn’t important to use force, but to give affection. And so, the playground toys became happy again. Ironman’s hugs were the secret to bringing a smile to everyone.

plan.problema: The toys in the playground had lost all their smiles and the park became sad.
plan.svolta: Ironman, with his repulsing strength, tried to get the children’s laughter going again, but he only made all the balls fly away!
plan.finale: He then collected all the toys and hugged them tightly, restoring their cheerful spirit.

ironman.text:
Ironman was in the playground, right next to the red slide. He was a shiny metal toy, with blue eyes that twinkled in the sun. He saw lots of boys and girls running and laughing. At one point, Ironman heard a big rumble coming from the swing.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Ironman. “The toy cars are stuck! Nobody knows how to get them moving.”

A little Leo, sitting on the swing with his mom, was watching the toy cars stop on the track. “I can’t get them to go!” said Leo with a sigh. 

Ironman went over to the toy cars. He tried to use his magnetic beam to unlock the wheels. The toy cars started to spin quickly, but they couldn’t move. Ironman was a little frustrated.

He thought, and thought, and thought… Then he had an idea! He took a small plastic shovel and started to dig a little channel near the track. He made a little stream that flowed next to the toy cars. The cool water splashed on them and suddenly, the wheels started to turn! The toy cars started moving, making Leo happy.

Ironman smiled happily. He had solved the problem calmly and patiently. The toy cars were running up and down the track, making a nice sound of tires. 

Leo waved goodbye to Ironman. “Thank you!” he said. “You’re fantastic!”

Ironman was getting ready to go back to the red slide, knowing that even the trickiest challenges can be overcome with calmness and a great idea.

plan.problema: The toy cars got stuck and nobody knows how to get them moving!
plan.svolta: Ironman, using his magnetic beam, tried to unlock the wheels but only spun them faster.
plan.finale: He then thought of creating a small channel for the water to flow and the cars started running again!

ironman.text:
Ironman was in the playground. It was a sunny day and the children were laughing. Ironman loved watching their games. At one point he saw a problem. All the toy cars were tangled in a huge mess! They were red, blue, yellow, all stuck together. The children were getting angry because they couldn't play anymore.

Ironman decided to do something. “I must help!” he thought. Ironman activated his magnetic beam. He pointed the beam at the cars. But instead of separating them, the beam only made a bigger mess! The cars flew everywhere, crashed into each other and fell off the swing. The children watched with wide eyes.

Ironman stopped for a moment. “I must be more precise,” he said to himself. He started pointing the beam again, but this time he adjusted it carefully. The beam became gentle and powerful. Slowly, the cars started to separate. One by one, Ironman moved them away from the tangle.

Finally, all the cars were free! The children rushed over and started playing happily. Ironman smiled. He was happy to have solved the problem. With patience and calmness, even the most difficult things can be fixed.

plan.problema: The toy cars got tangled and the children can’t play anymore.
plan.svolta: Ironman has the idea to use his magnetic beam to separate the cars, but at first he only makes a mess!
plan.finale: After carefully adjusting the beam, Ironman perfectly separates the toy cars and the children start playing happily again.
plan.morale: Patience is important for solving problems.

ironman.text:
Ironman was in the playground. He was an Ironman toy, big and red, ready for action. The children were laughing and running around him. But something wasn't right. A little boy was crying because he had lost his little teddy bear. Then another girl, desperate: she had to find her red car. Luca had also lost his fire truck.

Ironman activated. His sensors shone with a blue light. “Don’t be afraid!” said Ironman. “I’ll help you find your toys.” Using his scanners, he checked every corner of the playground. He looked for clues, tracks, anything that could show him where the lost toys were.

After a while, something hit him! A small signal came from under the swing. Ironman climbed quickly and found a teddy bear hidden among the cushions. He brought it back immediately, giving a big smile to whoever had lost the teddy bear.

“Now we need to make a plan!” said Ironman. “We’ll have a treasure hunt!” He called all the children and explained the rules. Together, they traced clues and solved little puzzles. Soon, every child had found their favorite toy. Everyone was happy! 

Ironman stopped next to Luca, who was holding his fire truck. Teamwork had made the difference. The other children thanked him with smiles and hugs. It was nice to see everyone working together towards a common goal.

plan.problema: The children had lost all their little toys!
plan.svolta: Ironman, using his advanced sensors, located a small teddy bear hidden under a swing and brought it back.
plan.finale: Thanks to his ingenuity, Ironamn organized a treasure hunt to find all the lost toys, bringing joy to all the children.

ironman.text:
Ironman was in the playground. It was a sunny day and the children were laughing happily. Ironman loved watching the children play, even though he couldn’t join them. He was a toy, a figure to build, but he had a secret: he could move and talk!

Suddenly, Ironman heard a cry. “Oh no!” he cried. The children had scattered all his building pieces all over the ground. There were gears, mechanical arms, his golden helmet… it was a disaster! Ironman tried to pick up the pieces with his mechanical hands, but it was too difficult. Every time he tried to grab a piece, it would roll away. It was frustrating.

A little boy, Leo, came up to Ironman. “Can I help you?” asked Leo. Ironman thought: “Maybe together we can solve this problem.” Leo started to pick up the smaller pieces and Ironman, with his mechanical strength, took the bigger ones. Together they worked quickly.

Then, Ironman had an idea! He used his built-in laser beam. He pointed the beam at a piece of plastic and rebuilt it perfectly. With the laser beam, he quickly rebuilt the tallest tower in the playground! It was even more beautiful than before. 

Leo smiled. “It’s fantastic!” said Leo. Ironman felt happy. He realized that working together made everything easier and more fun. Iron man and Leo watched the children playing, satisfied with the result achieved. The tower was there, tall and magnificent, and everyone could play together.

plan.problema: The children had scattered all of his building blocks all over the floor!
plan.svolta: Ironman tried to pick them up with his mechanical hands, but it was too difficult and they rolled away.
plan.finale: Using his built-in laser beam, Ironman quickly rebuilt the tallest tower of the playground!

ironman.text:
Ironman was in the playground. It was a sunny day and the children were laughing around him. Ironman loved to watch their games. Especially, he loved to see the toy cars zooming on the red track.

Suddenly, Ironman heard a big commotion. The toy cars were everywhere! They weren't going around the track, they were confused. Some were under the swing, others behind the sandcastle, and even some were inside the fountain. No one knew how they had gotten there.

Ironman thought: “I must do something!” He used his mechanical arms to reach out and look at the track. He saw lots of toy cars scattered and confused. Then he decided to act.

Ironman activated his magnetic beam, the special one that he had to collect metal objects. The beam shot out, attracting all the toy cars to him. With a precise movement, Ironman lined up the toy cars on the red track, one after another. Everything was perfect!

A little boy, Leo, saw what Ironman had done and smiled. “How lovely!” said Leo.

The toy cars quickly got back to their favorite game. They started to zoom quickly on the red track, making a lot of noise of tires. They were happy to be back in their place. Ironman felt happy and proud of his work. All the toy cars were running together, creating a vortex of colors and sounds. It was a beautiful moment to watch.

plan.problema: The cars got mixed up and don't know how to get back to their track!
plan.svolta: Ironman used his magnetic beam to collect the scattered cars and align them correctly.
plan.finale: All the cars set off quickly, happy to be back at their favorite game.

ironman.text:
Ironman was in the playground, as always. He was a shiny, red metal toy, ready for any adventure. He saw lots of cars zooming across the pavement and the sand. But then, suddenly, something went wrong.

The cars had gotten tangled! They were all mixed up, one on top of the other, in a huge mess. They couldn’t reach the swing where the wind was blowing strong and it seemed to be inviting them to play. Ironman was worried. The cars seemed stuck forever.

Ironman tried to use his repulsor beam. He thought a good blast would separate the cars and set them free. But instead, the repulsor beam made even more mess! The cars rolled away in all directions, creating an even worse tangle.

A little cat, Leo, came up to Ironman. “Maybe,” said Leo, “you should build something to help them.”

Ironman thought about it. Then he picked up some pieces of wood he found nearby and started to build a little bridge. Carefully, he placed the pieces on top of each other, creating a safe path for the cars. The cars started to pass, one at a time, without any more problems.

Ironman watched happily. He had solved the problem calmly and carefully. The cars played on the swing, happy and free. Ironman felt pleased to have helped everyone. He was a good hero, even if he was just a toy. 
Patience made the difference.

plan.problema: The toy cars got tangled in a confused mess, unable to reach the swing!
plan.svolta: Ironman tried to use his repulsor beam to separate the cars, but only made them even more of a mess.
plan.finale: He decided to build a small wooden bridge to let the cars pass calmly and safely.

joker.text:
Joker Smiling was a very smiley clown. He was made of colorful plastic and had a big yellow smile. But today Joker Smiling didn't seem happy. He was in an abandoned playground, among rusty swings and broken slides. Everything was gray. Even he! His colors had disappeared.

Joker Smiling looked around. There was no longer the red of his hat, nor the blue of his pants. Only grays of every shade. “Oh no!” he said. “I’m lost!”

He sat down on a bench and tried to laugh. He giggled softly, then laughed loudly, like clowns do. But the laughter didn’t do anything. Only a dull sound came out of his plastic mouth. There was no more color.

A little stray dog, Maru, approached Joker Smiling. He looked at him with curiosity. Joker Smiling thought maybe the dog could help him. But the dog didn’t do anything to bring the colors back to the playground. 

Suddenly, a shy ray of sunshine hit Joker Smiling. The sun touched his yellow hat and his blue pants. And then... boom! The colors returned, brighter than ever. Joker Smiling laughed again, a real and strong laugh. The playground began to shine with a thousand colors. 

Joker Smiling realized that his laughter had the power to bring joy. And joy, sometimes, is all we need.

plan.problema: Joker had lost all his colors and the park had become gray.
plan.svolta: He tried to laugh loudly, but the laughter didn't bring back the colors, it just made a dull sound.
plan.finale: A ray of sunshine hit Joker and suddenly, his colors returned bright!

joker.text:
Joker Smiling was a very smiley clown. He was made of colorful plastic and had a big yellow smile. He lived in an abandoned playground, a place full of rusty slides and broken swings. But something wasn't right. The children's laughter had disappeared. Joker Smiling felt sad and lonely. There was no one to play with, just the wind blowing through the empty benches.

One day, while sitting on a bench, Joker Smiling had an idea. He took his things: a top hat, a red balloon, and a small wooden cube. He decided to put on a show! He wanted someone to laugh!

He saw some little garden fairies fluttering around the playground. He called them and started to do tricks. He made the balloon disappear, made it reappear under the hat, and built towers with the wooden cube. The fairies were laughing until they cried!

One fairy, the smallest, flew away and began to spread her laughter. Other fairies did the same. Soon, the whole playground was full of sparkling light and happy laughter. The fairies attracted the children who were playing near the forest.

Joker Smiling smiled. His creativity had solved the problem. The playground had come back to life, full of races, shouts, and laughter. The fairies flew happily, spreading joy wherever they went. Everything can be more beautiful if you use your imagination.

plan.problema: The children’s laughter had disappeared and Joker felt sad and alone.
plan.svolta: He decided to create a small magic show, using his objects to make the fairies laugh.
plan.finale: The fairies, amused by his silly moves, began to spread their joy throughout the playground, attracting the children and filling it with laughter.

joker.text:
Joker was a toy clown. He lived in the playground, near the tall tower and the hanging bridge. Joker loved to make silly faces. It was his job, his mission: to make the children laugh. But one day, something strange happened. Joker’s smile disappeared. He couldn’t make anyone laugh anymore.

The children looked at him, but they didn’t laugh. He tried to make a funny face with his wide eyes and open mouth. No one laughed. Joker was sad. He felt useless. A little boy, Leo, was sitting near him, watching him quietly.

Joker had an idea. He collected sand with his rubber hands. He started to build a giant sandcastle! He made tall, narrow towers, thick walls, and protective battlements. The castle was enormous, the biggest the playground had ever seen.

The children came closer. At first, they looked at it with curiosity, then they started to play. They built other forts, slid on the sand, and had so much fun. Joker saw their smiles. His smile was back! He felt happy again.

Leo said, “Joker, you are the best clown in the world!” Joker replied, “It’s wonderful to see everyone so happy.” The children laughed and played together, creating an unforgettable afternoon. 

Joy spread like a wave, making everyone smile.

plan.problema: Joker’s smile had faded and he couldn’t make the children laugh anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to make funny faces, but nobody laughed, so he decided to build a giant sandcastle to get their attention.
plan.finale: The children had so much fun, and Joker, seeing them laugh, found his smile again.

joker.text:
Joker Smiling was a very funny clown. He was made of colorful plastic and had a big smile printed on his face. Joker Smiling lived in an abandoned playground, full of rusty benches and broken slides. He wanted to play, but there was no one.

Joker Smiling noticed something sad: among the benches grew yellow flowers. They were so faded they weren’t smiling. Joker Smiling wanted to help them. He tried to make silly faces, jump and spin around them, but the flowers stayed still.

“I must find a way to make them laugh!” thought Joker Smiling. Then he had an idea! He took his clowning soap and started to make huge bubbles. The colorful bubbles floated in the air, but they popped right away. “Oh no!” exclaimed Joker Smiling.

He then started to collect colorful confetti. He scattered them everywhere: on the green lawn, on the children who had arrived by chance at the playground, and even on the faces of the flowers. The colors shone brightly and the children burst out laughing. The flowers seemed to smile a little more too.

Joker Smiling felt happy. Seeing the children laugh made him feel even happier. And the flowers, thanks to the confetti, finally seemed happy. It was a beautiful day at the abandoned playground. Joker Smiling realized that when you share joy, everyone becomes smiling.

plan.problema: He can’t make the flowers growing between the benches smile.
plan.svolta: He decides to create a giant rainbow with bubble solution, but they all pop immediately!
plan.finale: He uses colorful confetti to decorate the lawn and the children, and seeing them laugh, it makes the flowers smile.

joker.text:
Joker Smiling was a very funny clown. He was made of colorful plastic and always had a big smile. He lived in an abandoned playground, full of rusty swings and faded slides. Usually, Joker Smiling loved to do cartwheels and make the birds flying around laugh.

But today, something wasn’t right. His smile had disappeared! He had become sad and gray. And this made the flowers in the playground sad too. The tulips had stopped blooming and the daisies were drooping. Nobody seemed happy anymore.

Joker Smiling decided to do something. He took all his colorful balloons – red, yellow, blue, and green – and thought he would create a giant rainbow! He started blowing up the balloons, one after the other, but then a strong wind arrived. The balloons flew away, scattered everywhere in the playground.

Joker Smiling felt a little down, but he didn’t give up. He picked up the balloons that were falling to the ground. Then, with patience and care, he started to build a little castle using colorful confetti. A wooden gnome sitting on a bench watched him carefully.

The flowers in the playground saw the castle and started to smile! The biggest tulip made a little movement and the smallest daisy opened up completely. Joker Smiling got his smile back, bright and happy. He realized that even a small kind gesture could bring so much joy. Every smile is a precious gift to share.

plan.problema: Joker’s smile had faded and he couldn’t cheer up the flowers in the park.
plan.svolta: He decided to create a giant rainbow using all his colorful balloons, but the wind blew them away!
plan.finale: Joker picked up the balloons and, with patience, built a small castle of confetti that made the flowers laugh.

joker.text:
Joker Smiling was a very smiley toy clown. He was made of colorful plastic and had a big, painted smile on his face. He lived in an old, abandoned playground, a place full of sand and rusty slides. Joker Smiling wanted to build a tall tower, but there was a problem: all the colorful blocks were scattered everywhere! He couldn’t find the right ones to make the base.

Joker Smiling felt a little sad. He tried to group the red and blue blocks, then the yellow and green ones. But it was too difficult! A group of squirrels entered the playground. They were three curious squirrels looking for colorful pieces to build their nest. 

Joker Smiling had an idea. He started to pick up the scattered blocks and put them in a pile near the squirrels. The squirrels were happy! They helped him carry the blocks to a small stone wall, away from the sand. 

After a lot of work, Joker Smiling had finally built the tower! It was tall and strong, with lots of blocks that shone in the sun. The colors seemed to dance in the air. The squirrels had found the perfect place for their nest. 

Joker Smiling was happy. The old, abandoned playground seemed like a new and joyful place, thanks to everyone working together. The tower sparkled in the sunlight, showing that sharing your resources can make everything more beautiful.

plan.problema: The colorful blocks are scattered everywhere and he can’t build a tall tower!
plan.svolta: He notices that a group of squirrels is trying to collect them to build a beautiful nest, so he helps them carry them to a safe place.
plan.finale: The tower is finally completed and the blocks shine in the sun, making the playground even more joyful.

joker.text:
Joker Feliz was a very special clown. He lived in the playground, near the tall tower and the red swing. Joker Feliz loved to make the silliest faces in the world! His smile was big and bright, the one that made all the children laugh.

But one day, Joker Feliz’s smile disappeared. He didn’t know why. The children came to the playground, but nobody laughed. Nobody found him funny. Joker Feliz tried to make the strangest faces: with his hands making the cow sound, with his eyes popping out of their sockets, even trying to make the swing fall down! Nothing.

A little girl, Sofia, sitting on the swing, was watching him. “You look a little sad, Joker Feliz?” she asked. Joker Feliz frowned. He started to make even bigger and sillier faces. But nobody laughed.

Then, suddenly, Joker Feliz had an idea. Instead of trying to make himself laugh, he started to make faces for the children. He made them fall into silly positions, he pretended to dance, and he made them make funny faces. And the children… they smiled! They really laughed!

Joker Feliz felt happier than ever before. His smile came back bright. He realized that his best smile comes when he makes others smile. And while Sofia laughed, Joker Feliz knew that joy is better when you share it with a friend.

plan.problema: Joker’s smile had faded and no one could make him laugh!
plan.svolta: He tried to make funny faces, but the children didn’t find him funny.
plan.finale: Joker learned that his most beautiful smile comes when he makes others smile.

joker.text:
Joker Smiling was a very happy toy clown. He had a big, yellow smile, ready to party.
He lived in an abandoned playground, full of rusty swings and dusty slides.
He was the only player inside.

One day, Joker Smiling noticed something wasn't right. His smile had become sad.
He couldn't make the flowers in the park smile anymore.
The roses were drooping and the daisies were closed. It was terrible!

Joker Smiling decided to play a big trick. He tried to knock over the sandbox, but only scared a ladybug who flew away.
The ladybug was very scared and Joker Smiling felt even more down.

Then, a little squirrel came out of a tree. He watched him with curiosity.
Joker Smiling had an idea. He started to collect pieces of wood, dry leaves, and stones.
With patience, he built little cozy homes for the squirrels.

The squirrels started to play right away. They jumped between the houses, hid, and laughed.
The flowers in the park seemed to cheer up too. Joker Smiling’s smile started to shine again.
He was happy to have brought joy to others.

Joker Smiling realized that doing good things made everyone happier, even him.
And as the squirrels played, he realized that a small kind gesture can light up the world.

plan.problema: Joker’s smile has faded and he can’t cheer up the flowers in the park.
plan.svolta: He tried to play a big trick, but he only scared a ladybug!
plan.finale: Joker decided to build little houses for the squirrels, who rediscovered the pleasure of playing and laughing.

joker.text:
Joker was a very happy rubber clown. He lived in the playground, near the fountain and the red swing. Every day he tried to make the children who came to play laugh. But today something wasn't going right. His smile, the big yellow one, had disappeared. He couldn't make them laugh anymore!

“Oh no!” exclaimed Joker, spinning around. “If the children don't laugh, I'm not a clown anymore!” The children playing around him looked at him, but no one was laughing. A little boy, Leo, offered him a gymnastic ball. Joker took it and did lots of jumps, but nothing! No one was laughing.

Then, Joker had an idea. He decided to play a big trick! He turned into a giant lion, then a fish swimming in the air, but no one was still laughing. He was very sad. He didn't understand why he couldn't make anyone laugh.

Joker sat on the bench and thought. Then he had a new idea: he built a swing! But this swing was special. It moved up and down, back and forth, in a silly and strange way. The children saw the swing and started to laugh. They laughed loudly, they laughed with pleasure. Joker felt happy. His yellow smile began to shine again.

Leo ran to him and said: "Joker you are the best!" Joker understood that the most important thing was to be kind to others. And when he was kind, everyone laughed. Kindness really makes people smile.

plan.problema: Joker’s smile faded and he couldn’t make the children laugh anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to play a big trick, but nobody laughed!
plan.finale: Joker decided to build a swing that moves in a silly way and suddenly everyone burst out laughing.

joker.text:
Joker Smiling was a very smiley clown. He was made of rubber and plastic, and he always had a big smile printed on his face. Joker Smiling lived in an abandoned playground, full of rusty swings and faded slides.

One day, Joker Smiling noticed something terrible: all of his colorful balloons had disappeared! The wind must have taken them away, perhaps. He was sad. He didn’t know how to make the children he loved so much happy. He wanted to make them laugh, but without his balloons, he couldn’t smile himself.

Joker Smiling thought and thought. Then he had an idea! He picked up all the building blocks he found on the ground: red, blue, yellow, green… He started to build a huge sculpture, as tall as a child. He created castles, trees, and funny animals. The sculpture was beautiful and full of color.

A boy, Marco, saw the sculpture and started to laugh. Then other children arrived, attracted by the beauty of the construction. They giggled, jumped around the giant sculpture. Joker Smiling felt a smile return to his face. Suddenly, his colorful balloons reappeared! They were hanging from the block castle.

Joker Smiling realized that his sculpture had brought joy and laughter. And while he put on a big show of colors for all the children, he thought that creating beautiful things can always lead to a smile.

plan.problema: Joker has lost all his colorful balloons and doesn’t know how to make the children happy.
plan.svolta: He decided to create a giant sculpture with building blocks, hoping that beauty would help him laugh and find his cheerful spirits.
plan.finale: The children, attracted by the sculpture, laughed and Joker found all his balloons, ready for a big display of color.

king.text:
King was a plastic king, a beautiful king with a tiny throne and lots of colorful gems.
He lived in a secret garden, a special place full of fragrant flowers and lush plants.
King loved his garden and loved to shine thanks to his gems: red, blue, yellow, green... they all shone in the sun!

One day, King noticed that something wasn’t right. His gems were gone! None of them were there anymore.
He was sad. He couldn’t shine like before. “Oh no!” said King, waving on his little throne.
“Where have all my colors gone?”

King decided to look for them. He started to look under the roses, the big and fragrant ones.
He crouched down and tried to see if the gems had fallen among the leaves. But they were too small!
He couldn’t see them anywhere. “Maybe they are hidden here,” thought King, but he found nothing.

Then, a white butterfly flew near him. The butterfly was very kind and looked at King with its little black eyes.
It started to flutter around the stream that flowed through the garden. King followed it, curious. 

And there, in the sunlight reflecting on the water, he saw his gems! They were hidden among the stones and they shone brighter than before.
King was so happy! He thanked the butterfly with a smile. He had found his gems thanks to the patience of looking carefully at every corner of the garden.

King returned to shining, full of colors. The secret garden was even more beautiful than before. 

King understood that even when things seem lost, looking calmly and carefully can lead to the solution.

plan.problema: King has lost all his colorful gems and doesn’t know how to shine anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to look under the roses, but the gems were too small to be seen there.
plan.finale: A butterfly pointed him towards a stream where the gems shone in the sunlight.

king.text:
King was a wooden king. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of strange flowers and plants. King loved to be there, sitting on a stone bench. He had so many colorful jewels: red rubies, blue sapphires, and green emeralds. He always kept them with him, attached to his golden dress.

One day, King noticed that his jewels were gone! He looked everywhere, under the roses, among the apple trees, but they were no longer there. “Oh no!” said King, “I’ve lost all my precious things!” He was very sad.

He decided then to ask for help. He saw a beautiful butterfly, with wings colored like a rainbow. The butterfly was flying around the flowers, collecting the most beautiful petals. King approached and said: “Butterfly, have you seen my jewels?” But the butterfly was too busy collecting flowers to listen to him. It flew away, saying nothing.

King sat there, thinking. Then, he noticed a big pink flower, right next to the bench. He went closer and, carefully, lifted the big petal. And there, hidden under the flower, were all his jewels!

King picked them up happily. He was so happy to have found them. He understood that sometimes, to find things, you have to wait and look carefully. King put his jewels in order and smiled. Patience had done its job.

plan.problema: King has lost all his jewels and doesn’t know where they are.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the most colorful butterfly in the garden, but the butterfly was too busy collecting flowers to listen to him.
plan.finale: King found his jewels hidden under a big pink flower and he felt happy.

king.text:
King was a wooden king. A very nice king and a little bit lost. He was in the Flowery Garden, a place full of wonderful colors. Red roses, yellow tulips, blue violets, and golden sunflowers. King loved the garden, but he had gotten lost. He was surrounded by so many beautiful flowers that he couldn’t find his special place.

King tried to shout: “Can anyone see me? I’m here!” But his voice was too small to be heard among all those petals. No flower answered. King felt sad and a little scared. He wanted to go back to his wooden little house, where lived Princess Fiorella.

Then, King had an idea. He heard a sweet and clear sound: the sound of the stream that flowed near the flowers. “Maybe the stream can help me,” he thought. So, King began to move towards the sound. He climbed up small stones, he was pushed by a light breeze, and he followed the stream carefully.

The stream led him closer and closer to the wooden little house. And right there, in front of the door, was Princess Fiorella waiting for him. Princess Fiorella ran to hug King happily. He was so happy to be home. 

King felt rested and calm. He had learned that even when things seem difficult, if you are patient and follow your own way, you will always find the solution in the end.

plan.problema: King got lost among so many colorful flowers and couldn't find his way back.
plan.svolta: He tried to call out to all the colors, but nobody heard him, so he decided to follow the sound of the stream.
plan.finale: The stream brought him right to his little wooden house and Princess Fiorella hugged him happily.

king.text:
King was a wooden king. A very special king, because he could move and talk. He lived in a secret garden, full of colorful flowers and tall trees. His favorite place was next to the golden throne, right under a big red rose.

One day, King found himself lost. The roses were so fragrant and so many, so many roses! He had gone too far from the throne and couldn't find it anymore. He was a lost king among the soft petals and green stems. “Oh no!” thought King. “I must go back to my throne!”

King tried to shout for help, but his voice was too small to be heard among the roses. Nobody listened to him. Then, King decided to do something different. He saw a stream flowing slowly through the garden and thought, “Maybe the stream will take me to my throne!”

King went to the stream and followed it. The water was cool and clear. King floated on the water, with his arms stretched up high. The stream carried him further and further, until… surprise! The stream stopped right in front of his golden throne.

Princess Rose, a beautiful porcelain doll, was waiting for King with a big, bright smile. “King!” said Princess Rose. “We were looking for you!” King was happy to be back home. He had learned that even when things seem difficult, having patience and following your instincts can lead to the right solution. The wooden king sat on his throne, happy to be finally safe.

plan.problema: King got lost among the roses and couldn't find his throne anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to shout for help, but no one could hear him, so he decided to follow the stream running through the garden.
plan.finale: The stream brought him right in front of his throne, where Princess Rose was waiting for him with a smile.

king.text:
King was a wooden king. A very special king because he could move and talk.
He lived in a secret garden full of fragrant flowers and lush plants.
It was his favorite place in the world.

King loved to sit on his throne, a small stone bench covered in moss.

One day, while playing among the red and yellow roses, King got lost.
The roses were so beautiful and fragrant that King followed a winding path.
Now he couldn't find his throne anymore. He was very worried.
He looked around, but everything seemed the same: just roses and green leaves.

King thought he was really lost. He didn't know what to do.
Then, he decided to call for help. He made a big “Noise!”
A loud and strange sound that echoed in the secret garden.
Nobody seemed to hear.

Suddenly, a red ladybug flew towards King. “What’s wrong?” asked the ladybug with a gentle voice.
King explained his problem: he was lost and couldn't find his throne.
The ladybug listened carefully.

The ladybug, who was called Stella, saw King sitting among the roses.
With care, she flew towards the throne and brought it back to King.
King was happy! He thanked Stella for her help.
He was so glad to be back on his throne. 

King realized that even a small act of kindness can make a difference.
And indeed, with the help of the ladybug, everything went back to normal.

plan.problema: King got lost among the roses and couldn't find his throne anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to call for help, making a loud 'Wow!' hoping someone would hear him.
plan.finale: A friendly ladybug saw King and gently carried him to his throne.

king.text:
King was a very important king.
He lived in a secret garden full of fragrant flowers and tall trees.
King loved his garden, but he had a big problem.
He had lost his crown!
It was a sparkling crown, full of colorful gems that made him look like a real king.

King was very sad.
Without the crown, he couldn’t be a king.
“Oh no, oh no!” said King, wiggling.
He looked everywhere in the secret garden.
He looked under the trees, but the crown was too small to fit between the roots.
He checked behind the big roses, but nothing.

King felt more and more down.
Then, he saw a bright red ladybug hopping near a sunflower.
“Hello!” said King to the ladybug.
“I’ve lost my crown and I don’t know where to look.”
The ladybug’s name was Dotty, and she was very kind.

Dotty helped King to look.
They looked together among the colorful flowers: yellow tulips, red poppies, and blue violets.
Finally, Dotty saw something sparkling hidden between two petals of white roses.
It was the crown! 

King was immediately happy.
He took his crown and put it on.
“Thank you, Dotty!” said King to the ladybug.
“I couldn’t have done it without your help.”
King realized that even when things are difficult, a friend can make a difference. 

King and Dotty played happily in the secret garden, and King felt like an important king again.
They realized that sometimes, having patience and a little friend is all you need.

plan.problema: King has lost his sparkling crown and can’t seem like a king anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to look under the trees, but the crown was too small to fit.
plan.finale: With the help of a friendly ladybug, King found the hidden crown among the colorful flowers.
plan.morale: Patience and friendship help to overcome difficulties.

king.text:
King was a wooden king, a little king with a golden crown and a blue dress. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. King loved to be there, watching the butterflies and listening to the birds sing.

---

One day, King was filled with curiosity. He had moved away from his usual place and got lost among the red and pink roses. The roses were so beautiful and fragrant that King wanted to explore them all! But when he had finished walking among the branches, he realized a problem: he couldn't find his throne! The throne was made of white stone and was part of the Secret Garden.

---

King tried to ask for help from the bees. The bees were flying around the flowers, collecting nectar to make honey. But they were too busy to pay attention to the little king. “Excuse me,” said King, “but I don’t know where my throne is!” The bees only replied with a buzz and continued to work.

---

Suddenly, a friendly white rabbit jumped out from behind a bush. The rabbit had long, soft ears and bright black eyes. “What’s happening?” asked the rabbit. King explained his situation. The rabbit smiled kindly. “Don’t worry,” he said, “I’ll take you to your throne!”

---

The rabbit hopped quickly under a large oak tree. There was a perfect throne for King! King sat on the throne and thanked the rabbit. The rabbit smiled at him again and then hopped away to play. King was happy to be back home, near his throne. It was important to be kind to everyone, even the animals you meet.

plan.problema: King got lost among the roses and couldn't find his throne.
plan.svolta: He tried to ask for help from the bees, but they were too busy collecting nectar.
plan.finale: A friendly rabbit kindly led him to his throne under a big tree.

king.text:
King was a wooden king. A very special king, because he could talk and move! He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. It was his favorite place in the world.

---

One day, King was playing among the red and yellow roses. He had so much fun that he got lost. He couldn't find his golden throne anymore! The throne was right next to the stone fountain. King was very worried. “Oh no!” he said. “I don’t know where I am!”

---

He decided to ask for help. He saw a giant rubber crocodile near the pond. The crocodile was taking the sun and seemed to be having fun. King ran towards him: "Crocodile, Crocodile! Can you help me find my throne?". But the crocodile was too busy smiling at the sun to pay attention to King. “Oh dear!” thought King.

---

King felt a little sad. Then he had an idea. He looked around and saw a big oak tree with tall and strong branches. With a little courage, King began to climb the tree. He climbed from branch to branch.

---

Finally, he reached the top! From there, he could see the whole secret garden. And right underneath him was his golden throne! King quickly climbed down from the tree and ran towards the throne, happy to be back home. 

---

King learned that sometimes, to find what you are looking for, you need a little patience and to look carefully. And so, every time he got lost, King remembered to look around carefully.

plan.problema: King got lost among the roses and couldn't find his throne anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the rubber crocodile that lived near the pond, but the crocodile was too busy soaking up the sun to help him.
plan.finale: King, with a little courage, climbed up a big oak tree and from there he saw his throne right under him!

king.text:
King was a wooden king, very important.
He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees.
King loved his garden, but he had a big problem.
He had lost all his sparkling jewels!
They were little precious gems that he always carried with him.
He had lost them somewhere in the garden and couldn’t find them.

King was very sad.
He looked everywhere: under the roses, behind the lavender bush, among the colorful ribbons.
But none of his jewels were anywhere.
“Oh no!” said King. “I must find my treasures!”

He decided to ask for help from the wind.
King blew hard, very hard, and tried to hear if the wind was telling him something.
He only felt the rustling of the leaves.
“Wind, wind,” whispered King, “have you seen my jewels? They are sparkling and beautiful!”

The wind began to blow harder.
Then, suddenly, it stopped.
The wind pointed with a little gust to a stream nearby.
King ran to the stream and looked.
He saw his precious gems floating on the water!
They had been carried there by the stream.

King collected his sparkling jewels and put them back on his neck.
He was happy to have found them.
King understood that even when things seem lost, with a little patience and curiosity, unexpected solutions can be found.
The wooden king smiled, happy with his secret garden.

plan.problema: King has lost all his sparkling jewels and doesn't know where they are.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask the wind for help, blowing hard to see if he heard any sounds or movement among the leaves.
plan.finale: The wind pointed him to a small stream where he had found his precious floating treasures.
plan.morale: Patience and curiosity lead to the solution.

king.text:
King was a metal king, shiny and golden. He lived in a secret garden full of fragrant roses. King loved to sit on his red wooden throne, watching the butterflies dance. But one day, while playing with a little bucket, spraying water on the roses, he got lost.

The roses were so many and so beautiful! King had wandered among their branches, trying to reach a particularly fragrant rose. When he tried to go back, he couldn't find his throne anymore. He was alone and a little scared. The throne was there, near the fountain, but King couldn't reach it.

King felt sad. He didn't know what to do. He tried to shout, but no one listened. Then, he decided to call for help. King squeezed his hand and rang his golden bell loudly. *Dinkle! Dinkle!* The sound echoed in the secret garden.

A little squirrel, called Nico, was collecting nuts nearby. He heard the sound of the bell and approached curiously. “Who made this noise?” asked Nico. “I’m King!” replied King. Nico followed the sound to King.

Nico took a colorful leaf and used it to push King towards his throne. King happily sat on his red wooden throne. He thanked Nico for helping him. Nico smiled and went away to collect more nuts. King realized that even when you get lost, someone can help you.

plan.problema: King got lost among the roses and couldn't find his throne.
plan.svolta: He decided to call for help, making a loud sound with his golden bell.
plan.finale: A little squirrel answered his call and brought him back to the throne with a colored leaf.

luigi.text:
Luigi was a little teddy bear. He lived in the garden at home, among the plants and flowers. He loved to be there, watching the butterflies fly. His favorite friend was Boris, a ray of sunshine that played hide-and-seek among the roses.

---

One day, Luigi was playing with Boris near the bush of red roses. Suddenly, Boris disappeared! Luigi looked everywhere, under the fragrant flowers and behind the green leaves. But Boris was no longer there. Luigi felt very lonely and worried.

---

He tried to shout: “Boris! Where are you?” But the strong wind blew in the garden and carried away his voice. Luigi felt even smaller and sadder. Nobody heard him, he was completely alone among the roses. 

---

Luigi thought that maybe Boris needed help. So he followed the sweet smell of the bees. The bees were flying around the yellow flowers and Luigi followed them carefully. The smell became stronger and stronger.

---

Finally, Luigi saw Boris! He was under a big sunflower, shining high in the sky. Boris was smiling and waving to Luigi. He explained that he had hidden to play hide-and-seek with a butterfly. 

---

Luigi felt happy to have found him. He understood that even when things seem difficult, if you are patient and look around, you can always find the solution. Luigi and Boris returned together to the rose bush, ready for another adventure.

plan.problema: Luigi got lost among the roses and couldn't find his friend Boris, a little ray of sunshine.
plan.svolta: Luigi tried to shout to Boris, but the wind carried away his voice and he felt even more alone.
plan.finale: Luigi followed the scent of the bees and finally found Boris who was waiting for him under a large sunflower.

luigi.text:
Luigi was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of big, fragrant flowers. The tulips were as tall as he was, and the roses looked like red castles. Luigi loved to play among the soft petals, but one morning he had gotten lost.

He had found himself surrounded by giant yellow and purple flowers. He couldn’t recognize his corner of the garden, the place where the sunlight kissed the grass. He was a little scared. He tried to move his little paws, but the flowers were so many that everything seemed the same.

Luigi decided to do something. He closed his eyes and thought of a cheerful melody that his mommy always sang to him. Then he started to sing, with his voice a little rough but full of joy. “Oh-oh-oh, I’m singing for you! I hope you help me find my place!”

A little squirrel, named Nuto, was listening to the song. Nuto was curious and loved cheerful voices. He came up to Luigi and said, "You were singing because you were lost? Listen, Luigi, you have to go straight towards the big apple tree. Your corner is right there nearby."

Luigi followed Nuto’s directions. He walked among the flowers, always with his melody, and finally arrived at the corner of the garden where he belonged. He was happy! He curled up on the grass, glad to be back home. The kindness of a little squirrel had saved him. Every good deed has its value.

plan.problema: Luigi got lost among the giant flowers and couldn't find his way back.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his voice to sing a cheerful melody, hoping someone would help him find his bearings.
plan.finale: A little squirrel, attracted by the song, pointed him to the right path towards the corner of the garden where Luigi belonged.
plan.morale: Kindness is the key to solving problems.

luigi.text:
Luigi was a teddy bear. He was very soft and had a big, happy smile. Luigi lived in the garden of Aunt Rosa. The garden was full of colorful flowers: red roses, yellow tulips, blue violets, and tall sunflowers.

One day, Luigi found himself in the middle of the flowers. He had wandered away from his favorite spot. He couldn't find his way back under the big tree anymore. He was a little scared. The colors were so bright and the smells were so strong that Luigi got lost.

Luigi tried to find his way around, but every flower looked the same to him. He felt sad and a little confused. “Oh no,” thought Luigi, “I’m lost!”

Suddenly, Luigi had an idea. He made a funny sound: a little squeak, like a teddy bear’s giggle. The noise was fun and unusual. Aunt Rosa was watering the flowers near her favorite corner. She heard the squeak and turned to look for him.

“Luigi!” called Aunt Rosa. Running towards the tree, she found Luigi among the red roses. She gently picked him up in her arms and brought him back under the big tree. Luigi immediately settled back in his favorite spot, near the sun. Aunt Rosa smiled. 

Luigi was happy to be back home. He understood that even when you get lost, asking for help can lead to a solution.

plan.problema: Luigi got lost among the colorful flowers and couldn't find his place.
plan.svolta: He decided to call for help, making a funny sound that reminded him of a laugh.
plan.finale: Rose, hearing the noise, ran to look for Luigi and brought him back to his favorite corner under the tree.
plan.morale: Asking for help is always the solution.

luigi.text:
Luigi was a very special little teddy bear. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and big plants. Luigi loved to play among the red and yellow roses, but sometimes he got lost. That day, he was really lost. The roses were so many, so tall! He couldn’t see his friend Bruno, the little teddy bear with a blue hat.

“Bruno? Bruno!” shouted Luigi, but nobody answered. He was very scared. He looked among the leaves, under the flowers, but Bruno wasn’t there. Luigi felt sad and lonely. He wanted so much to go back to Bruno. 

Then, Luigi had an idea! He had a little bell on his back, a small bell that rang when you touched it. He decided to use his bell to make a loud sound and hoped that Bruno could hear it. He rang, rang, rang! The bell made “tinkle, tinkle”.

Finally, Luigi heard a little “woof woof” coming from a farther place. Running as fast as he could, he arrived to see Bruno. The little teddy bear ran to meet him, happy to be found. They hugged tightly. 

Luigi was so happy to have found his friend again. He had learned that even when you get lost, you must not give up and look with perseverance. Luigi and Bruno continued to play together in the Secret Garden, knowing that determination can lead to a happy ending.

plan.problema: Luigi got lost among the roses and couldn't find his friend, the little teddy bear Bruno.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his bell to make a loud sound and hoped Bruno could hear it.
plan.finale: Finally, he heard a little "woof woof" and Bruno ran to meet him, happy to be found.

luigi.text:
Luigi was a very happy little teddy bear. He lived in a secret garden, full of colorful flowers and big trees. Luigi loved to play there every day. But one day, something had gone wrong. He had gotten lost among the fragrant roses! The roses were so tall and many, that Luigi couldn't see his friend, Barnaba, a little teddy bear with whom he always played.

Luigi felt sad. He looked for Barnaba everywhere, but the teddy bear was gone. Then Luigi tried to call: “Barnaba! Barnaba!”. But nobody answered. Only the wind blew through the leaves of the roses.

Luigi decided to do something different. He followed the most winding path of the secret garden, the one that snaked among the plants and bushes. It was a long and a little difficult path to find. Luigi kept walking, he didn’t give up.

Finally, after so much searching, Luigi saw something furry under a big sunflower! It was Barnaba! The teddy bear was hidden there, curled up among the big yellow leaves. Luigi ran to his friend and hugged him tightly.

The two teddy bears returned to play together happily in the secret garden. They rolled in the grass, they hid among the flowers and they laughed a lot. Luigi realized that even when things seem difficult, with a little patience and perseverance, you can always find happiness. And so, Luigi and Barnaba continued to play happily for the whole afternoon.

plan.problema: Luigi got lost among the roses and couldn't find his friend, a little teddy bear.
plan.svolta: Luigi tried to call the teddy bear, but nobody answered, so he decided to follow the most winding path through the garden.
plan.finale: Finally, Luigi found the teddy bear hidden under a large sunflower, and the two friends returned to play together happily.

luigi.text:
Luigi was a very special teddy bear. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of fragrant flowers and tall trees. Luigi loved to play among the leaves and listen to the birds singing. One day, while exploring near a bush of red roses, he found himself completely lost!

The roses were so big and fragrant that they had swallowed him up. He couldn't see his friend, Stella the butterfly anymore. Stella loved to fly among the flowers, and Luigi had been looking for her for a while. “Stella? Where are you?” Luigi asked, but he didn't hear an answer.

Luigi tried to call Stella with his metallic voice, the one he makes when he’s surprised. But nobody heard him. Nobody was in the secret garden that day. Then Luigi had an idea! He started to move his arms in a silly way, up and down, back and forth. He moved as if he were dancing a strange song.

Finally, a rustle among the leaves. Stella appeared! She flew quickly and landed on Luigi’s arms. “Luigi! Were you lost?” Stella asked, happy to have found him among the green leaves. Luigi hugged Stella tightly. He was so happy to see her again.

Stella explained that she had gotten lost chasing a blue ladybug. Luigi felt relieved and happy. They sat together under a big tree, and the sun warmed them. Luigi realized that even when things seem difficult, you should never give up. Perseverance helped Luigi find his friend.

plan.problema: Luigi got lost among the roses and couldn't find his friend butterfly, Stella.
plan.svolta: Luigi tried to call Stella with his metallic voice, but nobody heard him, so he started waving his arms silly to get her attention.
plan.finale: Stella arrived flying and hugged Luigi, happy to have found him among the leaves.

luigi.text:
Luigi was a little teddy bear. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. Luigi loved his garden very much. Every day he enjoyed rolling among the daisies and exploring the rose bushes.

 

One afternoon, Luigi felt a great fear. He was lost! He had ended up among a sea of red and yellow tulips. He couldn't find his friend, Pippo, the gnome who lived in a wooden house under an apple tree. Pippo had promised to tell him a story about the world.
