Luigi was alarmed. He tried to call Pippo, but his little voice was too small to be heard. Then Luigi decided to do something. He started to spin his orange wheel, the one he had on his tummy. He spun and spun, hoping to see Pippo from far away.

 

Luigi kept spinning, faster and faster. The sun shone brightly in the sky. Suddenly, Luigi heard a laugh! A small, happy and joyful laugh. Luigi stopped immediately. He followed the sound and, there he was! Pippo was sitting next to a large white lily, waiting for him with a smile.

 

Luigi ran to him and hugged his paw tightly. He was so happy to be found. Luigi’s perseverance, in spinning his wheel, had brought him happiness. And Luigi understood that even when things seem difficult, you should never give up looking for what you love.

plan.problema: Luigi got lost among the flowers and couldn't find his friend, the gnome Pippo.
plan.svolta: He decided to take a big spin on his wheel, hoping to see Pippo from afar.
plan.finale: Finally, hearing a laugh, Luigi found himself next to the gnome who was waiting for him with a smile.

luigi.text:
Luigi was a very special teddy bear. He lived in a secret garden full of fragrant roses and colorful flowers. Luigi loved to be there, watching the bees buzz and the birds sing. One day, while playing among the bushes, he found himself completely lost. The roses were so many, so big, that he couldn’t see his friend, gnome Barnaba.

“Oh no!” said Luigi, with his voice a little wobbly. “Barnaba told me to wait for him here! But I’ve disappeared!” He started to turn around the roses, trying to figure out where his friend had ended up. He was very worried. 

Luigi had an idea. He decided to use his loudest laugh to attract Barnaba’s attention. He tried to laugh, but only the squirrels responded, jumping from branch to branch and collecting nuts. Luigi felt a little disappointed.

Then, Luigi stopped and listened carefully. In between the rustling of the leaves and the singing of the birds, he heard a gentle tinkling sound. It was a delicate and unexpected sound. Luigi followed that sound and, to his surprise, he saw Barnaba picking red berries on a small bush.

“Barnaba!” shouted Luigi happily. The gnome turned around, smiling at Luigi. “How did you find yourself?” asked Barnaba. Luigi replied: “By listening carefully.” 

Luigi and Barnaba continued to play together in the secret garden, knowing that sometimes all it takes is a little patience and listening to solve problems. And so, Luigi learned that calmness is often the key to finding what you’ve lost.

plan.problema: Luigi got lost among the roses and couldn't find his friend, the gnome Barnaby.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his loudest laugh to attract the gnome’s attention, but only the squirrels responded.
plan.finale: Luigi listened carefully and heard a faint tinkling sound, following the sound he found Barnaby collecting berries.

luigi.text:
Luigi was a very special teddy bear. He lived in a secret garden, full of fragrant flowers and big trees. He loved to play among the red roses and the white lilies. His favorite friend was a little ray of sunshine that every day lit up his face.

One afternoon, Luigi got curious. He had wandered too far from the other roses and suddenly couldn’t find his friend anymore. Everything looked the same: roses, green leaves, and wet earth. Luigi felt a little scared. He didn’t know where the ray of sunshine had gone.

He decided to do something. He started to sing a happy song that reminded him of his mommy. “Oh, oh, oh, sing with me!” Luigi said, but only the butterflies answered him on the roses. The butterflies were beautiful, but they weren’t the ray of sunshine.

Suddenly, Luigi heard a sound: “tinkle, tinkle”. He followed the sound and saw a little bell vibrating among the flowers. The tinkling led him through the secret garden. Finally, Luigi found the ray of sunshine! The sun was there waiting for him with a bright smile. 

Luigi ran to the sun and hugged him. He was happy to be found again. He understood that even when you get lost, a little kindness and a sound can help you find your friends. Luigi and the ray of sunshine played together all afternoon.

plan.problema: Luigi got lost among the roses and couldn't find his friend, a little ray of sunshine.
plan.svolta: He decided to sing a cheerful song to attract the sun's attention, but only the butterflies responded.
plan.finale: Luigi followed the sound of a tinkling and finally found the ray of sunshine that was waiting for him with a bright smile.

luigi.text:
Luigi was a little teddy bear. He lived in the Flower Garden, a place full of colors and smells. There were red roses, yellow tulips, blue violets, and tall sunflowers. Luigi loved to watch the flowers, but sometimes he also enjoyed rolling among the leaves.

One day, while he was playing, Luigi realized he didn't know where he was anymore. He was surrounded by so many beautiful flowers that he couldn't tell which was his place. He was lost! Every flower looked the same as the other, and Luigi felt a little scared.

Luigi decided to shout for help. “Help! I’m lost!” he shouted with all his might. But no one answered. No bird, no insect, no flower, listened to him. It was as if he had disappeared into the garden.

Stumbling onto a branch, Luigi saw a little squirrel eating a nut. “Excuse me,” said Luigi, “I’m lost and I don’t know how to get home.” The squirrel, named Pippo, listened carefully to Luigi. Then, pointing with his paw, he said, "Follow the path to the big tree. Your little house is under the tree."

Luigi thanked Pippo and ran along the path. After a few steps, he saw his wooden house, just like he remembered it. He was happy! Luigi climbed into his house and immediately felt safe. 

Luigi realized that even when things seem difficult, you shouldn't give up. Continuing to look for the solution always leads to the right result.

plan.problema: Luigi got lost among so many colorful flowers and couldn't find his place anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to shout for help loudly, but no one seemed to hear him.
plan.finale: A little squirrel showed him the path to his little house under the big tree.

marmaid.text:
Coralia the mermaid lived in the Blue Bay. She was a porcelain white mermaid, with a bright blue dress and very long golden braids. She loved to play among the seaweed and collect colorful seashells. One day, Coralia was building a very tall tower with thousands of red and green seashells. She was so focused that she got lost!

All the seashells looked the same. She couldn’t figure out where her home was anymore. And most of all, she couldn’t find her favorite coral, a bright red coral that her mermaid grandma had given her as a gift. It was a special coral that shone like a little star.

Coralia was very sad. She sat down on a smooth rock and sighed. Then she had an idea! “I have to use my tail!” thought Coralia. She started swimming quickly, trying to follow the smell of the coral. But the sea air was full of different smells: salt, seaweed, fish... She couldn’t find the scent of her coral.

Coralia kept swimming and sniffing. She heard a sweet sound, a distant music. It was the music that mermaids make when they sing! Coralia followed the sound to a big blue pebble. And there, under the pebble, shone her red coral, just like a little star! Coralia was very happy and took it in her fins. 

The music of the mermaids got louder. Coralia realized that even when something seems difficult, you shouldn’t give up. And in the end, with a little perseverance, you always find the solution.

plan.problema: Coralie is lost among the thousand shells and can't find her favorite coral.
plan.svolta: She decided to use her fin to swim faster and sniff the air to follow the scent of the coral.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the sound of the sirens’ music, she found her coral shining under a large pebble.

marmaid.text:
Coralia was a porcelain mermaid. She lived in a crystal-clear lake, so clear you could see the little fish playing underwater. The lake was beautiful, but Coralia didn’t find it sparkling like before. She had lost her shimmering gem, a precious stone that shone in the sunlight and made the lake magical.

Coralia felt sad. Without the gem, the lake seemed dull. She looked everywhere: among the floating water lilies, under the pebble bridges, even in the deep water. But the gem was gone.

Then Coralia decided to ask for help. She saw some red fish swimming happily. “Red fish, red fish,” she called, “can you help me? I’ve lost a precious gem and the lake doesn’t shine anymore.” The red fish nodded and led her to a dark cave, hidden behind a waterfall of bubbles.

Inside the cave was damp and full of seashells. Coralia looked carefully and, finally, she saw something that was shining! The shimmering gem was stuck in a little nook between the seashells. Carefully, Coralia took it.

Coralia brought the gem back to the center of the lake. Immediately, the stone began to shine, reflecting the sunlight and lighting up the whole lake with bright colors. The lake was magical again! Coralia smiled happily. Perseverance had done its job.

plan.problema: Coralie has lost her sparkling gem and can't make the lake shine.
plan.svolta: She decided to ask for help from the little red fish, who guided her to a dark cave.
plan.finale: She found the gem trapped in a seashell nook and brought it back to the center of the lake, where it shone even brighter.

marmaid.text:
Sirena Luna lived in the Blue Lake. She was a porcelain white mermaid, with long blue hair and a shimmering dress. She loved to sing beautiful melodies that made the water lilies dance on the water’s surface. But one day, something changed.

Sirena Luna realized she couldn’t sing anymore. She was sad. She looked everywhere for her pearls, small iridescent gems that she always wore around her neck. The pearls were gone! Without them, her voice had become a whisper.

She started looking among the floating water lilies, moving gently in the clear water of the Blue Lake. But the pearls were too small to see. They were like tiny stars hiding in the shadows. Sirena Luna felt more and more desperate.

Then, she had an idea. She started to sing a special melody, a song that she only used when she needed help. Her voice, even though it was weak, echoed through the lake. Suddenly, a group of fat, curious, and friendly fish approached.

“What’s happening?” asked the fish. Sirena Luna explained her situation. The fish, with their fast fins, started to search around the jutting rock. And indeed, under the rock, were the pearls! She had dropped them when she lost her balance on a current.

The fat fish helped Sirena Luna find her pearls. Then, with one last song, Sirena Luna started to sing her most beautiful melody. Cooperation and mutual help had solved the problem. The pearls shone brightly in the sun of the Blue Lake.

plan.problema: The Siren Luna has lost her pearls and can’t sing her melody anymore.
plan.svolta: She tried to look among the water lilies, but the pearls were too small to see in the clear water.
plan.finale: Then she used her song to call for help, and a group of fat fish guided her to her hidden pearls under a rock.

marmaid.text:
Coralia was a coral mermaid. She always lived in her world, the Red Fish. 
The Red Fish was full of green seaweed and smooth stones. 
Coralia loved her coral very much, a beautiful bright pink color. 
But today the coral wasn't shining anymore.

Coralia looked around. “Oh no!” she exclaimed. 
“I’ve lost my sparkling gem! Without it, my coral is dull.” 
The gem was a precious stone that reflected the sunlight and made the coral bright. 
Coralia had tried to look in every corner, but there was no trace of her gem.

“I must be patient,” thought Coralia. 
She decided to explore every corner of the Red Fish. 
She squeezed between the green seaweed and climbed up a large smooth stone. 
She looked under the stones, inside the empty shells, and behind the coral plants.

After a lot of searching, Coralia noticed a small hidden nook behind a rock. 
Carefully, she reached out and grabbed her sparkling gem! 
It was stuck there, in the mud and seaweed.

Coralia put the gem back in its place. 
Immediately Coralia’s coral began to shine with a wonderful pink light. 
The Red Fish was full of colors and splendor again. 
Coralia smiled happily. 

Patience, even when things seem difficult, can always lead to the discovery of what we are looking for.

plan.problema: Coralie has lost her sparkling gem and can’t make her coral shine.
plan.svolta: She decided to explore every corner of the Red Fish, searching among the seaweed and under the rocks.
plan.finale: Finally, she found the gem trapped in a crevice, returning the shine to the coral.

marmaid.text:
Sirena Luna lived in the Sand Beach. She was a special mermaid, because she could talk and move! Her underwater house was beautiful, full of decorations made with colorful shells. But one day, Siren Luna noticed that the shells were gone.

“Oh no!” she said. “Where did they go? I can’t make my house shiny anymore!” She was desperate. She started to look everywhere. She looked among the green seaweed and the white pebbles, but the shells weren’t there. She looked for them under the waves that crashed on the sand, but nothing!

Siren Luna was so sad that she almost cried. She tried to ask for help from the little crab who lived near her house, but the crab was too busy collecting crustaceans to help her.

Then she had a brilliant idea! “Maybe the starfish can help me,” she thought. Siren Luna called the brightest starfish and asked them to help her find her lost shells. The starfish shone brightly and followed the light of the shells.

Together, they looked under a big rock. And there, hidden among the rocks, were the colorful shells! Siren Luna was so happy. She picked up the shells and ran home to decorate her underwater house. 

She was so happy to have found her shells thanks to the help of the starfish. With her friend, the little crab, they learned that working together makes everything easier.

plan.problema: The Siren Luna has lost her colorful shells and can no longer decorate her underwater house.
plan.svolta: Desperate, she tried to look for them among the seaweed, but the shells were everywhere!
plan.finale: Then she had an idea: she asked for help from the starfish that shone and together they found the hidden shells under a rock.

marmaid.text:
Sirena Stella lived on Sand Beach. She was a toy mermaid, made of colorful and shiny plastic. She had a blue tail and green hair that waved in the wind. Sirena Stella loved to make the fish dance very much. Every day she sang a special song and the little fish moved in a fun ballet.

But one day, something had changed. When Sirena Stella opened her mouth to sing, no melody came out. Only a dull silence. The fish around her didn't move anymore. They were confused and scared. “Oh no!” said Sirena Stella. “I’ve lost my melody!”

Sirena Stella began to look everywhere. She looked under the big white seashells, she peered among the green seaweed that clung to the rocks. She looked behind the round boulders, but she didn’t find anything. She was very sad. She didn’t know what to do to make the fish dance again.

Then, Sirena Stella had an idea. She closed her eyes and began to sing a new song. A slow, sweet, and quiet song. Her words were simple and gentle. The fish, curious, came closer.

The melody of Sirena Stella was different, but beautiful. The fish began to move slowly, first a little, then faster and faster. They danced in harmony, following the rhythm of Sirena Stella’s voice. The toy mermaid smiled happily. She had found the solution!

The fish continued to move with grace and beauty. Sirena Stella knew that even when things seem difficult, finding a new way to express yourself can lead to wonderful results.

plan.problema: The Siren Stella has lost her melody and can’t make the fish dance anymore.
plan.svolta: After searching under the seashells and among the seaweed, she decided to sing a new song, slow and sweet.
plan.finale: The fish, fascinated by the new melody, began to move harmoniously, and Siren Stella smiled satisfied.

marmaid.text:
Sirena Sofia was a glass mermaid. She lived in a beautiful glass, full of other toys. She was happy, but today she felt sad. She had lost her sparkly bracelet! The bracelet had lots of little colorful beads and Sofia loved it very much.

“Oh no, oh no!” said Sofia, wiggling in the glass. “I can’t find it! It’s so shiny and now it doesn’t make me pretty!” She looked among the porcelain dolls, among the plastic soldiers, and even among the toy cars. But the bracelet was gone.

Sofia felt desperate. Tears were about to fall from her big blue eyes. “I have to do something!” she exclaimed, and without thinking twice, she made a big jump into the glass. 

But instead of landing softly on the table, Sofia rolled down! She ended up bumping into the edge of the table, then she slid away. It was a big mess!

Sofia’s dad, a smiling teddy bear named Bruno, saw what was happening. Bruno was always patient and kind. With a soft ball of wool, Bruno gently pulled Sofia up. 

Just at that moment, Sofia saw her sparkly bracelet! It was under her leg. “I found it!” she shouted happily.

Sofia got her bracelet and put it on right away. She felt like a beautiful mermaid again. Bruno smiled, happy that Sofia was happy. It was important to look for things calmly and patiently, because even the biggest problems can be solved.

plan.problema: Sofia had lost it from her collection and couldn't find her shiny bracelet.
plan.svolta: Desperate, Sofia made a big jump into the glass, but she ended up rolling down the table!
plan.finale: Sofia’s dad, a teddy bear, pulled her up with a ball of wool and she immediately found her bracelet.

marmaid.text:
Stella the Siren lived at Peaceful Lake. She was a porcelain siren, with a bright blue dress and a long silver tail. She loved to sing, but one day she noticed that she could no longer find her favorite melody. She used to hear it so often, when the sun shone on the lake water. But now, her song was empty.

She was very sad. She sat down on the shore, near the floating water lilies. “Oh no,” said Stella, “where did my song go?” She tried to remember the notes, but nothing. It was as if a piece of her heart had disappeared. A little red fish, Pipì, was swimming around her. “What’s wrong, Stella?” asked Pipì.

Stella explained her problem. Pipì thought for a while and said, “Maybe the sound of the waterfall will help you remember your melody.” The waterfall was right behind the lake, a small stream that made a constant noise. 

Stella got up and ran towards the waterfall. The water fell with force, creating a loud, continuous sound. Stella the Siren listened carefully. Suddenly, a familiar note resonated in her head. It was her melody! She started to sing again, with joy and happiness. Her song filled the air of Peaceful Lake.

Stella realized that sometimes, the solution to finding something important is right beside us.

plan.problema: The Siren Stella has lost her favorite melody and can't sing anymore.
plan.svolta: She decided to search for the sound of the waterfall, hoping it could remind her of a lost note.
plan.finale: Reaching the waterfall, the noise of the water had awakened the melody, and Stella could sing again with joy.
plan.morale: Sometimes, the solution is right in front of us.

marmaid.text:
Stella the mermaid lived on the golden sand beach. She was a toy mermaid, but she could talk and move as if she were really alive. Her scales shimmered in the sun and her blue hair floated even when there was no wind.

One day, Stella the mermaid noticed a problem. She had lost her sparkly bracelet! That bracelet was special, she had received it from her mermaid grandma. And then, something wasn't right: Penelope, the little snail, was gone. She was always with her on the beach and now she had disappeared.

Stella the mermaid began to look everywhere. She looked under the big pink and white seashells. She looked among the tall grass near the shore. But Penelope wasn’t there. “Oh no!” said Stella the mermaid, worried.

Suddenly, she had an idea. She raised her little gaze to the starry sky. “Maybe the stars can help me,” she thought. The stars seemed to shine brighter and Stella the mermaid asked them for a clue. 

The stars moved slowly and pointed with their light towards a small hole in the dune. And there, under a pile of pebbles, was the sparkly bracelet! But next to the bracelet was Penelope, who had made her way through the pebbles.

Stella the mermaid ran to hug her. Together, happy to be reunited, they returned to the golden sand beach. The stars shone even brighter that night. Stella the mermaid realized that asking for help and sharing her worry can lead to great results.

plan.problema: The Siren Stella had lost her sparkling bracelet and couldn’t find her friend Penelope the snail.
plan.svolta: After searching under the seashells, she decided to ask for help from the stars in the sky.
plan.finale: The stars showed the right direction and Siren Stella found her bracelet and Penelope, happy to be reunited.

marmaid.text:
Sirena Sofia lived on Sand Beach. She was a beautiful toy mermaid with long green hair and a sparkly dress. She loved to play among the seashells and the warm sun. One day, while chasing a white starfish, she got lost. Her toy ocean was so big! She couldn't find her house under the pier anymore.

She was scared. The plastic waves seemed enormous and the colorful sands surrounded her everywhere. She desperately searched, but everything seemed the same. “Mommy? Daddy?” she called, but no one answered.

Then, Sirena Sofia had an idea. She decided to sing a sweet song, the one her mommy always sang to her before bedtime. But no one seemed to hear her. Her notes disappeared in the sound of the waves and the wind. She was sad.

Suddenly, a little toy fish floated near her. It had big blue eyes and a colorful fin. “I heard you singing,” said the fish. “Follow me, I’ll show you the way to the pier.”

The fish led Sirena Sofia through the sand dunes. He took her along a secret path made of smooth pebbles. Finally, she saw her family under the pier: her mommy, her daddy, and all her other mermaid brothers and sisters. She was happy! She splashed among them, happy to be home.

She had learned that even when things seem difficult, a little patience can lead to the best solution.

plan.problema: Sofia got lost in her toy ocean and couldn't find her house under the pier anymore.
plan.svolta: She decided to sing a sweet song to attract the attention of the other toys, but nobody seemed to hear her.
plan.finale: Finally, a little toy fish showed her the way to the pier and her family.

minions.text:
Minion was a very happy minion. He lived in Nonna Giulia’s colorful kitchen. The kitchen had colorful plates, pink and blue furniture, and lots of fun things. Minion loved to play there.

---

One day, Minion noticed something terrible. All the glitter was gone! There used to be lots of glitter on him: red glitter, yellow glitter, blue glitter. Now he was just a gray minion. “Oh no!” said Minion. “Where did my glitter go?”

---

Minion started to look everywhere. He looked under the table, behind the fridge, and inside the cupboard. He didn’t find anything. Then he decided to ask for help from the spoon. The spoon was in the tea that Nonna Giulia was making. “Spoonie, did you see my glitter?” asked Minion. The spoon just stirred the tea with a straw. It was too busy!

---

Minion thought for a while. Then he had an idea! He saw a bag of candy floss next to the table. He took the candy floss and started to draw on the mat. He drew a long, sparkly trail. And as he drew, he heard a noise. Under the table, among the old newspapers, were his glitter! Minion picked them all up and became beautiful again.

---

Minion was happy. He had found his glitter thanks to patience and a little candy floss. Nonna Giulia smiled seeing Minion so happy. The colorful kitchen seemed even more cheerful. Minion realized that waiting a moment could lead to a big discovery.

plan.problema: Minion has lost all his glitter!
plan.svolta: He tried to ask the spoon for help, but the spoon was too busy stirring tea.
plan.finale: Then he found a bag of candy floss and used it to draw a sparkling trail, finding the glitter hidden under the table.

minions.text:
Minion was a very happy minion. He lived in the pastel kitchen of Grandma Emilia. The kitchen had pink walls, a yellow table, and lots of rainbow bowls. Minion loved to play among the pots and pans. It was his favorite place in the world!

One day, Minion noticed something terrible: his glitter was gone! Red glitter, blue glitter, green glitter… all of it! Without glitter, Minion wasn’t a happy minion anymore. He felt sad and a little confused. Where could they have gone?

Minion decided to ask for help. He found the wooden spoon he was mixing sugar for Grandma Emilia’s cake. “Spoon, did you see my glitter?” Minion asked. The spoon just replied, “No, no, I’m stirring! I have to make the cake!” He was too busy to help Minion.

Minion continued to look. He examined under the table, inside the bowls, and behind the cupboard. Then, there they were! The glitter was hidden right under the big glass bowl. They had fallen when Grandma Emilia was making cookies.

Minion had a wonderful time collecting all the glitter with his little yellow hands. He was finally a sparkly and happy minion again! The kitchen looked even more colorful and cheerful. Minion realized that, even though it’s sometimes hard to wait, looking calmly and patiently can lead to the best solution.

plan.problema: Minion has lost all his glitter!
plan.svolta: He tried to ask for help from the spoon, but the spoon was too busy stirring the sugar.
plan.finale: Minion found the glitter hidden under the bowl and collected it with enthusiasm.

minions.text:
Minion was a very happy minion. He lived in Nonna Rosa’s colorful kitchen. 

The kitchen had pink tables, yellow chairs, and lots of chocolate spots! 

Minion loved to play there, rolling on the carpets and making bubbles.

One day, Minion noticed something wasn't right. He had lost his favorite banana! 

It was a big, golden banana, the one he liked best in the whole world. “Oh no!” said Minion, upset. “Where did I put it? I can’t find it anywhere.”

Minion started to look everywhere. He looked under the tables, behind the chairs, and in the fruit basket. He even looked in the oven, but the banana wasn't there. “Maybe it fell!” thought Minion, getting more and more worried. Nonna Rosa was making cookies and heard Minion complaining.

“Wait a minute,” said Minion. He squatted down and started to sniff with his nose. He sniffed, sniffed, sniffed! Minion’s nose was yellow and moved very quickly. Suddenly, he smelled a sweet, fruity smell.

Following the smell, Minion found the banana! It was hidden inside a bag of french fries. Nonna Rosa had put it there by mistake! 

Minion was so happy. He took his favorite banana and hugged it tight. He had found his treasure thanks to patience. 

Minion understood that even when things seem lost, you shouldn’t give up and look calmly.

plan.problema: The Minion has lost his favorite banana and can't find his place.
plan.svolta: After searching under the tables and behind the chairs, he decides to use his nose to sniff the smell of the banana.
plan.finale: Finally, he finds the banana hidden in a bag of chips, happy and satisfied.

minions.text:
Minion Freeze was a special minion. He was made of colorful plastic and had lots of glitter! Every time the light hit him, he shone like a star. He lived in Grandma Rosa’s kitchen, a kitchen full of colors and sweet smells.

But today Minion Freeze wasn’t shining anymore. He was sad. He had lost all his glitter! He looked around, but they were completely gone. “Oh no!” he exclaimed. “I’m not a sparkling minion anymore!”

Minion Freeze started to look for them. First, he looked under the table where he played often. But the glitter was too small. He couldn’t see them at all. He was frustrated. He sat on the floor, deflated and without light.

Then, Biscuit, Grandma Rosa’s cat, arrived. Biscuit was a soft and cuddly cat, with a big whisker. “What’s wrong, Minion Freeze?” meowed Biscuit.

Minion Freeze explained his problem. Biscuit thought for a little while. Then he had an idea! He took a small bucket and went under the sink. He turned on the faucet and started to spray water on Minion Freeze. The water, along with the remaining glitter, made Minion Freeze shine again!

Minion Freeze was so happy. He thanked Biscuit for helping him. Together, they had fun making the minion shine with the water from the faucet. 
It was nice to work together to solve problems.

plan.problema: Minion Gelo has lost all his glitter and can't shine anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to look under the table, but the glitter was too small to see.
plan.finale: Then he had an idea: he asked the cat Biscotto to spray him with the water from the tap, and he started shining again immediately!

minions.text:
Minion Giggling loved colorful cooking. He was a yellow minion, small and happy, perfect for making bubbles. Every day, in that kitchen full of colors, Minion Giggling made big bubbles, big, big bubbles! But today something wasn't right. Minion Giggling wasn't smiling anymore. He couldn’t make bubbles! He was sad.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Minion Giggling. “I’ve lost my smile!” He started to look everywhere. He looked under the table, where there were chocolate spots. He looked behind the red chair, the one with the wheels. But nothing! No smile to find.

Suddenly, Minion Giggling had an idea. He took his spray bottle, the one he used to make bubbles. He pointed it up high and... puff! A puff of yellow foam filled the kitchen. The foam turned into a giant cloud of bubbles!

Minion Giggling looked at the cloud, then he smiled. A big, bright smile! And, of course, he made lots and lots of bubbles of soap. The bubbles floated in the air, they shone in the sun. Next to him was a cookie, his favorite friend, who watched him happily.

Minion Giggling continued to make bubbles, laughing and jumping between the containers of flour and sugar. The colorful bubbles danced around his cookie friends, creating a party full of joy. The kitchen was full of magic and yellow foam.

Creativity can transform even the saddest day into a moment full of happiness.

plan.problema: Minion Giggling lost his smile and can’t make bubbles anymore!
plan.svolta: After looking under the table and behind the chair, Minion Giggling had an idea: he used his spray to create a bubble cloud and found his smile!
plan.finale: Minion Giggling made lots of colorful bubbles, laughing happily with his cookie friends.

minions.text:
Minion Pippo lived in the happy kitchen. He was a special minion, always ready to laugh and play. His favorite kitchen was his grandma’s, full of colors and yummy smells. He had lots of friends, other minions, but his favorite banana was the most important.

One day, Minion Pippo noticed something wasn't right. His yellow, smooth, and sweet banana was gone! He looked everywhere. He looked under the dining table, a big table with lots of colorful chairs. He checked behind the chairs, but nothing. The banana was gone.

Minion Pippo was very sad. He didn't know where he had put his banana. He started running back and forth in the happy kitchen, but the problem stayed the same: the banana was lost! He felt a little frustrated. 

Then, he had an idea. “Maybe someone can help me!” thought Minion Pippo. He ran to the fridge, a big white fridge with lots of food inside. “Fridge, fridge,” said Minion Pippo, “did you see my banana?” The fridge smiled and pointed with its door: “Look inside your little backpack!”

Minion Pippo opened his backpack and there, exactly where he never thought he would put it, was his favorite banana! He was happy. He had found his banana thanks to the fridge. Minion Pippo remembered to always put things back where they belong.

plan.problema: Minion Peppe has lost his favorite banana and can’t find his place!
plan.svolta: After looking under the tables and behind the chairs, Peppe decides to ask for help from the fridge.
plan.finale: The fridge, with a smile, points to Peppe exactly where he had left his banana: inside his little backpack!
plan.morale: Always remember where you put things!

minions.text:
Minions was a very happy minion. He lived in the kitchen of Grandma Emilia. The kitchen was full of colors and yummy smells. There were big pots, shiny pans, and lots of sweets. Minions especially loved cookies! He had a box full, all delicious and golden.

But today there was a problem! Minions noticed that the box was empty. “Oh no!” he cried. “My cookies have disappeared!” He looked everywhere. Under the table, behind the chair, even inside the closet. But all the cookies were gone.

Minions tried to look under the table, but the cookies were too many to count all at once. He was really confused. Grandma Emilia entered the kitchen and saw Minions so sad. “What’s wrong, sweetheart?” she asked. “My cookies have disappeared!” Minions replied with a worried voice.

Grandma Emilia thought for a moment. Then she took a colorful string, the blue one she used to hang laundry. With the string and a piece of cardboard, Minions built a small trap right next to the empty box. 

“Look!” exclaimed Grandma Emilia. Minions pulled the string and… surprise! All the scattered cookies gathered in the basket. Minions laughed with joy. He was so happy! With the help of Grandma Emilia, everything was back to normal. 

Minions realized that even a small problem could become a big game if you worked together. And while eating a cookie, he smiled with a big smile.

plan.problema: The Minions have lost all their cookies!
plan.svolta: He tried to look under the table, but the cookies were too many to count all at once.
plan.finale: With the help of a colorful rope and a big smile, he made a trap to collect all the scattered cookies!

minions.text:
Minion was a very happy Minion. He lived in a colorful kitchen full of pots and pans. His favorite kitchen was Grandma’s. He liked to play there every day. But today, Minion had a problem. He had lost his favorite banana! It was a yellow and juicy banana, the best in the world.

Minion started to look everywhere. He looked under the dining table, behind the red chair, and even inside the cookie box. But the banana wasn’t there. Minion felt sad. He didn’t know what to do. His banana was important to him.

“Oh no, oh no, oh no!” said Minion, wiggling. He decided to ask for help. He walked up to the kitchen robot, a big white appliance. “Robot! Robot! Can you help me?” asked Minion. The kitchen robot didn’t answer right away. Then, with a metallic voice, it said, “Tell me what you’ve lost.”

Minion explained that he had lost his banana. The kitchen robot thought for a little while, then pointed at Minion with a mechanical arm. “Look in your hat,” said the robot. Minion looked inside his yellow hat and… there it was! His banana! It was hidden right inside his hat.

Minion jumped for joy. He had found his favorite banana! Now he was happy and content. Minion learned that, even if he gets upset sometimes, with a little patience, everything works out. And now, he had a delicious banana to eat.

plan.problema: The Minion has lost his favorite banana and doesn’t know how to find it.
plan.svolta: After searching under the tables and behind the chairs, the Minion decides to ask for help from the kitchen robot.
plan.finale: The kitchen robot, with its metallic voice, tells the Minion that the banana was hidden inside his own hat!

minions.text:
Minion was a special minion. He was a toy, made of yellow plush and sparkling black eyes. He lived in the kitchen of a little girl, but the kitchen was always his home. Minion loved to play there, especially with his friend, the blue bowl.

The blue bowl was sad. It wasn’t smiling anymore. Minion worried so much about her! She had lost her favorite bananas and knew that bananas always made the bowl smile. “Oh no!” thought Minion. “I must find my bananas!”

Minion started to look. He looked under the table, where crumbs of cookies often fell. He also looked behind the chair, but nothing! The bananas weren’t there. Minion felt a little down. Then he had an idea. He took his little electric scooter, the one he had received for Christmas, and decided to go for a long ride all around the kitchen.

His scooter made “vroooom” as Minion zoomed between the objects in the kitchen. He went around the fridge, passed by the oven, and looked in every corner. At one point, behind a tall stack of cookies, he saw it! A mountain of golden, fragrant cookies.

Minion ran to the bowl and offered him the cookies. The bowl took them gently and made… a big smile! Minion was happy. He had solved the problem and made his friend smile. The bowl responded with a bright smile, showing that even a small gesture can make a difference.

plan.problema: Minion has lost his bananas and doesn't know how to make his friend, the bowl, smile.
plan.svolta: After looking under the table and behind the chair, Minion decides to take a long ride around the kitchen using his little scooter.
plan.finale: Finding a pile of cookies, Minion offered them to the bowl, who responded with a big smile!

minions.text:
Grey Minion lived in a modern kitchen. He was a special minion, full of glitter! Every surface around him shone thanks to his amazing glow. The kitchen was full of new appliances and bright colors, but Grey Minion was always the brightest.

---

One day, Grey Minion noticed something wasn't right. His glitter was gone! He looked everywhere, under the glass table, behind the metal chairs. But there was no trace of glitter. He was sad. He couldn't shine like before. He had become a little dull.

---

His friend, a little red pot, comforted him: “Maybe you can find some hidden glitter!” Grey Minion continued to look, but without success. Then he had an idea! He had a small tube of white plaster in his toy box.

---

“That’s what I’ll do!” thought Grey Minion. He took the plaster and began to cover his body with layers and layers of white color. The plaster, once dry, created a sparkling effect, just like glitter!

---

Grey Minion’s smile became even brighter as he shone brighter than ever, happy to be shining again. The modern kitchen seemed even happier with his renewed glow. It was nice to use your imagination to solve a problem and to be the brightest minion in the room again.

plan.problema: Grey Minion has lost all his glitter and can’t shine anymore!
plan.svolta: After looking under the table and behind the chairs, Grey Minion had a brilliant idea: he used his little chalk to cover his body with glitter again!
plan.finale: Grey Minion’s smile became even brighter as he shone brighter than ever, happy to be back sparkling.

native americans.text:
Warrior was a Native American warrior made of wood. He lived in the Pine Forest, among the tall trees and silent pine groves. He was strong and brave, but sometimes he got lost in the big forest. One day, while walking around a gnarled root, Warrior realized he couldn't hear the voices of his friends anymore.

He was alone. The sun was starting to set and the forest was getting darker. Warrior felt a great fear. He couldn't find his tribe, his warrior brothers and sisters. He sat down on a smooth rock and felt sad.

Then, Warrior decided to do something. He decided to follow the sound of the wind among the trees. The wind was blowing hard, moving the fir needles. Warrior got up and started to walk, following the sound of the wind. He walked slowly, listening to the rustling of the leaves.

After a long time, he heard a distant sound. A sound of drums, laughter, and voices singing. It was the song of the tribal dance! Warrior ran towards the sound, through the bushes and among the trees. And then... he saw his friends! They were gathered around the fire, happy to have found him.

An old warrior smiled at Warrior and said, “Don’t worry, little warrior, you found the right way.” Warrior joined the tribal dance, happy to be with his family again. Patience had helped Warrior find his way home.

plan.problema: The Warrior was lost in the big forest and couldn't find his tribe.
plan.svolta: He decided then to follow the song of the wind among the trees, hoping it would guide him home.
plan.finale: Finally, he heard the sounds of the tribal dance and ran towards the sound, finding his friends.
plan.morale: Patience is the key to finding your way.

native americans.text:
Shaman was a man of wood, a Native American warrior. He lived in the Pine Forest, among his tall pine trees. Shaman loved to explore, but sometimes he got lost. One day, while playing hide-and-seek among the trees, he found himself in a green maze. He couldn’t find the path that would take him back home.

Shaman was scared. The trees all looked the same, tall and silent. He turned over and over, but he couldn’t recognize anything. “Oh no,” thought Shaman, “I’m lost!”

Then Shaman had an idea. He sat at the foot of a big pine and began to talk to the spirits of the trees. “Spirits of the forest,” said Shaman, “I offer you these colorful stones. They are a little gift for you.” He pulled out small red, blue, and yellow stones that he always kept with him.

A wise owl, sitting on a high branch, watched him. The owl beat its wings and pointed in a direction towards the west. “Follow the sun,” hooted the owl. Shaman followed the owl, and after a while, he saw his house. He was happy!

Shaman ran home, happy to be back. He sat by the fire and thought about the spirits of the forest. He had learned that even when you are lost, with patience and respect for nature, you can always find your way. Shaman knew that listening to the advice of others can help you overcome difficulties.

plan.problema: The Shaman got lost in the maze of trees and couldn’t find the path back to his home.
plan.svolta: He decided to speak with the spirits of the trees, offering them small colored stones as a gift.
plan.finale: A wise owl showed him the right way with a flap of his wings and the Shaman returned home happy.

native americans.text:
Hunter was a Native American made of leather and wood. He lived in the Flowered Prairie, among tall grasses and colorful flowers. He was a good hunter and loved his place. One day, Hunter wandered too far during the hunt. He had lost his map, the one made of colorful feathers that showed the way back to his family.

Hunter was worried. The prairie was big and full of trees. He didn’t recognize anything anymore. He tried to follow the stream, but he found himself in an unknown place. He was alone and scared. He thought about his sweetheart, Half Moon, and his little ones.

Suddenly, Hunter had an idea. He listened carefully. The wind was blowing through the tall grasses, carrying with it a sweet sound. He decided to follow the song of the wind. He stood up and moved slowly, following the direction of the sound.

The wind guided him through thorny bushes and twisted roots. Hunter didn’t give up. He continued to follow the song, trusting the air that whispered to him. Then, suddenly, he saw a clearing. And there, among the fragrant flowers, was his family! Half Moon was waiting for him with a big smile and a new basket full of juicy berries. 

Hunter ran to hug his loved ones. He was happy to be home. The wind had done something unexpected, but Hunter understood that listening to nature can always lead you to the right path.

plan.problema: The Hunter has lost his map and cannot find the path to return to his family.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the song of the wind, hoping it would guide him home.
plan.finale: The wind unexpectedly carried him to the clearing where his family was waiting for him with joy and a new basket full of berries.
plan.morale: Patience and listening lead to solutions.

native americans.text:
Shaman was a man of wood, a Native American warrior. He lived in Pine Forest and loved his home very much. Shaman had red hair made of felt and blue eyes of glass. He wore a long striped cotton tunic.

One day, Shaman noticed that something wasn’t right. Pine Forest had become gray. The pine trees, the leaves, the sky – everything seemed dull. The wind had taken all of its colors! It had taken the orange of the sun, the green of the plants, and the blue of the lake.

Shaman felt very sad. Pine Forest had become a quiet and joyless place. He decided to do something. He gathered fresh leaves and colorful stones from the forest. Patiently, he built a small altar in the center of the clearing.

“Wind,” said Shaman, “I have made this gift for you. I hope you can return to find your magic.”

A long gust of wind approached the altar. The wind swirled around the colorful stones and the fresh leaves. Then, slowly, the colors returned! The orange of the sun shone brightly again, the green of the plants glowed anew, and the blue of the lake sparkled.

The wind thanked Shaman and Pine Forest became a wonderful place again. The birds sang, the squirrels played, and the flowers bloomed. Shaman smiled happily. He realized that even a small kind gesture could bring great joy. The forest was once again full of beauty, just as it should be.

plan.problema: The wind had lost all its colors, making the forest gray and sad.
plan.svolta: Shaman built an altar with fresh leaves and colorful stones, hoping that the wind would return to find its magic.
plan.finale: The wind, attracted by the offering, regained its colors and filled the forest with beauty once more.

native americans.text:
Cousin Cloud was a Native American made of wood. He lived in the Flowery Meadow and loved to play among the flowers. He had a special pendant made with colorful feathers. He liked his pendant so much, he always kept it close to his chest.

One day, Cousin Cloud noticed that his pendant was missing! He was very worried. Without his pendant, he couldn’t find his animal friends: Red Squirrel and Snow White Bunny. They were all scared and confused.

Cousin Cloud thought, thought, thought. He decided to follow the stream that ran through the meadow. “Maybe,” he said to himself, “the feathers from the pendant took me to a new place full of surprises.” He walked slowly along the stream, watching the water lilies and the birds.

Red Squirrel reached him soon. “Cousin Cloud!” said Red Squirrel, “we’re lost! We don’t know how to get home!” Cousin Cloud continued to follow the stream, and finally he saw something big: a giant daisy. The pendant was stuck in one of its petals!

Cousin Cloud carefully took it and gave it back to Red Squirrel and Snow White Bunny. All three of them hugged each other happily. Cousin Cloud realized that, even when things seem difficult, patience can lead to the best solution. The sun was setting over the Flowery Meadow, painting the sky pink and orange.

plan.problema: Cousin Cloud has lost his feather pendant and can't find his animal friends.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the stream, hoping the feathers had taken him to a new place full of surprises.
plan.finale: He found the pendant stuck in a giant daisy and his animal friends welcomed him with joy.

native americans.text:
Hunter was a wooden Native American warrior. He lived in the Pine Forest. He had red hair and a long blue tunic. He was always ready for an adventure. One day, Hunter was exploring the forest. The big pinecones were everywhere. Hunter enjoyed running among the pinecones, but then he got lost. He couldn't find his path anymore.

“Oh no!” said Hunter. “I’m completely lost! All these pinecones look the same!” He sat down on a big pinecone and waited. But no one came to help him. The sun was beginning to set, and the forest was getting darker.

Hunter decided to do something. He listened carefully to the wind. He decided to follow the sound of the wind among the tall trees. “Maybe the wind will guide me home,” thought Hunter. He walked for a while, following the whistle of the wind. The wind pushed him sometimes to the right, sometimes to the left.

Suddenly, Hunter heard a familiar sound. It was a sweet and clear sound: the sound of the bells of his brothers. Hunter ran towards the light. He saw his brothers waiting for him near the path. Running towards them, he reached safety.

The wind had stopped blowing. Hunter settled down next to his brothers, happy to be back home. Patience is a valuable virtue, and Hunter had learned it that day.

plan.problema: The Hunter got lost among the big pine cones and couldn’t find his way back.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the sound of the wind among the trees, hoping it would guide him home.
plan.finale: Finally, he heard the sound of his brothers’ bells and ran towards the light.

native americans.text:
Hunter was an Native American made of wood. He was tall and strong, with a brown fur coat and a bow in his hand. He lived in Bosco Forest, among the tall trees and thick bushes. Hunter loved to run and jump, but he also enjoyed watching the world around him sometimes.

One day, while playing hide-and-seek with his Native American friends, Hunter went too far away. When he tried to go back, he couldn't find his family anymore. He was scared and alone in Bosco Forest. “Where are you?” he said, but no one answered.

Hunter was very sad. He walked for a long time, looking for his friends with his eyes. He didn’t see anything familiar. Then, Hunter decided to do something. He remembered that Native Americans loved the river. “Maybe the river will take me to my people,” he thought.

Hunter started to follow the sound of the water. He walked along the riverbank, passing by plants and wildflowers. The river flowed quickly and Hunter followed it with determination. After a while, he heard voices. They were the voices of his Native American friends!

Hunter ran towards the sound and finally arrived at the camp. His friends hugged him happily to see him again. Hunter was happy to be home. He had learned that even when you get lost, with a little courage and perseverance, you can always find your way back to those you love.

plan.problema: The Hunter got lost in the forest and couldn't find his Native American family.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the sound of a river, hoping it would lead him to his people.
plan.finale: Finally, the Hunter heard the voices of his friends and reached their camp happily.

native americans.text:
Hunter was a wooden Native American warrior. He lived in Green Valley, a place full of tall trees and green meadows. Hunter loved to run among the mountains, but this time he got lost. The sun was setting and Green Valley seemed much bigger and scarier.

Hunter couldn’t hear the voices of his friends anymore. He didn’t see their bright colors. He was just him, a little wooden warrior, lost among the rocks. “I must find my tribe,” thought Hunter, trying to remember the way. But every tree looked just like the other.

Suddenly, Hunter heard a noise. It was the sound of water flowing. He decided to follow it. He walked along the rock, dodging bushes and stones. The water was leading him down the valley. He hoped the water would lead him to the river where his tribe had built a big fire to signal their location.

After a long walk, Hunter heard voices. They were strong and happy voices. Following the sounds, Hunter ran as fast as he could. He finally reached the camp. The tribe was waiting for him, happy to see him again. Everyone hugged him tightly. The chief smiled at Hunter.

Hunter felt safe and happy. He was home. He learned that even when things seem difficult, if you don’t give up, you always find your way.

plan.problema: The Hunter got lost in the mountains and couldn't find his tribe.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the sound of water, hoping it would lead him to the river where his tribe had built a large fire to signal their location.
plan.finale: The Hunter heard the voices of his tribe and finally reached the camp, welcomed with joy and hugs.

native americans.text:
Hunter was a Native American made of wood. He lived in the Pine Forest, among tall and quiet trees. He was a brave hunter, always ready for an adventure. One day, while exploring the forest, he went too far. The trees were so tall that Hunter couldn't see his path anymore.

“Ugh! Ugh!” said Hunter, trying to remember where he had gone. He was lost! He felt a little scared. The trees seemed very big and dark around him. He couldn’t understand how to go back.

Hunter decided to call for help. He remembered the words he had learned from the birds and the wolves. “Caw! Caw!” he shouted, imitating the sound of the starlings. “Wooof! Wooof!” he replied, trying to speak like a wolf. Silence.

Then he saw a little white rabbit. Hunter said, “Pip! Pip!” which meant “Help!”. The rabbit looked at him with his black eyes and began to move his head in one direction.

Hunter followed the rabbit, step by step. The rabbit was very kind and moved slowly. After a while, Hunter felt something familiar: the smell of his path.

The rabbit led him to the edge of the forest, where Hunter recognized his path. He was happy! He turned to thank the rabbit, but the animal was already gone among the trees. Hunter understood that even a little help can make a difference.

plan.problema: The Hunter got lost among the tall trees and couldn’t find his way back.
plan.svolta: He decided to call all his animal friends, using the words he imitated from the birds and the wolves, to ask for help.
plan.finale: A rabbit gently led him to the edge of the forest, where he recognized his path.

native americans.text:
Shaman was a man made of wood, an American Native made of cloth and bright colors. He lived in the Pine Forest, among the tall trees and the scent of resin. Shaman loved the forest, its long shadows and the song of the birds. But one morning, something wasn't right.

The Pine Forest had become gray. All the leaves on the trees had disappeared! It was as if someone had dusted the entire forest with a large gray brush. Shaman felt sad. The trees without leaves looked dull and silent.

Shaman decided to do something. He looked for the wind, calling it softly. He tried to sing a song that his grandmother had taught him, a song to ask the wind to return. But the wind didn't answer. Was it too far away, perhaps?

Shaman thought and thought. Then he had an idea. He collected colorful stones: red, yellow, blue, green. With the stones, he built a small altar under the biggest tree. He took fragrant flowers, those that grew near the stream.

Shaman placed the altars and flowers on the stone altar. He closed his eyes and continued to sing his song. Suddenly, he felt a light breeze. The wind returned! The leaves began to fall from the trees, one by one. The Pine Forest regained its bright green color. Shaman smiled happily. 

Shaman realized that even when things seem difficult, with patience and perseverance, you can always find the right solution.

plan.problema: The wind had blown all the leaves off the trees, making the forest gray and sad.
plan.svolta: Shaman tried to sing a song to call the wind, but the wind didn’t answer.
plan.finale: Shaman built a small altar with colorful stones and offered the wind fragrant flowers, and the wind returned to bring the leaves.

ninja turtle.text:
Michelangelo was a turtle ninja. He lived in the playground. He had a favorite red hat with a wide brim. He loved to wear it when he was having fun. Today he was sitting near the swing, which was moving back and forth with a child.

Suddenly, Michelangelo noticed something strange. His red hat was lying on top of the swing! It was too high for him to reach it on his own. He felt frustrated. “Oh no!” he thought. “I have to get it back!”

Michelangelo decided to do something. Collecting the colorful blocks scattered around, he started to build a small ladder. He tried to make it reach the hat, but the blocks were unstable. The ladder became taller and wobblier. Finally, with a big thump, the ladder collapsed!

Just at that moment, a group of curious squirrels approached Michelangelo. They were friendly and happy squirrels. They saw that Michelangelo was worried about his hat. Without hesitation, the little squirrels started to collect the blocks and rebuild the ladder. This time they made it stronger.

Together, the squirrels helped Michelangelo reach his hat. They gently took it and brought it down, putting it back on his head. He was happy! The little squirrels sat next to him, laughing and playing. 

Michelangelo realized that even the biggest problems can be solved with the help of friends. A smile lit up his turtle face.

plan.problema: His favorite hat fell on top of the swing, too high to reach.
plan.svolta: He decided to build a small ladder with colorful blocks to reach the hat.
plan.finale: The ladder collapsed, but a group of friendly squirrels helped him recover his hat and brought it down.

ninja turtle.text:
Leonardo the ninja turtle was in the playground. It was a sunny day and lots of children were laughing and playing. Leonardo loved this place so much! He moved between the slides and swings, always looking for new adventures. Suddenly, he saw something blue. A blue balloon had fallen into the tallest bush in the playground.

Leonardo went up to the bush. He tried to grab the balloon, but it was too far away! His little legs couldn't reach the balloon which was floating right above the leaves. It was frustrating! A boy nearby, Matteo, was watching Leonardo with curiosity.

Leonardo thought for a moment. Then he had a brilliant idea! He found a roll of colorful sticky tape. He quickly unrolled it and started to make a ramp. Carefully, he stuck the tape to the bush, creating a little staircase.

Carefully, Leonardo climbed up the ramp. He lined up well and made a good jump. He managed to grab the blue balloon! He was happy! He brought it back to Matteo who was watching him in amazement. Matteo smiled with joy. 

Leonardo felt proud of his success. He had overcome an obstacle with cleverness and perseverance. He turned around for one last time towards the playground, knowing that even the most difficult challenges can be solved with a little creativity. After all, determination is always a great friend.

plan.problema: The blue balloon fell into the bush and Leo can’t reach it!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his tape to make a ramp and reach the balloon.
plan.finale: With a well-calculated jump, Leo recovered the balloon and brought it back to the surprised child.

ninja turtle.text:
Michelangelo was a turtle ninja. He lived in the playground, between slides and swings. He had a red, pointy hat, his favorite. He loved it so much! One day, while playing hide-and-seek with the children, the wind blew it away. The hat ended up in the pond!

Michelangelo felt sad. His hat was important to him. He tried to grab the hat with his hands, but the water was too cold and slippery. He couldn't do it. He tried to reach the hat with a stick he had found, but the pond was too far away and the water too deep. The hat floated, still.

He bumped into a little blue fish. “Help!” shouted Michelangelo. “My hat fell into the pond!” The fish swam towards another yellow fish and then an orange fish. All the fish gathered around Michelangelo.

They worked together, gently pushing with their noses, to bring the red hat back to the shore. With patience and courage, they pulled it out of the water! Michelangelo thanked all the fish. He was happy to have his hat back. 

Michelangelo put his hat on, smiling at his new watery friends. He realized that even the most difficult things become easier when you help each other.

plan.problema: His favorite hat fell into the pond!
plan.svolta: Michelangelo tried to reach the hat with a stick, but it was too far and wet.
plan.finale: He then asked for help from the little fish swimming nearby, who gently brought it back to shore.

ninja turtle.text:
Leonardo was a very active turtle ninja. He loved to play at the playground. It was a place full of children who were laughing and playing on the slides and castles. Leonardo enjoyed running and doing acrobatics. One day, while running towards the big swing, he saw something blue. It was a balloon!

A child had let the balloon deflate and had left it falling into the nearest bush. The blue balloon was right there, hidden among the green leaves. Leonardo wanted to get it back. He walked up to the bush, but it was too tall for him to reach. He tried to climb it, but the bush was too strong and difficult to climb.

Leonardo stopped for a moment. He thought about what to do. Then he had an idea! He had some tape with him. He took several rolls and started to create a small improvised ladder around the bush. It was patient work. Leonardo stuck the tape, stretched it out, and reinforced it. Sometimes it fell, but he got up right away and started again.

After a lot of effort, he finally managed to reach the blue balloon! He grabbed it with his little hands and started to come down slowly. The children at the playground watched happily. Leonardo returned the balloon to the children who had lost it. Everyone was happy.

Leonardo felt proud of himself. He had overcome a small obstacle thanks to his determination. Perseverance, even when things are difficult, can lead to great results.

plan.problema: The blue balloon fell into the bush and Leo can’t reach it.
plan.svolta: Leo tried to jump, but the bush was too high, so he thought of using his tape to create an improvised ladder.
plan.finale: With a lot of patience and a few attempts, Leo managed to grab the blue balloon and bring it back to the happy children.

ninja turtle.text:
Leonardo was a very active turtle ninja. He loved to play at the playground. He had a giant sandcastle and lots of smaller ones too. One day, while running between the games, he heard a little cry. “Who made that noise?” Leonardo thought.

He went closer and saw a teddy bear, Bruno, who was lost. Bruno had fallen inside one of the biggest sandcastles! He was completely hidden. Leonardo tried to look for Bruno under every castle. But it was too big and full of sand. He couldn’t see anything.

Leonardo was a little frustrated. He sat down for a moment, thinking about what to do. Then, with his ninja agility, he decided to try another method. He climbed onto the tallest castle at the playground. It was a little tiring, but Leonardo was determined. 

“Bruno, where are you?” he shouted loudly. “Bruno, answer!” He repeated his shout many times, climbing up and down the castle.

Suddenly, he heard another little cry. And then, there was Bruno! The teddy bear appeared smiling from the sand tunnel underneath the castle. He had been attracted by the sound of Leonardo’s voice. 

Leonardo quickly climbed down and hugged Bruno. “I did it!” he said happily. He had been a little patient looking for Bruno, and that’s why he had found the solution. Patience makes great things happen.

plan.problema: The little teddy bear Bruno got lost among the sandcastles.
plan.svolta: Leonardo tried to look for Bruno under every castle, but it was too big and difficult to find.
plan.finale: Using his agility, Leonardo climbed onto the tallest castle and shouted 'Bruno, where are you?' until the bear appeared smiling from the sand tunnel.

ninja turtle.text:
Michelangelo was a very happy turtle ninja. He was sitting in the playground, under the shade of a big tree. The sun was shining and all the other toys in the playground were around him. Michelangelo loved his red pointy hat, he always wore it!

Suddenly, he heard something fall with a thud. He looked around and saw his hat, it was lying in a deep hole, very, very far away. It was a huge hole, full of dirt and dry leaves. Michelangelo was sad. His favorite hat was lost!

Michelangelo thought: “I have to get it back!” He decided to build a ladder with the colorful building blocks that were near him. He started stacking the blocks one on top of the other, hoping to reach the hat. But the ladder was unstable and wobbled.

A little teddy bear, Bruno, tried to help him, but the ladder kept falling down. Michelangelo got a little angry, but then he calmed down. “I can’t give up!” he said. Suddenly he had an idea! He took a stick and used it as a swing. He tied it to his body and started swinging, trying to reach the hat.

The swing worked! Michelangelo finally managed to grab his red hat. He was happy! The ladder had collapsed, but he had found the solution. Michelangelo stood up and continued to play in the playground. Despite the obstacles, he always found a way to reach his goals. And this made him a real turtle ninja!

plan.problema: His favorite hat fell into a deep hole!
plan.svolta: He decided to build a ladder with the colorful blocks to reach the hat.
plan.finale: The ladder was too unstable and it overturned, but Michelangelo improvised a ramp with a stick and finally recovered his hat!

ninja turtle.text:
Leonardo was a very active turtle ninja. He loved to play at the playground. It was a place full of colors and laughter. Today Leonardo was exploring the playground when he saw a problem. The red ball had ended up at the top of the swing! It was too high for Leonardo.

“Oh no!” said Leonardo. “I need to get the ball back.” He walked towards the swing, but he couldn’t reach it. He tried to jump, but even then it was too far. The other toys looked at him with curiosity. 

Leonardo thought for a little while. Then he had an idea! He found a roll of tape in his ninja backpack. “This could work,” he said to himself. He started attaching the tape to the swing, making steps. He was creating an improvised staircase, step by step.

With a lot of care and patience, Leonardo built his clever tape staircase. He climbed carefully, one step at a time. Finally, he reached the red ball! He grabbed it tightly and started to come down. 

When he arrived at the center of the playground, the other toys cheered. Leonardo had solved the problem! He had been patient and determined. He had used his intelligence to overcome the obstacle.

Leonardo rested for a little while before going back to play. He was happy to have done a good job as a turtle ninja. Perseverance can really make a difference when you put in the effort.

plan.problema: The red ball is at the top of the swing and Leo can’t reach it!
plan.svolta: Leo tried to jump, but it was too high. Then he decided to use his tape to create an improvised ladder.
plan.finale: With his clever tape ladder, Leo managed to grab the red ball and bring it back to the center of the playground!

ninja turtle.text:
Leonardo was a turtle ninja. He lived at the playground. He was a very brave ninja and always ready for action. He loved to run on the bouncy bridges and climb the swing. That day the sun was shining high in the sky.

Suddenly, Leonardo heard a sad voice. “Oh no! Oh no!” It was Leo, a little teddy bear. “I’ve lost my tummy!” exclaimed Leo, with his ears drooping. The teddy bear’s tummy was an important piece – it was his sunny fabric tummy. Without it, Leo seemed very sad.

Leonardo got to work right away. He looked under the swing, inside the sandcastle, and behind the slide. But the tummy was gone! No one had seen it. Leonardo felt frustrated. “I have to find Leo’s tummy!” he thought.

He kept looking around the playground. He saw a green lawn full of colorful flowers. Suddenly, he saw something strange: a sparrow was carrying a small yellow fabric tummy on its beak! The sparrow flew towards Leo and returned the tummy to him.

Leo ran to hug his tummy. “Thank you, thank you!” said Leo to Leonardo. Leonardo smiled. He was happy to have helped his little teddy bear friend. Kindness made all the difference. 

Leonardo sat on the swing, watching the sun set on the horizon. A little sparrow greeted him with a chirp. He always remembers to be kind to everyone.

plan.problema: The little teddy bear Leo had lost his tummy!
plan.svolta: Leonardo had looked everywhere, but the tummy was missing in the meadow.
plan.finale: Suddenly, he saw a sparrow carrying the tummy and returned it to Leo with a greeting.

ninja turtle.text:
Michelangelo woke up in the playground. The sun was shining brightly and the children were laughing around him. He was a plastic turtle ninja, but he could move and talk! He was wearing his brown suit and, most of all, he had a blue bandana with stars. He loved that bandana very much.

 

“Where am I?” Michelangelo asked, looking around. “It’s not there!” He noticed that his favorite bandana wasn’t in its place anymore. It was gone! Michelangelo felt a little sad. Without the bandana, he wasn’t a real turtle ninja.

 

He went up to Pippo, a small teddy bear sitting on a bench. “Pippo, have you seen my bandana with the stars?” Michelangelo asked. Pippo shook his head. “Maybe we can ask the other toys in the playground!”

 

Michelangelo ran to Rosa, a doll sleeping on the swing. Together, they decided to organize a treasure hunt! They called all the toys: a truck, a bunny, even a robot. Everyone helped to look for the bandana.

 

After a lot of searching, Rosa noticed something under the swing. “Michelangelo, look!” There, hidden between the legs of the swing, was his blue bandana with stars! Michelangelo took it happily and thanked all his friends.

 

“It was fantastic to work together,” said Michelangelo. All the toys smiled. They understood that when they help each other, even the biggest problems become easy to solve.

plan.problema: He can’t find his favorite bandana, the one with the stars!
plan.svolta: He decides to ask for help from the toys in the park and together they organize a treasure hunt.
plan.finale: The bandana is found under a swing, thanks to the help of his friends.
plan.morale: Working together makes it easier to solve problems.

ninja turtle.text:
Leonardo was a very active turtle ninja. He was in the playground, under the warm sun. The other children were laughing and playing, but Leonardo wanted to do his acrobatic tricks. He liked to run and jump.

Suddenly, Leonardo saw a blue ball. The ball was on the swing! It was right above him, but too high to reach with a simple jump. “Oh no!” thought Leonardo. “I have to get that ball!”

Leonardo started to run around the swing. He was looking for a way to get to the blue ball. Then he had an idea: he climbed onto the swing! He swung up and down, trying to catch the ball. But he kept falling! Every time he fell onto the playground grass. He was tired and frustrated.

A boy, Marco, saw Leonardo fall and said to him, “Maybe you can jump higher!” Leonardo tried to jump even higher, but he couldn’t do it.

Leonardo remembered another idea. He quickly climbed onto the swing, made it swing again, and then… he jumped! With all his ninja agility, he jumped from the swing to the little house next to it. He grabbed the blue ball with his strong ninja hands.

Leonardo, happy, brought the blue ball back to its place. He also took a little breath. Leonardo realized that sometimes you have to try many times to reach your goal. Learning from your mistakes always helps you to go forward.

plan.problema: The blue ball is in the swing and Leo can’t reach it!
plan.svolta: He climbs on the swing, but falls down many times without being able to catch the ball.
plan.finale: Thanks to his agility, he jumps from the swing to the little house and grabs the blue ball!

olaf.text:
Olaf was a very happy snowman. He lived in the Snow Garden, a magical place full of sparkling crystals and soft snowflakes. Olaf loved to play with the wind and do cartwheels in the fresh snow. His best friend was Penguin, another penguin toy always ready for a laugh.

One day, while running to chase a particularly big snowflake, Olaf found himself right in the middle of the biggest pile of snow in the garden. It was so tall that he couldn’t see Penguin! “Penguin? Penguin, where are you?” Olaf shouted with his snowy voice. But nobody answered.

Olaf was worried. He decided then to crawl under the snow to look for his friend. It was a bad idea! The snow was heavy and hard to move. Olaf started to roll, roll, roll... and suddenly he ended up sliding down a small slope.

Olaf found himself at the top of a white snow hill. He was confused and a little scared. Then, he heard a voice: “Olaf! Where did you get?” Penguin was there, near the pile of snow from which Olaf had slid. Penguin offered him a giant carrot, his favorite.

Olaf and Penguin hugged each other happily to see each other again. It was nice to have a friend with whom to share even just a big carrot. Friendship can do miracles, even in the Snow Garden.

plan.problema: Olaf got lost in the big pile of snow and can’t find his friend Penguin.
plan.svolta: He decides to crawl under the snow, but it’s too difficult and he ends up rolling down a small slope!
plan.finale: Penguin finds him and offers him a giant carrot to celebrate their reunion.

olaf.text:
Olaf was a snowman who was very happy. He loved to play in the Flower Meadow. The meadow was full of red, yellow, and blue flowers. Olaf had so much fun rolling amongst the soft petals. One day, while he was playing, Olaf got lost! He was surrounded by lots of colorful flowers, but he couldn’t see his friends anymore.

“Oh no!” said Olaf. “I don’t know where I am!” He looked around. The meadow seemed huge and confusing. He tried to call his friends, but nobody answered. A little green caterpillar, Pip, was climbing on a sunflower. “Pip, have you seen my friends?” asked Olaf. Pip shook his head.

Olaf was a little sad. Then he had an idea! He cheered himself up and started to sing a happy song that he loved very much. "Oh, oh, oh, I’m a snowman, happy and joyful!" sang Olaf. His voice was bright and full of energy.

Suddenly, he heard laughter! He looked in that direction and saw his friends: Leo the teddy bear lion and Stella the pink star. They were all happy to have found him. They surrounded him, hugging him. “Olaf, we were lost without you!” said Leo.

Olaf smiled. He was so happy to be with his friends again. His happiness had helped them find him. Olaf understood that even when things seem difficult, a little bit of joy can make a difference.

plan.problema: Olaf got lost in the meadow full of colorful flowers and couldn't find his friends.
plan.svolta: He decided to sing a cheerful song hoping that the others would hear him and guide him to him.
plan.finale: His ringing voice attracted the attention of his friends, who surrounded him happily to have found him.

olaf.text:
Olaf was a very happy snowman. He lived in the Flower Garden, a place full of colors and smells. He loved to play there, especially with his friend Pippo. Pippo was a little teddy bear and the two were inseparable.

---

One day, Olaf was running among the giant tulips, which seemed as tall as trees. In a moment, he got lost! He couldn't see Pippo anymore. Everything around him was red, thanks to the tulips. “Pippo? Pippo, where are you?” Olaf shouted, but nobody answered.

---

Olaf was scared. He looked for Pippo everywhere, but the tulips were too big and too many. He decided to do something new. “Maybe I can follow the smell,” thought Olaf. “Pippo always has a nice smell.”

---

He went towards the prettiest flower he found, a ripe strawberry. Its smell was sweet and intense. Olaf followed that smell, moving between the roses and the lavender bushes. The smell always led him further and further.

---

Finally, the smell led him directly under the umbrella. And there, he saw Pippo! Pippo was building a sandcastle with pebbles. “Pippo!” Olaf shouted happily. “I found you!”.

---

Olaf ran to Pippo and sat down next to him to help build the castle. The sun was shining and the two friends were very happy. Olaf realized that even when things seem difficult, if you don’t give up, you always find the solution.

plan.problema: Olaf got lost among the giant tulips and couldn’t find his friend Pippo.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the scent of ripe strawberries, hoping it would lead him to Pippo.
plan.finale: The scent led him directly under the umbrella, where Pippo was building a sandcastle with pebbles.

olaf.text:
Olaf was a very happy snowman. He lived in the Snow Garden, a magical place full of sparkling crystals and quiet. He loved to play with the snow, make little snowstorms, and create heart-shaped snowflakes. He also had a red hat that he wore particularly well.

One day, Olaf had too much fun. He slid down the big pile of snow and got lost! He was looking for his friends, the Christmas trees decorated with colorful lights. But it was all white, white, white! He couldn't see them. He was sad and a little scared.

Olaf thought he had to do something. He took his red hat and started to blow hard. He was trying to make little bubbles of air. The bubbles floated up into the sky, carried by the gentle wind of the garden. Olaf hoped the wind would guide him to the Christmas trees.

The wind kept blowing, carrying the bubbles of air away. At one point, a bubble hit a Christmas tree! Then another, and another one. Olaf followed the bubbles with his glass eyes. The wind was leading him to his group.

He ran quickly, hopping through the snow, and finally reached the Christmas trees. He was happy to be with them again! They all joined together, laughing and playing in the Snow Garden. Olaf realized that even when things seem difficult, if you don’t give up, you always find the solution.

plan.problema: Olaf got lost in the big pile of snow and couldn't find his friends, the Christmas trees.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his red hat to make little bubbles of air, hoping the wind would guide him to his companions.
plan.finale: The wind carried the bubbles of air to the Christmas trees, and Olaf ran to reach them, happy to be back in the group.

olaf.text:
Olaf was a snowman who was very happy. He loved the sandy beach! Every day he ran to play among the golden dunes. Today the sun was shining high in the sky and the sand was warm under his felt feet.

Suddenly, Olaf noticed that he couldn't see his friend Leo, the pink seashell. He was lost! He had ended up in a big pile of sand as high as a mountain. Olaf tried to move, but the sand was too soft and it made him slide down. “Oh no!” said Olaf. “I want to go back to playing with Leo!”

Olaf tried to call his friends. He shouted loudly: “Hey! Hey Leo!” But nobody answered. The sand almost covered his face and he couldn't hear their voices. He was sad and a little scared.

Then, Olaf had a brilliant idea! He started to make big waves with his hands. He waved his arms up and down, up and down, as if he were swimming. The waves formed in the sand and shone in the sunlight. And while he made the waves, Olaf smiled more. His smile was so bright that it seemed to make the sun shine!

Leo heard the sound of the waves and followed that noise to Olaf. “Olaf! Here I am!” said Leo, happy to find his friend.

Olaf felt relieved and happy. He had solved the problem with a little patience and a lot of creativity. The beach was even more beautiful when he played with Leo.

plan.problema: Olaf got lost in the big pile of sand!
plan.svolta: He tried to call his friends with his voice, but nobody could hear him.
