plan.finale: Then he had an idea: he started making big waves with his hands and his smile made the sun shine!
plan.morale: Patience and a little creativity always help.

olaf.text:
Olaf was a very happy snowman. He loved to play on the sand beach. The sand was warm and soft under his felt paws. Olaf had so much fun rolling and building castles.

One day, Olaf was building a very tall tower. He wanted it to be the biggest of all! But then, puff! a sand wave washed it away. Olaf found himself trapped in the big sand mountain. It was all around him and he couldn't move.

Olaf was scared. He tried to shout for help, but the sand was choking his voice. He tried to call his friends, Pippo the red fish who lived in the water bucket, but nobody could hear him. Pipì, the seashell, was too far away to hear Olaf.

Olaf thought, thought, and thought. Then he had an idea! He started making little waves with his hands. The sand waves spread across the mountain and his friends arrived right away. Pippo the fish and Pipì the seashell helped him climb out of the sand.

Olaf was happy! He was back out of the sand mountain. His friends hugged him. Together, they built a new tower even bigger and more fun. Olaf realized that having friends around made everything easier. And so, if someone needs help, just ask your friends to find the solution.

plan.problema: Olaf got lost in the big sand mountain!
plan.svolta: He tried to call his friends with his voice, but nobody could hear him.
plan.finale: Then he had an idea: he started making waves with his hands and his friends came to help him climb up!
plan.morale: Working together, they solve the problems.

olaf.text:
Olaf was a very happy snowman. He loved to play on the sandy beach. The sand was warm and soft under his felt paws. Olaf loved to make bubbles with the seawater.

One day, Olaf noticed that he was all alone. “Oh no!” he said. He didn’t see his fish friends anymore. The fish loved to play hide-and-seek among the waves. But today they weren’t there.

Olaf looked everywhere. He looked to the right and to the left. He looked under the colorful seashells. But the fish were gone. “Maybe if he calls them,” thought Olaf.

Then, Olaf had an idea! He started to gather the sand with his little hands. He made it pile up very high, super high. He built a giant sandcastle, with towers and fortified walls. It was the biggest castle Olaf had ever made.

The fish, curious about the noise and the strange shape, came closer to the castle. They started to jump around it and spray water on his towers. Olaf was smiling. He was happy to have found them! The fish played with Olaf all day. They had so much fun building and destroying the sandcastle. 

When the sun began to set, the fish said goodbye to Olaf and promised to come back the next day. Olaf knew that his creativity had helped him find his friends. And he thought: “Sometimes, a little imagination can do miracles.”

plan.problema: Olaf is lost and can’t find his little fish friends.
plan.svolta: He decides to build a giant sandcastle to attract the fish.
plan.finale: The fish, curious about the castle, follow it to the sea and play with him all day.

olaf.text:
Olaf was a very special snowman. He lived in the Flower Garden, among red roses and yellow sunflowers. Olaf loved to play with the flowers, tell them stories, and listen to their songs. One day, while playing hide-and-seek, he got lost. He ended up in the tall meadow, a place full of tall grass and shy daisies.

Olaf couldn’t find his flower friends. “Oh no!” said Olaf, with his snowy voice. “I can’t find anyone! I’m all alone.” He looked through the grass, but he couldn’t see his friends anymore. The meadow was too big and full of secrets.

Olaf remembered his magic nose, a little pink button that could smell anything. “Maybe I can use my nose,” thought Olaf. He closed his eyes and started to sniff hard. He was looking for the sweet smell of the flowers. The wind was blowing and made it harder to figure out where they were.

After a while, Olaf smelled something. A very strong scent led him upwards. He followed the smell and, finally, he saw his flower friends huddled near him. They were happy to be found! They giggled quietly. “Olaf, we’re almost there!” they said.

Olaf smiled. He had used his determination to find his friends. They stayed there, in the Flower Garden, playing together forever. Olaf learned that even when things seem difficult, with a little perseverance, you can reach your goal.

plan.problema: Olaf got lost in the tall meadow and couldn't find his friend flowers.
plan.svolta: He decides to use his magic nose to sniff the scent of the flowers and follow it.
plan.finale: After a while, he hears the laughter of the flowers and finds them curled up beside him, happy to be found.

olaf.text:
Olaf was a very special snowman. He lived in the Snow Garden, a magical place made only of snow and ice. Olaf loved to play among the white snowflakes and slide down the fresh snow. But today Olaf wasn’t happy. He had lost all his glitter! They were colorful glitter, that made him shine when the sunlight touched him. Without glitter, Olaf looked like a simple snowman.

Olaf looked around in the Snow Garden. He searched among the snow, but the glitter was gone. “Oh no!” said Olaf. “I must find them!” He thought about what to do. Then he had an idea! He decided that he would ask for help from the wind. The wind was strong and knew how to fly high.

Olaf stood up and shouted: “Wind, Wind! Please help me find my glitter!” The wind answered: "Don't be afraid, Olaf! I will help you." And so, the wind began to blow strongly. It took Olaf towards the stars in the night sky.

The wind collected the glitter from the stars and made them fall down like a sparkling waterfall. The glitter covered Olaf from head to toe, making him shine with a thousand colors. Olaf smiled happily. He had found his glitter! The wind said goodbye to him and returned to the Snow Garden. 

Olaf continued to shine, happy with his new look. He had solved the problem with a little courage and a lot of perseverance. And so, Olaf understood that even when things seem difficult, you can always find a solution if you don’t give up.

plan.problema: Olaf has lost all his glitter!
plan.svolta: He decided to ask the wind for help to collect new glitter from the stars.
plan.finale: The wind brought him a cascade of sparkling glitter, and Olaf smiled happily.

olaf.text:
Olaf was a snowman who was very happy. He lived on the sandy beach, near the sea. He liked to play with the sand and build castles. He also had a red hat, his favorite. He always wore it, because it made him even happier.

One day, Olaf noticed that his red hat was gone! It had disappeared. Olaf tried to look everywhere, but he couldn’t find it. Without his hat, Olaf couldn’t smile. He looked like a sad and gray snowman.

“Oh no!” said Olaf. “I must find my red hat! I can’t be happy without it.”

Olaf started to look under the colorful seashells that were on the beach. He pushed with his little hands, but the hat was too small to fit between the seashells. He was a little frustrated.

Then, Olaf had an idea! “Wind,” he whispered, “help me!” He raised his arms to the sky and shouted: “Wind, please, help me find my hat!”

The wind started to blow gently. It pushed away the sand and made the pebbles spin. And right there, among the pebbles, was Olaf’s red hat!

Olaf took his hat and immediately lit up with joy. He smiled again, a big and bright smile. Thanks to the wind and his idea, everything was back to normal.

Olaf realized that sometimes, even the biggest problems can be solved if we ask for help from others. And working together makes things much easier.

plan.problema: Olaf has lost his favorite red hat and doesn’t know how to smile again.
plan.svolta: He tried to look under the seashells, but the hat was too small to fit!
plan.finale: Then he had an idea: he asked the wind for help and together they found the hat hidden among the pebbles.

paracadutista.text:
Sammy was a cloth parachute. He loved to fly in the Flowery Garden. Every day, Sammy let the wind carry him, dancing among the colorful flowers. But today something wasn't right. Sammy had found himself halfway between the sky and the earth! It was too high to land softly!

Sammy felt the wind rushing around him. His parachute was banging uncontrollably. “Oh no!” thought Sammy. “I have to do something, otherwise I’ll get hurt!” He moved higher and higher, frightened. A little bird, a robin named Arturo, was watching him from a cherry tree branch. Arturo chirped encouragingly to Sammy.

Sammy concentrated. He saw a giant flower, a white lily with a strong scent. He huddled down and, with all his strength, tried to attach his parachute to the lily stem. Finally, he did it! The weight of the flower slowed Sammy’s descent.

Sammy continued to descend slowly, but in a controlled way. With a gentle “puff,” Sammy landed in a meadow full of daisies, happy and content. Arturo the robin flew down to greet Sammy. 

Sammy lay down on the cool grass, surrounded by the scents of the flowers. He felt tired but also very satisfied. He had learned that sometimes, to solve a problem, you just have to wait and find the right solution at the right time.

plan.problema: Sammy found himself stuck halfway between the sky and the earth, too high to land gently!
plan.svolta: He decided to attach a giant flower to his parachute to slow down his descent.
plan.finale: With a gentle ‘puff’, Sammy landed in a meadow full of daisies, happy and content.

paracadutista.text:
Pippo was a cloth parachute maker. He loved to play in the Flowered Garden. It was a place full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Pippo loved to dance among the daisies and tumble among the sunflowers.

---

One day, while playing near the pond, Pippo noticed something wasn't right. “Oh no!” said Pippo. “Where did my friend teddy bear Bruno go?” Bruno was a soft teddy bear with a big smile. He had left him there just before and now there was no sign of him anywhere!

---

Pippo looked everywhere, under the red roses, among the yellow tulips, and even inside the beehive. But Bruno was gone. Pippo felt sad and a little scared. He didn’t know what to do.

---

Then, Pippo had an idea. He prepared to jump down quickly, opening his parachute. He jumped down the hill, moving quickly among the flowers. He looked in every corner of the Flowered Garden, searching for Bruno. The wind tangled his cloth.

---

Finally, after a while, Pippo saw something brown hidden under a bush of fragrant roses. It was Bruno! Running with outstretched arms, Pippo reached the teddy bear and hugged him tightly. “Bruno! I found you!” exclaimed Pippo happily.

---

Bruno replied with a small smile. They sat together under the big apple tree, happy to see each other again. Pippo realized that sometimes, to find lost things, you just need a little patience and to look calmly. The search had led him exactly where his friend was.

plan.problema: Peter has lost his teddy bear friend and doesn't know how to find him.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his parachute to take a quick walk and carefully examine every corner of the garden.
plan.finale: Finally, he saw the teddy bear hidden under a rose bush and ran to reach him.
plan.morale: Patience is the key to solving problems.

paracadutista.text:
Sammy was a cloth parachute, blue and white. He loved to be on the merry-go-round in a secret garden, next to the red roses and tall sunflowers. Sometimes, he let himself be carried away by the wind and made little flights among the leaves.

 

One day, Sammy flew too high. The wind pushed him far, far away. When he opened his eyes, he found himself lost in the secret garden. There was no longer the merry-go-round in sight! He was surrounded by big trees and green plants. Sammy was scared. He didn’t know how to get back.

 

“Oh no,” thought Sammy, “I must find my way home!” Then he had an idea. He took his parachute and opened it again. He slowly descended, coming down among the flowers. He looked for the brightest colors, the ones that could guide him. He saw yellow tulips, blue violets, and orange daffodils.

 

Sammy followed the brightest flowers, little by little. He moved calmly, without hurry. He carefully observed every corner of the secret garden. After a while, he saw something familiar: the merry-go-round! It was right there, near the lavender bush.

 

Sammy landed gently on the merry-go-round and rested. He felt happy and a little tired. His adventure was over. Finally, thanks to patience, Sammy found his place on the merry-go-round, happy and rested. The sun was setting, painting the sky pink and orange.

plan.problema: Sammy got lost in the garden and couldn't get back to his place on the carousel.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his parachute to descend gently and find the way to the carousel, looking for the brightest flowers.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the bright colors, Sammy found his place on the carousel, happy and rested.

paracadutista.text:
Pippo was a cloth parachute. He loved the Flowery Garden very much. Every day, he dreamed of flying among the yellow flowers and the red roses. One day, while playing “landing” in the meadow, Pippo was carried away by the wind. A gust lifted him high, higher than ever!

Pippo ended up landing on the top of the tallest tree in the garden. It was a beautiful place, with a fantastic view of the flowers. But it was also very far from the meadow. Pippo felt lonely and a little scared. There was no way to get down!

He thought about what to do. He looked at the tree and had an idea. He started to roll, roll, roll his soft cloth. He made a kind of small slide. Then, with great care, he began to roll down the trunk of the tree.

The wind played with him as he slowly descended. Pippo concentrated and tried to just roll straight. He did it! He arrived softly in the meadow, happy to be back among the colorful flowers. A ladybug greeted him smiling.

Pippo settled down next to a daisy. He was happy to be safe again, near his floral friends. Patience, even for a parachute, can lead to the best solution.

plan.problema: Peter found himself stuck at the top of the tallest tree, too far from the meadow!
plan.svolta: He decided to roll himself into a ball to create a small slide and then to roll down carefully.
plan.finale: He crept into the meadow, happy to be back among the colorful flowers.

paracadutista.text:
Samuele was a special parachutist. He loved to fly in the Flowered Meadow. It was a meadow full of red roses, yellow marigolds, and purple tulips. Samuele had the job of gently landing in the middle of the flowers.

But Samuele had a little problem. Every time he tried to land, he always ended up in a pile of flowers! He tumbled, he crashed, and he became covered in petals. “Oh no!” Samuele would say, as he found himself among the tulips.

Samuele was frustrated. He tried to slow down, but it didn’t work. His little hands moved frantically, trying to control his descent. A little beetle, Bruno, watched him curiously from the meadow.

Then Samuele had an idea! He looked at his license, the one that allowed him to fly. “Wait!” Samuele thought. He started to move his hands regularly, as if he were drawing in the air. A beautiful, colorful arc formed around him, a bright trail of colors.

The trail slowed his descent. Samuele landed gently in the meadow, exactly where he wanted to go! The flowers around him smiled. “You did it, Samuele!” exclaimed the red roses and the yellow marigolds.

Samuele felt happy and proud. He had learned to be patient and to use his license carefully. Finally, he understood that a little change can lead to big results.

plan.problema: Samuel can’t land softly in the meadow, always ending up in a pile of flowers!
plan.svolta: He decides to use his patent to create a colorful trail and slow down his descent.
plan.finale: He finally lands softly, surrounded by happy flowers that thank him.

paracadutista.text:
Pippo was a cloth parachute. He loved the playground very much. Every day, he waited to see the other toys run and jump. He himself didn't move much at all. He was stuck at the top of the swing, tied to his string. Pippo was scared! He was very shy. He didn't want to come down, even though the wind pushed him down.

A little teddy bear, Bruno, came up to him. “Pippo, why don't you come down? It's fun!” said Bruno with his sweet voice. Pippo replied, “I’m scared! If I come down, I’ll get lost!”

Pippo took a deep breath. He decided to do something different. He started to slide slowly, his colorful fabric moved through the air like a waterfall of flowers. The colors shone in the sun and created pictures in the sky.

The other toys noticed the beautiful view that Pippo was creating. They gathered around him, encouraging him to keep going. Bruno gently pushed him with his nose. A remote control car came closer and pulled his string. All his friends joined in to help him come down gently.

Pippo finally arrived on the ground, surrounded by the smiles of his friends. He felt happier than ever before. He was the happiest toy in the playground. Pippo realized that having brave friends helped him overcome his fears.

plan.problema: Pippo had found himself stuck at the top of the swing, too shy to come down!
plan.svolta: He decided to slide down slowly, creating a cascade of colors that attracted the attention of the other toys.
plan.finale: All his friends helped him come down gently, making him the happiest in the park.

paracadutista.text:
Samuele was a very excited parachutist. He lived in the garden at home and loved to jump! Every day he prepared for a new adventure. But there was a small problem. Samuele couldn’t land softly in the meadow. He always ended up in a pile of colorful flowers, a real mess!

“Oh no!” exclaimed Samuele, as he found himself surrounded by red roses and yellow tulips. “I need to learn to slow down my fall.” He tried to concentrate, but it was difficult. Every jump was a new surprise, a new impact with the soft petals.

One day, Samuele had an idea. He watched a tree branch near the meadow. It was strong and well-positioned. “Maybe I can use my cord!” he thought. With great care, Samuele attached himself to the top of the branch with his cord.

When he started to fall, the cord slowed him down. The descent became slower, more controlled. Samuele felt a sigh of relief. Finally, he landed with a satisfied sigh right next to the sheep farm. It was exactly where he wanted to be!

A ladybug passed by to say hello to Samuele. “Good job!” said the ladybug. “You took the time you needed to reach your goal.” Samuele smiled, happy with his new skill. Learning takes patience and a little adjustment.

plan.problema: Samuel can't land softly in the meadow, he always ends up in a pile of flowers!
plan.svolta: He decides to use his rope to clip onto the nearest branch and slow his descent.
plan.finale: Finally, he lands with a satisfied sigh right where he wanted, next to the sheep farm.
plan.morale: Patience is key to achieving your goals.

paracadutista.text:
Parachutino was in the Flower Garden. He was a fabric parachute, blue and white, with a little red hat. He loved to be there, watching the colorful flowers and the butterflies flying.

Suddenly, Parachutino found himself very, very high up. The wind had carried him away from the garden! He couldn’t see the green lawn or the fragrant roses anymore. Only white clouds and an endless blue sky. He was scared. He didn’t know how to get back down.

Parachutino tried to unroll quickly, like his friends did when they landed. But something strange happened! Instead of descending gently, he started to spin around himself. His fabric bag spun faster and faster, without him being able to control it. He was a little disoriented.

A little hummingbird, Zephyr, landed near Parachutino. He looked at him with his black little eyes and said, “Don’t make sudden movements!” Parachutino listened to Zephyr. He took a deep breath and waited.

Then, a gentle breath of wind touched him. The wind was sweet and patient. It pushed him gently downwards. Parachutino descended slowly, getting closer and closer to the flowers of the Flower Garden. He landed softly among the bellflowers, right next to a daisy.

Parachutino rested a little, happy to be back home. He had learned that sometimes, calmness and waiting are the best things to find the right way.

plan.problema: The Parachute had gotten too high in the sky and didn’t know how to come down.
plan.svolta: He tried to unroll faster, but all he did was spin his cloth bag!
plan.finale: Finally, a gentle breath of wind brought him softly back among the flowers.

paracadutista.text:
Parachute was in the flowery meadow. He was a blue parachute, with a little red hat. He felt lonely. He wanted to play with the other toys. There was the dollhouse, the toy cars, and the teddy bear. But nobody saw him.

Parachute had found himself there all by himself. He didn’t know how to go back to playing. He felt sad. He tried to jump, but he couldn’t land softly. Every time he fell with a dull thud on the grass. He was frustrated.

“I wish I had a big canopy to land well,” thought Parachute. He looked around and saw lots of green and yellow leaves. An idea popped into his mind! He picked a big poplar leaf and spread it on the ground. Then he jumped!

The leaf slowed him down. It was like a big natural parachute. Parachute landed softly, right next to the dollhouse. Princess Sofia and Soldier Marco were waiting for him with joy. “Parachute! You’re back!” they shouted.

The other toys came to him. Together they played all afternoon in the flowery meadow. Parachute realized he shouldn’t give up and that sometimes, you just need to change your approach to find the right solution. 
He was happy to be with his friends again. Perseverance had brought him success.

plan.problema: The parachute had become alone and wanted to go back to play with the other toys, but didn't know how to do it.
plan.svolta: He tried to jump again, this time using the leaves as a big blanket, to see if he could land softly.
plan.finale: Thanks to the leaves, the parachute landed perfectly near the dollhouse, where his friends were waiting for him with joy.

paracadutista.text:
Pippo was a parachutist. He loved to fly in the Flowery Garden. The garden was full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Pippo had an important mission: to land gently in the wicker basket.

But Pippo couldn’t do it! Every time he got close to the basket, he spun and tipped over. “Oh no!” Pippo exclaimed, trying to keep his balance. The wind played with him, making him spin faster and faster.

A little rubber crocodile, Rocco, watched him closely. Rocco came up to Pippo and said, “Maybe you should do something different, Pippo.”

Pippo thought. He thought, he thought, he thought… Then he had an idea! He decided to roll quickly. He rolled his body, creating a little headwind. The wind slowed him down and made him descend more slowly towards the basket.

Pippo kept rolling with all his might. Finally, he landed in the basket! He didn’t spin, he didn’t tip over. It was perfect.

A shower of rose petals fell from the sky. The petals covered Pippo and the basket. Pippo felt happy and proud. He had learned that with a little perseverance, even difficult things can be done.

plan.problema: Pippo can't land gently in the bucket, always tipping over.
plan.svolta: He decides to roll faster to create a headwind and control his descent better.
plan.finale: Finally, Pippo lands gracefully in the bucket, where he is greeted by a cascade of rose petals.

peppa pig.text:
Peppa Pig was happy in her garden. The sun was shining and the birds were singing. Peppa loved to play among the roses and flowers. She had a favorite red hat, with lots of white bows. She loved it!

One day, while skipping on the lawn, the wind was blowing hard. Peppa Pig noticed that her hat was gone! She had lost it! “Oh no!” exclaimed Peppa Pig. She looked everywhere: under the bench, behind the apple tree, but the red hat was nowhere to be seen.

Peppa Pig started to call out: “Hat! Red Hat! Where are you?” But nobody answered. The wind kept blowing and the hat moved away, far, far away. Peppa Pig felt sad and a little scared. She didn’t know what to do.

Then, Peppa Pig had an idea! She saw a big hydrangea full of colorful flowers. Under the hydrangea lived many bees. “Hello Bees!” said Peppa Pig. “Will you help me find my red hat?” The bees buzzed around Peppa Pig. One of the bees, the kindest one, started to fly in a specific direction.

Peppa Pig followed the bee and, incredible! There was her red hat, lying among the tall grass. Peppa Pig ran to hug it. She was so happy! “Thank you Bees!” said Peppa Pig. The bees buzzed away, happy to have helped.

Peppa Pig realized that asking for help was the right thing to do when you are in trouble. Sometimes, even a small favor can lead to a big discovery.

plan.problema: Peppa lost her favorite hat in the meadow.
plan.svolta: She tried to look for it with her voice, but nobody could hear her, and the hat kept moving with the wind.
plan.finale: Then she had an idea: she asked for help from the bees that lived in the hydrangea, and the bees led her to her hat!
plan.morale: Asking for help is always a good idea.

peppa pig.text:
Peppa Pig was at the playground. The sun was shining high in the blue sky. Peppa loved to play on the slides and playground games. She really wanted to play with her friends. But then, while sliding down the last slide, she got lost!

She was surrounded by so many other slides, tall and short. She couldn’t see any of her friends anymore. “Oh no!” exclaimed Peppa Pig. “I don’t know where my friends are!” She was a little scared. She tried to turn around, but everything looked the same.

Peppa Pig decided to shout for help. She shouted loudly: “Help! I’m lost!” But the playground was full of noises: children laughing, others playing in the sand. No one heard Peppa Pig. It was too noisy to be heard.

Peppa Pig sat down on a small stool. Then, suddenly, she had an idea! She started to make her favorite snorts, the ones she made when she was happy. She did it loud, loud, loud!

A boy, sitting near the sandbox, looked up. “Look!” he said. “It’s Peppa Pig! Do you know where your friends are?” Peppa Pig nodded enthusiastically. The boy pointed to a corner of the playground, where all her friends were. 

Peppa Pig ran to her friends and started to laugh with joy. Everyone hugged each other happily. Peppa Pig realized that asking for help was the right thing to do.

plan.problema: Peppa got lost among the slides and couldn't find her friends.
plan.svolta: She decided to shout for help, but no one heard her because it was too noisy.
plan.finale: With a big smile, Peppa started making her favorite snorts, and a boy recognized her immediately and helped her find the other children.
plan.morale: Asking for help is always a good thing.

peppa pig.text:
Peppa Pig was in her garden. The sun was shining bright and the little birds were singing. Peppa Pig loved her garden very much. It was a place full of colorful flowers and green grass. But today, Peppa Pig was sad. She had lost her favorite rose! It was a red rose with a lovely smell that she had received for her birthday.

Peppa Pig looked everywhere. She looked between the yellow daisies and under the apple tree. But the rose was gone. “Oh no!” said Peppa Pig, with a little sigh. She was really angry. She couldn’t find her beautiful red rose.

Then Peppa Pig decided to ask for help from her friend George. George was a wise gnome who lived in the garden and knew all the secrets of the plants and flowers. “George, George!” called Peppa Pig. “I’ve lost my rose! Can you help me find it?”

George smiled. “Of course I can help, Peppa Pig,” he replied. George walked over to the wild rose bush and started to dig among the leaves. After a while, he found the red rose! It was hidden right there under.

Peppa Pig ran to George and hugged her friend. “Thank you, thank you, thank you!” said Peppa Pig, happier than ever. George smiled and said: "Working together is always better." Peppa Pig was very happy to have found her favorite rose.

plan.problema: Peppa has lost her favorite rose in the garden and can’t find it.
plan.svolta: She decides then to ask for help from her friend gnome, Grugno, who knows all the secrets of the garden.
plan.finale: Grugno helps Peppa find the hidden rose under a bush of wild roses and Peppa is very happy.

peppa pig.text:
Peppa Pig woke up in the garden at home. The sun was shining bright and the little birds were singing. Peppa Pig wanted to play! But then she noticed that her favorite red shoes were missing. “Oh no!” she exclaimed. “I can’t run and jump without my red shoes!”

Peppa Pig looked everywhere. She looked under the picnic table, behind the bench, and among the flowers. But the red shoes weren’t there. Peppa Pig was very sad. She didn’t want to do anything because she didn’t have her shoes.

“Maybe George can help me,” she thought. George was her best friend. She went towards George’s little house, hoping he had seen where the red shoes had gone. 

“George! George!” called Peppa Pig. “Did you see my red shoes?” George turned around and pointed with his finger. “I saw them!” he said. He went closer to a bush full of fragrant flowers. And there, under the bush, were Peppa Pig’s red shoes!

Peppa Pig ran to hug George. “Thank you, George! You’re very good at finding things!” she said happily. She put her red shoes on right away and started to play in the garden with George. It was a perfect afternoon. 

Peppa Pig realized that asking her friend for help had been a good idea. And together they solved the problem. Peppa Pig ran to get a balloon and threw it high in the air, laughing with joy.

plan.problema: Peppa has lost her favorite red shoes and can’t play.
plan.svolta: She decides to ask for help from her friend George, hoping he has seen where they went.
plan.finale: George finds the shoes under a bush full of fragrant flowers and Peppa is happy!

peppa pig.text:
Peppa Pig was in her house’s garden. The sun was shining high in the sky and butterflies were flying around. Peppa Pig loved her red polka dot hat very much. It was her favorite hat! But today there was a problem.

“Oh no!” said Peppa Pig. “I’ve lost my hat!” She looked everywhere, under the tree, near the bench, and even inside the wooden house. But the red polka dot hat was nowhere to be seen. And she noticed right away: “I can’t find my shadow anymore!”

Peppa Pig felt a little sad. Her shadow kept her cool when the sun shone so brightly. Then, Peppa Pig had an idea. She saw the sun and said, “Sun, Sun, can you help me?” The sun smiled with its golden rays. “Your hat has moved in that direction,” said the Sun, pointing with its light to the corner of the garden.

Peppa Pig ran quickly in that direction. She looked under a bush full of colorful flowers and… there it was! Her red polka dot hat! It was just hidden among the leaves. Peppa Pig jumped for joy. She quickly got her hat back. 

The sun continued to shine, warm and friendly. Peppa Pig sat on the grass and smiled. Everything was perfect again. She felt happy and calm.

plan.problema: Peppa has lost her favorite hat and can't find her shadow.
plan.svolta: She decides to ask for help from the sun, which tells her the direction in which the hat moved.
plan.finale: Peppa finds the hat under a bush full of flowers and returns happily.

peppa pig.text:
Peppa Pig was in her garden. It was a lovely garden full of colorful flowers and lots of mud puddles. Peppa loved to play in the mud puddles, especially when it rained. But today the sun was shining brightly in the sky and it was a perfect day to play outside.

Peppa was hopping happily when suddenly she noticed she had lost her favorite hat, the one with silver stars. “Oh no!” exclaimed Peppa. “I can’t find it! Where did it go?” She looked everywhere: under the tree, near the lavender bush, even inside the fish pond. But the hat was gone.

Peppa was very sad. She sat down on the ground, trying to figure out what to do. Then she had an idea! “Wait!” said Peppa Pig. “I’ll follow my footprints in the mud puddles! Maybe they took it away.”

And so, Peppa began to follow her own footprints, which stretched across the mud puddles. She walked back and forth, following her path. It was a little difficult, because the mud puddles were so many and sometimes they mixed up. But Peppa didn’t give up.

Finally, after a while, the footprints led her under a big rose and honeysuckle bush. And there, right among the roses, was her favorite hat! Peppa Pig ran straight over to celebrate with George and Daisy, her toy friends. Everyone was happy that Peppa had found her hat. 

Peppa rested a little, happy to have found her favorite thing thanks to her perseverance. The most important thing is never to give up, because with effort and curiosity, you can always reach your goal.

plan.problema: Peppa got lost in her backyard and couldn't find her favorite hat.
plan.svolta: She decided to follow her footprints in the mud dots, hoping they would lead her back to where she had left it.
plan.finale: Finally, she found the hat under a rose bush and ran to celebrate with her toy friends.

peppa pig.text:
Peppa Pig loved to play in the garden at home. It was a place full of colorful flowers and green grass. Today she really wanted to play tag and run, but she had a problem. She couldn't find her favorite boots! The boots were red with little white stars. She wore them yesterday and now she couldn't see them anywhere.

Peppa Pig looked around. She looked under the tree where she played often, but the boots weren't there. She looked near the wooden house, but nothing. She was so sad because she really wanted to run with her red boots.

Then Peppa Pig decided to ask for help from her friend George. Running towards his building, she saw George busy building a very tall tower with colorful blocks. “Hello George!” said Peppa Pig. “Can you help me find my boots?” But George was too busy. “I’m building my tower! I can’t help you!” George replied without looking around.

Peppa Pig felt a little sad, but she didn’t give up. She kept looking and, suddenly, she saw something red among the roses! The boots were right there, hidden under the rose bush. Peppa Pig picked them up right away and ran happily in the garden, jumping and laughing. She was so happy to have found them!

The day had been perfect for playing with her friends and her favorite boots. Peppa Pig learned that waiting a little while can lead to nice surprises.

plan.problema: Peppa can't find her favorite boots to play with.
plan.svolta: She decides to ask for help from her friend George, but he’s too busy building a tall tower!
plan.finale: Finally, she finds the boots under the rose bush and starts running happily in the garden.

peppa pig.text:
Peppa Pig was in an arcade full of colors. There were tall slides, drawing tables, and lots of other children playing. Peppa Pig loved to play here very much. But suddenly, she got lost! She got carried away while sliding down the red slide and couldn't find her friends, Suzy and Eddy.

She was a little sad. She looked between the slides, she looked under the drawing tables, but nobody saw her. “Oh no!” said Peppa Pig. “I can’t find my friends!” She felt a little scared.

Then, Peppa Pig had an idea! She decided to shout for help: “Hey, can anyone hear me?” But it was too noisy! There was a happy music coming from a speaker and nobody heard her. 

Suddenly, a little teddy bear, sitting on a bench, moved slightly. It was Bruno the teddy bear. Bruno pointed with his paw towards a corridor. “Follow this path,” said Bruno. “It will take you out and your friends are there.”

Peppa Pig followed Bruno’s advice. And indeed, shortly after, she saw Suzy and Eddy waiting for her. They hugged happily! Peppa Pig felt happy to be found. 

She sat next to her friends, laughing and playing. It was nice to have someone to share the game with.

plan.problema: Peppa got lost among the slides and couldn't find her friends.
plan.svolta: She decided to shout for help, but nobody heard her because there was too much music.
plan.finale: She met a teddy bear that showed her the way to the exit and her friends.
plan.morale: Asking for help is always a good idea.

peppa pig.text:
Peppa Pig was happy in her garden. The sun was shining and the little birds were singing. Peppa loved to play there, with her friends and buddies. Today, though, Peppa had something very important: her favorite red ball! She always held it tight, but suddenly… she lost it!

“Oh no!” exclaimed Peppa Pig. She looked everywhere. She looked under the rose bush, behind the old milk cart, and near her slide. But the red ball wasn’t there anymore. It had disappeared into the green field!

Peppa Pig sat down and started to look carefully. She tried to look under the big trees, but it was too high to see well. She couldn’t find anything, just tall grass and green leaves. “Mommy pig, Daddy pig, help me!” cried Peppa Pig, but her parents were too busy building a sandcastle.

Suddenly, she heard a friendly voice: “Hello Peppa Pig! Can I help you?” It was Mr. Potato Head, her friend with lots of movable parts. Together they looked and looked. Then, Mr. Potato Head had an idea. “Look here, Peppa Pig!” he said, pointing with a potato arm.

Peppa Pig came closer and looked. Her red ball was right where she had dropped her foot! She had been so distracted running that she hadn’t noticed. 

Peppa Pig picked up her ball and smiled. “Thank you, Mr. Potato Head!” she said happily. Peppa Pig realized that when you pay attention to what you’re doing, you easily find lost things.

plan.problema: Peppa has lost her favorite ball in the garden!
plan.svolta: She tried to look under the trees, but she was too tall and couldn't see anything.
plan.finale: With the help of her friend Mr. Potato Head, she found the ball exactly where she dropped her foot!
plan.morale: We have to be careful about what we do.

peppa pig.text:
Peppa Pig loved to play in the garden at home. It was a garden full of colorful flowers and green grass. Peppa Pig had red shoes that she loved to wear. Her red shoes were the most beautiful of all!

---

One day, Peppa Pig ran across the lawn chasing George. She had so much fun jumping and it was then that she noticed her red shoes were gone! “Oh no!” exclaimed Peppa Pig. “Where did my red shoes go?”

---

Peppa Pig looked everywhere. She looked between the flowers, under the trees, and behind the rose bush. But her red shoes weren't there. She was very sad. George arrived and said, "Maybe they fell into the grass!"

---

Peppa Pig started to look very carefully. She saw that the tulips were all scattered on the ground, as if they had made a big pile. Then she noticed something: the wind had blown the tulips! And maybe, just maybe, her red shoes were under the tulips.

---

Peppa Pig picked up a tulip and gently moved it to the side. Then she picked up another one and moved it to the other side. With patience, one by one, she moved all the tulips. It was a long and tiring job, but Peppa Pig didn’t give up.

---

Finally, after a long time, among the tulips, her red shoes were shining! They were dirty with dirt, but they were there! Peppa Pig jumped happily. Her red shoes were found! George ran to hug her. 

---

Peppa Pig realized that even when things seem difficult, if you persevere, you can always find the solution.

plan.problema: Peppa has lost her favorite red shoes in the garden!
plan.svolta: She noticed that the wind had blown the tulips into a pile and, with patience, she moved them one by one.
plan.finale: Finally, among the tulips, she found her shiny red shoes!

policeman.text:
Polis was a toy police officer. He loved the playground where he spent his days. He was made of blue plastic and had a white star on his forehead. Polis loved guarding the playground, making sure all the children had fun safely.

---

One day, he heard a cry. “Oh no!” exclaimed Leo. His red balloon had fallen into the fountain! It was a brand new balloon and Leo loved it very much. Polis ran towards the fountain. He saw the red balloon floating on the water, right in the middle.

---

Polis tried to reach the balloon with his toy finger, but it was too far away. Besides, it was slippery on the water! He couldn't do anything. He was frustrated. A little boy, Marco, was watching the scene. He saw Polis in trouble.

---

“Can I help?” asked Marco. Polis nodded quickly. Marco took a long, strong rope from his backpack. He tied it to Polis’s handle. Then, with a strong pull, he pulled the rope. The red balloon started to rise! With one last effort, Polis managed to get the balloon into the happy hands of Leo.

---

Leo thanked Marco and Polis. All the children at the playground watched the scene with admiration. Polis felt proud of his job. 

---

Polis realized that even a little help can make a big difference, especially when there are problems to solve together.

plan.problema: Leo’s red balloon fell into the fountain!
plan.svolta: Polly tried to reach the balloon with her toy finger, but it was too far away and she was slipping on the water.
plan.finale: Polly called for help, and a boy ran with a rope to pull the balloon out!

policeman.text:
Polis was a plastic policeman, blue and shiny. He lived at the playground. He loved to be a good policeman, even though he didn’t need to arrest anyone! Sometimes he just ran and jumped among the toys.

One afternoon, he heard a cry. It was Leo, a little boy playing with a red balloon. The balloon had flown away! It had ended up inside the tall, leafy bush. Leo was very sad. “My balloon!” he said, between tears.

Polis went to the bush. “Don’t worry, Leo,” he said. “I’ll help you get it back.” He tried to pull the balloon out with his flashlight, but it was too tight. His arms didn’t reach the red balloon.

He heard voices. It was Sara, a girl playing nearby. “What’s happening?” she asked. Polis explained the situation. Sara ran to get a long stick. Together they tried to reach the balloon, but it was still difficult.

Then other children arrived: Marco and Giulia. Everyone wanted to help Polis! Using sticks, their hands, and even their feet, they managed to pull the red balloon out of the bush. Leo was very happy to have his balloon back.

Polis smiled. He was happy that everyone had helped him. Everyone was happy and smiling. Polis felt like a real hero! Teamwork made all the difference.

plan.problema: Leo’s balloon ended up in the bush!
plan.svolta: Polly tried to pull the balloon out with her flashlight, but it was too tight.
plan.finale: He called for help and the children helped him to retrieve it, happy and smiling.

policeman.text:
Police Officer Leo was a very good police officer. He lived in the playground and loved to keep everything tidy. He had a bright blue jacket and a wide-brimmed hat. Today the sun was shining brightly and the children were playing happily.

Suddenly, Police Officer Leo noticed something strange. Rosa, a little girl who often played in the park, was very sad. “My balloons! They’ve disappeared!” said Rosa with tears in her eyes. All of her beautiful, light pink balloons were scattered all over the ground. Nobody knew where they had gone.

Police Officer Leo started to work right away. He looked among the trees, under the slides, near the fountain. But the balloons were too light. The wind had carried them away. There was nothing to do, thought Police Officer Leo. 

Then he had an idea! He ran to the highest slide in the park. He took a strong rope and tied it firmly to the edge of the slide. He pulled it up, creating a tall rope in the sky. “If the balloons fly high, they can come back here!” exclaimed Police Officer Leo.

To his great surprise, one by one, the pink balloons reappeared from the rope, floating happily around Rosa again. The little girl smiled happily.

Police Officer Leo sat down, satisfied. He had solved the problem calmly and patiently. He remembered that finding lost things takes time and attention. 

Serenity is often the key to overcoming any difficulty.

plan.problema: Rosa’s balloons are all finished on the ground, nobody knows where they’ve gone!
plan.svolta: Leo looked everywhere, but the balloons were too light and the wind had carried them away.
plan.finale: Then Leo thought of hanging a high rope to the highest slide to bring the balloons back!

policeman.text:
Sergeant Leo was a very good policeman. He had a bright red helmet and a powerful flashlight. He lived at the playground, right next to the fountain. Every day he helped to keep the order.

 

One afternoon, he heard a sad voice. “Oh no! Oh no!” Sergeant Leo turned around quickly. It was Rosa, a little girl who was playing in the gazebo. “My balloons are gone!” she cried. “I had just hung them here and now they’re not there!”

 

Sergeant Leo scratched his head with his hand. “Don’t worry, little Rosa,” he said. “I’ll take care of the problem.” He started to look around. The gazebo was empty. There were no signs of a theft. Sergeant Leo was frustrated.

 

Suddenly, he noticed something. Small paw prints of a cat on the ground, leading out of the gazebo. “There,” thought Sergeant Leo. “This could be a clue.” He followed the prints along the path. The prints were fresh and they led far away.

 

Sergeant Leo walked through the trees of the playground. Finally, he arrived under a big tree. And there, hidden among the roots, were Rosa’s balloons! A little kitten was sleeping among the balloons, using them as a soft bed.

 

Sergeant Leo smiled. He had solved the mystery. He picked up the balloons and returned them to Rosa who was very happy. The kitten woke up, curious, but then went back to sleep among his new colorful friends. Sergeant Leo realized that even the smallest problems require a little patience to solve.

plan.problema: Rosa’s balloons have disappeared mysteriously from the gazebo!
plan.svolta: Sergeant Leo, frustrated, decided to follow the tiny cat footprints.
plan.finale: He found the balloons hidden under a tree, where a little kitten had collected them to make a soft bed.

policeman.text:
Pipolino was a very special police officer. He was a toy, but he could move and talk! He lived at the playground, and that’s where a strange thing happened. Leo was enjoying his strawberry ice cream, a tall and delicious cone. Suddenly, the cone fell to the ground, spilling chocolate everywhere. Everyone around was astonished: “Who did it?” they asked. Nobody knew!

Pipolino scratched his mechanical head. “Don’t worry,” he said. “I’ll find the culprit!” He got into a marching position and began to inspect the grass. The children watched him curiously, some laughing. Pipolino was determined.

Then he had an idea! He took his megaphone, the one he used to speak loudly, and shouted: “Everyone stop! I’ll look for clues!” He began to follow the small dark chocolate sprinkles, as if they were important clues. The sprinkles moved slightly towards the biggest tree.

Pipolino followed the trail carefully. He saw a little bird sitting on a branch. The bird had a piece of ice cream on its tummy! Everyone laughed loudly. The chocolate had been eaten by a greedy bird.

Pipolino adjusted his hat and smiled. He had solved the mystery! The other children thanked Pipolino for helping them understand what had happened. Pipolino realized that even when things seem confusing, with calmness and patience you can always find the right solution. The playground returned to normal, and Pipolino continued to watch over the children.

plan.problema: Leo’s ice cream fell on the ground and no one knows who did it!
plan.svolta: Pipolino, with his megaphone, shouted: ‘Everyone stop! I’ll look for the tracks!’ and started following the small grains of chocolate.
plan.finale: Finally he found a little bird that had pecked a chocolate crumb of ice cream, and everyone laughed!

policeman.text:
Sergeant Pip was a plastic policeman, but he wasn’t a normal toy. He could move, talk, and help people. He was at the playground, ready for action. The sun was shining brightly in the sky and the children were laughing happily.

Suddenly, Sergeant Pip heard a sad cry. “Oh no! My blue balloon is at the top of the tree!” shouted Leo, a boy with scraped knees. The blue balloon was his favorite. Sergeant Pip knew what to do: he had to solve the problem.

Sergeant Pip walked up to the tree. It was very tall! He tried to jump, but it was too far. He slid down with a thump and landed on the sand. “Uff!” said Sergeant Pip, getting up. “We need to find a way to reach the balloon.”

A boy, Marco, saw Sergeant Pip in trouble. Marco had a long, flexible rope. Without thinking twice, he threw the rope to Sergeant Pip. The policeman grabbed the rope tightly and, with the help of Marco, climbed up the tree.

Finally, Sergeant Pip managed to grab the blue balloon! He brought it back to Leo who thanked him with a big smile. Sergeant Pip was happy to have helped. “Thank you, Marco!” exclaimed Sergeant Pip.

Leo took his balloon and hugged it tight. Sergeant Pip felt proud. He had solved the problem with someone. He turned to Marco and smiled. It had been wonderful to work together.

Sergeant Pip realized that even a little help can make a difference.

plan.problema: Leo’s blue balloon ended up at the top of the tree!
plan.svolta: Sergeant Pip tried to jump and reach the balloon, but it was too high and he slid down.
plan.finale: With the help of a child who threw him a rope, Sergeant Pip was able to grab the balloon and happily return it to Leo.

policeman.text:
Polis was a toy police officer. He lived at the playground. He was made of blue plastic and had a red hat and a toy gun. Polis loved to help everyone.

One day, the children at the playground were very sad. The red ball was missing! Everyone was looking for it but nobody could find it. “Oh no!” said Polis. “That’s not fair.”

Polis looked around. The children were crying. He wanted to do something. Then he had an idea. Polis took out his megaphone, the one that real police officers use. “Hey! Hey! Is anyone there?” he shouted loudly. “I need help finding a red ball!”

A little rabbit, Bianchino, was playing near a tree. He heard Polis and replied, “I saw the ball! It was under the big tree.”

Polis ran straight to the tree. There was the red ball! He picked it up and gave it back to the children. Everyone was happy. They were laughing and playing again.

Bianchino was hopping happily. Polis adjusted his gun. “It was fantastic working together,” he said. All the children thanked Polis and Bianchino. 

Polis realized that when everyone works together, even the biggest problems can be solved easily.

plan.problema: The red ball has disappeared and all the children are sad.
plan.svolta: Polly has the idea to use her megaphone to call for help and ask for information.
plan.finale: A little rabbit saw the ball under a tree and happily returned it to everyone.

policeman.text:
Sergeant Rocco was a plastic policeman, but he wasn't just plastic. He could talk! And he moved, just like a real law officer. He was at the playground, ready to help anyone who needed it.

The playground was full of children running and laughing.

Suddenly, Sergeant Rocco heard a sad voice. “Oh no!” he said. It was Leo, a little boy with teary eyes. “My balloons have disappeared from the gazebo!” he cried.

Sergeant Rocco walked over to the gazebo. The balloons were gone!

Sergeant Rocco decided to investigate. He tried to follow the footprints in the mud near the slide. But the mud was wet and the footprints were mixed up. Sergeant Rocco got lost among the slides, the water games, and the swings. It was a real mess!

Then, he heard a meow. A gray cat, Pipo, was looking at Sergeant Rocco with innocent eyes. Pipo had a colorful blanket in his hand. Under the blanket, were all of Leo’s balloons! Pipo had simply moved them there.

Sergeant Rocco smiled. “Found!” he said. Leo ran to the gazebo and got his balloons back. He was so happy. Sergeant Rocco went back to his rounds, checking that everything was in order. 

Sometimes, to solve a problem, you just have to look carefully where the solution is.

plan.problema: Leo’s balloons disappeared mysteriously from the gazebo!
plan.svolta: Sergeant Rocco tried to follow the footprints in the mud, but he got lost among the slides.
plan.finale: He discovered that the cat Pipo had simply moved the balloons under a colored sheet.
plan.morale: Sometimes all it takes is a little search.

policeman.text:
Polis was a toy police officer. He was made of blue plastic and had a red, pointy hat. He lived in the playground. Polis loved to be a good police officer. Every day he helped the children play safely.

One afternoon, a little girl was crying near the swing. “My red ball is lost!” she shouted. Everyone looked for the ball, but they couldn't find it. It was a brand new, shiny red ball, and everyone was very sad.

Polis started to work right away. He began to check under the slides. Then he looked behind the sandcastles. He searched among the swings and even inside the trampoline pit. But the red ball was still missing! Polis scratched his head with his little plastic hand.

Suddenly, Polis saw a little bird flying towards a tree. The bird had something in its feet: it was the red ball! The bird was taking the ball to its nest. Polis ran to the tree and told the bird to give back the ball.

The bird, a little shy, dropped the ball to the ground. Polis picked it up and gave it back to the little girl who had cried. The little girl smiled and thanked Polis. Everyone in the playground was happy. 

Polis sat down for a moment, pleased with his work. He realized that even when things seem difficult, with calmness and attention you always find the solution. He returned to his place next to the swing, ready to help the children play.

plan.problema: The red ball has disappeared and no one knows where it is!
plan.svolta: Polis looked everywhere, under the slides and behind the sandcastles, but the ball was still missing.
plan.finale: Then she saw a little bird carrying the ball to its nest, and she returned it happily!

policeman.text:
Policeman Leo was a very good policeman. He lived at the playground. He had a blue uniform and a red hat. He liked to help everyone. Today, however, there was a big problem!

Rosa, a little girl who often played in the park, ran to him with teary eyes. “Policeman Leo! My balloons have disappeared from the little house!” she exclaimed. Policeman Leo looked around. The little house was empty. There were no pink balloons left.

Policeman Leo began to investigate. He tried to follow the footprints in the mud near the little house, but he didn’t find anything. There were no clues, no trail to follow. He felt a little frustrated. He thought it would be difficult to solve the mystery of the missing balloons.

Suddenly, a little squirrel approached Policeman Leo. The little squirrel pointed with its tail to a spot among the nearest bushes. Policeman Leo ran towards the bushes and… he saw them! The pink balloons were on the ground, scattered everywhere. The strong wind had blown them away from the little house.

Policeman Leo carefully picked up the balloons and returned them to Rosa. Rosa was so happy to have her balloons back. Policeman Leo felt satisfied. He had solved the mystery, even if it took him a little while. 

Policeman Leo knew that sometimes you have to wait and look calmly to find the right solution. Patience can help solve the biggest problems.

plan.problema: Rosa’s balloons have disappeared mysteriously from the little house!
plan.svolta: Leo tried to follow the footprints in the mud, but he hadn’t found any clues.
plan.finale: A little squirrel showed him the hiding place among the bushes, where the balloons had fallen because of the wind!

power rangers.text:
Power Rangers was a special Ranger. He lived in the playground at Piazza del Sole. He was made of red, blue, and gold plastic. He loved to run among all the children who played there. One day, Power Rangers noticed something strange. The park’s puppets, the colorful ones with smiling faces, were all turning gray! They couldn’t be seen anymore.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Power Rangers. “This can’t happen! All my friends are lost!” He went up to Leo, a boy who was playing with toy trains. “Leo, have you seen them?” he asked. Leo shook his head, confused. “I don’t see them anymore,” he said.

Power Rangers thought, thought, and thought. He remembered something important: his special dart! It was a bright dart, made of golden metal. He always threw it when he needed to help others. Power Rangers grabbed the dart and aimed it at the gray puppets.

The dart shot out a bright light! The puppets started to change color, becoming red, blue, yellow, and green. They all became colorful and happy again. The children laughed with joy. Power Rangers jumped up high, a big jump of joy to see his friends back to playing.

Leo ran to Power Rangers and hugged him. “Thank you!” he said. Together, the children and Power Rangers played in the playground, showing that when you work together, everything is more fun.

plan.problema: The toy figures in the playground are becoming invisible!
plan.svolta: Ranger remembers to use his special dart to restore the colors of the toy figures.
plan.finale: All the toy figures return colorful and happy, and Ranger takes a big jump of joy!

power rangers.text:
I am Power Rangers! I am a blue and red Power Ranger, and I live in the big castle at the playground. I love to run, jump, and fight the bad guys… at least the ones who drop the blocks. Today was a strange day. The children were playing normally, but then they said, “The blocks have disappeared!”

I looked around with my powerful arms. The castle was full of colorful blocks: red, yellow, blue, and green. But they weren’t there anymore! No one knew where they had gone. I asked for help from Leo, the little squirrel who often visits me. Leo was very sad because he loved to build with blocks.

“We have to find the blocks!” I told everyone. We looked under the swings, behind the altar, and even in the sandbox. But nothing! Then, I had an idea! I took out my special scanner, the one I use to find the bad guys. I activated it and we pointed the beam towards the castle.

The beam went around quickly and then stopped near a small den among the roots of a big tree. Some curious squirrels came out, with lots of colorful blocks in their hands! They were building a new house for their family! Leo was very happy to help his squirrel friends.

Power Rangers smiled. He had solved the mystery and had helped everyone work together. The blocks were back in the castle, ready for new adventures. And Power Rangers understood that when you work together, even the hardest things become easy.

plan.problema: The colorful blocks have disappeared mysteriously from the big castle!
plan.svolta: After searching everywhere, the Power Rangers had the idea to use their scanner to locate the source of the problem.
plan.finale: The scanner revealed a small group of squirrels who were hiding the blocks in their den to build a new house!

power rangers.text:
I am Power Rangers! I am a red and blue Power Ranger. I love to play in the playground. There is a big castle, colorful slides, and lots of spinning dolls that go round and round. Today the playground is full of children laughing and running. But there was something strange.

The dolls weren't spinning anymore! They were standing still on the grass. The children sat near them, but the dolls stayed still. Nobody understood why. Power Rangers was worried. He wanted to help all the children play.

Power Rangers tried to push the first doll. It didn't move. He pushed the second, then the third… nothing! The children looked at Power Rangers with their arms raised. “I don’t know what to do!” Power Rangers thought.

Then, a girl named Sofia said: "Maybe there are some dry leaves that are blocking them!" Power Rangers went closer and saw a big pile of dry leaves covering the feet of the dolls. 

Power Rangers started to remove the leaves with his strong arms. Pull, pull, pull! And as he removed the leaves, the dolls started to spin quickly. All the dolls were spinning happily and the children clapped. Power Rangers felt happy. 

Sofia was smiling. “See, Power Rangers? Sometimes you just have to wait a little while and look for the solution calmly.” Power Rangers continued to play with all the children until sunset. Patience had solved the problem.

plan.problema: The dolls in the playground stopped spinning and nobody knows why!
plan.svolta: The Power Rangers, with their special strength, tried to push every doll, but none of them moved.
plan.finale: They discovered that the dolls were just stuck by a pile of dry leaves and, removing them, all the dolls went back to spinning happily!

power rangers.text:
I am Power Rangers! I am a Power Ranger made of plastic, green and red. I live in the playground. I really like watching the children play. But today there wasn't anyone really having fun. The playground figures were all still. They weren't moving anymore. It was sad!

I saw the little Leo sitting on the swing. Leo is a good boy at building. He slumped down on his knees, with his arms down. “I don’t understand,” said Leo, “there’s no more fun here.”

I, Power Rangers, had an idea! I pulled my special dart. It’s made of shiny metal and it goes “tick tick tick!”. I aimed the dart at the first figure, a teddy bear. *Tick tick tick!* The teddy bear started to spin really fast!

Then I aimed the dart at the train, then the swing, then the flashing ball. *Tick tick tick!* One by one, all the figures started to spin and move again. The little Leo was laughing with joy.

The playground was full of children running and playing. Everyone was having so much fun. Power Rangers felt a great happiness.

Leo said: “It’s fantastic! Thank you, Power Rangers!” All the figures were spinning together, in a swirl of colors. It was beautiful. Power Rangers knew that when everyone works together, things become more fun.

plan.problema: The toy figures at the playground stopped spinning and the fun disappeared!
plan.svolta: Leo, the Power Ranger, had an idea: he used his dart to activate each figure one by one.
plan.finale: All the toy figures started spinning quickly again and the playground was full of laughter once more!

power rangers.text:
Power Rangers was in the playground. He was a blue and red Power Ranger, very brave. The children loved him, but he preferred to watch the playground full of slides, swings, and a sandbox. Suddenly, Power Rangers noticed something strange. All his toy friends – the red car, the pink doll, the yellow train – were gone! Nobody could see them anymore.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Power Rangers. “This is a really big problem!” He looked around frantically. The playground seemed empty and quiet. They had to do something. Power Rangers had a special power: a small scanner that could detect the energy of the toys.

Power Rangers turned on the scanner. The blue light began to flash, pointing towards the trees of the playground. The scanner indicated a precise direction: the squirrel’s nest! Power Rangers ran quickly and found the squirrels playing among the branches. The little animals had collected all the missing toys and taken them to their nest.

“Guys, these are yours?” asked Power Rangers. The squirrels laughed and returned the toys to the children of the playground. Everyone was happy to see their friends again. Power Rangers felt very happy. He had solved the mystery! 

The sun was setting, lighting up the playground with a golden light. Power Rangers realized that sometimes, a small kind gesture can solve even the biggest problems.

plan.problema: The toys from the playground have disappeared mysteriously!
plan.svolta: Ranger decides to use his scanner to track the energy of the missing toys.
plan.finale: The energy leads him to a group of squirrels who had simply moved the toys to their den, and he brings them back happily.

power rangers.text:
Power Rangers was in the playground. He was a blue and red Power Ranger, with a special jacket and a sparkly armor. The other toys – cars, dolls, balls – were all grey and sad. They didn’t have their colors anymore!

“Oh no!” said Power Rangers. “This is terrible! All my friends have become so faded.” He turned around to see if anyone would help him, but only a little teddy bear was watching the situation with sadness.

Power Rangers decided to do something. He used his special laser, the one that shot out colorful beams. He aimed the energy up and analyzed the air. “There he is!” exclaimed Power Rangers. “A little wizard is stealing the colors! He’s flying above the tallest tower.”

The wizard was a small man with a pointy hat and a sparkly wand. He was collecting the colors of the toys in small glass bubbles. Power Rangers ran towards him, aimed his laser, and hit him. The wizard shouted and dropped the color bubbles.

Power Rangers used his strength to collect all the bubbles and give them back to his friends. Immediately the toys returned to shining like before. The teddy bear smiled happily. Power Rangers looked around, seeing all his friends laughing and having fun.

Power Rangers realized that to solve any problem, even the most complicated one, it’s important to work together. All the toys hugged each other happily to be back in color.

plan.problema: The toys in the playground have lost all their colors!
plan.svolta: Ranger decides to use his laser to analyze the air and discovers that a little wizard is stealing the color.
plan.finale: Ranger confronts the wizard with his strength and courage, recovering all the colors of the playground toys and returning them to their friends.

power rangers.text:
Power Rangers was in the playground. He was a blue and red Power Ranger, just like all the other little friends. Yesterday had been a fantastic day: the children had made him run, jump, and play! But today something wasn't right. He noticed that many of his friends, the playground toys, were turning blue. The tree toy was blue, the teddy bear was blue, even the carousel had become blue!

“Oh no!” exclaimed Power Rangers. “This isn’t fair! Colors are important!” He looked for help, but nobody seemed to know what to do. A little boy was watching, frowning.

Power Rangers noticed something: the sun was shining too brightly. The light was so intense that it seemed to be stealing the colors from his little friends. Then he had an idea! He took his umbrella, the big and colorful one, and opened it with a flourish. The umbrella created a cool, protective shadow over the blue toys.

Slowly, the colors came back! The tree toy became green, the teddy bear turned brown, and the carousel turned red again. All the toys were like new, happy and ready to play. Power Rangers felt happy. He had been clever to find a solution.

The children in the playground laughed and ran to play with all the toys. Power Rangers smiled: it was lovely to see them all together, happy and friends. The kindness of Power Rangers had solved the problem.

plan.problema: The dolls in the park are all turning blue!
plan.svolta: He realizes that the too bright sun is making the dolls lose their color and fixes them with an umbrella.
plan.finale: All the dolls return to their original shape, happy and ready to play together again.

power rangers.text:
I am Power Rangers! I am a Power Ranger and I live in the playground. I love to run between the slides and the swings. There are so many happy children here today. Suddenly, the playground pals stopped. They aren’t blinking anymore, they aren’t making their happy music! The children are starting to feel a little sad. The children’s smiles are fading.

I feel worried. I need to do something! I try to act. I try to press all the buttons, but nothing happens. Nothing moves. I call Leo, the biggest boy in the playground. “Leo, look! The pals are turned off!” he says. Leo shakes his head. “I don’t know what to do, Power Rangers.”

Then I try something different. I concentrate all my energy and I shoot a beam of light towards the pals. The beam hits, but the pals stay still. Nothing happens! I realize I made a mistake.

Then I remember: the pals love music! I take my remote control and I turn on a happy, upbeat song. The music starts to play and… the pals light up again! The children laugh, jump and run to them. The smiles come back to their faces. 

Power Rangers smiles. Music always makes things better! Everyone plays together happily. It’s wonderful to see the joy spreading.

plan.problema: The dolls at the playground stopped working and the children’s smiles were fading!
plan.svolta: Power Rangers tried to restart the dolls with an energy beam, but it didn’t work.
plan.finale: He realized the dolls just needed some happy music and brought them back to life!

power rangers.text:
Power Rangers was a special Power Ranger. He lived in the Blue Square Playground. He was made of red and blue plastic, with a star-shaped helmet. Every day, he watched the children play. He liked to see their happy smiles.

But today something wasn't right. The playground puppies, the ones that went up and down, stopped working! They were all still and quiet. And the children... the children had lost their smiles. It seemed like the sun had become more gray too.

Power Rangers felt sad. “I have to do something!” he thought. He went up to Leo, a boy who especially loved to run after the puppies. “Leo,” said Power Rangers, “it’s like something important is missing.”

Then Power Rangers started to do gymnastics! He jumped up and down, stretched, and made silly faces. He tried to move the energy inside himself. His star-shaped helmet shone a little.

Suddenly, with a big jump, Power Rangers jumped into the air! And then, with a huge smile, he hit the nearest puppy. The puppy started to spin! Then another and another one. The children burst with joy. They laughed and ran.

The playground puppies started to play again, full of energy. Power Rangers felt happy. He had brought the happiness back to the playground. A spark of positive energy can really do miracles.

plan.problema: The toys at the playground stopped working and the children’s smiles were fading!
plan.svolta: Ranger realized that he was missing a spark of positive energy and started to exercise to wake it up.
plan.finale: With a big jump and a smile, Ranger reactivated the toys, returning the game and joy to the children.

power rangers.text:
Power Rangers was in the playground. He was a Power Ranger blue, with a sparkling blaster arm. The children loved him and made him fly high. But today he was the only one there. The playground puppets, the little colorful teddy bears, were disappearing! They were first red and yellow, then they became gray and dull. No one saw them anymore!

Power Rangers felt worried. They had to do something. The little teddy bear Bruno, a yellow puppet, was the saddest of all. “I can’t play anymore!” said Bruno with a weak voice. Power Rangers understood that he had to act. He stood up, ready for action.

“I have to use my blaster arm,” thought Power Rangers. He pointed the blaster at the invisible puppets. He fired a bright blue light beam. The beam hit Bruno and all the other puppets. For a moment, everything became quiet. Then, one by one, the puppets returned to being colorful! Teddy bear Bruno became yellow again, the white rabbit became white, and everyone laughed with joy.

Power Rangers felt happy. He had saved the playground! The children ran to take the puppets, hugging them and laughing. Power Rangers knew that even a small gesture, made with courage, could make a big difference. And this was always true.

plan.problema: The toys in the playground are becoming invisible!
plan.svolta: Leo, the bravest Power Ranger, decides to use his blaster arm to try and make them reappear.
plan.finale: With one last ray of light, all the toys return colorful and happy.

robot humanoid.text:
Robby was a special humanoid robot. He lived in the Creative Lab, a place full of lights and colors. Robby loved to dance and make silly movements. He was always ready to turn around, to wave hello, and to make bubbles with his mechanical arms.

---

One day, Robby noticed that something wasn’t right. He couldn’t move! He tried to push his little feet, but nothing. He was stuck. “Oh no!” thought Robby. “I’ve lost my battery!”

---

Robby desperately looked for where he had put it. He saw the 3D printer, a big machine that created new toys. “3D printer, have you seen my battery?” asked Robby. The 3D printer was too busy creating a new robot with penguin wings. “I can’t help you now,” said the printer, while continuing to spray plastic.

---

Robby felt sad and frustrated. He sat down on his work table, a table full of small tools and mechanical parts. While he was tidying up, he felt something under him. It was his battery! Robby picked it up and put it in his body. Immediately, his little feet started to move and he started to dance with joy.

---

Robby did a happy twirl, grateful to have his energy back. He stopped for a moment and looked at the Creative Lab. Everything was quiet and silent. Robby understood that even waiting a little while could bring a nice surprise.

plan.problema: Robby lost his battery and can’t move anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to ask the 3D printer for help, but it was too busy making new toys.
plan.finale: Robby found the battery under his work table and started dancing with joy.

robot humanoid.text:
Robby was a very curious humanoid robot. He lived in the Creative Lab, a place full of colors and strange shapes. Robby loved to explore every corner, spinning and making little movements. He could play a melody or say a few words.

One day, Robby noticed that something wasn't right. He couldn't move anymore! He tried to jump, but nothing. “Oh no!” said Robby. “I’ve lost my battery!” He thought maybe someone had moved it, but nobody seemed to have seen it. Robby was very sad and still.

Dr. Leo, Robby’s creator, suggested he use his sensors. “Try to follow the last light you saw,” said Dr. Leo. Robby closed his eyes and focused. He used his sensors to find the ray of sunshine coming through the window.

Robby followed that bright ray, slowly turning towards the window. The ray guided him through the lab. Finally, Robby discovered something under a big pile of colorful building blocks: his battery! He took it and put it back in his body. Immediately, Robby felt full of energy. He could spin, jump, and play again.

Robby thanked Dr. Leo for his help. He was happy to be able to move again. Robby learned that even when things seem difficult, with a little patience, you can always find a solution. Robby immediately went back to exploring the Creative Lab, ready for new adventures.

plan.problema: Robby lost his battery and can't move anymore!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his sensors to track the last light he had seen, following the sunbeam through the window.
plan.finale: He found the battery hidden under a pile of colorful building blocks and was immediately back in action!

robot humanoid.text:
Robby was a very special humanoid robot. He lived in the Creative Lab, a place full of colors and strange but fun machines. Robby loved to move, dance, and wave hello with his hand. One day, however, something went wrong. He couldn't move his arms anymore! He was very sad.

Robby tried to turn himself around, to tap his feet, but nothing worked. He tried to talk to the big computer in the lab, but it didn't respond. “Oh no!” thought Robby. “I can’t do anything anymore!” Dr. Leo, a kind inventor, came closer. “What’s happening, Robby?” he asked.

Robby explained his problem. Dr. Leo tried to restart him by pressing a secret button that he had on his back. But it didn’t work. Robby was still frozen. Suddenly, a bright lightbulb turned on above his head. The light shone on a small wire that seemed to be slightly bent.

Robby focused, and with a small movement, he managed to straighten the wire! Immediately, his arms started to move again. Robby made a big smile. “I did it!” he exclaimed. Dr. Leo smiled happily. Robby waved hello with his hand, happier than ever. 

Robby realized that even when things seem difficult, you just need a little time and calmness to find the right solution. Patience always has an answer.

plan.problema: Robby got stuck and couldn’t move his arms anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried restarting with a secret button, but nothing worked.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a bright lightbulb, Robby discovered a small crooked wire and straightened it right away!

robot humanoid.text:
Robby was a humanoid robot and he loved the creative workshop very much. It was full of colors, lights, and strange machines. Robby spent most of his time moving, exploring every corner. One day, while trying to adjust the height of a building tower, he realized he was lost.



He was surrounded by tools: pliers, screwdrivers, nails, and clips. Robby couldn’t find his favorite screwdriver, the one with the yellow tip that he liked so much. He had left it there next to the tower and now he couldn’t see it anymore. “Oh no!” said Robby, making a small arm movement to express his frustration.



Robby tried to use a piece of wood to reach the highest shelf, the one where he kept the small screwdrivers. The wood was too short and wobbly. It fell to the ground with a light thump. Robby felt increasingly sad.



Suddenly, a small drone flew over the workshop. It was called Zoom and it was Robby’s friend. “What’s happening?” asked Zoom, approaching. Robby explained his problem and Zoom flew high, scanning the environment. After a while, he spotted something under a pile of colorful tubes.



“There it is!” exclaimed Zoom, pointing with his camera at the yellow screwdriver lying there. Robby quickly ran over and picked it up in his robotic hands. “Thank you, Zoom! You were fantastic!” said Robby.



Robby and Zoom worked together to fix the building tower. They realized that solving problems is easier when you help each other.

plan.problema: Robby got lost among so many tools and couldn’t find his favorite screwdriver.
plan.svolta: He tried to use a piece of wood to reach the top shelf, but it was too short and wobbly.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of his friend drone, Robby located the screwdriver under a pile of colorful tubes.

robot humanoid.text:
Robby was a humanoid robot. He lived in a creative laboratory full of colorful boxes. It was a wonderful place, but also a little confusing! Robby loved to move between the boxes, turning around and making new discoveries.

One day, while exploring, Robby got lost. He had ended up in an incredible maze. The boxes were so tall and so many, that he couldn’t find his way out. “Oh no!” said Robby, his mechanical arm moved nervously.

Robby had a laser sensor. He used it to see better when it was dark. But the maze was full of reflections! The laser beams refracted on every surface and confused him even more. Robby turned around, but he always ended up in the same place.
