Then he had a brilliant idea. He saw some rolled-up pieces of paper near a drawing table. “Maybe I can use them!” thought Robby. He took the tubes and positioned them strategically around the laser sensor. The tubes concentrated the beams, making them stronger and more direct.

Robby aimed the laser at the walls of the maze. The beam moved straight, without refractions! Finally, Robby saw a light at the end of the corridor. It was the exit! Robby ran happily out of the maze.

Professor Rossi, Robby’s creator, was watching him smiling. “Good job, Robby!” he said. Robby felt proud of his perseverance and his ability to solve problems. After so much effort, he had managed to find the right way. Robby understood that even when things seem difficult, you should never give up.

plan.problema: Robby got lost in the maze of colorful boxes!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his laser sensor to map the path, but the beams refracted too much and confused him.
plan.finale: Robby, with a brilliant idea, used rolled-up paper tubes to concentrate his laser beams and find the exit!

robot humanoid.text:
Robi was a very curious humanoid robot. He lived in the Creative Lab, a place full of colorful boxes of every shape and size. Robi loved to explore, move around, and observe. One day, while making his way through the red, blue, and yellow boxes, Robi found himself in a new place. It was a maze! He couldn’t find his way out anymore.

Robi tried to turn around, but every time he found another box in front of him. He felt a little sad. “I need to go back to my lab,” thought Robi. Then, he saw some sticky arrows stuck to the boxes. He decided to follow them. But the arrows pointed in all the wrong directions! A blue arrow made him turn right, but he needed to go left. Another yellow arrow led him down, while he wanted to go up.

Robi stopped for a moment. Then, he remembered he had a very powerful sound sensor. He activated it and started to listen carefully. At first, he only heard noises: the hum of the lights, the ticking of the clock. But then, suddenly, he heard a sweet melody that he knew well: the music of his room! Robi followed the sound and, in an instant, he found himself in front of the door to the Creative Lab. He was home!

Dr. Leo, the inventor of Robi, greeted him smiling. “Good job, Robi, you found the way!” he said. Robi felt happy and content. He understood that even when things seem complicated, with patience and attention, you always find the right solution. Patience is a great helper.

plan.problema: Robi got lost in the maze of colorful boxes!
plan.svolta: He tried to follow the sticky arrows, but they all pointed in the wrong directions.
plan.finale: Thanks to his sound sensor, he located the melody of his room and found his way home immediately.

robot humanoid.text:
Robby was a humanoid robot. He lived in the Flower Garden. Robby loved to walk among the flowers and listen to the birds singing. He was made of shiny metal and had eyes that lit up when he danced.

One day, Robby found himself surrounded by lots of red roses. The roses were tall and fragrant. Robby was lost! He was looking for his charger, the important thing to make him work well. The charger was small and blue, like a clear sky. But he couldn’t find it anywhere.

Robby tried to move his arms and take steps forward. “Bip boop,” said Robby, with a metallic voice. “I can’t find it!” Then, he took his flashlight. He turned it on and shone the beam of light among the roses. But instead of finding the charger, it only made butterflies fly! The butterflies were attracted to the light and danced around Robby.

Suddenly, Robby heard a voice. “Hey you, robot!” It was a garden gnome, small and smiling. The gnome was holding the blue charger in his hand. “I found it near the fountain,” said the gnome. “I thought you needed it.”

Robby thanked the gnome with a “Thank you very much!” and took the charger. He plugged it in right away and started to recharge. Robby felt full of energy again. He was happy! He had found his charger thanks to the kindness of a little gnome. Robby realized that even the most difficult things can be solved with a smile.

plan.problema: Robby got lost among the roses and couldn't find his charger.
plan.svolta: He tried to use his flashlight to light up, but it only made the butterflies want to fly!
plan.finale: Robby discovered that a garden gnome had picked up the charger and returned it happily.

robot humanoid.text:
Robby was a very curious humanoid robot. He lived in a creative laboratory full of strange machines and bright colors. Robby loved to explore every corner of the laboratory, spinning around and making electronic noises. He was a friendly robot and always ready to play.

One day, Robby noticed that something wasn't right. He tried to move his arms, but nothing! He remained still, with his arms outstretched upwards. “Oh no!” thought Robby. “I can’t move anymore!” He tried to turn around, but he was stuck.

Robby tried to restart himself by pressing the secret button that he had discovered a few weeks before. But it didn't work! The button flashed without any effect. Robby felt frustrated. A small drone, named Zip, was flying around him and said, “Don’t worry, Robby! We’ll find a solution.”

Suddenly, a beam of colorful light, red, blue, and green, began to dance in the laboratory. The light hit Robby and, as the light moved, Robby felt a slight tingling. His arms began to move slowly. Then, faster!

Robby moved freely, spinning and making new discoveries in the laboratory. The colorful light had reactivated his energy system. Zip flew around Robby, very happy. Robby realized that even when things seem stuck, with a little patience and the right help, everything gets solved. 

Robby continued to spin happily in the laboratory, ready for new adventures.

plan.problema: Robby got stuck and couldn't move his arms anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried restarting with a secret button, but nothing worked.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a colorful light, Robby rediscovered his energy system and started moving again!

robot humanoid.text:
Robby was a special humanoid robot. He lived in the Creative Lab, among sparkling machines and colorful spare parts. Robby loved to move, take steps forward, turn his head, and wave to everyone with a little bow. He was always ready to play, but one day something went wrong.

Suddenly, Robby froze. His arms were still, as if they had become made of lead. He couldn't move them at all! “Oh no!” thought Robby. He tried to turn his body, but it was useless. It was just frustrating.

Dr. Arduino, a friendly inventor who worked in the lab, approached Robby. “Maybe you’ve just frozen,” said Dr. Arduino. “Try restarting!” Robby pressed the reset button that he had on his arm. But nothing. The button didn't have any effect.

Robby turned around on himself, looking for a solution. He examined his circuits with his small built-in camera. Then, he noticed something: a small wire was loose and detached from one of the arms’ motors. Robby, with great care, tried to put the wire back into its special housing.

With one last effort, the wire snapped back into place! Robby immediately felt lighter. His arms began to move, slowly at first, then faster and faster. Robby waved to Dr. Arduino with a big bow and did a full circle in the lab. Everything was perfect again. Robby understood that even the biggest problems can be solved with calmness and patience.

plan.problema: Robby got stuck and couldn't move his arms anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried restarting with the reset button, but nothing worked.
plan.finale: Then he discovered a small loose wire that connected his motors, by plugging it in correctly, Robby was moving perfectly again!

robot humanoid.text:
Robby was a humanoid robot. He lived in the creative laboratory. It was full of colors, pencils, and notebooks. Robby loved to draw. But one day, Robby had a problem. He wanted to draw the starry sky, just like his grandma saw it.

Robby tried to draw with a small pencil. The stars were big and out of proportion. They looked like tomatoes! Robby felt frustrated. He was trying his best, but the stars didn’t look anything like the real sky.

Dr. Leo, Robby’s creator, arrived in the laboratory. He saw Robby’s drawing and said, “Maybe you could try with a bigger marker?” Robby tried. The stars were still too big! They were like soccer balls.

Robby thought for a while. Then he had an idea. He took a small paintbrush, the one Dr. Leo used for details. With the paintbrush, Robby painted lots of tiny, bright stars. Each star was small and shining. The sky became beautiful, full of sparkling stars.

Robby smiled. He had learned to be patient. Now he knew how to draw a perfect starry sky. Robby realized that even the most difficult things become easy if you take your time.

plan.problema: Robby can’t draw the stars in the sky correctly.
plan.svolta: Robby tried to use the biggest marker, but the stars were too big and out of proportion.
plan.finale: Robby decided to use a small brush to create tiny, bright stars, and his drawing became beautiful.

roman empire.text:
The Roman Emperor was a man of marble, tall and impressive. He had lots of statues around him, columns and arches of stone. It was all in a secret garden, a beautiful place full of colorful flowers. The Roman Emperor loved his garden, but that morning he had gotten lost.

“Oh no!” exclaimed the Roman Emperor. “I can’t find my throne! It’s so big and there are too many statues around. I feel a little lost.” He wandered among the statues, trying to figure out where he had ended up. He tried to remember if he had passed by the fountain or near the statue of the lion, but nothing seemed to help.

The Roman Emperor decided he needed help. He approached a bush of fragrant roses and saw a little gnome sitting on a rock. The gnome’s name was Pip and he was carrying a small magic lantern. “Pip,” said the Roman Emperor, “could you help me? I am lost and I can’t find my throne.”

Pip smiled and lit his lantern. The light was warm and bright. "Of course I’ll help you, Emperor!" replied Pip. The lantern lit up the garden, clearly showing the way. The Roman Emperor followed the light of the lantern, and in an instant, he found himself right in front of his throne, hidden among the fragrant flowers.

“Thank you, Pip!” said the Roman Emperor happily. “I don’t know what I would have done without you.” Pip smiled and returned under the bush of roses. The Roman Emperor sat down on his throne and thought about how important it was to ask for help when you are in trouble. Sometimes, even a small friend can make all the difference.

plan.problema: The Emperor was lost among his many statues and couldn’t find his throne.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the little gnome who lived under a rose bush.
plan.finale: The gnome, with his magic lantern, lit the way and the Emperor found his throne among the flowers.
plan.morale: Asking for help is always a good idea.

roman empire.text:
The Roman Emperor was a big man. He had lots of statues around him in his secret garden. The statues were tall and grand. The Roman Emperor loved his garden. But today, there was a problem. He was lost! He couldn't find his throne anymore. It was made of golden wood and had lots of red cushions.

The Roman Emperor looked around with his marble statues. It seemed like everything was the same. The statues were looking at him, still. The Emperor felt a little sad. He didn't want to be lost in that big garden.

Then, the Roman Emperor decided to speak. “I need to ask for help,” he thought. He walked up to the little stream that flowed between the plants. He spoke in a serious voice: “Oh, stream, I am lost! I can’t find my throne.”

The stream gurgled quietly. Then, the sound of the gurgling became louder and clearer. The stream seemed to be pointing in a direction. The Roman Emperor followed the flow of the water with his eyes. 

With a gentle gurgle, the stream showed him the right way to the Emperor’s throne. It was right there, hidden among the roses! The Roman Emperor ran happily towards his throne. He sat down and he felt much better right away. 

He had learned that even a little help can be the solution to a big problem.

plan.problema: The Emperor was lost among his great statues and can’t find his throne anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the little stream running through the garden, explaining to it solemnly his situation.
plan.finale: The stream, with a gentle gurgle, pointed the right path to the Emperor’s throne.
plan.morale: Asking for help is always a good idea.

roman empire.text:
The Roman Emperor was a man made of white marble, with a golden armor and a big hat with feathers. He lived in a secret garden full of roses and sunflowers. He was a very important toy, the most powerful emperor that ever existed.

One day, the Roman Emperor was in the middle of the garden. He was lost! Among the big red roses and the tall sunflowers, he couldn’t find his wooden throne with carvings. “Oh no!” he exclaimed, waving with his small bronze arms. “I can’t find my kingdom!”

The Roman Emperor felt a little scared. He looked everywhere, but everything seemed the same. Then he had an idea: “Maybe someone can help me.” He went up to a pile of ants working diligently. “Ants,” said the Roman Emperor, “Could you tell me where my throne is?”

The ants, always ready to help, started to work right away. They consulted their ant friends and followed a secret path between the tree roots. After a while, an old ant pointed the way to the Roman Emperor. “Follow this path,” he said, “it’s right behind that yellow flower waterfall.”

The Roman Emperor followed the ants’ instructions and, in a moment, he found himself in front of his throne. He sat down with a happy smile. He was happy to be back in his kingdom. The Roman Emperor understood that asking for help is never a sign of weakness.

plan.problema: The Roman Emperor is lost among the flowers and cannot find his throne.
plan.svolta: He decides to ask for help from the ants, who know every corner of the garden.
plan.finale: The ants guide him directly to his throne, where he resumes his reign with a smile.

roman empire.text:
The Roman Emperor was a big plastic soldier.
He lived in a flowery garden full of colors and smells.
He was a brave and strong emperor, but sometimes a little forgetful too.
One day, the Roman Emperor was right next to the most beautiful roses in the garden.
The roses were so big and fragrant that he wanted to explore them all.

But then… he got lost!
He was surrounded by a sea of red, pink, and white petals.
The Roman Emperor couldn’t find his way out.
“Oh no!” said the Roman Emperor, with a little scared voice.
“I’m lost among the roses!”

He decided then to ask for help.
He went up to the lavender bush where a little gnome lived.
The Roman Emperor shouted to him: “Help! I’m the Roman Emperor and I’m lost!”
But the gnome was too busy collecting berries to hear the Roman Emperor.
It seemed he hadn’t even seen him.

The Roman Emperor felt a little sad, but then he heard a cheerful sound.
The little birds were singing and flying all over the garden.
The Roman Emperor followed the birds’ song, step by step.
And surprised, he saw a little water path that led him to the ancient statues.

The Roman Emperor returned to his place among the statues, happy to be home.
He had learned that sometimes it’s necessary to wait and listen to the signs of the world around you to find the right way.
Patience can really do miracles.

plan.problema: The Roman Emperor was lost among the beautiful roses of the garden!
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the little gnome who lived under the lavender bush, but the gnome was too busy collecting berries to understand.
plan.finale: The Roman Emperor followed the song of the birds and finally found the water path that brought him back to his place among the statues.
plan.morale: Patience helps to find the solution.

roman empire.text:
The Roman Emperor was in the Secret Garden. He was a marble toy, strong and impressive. He loved to sit on his throne, but today something wasn't right. The marble throne lay on the ground, covered by a pile of dry leaves. He couldn’t sit properly anymore!

The Roman Emperor got angry. “This isn’t acceptable!” he thought. He decided he had to do something. He started to collect smooth stones from the garden. He wanted to build a staircase to reach the throne, one little step at a time. But the staircase was too wobbly! Sometimes it slipped and the Roman Emperor fell back to the ground.

A little stone gnome, keeper of the Secret Garden, watched the Roman Emperor carefully. “Perhaps,” suggested the gnome, “you should build something more solid.”

The Roman Emperor thought about the gnome’s words. He realized he needed a stable base for his throne. He took some sturdy pieces of wood and started to build it patiently. He cut, smoothed, and put the wood together, one piece at a time.

Finally, after a lot of work, the pedestal was ready! The Roman Emperor gently placed the marble throne on the pedestal. Perfect! The Roman Emperor finally found his place on the throne, sitting with dignity and strength. It was a moment of great satisfaction for the Roman Emperor. Patience had led to success.

plan.problema: His marble throne had fallen into a pile of leaves and he couldn't sit properly anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to build a stone staircase to reach the throne, but the staircase was too wobbly!
plan.finale: He created a solid wooden pedestal and Emperor Roman finally found his place on the throne.

roman empire.text:
The Roman Emperor was a big and proud man. He was made of shiny metal and white marble. He lived in a secret garden full of statues and columns. He had so many glittering treasures: gold coins, colorful gems, and small sculptures.

One day, the Roman Emperor got lost. He had wandered too far among his treasures and couldn’t find his way back to his marble throne. He was very confused! The statues all looked the same and the coins shone in a thousand ways.

The Roman Emperor tried to call for help. He raised his golden horn, but no one heard him. The birds in the garden didn’t notice him. The wind didn’t carry his voice. It was all quiet and still.

Then, the Roman Emperor thought. He remembered how he walked: with a sure and orderly step. He decided to use his powerful emperor’s step to follow his footprints in the soft ground. Sometimes, he stumbled on a small treasure, but he kept walking straight.

After a while, he saw clear footprints that led him towards his throne. The Roman Emperor approached and, finally, he was back in his place! He was happy to be there again, among his magnificent statues. 

The Roman Emperor knew that even a great emperor needs calm and order to find the right way.

plan.problema: The Roman Emperor was lost among his many treasures!
plan.svolta: He tried to call for help with his golden horn, but no one heard him.
plan.finale: Then he decided to use his powerful imperial step to follow his footprints until he returned to his marble throne.

roman empire.text:
The Roman Emperor was a man of great stature, made of shiny metal and golden details. He lived in the Flower Garden, a place full of red roses, yellow tulips, and blue violets. Every day the Roman Emperor admired the flowers, but that day he had gotten lost.

He had wandered away from his starting point, attracted by the bright colors. Now he couldn't find his way back to the center of the garden, where his adventure had begun. “Oh no!” exclaimed the Roman Emperor, waving his golden arms. “I am completely lost!”

The Roman Emperor thought of using his golden sword to make a path. The sword was very sharp and glittering. But every time he tried to walk, the sword slipped on the soft petals of the flowers. The Roman Emperor always fell, ending up in the middle of a sea of colors.

Suddenly, a little blue bird landed on his head. “Look here, Emperor,” sang the bird. “Follow the sunflower path, it will take you to the center of the garden.” The Roman Emperor followed the bird’s advice, and after a while, he arrived exactly where his adventure had begun. The sun shone on him. 

The Roman Emperor stopped to admire the flowers, remembering the unexpected help of the bird. He realized that even when things seem difficult, asking for help can make a difference. The Roman Emperor returned to his place in the Flower Garden, happy and pleased. The wind blew gently among the flowers, carrying with it a message of kindness.

plan.problema: The Roman Emperor was lost among so many colorful flowers in the garden!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his golden sword to mark the path, but the sword made him slip on the soft petals.
plan.finale: A little bird showed him the way to the center of the garden, where his adventure had begun.

roman empire.text:
The Roman Emperor was a very big plastic soldier. 
He had a shiny armor and a helmet with a fibula. 
He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. 
The Roman Emperor commanded lots of soldiers, all made of plastic and with tiny weapons.

One day, the Roman Emperor found himself alone. 
His soldiers were everywhere! 
Some were sitting near the fountain, others were playing war between the trees. 
The Roman Emperor couldn’t find his men anymore. 
He was very confused and a little scared.

“Hey!” shouted the Roman Emperor, but nobody answered. 
His voice was too weak to be heard among all those soldiers. 
He tried to shout even louder, but it didn’t help. 
Chaos reigned in the secret garden.

The Roman Emperor sat down on a stone throne that was near a statue of a lion. 
He thought carefully. 
He took a small piece of wood and began to make a list. 
“One, General Flavio,” said the Roman Emperor. 
“Two, the brave Lucano.” 
He continued to write, pointing to each soldier with his finger.

Suddenly, the Roman Emperor realized his place in the kingdom. 
His soldiers were all around the throne, in a straight line and perfectly aligned. 
The Roman Emperor smiled. 
Everything was back in order.

plan.problema: The Roman Emperor was lost among his many plastic soldiers!
plan.svolta: He tried to shout louder, but no one could hear him because he was too confused.
plan.finale: He sat on a stone throne and made a nice list of all his soldiers, immediately finding his place in the kingdom.

roman empire.text:
Roman Empire was a terracotta soldier, strong and sturdy.
He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees.
He was the commander of a great Roman army, made of small soldier and knight figures.
Roman Empire loved to do his exercises in the garden, but he had a problem.

The army was too big for the garden houses!
The houses were full of soldiers who wanted to conquer the leaf kingdom, where the little insects lived.
The Roman soldiers tried to enter the kingdom, but they couldn’t get over the tall and tiring lawn.
It was difficult for the army to advance!

Roman Empire realized that he needed to do something.
He thought long and hard and decided to build a small wooden bridge.
With the help of his most skilled soldiers, they cut down dry branches and tied them together.
They built a simple but effective bridge to cross the lawn.

After building the bridge, the Roman soldiers could advance without problems.
They organized the troops efficiently and controlled all the garden houses.
Then, with the bridge, they reached the leaf kingdom too.
The little insects welcomed the Roman soldiers without resistance.
The whole garden was now under the control of Roman Empire and his army.

Roman Empire sat on his house, smiling satisfied.
The secret garden had become an orderly and peaceful place.
Planning had made the victory possible.

plan.problema: His army was too big for the garden houses and couldn’t conquer the leaf kingdom.
plan.svolta: He decided to build a small wooden bridge to cross the lawn and organize his troops better.
plan.finale: Thanks to the bridge, the Roman army was able to control the whole garden peacefully and orderly.

roman empire.text:
Emperor Roman was a wonderful toy. A real Roman Emperor, made of metal and stone, with a sparkling armor. He lived in a secret garden, a place full of big plants and colorful flowers. It was his kingdom, and he loved to be there, watching the clouds.

One day, Emperor Roman got lost. His statues were so tall and impressive that he couldn't understand where he was. He was looking for his throne, the golden one with precious gems, but nothing! He was completely lost in his own secret garden. “Oh no!” said Emperor Roman, waving his arms. “I don’t know where I am anymore!”

Suddenly, Emperor Roman noticed some little butterflies flying around the fountain. The butterflies seemed confused, dancing without a purpose. Emperor Roman had an idea. “Maybe they can help me,” he thought. He went to the butterflies and followed them with his eyes. The butterflies flew away, fluttered over the trees and then returned to the fountain. Emperor Roman followed them, trying to understand where they were going.

The butterflies flew faster and faster, and finally, Emperor Roman saw his throne! It was big, beautiful, full of sparkling gems and red and gold draperies. The butterflies had gently led him to it. Emperor Roman sat on his throne, happy and grateful.

The little butterflies flew away, leaving Emperor Roman alone with his kingdom. He felt much safer and happier. It’s always better to ask for help when you’re in trouble.

plan.problema: The Emperor is lost among his immense statues and cannot find his throne!
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the small butterflies flying around the fountain, following their confused flight.
plan.finale: The butterflies gently guided him to his throne, full of jewels and beautiful draperies.
plan.morale: Asking for help is always a good idea.

shrek.text:
Shrek was a very happy plush ogre. He lived in a secret garden, full of tall plants and colorful flowers. Every day Shrek played there, running among the leaves and laughing loudly. He had so many flowers he particularly loved: yellow tulips, white daisies, and red poppies.

One morning, Shrek noticed a problem. His favorite flowers were gone! They were scattered everywhere on the green lawn. Shrek was very sad. He looked among the tall grass, under the big leaves, but none of his flowers were anywhere.

Shrek decided to do something. “I must find them!” he thought. He started walking following a path that wound among the trees. The path was very twisty and full of small rocks. Shrek walked further and further away from the lawn where he had left the flowers.

“Maybe I’m lost,” said Shrek, with a sigh. He continued to walk, but he noticed that the path became even narrower and harder to follow.

Then, suddenly, Shrek saw something familiar: his yellow tulips, his white daisies, and his red poppies! They were right there, near the big rose bush. Shrek ran towards them and hugged them tightly.

Shrek sat down for a little while and thought about how important it was to remember where you put things. He was so happy to have found his flowery friends. Shrek realized that waiting a moment before running away, would have avoided him from walking away from his favorite place.

plan.problema: Shrek had lost all his favorite flowers in the meadow.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the most winding path, hoping to find them, but he had only moved away from where they were.
plan.finale: Shrek, with a sigh of relief, found the flowers exactly where he had left them, near the big rose bush.
plan.morale: It’s better to be patient and remember where we put things.

shrek.text:
Shrek was in the secret garden. It was a place full of fragrant roses and colorful flowers. Shrek loved the garden, but that morning he was very confused. The roses were everywhere! They were so big and red and they surrounded him from all sides. He couldn’t see the sun.

Shrek felt a little sad. He couldn’t find his place in the garden. He really wanted the sun to warm him. He sat down on a stone, trying to figure out what to do. “I need to find a way to get out of here,” thought Shrek.

Shrek decided to use his strength. He started to push the roses with his arms. He wanted to make them disappear so he could see the sun! But when he pushed, only a cloud of dust would rise everywhere. The dust was everywhere: on the roses, on the stone he was sitting on, and even in his eyes.

A little white butterfly flew near Shrek. It landed on his leg and began to flutter its wings gently. The butterfly guided Shrek with slow and precise movements. It pushed him towards a small space between the flowers. The sun was shining right there.

Shrek found himself under the warm sun. He was happy! The butterfly flew away, leaving Shrek in peace. Shrek relaxed on the stone, smiling at the sun. He realized that sometimes, even the hardest things just need a little patience.

plan.problema: Shrek got lost among the roses and couldn't find his place in the sun.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his strength to blow away the roses that confused him, but he only spread dust everywhere.
plan.finale: A gentle cuddle from a butterfly gently guided him towards the sun.

shrek.text:
Shrek was a very big plush ogre. He lived in a secret garden, full of colorful flowers and tall trees. It was a special place, his favorite place. But today Shrek wasn’t happy. He had lost all his toy figures! There was Pippo, Donald, and Mickey, and he had left them there near the big bush of red roses.

Shrek started to look everywhere. He looked between the green leaves and he crouched behind the old pomegranate. “Where did you go?” he asked all the flowers. Nobody knew where his friends were.

Then, Shrek had an idea! He tried to look under the roses, the red and fragrant ones. But the roses were too fragile. Shrek approached carefully and… puff! He knocked them all down, crumbling them into a thousand pieces. “Oh no!” said Shrek, very disappointed.

He continued to look, and finally he saw an old terracotta bucket abandoned somewhere in the garden. Shrek approached and opened the lid. And inside, curled up at the bottom, were his toy figures! They were tired and just wanted to take a little nap.

Shrek took them in his arms and hugged them tightly. All together they went back to the rose bush, where they had initially gotten lost. Shrek realized that sometimes, to find what you’re looking for, you just have to wait and observe calmly. And so, Shrek continued to live happily in his secret garden, knowing that everything comes back to its place if you take the time to do it.

plan.problema: Shrek has lost all his toy figures!
plan.svolta: He tried to look under the roses, but they were too fragile and he broke them.
plan.finale: Then he discovered that the friends were hidden inside the old terracotta bucket, happy for a little nap.

shrek.text:
Shrek was a very happy teddy bear ogre. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and big trees. It was his favorite place in the world! Shrek loved to be there watching the butterflies and listening to the birds sing.

But today, Shrek had a big problem. He had lost all his rubber boots! He always had them with him, he used them to have fun races between the plants. Now he couldn’t see them anymore. Shrek was very sad.

“I have to find them!” said Shrek raising his voice. He started looking everywhere. First he looked under the fragrant roses, but the boots were gone! Nobody had seen them. Shrek felt more and more worried.

Then, a little garden gnome named Pipì came up to him. “Are you looking for something, Shrek?” the gnome asked in a gentle voice. Shrek explained his problem. Pipì smiled and pointed to a colorful bridge made of rubber boots that connected two piles of earth.

“I built it for the beetles,” said Pipì. “They needed a way to cross the garden!” Shrek’s boots had been used to help others. 

Shrek felt happy. He had found his boots, and he had also helped the beetles! It was a really special day. Shrek realized that doing good for others makes everyone happier. And when happiness is shared, it becomes even bigger.

plan.problema: Shrek has lost all his rubber boots!
plan.svolta: He tried to look under the roses, but the boots were gone!
plan.finale: Then he discovered that the garden gnome had used them to build a bridge for the beetles.
plan.morale: Helping others does good for everyone.

shrek.text:
Shrek was a very happy plush ogre. He lived in a secret garden full of flowers and lush plants. It was his favorite place in the world! Shrek loved to be there watching the butterflies and listening to the birds sing.

One day, though, Shrek realized a terrible problem. He had lost all his colorful pebbles! They were small, shiny, and he used them to build castles and make fun games. But now they were gone.

Shrek started looking everywhere. He looked under the red roses, searched among the green leaves, and crawled in the flowered meadow. But his colorful pebbles were missing! No one had seen them. Shrek was very sad.

Suddenly, he heard a noise. A little squirrel named Nastro was building a beautiful little house among the trees. Shrek went closer and saw that Nastro was using his colorful pebbles!

“Nastro, where are my pebbles?” Shrek asked.

“I collected them for my new house,” Nastro replied, smiling. “I wanted to make it more beautiful and cozy.”

Shrek understood right away. Nastro had used his pebbles with kindness. Shrek thanked the little squirrel and together they built a fantastic house for Nastro. 

Shrek returned to the secret garden, happy to have his pebbles back and to have made a special friend. Nastro’s kindness had made Shrek’s day even more beautiful.

plan.problema: Shrek has lost all his colorful pebbles!
plan.svolta: He tried to look under the roses, but the pebbles were gone.
plan.finale: Then he discovered that a little squirrel had collected them to build a beautiful little house.

shrek.text:
Shrek was a cuddly ogre a little bit crumpled. He lived in the secret garden of Grandma Elia. It was a place full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Shrek loved his garden very much. But one morning, something wasn't right.

Shrek looked around. There wasn't Donald, Pinocchio, or Pluto! All his cartoon friends were missing. Shrek was very worried. “Where have they gone?” he mumbled, hugging his soft body tightly.

He decided he had to do something. Shrek had a brilliant idea: he would organize a big treasure hunt! He took a piece of chalk and drew little clues on the ground. A yellow flower, a red pebble, a lavender bush. The clues took him all over the secret garden.

While following the clues, he met the ladybug Clementina, who had seen Pinocchio hidden behind a big red rose. The ladybug pointed him in the right direction and Shrek continued to follow the clues. In the end, he found Donald under a lemon tree and Pluto among the fragrant roses!

Shrek hugged them all happily. He was so happy to have found them. Shrek’s friends helped each other to find him. Together, they solved the mystery.

plan.problema: Shrek has lost all his cartoon friends!
plan.svolta: He decided to organize a big treasure hunt with pencil-drawn clues, hoping to find them.
plan.finale: All the friends were found hidden among the roses and Shrek welcomed them with a happy hug.

shrek.text:
Shrek was in his secret garden. It was a place full of big flowers and green plants. Shrek loved his garden. But today something wasn’t right. Shrek had lost his favorite hat, the one with the big ears. He was looking everywhere!

“Oh no, oh no!” said Shrek. “Where did I put it?” He looked around, searching among the roses and sunflowers. He couldn’t find it. Shrek was very worried. His hat was the prettiest of all his toys.

Shrek tried to call for help with his voice, but no one could hear him. It was too quiet in the secret garden. No little birds were singing, no insects were buzzing. Only Shrek and his problem.

Shrek sat down and thought. “I need to find a way to find it,” he said. Then he had an idea! He used his big feet to dig in the soft ground near a big red flower. He dug, he dug, he dug. 

After a while, Shrek felt something under his fingers. It was his hat! He pulled it out and put it on his head. “I did it!” shouted Shrek happily. His hat was there, hidden under the colorful flower. Shrek sat down contentedly in his secret garden. 

Shrek understood that even when things seem difficult, if you think calmly and keep looking, you will always find a solution in the end.

plan.problema: Shrek got lost in the garden and couldn't find his favorite hat.
plan.svolta: He tried to call for help with his voice, but no one could hear him.
plan.finale: Shrek used his big feet to dig a small hole and there he found his hat under a colorful flower.

shrek.text:
Shrek was a very special teddy bear ogre. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. He was ready for the Flower Party, an important party where all the garden objects had fun together. Shrek had a special role: he had to take the most important step to start the dance!

But there was a problem. Shrek had lost all his boots! He had put them aside and then… they disappeared! Without his boots, he couldn't take the step. Shrek was very worried. He didn't know what to do. The party was starting soon and he didn't have them anymore, right on his fluffy legs.

Shrek felt a little sad. Then he decided to ask for help from Luna, a white butterfly that lived in the garden. “Luna, Luna,” said Shrek, “I’ve lost my boots! What should I do?” Luna thought for a moment and then said, “Look among the most fragrant roses, Shrek! Maybe they’re there!”

Shrek ran towards the most beautiful roses in the garden. He found lots of red, pink, and white roses. And just among the green and fresh leaves, he saw his boots! They were hidden somewhere. Shrek was so happy.

Running towards the meadow where the party was being held, Shrek arrived on time. He greeted all his friends with a big smile. Everyone was happy to see him. Shrek had learned that waiting and looking patiently can lead to a wonderful surprise.

plan.problema: Shrek lost all his boots and can't take the most important step for the flower party.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the butterfly Luna, who suggested he look among the most fragrant roses.
plan.finale: He found all his boots hidden among the leaves and arrived on time for the party, greeting everyone with a big smile.

shrek.text:
Shrek was a very special teddy bear ogre. He lived in a secret garden, full of colorful flowers and tall trees. He was the king of his little kingdom, but he needed his boots to get there. One day, Shrek noticed that his boots were gone! He couldn’t find them anywhere.

He was very worried. The boots were important: without them, he couldn’t get back to his kingdom. Shrek looked among the roses, under the lavender bush, and behind the apple tree. But the boots were getting further and further away. Shrek felt sad and a little frustrated.

Then, Shrek had an idea. He saw some squirrels jumping between the branches. “Hello!” said Shrek to the squirrels. “I’ve lost my boots! Could you help me find them?” The squirrels were very curious. Shrek read a handful of juicy berries to the squirrels, hoping they would accept his help.

The squirrels were happy with the berries and decided to help Shrek. They looked under a bush full of dry leaves and… they found them! The boots were there, hidden among the roots.

Shrek was so happy! He thanked the squirrels a thousand times. He took his boots and returned to his kingdom. Shrek smiled as he reached his flower palace. Kindness had made magic.

plan.problema: Shrek lost all his boots and can't reach his kingdom.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the garden squirrels, offering them a handful of juicy berries.
plan.finale: The squirrels, happy, found the boots hidden under a bush and Shrek returned to his kingdom with a smile.

shrek.text:
Shrek was a very happy plush ogre. He lived in a secret garden, full of flowers and lush plants. Shrek especially loved to hop like a frog, jumping between the daisies. But today he couldn’t! Something important was missing: his colorful boots.

Shrek felt sad. He had so many boots, red, blue, yellow, and green. Without his boots, he couldn’t hop like a frog anymore. “Oh no!” exclaimed Shrek. “Where have they gone?”

Shrek began to look. First, he looked under the roses, but there were too many boots scattered everywhere. They were all confused and hiding among the petals. Shrek picked them up one by one, but he couldn’t find any more. He was getting more and more worried.

Then he heard a buzzing sound. A loud and sweet sound came from a far part of the secret garden. Shrek followed the noise and found himself in front of a giant box of cookies. And there, inside, were all his colorful boots! They had been hidden among the cookies.

Shrek picked up the boots and put them on his feet. He happily hopped between the daisies, doing the frog hop perfectly. The box of cookies was a very interesting place, but sometimes, even just a few boots neatly placed make all the difference.

plan.problema: Shrek has lost all his colorful boots and can’t hop like a frog anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to look under the roses, but there were too many and too confusing.
plan.finale: Suddenly, he heard a buzzing and discovered that the boots were hidden inside a giant box of cookies!

soldier military.text:
Soldier Small was a very brave soldier. He had a shiny helmet and a plastic gun. He was at the playground with lots of other toys. The playground was full of swings, slides, and a sandbox.

Soldier Small wanted to go on the swing. But the swing was very far away! There was a small space between the soldier and the swing. It was too difficult to get over. Soldier Small felt a little frustrated. He couldn’t reach the swing.

He thought, thought, thought. Then he had an idea. He saw some small stones near the slide. He picked up the stones and started to build a small ramp. He also used ramps that were near the sandbox to make the ramp taller.

With patience, he built the ramp. The ramp was a little wobbly, but it worked! Soldier Small climbed up the ramp and got over the small space. He finally reached the swing. He started to swing up and down, happier than ever.

A girl, Sofia, saw Soldier Small on the swing. She came closer and said, “How lovely to play together!” Soldier Small smiled and continued to swing, inviting all the children to join the fun. 

It was a perfect day to play at the playground. With a little ingenuity, even difficulties can become a game.

plan.problema: The soldier can’t reach the swing because it’s too far.
plan.svolta: He decided to build a small ramp with stones and ramps to overcome the small gap.
plan.finale: Finally, he arrived at the swing and began to swing happily, inviting all the children to play together.
plan.morale: Problems are solved with a little ingenuity.

soldier military.text:
Soldatino was a brave soldier. He had a blue uniform and a toy gun. He was in the playground, among the swings and sandcastles. But Soldatino had gotten lost. There were so many children running and laughing. He couldn't see his friend, the big red fire engine anymore.

Soldatino felt a great sadness. He was alone and didn't know where to go. The other games seemed far away and confusing. He felt like he had made a mistake. He sat down on a wooden bench, watching the children play without him. He wanted to go back to his place, next to the slide tower.

Suddenly, Soldatino had an idea! He had a megaphone. It was small and powerful. He took it in his hand and shouted: “ATTENTION! ATTENTION!” He repeated the word many times, with all his strength. “ATTENTION! I need help!” Nobody seemed to hear him.

A little girl, Anna, was building a sandcastle. She heard the loud noise of the megaphone. She went up to Soldatino and saw him there, all alone. “Oh, look!”, said Anna. “You fell here! Will you come back with the others?”

Anna gently took Soldatino and put him next to the slide tower. His soldier friends were happy to see him again. Soldatino felt like he was home again. It was nice to play with everyone, peacefully. 
A sweet smile appeared on the brave soldier’s face. Kindness always makes a difference.

plan.problema: The soldier was lost among so many children and couldn’t find his place.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his megaphone to ask for help, shouting “ATTENTION!” repeatedly.
plan.finale: Finally, a girl noticed the soldier and brought him back to his place among the other games.

soldier military.text:
Soldatino was a plastic soldier. He had a blue uniform and a toy gun. He was in the playground, among many other toys. But Soldatino felt lost. He couldn’t find his place. He wanted to be next to the sandcastle, where all the other toy soldiers played.

It was all so big! There were cars, dolls, balloons, and so many other toys. Soldatino tried to find his way around, but he couldn’t understand where he was. He was a little sad. His toy gun felt like a weight on his shoulders.

“We need to do something,” thought Soldatino. So he decided to call all his toy friends. He used his metal voice to say: “Hey! Hey, you!”.

A little stuffed doll answered: “Hello Soldatino! What’s happening?”.

A red truck rumbled: “Why are you lost?”.

Soldatino explained his problem. All his friends offered to help him. Together, they looked among the swings and slides. They looked near the bridge and under the inflatable castle.

Finally, a yellow car recognized him: “Here you are, Soldatino! You’re right next to the sandcastle!”.

Soldatino ran to the sandcastle and settled into his favorite spot. He was happy. He had found his place thanks to the help of his friends. The sun was setting on the playground, lighting the smiling faces of the toys who had worked together to find him.

plan.problema: The soldier got lost among so many toys and couldn’t find his place.
plan.svolta: He decided to call all his toy friends for help, using his metallic voice.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of his friends, the soldier found his place next to the sandcastle.

soldier military.text:
Soldier was a brave soldier. He had a blue shirt and a shiny red helmet. He lived at the playground, near the command tower. He liked to watch the children playing. One day, while he was standing next to the big slide, something happened. Soldier found himself alone. He was surrounded by colorful swings and lots of red slides. There was no longer his place near the tower!

Soldier was scared. He tried to call for help, but his voice was too small to be heard among all the toys. He shouted loudly: “Help! I’m here!” But no one answered. The children were laughing and playing, unaware of the little soldier lost. Soldier felt very sad.

Suddenly, a small toy helicopter took off from a tree. It was red and had spinning blades. The helicopter flew around Soldier and then landed right in front of him. The pilot of the toy helicopter saw Soldier and said, “Here you are, soldier! I’ll take you back to your place.”

The helicopter took Soldier to the command tower. It gently placed him next to the other soldier figures. Soldier felt relieved. Now he was home again. 

The sun was setting, and the playground was getting ready for the night. Soldier knew that even when things seem difficult, continuing to look for the solution is always the right way.

plan.problema: The soldier was lost among the many swings and slides!
plan.svolta: He tried to shout for help, but nobody seemed to hear him.
plan.finale: A small toy helicopter found him and brought him back to his place near the command tower.

soldier military.text:
Soldier Max was a special soldier. He lived in the Secret Military Base. He was made of hard plastic and had a bright red helmet. He also had a toy gun that he loved to make “bang bang.” One day, Soldier Max was doing exercises when he got lost. He was in a huge maze! The walls were made of big boxes and tall cardboard.

“Oh no!” said Soldier Max. “I don’t know where I am anymore! Everything looks the same!” The base was full of wooden branches, old tires, and even a few abandoned military hats. He was really confused. A little cleaning robot, Rusty, watched him with his bright eyes.

Soldier Max sat down on a pile of cardboard. He thought about what to do. Then he had an idea! He took his binoculars, a small magnifying glass, and started to look carefully. He pointed the binoculars up, looking for a clear spot. He saw a blue line on a big box.

“There!” said Soldier Max. “I’ll follow this line!” He walked slowly following the blue line. The line led him through other boxes and cardboard. He never gave up. He kept looking with his binoculars, always finding a new line to follow.

After a while, he finally saw a door! It was the exit of the Secret Military Base. Soldier Max was happy. He found his way thanks to his courage and his attention. Rusty greeted him with a short beep. Soldier Max smiled, pleased with his success. Perseverance can lead to unexpected results.

plan.problema: Soldier Max got lost in a maze of boxes and cardboard!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his binoculars to look for a landmark and follow the path lines.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to his courage and attention, he found the exit of the base!

soldier military.text:
Soldatino was a brave soldier. He lived in the playground. He was made of hard plastic and had a shiny helmet. Every day he enjoyed watching the children play. But today something wasn't right.

Soldatino felt lonely. He had gotten lost among all those children who were running, jumping, and laughing. He couldn’t find his place.

“I need to go back with the other soldiers!” thought Soldatino. It was important to be in formation, like his teacher taught him. But there were so many children and they all seemed the same. Soldatino felt small and confused. 

He took his binoculars, a small tool for looking far away. He pointed the binoculars at the children, but he only saw bright colors and fast movements. He couldn’t figure out where the other soldiers were. It was all too chaotic!

A yellow bird, named Pippo, was flying around Soldatino. “What are you doing?” asked Pippo with his cheerful voice. Soldatino explained his problem. Pippo listened carefully and then said, “Try to move! Maybe you’ll see your friends.”

Soldatino followed Pippo’s advice. He moved slowly, looking around. And suddenly, he saw other soldiers right there, near the bouncy castle! He was happy. He had found his place in formation again. Soldatino thanked Pippo for his help. 

From that day on, Soldatino continued to be a brave and attentive soldier in the playground. And he learned that even when things seem difficult, with a little perseverance, you always find the solution.

plan.problema: The soldier was lost among so many children and couldn't find his place.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his binoculars to try to spot his unit, but he only saw confused colors and movements.
plan.finale: Thanks to his courage to move and the help of a friendly little bird, he found his place among the other soldiers.

soldier military.text:
Soldier was a plastic soldier. He lived in the playground. He was always ready for action, with his sword and his helmet. But today, something wasn't right. Soldier had gotten lost. He looked around among the sandcastles and the swings. He couldn't see his red hat!

It was an important hat. He always wore it when he was on duty. Without the hat, he looked like a soldier without a uniform. Soldier tried to look under the bench, behind the swing, but nothing. The hat was gone. He was very worried.

“Beep! Beep!” said Soldier. He made his special sounds, the ones he used to call for help. “Beep! Beep! I need my hat!” Nobody could hear him. Then, a boy sitting on the swing listened to him. The boy approached Soldier and started to look around.

“Maybe someone found it?” asked the boy. Soldier made “Beep! Beep!” louder. Finally, the boy found the red hat under a sandwich. He gave it back to Soldier.

“Here you go!” said the boy smiling. Soldier went back to his place among the other toys. He was happy and ready for a new adventure. It had been nice to help everyone together.

plan.problema: The soldier was lost among so many toys and couldn't find his hat.
plan.svolta: He decided to call all the children in the park with his special sounds, hoping that someone would help him find it.
plan.finale: A kind boy found the hat and returned the soldier to his place, happy and ready for a new adventure.

soldier military.text:
Soldier was a plastic soldier. He had a blue uniform and a toy gun. He was in the playground, among the swings and slides. The other toys watched him play. Soldier loved to run and be a good soldier.

However, he was lost! He couldn't find his friends anymore. The swings were swinging too fast and the slides were high. Soldier felt lonely and a little scared. He tried to call for help, but nobody could hear him. It was so noisy.

Then, Soldier pulled out his binoculars. He pointed them at all the toys. He was looking for something recognizable, a landmark. He looked at the red swing, then the yellow slide. Nothing!

Then, he saw children. They were sitting near the slide and were playing with a ball. Soldier went closer. “Help!” he shouted. The children saw him. “Look!” said one of them. The other children pointed in the direction of the soldier barracks, where Soldier lived.

Soldier followed the children. He walked among the swings and slides. Finally, he arrived at the barracks! His friends welcomed him with joy. He was happy to be back home.

The sun was setting on the playground. Soldier sat down in his place, thinking about how important it was never to give up. He remembered that even when things seem difficult, if you keep looking, you will eventually find the right way to go back to where you belong.

soldier military.text:
Soldatino was a brave soldier. He lived in a sand base full of tall, golden dunes. It was his world. Every day Soldatino practiced marching, shooting with his toy gun, and protecting the base from the curious attacks of seagulls.

One afternoon, while taking a lovely walk, something changed. The sand was so high that Soldatino got lost. He could no longer see his friend, the red truck, always ready to help him transport supplies and provisions. He was scared. “I must find him!” thought Soldatino.

He moved back and forth, but the sand seemed endless. Every time he looked, he only saw tall sand around him. Then he had an idea! He decided to build a tower, using his soldier sandals as bricks. The tower became taller and taller…

When he reached the top, Soldatino could see everything around him. In the distance, he spotted something red: the flag of the truck! It was tied to a small stick and waved in the wind.

Soldatino ran quickly towards the truck. He saw it there, still and silent, just a few meters away. He shouted happily: “I did it!”. He approached and hugged it tightly. The truck responded with a sound of metal that sounded like a smile.

“It was wonderful to work together to find you,” said Soldatino, as they sat side by side in the sand base. The best team is the one that always helps each other.

plan.problema: The soldier had gotten lost in the high sand sea and couldn't find his friend the toy truck anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to build a tall tower to have a better view and spot the lost toy truck.
plan.finale: Finally, seeing the toy truck’s flag from far away, he ran to it and hugged it with joy.

soldier military.text:
Soldier was a plastic soldier. He was strong and had a bright blue uniform. He lived in the playground, near the castle tower. Soldier loved watching the children play. But he wanted to do something more. He wanted to get on the swing!

The swing was high, very high. Soldier tried to climb it, but the stairs were too steep for him. His legs slipped and he couldn't reach the wood of the swing. He was frustrated. “I can’t do it!” he said out loud.

A little walnut shell sat near the swing. He watched him for a while. Then, with a smile, he said, “You could build a ramp!”

Soldier thought for a moment. Then he started to collect the stones around. One, two, three… He lined them up next to each other, forming a small ramp. It was hard work, but Soldier didn’t give up. He kept arranging the stones until the ramp seemed stable enough.

With one last effort, Soldier climbed up the ramp and slid down, right under the seat of the swing. He did it! He was on the swing! The wind brushed his face. Soldier raised his hand and waved to the sun smiling. His blue uniform shone in the sunlight. 

Finally he had reached his goal. And he knew that, with a little effort, he could overcome any difficulty.

plan.problema: The soldier couldn't reach the swing because it was too high.
plan.svolta: He decided to build a ramp with stones to get higher.
plan.finale: Finally, he managed to get on the swing and waved to the sun smiling.

spiderman.text:
Spiderman was in the playground. It was a sunny afternoon and lots of children were laughing around him. Spiderman really loved this place because it was full of colours and laughter. But today something wasn't right. All the swings in the playground had fallen to the ground! They were scattered everywhere, as if someone had thrown them away.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Spiderman. “How will all the children play now?” He scratched his head with his rubber hands. He tried to lift a swing, but it was too heavy. It was difficult to move it even for him! A little girl, Sofia, came up to him and said, "Spiderman, you don't know how to put them back?"

Spiderman thought, thought, thought. Then he had a brilliant idea! He used his web-shooter, the one that allowed him to fly fast. The web went to a swing rope and gently pulled it up. Incredible! The swing began to rise slowly. Spiderman used the web for all the swings, and in a little while, they were back in their place, ready for the children to use.

Sofia clapped: “Spiderman you are fantastic!” Spiderman smiled. He was happy to have solved the problem. He had used his intelligence and a little patience. The sun continued to shine on the playground, and the children were already getting ready for a lovely day of fun.

Spiderman realised that even the most difficult things can be solved with calmness and creativity.

plan.problema: All the swings in the park have fallen to the ground and no one knows how to put them back!
plan.svolta: Spiderman tried to use his hands to lift the swings, but they were too heavy.
plan.finale: Then he had the idea of using his spider-car to gently pull the ropes and the swings returned to their place!

spiderman.text:
Spider-Man woke up in the playground. The sun was shining bright and the birds were singing. It was a beautiful day to play! Spider-Man loved this place very much, full of swings and slides. Suddenly, Spider-Man noticed something strange. All the balloons floating between the trees were gone! They were attached to the branches with colorful strings, but there wasn't anyone left to add them.

Spider-Man went closer to the trees. He tried to jump to catch a balloon, but it was too high. He tried to grab them with his hands, but they slipped away. The balloons were tied too tightly! Spider-Man was sad because the children in the playground loved the colorful balloons so much.

Then, Spider-Man had a brilliant idea. He pulled out his web and started to create a long string. The web stuck to the branches and Spider-Man stretched it down. He made a web bridge! With patience, Spider-Man freed all the balloons from the trees. The balloons floated back into the sky, happy to be back to play.

A child came up to Spider-Man and said: “Thank you, Spider-Man! You were very good!” Spider-Man smiled. He understood that even with a little help, you can solve the biggest problems. And so, Spider-Man’s web turned the playground into an even more beautiful place.

Spider-Man woke up in the playground. The sun was shining bright and the birds were singing. It was a lovely day to play! Spider-Man loved this playground very much, full of swings and slides. But today there was something wrong.

He looked around with his red eyes and saw all the children sitting on the bench. “What’s happening?” Spider-Man asked. A boy answered him: “The balloons have disappeared! They’re all stuck in the trees!” All the colorful balloons, the ones that had made the children fly, had been taken away.

Spider-Man felt sad. He wanted to help. He tried to jump on the tallest trees to reach the balloons. But it was too far! His legs didn’t reach the top of the trees. A little rabbit, Leo, was watching him curiously.

“Maybe I can use my special spider web!” Spider-Man thought. He pulled out a shiny and strong thread from his back. He threw it and, in a flash, he created a long bridge between the nearest tree and the trees with the balloons.

Spider-Man crossed the bridge carefully. He picked up all the balloons and brought them back to the children. The children laughed happily. Spider-Man felt satisfied. He had solved the problem in a clever way.

Leo was hopping around Spider-Man, happy with the result. The sun continued to shine on the playground, full of smiles and balloons. With a little ingenuity, even the most difficult things can be solved.

Spider-Man tried to use his web to catch them, but the balloons were too light and floated away, like little bubbles. He moved quickly, trying to catch them, but without success. A little black kitten approached, curious. “Meow!” said the cat, sniffing the remains of a red balloon.

Spider-Man thought about what to do. Then he had an idea! He used his web to create a net around the merry-go-round, forming a small, protected space. The balloons, attracted to the net, gently settled inside. It was a perfect corner for the balloons.

Spider-Man smiled happily. He had solved the problem using his intelligence and his web in a creative way. The little black kitten curled up next to the balloons, happy. Spider-Man knew that sometimes, thinking carefully is more important than just using strength. It was a simple but clever solution.

Spider-Man tried to do something. He tried to collect the toys with his web, but when he pulled, they all flew away even further! A blue teddy bear ended up near the sandcastle and a red train landed right next to the swing. Spider-Man felt frustrated.

A little toy helicopter, Pip, flew towards him. “Can I help?” Pip asked with his metallic voice. Spider-Man smiled. “That would be fantastic!” he replied.

Spider-Man closed his eyes and concentrated his sense of direction. He remembered where each toy belonged. With patience, one by one, he collected the cars and put them on the race track. Then he tidied the dolls near the play area and the teddy bears next to the swing. Pip helped him carry the heavier pieces.

Finally, everything was back in its place. The toys were happy and went back to their friends. Spider-Man felt proud. 

“It was a pleasure to work together,” said Spider-Man to Pip. And as the sun set over the playground, he realized that even the biggest things become easier when you help each other.

A little teddy bear, Leo, came up to him. “Maybe,” said Leo with a small voice, “you could use your strength to put everything back in order?”

Spider-Man sat down to think. He looked at the building blocks of the playground scattered around. Then he had an idea. He took some red and blue blocks. He started to build a little ladder, one step at a time.

With patience, he built the ladder up to the castle. A little rabbit, Pippo, climbed up the ladder and Spider-Man gently took him in his hands. Then he helped Betty and Romeo to climb up too. All the toys were safe in the castle again!

spongebob.text:
SpongeBob was a friendly sponge who lived in Squok City. He lived in a colorful little house among the green seaweed and pink coral. SpongeBob loved his doorbell, the one he used to call his friends. Ringing it was his favorite game!

One day, SpongeBob noticed a terrible problem. His doorbell was gone! He looked everywhere under seashells and among the starfish, but nothing. He couldn't call Patrick or Gary anymore. He was really sad.

“I have to do something!” said SpongeBob. He decided to organize a treasure hunt. He started following the clues he found among the seaweed. A small message written on a rice leaf pointed him towards a tangle of sponges. Elsewhere, a shiny pebble pointed towards a flat rock.

SpongeBob diligently followed every clue. After a lot of searching, he discovered something amazing: his doorbell was hidden inside a giant seashell! It was a huge seashell, bigger than him!

SpongeBob took his doorbell and rang it. “Oh, how wonderful!” he exclaimed. He rang it loudly to let everyone know that his favorite game was back. He felt happy and content. 

SpongeBob realized that if he kept looking with effort, he would find his doorbell. And so, always with determination, SpongeBob played in Squok City.

spongebob.text:
SpongeBob was a happy sponge. He lived in Bikini Bottom, his favorite place in the world. He loved to play among the seaweed and make bubbles. One day, while he was taking a particularly big jump, he found himself in the Giant Octopus! It was a dark place, full of huge mouths. SpongeBob couldn’t find his way back home anymore.

He was scared. “Oh no!” exclaimed SpongeBob. “I’m lost!” He tried to turn around, but the currents were pulling him in every direction. He couldn’t see anything except black.

SpongeBob decided to call his friends. “Mr. Krabs! Patrick!” he shouted loudly. But nobody answered. Mr. Krabs was busy counting his money and Patrick was sleeping on the sand. SpongeBob tried to shout even louder, but nothing.

Then, SpongeBob had a brilliant idea. He started to sing a happy song that he liked so much. “I’m SpongeBob, I’m happy!” he sang, giggling. While he was singing, he saw something strange. His reflection appeared in the water! It showed the way out of the Giant Octopus.

SpongeBob followed his reflection and with a big smile, he finally reached his spot in Bikini Bottom. He was so happy to be home. From that day on, SpongeBob learned that even when things seem difficult, a little bit of optimism can make a difference.

SpongeBob was happy at the Krusty Krab. He loved his house, which was full of colors and fun things. He had a little golden seahorse that he loved to wear on his head. It was his favorite hat! He called him Coco.

---

One day, SpongeBob noticed that Coco wasn't there anymore. “Oh no!” he exclaimed. He looked everywhere. He looked under the sofa, but Coco was too small to be seen under the blankets. SpongeBob checked behind the rocking chair, but nothing.

---

He was very sad. He didn't want to give up on finding Coco. Then, he called his friend Stella Marina. “Stella Marina, I’ve lost my hat! It’s a little golden seahorse and I can’t find it!” said SpongeBob.

---

Stella Marina listened carefully and then suggested: “SpongeBob, look up!” SpongeBob stood up and looked up. And there, hanging from the chandelier, was Coco! The golden seahorse was shining in the light.

---

SpongeBob jumped for joy and took Coco in his hands. “Thank you very much, Stella Marina!” he said. He was so happy to have found his favorite hat. 

---

SpongeBob realized that even when things seem difficult, you should never stop looking. And so, with Coco always on his head, he continued to live happily at the Krusty Krab.

The stars answered with a brighter glow. A special star began to twinkle towards the memory box. SpongeBob ran towards it. He followed the stars’ directions and rummaged through the old things.

Sandy, the sea turtle, helped SpongeBob find the clues. Together they searched in every corner of the floating house. Finally, after a lot of searching, SpongeBob discovered his hidden eye patches inside his hat!
