plan.svolta: He decided to use his powerful sound beam to make the cars stop racing and line up.
plan.finale: The cars, surprised by the sound, quietly lined up, allowing him to continue his mission.

transformers.text:
Optimus Prime was in the playground. He was a big transforming truck, made of shiny metal and bright colors. The other toys looked at him with admiration. Optimus Prime loved the playground because it was full of children who were laughing and playing.

 

Suddenly, a boy threw a red ball. The ball flew high, too high! It landed right on top of the swing, stuck between the seats. No one could reach it. The children tried to reach the ball with sticks, but it was too far away. They looked around worried.

 

Optimus Prime decided to do something. He focused all his energy and aimed his powerful beam at the ball. The beam was gentle and precise. It slowly lifted the ball, as if it were a little leaf. The ball didn’t roll, Optimus Prime carefully carried it to the ground.

 

A boy ran to pick up the ball. Then, all the children started to play with the red ball. They laughed and had fun together. They thanked Optimus Prime for helping them.

 

“Thank you, Optimus Prime!” they shouted.

 

Optimus Prime smiled. He liked to see the children happy. They understood that working together was much easier and more fun. And wonderfully, collaboration leads to the happiness of everyone.

plan.problema: The ball is stuck at the top of the swing and no one can get it!
plan.svolta: Optimus Prime uses his powerful beam to gently lift the ball, avoiding it rolling.
plan.finale: All the children are laughing happily while playing with the ball, thanking Optimus Prime for his help.

transformers.text:
Optimus Prime was a big battle truck. He lived in the playground. He was always ready to play with the other toys. There were lots of soldiers, cars, and teddy bears. But today something wasn't right. All the toys in the playground had become gray! The train was gray, the ball was gray, even the teddy bear was gray.

Optimus Prime felt sad. “This is a problem!” he said. He decided to do something. He used his transforming beam, the special one that made him a giant robot. He pointed the beam at the gray train and... BOOM! The train became completely gray!

Optimus Prime realized he had done too much. The beam was too powerful. The whole playground had become gray, uniform, and without life. It was a disaster!

A little teddy bear, Leo, came up to Optimus Prime. “Maybe you need to be more gentle,” said Leo with a shy voice. Optimus Prime listened to Leo. He took a deep breath and pointed the transforming beam very slowly, almost as if he were painting. 

The beam became light and warm. The train turned back to shining red, the ball turned to blue, and the teddy bear turned back to soft white. The colors came back bright and the playground smiled again. Optimus Prime understood that sometimes, to solve problems, you just need a little patience and a lot of care. Gentleness can do miracles.

plan.problema: The toys in the playground have lost all their colors!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his transforming beam to try to bring the colors back, but he did it too strongly and everything became gray!
plan.finale: With patience and a little attention, he used the beam gently and the colors returned bright.

trolls.text:
Troll Grigio lived in the Secret Garden. It was a place full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Troll Grigio loved to play and have parties with the other trolls. But one day, something had changed. His smile disappeared! He couldn't laugh or dance anymore.

Troll Grigio felt sad. No one knew why he had lost his smile. The other trolls looked at him worriedly. “What’s wrong, Troll Grigio?” they asked. But he didn't answer, he just sat there, still. He couldn't have parties anymore!

Then, Troll Grigio decided to try something. He tried to sing a happy song, but his voice was sad like his smile. “Ugh,” he said, “it doesn’t work!”

A little stone gnome, Rocco, came up to him. “Maybe,” suggested Rocco, “you just need a little water!” Troll Grigio looked around and saw a small withered flower near his base. It was almost without life.

Troll Grigio picked up a juicy carrot and watered the flower. The sun shone and the water slowly trickled over the ground. Immediately, the flower straightened up and its petals brightened. And what happened? Troll Grigio’s smile returned bright!

Troll Grigio was happy. He realized that helping others made him happy too. From that day on, Troll Grigio continued to take care of the Secret Garden and its inhabitants. A small gesture can make a difference for those who need it.

plan.problema: The Grey Troll has lost his smile and can't have parties anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to sing a happy song, but his voice was sad.
plan.finale: Then he discovered that a small withered flower needed water, and when he watered it, his smile returned bright!
plan.morale: Helping others makes smiles come back.

trolls.text:
Troll Birillo lived in the Secret Garden. He was a shiny brass troll, full of colors and laughter. He loved to play among the flowers and the little waterfalls. But one morning, something wasn't right. The Secret Garden had become much darker than usual.

Troll Birillo noticed right away that his favorite little star light was missing. It was a small light shaped like a star, always attached to his horn. Without it, the garden seemed sad and dull. Troll Birillo looked everywhere: under the roses, among the lilies, behind the water. But the star light wasn't there.

Then, Troll Birillo made a decision. He headed towards the pond, where the lighthouse was. The lighthouse was an old stone pillar, with a powerful light that illuminated the water. “Lighthouse,” called Troll Birillo, “can you help me? I’ve lost my star light and without it the garden is dark!”

The lighthouse answered with a deep sound: “I’ll try to track your star light. My light can see even in the dark.” The lighthouse pointed its powerful light towards the nearest rose bush. And there, among the red and fragrant petals, they found the star light! It was trapped in a leaf.

Troll Birillo reached out his hand and freed the star light. The star light shone even brighter when it returned to Troll Birillo’s horn. The Secret Garden was once again full of light and color. Troll Birillo smiled happily. He had been good to not give up. And with his perseverance, he had brought the smile back to his secret garden.

plan.problema: Billy Bright lost his favorite firefly, and without it the garden became very dark.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the lighthouse by the pond, hoping it could track the lost firefly.
plan.finale: The lighthouse, thanks to its powerful light, spotted the firefly trapped in a rose bush and Billy Bright freed it with joy.

trolls.text:
Troll Birillo lived in the Secret Garden. He was a bright troll, full of bright colors. But today he wasn't happy. His glitter, which made him sparkle and light up the garden, were gone! Without the glitter, the Secret Garden seemed very sad and gray.

Troll Birillo was worried. He looked everywhere. He looked under the red roses, behind the cherry trees, among the golden leaves. Nothing. His glitter was missing! “Oh no!” he exclaimed. “I must find my glitter to make the Secret Garden beautiful again.”

Then Troll Birillo tried to look among the white daisies. The daisies were small and delicate. But the glitter was too small, too many for them to be seen. Troll Birillo felt more and more down.

He bumped into a little squirrel named Pipì who was collecting nuts. Pipì was very agile and knew everything about the Secret Garden. “Pipì, I’ve lost my glitter! I can’t light up the garden anymore,” said Troll Birillo.

Pipì concentrated. He looked among the flowers, searching every corner. Finally, with a little paw tap, he pushed a hibiscus flower. And there, stuck between the colorful petals, were all of Troll Birillo’s glitter!

Troll Birillo picked them up and, one by one, added them to his body. Immediately, the Secret Garden shone like before. It was a wonderful place and full of light. 

Troll Birillo felt very happy. He understood that sometimes, even the smallest things can be difficult to find, but with calmness and patience, everything is solved.

plan.problema: Shiny Troll has lost his glitter and can’t light the garden anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to look for them among the daisies, but the glitter was too small to see.
plan.finale: With the help of a little squirrel, Shiny Troll found his glitter stuck in a hibiscus flower!
plan.morale: Patience is the key to solving problems.

trolls.text:
Trolletto was a very special troll. He lived in the Flower Garden, among the roses and tulips. He was a rainbow troll, with a skin that shone with a thousand colors when the sun shone. But one day, Trolletto noticed something: he wasn't shining anymore! He looked around, but his rainbow skin was gone.

Trolletto was very sad. Without his rainbow skin, he couldn't do his job: to light up the garden with his colors. He looked everywhere among the daisies and under the hydrangeas, but nothing! His skin was really missing.

Then Trolletto had an idea. “I have to ask for help,” he thought. “The butterflies know everything about the Flower Garden!” He approached a yellow butterfly, named Zephyr. “Zephyr, can you fly high and see if you find my skin?” he asked Trolletto.

Zephyr fluttered away, high in the clouds. After a while, he returned quickly. “I found it!” he exclaimed. “It’s under the big sunflower!”

Trolletto ran to the sunflower and there he saw it, his rainbow skin! He took it in his hands, and immediately, it began to shine with joy. Trolletto was happy again. Zephyr smiled and flew away. 

Trolletto realized that together, he and Zephyr had solved the problem. He felt grateful for the help he had received and prepared to light up the Flower Garden once again. It was nice to work with friends.

plan.problema: Trolletto has lost his rainbow-colored pouch and can’t shine anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the butterflies, who knew how to fly high and see everything from the sky.
plan.finale: The butterflies helped him find the pouch under a big sunflower, and Trolletto immediately started shining with joy.

trolls.text:
Troll Pista lived in the Secret Garden. He was a cloth troll, green and yellow, with big blue eyes. He loved to play among the red roses and yellow flowers. He also had a favorite ball, a red ball with white spots.

One day, Troll Pista was playing near the tall ferns. The red ball rolled away, into the tall grass. Troll Pista looked everywhere, but the ball was gone! He was very sad. “Oh no,” said Troll Pista, “I’ve lost my favorite ball!”

Troll Pista decided to ask for help. He saw a little wooden house and knew that a gnome lived there. He went to the house and knocked with his foot. The gnome opened and said, “Hello! What do you want?” Troll Pista explained that he had lost his ball among the ferns. But the gnome was too busy planting colorful flowers. “Wait a minute,” said the gnome, “I must finish putting these tulips in.”

Troll Pista stayed there, sitting next to the house. He took a deep breath and closed his eyes. He focused all his attention on the red ball. Then, with a stomp of his foot, he pulled the ball out! It was right among the ferns, exactly where he had lost it.

Troll Pista jumped for joy. He took it in his hand and hugged it tight. He realized that sometimes you just have to slow down and look carefully. He remembered the gnome and how busy he had been. Troll Pista started playing very happily in the Secret Garden, knowing that finding lost things takes a little patience.

plan.problema: Troll Pista has lost his favorite ball among the ferns and can't find it.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the gnome who lives in the wooden house, but the gnome was too busy planting flowers to listen to him.
plan.finale: Troll Pista concentrated, closed his eyes, and with a kick found his ball exactly where he had lost it!
plan.morale: Patience is key to solving problems.

trolls.text:
Trolletto was a troll made of cloth, soft and colorful. He lived in a secret garden full of flowers. The red tulips, the blue violets, and the white lilies loved to play with him. But Trolletto had a problem. He had lost his favorite smile! It was a little pink silk ribbon that he always wore on his chin.

Without the ribbon, Trolletto couldn't cheer up the flowers anymore. The tulips had become sad, and the violets had stopped blooming. Even Dotty the ladybug, a little friend, seemed down.

Trolletto felt very sad. He looked everywhere for the pink ribbon, under the leaves, among the bushes, but nothing! Then he had an idea. He stood in the middle of the secret garden and began to sing. It was a silly song, with strange words and funny sounds. At first, his voice was a little off-key, a little clumsy.

But the flowers listened. And then... they started to laugh! They laughed loudly, shaking their heads and opening their petals. Trolletto suddenly felt happy. His bright smile returned to his cloth face. The pink ribbon appeared, right there, near his face.

Trolletto realized that joy didn’t need a special thing to shine again. Sometimes, you just need to sing a silly song. The flowers still laughed a lot while Trolletto snuggled among them, happy and peaceful. Simplicity is a precious gift.

plan.problema: Trolletto had lost his favorite smile and couldn't cheer up the flowers in the garden anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to sing a silly song, even though his voice sounded a little off at first.
plan.finale: The flowers laughed so much and Trolletto immediately found his bright smile again.

trolls.text:
Trollino was a very happy troll. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. Trollino loved to play among the roses, but one morning he had gotten lost! The roses were so big and beautiful that they had swallowed him up. Now he couldn't see his troll friends anymore.

Everything around him was red. He didn’t recognize anything. “Oh no!” said Trollino, with a little sigh. He tried to go back, but he always found himself among the leaves. He was very scared.

He tried to call all his friends: “Hello Rocco! Hello Stella! Where are you?” But nobody answered. The silence of the garden was too loud. Trollino was sad and a little worried. He didn’t know what to do.

He sat down on a fallen leaf and thought. Then, he noticed a big white daisy. Under the daisy there was a little tunnel! Trollino crawled into the tunnel and began to slide. 

The tunnel was dark at first, then it became brighter. Soon, he heard happy voices. He came out of the tunnel and there he saw his troll friends waiting for him on the lawn. Rocco and Stella hugged him happily. Trollino was happy to be back home. 

Trollino understood that even when things seem difficult, you have to keep looking and never give up.

plan.problema: Trollino got lost among the roses and couldn’t find his troll friends.
plan.svolta: He tried to call all his friends, but nobody was answering.
plan.finale: Then he discovered a small tunnel under a daisy that brought him back to his friends’ meadow.

trolls.text:
Trolletto was a very happy troll. He lived in a secret garden full of strange flowers and plants. He also had a beautiful tower to build with colorful pebbles. Each stone had a different color: red, yellow, blue, green, and orange.

One day, Trolletto noticed that something wasn't right. His pebbles had disappeared! There were no more reds, yellows, blues, greens, or oranges. It was terrible! He couldn’t build his tower. “Oh no!” said Trolletto, upset.

Trolletto looked everywhere in the secret garden. He looked under the roses, behind the big lavender bush, and among the dry leaves. But the pebbles weren't there. Then, he remembered something. The wind had blown a strong gust and had carried away many leaves. Maybe his pebbles had ended up with the leaves!

Trolletto started to walk, using his little legs. He followed the path of the flying leaves to the stream. The leaves guided him through the tall grass and the fragrant flowers. He arrived at the stream and there, among the stones, he saw his pebbles! They were all scattered everywhere, but Trolletto picked them up one by one.

Trolletto ran back into the secret garden and put the pebbles on his tower. The tower was beautiful! Then, he settled down under a big yellow flower to rest a little. He felt happy and content. 

Trolletto realized that if he had waited and looked calmly, he would have found all his pebbles. And this made him even happier.

plan.problema: Trolletto has lost all his colorful pebbles and can’t build his tower anymore.
plan.svolta: He remembered that the wind had blown away the pebbles and, using his little legs, he followed the leaves towards the stream to find them.
plan.finale: Trolletto found all his pebbles, put them on his tower, and settled down under a flower to rest.

trolls.text:
Red Troll lived in the Secret Garden. He was a happy red troll, always ready to jump and play tricks with the other trolls. But for a few days now, Red Troll hadn’t laughed anymore. He had lost his happiest laugh, the one that made everyone else smile.

The other trolls were sad. They didn’t understand what had happened to Red Troll. They tried to make him laugh by telling jokes and making silly faces, but nothing seemed to work. Red Troll felt lower and lower.

Then, Red Troll had an idea. “I must find something that makes me smile again!” he thought. He decided to look for the brightest flower in the Secret Garden. He set off, hopping among the roses and sunflowers. He met a little snail named Luna. Luna helped him look, pointing out the most beautiful flowers.

Finally, Red Troll saw a flower! It was the brightest of all in the garden. Its light shone like a star. When Red Troll looked at the flower, his laughter started to flow. A contagious laugh that made all the other trolls in the Secret Garden smile. 

Red Troll realized that kindness and caring about others could lead to happiness. And so, the Secret Garden became a place full of laughter and joy again.

plan.problema: Red Troll has lost his happiest laugh and can’t make the other trolls smile anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to look for the brightest flower in the garden to attract attention and, hoping, rekindle his joy.
plan.finale: He found the flower and, illuminated by its light, Red Troll immediately found his contagious laugh.

trolls.text:
Trolletto was a very happy troll. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. He loved to play among the red roses and the yellow sunflowers. But today Trolletto wasn't happy. He had lost his favorite skin! It was a shiny skin, full of green and blue glitter.

Trolletto looked everywhere. He looked under the lavender bush, inside the bellflower pot, and behind the apple tree. There was no trace of his skin. Trolletto felt a little sad. He sat down on a smooth rock, with his arms around his knees.

Now he had to do something. He decided to ask for help from the old poppy, the wisest flower in the garden. The poppy was big and strong, with a strong scent. “Mr. Poppy,” said Trolletto, “I’ve lost my skin! I’ve looked everywhere.”

The poppy thought for a moment. Then, he pointed with a flowered bud at a small hole under a large stone. “Look here, Trolletto,” said the poppy. 

Trolletto ran towards the stone and dug quickly. And there, right in the hole, was his shiny skin! He took it in his hands and smiled again. He was so happy. 

The sun was shining on the secret garden, making Trolletto’s skin shine. He had learned that looking patiently can lead to great surprises.

plan.problema: Trolletto has lost his favorite pouch among the roses!
plan.svolta: After searching everywhere, Trolletto decided to ask for help from the old poppy.
plan.finale: The poppy pointed to a small hole under a stone, where Trolletto found his shiny pouch.

witch.text:
Witch Stella lived in the Secret Garden. She was a purple cloth witch and had green hair. She loved to play among the roses and fragrant flowers. One day, while skipping happily, she got lost. She found herself in a maze of red and pink roses!

Stella realized right away that she had lost her black pointy hat. It was a very important hat for a witch! Without it, she couldn't cast spells. “Oh no!” thought Stella. “I must find it!”

She looked everywhere, but the roses all looked the same. She wandered back and forth, scratching her head with a little gesture. She saw an old gnome under a blackberry bush. The gnome was dressed in green and had a long, white beard.

“Gnome! Gnome!” shouted Stella. “Can you help me? I’ve lost my hat!” But the gnome was too busy collecting the juiciest berries to listen to her. “I must make a stock for the winter,” he mumbled.

Witch Stella didn't give up. She decided to follow the brightest path she saw. She walked patiently, step by step, trying not to get discouraged. The sun was shining and butterflies were flying around her. 

Finally, after so much searching, she saw something black! It was her pointy hat, lying on a large stone. Stella cheered! She ran to hug it. From that day on, Witch Stella learned that with patience and determination, you can always reach your goal. And this made her even happier.

plan.problema: Stella got lost in the maze of roses and can’t find her hat!
plan.svolta: She decided to ask for help from the old gnome who lived under a bush, but the gnome was too busy picking berries to listen to her.
plan.finale: Stella, with patience and determination, followed the brightest path until she found her hat lying on a stone!

witch.text:
Witch Ambra lived in a secret garden. She was a porcelain white witch, with a pointy hat and colorful clothes. Ambra loved that garden more than anything. Every day she tried to make the flowers grow, but something wasn't right. The petals were faded and the colors were gone.

“Oh no!” said Witch Ambra. “I’ve lost my sparkling magic! I can’t make the flowers beautiful anymore.” She was sad because the garden without flowers was a quiet and gray place. 

Witch Ambra sat on a stone bench, thinking. She tried to concentrate, but nothing. Then she had an idea. She decided to sing a sweet and melodious song for the garden. She sang about stars, green meadows, and the scent of flowers.

The wind blew gently through the leaves. A little gnome, Pipino, shyly approached Witch Ambra. “Sing always, Ambra,” said Pipino. “Music is beautiful.” 

While Witch Ambra continued to sing, a tiny hummingbird arrived flying. It was beautiful, with iridescent feathers that shimmered in the sun. The hummingbird landed on Witch Ambra’s finger and returned the sparkle to her. The magic was back in the garden, the flowers took on color and scent. 

Witch Ambra smiled. She knew that a kind smile could do miracles. Music and friendship had brought the beauty back to that special place.

plan.problema: Witch Ambra has lost her sparkling magic and can’t grow flowers anymore.
plan.svolta: She decided to sing a sweet song for the garden, hoping that the magic would return.
plan.finale: The music attracted a little hummingbird that returned her sparkle with its iridescent plumage.

witch.text:
Witch Parlante found herself in a new place. It was a secret garden, full of roses and sunflowers. But Witch Parlante didn't recognize anything. She was lost! She didn't know how to get back home to her little house made of colorful flowers.

---

She was a talking witch, so she could talk, but she couldn't walk on her own. She was sitting on a lavender bush and she felt a little sad. “Oh no, oh no,” said Witch Parlante, “I must find my little house!”

---

Witch Parlante thought for a moment. Then she decided to call for help. She opened her mouth wide and began to sing a funny melody that she knew very well. It was a song with lots of strange words and a happy rhythm.

---

A little bunny, Maritozzo, was hopping among the daisies. He listened to Witch Parlante’s song. Maritozzo was very curious. He liked the song so much!

---

Maritozzo raised his head and pointed with a little paw towards a corner of the garden. “Over there!” said Maritozzo, “There’s a beautiful flower house!”

---

Witch Parlante followed Maritozzo’s paw. And there it was, her flower house! It was exactly the house that Witch Parlante was looking for. Witch Parlante thanked Maritozzo for helping her. Maritozzo smiled happily that he had been able to lend a hand. 

---

Witch Parlante went home, and she realized that helping others can lead to great satisfaction.

plan.problema: The witch got lost in the garden and couldn't find her house, a flower cottage.
plan.svolta: She decided to call for help, singing a funny melody she knew well.
plan.finale: A curious rabbit listened to the song and pointed the way to the flower cottage, happy to have helped the witch.

witch.text:
Witch Vivace lived in the Secret Garden. She was a soft-dressed witch with sparkling eyes. She loved her garden very much, full of roses, violets, and sunflowers. But one day, Witch Vivace realized a problem. The flowers didn't want to bloom! They were all closed, dull, without color.

Witch Vivace was desperate. “Oh no!” she said. “I need my magic to make them bloom again!” Her magic was what made her a real witch. Without it, the garden was sad and gray.

She tried to cast spells with her wands. She sang silly songs, but nothing! She tried to do magic tricks, but the flowers stayed closed. A little wooden crocodile, her friend, watched her worriedly. 

Witch Vivace sat down on a bench and thought. Then she had an idea! She went up to a buzzing bee around a flower. She smiled at the bee. The bee landed on her hand. Witch Vivace smiled at a ladybug and a little caterpillar too. 

And suddenly, the magic returned! The flowers began to open slowly, showing bright colors and delicious smells. The Secret Garden was full of beauty again. Witch Vivace realized that to make the flowers bloom, you didn’t need complicated spells, but just a little kindness. 

Witch Vivace smiled at the little wooden crocodile. The most powerful magic, she thought, is the one that comes from the heart.

plan.problema: Witch Vivace has lost her magic to make the flowers bloom!
plan.svolta: She tried to dance and sing, but the magic hadn't returned.
plan.finale: Then she discovered that she just needed to smile at the little insects to find her power.

witch.text:
Witch lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. She was a toy witch, made of wood and soft fabric. She loved to make the butterflies fly, but suddenly she had stopped. She couldn’t use her magic to do it anymore.

“Oh no!” said Witch, with her voice a little faded. “I can’t help the butterflies dance in the air.” She sat down on a stone bench, sad and quiet. The butterflies still fluttered in the garden, but they didn’t seem interested in her.

Witch tried to make little spells, to move her arms in a silly way, but nothing. The butterflies stayed far away. Then she had an idea: she tried to sing a song that her mom had taught her. But the sound was too strange, crackly and wobbly. The butterflies flew even further away!

Witch felt very sad. She sat under a big apple tree and closed her eyes. Then, suddenly, she smiled. She smiled at the butterflies, with a real, happy smile. The butterflies, seeing her smile, quickly came to Witch. They started to flutter around her head, dancing and rejoicing.

Witch realized that she didn’t need complicated spells. Her happiness was the most powerful magic of all. And while the butterflies played with her, she understood that a happy heart is the best gift for anyone.

plan.problema: The Witch had lost her magic and couldn’t fly the butterflies anymore.
plan.svolta: She tried to sing a song, but the sound was too strange and the butterflies didn’t want to come near.
plan.finale: Then she simply smiled at the butterflies and they were immediately full of joy, fluttering around her.
plan.morale: Happiness is the most important magic.

witch.text:
Witch was happy in her secret garden. It was a place full of colorful flowers and strange plants. Witch loved to cast spells, but she needed her pointy hat to do it well. One day, Witch noticed that her hat was gone!

“Oh no!” exclaimed Witch. “Without my hat, I can’t cast any spells!” It was a big problem. Witch began to look everywhere. She looked between the roses and under the trees. But the hat was missing.

Witch decided to ask for help from the butterflies. The butterflies were flying around her, but none of them had seen her hat. “Have you seen a pointy hat?” Witch asked the butterflies. The butterflies replied, “No, we haven’t seen it!”

Witch felt increasingly sad. She kept looking for a long time, but without luck. Then, she noticed a big yellow flower with lots of soft petals. And there, right under the flower, was her pointy hat! 

Witch ran to grab it. “I’ve got it!” she shouted happily. She took the hat and tried to cast a spell. A spell of happiness for all the animals in the garden. And it worked! The squirrels, rabbits, and little birds were having a happy time. 

Witch smiled. She was happy to have found her hat again. She realized that sometimes you have to wait a little while to find lost things. The sun was setting in the secret garden, giving a golden light. Witch knew that patience could lead to great satisfaction.

plan.problema: The witch lost her pointy hat and can’t cast spells anymore!
plan.svolta: She tried to ask the butterflies for help, but none of them had been able to find the hat.
plan.finale: Finally, she found the hat under a big flower and cast a spell of happiness for all the animals in the garden.

witch.text:
Witch was a patchwork witch, soft and colorful. She loved to be in the secret garden behind the old house. It was a place full of big and small flowers, green grass, and tall trees. One day, Witch found herself there, but something wasn’t right. She didn’t remember how she’d gotten to that spot.

“Oh no!” said Witch. “I’m lost! And I don’t know where my favorite hat is.” Her red hat with feathers was her most important accessory. Without it, she wasn’t a real witch.

Witch began to look everywhere. She looked among the roses, under the trees, and near the lavender bush. But the hat wasn’t there. “Maybe I can ask for help,” thought Witch. She walked towards the beehive, a small house where many busy bees lived.

Witch knocked on the door with her wooden foot. “Mr. Farina, can you help me?” she asked. But the bees were too busy collecting honey. They flew back and forth, carrying drops of honey in their little beehive. They didn’t have time for a lost witch.

Witch felt a little sad. Then, she noticed something red under a big lily. There was her hat! It had fallen there while Witch was trying to pick red berries. 

Witch took her hat and put it on her head. “How lovely!” said Witch, smiling happily. Everything was perfect again. She sat down on a smooth stone and waited for the bees to finish their work. Patience, Witch realized, can lead to great satisfaction.

plan.problema: Witch got lost in the garden and couldn't find her favorite hat.
plan.svolta: She decided to ask for help from the beehive, but the bees were too busy collecting honey to listen to her.
plan.finale: Witch found the hat under a lily and smiled happily, finding her perfect shape.

witch.text:
Witch was a little witch with soft fabric and tinkling bells. She lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of tall plants and fragrant flowers. One day, Witch moved too quickly chasing a ladybug. She got lost! She didn't recognize anything anymore. The garden seemed much bigger than before.


Witch wanted to go home to her little house made of colorful flowers. It was her favorite house in the Secret Garden. But she didn't know where it was. Witch started running from side to side, trying to figure out how to find her way back. 


Then, Witch had an idea. She pulled up the bell around her neck and shouted: “Help! I’m lost!” But no one answered. Only the wind whispered through the leaves.


Witch felt a little sad. Then she looked up. She saw colorful butterflies, yellow, blue, and green. She decided to follow them. The butterflies flew away, Witch followed them with all her fabric legs. 


After walking so much, the butterflies landed on a special little house. It was made entirely of flowers! And there was her friend snail, Stella. Stella smiled at Witch and said, “Welcome back!”


Witch was happy. She had found her house. The flower house was just like she had always dreamed. Witch realized that even when you get lost, you must never give up. With patience and courage, you can always find the right way.

plan.problema: The witch got lost in the garden and couldn't find her house, a flower cottage.
plan.svolta: She tried to call for help with her little bell, but nobody heard her, so she decided to follow the colorful butterflies.
plan.finale: The butterflies led her to the flower cottage, where her friend snail welcomed her with a smile.

witch.text:
Witch lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers. She was a cloth witch, soft and fluffy. She loved her garden and her flowers very much. Every day she tried to make them grow, but something wasn't right. The flowers were faded, without color.

Witch noticed that her sparkling star, which she always wore attached to her dress, was gone! Without the star, the flowers couldn’t bloom. Witch was sad and worried. She looked everywhere: under the roses, among the bellflowers, even inside the old terracotta bucket. But the star was missing.

Suddenly, Witch had an idea. She remembered that stars love to sing! So, she started to move her cloth body, taking small steps and swaying like a gentle breeze. She sang a sweet and delicate melody, with her arms moving up and down.

Then, the sparkling star began to shine again! The light of the star touched the flowers and, slowly, the petals began to open. The colors returned strong and vibrant. Witch jumped for joy. 

A little squirrel, Leo, came to Witch and danced with her. All the inhabitants of the secret garden joined the party. Witch danced happily, surrounded by the colorful flowers and friends. The star shone brighter than ever. 

Witch realized how important it was to be kind and create harmony around her. And so, the magic of the garden continued to grow thanks to her sweet melody.

plan.problema: The Witch has lost her sparkling star and can’t grow flowers anymore.
plan.svolta: She remembered that stars love to sing, so she began to hum a sweet melody with her cloth body.
plan.finale: The star returned to shine, the flowers bloomed, and the Witch danced with joy with the other garden residents.

witch.text:
Witch Stella was a witch made of wicker and stars. She lived in the secret garden, a place full of fragrant flowers and tall plants. Every day, Witch Stella loved to explore the garden, but sometimes she had too much fun!

---

One afternoon, while chasing a blue butterfly, Witch Stella got lost among the white lilies and red roses. The smells were so strong that she couldn’t tell where she was anymore. She realized she didn’t recognize anything around her. She was completely lost!

---

Witch Stella desperately searched for her wicker basket, her home in the secret garden. But the flowers all looked the same to her, and she felt more and more alone. “Oh no!” said Witch Stella, with a little sniffle.

---

Then, Witch Stella decided to call for help. She opened her mouth wide and began to sing a silly melody, with a squeaky voice and a little bit off-key. “Ee ee ee, I’m lost, I need help!”

---

A little brave squirrel named Ribbon heard Witch Stella’s voice. Ribbon was very curious and went towards the basket. He saw Witch Stella sitting among the flowers and understood right away what had happened.

---

Ribbon scampered up to Witch Stella and pointed with his paw at her wicker basket. Witch Stella thanked Ribbon with a smile. She was so happy to be back home! 

---

Witch Stella curled up in her basket, feeling safe and happy. Ribbon said goodbye and ran away towards the trees. The kindness of Ribbon made all the difference.

plan.problema: Stella got lost among the fragrant flowers and couldn't find her way home in the wicker basket.
plan.svolta: She decided to call for help, singing a silly tune with her squeaky voice.
plan.finale: A little brave squirrel led her to the basket, happy to have found her.

wizard.text:
Wizard Bruno lived in the Secret Garden. He was a very nice wizard, made of wood and fabric, with a pointy blue hat. Wizard Bruno loved to make the butterflies fly. Every day, he would take one of his magic wands and say: “Alarido!” And the butterflies would rise into the air.

But one day, something happened. Wizard Bruno noticed that his wands had disappeared! He looked for them everywhere among the flowers and the trees, but no! He was very sad. He couldn’t do “Alarido!” anymore and the butterflies stayed on the ground.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Wizard Bruno. “How will I help the butterflies?” He thought for a little while and then had a brilliant idea. He took an olive branch, a smooth pebble, and a feather fluff he had found near the pond.

With great care, he began to build a new wand. He glued the branch to the end of the feather fluff and fixed the pebble in the center. It was a special wand, made with his own hands!

Wizard Bruno gripped the new wand and said: “Alarido!” And this time, something magical happened. The butterflies rose into the air faster than ever, swirling around him like a rainbow. Wizard Bruno smiled happily. His creativity had solved the problem!

plan.problema: The wizard Bruno has lost all his magic wands and can't fly the butterflies anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to build a new wand with an olive branch, a smooth pebble, and a found feather.
plan.finale: With a little spell, the new wand made the butterflies fly faster than ever!

wizard.text:
Wizard Stellino was a very special wizard. He was made of colorful wood and had a pointy hat. Wizard Stellino lived in a secret garden, full of fragrant flowers and lush plants. Normally, he shone brightly, thanks to the stars embedded in his body. But today he wasn’t shining at all.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Wizard Stellino. “I’ve lost my stars! I can’t do magic if I don’t shine.” He nervously wiggled between the rose bushes. He looked everywhere, but without success. The stars were small and hidden.

Wizard Stellino tried to look for them among the big, colorful flowers. He looked under the white daisies and among the red tulips. But the stars were too small to be seen. He felt increasingly sad. A little squirrel, Pipì, watched him curiously, concerned by his unhappiness.

Suddenly, a ray of sunshine pierced through the trees’ leaves. It illuminated a small pond hidden in the secret garden. And there, inside the clear water, Wizard Stellino saw something shining! His stars! They reflected the sunlight and sparkled more than ever.

Wizard Stellino went to the water and began to shine brightly again. Pipì darted away happily to have seen the wizard shining again. Wizard Stellino realized that sometimes, to find what we’re missing, you just have to wait a moment and look carefully. Patience always helps to find the light.

plan.problema: Little Star Wizard has lost his stars and can’t shine anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to look for them among the flowers, but the stars were too small to be seen.
plan.finale: A ray of sunshine illuminated a small pond where the stars were shining, reflecting the light.

wizard.text:
Wizard Grey lived in the Secret Garden. He was a very special wizard, made of wood and fabric. He loved to do magic and especially, he loved to make the flowers grow. Every morning, with a wave of his magic wand, the petals opened and the garden became even more beautiful.

But one day, something went wrong. Wizard Grey tried to use his wand to make the red roses bloom, but nothing! The wand was gone! Wizard Grey was very sad. Without his wand, he couldn’t do magic and the flowers didn’t open.

“Oh no!” said Wizard Grey. “How will I make the flowers grow?” He looked around in the Secret Garden, but the wand wasn’t anywhere. 

Then, he heard a gruff voice: "Maybe I should help you." It was the garden gnome, a small green creature with a red hat. “I heard you lost your wand,” said the gnome. “Try to look under the big cherry tree.”

Wizard Grey ran to the biggest cherry tree in the garden. He looked and looked, until he felt something hard under the roots. With one last effort, he pulled out his magic wand! It was stuck between the roots of the tree.

Wizard Grey raised his wand and with a simple wave of magic, all the flowers in the Secret Garden opened in a burst of colors. The garden was more beautiful than ever! Wizard Grey smiled happily.

Wizard Grey’s patience had allowed him to find his wand and solve the problem. And now, the flowers continued to grow, one at a time.

plan.problema: Wizard Grey has lost his magic wand and can’t grow flowers anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the garden gnome, who suggested he look under the big cherry tree.
plan.finale: He found the wand stuck between the roots of the tree and managed to make all the flowers bloom with a simple wave of magic!

wizard.text:
Wiz was a very special wizard. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Wiz could do magic, but one day he noticed something wasn't right. He couldn't make the stars shine anymore! The stars in the sky seemed so far away, and he didn't know how to make them shine again.

Wiz began to look everywhere. He found it under the lilies, behind the big apple tree, even inside the old little house. But his magic wand was missing. He was very sad. A little squirrel, Pip, was watching him curiously. “What’s happening, Wiz?” asked Pip.

Wiz explained his problem. “I lost my wand and I can’t make the stars shine anymore!” he said with a sigh. He thought for a long time, scratched his felt head, and then he had an idea. He realized that the stars were too far away to reach.

Then, Wiz concentrated all his magic energy and whispered a special spell: “Light!” Immediately the garden was lit up by a sparkling light. The fireflies began to dance, the flowers became brighter, and slowly, the stars in the sky began to shine again with joy.

The garden was full of magical and beautiful light. Pip hopped happily around Wiz. Wiz smiled satisfied. He had found the solution to his problem, not in a hurry, but with patience. And he knew that even when things seem difficult, finding calm always helps to solve problems.

plan.problema: The wizard Wiz has lost his magic wand and can’t make the stars shine anymore.
plan.svolta: After searching everywhere, Wiz realized that the stars were too far away and used a light spell to light up the garden.
plan.finale: The garden was full of shimmering light, and the stars began to shine with joy.

wizard.text:
Wizard Stellino lived in a secret garden full of roses and sunflowers. He was a very special wizard, but one day he noticed a problem. His magic light, the one that allowed him to create stars in the night sky, was gone! He couldn’t make the sky shine with his little stars anymore.

Wizard Stellino tried all the spells he knew. He talked to all the fairies in the garden, waved his wand, and sang magic songs. But nothing worked. His light was still out. He was very sad.

A little ladybug, Lila, came up to him. “Maybe,” said Lila, “you need something that shines like the stars.” Wizard Stellino thought about the wisdom of the ladybug. He decided to collect all the brightest flowers in the secret garden.

He picked red roses, yellow sunflowers, and fragrant violets. He filled his hat to the brim. As the shiny petals slipped into his hat, Wizard Stellino felt a strange feeling. A warm light began to grow inside him. 

His magic light returned! Wizard Stellino smiled and with a big spell, he created a wonderful constellation for children, full of bright stars. The stars shone brighter than ever, like many little eyes looking at him. Wizard Stellino understood that kindness and the help of others can make even the dimmest light shine again.

plan.problema: Little Star Wizard has lost his magic light and can’t make stars in the sky anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to do a thousand spells, but nothing seems to work, so he decided to collect all the brightest flowers in the garden.
plan.finale: Filling his hat with shining petals, Little Star Wizard regained his light and created a wonderful constellation for children.

wizard.text:
Wiz was a toy wizard. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers. It was a special place, hidden behind an old oak tree. Wiz loved his garden very much and used his magic wand to make the most beautiful flowers in the world grow.

---

One day, however, he noticed that something wasn't right. His magic wand was gone! He tried to cast spells, but the flowers didn't bloom. “Oh no!” said Wiz. “If I don't have my wand, I can’t make the flowers grow anymore!”

---

Wiz decided to do something. He took his shiny stars, small and bright, and began to arrange them on the ground. He wanted to create a path that would guide him to his lost wand. But the path quickly got confused! The stars seemed to want to play hide-and-seek.

---

A little bunny, Pip, watched him curiously. “Maybe,” thought Wiz, “I should ask for help from the stars.” So, he stopped and began to sing a sweet and melodious song. The shiny stars began to move in a more orderly way. They followed Wiz’s song and led him to a rose bush.

---

There, under the fragrant roses, was his magic wand! Wiz took it and cast a spell. Immediately, the flowers in the garden cleared up and began to bloom in a thousand colors. He was happy! 

---

Wiz realized that even when things seem difficult, with patience and perseverance, you can find the solutions. The garden was beautiful again, just as he loved it.

plan.problema: Wiz has lost his magic wand and can’t grow flowers anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his sparkling stars to create a path to lead him to the wand, but the path kept getting confused.
plan.finale: Wiz had an idea to sing a song to the stars, and with their help, he finally found his wand under a rose bush.

wizard.text:
Wizardo was a very special wizard. He was a toy, a little wooden wizard, but he knew how to cast spells! He lived in a secret garden, full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. Every day, Wizardo tried to cast spells, but without his magic wand, he couldn’t make anything happen.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Wizardo. “I’ve lost my wand! Without it, I can’t do even a little spell!” He looked around in the secret garden, desperately searching for his wand. It was small, made of dark wood, and had a golden star on top.

Wizardo started to look among the roses. They were big and beautiful, but he was too small to reach them. He tried to jump, to push himself, but he couldn’t reach the wand which was right above the roses’ heads. It was frustrating!

Then, Wizardo noticed a lavender bush. It was shorter and had lots of fragrant leaves. He crouched down and looked underneath the bush. And there it was: his magic wand!

Wizardo took the wand in his hands and tried to cast a spell. “Spell of laughter!” he shouted. Immediately, a rabbit started to laugh, then a butterfly, and finally even the little birds in the sky. All the animals in the secret garden were having fun.

Wizardo smiled. He was happy to have found his wand and to have made his friends laugh. He realized that sometimes you have to wait a little while to find what you’ve lost. And, while he laughed with the other animals, he thought that a little patience can lead to great surprises.

plan.problema: Wizard has lost his magic wand and can’t cast spells anymore!
plan.svolta: He started to look among the roses, but he was too small to reach the tallest flowers.
plan.finale: He found the wand under a lavender bush and cast a spell of laughter that made all the animals in the garden laugh!

wizard.text:
Wizard Silvano lived in a secret garden. He was a toy wizard, made of wood and blue fabric. He loved his garden very much, full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Every day, Wizard Silvano watched the stars in the sky.

One morning, Wizard Silvano noticed something strange. The brightest star in the garden wasn't shining anymore. The sky had become too dark and the flowers seemed faded. Wizard Silvano was very worried. “What’s happening?” he asked the wind. But the wind didn’t answer.

Wizard Silvano tried to do magic. He cast spells, waved his hands, but nothing worked. Then he had an idea: to sing! He sang a magical song that he knew, a sweet and ancient melody. Instead of a bright light, only the butterflies began to dance around him.

Wizard Silvano thought again. He saw a group of little bees collecting nectar from the flowers. He found his courage and gathered all the most beautiful flowers from the garden: red roses, yellow sunflowers, and blue violets. Carefully, he placed the flowers under the faded star.

Suddenly, the star shone brightly! The light filled the secret garden, lighting up every corner and waking up the colors of the flowers. Wizard Silvano smiled happily. He had solved the problem. The sky was full of stars again. 

Wizard Silvano understood that even a small kind gesture can bring so much joy to the world.

plan.problema: The brightest star in the garden had stopped shining, and the sky became too dark.
plan.svolta: Wizard Silvano tried to sing a magic song, but only the butterflies started to dance.
plan.finale: He then gathered all the most beautiful flowers from the garden and placed them under the star, which began to shine brightly again.

wizard.text:
Wizard Stellino loved his secret garden. It was a special place, full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Wizard Stellino was a toy wizard, with a pointy hat and a soft white beard. He loved to do magic, but one evening something wasn't right. The garden was very dark!

Wizard Stellino noticed that his shining stars, which usually twinkled around him, were gone. Without the stars, the garden seemed sad and dull. Wizard Stellino felt a little worried. “Oh no!” he said. “Where have my stars gone?”

He began to look everywhere. He started to rummage under every flower, between every green leaf. He looked behind the rose bushes and under the big apple tree. But he didn’t find anything. He was a little discouraged. There was no one to help him find his stars.

Then Wizard Stellino had an idea! He closed his eyes and began to sing a sweet song, a song full of hope. The song talked about bright dreams and a starry sky. As he sang, his voice echoed in the secret garden.

Suddenly, the shining stars reappeared! They twinkled in the night sky, lighting up the garden with their magic. Wizard Stellino smiled happily. The stars were returning to shine because of the kindness and hope he had given. The secret garden was full of light again. 
Wizard Stellino understood that even when things seem difficult, a small act of kindness can lead to the most beautiful solution.

plan.problema: Wizard Stellino has lost his shining stars and the garden has become very dark.

wizard.text:
Wizard Blue lived in the Secret Garden. He was a toy wizard blue, made of wood and soft fabric. Wizard Blue loved to play among the fragrant flowers and lush plants. One day, he heard a soft sigh. It came from the brightest star in the garden!

The Bright Star wasn’t shining anymore. It was dim and sad. Wizard Blue approached carefully. “What’s wrong?” he asked. The Bright Star didn’t answer. Wizard Blue was worried. He didn’t understand why the star had stopped shining.

He tried to talk to her, telling her a funny joke, but nothing. Then, Wizard Blue had an idea! He remembered an old song his grandma had taught him. He began to sing loudly, with a sweet and melodic tone. But the Bright Star remained silent as always.

Wizard Blue concentrated. He used all his magic. He sent a small blue ray from his hand towards the star. Then, he moved the water from a tiny pond nearby with his wand. A few drops of water fell on the Bright Star.

Immediately, the star began to shine again! It became brighter and happier. Wizard Blue smiled happily. “We did it!” he exclaimed. The Bright Star shone brighter than ever. 

Wizard Blue realized that sometimes good things just need a little help to shine again. And, looking at the bright star, he thought: “Sometimes it just takes a simple kind gesture.”

plan.problema: The brightest star in the garden had stopped shining!
plan.svolta: Wizard Blue tried to sing her a song, but the star remained silent.
plan.finale: Then Wizard Blue discovered that the star just needed a little water, and with a small ray of magic, he made it shine again!
plan.morale: Sometimes all it takes is a small kind gesture.

wonderwoman.text:
Wonderwoman woke up in the playground. The sun was shining bright and the children were laughing. But Wonderwoman noticed something strange right away. The red and blue balls were gone! No one could play basketball anymore. “Oh no!” said Wonderwoman, raising her arm. “This can’t happen!”

A little boy, Marco, came up sadly. “There are no more balls,” he sobbed. “We can’t play basketball.” Wonderwoman felt she had to help. She decided she had to do something.

Then Wonderwoman thought. Her lasso was perfect for this! She stretched it out and started collecting the scattered balls all over the playground. One by one, she brought them back to the basket. It was a long job, but Wonderwoman didn’t give up. 

Another boy, Luca, watched her in amazement. “Wow, Wonderwoman is so strong!” he exclaimed. He helped Wonderwoman collect the balls closest to the basket. Together they worked quickly and everything was done.

Finally, all the red and blue balls were back in the basket. The children ran to the basket and started playing basketball right away, laughing and joking. Wonderwoman smiled. Seeing the children happy filled her with joy. Together they had fun and worked together for a beautiful game. 

Wonderwoman realized that when everyone helps, even the most difficult things become easy. And so, the playground was full of laughter and friendship.

plan.problema: The balls are finished and the children cannot play.
plan.svolta: Wonderwoman decides to use her lasso to collect the scattered balls, one at a time.
plan.finale: All the balls have returned to the basket and the children started to play happily.

wonderwoman.text:
Wonderwoman woke up suddenly. She was in the playground! The sun was shining and the children were laughing. Wonderwoman loved this place very much. But there was a problem. All the colorful balls were scattered everywhere! Red, yellow, blue… They were spread under the slides, near the sandbox and even among the wooden benches. Nobody could pick them up.

“Oh no!” said Wonderwoman. “It’s a disaster! We have to do something.” She looked around. A little boy was trying to catch a red ball, but it kept falling. A girl was running after a yellow ball, but it got lost in the tall grass.

Wonderwoman thought, thought, thought… Then she had an idea! She prepared to jump. She jumped as high as she could! And with a big movement of her arms, she created a little puff of air. The colorful balls, as if attracted by an invisible force, started to fly towards the center of the playground and piled up together in one giant heap.

“There!” exclaimed Wonderwoman, happy. The children ran to help right away. They picked up the balls and put them back in the bag. They were having so much fun! Wonderwoman smiled contentedly. Seeing the children so happy made her even happier. Together, they were having fun playing with the balls. And they realized that when you work together, the game is even more fun.

wonderwoman.text:
Wonderwoman woke up in the playground. The sun was shining bright and children were running around. Wonderwoman loved this place! But then she heard a sad whimper. She went closer and saw lots of children sitting on the swings, with tears in their eyes.

“What’s wrong?” asked Wonderwoman.

A boy answered, “There are no more balls! We can’t play!”

The other children nodded sadly. It was true, all the balls had been used and nobody knew what to do. Wonderwoman felt sad for them. She had to do something!

She thought, she thought, she thought… Then she had a brilliant idea. With her incredible strength, she started to collect the scattered colorful blocks on the ground. She stacked them one on top of the other, higher and higher, creating a giant and fun mountain.

“There you go!” exclaimed Wonderwoman. “Now you can build castles and houses! You have a new game!”

The children looked at the block mountain in amazement. At first they were shy, then they started to run and build together with Wonderwoman. They laughed and had so much fun.

“Thank you, Wonderwoman!” they shouted all together. “You’re the best!”

Wonderwoman smiled. She was happy to have helped them. The playground was full of laughter and children playing with the colorful blocks. Creativity had solved the problem and everyone was happy.

wonderwoman.text:

Wonderwoman launched the circles one after another, creating a rainbow of colors that finally reached all the balloons. The children were laughing with joy, collecting the balloons with enthusiasm. wonderwoman.text:
Wonderwoman loved her secret garden. It was a magical place full of colorful flowers and lush plants. Wonderwoman spent a lot of time there, watching the butterflies and listening to the birds sing. Today, however, something wasn't right. The biggest flower in the garden, a magnificent white lily, had lost its smile. Its petals were drooping and the color had become faded.

Wonderwoman approached the lily carefully. “What’s wrong?” she asked. The lily replied with a faint voice: "I feel sad, I don't understand why my smile has disappeared." Wonderwoman tried to understand what had happened. She checked to see if there were any pesky insects or diseases on the flower. But nothing seemed to change.

Then, Wonderwoman decided to do something different. She began to sing a happy song that she loved so much. “La la la, la la la, what a beautiful sun!” she sang with a strong and clear voice. The lily remained still, as sad as always.

Wonderwoman sat down beside the flower. She thought for a moment, then approached and gently hugged it. "You don't have to be sad," she said kindly. And immediately the lily’s smile returned bright! Its petals rose up again and the color became vivid and luminous.

Wonderwoman smiled. She realized that sometimes, the hardest things to solve are those for which you don't know what to do. She realized that a single kind action could bring so much joy. Wonderwoman continued to admire the happy lily in her secret garden.

plan.problema: The smile of the biggest flower had disappeared and no one knew why.
plan.svolta: Wonderwoman tried to sing a happy song, but the flower remained sad.
plan.finale: Then she realized that the flower just needed a gentle hug and the smile returned bright.

wonderwoman.text:
Wonder Woman was happy at the playground. The sun was shining and the children were laughing. Wonder Woman loved to watch everything from up high, leaning against the bouncy castle. Suddenly, she heard a whimper. “Oh no! Oh no!”

She looked around. She saw lots of red, blue and yellow toy cars scattered on the ground. They were all confused. “What’s happening?” asked Wonder Woman. A little red car replied, “We don’t know where our track is anymore!” The other toy cars nodded sadly. They couldn’t find their place among the fences and slides.

Wonder Woman thought quickly. She stretched out and hugged her red cape tightly. She started to move her arms with strength. A gentle breeze began to blow. The air current gently pushed the toy cars. It carried them towards a small gravel path. 

“Come here, little cars!” shouted Wonder Woman. The toy cars followed the wind, happily running on the track. They quickly returned to their place, ready to have races. A boy smiled seeing the toy cars running again.

Wonder Woman was smiling happily. She had helped everyone. She sat down again on the bouncy castle and watched the toy cars play together. It was wonderful to see others happy. Sometimes, a small gesture can make a difference for those who need it.

plan.svolta: Wonder Woman uses her cape to create a gust of wind that gently guides her to their track.
plan.finale: All the cars find their place, happy and racing, while Wonder Woman smiles contentedly.

woody toy story.text:
Woody lived in Andy’s house. He was a brave cowboy and loved to play. But lately, the house seemed very quiet. All his toy friends – Buzz, Rex, Jessie – had disappeared. Andy had started school and had gone away with them. Woody felt lonely. There was no one to do acrobatic tricks or tell stories.

Woody sat on his favorite cushion, watching the rug. He thought about how much he missed the sound of Buzz’s laughter and the races with Rex. He felt sad and a little lost. He decided he had to do something.

He took a piece of paper and a pencil. He wrote letters to his friends. He sent them among the furniture, hoping someone would find them. Days passed. Woody waited impatiently. Then, Buzz left a reply next to his box: “I miss you too, Woody! I want to go on another treasure hunt!”

Rex wrote: “Playing together is always more fun!” And Jessie added: "I love you, friend!" Woody smiled. He realized his friends were still thinking about him.

Woody decided to organize a big party for all the toys in the house. He called everyone, and in a little while, the room was filled with joy and laughter. Everyone played together, as always. Woody felt happy and he wasn’t lonely anymore. Friendship makes every moment special.

plan.problema: Woody feels lonely because all his toy friends have gone away.
plan.svolta: He decides to write letters to his friends, telling them how much he misses playing together.
plan.finale: Receiving replies from his friends, Woody organizes a big party for the toys and has a lot of fun.

So, he took his little building block and started to write. He wrote “Bye Rex, I miss you!” and “Jessie, I hope you’re having fun!”. While he was writing, he heard a noise. It was Buzz Lightyear!

“Woody! I have a fantastic idea!” said Buzz. “Let’s have a surprise party for all our friends when they come back!” Woody was so happy. Together they started to prepare where the toys would be kept, to tidy up the cars, and to put out lots of little presents.

Soon after, Rex, Jessie, and Mr. Potato Head arrived. They were all excited to see Woody and to join the party. Andy’s House filled with laughter and games. All the toys ran, jumped, and had fun together. It was a wonderful day!

Woody realized that even when his friends were far away, friendship made him special. And he knew that having special friends was the most important thing in the world.

Woody was on the dusty attic. It was full of old things and furniture covered with white sheets. The light came in hard through a small window. Woody was a toy cowboy, but today he didn't feel very brave. He had lost his favorite button. It was a small red button with a golden star. He always kept it attached to his clothes and it made him feel safe.

Woody had looked everywhere. He looked under the chairs, inside the chests, and behind the bookshelves. But the button wasn't there. Woody was sad. He couldn't play like before. He felt incomplete. 

Suddenly, Woody saw an old and wrinkled teddy bear. It was Bruno, a stuffed bear who had lived in the attic for a very long time. Bruno had dull eyes and matted fur. “Bruno,” said Woody, “I’ve lost my button. I’ve been looking for it for hours.”

Bruno moved slowly. With his little arms, he rummaged through a pile of old dolls. After a while, he found something! It was exactly the red button with the golden star. Bruno reattached it to Woody.

Woody smiled. He felt much better right away. “Thank you, Bruno!” said Woody. “You were very good.”

Bruno replied, "It's no problem, my friend."

Woody realized that, even if he was just a toy, having a friend could make a difference. Every little help is important when you’re trying to solve a problem.

Woody decided to do something. He used his strong voice to shout: “Buzz! Riri! Help!” He shouted loudly, repeating his name many times. After a while, he heard a reply. Buzz Lightyear arrived running, followed by Riri, the robot doll.

“Where are you, Woody?” asked Buzz. “We’re here to help you!” added Riri. Together, the three friends searched every corner of the toy box. Finally, they found him! Woody was happy to be back with his friends. They all hugged together.

plan.problema: Woody feels lonely because all the other toys have new friends.
plan.svolta: He decides to create a special game to have fun together, inventing silly and strange rules.
plan.finale: All the toys have a lot of fun, and Woody realizes that the important thing is to play together, even if they are different.

woody toy story.text:
Woody lived in Andy’s house. He was a brave cowboy and always ready for an adventure. But this week was different. All of his toy friends had gone on vacation. Buzz, Jessie, Rex, Slinky… all far away. Woody felt very lonely. His room seemed big and quiet without the sound of plastic laughter or the click of little feet.

He sat down on his favorite pillow, near Andy’s bed. He thought about how much he missed playing with them together. “I wish you were here,” Woody thought. He scratched his head in a silly way and felt even sadder.

Suddenly he had an idea! He took a piece of paper and a pencil that Andy had left on the floor. He started to write letters to his friends. He wrote: “Dear Buzz, I miss you so much! Tell me how your vacation is going!” And then, for each friend, he wrote something similar.

Days went by. Woody waited impatiently. Then, one morning, he found little pencil drawings of laughter on his pillow. They had been drawn by Buzz, Jessie, and Rex! The laughter was colorful and fun. Woody understood right away what they meant.

He smiled. Even though his friends were far away, their spirit was with him. Andy’s room didn’t seem so big or quiet anymore. Woody knew that true friendship can overcome any distance.

plan.problema: Woody feels lonely because all his toy friends have gone away on holiday.
plan.svolta: He decides to write postcards to his friends, expressing his homesickness and asking them to write back.
plan.finale: Receiving soon drawings of laughter from his friends, Woody realizes that even though they are far away, they are always with him in his heart.

yoda.text:
Yoda Piccolo was a little Yoda plush. He lived in the Flower Garden. He loved to sit among the tulips and roses. Every day, he wore his little green hat, perfect in every way.

One morning, Yoda Piccolo noticed that his hat was gone! “Oh no!” he said. He looked everywhere. He looked under the lavender and behind the geranium. But his green hat was missing. 

Yoda Piccolo was very sad. His hat made him feel complete. He decided to ask for help. He saw a red ladybug flying around a sunflower. “Ladybug,” said Yoda Piccolo, “did you see my hat?”

The ladybug stopped and looked carefully. “I saw something green near the sunflower!” replied the ladybug. Together, Yoda Piccolo and the ladybug searched among the flowers. Finally, they found the little green hat under the big sunflower.

Yoda Piccolo took his hat and put it on again. He was so happy! “Thank you, ladybug!” he said. The ladybug flew away, happy to have helped. Yoda Piccolo felt good, with his hat and a friend. 

Yoda Piccolo realized that even small friends can do big things when they work together.

plan.problema: Yoda had lost his little green hat!
plan.svolta: Yoda had looked everywhere, but the hat was missing among the flowers, so he asked for help from the ladybugs.
plan.finale: The ladybugs found the hat under a sunflower, and Yoda put it on again with joy.

yoda.text:
Yoda was in the secret garden. It was a garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Yoda was a green toy, made of plastic, but he could talk and move! Today, though, Yoda wasn't happy. “Oh no!” he said with his raspy voice. “I’ve lost my laser sword!”

The laser sword had a special sound: ‘beep beep’. That was what Yoda loved most. He always kept it close, but today it was gone. Yoda began to look for it. He rummaged through the yellow tulips and the white daisies. He looked under the big, shiny stones.

“Beep beep… where is it?” Yoda repeated as he moved back and forth. Then, he decided to ask for help. He went to a group of squirrels jumping between the branches. “Chirp, chirp!” Yoda shouted to the squirrels. “Have you seen my laser sword?” But the squirrels just blinked their eyes and continued to collect nuts. No one had seen the laser sword.

Yoda felt a little sad. He continued to look, but more slowly this time. Then, accidentally, he moved a bush of fragrant roses. And there, under the bush, was his laser sword! “Beep beep!” Yoda exclaimed happily. He picked it up in his hands and smiled.

Yoda adjusted his green hat and continued to explore the secret garden. Everything seemed more beautiful to discover calmly. Yoda learned that finding what you’ve lost takes a little patience and a small adventure.

plan.problema: Yoda had lost his favorite laser sword, the one that made a 'beep beep' sound.
plan.svolta: After searching among the flowers and stones, Yoda tried to ask for help from the squirrels, but no one had seen him.
plan.finale: Yoda found the laser sword under a rose bush, which he had accidentally moved during his walk!
plan.morale: Patience and a little exploration help.

yoda.text:
Yoda was in his secret garden. It was a garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Yoda was a special toy, a little Jedi made of green plastic. Yoda loved his laser sword very much, the one with the star-shaped handle. But today, the sword wasn’t there!

Yoda frowned. He couldn’t do his Force lessons without his laser sword. Without it, his movements were slow and clumsy. “Oh no!” exclaimed Yoda, waving his little arms. He looked everywhere: under the lavender bush, behind the fountain, even inside the berry bucket. But the laser sword wasn’t anywhere.

Yoda decided to ask for help. He sat in the center of the garden and whispered softly to the wind: “Wind, wind, please! Did you see me pass? Did you take my laser sword?” The wind blew lightly through the trees’ leaves, but it didn’t answer. Yoda closed his eyes and continued to whisper, calmly and patiently.

Suddenly, a rustle of leaves. The wind gently pushed a red rose towards the bush. Under the rose, there was the laser sword! Yoda picked it up happily, relieved. His little hand held it tight. 

Yoda smiled. He was so happy to have found his sword again. He sat down again and started to do his Force exercises, with precise and quick movements. The secret garden seemed even more magical. Yoda knew that even when things seem lost, a little patience can help to find what really matters.

plan.problema: Yoda has lost his favorite laser sword and doesn't know how to teach his Force lessons!
plan.svolta: He decided to ask the wind for help, whispering his wishes softly to it.
plan.finale: The wind brought him the laser sword hidden under a rose bush, happy and relieved.

yoda.text:
Yoda Piccolo was a little Yoda plush. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. But Yoda Piccolo wasn't happy. He had lost his lucky stick, the small wooden one he always held tight in his hands. Without the stick, Yoda Piccolo couldn't find happiness.

“Oh no,” said Yoda Piccolo, upset. “Where did it go?” He looked everywhere: under the biggest tree, behind a waterfall of leaves, even inside a vase full of daisies. But the stick was gone.

Yoda Piccolo decided to ask for help. He went up to two squirrels who were running and collecting nuts. “Excuse me,” said Yoda Piccolo, “have you seen my stick?” The squirrels interrupted him: “Nuts! Nuts! We have to fill our nests!” And they continued to run away without listening to him.

Yoda Piccolo was sad. He sat down on a small stone and looked carefully at the garden. The sun shone through the trees, creating dancing shadows. Yoda Piccolo concentrated. Then, he noticed a ray of sunshine shining on a small stone, right next to him. And there, under the stone, was his lucky stick!

Yoda Piccolo took it in his hand and smiled. He was happy again. He had found his stick thanks to his attention. Yoda Piccolo understood that even when things seem difficult, you just need to look calmly and patiently to find the solution.

plan.problema: Yoda had lost his lucky little stick, and he couldn’t find happiness.
plan.svolta: Yoda had tried to ask for help from the squirrels, but they were too busy collecting nuts to listen to him.
plan.finale: Yoda, looking carefully at the garden, noticed a ray of sunshine that was shining on a small stone, and there he found it!

yoda.text:
Yoda was in his secret garden. It was a magical place, full of colorful flowers and tall trees. But today Yoda wasn’t happy. He had lost his little green hat. A special hat, made of moss and fresh leaves.

“Oh no!” said Yoda, waving his small arms. “I can’t concentrate! Without my hat, my mind is confused.” Yoda looked everywhere: under the bushes, among the roses, near the pond. But the hat was gone.

Yoda sat down on a smooth stone and thought. He thought for a long time. Then, he had an idea. He had learned an ancient spell from his Jedi masters. A spell to call the wind.

“Wind,” whispered Yoda, with his raspy voice. “Come here! I need your help.” The wind began to blow gently, lifting the leaves of the trees. Yoda continued to repeat the spell, concentrating all his energy.

Suddenly, a rustle of leaves and a small thump. The green hat appeared! It had floated away on the wind and then come back.

Yoda took his hat and put it on right away. He smiled. “Thank you, wind,” said Yoda. “You were kind.” Then he sat down again on the stone, watching the secret garden calmly.

The sun was setting slowly, painting the sky pink and orange. Yoda knew that finding what is lost takes time and patience. And now, with his green hat, he could return to concentrating on his work.

plan.problema: Yoda had lost his little green hat and couldn’t concentrate.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the wind, whispering an ancient spell.
plan.finale: The wind returned his hat, which Yoda wore with a satisfied smile.
plan.morale: Patience is important for finding things.

yoda.text:
Yoda Piccolo was in the Flowery Garden. He was a little Yoda plush, green and wise. He loved to be there among the colorful flowers, listening to the birds sing. But today he wasn't happy. “Oh no,” said Yoda Piccolo, “I’ve lost my hat!”

His little green hat was perfect for his head. Without it, Yoda Piccolo didn't seem complete. He wanted to be perfectly shaped again. It was a really frustrating problem!

Yoda Piccolo turned around and called to the butterflies. “Butterflies,” he said, “have you seen my green hat?” The butterflies flew around the flowers, but none of them had his hat. “I don’t see it,” said the biggest butterfly, Zephyrino.

Yoda Piccolo sat down on a rose bush. He thought, and thought, and thought. Then he had an idea! “The sun,” said Yoda Piccolo, “is warm and bright. Maybe my hat is near the sun!”

Yoda Piccolo raised his arms towards the sky. He pointed his little body towards the sun. The sun was high in the sky, bright and warm. Suddenly, the green hat pushed through the flowers, as if it wanted to come back to him. 

Yoda Piccolo ran to grab it. “There it is!” he exclaimed. It was perfect again! Yoda Piccolo smiled happily. He had learned that sometimes, patience is the key to finding what you’ve lost. The sun, with its gentle light, had done its job.

plan.problema: Yoda had lost his little green hat and couldn’t find his perfect shape.
plan.svolta: Yoda had tried to ask for help from the butterflies, but none of them could find the lost hat.
plan.finale: Yoda, using his wisdom, simply returned the hat to the sun and it made its way through the flowers.

yoda.text:
Yoda was in his secret garden. It was a garden full of colorful flowers and lush plants. Yoda loved his little pebbles very much. They were small, smooth, and different colors. He had collected them carefully to keep them.

But today, something wasn't right. Yoda was looking for his pebbles everywhere! They were gone from his hands. He was very worried. “Where are they?” Yoda mumbled, shaking. “I’ve lost all my pebbles!”

Yoda decided to ask for help from the butterflies. They flew around him, but none of them knew where his pebbles had gone. "I haven't seen them," said the butterflies. "Maybe they flew away?" Yoda shook his head. It wasn't possible!

Yoda sat down on a rock and thought. He thought for a long time. Then, he had an idea. He followed a little beam of green light that came from a corner of the garden. The beam led him to a small glass case. And there, inside, were all his pebbles! They had fallen inside the case when Yoda had moved the rock.

Yoda used his green beam to gently take the pebbles out of the case. He picked them up and put them in order on his table. He was very happy. 

Yoda arranged his pebbles, thinking about the patience that had helped him find them. Slowly and carefully, everything is found.

plan.problema: Yoda has lost all his little collection stones!
plan.svolta: He tried to ask for help from the butterflies, but none of them knew where they had gone.
plan.finale: Yoda discovered that the stones had fallen inside a small glass case and retrieved them with a gentle green beam of light.

yoda.text:
Yoda was in his secret garden. A special place, full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Yoda loved his garden very much. He especially loved looking at the stars every night. But one night something wasn't right. Yoda couldn't see anything!

“Oh no!” said Yoda. “I’ve lost my glasses!” They were small, green, and with red lenses. Without them, the stars were just dark dots in the sky.

Yoda tried to use the Force. He closed his eyes, he focused, and he tried to see where his glasses were. But instead of a clear picture, he only felt the smell of the flowers. The smell of jasmine led him to a pink flower, then the smell of lavender led him to a red rose. He was confused!

“It’s not working!” exclaimed Yoda. “The smell is tricking me.” Then he had an idea. He remembered that the sun was shining brightly that day. He pointed his body towards the light and used a small ray of sunlight reflected from his green fabric. 

The ray hit a bush. And there, leaning among the leaves, were his glasses! Yoda picked them up and put them on right away. Finally, he could see the stars shining in the night sky.

A little white butterfly landed on him. “Good job, Yoda,” said the butterfly. “You found the solution.” 

Yoda smiled. He had learned an important lesson that day.  It takes time and concentration to find something, even when it seems difficult.

plan.problema: Yoda lost his glasses and can’t see the stars anymore.
