plan.svolta: He tried to use the Force to find them, but only the scent of flowers guided him in the wrong directions.
plan.finale: Yoda used a beam of light reflected by the sun to locate the glasses lying on a bush.

yoda.text:
Yoda was in his secret garden, a place full of colorful flowers and tall trees. He was a Yoda toy, made of soft green plush. Yoda loved to sit on the cool grass and watch the bees flying around the flowers.

Suddenly, Yoda noticed something was wrong. “My cookies!” he exclaimed, his voice raspy like a whisper. His little milk cookies, always in their place, were gone. Yoda was very worried. He was afraid he had lost them forever!

Yoda began to turn around in the garden, looking between the leaves and bushes. He sniffed every corner, but he didn't find anything. “Where are they?” he repeated, getting more and more upset. A bee, Ginger, was flying nearby. “Ginger, have you seen my cookies?” Yoda asked. Ginger just buzzed and flew away.

Yoda decided to take an even more careful look around. He sniffed every flower, every stone, every leaf. Then, he had an idea! He asked for help from the butterflies fluttering in the garden. “Butterflies, help me find my cookies!”

Finally, after so much searching, Yoda saw something brown under a giant rose. And there they were – his milk cookies! They had fallen there during a little jump. Yoda laughed at himself for being so worried. He had been so scared and almost lost his treasure. 

Yoda sat down, happy to have found his cookies again. He felt calm and content. Being calm helps you find things you’ve lost.

plan.problema: Yoda can't find his little milk biscuits, scared he’s lost them.
plan.svolta: He decided to take a careful turn, sniffing every corner of the garden and asking for help from the butterflies.
plan.finale: Finally, he found his biscuits hidden under a giant rose, laughing at himself for his fear.

yoda.text:
Yoda felt strange. His secret garden wasn’t the same anymore. 

“Oh no,” said Yoda, his voice rough like a falling leaf. “I’ve lost my laser sword!”

The laser sword was special. It contained his little lightning bolts, blue sparks that made the garden shine. Without it, everything seemed dull and gray. Yoda looked everywhere: under the roses, between the stones, behind the apple tree. But the laser sword wasn’t there.

Yoda was frustrated. He sat on the lawn, with his arms crossed. “I must find my lightning bolts,” he mumbled. Then he had an idea. He saw some colorful butterflies fluttering around him. “Help!” called Yoda to the butterflies. “Have you seen my laser sword?”

The butterflies answered with a quick flight and led him to a small pond hidden in the garden. Yoda followed the butterflies, his heart beating fast. Under a waterfall of water lilies, he saw something blue. It was his laser sword! It had fallen among the floating leaves.

Yoda grabbed the laser sword and pointed it upwards. Immediately, the little blue lightning bolts began to shine, lighting up the secret garden with a magical light. Yoda laughed with joy. “There,” said Yoda, “everything is back to normal.” 

Yoda sat content, watching the lightning bolts dance around his laser sword. Patience had helped him find what he was missing.

plan.problema: Yoda has lost his favorite laser sword and doesn't know how to find his little lightning bolts.
plan.svolta: After searching everywhere, Yoda decides to ask for help from the butterflies, who guide him to a small pond.
plan.finale: Yoda finds the laser sword stuck among the water lilies, illuminating the garden with its lightning and smiling contentedly.

ape.text:
Ape Zenzero was a very curious bee. He lived in the Flowery Garden, among the yellow tulips and blue violets. He loved to fly from flower to flower, collecting nectar to make honey. One day, he smelled an incredible scent: the scent of roses! It was so intense, so sweet, that Bee Zenzero found himself flying further and further, following that good smell.

He got lost! He couldn’t find his friends from the hive anymore. The Flowery Garden seemed much bigger than before. Bee Zenzero continued to fly, attracted by the scent of red and yellow roses.

He tried to follow the wind, but he only found a giant sunflower! It was too tall for him, and he felt tired under the hot sun. He fell down onto the stem of the plant, disappointed. “I can’t do it,” thought Bee Zenzero.

Suddenly, he saw a little red ladybug walking among the daisies. “Hello Ladybug,” said Bee Zenzero, “I’m lost! I don’t know how to get back to my hive.” The ladybug smiled and said, “I know the Flowery Garden very well. Follow the direction of the bellflowers, and you’ll get there!”

Bee Zenzero followed the ladybug’s words. He flew among the white bellflowers, and suddenly, he recognized it! It was his hive, full of happy bees. Bee Zenzero joined his friends, and he realized that asking for help was the right thing to do. 

Bee Zenzero returned to his place among the flowers of the Flowery Garden, knowing that together, you can always find the best way.

plan.problema: Honeybee Ginger got lost in the intense scent of the roses!
plan.svolta: He tried to follow the wind, but only found a sunflower too tall and gave up under the sun.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a friendly ladybug, he found his nest among the forget-me-nots.

ape.text:
Ape Leo was a very happy bee. He lived in the Flowery Garden, a place full of fragrant flowers and bright colors. Ape Leo loved to fly among the petals, collecting nectar and turning it into delicious honey. But one day, something terrible happened.

Ape Leo woke up and noticed that all of his little helpers had disappeared! There were no more small and useful ones with whom he climbed on the flowers to collect the nectar. It was a disaster! Without the little helpers, Ape Leo couldn’t make honey anymore. He was very sad.

He flew around the Flowery Garden, but nobody seemed to know where his little helpers had gone. Then he met the old squirrel, who was sitting on a branch of a big oak tree. “What’s wrong, Ape Leo?” asked the squirrel with his rough voice. Ape Leo explained his problem.

The squirrel thought for a moment and then said, “Use the petals! They are colorful and sweet like the nectar.” Ape Leo tried the idea and collected lots of red, yellow, and blue petals. He started collecting the nectar from the flowers with the petals, and incredibly, he managed to make honey!

Ape Leo was very happy. He collected a bag full of golden honey. The butterflies flew around Ape Leo, happy for him. Together, they had fun celebrating. Ape Leo realized that even when things go wrong, with the help of others, you can always find a solution. And he knew that working together makes everything more beautiful and easy.

plan.problema: Bee Leo has lost all his honeycombs and can’t collect honey anymore!
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the old squirrel, who suggested using colorful petals as substitutes.
plan.finale: Bee Leo collected a sack full of golden honey thanks to the petals and celebrated with the butterflies.

ape.text:
Ape Bruno was a very happy bee. He lived in the Flowery Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and delicious smells. Every day, Bruno flew among the plants, collecting nectar to make honey. But this day was special.

The scent of the roses was so strong that Bee Bruno felt irresistibly drawn to them. He flew closer and closer to the red and pink roses, inhaling their sweet smell. He got lost! He couldn’t find his hive among the bees. It was all confusing.

Bee Bruno decided to fly high to get a better view of the garden. But the scent of the roses was too strong. Every time he rose up, he spun around and around without being able to orient himself. He felt a little sad and impatient.

Suddenly, a white butterfly, named Lila, flew towards him. “What’s wrong, little bee?” asked Lila with a gentle voice. Bee Bruno explained his problem. Lila listened carefully and then said, “Try flying slowly, following the path between the yellow flowers. It’s a safe route.”

Bee Bruno followed Lila’s advice. He flew slowly, concentrating on the path between the yellow flowers. After a while, he saw his hive and his fellow bees. He was happy! He found his way thanks to patience. 

Bee Bruno returned to the hive with his precious load of nectar, thinking that sometimes, even when you get lost, finding the solution only requires a little calm.

plan.problema: Bee Bruno got lost in the intense scent of the roses!
plan.svolta: He tried to fly high, but the scent made him spin and spin without being able to find his way back.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a kind butterfly, Bruno found the path that brought him back to his wonderful nest.
plan.morale: Patience helps to find the solution.

ape.text:
Ape Bruno was a special bee. He was made of colorful wood and had big blue eyes. He lived in the Flowery Garden, among red roses, tall sunflowers, and fragrant lavender. Every day, Bruno flew from one plant to another, collecting yellow pollen.

---

One afternoon, while exploring a hibiscus bush, Bruno got lost. The flowers were so many, so beautiful, so fragrant! He had gone too far and couldn't recognize his hive anymore. “Oh no!” exclaimed Bruno, flapping his wings. “I don’t know where I am!”

---

Bruno tried to find his way, but everything seemed the same. The red petals, the white petals, they all smelled so strongly. He was a little scared. Then, he heard a sound: a distant buzzing. “Maybe it’s my hive!” thought Bruno and decided to follow the noise.

---

Flying further and further, Bruno saw other bees flying around him. “Buzz, buzz!” said the bees. Bruno followed their buzzing and realized they were heading towards a part of the garden where there were many yellow daisies. He remembered having seen those daisies near his hive!

---

Bruno continued to fly, focused on the path marked by the buzzing of the other bees. Finally, he spotted a small path made of pollen that led directly to his hive. He was happy! He returned to his honey and his friends. Bruno realized how important it is to be persistent when you are lost.

plan.problema: Bruno got lost among the fragrant flowers and couldn't find his nest anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the buzzing of the other bees, hoping they would lead him home.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to his good sense, he spotted the path marked by his wings and returned happily to his nest among the honeys.

ape.text:
Ape Leo was a very happy bee. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and sweet smells. Ape Leo especially loved making honey. He used his stinger to collect the nectar from the most beautiful flowers. Nectar was his favorite ingredient!

One day, Ape Leo noticed that something wasn't right. His honey box, where he kept the nectar, was empty. “Oh no!” he exclaimed. “I’ve lost my favorite nectar and I can’t make honey anymore!” It was a big disappointment for Ape Leo.

He decided to ask for help from the butterflies that flew in the Secret Garden. He saw the butterfly Iris, a bright blue butterfly. “Iris, do you have any drops of nectar?” asked Ape Leo. Iris smiled kindly and replied, “I’m sorry, Leo, but I collect pollen.”

Ape Leo tried to ask the ladybugs too, but none of them had nectar to share. Ape Leo felt a little sad. He felt lonely and frustrated.

Then, while he wandered among the bushes, he noticed something unusual: a small flower hidden under a tall bush. The flower was a bright yellow and it was dripping with lots of sweet nectar! Ape Leo ran to the flower and collected all the nectar he could collect.

With the new nectar, Ape Leo quickly returned to his hive to make honey. He was happy and content. Ape Leo realized that even when things seem difficult, you have to keep looking. And in the end, perseverance leads to the discovery of wonderful new things.

plan.problema: Bee Leo has lost his favorite nectar and can’t make honey anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to ask for help from the butterflies, but none of them had nectar to share.
plan.finale: Then he discovered a small flower hidden under a bush with lots of sweet nectar!

ape.text:
Ape Pippo lived in the Flowery Garden. He was a special bee, very hardworking. Every day he flew from flower to flower to collect the nectar. With the nectar he made honey, his favorite food. But today something wasn't going well.

Pippo felt sad. He had tried to fly on a thousand flowers, but none had the nectar he loved. He couldn't make honey anymore! It was a big problem for a little bee like him. 

“I have to do something!” thought Bee Pippo. “I can’t stay here without my nectar.” So he started to work right away. He tasted the petals of the tulips with his antennae, smelled the corollas of the sunflowers, searched, searched, searched. No flower had his special nectar.

Bee Pippo decided to explore every corner of the Flowery Garden. He flew under the trees, climbed the rose bushes, and even entered a small insect house. 

Finally, while flying among the aromatic plants, he smelled a strong scent. He saw a large lavender flower, purple and fragrant. He tasted the nectar of the flower with his antennae and… it was perfect! A sweet and dense nectar, just what Pippo was looking for.

Pippo filled his tummy with delicious honey. He felt happy and full of energy. He flew around the large lavender flower, grateful for having found his treasure. 

Bee Pippo understood that if you never give up, even the biggest problems can be solved. And so, flying among the flowers of the Flowery Garden, he knew that every little effort can lead to great satisfaction.

plan.problema: Bee Pippo has lost his favorite nectar and can no longer make honey.
plan.svolta: He decided to explore every corner of the garden, probing the flowers with his antennae to find a new treasure.
plan.finale: He found a large lavender flower and its nectar was perfect, filling his tummy with sweet honey.

ape.text:
Ape Leo was a special bee. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and sweet smells. Ape Leo loved his job: collecting nectar to make honey with the other bees in the hive.

---

One day, Ape Leo noticed there was a big problem. All the most beautiful flowers were too tall! His wings couldn’t fly high enough to reach the nectar. He was sad and frustrated. He couldn’t make honey, and the other bees were waiting for him.

---

Ape Leo thought, thought, thought. He saw many fallen branches near a big apple tree. An idea popped into his mind! He took the longest branches and collected big, green leaves. He started to build a little ladder, one by one. It was hard work, but Ape Leo didn’t give up.

---

With patience, he built his ladder, attaching the branches with the leaves. The ladder was a little wobbly, but Ape Leo kept going up and down, higher and higher. Finally, he was able to reach the tallest flowers in the garden! He collected the nectar with excitement, filling his little bag.

---

Ape Leo happily returned to the hive, full of nectar. The other bees welcomed him with joy and thanked him for his hard work. Ape Leo knew that even if there are obstacles, with effort and a little ingenuity, you can always find solutions. And so, Ape Leo’s day was full of sweetness.

plan.problema: Bee Leo can’t collect the nectar to make honey because all the flowers are too tall.
plan.svolta: He decided to build a small ladder with twigs and leaves to reach the tallest flowers.
plan.finale: The ladder was a little wobbly, but in the end Bee Leo managed to collect all the nectar he needed and returned happily to his hive.
plan.morale: You can overcome obstacles with effort.

ape.text:
Ape Leo was a very curious bee. He lived in the Flowery Garden, among the sunflowers and daisies. Every day he flew from flower to flower, collecting pollen for his colony. One afternoon, he smelled a delicious scent: the scent of roses! It was so strong, so fragrant, that Ape Leo found himself flying closer and closer.

He flew and flew, but he couldn't get back to his place. The scent of the roses had enchanted him. Ape Leo was lost! He didn't know where his garden was anymore, or how to get back. He was a little scared.

He tried to follow the wind. The wind was blowing south, but Ape Leo still felt more confused. He tried to find his way, but the scent of the roses kept distracting him. He saw a blue butterfly flying high above and asked for help. The butterfly told him: "Look beyond the roses!"

Ape Leo followed the butterfly’s advice and saw a sparkling stream. He approached cautiously and drank the cool water. The water was so refreshing that Ape Leo felt the need to fly again, to find his way. 

After drinking, Ape Leo realized where he was. The stream had given him the right direction. He flew east, following the course of the river. Soon he found his friends, the flowers, in the Flowery Garden. He was happy and refreshed. Ape Leo flew among the colorful petals, happy to be back home. It was important to stop for a moment to listen to your inner voice, because only then can you find your way.

plan.problema: Bee Leo got lost in the intense fragrance of the roses!
plan.svolta: After trying to follow the wind, he discovered a stream and drank the cool water to regain his sense of direction.
plan.finale: Thanks to the stream, Bee Leo returned to flying among the flowers, happy and refreshed.
plan.morale: Calm helps to find the way.

ape.text:
Ape Leo was a very special bee. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and sweet smells. Ape Leo especially loved the nectar from sunflowers. With that nectar, he made his favorite honey, a bright yellow honey.

One day, Ape Leo noticed that something wasn't right. His honey barrel was empty! “Oh no!” he exclaimed. “I’ve lost my favorite nectar!” He couldn’t make his honey anymore, and this made him very sad.

Ape Leo flew to ask for help. He saw a blue butterfly and then a yellow butterfly. He asked if they had seen any nectar around. The butterflies smiled kindly, but they said they hadn’t seen any. “Maybe it fell somewhere,” said the blue butterfly.

Ape Leo was still worried. He saw a red ladybug moving on the flower of a hydrangea. He asked for advice, and the ladybug, with its tiny antennae, suggested: “Look near the big tree! I saw a small pond full of fragrant flowers.”

Ape Leo followed the ladybug’s advice and flew towards the tree. And there, among the flowers, he found a wonderful little pond. It was full of yellow and red flowers that smelled of vanilla! He collected lots of nectar.

Ape Leo returned to his honey barrel happy and filled it with the new nectar. He had learned that asking for help can be a great idea. Ape Leo realized that together you can achieve wonderful results.

plan.problema: Bee Leo has lost his favorite nectar and can’t make honey anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to ask for help from the butterflies, but none of them were able to find more.
plan.finale: Thanks to the advice of the ladybug, he discovered a small pond full of fragrant flowers where he found a huge amount!
plan.morale: Collaboration is the key to success.

ape.text:
Ape Leo was a very lively bee. He lived in the Flowery Garden, a place full of colors and smells. He loved to fly among the big, colorful flowers. One day, while having fun collecting nectar, he got lost. The rose petals were so tall, the daisies so many! Ape Leo couldn’t see where he was going anymore.

“Oh no!” said Ape Leo. “I’m lost! I can’t find my hive.” He was very worried. He was afraid of being alone in the garden. He tried to fly high, looking around, but everything seemed the same. The tulips were red and yellow, the sunflowers big and golden. Ape Leo felt more and more lost.

Then, he noticed something special: a bright path made of shiny yellow petals. “Maybe this can help me,” thought Ape Leo. So, he began to follow the path. It was narrow and full of light. With every step, he felt safer.

In the distance, he saw a familiar shape: the bee’s hive! Ape Leo flew quickly towards it and landed on the edge. He saw his sisters and brothers waiting anxiously for him. They were all happy to see him again. Ape Leo joined his family and felt right at home. He was so happy to be back.

Ape Leo realized that even when things seem difficult, if you don’t give up, you always find the way to come home safe and happy.

plan.problema: Bee Leo got lost among the big flowers and can’t find his hive anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the brightest path, made of shining yellow petals.
plan.finale: Finally, he found his nest full of sisters and brothers who were waiting for him anxiously.

beaver.text:
Beaver was a little wooden beaver who was very curious. He lived in the playground, near the tower of stairs. He loved to explore every corner, but that day he had gone too far. He had found himself inside the sand maze! It was a big place and full of curves. Beaver couldn't find the way out.

It was all the same: tall and low sand dunes, paths that crossed each other. Beaver turned and turned, but every time he ended up in a dead end. He started to feel a little sad. A little bird, a sparrow, was watching him from a branch. It didn't say anything, but it seemed to encourage him.

Beaver remembered how beavers did when they built their canals. He took his little paws and started to dig. He made a little channel, following the narrowest path. He dug with effort, moving the sand with his paws. The channel took him to places he had never seen before.

He explored every corner of the maze, thanks to his little channel. Finally, after so much digging, Beaver noticed a hidden passage behind a big sand dune. It was a secret tunnel! He followed it and, in an instant, he found himself outside the maze, right next to the tower of stairs. He was happy and satisfied with his journey. 

Beaver rested a little in the sun, thinking how important it was to be persistent when you have a mission. The playground seemed even more beautiful than before.

plan.problema: Beaver got lost in the sand maze and couldn't find the exit.
plan.svolta: He decided to build a small channel with his paws to explore every corner of the maze.
plan.finale: In the end, thanks to the channel, he discovered a secret passage that took him out of the maze, happy and satisfied.

beaver.text:
Beaver was a very curious stuffed beaver. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. Every day Beaver explored the garden, running among the daisies and jumping over rose bushes.

 

One afternoon, while chasing a yellow butterfly, Beaver found himself in the middle of a flower maze. He had instantly gotten lost! The fragrant petals surrounded him from every side, and he couldn't find his way out. “Oh no!” cried Beaver, “I’m lost!”.

 

Beaver tried to follow the widest path, hoping to reach a safe place. But the path had turned into a dead end. He ended up in front of a large sunflower that was looking at him with its big yellow eyes. Beaver was desperate.

 

Then, he remembered his special whisker! It was a soft, fluffy whisker, made just for feeling smells. Beaver closed his eyes and used his whisker. He smelled the scent of the garden, the scent of the most fragrant flowers, the scent of the herbs.

 

The whisker led him to a small path hidden among the violets. Following the whisker, Beaver finally found the way out of the maze! He ran happily towards his wooden house, where a small flat stone was waiting for him.

 

Beaver rested on the stone and smiled. He had overcome a big problem thanks to his determination. He was so happy to be back home. Perseverance can lead to great discoveries.

plan.problema: Beaver got lost in the flower maze!
plan.svolta: He tried to follow the widest path, but ended up in a dead end.
plan.finale: Thanks to his special whisker, Beaver found the exit and happily returned to his little house.

beaver.text:
Beaver lived at the Flowered Pond. He was a very active beaver and he loved to build. He had built a beautiful dam, tall and strong. He wanted the pond to be a special place, full of calm and quiet water. But Beaver was a little too excited!

Beaver continued to collect branches and stones to make the dam even bigger. The water of the pond began to rise. The water lilies floated higher, the little fish swam with difficulty, and Beaver’s nest began to flood! It was a disaster. The water went everywhere, wetting his leaves and his soft bedding.

Beaver realized that something was wrong. He tried to push the larger branches, but the water kept rising. Then, with patience, he began to remove the small stones that were stuck in the dam. One by one, he took them out with his little paws.

After a lot of work, Beaver understood the problem: the dam was full of stones that prevented the water from flowing well. He removed all the stones and realigned the branches, making the dam lower and smoother. The water returned to flow freely in the pond. Beaver’s nest was saved!

A little frog, Flora, greeted Beaver with a happy croak. Beaver smiled satisfied. He had learned that even the biggest things require patience and attention to be completed successfully. Beaver settled into his dry nest, thinking how important it was to work calmly and methodically.

plan.problema: Beaver built a dam too high and the lake water is flooding his nest!
plan.svolta: Starting to remove the branches with his little paws, he noticed that the dam was full of small stones that were obstructing the flow of water.
plan.finale: He removed all the stones and realigned the dam, restoring the balance of the lake and saving his nest!

beaver.text:
Beaver was a very active beaver. He lived in the playground, among the water games and the swings. He especially liked building his dam, a beautiful structure made of red bricks. That morning, Beaver noticed that something wasn't right. His favorite bricks were gone!

Beaver was very sad. Without the bricks, he couldn't finish the dam. “Oh no!” he said, shaking a little. He first looked under the swing, then near the fountain. But the bricks were too many to see all together. They seemed to be scattered everywhere in the playground.

Beaver felt more and more worried. He didn't know what to do. Then, he looked up and saw the wise owl sitting on a branch of the biggest tree. The owl was famous for his wisdom. 

“Owl,” called Beaver, “I’ve lost my bricks! I don’t know where to look.”

The owl listened carefully and then said, “Beaver, sometimes it’s useful to ask for help. Let’s look for them together.” Together, Beaver and the owl explored the hidden corner behind the wooden house. And there, right under a bush, they found the red bricks!

Beaver was very happy. He thanked the owl and immediately went back to building his dam. He was glad to have a friend who helped him. Beaver realized that asking for help is never a bad thing. And so, with his bricks found, he continued to play happily in the playground.

plan.problema: Beaver has lost his favorite building blocks and can't build his dam.
plan.svolta: He tried to look under the trees, but the blocks were too many to find with a single glance.
plan.finale: Then he had the idea of asking for help from the wise owl in the park and together they found the blocks in a hidden corner!
plan.morale: Asking for help is always a good idea.

beaver.text:
Beaver was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in Aunt Rosa’s garden. Aunt Rosa had so many beautiful flowers. His favorite place was near the big rose bush. The roses were red and yellow and smelled very, very nice!

One day, Beaver was hopping among the dry leaves. He was looking for a shiny leaf to make a new hat. He got too close to the rose bush and… puff! He was lost! He was completely hidden by the trees and the roses. He couldn’t see the garden anymore.

Beaver tried to crawl between the branches. He tried to move quickly, but the branches were too tight. He got stuck! His little paws got stuck and he couldn’t get free. He was a little scared.

Aunt Rosa was watering the roses when she heard a little cry. “Beaver? What’s wrong?” asked Aunt Rosa. She saw Beaver stuck among the branches. She took a little gardening fork and, very carefully, pushed the branches gently to free the teddy bear.

Beaver was finally pulled out. He felt happy and grateful. “Thank you, thank you, thank you!” said Beaver. “You were very good, Aunt Rosa!” Aunt Rosa smiled and held him in her hands. 

Beaver snuggled up near the roses, happy to be safe. Aunt Rosa continued to take care of her garden. It was clear that together they could do lots of wonderful things.

plan.problema: Beaver got lost in the big rose bush!
plan.svolta: He tried to crawl between the branches, but it was too tight and he got tangled!
plan.finale: Aunt Rosa pulled him out with a small fork and Beaver thanked her happily.

beaver.text:
Beaver lived in the Flower Garden. He was a teddy bear beaver, soft and a little bit squished. He loved to play among the colorful flowers and the lush plants. His favorite game was to nibble on the carrots that grew near the stream.

One day, Beaver noticed a problem. He didn’t have his favorite teeth anymore! He had lost them mysteriously during playtime. It was terrible! Without his teeth, he couldn’t chew the carrots. The carrots were so yummy!

Beaver looked around in the Flower Garden. He searched among the tulip stems and among the basil leaves. Nothing. Then he had an idea. He decided to build a small dam with colorful pebbles. He put it in front of a big rock, hoping that the movement of the pebbles would attract his attention.

A blue butterfly, Luna, landed on the rock and started to dust the pebbles with flower dust. While Beaver watched, he noticed something shiny among the rocks. With a little push, he got his teeth back! They were bright like the sun.

Beaver smiled happily. He immediately started to nibble on a juicy carrot. It was delicious! Beaver learned that waiting and watching can lead to the solution of any problem. 
Now he always knew where to find his favorite carrots, thanks to his patience.

plan.problema: Beaver lost his favorite teeth and can’t chew carrots anymore!
plan.svolta: He decided to build a small dam with pebbles to attract his attention and find the hidden teeth among the rocks.
plan.finale: The teeth reappeared shiny, ready for another delicious carrot.

beaver.text:
Beaver lived in the Flower Garden. He was a very busy beaver and he loved building little houses among the flowers. One day, Beaver noticed that something wasn't right. His little building branches were gone! He had put them there to start building a new little house, but now there was nothing left.

Beaver began to look everywhere in the Flower Garden. He looked among the roses, under the lavender bush, and near the little pond that he had built himself. “Where have they gone?” Beaver wondered, worried.

He decided to ask for help from the bees. The bees lived in a straw house next to the waterfall. “Mr. Bee,” said Beaver, “have you seen my branches? I have lost them and I need to find them!” But the bees were too busy collecting honey. “Sorry, Mr. Beaver,” they buzzed, “we have to work!”

Beaver was sad and thoughtful. He didn't know what to do. Then, he noticed a big red carnation leaf, enormous and shiny. He went up to the leaf and lifted it up with his little paws. And there, under the carnation leaf, were all his branches!

Beaver quickly picked them up and was happy. He immediately started building his new little house in the Flower Garden. The building took time and patience, but in the end, Beaver finished his work. 

Beaver learned that even the hardest things become easy if you take your time.

plan.problema: Beaver has lost all his little building branches!
plan.svolta: He tried to ask for help from the bees, but they were too busy collecting honey.
plan.finale: Finally, Beaver found them hidden under a big carnation leaf!

beaver.text:
Beaver was a little wooden beaver who was very curious. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. It was a special place, where the sun shone through the leaves and the birds sang happy songs.

---

One day, Beaver decided to explore the garden even further. He went deeper among the tall sunflowers and the fragrant roses. Suddenly, he found himself in a maze! The flowers were so many that he couldn’t figure out where he was going. He was lost!

---

Beaver tried to go back, but every path led him to other flowers. He was frustrated. He didn’t know what to do. He sat down on a stone and sighed deeply.

---

Then he had an idea. He decided to follow the brightest path. The sun shone brightly in that direction and he hoped it would guide him out of the maze. But, when he reached the end of the path, he found himself only in a dark corner of the garden. He was still lost!

---

Suddenly, a white butterfly flew near him. The butterfly was very kind and smiled. It flew in front of Beaver and led him through the flower maze. Finally, Beaver saw the light at the exit of the secret garden. He was happy!

---

Beaver thanked the butterfly for helping him. The secret garden seemed even more beautiful thanks to his adventure. Perseverance had made all the difference.

plan.problema: Beaver got lost in the maze of flowers and couldn't find his way out.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the brightest path, but he only found himself in a dark corner.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a kind butterfly, Beaver finally found the way out of the garden.

beaver.text:
Beaver was a very happy little beaver made of wood. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and soft grass. Beaver loved building a big dam, but he had a little problem. His building blocks, the gray stones, were gone! He couldn't find any more, and his dam couldn't be finished.

Beaver huddled down sadly under a big sunflower. “Oh no!” he said. “How will I build my dam if I don’t have the blocks?” He wiggled back and forth in the garden, desperately searching.

Then, Beaver had an idea. He saw Ant, the busiest ant in the Secret Garden, carrying a big leaf. “Ant,” called Beaver, “Can you help me? I’ve lost my blocks and I need to build the dam.”

Ant stopped and listened carefully. “Of course, Beaver,” replied Ant, “I’m happy to help you! But in return, I promise you a pile of fresh leaves that have just fallen!”

Beaver was pleased. Ant found the hidden blocks under a fragrant red rose. Together, Beaver and Ant put the blocks one on top of the other, creating a strong and sturdy dam. The river in the Secret Garden flowed calmly around the new dam.

Beaver smiled. “Thank you, Ant! You were very good!”

Beaver and Ant were friends and they had built the dam together. It was nice to work together to reach a common goal.

plan.problema: Beaver has lost his building blocks to build a dam, and he can’t finish it.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the busiest ant in the garden, promising in return a pile of fresh leaves.
plan.finale: The ant helped Beaver find the hidden blocks under a rose, and together they successfully completed the dam.

beaver.text:
Beaver was a very curious stuffed beaver. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of tall plants and colorful flowers. It was his favorite place! One day, while hopping among the red tulips, Beaver decided to explore a new corner of the garden. He went deeper among the giant ferns and the fragrant roses.

Soon, he realized he was lost. The Secret Garden seemed like a maze! The plants were so tall that he felt small and confused. Beaver tried to turn around, but every time he only found more plants and flowers. He felt a little scared.

Beaver decided to follow the stream that ran nearby. He thought it might take him out of the maze. But the stream was long and twisty. Beaver got further and further away from where he had started his adventure. He was even more lost!

Beaver didn’t want to give up. He calmed down and thought, “I have to be brave!” He started to look around carefully. Then, he noticed something strange: a little path hidden among the roots of a big lemon tree.

Beaver followed the path, step by step. The path led him closer and closer to the center of the Secret Garden. Finally, Beaver found himself back in his favorite place, next to the fountain with the waterfall. He was happy and glad to be home. Beaver understood that even when things seem difficult, you should never stop looking.

plan.problema: Beaver got lost in the maze of plants and flowers.
plan.svolta: He tried to follow the stream, but he had only gone further away from his starting point.
plan.finale: Thanks to his courage and determination, Beaver found a secret path that brought him back to the heart of the garden.

bluey toy.text:
Bluey was a little blue car. She loved to run in the garden at home. Her main mission was to make happy circles around the apple tree. But today something wasn't right. Bluey felt sad. Her favorite button, the red star-shaped one, was missing!

Bluey tried to move her wheels, but nothing. The car wasn't working. “Oh no!” exclaimed Bluey, with a little squeaky voice. She looked under the picnic table, inside the feather house, and even behind the bench. But the red button was gone.

Bluey thought: “Maybe it fell off?” She looked around the garden. The leaves were red and yellow, scattered everywhere. Bluey decided to look among the leaves. Leo’s mom, the garden cat, was dozing on the lawn. Bluey huddled down and started to search carefully.

After a while, she heard something under a big yellow flower. It was the red button! Bluey grabbed it with her wheels and pushed it back into its place. Immediately, Bluey’s car started working again. She began to make happy circles around the tree, fast and happy. 

Bluey stopped for a moment, watching the sun shining on the garden. It was so lovely to see her car starting to run again. Bluey realized that even when things seem difficult, with a little patience, you can always find a solution.

plan.problema: Bluey lost her favorite button and can’t make her car work.
plan.svolta: She decided to look among the leaves, thinking the button might have fallen there.
plan.finale: She found the button under a flower, went back into the car, and immediately started making happy circles.
plan.morale: Patience is key to solving problems.

bluey toy.text:
Bluey Toy was a very happy blue teddy bear. He lived in the Flower Garden, among the fragrant flowers and colorful butterflies. Every day, Bluey Toy loved to play there, but today he felt sad. He had lost his favorite button! It was a small red button that, when you turned it, made his special music sound.

Bluey Toy started to look everywhere. He looked under the red roses and behind the tall trees. He looked among the white daisies and the yellow tulips. But the button wasn't there anymore! Bluey Toy was very worried, his music was finished.

“Maybe someone can help me,” thought Bluey Toy. Then he decided to ask the stone gnome who lived near the lavender bush. The gnome was old and wise, with a long, white beard. “Gnome, I’ve lost my button!” said Bluey Toy.

The gnome scratched his beard thoughtfully. Then, he pointed to a fragrant lavender bush. “Look here, little teddy bear,” he said. And there, among the purple flowers, was the red button!

Bluey Toy took his button and turned it. It made a joyful, happy music sound. Bluey Toy was so happy. He thanked the gnome and continued to play in the Flower Garden, knowing that even when you lose something, with a little patience, you always find it. The sun shone warm on the garden, and Bluey Toy played his music even louder.

plan.problema: Bluey Toy lost his favorite button, the one that makes his melody sound!
plan.svolta: After searching under the roses and behind the trees, Bluey Toy decided to ask for help from the stone gnome.
plan.finale: The gnome found the button hidden in a lavender bush and returned it to Bluey Toy, who played a joyful melody.
plan.morale: Patience is useful for finding what is lost.

bluey toy.text:
Bluey woke up in the garden. The sun was shining bright and the flowers smelled wonderful. Bluey was a soft blue puppy, and his body was made of fluffy plush. He loved to play among the green leaves of the apple tree. But today, something wasn’t right.

Bluey had wandered too far. He had ended up in the tall grass, full of high, yellow grass. He couldn’t see his house! His house was a little corner under the apple tree, where he often rested among the leaves. Bluey felt a little scared. His fluffy paws were wet with grass.

Bluey tried to move, but the tall grass was blocking him. He tried to go back, but he couldn’t figure out where he had ended up in the field. Bluey made a sweet sound: “Boo-lee, boo-lee”. He repeated his name slowly.

A little red ladybug stopped to listen. The ladybug was curious about the sound. It followed Bluey with its black eyes. The ladybug flew towards the apple tree and then pointed with its head. Bluey followed the ladybug, moving slowly through the tall grass.

Finally, Bluey reached his safe spot! He was surrounded by green, cool leaves. He curled up there, happy to be home. The leaves gave him a little shade from the hot sun. Bluey felt calm and happy. 

Bluey realized that even when things seem difficult, asking for help can lead to the answer. And patience, to find your place, is a great resource.

plan.problema: Bluey got lost in the tall grass and couldn't find her house, a little corner under the apple tree.
plan.svolta: She decided to call for help, making a sweet and repeated sound until a ladybug led her to the apple tree.
plan.finale: She finally reached her safe corner, happy to be home with her green leaves.

bluey toy.text:
Bluey was a little blue puppy. She lived in the Flower Garden, a place full of colors and smells. She was happy, but today she felt a little sad. The flowers in the garden were beautiful, red, yellow, and white. But their buds didn’t seem to be growing.

“I’m too small,” said Bluey, looking around. “I can’t do anything to help the flowers get big.” She sat down next to a red rose, feeling a little frustrated. A white butterfly flew around her and landed on her head. 

Bluey thought. She thought about the sun shining high in the sky. The sun was very bright! The flowers needed shade to grow well. Bluey had a brilliant idea. She used her little legs to lean against a small bush and her hat to protect herself from the sun. 

She made a little umbrella over the delicate flowers. Her legs were a little wobbly, but the hat was perfect! The sun was still bright, but now the flowers had a little shade. The flowers stretched up towards the sky and began to bloom.

Bluey smiled. She felt happy and proud. The flowers seemed to smile at the sun! Bluey was a real helper of the Flower Garden. Now she knew that even small things can do great magic.

plan.problema: Bluey feels too small to help the flowers grow.
plan.svolta: She decided to make a little umbrella to protect them from the scorching sun, using her legs and her hat.
plan.finale: The flowers smile at the sun and Bluey feels like a real garden helper.
plan.morale: Even small ones can do big things.

bluey toy.text:
Bluey was a soft blue teddy bear. He lived in the garden at home, among the flowers and the trees. He loved to play with all his toy friends, but he especially liked to be near his box of colors. One afternoon, while the sun was shining brightly in the sky, Bluey was right there.

Suddenly, Bluey noticed he was surrounded by green branches and leaves. He had ended up under a big rose bush! The roses smelled very strongly, but Bluey couldn’t move. He was lost! His blue face was a little sad.

Bluey thought quickly. He decided to take a series of criss-cross steps. First he turned to the right, then to the left, then forward. Then he turned to the right and to the left again. He was a little confused, but he didn’t give up. He kept moving calmly.

A little black kitten, Micio, was watching him curiously. “Are you getting lost?” he meowed. Bluey nodded sadly. But Bluey continued his criss-cross steps. Finally, after a while, Bluey saw his box of colors! He was happy! He was back in his place among the colorful toys. Bluey carefully arranged himself, happy to be home. 

Bluey understood that even when things seem difficult, if you try and don’t give up, you always find the right way.

plan.problema: Bluey got lost under a big rose bush!
plan.svolta: She decided to take a series of steps in crisscross pattern to find her way.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to her good sense, she was back in her place among the colorful toys.

bluey toy.text:
Bluey woke up in the secret garden. It was a place full of colorful flowers and big plants. Bluey loved this garden very much. But today something wasn't right. Bluey had gotten lost among the red and white roses. The roses were so tall and fragrant that they made her spin around. She couldn't see her friend Lockette, a little blue lock with a small star-shaped tag.

Bluey looked everywhere. She climbed a bush, squeezed between the big leaves, and even huddled under a lavender plant. But Lockette was gone! Bluey started to feel sad. She was very lonely in the secret garden.

Then Bluey took a deep breath and decided to call for help. She had an idea! She made a sweet sound, like a little bell. The sound filled the secret garden. 

A small, curious squirrel named Pipistrello listened to the sound. Pipistrello came up to Bluey and looked at her with his black eyes. “What’s wrong?” asked Pipistrello. Bluey explained that she was lost and couldn't find Lockette.

Pipistrello, very kind, started to look around the lavender bush. And there, right underneath, among the roots, was the blue lock with the star-shaped tag! Bluey thanked Pipistrello and hugged him tightly. 

Bluey and Pipistrello became good friends because of their teamwork. They realized that together they could solve any problem. And Bluey understood that helping others makes you feel good.

plan.problema: Bluey got lost among the roses and couldn't find her friend Lockette.
plan.svolta: She decided to call for help, making a sweet sound like a bell to attract attention.
plan.finale: A curious little squirrel helped her find Lockette under a lavender bush.

bluey toy.text:
Bluey woke up suddenly. She was surrounded by red and pink roses, fragrant and big. But she wasn’t in her favorite place: the Secret Garden. The Secret Garden was near the fountain, with the water gurgling softly. Bluey loved that place because there the sunbeams warmed her the most.

Now, though, she felt lost. The roses were so many, all the same and fragrant. She couldn’t see the green lawn where she usually lay near the fountain. She tried to move, but the dry leaves made her slide away. It was all confusing!

Bluey tried to shout for help, but her voice was too small to be heard among so many flowers. Nobody was listening. She felt sad and a little scared. She wanted to go home so much.

Suddenly, she heard a small sound: “Tick-tac… tick-tac…” She looked down and saw a little gnome with a red hat. The gnome was smiling. “Don’t worry,” said the gnome. “I heard you calling.”

The gnome gently took Bluey in his hands and carried her softly towards the fountain. He put her on the green lawn, near the fountain where she lived. Bluey felt immediately safe and happy. The gnome smiled one more time and disappeared among the plants.

Bluey relaxed, watching the water of the fountain gurgle. She realized that even when you feel alone, asking for help can lead to new friendships.

plan.problema: Bluey got lost among the fragrant roses and couldn't find her way back.
plan.svolta: She decided to shout for help, but her voice was too small to be heard.
plan.finale: A little garden gnome listened to Bluey and gently brought her near the fountain where he lived.
plan.morale: Even when you feel alone, asking for help is a good idea.

bluey toy.text:
Bluey was a bright blue teddy bear. He lived in the garden at home. He loved to play among the roses and sunflowers. But today Bluey had a problem. He had gotten lost! He had ended up among the green leaves and thick bushes. He couldn’t find his box. The box was where all his friends lived, the other toys.

Bluey looked around with his blue eyes. He looked, he looked, but he didn’t see anything familiar. “Oh no!” said Bluey. “I need to find my box!”

Then Bluey decided to ask for help. He flew towards the colorful butterflies that fluttered in the garden. “Butterflies,” called Bluey, “do you know where my box is?” But the butterflies were too busy flying from one plant to another to answer. They couldn’t show him the way.

Bluey was a little sad. He sat down on a small pebble and waited. The sun shone brightly in the sky. Then, he heard a meow. A tabby cat named Milo was approaching. He was a curious and friendly kitten.

“What are you doing here, blue bear?” asked Milo. Bluey explained his problem to Milo. Milo looked at Bluey carefully and, thanks to his bright blue color, which stood out very much against the green plants, he quickly approached him. He gently took him in his paws and brought him right next to the toy box!

Bluey jumped inside happily. He was happy to be back with his friends. Bluey realized that even when things seem difficult, you should never give up.

plan.problema: Bluey got lost among the plants and couldn't find her box.
plan.svolta: She tried to ask for help from the butterflies, but none of them were able to show her the way.
plan.finale: In the end, thanks to her bright blue color, she attracted the attention of the cat Milo, who immediately brought her close to the box.

bluey toy.text:
Bluey was a soft blue teddy bear. He lived in the Rose Garden. The roses smelled very strongly and Bluey loved to be there. One day, while playing hide-and-seek with the roses, he got lost. He couldn't find his place anymore. He was surrounded by lots of red and pink petals. “Oh no!” said Bluey. “I don’t know how to go back!”

Bluey tried to remember where he had to be. He looked around frantically. The roses were so beautiful, but he wanted to go home. A little squirrel, Pip, was watching him from a branch. Pip was curious and greeted Bluey with a chirp. Bluey replied with a silent greeting.

Bluey made a decision. He decided to follow the brightest path. The sun shone through the roses and created a bright beam. Bluey moved slowly, looking ahead. It was important not to give up. Every step was a little effort.

After walking for a long time, he finally saw something. He saw his colorful box under a big apple tree. The box was blue like him! Bluey ran towards it and snuggled up. He felt tired but happy. He was home. Bluey closed his eyes and rested, knowing that even if you sometimes get lost, with a little effort you always find your way.

plan.problema: Bluey got lost among the fragrant roses, unable to find her way back.
plan.svolta: She decided to follow the brightest path, hoping it would lead her home.
plan.finale: Finally, Bluey saw her colorful box under a large apple tree and ran to rest.

bluey toy.text:
Bluey woke up in the Flower Garden. It was a toy of Bluey’s, soft and blue like her favorite color. The garden was full of red, yellow, and purple flowers. It looked like a beautiful place, but Bluey felt a little scared.

She had gotten lost! She had started to wander around looking for a special flower, a flower just like her, and now she didn’t know where her special spot in the garden was. The flowers were so many and all so similar! Bluey sat down on a little bush of red roses, but she couldn’t find her favorite corner near the fountain.

Bluey wanted to do something. She thought maybe someone would have heard her. Then she made a little musical sound, like a bell ringing softly. It was a sweet and gentle sound.

Not long after, Mrs. Turtle came out of her shell. She had heard the sound! “Oh, how cute!” said Mrs. Turtle. “You were trying to call for help, weren’t you, Bluey?” She pointed with her claw towards a corner of the garden, near a big yellow sunflower. “Your home is right there!”

Bluey ran quickly towards the sunflower. It was exactly where she wanted to be! She felt happy and relieved. She thanked Mrs. Turtle with a smile. Bluey realized that asking for help could be a wonderful thing.

plan.problema: Bluey got lost among the colorful flowers and couldn't find her way back.
plan.svolta: She decided to call for help, making a small musical sound to get attention.
plan.finale: Mrs. Turtle heard the sound and kindly showed Bluey the right way.
plan.morale: Asking for help is always a good idea.

canguro.text:
Canguru lived in the Flowery Meadow. He was a toy kangaroo, a little bit deflated and with a few scratches, but very happy. Every day he loved to jump among the flowers and collect the prettiest leaves for his nest. He had a red felt pouch that he used to carry them.

One morning, Canguru noticed that his favorite pouch was gone! It had disappeared in the meadow. “Oh no!” he exclaimed. He couldn’t collect the leaves for his nest anymore. The leaves were big and green, perfect for making the nest soft and warm.

Canguru was very sad. He jumped here and there looking for the pouch, but without success. Then he decided to ask for help. He saw a red ladybug moving on the biggest flower. “Ladybug, Ladybug,” said Canguru, “can you help me? I’ve lost my pouch!”

The ladybug was very kind. “I know every corner of the Flowery Meadow,” she replied. “Follow me.” The ladybug flew in front of Canguru, pointing the way with her little antennae.

Canguru followed the ladybug to a small stream. And there, right next to the stream, was his red pouch! It had fallen into the water after slipping during one of Canguru’s jumps. The kangaroo quickly retrieved it and filled it with leaves.

Canguru was very happy. He thanked the ladybug for her help. He returned to his nest, happy to have his pouch back. It was always better to ask for help when you need it.

plan.problema: Kangaroo has lost his favorite pouch and can’t collect pretty leaves for his nest anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the ladybug, who knew all the corners of the meadow.
plan.finale: The ladybug led him to a small stream where the pouch had fallen, and Kangaroo retrieved it happily!
plan.morale: Asking for help is always a good idea.

canguro.text:
Cody was a teddy kangaroo. He lived in a flowery garden full of colors and smells. He loved his place very much, among the white daisies and tall sunflowers. But today Cody felt worried. He was all alone, and something wasn't right.

Cody had many little toy kangaroos. They were all white like him and had little pockets full of fake flowers. But now, all those little friends were gone! It seemed they had scattered everywhere among the daisies. Cody looked for them, but he couldn't find them. He was very sad.

“I must find my little ones!” thought Cody. So he decided to make a circle around the lawn. Cody focused with his eyes pointed and looked carefully at every single daisy. He was looking for his little white kangaroos, one by one. 

The sun was shining high in the sky. A red ladybug passed by, but Cody didn't notice it. He was too busy looking for his friends. After a while, he finally saw something white under a red petal! He found the first little kangaroo, then another, and another one. All his little ones were hidden under the colorful petals of the roses.

Cody picked them all up in his hug. He was happy to have his little kangaroos beside him. The flowery garden looked even more beautiful with them.

plan.problema: Cody had lost all his little toy kangaroos scattered among the daisies.
plan.svolta: He decided to make a circle around the lawn, searching with his keen eyes every little white kangaroo.
plan.finale: Finally he found all his pups hidden under the colorful petals of the roses.

canguro.text:
Coco was a very happy teddy kangaroo. He lived in the Flowery Meadow, a place full of yellow and green daisies and fragrant herbs. Coco loved to jump and play with the other kangaroos in his family. But today, Coco had gotten lost!

He had been exploring near a big red rose when he closed his eyes for a moment. When he opened them again, his parents and brothers were gone. Coco felt very sad. He didn't know where he was and couldn't find his family.

Coco was desperate. He sat down on the grass, with his paws crossed. “I have to go home,” he thought. Then, Coco decided to do something. He stood up and started to jump as hard as he could. He jumped up and down, as high as a tree, then he slowed down and started again.

He jumped all over the meadow, hoping to see something familiar among the daisies. A little bird, a yellow sparrow, was watching him jump. “Maybe you could jump even stronger!” chirped the sparrow. Coco followed the sparrow’s advice.

Suddenly, Coco heard a shout: “Coco! Coco!” It was the voice of his mommy kangaroo. Coco turned around and saw his parents running towards him. He jumped quickly and ran into their arms for a happy hug.

Coco was so happy to be home. He had learned that even when you get lost, you must never give up. And in the end, perseverance did good for Coco.

plan.problema: Koco got lost from his kangaroo family and doesn’t know how to get home anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to jump as hard as he could, hoping to see a familiar sign in the meadow.
plan.finale: Finally, he heard his kangaroo mum’s call and jumped towards her for a happy hug.

canguro.text:
Rocky was a very happy teddy kangaroo. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. The squirrels jumped between the branches, the butterflies flew lightly, and the rabbit Pipino ran fast. Rocky wanted to join them, but he had a little problem. He couldn’t jump like the other animals. His jumps were short and weak.

Rocky felt sad. He wanted to run and play with his friends. “Why can’t I jump?” he thought. Pipino looked at him curiously: “Maybe you’re a little tired, Rocky!” said the rabbit.

Rocky decided to do something. He sat down on the soft grass of the secret garden and started to jump up and down. He jumped repeatedly, getting stronger and stronger. He took breaks to rest, but then he started again right away. It was a long training! The sun shone brightly in the sky.

After a long time, Rocky still felt tired, but his legs seemed more energetic. He tried to jump again. This time, he made a huge effort! He jumped higher than he had ever jumped before! He flew over a bush and landed with a small thump.

Pipino ran to hug him: “You did it, Rocky!” he exclaimed happily. Rocky smiled satisfied. He had learned that with effort and perseverance, you can overcome any difficulty. He was ready to play with all his friends in the secret garden. Rocky jumped for joy, feeling stronger and happier than ever.

plan.problema: Rocky can't jump as high as the other animals in the garden.
plan.svolta: He decided to do a long training, jumping up and down repeatedly to wake up his tired legs.
plan.finale: Finally, with a great effort, Rocky managed to jump higher than ever before!
plan.morale: With effort, you can overcome any difficulty.

canguro.text:
Canguru lived in the Flowery Meadow. He was a very happy teddy kangaroo and loved to jump among the flowers. One day, Canguru had a special bag. The bag was full of beautiful, colorful flowers. He had collected them to make a gift for his friend, the butterfly, Lila.

But then… the bag disappeared! Canguru looked everywhere. He looked among the daisies, under the tulips, and even near the lavender bush. But the bag was gone. Canguru felt very sad. “Oh no!” he said. “Where have my flowers gone?”

Canguru decided to do something. He looked at his back legs, the ones he used to jump. He thought, “Maybe if I follow my legs, they will take me to the bag!” So, Canguru started to jump, following the path of his legs. He jumped back and forth in the meadow.

He jumped among the tall sunflowers. Suddenly, Canguru saw something colorful under a big sunflower. It was his bag! The bag was hidden right there, in the sun. Canguru smiled happily. He picked up all the flowers and put them back in the bag.

Canguru sat among the flowers, happy. He had learned that sometimes you have to wait a little while to find what you have lost. The butterfly, Lila, arrived soon after, and Canguru gave her his beautiful flowers.

plan.problema: Kangaroo has lost his bag full of flowers and doesn't know where it's gone!
plan.svolta: He decided to follow his back legs, hoping they would lead him to the lost flowers.
plan.finale: He found the bag hidden under a big sunflower and smiled happily.
plan.morale: Patience is important for finding what you have lost.

canguro.text:
Canguru lived in the Flowery Meadow. He was a teddy bear kangaroo, soft and happy. He loved to jump among the flowers. One day, Canguru was playing with lots of enthusiasm. He jumped up and down, higher and higher!

Suddenly, Canguru realized he was lost. His family, his teddy bear brothers, were not around anymore. “Oh no!” said Canguru, a little scared. He looked everywhere, but nobody could see him.

Canguru decided to try to find them. He jumped right, he jumped left, he jumped forward! But every time he jumped, he landed on a colorful flower: red, yellow, blue, and pink. The flowers were beautiful, but Canguru wanted his family.

Canguru stopped, tired. He sat down on a big sunflower and thought. Then, suddenly, a bright ray of sunshine shone on the meadow. The sun lit up a little hidden path between the roses!

Canguru followed the path and saw his family, happy and waiting for him. His daddy teddy bear hugged him tight. His sister and brother teddy bears were there too, hopping around him. Canguru was so happy to be back with them.

Canguru understood that finding family takes a little time and patience. And now, Canguru jumped happily in the Flowery Meadow, near his loved ones. His family was there, always waiting for him.

plan.problema: Kangaroo got lost from his family during playtime!
plan.svolta: He tried to jump in all directions, but only found colorful flowers.
plan.finale: A ray of sunshine illuminated a hidden path, and Kangaroo saw his family happy to welcome him.

canguro.text:
Canguro Leo loved to play in the Flowery Meadow. He was a very happy and bouncy stuffed kangaroo. Every day he ran between the yellow and red flowers, trying to reach the butterflies. One afternoon, while he jumped as high as he could, he went too far from his family.

“Mommy? Daddy?” called Leo, but he didn’t hear an answer. He realized he was lost. He was all alone and a little scared. The meadow was beautiful, but without his loved ones, it seemed very big. He tried to follow his footprints, but everything looked the same.

Canguro Leo decided to do something silly. He decided to jump as high as possible! He jumped and jumped, trying to climb onto a tree to see his family. But every time he landed, he was even further into the meadow. He was frustrated.

Suddenly, he smelled something. A sweet and familiar smell: the scent of his mommy’s favorite mint leaves! Canguro Leo followed the smell, jumping with more energy than ever. The smell became stronger and stronger.

And then, he saw it! His mommy, his daddy, and his little kangaroo brothers and sisters were waiting for him under a big sunflower. “Leo!” they all shouted happily. Canguro Leo ran to reach them, happy to be back home. 

Canguro Leo’s perseverance, despite the fear and frustration, made a difference. After all, a good jump can lead you to the right place.

plan.problema: Leo got lost from his kangaroo family while playing and couldn't find them.
plan.svolta: He decided to jump as high as possible, hoping to see his family from up there, but he only found himself even further away.
plan.finale: Thanks to his big jump and his determination, Leo smelled a familiar scent and, following the smell, he found his loved ones who were waiting for him.

canguro.text:
Cappy was a teddy kangaroo. He lived in the Flowery Meadow, full of colorful flowers and green grass. Cappy loved to jump among the flowers, but sometimes he had too much fun. One day, while he was taking a particularly long jump, he realized he was all alone. He couldn’t see his kangaroo family anymore!

Cappy was scared. He shouted: “Mommy? Daddy? Where are you?” But nobody answered. The Flowery Meadow seemed enormous and Cappy didn’t know where to go. He sat down on the grass, sad and worried. He really wanted to find his parents and his little kangaroo brothers and sisters.

Cappy thought he had to do something. He decided to jump as high as possible. He jumped and jumped, trying to look far away. His cloth feet got very tired, but Cappy didn’t give up. He jumped stronger and stronger, hoping to see his loved ones.

Suddenly, Cappy heard a noise. He looked up and saw a group of kangaroos! They were far away, but Cappy was able to recognize his dad’s brown fur. The kangaroos ran towards him and welcomed him with joy. They hugged him tightly, happy that Cappy was back.

Cappy was so happy. He was finally home again. It had been a long and tiring jump, but it was worth it. Cappy understood that you shouldn’t ever give up when you want something. And this helped him find happiness.

plan.problema: Cappy got lost and couldn't find his kangaroo family.
plan.svolta: He decided to jump as high as possible, hoping to see his loved ones from far away and show them the way.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to his daring jump, he saw a group of kangaroos who welcomed him with joy and hugs.

canguro.text:
Canguro Rosso lived in the Flowery Garden. He was a bright red kangaroo and loved to jump among the flowers. But today, Canguro Rosso couldn't jump well. He felt very sad. His legs seemed heavy and tired.

"Oh no," said Canguro Rosso, "I can't jump anymore! I don't like feeling so slow." He tried to jump hard, but only small hops. Then he tried to go up and down the lawn, but still nothing. He was really disappointed.

A blue butterfly, Lila, landed near Canguro Rosso. “Why are you so sad?” asked Lila with her gentle voice.

Canguro Rosso explained that he couldn't jump and he was feeling a little down. Then, he decided to do some stretching: he stretched his legs up and down, back and forth. But even that didn't help. His legs were still heavy.

Suddenly, Canguro Rosso noticed something under his foot. It was a small stone! The stone was right there, stuck between his paws. Canguro Rosso removed it carefully and tried again. 

He jumped! He jumped high and happily in the Flowery Garden. His legs were light and agile again. Canguro Rosso hopped around Lila, happy and grateful for finding such a simple solution. The stone was small, but it made all the difference.

plan.problema: Red Kangaroo can’t jump well and feels sad.
plan.svolta: He tried to do a little stretching, but it didn’t work.
plan.finale: Then he discovered that a small stone was blocking his legs and, removing it, he could finally jump happily!
plan.morale: Sometimes it just takes a small thing to solve problems.

canguro.text:
Coco was a very silly stuffed kangaroo. He loved to play in Grandma’s secret garden. The garden was full of colorful flowers and lush plants. Coco loved to hop among the bushes, but sometimes he got lost in the winding paths.

One day, while he was playing, Coco found himself in a maze of roses. The roses were so tall that they surrounded him on every side. He couldn’t find his little wooden house, where he slept when it was dark. He was very sad and scared. “Oh no,” said Coco, “I’m lost!”

Coco tried to go back, but the roses seemed to never end. He climbed up a small dirt hill, but he only saw more roses. Then, he took a deep breath and decided to do something different. He decided to jump as high as he could, hoping to see something from far away that would help him find his way.

He jumped and jumped, using all his strength. His fluffy feet thumped with energy. Finally, after many jumps, he jumped over the wall of roses! In front of him was a small open space and in the center, his cozy little house. Coco ran to it and crawled inside, happy to be home. He curled up on his soft pillow and closed his eyes.

Coco realized that even when things seem difficult, if you try your best with perseverance, you always find the right way.

plan.problema: Coco got lost in the maze of flowers and couldn't find his little house.
plan.svolta: He decided to jump as high as possible, hoping to see something from far away.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to his agility, he managed to climb over the wall of roses and found his cozy little house.

cat.text:
Cat was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in the Flower Garden, a place full of colors and smells. He loved to play among the red tulips and yellow roses. He had a favorite red ball, his greatest joy.

One day, Cat was bouncing his ball when... he lost it! The ball had ended up among the flowers, hidden by a tangle of green leaves. Cat felt sad and lost. “I must find my ball again!” he meowed, looking everywhere.

Cat started to look among the white daisies. He moved towards the ball, but right away a strong wind blew and pushed it away! Cat got up and tried again, but the wind was always there, unfriendly. A red ladybug looked at him for a moment while he fussed about.

Cat decided to explore every corner of the garden. He climbed up a small hill of earth and then huddled under a lavender bush. But the ball was always elusive.

Then, Cat had an idea! He saw a big oak tree, tall and strong. He climbed onto the trunk, climbing, climbing, with his fluffy paws. When he reached a high branch, he saw his red ball! It was hanging on the branch, shaken by the wind.

Cat jumped down from the oak tree and took his ball. He hugged it tight. He felt so happy! He had been patient and finally he had found what he was looking for. Patience can really do miracles.

plan.problema: Cat got lost and couldn't find her favorite ball among the flowers.
plan.svolta: She decided to explore every corner of the garden, but every time she got close to the ball, a strong wind pushed it away.
plan.finale: Finally, Cat had the idea to climb a big oak tree and saw her ball hanging from a branch!

cat.text:
Cat lived in the Secret Garden. He was a soft and fluffy teddy bear cat, always ready to play. He had a cozy nest under a big fern, his favorite place. Cat loved his white feather more than anything. He always kept it with him, holding it tight when he relaxed.

One day, Cat noticed that the feather was missing! It had fallen somewhere in the garden. He couldn’t find it. He had to go back to his nest, but without the feather it seemed much harder. “Oh no!” meowed Cat, furrowing his fluffy eyebrows.

He decided to look everywhere. He looked among the colorful flowers, under the stones, and even inside the old rusty bucket. But the white feather was still missing. Then he had an idea: he should reach his feather from the tallest rose in the garden!

Cat began to climb the rose, trying to grab it with his paws. But he slipped down, unable to catch the feather. He fell onto the grass, a little confused. A red ladybug passed by, looking at him curiously.

Then Cat found a piece of fishing line abandoned in the grass. With great care, he used the line to reach the feather that was hanging from a leaf. He picked it up gently and returned to his nest. He was so happy!

Cat put his feather in his nest and curled up under the fern, feeling calm and peaceful. Cat’s patience had helped him find what he loved. And now he was sleeping peacefully, knowing that everything would be as it should be.

plan.problema: Cat lost her favorite feather and couldn't reach her nest.
plan.svolta: She decided to climb the tallest rose, but she slipped down without being able to catch the feather.
plan.finale: Using a fishing line, Cat gently recovered her feather and returned to the nest in peace.

cat.text:
Cat was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in Grandma Emilia’s garden. It was a garden full of flowers and lush plants. Cat loved to be there, watching the butterflies flutter around. But today he wasn't happy.


He was lost! He had played too close to the big lawn and now he couldn’t find his favorite ball of yarn, the one made of red wool. It was a soft and warm ball, perfect for naps. Cat had been looking for it for a long time, but nothing, vanished in the green.

Cat felt a little sad. He didn’t know what to do. Then he decided to explore the garden. He saw a path made of pebbles winding among the plants. “Maybe there’s a clue,” thought Cat and began to follow it.

The path led him near the rose bush, fragrant and colorful. And there, right under a red rose, was his ball of yarn! Cat ran to hug it. He was happy to have found it. He cheered up and settled down next to the ball of yarn, ready for a long nap. Grandma Emilia passed by and smiled at Cat. 

Cat realized that even when things seem difficult, if you keep trying to find something, you always find the solution. And this made him feel even happier to be a teddy bear in Grandma Emilia’s garden.

plan.problema: Cat got lost in the big meadow and can’t find his favorite ball of yarn.
plan.svolta: He decided to explore the garden following the path made of pebbles, hoping to find a clue.
plan.finale: Finally, he found the ball of yarn under a rose bush and cheered himself up.

cat.text:
Cat was a very happy plush kitten. He lived in the Secret Garden, a special place full of flowers and green plants. Every day Cat loved to play there. He had a favorite red ball, his greatest joy. He always kept it with him.

One afternoon, while hopping among the white daisies, he noticed that the ball was gone! “Oh no!” meowed Cat. “Where has it gone?” He looked everywhere: under the old tree, behind the rose bush, but the red ball was missing.

Cat tried to dig with his paws in the dirt. He collected a lot of dust and dry leaves, but he couldn’t find the ball. He was very frustrated. “I can’t do it!” said Cat, lowering his head.

Suddenly, he saw a red ladybug flying nearby. “Hello Ladybug,” said Cat. “I’ve lost my favorite ball and I don’t know where it is.” The ladybug, named Rosina, smiled. “I’ll help you!” she exclaimed.

Rosina flew around the daisies and, with a little kick of her foot, gently lifted a leaf. Under the leaf, there it was! Cat’s red ball was shining in the sun. 

Cat hopped happily. He thanked Rosina for her help. “Thank you very much!” meowed Cat. “I could never have done it without you.” Cat took his ball and sat next to Rosina, knowing that together they could solve any problem.

plan.problema: Cat lost her favorite ball in the middle of the daisies!
plan.svolta: Trying to dig with her paws, she just got a little dirt on herself.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a friendly ladybug, she found the ball under a flower.

cat.text:
Cat was a very happy plush kitten. He lived in the Flower Garden, among the tulips and violets. He loved to play hide-and-seek among the apple trees. One day, while happily skipping, he found himself in the middle of the rose maze. The roses were big and smelled very strongly!

Cat realized that he was lost. He couldn't find his home, the green lawn where he slept every night. He was a little scared. He tried to call for help, but no one answered.

He decided then to use his little paws to explore every path. He walked back and forth, through the lavender bushes and among the geraniums. But the more he went, the more confused he became. Every rose seemed exactly like the other!

An old squirrel, who lived at the top of the big cherry tree, watched Cat with curiosity. He said, "Don't give up, little cat. Explore every corner."

Suddenly, Cat smelled a sweet and intense fragrance. It was the smell of his friends! He followed that scent and, after a few steps, he saw the garden gate. His friends – the red rubber balls and the blue plush bunny – were waiting happily.

Cat ran to them, happy to be back home. He snuggled between his friends' legs and felt safe and content. Cat learned that even when things seem difficult, continuing to go forward can lead to the solution.

plan.problema: Cat got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his way home.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his little paws to explore every path, but he only got more confused.
plan.finale: A sweet scent led him to the garden gate, where his friends were waiting happily.

cat.text:
Cat was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in the Flower Garden, among fragrant roses and tall sunflowers. Every day he enjoyed rolling on the soft grass. He also had a favorite red wool ball, his most precious treasure.

One afternoon, Cat was playing near the lavender bush. Suddenly, he heard a strong breeze and, in an instant, he ended up in the tall meadow. It was much taller than him! He looked for his wool ball, but he couldn't find it. “Oh no!” meowed Cat, worried.

He decided he had to do something. Then, he started jumping up and down, trying to see better. He jumped between the daisies and clover. But every time he moved even further away from the lavender bush. “Maybe I’m too excited,” thought Cat, a little frustrated.

Suddenly, he heard a chirping sound. A little blue bird perched on a yellow flower and pointed with its beak at the meadow. Cat followed the bird’s gaze and immediately saw his red wool ball! It was there, next to a big daisy.

Cat ran towards the wool ball and hugged it tightly. “I did it!” exclaimed Cat happily. The bird flew away, waving to Cat. The sun shone on the Flower Garden, and Cat felt very happy to be back home. 

Cat realized that even when things seem difficult, a little help can make a difference.

plan.problema: Cat got lost in the tall meadow and couldn't find his favorite ball of wool.
plan.svolta: He decided to take little hops to explore the meadow better, but he had only gone even further away.
plan.finale: A little bird pointed at him with its beak, and Cat found his ball of wool right next to a daisy.
plan.morale: Patience and help can solve problems.

cat.text:
Micio was a very happy teddy bear kitten. He lived in the Flower Garden, a place full of colors and smells. Micio loved his nest, a soft den under a big apple tree. He had lots of toys, but his favorite toy was special. It was yellow and fluffy, perfect for making little purrs.

One day, Micio noticed that his feather was gone. He looked everywhere, under the red roses, between the white daisies, but nothing! He couldn’t find his place in the nest. He was very sad and a little confused. He needed to put the feather there, near his nose, to feel better.

Micio made a decision. He said, “I’ll follow my ears!” His ears were big and white, and Micio thought they might lead him to the lost feather. He moved slowly, following the movement of his ears. He jumped onto a lavender bush, climbed onto a wooden bench, and then...

Under a big yellow flower, his feather was shining! Micio ran to get it. He quickly brought it back to his nest and put it down carefully. He was happy! The nest seemed even cozier now that the feather was there. A ladybug sat on the nest and watched him.

Micio curled up and made little purrs. Everything was perfect. Micio’s patience had done good for him.

plan.problema: Whiskers has lost his favorite feather and can't find his place in the nest.
