plan.svolta: He decided to follow his ears, hoping they would lead him to where he had left the feather.
plan.finale: He found the feather under a yellow flower and happily brought it back to his nest.

cat.text:
Cat was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers. The garden was a special place, with lots of bushes and tall trees. Cat loved to play there, rolling on the cool grass.

---

One day, Cat was playing with his favorite ball of wool. It was red and soft, perfect for making a ball! But then, while hopping among the roses, he got lost. He couldn't see the ball of wool anymore. "Oh no!" meowed Cat. “Where did I put it?”

---

Cat started to look everywhere. He climbed onto a bush, but it was too low. Then he tried to run between the plants, but the secret garden was big and full of different directions.

---

So, Cat decided to climb onto the big tree in the garden. It was a very strong tree! But as he made his way through the branches, he slipped down! He couldn't catch the ball of wool. It had fallen into a puddle near the tree.

---

Cat was very sad. Then, a ray of sunshine hit something red under a bush. It was his ball of wool! Cat jumped towards the bush and got it back. He held it tight in his paws. "I've got it!" meowed happily.

---

A little bird was singing near Cat, while he snuggled under a flower. The secret garden was joyful again for the teddy bear. He was happy to have found his ball of wool.

plan.problema: Cat got lost among the roses and couldn't find her favorite ball of wool.
plan.svolta: She decided to climb the big tree, but she slipped down without being able to catch the wool.
plan.finale: A ray of sunshine lit up the ball of wool that had fallen under a bush, and Cat recovered it happily.

cat.text:
Cat was a very happy teddy bear kitten. He lived in the Flower Garden and loved to play among the colorful flowers. He had a favorite wool ball, bright red, that he always kept with him. One day, while he was hopping, the wind blew his wool ball away! Cat chased it across the tall meadow, a meadow full of tall grass and fragrant flowers.

He was lost! The meadow was so big and the flowers were so many that he couldn't find his red wool ball anymore. He was very worried. He looked everywhere, but the wool ball was hidden in the grass.

Cat decided to crawl under the big leaves to see if the wool ball was hiding there. But it was too dark and tight! Cat felt even more confused and scared. He didn't know what to do.

Suddenly, he heard a “crock… crock” coming from the pond near the fountain. He saw a little green crocodile that lived there. “Help!” cried Cat. “I’ve lost my red wool ball!” The crocodile came closer and with his gentle snout he dug through the leaves.

In just a moment, he found the red wool ball right next to the fountain! Cat was so happy that he hopped with joy. He thanked the crocodile a thousand times. From that day on, Cat continued to play in the Flower Garden and every time he got lost, he remembered to look patiently and determinedly. Perseverance can lead to great discoveries.

plan.problema: Cat got lost in the tall meadow and couldn't find his favorite ball of yarn anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to crawl under the leaves, but it was too dark and he felt even more confused.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of the crocodile who lived in the pond, he found his ball of yarn near the fountain.

cat.text:
Cat was a soft, cream-colored teddy bear. He loved to play in the Flower Garden. It was his favorite place in the world. Today, however, Cat had gotten lost. He had wandered among the fragrant roses and tall plants, but he couldn’t find his way home anymore. 

The rose maze seemed endless. The green leaves surrounded him everywhere. Cat meowed, trying to figure out where he had ended up. He was a little scared. He couldn’t hear the sounds of the garden anymore. Only the strong scent of the roses.

Cat realized he was very far from his favorite corner under the big cherry tree. He sat down on a rock and thought. “I need to do something,” thought Cat. Then, he took a deep breath and meowed loudly, loudly, loudly! 

A red sparrow with sparkling eyes landed on a branch nearby. The sparrow listened to Cat and flew towards him. “What do you want, little cat?” asked the sparrow. 

Cat explained that he was lost. The sparrow, kind, said: “I’ll take you back!” And so, the sparrow flew in front of Cat, showing him the way. 

After a while, they finally arrived at his favorite corner under the big cherry tree. Cat snuggled there, happy and tired. He curled up on himself and closed his eyes. He was so happy to be back home. Cat knew that asking for help could lead to great surprises.

plan.problema: Cat got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his way home.
plan.svolta: He decided to call for help, meowing loudly to attract a pigeon's attention.
plan.finale: The pigeon led him to his favorite corner under the big cherry tree, where he rested happily.
plan.morale: Asking for help is always a good idea.

cavallo.text:
Ronaldo was a wooden horse. He lived in the Flowery Meadow, a place full of colors and smells. He was a strong and sturdy horse, with a red mane and a pair of blue eyes that shone in the sun. But Ronaldo felt lonely. No one wanted to ride him. The flowers passed by him without stopping. The butterflies flew away, too busy dancing among the petals.

Ronaldo sighed. “I wish I had a friend,” he said, but no one listened. He spent his days watching the meadow and wishing he could play with someone. He was very sad.

Then, Ronaldo had an idea! He decided to have a party. He called all the butterflies in the Flowery Meadow. He said, “Come everyone! There will be flower sweets and music!” And he invited the most beautiful flowers too. The tulips, the daisies, the roses… Everyone arrived at the meadow.

The queen of the butterflies, a monarch butterfly named Luna, joined the party. They danced and laughed together. Ronaldo galloped happily around the meadow, while Luna tickled him with her wings. It was the best thing Ronaldo had ever felt.

Ronaldo realized that friendship was a precious gift. Everyone was happy together in the Flowery Meadow. The air was full of laughter and music. And Ronaldo, the lonely horse, had finally found many friends.

plan.problema: Ronaldo felt very lonely because nobody wanted to ride him.
plan.svolta: He decided to organize a party for all the objects in the meadow, inviting the butterflies and flowers.
plan.finale: Everyone danced and laughed together, and Ronaldo realized that friendship is a precious gift.

cavallo.text:
Ramiro was a wooden horse. He lived in the Flowery Meadow, a meadow full of colorful flowers and soft grass. Ramiro loved the meadow, but he felt lonely. No one wanted to ride him. The other toys were always more popular: the dolls danced, the soldiers fought, but no one sat on him.

Ramiro sighed. “How boring,” he thought. He gave up on staying still, watching the sun warm the meadow. He wanted someone to play with, someone to make him gallop happily.

Then Ramiro made a decision. “I’ll take a big walk around the meadow!” he exclaimed. He moved his hoof, starting to run quickly among the flowers. He tried to attract someone’s attention, anyone’s. He ran back and forth, trying to look fun.

Suddenly, a little white rabbit came out from behind a red rose. The rabbit looked at Ramiro and then started to hop behind him. He hopped happily, following the horse that was running.

Ramiro felt immediately lighter. He was happy! He had a friend to play with. He hopped along with the rabbit, running among the flowers of the Flowery Meadow. It was the best thing he had ever felt. 

The sun was setting, coloring the meadow pink and orange. Ramiro and the little rabbit continued to hop together, happy and friends forever. Friendship comes from meeting, thought Ramiro as he was lulled by the wind of the Flowery Meadow.

plan.problema: Ramiro felt lonely because no one wanted to ride him.
plan.svolta: He decided to take a big tour around the meadow, hoping to attract someone's attention.
plan.finale: A little rabbit ran towards him and started hopping behind him, making Ramiro very happy.

cavallo.text:
Rocco was a wooden horse. A beautiful brown horse with a red mane and a pair of moving eyes. He lived in the Flowery Meadow, a meadow full of yellow, pink, and blue flowers. Rocco loved the Flowery Meadow. Especially, Rocco loved his friend, Pipì, a soft and fluffy felt rabbit.

One day, while playing among the flowers, Rocco got lost. He had wandered too far from the meadow and couldn't find Pipì anymore. “Oh no!” said Rocco. “Pipì! Where are you?” he shouted, but no one answered. It was all silent, only the scent of the flowers.

Rocco felt very sad. He didn't know what to do. Then, an idea popped into his head. He decided to run as fast as he could, jumping over the colorful flowers. He jumped over the white daisies, slid through the red tulips, and passed by the blue violets. He hoped to see the rabbit from far away.

Rocco ran and ran. He got a little tired, but he didn't give up. He continued to jump and run, pushed by his friendship for Pipì. Suddenly, he heard a little “qua qua”. Rocco slowed down and looked around. He saw the rabbit waiting for him under a big sunflower. Pipì hopped happily, ready to hug his friend. Rocco went to Pipì and the two friends returned to the Flowery Meadow. Rocco realized that he would never give up on finding his friend. And this made him very happy.

plan.problema: Rocco had gotten lost and couldn't find his friend, a stuffed bunny.
plan.svolta: He decided to run as fast as he could, jumping over the colorful flowers, hoping to see the bunny from far away.
plan.finale: Finally, he heard a little “qua qua” and saw the bunny waiting for him under a big sunflower.

cavallo.text:
Rocco was a stuffed horse, soft and brown. He lived in the Flower Meadow, a place full of red roses and yellow sunflowers. Rocco loved the meadow, but lately he felt very sad. Nobody wanted to play with him. The other toys in the meadow ignored him. Even the butterflies flew around other things, never coming near Rocco.

Rocco sighed. “I wish I had a friend,” he said quietly. He huddled under a big sunflower and felt even more alone. A little ladybug, Lila, passed by and looked at him curiously. “Why are you so sad, Rocco?” asked Lila with her squeaky voice.

Rocco explained his problem. Lila listened carefully. Then she had an idea! “Let’s have a party!” exclaimed Lila. Rocco got excited. He started jumping and running back and forth, inviting everyone in the meadow to join. He collected colorful pebbles to offer as pretend candies.

Soon, the Flower Meadow was filled with colors and laughter. The bees buzzed around Rocco as he kept jumping. The flowers leaned towards him, happy to join the party. Some butterflies even joined the fun. Everyone wanted to play with Rocco!

Rocco smiled for the first time in a long time. The meadow was full of friends. The ladybug Lila winked at him. Rocco realized that being kind and inviting others to have fun was the best thing in the world. And so, the Flower Meadow became even happier thanks to Rocco’s party.

plan.problema: Rocco felt sad because no one wanted to play with him.
plan.svolta: He decided to organize a party for all the friends in the meadow, offering fake candies and doing jumps.
plan.finale: All the flowers and butterflies joined Rocco’s party, and he finally smiled.

cavallo.text:
Rondina was a wooden horse. He lived in the Flowery Meadow, full of daisies and clover. Rondina loved to run among the flowers, but today he felt lonely. “I wish I had a friend,” thought Rondina.

Suddenly, Rondina saw Gnome Sugar sitting under a big tree. Sugar was his best friend, but he had disappeared! Rondina started to gallop in circles, trying to find him. “Sugar! Sugar!” cried Rondina, but nobody answered.

Rondina felt more and more sad. He turned around again and again. He was tired of searching without success. Then he had an idea: “Maybe Sugar is near the stream!” He ran towards the sound of the water flowing between the stones.

He followed the sound of the stream for a while. Finally, he saw Sugar sitting on a big rock, watching the water. “Rondina! Here I am!” shouted Sugar happily.

The two friends hugged and played together until the sun began to set. They played hide-and-seek among the flowers and even had a picnic with some daisies. Rondina was so happy to have found Sugar again. 

When the sky became dark, Rondina snuggled next to his friend gnome. Rondina’s persistence had made all the difference. And he knew that friendship is a precious treasure to be protected always.

plan.problema: Robin got lost and couldn't find his friend, gnome Sugar.
plan.svolta: After turning around many times, Robin decided to follow the sound of the stream to see if he found him.
plan.finale: Robin found Sugar sitting on a stone, and the two friends played together until sunset.

cavallo.text:
Destiny was a wooden horse. He lived in a flowery meadow full of colors and smells. He was a beautiful rocking horse, with a bright red mane and sturdy legs. But Destiny felt lonely. No one wanted to ride him. The other toys in the meadow were always busy, but nobody seemed interested in him.

“I wish I could play,” Destiny thought, watching the butterflies fluttering around the flowers. “I wish I had someone to run and jump with.”

One day, Destiny made a decision. “I’m going to make a big jump!” he exclaimed. He focused and jumped into the air, trying to get the children’s attention. But the jump was clumsy. Destiny landed on his face on a prickly bush.

“Oh no!” he cried, in pain. The thorns irritated his skin. He felt even lonelier and sadder. Suddenly, he heard a little song. A little bird had made its nest in his red mane. The bird was singing a happy and sweet song.

Destiny felt much better right away. He started to move his head and legs, as if he were dancing with the bird. The bird perched on his mane again and continued to sing to him. Destiny was happy! He was finally surrounded by friendship. 

The bird chirped louder and louder, and Destiny realized that even just a small kind gesture could bring so much joy.

plan.problema: Destiny felt lonely because no one wanted to ride him.
plan.svolta: He decided to make a big jump in the air to get attention, but he landed clumsily on a bush.
plan.finale: A little bird perched on his mane and began to sing to him, making him immediately happy.

cavallo.text:
Rocco was a little horse, a little faded from the sun of the Flowery Meadow. He had a red mane and a pair of eyes that seemed to smile all the time. But Rocco felt lonely. Many children passed near the meadow, looked at the flowers and then ran away, never turning to him. “Nobody wants to play with me,” Rocco thought, clutching his wooden legs tightly.

The Flowery Meadow was full of colors and scents. The white daisies danced in the light wind and the sunflowers followed the sun. But Rocco didn’t see anything beautiful. He was sad and quiet. He spent his hours watching the other animals in the meadow, but nobody greeted him or invited him to play.

One day, Rocco made a decision. “I’ll take a long gallop,” he said to himself. “Maybe someone will see me and want to run with me.” And so, Rocco began to gallop around the meadow, as fast as he could. He ran among the flowers, trying to attract someone’s attention.

Suddenly, a colorful butterfly, a beautiful rainbow of colors, landed on his red mane. “Let’s dance!” exclaimed the butterfly. Rocco stopped and began to move with the butterfly among the flowers of the Flowery Meadow. He was so happy! He wasn’t lonely anymore.

The butterfly and Rocco danced all afternoon, laughing and having fun together. Rocco realized that friendship is born when you share a moment of joy with someone. And Rocco felt included, finally happy in the Flowery Meadow.

plan.problema: Rocco felt lonely because no one wanted to play with him.
plan.svolta: He decided to take a long gallop around the meadow, hoping to meet someone to share his joy with.
plan.finale: He met a colorful butterfly that invited him to dance among the flowers, and Rocco felt happy and included.

cavallo.text:
Rocky was a very special palomino horse. He lived in the Flowery Meadow, a meadow full of daisies and sunflowers. Rocky could move on his own, jump, and run, just like real horses. Every day he loved to play among the flowers.

One morning, Rocky noticed that something wasn't right. His favorite blanket, a soft star-shaped cushion, was gone! He had lost it among the fragrant daisies. Rocky was very sad. Without his blanket, the meadow seemed less beautiful.

Rocky thought he had to do something. He decided to use his powerful nose. He closed his eyes and took a deep breath. He was looking for the smell of the soft, fluffy fabric of his blanket. He followed the scent, moving among the tall, fragrant daisies.

The scent led him to the center of the meadow. Then, suddenly, he smelled something even stronger! It was under a big sunflower, the tallest sunflower of all in the Flowery Meadow. There was his blanket, curled up and happily sleeping.

Rocky ran to it and picked it up with his hooves. He put the blanket on him and relaxed on the meadow. He was so happy! Rocky realized that he shouldn't give up when he was looking for something important. After so much patience, he had found what he liked most. 

Rocky slept peacefully under the sunflower, knowing that perseverance can lead to great satisfaction.

plan.problema: Rocky had lost his favorite plushie among the daisies.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his powerful nose to follow the scent of the soft, fluffy fabric.
plan.finale: Finally, he found the plushie under a large sunflower, peacefully sleeping.

cavallo.text:
Rondina was a wooden horse. He lived in a meadow full of colorful flowers. It was a beautiful and fragrant meadow. Rondina loved to be there, watching the butterflies. But lately Rondina didn't feel happy. He couldn't shine anymore. His coat, once shiny and white like snow, had become dull.

“Oh no!” said Rondina. “I’ve lost my sparkle! I can’t be beautiful anymore.” He sat on the meadow, sad. A ladybug passed by, looked at him and said, "Maybe if you move, you’ll find your light again!"

Rondina thought about what the ladybug said. He decided to do something. He started to prance with all his legs. He jumped forward and backward in the flowered meadow, trying to feel happier. He jumped over the tulips, around the daisies, among the fragrant roses.

Suddenly, a ray of sunshine hit his coat. The sun was warm and bright. Rondina felt much better right away. His coat began to shine! It was like before, shiny and white like snow.

Rondina stopped prancing and smiled. He realized he didn’t need to find something outside of himself to be happy. Happiness was already inside him. Rondina continued to stay in the flowered meadow, radiant and content.

plan.problema: The robin had lost his sparkle and couldn't shine anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to hop with all his legs, hoping that joy would bring him back.
plan.finale: A ray of sunshine hit his fur, making him radiant as before.

cavallo.text:
Ramiro was a wooden horse. He was very strong and had a bright red mane.
He lived in the Flowery Meadow, a place full of yellow, blue, and brown flowers.
Ramiro loved to run among the flowers, but sometimes he had too much fun.

One day, while galloping quickly, he realized he couldn't hear his home anymore.
It was the giant tree, the biggest in the meadow, where he often lay down to rest.
Ramiro was lost! He couldn't understand where he had gone.

“Help!” shouted Ramiro, but the wind was blowing strongly. His words were carried away and he couldn't hear anything anymore.
He kept running, more and more disoriented. “Ramiro, stop!” said a little squirrel who was watching him from a branch.
But Ramiro hadn't heard him.

He decided to try shouting even louder. “Hello! Giant tree! It’s me!” But the wind continued to blow and his words were lost in the meadow.
Ramiro was getting sadder and sadder.

Then, he smelled a sweet scent. It was the scent of wildflowers growing near the meadow.
Ramiro followed that scent, step by step. The scent was leading him towards something familiar.

And then, there he was! The giant tree stood before him, big and strong.
Ramiro jumped down from the ground and ran towards his friend tree.
He lay down in its shade, happy to be back home. 

Ramiro learned that, even when things seem difficult, waiting a little while and following your senses can help you find the right way.

plan.problema: Ramiro had lost himself in the meadow and couldn't find his house anymore, a giant tree.
plan.svolta: He decided to call out loudly, but the wind carried away his words and he continued to get lost.
plan.finale: Ramiro followed the scent of wildflowers, which finally led him to the giant tree.
plan.morale: Patience helps to find your way.

cerbiatto.text:
Cerbiatto Leo was in the Flowery Meadow. The meadow was full of red roses, yellow tulips, and bluebells. Leo loved to play there, but this time he had wandered too far from his mama. Now he couldn't see her anymore!

“Mama?” called Leo, with his sweet voice. But nobody answered. The meadow seemed enormous and the flowers were so many that they all looked the same. Little Deer Leo felt a little scared. He didn't know where his mama was.

He turned from side to side, trying to understand what he had done. He looked among the white daisies and among the red poppies, but it was all the same. “Maybe if I follow the brightest path I can find her,” thought Little Deer Leo. The sun shone on a small path made of tall grass, and Leo began to walk along that path.

As he moved, he saw a red ladybug flying around a rose. The ladybug looked at him and then flew away. Little Deer Leo continued to follow the bright path. After a while, he heard a familiar sound: the voice of his mama calling him.

“Leo! Leo!” shouted mama. Little Deer Leo ran as fast as he could, and finally he saw his mama running towards him with a happy smile. He was so happy to see her again. Mama stroked his soft fur.

Little Deer Leo hugged his mama tight. He had learned an important lesson: when you get lost, you must be patient and follow the light. Now he knew that waiting calmly always helps you find what you love.

plan.problema: Leo got lost from his mom and can’t find her in the flower-filled meadow.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the brightest path, hoping it would lead him to his mom.
plan.finale: Finally, Leo saw his mom running towards him with a happy smile.
plan.morale: Patience helps you find your way.

cerbiatto.text:
Cerbiatto Leo loved the Flowery Forest. It was a forest full of colorful and fragrant flowers. Every day, Leo explored the paths between the red roses, the blue violets, and the yellow daisies. One day, while running and jumping among the flowers, he realized he couldn't hear his mother's voice anymore.

Everything was so beautiful and fragrant that Little Deer Leo had gotten lost! He turned around and around, but he couldn't recognize anything. The petals of the flowers reached his little feet. “Mommy?” he called, but only the wind answered with a gentle rustle among the leaves. He was scared and a little sad.

Little Deer Leo decided to do something. He heard a distant sound: the water flowing. “Maybe that sound will lead me home,” he thought. He started to move his little hooves following the sound, crossing thyme bushes and weeping willows.

A little squirrel, named Cloud, saw him running and asked him what he was doing. Little Deer Leo explained his situation, and Cloud encouraged him to follow the stream. “Follow the water, it will guide you!” Cloud said.

Little Deer Leo followed the stream, hopping happily. After a while, the stream led him right to the meadow where his mother was waiting for him with a big hug. He was so happy to see her! Little Deer Leo hugged his mother tightly, feeling finally safe. The sun was shining, and the flowers smelled even more intensely. Little Deer Leo realized that even when you get lost, if you never stop looking, you always find your way back home.

plan.problema: Leo got lost among the fragrant flowers and couldn't find his mom anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the sound of the stream, hoping it would lead him home.
plan.finale: The stream led him right to the meadow where his mom was waiting for him with a big hug.
plan.morale: Follow your tracks and don't give up.

cerbiatto.text:
Cerbiatto Leo was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in the Flowery Meadow, a meadow full of yellow daisies and red roses. He had lots of brother deer, all just like him. They spent their days playing together, hopping among the flowers.

One day, Cerbiatto Leo had wandered too far. He was trying to chase a blue butterfly, but when he looked back, his brothers were gone. He was all alone and a little scared. “Brothers! Brothers!” he shouted, but nobody answered. His voice was too small to be heard among so many flowers.

Cerbiatto Leo sat down on a small lavender bush. He tried to figure out what to do. Then he had an idea! He started to hop. He hopped quickly, following the scent of the most fragrant flowers. The scent was sweet and strong, coming from a corner of the meadow.

Hopping faster and faster, Cerbiatto Leo smelled an even stronger scent: the scent of his mommy deer. He followed that scent until he saw his brothers waiting for him under a big sunflower. They hugged each other happily. Mommy deer gave him a little kiss on the nose.

Cerbiatto Leo felt safe and happy again. He understood that even when you get lost, if you don’t give up, you always find your way back home. And so, Cerbiatto Leo hopped happily with his brothers in the Flowery Meadow.

plan.problema: Leo got lost from his brothers and couldn’t find them in the meadow.
plan.svolta: He tried to call them, but nobody answered and his voice was too small to be heard.
plan.finale: Then he started to hop happily, following the scent of the most fragrant flowers until he found his brothers who were waiting for him.

cerbiatto.text:
Deer Leo loved to play in the Flowery Meadow. It was a meadow full of yellow marigolds, red tulips, and white bellflowers. Leo was a soft and fluffy deer, with big black eyes and a small horn. He liked to jump among the flowers and make new friends.

One day, while he was playing, Deer Leo wandered too far from his mom. The colors of the flowers were so beautiful! Leo chased after a blue butterfly, then a red ladybug. When he finally realized he was alone, he realized he was lost. His mom deer was no longer in sight.

Leo was scared. The meadow seemed very big now. He tried to call his mom, but his little horn couldn't make much noise. He saw a bee buzzing around a sunflower. The bee was very active and ran from flower to flower. Deer Leo thought, “Maybe the bee will take me to my mom!”

So, Deer Leo followed the buzzing of the bee. He hopped among the flowers, trying to keep the bee in front of him. The bee flew higher and higher and then came back to buzz near a rose bush.

Finally, he heard a familiar voice: “Leo! Where are you?” Deer Leo ran towards the sound and saw his mom deer waiting for him with eyes full of joy. They hugged tightly. It was wonderful to see her again.

Deer Leo snuggled next to his mom, happy to be home.

plan.problema: Leo got lost from his mom in the meadow full of colorful flowers.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the buzzing of the bees, hoping they would lead him to his family.
plan.finale: The buzzing led him right to his mommy deer, happy to hug him again.
plan.morale: Follow the instructions of the older ones.

cerbiatto.text:
Deer Leo was a soft, fluffy deer. He lived in the Flowery Meadow, a place full of yellow daisies, red roses, and white bellflowers. He had lots of brothers and sisters deer, and they loved to play together running among the flowers.

One day, Leo had wandered too far from his little brothers and sisters. He was lost! The meadow seemed enormous and the flowers were so many that he couldn't see them anymore. “Mommy? Daddy?” he called, but no one answered. He was all alone and a little scared.

Deer Leo sat down on a big leaf, thinking. He didn't know what to do. Then he had an idea! He heard a light sound: “Bzzzz… bzzzz…” were the bees flying around the flowers. “Maybe they can help me,” thought Deer Leo.

He decided to follow the buzzing of the bees. He moved among the flowers, trying to stay close to the noise. The bees were flying further and further, towards a corner of the meadow. Deer Leo ran following the bees, with all his strength.

Finally, he heard a familiar moo: “Leo! Leo!” It was his brother Pipolo! Running towards the sound, he found his brothers and sisters, happy to see him again. They all hugged and played together, under the warm sunshine of the Flowery Meadow. Deer Leo was happy to be home. 
It had been a long day, but in the end, he had found the right way.

plan.problema: Leo got lost from his brothers and couldn't find them in the meadow full of flowers.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the buzzing of the bees, thinking they might have shown him the way to his little brothers.
plan.finale: Finally, he heard a familiar moo and ran towards the sound, finding his brothers happy to see him.

cerbiatto.text:
Cerbiatto Leo was a very lively fawn. He lived in the Flowery Meadow, a place full of yellow and green marigolds. Leo loved to play there with his mommy fawn. One day, they were playing hide-and-seek. Leo had so much fun that he ran among the marigolds, trying to find the perfect place to hide.

Suddenly, he realized he was lost! His mommy wasn’t nearby anymore. Fawn Leo was all alone, and a little bit scared. The marigolds all looked the same now. He looked for his mommy, but he couldn’t find her.

Fawn Leo decided to call for help. He ran quickly towards the stream that flowed through the meadow. He knew that the old owl lived at the top of the tree near the stream and often heard his voice. “Owl, Owl! I’m lost!” cried Fawn Leo.

The owl smiled with his big eyes. “Don’t worry, little fawn,” said the owl. “I’ll guide you home.” The owl flew gently over the meadow, pointing the way to Fawn Leo.

Finally, Fawn Leo saw his mommy fawn! She was there waiting for him, with her eyes full of joy. Mommy fawn ran to hug Fawn Leo, making him feel safe and happy. Fawn Leo realized that calling for help had made all the difference.

plan.problema: Leo got lost from his mom while playing hide-and-seek among the daisies.
plan.svolta: He decided to call for help, running towards the stream where he heard the voice of the old owl.
plan.finale: The owl gently guided him to his mommy deer who was waiting for him with a happy hug.

cerbiatto.text:
Deer Leo was a soft and fluffy deer. He lived in the Flowery Meadow, a meadow full of yellow daisies and golden stars. Leo loved to run among the flowers, but sometimes he had too much fun! One day, while chasing a blue butterfly, he realized he couldn't hear his mommy's voice anymore.

“Mommy?” called Leo, but he didn’t get a reply. He turned around and saw only the flowery meadow around him. It was all the same, and he was lost! His little legs were shaking a little. He didn’t know what to do. He was scared and he wanted his mommy so much.

Deer Leo decided to do something. He thought, “Maybe the stream can help me!” The Flowery Meadow had a small stream that flowed between the rocks. Deer Leo started to run towards the stream, following the sound of the water gurgling.

He walked and walked, passing some tall ferns and a friendly green frog that was jumping on the grass. The stream carried him further and further. Finally, after a while, Deer Leo saw something familiar: the Flowery Meadow! And there, right in the center of the meadow, was his mommy deer, with a big smile on her face.

Mommy Leo ran to hug him. She was so happy to see him again. Deer Leo hugged his mommy tight and realized that sometimes, trusting your instincts is the best thing to do. Mommy was waiting for him, knowing that he would come back.

plan.problema: Leo had lost his mom and didn’t know how to find her.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the sound of the stream, hoping it would lead him to his family.
plan.finale: The stream led him right to the meadow where his mom was waiting for him with a big smile.
plan.morale: Follow your instincts and never give up.

cerbiatto.text:
Cerbiatto Leo was in the Flowery Meadow. The meadow was full of white and yellow daisies, pink clover, and bright green grass. Leo loved to play there, running among the flowers and jumping on the lawns. But today something wasn’t right. Leo had lost his daddy deer.

“Daddy?” called Leo, but his voice was lost in the light wind. He looked everywhere, looking between the red roses and the yellow sunflowers, but his daddy wasn’t there anymore. Leo was sad and a little scared. He didn’t know where he was and how to find him.

A little blue bird landed on a flower near Leo. It was chirping a happy and inviting melody. Cerbiatto Leo had an idea. “Maybe,” he thought, “the bird knows where my daddy is!”

So, Cerbiatto Leo began to follow the bird’s singing. The bird flew back and forth, guiding him through the meadow. Leo ran quickly, following the sound of the singing. It was a little difficult, because the meadow was full of flowers and trees.

Finally, the bird landed on a bush near his daddy deer. “Daddy!” shouted Leo happily. The daddy deer ran to hug Leo. He was so happy to see him! Cerbiatto Leo felt safe and happy. 

They snuggled together under the warm sun, smiling. Leo understood that sometimes, trusting your instincts is the best thing to do.

plan.problema: Leo had lost his dad and didn’t know how to find him anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the song of a little bird, hoping it would lead him to his dad.
plan.finale: The bird’s song led him directly to his dad, a happy deer, glad to be reunited.
plan.morale: Follow your instincts and don’t give up.

cerbiatto.text:
Cerbiatto Leo was happy in the Flowery Meadow. The meadow was full of yellow and red flowers, green and soft grass. Cerbiatto Leo loved to run among the flowers. One day, a colorful butterfly, blue and gold, flew in front of him. Leo was excited and started to chase it. Running, running, he got further and further away from his daddy deer.

Cerbiatto Leo’s daddy was there waiting for him, with tall and gentle antlers. But Cerbiatto Leo couldn’t see him anymore. He felt lonely and a little scared. The meadow seemed big and the warm sun made him dizzy.

Desperate, Cerbiatto Leo started to call his daddy with a soft moo. “Daddy! Daddy!” but nobody answered. Only the wind blew through the flowers. Cerbiatto Leo sat down on the grass and started to cry quietly.

Then, he heard a sound: the water of a stream flowing nearby. Cerbiatto Leo followed the noise with attentive ears. He moved slowly, trying to understand where it led. The stream was cheerful and sang a sweet melody.

Finally, Cerbiatto Leo saw between his daddy deer’s protective antlers. “Daddy!” he shouted happily and ran towards him. Daddy hugged him with his head. Cerbiatto Leo felt safe. 

Now he was close to his daddy, among the fragrant flowers. It had been a little moment of fear, but in the end, the sound of the stream had helped Cerbiatto Leo find his way back.

plan.problema: Leo got lost from his fawn dad while chasing a colorful butterfly.
plan.svolta: Desperate, Leo started calling his dad with a faint moo, but no one answered.
plan.finale: Then, hearing the sound of a stream, Leo followed the noise and found himself between his dad’s protective horns.
plan.morale: Patience helps to find the way.

cerbiatto.text:
Deer Leo was a very cuddly deer. He lived in the Flowery Meadow, a meadow full of white and yellow daisies. Leo loved to run among the daisies, jump and play with his insect friends. One day, while he was playing, Leo wandered too far from his mommy deer. He found himself alone, surrounded by so many, so many daisies!

“Mommy?” called Leo, but his voice was small and got lost in the wind. He tried to go back, but every daisy looked exactly like the other. He was very scared. He couldn’t find his mommy deer. He felt sad and a little lost.

Leo thought for a moment. He saw a little stream flowing among the daisies. “Maybe the stream will take me towards Mommy,” he thought. So, Deer Leo began to follow the sound of the water. He hopped and ran, following the stream with his eyes.

The stream carried him further and further. Then, suddenly, Leo saw a big deer, with a white and soft coat. It was his mommy! Deer Leo ran to her, happy to be reunited with her. His mommy deer hugged him tightly.

“I looked for you everywhere!” said the mommy deer. Deer Leo felt safe and happy. It was so nice to be found after a little confusion. The flowery meadow seemed even more beautiful when he was next to his mommy.

plan.problema: Leo got lost from his mom and can’t find her among the thousand daisies.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the sound of the stream, hoping it would lead him to his mom.
plan.finale: The stream brought him right next to his mom deer, happy to reunite with her.

delfino.text:
Delfino Blu was a very happy rubber dolphin. He lived in the Joyful Pool, a pool full of colorful water games. He loved to play with the spiral slides and the water jets that sprayed. One day, while taking a fast spin, Delfino Blu found himself in a strange place. He was in the water game maze!

The walls were tall and full of green reeds. Delfino Blu swam up and down, but he couldn't find the exit. He tried to turn to the right, then to the left. He tried to go straight, but every time he ended up in the same place. He was a little sad.

Suddenly, he saw a very cute red fish. The fish was called Rosso and he was floating near him. “Hello!” said Rosso. “Why are you so worried?” asked Delfino Blu. “I’m lost in the maze!” replied the dolphin.

Rosso smiled. “Don’t worry,” he said. “I know how to get out of here! Follow the blue waves, they always go towards the sun.” Delfino Blu followed the blue waves and, after a while, he finally saw the sunlight. He was happy! He found himself near the yellow sponge he loved so much.

Delfino Blu thanked Rosso for his help. Then, he lay down on the edge of the pool, smiling at the warm sun. Rosso’s patience had helped Delfino Blu to find his way. And now, the dolphin could go back to playing in the Joyful Pool.

plan.problema: Blue Dolphin is lost in the water play maze!
plan.svolta: He tried to swim in all directions, but every time he ended up in the same place.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a friendly red fish, he found the way out and found himself in the sun.

delfino.text:
Delfino Blu was a bright blue dolphin toy. He lived in the Blue Pool, a big pool full of water. Delfino Blu loved to play there, jumping and making bubbles. Sometimes he made friends with the floating water lilies that moved slowly on the surface of the water.

One day, while Delfino Blu was running as fast as he could, he found himself in a strange place. He was near a whirlpool! The whirlpool was strong and it sucked him in. Delfino Blu was spinning faster and faster. He was scared! He couldn’t understand how to get out.

He tried to swim backwards, but the whirlpool made him spin even faster. Delfino Blu felt desperate. He tried to stay calm, but it was hard when he was spinning without stopping. A little orange fish, Poldo, watched him curiously.

Then, Delfino Blu had an idea! He focused all his strength and, with a big flick of his tail, he hit the water with all his might. A wave of force spread out and Delfino Blu plunged into calm waters. He was out of the whirlpool!

Delfino Blu swam happily towards the edge of the Blue Pool. Poldo greeted him with a wiggle. Delfino Blu realized that even when things seem difficult, if you believe in it really and don’t give up, you can always find a solution.

plan.problema: Blue Dolphin is lost in the whirlpool of the pool!
plan.svolta: He tried to swim backwards, but the whirlpool made him spin faster and faster.
plan.finale: With a big fin stroke, Blue Dolphin hit the water with force and dove back into calm waters!

delfino.text:
Delfino Blu lived in the Silent Lake. He was a toy dolphin, made of shiny blue plastic and always ready for an adventure. One day, Delfino Blu decided to explore the shores of the lake. He went up to a tangle of water lilies, thinking it would be a lovely trip.

But then, he got trapped! The water lilies were very tall and all the same. It was as if the lake had created a maze around him. Delfino Blu couldn’t find his way out anymore. He spun around and around, but he only saw white and green water lilies.

“Oh no!” thought Delfino Blu. “I’m lost!” He tried to swim to the right, then to the left, but every time he ended up in another tangle of water lilies. He was tired and a little scared.

Then, Delfino Blu had an idea. He had a small sound device built into his body. He activated it and started to make special sounds. The sonar helped him understand where he was in relation to the other water lilies. He made a map with his sounds!

Delfino Blu carefully followed his sound map, swimming calmly and concentrating. Every sound guided him to a precise point in the maze. Finally, after so much searching, he saw a ray of sunshine! Delfino Blu came out of the water lily maze, happy and relieved. The sun warmed his back.

Delfino Blu realized that even when things seem difficult, if you try to find a solution, you always succeed.

plan.problema: Blue Dolphin is lost in the maze of water lilies and can’t find his way out.
plan.svolta: He tried to swim in all directions, but only found more water lilies, so he decided to use his sonar to make a map.
plan.finale: Blue Dolphin followed his sonic map and finally came out of the maze, finding the sun.

delfino.text:
Delfino Blu was a very happy rubber dolphin. He lived in the Blue Pool, a big, blue pool with lots of water plants. Delfino Blu loved to play there, swim, and make new friends. His best friend was Pinno, a little goldfish who lived among the water lilies.

One day, while they were playing hide-and-seek among the reeds, Delfino Blu got lost! He found himself surrounded by green reeds and floating plants. He couldn’t find Pinno anymore. “Pinno? Pinno!” he shouted, but nobody answered. He was very worried.

Delfino Blu started swimming frantically in all directions. He looked behind every plant, under every stone. But Pinno wasn’t there! He felt sadder and more impatient. Then, suddenly, Delfino Blu had a brilliant idea.

He started spraying water with force, creating giant bubbles that floated towards the surface. The bubbles were bright and shone in the sun. Pinno, who was exploring a big lotus leaf, saw the bubbles. “What are these things?” he asked himself.

The bubbles led him to Delfino Blu! Pinno swam quickly towards the dolphin and the two friends hugged happily. They found each other right away and continued to play in the Blue Pool, making even more bubbles together. It was nice to be friends again. 
Delfino Blu realized that even when things seem difficult, a little patience and a little creativity can make a difference.

plan.problema: Blue Dolphin got lost among the many water plants and can’t find his fish friend anymore!
plan.svolta: After swimming frantically in all directions, Blue Dolphin had an idea: he started making giant bubbles to attract the fish’s attention!
plan.finale: The fish, seeing the bright bubbles, came to find him right away and they became good friends again.

delfino.text:
Dolphin Blue was a bright, shiny blue rubber dolphin. He lived in the Sunny Pool, where the sun sparkled on the water. Every day he played among the water plants and admired the little fish that jumped out. One afternoon, while floating peacefully, something strange happened.

Dolphin Blue found himself surrounded by lots of colorful building blocks! They were stacked in a row, forming a confusing maze. He didn't understand how he’d gotten in there. It was all new and a little scary.

At first, Dolphin Blue tried to swim quickly, trying to find a way out. He turned right, then left, forwards and backwards. But every time he got even more confused! The building blocks seemed to move and the maze became more and more complicated.

Then, Dolphin Blue thought, “Maybe I need to do something different.” He slowed down his swimming, becoming quiet like a fish. He started to follow the sunlight that shone on the surface of the water.

Slowly, calmly and patiently, Dolphin Blue went around the maze. The sun guided him. After a long time, he saw an opening! A small glimpse of blue sky. And then, finally, he came out of the colorful building block maze, back into the Sunny Pool.

Dolphin Blue settled on his favorite platform, watching the sun warm the water. He was happy and pleased to have found the right way. Patience can lead to amazing results.

plan.problema: Blue Dolphin is lost in the colorful building block maze!
plan.svolta: He tried to swim fast in all directions, but only made more confusion.
plan.finale: Then, he decided to take a slow and quiet tour, following the sun shining on the surface of the water, and finally, he came out of the maze!

delfino.text:
Delfino Blu was a very happy dolphin. He lived in the Blue Pool and loved to play with bubbles. One day, while jumping between the floating plants, he found himself alone. He didn’t see his friend Fishy anymore.

“Oh no!” said Delfino Blu. “Fishy? Where are you?” He swam in all directions, but the floating plants were many and confusing. Delfino Blu felt a little scared. He looked for Fishy everywhere, but he couldn’t find him.

He tried to ask the green algae for help, but the algae didn’t answer. He tried to call Fishy, but his voice was too weak to be heard in the water. Delfino Blu decided to swim faster. He swam and swam, trying to figure out where his friend had gone.

Suddenly, he saw a waterfall of water falling on one side of the pool. Delfino Blu approached carefully and tried to swim under the waterfall. He went through a small secret passage! 

There, among the giant bubbles, was Fishy. He was having fun making the bubbles float into the air. “Delfino Blu!” shouted Fishy happily. The two friends said hello with a big hug. 

Delfino Blu and Fishy spent the rest of the day playing together in the Blue Pool. Delfino Blu had learned that even when things seem difficult, continuing to look for the solution is always a good idea.

plan.problema: Blue Dolphin is lost among the floating plants and can't find his little fish friend.
plan.svolta: Trying to swim faster, he discovered a secret passage under a waterfall.
plan.finale: Reaching the waterfall, he found Little Fish playing with bubbles and they said hello happily.

delfino.text:
Delfino Blu lived in the Joyful Pool. He was a bright blue rubber dolphin and he loved to play in the water. Delfino Blu liked to wobble, make spirals, and jump. One day, while he was playing, he swam too far from the shore. The big water game was so vast!

Delfino Blu looked for his friend, Shrimp Red. Rosso loved to hide among the floating plants. But Rosso wasn't anywhere. Delfino Blu swam up and down, but he couldn't find him. “Rosso? Rosso, where are you?” he shouted. Nobody answered.

Delfino Blu felt frustrated. He started making big swirls in the water. He was trying to get Rosso’s attention with his rotations. But the scared fish swam away, ignoring his need. Delfino Blu stopped, tired and a little sad.

Then he thought of something different. He made a gentle sound, like a sweet gurgle. “Gurgle… gurgle…” he repeated. The gurgle was the sound he made when he tried to communicate with Rosso. 

After a while, he heard a little “tap tap” and he saw Rosso following him. The shrimp, curious about the gurgle, swam up to Delfino Blu. Together they swam towards the shore of the Joyful Pool, happy to be back together. 

Delfino Blu realized that waiting for the right moment and using a calm approach can help to solve problems. Sometimes, a little gurgle is more effective than a big swirl.

plan.problema: Blue Dolphin got lost in the big water game and can’t find his little shrimp friend.
plan.svolta: Frustrated, Blue Dolphin started making big whirlpools in the water to get attention, but it only scared the fish.
plan.finale: Finally, using a gentle sound like a gurgle, he convinced the shrimp to follow him and they returned together to the pool’s edge.

delfino.text:
Delfino Leo loved the Blue Pool. It was his favorite place. Leo was a rubber dolphin, very slippery and happy. Every day he played floating and jumping in the water. But one afternoon, while chasing a giant bubble of soap, he found himself in a new place. It was very, very deep!

Leo couldn't find the surface anymore. The water was dark blue and he couldn't see the sun. He was scared. He tried to swim up, but he quickly realized he was only going deeper and deeper. The current was pulling him! It was like being trapped in a big whirlpool.

He bumped into a smooth, gray rock. He felt sad and a little lost. At some point, he heard a gentle voice: “Hey, little dolphin!” It was Leo’s mom, a sea turtle with a shiny green shell. Leo’s mom swam slowly but calmly.

Leo’s mom gently took him in her strong fins and brought him up. Leo followed his mom, swimming quickly, to the edge of the Blue Pool. Leo’s mom was smiling. Delfino Leo was safe! He was happy to be back home. He had learned that asking for help can lead to rescue.

plan.problema: Leo got lost in the deep of the pool and couldn’t find the surface.
plan.svolta: He decided to swim hard upwards, but he had only gotten caught in the current!
plan.finale: His mom, a kind sea turtle, helped him reach the edge smiling.
plan.morale: Asking for help is always the answer.

delfino.text:
Delfino Blu was a bright blue rubber dolphin. He lived in the Joyful Pool. 
The Joyful Pool was full of water and lots of colorful tiles. 
Delfino Blu loved to swim in it, do flips, and play with the water.

One day, while trying to make a big circle, Delfino Blu noticed something was wrong. He was lost! He turned and turned, but he couldn't find his way. The tiles in the pool all looked the same. “Oh no!” cried Delfino Blu. “I’m lost!”

He tried to go around the pool, but he always ended up in the same place. He was frustrated. He didn’t know what to do. Then he saw a little goldfish swimming near him. "Help!" said Delfino Blu. "I don’t know how to get out of the pool!"

The goldfish, named Nemo, smiled. “Don’t worry,” said Nemo. “Follow me!” And so, Nemo began to swim towards the exit of the pool. Delfino Blu followed him with all his might. After a while, they finally reached the exit!

Delfino Blu took a big, happy dive into the cool, clean water. He was so happy to be back in his Joyful Pool. He felt proud of himself for not giving up.

plan.problema: Blue Dolphin is lost among the tiles of the pool!
plan.svolta: He tried to make a turn around the pool, but he always found himself in the same place.
plan.finale: Thanks to his friend goldfish, he found his way to the exit and made a big happy dive!

delfino.text:
Delfino Blu was a bright blue rubber dolphin. He lived at Peaceful Pond. He loved to swim among the floating water lilies and play with the water. One day, Delfino Blu was having fun weaving through the water lilies. Suddenly, he noticed that he wasn't feeling the sun on his face anymore. The water lilies were everywhere! Delfino Blu was completely lost.

He was surrounded by green and white leaves. He couldn't find his way back to the edge of the pond. He started to swim quickly, hoping to meet someone or something that would help him. But the more he swam, the more confused he felt. The water lilies seemed to be getting more and more numerous and Delfino Blu was getting more and more desperate.

Then, Delfino Blu decided to stop. He closed his eyes and listened carefully. He heard a little song. It was a bird singing among the leaves. The bird was singing regularly, almost as if it were pointing in a direction. Delfino Blu followed the sound of the song. He swam slowly towards the source of the melody.

After a while, Delfino Blu saw the edge of the pond! He was happy and refreshed by the sunshine shining on the water. He found his way thanks to the patience of listening. Delfino Blu lay on the bank, happy to be back home. Calm always helps to find a solution.

plan.problema: Dolphin Blue was lost among the floating lily pads of the lake.
plan.svolta: After swimming frantically for a while, Dolphin Blue decided to stop and listen carefully to the sounds of the water, recognizing the song of a bird that pointed him the way.
plan.finale: Dolphin Blue returned to the edge of the lake, happy and refreshed by the sun.
plan.morale: Patience helps to find the solution.

dinosaur.text:
Rex was a rubber dinosaur, a friendly T-Rex and a little bit clumsy. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of fragrant roses and colorful flowers. Rex loved to explore the garden, but sometimes he got lost among the bushes.

One day, while he was making a big circle, Rex found himself completely lost. The roses were everywhere, tall and fragrant. He couldn't find his place next to the stone fountain anymore. He was sad and a little scared. “Oh no! I’m lost!” Rex roared, but no one answered.

Rex thought he had to do something. He looked around with his dinosaur eyes. He saw many low branches that hid his view. Then he had an idea: he would use his powerful jaws to sweep away those branches! He started to bite and break off the small trees. He swept away the branches with force, trying to see farther.

While Rex was working like that, a little girl was playing in the garden next door. She heard a big roar. She turned around and saw Rex! “Look!” she shouted, recognizing her favorite dinosaur right away. Rex was happy! He was back home. 

The little girl took Rex in her arms and hugged him tight. Rex felt proud of himself. With a little courage and perseverance, he had solved his problem. And Rex understood that even when things seem difficult, you shouldn’t give up ever.

plan.problema: Rex had gotten lost among the roses and couldn’t find his place.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his powerful jaws to sweep away the low branches, hoping to see a little further.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to his roar, a girl saw him and recognized him immediately!

dinosaur.text:
Rex was a plastic dinosaur. He was green and had big feet. He lived in the Rose Garden. He loved that place very much, full of lovely smells. Every day he would sit in his favorite spot under the big tree.

---

One afternoon, Rex was pretending to be asleep. He had curled up near a pot of red roses. When he woke up, he couldn’t see his spot anymore! He was surrounded by pots full of yellow, pink, and white flowers. Rex felt very lonely and scared. He couldn’t find his spot under the tree.

---

Rex tried to shout: “Help! I’m here!” But nobody heard him. Nobody called him. Rex was sad. Then he decided to do something different. He started to move his big feet. “Picnic, picnic, picnic.” He made a funny noise.

---

Finally, the noise attracted the attention of the garden lady. The lady had gray hair and always smiled. She followed the sound and found Rex hidden among the roses. “Oh, Rex! How I’ve been looking for you!” she said. She gently took him and brought him back to his favorite spot under the big tree.

---

Rex settled right down there. He was happy to be home. The lady smiled at him watching. Rex understood that even when things seem difficult, you have to keep trying your best. And in that way, you always find your way back to where you belong.

plan.problema: Rex got lost among the flower pots and couldn't find his place anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to shout, but no one could hear him, so he started to move his paws to make a noise.
plan.finale: Thanks to the sound, the garden lady came to look for him and brought him back to his favorite corner under the big tree.

dinosaur.text:
Rex was a plastic dinosaur, red and strong. He loved to be in the Secret Garden. It was a special place, full of fragrant flowers and tall trees. Rex enjoyed watching the butterflies flying around the roses.

One day, while Rex was exploring a particularly dense area, he got lost. The roses were so beautiful and fragrant that he had followed his nose, stretching among the branches. Now he couldn't find his place in the garden anymore. He was a little scared.

Rex tried to move, trying to reach the tallest trees. He was trying to push the prickly branches of the roses to make space and see better. But every time he did, the leaves fell down! It was frustrating. He couldn't understand how to go back.

Then Rex had an idea. He made a little roar, a dinosaur roar that was strong but gentle. The sound attracted the attention of the gardener, who was pruning the trees. The gardener came closer and saw Rex hidden among the roses. He gently picked him up and took him back to his friends, a blue butterfly.

Rex was happy to be back home. He snuggled next to the butterfly, feeling safe. The gardener smiled and said, "You're a good dinosaur, Rex!" It was important to wait for things to sort themselves out.

plan.problema: Rex had gotten lost among the roses and couldn’t find his way back anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his strength to push the thorny branches, but all he did was make the leaves fall!
plan.finale: Thanks to his little roar, the gardener found him and brought him back among his friends, a blue butterfly.

dinosaur.text:
Rex was a plastic dinosaur, green and strong. He lived in a secret garden full of roses. 
It was a beautiful place, but also a little confusing. 
The roses grew everywhere, forming a big maze. 
Rex loved to explore the garden, but sometimes he got lost.

One day, Rex went into the rose maze and right away he noticed he couldn’t find the way out. 
The trees were tall and the roses were sticking out everywhere. 
It was all red and fragrant, but it only made him more confused. 
Rex tried to run in one direction, then in another, but every time he found himself among the roses.

Rex decided to use his strong legs to push the prickly branches that were blocking his way. 
He tried to make his way through, but when he did, the roses fell to the ground! 
It was frustrating. None of his attempts seemed to work.

Suddenly, Rex smelled a sweet and inviting scent. 
It was the smell of honey coming from a small opening between the roses. 
Rex followed that scent, moving slowly and carefully. 
The honey was leading him to the light.

After a while, Rex finally saw the exit of the secret garden! 
It was a small path surrounded by roses. 
Rex stopped and looked back at the maze. 
He realized that sometimes, to find the way, you have to be patient and follow your senses. 
Patience is the key to solving any problem.

plan.problema: Rex got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his way out.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his strong legs to push the thorny branches, but that only made the roses fall!
plan.finale: Rex followed the sweet scent of honey and finally found the exit of the garden.

dinosaur.text:
Rex was a plastic dinosaur. A green and sturdy dinosaur, with big feet and a powerful snout. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and lush plants. Rex loved to explore the garden, walking among the trees and watching the butterflies.

One day, while playing hide-and-seek among the big red roses, Rex got lost. The roses were so tall and fragrant that they had swallowed him up! He couldn’t find his place near the pond, where he usually was. He was a little scared.

Rex tried to scratch his head with a foot, but it didn’t help. He tried to move forward and backward, but he kept spinning around the roses. Then he had an idea: “Maybe I can use my snout to blow away the leaves that are hiding me!”

Rex started banging his snout against the dry leaves. But instead of blowing them away, he made even more leaves fall! The garden became more and more confused and full of scattered leaves everywhere. Rex felt frustrated.

Suddenly, a bright yellow sunbeam shone through the roses. It lit up Rex’s path and led him straight to the pond. Rex found himself next to the pond, just where he needed to be. He was happy! The old garden gnome smiled seeing him. 

Rex realized that sometimes you have to wait a little while to find the right way. And with calmness and patience, even the most difficult things can be solved.

plan.problema: Rex got lost among the big roses and couldn't find his way back.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his powerful nose to blow away the leaves that were hiding him, but he only made more leaves fall!
plan.finale: Finally, a ray of sunshine lit his way and Rex found himself by the pond.

dinosaur.text:
Rex was a very happy rubber dinosaur. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of strange flowers and plants. Rex especially loved his den among the red roses. It was his favorite place to have a nap.

---

One day, Rex found himself lost. He was trying to get back to his den, but he couldn’t find it. The roses all looked the same! “Oh no!” thought Rex. “I’m lost!”

---

Rex tried to use his big nose to push the lavender bushes. He tried to push hard, but only the roses moved! The roses giggled and turned around, making it even harder to find his den. Rex was a little frustrated.

---

Then, Rex noticed a big red geranium. He approached carefully and began to feel around the ground around the plant. He felt something soft under the leaves. It was a tunnel! Rex crawled in and rolled, rolled, rolled.

---

Finally, the ground stopped being hard and Rex found himself in a cozy den, right among the roses! It was his favorite place. A little squirrel looked at him curiously. Rex settled down comfortably, happy to be home. After a little while, Rex realized that taking it slow and being patient made all the difference.

---

Patience can always help you find what you’re looking for.

plan.problema: Rex got lost and couldn't find his favorite den among the roses.
plan.svolta: He tried to use his nose to push the bushes, but only the roses spun around!
plan.finale: Finally, he discovered a secret tunnel under a big geranium and found himself in his cozy den.

dinosaur.text:
Rex was a very silly rubber dinosaur. He loved to play in the Secret Garden so much. The garden was full of colorful flowers and tall plants. Rex loved to climb everything, but he especially loved his favorite rock. It was a big, smooth rock, perfect for taking breaks.

One day, Rex found himself all alone. He had moved too far and couldn’t find his rock. “Oh no!” thought Rex. He looked everywhere, but nothing. The rock was gone! He was very worried.

Rex tried to shout for help, but nobody heard him. Only the wind was blowing through the leaves of the garden. Then, Rex decided to do something different. He listened carefully and heard a sound: the water flowing in a little stream. “Maybe the rock is near the stream,” thought Rex.

Rex followed the sound of the water. He walked between the plants, pushing past the bushes. Finally, he saw something familiar: his rock! It was right there, under a waterfall of cool water. Rex leaned against the rock and closed his eyes. He felt very happy.

A warm hug of sunshine reached him. Rex rested contentedly. He had found his rock and he had never had such an exciting journey before. The Secret Garden was even more beautiful than usual. Rex knew that, with a little patience, everything can be reached.

plan.problema: Rex got lost and couldn't find his favorite rock.
plan.svolta: He tried to shout for help, but no one heard him, so he decided to follow the sound of the water.
plan.finale: Finally, Rex found his rock and rested contentedly in the sun.

dinosaur.text:
Rex was a green and strong dinosaur. He had strong legs and a long tail. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Rex loved to spend time with the other toys: the soldiers, the dolls, and the stuffed animals.

One day, Rex found himself among the roses. They were so fragrant and big! He was lost. He couldn’t find his place in the pile of toys. He was alone, a little scared. He tried to move, but the roses made him climb and he fell down.

Rex decided to take a walk. He explored every corner of the garden. He saw a red ladybug flying around a sunflower. He talked to the ladybug, but she didn’t know where the pile of toys was. Rex kept walking, looking under the leaves and behind the bushes.

Then, he heard a sound. It was a little bell that Rex had attached to his tail. The bell tinkled slowly. Rex followed the sound and ran happily towards his friends. He found his place in the pile of toys and everyone hugged him.

Rex was happy to be back with everyone. He felt strong and safe. After a while, he fell asleep, dreaming of new adventures in the Secret Garden. Perseverance, even when things seem difficult, can lead to wonderful results.

plan.problema: Rex got lost among the roses and couldn't find his place in the pile of toys.
plan.svolta: He decided to take a walk, exploring every corner of the garden to look for clues.
plan.finale: He found his place thanks to the sound of the bell he had attached to his tail and ran happily towards his friends.

dinosaur.text:
Rex was a green and sturdy dinosaur. He loved his secret garden very much. It was his favorite place to be. One day, Rex was right in the middle of a flowery meadow. He was trying to jump, but he tripped over a fragrant red rose. He found himself surrounded by red and white roses. The roses were big and tall, bigger than him!

Rex couldn’t find his way out. He was lost among the roses. He was looking for his favorite corner under the old tree, but it wasn’t there. He felt a little sad. He tried to shout for help, but his voice was too weak to be heard. Nobody heard him.

Rex sat down on a fallen leaf and thought. He thought maybe someone would find him. But time passed and he remained lost among the roses. Suddenly, he heard a small noise. A little squirrel with a bushy tail was watching Rex.

“Hey, you! Why are you so sad?” asked the squirrel. Rex explained that he was lost. The squirrel smiled and said, “I’ll follow you!” And he did. Running among the plants, the squirrel led Rex to the old tree.

Rex followed the squirrel and they finally arrived at his favorite corner under the tree. It was perfect! He felt very happy to be back home. The squirrel waved goodbye with a nod of his head and ran away. Rex settled down there, happy to be back in his place. Persistence had brought him back.

plan.problema: Rex got lost among the roses and couldn't find his place.
plan.svolta: He tried to shout, but his voice was too weak to be heard.
plan.finale: A little squirrel led him to his favorite corner under the old tree.

dinosaur.text:
Rex was a green plastic dinosaur. He loved to play in the Flower Garden very much. It was a place full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Rex loved to run among the daisies and hide behind the rose bushes.

---

One day, while he was playing pretend to be a giant, Rex got lost. He couldn’t find his little wooden house, where he kept his stuffed animals. He was a little scared. “Help! Where am I?” Rex shouted, but nobody answered. Only the wind was blowing through the leaves of the trees.

---

Rex felt very sad and confused. He looked everywhere, under the roses, behind the tulip stems, but nothing. He couldn’t find his little house. Then, Rex had an idea. He heard a distant sound: the sound of water flowing.

---

Rex followed the sound of the stream. He walked quickly, passing between the fragrant plants. The stream led him to a point further into the garden. And then, there it was! Right in front of him was his little wooden house, with the door slightly open.

---

Rex ran happily towards the house and climbed inside. He was so happy to be safe again. The little gnome who lived in the house smiled at Rex. 

---

Rex realized that, even when things seem difficult, you have to keep looking patiently and determinedly. And in the end, perseverance always leads to the solution.

plan.problema: Rex got lost and couldn't find his wooden house.
plan.svolta: He tried to shout, but no one could hear him, so he started to follow the sound of the stream.
plan.finale: The stream led him right in front of his house, happy and pleased!

dog.text:
Buddy was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in the Flower Garden, a place full of colors and smells. He loved to run among the flowerbeds, but especially he loved his red ball. It was his favorite! One day, while he was playing, the ball rolled away, hidden among the many rose bushes.

Buddy noticed right away that it was missing. He started to look everywhere. He looked behind the daisies, sniffed the tulips, but the ball wasn’t there. “Oh no!” thought Buddy. “Where did you go?” He was very sad. The Flower Garden suddenly seemed like a scary place without his ball.

Buddy decided to try to find the ball on his own. He sniffed every rose, looking for the smell of his friend. But nothing! Then he had an idea: he would dig with his paws. He dug and dug, but he only found wet earth and a few broken pieces of pottery. He was tired and frustrated.

Suddenly he heard a small sound: “Chip-chip!” It was Ricciolino, the hedgehog of the garden. Ricciolino saw Buddy so sad and asked him what had happened. Buddy explained his adventure. Ricciolino thought for a moment and then said: “I’ll help you look for it!” Together, they searched under a big rose bush and… there it was! The red ball lay among the leaves.

Buddy jumped happily and ran to Ricciolino. He hugged him tightly. He was so happy to be back in his place in the Flower Garden. Buddy realized that, even when you lose something, having a friend to help you makes everything easier. Buddy and Ricciolino remained friends forever, ready to share many more adventures.

plan.problema: Buddy lost his favorite ball among the roses!
plan.svolta: After smelling every rose, Buddy decided to dig with his paws, but he only found dirt and some shards.
plan.finale: His friend hedgehog helped him find the ball under a bush, happy to be back in its place.

dog.text:
Rex was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in the Flower Garden, among the tulips and daisies. He spent his days rolling in the cool grass and puffing when the wind blew. He had a favorite red ball, a soft ball full of air.

One day, Rex played with his ball in the Flower Garden. He threw it up, very high! Then, running after it, he noticed that the ball wasn’t there anymore. It had disappeared into the big field that surrounded the garden. Rex started to run frantically, but he couldn’t find his red ball.

It was so big! Rex felt a little sad and confused. “Oh no!” thought Rex. “Where did my ball go?” He decided to do something. He stopped and said: "I have to sniff every corner. Maybe I can recognize the smell of my red ball."

Rex began to walk slowly, sniffing the grass, the flowers, and the trees. He sniffed under the rose bush, near the pond with the water lilies, and behind the fountain. The sun shone brightly in the sky. Mrs. Emilia, who took care of the garden, came up to Rex. “Hello Rex, are you looking for something?” asked Mrs. Emilia. Rex sniffed again and then, there it was! The red ball was hidden under a rose bush, just where Rex had decided to look.

Rex ran happily towards his ball. He was so happy to have found it thanks to his amazing nose. Rex snuggled up with his red ball and fell asleep peacefully in the Flower Garden. Perseverance can lead you to find even the most hidden things.

plan.problema: Rex got lost in the big field and can’t find his favorite ball.
plan.svolta: He decided to sniff every corner, hoping to recognize the smell of his red ball.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to his amazing sense of smell, he found the ball hidden under a rose bush!

dog.text:
Rex was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in the Flower Garden, among the fragrant roses and colorful flowers. Rex loved the garden, especially his bright red ball. The ball was his favorite!

---

One day, Rex was playing with his ball. He threw it far away and then ran to catch it. But this time, something went wrong. Rex chased the ball too far and found himself in a maze of roses. It was all red and fragrant, but he couldn't find his way back anymore.

---

Rex was very worried. He started to walk among the roses, trying to figure out where he had ended up. He tried to wag his tail at every rose, hoping someone would help him. But only the butterflies looked at him curiously and flew away. 

---

“Oh no,” thought Rex, “I don’t know what to do!” Then he decided to sniff the air. He sniffed the scent of the roses, then the scent of the yellow flowers. Nothing. Then, just when he was about to lose hope, he sniffed a secret path among the lavender bushes.

---

The path was narrow and full of lavender scent. Rex followed the path and, suddenly, he saw something bright! It was his bright red ball! Rex was so happy. He brought the ball back to its place in the garden and settled down under a yellow flower. 

---

Rex realized that even when things seem difficult, you shouldn’t give up. And with patience, you always find the right solution.

plan.problema: Rex got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his favorite ball.
plan.svolta: He tried to wag his tail towards each rose, but only the butterflies looked at him curiously.
plan.finale: Eventually, he sniffed a secret path between the lavender bushes and found his shiny ball!

dog.text:
Buddy was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in the Flower Garden and loved to play among the colorful flowers. He had a favorite red ball, his greatest joy. One day, while running happily, the ball ended up in the tall grass. Buddy looked everywhere, but the ball was gone! He was really sad.

“Oh no!” said Buddy, lowering his nose. “I have to find it! It’s so red and soft.” He looked around in the Flower Garden, among the fragrant roses and tall sunflowers. He was looking for the ball, but it was too difficult to find.

Buddy started to dig frantically. He pulled up dirt, leaves, and small stones. But the more he dug, the more the ladybugs came closer, flying around him in a swirl of colors. Buddy got scared and stopped digging. The ladybugs continued to buzz, creating even more confusion.

Suddenly, Buddy heard a sound: “Bzzz… bzzz…” It was the buzzing of the bees collecting nectar from the flowers. Buddy followed the sound and noticed something under a rose bush. There was his red ball!

Buddy picked it up with his paws and hugged it tightly. He calmed down, smiling happily. He had found his ball thanks to patience and the help of the buzzing of the bees. Buddy realized that sometimes, to solve a problem, you just have to slow down and look carefully.

plan.problema: Buddy lost his favorite ball among the tall flowers.
plan.svolta: He started to dig frantically, but ended up scaring the ladybugs flying around.
plan.finale: He calmed down and, following the buzz of the bees, found the ball under a rose bush.

dog.text:
Buddy was a very silly teddy bear. He had long, soft ears and a smile always on his face. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Buddy loved to play there, but today he felt a little sad.

“Oh no,” said Buddy, with his voice a little rough. “I’ve lost my red ball! It was my favorite!” He started running from one side of the garden to the other, sniffing every corner. He looked for it among the yellow marigolds and under the big apple tree. But the red ball wasn’t there.

Buddy was very worried. He sat down next to a small pond and slumped down. A blue butterfly landed on his nose for a moment, then flew away. Buddy kept looking, but without success.

Then he had an idea! “Maybe it fell under the ground,” he thought. With great care, Buddy started to dig in the soil near the rose bush. He dug and dug, making little holes everywhere. The earth was warm and damp on his plush fur.

Finally, after a little while, he felt something under his paws. It was his red ball! Buddy pulled it out with joy. He started happily bringing it back home, running among the flowers of the Secret Garden. Buddy realized that finding what you’ve lost takes a little patience and perseverance.

plan.problema: Buddy got lost and couldn't find his favorite ball.
plan.svolta: After sniffing every corner, Buddy decided to dig in the dirt hoping to find his lost toy.
plan.finale: Finally, under a rose bush, Buddy found his ball and started happily bringing it back home.
plan.morale: Patience is important for finding what you're looking for.

dog.text:
Rex was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in Grandma Rosa’s garden. Grandma Rosa loved him and always gave him lots of cuddles. Rex loved to run between the plants and sniff the fragrant flowers. He had a favorite red ball, his most special ball.

One day, while he was playing, Rex threw the ball. The ball flew high and landed among Grandma Rosa’s roses. It was a place full of many beautiful and fragrant roses. Rex ran to look for the ball, but it was hidden! The roses were tall and dense, and the red ball got mixed up with the petals.

Rex looked everywhere. He dug through the leaves, sniffed every rose, but he couldn’t find his ball. It was too small to see well. Rex started to get angry. He didn’t want to give up his favorite ball!

Then Rex had an idea. He started to dig with his paws. He dug and dug, making a little hole in the ground. The dirt flew everywhere! After a lot of digging, finally, Rex found his red ball! It was buried right under a big white rose.

Rex let out a happy bark! With a little bit of strength, he pulled out the ball and started to roll it happily around Grandma Rosa’s garden. Grandma Rosa watched him smiling. Rex was so happy to have found his ball again. He had learned that even when things seem difficult, with a little bit of patience, you can find a solution.

plan.problema: Rex lost his favorite ball among the roses!
plan.svolta: He looked everywhere, but the ball was too small to be seen; then he started digging with his paws.
plan.finale: Finally, with a joyful bark, Rex brought the ball out of the hole and rolled it happily!

dog.text:
Rex was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in the Secret Garden, a special place full of flowers and tall trees. Rex loved to run among the plants, but especially he loved his red ball. It was a soft and perfect ball for throwing.

One day, Rex noticed that his ball was gone! He started to look everywhere. He looked under the big apple tree, inside the yellow rose bush, and behind the wooden bench. “Where are you?” Rex barked, but no one answered.

Rex also tried to sniff every corner of the garden. He used his nose to follow the smell of the ball, but his nose didn’t seem to understand where it was. He felt a little sad and frustrated. A little ladybug, Lila, was watching him closely. “Maybe it’s hidden?” he asked Rex.
