Rex continued to look, getting slower and slower. He sat down to think, then he got up and started to turn around the big red rose that grew near the path. Suddenly, a ray of sunshine hit the red ball! It was hidden right under the rose, covered by a leaf.

Rex ran to his ball and picked it up with his paws. He hugged it tight. He was so happy to have found it again. Rex understood that sometimes, even when you are frustrated, you have to keep looking calmly. 

Rex went back to playing in the Secret Garden, happy with his ball and pleased with his little success. With patience, even lost things can be found.

plan.problema: Rex has lost his favorite ball and doesn't know where to look.
plan.svolta: He tried to sniff every corner, but his nose doesn't seem to understand where it is.
plan.finale: Suddenly, a ray of sunshine hit the hidden ball under a red rose!

dog.text:
Buddy was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in the Flower Garden, a place full of colors and smells. He loved to run among the flowers and play with the butterflies. His favorite ball, a bright red one, was his most beloved toy.

One day, Buddy threw the ball far into the tall grass. He wanted to get it back right away, but the ball disappeared! Buddy looked everywhere, under the tulip stems and behind the roses. But the ball was no longer there. He was just very sad.

“I have to find it!” thought Buddy. So he decided to dig with his paws in the grass. He dug and dug, but he only found himself full of dirt! His paws were dirty and his fur was sticky. He couldn’t find the ball.

Suddenly, he heard a chirping sound. A little sparrow, named Pippo, landed near Buddy. “What’s happening?” Pippo asked. Buddy explained that he had lost his red ball. Pippo flew high and looked at the grass. Then, he returned to Buddy and pointed with a flap of his wings to a lavender bush.

Buddy went to the bush and... there was his ball! He got it back happily and hugged it tight. “Thank you, Pippo!” said Buddy. Pippo replied: "It doesn't matter, friend!"

Buddy learned that even when things seem difficult, with a little patience you can always find a solution. The sun shone on the Flower Garden and Buddy continued to play happily.

plan.problema: Buddy can’t find his favorite ball in the tall grass.
plan.svolta: He decided to dig with his paws, but he only ended up full of dirt!
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a friendly sparrow, Buddy spotted the ball under a bush.

dog.text:
Buddy was a teddy bear, soft and honey-colored. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of fragrant roses and hidden corners. Buddy loved to run among the bushes, but sometimes he had too much fun.

One day, while chasing a blue butterfly, Buddy found himself in a maze of red and pink roses. It was beautiful, but also very confusing. He couldn’t find his way out! “Oh no!” thought Buddy, with his ears drooping. “I’m lost!”

Buddy tried to run forward, then backward, but every time he found himself back among the roses. He was a little sad and a little scared. A little squirrel, Pipì, looked at him curiously. “What are you doing here, Buddy?” asked Pipì.

Buddy decided to do something different. He closed his eyes and began to sniff every flower. He smelled the sweet scent of jasmine, the intense aroma of the red rose, the fresh scent of lavender. He hoped to smell the warm sunshine and the fresh air of the house.

Suddenly, Buddy heard a sound: a little bird singing a cheerful melody. He followed the song with his ears up, and suddenly, he saw a hidden gate among the plants! It was the secret gate of the Secret Garden.

Buddy ran towards the gate and came out of the maze of roses. He returned to the garden, happy and content. Buddy learned that even when you get lost, you must be patient and look carefully. Patience is the key to always finding the right way.

plan.problema: Buddy got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his way out.
plan.svolta: He decided to smell every flower, hoping to smell the scent of the sun and home.
plan.finale: Finally, following the sound of a bird singing, he found the hidden gate and returned to the garden.

dog.text:
Rex was a very happy teddy bear. He loved to play in the playground. He was always ready to snuggle under the swings or roll down the slides. One day, Rex had too much fun. Running after a red ball, he found himself in a strange place. He was inside a maze of swings and slides!

Rex couldn’t find his way out anymore. The swings banged, the slides creaked, and children laughed around him. Rex tried to bark, but no one could hear him among all the laughter. He tried to jump, but he got tangled in a string of a tent.

Rex was sad. He sat down near a slide and started to whimper. But the noise of the playground was too loud. No one could hear him! Rex felt really alone.

Then, Rex had an idea. He snuggled up and started to push against the wood of one of the swings. And surprisingly, he discovered that under the swing there was a secret tunnel! Rex ran into it. The tunnel was dark and narrow, but Rex didn’t give up.

Finally, he came out right next to Pippo the balloon, a friendly yellow balloon who was playing with the other children. Rex was happy to be back in the right place. 

Rex understood that even when things seem difficult, if you don’t give up, you always find a solution.

plan.problema: Rex got lost in the maze of swings and slides.
plan.svolta: He tried to whine, but no one could hear him over the noise of the children’s laughter.
plan.finale: Then he discovered a secret tunnel under the swing and came out right next to his friend, Pippo the balloon.

dragon.text:
Drago Verde was a very special teddy bear dragon. He lived in the Flower Garden, among red roses and yellow tulips. He loved the garden just as much as his favorite flower, a white daisy with a bright yellow heart. One day, while playing to roll on the grass, Drago Verde found himself lost in the tall meadow. It was much taller than him and he couldn’t see where he’d gone.

“Oh no!” said Drago Verde. “I can’t find my daisy! It’s my favorite flower.” He wiggled, trying to figure out how to go back. He tried to fly, opening his green fabric wings, but the wind was too strong. It pushed him away, far from the garden. Drago Verde kept getting higher and higher and couldn’t stop himself.

“Maybe I should walk,” he thought. So he began to move his little rubber feet, one step at a time, trying to follow the sweet smell that smelled like daisy. The wind continued to blow, but Drago Verde didn’t give up. He used his sniffing nose to smell the air and look for that special scent.

Finally, after so much walking, a beautiful yellow flower appeared in front of his nose. It was just the white daisy with the yellow heart he was looking for! Drago Verde ran towards it, happy to have found it. He snuggled next to it, content and calm. 

The sun was setting on the Flower Garden, and Drago Verde knew that if he had waited any longer, he would never have found it.

plan.problema: Green Dragon is lost in the tall meadow and cannot find his favorite flower.
plan.svolta: He tried to fly higher, but the wind pushed him too far away, so he decided to walk.
plan.finale: Thanks to his fragrant nose, Green Dragon finally smelled the sweet scent of the flower and approached happily.

dragon.text:
Drago was a very special teddy bear dragon. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and lush plants. It was a quiet place where the sun shone through the leaves. Drago loved his garden so much, but lately he wasn't happy. He had lost his brightest scale, the one that shone like a star.

Drago looked around, searching desperately. “Oh no,” he said with a sad voice. “How will I be happy again without my scale?” He looked under the roses, behind the lavender bush, but nothing. The scale was gone!

He decided he had to ask for help. He went up to the old tree in the garden, the biggest and wisest tree of all. “Mr. Tree,” said Drago, “will you help me? I’ve lost my brightest scale.” The old tree listened patiently. After a while, he whispered: “Follow the stream that flows past the water lilies. There you will find what you’re looking for.”

Drago ran towards the stream. And there, in the cool water and shimmering reflections, he saw his scale! It was sparkling, clean, and new, as if it had just fallen. Drago took it in his paws and smiled. He felt happy again.

The secret garden seemed even more beautiful than before. Drago understood that even when you have a problem, looking calmly and patiently can lead to the right solution. Drago knew that sometimes, waiting a little while makes all the difference.

plan.problema: The Dragon had lost his brightest scale and didn’t know how to be happy again.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the old tree in the garden, hoping it had some advice.
plan.finale: The tree showed him a stream where the Dragon found his sparkling, clean, and new scale.

dragon.text:
Drago Leo was a special toy dragon. He had shiny green scales and golden eyes. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Drago Leo loved to fly, but to do that he needed his sparkling gemstone. The gemstone made him shine even brighter when he zoomed among the flowers.

One day, Drago Leo noticed that the gemstone was missing! It had disappeared while he was playing near the big rose bush. “Oh no!” exclaimed Drago Leo. “I can’t fly without my gemstone!” He looked everywhere: under the white daisies, between the red tulips, but nothing. The gemstone was gone.

Drago Leo was sad and a little worried. He started to look more carefully, he curled up under every leaf and climbed every flower. But the gemstone remained hidden. Then, Drago Leo decided to ask for help. He saw the old garden tree, the biggest and wisest tree of all.

“Mr. Tree,” said Drago Leo, “I’ve lost my gemstone! Could you help me find it?” The tree listened to him patiently. Then, slowly, he moved a branch to point among his roots. And there, right under a big root, was the sparkling gemstone!

Drago Leo took the gemstone and put it in his chest. Immediately, it started to shine even brighter. He took off into the air, happy and grateful. He flew up and down in the secret garden, joyful like never before. Drago Leo understood that even when things seem difficult, looking carefully and patiently always leads to the right solution.

plan.problema: Dragon Leo had lost his sparkling gemstone, the thing that made him fly.
plan.svolta: He started looking under every flower and leaf, but nothing, so he decided to ask for help from the old tree in the garden.
plan.finale: The tree showed him the hidden gemstone among the roots, and Dragon Leo could fly again!

dragon.text:
Drago lived in a secret garden. He was a teddy bear dragon, big and green, with soft wings and blue eyes. He loved to play among the fragrant flowers and under the warm sun. But one day, Drago noticed that something wasn't right. He wasn't shining anymore! His sparkle, what made him so special, was gone.

Drago tried to turn around, to jump, even to flap his wings. Nothing. He had become a grey and dull dragon. He felt sad. A little blue butterfly, Lila, came up to him. “What’s wrong, Drago?” she asked in a gentle voice.

Drago explained his problem: he had lost his sparkle. Lila listened to him carefully, then she had an idea. “Try to sing!” she said. Drago was a little shy, but he decided to try. He began to sing a silly song, a squeaky melody full of exclamations. "Ugh! Ugh! What a brown dragon!" he sang.

The sound of his voice made the air vibrate. The environment around Drago filled with a thousand colorful sparkles. His body began to shine, a rainbow of dancing lights. Drago was shining again! The dragon’s laughter had made the magic.

plan.problema: The Dragon had lost his sparkle and couldn’t shine anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to sing a silly song, hoping that his joy would help him find his brilliance.
plan.finale: The sound of his voice made the air vibrate and suddenly the Dragon filled with a thousand colorful sparkles!

dragon.text:
Drago was a very special teddy dragon. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and lush plants. Drago loved his garden. Every day he enjoyed rolling in the tall grass and hiding among the roses.

One morning, Drago noticed something was wrong. His sparkly scales, which helped him fly, were gone! Drago tried to flap his wings, but he couldn't lift himself off the ground. He was sad and frustrated. “Oh no!” said Drago. “If I don’t have my scales, I can’t fly anymore!”

He decided to ask for help. He went to the most beautiful ladybug in the garden, Coccoroso. Coccoroso knew all the secrets of the secret garden. “Coccoroso,” said Drago, “can you help me? I’ve lost my sparkly scales!”

Coccoroso scratched with his legs and said, "I know where it is! Follow the stream that flows between the trees.” Drago followed Coccoroso. The ladybug guided him through the lavender bushes and past a big red mushroom.

Finally, they arrived at the stream. And there, sparkling in the sunshine, were Drago’s sparkly scales! Drago ran to grab them, and just after, he lifted off into the air. He flew high in the secret garden, happier than ever.

Drago thanked Coccoroso for his help. From that day on, Drago and Coccoroso became great friends and played together every day in their secret garden. It was nice to have a friend to share your adventures with.

plan.problema: The Dragon had lost his sparkling scale and could no longer fly.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the ladybug, who knew all the garden’s secrets.
plan.finale: The ladybug led him to the stream where he found his glittering scale, and the Dragon could finally fly again.

dragon.text:
Drago Verde was a bright green plush dragon. He lived in the Flower Garden, a place full of fragrant roses and colorful flowers. He loved to explore the garden, but sometimes he got lost among the plants.

One day, Drago Verde found himself in the middle of the rose maze. The roses were tall and dense, and he couldn’t find his way back to his little house. He was a little scared. “Oh no!” he exclaimed. “I don’t know where I am anymore!”.

Drago Verde’s little house was cozy and welcoming, full of colorful candies and lots of toys. But the rose maze seemed endless. Drago Verde sat on a bush of red roses and thought about what to do.

Then he had an idea! He saw a path that shone slightly brighter than the rest. It was full of thorns, but Drago Verde decided to follow it. “Maybe it’s the best way to get back,” he said to himself. He pushed himself and kept walking, carefully avoiding the thorns.

After a while, the bright path became clearer and clearer. And suddenly… here it was! Drago Verde’s little house appeared in front of him. It was just like he remembered: small, cozy, and full of candies and toys.

A little squirrel jumped out of the house and said, “Welcome back, Drago Verde!”. The green dragon smiled happily. He had found his way! Drago Verde understood that even when things seem difficult, if you don’t give up, you can always find the solution.

plan.problema: The Green Dragon was lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his little house.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the brightest path, even though it seemed full of thorns!
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to his courage, he found his little house full of sweets and toys.

dragon.text:
Dragon was a very special teddy bear dragon. He lived in a secret garden, full of colorful flowers and tall trees. It was a garden where the sun always shone brightly. Dragon loved that garden just as much as he loved to shine. Usually, his scales were covered in a thousand colors that reflected the sunlight, creating a real magic.

But today something wasn't right. Dragon noticed that he wasn't shining anymore. His scales were gray and dull. “Oh no!” said Dragon. “I’ve lost my sparkle!” He was very sad. He tried to hop, hoping that a jump would help him to find the light, but nothing. His sparkle was still gone.

Dragon sat down on a smooth stone and thought. Then he had an idea! He started to sing a silly song, a song with strange words and a strange rhythm. He sang about fish that flew and clouds shaped like ice cream. But his sparkle didn’t come back.

Suddenly, Dragon felt suddenly happy. He laughed with delight, a big and loud laugh. While he was laughing, he started to spin around the secret garden. And suddenly, his scales started to shine again! A wonderful sparkle covered him in a thousand colors.

Dragon stopped for a moment, then continued to spin happily. The secret garden was even more beautiful with his sparkle. Dragon realized that laughter was the key to finding joy, and with joy, everything shone again.

plan.problema: The dragon had lost his sparkle and couldn't shine anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to hop, but the sparkle was still gone; then he decided to sing a silly song.
plan.finale: The sparkle returned when Dragon laughed out loud and took a lovely turn!

dragon.text:
Dragon was a very special toy dragon. He lived in a secret garden, full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Dragon loved his garden. But today Dragon wasn’t happy. He had lost his shiny scales!

Normally, when the sun shone, Dragon would sparkle like a thousand stars. Now, he was just a gray dragon. “Oh no!” said Dragon, making his plastic wings squeak. “I can’t shine anymore!”

Dragon decided to take a little trip around the garden. He walked between the green leaves and the fragrant flowers. He looked under the trees and behind the roses. But he couldn’t find his shiny scales. None! He was very sad.

A little squirrel, Pipì, saw him sitting on a bush. “What’s wrong, Dragon?” asked Pipì. “Why are you so sad?”

Dragon explained his problem. Together, they explored the garden even more. Then, Dragon heard the fresh air and the sound of water. He followed the noise and found himself in front of a little waterfall. 

And there, under the waterfall, were his shiny scales! They had been washed away by the cool water and ended up there. Dragon picked up the scales in his hand and held them tight. Immediately, he began to sparkle with a thousand colors! He sparkled brighter than ever.

Dragon was happy. He had found his scales and now he could go back to shining in his secret garden. It’s important to look carefully and patiently, because sometimes lost things are found exactly where we least expect them.

plan.problema: Dragon had lost his shiny scales and couldn't shine anymore!
plan.svolta: He decided to take a walk around the garden, looking among the leaves and flowers, but without success.
plan.finale: He found his scales under a waterfall of cool water and picked them up again, shining even brighter.
plan.morale: Patience is the key to the solution.

dragon.text:
Dragon was a very special teddy bear dragon. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Dragon loved that space, he thought it was magical. Every day he played among the roses and snuggled under the big apple tree.

One morning, though, Dragon noticed that something was strange. He couldn't fly anymore! His sparkle, that special light that made him shine, was gone. He was sad and confused. Without his sparkle, he couldn't get up from the ground.

Dragon tried to run, to jump, but nothing. He tried to call the flowers, but they only answered with the wind. Then he met a ladybug who was watching him. “What’s happening?” asked the ladybug. Dragon explained his problem.

Suddenly, Dragon had an idea. He tried to sing a silly song, the one that reminded him of his mother. But the sound was too loud! It scared him and made him shake. His sparkle didn't come back.

Dragon closed his eyes tight-tight. He imagined he was light as a feather, floating in the air. He thought about the wind that tickled the leaves. And, just at that moment, his sparkle returned! It shone brighter than ever.

Dragon flew up into the air, happy and pleased. It was wonderful to be able to fly again. Dragon realized that sometimes, to solve problems, you just need a little bit of imagination. Fantasy can really do miracles.

plan.problema: The Dragon had lost his sparkle and couldn’t fly anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to sing a silly song, but the sound was too loud and it scared him.
plan.finale: Then he simply closed his eyes and imagined he was light as a feather, and his sparkle returned!

dragon.text:
Drago was a teddy bear who was very special. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Drago loved to fly, but he had a sparkly tail that helped him float in the air. This tail sparkled in the sun and made his flights even more beautiful.

One day, Drago noticed that his tail was gone! It was missing in the green meadow. Drago tried to jump, to run, but he couldn't fly. He was very sad. "Oh no!" thought Drago. “If I don’t have my sparkly tail, I can’t fly anymore!”

He decided to ask for help. He went to the butterflies that were dancing in the sun. They were beautiful and light. Drago said, "Butterflies, will you help me? I lost my sparkly tail!" The butterflies listened carefully. Then, Drago had an idea! He offered them a drop of sweet, sticky honey.

The butterflies were very happy and thanked Drago. “We know where your tail is,” said a blue butterfly. “Follow us!” The butterflies flew, and Drago followed them through the secret garden. They arrived at a small, crystal-clear stream. The sparkly tail was shining among the shiny stones.

Drago quickly got it back and attached it to his body again. Immediately, he felt the magic of the tail and lifted off to fly! Drago flew happily around the secret garden. He was so happy to have found his tail again.

plan.problema: Dragon had lost his shimmering scale and could no longer fly.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the butterflies dancing in the sun, offering them a drop of honey in exchange for information.
plan.finale: The butterflies led him to a stream where the shimmering scale shone among the stones, and Dragon retrieved it with joy.

duck.text:
Orello Canary was a cloth duck. He was soft and had a bright yellow beak. Orello lived in a secret garden full of fragrant roses and tall trees. Every day Orello enjoyed exploring the garden with his insect friends.

One afternoon, Orello was running to chase a colorful butterfly. He had run too far from the secret garden gate. Now Orello found himself in a huge meadow, full of red, yellow, and blue flowers. The meadow was very big and Orello couldn’t find his way back.

Orello was scared. He didn’t recognize anything around him. He felt lonely and confused. He tried to go back, but every flower seemed the same as the other. His tummy rumbled and he was very thirsty.

Then Orello had an idea. He started to sing his happiest song, a little “qua qua” repeated many times. The sound of his song spread through the secret garden.

A little squirrel, named Pipistrello, heard Orello’s song. Pipistrello ran towards the sound and found Orello Canary in the meadow full of flowers. Pipistrello led Orello back to the secret garden gate. 

Orello was so happy to be home. He curled up in his favorite spot under a big rose bush. He was glad to be back, and he knew that with a little courage, even the biggest problems can have a happy ending.

plan.problema: Orello got lost in the flower-filled meadow and couldn't find his way home.
plan.svolta: He decided to call for help, singing his happiest song to get attention.
plan.finale: A little squirrel led him to the gate of the secret garden, happy to be home.

duck.text:
Daffodil was a very special duck. He could talk and move all by himself! He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. It was his favorite place in the whole world. One day, Daffodil was happily floating on the water when a strong wind pushed him out of the secret garden.

Daffodil found himself in a big meadow. The meadow was enormous and full of tall grass. Daffodil couldn't find his way back. He was scared! He didn't recognize anything and he couldn't see his little house. Daffodil cried, feeling very lonely.

A little crocodile, Leo, saw him sitting on the grass. “What’s happening?” asked Leo. Daffodil explained that he was lost. Leo thought for a moment and said, “Follow the stream! It always leads home.”

Daffodil followed the stream. It was a long journey and sometimes difficult, but Daffodil didn't give up. He kept going forward, pushed by hope. The stream took him through bushes and stones.

Finally, after so much walking, Daffodil saw something familiar: his little house! It was under a big apple tree, just like he remembered. Daffodil cheered! He jumped happily and waddled into his little house. He was so happy to be home. Daffodil realized that you must never lose hope and keep looking.

plan.problema: The duck got lost in the big meadow and can't find his way home.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the stream, hoping it would lead him to his shelter.
plan.finale: Finally, the duck saw his little house under a big apple tree and cheered!

duck.text:
Duck was a very happy plush duck. He lived in a secret garden, full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. It was his favorite place in the world! Duck loved to be there, watching the bees buzz and the birds sing.

One day, Duck wanted to play with his friend, Daisy. Daisy was a white daisy, sweet and fragrant. But Duck got lost in the tall grass! The grass was very high and Duck couldn't see Daisy anymore. He was a little scared.

Duck looked everywhere. He looked between the red roses and the yellow tulips, but Daisy wasn't there. “Quack! Quack!” shouted Duck, but nobody answered. He was getting more and more worried.

He decided he had to ask for help. Duck made the loudest “Quack! Quack!” he could. The sound was a little strange, but he hoped someone would hear it.

Suddenly, a red ladybug arrived flying. The ladybug listened to Duck and said, “I know where Daisy is! She is among the roses!” The ladybug led Duck through the secret garden, until he saw the white daisy.

Duck ran to hug her. He was so happy to have her back. Daisy smiled and Duck understood that even when you get lost, asking for help can lead to great surprises.

Duck and Daisy stayed together all afternoon, happy to have each other’s friend.

plan.problema: Duck is lost in the tall meadow and can’t find his friends, the daisy.
plan.svolta: He decided to call for help, making the loudest ‘Quack! Quack!’ he could.
plan.finale: Finally, a ladybug helped him find the daisy among the roses.

duck.text:
Duck was a very happy plush duck. He lived in the Flower Garden, among fragrant roses and tall sunflowers. Duck loved to be there, sitting on the cool grass, watching the butterflies. He also had a little mirror that he liked very much to check if his little eyes were clean.

One day, while he was dozing under a bellflower, Duck noticed something: his mirror was gone! He stood up and began to look everywhere. It had fallen into the tall meadow, the one full of tall grass and shy daisies. Duck couldn’t find it. He was very sad.

Duck felt lost and a little scared. He didn’t know what to do to see his reflection again. He sat on the grass, with his feet crossed, and scratched his head with a paw. 

“Quack! Quack!” shouted Duck, loudly, loudly. This was his loudest voice. The sound echoed in the garden.

A little red ladybug, who was eating a piece of berry, listened carefully. The ladybug approached Duck and said, “I heard your ‘Quack! Quack!’”.

The ladybug pointed with an antenna to the edge of the garden. “Look there,” she said. And in the sunlight, Duck’s little eye was shining in the mirror.

Duck ran to the edge of the garden and retrieved his mirror. He was happy! He sat down again under the bellflower and smiled. He always remembered that asking for help is a smart way to solve problems.

plan.problema: The Duck was lost in the tall meadow and couldn't find his mirror.
plan.svolta: He decided to call for help, making a loud 'Quack! Quack!' until a ladybug heard him.
plan.finale: The ladybug pointed the Duck towards the edge of the garden, where his mirror was shining in the sun.
plan.morale: Asking for help is always the answer.

duck.text:
Ocese was a cloth duck, soft and colorful. He lived in a secret garden, full of fragrant flowers and lush plants. It was his favorite place. Ocese loved to walk among the roses, smelling their delicate petals.

 

One day, while exploring a particularly flowery corner, Ocese got lost. The roses were so big and fragrant that they had swallowed him up! He couldn't find his little silver mirror anymore. Ocese loved it very much because it allowed him to see how cute he was.

 

Ocese was worried. He turned around, trying to find his way, but he didn't know where he was. “Quack! Quack!” he shouted loudly, hoping someone would hear him. No one answered. It was all silent and confusing.

 

Suddenly, a little red ladybug stopped to look at him. The ladybug was quick and fast. “What’s wrong, little duckling?” asked the ladybug with a cheerful voice. Ocese explained his problem. The ladybug listened carefully and then said, “Follow me! I know where your mirror is.”

 

The ladybug ran among the plants, and Ocese followed her with difficulty. Finally, under a lavender bush, he saw his mirror! Ocese jumped on it, looking at himself carefully. He was a beautiful duckling, with black eyes and a yellow beak.

 

Ocese smiled. He felt happy to see his beautiful reflection. He realized that even when you get lost, it’s important never to give up.

plan.problema: Ochese got lost among the roses and couldn't find his mirror.
plan.svolta: He decided to call for help, shouting 'Qua! Qua!' loudly until the ladybug guided him.
plan.finale: Ochese finally found his mirror and looked at himself, happy to see his beautiful reflection.

duck.text:
Ducky was a happy duck. He lived in a flowery meadow full of colors and smells. He loved to run among the yellow and red flowers, jump on the green grass, and swim in the little puddles of water. One day, while playing chase with a butterfly, Ducky wandered too far from his favorite spot.

When he realized he was lost, he felt a great panic. The flowery meadow seemed huge and full of tall plants that hid him. He couldn’t find his home anymore, a little corner under a big oak tree. Ducky was very scared.

“Quack quack!” shouted Ducky with all his might. “Quack quack! Help! I’m lost!” But no one answered. Only the wind blew through the flowers. Ducky felt more and more alone and sad.

Suddenly, he heard a sound: “Quack quack? What’s happening?” It was a crocodile named Rocco, who lived near the stream. Rocco was very kind and loved to help friends. He listened carefully to Ducky and encouraged him to keep calling for help.

Ducky continued to say “Quack quack!” louder and louder. Rocco followed the sound to the stream where, finally, he saw his family: his mom, his dad, and his brothers. Ducky ran to them happily.

Rocco smiled at Ducky. “You were very brave to call for help,” said Rocco. Ducky hugged his duck mom. He was happy to be home. Ducky understood that, even when you’re scared, a little bit of courage can make a difference.

plan.problema: The duck got lost in the meadow and couldn't find his way home.
plan.svolta: He decided to call for help, making his usual "quack quack" as loudly as he could.
plan.finale: Luckily, a friendly crocodile led him to the stream where his family was.
plan.morale: Courage helps you find your way back.

duck.text:
Duck was a special duck. He wasn't a regular toy duck. Duck could talk and move in his secret garden. The garden was full of fragrant roses and colorful flowers. It was Duck’s favorite place.

One day, Duck was floating among the red roses. He enjoyed watching the butterflies flying around. But then, he noticed a problem. He couldn't find his mirror anymore! A small silver mirror must have been nearby.

Duck was very worried. He looked among the rose petals, under the green stems, and behind the big leaves. But his mirror wasn’t there. Duck felt a little sad. He didn’t like when he couldn’t find things.

“Quack! Quack!” Duck shouted loudly. “Help! I’m lost!” He shouted even louder, hoping someone would hear him. 

A little red ladybug, named Lila, heard Duck’s cry. Lila flew towards him and said, “What’s wrong, Duck? Why are you shouting?”

Duck explained his situation. Lila, with her sharp sight, followed Duck through the secret garden. Finally, under a bush of white roses, she spotted a shiny mirror. It was his mirror!

Duck ran towards the mirror and looked at himself carefully. He thought he looked very handsome. “Thank you, Lila!” said Duck happily. Duck’s persistence in searching for his mirror led him to success. In the end, everything lost finds its way.

plan.problema: Duck is lost among the roses and cannot find his mirror.
plan.svolta: He decided to call for help, emitting his characteristic quacks to attract attention.
plan.finale: Finally, a kind ladybug led him to his shiny mirror, where he could admire himself with satisfaction.

duck.text:
Ollie was a teddy bear duck, but he wasn't just any duck. Ollie could talk and move around in the Secret Garden. 

The garden was full of colorful flowers, tall trees, and a little sparkling pond. Ollie loved the Secret Garden very much because he felt happy there.

One day, Ollie noticed that something wasn't right. He was lonely, very lonely. He looked for his squirrel friend, Pipo, but Pipo wasn't there. Ollie was worried. He couldn’t find Pipo anywhere in the garden. “Pipo? Pipo where are you?” he shouted, but nobody answered.

Ollie felt sadder and sadder. The Secret Garden seemed like a scary place without his friend. He decided to do something. He had to call for help! He took a deep breath and made the loudest sound he could: “Qua-qua! Qua-qua!”

The sound echoed in the garden, clear as a bell. Suddenly, he heard a noise among the leaves. Pipo ran towards him, happy to see Ollie. The two friends hugged each other tightly, glad to be reunited. 

“Thank you, Ollie! You saved me!” said Pipo with a big smile. Ollie was so happy to have found his friend. He felt even happier than before. The Secret Garden really seemed magical when shared with a friend.

plan.problema: Ollie had gotten lost and couldn't find his squirrel friend, Pipo.
plan.svolta: He decided to call for help, making the loudest sound he knew how: 'Qua-qua! Qua-qua!'
plan.finale: Finally, Pipo heard the sound and ran to meet him for a happy hug.

duck.text:
Duck Pip was a special duck. He wasn't just a rubber toy. Pip could talk and move! 

He lived in a secret garden, full of fragrant roses. It was his favorite place in the whole world.

One day, Pip was exploring the rose maze. The roses were so beautiful and fragrant! Pip had made his way through the branches, following a winding path. Suddenly, he realized he was lost. The rose maze seemed endless. He couldn't find his way out anymore. He was very scared.

Pip quacked loudly, hoping someone would hear him. “Help! Help!” he repeated without stopping. After a while, he heard a gentle voice reply: “Don’t worry, little duckling.” It was Mrs. Emilia, who lived near the secret garden and loved to take care of the roses. Mrs. Emilia knew where Pip was.

Mrs. Emilia guided Pip through the scents of the roses, showing him the right way. Duck Pip followed her words carefully. Finally, after a while, Pip came out of the maze! He was happy to be back home. He snuggled under a warm sun and rested.

Pip thought that even when you feel lost and scared, there are always people willing to help you. Duck Pip felt strong and confident. Hope and help can overcome difficulties.

plan.problema: Pippo had gotten lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his way out.
plan.svolta: He decided to call for help, shouting loudly until he heard a kind voice guiding him through the scents of the roses.
plan.finale: Finally, Pippo came out of the maze and rested under a warm sun, happy to be back home.
plan.morale: Hope and help can overcome difficulties.

duck.text:
Duck was a very happy plush duck. He lived in Zia Rosa’s garden. Zio Rosa had lots of colorful flowers and a big, big lawn. Duck loved to be there, near the fountain.

One day, Duck was floating on the water of the fountain. Suddenly, he found himself very far away. He was in the big lawn! He couldn’t see his mirror anymore. His mirror was a little golden mirror and he loved it very much. He always wanted to look at himself.

Duck got worried. He said, “Help! Help!” But nobody heard him. He tried to call the flowers. “Oh, sunflowers, can you help me?” he asked. “And you, beautiful tulips?” but the flowers didn’t answer. They didn’t listen to him at all.

Duck sat down on a stone. He was sad and a little scared. Then, he noticed something strange. A bright ray of sunshine was shining on the water of the fountain. Duck followed the ray with his eyes.

And there, right in front of him, was his mirror! The little golden mirror was sparkling in the sun. Duck went closer and looked at himself. He was a lovely duck.

Zio Rosa was watching Duck from the window. He was smiling. Duck understood that he didn’t need to hurry. He waited, patiently, and in the end, he found his mirror.

plan.problema: Duck got lost in the big meadow and couldn’t find his mirror.
plan.svolta: He tried to call the flowers, but they didn’t listen.
plan.finale: Then he saw a ray of sunshine shining on the water and found his beautiful mirror again.

elephant.text:
Elephant lived in a secret garden. He was a teddy bear elephant, soft and big. He loved to play among the fragrant roses and colorful flowers. His favorite place was under the giant flower, the one with the dark purple petals. There he always found a cool drop of water that fell when the morning dew wet the petals.

One day, Elephant noticed that the water was gone. He looked everywhere, under the giant flower, behind the leaf waterfall, but nothing. He was very sad. “Where did my water go?” Elephant grumbled.

He tried to push the giant flower to see if the water was hidden inside. But the flower was too heavy! Elephant couldn't even move it an inch. He felt even more lonely and worried.

“Help!” Elephant grumbled with all his might. The sound was loud and clear. Immediately, a little blue bird arrived flying. The bird landed on Elephant’s head and brought him a cool drop of water to his nose.

Elephant drank the water quickly and smiled. The bird also made him lick it, gently cleaning him. Then, the bird flew away, happy to have helped his friend elephant. Elephant realized that sometimes, to solve problems, you have to ask for help from others.

Elephant relaxed under the giant flower, happy and joyful. It was a lovely way to share his joy.

plan.problema: The elephant had lost his favorite water under the giant flower.
plan.svolta: Trying to push the flower, he realized it was too heavy for him.
plan.finale: He called for help with a loud groan, and soon he got cuddles from a little bird who brought him a drop of fresh water.

elephant.text:
Eleanor was a teddy bear elephant, and she was very nice. She lived in a secret garden, full of colorful flowers and lush plants. Eleanor loved her secret garden! Especially, she loved her favorite banana: the yellowest, softest, and sweetest one.

One day, Eleanor noticed that her banana was gone. “Oh no!” she said. “Where did it go?” She started to look everywhere. She looked under the red roses, inside the fragrant lavender bush, and behind the strawberry bush. But the yellow banana was disappeared!

Eleanor felt a little sad. She sat on the green lawn, with her ears drooping. She tried to look under the big tree, where she often put her banana to keep it cool, but the banana was gone and she felt a little sad.

Stumbling upon Rocco, the rubber crocodile who lived in the secret garden, Eleanor explained her problem. Rocco listened carefully and then, patiently, helped Eleanor to look behind a pile of colorful flowers. 

And there, right among the fragrant petals, was her banana! Eleanor took it in her hand and hugged it tight. “Thank you, Rocco!” she exclaimed happily. “You saved my day!”

Rocco smiled. Eleanor realized that sometimes, to find lost things, you just have to wait a little while and look calmly. And so, Eleanor continued to play in her secret garden, knowing that everything will come back to its place if you are patient.

plan.problema: Electro can't find his favorite banana, the yellowest one!
plan.svolta: He tried to look under the big tree, but the banana was gone and he felt a little sad.
plan.finale: His crocodile friend, Rocco, helped him look behind a pile of flowers and there it was his banana!

elephant.text:
Elefante was a very special teddy bear. He lived in a secret garden full of fragrant flowers and tall trees. It was his favorite place in the world. One day, Elefante had so much fun exploring that he went too far into the rose maze.

The roses were so beautiful and fragrant that Elefante didn't notice right away.

When he turned around to go back, he realized he was lost! The secret garden seemed endless with its many red and white roses. Elefante was a little sad. He didn’t know where his home was, his favorite corner under the apple tree.

Elefante decided to use his long trunk to feel every path. He started moving his trunk back and forth, trying to figure out which way would take him out of the maze. But he only kept stumbling over the soft petals of the roses. Every time he fell down, he made a little “bum!”

A blue butterfly, called Stella, flew near Elefante and said, “Don’t give up! Keep looking!” Elefante, with his good mood, didn’t stop moving his trunk. He continued to feel every path, little by little.

Then, suddenly, he heard a small opening between the roses. It was a secret door! Elefante squeezed through the opening and immediately found his favorite corner under the apple tree. He was so happy!

Elefante realized that with a little patience and perseverance, even the biggest problems can be solved. And this made him feel even happier to be a special elephant in his secret garden.

plan.problema: Elephant is lost in the maze of roses and cannot find his way home.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his long trunk to explore every path, but he only found himself stumbling among the petals.
plan.finale: Thanks to his good mood and his patience, he found a small opening that brought him back to his favorite corner under the apple tree.

elephant.text:
Elefante lived in a secret garden. He was a soft cloth elephant, with big eyes and floppy ears. He loved to play among the roses and sunflowers. But today Elephant was worried. He had lost his favorite foot! It was a brown foot, with little toes that he loved to use for walking.

“Oh no!” Elephant exclaimed. “Where have I gone?” He looked everywhere: under the big tree, behind the lavender bush, but the foot wasn’t there. The leaves of the secret garden had all fallen to the ground and were piled everywhere. It looked like a real green carpet.

Elephant thought for a while. Then he had an idea! He used his long trunk to sweep away the leaves. He swept, he swept, he swept, trying to see better. The leaves piled up around him, but Elephant didn’t give up. He kept sweeping patiently.

Finally, under a big colorful flower, he saw something brown! It was his foot! Elephant gently took it and put it back on his tummy. “I did it!” he said happily. 

A little green crocodile, Rocco, was watching him curiously. “Good job, Elephant,” said Rocco. “You showed that you never give up.” 

Elephant smiled. He was happy to have found his favorite foot. He felt good and happy. He had learned that even when things seem difficult, with a little patience, you can find all the solutions.

plan.problema: He can’t find his favorite leg that’s gotten lost among the leaves.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his long trunk to sweep away the leaves and look for the lost leg with more care.
plan.finale: Finally, he found the hidden leg under a big, colorful flower and brought it back to its place happily.

elephant.text:
Elefante was a very special teddy bear. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Elephant loved his garden. Every day he played there all by himself, snuggled among the roses.

---

One afternoon, Elephant noticed that his cuddly friends weren't with him. They were going to have a picnic! But Elephant couldn't find them anywhere. “Oh no!” said Elephant. “Where have my friends gone?”

---

Elephant decided to look for them. He started to walk through the tall grass, trying to follow the cuddly friends’ tracks. Leaves fell onto him and the sun warmed him up. He looked everywhere: behind a lavender bush, under a big daisy.

---

Suddenly, Elephant saw something soft in the grass. He pushed forward and squeezed in further. And there, cuddled up and happy, were his cuddly friends! They were snuggled under a big apple tree, with cookies and fruit juice.

---

The cuddly friends waved hello to Elephant with a big hug. Then they started to eat their cookies. Elephant sat down near them and watched his friends have fun. He was happy to have found them. 

---

Elephant realized that even when the search is difficult, you shouldn’t give up. And so, with a smile, he continued to play with his friends in the secret garden.

plan.problema: He can't find his cuddly friends for their picnic.
plan.svolta: He decides to take a long walk, trying to follow the cuddly friends’ tracks through the tall grass.
plan.finale: Finally, he finds them huddled under a big apple tree, happy and ready to eat.

elephant.text:
Elefante lived in the Flowery Garden. He was a soft cloth elephant, with big button eyes and colorful little feet. He loved to play among the fragrant flowers and dancing butterflies. One day, Elefante noticed something strange. His friend, Ricciolino, wasn't there!

“Oh no!” said Elefante with a little sigh. “Ricciolino has disappeared! I must find him.” He started to look everywhere: under the red roses, among the yellow tulips, near the lavender bush. But Ricciolino wasn't there.

Elefante was very worried. He didn’t know what to do. Then he had an idea! He decided to follow his big ears. Elefante’s ears were long and floppy, perfect for looking far away. He moved back and forth, trying to figure out where Ricciolino could be.

After a while, Elefante realized that his ears were leading him to the center of the garden. He saw a big sunflower that held the sun with its yellow face. And there, hidden among the big petals, was Ricciolino! He was sitting and watching the bees.

Elefante ran to him and hugged him tightly. “I found you!” he exclaimed happily. Ricciolino smiled and the two friends went back to playing together in the Flowery Garden, laughing and joking in the warm sunshine. Elefante realized that even when things seem difficult, you should never give up. And in the end, patience did its magic.

plan.problema: Elephant had lost his friend, the hedgehog, and didn’t know how to find him.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow his big ears, hoping they would lead him to the little hedgehog.
plan.finale: Finally, he found the hedgehog hidden under a big sunflower, and the two friends returned to play together happily.

elephant.text:
Elephant lived in the Flower Garden. He was a cloth elephant, soft and colorful. He loved to be there among the fragrant flowers and dancing butterflies. One day, Elephant noticed something delicious: red strawberries, juicy and inviting, growing on the tallest tree in the garden.

Elephant wanted those strawberries so much! He tried to reach them with his body, but he was too short. The strawberries were too high. Elephant thought, “I must find a way to reach them.”

Suddenly, he had an idea. He prepared to jump, stretching out his little feet and puffing out his chest. He jumped with all his strength! But he lost his balance and fell heavily into the dirt. It was all covered in dust!

Elephant slowly got up. He realized that jumping wasn’t the solution. Then, he tried to take one step at a time, using his trunk to push himself forward. One foot after another, Elephant moved forward calmly and persistently.

Finally, after many small steps, he reached the juicy strawberries! He ate them one after the other, happy and satisfied. A ladybug passed by and waved to Elephant.

Elephant rested a little under the warm sun, happy with his achievement. He realized that even when things seem difficult, with patience and effort, you can achieve anything. And so Elephant continued to live happily in the Flower Garden.

plan.problema: She couldn't reach the highest strawberries on the tree.
plan.svolta: She tried to jump, but she lost her balance and fell into the soil!
plan.finale: She took one step at a time, using her trunk to push forward until she reached the juicy strawberries.

elephant.text:
Elefante lived in a secret garden. He was a teddy bear elephant, soft and big. He loved to play among the tall plants and colorful flowers. Every day, Elefante eagerly waited for his favorite banana.

One afternoon, Elefante sat under a big oak tree. He had just finished his banana, but he didn't have his little box anymore. He looked everywhere. The banana was gone! Elefante was a little bit angry. Where could it have gone?

He looked around. The leaves were green and big, and the sun shone brightly in the sky. He couldn't find his banana among those leaves. “Oh no,” thought Elefante. “I must find it!”

Then he had an idea. Elefante used his long trunk to pick up the leaves. He moved them gently, one by one. He cleaned a small circle around the oak tree. He brushed away the dry leaves and the small branches. 

He continued to clean, slowly, with patience. He didn’t give up. After a while, Elefante’s trunk touched something soft under a big red flower. There it was! His favorite banana was hidden among the roots of the flower.

Elefante jumped for joy. He finally found his banana. He was so happy. He sat down next to the flower and began to eat his sweet banana slowly. Elefante understood that even when something seems lost, with a little patience and attention, there is always a solution.

plan.problema: He can’t find his favorite banana among the leaves.
plan.svolta: He decides to use his long trunk to clean the area and find where it’s hiding.
plan.finale: The banana was under a flower, and Elephant found it very happy.

elephant.text:
Elefante was a soft, blue cloth elephant. He lived in a secret garden full of yellow flowers and red roses. Elephant loved to play among the plants, but one day he noticed a big problem. He had lost all his feet! He couldn’t move anymore, he was stuck in the grass.


He was very sad. He tried to move with his legs, but it didn’t work. He looked under every flower, behind every bush, but the feet were gone. “Oh no!” said Elephant. “How will I go forward?”

Then he had an idea. Elephant was big and he had enormous ears. He decided to use his ears to listen to the wind. He closed his eyes and he concentrated. The wind was blowing lightly, but Elephant heard it. He listened carefully, trying to understand where his feet had gone.

The wind whispered to him: “Follow me… follow the current…” And Elephant followed the wind with his big ears. He walked slowly, but with determination. The wind guided him to a sparkling stream. 

There, among the shiny stones, he saw his feet! They were sparkling like candies, and they were waiting for him patiently. Elephant took them and he started to walk again in the secret garden. He was happy to be able to move again. 

Elephant understood that even when things seem difficult, you should never give up. Perseverance is the key to overcoming every obstacle.

plan.problema: Elephant has lost all his hooves and can’t walk anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his big ears to listen to the wind and find out where the hooves had gone.
plan.finale: The wind led him to a stream where he found his hooves, shiny like candies!

elephant.text:
Elephant lived in a secret garden. He was a soft, cream-colored stuffed elephant, and he loved to play among the roses and flowers. One day, Elephant noticed something strange. “Oh no!” he exclaimed. “I’ve lost all my hooves!” He looked everywhere. He looked under the big lavender bush, but they weren’t there.

Elephant was very sad. He couldn’t walk well without his hooves. The secret garden seemed like a harder place to explore. A little squirrel, Netti, saw him sitting and looking at the ground. “What’s wrong, Elephant?” asked Netti with his squeaky voice.

Elephant explained his problem. “I’ve lost my hooves and I don’t know where they are!” Netti thought for a moment. Then he said, “Maybe you should look among the daisies and under the trees. They might be there.” Elephant followed Netti’s advice. He began to look carefully, moving slowly among the flowers.

Elephant crouched down and looked among the green leaves. Then, under a big apple tree, he saw something brown. “There they are!” shouted Elephant happily. His hooves were hidden among the dry leaves. Elephant picked them up and put them on right away. He smiled happily. He had found his hooves thanks to his patient search. 

Elephant realized that, even when things seem difficult, looking carefully and calmly can lead to a wonderful solution.

plan.problema: The Elephant has lost all his hooves!
plan.svolta: He decided to make a big search, looking among the daisies and under the trees.
plan.finale: He found his hooves hidden among the dry leaves and smiled satisfied.

farfalla.text:
Butterfly Luna loved the secret garden. It was a place full of colorful flowers and sweet scents. Butterfly Luna flew among the tall sunflowers and red roses. Every day she played with the other insects, but she had a favorite flower: a little white daisy, right next to the stream.

One day, while dancing in the wind, she wandered too far from the stream. She got lost! She was looking for her favorite flower, but she couldn't see it anywhere. “Oh no!” thought Butterfly Luna. “I don’t know where I am anymore!”

Butterfly Luna flew this way and that, circling around the plants. But the white daisy was gone. She felt a little sad and confused. She decided to try flying high, hoping to see the garden from a different perspective.

But as soon as she rose into the air, the fog obscured her vision. She couldn't see anything. It was difficult to find her flower when she couldn't see well. A little green caterpillar was watching Butterfly Luna with curiosity. 

Then, suddenly, a ray of sunshine broke through the clouds. Butterfly Luna followed that bright ray, and in an instant, she saw her white daisy! She landed gently on the flower, happier than ever. She was so happy to have succeeded.

Butterfly Luna realized that, even when things seem difficult, it’s important to keep looking and not give up. Perseverance can lead to the discovery of what you love.

plan.problema: The butterfly Luna got lost in the garden and can’t find her favorite flower anymore.
plan.svolta: After wandering uselessly, she tried to fly high to get a better view of the garden, but the fog clouded her sight.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a ray of sunshine that made its way through the clouds, Luna finally spotted her flower and landed on it with joy.

farfalla.text:
Stella Butterfly had woken up in a wonderful place. It was the Secret Garden, full of colorful flowers and sweet scents. Stella Butterfly loved to fly among the soft petals. But today something wasn’t right. She felt lonely.

“Mommy?” she called, opening her wings. “Mommy, where are you?” But there was no answer. Stella Butterfly was lost! She was surrounded by red roses, yellow sunflowers, and fragrant violets. She couldn’t find her mommy. Fear began to feel inside her.

“I have to do something!” thought Stella Butterfly. She decided to fly higher, towards the blue sky. She tried to see beyond the flowers, hoping to catch a glimpse of her mommy’s figure on the horizon. She flew, she flew, her wings moving quickly.

A little beetle, a friend of Stella Butterfly, was watching her climb. “Don’t give up!” the beetle said to her, encouraging her.

Finally, thanks to her agile and determined flight, Stella Butterfly saw her mommy waiting for her under a big sunflower. Mommy smiled, happy to see her little butterfly. Stella Butterfly flew to her, her wings full of joy. She was so happy to be home.

Perseverance had helped Stella Butterfly to find her mommy and to return to a safe and happy place.

plan.problema: Stella got lost among the flowers and couldn't find her mom.
plan.svolta: She decided to fly higher, hoping to see her mom's figure on the horizon.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to her agile flight, Stella saw her mom waiting for her under a big sunflower.

farfalla.text:
Butterfly Luna loved the Secret Garden. It was a place full of colorful and fragrant flowers. Butterfly Luna flew among the petals, dancing with the wind. Her favorite place was on the yellow flower, the biggest in the garden.

---

One day, while playing hide-and-seek among the roses, Butterfly Luna got lost. She couldn't find her special corner anymore. “Oh no!” she said. “I don’t know where I am!” She felt a little sad. She tried to fly towards the red tulips and then towards the blue irises, but she couldn’t find the yellow flower.

---

Butterfly Luna tried to fly even higher, hoping to see her place from up there. But suddenly, with a little wobble, she pulled up all the petals of the yellow flower! The flower looked sad and without color. Butterfly Luna felt very guilty.

---

A little ladybug, who lived near the garden, saw what had happened. “Don’t worry, Butterfly Luna,” she said. “Pick up the petals and put them back gently.”

---

Butterfly Luna followed the ladybug’s advice. With slow and careful movements, she collected every single petal of the yellow flower. Then, with great care, she put them back on the stem. The flower returned to shining a bright yellow.

---

Butterfly Luna settled into her special corner, next to the yellow flower. She was happy and satisfied. The ladybug smiled at her. Butterfly Luna realized that even when you make mistakes, kindness can always help.

plan.problema: The Moon Butterfly is lost and can’t find her place among the flowers.
plan.svolta: Trying to fly higher, she accidentally knocked off all the petals of her favorite flower, feeling guilty.
plan.finale: Collecting carefully each petal and arranging them with care on the flower, the Moon Butterfly found her special corner in the garden.

farfalla.text:
Butterfly Lila lived in the Flowered Garden. She was a butterfly of a beautiful purple and yellow color. She loved to fly among the fragrant flowers. But Lila felt sad. She couldn't fly high like the other butterflies. She got tired quickly and always came down.

“I wish I could reach the sun,” thought Butterfly Lila. “But I can’t!”

One day, a red ladybug named Rosso told her, “Come on Lila, try to fly higher! Don’t give up!”

Butterfly Lila decided to listen to Rosso. She made a big jump. She flew up, up, up… but then she fell down hard. She landed gently on the grass. 

When she got up, she noticed something. Her wings were full of dust! They were so dirty that she couldn't fly well.

Butterfly Lila thought, “I must clean my wings!” She looked for a fresh, green leaf. She took the mint leaf and began to gently clean her wings. She rubbed carefully, with a lot of patience. 

And then… something magical happened! Butterfly Lila lifted off into the air! She flew higher than ever, passing over the flowers and trees of the Flowered Garden. She was happy!

plan.problema: Lila felt sad because she couldn't fly high like the other butterflies.
plan.svolta: She decided to make a big jump and, falling, realized that her wings were covered in dust.
plan.finale: She cleaned them gently with a mint leaf and, suddenly, she could fly higher than ever before!
plan.morale: Perseverance is the key to success.

farfalla.text:
Butterfly Luna lived in the Secret Garden. She was a white fabric butterfly, with wings decorated with glitter. She loved to fly among the flowers and the scent of roses. But Butterfly Luna felt lonely. There were no other toys with which she could play.

Every day she looked for someone to share her flight with. She asked the caterpillars to sit on the leaves, but they were too busy eating. She spoke to the ladybugs, but the ladybugs had to protect their eggs. Even the ants seemed too busy to play.

Butterfly Luna was sad. She wanted a friend to do something fun with. She thought that maybe if she became more beautiful, someone would notice her. So Butterfly Luna began to fly quickly. She moved back and forth, showing off her sparkling wings.

She flew faster and faster, creating bright spirals in the garden. The glitter on her wings shone like stars. The other insects stopped to admire her. A beetle approached curiously, then a red and yellow ladybug. Some ants even crowded together to see the butterfly flying so well.

Butterfly Luna was happy! Finally she had friends. She liked to tell them how much she loved the Secret Garden. Together, they played hide-and-seek among the flowers and followed the bright trails of Butterfly Luna. And Butterfly Luna realized that being kind always helps to find new friends.

plan.problema: The Luna butterfly felt lonely and couldn't find other friends to play with.
plan.svolta: She decided to create a little luminous show flying faster and more attractively, attracting the attention of other insects in the garden.
plan.finale: Many caterpillars, ladybugs, and ants approached Luna to admire her shimmering flight, becoming her new friends.

farfalla.text:
Butterfly Luna was a special butterfly. She was made of colorful silk and had shiny wings. She lived in a secret garden full of fragrant flowers and tall trees. Butterfly Luna loved to fly among the plants, but one morning she found herself in a strange place. She had ended up in the rose maze!

The roses were all red and smelled very strongly, but there was no way out. Butterfly Luna was spinning around the same bushes, looking for the path. She felt a little sad. She couldn't understand where she was. Her wings got tired from flapping.

Suddenly, Butterfly Luna heard a sweet sound: tinkle, tinkle! It came from the meadow nearby. A little gnome was ringing a bell. Butterfly Luna had an idea. “Maybe the sound will guide me,” she thought.

She decided to follow the sound of the bells. She flew faster, following the tinkle. The gnome kept ringing the bell louder and louder. At one point, the sound led her to a small passage between the roses.

Butterfly Luna flew through the passage and… there! She was on the sunny path. The path wound through the trees and led to the secret garden. Butterfly Luna was happy to be back home. She had shown that, even when things seem difficult, you should never give up.

plan.problema: The butterfly Luna got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find her way out.
plan.svolta: She decided to follow the sound of the bells ringing from the meadow, hoping they would lead her out of the maze.
plan.finale: The sound showed her a small passage between the roses and the butterfly finally found the sunny path.

farfalla.text:
Butterfly Stella was a very special butterfly. She was made of colorful fabric and had shiny wings. She lived in the Flowery Garden, a place full of red roses, yellow tulips, and blue violets. Butterfly Stella loved to fly among the flowers, but one morning something wasn’t right.

She had gotten lost! Among so many soft petals and sweet scents, she couldn’t find her mommy anymore. “Mommy? Mommy where are you?” she called, but no one answered. She was very scared. Her wings fluttered frantically.

Butterfly Stella thought that maybe if she flew higher, she could see the sky and understand where she was. So, with a great effort, she began to climb, climb, climb. She flew over white daisies and lavender gardens. The wind tangled her wings.

Suddenly, Butterfly Stella heard happy sounds: the singing of the little birds. She followed the sound and, looking down, she saw a big sunflower. Under the sunflower, there was her mommy! Mommy butterfly was smiling and stretched out her wings to welcome her.

Butterfly Stella flew right to her, happy to be back home. Mommy hugged her tightly with her wings. From that day on, Butterfly Stella learned that even when you get lost, you shouldn’t give up and keep looking. Every effort makes progress and eventually you always find the right way.

plan.problema: Stella Butterfly is lost among so many colorful flowers and can’t find her mommy anymore.
plan.svolta: She decided to fly higher, hoping to see the sky to get her bearings better.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the song of the little birds, she spotted her mommy who was waiting for her under a big sunflower.

farfalla.text:
Butterfly Luna was a cloth butterfly, white with wings colored like a summer sky. She lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of fragrant flowers and lush plants. She loved to fly among the petals, dancing with the wind.

One day, while playing chase with her sisters, Butterfly Stella and Butterfly Iris, she got lost. She found herself in the middle of many big and small flowers, but she couldn't find her place among the others anymore. She looked everywhere: near the tall sunflower, beside the fragrant rose, under the blue lavender. But nothing, there wasn't a flower that seemed familiar to her.

She was very sad. Her wings grew tired of fluttering and her cloth heart beat fast. “Oh no,” thought Butterfly Luna, “I don’t know where I am anymore!”

Then, she had an idea. She decided to fly very, very high, towards the sky. She rose higher and higher, above the trees and plants. From up there she could see the whole Secret Garden!

Finally, thanks to her new view, she spotted something pink among the flowers. It was a big flower in the shape of a cup, right where Butterfly Stella and Butterfly Iris had perched their twin. Butterfly Luna flew quickly to the flower and rejoined her sisters.

The three butterflies danced happily all afternoon. Butterfly Luna realized that sometimes, to find what you’re looking for, you need a little patience and to look at things from a different perspective. And so, with calmness and determination, she would always find her way.

plan.problema: The butterfly Luna is lost and can’t find her place among the flowers.
plan.svolta: After searching everywhere, the butterfly Luna decided to fly very high to get a better view of the garden.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to her view from above, she spotted the pink flower where she had perched with her sisters and rejoined them.
plan.morale: Patience helps to find the solution.

farfalla.text:
Butterfly Lila lived in the Flowered Garden. She was a beautiful butterfly, with colorful wings like a rainbow. Every day, Lila loved to dance among the fragrant flowers. But today, Lila felt sad. She couldn’t find the sun! Her wings were heavy and didn’t want to fly.

“Oh no,” said Butterfly Lila, “it’s so difficult!” She sat down on a big sunflower, watching the other flowers. They all seemed happy, but she was alone and sad. A busy bee named Zucchini asked her what was wrong.

“I can’t find the sun,” replied Lila with a weak voice. “I wish I could fly!”

Then Butterfly Lila made a decision. She decided to follow the buzzing of the bees. The bees knew where the sun was! She flew in that direction, following the cheerful sound of the buzzing. Zucchini helped her find the fastest path.

Finally, after a while, Butterfly Lila saw the sun! It was warm and bright. The sun gently reached her and her wings filled with energy. She flew up, up, up among the colorful flowers, happier than ever. 

Butterfly Lila flew high in the Flowered Garden, dancing with the wind and smiling at the sun. Perseverance had helped Butterfly Lila to find her joy. And so, every day, she enjoyed flying among the flowers.

plan.problema: Lila felt sad because she couldn't find the sun to fly.
plan.svolta: She decided to follow the buzzing of the bees, hoping to find it.
plan.finale: The sun found her and Lila flew happily among the colorful flowers.

farfalla.text:
Butterfly Luna lived in the Secret Garden. She was a beautiful butterfly, with wings of a deep blue and glittering golden spots. But Butterfly Luna felt very lonely. No one seemed to notice her special colors. The other insects preferred white butterflies or those of a simple yellow color.

“I wish someone would admire me,” thought Butterfly Luna, sitting on a red rose. “My colors are so beautiful, but no one sees them.” Little drops of dew began to fall on her wings.

One day, Butterfly Luna decided to do something. She started to move her wings quickly, faster and faster! Her wings shimmered in the sunlight and created a bright rainbow that stretched across the whole Secret Garden. It was an incredible sight!

A little squirrel, called Pippo, came out of the woods and followed the rainbow. Then the little birds arrived: canaries, robins, and sparrows. Everyone stopped to watch Butterfly Luna dance. They were all very amazed by her bright colors.

Butterfly Luna smiled. She felt happy! The little birds and Pippo flew around her, singing and hopping. Finally, she was surrounded by friendship. She realized that being different was something wonderful. 

From that day on, the Secret Garden was full of colors and laughter, because every creature appreciated the unique beauty of Butterfly Luna.

plan.problema: The Luna butterfly felt lonely because no one appreciated her bright colors.
plan.svolta: She decided to dance faster, creating a shimmering rainbow to attract attention.
plan.finale: The birds and squirrels came to watch her in amazement, and the Luna butterfly finally felt surrounded by friendship.

fenicottero.text:
Pippo was a very happy plush flamingo. He lived in the Flowery Meadow, a place full of colorful flowers and soft grass. He loved to run among the sunflowers and jump on the daisies. But Pippo had a little problem: he couldn’t walk straight! Every time he tried to move, he always fell on one side. “Oh no!” Pippo thought, rolling on the grass.

A blue butterfly, named Stella, landed beside him. “Why are you so sad, Pippo?” Stella asked with her gentle voice. Pippo explained his problem: it was too difficult to stand up!

Pippo stopped and thought about it. He remembered seeing real flamingos walking elegantly. He decided to try to take lots of small steps, just like the birds did. He focused all his attention on his balance. One step forward, another one, and another one. It was difficult, but Pippo didn’t give up.

Pippo kept taking little steps, slowing down and speeding up. Slowly, slowly, his body began to go straight. He felt so proud! Finally, after many attempts, Pippo learned to walk straight. With an elegant step forward, happy, he ran back among the flowers of the Flowery Meadow. It was wonderful to be able to do what seemed impossible to him. Determination always helps you achieve your goals.

plan.problema: Pippo can't walk straight and he always falls down!
plan.svolta: He decided to take many small steps, like a real bird, and he focused on his balance.
plan.finale: Finally, Pippo learned to walk straight and took a graceful step forward, joyful.

fenicottero.text:
Filippo was a lively pink flamingo. He lived in the green marsh, a place full of water lilies and tall reeds. Filippo loved the marsh! But Filippo had a little problem. He couldn’t walk straight. Every time he put one foot in front of the other, he would fall down with a thump! It was very frustrating for him.

Filippo tried to stand on one leg. He tried to take a step, but he always ended up falling down. A little squirrel, Leo, watched him from under a bush and wondered why Filippo couldn't walk well.

“Maybe,” thought Filippo, “I should try something different.” So, Filippo started to take lots of small hops. He tried to keep his balance while hopping. He hopped forward, then backward, trying to coordinate his feet. At first it was difficult, but Filippo didn't give up.

He continued to hop, a little higher, a little slower. After a long time, Filippo began to move his legs in a more elegant way. He could walk straight! He was so happy!

Then, Filippo had another idea. He started to dance with the other swallows that were circling above the green marsh. He hopped and moved with grace, as if he was born to do it. Finally Filippo had learned to walk well. And he knew he had overcome a great difficulty thanks to his perseverance. The green marsh had become even more beautiful, because Filippo danced happily.

plan.problema: Filippo couldn't walk straight and kept falling down!
plan.svolta: He decided to make lots of little jumps, trying to keep his balance.
plan.finale: Finally, Filippo learned to move his legs gracefully and began to dance with the other swallows.

fenicottero.text:
Flamingo lived in a flowery meadow full of colors. Red roses, yellow sunflowers, and fragrant violets surrounded him. Flamingo loved that meadow. But today there was a little problem. Flamingo couldn't walk straight! Every time he put one foot forward, the other followed in a strange way. He fell to the side, then to the side again, and he always found himself upside down. He was very frustrated.

A blue butterfly, Lila, flew nearby. “Can I help you?” asked Lila with a gentle voice. Flamingo shook his head. “I don’t know what to do!” he exclaimed. He thought that maybe if he turned around himself he would find a solution. So he began to turn slowly. But the more he turned, the more confused he became! He couldn’t understand where his front foot and his back foot were. It was really a mess!

Flamingo stopped, took a deep breath, and closed his eyes. He said to himself, “I must trust myself.” Then, with all his strength, he began to move his legs forward and backward. He walked slowly, but straight! His elegant step returned immediately. Flamingo felt happy and proud.

Lila the butterfly smiled. “Good job, Flamingo!” she said. Flamingo understood that sometimes, to do things well, you just need to believe in yourself. And so, Flamingo continued to walk in the flowery meadow, a little flamingo with a sure and happy step.

plan.problema: Flamingo cannot walk straight and keeps falling down!
plan.svolta: He decided to turn himself around to see if this helped, but only got even more confused.
plan.finale: Finally, he simply closed his eyes and began to move his legs with determination, immediately finding his elegant step again.
plan.morale: Sometimes all it takes is a little self-confidence.

fenicottero.text:
Pippo was a very happy plush flamingo. He lived on a sandy beach, a beach full of smooth stones and colorful seashells. He loved the warm sun and the sound of the waves. But Pippo had a little problem. He couldn’t walk straight! Every time he put one foot in front of the other, he always fell down, tumbling onto the sand.

It was very frustrating for Pippo. He wanted to be elegant like the other imaginary flamingos that he saw in books. A shrimp, named Leo, watched him from a distance with curiosity. “Why can’t you walk straight, Pippo?” asked Leo.

Pippo sighed. “I don’t know! I try to keep my balance, but it’s too difficult.” He huddled down on the sand and felt a little sad. Then he had an idea! He decided to do some exercises with his legs. He stretched one leg up high, then straightened it. He did it again, stretching and straightening repeatedly.

At first he fell down many times, but Pippo didn’t give up. He kept doing the exercises, focused and determined. After a long time, he felt something was changing. He began to move slowly, a little clumsy at first, then more and more smoothly.

Finally, after many attempts, Pippo learned to move elegantly and proudly on the sand. He walked straight, with a confident step, looking at the sparkling sea. He was happy! The beach had become even more beautiful for him. And he knew that every little effort can lead to big results.

plan.problema: Peter can’t walk straight and always falls down!
plan.svolta: He decided to do exercises with his legs, stretching and straightening repeatedly.
plan.finale: Finally, after many attempts, Peter learned to move gracefully and proudly on the sand.

fenicottero.text:
Pippo was a very happy plush flamingo. He loved the sandy beach. Every day he ran to play there. Pippo had one thing he loved more than anything: his little red sippy cup.

One morning, Pippo was looking for his favorite sippy cup. He had left it near the shore and wanted to get it back. Running between the dunes, Pippo got lost! He couldn't hear his mommy's voice anymore. He was just a little flamingo on a big beach.

Pippo was worried. “Oh no!” he said. “I don’t know where my sippy cup is!” He looked around, but everything seemed the same. The sun was shining brightly and the sand was sparkling. Pippo wanted to find his sippy cup.

Then, Pippo made a decision. He decided to use his long legs to walk backwards. He walked slowly, trying to follow a path that he might have left. The sand was warm under his feet.

He continued to walk backwards, with so much determination. A little seagull watched him curiously. Finally, thanks to the shining sun, Pippo saw his shiny sippy cup near a colorful seashell. It was right there, hidden among the grains of sand!

Pippo ran happily towards his sippy cup and hugged it tight. He felt very happy. He had overcome a little challenge thanks to his perseverance. 
The beach was still full of wonders to discover.

plan.problema: Pippo got lost while looking for his favorite juice.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his long legs to walk backward, hoping to find the trace of his juice.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the shining sun, he saw his glittering juice near a colorful shell.

fenicottero.text:
Flamingo lived in the Pond of Flowers. He was a red and pink flamingo, very funny. He loved to be there, near the fragrant roses and white water lilies. But Flamingo had a problem. Every time he tried to walk, he always fell down! His legs didn’t work well together. He wobbled and fell with a gentle splash into the water.

A blue butterfly, called Luna, watched him from a distance. “Are you sad, Flamingo?” asked Luna. “It seems like you need a little help.”

Flamingo sighed. “I’ve tried to walk in so many ways,” he said. “But I just can’t stand up.” He frowned, thoughtful. Then he had an idea! He saw the fish swimming and making waves with their bodies to move. “Maybe,” thought Flamingo, “I need to learn to make waves with my legs!”

He started to practice. He tried to lift one leg and then the other, as if he were making a wave. He tried hard, chased himself, fell down again, but he didn’t give up. He kept trying, day after day. 

Finally, after many attempts, Flamingo managed to move his legs in a coordinated way. He walked straight for the first time! He was so happy that he did a big jump of joy. Luna smiled, happy for him. Flamingo realized that with effort and determination, even a difficult thing can become easy. And this made him even funnier and happier in the Pond of Flowers.

plan.problema: Flamingo can't walk straight and always falls down!
plan.svolta: He decided to learn to make waves with his legs, like the fish do.
