plan.finale: After many attempts, Flamingo finally managed to move his legs in a coordinated way and walked straight for the first time!

fenicottero.text:
Pippo was a very special flamingo. He lived on the golden beach and loved to walk. Every step he took was light and happy. Pippo had two long, red legs, but he preferred his right leg. It was his strongest leg and he used it to make beautiful zigzag steps.

One day, while he was playing near the sea, something bad happened. Pippo moved too far and his right leg disappeared! The leg had fallen into the water. Pippo felt very sad. He couldn't walk well without that leg.

Pippo tried to push with his beak to reach his leg, but it was too far away. The water was making him slide away and he couldn't get closer. He felt lower and lower.

Suddenly, he saw a starfish floating near him. “What’s happening?” asked the starfish. Pippo explained his problem. The starfish gently came closer and using its body, pushed Pippo’s leg towards the shore.

Pippo finally got his leg back! He was so happy. He thanked the starfish and started walking again on the golden beach, making his zigzag steps. Pippo felt strong and brave. 

He continued to walk happily, knowing that even when things seem difficult, with a little help you can always find the solution.

plan.problema: Pippo had lost his favorite foot in the sea!
plan.svolta: He tried to push with his beak, but the foot was too far away and the water was making him slide.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a friendly starfish, Pippo recovered his foot and continued to walk happily on the beach.

fenicottero.text:
Flamingo lived in a flowery meadow. The meadow was full of red roses, yellow sunflowers, and white bellflowers. Flamingo loved that meadow. He spent his time watching the colorful butterflies flying around the flowers.

But Flamingo had a little problem. He couldn’t walk straight! Every time he tried to move, he fell right down onto the meadow. “Oh no!” exclaimed Flamingo. He bumped into the roses, rolled among the sunflowers, and even ended up in the bellflower bush. He was very frustrated.

A ladybug, who was called Camilla, told him: “Flamingo, why are you always on the ground? Flamingos walk in a strange way, but it’s okay!” Flamingo thought about the ladybug and watched how his flamingo friends walked in the picture book he had seen.

Suddenly, Flamingo understood! He needed to move his left foot and then his right foot, a little like a real flamingo. He tried to do that and, unbelievably, he could walk straight!

Flamingo felt happy. He started walking straight in the flowery meadow, chasing the colorful butterflies. He hopped among the flowers, without falling anymore. He was finally free to explore his favorite meadow. Flamingo realized that with a little patience and trying, he too could reach his goals.

plan.problema: Flamingo cannot walk straight and falls down continuously.
plan.svolta: He realized that he needed to move his legs alternately, like a real flamingo!
plan.finale: Finally he managed to walk straight, chasing the colorful butterflies in the meadow.

fenicottero.text:
Fenicottero Rosso was a bright red flamingo. He lived on a sandy beach, a beach full of games and seashells. Every day, Fenicottero Rosso loved to be there, watching the sea. But there was a little problem.

Fenicottero Rosso couldn’t walk straight! Whenever he tried to take a step, he always ended up headfirst in the sea! The water was cool and the wave would roll him away. It was very frustrating for Fenicottero Rosso.

One day, while he was sinking back into the sea again, Fenicottero Rosso had an idea. He looked at his red, chubby legs. He thought, “Maybe I can use these legs to push the water!” So he started to flap his legs quickly towards the sea.

With every flap, the water went back a little. Fenicottero Rosso kept flapping, focused and determined. Slowly, slowly, he managed to stand up! At first, it was wobbly, but then he found his balance.

Fenicottero Rosso ran on the sandy beach! He ran happily, quickly, and without falling into the sea. He was so happy to have learned to walk straight. A little crab, who was called Carlo, watched him with admiration.

Fenicottero Rosso realized that if you really try, even the most difficult things can be overcome. And this taught him that every effort is worth it.

plan.problema: He can't walk straight and he always ends up headfirst in the sea!
plan.svolta: He decides to use his legs to push the water away while he tries to stand up.
plan.finale: He finally manages to move with confidence, running happily on the beach!
plan.morale: With effort, you can overcome any difficulty.

fenicottero.text:
Flamingo lived in a quiet little lagoon. The water was clear and reflected the blue sky. Flamingo loved that place. He was a plastic flamingo, with long, red legs. But there was a small problem: Flamingo couldn't walk straight! Every time he tried to take a step, he always fell on his side.

It was very frustrating. Flamingo wiggled in the mud, trying to keep his balance. He tried to stand on his tiptoes, but nothing seemed to work. A little squirrel, Leo, watched him curiously from the lagoon.

“Why do you always do this, Flamingo?” asked Leo with his squeaky voice.

Flamingo sighed. “I don’t know how to walk straight!” he said. Then he had an idea. He closed his eyes and decided to turn around three times. He turned slowly, turn after turn. He felt the mud under his legs and the fresh air on his plastic body.

When he finished turning, he opened his eyes. Surprisingly, Flamingo could stand up! He walked straight, step by step, without falling once. Flamingo felt so happy! He turned around and waved goodbye to Leo with a big smile. 

He had finally learned to walk straight. It was really lovely to see Flamingo moving gracefully in the lagoon. And this shows that, even when things seem difficult, if we try hard, we can always overcome them.

plan.problema: He can't walk straight and he always falls down!
plan.svolta: He decides to spin around three times, hoping to find his balance.
plan.finale: Finally, he can walk straight and greets with a smile!

fiore.text:
Fiorino lived in the Secret Garden. He was a beautiful yellow flower, with many soft and fragrant petals. Fiorino loved to be there, among the butterflies and singing birds. But lately, something wasn't right. His color had become faded, almost gray. His petals were dull and no longer shone as before.

Fiorino felt sad. He didn't understand why he had lost his light. He tried to move, to open his buds, but it all seemed useless. A little ladybug, called Lila, looked at him with concern. “What’s wrong, Fiorino?” asked Lila.

“I don’t know,” replied Fiorino in a weak voice. “I’ve lost my brightness.” He tried to make a smile, but it was difficult when he didn't feel well. Then, Fiorino decided to sing. He sang a cheerful song that reminded him of the sun and summer rains. But the sound didn't seem enough to wake him up.

The wind whispered among the leaves of the Secret Garden. Fiorino felt even worse. Suddenly, a warm ray of sunshine reached him. The sun kissed him with its golden light. And then, Fiorino began to shine! His petals turned yellow and bright again, just like before. He was more beautiful than ever!

Fiorino felt much better right away. He understood that even when you are sad, just a little bit of joy is enough to find your light. Lila hopped around him, happy. Fiorino knew that the Secret Garden was even more special thanks to his new brightness. And every time he heard a laugh, he understood how important it was to be happy.

plan.problema: The Buttercup had lost his shine and his color had faded.
plan.svolta: He tried to sing a happy song, but the sound didn't seem to be enough.
plan.finale: A ray of sunshine kissed him and Buttercup began to shine brighter than ever!

fiore.text:
Flower Blue was a special flower. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of tall plants and colorful flowers. Flower Blue had petals a deep blue color and a sweet scent. But one day, something changed. The sun didn’t reach him anymore. Flower Blue felt sad and dull. He couldn’t shine like before.

“Oh no,” said Flower Blue, “I’m lost! I can’t see the sun anymore.” He huddled among the leaves, hoping someone would help him. A little snail, named Lilla, passed by and saw the sad flower. “What’s happening?” asked Lilla.

Flower Blue explained his situation. “I can’t find the sun anymore,” he repeated. Lilla thought for a moment and said, “Maybe you should climb on the big rock! It’s very tall, maybe from up there you can see the sun.”

Flower Blue moved slowly towards the rock. It was big and rough, but Flower Blue didn’t give up. Climbing with his little roots, he climbed higher and higher. The journey was tiring, but Flower Blue wanted to see the sun so much.

Finally, he reached the top of the rock! From there he could see all of the Secret Garden. And then something magical happened. The sun was kissing him with its golden rays. Flower Blue’s petals began to shine with a thousand colors. He was happier than ever.

Flower Blue shone again like a jewel in the Secret Garden, and he understood that, even when things seem difficult, you shouldn’t ever give up. With his perseverance, he had found his happiness.

plan.problema: The blue flower was lost and couldn't find the sun anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to climb a big rock to reach the top of the garden, hoping to see the sun.
plan.finale: When he reached the top, he discovered that the sun was kissing him with its golden rays, and it began to shine with a thousand colors.

fiore.text:
Fiore was a special flower. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colors and smells. Fiore loved to be there, near the pond with the white water lilies. One day, while the wind was blowing hard, Fiore found himself in the middle of a maze of tall grass. 

The grass was so high that he couldn't see the sky anymore!

It was all gray and dark. He didn't feel the sun on his petals. Fiore felt very lonely and scared. He tried to move, but the grass made him spin around and around. He didn't know how to find the light.

Then, he noticed a big sunflower that stood tall in the garden. “Maybe I can see something from up there!” thought Fiore. With a lot of effort, he began to climb the sunflower’s stem. It was difficult; the grass was sticky and the sunflower was very tall. But Fiore didn’t give up.

Once at the top, Fiore had a wonderful view! He saw many different plants and flowers. Carefully, he looked among the green leaves. Finally, he spotted a ray of light shining through the trees. He followed that light with courage, moving slowly through the tall grass.

With great effort, Fiore made his way to the center of the garden. The sunlight gently kissed him. He was happy! He had finally come home. Fiore understood that even when things seem difficult, if you never give up, you always find your way.

plan.problema: The flower had gotten lost in the tall grass maze, not knowing how to find the sun.
plan.svolta: He decided to climb a giant sunflower to get a better view and find the right direction.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the light filtering through the leaves, he saw the sun and made his way bravely to the center of the garden.

fiore.text:
Flower Blue was a special flower. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of tall and short plants, green ferns, and babbling brooks. Flower Blue loved his garden, especially his friend, the Sun. Every day, the Sun warmed him and gave him a beautiful light.

One day, the wind was very strong. It had blown him away from his place near the stream. Flower Blue found himself lost in a big meadow full of tall grass. He couldn’t see the Sun! He was very sad. “I must find him,” thought Flower Blue.

He decided he would do something. He crouched down and began to smell all the flowers in the garden. There were red roses, yellow tulips, and blue violets. Every time he smelled a flower, he wondered, “What does the Sun smell like?”

After smelling so many flowers, he smelled a sweet and warm scent. It was a special fragrance, different from all the others. He followed that scent, and suddenly, he saw a bright light.

It was the Sun! The Sun was shining on him with a bright ray. “I looked everywhere for you!” said Flower Blue happily. The Sun smiled and said, “You did a great job, little flower.”

Flower Blue returned to his place in the Secret Garden, near the stream, and felt very proud of himself. Perseverance had helped him find his friend, the Sun.

plan.problema: The Blue Flower had gotten lost in the meadow and couldn't find his friend, the sun.
plan.svolta: He decided to smell every flower in the garden to figure out which direction the scent of the sun was coming from.
plan.finale: Finally, following a sweet and warm scent, he found the sun who was waiting for him with a bright ray.

fiore.text:
Flower Blue lived in the Secret Garden. He was a very blue flower, with soft petals and a sweet scent. He loved to play among the plants and listen to the birds singing. One day, while following a yellow butterfly, he found himself in the middle of a maze of red roses. The roses were tall and smelled very strongly, but Flower Blue couldn’t find his way out.

The sun, which had been warming him, had disappeared behind the many roses. Flower Blue felt sad and a little scared. He couldn’t see his place in the Secret Garden anymore. He tried to turn around, but every rose seemed just like the other.

Then, he had an idea. He gathered his blue petals and scattered them everywhere. “Maybe someone saw me!” he thought. By scattering the petals, Flower Blue felt a little braver. 

A little brown squirrel named Ribbon was collecting nuts. He saw the many blue petals and went to Flower Blue. “Oh, it’s you!” shouted Ribbon. “I saw you get lost in the maze! I’ll guide you out.”

Ribbon ran between the roses, following the trail of blue petals. Finally, they arrived in front of a golden ray of sunshine. Flower Blue found his place back in the Secret Garden, near the cool water and the fragrant plants. He was happy to be back. 

Flower Blue understood that even when you get lost, Ribbon’s kindness helped him find his way back to the light.

plan.problema: The Blue Flower is lost in the maze of roses and can’t find the sun anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to scatter blue petals everywhere, hoping someone had seen him.
plan.finale: A little squirrel, seeing the petals, led him out of the maze towards a golden ray of sunshine.

fiore.text:
Flower Blue lived in the Secret Garden. He was a bright blue flower, full of life. The other flowers in the garden admired him. But one day, Flower Blue noticed that his color had faded. It wasn’t bright blue anymore, but gray and dull. No one wanted to play with him anymore.

Flower Blue was sad. He felt lonely in his corner of the garden. He tried to smile, but he couldn’t cheer anyone up. The sun seemed farther away too.

“I wish I could shine again!” thought Flower Blue. So he took a deep breath and decided to do something. He decided to sing a song to the wind. “Oh, wind, please help me! Bring back my blue color!”

But the wind was too fast. Flower Blue’s whispers were lost in the rustle of the leaves.

A little squirrel, Pipì, was scampering among the flowers. He heard Flower Blue’s faint voice and came closer. “What’s wrong?” asked Pipì.

Flower Blue explained his problem. Pipì thought for a moment. Then he collected some drops of fresh dew on the leaves and gently poured them onto Flower Blue’s petal. 

The vibrant color returned immediately! Flower Blue shone brighter than ever. He was happy, thanks to Pipì. 

From that day on, the flowers in the Secret Garden admired Flower Blue even more, and he understood that even a small kind gesture can make a difference.

plan.problema: The blue flower had lost its brightness and no one wanted it anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to sing a song to the wind to ask for help, but the wind was too fast.
plan.finale: A little squirrel brought him drops of fresh dew, which restored the flower's vibrant color.

fiore.text:
Fiorellino was a beautiful yellow flower. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of strange plants and bright colors. Fiorellino loved to play among the big leaves and to smell the flowers. One day, while he was dancing with the wind, he went too far from his place. He found himself in a tall meadow, full of tall grass that completely hid him.

Fiorellino felt scared. He couldn't find his home, the nest among the green leaves of the Secret Garden. He tried to move his petals to attract attention, but it was too difficult. He shouted: “Help! I’m here!”, but nobody heard him. Only the wind whispered among the tall grass.

Fiorellino thought he had to do something different. Then, with all his strength, he climbed onto a small bush. It was a little uncomfortable, but from there he could see better. He saw the clear water of the pond and the sun shining above.

Suddenly, Fiorellino saw something familiar: his nest among the green leaves of the Secret Garden! The sun reflected on the water and created a bright beam that guided him. With great joy, Fiorellino plunged into its leaves. He felt safe and happy to be back home. 

From that day on, Fiorellino always played near his nest, remembering that even when things seem difficult, you should never give up. Perseverance helped the flower to reach his destination.

plan.problema: Little Flower got lost in the tall meadow and couldn't find his way home.
plan.svolta: He tried to call for help, but nobody could hear him, so he decided to climb a small bush for a better view.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the sun reflecting on the pond water, he saw his home and happily dove into its leaves.

fiore.text:
Fiore lived in the Secret Garden. He was a beautiful pink flower, with many soft and fragrant petals. Every morning, he took the sun and listened to the song of the birds. But lately, Fiore felt very sad. His petals had become too red, as if he had cried a lot. He didn't want to smile anymore.

“Oh no,” thought Fiore, “if I can’t smile, the garden will be gray!” He sat on his favorite leaf, trying to straighten his petals, but it was impossible. The red color seemed not to want to disappear. A little ladybug, called Stella, passed by and asked, “Fiore, what’s wrong?”

Fiore explained his problem. Stella thought for a while and said, “Maybe if you sang a happy song, it would make you smile!” Fiore tried to sing. But his singing was too loud! The bees in the garden got scared and flew away in a panic.

Fiore felt even sadder. Then, with delicacy, he made a sweet whisper of wind. It was a light and gentle sound, like a caress. The wind stroked his petals and, slowly, the red color began to fade. The petals quickly returned to their bright pink color.

Fiore felt immediately better. He smiled again, happy and content. Stella looked at Fiore and said, “You are wonderful!” Fiore understood that even a small kind gesture could do great things. 
Kindness does miracles.

plan.problema: The flower felt sad because its petals were too red and it didn't want to smile anymore.
plan.svolta: It tried to sing a happy song, but its singing was too loud and scared the bees.
plan.finale: Then, with delicacy, it made a sweet whisper of wind and its petals returned to their bright pink color immediately.

fiore.text:
Flower Blue lived in the Secret Garden. He was a beautiful blue flower, with soft petals and a sweet scent. He loved that garden full of colorful flowers and lush plants. One day, however, he had gotten lost. He didn't know how he had ended up among the tall ferns and dense bushes.

Flower Blue had a big problem: he couldn't find the sun anymore! His blue color was fading and he felt cold. He desperately tried to move, but the earth was hard and difficult to climb.

He tried to stretch his petals upwards, hoping to reach the light. But the sun seemed so far away! His shadow wrapped around him more and more, making him feel even sadder. A little insect, a ladybug, watched him closely, curious about his situation.

Flower Blue felt weak and tired. He didn't know what to do. Then, suddenly, a gentle little wind blew on him. It gently pushed him upwards, towards a bright ray of light that came between the leaves.

Flower Blue moved slowly, guided by the wind. Finally, he felt the warmth of the sun on his surface. His blue color returned vivid and vibrant. He felt happy and full of energy. 

The Secret Garden seemed even more beautiful under the sunlight. Flower Blue realized that even when things seem difficult, with a little perseverance, you can always find happiness. And this is true for all of us.

plan.problema: The blue flower had lost its way in the garden and couldn't find the sun anymore.
plan.svolta: It tried to stretch its petals upwards, but the sun seemed too far away and its shadow wrapped around it more and more.
plan.finale: A little gentle wind pushed it softly towards a bright ray of light, and the blue flower finally found the warmth of the sun.

fiore.text:
Fiorino was a bright yellow flower in the Secret Garden. He loved to be there, among the green leaves and sweet smells. One day, Fiorino suddenly felt himself sinking. He had fallen into a maze of red and white roses! The roses were so tall and many, he couldn’t see the sun anymore.

Fiorino was very sad. He tried to move, but the roots held him tight. He couldn’t find the light. “Oh no!” thought Fiorino. “I’m lost!”

Then, Fiorino had an idea. He focused and called to all the insects he met: “Help! Help! I’m lost!” Initially, nobody answered. Then, a little ladybug came closer. “What do you want, little flower?” asked the ladybug. Fiorino offered her a drop of honey that he had collected from a bud.

The ladybug agreed to help Fiorino. Together, they asked for help from the beetles. The beetles knew every corner of the garden. “We have seen so many things,” said a beetle, “We know where there is more light.” 

With the help of the beetles and the ladybug, Fiorino made his way through the roses. Finally, they arrived at a place in the garden where the sun shone brightly. Fiorino was happy! He felt safe and illuminated. The ladybug waved goodbye to Fiorino and the beetles quickly disappeared. 

Fiorino realized that even the smallest ones can help if they work together. And so, Fiorino continued to shine in the Secret Garden, always remembering the importance of asking for help when you need it.

plan.problema: The little frog got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find the sun.
plan.svolta: He decided to call all the little insects in the garden for help, offering them a drop of honey in exchange.
plan.finale: The beetles and ladybugs guided him with their experience, leading him back to the brightest spot in the garden.

fish.text:
Fish was a very happy plastic fish. He lived in the sunny pool, where the sun warmed the water and the little fish played hide-and-seek. Fish loved to play with his fishy friends, but especially he loved to swim.

One day, while taking a quick turn, Fish found himself in a new place. He was inside the big pool tube! He couldn’t find his way out. The tube was very narrow and Fish couldn’t move well. “Help!” he cried.

Fish tried to swim quickly, hoping to deflate the tube. But the tube was too narrow and he couldn’t get out. He felt a little sad. A little red fish, Pipì, was watching him worriedly. “Maybe you should try something different,” said Pipì.

Fish thought, thought, thought. Then he had an idea! He went to the edge of the pool and concentrated. With an effort, he slid down the edge and, with a push, he managed to slide out of the tube. He was free!

Fish found himself near the grass next to the pool. He saw a small hole in the grass and had another idea. He pushed himself into the hole and… he slid out! Immediately he saw his family of fish waiting anxiously. Everyone hugged happily.

Fish realized that sometimes, when things are difficult, you need to be patient and find a different solution. Calmness always helps to find the best way to get back.

plan.problema: The Fish got lost in the big pool slide!
plan.svolta: He tried to swim fast, but the slide was too narrow and he couldn't get out.
plan.finale: Then he discovered a small hole in the grass near the pool and slid out, immediately finding his family of little fish.

fish.text:
Fish was a very happy plastic fish. He lived in a big, blue pool. Every day he enjoyed floating and watching the colorful stars that twinkled on the bottom of the pool. But one day, something changed.

While Fish was swimming quietly, a wave pushed him towards a group of floating leaves. The leaves were big and soft, perfect for making slides. Fish had a lot of fun rolling between the leaves, but when he tried to go back to his place, he couldn't! He was lost.

Fish swam up and down, desperately searching for his corner of the pool. The leaves pushed him everywhere. He was frustrated. He didn't understand where he had ended up. A small stone was near the leaves, and Fish accidentally hit it with his fin.

Then Fish decided to try swimming faster. He swam and swam, focusing on the corner where the leaves were pushing him. At first he felt a little tired, but he didn't give up. 

Finally, the corner led him to a point in the pool that Fish had never seen before. He followed the corner and, suddenly, he saw his house among the colorful stars at the bottom! He was happy to be back in his place. Fish curled up content, waiting for the next day for new adventures. Patience always helps you find what you are looking for.

plan.problema: Fish got lost among the floating leaves and couldn't find his way back.
plan.svolta: Trying to swim faster, he noticed that the leaves were pushing him towards a corner of the pool.
plan.finale: Following the corner, Fish finally found his home among the colorful stars at the bottom of the pool.

fish.text:
Fish Blue was a shiny blue plastic fish. He lived in the Sunny Pool, a pool full of sunshine and cool water. Every day, Fish Blue enjoyed floating and nibbling his little fishy treats. He was the favorite toy in the pool!

One afternoon, while having a quick spin, something went wrong. Fish Blue found himself at the bottom of the pool! It was dark and the water was cold. “Oh no!” he said. “I’m lost!”

He started to swim, but he couldn’t get back. He got very tired quickly. His fins got tired and the water seemed heavier and heavier. “I have to do something!” thought Fish Blue.

Then he saw a floating leaf, as big as his hand! He tried to climb onto the leaf. It was hard, but Fish Blue kept pushing with his fins. Finally, he managed to get to the top of the leaf and slowly climbed towards the surface.

When he got back up high, he saw the sun! It was so warm and bright. He smiled with joy. The sun shone on the Sunny Pool. A little coconut shell floated near Fish Blue. He waved to it with a wiggle.

Fish Blue was happy to be back on the surface. He rested for a little while and then continued to play in his beloved pool, remembering that even when things seem difficult, you should always try!

plan.problema: Blue Fish is lost at the bottom of the pool!
plan.svolta: He tried to swim faster, but only got tired.
plan.finale: Then he found a floating leaf and climbed it to come up, happy to see the sun.

fish.text:
Fish Ball was a very happy rubber fish. He lived in the Sunny Pool, a pool full of sunshine and clear water. He loved to play among the floating leaves that sometimes reached the surface. One day, Fish Ball had so much fun that he sank among the leaves. When he tried to swim up, he realized he was completely lost!

“Oh no!” he exclaimed. “I can’t find the edge of the pool anymore!” The floating leaves were all the same and gray. Fish Ball tried to swim quickly, hoping to reach the bottom and then swim up right away. But he got more and more confused. He swam to the right, then to the left, then up!

“I need to calm down,” thought Fish Ball. He tried to stop for a moment to breathe. He closed his eyes and tried to concentrate. Suddenly, a ray of sunshine hit his blue scale. The scale shone like a star! The ray of sunshine clearly showed him the way: swim towards the edge of the pool.

Fish Ball followed the ray of light and in just a moment he arrived at the edge. He rested a little on the warm stone. A small shell of water smiled at him. Fish Ball realized that sometimes, to find the way, you just have to wait and watch. Patience was a great ally.

plan.problema: Ball the Fish is lost among the floating leaves!
plan.svolta: He tried to swim faster, but only got more confused.
plan.finale: A ray of sunshine made his blue scale shine, showing him the way to the edge of the pool.
plan.morale: Patience is key to finding the solution.

fish.text:
Fish was a plastic fish, blue and shiny. He lived in a new swimming pool, big and full of water. It was his favorite home. One day, Fish was playing to float near the surface. Suddenly, he found himself surrounded by green floating plants. There were so many, so many, so many!

Fish tried to swim. He swam fast, very fast. But the more he swam, the more he got lost among the green leaves. He couldn’t see his home, his favorite corner near the waterfall. He was scared. “Oh no!” said Fish. “I don’t know where I am!”

He kept swimming, but he didn’t find anything familiar. Every time he tried to go in a direction, he only found another floating plant in front of him. He was confused and tired.

Suddenly, he saw a red ladybug with seven black dots. The ladybug was walking on a leaf. “Hey, ladybug!” called Fish. “Can you help me? I’m lost!”

The ladybug answered: “Follow me, little fish! I know where you want to go.” And so, the ladybug led Fish through the floating plants. Finally, they reached Fish’s favorite corner near the waterfall. “I did it!” exclaimed Fish happily. 

Fish relaxed and watched the water flowing. He was happy to be back home. Sometimes, patience helps you find the right way.

plan.problema: Fish is lost among the floating plants and can’t find his home.
plan.svolta: He tried to swim faster, but only got more confused.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a ladybug that guided him, Fish found his favorite corner of the pool.
plan.morale: Patience helps to find the solution.

fish.text:
Fish Leo was a very happy plastic fish. He lived in the Joyful Pool, a pool full of games and colors. Every day, Fish Leo swam happily among the floating plants and the fountain that sprayed cool water.

 

One afternoon, while playing hide-and-seek with a green algae, Fish Leo found himself in a new place. He was surrounded by many green and white leaves. He couldn’t find his place near the waterfall where he usually had fun. “Oh no!” thought Fish Leo. “I’m lost!”

 

He started swimming quickly, hoping to find his way back. But every time he tried to go straight, he ended up swimming in circles among the plants. He became more and more confused and felt a little sad. “Maybe it’s better if I rest,” he thought.

 

Suddenly, he saw a blue starfish named Stella. Stella was kind and loved to play in the Joyful Pool. He asked Stella for help: “Stella, please, can you help me? I can’t find my place!”

 

Stella swam around Fish Leo and said, “Swim towards the waterfall! Do you see it there?” Fish Leo followed Stella’s instructions, and in a little while, he arrived at his place near the waterfall. He was so happy! “Thank you, Stella!” said Fish Leo.

 

Fish Leo settled down next to the waterfall and continued to play happily. He remembered that even when things seem difficult, you should always believe in yourself and ask your friends for help.

plan.problema: Fish Leo got lost in his watery world, among the floating plants!
plan.svolta: He tried to swim faster, but only confused his path even more.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a friendly starfish, Fish Leo found his place near the waterfall.
plan.morale: Never give up, even if things seem difficult.

fish.text:
Fish Pippo was a very happy plastic fish. He lived in the Blue Pool. The pool was big and full of cool water. Fish Pippo loved to play there with the bubbles that the children made.

---

One day, while hopping among the floating leaves, he found himself all alone. He was lost! The Blue Pool seemed enormous now. He couldn’t find his favorite corner near the yellow sponge.

---

Fish Pippo started to swim quickly. He tried to reach the edges of the pool, but only he got even more confused. The water was blue everywhere, and he couldn’t see anything familiar. He was a little sad.

---

Then, he noticed something: a small waterfall of water falling from a corner of the pool. Fish Pippo decided to follow it. The waterfall led him through a twisty path among the stones.

---

Finally, the waterfall stopped right in front of the yellow sponge! Fish Pippo was back in his favorite place. He was happy and glad. He settled down there, next to the sponge, and started to make bubbles of joy. 

---

The yellow sponge watched him smiling. Every time the sun shone on the Blue Pool, Fish Pippo knew that he would always be safe and happy.

plan.problema: Fish Pippo got lost in the big pool and couldn't find his home.
plan.svolta: He tried to swim faster, but only got more confused.
plan.finale: Then he discovered a waterfall of water that brought him back to his favorite corner near the yellow sponge.

fish.text:
Fishy was a very special little fish. He lived in the Joyful Pool, a pool full of bouncy cuddles! The cuddles were soft and colorful, some shaped like swim fins, and others like starfish. Fishy loved to play among the cuddles, jumping from one to another.

One day, while he was making a big wiggle, he found himself inside a deep hole. It was a hole made of yellow cuddle and it was very, very big! Fishy had gotten lost in the maze of bouncy cuddles. He couldn’t find his way out.

Fishy tried to swim towards the edge of the pool, but every time he got closer, he ended up in another hole! A blue hole, a pink hole, even a green hole with bubbles of foam. It was really frustrating.

He then bumped into Gnome, a small, smiling gnome who lived under a cuddle shaped like a mushroom. “Gnome, help me!” said Fishy. “I can’t get out!”

Gnome thought for a little while and then said, “Jump, Fishy! Jump with all your strength!” 
Fishy listened to Gnome and made a big wiggle. He jumped out of the pool with all his energy. He was free!

He was back at the Joyful Pool, near the edge. Fishy turned to Gnome and thanked him. Perseverance can lead to unexpected results.

plan.problema: Little Fish got lost in the maze of bouncy cuddles!
plan.svolta: He tried to swim towards the edge, but only found himself in another hole!
plan.finale: Thanks to his gnome friend, he found the exit jumping out with a big splash!

fish.text:
Pippo the Fish was a bright yellow fish. He lived in a big bathroom full of colors. He loved to play among the bubble bath tubs and all the floating toys. But sometimes, he had too much fun! One day, while zooming around the tub, Pippo found himself in a new place: the big tub, the one that filled up with water when someone took a shower.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Pippo. “I can’t get back to my cuddle nest! I’m lost!” He tried to move his fins, but everything seemed farther away. The tub was full of water and Pippo didn’t know how to get out.

Pesco Pippo tried to jump out of the tub, hoping to land on the edge. But the surface was too slippery! He slid back, ending up back in the water. He was frustrated.

Then, he had an idea! He started to move his fins quickly, in a perfect circle. The water began to swirl around him, creating a whirlpool. Pippo found himself spinning faster and faster. 

With a splash of water, Pippo reappeared right near his cuddle nest, full of soft towels and plushies. He was happy! He settled down there, glad to be home. Pippo the Fish’s perseverance made all the difference.

plan.problema: Fish Pippo got lost in the tub and can't get back to his home!
plan.svolta: He tried to jump out, but it was too slippery!
plan.finale: Then he did a dizzy spin and, with a splash of water, he appeared again near his cuddle nest.

fish.text:
Fish Nemo was a very lively fish. He lived in a bright aquarium, full of colors and floating plants. He was a special fish because he could talk and move! He loved to play with his coral friends, but sometimes he got lost among the green leaves and the glass of the aquarium.

One day, Fish Nemo was exploring a new area near the rock. He was trying to reach his coral friends, who were playing hide-and-seek behind a big mushroom. But he got lost! The plants were so many and all looked alike, so he couldn’t figure out where he was.

Fish Nemo started to swim quickly, hoping to find his friends. He moved straight, then to the right, then to the left. But the faster he swam, the more confused he got! He couldn’t see anything clearly among the green leaves and the reflection of the light on the water.

Suddenly, a small blue sea urchin approached Fish Nemo. The sea urchin looked at him with his little black eyes and pointed with a paw in the direction of a group of happy corals that were laughing and jumping. “Follow this path,” said the sea urchin.

Fish Nemo thanked the sea urchin and followed his directions. Soon he reached his coral friends, who welcomed him with hugs and laughter. Fish Nemo felt happy to be back home. He realized that sometimes, to find the right way, you have to slow down and look carefully. And so, Fish Nemo learned to wait a little while before letting impatience take over.

plan.problema: Nemo the fish is lost among the plants and can’t find his coral friends.
plan.svolta: He tried to swim faster, but only got more confused!
plan.finale: A little sea urchin kindly pointed him towards the group of happy corals.

fox.text:
Fox was a very lively teddy fox. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of fragrant roses and colorful flowers. Fox loved to explore the garden, but sometimes he got lost among the many plants.

---

One day, while playing hide-and-seek with the roses, Fox realized he was lost. He had ended up in a maze of red roses and white roses. He couldn't find his little wooden house next to the big apple tree anymore.

---

Fox was a little scared. He tried to find his way around, turning right, then left, but every path seemed the same as the other. He felt frustrated and wanted to go home. 

---

Suddenly, Fox smelled something delicious: the scent of his favorite cookies! His mom, a pink plush bunny, always made him cookies before going to bed.

---

Fox decided to follow the scent. He moved between the roses, trying to follow that sweet smell. The scent became stronger and stronger. After a while, Fox saw a light and found himself in front of a door. It was the door to his little house!

---

Inside were his plush family: Dad the blue wolf, his little sister the white marmot, and all his friends. They were all so happy to see him. Fox was so happy to be home. 

---

Fox realized that even when you get lost, you shouldn't give up and try to follow what you like. And in the end, everything always works out.

plan.problema: Fox got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his little house.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the scent of his favorite cookies, hoping it would lead him out of the maze.
plan.finale: The scent led him directly to the door of his little house, where he was happily greeted by his plush family.

fox.text:
Fox was a soft plush fox, with sparkling black eyes. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of fragrant roses and colorful flowers. Fox loved to run among the plants, but he also enjoyed just sitting and watching the insects fly around.

One day, Fox decided to go on a big adventure. He squeezed through the rose bushes, stretching to explore the maze that formed between the flowers. But soon he realized a problem: he was lost! The roses were so many, so similar, and the paths crossed endlessly. Fox felt a little sad. He couldn't find his way out.

Fox looked around, searching for a clue. He saw a small stream flowing between the stones. “Maybe this will help me,” he thought. Then, Fox began to follow the stream, pushing with his plush paws along its bank. The stream was slow, but Fox didn’t give up. He kept going forward, hoping it would take him out of the maze.

After a while, the stream made a sweet gurgle and suddenly, Fox found himself right in front of the door of the Secret Garden! His friend the butterfly Luna was waiting for him, along with other little friends. Everyone was happy to see him. Fox was happy to be home. Perseverance had done its magic.

plan.problema: Fox got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his way out.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the stream, hoping it would lead him out of the maze.
plan.finale: The stream brought him right in front of the door to the secret garden, where his friends were waiting for him with joy.

fox.text:

Fox quickly found himself lost. All the roses were the same, tall and fragrant. He couldn’t understand where he was going. He turned around, he turned around, but every time he found himself facing another identical rose. He was very scared. Fox cried, his red fur crumpled.

Then he had an idea! He saw a small stream running between the roses. “Maybe,” thought Fox, “the stream will take me out of the maze!” He went towards the stream and started to follow it. The water was cool and bubbly. The stream guided him along a narrow path between the roses.

After walking for a long time, the stream became wider. Fox saw a green door in front of him! It was the door of the Secret Garden! Fox ran towards the door and came out right into his favorite place: under the apple tree. He settled down there, happy and content. He had learned that even when things seem difficult, finding calm and following your instincts can lead to the solution.

plan.svolta: He decided to follow the stream, hoping it would take him out of the maze.

plan.morale: Patience is the key to solving problems.

“Rocco? Rocco!” Leo called, but nobody answered. The Secret Garden seemed bigger and a little scary now. Leo was worried. He looked everywhere, under the lavender bushes, behind the apple tree. But Rocco wasn’t there.

Leo had an idea. His spotted fur could help him blend in with the flowers! He crouched among the red roses and tried to pretend to be a spotted rose. But Rocco was too curious to be seen! He jumped from flower to flower, exploring the garden.

Leo began to feel frustrated. He decided to do something different. He closed his eyes, took a deep breath, and started to roar loudly: “Roar! Roar!” The sound echoed in the Secret Garden. After a while, he heard another roar, closer. Rocco ran towards the sound, happy to find his friend. They hugged among the roses. 

Leo the Jaguar relaxed and smiled. He had learned that sometimes, even when you are lost, a little patience can make a difference. And now he knew that friendship is always worth waiting for.

The smell of lavender was so strong that Leo closed his eyes. Suddenly, he saw something! Teddy bear Bruno was playing with colorful stones, red, yellow, and blue. Bruno was having fun building a little tower. 

Leo the Jaguar ran to Bruno, happy to see him again. He hugged him tight, tight. “Bruno, I was lost!” he said. Bruno replied, “Don’t worry, Leo! I was just here playing!”

Thanks to the smell of lavender and the patience of Leo the Jaguar, they found each other. It was nice to go back to playing together in the Secret Garden. Sometimes, you just have to wait a little while to see things clearly.

After a long day of playing in the river, Leo the Jaguar realized that even when things are difficult, you shouldn’t give up. And so, with renewed energy, he continued to play in the Flowery Meadow.

Leo the Jaguar thought he had to do something. He decided to use his pointy nose to sniff the air. He took a deep breath, trying to smell Rocco’s scent. The scent was faint, but there it was! Leo started to run, following the smell among the plants.

He ran between the trees, under the bushes and around the fountains. Leo’s nose worked hard. Finally, he smelled the strongest scent. He stopped under a big apple tree, exactly where Rocco was sleeping peacefully. 

“Rocco!” shouted Leo the Jaguar happily. Rocco opened his eyes and smiled at Leo. They were so happy to find each other! Leo the Jaguar realized that even when things seem difficult, if you keep trying and use your strength, you can always find a way out.

plan.problema: Leo had gotten lost among the tall roses in the garden and couldn’t find his crocodile friend, Rocco anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his sensitive nose to sniff the air and follow the scent of Rocco.
plan.finale: Finally, Leo found Rocco under a large apple tree, happy to have found him!

giaguaro.text:
Leo the Jaguar was a very lively teddy bear. He lived in the Flowery Meadow, a place full of green grass and colorful flowers. Leo loved to run among the flowers, jump on the tall grass, and play with the wind.

One day, while chasing a blue butterfly, he found himself lost. He couldn't see his butterfly family flying around the sunflowers anymore. He was all alone, very alone! “Where am I?” thought Leo the Jaguar. He looked everywhere, but he couldn't find them.

Then, he decided to do something. He tried to roar, roar, roar! But the wind blew away his roar and only answered with a whistle. “It doesn’t work!” said Leo the Jaguar, disappointed.

He closed his eyes and sniffed the air. He smelled a sweet smell, a very sweet smell. It was the smell of the most beautiful flowers in the Flowery Meadow! He decided to follow that smell. He moved slowly, step by step, following the scent trail.

Suddenly, he saw a mommy butterfly flying towards him. It was a blue butterfly, just like the one he had been chasing! The mommy butterfly surprised Leo the Jaguar and hugged him with her colorful wings. “Leo, you were lost!” said the mommy butterfly happily.

Leo the Jaguar felt immediately safe and happy. He was surrounded by his butterfly family. He learned that sometimes it just takes a little patience and lots of curiosity to find what you are looking for. The Flowery Meadow seemed even more beautiful when he was with his family.

plan.problema: Leo got lost in the meadow and couldn't find his butterfly family.
plan.svolta: He tried to roar loudly to get attention, but only the wind answered.
plan.finale: Leo followed the sweet scent of the flowers and was found by his butterfly mom who was hugging him with her colorful wings.

giaguaro.text:
Leo the Jaguar was a very brave stuffed jaguar.
He lived in the Green Meadow, a big field full of tall grass.
Leo loved to run among the plants, jump on the bushes, and play hide-and-seek with the wind.

One day, while chasing a yellow butterfly, Leo went too far.
He found himself all alone, in the middle of the meadow.
He couldn’t recognize the way to go home anymore.
The Green Meadow seemed huge and scary without his friends.

Leo wanted to find his crocodile family.
They were gentle crocodiles and always smiling.
But he couldn’t find them!
He shouted loudly: “Help! Where are you?”
But the wind was too strong.
His voices were muffled, nobody heard him.

Leo felt sad and a little scared.
Then, he saw a little blue bird.
The bird flew up and down, as if it was pointing something out.
Leo followed the bird with his eyes.

The bird led him to the river.
And there, right on the edge of the water, was his crocodile family!
They were happy to see Leo the Jaguar.
They hugged him and played with him. 

Leo the Jaguar was happy.
He had found his family thanks to the courage to follow the bird and the kindness of the crocodiles.
The Green Meadow didn’t seem so scary anymore when he was back in the warm arms of his friends.

plan.problema: Leo had gotten lost in the meadow and couldn't find his family of crocodiles.
plan.svolta: He decided to shout as loud as he could, but his cries were muffled by the wind.
plan.finale: A little bird led him to the river where the happy crocodiles lived.
plan.morale: Courage and help can solve any problem.

giaguaro.text:
Giaguaro Leo was in the Flowery Meadow. He was a teddy bear jaguar, soft and fluffy. He loved to run among the daisies and sunflowers. One day, while chasing a blue butterfly, he had gone too far. Now he couldn't find his way back.

It was all so big! The plants were tall, the trees enormous. Giaguaro Leo felt lonely and a little scared. He desperately searched for his family of butterflies: the yellow and black butterflies that he loved so much. But he couldn't see them anywhere.

“Mommy? Daddy?” called Giaguaro Leo, but the wind only carried the sound of the bees buzzing. He was very sad. Then he had an idea! He decided to do something strong. He started to roar. A big, powerful roar that echoed in the Flowery Meadow.

The noise attracted the attention of a little ladybug. “What are you doing, Giaguaro Leo?” asked the ladybug, approaching cautiously. “The butterflies are over there!” she pointed with her head towards the center of the meadow.

Giaguaro Leo continued to roar, louder than before. The butterflies, attracted by the sound, began to fly towards him. They followed Giaguaro Leo, who ran and jumped through the flowers. They arrived at the center of the meadow, where his family of butterflies was waiting anxiously. The mommy butterfly ran to him to hug him with her soft wings.

Giaguaro Leo was happy. He had found his family and had learned that even when you are lost, you must keep looking and try new things. Because in the end, perseverance always leads to success.

plan.problema: Leo had gotten lost in the meadow and couldn’t find his butterfly family.
plan.svolta: He decided to make a loud roar, hoping the butterflies would hear him and lead him to them.
plan.finale: The butterflies, attracted by his roar, followed him to the center of the meadow, where his butterfly family was waiting anxiously.

giaguaro.text:
Leo the Jaguar was a very special jaguar. He could move and talk! He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. It was his favorite place.

---

One day, Leo was playing with Rocco, his crocodile friend. They had walked too far and suddenly Leo got lost. The roses were so big and red that they had swallowed him up! He couldn't see Rocco anywhere. “Rocco? Rocco!” he shouted, but nobody answered.

---

Leo was very worried. He was a brave jaguar, but he didn't know what to do. He crouched down, thinking carefully, trying to figure out where his friend had gone. He decided he would try to crawl under the fragrant lavender bushes. Maybe there was a new path from there.

---

Leo pushed his way through the purple flowers, moving slowly and carefully. He tried not to bump into the leaves and not to make any noise. At one point, he smelled a strong and familiar scent: basil! And then... he saw a smile hidden behind a giant basil leaf.

---

“Leo!” shouted Rocco, happy to see him. He had just hidden to wait for him. Leo jumped on him, happy. The Secret Garden seemed even more beautiful when he had found his friend. 

---

Leo the Jaguar understood that sometimes you have to be patient and look calmly to find those you love.

plan.problema: Leo got lost among the roses and couldn't find his friend, Rocco the crocodile.
plan.svolta: He decided to crawl under the lavender bushes to look for a new path.
plan.finale: Rocco greeted him with a lovely smile, hidden behind a giant basil leaf!

giraffa.text:
Gerry the giraffe lived in the Flowery Meadow. He was a soft cloth toy, with glass eyes and rubber hooves. Gerry loved the meadow, the yellow daisies, and the green grass. But Gerry had a little problem.

There was a big apple tree in the meadow. Its leaves were juicy, perfect for a tasty meal. Unfortunately, Gerry couldn’t reach them! His neck was too long and the leaves were too high. Gerry felt a little sad.

He thought about what to do. He decided to use his long neck to make sudden jumps. He jumped up and down, trying to stretch towards the tree. But every time he fell clumsily! He wobbled, slipped on the hay, and always ended up on the ground with a thump.

A little blue butterfly, Zephyr, landed on Gerry’s head. “Don’t give up!” said Zephyr. Gerry listened to her and made one last effort. He used all his strength to lift himself up high, gracefully. He managed to reach the juiciest leaves of the apple tree!

Gerry started to eat the leaves, offering some to the butterflies that were flying around. Zephyr danced happily among the leaves and buds. Gerry felt very happy. He had learned that with a little effort, even the most difficult goals can be achieved.

plan.problema: Gerry can’t reach the juiciest leaves of the apple tree.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his long neck for sudden jumps, but he ended up falling clumsily.
plan.finale: With one last effort, Gerry rose gracefully and reached the leaves, sharing them with the butterflies.

giraffa.text:
Gigi was a cloth giraffe, a little faded from the sun of the Flowery Meadow. She loved that meadow very much, full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Every day, Gigi stood up with her long neck to eat the leaves.

But there was a problem! The juiciest leaves grew high up, on the biggest tree in the meadow. Gigi stretched her neck, but she never quite reached them. It was so frustrating! “I wish I could reach those leaves,” thought Gigi.

One day, Gigi had an idea. She decided to climb along the trunk of the tree. She started to climb, slowly, but every time she slipped backwards! She always found herself in the same place, right under the leaves she wanted. A little caterpillar, called Leo, watched him with curiosity.

Gigi calmed down a little. Then, she understood something important. She started to move her neck forwards and backwards, pushing the lower flowers up. With patience, Gigi was able to make some leaves fall directly in front of her little feet! The juicy leaves were finally within reach.

Gigi relaxed, pleased with her work. She had learned that even if things seem difficult at first, with a little patience and perseverance, you can reach your goals. Gigi continued to eat the leaves, happy and content. The sun shone on the Flowery Meadow, and Gigi knew that the most important thing was never to give up.

plan.problema: Gigi couldn't reach the juiciest leaves of the tree.
plan.svolta: She decided to climb down the trunk, but she always slid back!
plan.finale: She realized she could use her neck to push the flowers up, and then the leaves were within reach.

giraffa.text:
Gigi was a very happy stuffed giraffe. He lived in the Flowery Meadow, a place full of colorful and fragrant flowers. Every day Gigi loved to look at the trees, especially the biggest apple tree in the meadow. Their leaves looked so juicy and inviting!

Gigi really wanted to reach the highest leaves of the tree. It was a strong wish, but every time he stretched his neck, the leaves remained out of reach. “What a trick!” Gigi thought, frustrated. “I’m too short!”

One morning, Gigi had an idea. “Maybe I can climb on the meadow!” he exclaimed. He started to move forward and backward on the soft ground. But the ground was so slippery! With a squeak, Gigi lost his balance and rolled down the slope, ending up in a pile of red leaves.

He got up, a little confused. Then he remembered his long neck. “Maybe I can use it as a ladder!” he thought. With great care, Gigi began to slide his neck upwards, holding onto the apple tree’s leaves. Slowly, slowly, he reached the juiciest leaves!

He ate them with pleasure and then, using his neck as a cup, he made a delicious tea with the freshest leaves. A little squirrel, Leo, watched him curiously. Gigi smiled. It was the best tea he had ever drunk. 

Gigi felt proud of himself. Perseverance and cleverness had made the difference. That’s exactly how you always get the results you want.

plan.problema: Gigi can't reach the highest leaves of the apple tree.
plan.svolta: She decided to climb the meadow, but the ground was too slippery and she slid down.
plan.finale: Using her long neck as a ladder, Gigi managed to reach the juiciest leaves and make a delicious tea!

giraffa.text:
Gigi was a patchwork giraffe, with a long neck and brown hooves.
He lived in the Flowery Meadow, a place full of colorful flowers and tall trees.
Every morning, Gigi woke up excited to eat the tastiest leaves from the trees.
But there was a small problem: Gigi was too short!
The best leaves were always too high up.

Gigi tried to jump, to drag himself along the ground, but nothing worked.
He felt frustrated. “Oh no,” thought Gigi, “I can never reach the treats!”
A little squirrel named Pio was watching him from a branch.
Pio was curious and wanted to help Gigi.

Gigi had an idea! He saw lots of fallen leaves scattered on the meadow.
With patience, he collected the biggest leaves and made them fall into a small ramp.
He created a little slide. Gigi climbed up the ramp and… he slid down quickly!
It was fun!

Gigi kept sliding, higher and higher, until he reached the branches of the tallest trees.
He could finally eat the juiciest and most fragrant leaves.
Gigi jumped happily. “I did it!” he shouted.
Pio came closer to Gigi, surprised and happy.

Gigi invited all his animal friends from the Flowery Meadow: the birds, the butterflies, and even the rabbit.
Together they ate the most beautiful leaves and had a big feast.
Gigi was happy and knew that with courage and a little ingenuity, you can achieve any goal.

plan.svolta: She decided to use a small slide made of dry leaves to speed up her descent.
plan.finale: Finally, with a happy jump, she reached the delicacies and invited her friends to join her feast.

Gigi wanted to eat those leaves so much. But he was too short! He couldn't reach the highest branches of the tree. He would huddle down, stretch his neck, but it was never enough. “Oh no!” Gigi would say, frustrated. “I really wish I could get to the top!”

One day, Gigi had an idea. He decided to climb the tree. He grabbed the branches with his little plush legs. He climbed, climbed, climbed! But every time he got close to the top, he would slide down, falling to the ground with a soft thump. “Ugh!” Gigi would exclaim, getting back up.

Then, while he was resting under the tree, he saw a ladybug flying around the branches. Another idea popped into his mind. Gigi began to stretch his neck towards the tallest leaves, gently pushing them down. The leaves fell, dropping right into the meadow!

Gigi ate lots of juicy leaves. He was happy and satisfied. He had learned to use his special feature in a clever way. And as he rested in the shade of the tree, Gigi thought that even the hardest things can be done if you take your time.

The most beautiful trees had the juiciest leaves at the top! Gigi wanted to eat them so much, but he was too short to reach them.

Gigi moved back and forth in the meadow, trying to stand on his tiptoes, but it wasn’t enough. His legs were short and his neck was long. He felt a little frustrated. “Oh no!” Gigi would say, “I can never reach the best leaves!”

One day, while he was sitting under a big pine tree, he saw Leo, the squirrel. Leo was very lively and loved to climb trees. “Hello Gigi!” said Leo. “Why are you so sad?” Gigi explained his problem: he couldn’t eat the tastiest leaves.

Leo had an idea! “Try to use your legs to push yourself forward!” suggested Leo. “You could move towards the tree and then stretch your neck!” Gigi took a deep breath. He focused and tried to stretch his neck even further, but he lost his balance! He fell to the ground with a soft thump.

Leo ran to help Gigi. With small pushes of his legs, Gigi was able to reach the juicy leaves of the tree. Gigi was so happy! “Thank you, Leo!” said Gigi. “If you hadn’t been my friend, I would never have eaten these delicious leaves!” Gigi and Leo remained friends in the Flowery Meadow, always ready to help each other.

“I can’t do it!” said Gerry, with a sigh. He decided to climb the trunk of the tree. He began to climb, step by step, but every time he slipped down! He wrinkled his nose, he was frustrated. A red ladybug landed on his leg and looked at him curiously.

Gerry thought for a while. Then he had an idea. He began to stretch his long neck, slowly, very slowly. He stretched, he slowed down, then he stretched again. With patience, he managed to reach the highest leaves of the tree! He pulled them off gently and ate them happily.

Gerry felt satisfied and happy. He had learned that even if something seems difficult, with calmness and perseverance you can always find the solution. Gerry continued to stretch his neck to collect more delicious leaves. The ladybug flew away, leaving Gerry alone with his victory.

gorilla.text:
Grugno was a teddy bear gorilla who was very happy. He lived in the secret garden behind the house. The garden was full of colorful flowers, tall trees, and lots of insects that flew around. Grugno loved to explore every corner of the garden.

---

One day, Grugno noticed something terrible: he had lost his favorite banana! It was a yellow banana, soft, and juicy. Grugno really wanted it. “Oh no!” said Grugno. “Where did I put it?”

---

Grugno started to look everywhere. First, he looked near the water fountain. Then, he went to the fragrant roses. He looked among the red and pink petals, but the roses were too fragile. Grugno tried to pull a little, but all the roses broke! “Oh no, oh no!” repeated Grugno.

---

He felt very frustrated. He decided to stop for a moment. He closed his eyes and took a deep breath. Then, slowly, he curled up under the big apple tree. The roots of the tree were big and soft. And there, right among the roots, was his banana!

---

Grugno took it with his little hands and smiled. He was so happy to have found it. The sun shone on the secret garden and Grugno felt very content. He had learned that sometimes you have to slow down and look carefully. Grugno curled up under the tree, eating his banana and watching the clouds.

plan.problema: Gruff has lost his favorite banana and doesn't know where to look.
plan.svolta: He tried to rummage through the roses, but they were too fragile and they all broke!
plan.finale: He huddled under the big apple tree and found his banana hidden among the roots.

gorilla.text:
Grugno was a very happy teddy bear gorilla. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of flowers and big trees. Grugno loved to play among the leaves and slide on the grass. He had a favorite banana, a juicy yellow banana that he really, really liked.

One day, Grugno noticed that his banana was gone. “Oh no!” he exclaimed. “Where did it go?” He looked everywhere under the lavender bush and behind the apple tree, but the banana was missing. He was very sad.

Grugno decided to do something. “I must find my banana,” he thought. So he started to follow his footprints in the wet ground. The footprints were small and clear, as if someone had walked with a happy step. Grugno followed the footprints to the edge of the Secret Garden.

Suddenly, he saw a little squirrel jumping between the flowers. The squirrel had Grugno’s banana in his hand! “Are you playing with my banana?” asked Grugno. The squirrel replied, “I just wanted to roll it!”

Grugno got his banana back and hugged it tight. He found it right under a rose bush, where the squirrel had put it for fun. Grugno thanked the squirrel, and they waved goodbye to each other with a nod. He was happy to have found his favorite banana. Grugno realized that even a little kind gesture could solve a problem.

gorilla.text:
Grugno was a teddy bear gorilla who was very, very hungry. He lived in the secret garden behind the house. The garden was full of fragrant roses and colorful flowers. Grugno loved to climb on the plants and hide among the leaves.

One day, Grugno was playing hide-and-seek among the red roses. He had so much fun that he didn’t notice how far he had moved away from his spot. Now, he couldn’t find his wicker basket where he lived. It was all red and smooth, perfect for resting after a day full of adventures.

Grugno tried to turn around, to move his arms, but he was always surrounded by roses. He felt a little sad. “Help!” shouted Grugno with all his might. But his shout was too loud and scared the butterflies that were flying around the flowers. The butterflies flew away terrified.

Grugno realized that it wasn’t useful to shout. He calmed down and closed his eyes. He listened carefully. He heard a sweet song, the wind blowing through the flowers. The wind gently guided him towards a secret path made of dry leaves.

Grugno followed the wind. Slowly, he found himself near the wicker basket. It was right there! Grugno crawled inside happily. He settled down with a sigh of relief. The garden was beautiful, but it was even more beautiful when everything was quiet. Grugno understood that sometimes, silence is the key to finding your way.

plan.finale: Grumble found his way thanks to the gentle singing of the wind blowing among the flowers.

gorilla.text:
Gigi was a teddy bear gorilla. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of flowers and tall trees. Gigi loved bananas very much. Every day he tried to grab one with his hands, but one day something bad happened. Suddenly, all his fingers disappeared! He didn’t know how to hold the fruit anymore. He was so sad.

Gigi moved slowly through the garden, trying to figure out what to do. He tried to use his big arm to look for his fingers, but it was too long. He looked everywhere, under the roses and behind the trees, but nothing! His fingers were scattered all over the lawn.

“Oh no!” said Gigi with a sigh. “It’s impossible to find all my fingers so quickly.” Then he had an idea: he would use his arm to collect the scattered fingers. He started to move, but it was too tiring. Gigi’s arm was very long and the fingers were far away.

Suddenly, he heard a light breeze. It was the whispering wind of the garden! The wind began to play with Gigi’s fingers, picking them up gently one at a time. The wind carried them towards Gigi, who picked them up with his big arm.

Gigi smiled happily. He had all his fingers back! He was happy and content. The whispering wind continued to play in the garden, while Gigi relaxed under a tree. Gigi realized that even the biggest problems can be solved with calmness and patience.

plan.problema: Gigi had lost all her fingers and couldn't figure out how to hold the bananas anymore!
plan.svolta: She decided to use her big arm to collect her scattered fingers in the field, but it was too long and tiring.
plan.finale: Thanks to the breezy wind, Gigi collected all her fingers and smiled satisfied.

gorilla.text:
Gigi was a very special teddy bear gorilla. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of flowers and lush plants. Gigi loved to climb on the red and green roses, but sometimes he got lost among their strong smells.

One day, while playing hide-and-seek among the leaves, Gigi realized he was lost. He couldn’t find his place near the fountain anymore. “Oh no!” said Gigi, with a little scratchy voice. “I don’t know where I am!”

Gigi decided to follow the beaten path, the one the flowers follow to grow strong. But every time he took a step forward, he found himself in a different corner of the garden. He was lost among the white bells and the tall sunflowers.

A little squirrel, named Leo, saw him confused. “Are you looking for something?” asked Leo with his squeaky voice. Gigi explained his problem. Leo advised Gigi not to hurry and to keep looking calmly.

Gigi focused and continued to walk. Suddenly, he heard a familiar sound: the ringing of the bell he always wore around his neck. The sound was leading him! Following the sound, Gigi slowly approached the fountain. He was almost there!

Finally, with a big smile, Gigi returned to the fountain where it all began. He settled among the leaves and flowers, happy to be home. Patience had helped Gigi find his place.

plan.problema: Gigi got lost among the roses and couldn't find her way back.
plan.svolta: She decided to follow the beaten path, but every time she found herself in a different corner of the garden.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the sound of the bell she always carried with her, she returned near the fountain where it all began!

gorilla.text:
Gio was a very cuddly teddy bear gorilla. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of big flowers and plants. Gio loved to run among the roses and hide behind the lavender bush. But today he wasn't happy.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Gio. “I’ve lost all my favorite bananas! I had left them under the biggest tree in the garden.” Gio looked everywhere. He crouched among the dry leaves, rummaged in the grass, and climbed the little stone wall. But the bananas weren’t there.

Gio was sad. He sat under the tree, sighing deeply. “Maybe someone has seen them?” thought Gio. Then he had an idea! In the Secret Garden lived very lively squirrels. Maybe they could help him.

Gio went up to the big tree where he had lost his bananas and called to the squirrels. “Excuse me, Mr. Squirrels,” said Gio. “I’ve lost all my bananas! Can you help me find them?” The squirrels laughed. One of them, called Hazelnut, started pointing with his tail in one direction. Then another squirrel followed him. Gio followed them, running and jumping.

Finally, Gio found all his bananas! They had fallen into a little hole near the tree’s roots. Gio was so happy! The squirrels were happy for him. Gio thanked the squirrels and went back to play in the Secret Garden. They learned that working together makes everything easier.

plan.problema: Gio had lost all his favorite bananas under a big tree.
plan.svolta: After searching everywhere, Gio decided to ask for help from the garden squirrels.
plan.finale: The squirrels, amused, pointed him in the right direction and soon Gio found all his bananas in a small hole.

gorilla.text:
Gigi was a very friendly teddy bear gorilla. He lived in the garden at home, among the plants and flowers. It was his favorite world. Gigi loved to climb the lavender bush and pretend to sleep under the shade of the big apple tree.

---

One day, Gigi noticed that something wasn't right. His favorite banana, the yellow and juicy one that his friends always gave him, was gone! “Oh no!” said Gigi with a big sigh. “Where did it go?” He started to look everywhere. He checked under the lawn, near the fountain, and even inside his wooden toy house. But the banana wasn't there.

---

Gigi decided to try to look under the rose bush. He stretched out his furry arms and squeezed between the thorny branches. He only found fallen petals and lots of ants running away. “What a disappointment!” thought Gigi, a little discouraged.

---

But Gigi didn’t give up. He continued to look, slowly and calmly. Then, suddenly, he saw it! It was lying on the windowsill, next to his friend, Bruno the teddy bear. The yellow banana shone in the sunlight. 

---

Gigi jumped down from the rose bush and ran to the windowsill. “Bruno, you put it here?” asked Gigi to the teddy bear. Bruno only replied with a little smile. Gigi sat next to his friend, happy to have found his banana. 

---

Gigi realized that sometimes, you just need to wait a little while and look patiently to find what you are looking for.

plan.problema: Gigi has lost her favorite banana and doesn't know where to look.
plan.svolta: She tried to rummage under the rose bush, but only found petals and ants.
plan.finale: Suddenly, she sees it leaning against the windowsill, next to her teddy bear friend.

gorilla.text:
Gigi was a teddy bear gorilla. He lived in the Secret Garden. It was a magical place full of tall plants and fragrant flowers. Gigi loved to play there, but today he had gotten lost. “Oh no!” thought Gigi. “Where is Rocco?”

Rocco was his crocodile friend, a big green toy. Gigi had looked for him everywhere, behind the ferns and among the strawberry bushes. But Rocco wasn’t there. Gigi felt sad and a little scared. His sound-making ears, the ones that made “eh-eh” when you touched them, moved frantically.

He decided to take a long walk around the big rose bush. Gigi was a strong gorilla, but the roses were tall and fragrant. He tried to hear Rocco’s voice with his sound-making ears. “Rocco? Rocco!” shouted Gigi, but he didn’t hear anything except the rustling of the leaves.

Gigi kept walking around. Then, suddenly, he heard a sound. A happy roar! Gigi followed the sound and found himself right behind a waterfall of colorful flowers. There was Rocco, waiting for him with a smile. “Gigi!” said Rocco. “I was waiting for you!”

Gigi ran to hug his crocodile friend. He was so happy to be back from the Secret Garden. Gigi realized that sometimes, even when you get lost, you have to be patient and look carefully. And so, Gigi and Rocco continued to play together in their secret garden.

plan.problema: Gigi got lost among the tall plants and couldn’t find her crocodile friend, Rocco.
plan.svolta: She decided to take a long walk around the big rose bush, trying to hear Rocco’s voice with her mimetic ears.
plan.finale: Finally, she heard Rocco’s happy roar waiting for her right behind a waterfall of colorful flowers.

gorilla.text:
Gigi was a very strong teddy bear gorilla. He lived in the garden at home, among the roses and geraniums. He loved to climb the old apple tree and roll in the fresh grass. One day, while playing hide-and-seek with his friend Pippo, the white rabbit, Gigi got lost.

The big garden lawn suddenly seemed much bigger. Gigi looked for Pippo everywhere. He looked behind the yellow marigolds and under the fragrant lavender bush. But Pippo wasn't there. Gigi was worried. He didn't know where his little friend was.

Gigi felt more and more alone. He tried to call Pippo, but no one answered. It was too far away to be heard! Gigi thought that maybe if he shouted for help someone would listen. “Help! Help!” Gigi shouted with all his might. But the wind was blowing hard and no one heard his shout.

Suddenly, Gigi heard a small step. Pippo was running towards him! “Gigi!” Pippo shouted happily. The two friends hugged each other tightly, as strong as two gorillas and a rabbit. Gigi was so happy to find his friend again.

Now Gigi and Pippo were playing together under the apple tree. They had learned that when you get lost, it’s important to look for each other. And they realized that facing difficulties becomes much easier when you work as a team.

plan.problema: Gigi got lost in the big meadow and couldn’t find her friend, the bunny, Pippo.
plan.svolta: After searching everywhere, Gigi decided to shout for help, but nobody heard her.
plan.finale: Pippo, hearing Gigi’s cry, ran to her and the two friends hugged happily.

gorilla.text:
Grugnolo was a teddy bear gorilla. He lived in the secret garden behind Grandma and Grandpa’s little house. It was a place full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Grugnolo loved his garden very much. He spent his days playing among the roses and watching the butterflies.

One day, Grugnolo noticed that something wasn’t right. He had lost his favorite banana! It was a yellow banana, soft, and sweet-smelling. He looked everywhere, under the lavender bush, behind the fountain, but nothing. He couldn’t find his place in the garden.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Grugnolo. “Where did I put it?” He felt a little sad. He decided he had to do something. He used his strong arms to explore every corner of the garden, pushing the flowers and looking under the plants. The ladybug, Lila, watched him curiously.

Grugnolo found his courage. He moved away from his favorite spot and began to explore the garden in a different way. He touched every tree, every stone, every blade of grass. Then, suddenly, he felt something soft under a big green leaf.

Grugnolo bent down and pulled out his banana! It was right there, hidden under the big leaf, just where he had left his box. Grugnolo smiled happily. “I did it!” he said. 

Lila the ladybug greeted Grugnolo with a little chirp. Grugnolo put his banana back in his box and returned to his place in the garden. It was important to keep things in their place, thought Grugnolo as he relaxed in the sun.

plan.problema: Grumbles has lost his favorite banana and can't find his place in the garden.
plan.svolta: He decided to take an exploratory walk, using his strong arms to explore every corner of the garden.
plan.finale: He found the banana hidden under a big leaf, just where he left his box!
plan.morale: Order is important for finding things.

granchio.text:
Grey was a rubber crab, blue and grey. He lived on the sandy beach. He loved to run between the waves and hide under the rocks. Every day he made friends with other toys that lay on the sand.

One afternoon, Grey was playing with his friend Fish, a little yellow goldfish. They had fun jumping on the seaweed. Suddenly, Fish disappeared! Grey looked around. There was no more Fish. He was very worried.

“Oh no!” said Grey. “Where have I ended up? I must find my friend.” Grey was sad and a little scared. He looked everywhere, but Fish didn’t help him to find him.

Grey made a decision. He decided to follow the stream that flowed slowly on the beach. The water started from a small pond and made its way between the rocks. Grey crawled along the edge, following the water carefully. He was tired, but he didn’t give up.

After a long time, suddenly, he saw something yellow! Fish was swimming happily near a shiny shell, full of small seaweed. Grey ran to him and hugged him. “I did it!” exclaimed Grey. 

Fish wiggled happily around him, jumping between the waves. Grey felt happy and safe with his friend. Perseverance always helps to find what is most important to you.

plan.problema: Gray is lost from his friend the little fish and doesn’t know how to find him.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the stream that was flowing on the beach, hoping to find the little fish.
plan.finale: Finally, he saw the little fish swimming happily near a shiny shell.

granchio.text:
Grey was a rubber crab, dark blue and a little wobbly. He lived on the golden sand beach. Every day Grey loved to climb on the rocks and have a swim in the cool water. Today, though, he wasn’t happy. He was all alone. He had gotten lost!

“Stella? Stella!” shouted Grey, but his voice got lost in the sound of the waves. Stella was his best friend, a shiny white shell that often followed Grey while he walked on the sand. Today Stella wasn’t there.

Grey started to look around frantically. The beach seemed huge and full of new things: smooth pebbles, green seaweed, and even an old fisherman’s hat. Grey tried to crawl along the shore, hoping to find Stella. But Stella was too fast to catch! She moved too quickly among the shells.

Grey thought, thought, thought. Then he had an idea. He used his strong claws and started to scratch the water. Little waves formed and crashed on the sand. One of these waves brought Stella back! The white shell smiled at Grey.

“Thank you, Grey!” said Stella. “You were brave to look for me.”

Grey felt happy. He had found his friend again. Together, Grey and Stella continued to explore the sandy beach, hand in shell, or rather, claws in the sand. The most important thing was to have a friend by your side. Grey realized how wonderful it was to help his friend.
