plan.problema: Grey is lost and can't find his seashell friend, Stella.
plan.svolta: Grey tried to crawl along the shore, but Stella was too fast to reach.
plan.finale: Grey used his powerful claws to make little waves that brought Stella back to the beach.

granchio.text:
Grey was a blue and white rubber crab. He lived on the golden beach. He was a very lively crab, he loved to slide on the sand and make funny shapes with his claws. Grey had a large family: lots of other crabs who lived near him.

One day, while playing among the seaweed, Grey noticed he was alone. His brothers, his mom, and his dad were not there anymore. “Oh no!” thought Grey. “I’m lost!” He shouted loudly, but no one answered. It was all quiet and the sun warmed the sand.

Grey decided to do something. He decided to follow the waves. He thought the water would take him close to his family. He climbed onto a foamy wave, then followed another bigger one. But the wave was too strong! Grey was pushed away, far from the beach and further into the sea.

Grey felt tired and scared. He rested on the warm sand and waited. Suddenly he heard a sweet sound: the song of the cicadas. The cicadas were singing near him, in a precise direction. Grey listened carefully and understood that the song was leading him towards the beach.

Grey moved slowly, following the sound of the cicadas. After a while, he saw lots of crabs playing together! He ran happily towards them and joined his family. Grey rested on the sand, feeling safe and happy. Patience had helped him to find his friends.

plan.problema: Grey is lost from his family of crabs and doesn’t know how to find them.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the waves, hoping they would bring him closer to his home, but the wave pushes him away!
plan.finale: Grey rested on the sand and, thanks to the singing of the cicadas, he understood the right direction to return to his friends.

granchio.text:
Grey was a rubber crab. He lived on the sandy beach. He was a very happy crab, especially because he had a family! His brothers and sisters crabs always played together. Grey loved to run between the waves and dig holes in the sand.

One day, while Grey was chasing a starfish, he realized he was all alone. His family had disappeared! “Oh no!” thought Grey. “I don’t know where they are!” He felt a little scared. He looked for his crab parents, but he couldn’t see them anywhere.

Grey decided to follow the waves. He thought that maybe his family had gone further out to sea. But the water was too cold! The waves pushed him away and Grey ended up far from the beach. He was tired and sad.

Then, Grey had an idea. He saw a shiny little seashell. He took the shell in his claws and started to slide down the sand. He was having fun little slides! And while he was sliding, he noticed something familiar: it was his crab brothers looking for treasures too.

Grey ran to them and joined his family. All the crabs hugged him happily. Grey was happy to be back home. He had learned that, even when things seem difficult, you should never lose hope.

plan.problema: Grey was lost from his crab family and doesn't know how to find them.
plan.svolta: He tried to follow the waves, but the water was too cold and pushed him away.
plan.finale: Grey discovered a small shell and used his shell to make slides in the sand, finally finding his family!

granchio.text:
Grey was a plastic crab, very friendly. He lived on the golden beach, near a big rock topped with a red shell. Grey loved his rock. It was his home and his favorite place to eat seaweed.

 

One day, Grey had gone too far. He was looking for a particularly tasty piece of seaweed and didn't notice that his rock had become small in the distance. When he finally realized he was lost, he tried to call to the shell. “Who’s there?” he shouted. But nobody answered.

 

Grey was very worried. He couldn't find his rock. He started to walk along the golden beach, trying to figure out where it had gone. The wind was blowing hard and it ruffled his spikes. Grey tried to run, but he was too slow and the wind pushed him away.

 

“I have to do something different,” thought Grey. So, he rolled slowly inwards, like he does when he’s looking for a good place to hide. He followed the sound of the waves crashing on the beach. The waves pushed him and brought him back, but Grey didn’t give up.

 

Gradually, Grey got closer to his rock. He saw the red shell and ran towards it. He rolled one last time and finally touched his rock! He was happy to be back home. The sun was setting on the golden beach. Grey settled on his shell, satisfied with his journey. He had learned that even the most difficult things can be achieved with patience and perseverance.

plan.problema: Grey is lost from his rock and can’t find it.
plan.svolta: He tried to run along the beach, but the wind was messing up his quills!
plan.finale: Grey decided to roll slowly inwards, following the sound of the waves and, finally, he returned to his rock.
plan.morale: Patience helps you achieve your goals.

granchio.text:
Grey was a very friendly rubber crab. He lived on the golden beach, where he spent his days rolling and sinking into the sand. He had a little red shell as a house and especially loved a big rock near the shore. It was his favorite place in the world.

One day, Grey was playing and wandered too far from his rock. When he looked back, it was gone! He was completely lost. Grey was very sad. He wiggled in the white sand, trying to figure out where he had disappeared. He couldn't find his rock.

Grey thought he had to do something. He decided to use his strong claws to feel the wet sand. He followed the sound of the waves crashing on the shore. The waves swept away the sand and Grey, with his claws, tried to figure out the right path. 

Suddenly, Grey smelled a familiar smell: the salty smell of the sea and the rock! It was the smell of his rock! Grey moved quickly, running towards the scent. He finally reached his favorite rock and curled up happily nearby.

A little starfish, named Stella, greeted him with a smile. Grey was happy to be home. After so much searching, he had found his special place. Grey understood that you shouldn’t ever give up and keep looking, even when things seem difficult.

plan.problema: Grey is lost from his favorite rock and can’t find it.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his flippers to feel the sand, following the sound of the waves.
plan.finale: Finally, he detected the salty smell of his rock and ran towards it, happy to be home.

granchio.text:
Grey was a rubber crab, small and blue. He lived on the sandy beach. He loved to play hide-and-seek with his brothers and sisters. One day, while running to look for a special shell, Grey realized he couldn't hear them anymore. He was all alone!

“Mommy? Daddy? Little brother?” Grey shouted, but the beach was too big and the wind carried away his voices. He felt very sad. He didn't know where his family was. He was scared to be alone in the sand.

Grey thought about what to do. Then he had an idea! He decided to do a really great trick. He started to slide very, very fast on the sand, leaving a shiny trail as if it were made of gold. He slid up and down, back and forth. The sand seemed to be running after him.

A little chick, Leo, watched him curiously. “How lovely!” the chick exclaimed, while Grey continued to slide.

Grey didn't give up. He continued to make his shiny trail. After a while, the trail led him right to his dear crabs who were waiting anxiously for him. “Grey! You’re here!” they shouted all together. Grey ran towards them, happy to be back home. He hugged his mother and father and played all afternoon.

Perseverance helped Grey find his family.

plan.problema: Gray was lost from his crab family and couldn’t find them.
plan.svolta: He decided to do a great trick: he started to slide very fast on the sand, leaving a shiny trail!
plan.finale: Finally, the trail led him right to his dear little crabs who were waiting anxiously.

granchio.text:
Grey was a toy crab. He lived on the sandy beach. He was a dark blue crab, but he had a special shell: it shone in the sun. Grey loved the beach. He liked to climb on the rocks and roll in the sand.

One day, Grey was with his brothers and sisters. They were all playing hide-and-seek among the seaweed. Suddenly, Grey noticed that he couldn’t see them anymore. He felt lonely. He was lost from his crab family!

Grey looked everywhere. He dug in the sand with his claws. He shouted loudly: “Dad? Mom? Little brother?” But the sound of the waves covered his voice. He couldn’t hear them answering. Grey felt very sad.

He sat down on the shore and thought. Then, an idea! Grey looked at himself carefully. His shell shone with a thousand colors when the sun hit it. Grey understood: he could use the light to see!

Grey gripped his claws and pointed his shell upwards. The bright light reflected on the sand, creating a small beam. And that beam pointed in one direction! Grey followed the beam and heard a familiar sound: “Grey! Where did you disappear?”

His crab family was there, happy to see him. Grey ran among them, happy to be home. The sandy beach seemed even more beautiful with his family around. Grey understood that even when things seem difficult, you must always have faith and never give up.

plan.problema: Grey was lost from his crab family and can’t find them anymore.
plan.svolta: Trying to shout loudly, but the sound gets lost in the noise of the waves.
plan.finale: Grey discovered that his shiny shell reflects the sunlight and he could show his family the way.

granchio.text:
Grey was a very silly rubber crab. He lived on the golden beach and especially loved a little rocky outcrop right by the shore. Every day, Grey climbed onto his outcrop to take the sun and watch the waves coming to lap at the sand.

One day, Grey had gone too far. The waves had been strong and they had carried him away from his favourite outcrop. Grey felt very sad. He looked everywhere, but he couldn't find it. “Oh no!” thought Grey, “I’m lost!”.

Grey decided to do something. He used his strong claws to dig in the wet sand. He wanted to follow the tracks that the waves had left. The waves had made real pathways on the beach. Grey followed these pathways, moving slowly with his claws.

A seagull, named Pio, watched him from a distance. “What are you doing, Grey?” asked Pio. Grey explained his problem and Pio suggested he look carefully. The sun was shining brightly on the beach and the rays shone on the sand.

Suddenly, Grey recognised the shape of his outcrop! It was right there, under the warm sun. Grey ran quickly to the outcrop and climbed onto it straight away. He rested a little, happy to be back home. The sun warmed his claws and Grey finally felt calm. Grey realised that, even if there are sometimes difficulties, you must never lose hope.

plan.problema: Grey is lost from his favorite rock and can’t find it.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his pincers to follow the tracks of the waves in the sand.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the sun shining, he recognized his rock and ran to rest there.

granchio.text:
Grey was a plastic crab, dark blue. He lived on Sand Beach. He was a very active crab and loved to scuttle among the seashells. One day, Grey saw his friend, Blue, skipping happily nearby. They became good friends right away.

Suddenly, Blue disappeared! Grey looked everywhere. He dug in the sand, climbed on every pebble, but Blue was nowhere to be found. Grey was very sad. He didn’t know what to do. “Blue? Blue where are you?” he shouted, but the beach only answered with the sound of the waves.

Grey decided to keep looking. He looked under all the colorful seashells. He picked up a big, white one, then a pink and a green one. But Blue wasn’t anywhere. Grey felt a little discouraged.

Then he had an idea! “Wait,” thought Grey, “Blue loves the water!” So, Grey began to crawl along the shore, always towards the sea. He moved quickly, using his little claws to push himself forward. The sand was warm under his little feet.

Finally, he saw Blue! The little fish was swimming happily, skipping and making bubbles. Grey ran to him and climbed on his back. They hugged tightly. “I did it!” said Grey with a smile. 

Grey realized he shouldn’t give up ever, even when things seemed difficult. Perseverance had brought him to find his friend. And happiness is always within reach of those who truly believe.

plan.problema: Grey is lost from his little fish friend and doesn’t know how to find him.
plan.svolta: After searching under all the seashells, Grey had the idea to wiggle along the shore towards the water.
plan.finale: Finally, he saw his little fish friend swimming happily and swam over for a hug.

gufo.text:
Owl Pio lived in the Wildwood Forest. He was a soft, fluffy owl, perfect for cuddles. He loved his favorite feather very much, the softest of all. He always kept it in the right place in his nest, among the green leaves.

One day, Owl Pio noticed that the feather was gone! He looked everywhere: under the trees, behind the trunks, among the yellow flowers. But the feather was missing. Owl Pio was very sad. He couldn't sleep well without it.

He decided then to ask for help from the squirrels. The squirrels lived in the big beech tree of the Wildwood Forest and loved to collect nuts. Owl Pio flew to them, but the squirrels were too busy. They jumped from branch to branch, filling their pockets with nuts. “We don’t have time,” they said, “we have to prepare for winter.”

Owl Pio felt a little discouraged. Then, he looked carefully around. He saw a bush full of red and pink roses. And there, trapped among the petals, was his feather! Owl Pio gently took it and brought it back to his nest. He immediately put it in his favorite place.

Owl Pio felt better and fell asleep, happy to have his soft feather again. The Wildwood Forest was quiet and peaceful that night. Owl Pio realized that sometimes, to find what you’ve lost, you just have to look calmly and patiently.

plan.problema: Old Owl cannot find his favorite feather, the softest one.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the squirrels, but they were too busy collecting nuts to help him.
plan.finale: He found the feather trapped in a rose bush, and he brought it back to its place in the nest.

gufo.text:
Owl Pio lived in the Wildwood Forest. He was a stuffed owl, soft and with big black eyes. He loved to sit on the roots of the oldest trees and listen to the birds singing. One day, Owl Pio found himself completely alone. He had followed a blue butterfly and now he didn't know where he was. He couldn’t find his nest, a small space among the branches of a pine tree. He was scared!

“Oh no,” said Owl Pio, with a small voice. “I must go home!” He tried to fly, but he moved slowly. The Wildwood Forest seemed much bigger and confusing when you didn’t know the path.

Owl Pio made a decision. “If I want to find my nest, I must see everything from above!” So, he went on a frantic flight. He flew higher and higher, trying to spot something familiar. But as time went on, he realized he was just looking at the blue sky. There was nothing to see, just white clouds and the warm sun.

Suddenly, he heard a small rustle. A tiny squirrel, called Hazelnut, was looking at him curiously. “Are you lost?” asked Hazelnut. Owl Pio nodded. “Do you know the way to the nest?”

Hazelnut smiled and pointed in a direction. He flew gently towards the owl, guiding him through the trees. After a while, Owl Pio finally saw his nest! It was hidden among the branches of the trees, just like he remembered. Owl Pio thanked Hazelnut with a big smile. The kindness of a little squirrel had solved his problem.

plan.problema: Wise Owl has gotten lost in the forest and can't find his nest.
plan.svolta: He decided to fly as high as possible to have a better view of the land, but he found himself only looking at the sky.
plan.finale: A little squirrel gently led him to his nest among the tree branches.

gufo.text:
Bear was a very special owl. He lived in the Wildwood Forest and he could talk! He had soft brown feathers and big yellow eyes that always looked around. One day, Bear felt a little tired of hanging on his favorite branch. He decided to go for a walk.



He flew and flew, but the forest seemed much bigger than usual. Now Bear didn't know where he was! He was lost. He was scared. He couldn't find his cozy den under the roots of an old tree.



Bear tried to call his little squirrel friends. “Hello! Hello!” he shouted loudly. But nobody could hear him. He was too far in the forest. The little squirrels were hidden among the leaves and couldn’t hear his voice. Bear felt even more alone.



Then, Bear decided to do something different. He started to fly in circles, higher and higher. He shouted with all his might: “Help! Help!” His shout echoed among the trees.



Suddenly, a little white bunny named Pippina saw him. Pippina was one of the many bunnies that lived in the Wildwood Forest. The little bunny ran towards Bear and said, “I see you! You’re right here!”



Pippina pointed in the right direction. Following her directions, Bear finally reached his den. His mama owl was waiting anxiously. Bear snuggled up in her arms. From that day on, Bear always learned to be patient and not to go too far from his nest. The forest is full of surprises if you take the time to look at them calmly.

plan.problema: Bear got lost in the forest and couldn't find his den.
plan.svolta: Bear tried to call his squirrel friends, but nobody could hear him because he was too far away.
plan.finale: Bear started flying in circles, making a loud and clear cry until he was spotted by a little bunny who led him home.

gufo.text:
Oliver was a teddy bear owl, soft and light. He lived in the Wildwood Forest, among the tall trees and thick bushes. He loved to sit on an oak branch and watch the world. One day, Oliver moved too much. He slid down the branch and landed gently on the wet grass.

He realized right away that he was alone. He tried to go back to his place, but among the trees he couldn’t find his little house. The house was full of colorful feathers, little dreams, and a warm place to rest. Oliver felt scared. He didn’t know where to go.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Oliver, with a muffled voice. “I’m lost!” He tried to fly, but his fluffy wings were too light. He couldn’t lift himself off the ground. 

He decided he had to call for help. Oliver closed his eyes and made his loudest hoot: “Uuuuuh! Uuuuuuuh!” The sound echoed through the Wildwood Forest.

Right away, a little squirrel, Pipì, came closer. “What’s wrong?” asked Pipì. Oliver explained his situation. Pipì understood right away and ran to look for the other squirrels.

A few minutes later, a group of squirrels guided Oliver through the trees. They pointed him in the right direction with their little paws. Finally, they saw the little house! Oliver happily flew to his place. It was his home. The squirrels said goodbye to him and went away, happy to have helped Oliver.

Oliver settled back among his feathers, happy and safe. Help is always there, when you need it.

plan.problema: Oliver got lost and couldn't find his little house among the trees anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to call for help, making his loudest sound to attract the attention of his squirrel friends.
plan.finale: The squirrels happily guided him to his little house, full of feathers and dreams.

gufo.text:
Owl Bimbo lived in the Wildwood Forest. He was a small, fluffy owl, always ready to play a little trick. Owl Bimbo loved to fly among the tall trees and listen to the birds sing. But most of all, he loved to look at the stars at night.

One day, Owl Bimbo noticed a problem. “Oh no!” he exclaimed. “I can’t see the stars! I don’t have my glasses!” Without his little owl glasses, the world was gray and confusing. He couldn’t find the moon or the constellations anymore.

Owl Bimbo was worried in the forest. He looked among the dry leaves, under the bushes, but his glasses must not be anywhere. Then, he decided to ask for help from the wisest hedgehog in the Wildwood Forest, Riccardino. Owl Bimbo flew to Riccardino’s burrow and explained his problem to him. “I can’t see the stars without my glasses!” said Owl Bimbo, with a little sigh.

Riccardino listened carefully to Owl Bimbo. Then, he thought for a moment and said, “Owl Bimbo, do you remember playing near the biggest red mushroom in the forest?” Owl Bimbo scratched his head. “Oh! Yes!” he exclaimed right away.

Owl Bimbo quickly flew to the biggest red mushroom. And there, leaning on the soft cap of the mushroom, were his owl glasses! Owl Bimbo put them on and finally could see the stars shining in the night sky. 

Owl Bimbo realized that sometimes, the most important things are those that are close to us. It was important to keep track of everything you own.

plan.problema: Owl Bimbo can’t find his glasses, without which he can’t see the stars!
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the wisest hedgehog in the forest and explained his problem to him.
plan.finale: The hedgehog, with a little clue, pointed to Owl Bimbo where he had left his glasses, leaning against a red mushroom!
plan.morale: Be careful with the things you have.

gufo.text:
Owl Pio lived in the Wildwood Forest. He was a stuffed owl, soft and with big black eyes. He loved to hang from the biggest branch of the forest, watching the squirrels and bunnies. One day, while the wind was blowing hard, Owl Pio felt himself moving among the big leaves. The leaves had taken him and pushed him away from his place.

Owl Pio couldn’t find his nest. It was a small nest, made of moss and feathers, where his mama owl was waiting for him. He looked everywhere, but the leaves were too big and everything looked the same. “Oh no!” said Owl Pio, “I’m lost!”.

Then, he made a decision: he would fly higher! He needed a better view of the forest to find his nest. But as he rose higher and higher into the air, the fog became thicker. Owl Pio got even more lost. The fog was dense and made him confused.

A little squirrel, named Leo, saw Owl Pio in trouble. “Guide your flight!” shouted Leo, but Owl Pio didn’t understand where to go. Then, suddenly, a ray of sunshine shone through the fog. The ray of sunshine gently pointed the right direction.

Owl Pio followed the ray of sunshine and, slowly, he saw his happy family in the tallest branch of the forest. Mama Owl hugged him with her wings. Owl Pio was finally home. He had been a little patient waiting for the sun to guide him. He returned to his nest, happy to be safe and surrounded by the love of his family.

plan.problema: Wise Owl has gotten lost among the big leaves and can’t find his nest.
plan.svolta: He decided to fly higher to get a better view, but he got lost even more in the mist.
plan.finale: A ray of sunshine gently guided him towards his happy family in the highest branch.

gufo.text:
Owl Bruno lived in the Silvan Forest. He was a stuffed owl, soft and friendly. He loved to fly among the trees, watching the little animals move on the ground. He had a white feather, the softest of all. He always kept it with him, because it was his favorite.

One day, Owl Bruno noticed that the feather was gone. “Oh no!” he exclaimed. He first looked under his nest, then among the dry leaves. But the white feather had disappeared. He was very worried. He wanted to keep it safe so much.

He decided to ask for help from the old badger, the wisest in the forest. The badger lived in a hidden burrow among the tree roots. Owl Bruno flew to him and explained his despair. But the badger was too busy collecting red berries to understand what had happened. “I must gather these berries, little owl,” said the badger, without looking at him.

Owl Bruno didn’t give up. He continued to search everywhere in the Silvan Forest. He searched every corner, under every bush, between every root. He spent hours and hours looking at the ground and the plants. Finally, he found the feather! It was trapped in a rose bush, hidden among the white petals.

Owl Bruno felt happy. He recovered his favorite feather and hugged it tightly. He realized that sometimes, finding what you’re looking for takes time and patience. Owl Bruno returned to his nest, happy to have his white feather back in his paws.

plan.problema: Owl Bruno can't find his favorite feather, the softest and whitest.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the old dormouse, the wisest in the forest, but the dormouse was too busy collecting berries to understand what had happened.
plan.finale: Owl Bruno, after searching every corner of the forest, found the feather trapped in a rose bush and felt happy.
plan.morale: Patience is key to finding what you're looking for.

gufo.text:
Owl Pio lived in the Wildwood Forest. He was a soft, fluffy owl with big black eyes. Owl Pio loved to fly among the trees and watch the world below. But one morning, something strange happened. Owl Pio realized he couldn't see anymore! His eyes were like two pieces of burnt coal.

He was very worried. He didn't know where his nest was, the safe place to sleep and protect his little ones. He tried to lift his eyes, but everything was confused and gray. “Oh no,” said Owl Pio, “I’ve lost my sight!”

Owl Pio sat on a branch, thoughtful. Then he had an idea! His ears were big and powerful. Maybe he could use his ears to figure out where his nest was. He closed his eyes and listened carefully. He heard little songs. They were the little birds singing happily in the forest.

Owl Pio followed the sound with his ears. He moved from branch to branch, higher and higher. The birds’ song became louder. Finally, after a while, Owl Pio saw something: his nest! It was hidden among the tallest branches of the tree, protected by leaves and moss.

A little badger, Pipì, was watching him curiously. “Your mother is waiting for you,” said Pipì smiling. Owl Pio flew to the nest and joined his family. He was happy to be home. 

Owl Pio learned that even when things seem difficult, with a little effort and courage, you can always find the right way.

plan.problema: Wise Owl has lost his sight and can’t find his nest anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his big ears to figure out where it was and followed the sound of the birdsong.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the noise, he found his hidden nest among the tallest branches of the tree.

gufo.text:
Owl Pio lived in the Wildwood Forest. He was a soft, fluffy owl with big black eyes. He loved his nest very much, a cozy place among the roots of a big tree.

Owl Pio had a passion: decorating his nest with colorful feathers that he found in the forest.

But today there was a problem! His favorite feathers, the green and blue ones, were gone. Owl Pio looked around, but he didn’t see them anywhere. “Oh no!” he said, “Where have they gone?” He was very sad because he loved those feathers so much.

Owl Pio knew he had to ask for help. The most experienced in the Wildwood Forest at finding lost things was Hedgehog Ruggero. Owl Pio flew quickly to Ruggero’s nest, a small hole under a mossy rock. “Ruggero, Ruggero!” he called.

Hedgehog Ruggero came out curious. “What’s happening, Owl Pio?” he asked. Owl Pio explained his problem and Ruggero said, “I’ll follow you!” Together, they ventured into the forest. Ruggero followed the tracks with his nose.

Finally, they arrived at the stream that ran near Owl Pio’s nest. “Look!” exclaimed Ruggero. The green and blue feathers had been carried away by the water and were floating on the surface. Owl Pio quickly picked them up with his little feet. He was happy! 

Owl Pio thanked Ruggero for his help. Together, they returned to Owl Pio’s nest, where the owl decorated his home with the found feathers. Owl Pio realized that asking a friend for help can be a wonderful thing.

plan.problema: Owl Pio can’t find his favorite feathers to decorate his nest.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from Hedgehog Ruggero, the most experienced in the forest at finding lost things.
plan.finale: Hedgehog Ruggero led him to a stream where the feathers had been carried by the water, and Owl Pio happily recovered them.

gufo.text:
Owl Pio lived in the Wildwood Forest. He was a very special owl, because he could talk! He had big yellow eyes and soft feathers. But Owl Pio had a little problem. One morning, while he was flying between the trees, he lost his most beautiful feather, a feather white as snow.

After looking around, Owl Pio realized that he couldn’t fly straight anymore. He moved in jumps, spun around himself, and often fell down. He was very sad. “Oh no!” said Owl Pio, “I must find that feather!”

Then, Owl Pio decided to do something. He started to collect all the shiniest leaves he found in the Wildwood Forest. The leaves were green, yellow, and red. Some had a special light, as if they were covered with little stars. 

With patience, Owl Pio wove the leaves to create a strong and light harness. He tied it around his body, right under his wings. At first, he was a little unsure, but then he tried to take flight. 

Owl Pio lifted into the air! He flew straight, fast, and safely. He smiled happily. “I did it!” exclaimed Owl Pio. His harness of sparkling leaves had helped him to stay in flight. The little squirrel Stripe, who lived in the forest, watched him with admiration.

Owl Pio flew all afternoon, happy and free. Finally, with his harness made of sparkling leaves, he flew straight and happily! And Owl Pio understood that even when things seem difficult, if you persevere, you can reach your goal.

plan.problema: Wise Owl has lost his most beautiful feather and can't fly straight anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to collect all the shiniest leaves in the forest to make a harness to help him stay in the air.
plan.finale: Finally, with his harness made of glittering leaves, Wise Owl flew straight and happy!

leone.text:
Leo the lion was a very special lion. He could talk and he could even move! He lived in the Flower Garden, a place full of wonderful colors. Red roses, yellow sunflowers, purple tulips… So many flowers! Leo loved to look at the flowers, but sometimes he got lost among them.

One day, Leo found himself in the middle of a sea of petals. He couldn’t find his place anymore, the bench where he was sitting near the fountain. Everything was so confusing! The colors were too bright and the smells were too strong. Leo felt lonely and a little scared.

“Meow!” Leo shouted with all his might. He was trying to get someone’s attention, but nobody answered. Nobody heard him. Even the butterflies that were flying around the flowers didn’t seem to notice.

Suddenly, a little blue bird landed on a red rose. The bird looked at Leo with his black eyes and then fluttered its wings. It was pointing in a specific direction. Leo followed the bird with his eyes.

The bird flew towards the sun that was shining above the bench. Leo moved slowly, guided by the bird’s wing. Finally, he arrived at the bench! He was happy to be back in his place. 

Leo curled up near the fountain and watched the flowers calmly. He realized that sometimes, even a simple shout can make a difference. Maybe it was better to ask for help rather than getting lost.

plan.problema: Leo got lost among so many colorful flowers and couldn’t find his way back to his place.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his powerful voice to shout for help, but nobody seemed to hear him.
plan.finale: A little bird pointed at him with its wing, guiding him towards the sun shining above the bench where he was sitting.
plan.morale: Asking for help is always a good idea.

leone.text:
Leo was a very brave teddy bear. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Leo loved his secret garden more than anything in the world. He had a special gem, a little red ruby, that he always kept close in his fluffy tummy.

One day, Leo noticed that his gem was gone! It had disappeared! “Oh no!” said Leo. “Where could it be?” He started to look everywhere. He looked under the trees, between the big yellow and red flowers, but he couldn’t find the ruby. He was very worried.

Leo felt a little sad. He looked all over the garden, but the gem was still missing. Then he had an idea! Leo could use his powerful roar to get the attention of the other animals in the garden. “Maybe someone has seen it!” he thought.

Leo shouted, “ROAR!” A loud and clear sound that echoed through the Secret Garden. Suddenly, he heard a buzzing. It was a bee! The bee was flying around a giant leaf. Leo followed the bee and, there it was: his red ruby was hidden under the leaf!

Leo picked up his gem and held it tight. “I’ve got it!” he exclaimed happily. He was so happy to have found it thanks to his perseverance. Leo realized that even when things seem difficult, you should never give up.

plan.problema: Leo can't find his favorite gem, a little ruby.
plan.svolta: After looking under the trees and inside the flowers, Leo decides to use his powerful roar to attract the attention of the other animals in the garden.
plan.finale: The buzz of a bee leads him to the hidden gem under a giant leaf!

leone.text:
Leo was a teddy bear lion. A very brave lion and a little bit clumsy. He lived in a secret garden, full of colorful flowers and lush plants. It was his favorite place in the world.

---

One day, Leo was having fun jumping through bushes of red roses. The roses were so fragrant! He jumped too high and, when he stood up, he realized he didn’t recognize anything. He was surrounded by a maze of white and pink roses. He couldn’t find his way out anymore.

---

“Oh no!” said Leo. “I’m lost! I’m a really lost lion!” He turned around himself, but he couldn’t see which way to go. It was all the same, full of roses. He was getting more and more worried.

---

Leo decided to do something. He roared loudly, with all his strength. “Raaaaa-aaaaah!” The sound echoed in the secret garden. Suddenly, a little sparrow landed on a branch near him. The sparrow looked at him curiously.

---

Leo roared again, even louder. The sparrow flew in a circle around Leo, then started to fly in a precise direction. Leo followed him with his eyes, then with his body. The little sparrow was guiding him through the maze of roses.

---

After a while, they finally saw the light! Leo was near the exit of the secret garden. The sparrow flew around him for a moment, as if to say goodbye, and then flew away. Leo felt happy and relieved. He understood that even the smallest creatures can help if you ask for their help.

plan.problema: Leo got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his way out.
plan.svolta: He decided to call for help, roaring loudly to attract the attention of the pigeons.
plan.finale: A little pigeon guided him with circling flights to the exit of the secret garden.

leone.text:
Leo was a teddy bear lion. He lived in the Flower Garden. It was a garden full of big, colorful flowers. Leo loved that garden. Every day he enjoyed spinning among the fragrant petals.

One day, Leo decided to reach the top of the flower hill. The hill was full of yellow tulips, red roses, and white daisies. Leo wanted to see the view! But it was difficult. His fluffy paws slipped on the flowers. Leo fell down, down, down.

He had climbed up several times, but every time he slipped away. He was tired and a little frustrated. “Oh no,” thought Leo, “I never manage to do it!” Then, suddenly, he had an idea! His whiskers were long and soft. Maybe he could use them as ramps to climb!

Leo began to crawl with his whiskers on the hill. He used them like a staircase ramp. Slowly, but surely, Leo made his way up. It was a patient and hard job.

Finally, after many attempts, Leo reached the top of the hill! He was so happy! He turned around and roared loudly: “Uuuuuhhh!” The wind ruffled his fur. The view was fantastic. He could see the whole Flower Garden.

Leo felt proud of himself. He had shown that, with patience and determination, even a teddy bear lion can reach his goals. Leo continued to enjoy his victory.

plan.problema: Leo can't reach the top of the hill of colorful flowers.
plan.svolta: After climbing and sliding several times, Leo has the idea of using his whiskers as ramps to climb.
plan.finale: With patience and determination, Leo reached the top of the hill and celebrated with a big happy roar.

leone.text:
Leo the lion was happy in the Flower Garden. The roses smelled so sweet and the sun warmed his brown fur. Leo loved to play among the flowers, roll on the green grass, and imagine he was a real king.

---

One day, while climbing on a big red rose, Leo saw a little teddy bear. The teddy bear was sitting near a lavender bush and seemed to be waiting for him. Leo ran to the teddy bear, but when he arrived, the teddy bear was gone!

---

Leo looked around. The roses all looked the same and the garden seemed very big. He was lost! He looked for the teddy bear everywhere, under the leaves, among the yellow flowers, but nothing. He was all confused and a little scared.

---

He decided to shout for help, but his voice was too quiet to be heard. Nobody listened. Leo slumped down near a big daisy, sad and worried.

---

Suddenly, a little blue bird landed on a nearby rose. The bird looked at Leo with his black eyes and then flew towards the garden where Leo often played with his teddy bear. It sniffed the air, pointed with its beak towards a corner of the garden full of sunflowers.

---

Leo ran quickly in that direction and there, under a big sunflower, he found the teddy bear! He was happy to see him again. Leo understood that he shouldn’t give up, even when things seemed difficult. Perseverance had helped him find his friend.

plan.problema: Leo got lost among the roses and couldn't find his teddy bear anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to shout for help, but his voice was too weak to be heard.
plan.finale: Finally, a little bird pointed him towards the garden where he played with his teddy bear.

leone.text:
Leo was a very brave teddy bear. He lived in a beautiful garden full of colorful flowers. Red roses, yellow tulips, blue violets, and so many others. Leo loved to be there, watching the colors and the smell of the flowers.

One day, Leo was near a rose bush. The smell was so strong, so sweet! Leo got closer and closer, sniffing each flower. Soon, he got completely lost in the smell. He couldn’t figure out where he was! He was all alone and a little scared.

Leo took a big step. “I need to do something!” he thought. He listened carefully and heard a sound: buzzing! Bees were flying around the flowers, following their sweet nectar. Leo decided to follow them. He walked between the tulips, following the buzzing of the bees.

Suddenly, he saw a white butterfly, Beatrice. “Beatrice! It’s you!” Leo exclaimed. The butterfly flew towards him and brought him back to his place among the tulips, just where he belonged. 

Beatrice smiled at Leo. “It’s always better when you’re with friends,” she said. Leo settled back among the tulips, happy to be home. He understood that having friends is important.

plan.problema: Leo got lost in the intense scent of the roses!
plan.svolta: He took a leap and decided to follow the buzzing of the bees, hoping to find his way.
plan.finale: The sound led him to his friend Beatrice, the butterfly, who brought him back to his place among the tulips.

leone.text:
Leo was a very brave teddy bear. He lived in the Flower Garden, among fragrant roses and colorful flowers. Leo loved to explore the garden, but sometimes he had too much fun. One day, while playing hide-and-seek among the plants, he found himself in a difficult situation. He had gotten stuck inside a maze of roses!

The roses were so tall and dense that Leo couldn't see where he was putting his feet. He turned and turned, but every time he found only more roses. “Oh no!” said Leo, “I’m lost!”. He was sad and a little scared. He tried to go back, but it was all the same.

Leo decided he had to do something. He saw a little stream running among the plants. He thought, “Maybe the stream will take me out of this maze!”. So he started to follow the course of the water, climbing over small stones and going around the bushes.

The stream got wider and wider. Leo kept walking with determination. At one point, the stream reached a large, smooth stone. Behind the stone, Leo saw a door! It was the door to the Flower Garden.

A child’s mom was smiling and calling, “Leo! Where have you been?” The other children hugged him happily. Leo was happy to be back home. Perseverance had paid off.

plan.problema: Leo got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his way out.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the stream, hoping it would take him out of the maze.
plan.finale: The stream led him right to the gate of the garden, where his friends were waiting for him.

leone.text:
Leo was a teddy bear lion. He lived in the Flower Garden, among the colors and smells of the flowers. He loved to run among the plants, but sometimes he had too much fun. One day, while chasing a yellow butterfly, Leo got completely lost. He was surrounded by red, pink, and white roses. The roses were beautiful, but Leo couldn't find his friend Croco, the rubber crocodile.

Croco had always been there, near the big lavender bush. But now, Leo couldn't see him anymore! He was scared. “Croco? Croko!” Leo shouted, but his voice was lost among the soft petals of the roses. The lion’s roar was too loud for those delicate plants. It didn’t attract anyone’s attention.

Leo thought he had to do something different. He noticed that the biggest leaves were far from the lavender bush. He decided to rub against the biggest leaves, leaving a bright golden trail on the ground. He rubbed and rubbed, making a clear and bright path. 

After a while, he heard a “Croco!” coming from the direction of the golden path. Leo ran fast and there he saw him: Croco was waiting, smiling. Together they returned to the lavender bush, happy to see each other again. Leo realized that even when things seem difficult, you shouldn’t give up and keep looking. Perseverance always makes a difference.

plan.problema: Leo had gotten lost among the roses and couldn't find his friend, Croco, anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to call out loudly, but his roar echoed only among the fragile rose petals, without attracting Croco's attention.
plan.finale: Leo then began to rub against the larger leaves, leaving a golden trail that Croco could easily follow.

leone.text:
Leo was a teddy bear lion, very brave. He lived in a secret garden, full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Leo loved to explore his garden, but one morning he had gotten lost. He had ended up in a maze of red and pink roses! The roses were beautiful, but also confusing.

Leo tried to figure out where he was. He tried to follow the widest path, but he always ended up in another corner of the maze. He couldn’t see the exit and began to feel a little sad. “Oh no!” thought Leo. “I’m really lost!”

Leo decided to do something different. He closed his eyes and sniffed the air. He smelled many different scents: the scent of the roses, the scent of wet earth… and then, he smelled a sweet scent. It was a scent he knew well!

It was the scent of bees! The bees were flying around the flowers and Leo followed their scent. The bees guided him through the lavender bushes and towards a bright spot. Leo finally saw the sun! The sunlight made the roses around him shine. 

Leo was happy to be back in his place, near the big apple tree. He had learned that even when you get lost, following your senses can help you find your way. Leo settled down and waited for the next day for new adventures in the secret garden.

plan.problema: Leo had gotten lost in the maze of roses and didn’t know how to get home anymore.
plan.svolta: After trying to follow the widest path, Leo decided to sniff the air to find a familiar scent.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the sweet smell of his bee friends, Leo found his way towards the sun.
plan.morale: Patience and smell help to overcome difficulties.

leone.text:
Leo was a teddy bear lion. He lived in the Flower Garden, among fragrant roses and tall sunflowers. Leo loved to play there, to have naps in the sun, and to watch the insects. One day, while snuggled on the cool grass, he heard a voice. “Leo! Leo!” It was Pip, the fastest squirrel in the garden.

Leo tried to answer, but Pip had already disappeared among the tall grass. Leo realized he was lost. The lawn was so high that he couldn't see where Pip was going. “Oh no!” thought Leo. “I have to find him!”

Leo started to walk, trying to follow Pip’s tracks. He moved between the flowers and the plants, but Pip didn’t see him. Then he decided to take a big step forward. But he tripped over a daisy! Leo rolled down a small hill, ending up with his face in the dirt.

He got up, covered in dirt, and looked around. Then, he saw him! Pip was running towards him, jumping happily. “Leo! I’ve looked for you everywhere!” shouted Pip. He hugged Leo tightly, happy to find him.

Leo felt relieved. He was so happy to be with his friend. They snuggled together under a big sunflower, watching the butterflies. Leo understood that having a special friend was the most important thing in the world. Pip’s happiness was his happiness.

plan.problema: Leo got lost in the tall meadow and couldn't find his squirrel friend, Pippo.
plan.svolta: He decided to take a big step forward, but he tripped over a daisy and rolled down a small hill!
plan.finale: Pippo saw him and ran to hug him, happy to find him.

lumaca.text:
Lucio was a very special snail. He could talk and move! He lived in the Flowery Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and tall plants. Lucio loved his friend, the sunflower Arturo, very much. Arturo was always high in the sky, with his big yellow face that followed the sun.

---

One day, Lucio was climbing on a green leaf. Suddenly, he realized he was lost! The leaves of the Flowery Garden were huge and tall. It seemed like a maze for a little snail like him. “Arturo? Arturo!” he called, but nobody answered. He was very worried.

---

Lucio thought maybe Arturo had gone to see the butterflies. But he didn’t find anything familiar. Then, Lucio decided to take a long walk. He chose the biggest leaf in the garden and climbed onto it slowly. The leaf was soft and smelled nice. Lucio slid slowly, looking around.

---

From up there, he could see lots of things: the bees buzzing among the flowers, the birds singing. But he didn’t see Arturo! Lucio kept going forward, driven by hope. Then, suddenly, he heard a happy voice: “Hello Lucio!”.

---

Lucio followed the sound and found himself in front of Arturo, the sunflower. They hugged happily. It had been a long and tiring journey, but Lucio had found his friend. Perseverance brought him happiness.

plan.problema: Lucchio got lost among the big leaves of the garden and couldn't find his friend, the sunflower.
plan.svolta: He decided to take a long ride on the biggest leaf, hoping to see the sunflower from afar.
plan.finale: Finally, hearing the cheerful voice of the sunflower, Lucchio reached his friend and they hugged happily.

lumaca.text:
Lucio was a very special snail. He could talk and move around the Secret Garden like all the other creatures who lived there. The garden was full of colorful flowers, green grass, and a little sparkling pond. Lucio loved to explore every corner of the garden, but especially he loved to play with his best friend, the daisy.

One day, while he was moving slowly through the leaves, Lucio got lost. He couldn’t see the daisy anymore, and everything seemed the same. “Oh no!” thought Lucio. “I’ve gone too far!” He was very sad. He looked everywhere, but he couldn’t find her.

Lucio thought for a little while. Then, he had a brilliant idea! He started to leave a trail of shiny slime on every leaf he touched. The slime shimmered in the sunshine and made it easier to follow his path. “If I follow myself with this slime,” said Lucio, “it will be easier to find the daisy!”

Lucio crawled slowly, following his trail of shimmering slime. After a while, he heard a sweet voice: “Lucio! You’re here!” The daisy was right there, in front of him, with a fragrant flower that smelled delicious.

Lucio went to the daisy and hugged her with his little antennae. He felt happy to be found. Finally, Lucio felt like he was home in the Secret Garden. 
It was nice to have someone who was always waiting for him.

plan.problema: Lucio got lost in the garden and couldn't find his friend, the daisy.
plan.svolta: He decided to leave a trail of sparkly slime to follow the path and find the daisy.
plan.finale: The daisy was waiting for him with a smile and a fragrant flower, and Lucio finally felt at home.

lumaca.text:
Luccio was a very special snail. He lived in the Flower Garden and loved marigolds very much. There were lots of marigolds, big and small, but Luccio wanted to reach the most beautiful one of all. It was a white marigold, with a bright yellow center.

It was right there, just a few centimeters away from him, but Luccio couldn’t reach it. The leaves were too high, and the ground was too bumpy. Luccio started to feel a little discouraged. “I need to do something,” he thought. 

He went up to the terracotta pot, full of fragrant geraniums. “Maybe I can climb on that pot,” said Luccio. He started to crawl upwards, slowly but with determination. But when he got to the top, he yawned a little and slid down, going back a few centimeters.

Luccio got up and thought again. “I need to be patient,” he told himself. He started to move again, taking small steps towards the marigold. Every step was tiring, but Luccio didn’t give up. He focused on the white marigold and kept moving forward.

Finally, after a lot of effort, Luccio reached the marigold! It was just like he had always dreamed: white, bright, and fragrant. Luccio enjoyed the pleasure of this achievement, happy and satisfied with his little success. 

Luccio realized that even the most difficult things can be reached with patience and perseverance. And this made him feel even more special in the Flower Garden.

plan.problema: Luccio can't reach the prettiest daisy in the garden.
plan.svolta: He decided to climb the pot, but he slid down with a little yawn.
plan.finale: With patience and small steps, Luccio finally reached the daisy, happy and satisfied.

lumaca.text:
Luccio was a very special snail. He lived in the Flower Garden and loved to explore every corner. Every day he moved slowly, leaving a little shiny trail on a rose petal or a basil leaf.

 

One afternoon, Luccio was near a giant lily. It was so big that Luccio got lost! He found himself surrounded by enormous flowers: tulips as tall as a man, daisies as big as plates, and red poppies that looked like hearts. He couldn’t find his place under the geranium pot, where he lived with his other snail friends.

 

Luccio was very worried. “I have to do something!” he thought. So he decided to crawl faster. But, incredibly, he slowed down even more! It seemed like every step was a challenge. A little beetle, Leo, watched him curiously.

 

“Maybe,” said Leo, “you should try to go slowly and calmly.” Luccio tried to follow the beetle’s advice. He focused on one petal, then on the other. At one point, a white butterfly, Alice, flew near him.

 

Alice began to flutter in the air, pointing with her wings towards a corner of the garden. Luccio crawled following the butterfly and, finally, he arrived under the geranium pot! It was his home.

 

Luccio rested on the cool, damp earth, happy to be back in his place. Patience had made the difference.

plan.problema: Lucchi got lost among the big flowers and couldn't find his place.
plan.svolta: He decided to crawl faster, but he only slowed down even more!
plan.finale: Finally, a butterfly guided him to his home under the geranium pot.

lumaca.text:
Luccio was a very special snail. He could talk and move around in the Secret Garden just like all the other little creatures. The garden was full of colorful flowers, tall grass, and little streams. Luccio especially loved his friend, a little white teacup, who was always sitting near the big rose bush.

---

One day, while making his way through the grass, Luccio found himself in the highest meadow of the garden. It was very far from the rose bush and, most of all, he couldn’t see his friend the teacup. “Oh no!” thought Luccio. “I’m lost!”

---

Luccio looked everywhere: under the big leaves, behind the fragrant flowers, but the teacup wasn’t anywhere. He was very worried. His little shell seemed heavier than usual.

---

Then, Luccio had an idea. He decided to dig a little tunnel under the tall, bushy fern. He slowly climbed onto the wet earth and began to dig. He hoped the teacup would find him there, in the middle of the ground. He waited with his heart beating fast.

---

After a while, he heard a noise nearby. A little movement. And then, right in front of him, the teacup came closer. With his little terracotta hand, he gently hugged him. “Luccio!” said the teacup. “I was so worried about you!”

---

Luccio was happy. He snuggled up next to his friend and immediately felt safe. Friendship is a precious treasure to always keep safe.

plan.problema: Luccio got lost in the tallest grass and couldn't find his friend, the teacup.
plan.svolta: He decided to make a little tunnel under the weeds, hoping the teacup would find him there.
plan.finale: The teacup came up to Luccio and hugged him with his little terracotta hand.

lumaca.text:
Lucio was a very special snail. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of fragrant flowers and green grass. Lucio loved his garden, but he had a little problem. There was a daisy, the most beautiful of all, with white and yellow petals that shone in the sun. It was right there, just out of his reach.

Lucio tried to move towards the daisy. But it was too far! Every step he took seemed like an endless journey. “I have to get there!” thought Lucio, and he continued to move forward slowly.

Then he had an idea: “Maybe I can climb onto the pot!” He pushed with his little antennae onto the edge of the terracotta pot. He climbed, climbed, but he slipped down! A small thump brought him back to the ground, slightly confused.

Lucio got up and started moving again. He was patient. Every step he took was small, but constant. He didn’t get discouraged. He kept moving towards the daisy, without hurry. The sun shone on his shiny shell.

Finally, after a long time, Lucio reached the bright daisy. It was so close! He looked at it with joy and was ready to explore its soft petals.

Lucio had learned that even the most difficult things can be done if you are patient and persistent. And this made him a really special snail.

plan.problema: Luccio can’t reach the prettiest daisy in the garden.
plan.svolta: He decided to climb the pot, but he slid down with a little thump!
plan.finale: Thanks to his slow and steady progress, Luccio finally reached the bright daisy.

lumaca.text:
Luccio was a very special snail. He lived in the Flower Garden and loved his home among the fragrant petals. Every day he enjoyed crawling on the flower socks, leaving a little trail of shiny slime behind him.

One morning, Luccio was exploring the garden when he found himself in the tall meadow. It was full of tall grass and rustling leaves. Luccio was lost! He couldn’t find his place among the colorful flowers anymore. He was scared and a little sad.

“Oh no!” said Luccio, trying to move quickly, but he was too slow for the tall meadow. He thought maybe a little helper could help him. A red ladybug flew near him and looked at him curiously. Luccio explained his situation to her.

Then Luccio had an idea. He decided to take one step at a time, very slowly. Every now and then he left a little trail of sparkling slime on the meadow. That way he could find his way if he got lost again.

Luccio crawled and crawled, following his slime trail. It was slow work, but Luccio didn’t give up. He kept taking one step at a time. Finally, after a long time, he reached a very fragrant red rose. It was just his place!

Luccio settled among the soft petals and felt happy to be back home. His slow but steady progress had led him to success. Luccio knew that even the most difficult things can be achieved with patience and perseverance.

plan.problema: Lucchi got lost in the tall meadow and couldn’t find his place among the flowers.
plan.svolta: He decided to take one step at a time, leaving a small trail of shimmering slime to remember the way.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to his slow but steady progress, he reached the fragrant red rose where he lived.

lumaca.text:
Lucio was a very special snail. He could talk and move around in the Flower Garden. It was a place full of colors and lovely smells. Lucio loved to explore every corner of the garden with his slow step.

One day, Lucio was looking for his friend Pippo, a very lively ladybug. Pippo had promised to show him a new kind of daisy. But Lucio had gotten lost! The big flowers had swallowed him up and he couldn’t find the path anymore.

“Oh no!” said Lucio, slowing down even more. “I can’t find Pippo! This garden is so big.” He curled up on a green leaf and looked around. It seemed like all the flowers were the same.

Lucio had an idea. He decided to climb on the big sunflower. Maybe from up there he could see the whole garden and find Pippo. He began to slowly crawl on one of the yellow petals. It was a long and tiring journey for a snail!

But as he was climbing, he slid down very slowly! Lucio found himself back on the ground, covered in yellow dust. He was tired, but he didn’t give up.

Suddenly, he heard a happy buzzing sound. Following the sound, he saw Pippo waiting for him under a fragrant red rose. “Lucio!” exclaimed Pippo. “I looked for you everywhere!”

Lucio ran to his friend and rested on the red rose. The Flower Garden was even more beautiful to explore with a friend nearby. Lucio learned that even the longest journeys can have a happy ending if you are patient.

plan.problema: Luc had gotten lost among the big flowers and couldn't find his friend, Pip.
plan.svolta: He decided to climb a tall sunflower for a better view of the garden, but he slid down slowly!
plan.finale: Finally, he heard a cheerful buzzing and saw Pip waiting for him under a red rose.

lumaca.text:
Lomio was a very special snail. He could talk and move however he wanted. He lived in the Flower Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and delicious smells. Lomio loved his little corner under the biggest red rose.

---

One day, while he was walking home, Lomio got lost. He ended up in a tall meadow, full of tall grass that covered his view. He couldn’t see the flowers and he didn’t know where he was. “Oh no!” said Lomio, with his slow little voice. “I’m lost!”

---

Lomio felt very sad. He tried to move forward and backward, but the grass was too high and everything looked the same. Then he had an idea! He decided to make little spirals in the grass. He moved slowly, leaving a spiral-shaped trail behind him.

---

A blue ladybug, called Stella, saw Lomio. “What are you doing?” asked Stella. “I’m looking for my home,” replied Lomio, continuing to make his spirals. Stella carefully watched his paths and pointed the right direction to Lomio.

---

Lomio followed his spirals, one after another. Each spiral brought him closer and closer to his favorite corner. Finally, with a little movement, Lomio reached his place under the big red rose. He was happy! He settled down there, content and pleased with his journey. Patience had helped Lomio find his way.

plan.problema: Lomo had gotten lost in the tall meadow and couldn't find his way home.
plan.svolta: He decided to make little spirals, leaving a trail to find his way back.
plan.finale: Thanks to his spirals, Lomo finally reached his favorite spot under the rose.

lumaca.text:
Luccio was a very special snail. He talked and moved as if he wanted to do a thousand things. He lived in the Secret Garden, a magical place full of colorful flowers and soft grass. One day, Luccio was exploring the garden when he found himself in a very tall meadow. He had gotten lost!

Luccio was worried. He was looking for his friend Coco, a toy crocodile that he loved very much. Coco liked to make big bubbles and play with fishing. But Coco didn’t hear him calling. “Oh no,” thought Luccio, “I have to find him!”

Luccio began to move slowly. He pushed his way through the tall grass, little by little. He left a shiny trail of slime behind him. Every step was small and steady. Luccio followed his slime trail, exploring every corner of the secret garden.

After a long time, he heard something. “Laugh! Laugh!” It was the happy laughter of Coco! Luccio pushed faster and saw Coco sitting near the little pond. The crocodile was fishing for floating leaves with a twig.

“Coco!” shouted Luccio happily. Coco turned around, smiled, and waved to his snail friend. They sat together beside the pond, ready for a new adventure. 

Luccio realized that even if things sometimes seem difficult, with patience and perseverance, you can always find the right way. The sun was setting on the Secret Garden, lighting up the slime trail left by Luccio.

plan.problema: Lucio had gotten lost in the tallest meadow and couldn’t find his crocodile friend, Coco.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his slow but steady walk to explore every corner of the garden, leaving a little trail of slime behind him.
plan.finale: Finally, he heard Coco’s laughter and found him sitting by the pond, busy fishing floating leaves.

lupo.text:
Lupo Grigio was a very friendly teddy bear. He lived in the Flower Garden, among the fragrant roses and tall sunflowers. He loved to run between the trees and play with the dry leaves. One day, Lupo Grigio found himself in a strange situation. He had ended up inside a rose maze! The roses were many, beautiful, and all the same. There was no way out, it was all confusing.

Lupo Grigio tried to figure out where he was. He walked to the right, then to the left, but he always found himself in another corner of the maze. He was a little sad and scared. He wanted to go back out of the Flower Garden. He tried to follow the paths marked with stones, but they always led him to the wrong places.

Then Lupo Grigio had an idea. He closed his eyes and began to sniff the air. He smelled many different scents: the scent of the roses, the scent of fresh grass, the scent of flowers. But then he smelled something special, a very strong and inviting scent. It was the scent of the barbecue!

Lupo Grigio followed that scent and, after making another wrong path, he finally found the exit from the maze. He ran out of the Flower Garden and was happy to be free. Mr. Rossi, who had the barbecue, smiled at Lupo Grigio and offered him a piece of sausage.

Lupo Grigio realized that sometimes, trusting your instincts can lead to the best solution.

plan.problema: The Gray Wolf was lost in the maze of roses!
plan.svolta: After having taken a wrong path, he decided to sniff the air to find the exit.
plan.finale: Thanks to his good sense of smell, he detected the smell of barbecue and finally exited the maze.

lupo.text:
Lupo Rosso lived in the Flower Garden. He was a red teddy bear, soft and cuddly. He loved to play among the fragrant flowers. One day, Lupo Rosso noticed that something wasn't right. His red tummy, the one that made him so special, had become gray!

“Oh no!” exclaimed Lupo Rosso. “I’ve lost my red tummy and I don’t know how to make it shine again.” He looked everywhere, under the big apple tree, among the red roses, but nothing. His tummy was completely gray and dull.

A little ladybug, named Stella, saw him sad. “What’s wrong, Lupo Rosso?” asked Stella. “Why are you so worried?”

Lupo Rosso explained his problem. Stella had an idea. “Let’s spray you with water from the pond!” she suggested. Lupo Rosso ran to the pond and was sprayed with cool water, but only got wet! His fur was wet and his red tummy didn’t come back.

Suddenly, the sun was shining brightly in the Flower Garden. A big sunflower, with its yellow face, followed the sun. Lupo Rosso looked at the sunflower and the sun shone directly on his tummy. And the magic happened! Lupo Rosso’s tummy returned to shining a bright, intense red.

Lupo Rosso jumped for joy. He was happy to be back to his original splendor. He lay down under the sunflower, admiring the beauty of the Flower Garden. The sun warmed his red fur and the fragrant flowers perfumed the air.

plan.problema: The Red Wolf had lost his red tummy and didn’t know how to shine again.
plan.svolta: He tried to spray himself with the water from the lake, but he only got wet!
plan.finale: He found a sunflower and the sun lit up his tummy, bringing it back to its original brightness.

lupo.text:
Lupo Grigio was a very special teddy bear. He lived in the Flower Garden, among the sunflowers and fragrant roses. Every day, Lupo Grigio loved to explore the garden, walking among the colorful flowers.

---

One afternoon, while playing hide-and-seek with a blue butterfly, Lupo Grigio got lost. He had ended up inside a maze of red and white roses! The roses were so many, so tall, that he couldn’t see where to go. Lupo Grigio was very worried. He didn’t know how to get back.

---

“Oh no,” said Lupo Grigio, “I’m lost!” He tried to turn around, but every path seemed the same. The sun was starting to set and the garden was getting darker. 

---

Then, Lupo Grigio had an idea. He saw that on one side of the maze there was a path that was shining with light. It was a little twisty, but it seemed like the best way. So, Lupo Grigio began to walk along that bright path.

---

He passed by other roses, he went over some bushes, and he kept following the light. Finally, after a long walk, Lupo Grigio came out of the maze! It was right next to the fountain in the garden, with the water gently bubbling. 

---

Lupo Grigio felt happy and satisfied. He had overcome the maze thanks to his perseverance. He went to rest among the flowers, knowing that even if things seem difficult, continuing to try can lead to success.

plan.problema: The Grey Wolf had lost himself in the maze of roses and couldn’t find his way out.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the brightest path, even though it seemed a little winding.
plan.finale: Finally, he came out of the maze right next to the fountain, happy and satisfied with his journey.

lupo.text:
Wolf Arturo was a very special teddy bear. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of fragrant roses and tall trees. Wolf Arturo loved to run among the plants, play with the leaves, and dream of adventures.

One day, while chasing a yellow butterfly, he got lost. The garden had become a maze! Red roses, white roses, and pink roses surrounded him from all sides. Wolf Arturo couldn’t find his little wooden house, his favorite place in the garden.

He was very worried. He looked everywhere, he hid behind the bushes and he hid under the trees, but nothing. Then, Wolf Arturo had an idea: he decided to call for help! He shouted very loudly: “Uuuuuu!” But his howl echoed only among the leaves, without anyone hearing him.

Wolf Arturo felt a little sad and tired. He sat down on a small stone wall and thought. He saw the sun shining through the branches of the trees, creating bright rays. He decided to follow the brightest path. The sun guided him through the maze of roses.

Finally, after so much searching, Wolf Arturo saw his cozy little house! It was a warm and comfortable place, with a soft blanket and a fluffy cushion. Wolf Arturo ran towards it happily. He snuggled under the blanket and fell asleep immediately. After so much effort, the sun had helped him find his nest.

Wolf Arturo learned that even when things seem difficult, you should never give up.

plan.problema: Wolf Arturo had gotten lost in the maze of roses and couldn’t find his little house anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to shout out loud, but his howl echoed only among the leaves without any result.
plan.finale: He then began to follow the brightest path, illuminated by the sun filtering through the branches and finally found his cozy little house.

lupo.text:
Wolf was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in a secret garden full of fragrant roses. The roses were big and red, some white and others pale pink. Wolf loved to be there, watching the birds and the wind.

One day, while playing among the roses, Wolf noticed that something wasn't right. He couldn't see his friend, Stripe the squirrel, anymore. “Stripe? Where are you?” Wolf called, but no one answered. He was lost! The roses all looked the same and Wolf felt a little scared.

Wolf thought he had to do something. He decided to ask for help. He went up to the garden butterflies. There were lots of butterflies, of all colors: yellow, blue, green, and orange. “Butterflies,” said Wolf, “do you perhaps know where Stripe is?”

The butterflies landed on his ears and answered together: "We saw the squirrel collecting nuts on the other side of the garden!" Wolf thanked the butterflies. He followed their directions, moving among the roses.

Finally, he saw Stripe putting nuts in a small hole in the trunk of a tree. “Stripe!” Wolf shouted. The squirrel jumped up and hugged Wolf. 

Wolf was happy to have found his friend again. The butterflies smiled, happy to have helped. Wolf realized that when you work together, even the most difficult things become easy.

plan.problema: The Wolf was lost among the roses and couldn't find his squirrel friend.
plan.svolta: He decided to call together all the butterflies in the garden to ask them for directions.
plan.finale: The butterflies, happy to help, guided him to the squirrel who was collecting nuts.

lupo.text:
Wolf Grey was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in the Flower Garden, among fragrant roses and colorful flowers. He loved to run among the bushes and play with dry leaves. One day, while chasing a yellow butterfly, he went too deep into the rose maze. Suddenly, he realized he was lost!

Wolf Grey tried to go back, but all the roses looked the same. He couldn't find his little wooden house, where he lived safely. He was a little scared and started to jump nervously.

Then, Wolf Grey made a decision. He decided to follow the brightest path he saw. He started to walk with a determined step, hoping to find his way out. But after a few meters, he found himself in a dead end! The road was blocked by a large red rose.

Wolf Grey closed his eyes and took a deep breath. He remembered his sense of smell, his natural instinct. He took an even deeper breath and started to follow the smell of moss and damp earth. After a while, he smelled a familiar scent: the smell of the big tree where his little house was placed.

Wolf Grey continued to walk, following his sense of smell, until he finally found the path that led to his cozy home. The little house looked even more beautiful and warm than before. Wolf Grey snuggled under the tree, happy to be home. He had learned that even when things seem difficult, you should never give up.

plan.problema: The wolf was lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his little house.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the brightest path, but he found himself in a dead end.
plan.finale: Thanks to his nose, he finally found the way to return to his cozy home under the big tree.

lupo.text:
Lupo Bruno was a very special teddy bear. He lived in the Flower Garden and loved to run among the roses. One day, while playing hide-and-seek, he got lost. He ended up in the middle of the maze of red and white roses. Wolf Bruno couldn't find his little house anymore.



It was all so fragrant! The smells of the roses made him dream. But Wolf Bruno had to find his little house. He looked to the right, he looked to the left, but nothing. He was always surrounded by roses.



Then, Wolf Bruno made a decision. He decided to follow the brightest path. The path was full of fragrant flowers and colorful butterflies. But Wolf Bruno didn't stop. He kept walking towards the light. It was important to get home!



Suddenly, Wolf Bruno heard a sound. A loud and clear song: "Cai-cai-cai!". It was the garden rooster. The rooster was singing in the direction of Wolf Bruno's little house. Wolf Bruno followed the song and finally, after so much searching, he saw his little house!



He was happy. He snuggled up to the door and felt safe. Wolf Bruno had learned that even when things are difficult, continuing to do his best always leads to success.

plan.problema: Wolf Bruno got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his little house.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the brightest path, even though it was full of fragrant flowers that distracted him.
plan.finale: Finally, he found his little house thanks to the rooster's crow that showed him the way.

lupo.text:
Wolf Happy was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in the Flower Garden, a place full of colors and smells. He loved to run among the roses, to smell the jasmine and to play with the daisies. But today Wolf Happy wasn't happy.

He had lost his favorite nose! It was a small, soft nose and it had a pink bow. He loved it so much because it made him smile. He had looked everywhere: under the apple tree, among the cornflowers, even in the lavender bush, but nothing!

Wolf Happy decided he had to ask for help. He saw some colorful butterflies flying among the flowers. “Butterflies,” said Wolf Happy, “have you seen a nose with a pink bow?” The butterflies replied yes, but none of them had seen one pink. “No, I’ve never seen it,” said the blue butterfly, “only yellow and black colors!”

Wolf Happy was a little sad, but he continued to look. Then, suddenly, he noticed something shiny. A big sunflower stood tall in the garden, the sun illuminated it. And there, right under the sunflower, was his nose! It was hidden among the big green leaves.

Wolf Happy ran to kiss it happily. The pink bow was still perfect. He felt so happy to have found his nose. The sun warmed the garden and Wolf Happy knew that, even if sometimes it seems difficult to find what you are looking for, with a little patience the discovery is always around the corner.

plan.problema: The wolf had lost his favorite nose, the one with the pink bow!
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the butterflies that were flying among the flowers, but none of them had seen one pink.
plan.finale: He found the nose under a large sunflower, illuminated by the sun, and ran to kiss it happily.

lupo.text:
Lupo Bruno was a very special teddy bear. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Lupo Bruno loved to run among the plants, but today he felt a little sad. He couldn’t find his shiny buttons for his coat! They were buttons made of glass that sparkled in the sun.

Lupo Bruno looked everywhere. He looked under the fountain, inside the old wooden box, and among the dry leaves. But the buttons weren’t there. “Oh no!” said Lupo Bruno, fluffing his fur. “They must have disappeared!”

He decided to ask for help from the ladybug that lived on the tallest sunflower. Running towards her, Lupo Bruno found her busy collecting seeds. The ladybug was very busy and said, “I’m sorry Lupo Bruno, I’m too busy! I must collect all these seeds for the winter.”

Lupo Bruno didn’t give up. He continued to look carefully at the garden. Then, he noticed something big under a giant rose. His shiny buttons were there, hidden among the red and fragrant petals! 

With a little effort, Lupo Bruno pushed the buttons back into his coat. The coat sparkled like before. Lupo Bruno smiled. He was happy. He had solved the problem. He had been patient in his search and in the end, he had succeeded. Patience can really lead to a wonderful surprise.

plan.problema: Wolf Bruno can't find his shiny buttons for his coat!
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the ladybug, but she was too busy collecting seeds.
plan.finale: Finally, he found the buttons hidden under a giant rose and put them in his coat with a smile.

lupo.text:
Lupo Grigio was a very soft teddy bear. He lived in the Flower Garden, among red roses and tall sunflowers. He loved to play there, rolling on the fresh grass. One day, Lupo Grigio was in the meadow full of white daisies. He was so busy chasing a yellow butterfly that he didn’t notice where he had gone.

When he finally stopped running, he realized he was lost! The meadow was huge and the daisies all looked the same. Lupo Grigio began to wander, looking for his home among the trees of the garden. But every time he walked, he ended up even further away from where he felt safe.

Then, he heard a sound: “Buzz, buzz!” He tried to follow the sound of the bees, thinking that maybe the bees would guide him home. But the buzzing only took him further, into fields of red poppies! Lupo Grigio felt sadder and more confused.

Suddenly, he noticed something strange: a path made of butterflies fluttering around the flowers. The butterflies were following a bright trail, a path marked by their flight. Lupo Grigio decided to follow them. Slowly, calmly, the teddy bear moved towards the butterfly path.

After a while, he smelled the earth and saw the trees of the Flower Garden. He was back in his home! Lupo Grigio curled up under a red rose and fell asleep, happy to be home. Patience had helped Lupo Grigio find his way.

plan.problema: The Gray Wolf was lost in the meadow full of daisies!
plan.svolta: After wandering for a while, he tried to follow the buzzing of the bees, but it only took him further away from his den.
plan.finale: Then, he decided to follow the path marked by the butterflies and finally returned among the trees of the garden.
plan.morale: Patience helps to find the way.

maiale.text:
Pippo was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in the Flower Garden, among the fragrant roses and colorful flowers. He loved to play there, rolling on the soft grass. One day, Pippo had so much fun chasing butterflies that he went too far away from his place. Suddenly, he realized he was surrounded by tall, fragrant roses. He had become lost in a big maze!

Pippo desperately searched for his little house, but he couldn't find it. The roses were everywhere, all the same. “Oh no!” thought Pippo. “I’m lost!” He tried to run as fast as possible, but he kept getting more and more confused. He was very sad and a little scared.

Then, Pippo had an idea. He decided to take a slower walk. He followed the brightest path, the one that shone thanks to the sun filtering through the roses. As he walked slowly, he saw a red ladybug flying nearby. The ladybug greeted him and said, “Hello Pippo, are you looking for your little house?”

Pippo nodded enthusiastically. The ladybug pointed to the brightest path and said, “Follow this path!” Pippo followed her words, and suddenly, he heard a familiar sound: the little bell on his little house tinkling. He was happy! He had finally returned to his door.

Pippo curled up in his place among the roses, happy to be home. Patience had helped Pippo find his way back.

plan.problema: Peter got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his little house.
plan.svolta: He decided to take a slower turn, following the brightest path to see if he could meet someone who could help him.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the sound of the bell on his little house, Peter happily returned to his door.
