plan.morale: Patience helps to find the solution.

maiale.text:
Poldo was a teddy bear pig. He lived in the Secret Garden, among the roses and fragrant flowers. Poldo loved to play very much, rolling in the tall grass and having nice puddles. But today he wasn’t happy. He had lost his favorite carrot, a big, juicy carrot that he had received as a gift for his birthday.

Princess Butterfly, a butterfly with shimmering wings, needed that carrot! Princess Butterfly was very kind and Poldo knew he had to help her. “Oh no!” exclaimed Poldo, ruffling his fur. “I can’t make her happy without her carrot!”

Poldo had a brilliant idea. He decided to organize a treasure hunt! He took a piece of chalk and began to draw clues on his body: a star on his belly, a heart on his front paws, and a little flower on his back. “Follow the clues!” shouted Poldo, hoping that Princess Butterfly would find it.

Princess Butterfly carefully followed the clues. She found the heart, then the flower, and finally reached the star. With great joy, Poldo pulled the lost carrot out of his pocket.

Princess Butterfly was so happy to receive her carrot that she made a big smile. Poldo felt like the luckiest pig in the world. Princess Butterfly offered him a kiss on her wings and Poldo understood how important it was to be kind to others. With the shared carrot, everyone in the Secret Garden was happy.

plan.problema: Paul lost his favorite carrot and doesn't know how to make Princess Butterfly happy.
plan.svolta: He decided to organize a treasure hunt with pencil-drawn clues on his body to find the carrot.
plan.finale: Princess Butterfly was so happy to receive her carrot that Paul felt like the luckiest pig in the world.

maiale.text:
Pip was a very happy teddy pig. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and big plants. The secret garden was his favorite place in the whole world. Pip loved to run among the roses, roll in the tall grass, and take naps in the shade of the big tree.

One day, though, Pip noticed a problem. He had lost his favorite carrot! It was a big, juicy carrot that he always kept close. Pip was very sad. He didn't know what to do without his carrot. He sat on the lawn, with his ears down and his snout thoughtful.

He decided to ask for help from the gnome. The gnome lived under the big tree and knew all the secrets of the garden. Pip ran to him, but the gnome was too busy tidying up a pile of red building blocks. “Wait here!” said the gnome without looking up. “I’m almost ready to build a very tall tower!”

Pip felt a little frustrated, but he thought maybe the gnome was right. Maybe he should wait. So, Pip followed the muddy tracks that the carrot had left when it fell. The tracks led him to the fountain in the center of the secret garden.

There, among the white and pink water lilies, he saw something red! His favorite carrot! It was hidden under a big leaf. Pip took it in his mouth and was very happy. 

The sun was setting slowly, painting the sky orange and pink. Pip went to take another nap in the shade of the big tree, happy with his discovery. He learned that even when things don’t go as we want, waiting a little bit can bring some nice surprises.

plan.problema: Bat has lost his favorite carrot and doesn’t know what to do.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the gnome who lived under the big tree, but the gnome was too busy building with his blocks to listen to him.
plan.finale: Bat followed the muddy tracks to the fountain and found his carrot hidden among the water lilies!

maiale.text:
Pippo was a teddy bear pig, soft and pink. He loved the Secret Garden very much. It was a special place, full of fragrant roses and colorful flowers. Pippo spent his days rolling in the fresh grass and smelling the beautiful scents.

---

One day, while he was having fun exploring among the trees, Pippo got lost. The roses were so big and fragrant that they had swallowed him up! He couldn’t find his place anymore. He was very scared and a little sad. He tried to shout for help, but his little voice was too quiet to be heard among so many plants.

---

Pippo thought he had to do something. Then, he took all the dry leaves he found around and started spreading them everywhere. “Oh oh oh!” Pippo said, making a big noise. He hoped someone would hear him and help him find his way back.

---

A red ladybug, named Stella, was passing by. She heard the noise of the leaves and went to Pippo. “Who are you?” Stella asked. “I’m Pippo, the pig! I’m lost!”

---

Stella immediately recognized the pink pig. She knew his little house under the apple tree very well. Running among the plants, she showed Pippo the way. Finally, Pippo arrived at his little house. He was happy to be back in his place. 

---

Pippo curled up and fell asleep, dreaming of new adventures in the Secret Garden. Perseverance did good for him that day.

plan.problema: Peter got lost among the fragrant roses and couldn't find his way back.
plan.svolta: He decided to make a big noise by scattering dry leaves to attract attention.
plan.finale: Finally, a ladybug recognized him and led him to his little house under the apple tree.

maiale.text:
Pippo was a very special teddy bear. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and lush plants. Pippo loved his secret garden more than anything in the world. Every day he played among the roses, sunflowers, and trees.

One morning, Pippo noticed that something wasn't right. His favorite rose, a fragrant red rose, was gone! Pippo was very sad. He looked everywhere: under the lavender bush, next to the pond, even inside the firefly house. But the red rose wasn't there anymore.

Pippo decided to ask for help. He saw Bruno, a crocodile who lived in the garden, and ran to him. “Bruno, have you seen my rose?” Pippo asked. Bruno was soaking up the sun and smiling. “I haven’t seen anything, Pippo,” Bruno replied, without moving. “I’m too busy taking the sun!”

Pippo felt a little down. He continued to look, searching every corner of the Secret Garden. He examined under the leaves, inside the bushes, and behind the big stones. Time passed and Pippo didn’t give up. 

Finally, after so much searching, he saw it! The red rose was there, hidden among the wild roses near the old stone wall. Pippo jumped for joy! He was so happy to have found it. He put the rose next to him and relaxed. The Secret Garden seemed even more beautiful than before.

Pippo realized that even when things seem lost, with a little patience and perseverance, you can always find the solution.

plan.problema: Pippo lost his favorite rose and doesn’t know where to look.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from Crocodile Bruno, but Bruno was too busy soaking up the sun to help him.
plan.finale: After searching the whole area, Pippo found the rose under a bush of wild roses and was very happy.

maiale.text:
Pippo was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and tall grass. Pippo loved to be there, especially when the sun was shining. He had a favorite poem, with pictures of stars and moons, that he always held close.

One day, while he was sitting near a tall bush, he noticed that his poem was gone! He had lost it under the leaves. Pippo began to look everywhere. He dug through the grass, pushed with his tummy, but nothing. The poem had disappeared.

Pippo was very sad. He didn't want to give up. He tried to push the bush as hard as he could, but it was too big and stiff. It didn’t move even an inch. Pippo thought, thought, thought… Then he had an idea!

“I’ll call for help!” exclaimed Pippo. A red ladybug with black spots flew towards him. “Ladybug, Ladybug, could you help me?” asked Pippo. The ladybug listened carefully. Together they began to search through the leaves of the bush.

The ladybug had very good eyes for seeing things hidden. After a while, the ladybug pointed: “There it is! I find it here!” Pippo took his poem and held it tight. He was happy to have found it again.

Pippo thanked the ladybug for her help. He felt much better, now he had his favorite poem again. It had been nice to work with a friend.

plan.problema: Pippo had lost his favorite sonnet under a tall bush.
plan.svolta: After trying to push the bush with his tummy, Pippo had a brilliant idea!
plan.finale: Pippo asked for help from the ladybugs and together they found the sonnet among the leaves.

maiale.text:
Red was a teddy bear who was very happy. He lived in a secret garden, a special place full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Every day Red loved to play there. He loved to run across the green meadows and roll on the muddy ground.

A sunny afternoon, Red found a beautiful red rose. It was his favorite rose! He held it tight in his little plush arm. But then… the rose disappeared! Red looked around with worry. “Where has it gone?” he asked, but nobody answered.

Red began to look everywhere. He tried to sniff every corner of the secret garden. He looked under the trees and behind the big lavender plants. But the rose was too small to be found with his nose. Red felt a little sad. He didn’t know what to do.

“Maybe it fell between the leaves?” thought Red. So, he used his little paws to explore under the green and brown leaves. He dug and rummaged in the wet soil. The sun shone brightly in the sky. 

After a while, Red felt something soft among the flowers. With great joy, he saw his red rose! It was hidden among the petals of a beautiful white daisy. 

Red was so happy! He got his favorite rose back and hugged it tight. He realized that sometimes, finding lost things takes a little patience. Red lay down on the meadow, happy with his little rose and his secret garden. It was a perfect day for a teddy bear.

plan.problema: Rosso has lost his favorite rose and doesn't know where to look.
plan.svolta: He tried to sniff every corner of the garden, but the rose was too small to be found with his nose.
plan.finale: So, Rosso used his little paws to explore under the leaves and found the rose hidden among the flowers!

maiale.text:
Porco was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in a secret garden, a place full of fragrant flowers and tall trees. One day, Porco decided to explore the rose maze. The roses were so beautiful and colorful! He went deeper into the little wood, following a narrow path between the plants.

After walking for a long time, Porco realized he was lost. The roses surrounded him on every side and he couldn't find his way out. He was a little scared. “Oh no!” exclaimed Porco, scratching his nose with a paw. “I don’t know where I am anymore!”

Porco thought for a moment. He saw some bees buzzing around a yellow flower. “Maybe the bees know the way!” said Porco. So, he decided to follow the buzzing of the bees, hoping they would take him out of the little wood. The bees flew quickly and Porco tried to follow them with a happy step.

At some point, he heard strange sounds: “Tweet, tweet!” It was the song of the little birds. Following the song, Porco finally saw the exit of the secret garden. He found himself among his butterfly friends, who were flying around the flowers. Porco was happy to be home. Perseverance had helped him find his way back. Porco understood that even when things seem difficult, continuing to look for a solution always leads to success.

plan.problema: Pig got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his way out.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the buzzing of the bees, hoping they would take him out of the copse.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the song of the little birds, Pig found the exit of the secret garden and rejoined his butterfly friends.

maiale.text:
Porco was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and soft grass. He loved to play among the plants, but he also had a favorite thing: a big, juicy carrot that he always kept with him.

One day, Porco noticed that his carrot was gone! It had disappeared! Porco was very sad. He looked everywhere, under the fragrant rose bush, behind the old apple tree, but nothing. The carrot wasn’t anywhere.

Porco tried to dig under the rose bush, hoping to find it there. But he only managed to pull out dry, dusty leaves. They were very plump and didn’t give him any clues about his carrot. Porco was getting more and more worried.

Suddenly, he heard a buzzing sound. A family of bees was flying around the garden. Porco had an idea! “Help!” he shouted to all the bees. “I’ve lost my favorite carrot and I don’t know where to look.” The bees listened carefully. Then, with quick movements, they flew towards the roots of a big tree.

There, hidden among the roots, was his carrot! Porco was so happy that he hugged the carrot with all his little paws. The bees watched him smile. Porco realized that asking for help from those who can help is always a good idea. 

Porco and the bees became great friends and played together in the Secret Garden all afternoon. It was nice to work together to solve a problem.

plan.problema: Pig has lost his favorite carrot and doesn’t know where to look.
plan.svolta: He tried to rummage under the rose bush, but only dry leaves came out!
plan.finale: Then he had an idea: he asked for help from the bees, who guided him directly to the hidden carrot among the roots of a tree.

maiale.text:
Pippo was a teddy bear pig. He lived in Grandma Rosa’s garden. It was a garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Pippo loved his garden very much. Especially, he loved his carrots. They were his favorites!

One day, Pippo noticed that his carrots were gone. He looked everywhere: under the apple tree, near the fountain, and among the red tulips. But the carrots were no longer there. Pippo was very sad. He didn’t understand where they had gone.

“Oh no, oh no!” exclaimed Pippo, wiggling with his little legs. “Where did I go?” He decided to ask for help. He knew a special friend: Coco, the crocodile who lived near the garden pond. Coco knew all the secrets of the garden!

Pippo ran to the pond and found Coco sleeping in the shade of a palm tree. “Coco, Coco!” shouted Pippo. “Can you help me? I’ve lost my favorite carrots!” Coco opened one eye and looked around. Then, with a smile, he pointed under his nose. “Look, look! Here are your carrots!”

Pippo went closer and took his carrots. They were right there, under Coco’s nose. Pippo was so happy! He thanked Coco and went back to play in Grandma Rosa’s garden. After so much searching, Pippo realized that waiting a little while and asking for help could be useful. Patience always helps to find what you have lost.

plan.problema: Pippo has lost his favorite carrots and doesn’t know where they’ve gone.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from Crocodile Coco, who knows all the garden’s secrets.
plan.finale: Coco recognized the carrots under his nose, and Pippo was so happy to have found them.

micky mouse.text:
Mickey Mouse was a very happy mouse. He was sitting on the dark wood of a slide in the playground. The sun was shining and the other toys were far away. Mickey wanted to play with his friends, Mickey Mouse and Pluto. But they had to be there!

He looked around. The slides were tall and long. There were many curves and corners. Mickey had gotten lost! He couldn’t understand where he had ended up. He was sad because he couldn’t see his friends anymore. He tried to run, but he always found himself in a new place, among the slides.

“Oh no!” said Mickey. “I can’t find anyone!” He sat down on a red bench and he felt even more alone. He closed his eyes for a moment.

Then, he took a deep breath and thought: “I have to do something!” He decided to shout loudly: “Help! Mickey Mouse!” He shouted again: “Help! Mickey Mouse!” And again: “Help! Mickey Mouse!”

A boy sitting on the swing heard the voice. “Look!” he said to his dad. “It’s Mickey Mouse!” The other children in the park came to Mickey Mouse. They recognized him right away and brought him back to the starting point, near the main slide. His friends were very happy to see him again!

Mickey Mouse smiled. He was happy to be back with everyone. He understood that asking for help can lead to great surprises. And so, Mickey continued to play with his friends, happy and sure that he would never get lost again.

plan.problema: Mickey got lost among the slides and couldn't find his friends.
plan.svolta: He decided to shout loudly 'Help!' repeating his name several times.
plan.finale: The children in the park, hearing him, recognized him and brought him back to the starting point.
plan.morale: Asking for help is always a good idea.

micky mouse.text:
Mickey Mouse was at the playground. It was a happy day, full of laughter and children playing. Mickey loved to run and jump with his friends: Pippo, Topolino, and Pluto. They were always together, they had so much fun!

But suddenly, Mickey realized he was all alone. He didn’t see his friends anymore. He was a little scared. “Pippo! Topolino! Pluto!” shouted Mickey Mouse, but nobody answered. Only the sound of the wind and the noise of the children surrounded him.

Mickey Mouse felt more and more confused. He tried to run in all directions, but every time he found himself in a different place. The confusion grew! He didn’t know where his friends were and how to find them. He sat down on a bench, sad.

Then, Mickey Mouse saw something beautiful: a white butterfly. It was delicate and light. The butterfly flew forward and back, as if inviting Mickey to follow it. Mickey Mouse followed the butterfly through the playground.

And then, he saw them! His friends were there, sitting under a tree, playing with a red ball. “Mickey!” they all shouted happily. Mickey Mouse ran towards them and hugged everyone. He was so happy to be back with his friends. 

Mickey Mouse understood that even when you get lost, help can come from where you least expect it. The patience of waiting and the kindness of the butterfly had brought him back.

plan.problema: Mickey got lost from his group of friends and didn’t know how to find them.
plan.svolta: He tried to call them, but nobody answered and the confusion increased!
plan.finale: Then he saw a butterfly that guided him to his happy friends who were glad to see him.

micky mouse.text:
Mickey Mouse was happy at the playground. The sun was shining and the slides glistened. Mickey loved to slide down quickly, laughing loudly. But suddenly, he realized he was all alone. He looked around and didn't see his friends, Mickey, Minnie, and Pluto anymore. He was lost among the colorful slides!

Mickey was a little scared. The slides seemed very tall and lots of children were running everywhere. He couldn't understand where his friends were. He felt small and lonely. He tried to call out, but his little voice was too weak to be heard.

Mickey had an idea! He took his red whistle, the one he liked to play so much. He closed his eyes and blew with all his strength. “Pipì-pipì!” the whistle shouted. The sound was loud and clear.

A boy was playing near the swing. He heard the whistle and ran over right away. “Mickey Mouse! You’re here!” the boy shouted, running towards him. Mickey jumped into the boy’s arms happily. He had been found! The boy hugged him tight and smiled. 

Mickey was happy to be back with his friends. He had learned that even when you get lost, asking for help can make a difference. And so, a shy smile lit up Mickey Mouse’s face as he held his new friend in his arms.

plan.problema: Mickey got lost among the slides and couldn't find his friends.

plan.finale: A boy ran towards him to hug him, happy to have found him.

micky mouse.text:
Mickey Mouse loved the playground very much. He was a stuffed mouse, smiling and ready to play. Every day, when the children arrived, Mickey had a wonderful time. But today, Mickey had a problem. He had lost all his gloves!

He had red gloves, soft and warm. He loved them so much because they made him look even friendlier. Mickey looked first under the colorful slide. He scratched with his little plastic feet, but the gloves weren't there. Then, he climbed on the big swing, but even there nothing.

Mickey was a little sad. He looked around the playground: the sandboxes, the slides, the swings. He looked among the wooden benches, under the fountain that sprayed water. But the gloves weren't there! He couldn't find them anymore.

Suddenly, a group of children were playing near the toy box. There was a girl with two blonde pigtails and a boy with a red hat. The children were looking for something in the box. And then... he saw them! “Mickey!” exclaimed the girl, pulling out the red gloves.

Mickey Mouse lit up with joy. He thanked the children with a big smile. He was happy that his gloves were back. The children laughed and continued to play. Mickey realized how important it was to be kind and to help others. A small gesture can make a difference, and especially, kindness does good for everyone.

micky mouse.text:
Mickey Mouse was a very happy mouse. He was sitting in the playground, next to the sand tower. The sun was shining high in the sky and the children were laughing around him. Mickey loved to play with the sand, but today he was doing something new: he had ventured inside the sand maze!

Mickey was having a lot of fun, building tall walls and small dunes. Then, suddenly, he realized that he didn't know where he was anymore. He was completely lost! The sand maze seemed endless. “Oh no!” said Mickey, with his squeaky voice.

Mickey tried to shout for help, but nobody could hear him. Only the sound of the children’s laughter and the sound of the sand crunching under his feet. There was nobody around. He was a little sad.

Mickey thought: “I have to do something!” He remembered what his grandma always said: “Follow the sun!” So, Mickey turned around and started to walk towards the warm light. The sun was guiding him with its golden rays. 

Mickey followed the sun for a while. With every step, the maze seemed to get smaller. Finally, after many turns and climbs, Mickey saw a light! It was the exit of the maze!

His friends, Pluto and Mickey, were waiting for him happily. They ran towards him to hug him. Mickey was so happy to be back with them. Mickey understood that even when things seem difficult, you must never lose hope. And this made him even happier.

plan.problema: Mickey got lost in the sand maze!
plan.svolta: He tried to shout for help, but nobody heard him, so he decided to follow the sun.
plan.finale: The sun led him to the exit of the maze, where his friends were waiting for him, overjoyed.

micky mouse.text:
Mickey Mouse was in the playground. He was a big, smiling plush mouse. He loved to play there, especially with his friends. But today something wasn't right. Mickey Mouse was lost! He had walked through the colorful slides, further and further, without seeing any of his friends.

“Oh no!” said Mickey Mouse. “Where have Goofy and Pluto gone?” He tried to call his friends, but his little voice got lost in the noise of the playground. Nobody answered. It was all a big silence.

Mickey Mouse was sad. He sat down on a red bench and thought about what to do. Then he had an idea! He tried to shout louder: “Goofy! Pluto! I’m here!” But still nothing.

Suddenly, Mickey Mouse noticed something wonderful. A beautiful rainbow had appeared in the sky after the rain. The colors shone brightly. Mickey Mouse decided to follow the color red. He stood up and began to walk towards the rainbow. 

After a while, he saw Goofy and Pluto playing with other children. They were happy to see Mickey Mouse! All together they had a lot of fun. Mickey Mouse realized that even when things seem difficult, if you don’t give up, you always find the solution. Mickey Mouse and his friends went back to playing, knowing that friendship is a precious treasure.

micky mouse.text:
Mickey Mouse was happy at the playground. The sun was shining and the children were laughing. Mickey loved to do slides, but he had a problem. He had lost his favorite gloves! They were red gloves with star prints. Without them, he couldn't do the slides properly. He was very sad.

Mickey looked around. The playground was full of swings and slides. But Mickey didn't see his gloves. “Oh no!” he said. “How will I do the slides?”

Then, Mickey decided to call his friends. First, he called Pluto. “Pluto, Pluto! I’ve lost my gloves!” he shouted. Pluto replied: “Don’t worry, Mickey! I’ll look with you!” Then he called Goofy, the dog. “Goofy, can I count on you?” Mickey asked. Goofy nodded and joined the search.

Together, Mickey, Pluto, and Goofy looked everywhere. They looked under the benches, behind the slides, and near the swings. Finally, Mickey saw something red between the roots of a big tree. They were his gloves!

Mickey picked them up happily. Now he could do the slides wonderfully. “Thank you friends!” said Mickey. “You were fantastic!” Everyone hugged and smiled. Mickey realized that with the help of his friends, everything was easier and more fun.

Mickey and his friends went back to play happily, knowing that together they could solve any problem.

micky mouse.text:
Mickey Mouse was a very happy mouse. He loved to play in the playground. There were colorful swings and long slides. Mickey Mouse loved to go down them! But today, something strange happened. He found himself all alone.

He was surrounded by lots of other toys from the playground. Some children were looking at him, but nobody seemed to really notice him. Mickey Mouse felt a little scared. He was really lost among the swings and slides! 

“Help!” shouted Mickey Mouse with his squeaky voice. “Can anyone hear me?” But the wind was blowing hard and nobody answered. Mickey Mouse tried to run, but he got even more lost.

A little boy, Leo, was watching Mickey Mouse. Leo smiled and said, "Hello Mickey!" Mickey Mouse thanked Leo with a big smile. Then he had an idea! He huddled close to a big slide and jumped down. He jumped again and again, trying to get attention.

Finally, while jumping near an old play blanket, Mickey Mouse saw something: a secret tunnel! It was hidden under the roots of a tree. Without hesitation, Mickey Mouse crawled into the tunnel. With a big jump, he came out on the other side and... he was back in his favorite place, near the goose tower! 

Mickey Mouse did a big happy circle around the playground. He learned that even when things seem difficult, you should always try to find a solution. He always remembered not to give up ever.

micky mouse.text:
Mickey Mouse was a very happy mouse. He loved to play in the playground. He was a special toy, he could move and talk! One day, Mickey wanted to explore the sand maze. It was huge and full of narrow paths.

Mickey had so much fun running between the dunes. But then, he got lost! He couldn’t see his friend, the red ball anymore. The maze seemed endless. Every path was just like the other. Mickey couldn’t find the exit. He was a little sad.

Mickey tried to move forward, backward, to the right and to the left. But nothing, he kept getting lost! The sun was starting to set. Mickey shouted for help, but nobody answered. Nobody heard him. The sky was getting darker and darker.

Suddenly, a little bird sitting on a dune looked at Mickey. “Tweet, tweet!” said the bird. “Look there, down there!” And he pointed with his beak at a secret tunnel in the sand.

Mickey ran to the tunnel and followed it. It was dark at first, but then… he came out of the maze! He was back at the playground, near the red ball. Mickey was relieved and happy. He rested a little under the shade of a tree.

Mickey understood that you shouldn’t ever give up, even when things seem difficult. And so, with a smile, he prepared for a new adventure at the playground.

micky mouse.text:
Mickey Mouse was at the playground. It was a sunny day and lots of children were laughing happily. Mickey loved his spot under the swing very much. He loved to do his wave: “Hello!”. But today something wasn't right. Mickey noticed that his favorite gloves, the red ones with the little stars, were gone!

Mickey was very sad. He couldn't do his wave. “Oh no!” he exclaimed. He decided to look everywhere. He started to look under the slides, but there were no gloves. He looked behind the bench, but nothing. He was frustrated!

“Maybe they fell,” thought Mickey. He started to run around the playground, trying to figure out where they could be. A little bird, Pipetto, was watching him from a branch of the tree. Pipetto had bright red and shiny feathers.

Mickey looked at the tree carefully. And there, among the branches, he saw his gloves! They were hanging in the nest that Pipetto was building. The little bird had taken them to make his nest warmer and cozier.

Mickey smiled. “Thank you, Pipetto!” he said. He took his gloves and immediately started to do his wave: “Hello!”. He was happy to have his gloves back. 

Pipetto flew away, while Mickey continued to play at the playground, looking around carefully. Sometimes, you just have to stop for a moment to see things clearly.

monkey.text:
Mocco was a very special teddy bear gorilla. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and big trees. Mocco loved to explore the garden with his strong arms and his soft tail. Every day he played among the sunflowers and climbed on the lavender stems.

---

One day, Mocco noticed that something wasn't right. Mrs. Tulip, a beautiful red tulip, seemed very sad. Her leaves were a little messy and her color was faded. Mocco knew that Mrs. Tulip loved bananas! And Mocco had lost his favorite banana, the yellow and juicy one that he liked best in the whole world.

---

“I must make Mrs. Tulip smile!” thought Mocco. So he tried to make a funny face with his arms, trying to imitate a smile. But Mrs. Tulip seemed even sadder. It seemed like her sadness had become stronger.

---

Mocco felt a little down. Then suddenly he had an idea! He started jumping up and down in the garden, doing somersaults and spinning around the trees. He giggled with delight while he made all those silly moves.

---

Mrs. Tulip watched Mocco carefully. And then, slowly, her face lit up. Mrs. Tulip finally smiled! A big, bright smile that filled the whole Secret Garden. 

---

Mocco understood right away what had happened: the joy of a little gorilla could be contagious.

monkey.text:
Mocco was a teddy bear gorilla who was very special. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Mocco loved to play among the red roses and the yellow sunflowers. But today, Mocco didn't want to play. He was very sad.

He had lost his favorite banana! It was a bright yellow banana, soft and fragrant. Without that banana, Mocco couldn't smile. He didn't understand why he felt so down.

Mocco began to look everywhere. He looked under the big blue flowers, but the banana was too big to be there. He looked behind the fragrant lavender bush, but nothing. Mocco huddled down and looked among the green leaves of the old apple tree. There was no trace of his banana there either.

“Oh no!” said Mocco with a sigh. Then he had an idea! He began to sing a happy song that he liked so much. It was a simple song, with easy words to remember: “Jump, jump, dance, dance, the sun is warm and beautiful!”

While Mocco sang loudly, he felt something soft under the picnic table. He looked up and… there it was his banana! It was right on the table, next to his plate of cookies.

Mocco jumped for joy. He realized that he didn't need the banana to be happy. It was enough to sing a song and smile. 

Mocco settled down on the bench in the secret garden, with his banana in his hand. He was a happy gorilla. Sometimes, the simplest thing is what makes us truly happy.

plan.problema: Marco lost his favorite banana and can't seem to smile.
plan.svolta: He tried to look under the flowers, but the banana was too big to fit there.
plan.finale: He decided to sing a happy song, and while he was singing, the banana reappeared on the picnic table!

monkey.text:
Mungo was a very happy teddy bear gorilla. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Mungo loved to climb the trees, jump through the tall grass, and play with the butterflies. But today Mungo was sad. He had lost his favorite banana! It was a yellow banana, big and juicy, that his friend Rocco the crocodile had given him.

Mungo looked around in the secret garden. He looked among the flowers, under the leaves, but there was no trace of his banana. “Oh no!” said Mungo, “I don’t know where I put it!”. He wiggled and he got angry. He wanted his banana so much!

Then Mungo had an idea. He decided to use his fluffy nose to sniff the air. He closed his eyes tight, tight, and took a deep breath. But instead of the smell of the banana, he only smelled the smell of fragrant roses. The roses were many, beautiful, and red in the secret garden.

Mungo continued to look. He moved towards the fragrant lavender bush. And there, right under a lavender bush, he saw his banana! It was hidden among the green, fragrant leaves. Mungo took it in his hand and he was very happy.

Rocco the crocodile arrived at Mungo. “Did you find your banana?” asked Rocco. Mungo nodded happily. He felt brave for having searched so long. 
Mungo understood that even if things are lost, you must always keep looking and never give up.

plan.problema: Mungo has lost his favorite banana and doesn’t know where to look.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his furry nose to sniff the air, but he only smelled the roses!
plan.finale: He found the banana hidden under a lavender bush, thanks to his brave attempt.

monkey.text:
Mickey was a very happy teddy bear gorilla. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and strange plants. Mickey loved his garden because it was his favorite place in the world. Every day he had his little adventures among the trees.

 

One afternoon, Mickey noticed a big problem. He had lost his banana! It was a yellow banana, soft and fragrant, his favorite banana. Mickey looked everywhere, but he couldn't find it. “Oh no!” said Mickey, wiggling. “Where did I put it?”

 

Mickey started looking under the roses. The roses had a very strong and sweet smell. But the smell was so intense that Mickey couldn't see anything! He looked and looked, but the banana wasn't there yet. He was frustrated.

 

Then, Mickey had an idea. He went up to a big bush of blue and purple lavender. The smell of lavender was relaxing. Mickey hid behind the bush and looked carefully. He saw a very big and green leaf. And there, right above the leaf, was his banana!

 

Mickey jumped happily and took his banana. It was exactly where he had least suspected. It had hidden itself in a secret place, right behind the lavender bush. Mickey settled down in his new position, happy and satisfied. 

 

The sun was setting on the secret garden, painting the sky with warm colors. Mickey knew that if he waited a little longer, he would find his banana. And so, with patience and attention, he had gotten what he wanted.

plan.problema: Mickey has lost his favorite banana and can’t find his place.
plan.svolta: He tried to look under the roses, but it was too fragrant to find the banana!
plan.finale: Mickey hid behind a large lavender bush and found it right there, lying on the biggest leaf.

monkey.text:
Mocco was a teddy bear gorilla who was very happy. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and lush plants. Mocco loved to climb trees and roll in the tall grass. But today, Mocco wasn't happy.

He had lost his favorite banana! It was a yellow banana, juicy and fragrant. Mocco always kept it with him, it was his favorite toy. He looked everywhere: under the rose bush, behind the fountain, even inside the gardener’s bucket. But the banana was gone.

Mocco felt sad and a little scared. He didn't know what to do. He sat down on a smooth stone and sighed deeply. Suddenly, he saw Lila, a blue butterfly with shimmering wings. Lila was the kindest butterfly in the Secret Garden.

“What’s wrong, Mocco?” asked Lila. “Why are you so down?”

Mocco explained that he had lost his banana. Lila thought for a moment and said, “I have an idea! Follow the sugar trails. Your banana was very sweet!”

Mocco followed the small white spots that spread between the flowers. The spots were easy to see, like little pathways. After a little while, Mocco saw his banana under a big yellow flower. It was there, hidden among the petals!

Mocco jumped for joy and thanked Lila for her help. Lila smiled and flew away. Mocco realized that asking for help from someone can solve even the biggest problems. Mocco was happy to have his banana back. It was a beautiful day in the Secret Garden.

plan.problema: Marco had lost his favorite banana and didn’t know what to do.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the kindest butterfly in the garden, Lila, who suggested he follow the sugar trails.
plan.finale: Marco found his banana under a big flower, happy and pleased.
plan.morale: Collaboration is key to solving problems.

monkey.text:
Mocco was a teddy monkey who was very happy. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of strange flowers and plants. Mocco loved to climb trees and jump through the bushes. But today he wasn't happy. He had lost his favorite banana! It was a juicy yellow banana, the best in the world.

Mocco turned around and around, but the banana wasn't there anymore. “Oh no!” said Mocco, with a little shout. He didn't know what to do. He was very sad. He looked under the roses, he looked behind the big lavender bush, but nothing! The banana was gone.

Mocco felt a little down. He saw a big sunflower smiling at the sun. “Mr. Sunflower,” said Mocco, “I’ve lost my banana and I don’t know where to look!” The sunflower thought for a moment and then said, “Try to look among the leaves, Mocco! Maybe it fell there.”

Mocco thanked the sunflower and started to rummage through the leaves. He looked everywhere, under the big leaves and under the small leaves. He rummaged for a long time. He was a little tired, but he didn’t give up. Then, finally, he saw it! His yellow banana was hidden right under a rose bush!

Mocco jumped for joy and hugged his banana. “I found it!” he exclaimed. The sunflower smiled and said, “Well done, Mocco!” Mocco understood that sometimes you have to be patient to find what you’ve lost. And so, Mocco continued to play happily in the Secret Garden.

plan.problema: Mocco had lost his favorite banana and didn’t know what to do.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the big sunflower, who suggested he look among the leaves.
plan.finale: After searching for a long time, Mocco found his banana under a rose bush!

monkey.text:
Mocco was a very lively teddy monkey. He lived in the secret garden behind the house. It was a place full of fragrant flowers and tall trees. Mocco loved to explore the garden with his friends. His best friend was Rocco, a big blue rubber crocodile.

One day, Mocco was playing hide-and-seek among the red roses. He was having so much fun that he got lost! He couldn’t see Rocco anymore. “Oh no!” cried Mocco. “I’m lost!” The roses all looked the same, and Mocco was very confused. He had been looking for Rocco for a little while, but he couldn’t find him.

Mocco thought: “I need to find a place to see the garden better.” So he made a decision. He decided to climb the old stone fountain. It was tall and a little slippery, but Mocco was determined. He climbed slowly until he reached the top of the fountain.

From the top, Mocco saw the whole secret garden. And then… he saw him! Rocco was running towards him. “Mocco!” shouted Rocco. “I’ve looked for you everywhere!” Rocco ran to hug Mocco with joy. He was so happy to have found him.

Mocco felt relieved and happy. Together, monkey and crocodile, they continued to play in the secret garden. They had learned that when there are problems, it’s best to work together to solve them. And Mocco realized that Rocco was his best friend, always ready to help him.

plan.problema: Marco got lost among the roses and couldn't find his crocodile friend, Rocco.
plan.svolta: He decided to climb the old fountain for a better view of the garden.
plan.finale: Rocco saw him at the top of the fountain and ran to hug him with joy!

monkey.text:
Mocco was a teddy bear gorilla who was very happy. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Mocco loved to jump, climb, and make little gorilla noises. But today Mocco wasn't happy. He had lost his favorite banana, a juicy yellow banana that he liked so much.

“Oh no, oh no!” said Mocco, waving his arms. “Where has it gone?” He started to look everywhere in the secret garden. He looked under the rose bush, behind the fountain, and among the leaves of the apple tree. But the banana wasn’t there!

Mocco decided to ask for help. He saw a gnome sitting on a bench. The gnome was small, with a red hat and a pair of green shoes. “Gnome,” said Mocco, “have you seen my banana?” But the gnome was cleaning his shoes with a toothbrush. “I can’t help but clean my shoes!” replied the gnome without looking at Mocco.

Mocco was disappointed, but he didn’t give up. He decided to follow the twistiest path he found in the secret garden. The path was narrow and full of rocks, but Mocco kept walking. He walked back and forth, up and down, following the path without stopping.

Finally, Mocco saw something yellow under a big sunflower. It was his banana! Mocco jumped for joy. He had found his favorite banana thanks to patience. Mocco was happy and content. The sun was shining in the secret garden.

plan.problema: Rocco had lost his favorite banana and didn’t know where to look.
plan.svolta: He tried to ask for help from the garden gnome, but the gnome was too busy cleaning his shoes to listen.
plan.finale: Rocco decided to follow the most winding path and finally he found it under a giant sunflower!

monkey.text:
Mickey was a very happy teddy bear gorilla. He lived in the flower garden, among fragrant roses and tall sunflowers. He loved to play hide-and-seek with the butterflies that flew around the colorful petals. One day, Mickey saw a particularly beautiful daisy. It was the biggest of all, right there in front!

Mickey climbed up a small pedestal, but it wasn’t enough. His arms could almost reach it, but it was just a little too high. He wanted to reach that wonderful daisy. He tried to jump, he pulled himself up with his legs, but it was too tall. He was frustrated!

“I need to find a way,” thought Mickey. He decided to climb onto the rose bush. The thorns were a little prickly, but he didn’t give up. He made his way through the branches and… he slipped down without success! He had fallen to the ground, a little confused.

Mickey thought about it. He saw many leaves falling onto the bushes. An idea came to him: he built a small ladder with the biggest leaves. With patience, he placed the leaves one on top of the other, creating a little step. He climbed slowly, step by step. He reached the most beautiful daisy and hugged it tightly in his arms. It was right there, at a reachable level! Mickey was happy.

The sun was setting on the flower garden, painting the sky pink. Mickey sat next to the daisy, satisfied with his little achievement. Perseverance can help overcome even the biggest obstacles.

plan.problema: Mickey can't reach the last daisy because it's too tall.
plan.svolta: He decided to climb the rose bush, but he slid down without success.
plan.finale: With a little ingenuity, he built a small ladder with some leaves and finally reached the most beautiful daisy.

monkey.text:
Mocco was a very lively teddy monkey. He lived in a secret garden, full of colorful flowers and tall trees. He was the garden’s favorite toy, always ready for a new adventure. One day, Mocco was near a big bush of red roses. The roses smelled so wonderful!

Mocco started to explore. He found himself in a maze made of roses! He was confused. He couldn’t find his way out anymore. Every time he tried to go forward, he always ended up in the same place. “Oh no!” exclaimed Mocco, “I’m lost!”

Mocco decided to try jumping over the rose bushes. He jumped over a bush and fell down on the other side. The smell of the roses was so strong that it made him spin around even more! It was as if the roses wanted to keep him inside the maze.

Mocco stopped for a moment and thought. Then, he started to walk, one little step at a time. He walked slowly, looking carefully at every rose. Step by step, Mocco pushed his way through the roses. 

Finally, after so much walking, Mocco saw the light! He had come out of the rose maze and was back among the other toys in the secret garden. All his friends were waiting for him.

Mocco was happy to be home. His little adventure had shown that even when things seem difficult, with patience and perseverance, you can always find the solution. Mocco knew that every little step makes a difference.

plan.problema: Mocco has gotten lost in the rose maze!
plan.svolta: He tried to jump over the hedges, but only the scent of roses made him spin even more.
plan.finale: Thanks to his little adventurous step, Mocco managed to get out of the maze and back among the other toys.

mucca.text:
Miele was a Jersey cow. She lived on the green farm, among the wheat fields and fruit trees. Miele loved her place very much. Every day she played to stand up, to fall down, and to get back up.

 

One afternoon, while skipping happily, she got lost. She found herself in the middle of the sunflower field. The sunflowers were tall and yellow, a sea of flowers that made it hard to see the barn. Miele didn’t recognize anything. She was scared!

 

“Muuuuu,” said Miele with a trembling voice. “Muuu, help! I don’t know where I am!” But nobody answered. The sunflowers were too far away to hear her moo.

 

Miele decided to move slowly. She mooed softly, step by step, hoping someone would hear her. “Muuuu... Muuu...” Every moo was a little whisper in the big field.

 

Then, a white rabbit came closer. He had long ears and a pink nose. “What’s wrong?” asked the rabbit. Miele explained that she was lost. The rabbit smiled and said, “Follow the blue flower path, I’ll take you to the barn!”

 

Miele followed the rabbit’s instructions. The path was narrow and full of fragrant blue flowers. Finally, she saw her barn! She was so happy to be home. Miele settled in her favorite spot and thought that, even when you get lost, moving slowly and asking for help can make a difference.

plan.problema: Honey has lost her stable in the sunflower field and can't find it.
plan.svolta: She decided to move slowly, mooing softly to ask the flowers in the field for help.
plan.finale: A friendly rabbit showed her the right path, finally leading her to the safety of the stable.

mucca.text:
Berta was a very special cow. She lived on a green farm, full of tall trees and colorful flowers. Berta loved her barn, a big red building where she spent sunny days. But most of all, Berta loved to eat!

One day, Berta noticed that she couldn’t find the tastiest grass for her lunch. The regular grass was boring and dry. “Oh no!” mooed Berta. “Where can I find delicious grass?”

Berta started to walk, but she couldn’t find anything good. She turned around and around, looking among the cows eating the pasture grass. Nobody seemed to know where the perfect grass was.

Then Berta decided to take a nice walk around the barn. “Maybe there’s a secret meadow!” she thought. She walked and walked, passing between the hay bales and the green tractors.

Finally, after so much searching, Berta saw something wonderful! It was a field full of juicy heather, bright green and fragrant. Berta rushed over and started to eat with pleasure. “Mmmh, this is just the best thing!” said Berta, happy.

A little white rabbit hopped near Berta, but didn’t say anything. It just sniffed the grass before moving away. 

Berta rested, satisfied with her lunch. Patience had done its magic, and she had discovered a special place to eat. Berto thought that sometimes, when you wait calmly and curiously, beautiful things are revealed.

plan.problema: Berta can't find the tastiest grass for her lunch!
plan.svolta: She decided to take a nice walk around the barn, hoping to discover a secret meadow.
plan.finale: Finally, she found a field full of succulent heather, perfect for a greedy cow like her.

mucca.text:
Miele was a very special teddy bear cow. She lived on the sleepy farm, a quiet place where everything slept after lunch. Miele loved to be in the tall hay, but that day she had gotten lost. She couldn't hear her friend, the chicken, Pippo anymore.

“Oh no!” mooed Miele. She looked around, but she couldn't see Pippo anywhere. The hay was very high and full of straw! It was a big mess for a cow like her. Miele tried to call Pippo, but the chicken was too far away for her to hear.

Then Miele had an idea. She decided to moo loudly, loudly, loudly! She mooed so much that her cheeks puffed up. But Pippo didn't answer. Miele was sad and worried.

Then, she had another brilliant idea. She used her strong horn to dig in the hay. She dug and dug, making a little tunnel. The straw fell everywhere, but Miele kept digging. The tunnel became bigger and bigger.

Finally, the tunnel opened into a cozy nest among the beech trees. And there, right underneath her, was Pippo! The two friends hugged each other happily. Miele was so happy to have found her friend again.

The sleepy farm became even quieter and more peaceful, and Miele realized that sometimes, with a little patience and a little creativity, even the biggest problems can be solved.

plan.problema: Honey got lost in the tall hay and can't find her friend, chicken Pip.
plan.svolta: After trying to moo loudly to call Pip, Honey decided to use her horn to dig a small tunnel in the hay.
plan.finale: The tunnel led her directly to Pip’s nest, where the two friends happily hugged.
plan.morale: Patience and creativity help solve problems.

mucca.text:
Miele was a special cow. She lived on a green farm, full of green meadows and big trees. Miele loved to play in the hay and make bubbles with the sun. One day, while she was grazing, she walked up to a field full of sunflowers. The sunflowers were so tall! Miele wanted to see how tall they were.



She went deeper into the field, further and further, until she noticed that the sunflowers were surrounding her on all sides. She was lost! She couldn’t find her way back to the farm. Fear began to come and Miele started to tremble.



She tried to moo loudly, but her moo was lost among so many other noises in the field: the wind blowing, the birds singing, and the sun shining. Nobody could hear her. Miele was desperate.



She bumped into a big sunflower, trying to figure out how to get out of the field. Then, just when she was about to lose hope, she noticed something: between the tall stems of the sunflowers there was a small passage, almost hidden. Miele squeezed into the passage and… surprise! She found herself back in the pasture, with the other cows peacefully eating fresh grass.



Miele’s mommy cow came close and hugged her. Everything was over. Miele understood that when you get lost, you need to have a little patience and look calmly. After so much effort, even the smallest passage can lead to a wonderful surprise.

plan.problema: Honey got lost in the tall sunflower field!
plan.svolta: She tried to moo loudly, but no one heard her among so many noises.
plan.finale: Then she discovered a small passage between the flowers and found herself in the pasture with the other cows.

mucca.text:
Berta the cow was very greedy. She lived on a beautiful countryside farm, surrounded by green fields and a bright blue sky. Every day Berta needed to eat fresh grass to be happy. But today she couldn't find the tastiest grass!

“Oh no!” mooed Berta. “Where have I gotten? All the grass seems boring.” She looked around, but the main lawn had already been eaten by all the animals. Berta was very hungry and didn't know what to do. 

Berta decided to ask for help. She raised her head to the sky and called the sun. “Sun,” said Berta, “can you help me find the best grass?” The sun smiled with its warm rays and replied: “Look behind the barn, Berta. There’s a secret lawn there!”

Berta ran quickly behind the barn. And there it was! A lawn full of green and juicy grass that smelled of flowers. Berta went closer and started to eat happily. The grass was so good that Berta couldn't stop eating.

After eating everything she wanted, Berta lay down under a starry sky, tired but content. The sun had helped her. Berta closed her eyes and dreamed of fresh grass and secret lawns. It was a perfect evening for a greedy cow.

plan.problema: Berta can't find the tastiest grass for her lunch!
plan.svolta: She decided to ask for help from the sun, which showed her a hidden meadow behind the barn.
plan.finale: Berta happily ate the juicy grass and fell asleep under a starry sky.
plan.morale: Asking for help is always a good idea.

mucca.text:
Moo Moo the cow was happy on the green farm. The farm was full of green meadows and tall trees. Moo Moo loved to play among the yellow and red flowers. She had a special milk bucket, her favorite. She used it to “drink” milk when she felt a little sad.

One day, while Moo Moo was playing, she got lost! She couldn’t find her milk bucket anymore. She was very worried. “Mooo?” she asked, but nobody answered. She looked everywhere, behind the bushes and under the trees, but there was no trace of her bucket.

Then Moo Moo decided to try something different. She mooed loudly, loudly, loudly! The little birds in the sky started to sing in response. But it wasn’t the sound of her milk bucket. It was just the song of the birds.

Moo Moo felt a little discouraged. Then she noticed something: among the fragrant flowers there was a small hidden path. She followed it carefully. The path was narrow and full of colorful petals.

Finally, the path opened into a small clearing. And there, right in front of Moo Moo, was her milk bucket! She was happy to have found it. Moo Moo drank a little “milk” and she felt much better.

From that day on, Moo Moo always continued to look for the things she liked, even when it seemed difficult. And in the end, with a little perseverance, she always reached her goal. After so much searching, Moo Moo understood that never giving up is the key to finding what you’re looking for.

plan.problema: Moo Moo is lost and can't find her milk pail.
plan.svolta: She tried to moo loudly, but only the little birds answered!
plan.finale: Then she discovered a secret path among the flowers and finally found her pail.

mucca.text:
Mela was a woolen cow, lively and a little bit greedy. She lived on a green farm, full of fresh grass and warm sunshine. She loved to play among the yellow flowers and listen to the song of the birds. But Mela had a big problem. She had lost her little bell! It was a small, silvery bell that she liked very much, because it made her sleep soundly.

Without her bell, Mela couldn’t fall asleep anymore. She turned around and around in her stall, and she felt sad and lonely. “Oh no!” mooed Mela. “How will I have a nap?”

Mela tried to shout loudly, hoping that someone would hear her. She shouted all afternoon, but nobody answered. She felt even more lonely. The sun began to set and the farm became quieter.

Then, Mela noticed something strange. A little bird was sitting next to her, and he was using her bell to build a beautiful little house! The bird was putting it among the twigs and using it like a little brick.

Mela slowly walked towards the bird and gently took her bell. It was still clean and shiny. With great joy, Mela went back to her stall and fell asleep right away, with her bell tinkling softly.

Mela understood that sometimes you have to wait a little while to find what you’ve lost. And so, the woolen cow slept peacefully on the green farm.

plan.problema: Apple has lost her rattle and can't go to sleep anymore.
plan.svolta: She tried to shout loudly, but no one heard her and she felt even more alone.
plan.finale: Then, she discovered that a little bird had picked up the rattle and was using it to build a beautiful little house.

mucca.text:
Miele was a very special teddy bear cow. She lived on the green farm, a place full of tall grass and leafy trees. Miele loved watching Farmer Bruno as he worked in his garden. Bruno was always kind to her and often took her for a swing.

One day, Miele was skipping happily when she noticed that Bruno was no longer visible. He was lost! Miele felt very scared. The flower field was huge and full of bright colors. It was easy to get lost among the yellow daisies, red tulips, and blue violets.

Miele thought, “I must find Bruno!” So she decided to call out all the colors she knew. “Yellow like the sun!” she shouted loudly. Then she added, “Blue like the sky!” And again, “Red like the tulips!” She tried to find her way, following the colors of the field. She was a little confused, but she didn’t give up.

Suddenly, she heard a familiar voice. “Miele! Where had you gone?” Miele spun around and saw Bruno busy picking vegetables from his garden. He was happy to see her again. Bruno hugged his favorite teddy bear cow.

Miele snuggled up next to Bruno, feeling safe and happy. The green farm seemed even more beautiful with her friend nearby. She had learned that even when things seem difficult, a little help and a good friend can make all the difference.

plan.problema: Honey got lost in the big flower field and couldn't find her tired hero, Farmer Bruno.
plan.svolta: She decided to call all the colors she knew to help her find her way.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the yellow of the sun and the blue of the sky, Honey found Bruno busy picking vegetables from his garden.

mucca.text:
Muccia the cow lived on a beautiful countryside farm. She was a special cow because she could talk and move! She loved the sun and the fresh grass very much. One day, Muccia noticed something terrible: she had lost her favorite flower.

The flower was a yellow flower, small and fragrant. Muccia always kept it tied to her nose with a thin string. It was her most beautiful flower and she loved to look at it when the sun warmed her. Without it, Muccia felt sad.

“Oh no!” mooed Muccia. “Where did my flower go?” She thought she had to find it right away. She started to look first around her favorite spot in the meadow. She turned and turned among the tall grass, trying to see something yellow.

Then, Muccia decided to do a careful search. She squeezed into the tallest grass, peering among the pebbles and small bushes. Carefully, she made her way through the wildflowers. The wind was blowing lightly, making the grass wave.

Finally, after so much searching, Muccia found it! It was hidden under a clover leaf, exactly where the sun didn’t reach. Muccia hugged her flower tightly to her nose, happy and content.

A little chick, Pipì, approached Muccia. “How lovely, Muccia! Do you like your flower?” said the chick. Muccia mooed a thank you and smiled.

Muccia realized that with calmness and patience, even lost things can be found. And so, the cow continued to enjoy her little yellow flower.

plan.problema: Meadow had lost her favorite sonnet, a yellow flower she loved so much.
plan.svolta: She decided to make a meticulous search in the tall grass, looking for clues among the clumps and small bushes.
plan.finale: Finally she found it, hidden under a clover leaf, and hugged it tightly to her happy muzzle.

mucca.text:
Miele was a fluffy sheep-colored cow, very funny and a little bit clumsy. She lived on the green farm, a place full of tall trees and juicy fruits. Miele loved to run through the fields and play with the clouds.

One day, Miele was in the orchard. There were red apples, yellow pears, and soft peaches. She had walked too close to a peach tree and, when she turned around, she couldn’t see her fence anymore! She was lost among the tall, green trees.

Miele mooed sadly. “Oh no,” she said. “I don’t know how to get back!” She tried to walk forward, then backward, but every tree looked the same to her. She was very scared.

Then Miele had an idea. She used her horn and made “Muuu! Muuu!” with all her strength. The sound was loud and ringing. The birds stopped singing, and the insects hid.

A little squirrel, who was collecting nuts, heard the moo. He cautiously approached Miele. “Is it you?” asked the squirrel. “I heard you!”

The squirrel, very kind, began to guide Miele with small steps, following her moos. He gently led her towards the fence.

Finally, Miele reached her fence and felt relieved. She thanked the squirrel. “Thank you very much!” said Miele.

The squirrel smiled and went back to collecting nuts. Miele realized that even a little help can make a difference.

plan.problema: Honey has gotten lost among the many trees of the orchard and can’t find her fence.
plan.svolta: She decided to use her horn to make loud noises, hoping someone would call her.
plan.finale: A little squirrel, hearing her moos, gently led her home.

octopus.text:
Polipo lived in a little bathroom. He was a rubber octopus, soft and colorful. He had eight long, flexible tentacles. Polipo loved to play in the bathroom, but sometimes he had problems.

---

One day, his friends, Ventose, were scattered everywhere! Some were near the sink, others under the faucet, and others still in a corner of the floor. But Polipo couldn’t reach them all! They were too far for him. He moved back and forth, but his ventosas always stayed hidden. He was very frustrated.

---

Polipo thought, thought, and thought. Then he had an idea! “If I could stretch out,” he said to himself, “I could reach them too!” He looked carefully around. He saw an old toothbrush lying on the floor. With one of his tentacles, he picked up the toothbrush and tied it to another tentacle.

---

So Polipo built a swing! He swung back and forth, using his longest tentacles to reach the farthest ventosas. With a big wiggle, Polipo reached every single ventosa, one after another. He was happy and satisfied. His reflection of the bathroom looked at him smiling.

---

Polipo’s mom, seeing his success, told him, “Good job, Polipo, you were very patient!” Polipo understood that with a little effort and creativity, he could overcome any difficulty. Perseverance can really lead to amazing results.

plan.problema: Polipo can't reach all his suckers because they are too far away!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his longest tentacles to make a swing and reach the ones up high.
plan.finale: With a big wiggle, Polipo reached every single sucker, happy and satisfied.

octopus.text:
Polipo lived on the sandy beach. He was a very special toy octopus, because he could talk! He loved to play making bubbles, but one day something bad happened. Polipo woke up and discovered that his eight tentacles were missing. He didn’t know how to make bubbles!

He was very sad. He looked everywhere for his lost tentacles. He looked under the seashells, behind the seaweed, and among the rocks. But none of them had come back. Polipo couldn’t make even one little bubble of soap. 

Then a soft cloud arrived. A seagull, Leo, offered him the cloud to help him. Polipo tried to blow up the cloud with soap, but the cloud melted too quickly! It was a disaster.

Polipo was almost without hope. Suddenly, he noticed something strange: little bubbles of air were sticking to his tentacles. Polipo took a deep breath and made a hole. The bubbles became bigger and bigger! 

He learned to control his breath to make the bubbles grow. Now he could make beautiful giant bubbles of soap on the sandy beach. Polipo smiled happily, and Leo watched him with admiration. 

Polipo had learned that even when things seem difficult, if you are patient, you always find a solution. Everything comes at the right time.

plan.problema: The octopus had lost his eight tentacles and couldn’t make bubbles anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to use a fluffy cloud, but the cloud melted too quickly.
plan.finale: Then he found bubbles of air that stuck to his tentacles and learned to make them big with his breath!

octopus.text:
Polipo was a very happy rubber octopus.
He lived on Sand Beach, right next to the waves.
He loved to play in the sand and with seashells.
But today Polipo had a problem.
His tummies were missing!
They were eight beautiful, colorful tummies:
red, yellow, blue, green, purple, orange, pink, and brown.
He had lost them everywhere!

Polipo looked around.
The beach was full of white sand and green seaweed.
He was looking for his tummies but he couldn’t find them.
“Oh no!” said Polipo. “They must be scattered everywhere!”
He started to look between the waves, but the tummies were gone.

Polipo decided to do something smart.
He used his eight arms and started to move slowly around the beach.
He turned around himself, exploring every corner.
He squeezed under big and small seashells.
He also checked between the green seaweed that clung to the rocks.

After a while, Polipo found the first tummy, the red one, hidden right under a big pink seashell.
Then he found others: the yellow one under a rock, the blue one near the water, the green one among the seaweed tufts.
One by one, Polipo recovered all his colorful tummies!

Finally, after a long time, Polipo was complete again.
He was so happy that he rolled up himself and smiled.
The beach looked even more beautiful with all his colors.
Polipo understood that searching calmly and patiently made all the difference.

plan.problema: The octopus couldn't find his colorful bellies, scattered everywhere on the beach.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his eight arms to go around the beach completely, searching every corner.
plan.finale: He found all his bellies hidden under the seashells and under the seaweed, happy to be complete again!

octopus.text:
Polipo lived on the sandy beach. He was a soft, colorful toy octopus, full of silky curls. He loved to play among the waves and collect seashells. One day, Polipo noticed a problem. His silky curls were gone!

Polipo began to look everywhere. He squeezed under the rocks, explored the sand dunes, and climbed over some pebbles. But his curls weren’t there. He was very worried! He couldn’t play without his soft curls.

Polipo was so thirsty to find his curls. He had been searching for a long time, but he couldn’t find them. Then he had an idea. Near his little den, there were many seashells. The seashells were quiet and crooked, but Polipo thought they might help him.

“Seashells, please! I lost my curls!” said Polipo. “Could you help me find them?” The seashells listened carefully. Then, a big, old seashell spoke: “Look under the big rock!”

Polipo ran quickly to the biggest rock on the beach. And there, hidden among the roots, shone his silky curls! Polipo picked them up happily. He was so happy to have found them thanks to the help of the seashells. 

Polipo realized that even if it’s important to look on your own, asking for help can be a great idea. And when everyone works together, things always get better.

plan.problema: Polipo can’t find his silky curls scattered on the beach.
plan.svolta: After searching for hours, Polipo decides to ask for help from the shells near his den.
plan.finale: The shells, with their marine wisdom, guide him to his shimmering curls hidden under a large rock.

octopus.text:
Polipo loved the sandy beach. He was an octopus toy, made of soft rubber and full of suction cups. Every day he enjoyed rolling on the warm sand, making slides and swirls. Polipo knew how to do something special: make bubbles of soap! He used his eight arms to dip in liquid soap and air. The bubbles flew high in the blue sky.

One day, Polipo noticed that something wasn't right. His tentacles were missing! They had disappeared! Without them, he couldn't make bubbles anymore. He was very sad. “Oh no!” said Polipo, “How will I make the bubbles?”

He started to look for a solution. He found an old sponge and tried to use it to make bubbles. But the sponge was too big! When Polipo tried to dip it in soap, the sponge rolled him away from the beach. It was a disaster!

Polipo sat on the sand thinking. He closed his eyes and took a deep breath. Then, with a little click, he started to move his suction cups. He realized that he could use the suction cups to create small bubbles of soap! They were perfect, big and shiny.

A seagull, who was watching Polipo, cawed in approval. Polipo continued to make bubbles, happy to have found his special way to play. The sand shone under the colorful bubbles.

Polipo learned that, even when things seem difficult, with a little patience you can always find the right solution. And so, Polipo continued to make bubbles on the sandy beach, forever happy.

plan.problema: The octopus lost his eight tentacles and can’t make bubbles anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to use sponges, but they were too big and made him roll away.
plan.finale: Then, with a little click, he created perfect bubbles using only his suckers!

octopus.text:
Polipo was a very happy rubber octopus. He lived on the sandy beach, near the sea. Every day he enjoyed rolling in the sand and playing with the waves. Polipo also had little candy pieces that he always kept attached to his eight tentacles. He loved them so much!

One morning, Polipo noticed that his candy pieces had disappeared! He looked everywhere: under the biggest shell, behind a clump of seaweed, even inside the wet sand. But none of his candy pieces were anywhere. He was very sad.

Polipo decided to dive into the sea to look for them. He moved quickly through the green algae and colorful corals. He explored every corner, but he didn’t find even one candy piece. “Oh no!” thought Polipo, becoming more and more worried.

Suddenly, he saw a sea turtle approaching. The turtle had… Polipo’s candy pieces in its mouth! “You were looking for food for your little one,” explained the turtle with a kind smile. “I thought they were delicious candies.”

Polipo understood right away what had happened. He felt happy and pleased. He picked up his candy pieces and brought them back to the beach. Sharing them with the turtle and her baby made the day much more beautiful. 

Polipo rolled up in the sand, smiling. The happiness of sharing was a wonderful thing.

plan.problema: The octopus had lost all his candy pieces!
plan.svolta: He dove dived deep into the sea, searching among the seashells and seaweed, but he found none.
plan.finale: He then discovered that a sea turtle had collected his pieces, thinking they were food for her baby.

octopus.text:
Polipo lived on the sandy beach. He was a toy octopus, soft and colorful, and he loved to play among the waves. Every day he moved happily, sliding on the sand and hopping in the water. But one day, something had changed. Polipo couldn't move!

He noticed that all of his suckers, those little sticky pads that made him move, were gone! He had lost them everywhere: under the rocks, among the seaweed, even inside the shell of a little shrimp. Polipo was very sad and felt helpless. He couldn't do anything anymore.

Then, Polipo had an idea. He collected lots of small white and colorful shells. With patience, he built tiny houses for each of his lost suckers. He placed them gently beside him, hoping that one of them would stick and help him move again.

While he waited, he saw Stella arrive, a little starfish. Stella was curious about Polipo and wanted to help him. With slow and gentle movements, she collected all the little shell houses and returned Polipo’s suckers. Polipo was overjoyed! He could finally move again on the sandy beach.

Polipo thanked Stella a thousand times. Stella smiled and said, “It was a pleasure to make a new friend.” Polipo understood that kindness could really do miracles. Polipo’s happiness reflected in a bright smile.

plan.problema: The octopus had lost all his suckers and couldn’t move anymore!
plan.svolta: He decided to build little seashell houses for each one, hoping they would stick.
plan.finale: Finally, a little starfish kindly returned all his suckers, happy to have made a new friend.

octopus.text:
Polipo was a very happy octopus. He lived on the sandy beach, right by the sea. He loved to play collecting the shiny seashells that the sea brought in with the tide. He had eight strong and long tentacles, perfect for grabbing every shell.

One day, Polipo noticed a problem. “Oh no!” he exclaimed. “Where have my tentacles gone?” He looked around and saw that they were missing! They had disappeared! He couldn’t catch the shells anymore. He was very sad.

Polipo tried to look for them in the sand, but it was too difficult. He searched everywhere, but his tentacles were nowhere to be found. He felt frustrated. “I have to do something!” Polipo thought.

Then he had an idea! He took his shell, the big, round one that he had, and used it as a little shovel. He started to dig carefully in the sand. He dug here, he dug there, without stopping. He was patient.

After a long time, Polipo found something! Under a big rock, hidden in the sand, were his eight tentacles! He grabbed them right away and stretched them out. “I did it!” he shouted happily.

A little seagull, who had been watching Polipo, said to him, “You did a fantastic job!” Polipo smiled. He was happy to have found his tentacles again. Now he could go back to playing on the beach and collecting all the shells he wanted. 

Polipo understood that even when things seem difficult, you shouldn’t give up and look patiently. And so, Polipo continued to play happily on the sandy beach.

plan.problema: The octopus had lost his eight tentacles and couldn’t collect seashells anymore!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his shell as a small shovel to look for his lost tentacles.
plan.finale: After a while, he found all his tentacles hidden under a big rock, happy and ready to play.

octopus.text:
Polipo was a special toy octopus. He lived on the sandy beach, near the sea. He loved to play and make waves with his water. But one day, Polipo noticed a problem. He had lost his eight tentacles! He didn't know where they had gone. Without his tentacles, he couldn't move quickly in the water and, especially, he couldn't make the waves he loved so much.

Polipo was very sad. He sat down on the wet sand and looked around. He looked for them among the colorful seashells. “Maybe someone can help me?” he asked a big seashell. "But you're just a seashell, you can't replace my tentacles!" the seashell replied. Polipo tried to ask for help from a little starfish too, but she couldn't help him either.

Then, Polipo saw a little coral fish that lived near the shore. The fish had small, colorful bumps that poked out from his body. “Hello!” said Polipo. “I’ve lost my tentacles and I don’t know how to make waves anymore.” The coral fish smiled. Together, Polipo and the fish started to move. The fish’s bumps moved in the water and the water sparkled with a thousand colors! They made wonderful waves that crashed on the beach. 

Polipo realized that even though he was different, he could still do fantastic things. Together, Polipo and the little coral fish had found a way to start playing again.

plan.problema: The octopus had lost his eight tentacles and couldn’t make waves anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to ask for help from the shells, but none could replace his tentacles.
plan.finale: Then he discovered that a small coral fish had small bumps like tentacles, and together they made the water sparkle, creating wonderful waves!

octopus.text:
Polipo lived on the sandy beach. He was a toy octopus, soft and colorful. He loved to draw with his pencil on big sheets of paper. But one day, something went wrong. Polipo realized that his eight tentacles were gone! There were no more his long, flexible arms.

Polipo tried to draw a straight line. But the line was curved, zigzag, all wrong. He was very sad. “I can’t draw straight lines anymore!” exclaimed Polipo. Nobody helped him. Only the wind blew on the beach.

A little crab, named Carlo, passed by and saw Polipo worried. Carlo said, “Try to use a seashell! It might help you guide your lines.” Polipo took a big white seashell and tried to draw. But even then, the line was curved. It didn’t work.

Polipo got a little angry. Then, he did something different. He started to squeeze his remaining tentacles tightly. Squeeze, squeeze, squeeze. And unbelievably, the lines he drew became perfect, straight, and precise!

Polipo smiled. With patience and care, he built a beautiful sandcastle with tall towers and strong walls. The sun shone on the beach and the sea made gentle waves. Polipo was happy. He had learned that focusing and doing things slowly leads to wonderful results. Perseverance makes every task easier to accomplish.

plan.problema: The octopus had lost his eight tentacles and couldn’t draw straight lines anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to use a shell as a guide, but the lines were still curved.
plan.finale: Then he discovered that by holding his arms tight he could draw perfect lines and he drew a beautiful sandcastle.

orso.text:
Bear Bruno was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in the Flower Garden, under the big, shady tree. He loved to play among the red roses and the yellow sunflowers. One day, Bear Bruno wandered too far from his place. Running after a blue butterfly, he ended up in a tall meadow, full of tall grass and fragrant flowers.

He realized right away that he was lost! The meadow was much bigger than he thought. He tried to find his way home under the tree, but he couldn’t see it. The grass was so high that it blocked his view. Bear Bruno felt a little sad.

He decided then to shout for help: “Help! I’m here!” But the wind was blowing hard and carried away his words, without anyone hearing them. A little rubber crocodile, Coco, passed by and told Bear Bruno, “Maybe you should look in another direction!”

Bear Bruno didn’t give up. He continued to walk, pushing himself through the colorful flowers. He tried to follow the sun to find the right path. With a lot of determination, he found a little secret path between the white daisies and the red tulips.

Finally, after so much searching, Bear Bruno found himself back under the big tree, happier than ever. He was happy to be home. Bear Bruno understood that if he had stopped trying, he would never have been able to find his way. Perseverance had led him to success.

plan.problema: Bruno the Bear was lost in the tall meadow and couldn’t find his way home under the tree.
plan.svolta: He decided to shout for help, but the wind carried his words away and no one heard him.
plan.finale: He found a secret path among the flowers, thanks to his determination, and finally returned under the tree happy.

orso.text:
Poldo was a teddy bear who was very happy. He lived in Zia Rosa’s garden and loved to be there, near the apple tree. Poldo loved apples! Every day, Zia Rosa offered him a juicy one.

But one morning, Poldo noticed that something wasn't right. His tummy, his soft fabric tummy, was gone! There was no more. Poldo tried to look everywhere, but the tummy had disappeared without a trace. Without his tummy, Poldo couldn't eat apples anymore! He was really sad.

Poldo decided to ask for help. He went to the apple tree and saw Bruno, a friendly crocodile who lived nearby. “Bruno,” said Poldo, “I’ve lost my tummy and I can’t eat apples anymore!”
