Bruno stretched and said, “Don’t worry, Poldo! I’ll look for your tummy.” Bruno ran towards the rose bush and dug for a while. Finally, he found Poldo’s tummy, hidden among the leaves. He brought it back to Poldo right away.

Poldo hugged his tummy with joy. Then, Zia Rosa offered him an apple. Poldo ate it happily and contentedly. Bruno smiled. 

Poldo realized that asking for help was the right thing to do when you had a problem. Sometimes, even the biggest crocodiles can be true friends.

plan.problema: Poor Poldo has lost his tummy and can’t eat apples anymore!
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from Crocodile Bruno, who lives near the apple tree.
plan.finale: Bruno found Poldo’s tummy under the rose bush and returned it to Happy Bear.
plan.morale: Asking for help is always a good idea.

orso.text:
Teddy was a very soft teddy bear. He lived in a flower garden, a place full of colors and delicious smells. He loved to play among the red tulips and the yellow daisies. His favorite friend was a little rabbit named Pipì.

One day, Teddy was chasing a bright blue butterfly. The butterfly flew away, and Teddy found himself surrounded by tall flowers. It was all so big! He couldn't see Pipì anymore. “Oh no!” said Teddy. “I’m lost!”

Teddy looked for Pipì everywhere. He looked between the fragrant roses and under the tall sunflowers. But the little rabbit didn't see him. Teddy was sad. He really wanted to find his friend.

Then, Teddy had an idea. He decided to gently scratch the leaves with his paw. He made a “gra gra” sound on a “gra gra” sound. He hoped the sound would attract Pipì’s attention. 

After a while, he heard a little hop. A bush nearby moved! Finally, the little rabbit jumped out. Pipì ran towards Teddy and hugged him with joy! “Teddy! I was lost!” said Pipì.

Teddy was so happy to see his friend again. Together, the teddy bear and the little rabbit continued to play in the flower garden. It was nice to work together to solve problems.

plan.problema: Bear got lost among the big flowers and couldn't find his friend Rabbit.
plan.svolta: He decided then to gently scratch the leaves with his paw to attract Rabbit's attention.
plan.finale: Finally, Rabbit hopped out of a bush and hugged Bear with joy!

orso.text:
Bear Bruno was a very soft teddy bear. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Bear Bruno loved to explore the garden every day. But one day something didn't go as usual.

After rolling down a dirt hill, Bear Bruno found himself in a corner of the garden he had never seen before. It was all big and unknown! And then, he felt a great fear: his friend, Pip, was missing. Pip was always happy and hopping around the garden.

Bear Bruno called out loudly: “Pip! Pip, where are you?” But he didn't get a reply. Bear Bruno was very sad. He sat down on a rose bush and felt lost. 

Suddenly, Bear Bruno had an idea. “If I have to find Pip,” he thought, “maybe I should follow his soft ears!” Pip’s ears were always down to the ground, when he was sleeping or listening. Bear Bruno began to walk following Pip’s ears, moving slowly among the plants.

After a while, he heard a little “hello!” and saw Pip hidden under a giant rose, red like his heart. Pip was happy to see Bear Bruno! They hugged tightly, smiling. 

Bear Bruno realized how important it was to have a friend to play with and share his adventures in the Secret Garden. It was nice to return together with Pip, knowing that friendship makes every day special.

plan.problema: Bear Bruno got lost in the garden and couldn't find his little friend bunny.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow his soft ears, hoping they would lead him to his friend.
plan.finale: Finally, he heard a little ‘hello’ and found the bunny hiding under a giant rose.

orso.text:
Bear Bruno lived in the Flowery Garden. He was a soft, brown teddy bear, very happy with his life among the fragrant flowers. Every day he played among the red roses and the yellow lily. But today Bear Bruno was sad. He couldn't find his favorite box!

The box was small and blue with a picture of a star. It was there where he rested when it was too hot. He looked everywhere: under the hydrangea, behind the clover, even inside the geranium vase. But the box was gone.

Bear Bruno was worried. He sat on a lavender bush and sighed. He saw a white butterfly fluttering around him. “Hello, little butterfly,” said Bear Bruno. “I’ve lost my box!” The butterfly listened carefully. Then, with a flap of its wings, it pointed to the lawn. “Follow me,” it whispered.

Bear Bruno followed the butterfly across the green lawn to the abandoned farmhouse at the edge of the garden. The butterfly landed on an old door and Bear Bruno saw the blue box under a big apple tree.

He ran to it, picked it up between his paws, and curled up softly on the lawn. He felt so happy! It was time to sleep. The white butterfly flew away. Bear Bruno closed his eyes and thought that sometimes finding things just takes a little patience. And, when you find the right thing, you can curl up peacefully.

plan.problema: Bruno the Bear can’t find his favorite box where he rests.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the butterflies, who guided him through the meadow to the abandoned farmhouse.
plan.finale: He found the box under an old tree and curled up to sleep peacefully.

orso.text:
Bruno the Bear was a big, soft teddy bear. He lived in the Flower Garden, among fragrant roses and colorful flowers. Every day, Bruno the Bear loved to explore the garden, walking among the plants. One afternoon, while playing hide-and-seek with the bellflowers, he got lost.

He found himself in a maze of red and pink roses. The roses were so tall that Bruno the Bear couldn’t see beyond them. He desperately searched for a way out, but every time he ended up in a dead end. He was sad and a little scared. He didn’t know where to go and he felt lonely.

Bruno the Bear thought for a moment. He saw that the sun was shining brightly in one spot of the maze. He decided to follow that bright path. He moved slowly, trying not to stumble among the roses. The path became clearer and clearer, and the sun warmed him.

Finally, after a long walk, Bruno the Bear saw a bright light! He came out of the maze and found a little bunny hopping happily. “Bruno the Bear!” shouted the bunny. “We were looking for you!” Bruno the Bear was so happy to be found.

The sun continued to shine in the Flower Garden, lighting up the roses and making everything more beautiful. Bruno the Bear realized that he had never stopped looking and this had helped him find his way. After so much effort, it’s always better to persevere to reach your goal.

plan.problema: Bear Bruno had gotten lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his way out.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the brightest path, the one where the sun shone the strongest.
plan.finale: Finally, Bear Bruno came out of the maze and found his little friend bunny, happy to have found him.

orso.text:
Orso Bruno was a very special teddy bear. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. Orso Bruno loved to explore the garden, but one morning he had gotten lost. He had ended up in a real maze of red roses, yellow tulips, and purple lavender.

Orso Bruno looked for his friend gnome Pippo everywhere. He shouted: "Pippo! Pippo where are you?". But nobody answered. The gnome was always so cheerful and he was always waiting for him near the little pond. Orso Bruno felt very sad.

He decided to follow the brightest path, the one that shone thanks to the sunlight reflected on the petals. He walked and walked, but the path led him to a dead end. It was full of white daisies, beautiful, but there was no Pippo.

Orso Bruno frowned. He couldn't give up. He remembered the words of his mama bear: “If you have a problem, look for it calmly!”. So, Orso Bruno continued to look around, searching every corner of the garden.

Finally, under a big sunflower that seemed to touch the sky, Orso Bruno saw him! Pippo was there, smiling, waiting only for him. Together they went back to play in the Secret Garden, happy to be friends again. Orso Bruno understood that even when things seem difficult, if you never give up, you always find the solution.

plan.problema: Bruno the Bear got lost in the maze of flowers and couldn't find his little friend Gnome Pippo.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the brightest path, but he found himself in a dead end full of white daisies.
plan.finale: Bruno the Bear, with a big sigh, found Pippo waiting for him under a big sunflower and together they went back to play.

orso.text:
Teddy was a very silly teddy bear. He lived in the garden at home, among the roses and tulips. He loved to play there, but sometimes he got lost. One day, while exploring the tall grass, Teddy noticed that he couldn’t see his family of toys anymore: all the other teddy bears, dolls, and toy trains. Everything was quiet and green around him.

Teddy was scared. He couldn’t find anyone. The grass was very tall and the weeds hid him. Teddy felt lonely and a little sad. He tried to call his friends, but nobody answered.

Then, Teddy had an idea! He focused and blew with all his might. He blew hard, he blew hard again! He knew that Felix, the cat, often was in the garden. Maybe he would hear his blow.

Felix was sitting on the stone wall. He listened carefully to Teddy’s blow and approached curiously. He followed the sound to the tall grass where Teddy had gotten lost. Felix, with a happy step, reached him and quickly brought him back to his family of toys.

All the other toys welcomed Teddy with joy. He was happy to be back home. Teddy realized that even when things seem difficult, a little bit of courage can make a difference. And so, Teddy continued to play in the garden, always knowing that he could count on Felix.

plan.problema: Bear got lost in the tall meadow and couldn't find his toy family.
plan.svolta: He decided to call for help, blowing with all his might to attract the attention of cat Felix.
plan.finale: Felix, curious about the puff, followed Bear to the meadow and brought him back to his family happily.

orso.text:
Teddy was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in the Flower Garden, among fragrant roses and tall sunflowers. Teddy loved to play there, rolling on the soft grass. One day, Teddy saw the rabbit, Pipì. Pipì was celebrating his birthday!

Teddy ran to say hello to his friend. But then, Pipì jumped away too quickly. Teddy found himself in the tall meadow, a meadow full of tall grass and wildflowers. He couldn’t see Pipì anymore. He was scared!

“Oh no!” said Teddy. “I don’t know where my friend is.” He looked around, but everything seemed the same. He tried to shout to Pipì, but his voice was too small to be heard.

Teddy made a decision. He decided to crawl under the daisies, hoping to see something. But he had only made things even more confusing! The daisies were so many and all looked alike.

A red ladybug arrived at the same time in the meadow. “What’s happening?” asked the ladybug. Teddy explained his problem. The ladybug thought for a little while and then said, “Wait, I saw Pipì! He was celebrating near the big lavender bush.”

Teddy followed the ladybug and, in just a few minutes, he found Pipì who had a carrot-shaped cake. Teddy joined the party and everyone was happy.

plan.problema: Bear got lost in the tall meadow and couldn't find his friend rabbit.
plan.svolta: He decided to crawl under the daisies, but he only got even more confused!
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a ladybug, Bear found the rabbit who was celebrating his birthday.

orso.text:
Teddy was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. It was his favorite place in the world! One day, Teddy was exploring the big meadow, the one that was very tall where the flowers smelled the strongest. He loved to roll on the fresh grass.

But then, a little too excited, Teddy found himself in the middle of the tall meadow. It was very, very high! He couldn't see his house, his favorite corner under the apple tree. He felt lonely and a little scared. He tried to walk, but the grass was too high and he got lost more and more.

Teddy thought he had to do something. He decided to shout loudly, just like the birds do. “Grrr! Grrr! Help!” he shouted with all his might. Nobody answered. Teddy was really alone.

Suddenly, he heard a small sound: “Cucù?” He looked up and saw a little brown squirrel, with a bushy and lively tail. The squirrel came closer to Teddy and said, “I heard you shouting! I will guide you to your special place.”

The squirrel ran back and forth, pointing the way. Finally, Teddy reached his favorite corner under the apple tree, just where he wanted to be. He was happy to be back home. Teddy snuggled up on the soft meadow, thinking that asking for help could really be a fantastic idea.

plan.problema: Bear has gotten lost in the tall meadow and can’t find his way home.
plan.svolta: He decided to shout loudly, hoping someone would hear him and help.
plan.finale: A little kind squirrel led him to his favorite corner of the garden.
plan.morale: Asking for help is always a good idea.

panda.text:
Panda Piuccio lived in the Secret Garden. He was a teddy bear panda and he was very happy and loved to play there. He had lots of friends among the leaves and flowers, but especially he had a favorite red ball! His red ball was soft and smelled like strawberries!

One day, Panda Piuccio was rolling his red ball in the meadow. Suddenly, the ball disappeared! Panda Piuccio looked everywhere. He looked under the tree, inside the rose bush and behind the stones. But the red ball was no longer there.

Panda Piuccio felt sad. His red ball was important to him. He tried to climb the rose bush, but it was too high and he always slipped down. He couldn't reach the ball!

Suddenly, Panda Piuccio saw two red ladybugs flying around. “Help!” shouted Panda Piuccio. “My red ball fell into the rose bush and I can’t get it!”

The ladybugs landed on the rose bush. With their little antennae, they quickly spotted the red ball. They picked it up gently and brought it to Panda Piuccio.

Panda Piuccio took his red ball and smiled again. He was happy! Thanks to the ladybugs, he had found his favorite toy. He felt happy and cheerful.

Panda Piuccio realized that working together, even with little helpers like the ladybugs, could be very fun.

plan.problema: Panda Piuccio has lost his favorite ball in the rose bush!
plan.svolta: After trying to climb the bush, uselessly, Piuccio had an idea: he called for help from the ladybugs.
plan.finale: The ladybugs picked up the ball and returned it to Piuccio, who immediately got his smile back.

panda.text:
Pippo was a teddy bear panda. He lived in the Secret Garden. It was a place full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. Pippo loved his garden very much. He spent his days watching butterflies and listening to the birds singing.

One day, Pippo noticed a problem. He had lost all his buttons! They were the ones that held his body together. Without the buttons, he had become a tattered panda. He was very sad. He looked everywhere, but he couldn't find his buttons.

Pippo climbed under the red roses. He examined behind the fragrant lavender bush. He didn't find them even under the tree with the big leaves. He was tired and a little discouraged. “Maybe I should take a nap,” Pippo thought, closing his eyes.

After a while, Pippo woke up. He looked around. His buttons were still missing! Then he saw something strange. The buttons were in the meadow, near the hydrangea bush. And there was a ladybug using them to build a little house. The ladybug was very happy, and the buttons were serving as building blocks for her.

Pippo realized he didn’t need to rush. He had been patient, and in the end, he had found the solution. The ladybug was using her buttons to build a house, and Pippo was happy to see his new friend playing. 

He sat down next to the ladybug, happy with the day. Sometimes, being patient helps you find things in an unexpected way.

plan.problema: Pippo had lost all his buttons!
plan.svolta: After searching under the roses and behind the lavender bush, Pippo decided to take a long nap.
plan.finale: When he woke up, his buttons were gone in the meadow, where a ladybug was using them to build a house.

panda.text:
Panda Leo loved the Flowery Garden very much. His little wooden house was there, among the tulips and roses. Panda Leo adored decorating his house with the prettiest ribbons. He had a bag full of colorful ribbons, but today his favorite was missing: a ribbon blue like the sky.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Panda Leo. “Where did my blue ribbon go? I need to use it for the door of my house!” He began to look everywhere, under the daisies and among the geraniums. But the blue ribbon was no longer there. It was gone!

Panda Leo decided to ask for help from the butterflies that fluttered in the garden. “Butterflies, have you seen a blue ribbon? I’m looking for it!” he asked a yellow butterfly. The butterfly nodded its head and said, “I don’t see it, Panda Leo. I flew all over the garden.” Other butterflies replied in the same way. No one knew where the blue ribbon had disappeared to.

Panda Leo didn’t give up. He continued to look, carefully examining every corner of the Flowery Garden. Then, he noticed a large sunflower that stood tall in the garden. He walked up to it and, carefully, pushed by the wind, he saw something blue! The blue ribbon was hidden right under the big sunflower, protected by its big leaves.

Panda Leo ran to pick up the ribbon and immediately took it to his little house. He put it in the door, making it even more beautiful. Panda Leo’s house really seemed magical. After so much searching, Panda Leo realized that even when things seem difficult, with a little patience you always find the solution.

plan.problema: Panda Leo can't find his favorite flower charm to decorate his little house.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the butterflies, but none of them knew where the charm had gone.
plan.finale: Finally, he found it hidden under a big sunflower, and he used it to make his little house even more beautiful.

panda.text:
Panda Leo was a very curious teddy bear. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and lush plants. It was everyone’s favorite place, especially all the insects that lived there. One day, while he was hopping among the biggest roses in the garden, Panda Leo got lost! The roses were so tall and fragrant that they had swallowed him up.

Panda Leo was scared. He couldn’t see anything beyond the red and pink petals. He tried to go back, but every time he ended up stuck among the roses. “Oh no!” thought Panda Leo. “I’m lost!”

He decided to call for help all the insects in the garden. “Help! I’m lost!” shouted Panda Leo. But nobody knew where he was. The ladybug flew from flower to flower, the caterpillar moved slowly on the leaf, and the bee buzzed around the jasmine. Nobody had seen Panda Leo.

Then, a little caterpillar came up to Panda Leo. With his antennae, he pointed to a small crack between the roses. “Go there!” said the caterpillar.

Panda Leo followed the caterpillar’s directions and he was immediately out of the roses! He was free! He thanked all the insects for their help. The secret garden seemed even more beautiful than before. Panda Leo realized that even when things seem difficult, asking for help can make a difference.

Panda Leo went back to happily hopping among the roses, remembering that courage always helps you find your way out.

plan.problema: Panda Leo got lost among the biggest roses in the garden!
plan.svolta: He decided to call together all the insects for help, but nobody knew where he was.
plan.finale: A little caterpillar pointed to him with its antenna, and Panda Leo found the way out of the roses right away.
plan.morale: Courage is important to overcome difficulties.

panda.text:
Panda Piu’ lived in the Secret Garden. He was a very cute teddy bear and always ready to play. He had a special friend: a bright red ball. He loved her very much and always took her with him.

---

One day, while playing in the tall grass of the garden, the ball rolled away. Panda Piu’ realized it was stuck in the tall grass! He tried to grab it, but it was too difficult. He tried to jump, but he didn’t jump high enough. He shouted for help, but no one could hear him in the Secret Garden.

---

Panda Piu’ was very sad. He didn’t want to give up his favorite ball. He thought and thought, and then he had an idea! His fur was very soft and long. Panda Piu’ began to rub his fur against the grass, making a long slide.

---

With the slide made of fur, Panda Piu’ ran down quickly. He arrived right at his red ball! He grabbed it with joy and brought it back. He was happy to have found it again. A little bird, who had been watching everything from a branch, chirped happily.

---

Panda Piu’ realized that even when things seem difficult, you just need to use your imagination to find a solution. And so, with a little creativity, he could always solve his problems.

plan.problema: Panda Piu’ has lost his favorite ball in the tall field and can’t reach it.
plan.svolta: After trying to jump and shout for help, Panda Piu’ had a brilliant idea: he used his big fur to make a slide!
plan.finale: With the slide made of fur, Panda Piu’ reached his ball immediately and got it back happily.

panda.text:
Pippo was a very nice teddy bear. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of fragrant flowers and tall trees. Pippo loved to play among the plants, but especially he loved his friend Bruno, a white and fluffy rabbit.

One day, Bruno was hopping happily in the tall meadow, near the big rose bush. Pippo followed him with his eyes and suddenly… Bruno disappeared! Pippo felt very worried. He didn't know where his friend was. The meadow was too high for him, he couldn't see anything.

Pippo decided to take a long walk. He held his arms tight and began to crawl under the biggest rose. It was a little difficult, but Pippo didn't give up. Then, with a little effort, he managed to climb up a small hill. From up there he could see everything in the garden!

Pippo carefully looked at every corner of the Secret Garden. He looked for Bruno among the leaves and flowers. The sun was starting to set. Pippo was a little tired, but he didn't want to give up. 

Finally, he heard a light touch. He looked up and saw Bruno waiting anxiously near the pond. “Pippo! I was lost!” exclaimed the happy rabbit to see him again. Pippo ran to hug him. He was so happy to have found his friend. 

Sometimes, patience is the best way to find those we love.

plan.problema: Pippo got lost in the tall meadow and couldn't find his friend rabbit, Bruno.
plan.svolta: He decided to take a long walk, crawling under the roses and climbing a small hill for a better view.
plan.finale: Finally, Pippo felt a little nudge and saw Bruno waiting anxiously by the pond.
plan.morale: Patience is the key to finding friends.

panda.text:
Pippo was a very special teddy bear. He lived in the Flower Garden, among the fragrant roses and colorful tulips. He was always happy, but that morning he felt sad. He had lost his favorite bow, the one with the white stars.

“Oh no!” said Pippo, furrowing his fluffy brow. “I can’t feel important if I don’t have my bow! All the other toys in the garden are so beautiful and special.”

Pippo decided to take a walk around the Flower Garden. He walked among the red roses and yellow tulips, looking for his bow. He looked under the big, spiny leaves, but there was nothing. “I don’t find it, I don’t find it!” Pippo repeated, becoming more and more worried.

A brown bee was flying around him. “Hello Pippo,” said the bee. “Are you looking for something?”

“Yes,” replied Pippo. “I lost my bow and I feel a little down.”

Suddenly, Pippo saw a blue butterfly flying among the flowers. And there, hanging from its pretty beak, was his bow!

“There it is!” exclaimed Pippo, jumping for joy. He immediately felt happy and important again. The bow was small, but he loved it very much. 

Pippo realized that even the simplest things can bring so much happiness.

plan.problema: Pippo had lost his favorite scarf and couldn't feel important anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to take a walk around the garden, looking among the roses and tulips, but without finding anything.
plan.finale: He found the scarf hanging from the blue butterfly that was flying among the flowers, and he immediately felt happy!
plan.morale: Beauty can be found in small things too.

panda.text:
Pippo was a very special teddy bear. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of fragrant roses and colorful flowers. Pippo loved to explore the garden, but sometimes he got lost among the many paths.

---

One day, while playing hide-and-seek with the roses, Pippo found himself in a difficult situation. He had ended up in a maze! The roses were so tall and dense that he couldn't see where to go. He couldn't find his little wooden house, where he slept every night.

---

Pippo was sad and a little scared. He sat down on a pink bush and thought, “I must find my little house!” Then, he decided to do something. He saw a small stream flowing among the plants. He thought, "Maybe the stream will take me home."

---

Pippo began to follow the stream. He walked carefully, stepping over stones and small pebbles. The stream guided him through the maze of roses. After a while, Pippo heard a light. It was a little sparkling light! He went closer and saw... it was the door to his little house!

---

Pippo jumped inside, happy to be home. He settled down on his soft cushion and fell asleep immediately. Perseverance had helped him find his place in the Secret Garden.

plan.problema: Peter got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his little house.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the stream, hoping it would take him home.
plan.finale: Finally, Peter saw a small sparkling light: it was the door to his little house!

panda.text:
Panda Pipo loved the Flower Garden very much. It was a garden full of colors and smells, especially because of the roses. Pipo spent his days rolling in the fresh grass and exploring every corner of the garden.

One day, while playing among the roses, Pipo noticed that he was all alone. His friend rabbit, Leo, wasn't there. Leo was always there, ready for a run or to tell stories. Pipo looked for Leo among the red and white rose bushes. But Leo was gone.

Pipo felt a little sad. He scratched his head with his furry paw. “Where could you be, Leo?” he thought. The garden was big and full of fragrant roses. Pipo decided to follow the brightest path. It was a narrow path between the plants.

Pipo walked and walked, scratching his head with his paw to figure out which direction to take. He imagined that Leo was calling him. Finally, Pipo saw Leo! The rabbit was sitting under a big sunflower, giving him lots of sunshine.

“Pipo!” exclaimed Leo. “I was waiting for you!” Pipo ran to Leo and snuggled happily against him. He felt happy to be found.

They stayed there playing together all afternoon. Then, when the sun began to set, Pipo realized it was time to go home. He said goodbye to Leo and promised to find him again tomorrow. 

Pipo knew that even if you get lost sometimes, friendship is always there waiting for you.

plan.problema: Pip lost himself among the fragrant roses and couldn't find his friend rabbit, Leo.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the brightest path, scratching his head with his paw to figure out which direction to take.
plan.finale: Finally, Pip saw Leo waiting for him under a large sunflower, happy to be reunited with his friend.

panda.text:
Pippo was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of flowers and lush plants. Pippo loved to play there, especially with his favorite red ball. It was a small, soft ball that he really liked to roll around with.

One day, Pippo noticed that the red ball was gone! He looked everywhere: under the big tree, among the roses, near the pond… But he couldn’t find the ball. “Oh no!” said Pippo, worried. “Where has it gone?”

Pippo sifted through the tall grass with his little paws. He got a little tired, but he didn’t give up. He had to find his red ball! Then he had an idea: he knew there were squirrels that lived in the tallest tree in the garden. Maybe someone had seen it.

Pippo ran to the tree and called to the squirrels. “Help! I’ve lost my red ball!” he shouted. The squirrels, a little squirrel named Leo, listened carefully. Then Leo jumped down from the tree and started looking among the leaves. After a while, Leo pointed with a paw: “There it is! It’s right under the bush!”

Pippo ran to the bush and found it right away! He was so happy to have his red ball back. Pippo thanked Leo and the squirrels for their help. He was so happy, he started to roll around with his red ball in the Secret Garden.

plan.problema: Pippo has lost his favorite ball, a red ball, and doesn't know where to look for it.
plan.svolta: After searching through the tall grass, Pippo decided to ask for help from the squirrels that lived in the tree.
plan.finale: The squirrels found the ball under a bush, and Pippo was very happy to find it again.

paperino.text:
Paperino was a very nice rubber duck. He lived in a secret garden behind the house. It was a garden full of roses and tall trees. Paperino loved to be there, watching the butterflies. One day, while he was playing with a pebble, he fell into a hole! It was a deep hole, very dark. 

Paperino found himself stuck. He couldn't see anything. He tried to pull himself up, but the hole was too narrow. “Oh no!” said Paperino, with a little sigh. He felt lonely and a little scared. He didn't know how to get out.

He decided to take a long walk around the hole. He walked and walked, looking at the ground, the plants, everything around. “Maybe I’ll see something!” thought Paperino. But there was nothing that could help him find his way out. 

Then, he saw a stone gnome sitting on a rock. The gnome was smiling. Paperino went closer and the gnome pointed to him with a small shiny stone. The stone shone in the sunlight. “Follow this stone,” said the gnome, in a calm voice. 

Paperino followed the shiny stone and, slowly, he managed to pull himself out of the hole. He was happy to be free! He sat next to the gnome, happy to have overcome that little difficulty. Paperino understood that sometimes, to find the solution, you need a little patience.

plan.problema: Freddie got lost in the hole of the garden and can't find his way out.
plan.svolta: He decided to take a long walk around the hole, hoping to see something that could show him the right path.
plan.finale: A stone gnome, smiling, pointed him in the right direction with a small, glittering stone.

paperino.text:
Paperino was a porcelain duck. A very special duck because he could move and talk! He lived in a secret garden, full of colorful flowers. Pink, yellow, purple, blue… there were so many, so many flowers. Paperino loved to play among them, but sometimes he got lost.

One day, while dancing with the white daisies, he noticed something wasn't right. “Oh no!” he said. “I’ve lost my mirror!” His mirror was small, made of shiny glass, and it helped him see if everything was perfect. Without it, Paperino seemed a little confused.

Paperino looked everywhere. He squeezed between the fragrant roses, climbed the lavender bush, but his mirror wasn't there. He was getting more and more worried. The colorful flowers seemed to be laughing at him.

Then Paperino made a decision. He decided to take a big jump into the grassy field, hoping to see the reflection of the sun and find his mirror. He jumped, jumped, jumped! He was a little scared, but he found his courage.

When he landed softly on the cool grass, he saw something: a big, shimmering reflection! It was his mirror, right there under a giant sunflower. Paperino ran towards it and picked it up in his hands. He was happy! 

Paperino sat next to the sunflower, watching his reflection shine in the sun. Sometimes, patience is the key to finding what you’ve lost.

plan.problema: Freddie got lost among the colorful flowers and can’t find his mirror.
plan.svolta: He decided to take a big jump into the grassy field, hoping to see his reflection of the sun.
plan.finale: The reflection led him to his shiny mirror, right under a big sunflower.

paperino.text:
Paperino was a porcelain duck. He lived in a secret garden, full of roses and sunflowers. He was happy, but today he felt a little worried. He had gotten lost! He had ended up right in the middle of a maze of colorful flowers. The petals touched him, they smelled so nice, but he couldn't find his mirror.

His mirror was small and shiny. It was his favorite. Paperino loved it because it allowed him to see his smile. But now, Paperino’s smile had become sad. He turned over on his face, trying to figure out where he had ended up. The tulips were red, the lilies were white, but nobody knew where he was.

“Oh no,” said Paperino, with his voice a little squeaky. “I’m lost!” He decided to call for help. He had a muffled cry, like the air that comes out of a doll when it takes off its veil. The sound echoed among the petals, but nobody heard it.

Then, a little blue bird arrived to look. It was attracted by the sound and perched on a sunflower. The bird looked at Paperino with its little black eyes. Then, it pointed with its beak the way.

Paperino followed the bird. He saw something shiny: it was his mirror! The reflection shone among the flowers. Paperino ran to hug it. He was so happy to be back home.

The bird flew away, happy to have helped a lost friend. Paperino understood that even a little help can make a difference. And he knew that when you are in trouble, kindness attracts help.

plan.problema: Freddie got lost in the maze of flowers and couldn't find his mirror.
plan.svolta: He decided to call for help, emitting a muffled cry that echoed among the petals.
plan.finale: A little bird, attracted by the sound, showed him the way to the shimmering reflection.

paperino.text:
Paperino was a cloth duck, a little tired and covered in dust. He was in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and sweet smells. Paperino loved to be there, watching the bees buzz and the butterflies fly. But today something wasn't right.

Paperino had gotten lost! He had ended up in a maze of red roses, yellow tulips, and white lilies. He couldn't find his mirror anymore. The mirror was important; he used it to make his silly faces and see if he looked neat.

Paperino tried to go forward, then backward, but every time he ended up in the same confusion of flowers. He felt a little sad and scared. “Oh no!” said Paperino, “I must find my mirror!”

Then, he made a decision. He decided to call for help! He made a loud squeak, repeated many times: “Squeak! Squeak! Help!” The squeak echoed through the garden, and Paperino waited, with his heart beating fast.

Just at that moment, a red ladybug arrived to look at Paperino. The ladybug was a friend of all the residents of the Secret Garden. “Don’t worry,” said the ladybug, “I’ll guide you.” And so, the ladybug followed Paperino among the flowers until, finally, she brought him in front of his shiny mirror.

Paperino looked at himself and smiled, happy with his reflection. He was a happy and glad duck to be back home. Paperino realized that asking for help could be the best thing to do.

plan.problema: Frog has gotten lost in the maze of flowers and can’t find his mirror.
plan.svolta: He decided to call for help, making a loud and repeated squeak until a ladybug led him.
plan.finale: Frog finally found his mirror and looked at himself, smiling pleased with his reflection.
plan.morale: Asking for help is always the right thing to do.

paperino.text:
Paperino was a very happy paper duck. He lived in a secret garden, full of fragrant flowers and tall trees. It was his favorite place in the world. One day, Paperino was hopping among the red and yellow leaves. He wanted to have a fast race!

But then, something bad happened. He got lost! The leaves were so many, so high, that Paperino found himself completely alone. He couldn’t see his favorite red hat anymore. It had disappeared among the dry leaves.

Paperino was very worried. He tried to call for help, but his voice was too weak to be heard. Nobody could hear him! He sat down on a leaf and started to cry a little. 

“I have to do something!” said Paperino. Then, he decided to do a fast spin, round and round, up and down. He spun so fast that the leaves lifted around him. And just as he was spinning, look! His red hat appeared right in front of him!

Paperino cheered. He was so happy to have his hat back. He thanked the leaves and the flowers of the secret garden. From that day on, Paperino always continued to play with courage and determination. 
Perseverance can lead to happiness even when things seem difficult.

plan.problema: Freddie got lost among the leaves and couldn’t find his hat.
plan.svolta: He tried to shout, but his voice was too weak to be heard.
plan.finale: Then he decided to do a quick whirl, and the hat appeared right in front of him!

paperino.text:
Paperino was a very happy rubber duck. He lived in the Flowery Garden, among the colorful flowers and the sparkling pond. He loved to play with water and make giant bubbles. But today, Paperino had a problem.

He was lost! He had ended up in the middle of the big green meadow that stretched beyond the garden. And he couldn't find his favorite hat, the red one with the black ribbon. The hat was important to him, he used it to make waves in the pond.

Paperino looked everywhere. He huddled under the biggest rose and looked ahead. He shouted: “Help! Help!”. But nobody answered. Then he had an idea. He decided to make little waves in the pond, hoping that the wave would attract the attention of his hat.

But only the water lilies moved! The water lilies floated gently on the surface of the water, but the red hat didn’t appear. Paperino was a little sad.

Suddenly, a friendly sparrow flew towards him. “What’s happening?” asked the sparrow. Paperino explained about his lost hat. The sparrow flew high above the rose bush and pointed with its wing: "Look there!".

And indeed, under the rose bush, there was the red hat! Paperino ran to pick it up and put it on right away. He was very happy. 

The sparrow waved goodbye to Paperino and flew away. Paperino sat on the edge of the pond, happy to have found his hat. He realized that waiting a little while and looking calmly had made all the difference. After so much searching, Paperino understood that sometimes it is necessary to be patient to achieve what you want.

plan.problema: Peter has gotten lost in the big meadow and can’t find his favorite hat.
plan.svolta: He decided to make little waves in the pond to attract the hat’s attention, but only the water lilies moved!
plan.finale: A friendly sparrow guided him to the hidden hat under a rose bush.

paperino.text:
Paperino lived in the secret garden. He was a cloth duck, soft and colorful. He loved to play among the roses and the trees. One day, Paperino noticed that something was wrong. He was flat! He didn’t have his legs anymore, nor his red hat. He was just a small piece of cloth.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Paperino. “Where have I gone?” He looked everywhere, under the bushes and among the leaves, but no one found him. He was very sad. He tried to sit down, to stand up, but nothing worked. He remained flat and shapeless.

Paperino walked around the secret garden a thousand times. He spun around, he stretched and he shortened, but his shape never came back. He was frustrated. He didn’t understand what had happened.

Suddenly, a white butterfly flew near Paperino. The butterfly had colorful wings and a gentle smile. “What’s wrong, little duck?” asked the butterfly.

Paperino explained his problem. The butterfly smiled and said, “Try to smile!” Paperino closed his eyes and thought of something beautiful. He imagined the fragrant roses and the children playing in the garden. Suddenly, a small smile appeared on Paperino’s face. And look what happened! His legs reappeared, his red hat went back to its right place, and Paperino returned to his perfect shape.

Paperino thanked the kind butterfly. From that day on, whenever he felt a little down, he remembered to smile. And so, even the most difficult things became easy to solve.

plan.problema: Frog has lost his shape and can’t get back to his original form.
plan.svolta: He tried to go around a thousand times, but his shape was still flat and without legs.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a kind butterfly, Frog discovered that he just needed to smile to find his perfect shape.

paperino.text:
Paperino was a very special paper boat. He lived in the Flowery Garden, among red roses and yellow tulips. He loved to play with the butterflies and listen to the birds singing. But one day, Paperino noticed something wasn't right. He had become flat, without his usual round shape. He couldn’t get back to his real size!

“Oh no!” cried Paperino, trying to bend and become normal again, but nothing worked. He was a sad paper boat in the Flowery Garden. 

He decided to go for a lovely walk. He walked among the colorful flowers, looking for clues. He saw a red ladybug flying around a sunflower. “Maybe the ladybug knows something?” thought Paperino. The ladybug waved to him with a flap of her wings and flew towards a lavender bush.

Paperino followed the ladybug, hoping to find an answer. Then, suddenly, he saw a ray of sunshine shining through the leaves. The ray hit Paperino right in the middle. 

With a big smile, Paperino immediately returned to his normal shape, full and round as always. He felt happy in the Flowery Garden. Everything was perfect!

plan.problema: Freddie has lost his shape and can’t get back to his real size!
plan.svolta: He decided to take a lovely walk around the garden, looking for clues among the colorful flowers.
plan.finale: He found a ray of sunshine that touched him, and with a big smile he returned to normal right away.

paperino.text:
Paperino was a felt duck, very funny and a little clumsy. He lived in a secret garden, full of fragrant roses and tall trees. The garden was his world, his kingdom. Sometimes he enjoyed jumping among the flowers, other times he liked to roll in the muddy earth.

One day, while playing hide-and-seek with the fallen leaves, Paperino got lost. The leaves were so big and colorful that they had swallowed him up! He found himself surrounded by a sea of green and brown. He was very sad because he had lost his favorite hat, the red one with the little pompom on top.

Paperino looked everywhere, but nothing. He scratched his wooden feet against the leaves, turned around and shouted: “Where are you, hat?” No one answered. Then, Paperino decided to take a slower walk. He stopped to watch every leaf that fell, every blade of grass that sprouted from the ground.

He carefully looked at the sun that filtered through the trees. He saw a white and blue butterfly flying around a large sunflower. And there, right under the sunflower, was his red hat! Paperino ran to pick it up, happy to be complete again.

He sat down among the roses, smiling. The secret garden seemed even more beautiful when everything was in its place. Paperino realized that sometimes, to find what you’ve lost, you just have to slow down and look carefully. Patience can really make a difference.

plan.problema: Freddie got lost among the leaves and can't find his favorite hat.
plan.svolta: He decided to take a slower turn, carefully observing every leaf and blade of grass to spot his hat.
plan.finale: Finally, he found the hat under a big sunflower and ran to get it, happy to be complete again.
plan.morale: Patience is the key to the solution.

paperino.text:
Paperino was a paper boat a little bit clumsy. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of tall plants and big leaves. He loved to play among the ferns and under the colorful flowers. But one morning, Paperino got lost! He ended up in the middle of a mountain of red and yellow leaves, and he couldn’t find his friend gnome, Giammello.

Giammello was a little wooden gnome with a red hat. Paperino loved him and always waited for him to tell stories. “Oh no!” said Paperino, wiggling among the leaves. “I have to find him!” He looked everywhere, but he couldn’t see him. The leaves covered everything!

Paperino had an idea. He decided to jump higher. He pushed against the thick trunk of a giant tree, trying to reach the top of the little waterfall that flowed among the leaves. He stretched out his arms, concentrated, and... he got it! He was at the top of the waterfall!

From there, he could see the whole garden. And just then, he saw the little gnome waiting for him with a big smile and a yellow flower in his hands. Giammello ran to Paperino and they both hugged happily. 

Paperino realized that even when things seemed difficult, if you put in effort and never stop looking, you always find a solution. And so, Paperino and Giammello returned to play together in the Secret Garden.

plan.problema: Freddie got lost among the leaves of the garden and couldn't find his gnome friend.
plan.svolta: He decided to jump higher, pushing against a large tree to reach the top of the water cascade flowing through the leaves.
plan.finale: Finally, from the highest point, he saw the little gnome waiting for him with a smile and a yellow flower.

pappagallo.text:
Pippo was a colorful parrot. He had green, red, and yellow feathers. He lived in a secret garden full of fragrant flowers. The tulips were red, the roses were pink, and the lilies were white. Pippo loved to fly among the flowers, but sometimes he got lost.

One day, while he was playing, Pippo found himself completely lost. He was surrounded by many colorful flowers and couldn’t find his friend gnome Bruno. Bruno was a kind gnome who often told him stories. Pippo had been looking for him for a little while, but nothing, there was no trace of him.

Pippo felt sad. Then he thought, “I have to do something!” He decided to sing his happiest melody, the one he loved so much. He sang loudly, with all his strength. “Tweet, tweet, oh oh oh!” Pippo repeated.

Silence. Then, a small sound came from far away. It was the sound of a bell! Pippo turned quickly and saw gnome Bruno. The gnome was smiling at Pippo. “Hey, Pippo!” said Bruno. “You were singing! You made me come here!”

Bruno pointed with his little hand to a path among the flowers. “Follow this path,” said Bruno, “and you’ll return to your place.” Pippo thanked the gnome and ran along the path. He was happy to be back home. 

Pippo realized that even a small song can do great things. And with a tweet, he said goodbye, knowing that help always comes from where you least expect it.

plan.problema: Peter got lost among the colorful flowers and couldn't find his gnome friend.
plan.svolta: He decided to sing his happiest melody hoping the gnome could hear him and show him the way.
plan.finale: The gnome, curious about the music, answered with a small bell sound, revealing the path to Peter.

pappagallo.text:
Coco was a red and yellow parrot. He lived in a secret garden full of fragrant roses. Coco loved to fly among the branches and watch everything that happened. One day, while playing hide-and-seek with the leaves, he got lost. The roses were so big and beautiful! He was completely disoriented.

Coco looked for his friend, Pipì. Pipì loved to sit on a mossy stone near the watermill. But Pipì was nowhere to be seen. Coco felt a little scared. He couldn't find his friend.

Coco thought he had to do something. He decided to imitate the birds’ chirps. “Ciu, ciu!” Coco shouted. “Pipì! Pipì!” But nobody answered. Only the wind blew through the roses. Coco felt even more alone.

Coco continued to call Pipì, louder and louder. “Ciu, ciu, hello!” Finally, he heard a small step. Pipì was behind a big red rose! The gnome had heard Coco and had found him.

Pipì smiled at Coco. He offered him a juicy strawberry that he had picked. Coco ate the strawberry with pleasure. Then, together, they returned to the mossy stone where Pipì loved to sit. Coco realized that even when things get difficult, you should never give up.

plan.problema: Coco got lost among the roses and couldn't find her gnome friend.
plan.svolta: She decided to imitate the birds' chirping to attract the gnome's attention, but nobody was responding.
plan.finale: Finally, the gnome found her thanks to Coco’s loud calling and offered her a strawberry.

pappagallo.text:
Pippo was a colorful parrot. He lived in a secret garden, full of fragrant flowers and tall trees. Pippo loved his garden very much. He spent his days spraying water with his feather and singing happy songs.

One day, Pippo noticed that something wasn't right. He had lost all his favorite seeds! They were small, golden, and he loved them very much. He looked everywhere: under the biggest tree, among the red roses, behind the lavender bush. But the seeds were gone! Pippo was very sad.

“Oh no, oh no!” exclaimed Pippo, flapping his wings with worry. “Where did my seeds go?”

Suddenly, Pippo had an idea. He decided to look among the leaves. He began to dust every corner of the garden with his little beak. He collected small dry leaves and dead insects, but he didn't find his seeds. 

A red ladybug approached Pippo. “I’m helping you to look!” said the ladybug. Together, they explored every corner of the secret garden. Finally, under a giant flower, they discovered the seeds! They were hidden among its large green leaves.

Pippo was so happy to have them back. He took them between his claws and ate them one by one. The secret garden seemed even more beautiful thanks to his joy. Pippo realized that, even if it sometimes takes time to find what you’ve lost, patience always has a reward.

plan.problema: Peter has lost all his favorite seeds and doesn't know where they've gone.
plan.svolta: He decided to look among the leaves, dusting every corner with his little beak.
plan.finale: He found the hidden seeds under a giant flower, happy to have recovered them!

pappagallo.text:
Coco was a colorful parrot. He lived in a secret garden full of fragrant flowers and lush plants. Coco loved to fly among the big petals and green leaves. Sometimes, he would sit on a tall branch to watch the insects buzzing around.

One day, Coco was playing with a yellow flower. Suddenly, he realized he was surrounded by many red and white flowers. He couldn't see his friend, Pippo anymore. Coco was scared! “Pippo? Pippo, where are you?” he called, but no one answered.

Coco felt very sad. He tried to fly in all directions, but the flowers seemed endless. He couldn't find his friend. He decided to do something different. He closed his eyes and thought of the happiest sound he knew. Then, he started to sing his loudest chirp, a beautiful “Ciaooo! Ciaooo!”

The sound echoed in the secret garden. Suddenly, Coco heard a noise running. Pippo ran towards him, jumping happily. “Coco! Here I am!” said Pippo.

Pippo pointed with his paw at a path full of red apples. “Follow this path!” he exclaimed. Coco flew following the path and soon he found Pippo again. He was so happy to be back with his friend. 

Coco and Pippo spent the rest of the afternoon eating red apples in the secret garden. It was a beautiful day, and Coco realized that even a gentle chirp can lead to happiness.

plan.problema: Coco got lost among the flowers and couldn't find her friend, Squeaky.
plan.svolta: She decided to sing her happiest chirp hoping that Squeaky could hear her and show her the way.
plan.finale: Squeaky, attracted by the sound, ran towards Coco and pointed out a path full of red apples.

pappagallo.text:
Pippo was a colorful parrot. He lived in a secret garden full of fragrant flowers and tall trees. Pippo loved his garden very much. Every day he would sing and enjoy the sunshine.

One day, Pippo noticed that something wasn't right. He had lost his favorite sunflower seed! It was a golden seed, small but special. Pippo loved it because it was his favorite. He started to look everywhere, but nothing. The seed was gone.

Pippo felt sad. He decided to ask for help from the flowers in the garden. “Little red flower, have you seen my seed?” he asked the tulip. “I haven’t seen it,” replied the tulip. He asked the fragrant rose and the white lily. Nobody had seen his seed.

Pippo was desperate. He sat on a rose bush, thoughtful. Then, he had an idea! He closed his eyes and concentrated. “Maybe… maybe I fell here nearby!” Pippo thought.

Suddenly, he saw something golden under a big lettuce leaf. It was his seed! Pippo was so happy. He took it in his feet and hugged it tight.

Pippo rested under the lettuce leaf for a while. It had been a long day and full of searching. Afterwards, he flew happily in the secret garden.

He realized that sometimes finding what you’re looking for just takes a little patience.

plan.problema: Pippo had lost his favorite sunflower seed, and he didn't know where to look.
plan.svolta: He tried to call all the flowers in the garden, but none of them had seen him.
plan.finale: He found the seed under a lettuce leaf, just where it had been sleeping!
plan.morale: Patience is important for finding what you're looking for.

pappagallo.text:
Coco was a very lively parrot. He lived in a secret garden, full of colorful flowers and lush plants. Coco loved to fly among the bushes and watch the butterflies. His favorite nut was a nutmeg nut, the most fragrant of all!

One day, Coco noticed that the nut was gone. “Oh no!” cried Coco. “Where did I go?” He looked everywhere: under the big tree, among the red tulips, behind the yellow roses. But the nut was missing! Coco was very sad.

He decided to ask for help from the flowers. “Pretty tree!” shouted Coco. “Did you see my nut?” But the tree didn’t answer. “Red tulip!” called Coco. “Did you touch my nut?” Even the tulip remained silent.

Coco felt more and more frustrated. Then, he stopped and thought: “Maybe I should look in a new place.” He went to a bright green leaf, the biggest in the secret garden. And there, right under the leaf, was his nut!

Coco sang to thank the sun that had helped him find it. He was so happy to have his favorite nut back. Coco realized that even if it’s sometimes difficult to find things, with a little patience and observation everything is solved. The sun shone high in the sky, lighting up the secret garden.

plan.problema: Coco has lost her favorite nut and doesn’t know where to look.
plan.svolta: She tried to call all the flowers, but none of them had seen her!
plan.finale: Finally, Coco found the nut under a bright green leaf and sang to thank the sun.

pappagallo.text:
Coco was a colorful parrot. He lived in a secret garden full of fragrant flowers and tall trees. Coco loved his garden very much. He spent his days flapping his wings and studying the insects. 

One day, Coco noticed that something wasn't right. His favorite banana was gone! It was a juicy yellow banana, the best in the world. Coco looked everywhere: under the big apple tree, behind the flower waterfall, even inside the old wooden bucket. But nothing! He couldn't find his banana.

Coco felt sad and a little scared. “Oh no!” he exclaimed. “I’ve lost my banana!” He sat on a branch and thought. He thought, and thought, and thought. Then he had an idea. Coco decided to sing a funny song, a song that even made the squirrels laugh.

“Cip cip, wiggle, fly high, a very happy journey!” Coco sang with all his voice. Suddenly, a small, brave beetle, called Leo, came out from under a leaf. “What are you doing, Coco?” Leo asked. Coco explained his problem to him. Leo listened carefully and then offered to help. 

Leo dug through the dry leaves and, after a while, he found the banana! He returned it to Coco, who thanked him with a big shout: “Thank you, thank you very much, Leo!” Coco flew happily around the garden, happy with his brave friend. Coco realized that asking for help is always a good thing. And helping others makes you feel good.

plan.problema: Coco got lost and can't find his favorite banana!
plan.svolta: He decided to sing a silly song to attract the attention of his insect friends.
plan.finale: A little brave beetle found the banana and returned it to Coco, who thanked him with a big shout!

pappagallo.text:
Pippo was a very lively parrot. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. He loved to sing and say “Hello!” in a funny way, with his head tilted and his wings flapping. But one day, Pippo noticed a problem. He couldn’t say “Hello!” like before. He was sad.

Pippo had lost his red gland! That special gland was what allowed him to make the funny sound. He looked everywhere: under the bushes, among the roses, behind the fountain. But the red gland wasn’t there.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Pippo. “If I can’t say ‘Hello!’ in a funny way, I won’t be the same.”

Then, Pippo made a decision. He climbed onto the bell of the biggest tree in the secret garden. The wind was blowing hard and made the bell swing. Pippo closed his eyes and let himself be carried away. He wanted to take a ride, hoping that the wind would take away his sad thoughts.

While he was spinning around, he heard a voice. It was Leo, a little squirrel who lived in the secret garden. “Hello Pippo!” said Leo.

Pippo stopped. Suddenly, he felt something soft near the waterfall. It was a bright red berry! Pippo picked it up and… surprise! His red gland came back immediately!

Pippo started to say “Hello!” in a funny way, with his head tilted and his wings flapping. He was happy. The wind had stopped blowing and the sun was shining.

Joy is found in small things.

plan.problema: Pippo has lost his red gland and can’t say ‘Hello!’ in a funny way anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to go for a ride on the tree swing, hoping the wind would blow away his sad thoughts.
plan.finale: The wind brought him back to the waterfall where he found a bright red berry and the gland returned immediately!
plan.morale: Joy is found in small things.

pappagallo.text:
Coco was a colorful parrot. He lived in a secret garden full of flowers and tall trees. Coco loved to sing, but he needed his favorite sunny spot to do it. It was a little shiny stone that brought him the light of the sun.

One day, Coco noticed that his sunny spot was gone! He started flapping his wings and talking: “Oh no! Where did it go? I can’t sing!” Coco was very sad. He looked everywhere in the secret garden, under the trees and among the flowers, but nothing.

He decided then to ask for help from the butterflies. He flew from one butterfly to another, asking if they had seen it. “Did you see my sunny spot?” Coco squawked. But no butterfly had the last sunny spot. The butterflies said: “We are sorry, Coco, we didn’t take it.”

Coco was almost without hope when he noticed a big fragrant flower. It was full of soft and colorful petals. And there, trapped among the petals, was his sunny spot! Coco approached carefully and, with a joyful shout, he freed the shiny stone.

Coco immediately took his sunny spot and started to sing again. His voice was happier than ever. Coco understood that even when things seem lost, you have to look patiently and determinedly. After a little while, Coco relaxed on his favorite branch, ready to chirp happily.

plan.problema: Coco has lost her favorite sunbeam and doesn't know how to sing anymore.
plan.svolta: She tried to ask the butterflies for help, but none of them had the last sunbeam.
plan.finale: Finally, she found it trapped in a fragrant flower and freed it with a joyful shout!
plan.morale: Patience is the key to solving problems.

pappagallo.text:
Pip was a bright red parrot. He lived in a secret garden, full of fragrant flowers and tall trees. Pip loved to sing, his song was full of colors. But one day, Pip noticed that something wasn't right. He couldn't sing anymore!

Pip looked at his feathers. They were still beautiful, but something was missing: his sparkle. It was a special light that made him so happy and colorful. Without his sparkle, Pip felt sad.

“Oh no!” said Pip. “Where did my sparkle go?”

Pip began to look everywhere. He looked under the roses, behind the lavender bushes, and even inside the squirrel’s house. But nothing! Then he had an idea: he tried to climb the stairs that led to the old tree. Pip climbed, climbed… but he slipped down without success!

He was so sad he didn’t know what to do. A little green crocodile, Coco, was watching him with curiosity. “What’s wrong, Pip?” asked Coco.

Pip explained his problem. Coco suggested he look up. Pip looked up and saw a ray of sunshine filtering through the leaves. The ray was warm and bright. Pip went towards the ray and let himself be flooded with light.

Suddenly, his sparkle came back! It was brighter than ever. Pip began to sing, his song filled the secret garden with colors and joy. Pip was happy. 

Pip realized that even the smallest things, like a ray of sunshine, could bring so much joy.

plan.problema: Pip has lost his sparkle and can't sing anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to climb the stairs, but he slipped down without success!
plan.finale: He found a ray of sunshine and filled himself with light, returning immediately happy and full of color.
plan.morale: Joy is found in small things.

pikachu.text:
Pikachu lived in a flowery meadow full of colors and smells. He was a special Pikachu, made of soft fabric and with big black eyes. Usually, Pikachu shone very brightly, a bright yellow that made all the flowers in the meadow happy. But today, something wasn't right.

Pikachu felt strange. His yellow had become dull, almost gray. He couldn't shine anymore! He tried to jump, to do his little faces, but nothing. It was as if he had lost all his energy. A blue butterfly, that passed through the meadow, landed on his head and looked at him curiously.

“Why don’t you shine anymore?” asked the butterfly.

Pikachu thought for a while. Then, he had an idea! He started to take small steps, as if he were dancing. He decided to sing a happy song, the one he liked so much: “Pika pika, pika pika, I’m happy!” His voice was a little weak at first, but he continued to sing.

While he was singing, his big eyes lit up. He started to laugh! A small and funny laugh, but full of joy. And suddenly, his contagious laughter filled the flowery meadow. Pikachu started to shine brighter than ever, a blinding yellow that made the flowers bloom. The blue butterfly flew around him, happy. 

Pikachu realized that when he had been having fun, his energy always came back. And so, the flowery meadow had become even more beautiful.

plan.problema: Pikachu had lost his energy and couldn't shine anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to sing a happy song hoping that the energy would return.
plan.finale: His contagious laughter filled the meadow, and Pikachu began to shine brighter than ever before.

pikachu.text:
Pikachu lived in the Flower Garden. He was a friendly and playful Pikachu. He loved to run among the colorful flowers and make little sparks. His electric stick was his favorite of all! It was yellow, small, and perfect for making his little eyes shine.

One day, Pikachu noticed that his stick was missing. “Oh no!” he exclaimed. “I can’t make my sparks anymore! I’m so sad.” He looked everywhere: under the lavender bush, behind the red tulip, but the stick wasn’t there.

Pikachu tried to look under the roses. The thorns were too pointy for him. He couldn’t get too close without getting hurt. He was really worried. He didn’t know what to do. 

He saw a little bee flying around the giant sunflower. “Bee,” said Pikachu, “could you help me? I’ve lost my electric stick!” The bee landed on a petal and looked at Pikachu with its big eyes. Then, the bee made a little flap of its wings and pointed towards the sunflower.

Pikachu ran quickly behind the giant sunflower. And there, right among the leaves, was his electric stick! He picked it up in his hand and tried to make a spark. It worked! Pikachu was so happy. 

The bee greeted him with a little bow. Pikachu realized that even a little help can solve the biggest problems. And he realized that, together, they are even stronger.

plan.problema: Pikachu has lost his favorite lightning bolt and can’t make sparks anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to look under the roses, but it was too prickly for him.
plan.finale: He then asked for help from the bees and they pointed him right behind the big sunflower!

pikachu.text:
Pikachu lived in a flowery meadow full of colors. He was a special Pikachu because he could make the flowers shine with his energy! Every morning, Pikachu would wake up and run among the red roses, blue violets, and white daisies. He would light them up with little golden flashes, making them even more beautiful.

One day, however, something had changed. Pikachu tried to make a bellflower shine, but nothing! He tried to concentrate, he wiggled a little, but the flowers stayed dark. “Where did my magic wand go?” Pikachu thought, worried. His electric wand was special, it gave him the strength to make the flowers shine.

Pikachu began to look everywhere in the flowery meadow. He squeezed between the green leaves, peeked under the tulip stems, and climbed up a small lavender bush. He looked among the tall grass, but the sun was shining brightly and confused him. It was as if the sun had made everything more difficult to find.

Pikachu sat down for a moment, then with a happy jump, he found his wand! It was stuck under a yellow flower, right where the sun shone the brightest. He took the wand between his little paws and tried to make the flowers shine. Flash, flash, flash! The flowers started to sparkle, full of light. Pikachu was very happy.

The wind was blowing gently in the flowery meadow, carrying with it the scent of the shining flowers. It was a perfect moment for all the colors of the meadow.

plan.problema: Pikachu has lost his electric stick and can’t make the flowers shine anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to look for it among the tall grass, but the sun had confused him.
plan.finale: With a happy jump, Pikachu found the stick stuck under a yellow flower and the flowers shone again!

pikachu.text:
Pikachu lived in a secret garden. He was a little Pikachu plush, very special because he could move and talk! The garden was full of colorful flowers, tall trees, and a sparkling pond. Pikachu loved to explore his garden every day.

A morning, Pikachu noticed that there was something strange. Usually, his fur shone with a yellow light, like lots of little lightning bolts! But that morning it wasn't shining at all. “Oh no!” exclaimed Pikachu. “I’ve lost all my lightning bolts!”

Pikachu began to look everywhere. First, he looked among the fragrant roses, but there were lightning bolts everywhere! They were scattered among the red and white petals. He looked under the big apple tree, but there too he found lots of little lightning bolts.

“Maybe they are hidden!” thought Pikachu. He decided to look carefully at the leaves. He went to the fragrant basil, a green herb that grew near the pond. He examined each leaf, one at a time. 

Then, to his great surprise, he understood where they were! The little lightning bolts were hidden inside the basil leaves! Gently, Pikachu took one leaf at a time and made a little lightning bolt come out. “Zap!” he said happily. He made lots more come out, one after another.

Finally, all his lightning bolts were shining again. His fur was full of yellow light and Pikachu was smiling. He was so happy! He had learned that even when things seem difficult, with a little patience you always find the solution. And now, Pikachu continued to shine in his secret garden.

plan.problema: Pikachu has lost all his lightning and can’t shine anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to look for them among the roses, but the lightning was everywhere and he couldn’t find it.
plan.finale: Then he discovered that the lightning was hidden inside the basil leaves, and one by one, he made them come out with a big smile!
plan.morale: Patience is the key to success.

pikachu.text:
Pikachu lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. He was a special Pikachu because he could talk and move on his own. He loved to play among the leaves and make new friends. His favorite game was giving carrots to the little snail Lila.

---

One day, Pikachu noticed that something wasn't right. His carrots were gone! He had put them next to Lila to make her laugh, but Lila seemed sad. “Oh no!” said Pikachu. “I can’t make Lila smile without my carrots.”

---

Pikachu thought, thought, and thought. Then he had an idea! He used his long, soft whiskers as pedals. With great effort, he made an improvised bicycle ride in the secret garden. He looked, looked, looked for his carrots.

---

Finally, he saw one of the carrots under a rose bush! Then he found another, and then another! The carrots were everywhere! Pikachu ran to Lila and gave her all his carrots.

---

Lila started to laugh with joy. Her laughter was so sweet that even the other residents of the secret garden smiled. Pikachu felt happy. He had done a good thing for a friend. 

---

Pikachu realized how important it was to be kind and to help others. And when everyone was laughing together, Pikachu thought: "A smile is the best gift you can receive."

plan.problema: Pikachu has lost all his carrots and can’t make little snail Lila smile.
plan.svolta: He decided to take an impromptu bike ride, using his whiskers as pedals!
plan.finale: Thanks to his recovered carrots, Pikachu made Lila and all the garden friends laugh.

pikachu.text:
Pikachu lived in a beautiful Flower Garden. He was a special Pikachu because he could move and talk! He loved to play among the colorful flowers, but one day he noticed a problem. All of his flower seeds were gone! The garden was empty, sad, and gray.

Pikachu was very worried. He looked everywhere, under the roses, behind the wisteria, but he didn’t find anything. “Oh no!” said Pikachu, with his squeaky voice. “How will I make the garden bloom again?”

A little crocodile, named Croco, was passing by and saw Pikachu sad. “What’s wrong?” asked Croco. Pikachu explained his problem. Croco thought for a little while and then had an idea! 

Pikachu decided to collect all the insects flying around the garden. He smiled and took out a jar full of honey from his pocket. He offered the honey to the bees, hoping they would come to the flowers. The bees, attracted by the sweet honey, began to fly from flower to flower.

The bees were collecting pollen from the flowers and taking it with them. The garden began to fill with bright colors! The flowers were blooming one after another. Pikachu was so happy! 

The Flower Garden returned to shining, full of perfumes and of life. Pikachu realized that even a little help can make a difference. Collaboration makes everything easier and more beautiful.

plan.problema: Pikachu has lost all of his flower seeds and doesn't know how to make the garden bloom again.
plan.svolta: He decided to collect all the little insects flying around and, with a smile, offered them honey to attract the bees!
plan.finale: The bees, very happy, collected the pollen from the flowers and the garden shone again.

pikachu.text:
Pikachu lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. He was a special Pikachu because he could talk and move on his own! He loved to play among the fragrant roses and blackberry bushes. But one day, something didn't go as usual.

Pikachu noticed that his lightning, the bright yellow that made him shine, was gone! He looked everywhere in the secret garden. He scratched the ground with his little paws and looked between the leaves. “Where did you go?” he repeated to himself.

“I can’t shine anymore!” exclaimed Pikachu, sad. He tried to look under the roses, hoping his lightning had fallen there. But the lightning was too small to be seen among the red petals. It was like a tiny ray of sunshine hidden in the grass.

Pikachu felt more and more tired. He sat down on a smooth stone and closed his eyes. A little bird, a yellow sparrow, watched him closely and chirped softly. After a while, Pikachu yawned.

Then, suddenly, he woke up! The sun was shining high in the sky. Pikachu felt a great energy passing through him. And there, right above his head, shone his yellow lightning! It had returned immediately!

Pikachu jumped for joy. He just needed a little rest to find his strength. He snuggled up in the shade of a tree and watched the sparrow fly away. Sometimes, all it takes is a little rest to become happy again.

plan.problema: Pikachu has lost his lightning and can’t shine anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to look under the roses, but the lightning was too small to be seen.
plan.finale: Then he discovered that the sun had made him fall asleep and he woke up full of energy, immediately finding his lightning again!
plan.morale: Sometimes all it takes is a little rest.

pikachu.text:
Pikachu was a happy Pikachu. He lived in the playground. He loved making sparks! Every time he moved quickly, a little blue spark would pop out from his tail. But today something wasn't going right. Pikachu tried to jump, to run, but nothing! He wasn't making sparks anymore.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Pikachu. “I’ve lost my electric wand!” The wand was special. It was what allowed him to make sparks. Without it, he was just a little toy.

Pikachu decided to use his nose. He looked for the dust tracks that the wand had left while he moved. But the playground was full of slides and swings! Pikachu got lost among the red and white slides. He couldn't figure out where his wand had gone.

He bumped into Puffo, a little bird who lived in a house on top of the swing. Puffo had seen Pikachu lost. “Can I help you?” asked Puffo. Pikachu explained his problem and Puffo pointed with his beak at something near the fountain.

Pikachu ran quickly towards the fountain. And there, right next to the bubbling water, was his electric wand! Pikachu picked it up and tried to jump. A big blue spark popped out from his tail. 

“Thank you, Puffo!” said Pikachu very happy. Puffo smiled and flew away. Pikachu realized that even a little help can make a difference. With the help of his friend, he had found the way to shine.

plan.problema: Pikachu has lost his electric stick and can’t make sparks anymore!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his nose to follow the dust tracks left by the stick, but he was lost among the slides.
plan.finale: Thanks to his friend Puffo, a little bird that lives in the park, Pikachu found his stick near the fountain.

pikachu.text:
Pikachu lived in a secret garden. He was a special Pikachu because he could talk and move all by himself! He loved to play among the colorful flowers and the green leaves. But one morning, Pikachu felt sad. He couldn't shine!

His favorite shell, the yellow and round one, was missing! Pikachu loved it because when he held it close, it gave off a golden light. He looked everywhere: under the roses, among the bluebells, next to the lavender bush. But nothing! The shell was too small to be seen.

Pikachu was desperate. He couldn't shine without his shell. Then, he went towards the pond in the secret garden. The water was calm and clear, and the sun shone brightly in the sky. Pikachu noticed something strange: the sunlight reflected on the water hit exactly where his shell was placed!

Immediately, the yellow shell began to shine again! Pikachu made a little smile and went towards the water. He stayed there, smiling, while the sun continued to reflect his golden light. 

Pikachu realized that even when things seem difficult, with calmness and attention, you can always find solutions. And so, shining again, Pikachu went back to playing in his secret garden.

plan.problema: Pikachu has lost his favorite case and can’t shine anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to look for it among the flowers, but the case was too small to be seen.
plan.finale: Then he discovered that the reflection of the sun on the water made him shine again and he smiled.

pikachu.text:
Pikachu was a very happy Pikachu. He lived in the playground, near the bell tower. He loved to see the children playing and laughing. His special job was to make all the little children happy with his candies, which he kept in a small golden wand.

But one day, Pikachu noticed that his wand was missing! It had fallen between the swing and the sandcastle. Without the wand, he couldn't give candies to the children anymore. He felt sad because the children's smiles were fading away.

Pikachu thought for a little while. Then he had a brilliant idea! He used his powerful lightning to create little colorful bubbles: pink, blue, and yellow! The bubbles floated in the air, shining in the sun. The children stopped to watch, amazed by this magical show.

A little girl, Sofia, reached out her hand and a bubble touched her finger. She giggled with joy. The other children started to chuckle and run after the bubbles. They were having so much fun!

Pikachu felt happy. He didn't need the wand anymore to make the children smile. Creativity, thought Pikachu, was a wonderful way to solve any problem. 

The children played and laughed, completely forgetting about the lost wand. Pikachu watched the scene, satisfied with the fun he had created. It was just lovely to see everyone happy.

plan.problema: Pikachu has lost his candy stick and can’t make the children happy anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his lightning to create small colorful bubbles, attracting the children’s attention.
plan.finale: The children laughed and started to play with the bubbles, forgetting the lost candy stick and happy with the fun.

pinguino.text:
Pinguino Polo lived at the Arctic Weather Station. He was a very special teddy-bear penguin because he could move and talk! He spent his days watching the thermometers and listening to Dr. Fred, who worked there.

---

One day, Pinguino Polo found himself in a strange place. He was inside a maze made of long tubes and strange sensors. He couldn’t find his way out! Everything seemed confusing and gray. “Oh no!” thought Pinguino Polo. “I’m lost!”

---

Dr. Fred was worried. He looked for Pinguino Polo everywhere, but the penguin didn’t move. Pinguino Polo looked at the sensors and had an idea. He had a little button on his chest! He decided to use his button to push the red and blue buttons he saw on the tubes.

---

He pushed, pushed, pushed. The sensors flashed and the tubes moved slightly. After a lot of searching, finally, a red button began to flash red! The red light flashed faster and faster. Pinguino Polo heard a message in his little listening booth: “Follow the blue line.”

---

The voice guided him through the maze. Finally, Pinguino Polo came out of the tunnel and found himself in front of the station door. Dr. Fred ran to hug him. He was so happy! Pinguino Polo understood that with effort and a little ingenuity, even difficult things can be solved.

plan.problema: Penguin Polo got lost in the maze of tubes and sensors of the station.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his beak to push the buttons and make the tracking system work!
