plan.finale: Finally, the red light flashed and Penguin Polo heard a message that guided him out of the maze.

pinguino.text:
Pingu Bob was a very happy teddy penguin. He lived in the Polar Base, a place full of sparkling ice and snow. Pingu Bob loved to play by himself, but especially he loved his friend, Bruno the bear. One day, while they were playing hide-and-seek among the huge piles of ice, Bruno disappeared!

Pingu Bob realized right away that he was lost in the ice maze. The walls were white and cold, and every turn seemed the same as the other. Pingu Bob felt a little scared. He couldn't find Bruno. He called out loudly: “Bruno? Bruno, where are you?” But he didn’t get an answer.

Then he had an idea! Pingu Bob knew that he had lots of penguin friends in the Polar Base. He shouted as loud as he could: "Help! Help! I’ve lost Bruno!” Immediately, other penguins began to come closer. There was Pippo, Penelope, and Percy. 

“We have to look for him together!” said Pingu Bob. All the penguins started to search every corner of the maze, shouting: “Bruno! Bruno!” They spread out in every part of the ice, checking behind the piles of snow and under the blocks of ice.

After a while, Pippo shouted: "I found him!” Pingu Bob ran towards the shout and saw Bruno sitting near a big iceberg, happy to see his penguin friend again. All the penguins hugged each other with joy. Pingu Bob realized that together he was much stronger than alone. It was nice to help friends, and working together makes everything easier.

plan.problema: Pingu Bob got lost in the ice maze and couldn’t find his friend Bear.
plan.svolta: He decided to call all his penguin friends to help him, spreading out in every corner of the maze.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to teamwork, Pingu Bob found Bear happy and pleased.
plan.morale: Working together is always the solution.

pinguino.text:
Pippo was a very friendly teddy penguin. He loved the white beach, made of fine and soft sand. Every day, Pippo would sit on the sand near the water, watching the waves come to lick the shore. Pippo had a favorite hat: a small yellow straw hat. It was his most beautiful hat!

One morning, Pippo noticed that his hat was gone. “Oh no!” cried Pippo. He looked everywhere. He looked under every stone, behind every seashell. But the yellow straw hat had disappeared. Pippo was very sad.

“I must find my hat,” said Pippo, deciding to do something. He began to walk along the beach, desperately searching. Then he had an idea! He picked up a small toy bicycle that he had found and began to go around the white beach.

Pippo pedaled quickly, passing the waves and small sand dunes. He kept searching, without stopping. And then, he saw it! His yellow straw hat was lying on the back of a giant starfish, sleeping peacefully on the white beach.

Pippo ran to the starfish and took his hat. He was happy! He immediately put his hat on his head and sat back down on the sand. He had learned that even if things sometimes seem difficult, with a little patience, you always find a solution. Pippo knew that next time he would hold his yellow hat tighter.

plan.problema: Pippo had lost his favorite hat, a small yellow straw hat.
plan.svolta: After looking under every stone and behind every seashell, Pippo decided to go for a bike ride all over the beach.
plan.finale: Finally, he saw it lying on the back of a giant starfish, happy and ready to go home.

pinguino.text:
Pingu Jack was a very happy teddy bear penguin. He loved the sandy beach. The sand was warm under his little feet and the sea always looked inviting. One day, Pingu Jack was playing with his friend, Bruno the teddy bear. Bruno was sitting near him while Pingu Jack ran after the waves.

Suddenly, Pingu Jack noticed that Bruno was gone. “Bruno?” he called, but he didn’t hear an answer. He looked around. The beach seemed huge and full of white sand. Pingu Jack was very worried. He was alone, without his friend Bruno.

Pingu Jack thought, thought, thought. He had to do something! He decided to shout: “Bruno! Bruno!” He shouted with all his might. His little voice was small, but Pingu Jack didn’t give up. He kept shouting: “Bruno! Where are you?”

After a while, he heard a faint answer. “Pingu Jack? I’m here!” It was Bruno, hiding behind a big rock. Pingu Jack ran to him and hugged him tight. Together, the two friends went back to playing on the beach. They rolled in the sand, built castles and had a wonderful time. 

Pingu Jack understood that even when things seem difficult, you should never lose hope. And with a little perseverance, you can always find the solution.

plan.problema: Jack was lost from his teddy bear friend and doesn’t know how to find him.
plan.svolta: He decided then to shout out loudly, hoping that the teddy bear would hear him.
plan.finale: Finally, the teddy bear answered, and the two friends returned to play together on the beach.

pinguino.text:
Pinguino Leo lived in the Alpine cabin. He was a plush penguin, soft and blue. He loved to be beside the fire when it was cold outside. One day, while playing with fresh snow, he found himself in the middle of a huge white pile. He couldn’t get back!

Leo looked for his friend Bear Bruno, but Bruno wasn’t anywhere. The wind was blowing and the snow was falling, making everything even more confusing. Leo felt lonely and scared. “I have to find Bruno!” thought Pinguino Leo.

Then he had an idea! He used his big feet to dig in the snow pile. He wanted to make a tunnel to reach Bruno. He dug and dug, but he ended up making only a big hole! The snow fell down from the hole and Leo found himself even more in trouble.

Leo felt a little sad, but he didn’t give up. With a lot of patience, he started to collect small pieces of ice. He put them one on top of the other, trying to build something that could cross the hole. After a lot of work, he managed to create a small ice bridge!

Crossing the bridge, Pinguino Leo saw Bruno waiting for him with a big smile. “Leo! I was just wondering where you were!” said Bruno. Pinguino Leo was so happy to be found. 

The snow stopped falling and the Alpine cabin seemed even cozier. Pinguino Leo realized that even when things seem difficult, with a little effort, you can reach your goals.

plan.problema: Leo got lost in the snowdrift and can’t find his friend Bear Bruno.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his big paws to dig a tunnel in the snow, but he ended up making only a big hole!
plan.finale: With patience, Leo built a small ice bridge and found Bruno waiting for him with a smile.

pinguino.text:
Pinguino Pip was a very happy teddy-bear penguin. He lived on the sandy beach, near the sea. Every day he played among the waves and admired the sun. One day, while he was running on the beach, Pinguino Pip noticed he was all alone. He had gotten lost! He couldn’t see his penguin brothers or his parents anymore.

He was scared. The sand seemed very big when you are alone. He shouted: “Papa? Mama? Where are you?” But the wind was blowing very, very strong! Nobody could hear him. Pinguino Pip tried to call his brothers, but the wind carried away his little voices. It was impossible to speak.

Pinguino Pip thought, thought, thought. Then he had an idea! He took his soft feathers and rolled them up with his little feet. He made a colorful scarf, white, black, and a little bit of pink thanks to the sun. The scarf was beautiful!

Now Pinguino Pip sat down on the sand and waited. Suddenly, he saw two figures running towards him. They were his penguin parents! They were looking for him with joy, happy to have found him. 

“Pip! You’re here!” shouted his papa. Pinguino Pip ran into the arms of his parents. He was so happy to be home. The sand didn’t seem scary anymore when he was safe with his family. Pinguino Pip understood that even if things get difficult, continuing to look always leads to happiness.

plan.problema: Pip got lost and couldn't find his family.
plan.svolta: He tried to call his brothers, but the wind was blowing too strong!
plan.finale: Pip used his feathers to make a colorful scarf and saw his parents searching for him with joy.

pinguino.text:
Pinguino Pio was a very happy teddy bear penguin. He loved the sandy beach. Every day he would sit there, watching the sea and the waves that came to lick the shore.

Piu had a little seashell. He used it as a magnifying glass to observe the details of the world. It was his favorite eye!

One day, Pinguino Pio noticed he didn't have his seashell anymore. “Oh no!” he thought. “Where did I put it? I can’t see well!” He looked everywhere on the sand, under his fluffy feet, among the pebbles. But the seashell was gone.

Piu felt sad and a little confused.

He decided to look in the tall grass field that was near the beach. The grass was tall and very green, full of colorful flowers: yellow, red, blue. Pinguino Pio walked among the flowers, looking for his seashell. A little crab greeted him: “Hello Piu! What are you looking for?”

Piu explained his problem. The crab suggested he look carefully.

After a while, Pinguino Pio saw something shiny lying on a big rock. It was his seashell! He picked it up gently and, happy, returned to his place on Piu’s heart.

Piu settled down, watching the sea with his magnifying glass. He had learned that looking patiently always leads to finding what is missing.

plan.problema: The more his favorite eye, a small shell he used as a magnifying glass, was lost.
plan.svolta: He decided to look in the meadow of tall grass, hoping to find it among the colorful flowers.
plan.finale: Finally he found it leaning against a large stone, and happy he returned to his place in Piu’s heart.

pinguino.text:
Pippo was a very happy teddy-bear penguin. He lived in a big snowy field full of soft snow and perfect hills for sliding. Pippo loved to run, jump, and especially, to slide down the hills! One day, Pippo had so much fun. He slid up and down, fast as a lightning bolt.

Suddenly, Pippo realized he was all alone. His family – Daddy Penguin and his sisters – were gone! He was lost in the snowy field. Pippo was a little scared. The wind was blowing hard and the snow was in his eyes. He couldn't find his brothers.

Pippo decided to do something. “Help! Help!” he shouted with all his might. His little voice, however, got lost in the wind. He shouted even louder, “Daddy! Sisters!” Nobody answered. Pippo was sad and a little worried.

Then, Pippo had an idea. He kept calling, louder and louder, hoping someone would hear him. And guess what? After a little while, he heard a laugh! It was his Mummy Penguin! Mummy ran to him, happy to have found him. She hugged him tight, tight, tight. Pippo was so happy to be back home.

Mummy said to him, “Don’t worry, Pippo, I’m always here for you.” Pippo felt safe and happy, held tight in Mummy’s arms. 

It was lovely to be found, and Pippo understood that even when you are lost, calling bravely helps you find those you love.

plan.problema: Pippo got lost from his family during a lovely slide!
plan.svolta: He decided to shout out loud, hoping his brothers would hear him.
plan.finale: Finally, he heard a laugh and his mommy penguin hugged him happily.

pinguino.text:
Pingu Bob was a teddy penguin. He loved the beach. Every day he came back to the same golden sand.

Pingu Bob had soft feet and a red beak. He liked to walk on the sand, leave footprints, and watch the sea.

One day, a little boat arrived carrying ice cream. The sun was shining brightly and the ice in the boat began to melt. A big river of butter flowed onto the beach!

Pingu Bob, curious, went closer. Before he could understand what was happening, he found himself completely covered in butter. It was hard to move, everything was sticky.

Pingu Bob tried to scratch his head with a big white seashell. He tried to clean his beak, but the butter was everywhere! He felt frustrated and a little sad. A little shrimp, who had been watching everything from nearby, came closer. “Don’t give up, Pingu Bob!” said the shrimp.

Pingu Bob kept moving, pushing himself with his feet in the sand. He made an effort. Then, a gentle wave arrived on the beach. The wave gently stroked Pingu Bob and brought him back to the shore, clean and happy. The butter was gone.

Pingu Bob felt like he was home again.

Pingu Bob understood that even when things are difficult, you should never stop trying. And with a smile, he went back to walking on the sand, ready for a new adventure.

plan.problema: Ping Bob got lost in the butter the sun had spilled from the boat!
plan.svolta: He tried to scratch his head with a shell, but the butter was everywhere!
plan.finale: A gentle wave brought him back to the shore, clean and happy.

pinguino.text:
Pinguino Blu was a very happy blue penguin. He lived on the sandy beach, right next to the sea. He loved to play with the sand and watch the waves crashing. One day, Pinguino Blu was exploring, when he noticed something: lots and lots of seashells! They were so many that they had swallowed him up! He was lost in a sea of seashells.

Pinguino Blu tried to move, but the seashells were everywhere. He couldn’t find his place on the beach anymore. He started to feel a little sad. “Help!” he cried, but nobody answered.

Then Pinguino Blu decided to do something different. He started to sing his favorite song, a cheerful little tune that he loved so much. But this didn’t work either. Nobody could hear him.

Just when he was about to give up, he saw something: a tunnel made of green seaweed! Pinguino Blu crawled into the tunnel and… poof! He popped out onto the beach. The sun was shining warmly on his feathers. He saw his friend Granchio Rosso looking at him smile.

Pinguino Blu was so happy to be back home. He had learned that even when things seem difficult, you have to keep looking and try to do something new. Pinguino Blu settled down on the sand, ready for another day of playing.

plan.problema: The Blue Penguin was lost in the seashell sea!
plan.svolta: He tried to sing a song to call his friends, but nobody was answering.
plan.finale: Then he discovered a tunnel made of seaweed and reappeared on the beach, happy to see the sun.

rabbit.text:
Coniglio was a very happy teddy bear.
He lived in a secret garden full of flowers and trees.
It was a magical place where the sun always shone.
Coniglio loved to jump between the plants and play with the leaves.

One day, Coniglio noticed something terrible:
his favorite carrot was gone!
It was a big, juicy carrot, the best in the world.
Coniglio looked everywhere, under the trees, behind the bushes,
but nothing. He didn't know what to do.
He was very sad.

He decided to ask for help from the wise owl who lived at the top of the tallest tree.
Coniglio ran to the owl, but he heard a deep noise:
the owl was sleeping!
Coniglio waited patiently, hoping the owl would wake up.

After a long time, Coniglio had an idea.
He picked up shiny leaves and placed them on the ground to draw a path.
Following the leaf path, Coniglio continued to look.
Finally, he found something colorful under a big, red flower.
It was his carrot!

Coniglio took it between his little paws and hugged it tight.
He was so happy.
The owl woke up, surprised by all the joy.
Coniglio thanked the owl for his help, even though he hadn't helped directly. 

The little rabbit returned to play in the secret garden,
knowing that even when things seem difficult,
a little patience and maybe a little help can make a difference.

plan.problema: The Rabbit has lost his favorite carrot and doesn't know what to do.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the wise Owl in the garden, but the Owl had fallen asleep!
plan.finale: After collecting the shiny leaves to show the way, the Rabbit found his carrot hidden under a colorful flower.

rabbit.text:
Coniglio was a very nice teddy rabbit. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. He was the favorite rabbit of the garden, always ready for a new adventure.

---

One day, Coniglio was right in the middle of the rose maze. The roses were fragrant and beautiful, but also confusing! He couldn’t find his little house; he was completely lost. He was a little scared. He looked around, hopping through the bushes, but he didn’t see anything familiar.

---

Then Coniglio had an idea. He decided to follow the brightest path. He thought the light would lead him home. But, alas, he went further and further away from his little house! The bright path was a trick.

---

Coniglio stopped, a little sad and confused. He tried not to give up. He noticed that a fragrant lavender bush was near him. Coniglio approached it carefully.

---

And then, look! He found a small hidden door under the lavender bush. The door was secret and not very noticeable. Coniglio opened it with his little paws and… finally, he was taken home! He was happy to be back in his warm and cozy little house.

---

Coniglio settled down on his favorite cushion and thought about his adventure in the maze. He realized that even when things seem difficult, if you never give up, you always find your way back home.

plan.problema: The Rabbit is lost in the maze of roses and cannot find his little house.
plan.svolta: He tried to follow the brightest path, but he had only gone further away from his little house.
plan.finale: Then he discovered a small hidden door under a lavender bush and, finally, he went home!

rabbit.text:
Rabbit Pipkin lived in the Secret Garden. He was a soft, fluffy bunny, just like a toy. He loved to hop among the flowers and roll around in the green meadow. He had a wide-brimmed red hat that he really liked. He always wore it when he was having fun.

One day, while he was playing hide-and-seek with the daisies, Pipkin lost his favorite hat. The hat had fallen under a big rose bush. Pipkin desperately tried to put it back on top, but it was too high for him to reach. His little paws got dirty and his whiskers were full of petals.

Pipkin tried to dig with his paws, but the ground was hard and he couldn't reach the hat. He was very sad. He thought that maybe no one could help him.

Suddenly, he saw a shiny red ladybug sitting on a flower. Pipkin approached shyly. “Ladybug,” he said, “could you help me? I lost my hat and I can’t find it!”

The ladybug, with her sharp eyesight, looked carefully under the bush. “Look here!” she exclaimed. And indeed, right there, among the leaves, was Pipkin’s red hat.

Pipkin ran to get his hat and put it on right away. He was so happy! He thanked the ladybug for her help. From that day on, Rabbit Pipkin learned that asking for help is always a good idea.

plan.problema: Rabbit Pip has lost his favorite hat under a big bush.
plan.svolta: After trying to dig with his paws, he realized he needed to ask for help from the ladybug.
plan.finale: The ladybug, with her sharp sight, spotted the hat and Rabbit Pip recovered it happily.
plan.morale: Asking for help is always a good idea.

rabbit.text:
Coniglio lived in a secret garden. He was a teddy bear rabbit, soft and friendly. He loved to play among the colorful flowers and the green plants. He had a favorite carrot, bright orange, that he always kept with him.

---

One day, Coniglio was eating his carrot when... he lost it! The carrot rolled away, ended up in the tall grass, the biggest in the secret garden. Coniglio was very worried. “Oh no!” he said. “I must find it!”

---

Coniglio started looking everywhere. He hopped through the tall grass, but he couldn’t see the carrot. He also got tired. He decided to jump as high as possible to reach the top of the grass and find his carrot. But he jumped and jumped, he got so tired that he didn't get anywhere.

---

Suddenly, a little blue bird landed on a daisy near Coniglio. “I saw your carrot!” sang the bird. “The wind blew it away and dropped it under the big tree!”

---

Coniglio ran to the tree and there, right under its roots, he found his favorite carrot! It was a little dirty with soil, but it was safe. Coniglio thanked the bird. The bird flew away happily.

---

Coniglio put his carrot between his paws and smiled. He realized that sometimes, even the little ones can help a lot. And together, a rabbit and a bird, are able to solve any problem.

plan.problema: The rabbit had lost his favorite carrot in the tall field.
plan.svolta: He decided to jump as high as possible to reach the top of the field, but he only got tired.
plan.finale: The rabbit found the carrot thanks to the help of a little bird who had carried it with the wind.

rabbit.text:
Bunny was a very happy teddy bear.
He lived in a secret garden, full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants.
It was his favorite place in the whole world.
Every day he played among the red roses and the blue violets.

One day, Bunny noticed something terrible: his favorite carrot was gone!
The carrot was big and orange, with fresh green leaves.
Bunny loved it very much. He didn't know where it had gone.
He was very sad. He didn’t want to play anymore.

Bunny began to look everywhere.
He looked under the big apple tree, behind the waterfalls, and among the lavender bushes.
But the carrot wasn’t there.
He decided to look very carefully under every flower, hoping to find it.
He found only white butterflies fluttering and red ladybugs hiding among the leaves.

Suddenly, he heard a sweet voice: “Bunny, darling!”
Mommy Bunny was there, beside him.
In her hand she held a new carrot, juicy and even bigger than the lost one.
Bunny took it right away and began to eat it with pleasure.
It was delicious!

Bunny realized that even if he had lost his favorite carrot, he could find something new and just as good.
He felt happy and excited. 

The sun set over the secret garden, and Bunny fell asleep peacefully, knowing that every day can be a special adventure.

plan.problema: The Rabbit has lost his favorite carrot and doesn’t know what to do.
plan.svolta: He decided to look carefully under every flower, but he only found butterflies and ladybugs.
plan.finale: Suddenly, Mom Rabbit offered him a new, juicy carrot that he loved.
plan.morale: Happiness can be found in new experiences too.

rabbit.text:
Coniglio was a very happy teddy bear.
He lived in a secret garden, full of colorful flowers and tall trees.
It was his favorite place in the world.

Every day, Coniglio hopped among the plants, playing with the leaves and listening to the birds singing.

One morning, Coniglio noticed something terrible: his favorite carrot was gone!
It was a big, juicy carrot, the best he had ever eaten.
He had left it there for just a moment and then… it was gone.

Coniglio began to look everywhere.
He looked under the roses, inside the lavender bushes, even behind the old apple tree.
But the carrot was too big to see by himself.
It was hidden in the green meadow.
Coniglio felt sadder and more worried.

Suddenly, a red ladybug arrived to ask him what had happened.
Coniglio explained his problem to her.
The ladybug, who was called Rosa, was very kind.
“Don’t worry,” said Rosa, “I’ll help you find it!”

Rosa flew high and looked carefully at the meadow.
Then, with a little flap of her wings, she spotted something orange under a giant flower.
It was the carrot!
Coniglio ran towards it and picked it up in his paws.

Coniglio thanked Rosa for her help.
He felt very happy and relieved.
The carrot was safe, and he had made a new friend.
Coniglio realized that even when things seem difficult, with a little courage and a friend, everything works out.

plan.problema: The Rabbit had lost his favorite carrot in the meadow!
plan.svolta: He started to look everywhere, but the carrot was too big to see by himself.
plan.finale: A friendly ladybug helped him find the hidden carrot under a giant flower.

rabbit.text:
Bunny was a very happy stuffed bunny.
He lived in a secret garden full of fragrant flowers and lush plants.
The garden was his whole world!

One day, Bunny noticed that something wasn't right.
His favorite carrot, a big, juicy carrot, was gone.

“Oh no!” said Bunny with a big sigh.
“I don’t know where my home is!”
He was very confused.
He couldn’t find the path to get back to his place in the tall grass meadow.

Bunny decided to try to find his carrot.
He started to follow the smell of wet earth, hoping it would guide him.
But he found himself in a maze full of red and pink roses!
He was so confused that he got completely lost.
He turned and turned, without finding a way out.

A little ladybug, Dot, asked him, “Bunny, what are you looking for?”
Bunny explained his problem.
Dot listened very carefully.
Then, Bunny had an idea!
He closed his eyes and took a deep breath.
He smelled a sweet and familiar scent.

And there, right under his nose, full of fallen colorful petals from the roses, was his carrot!
Bunny took it in his paws and smiled.
He was so happy to have found it! 

Bunny realized that sometimes, the answers are right in front of our eyes.

plan.problema: The rabbit lost his favorite carrot and can't find his way home.
plan.svolta: He tried to follow the scent of the earth, but he was lost in a maze of roses!
plan.finale: The rabbit discovered that his family was looking for him right under his nose, full of colorful petals.
plan.morale: Sometimes, the answers are right beside us.

rabbit.text:
Bunny was a very special teddy bear. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. Bunny loved to hop among the petals, exploring every corner. One day, while playing hide-and-seek among the roses, he found himself in a difficult situation. He had gotten stuck inside a maze of flowers!

The walls were made of tall sunflowers and fragrant bellflowers. Bunny couldn’t find his way out anymore. He felt a little scared, but he decided to do his best. “I need to find a solution,” thought Bunny.

Then, he saw a path that was shining with light. Bunny decided to follow it. But, alas, the path led him into a small dead end. It was full of blue hydrangeas and there was no way out! Bunny was almost discouraged.

He looked around, searching for another clue. Finally, he noticed a road that wound among the fragrant roses. Bunny started to hop with enthusiasm. And then… he saw it! The exit of the Secret Garden!

Bunny was surrounded by red and pink roses. The scent was sweet and intense. He was very happy, so very happy. Bunny sat down on a bush, satisfied with his adventure. After so much effort, Bunny had learned that you shouldn’t give up, even when things seem difficult.

plan.problema: The Rabbit is lost in the flower maze!
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the brightest path, but he found himself in a dead end.
plan.finale: The Rabbit hopped with joy finding the exit, surrounded by fragrant roses.

rabbit.text:
Bunny was a very special teddy bear. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of fragrant flowers and lush plants. Bunny loved to hop among the daisies and hide behind the lavender bushes.

 

One day, Bunny decided to play hide-and-seek with a blue butterfly. He jumped further than usual, between a stone wall and a waterfall of red roses. He had so much fun that he didn't notice he was lost. When the butterfly flew away, Bunny looked for his favorite spot, the one under the big tree with the gnarled roots. But it wasn't there!

 

Bunny was desperate. The roses all looked the same and had swallowed him up in their strong scent. He couldn’t understand where he had disappeared to. He tried to jump forward, then backward, but he kept getting lost. 

 

Then Bunny had an idea. He used his long ears, very long ears, to listen to the sounds of the wind. The wind blew through the roses and rustled the leaves. Bunny closed his eyes and tried to figure out where the noises were coming from.

 

The wind whispered a direction to him. Bunny followed the sound, moving slowly among the fallen leaves. He discovered a hidden path, little used, that wound between the fallen leaves. And right in front of him, was his favorite spot under the big tree! Bunny jumped for joy. He was happy to be back home.

 

Bunny learned that even when things seem difficult, continuing to look can lead to the most beautiful solution.

plan.problema: Rabbit is lost among the roses and can’t find his burrow anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his long ears to listen to the sounds of the wind, hoping to find the right direction.
plan.finale: The wind showed him a hidden path among the leaves and Rabbit found his favorite corner under the big tree right away.

rabbit.text:
Coniglio was a very special teddy rabbit. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of fragrant flowers and lush plants. He was the king of the garden, even though nobody really knew it. Coniglio loved to hop among the daisies and hide behind the trees.

One day, while playing hide-and-seek with the roses, he got lost. The roses were so big and red, they had swallowed him up! He couldn’t see the path anymore. Coniglio was very worried. He wanted to find his friend gnome, a little smiling gnome who lived near the meadow.

“Oh no!” said Coniglio, wiggling his felt paws. “I can’t find the gnome! It’s all red and fragrant here.”

Coniglio decided to do something. He remembered there was a stream in the secret garden, near the big sunflower. Maybe the stream could help him. Coniglio began to hop towards the sound of the water. He hopped between the leaves and flowers, following the gurgling sound of the stream.

Finally, after a while, the stream led him right to the gnome! The gnome was sitting under a big sunflower, casting a shadow on his face. Coniglio hopped happily towards him and hugged him tight. “I did it!” exclaimed Coniglio.

The gnome smiled. They sat together watching the sun shine in the Secret Garden, friends forever. Coniglio realized that even when you get lost, with a little patience and friendship, everything works out.

plan.problema: The rabbit is lost among the roses and cannot find his friend gnome.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the sound of the stream, hoping it would lead him to the gnome.
plan.finale: The stream led him right to the gnome, happy to have found him under a large sunflower.

riccio.text:
Red Hedgehog was a very funny red hedgehog. He lived in the Flowery Garden and loved to play among the yellow tulips and blue violets. One day, while happily hopping near a waterfall of red roses, he noticed something wasn't right. He was lost!

Red Hedgehog had gotten lost among the colorful flowers. He couldn't find his burrow, a small hole under the roots of a big apple tree. He felt a little scared. The fragrant petals all seemed the same to him, and the colors confused him.

Red Hedgehog thought he had to do something. He decided to call for help. He gently scratched the ground with his soft fur, making a small sound, like a tiny bell. The noise was almost imperceptible, but he hoped someone would hear it.

A lovely Butterfly Lady, with colorful and sparkling wings, was flying among the flowers. She heard the little sound and approached Red Hedgehog. “What’s wrong, little one?” asked the Butterfly Lady.

Red Hedgehog explained that he was lost. The Butterfly Lady smiled kindly and guided him through the garden, flying in front of him. After a while, they finally arrived at Red Hedgehog’s burrow under the roses. It was a cozy and warm place. 

The Butterfly Lady waved goodbye to Red Hedgehog and flew away. The hedgehog squeezed into his burrow and immediately felt safe. He realized that asking for help from someone can lead to wonderful surprises.

plan.problema: The little Red Hedgehog had gotten lost among the colorful flowers and couldn't find his burrow anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to call for help, scratching gently on the ground with his fur to make a small sound.
plan.finale: Mrs. Butterfly saw him and guided him to his cozy burrow under the roses.
plan.morale: Asking for help is always a good idea.

riccio.text:
Riccio was a little plush hedgehog. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and soft grass. Riccio loved to explore the garden, but sometimes he got lost among the white daisies.

One day, while he was playing, Riccio found himself completely alone. The daisies were everywhere, all the same. He couldn’t see his burrow, a small hole under the roots of the tree. He was scared! “Oh no!” said Riccio, “I’m lost!”.

Riccio thought for a while. Then he had an idea. He saw lots of ants carrying crumbs of bread. He decided to follow the path the ants made, hoping it would take him home. He moved slowly, following the little tracks on the ground.

Suddenly, a red ladybug arrived near him. “Hello!” said the ladybug. “Why are you so sad?” asked Riccio. “I’m lost,” replied the hedgehog. The ladybug was a friend of everyone in the garden. She flew high and turned around to look. She saw Riccio’s burrow under the roots of the tree.

“Look there!” exclaimed the ladybug. Riccio ran towards the tree and finally found his burrow. He was so happy! He snuggled up to his soft cushion. The ladybug said goodbye and flew away. Riccio felt safe and content. 

Riccio realized that even a little friend can help you find your way.

plan.problema: The little hedgehog got lost among the daisies and couldn't find his burrow.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the path made by the ants, hoping it would lead him home.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the help of a friendly ladybug, he found his burrow under the roots of the tree.

riccio.text:
Riccio Pippo was a little, soft hedgehog. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and lush plants. He loved to explore every corner, but sometimes he got lost among the fragrant roses.

One day, Hedgehog Pippo decided to go on an adventure further than usual. He ventured among the bushes and hedges, following a path that seemed inviting. Soon, however, he found himself in a real labyrinth! The roses were everywhere, all the same, and Hedgehog Pippo couldn't find his burrow anymore.

He was scared. He tried to follow the widest path, hoping it would take him out of the labyrinth. But he ended up in a dead end: a wall of roses blocked him completely. Hedgehog Pippo curled up to think.

Then he had an idea! He used his little nose and started to sniff the air. He was looking for a familiar smell, something that would guide him home. He smelled the scent of damp earth, fragrant after the rain. He remembered that smell when he approached his burrow!

Hedgehog Pippo followed the scent and, after a while, he finally saw a small opening between a lavender bush. That’s where his burrow was! He squeezed inside happily and content. 

Mom hedgehog was waiting for him with a smile. Hedgehog Pippo realized how important it was to be patient and trust his instincts. After all, patience had done its job.

plan.problema: Hedgehog Pip got lost in the rose maze and can’t find his sett.
plan.svolta: After trying to follow the widest path, he found himself in a dead end, so he decided to use his little nose to smell the scent of damp earth, which reminded him of home.
plan.finale: Thanks to his sense of smell, Hedgehog Pip finally found his hidden sett under a lavender bush.

riccio.text:
Riccio Piccolo was a very small and soft hedgehog. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and tall plants. Riccio Piccolo loved his secret garden more than anything. He had a special place to sleep, a small, smooth and warm oak pinecone.

But today, Riccio Piccolo was very sad. His favorite pinecone was gone! He couldn't find it under the rose bush or behind the big red mushroom. He couldn't find his place to sleep. He was a very confused hedgehog.

Riccio Piccolo decided to do something. “I must find my pinecone,” he thought. So, Riccio Piccolo set off. He decided to follow his little feet, sniffing every corner of the garden looking for a familiar scent. He sniffed the damp earth, smelled the flowers and even the bees.

A little blue beetle, Leo, greeted him. “Hello Riccio Piccolo! What are you looking for?” Leo asked. “I’ve lost my pinecone,” Riccio Piccolo replied. “And I can’t find my place to sleep.”

Riccio Piccolo continued to sniff and look. Then, suddenly, he saw it! His pinecone was under a giant leaf, right there nearby. Riccio Piccolo had taken a nap! He quickly curled up in his warm pinecone and fell asleep immediately. 

The Secret Garden was still full of surprises, but Riccio Piccolo knew that sometimes, the best way to find what you’re looking for is simply to wait and watch carefully.

plan.problema: Little Hedgehog has lost his favorite pinecone and can't find his place to sleep.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow his little feet, sniffing every corner of the garden for a familiar scent.
plan.finale: Finally, he found the pinecone under a giant leaf, where he had taken a nap!

riccio.text:
Ricky Pippo was a very happy teddy-bear hedgehog. He lived in the Flower Garden, among fragrant roses and white bellflowers. He loved to run among the flowers, rolling on the damp earth. One day, while playing hide-and-seek with the daisies, he got lost.

Pippo found himself surrounded by a thousand yellow daisies. They were big and tall, and he couldn't see his burrow anymore. He was a little scared. “Help! Who can help me?” he cried, but nobody answered.

He tried to call the flowers, to ask them the way to go home. But the daisies were too busy opening their buds to the sun. They didn't listen to him. Ricky Pippo was very sad.

Then, Ricky Pippo thought. He looked carefully around and saw a little path. It was lit by a bright white light. “Maybe this can help me,” Pippo said to himself. So, he started to follow the bright path.

The path led him through a field of clover and beside a lavender bush. Finally, after so much walking, he arrived at his burrow! It was a small hole under the roots of a big sunflower. Pippo was happy and rested in the warm sunshine. He felt very happy to be home.

plan.problema: Hedgehog Pip has gotten lost among the daisies and can't find his burrow.
plan.svolta: Pip tried to call the flowers, but none of them answered, so he decided to follow the brightest path.
plan.finale: Finally, Pip arrived at his burrow, happy and rested under a large sunflower.

riccio.text:
Little Hedgehog lived in the Secret Garden. He was a very small and fluffy teddy bear hedgehog. He loved that garden so much, full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. Little Hedgehog had a special home: a hole dug among the roots of a big tree.

But one day, Little Hedgehog noticed a problem. He had lost all his prickles! Without his prickles, he couldn't dig his sleeping hole anymore. He was very sad and frustrated. He couldn’t do anything. The hole was still there, empty and unusable.

Little Hedgehog thought about what to do. He decided to try to collect some dry leaves to make a soft nest. He began to collect the prettiest leaves he found in the garden. He arranged them inside the hole, hoping to make a comfortable bed. But the leaves were too hard! The hole remained stiff and uncomfortable.

Suddenly, he saw fireflies dancing among the flowers. “Help!” shouted Little Hedgehog to the fireflies. The fireflies listened to his problem and offered him a solution. They brought Little Hedgehog a bed of soft moss, soft as a cloud.

Little Hedgehog climbed into the moss bed and fell asleep immediately. It was so warm and comfortable! He felt happy and safe. The fireflies watched him smile. 

Finally, Little Hedgehog found the solution to his problem. The Secret Garden was a wonderful place and now the hedgehog had a perfect bed to sleep in. With a sigh of peace, he fell asleep peacefully, knowing that patience can lead to unexpected results.

plan.problema: Little Hedgehog has lost his spines and can’t dig a burrow to sleep in anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to try collecting dry leaves to make a soft nest, but it was too hard.
plan.finale: With the help of the fireflies, Little Hedgehog found a bed of soft moss and finally fell asleep happily.

riccio.text:
Riccio Pippo lived in the Secret Garden. He was a soft, furry hedgehog with big black eyes and a long, fluffy tail. He loved to play among the colorful flowers and the green plants. One day, while rolling happily, he felt a big tickle!

“Oh no!” exclaimed Riccio Pippo. “I’ve lost my favorite little nose!” His nose was small, pink, and very soft. He loved to stroke it with his tail. But among the big leaves of the garden, he couldn’t find it. The leaves were enormous, like green mountains! Riccio Pippo felt a little sad.

He tried to push with his tail all the leaves. He pushed hard, but the leaves moved very little. Then he tried to jump, but he always fell down. He just couldn’t find his nose. A ladybug, named Lila, watched him curiously.

Riccio Pippo stopped for a moment and thought. “Maybe I need to be more gentle,” he said to himself. Then, using his little paws, he began to stroke the leaves very carefully. He stroked slowly, turning around each leaf.

Finally, among the green leaves, he saw something shining! It was his pink nose! Riccio Pippo rolled with joy, happy to have found it. He jumped up and down, pleased to be able to stroke it again with his soft tail. 

Riccio Pippo learned that sometimes, to find what you’re looking for, you have to be patient and look carefully. And patience, as they always say, makes everything better.

plan.problema: Hedgehog Pip has gotten lost among the big leaves and can’t find his favorite nose.
plan.svolta: After trying to push with his tail all the leaves, he had the idea to use his little paws to gently caress them.
plan.finale: Finally, among the leaves, he saw his nose shining and happily rolled with joy.

riccio.text:
Little Hedgehog lived in the Secret Garden. He was a little, soft hedgehog, made of plush. He loved his secret garden very much, full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. Every day he built his nest, using little spines to stick the leaves and branches together.

A morning, Little Hedgehog realized a big problem. He had lost his favorite spine! It was a little brown spine, perfect for tying together the parts of his nest. “Oh no!” said Little Hedgehog, furrowing his brow. “How will I finish my nest without this spine?”

He started to look right away. First, he tried under the red roses. The scent of the roses was so intense that Little Hedgehog squinted and couldn't see anything. “Too fragrant!” he thought, retreating. He decided to try another place.

Little Hedgehog climbed among the stones of the garden. He looked for spines among the rocks, under the bushes and behind the plants. He was tired and a little frustrated. Then, suddenly, he saw something! A little brown spine was stuck in a small hole between the stones.

With patience, Little Hedgehog used his little paw to gently grab the spine. He pulled it out slowly and carefully. “I did it!” he exclaimed happily. Now he could go back to building his nest. Little Hedgehog tied the leaves together with his found spine, smiling satisfied with his good work. 

He settled into his nest, ready for a quiet nap in the Secret Garden. Little Hedgehog’s patience had really made a difference.

plan.problema: Little Hedgehog has lost his prickle to build his nest.
plan.svolta: He tried to look for it under the roses, but it was too fragrant and it made him rub his eyes!
plan.finale: Then he discovered that the prickle was stuck in a small hole between the stones and he managed to pull it out.
plan.morale: Patience helps you achieve your goals.

riccio.text:
Riccio Piccolo lived in the Flowery Garden. He was a soft, little plush hedgehog with sparkling black eyes. He loved to play among the tall daisies and colorful flowers. One day, Riccio Piccolo had too much fun rolling in the fresh grass. When he got up, he didn't recognize anything anymore. He was completely lost!

The daisies all looked the same. They were white and perfect, but they didn't take him back to his home. Riccio Piccolo was scared. He didn't know where his safe burrow under the giant rose was, his favorite place in the garden.

“Hello Gnome Bruno!” called Riccio Piccolo, but there was no answer. The gnome loved to take naps among the plants and rarely moved. Riccio Piccolo tried to shout even louder, but no one listened to him. It was all silent.

Riccio Piccolo began to feel sad. He thought that maybe he would never return home. Then, a bright ray of sunshine hit the garden. The sun illuminated a small path among the aromatic plants. Riccio Piccolo followed that ray of light, and suddenly, he saw it!

His safe burrow was there, under the giant rose. It was small and cozy, a perfect place for a little hedgehog. Riccio Piccolo ran towards the burrow and crawled inside. He felt happy and safe. The light of the sun reminded him that even when things seem difficult, you must always go forward with courage.

plan.problema: The little Hedgehog had gotten lost among the daisies and didn’t know how to get back home.
plan.svolta: He tried to call his gnome friend, but nobody was answering.
plan.finale: Finally, a ray of sunshine lit the path leading to his safe burrow under the giant rose.

riccio.text:
Riccio Pippo lived in the Secret Garden. He was a soft, furry hedgehog with sparkling black eyes. He loved to play among the fragrant roses and colorful flowers. One day, while climbing a bush with red leaves, he noticed something wasn't right. He was lost!

The red leaves were everywhere, tall and rustling. Hedgehog Pippo looked for his nest, but he couldn't find it anymore. He was a little scared. The Secret Garden seemed very big when you were lost. He looked among the yellow flowers and the green plants, but nothing.

Hedgehog Pippo decided to shout for help. "Help! Help!" he said with his loudest voice. But his voice was too small to be heard by the other animals in the garden. Nobody listened.

Suddenly, a friendly blue beetle, called Zecchino, approached Hedgehog Pippo. “Don’t worry,” said Zecchino. “I’ll guide you to your nest.” Zecchino flew gently among the tall ferns and Hedgehog Pippo followed him.

After a while, here! There was Hedgehog Pippo’s nest, a warm and comfortable place among the green ferns. It was exactly where it should be. Hedgehog Pippo snuggled into his nest, happy to be home. Zecchino waved goodbye to Hedgehog Pippo before flying away. Hedgehog Pippo realized that even when things seem difficult, asking for help can make a difference.

plan.problema: Hedgehog Pip lost himself among the red leaves and couldn't find his nest anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to shout for help, but his voice was too small to be heard.
plan.finale: A friendly beetle gently led him to his comfortable nest among the ferns.
plan.morale: Never give up and ask for help.

rinoceronte.text:
Rino was a stuffed rhinoceros. He lived in the Flower Garden, among red roses and tall sunflowers. Rino loved the Flower Garden because there he could be very peaceful. One day, while exploring, he wandered too far from his favorite spot near the lavender bush.

Rino found himself in the big meadow. It was enormous! He tried to go back, but he couldn't find it. “Pippo!” cried Rino, but his voice was lost in the air. Pippo was his best friend, a fluffy white rabbit. Rino was very worried.

Rino decided to call out even louder. “Help! Pippo, where are you?” But the wind was blowing too hard. His voice didn’t reach Pippo. Rino felt sad and lonely. He sat down on a small pile of dry leaves.

Then, he noticed a sparkling stream among the flowers. The water looked inviting. Rino thought, “Maybe I can see something from the stream!” So, with courage, he jumped into the cool water.

The water carried him to the other side of the stream. And there, he saw Pippo! The white rabbit was hopping happily to see him. “Rino!” cried Pippo. Rino ran to his friend and they hugged tightly.

Rino realized that sometimes it takes a little time to find your friends, but waiting and looking patiently is always the right thing to do. Their friendship was even more beautiful after this little adventure in the Flower Garden.

plan.problema: Rhino got lost in the big meadow and couldn't find his friend rabbit, Pip.
plan.svolta: He decided to call out loudly, but the wind was blowing too strong to hear his words.
plan.finale: Curious about a stream, Rhino jumped in and found Pip waiting for him on the other side, happy to see him.

rinoceronte.text:
Rino was a very silly stuffed rhinoceros. He lived in the Flowery Meadow, a place full of red, yellow, and blue flowers. Rino loved the Flowery Meadow because there he could play with the insects and have wonderful dreams.

One day, Rino was playing with a group of butterflies when he heard a voice. “Rino! Rino!” It was Leo, Rino’s friend the squirrel. But Leo was no longer visible. Rino realized that he had gotten lost among all the colorful flowers.

“Oh no!” said Rino. “I must find Leo back!” He looked around, but he only saw lots of soft, fragrant petals. He decided to do something. He used his long, flexible trunk to sniff the air. “Maybe I’ll smell Leo’s scent!” thought Rino.

But when he used his trunk, he didn’t smell Leo’s scent! He only smelled the sweet scent of the flowers. It was a beautiful scent, but it didn’t help him find his friend. Rino felt sad and confused.

Suddenly, he had an idea. He called out to Leo: “Leo, come here!” And he ran straight ahead, following the direction he thought Leo had gone. After a few meters, he saw Leo under a big tree with a hazelnut in his hand. Leo was smiling at Rino.

“You did it!” said Leo. “I was waiting for you right here!” Rino and Leo hugged each other happily. From that day on, Rino and Leo always played together in the Flowery Meadow.

plan.problema: Rhino got lost among the many colorful flowers and couldn't find his friend squirrel, Leo.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his trunk to sniff the air and follow the scent of Leo, but he only smelled the scent of flowers!
plan.finale: Rhino ran straight ahead until he found Leo who was waiting for him under a big tree with a hazelnut.

rinoceronte.text:
Rino was a stuffed rhinoceros. He lived in the Flowery Meadow, a meadow full of colorful and fragrant flowers. Rino loved to run among the flowers, but he also enjoyed just standing still, watching the butterflies.

One day, Rino was playing with the sun. Suddenly, he ran too fast! He found himself all alone in the Flowery Meadow, a very big meadow. “Oh no!” said Rino. “Where have I ended up?”

Rino wanted to find his friend Pippo, the squirrel who lived in the meadow. Pippo loved to jump between the trees and play with Rino. But Pippo wasn't anywhere.

Rino tried to follow Pippo’s tracks. He saw the little footprints in the wet earth. He thought, “Maybe Pippo went to collect nuts.” But then, Rino found himself surrounded by fragrant flowers. They were pink, yellow, and blue! Rino got confused and lost his way. He didn’t know where Pippo was anymore.

Rino was worried. He sat down on a yellow flower and began to grumble loudly: “Grrr! Grrr! Pippo!”

Immediately, Pippo ran towards Rino’s happy sound. He reached him in one jump and hugged Rino with his little paws. “Hey Rino! I was just wondering where you were!” said Pippo. 

Rino was happy. He felt good because he had continued to look for his friend. It was important never to give up, even when things got difficult. Rino and Pippo continued to play in the Flowery Meadow, happy to be together.

plan.problema: Rhino got lost in the meadow and couldn't find his squirrel friend, Pip.
plan.svolta: Rhino tried to follow Pip’s tracks, but he got confused among the fragrant flowers and lost his way.
plan.finale: Rhino started to bellow loudly and Pip immediately ran towards his sound, happy.

rinoceronte.text:
Rino was a rhinoceros plush toy. He lived in the Flowery Meadow, a place full of colors and smells. Rino loved to sing very much, especially a happy song that reminded him of summer. It was his favorite melody and he always sang it when he relaxed under the sun.



One day, Rino got lost. He had followed a blue butterfly and he found himself all alone, far from the meadow. “Oh no!” thought Rino. “I can’t find my song!” He looked everywhere, but he couldn’t hear it. It was as if he had forgotten it.



Rino decided to ask for help from the flowers. He shouted: "Who knows how to sing 'The Sun Shines'?" But the tulips only answered with their perfume, the roses whispered secrets, and the irises moved in the wind. No one knew that song! Rino felt sadder and sadder.



Then, Rino listened very carefully. He heard a light sound, almost a secret, that came from the green leaves. It was the wind. The wind was whispering the melody among the leaves! Rino followed the wind, moving gently among the flowers and bushes.



The wind led him to the farmhouse where the squirrels lived. The squirrels loved to listen to the song and they sang it together with Rino. Rino was happy to have found it again. He had learned to wait and to listen carefully, and finally he had found his favorite melody. Rino realized that even the most beautiful things require a little patience to be discovered.

plan.problema: Rhino got lost and couldn't find his favorite melody.
plan.svolta: He tried to call the flowers, but none of them knew that song!
plan.finale: Rhino discovered that the wind was whispering the melody through the leaves and he followed it to the farmhouse where the squirrels lived.

rinoceronte.text:
Rino was a very nice stuffed rhinoceros. He lived in the Flower Garden, among fragrant roses and tall sunflowers. Rino loved to play there, but he also enjoyed just watching the other flowers.

One day, Rino saw a little rabbit hopping happily. He wanted to play with him! But the rabbit was fast and ran away into the tall grass of the lawn. Rino followed him, but the grass was so high that he couldn’t see him anymore.

“Oh no!” said Rino. “I’m lost! I don’t know where my friend is.” He felt a little sad and confused. He tried to call the rabbit, but his voice was lost in the grass.

Rino thought for a moment. Then he had an idea. He used his big nose and began to feel around in the tall grass. “Maybe,” he thought, “if I listen carefully, I can sense the rabbit’s smell!” He gently touched the grass, back and forth.

After a while, Rino felt something sweet. A light and pleasant scent. He followed that scent, using his nose upwards. The scent became stronger and stronger.

Finally, Rino stopped under a colorful red flower. There was the rabbit! He was hopping happily and waiting for Rino. They hugged right away.

Rino realized that sometimes, to find something, you have to be patient and look carefully. And so, Rino continued to play in the Flower Garden, always knowing that he could count on his good smell.

plan.problema: Rhino got lost in the tall meadow and couldn't find his friend, a little rabbit.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his trunk to feel the tall grass and see if he sensed the rabbit's scent.
plan.finale: Rhino followed the sweet scent and finally found the rabbit who was waiting for him under a colorful flower.

rinoceronte.text:
Rino was a very happy stuffed rhinoceros. He lived in the Flower Garden, among fragrant roses and tall sunflowers. Every day Rino loved to explore the garden, walking along the flowerbeds and watching the birds.

One afternoon, while playing near the tall lawn, Rino got lost! The grass was so high that he couldn’t see his friend, Bruno, the gnome. Bruno loved to sit on a small stone and watch the butterflies. Rino knew he had to find him.

“Bruno? Bruno!” shouted Rino, but no one answered. The wind was blowing and carried away his voice. Rino felt a little sad. He tried to run forward, then backward, but he couldn’t find Bruno in the tall grass.

Rino thought. Then, he noticed something: small yellow flowers were sprouting among the grass. There were so many! Rino began to follow the tracks of the yellow flowers. He walked slowly, carefully watching where they went.

After a while, the yellow flowers led him under a large sunflower. And there was Bruno! The gnome was sitting on his stone, just like always. Rino ran to Bruno and hugged him tightly.

Bruno smiled. “Hello Rino! I was just resting.” Rino felt very happy to have found his friend again. He had learned that sometimes you have to be patient and observe carefully to find what you are looking for.

plan.problema: Rhino is lost in the tall meadow and can’t find his friend, gnome Bruno.
plan.svolta: Rhino tried to call Bruno out loud, but nobody was answering.
plan.finale: Rhino started following the tracks of small yellow flowers, finally finding Bruno hidden under a large sunflower.

rinoceronte.text:
Rino was a stuffed rhinoceros. He lived in the Flower Garden. He was a very happy rhinoceros. He liked to watch the colorful flowers. There were yellow tulips, blue violets, and red roses. But Rino especially admired a white daisy. It was the most beautiful of all!

Rino wanted to reach it. He walked quickly towards it, but it was too far away. His fluffy legs didn't reach the daisy. Rino felt a little sad. He couldn't see the daisy well from the ground.

“We need to find a way!” thought Rino. He saw a rose bush nearby. “Maybe I can climb!” he said. Rino started to climb the bush. It was a little slippery, but Rino kept going forward. Suddenly, he slipped down! Rino landed gently on the grass.

Rino got up and thought again. He looked at the daisy again. Then he had an idea. Rino used his horn like a little lever. He took a clump of grass near the daisy and pushed it gently. The grass moved a little, and Rino got closer and closer.

Finally, with one last effort, Rino reached the daisy! He touched it with his snout. It was really beautiful. Rino was happy and content. Rino realized that sometimes you have to wait and try different solutions to reach your goals.

plan.problema: Rhino couldn't reach the prettiest daisy in the garden.
plan.svolta: He decided to climb the rose bush, but he slid down!
plan.finale: Using his horn as a lever, Rhino gently pushed a clump of grass and reached the daisy.

rinoceronte.text:
Rino was a rubber rhinoceros. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Rino loved his garden very much. Every day he played among the plants and enjoyed scratching lines in the ground with his horn.

---

One morning, Rino noticed something terrible: his scratches were gone! There were no longer the lines he had left the day before. “Oh no!” said Rino. “Where did all my scratches go?” He was very sad. He looked everywhere, under the roses and near the lavender bush, but nothing.

---

Rino decided to try a new idea. He used his hoof to dig in the tall grass. He pushed the grass around with force, looking for his scratches. But instead of finding his scratches, Rino found himself rolling! He rolled and rolled until he stopped tired and clumsy.

---

Then, Rino had a brilliant idea. He went to a big sunflower that stood tall and proud. He looked behind the sunflower and... he saw them! His scratches were hidden right there, among the green leaves. Carefully, Rino rearranged them one by one, as if he were drawing them again.

---

A little ladybug watched him curiously. Rino smiled. He was happy to have found his scratches again. The secret garden seemed even more beautiful with his white lines on the ground. Rino realized that sometimes, to find what you’ve lost, you just need to be a little patient.

plan.problema: Rhino had lost all his scratches!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his paws to search through the tall grass, but he only found himself rolling!
plan.finale: He found his scratches hidden behind a large sunflower and carefully rearranged them.

rinoceronte.text:
Rino was a stuffed rhinoceros. He lived in the Flowery Meadow, a place full of colorful flowers and soft grass. Rino loved to run among the flowers, but he also enjoyed just watching the world around him sometimes.

One day, while playing with cool water, Rino found himself very, very far from home. He couldn’t see his gnome friends or the ladybugs anymore. He was lost! And worse of all, he couldn’t find Lila, his butterfly friend.

Lila was a blue butterfly with sparkling wings. Rino really wanted to talk to her. So he tried to call her: “Lila! Lila!”. But nobody answered. Only the wind blew through the flowers.

Rino noticed that there was a path that glowed with its own light. It was the brightest path in the Flowery Meadow! Rino decided to follow it, step by step. The path led him through rose bushes and apple trees.

After walking for a long time, Rino saw Lila. The butterfly was sitting on a lily pad, a floating leaf on the water, and was enjoying a cool drink. “Lila!” shouted Rino happily. Lila flew right to him.

From that day on, Rino and Lila became inseparable. They had fun playing together in the Flowery Meadow. Rino learned that even when things seem difficult, continuing to look for the solution always leads to happiness.

plan.problema: Rhino got lost in the meadow and couldn't find his friend butterfly, Lila.
plan.svolta: Rhino tried to call Lila, but nobody was answering, so he decided to follow the brightest path.
plan.finale: Eventually, Rhino found Lila enjoying a lovely water lily and the two became inseparable.

rinoceronte.text:
Rino was a very silly stuffed rhinoceros. He lived in the Flowery Meadow, a place full of red, yellow, and blue flowers. Rino loved the Flowery Meadow because that’s where he met lots of friends. His best friend was Leo, a speedy and playful squirrel.

One day, Rino was running among the flowers with Leo. They were so beautiful! Rino lost his grip and, in a moment, he got lost. The flowers were too big and colorful. He couldn’t see Leo anywhere. “Leo? Where are you?” shouted Rino. But his voice was too loud. The butterflies flew away, scared.

Rino felt sad. He looked for Leo everywhere, but he couldn’t find him. Then he thought, “Maybe if I tried to do something different…” He started to make little rhinoceros sounds. “Hello… hello…” Rino repeated. It sounded like a little bell!

Suddenly, he heard a happy shout: “Rino!” Leo ran towards him and hugged him tightly. Rino was happy to have found his friend again. They sat together under a big yellow flower, laughing and playing.

Rino realized that sometimes it’s necessary to slow down and find solutions calmly. He needed time to figure out how to find Leo. And so, Rino also learned to wait patiently.

plan.problema: Rhino got lost among the many colorful flowers and couldn't find his friend squirrel, Leo.
plan.svolta: Rhino tried to shout to Leo, but his voice was too loud and scared the butterflies.
plan.finale: Rhino started making little rhino noises, sounding like a bell, and Leo ran towards the sound to hug him.

scoiattolo.text:
Squirrel Leo was a very active little squirrel. He lived in a big apple tree, the most beautiful tree in the forest. Every day, Leo loved to collect juicy apples and, especially, his favorite hazelnuts. He hid them among the branches of the tree so he would always have them available.

One morning, Squirrel Leo wanted to eat his hazelnuts. But when he tried to take one, he couldn't find them! He dug everywhere: under the branches, inside the apple bushes, among the green leaves. Nothing, not a single hazelnut!

Leo was very sad. He was sure he had hidden them right there, near his favorite spot. He sat down on a branch and thought about what to do. “I can’t find my hazelnuts by myself,” he said to himself.

Suddenly, Squirrel Leo had an idea. He called with his loudest voice: "Wind, wind, can you help me?" The wind blew gently through the branches of the apple tree. Squirrel Leo closed his eyes and concentrated. He heard the wind whisper: “Follow the sound… look at the hole…”

Squirrel Leo followed the wind’s instructions. The wind led him to a small hole in the trunk of the apple tree. And there, right under the hole, were his precious hazelnuts! Squirrel Leo took them all and began to eat them happily.

The wind continued to blow gently among the leaves of the apple tree. It’s always better to ask for help when you need it.

plan.problema: Leo can't find his favorite hazelnuts hidden among the branches.
plan.svolta: After searching everywhere, Leo decides to ask the wind for help to find where the hazelnuts are.
plan.finale: The wind points him to a small hole in the trunk and Leo finally finds his precious hazelnuts!
plan.morale: Asking for help is always a good idea.

scoiattolo.text:
Squirrel Pipkin lived in a giant apple tree. He was a little playful squirrel and very curious. He loved collecting apple seeds more than anything. He had a lovely collection! But one day, Squirrel Pipkin noticed with horror: his favorite seeds were gone! He had put them in a small pouch of dry leaves, but when he opened it, it was empty.

Squirrel Pipkin jumped from branch to branch, desperately searching. He shouted: “Where have you gone?” But no one answered. He was very sad and confused. He decided he had to do something. He thought long and hard and then had an idea: he would follow the wind!

“The wind knows how to go anywhere!” thought Squirrel Pipkin. He leaned against the tallest branch and began to jump, trying to follow the direction of the wind. An old owl, who lived in the tree, watched him with curiosity. “Good luck, little squirrel!” hooted the owl.

The wind pushed Squirrel Pipkin forward and backward. Then, suddenly, he smelled a sweet smell of apples. And just as he let himself be carried by the wind, he saw a large red leaf, the size of his hand. Under the red leaf were his seeds!

Squirrel Pipkin jumped happily and collected them all. He was so happy to have found them. He returned to his place in the apple tree, more careful than ever about his precious seeds. And as he put everything in order, he thought how important it was to wait for the right moment. Patience really made the difference in this adventure.

plan.problema: Peter has lost his favorite seeds!
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the wind, hoping to find them.
plan.finale: The wind carried him right among the apple trees, where he found his hidden seeds under a red leaf.

scoiattolo.text:
Squirrel Pipkin lived in a big apple tree. He was a little playful squirrel and he especially loved his apple seeds. He collected them carefully, hid them among the leaves, and then he waited for them to plant when winter was over.

One day, Squirrel Pipkin noticed that his seeds were gone! He had lost many of them. He was very sad. He looked everywhere under the trunk of the tree, among the roots, and in the holes of the branches. But none of his seeds were anywhere.

Squirrel Pipkin decided to ask for help. He stood on his paws and shouted: “Wind, wind! Can you help me find my seeds?” The wind blew strongly and began to push Squirrel Pipkin among the dry leaves. It took him to turn around the tree, under the tallest branches.

The wind pushed him strongly towards a big yellow flower. Squirrel Pipkin approached cautiously and… there they were! His apple seeds were hidden right under the flower, protected from the sun.

Squirrel Pipkin collected all the seeds and put them back in his little hiding place. He was happy and satisfied with his discovery. He carefully arranged the seeds, thinking how wonderful it would be to see them grow in a beautiful garden full of apples. 

After so much searching, Squirrel Pipkin realized that waiting and carefully observing can lead to the right solution to problems.

plan.problema: Pippo has lost all his favorite apple seeds!
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the wind, which pushed him to look among the leaves and branches.
plan.finale: Pippo found the hidden seeds under a big flower, happy and satisfied.

scoiattolo.text:
Scattino was a very lively squirrel. He lived in a big apple tree. The tree was full of juicy fruits and strong branches. Scattino loved to climb, collect the apples, and play among the green leaves. He had a favorite nose: a perfect little nut! It was his most precious treasure.

One day, Scattino was jumping from branch to branch. He had gotten carried away with the joy of running and suddenly realized that his nut-nose was gone. “Oh no!” exclaimed Scattino. “Where did I put it?”

Scattino started looking everywhere. He looked under the red apples, behind the thick branches, and among the green leaves. But the nut was missing. He decided to look among the dry leaves that had accumulated at the base of the tree. He only found soft feathers and curious little insects. He was frustrated.

“Maybe I lost it when I was tired,” thought Scattino. He lay down on a branch, closed his eyes, and took a nap. When he woke up, he felt something strange under his nose!

Scattino stretched out his paw and pulled out his nut-nose! It was right there, under a fallen branch, exactly where he had left it for a nap. Scattino was so happy.

He collected apples and played among the leaves, but this time he paid very close attention to where he put his favorite nose. He knew every corner of his apple tree well. Scattino realized that finding what you’ve lost takes a little patience and a careful eye.

plan.problema: Snap shot had lost his favorite nose, a little nut!
plan.svolta: He decided to look among the dry leaves, but he only found feathers and insects.
plan.finale: He found it under a fallen branch, just where he’d left it for a nap!

scoiattolo.text:
Scattino was a very active teddy squirrel. He lived in a big apple tree. The tree had lots of branches full of red and juicy apples. Scattino loved to climb the branches, jump from one leaf to another, and hide his little feathers.

One day, Scattino noticed that something wasn't right. He couldn't make nuts anymore! Usually, when he felt happy, his glands produced soft, fragrant brown. But now nothing. He was very sad. “Oh no!” said Scattino. “I’ve lost my glands!”

He decided to do something. He saw some red berries on the trees and thought, “Maybe if I eat these berries, my glands will come back!” He ate them with his little paws, but nothing happened. They didn’t turn into nuts. He was even more worried.

An old owl, called Professor Pio, was watching him from above. “Try to lie in the sun!” advised Professor Pio. Scattino lay down on the sunniest branch of the apple tree and closed his eyes. He felt the warm light that warmed his fur.

Suddenly, he felt a tingling in his paws! He looked and saw his glands returning to produce brown nuts! Scattino jumped for joy. The sun had made him happy, and this had made his glands come back. 

Scattino continued to play in the sun, happy and full of energy. It was important to be happy to do nice things.

plan.problema: Snap had lost all his glands to produce nuts!
plan.svolta: He tried to collect some red berries, but they weren't nuts and they didn't work.
plan.finale: Finally he discovered that the bright sun did him good and his glands returned!

scoiattolo.text:
Squirrel Pip was a very cheerful teddy bear. He lived in a big apple tree. The tree was full of red and green fruits, perfect for a greedy little mouse like him. Pip loved to collect apples and hide them among the roots of the tree. But one morning, Pip noticed something strange. He didn’t have his glands anymore!

The glands allowed him to produce nuts, his favorite food. Without the glands, Pip couldn’t eat the apples with the same joy. He was very sad and a little worried. “Oh no!” he exclaimed. “How will I eat?”

He decided he had to find his lost glands. He started to rummage through the dry leaves, under the branches of the apple tree. He dug with his little paws, trying to remember where he had seen the last glands. He saw a blue butterfly flying around him. The butterfly told him: “I saw some walnut seeds fall from the sky!”

Pip followed the butterfly and found a bag full of walnut seeds. With great care, Pip planted the seeds under the apple tree. He watered the little sprouts with the morning dew. He patiently waited for them to grow. After a long time, the seeds became walnut trees, full of juicy walnuts. Now Pip always had his favorite food available, and he knew how to take care of things. Squirrel Pip realized that waiting patiently could lead to great results.

plan.problema: Squirrel Pip has lost all his glands to produce nuts!
plan.svolta: He decided to look for the fallen nuts, rummaging through the leaves and under the branches.
plan.finale: He found a bag full of walnut seeds and planted them carefully, waiting for them to grow so he would always have some.

scoiattolo.text:
Scio was a very lively teddy squirrel. He lived in a big apple tree. He loved to jump between the branches and collect the beautiful red apples. He had lots of squirrel friends with whom he played every day.

One afternoon, Scio was playing hide-and-seek among the leaves. His friends were everywhere: behind the branches, under the trees, even inside a basket of apples! But then, everyone went away. Scio realized that he was all alone. All his friends had disappeared among the green leaves!

Scio felt very sad. He tried to shout: “My friends, where are you?” But nobody heard him. There were too many green leaves around and his voice got lost. It was a big mess! Scio was desperate.

Then, Scio had an idea. He started running along the branches of the apple tree. He was looking for something that could help him find his friends. Suddenly, he spotted a little path made of woven branches. It was hidden among the leaves!

Scio followed the secret path and, unbelievably, he found all his friends! They were sitting together, eating apples and laughing. Scio was so happy. They all hugged each other. 

After a little bit of playing, Scio realized that when you help each other, it’s much easier to find the right way. And so, the squirrels played happily all afternoon.

plan.problema: Ski is lost all his friends in the leaves!
plan.svolta: He tried to shout, but no one could hear him among so many green leaves.
plan.finale: Then he discovered a secret path made of branches and found all his friends happy.

scoiattolo.text:
Scio was a little teddy squirrel. He lived in the biggest apple tree in the forest. He loved climbing among the branches and collecting the beautiful red apples. But one day, Scio noticed that something wasn't right. He couldn't find his glands anymore! These special glands produced the nuts that gave him energy to jump and play.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Scio. “Where have they gone?” He looked everywhere, under the branches, among the leaves, but nothing! He was sad because he didn't have the strength anymore to collect nuts to hide for the winter.

Scio tried to eat a juicy apple. The apple was sweet and good, but it didn't give him the right energy. He couldn't run as fast as before. “This apple doesn’t help me,” thought Scio.

Just at that moment, a wise owl sitting on a branch nearby was listening to the little squirrel. “Maybe,” advised the owl, "you should look for a pine cone full of seeds. They are very tasty and will give you the strength you need.”

Scio followed the owl’s advice and found just the perfect pine cone! He ate it quickly, one after another. Immediately he felt a wave of energy. He was full of strength again! Scio happily skipped among the branches of the apple tree.

The owl smiled at Scio. “See,” said the owl, "the help of friends can lead to solving problems.” Scio and the owl became great friends and spent the rest of the afternoon playing in the apple tree.

plan.problema: Ski has lost all his glands that produce nuts!
plan.svolta: He tried to eat some apples, but they were too sweet and didn't give him energy.
plan.finale: Thanks to the advice of a wise owl, Ski discovered a pinecone full of tasty seeds and is now full of strength again!
plan.morale: Friendship helps to find the solution.

scoiattolo.text:
Squirrel Pipkin lived in a big apple tree. The tree was full of red, juicy apples. Pipkin loved apples very much, but especially he loved to collect acorns for the winter. He had a huge pile of acorns under his nest.

One day, Squirrel Pipkin noticed that something wasn't right. His favorite acorns had disappeared! He had looked everywhere: among the leaves, inside the branches, even in the farmer’s abandoned apple crate. But no acorns!

Pipkin was very sad. How would he prepare for the winter without acorns? The winter was coming, and the cold would get stronger and stronger. He had to do something, and quickly!

Then, Pipkin had an idea. He gathered lots of golden dry leaves and some thin, flexible branches. He started to build a big ball. He put the leaves inside, added the branches, and tried to make it as full as possible.

He worked hard all afternoon. Finally, his new ball was packed full of acorns! Pipkin collected more from the ground, filling his ball even more. He finally felt ready for the winter. 

Pipkin settled into his nest, surrounded by his ball of leaves and acorns. He was happy and sure that he could face the cold. And so, Squirrel Pipkin learned that with a little effort and perseverance, even the biggest problems can be solved.

plan.problema: Pippo has lost all his favorite nuts and doesn't know how to prepare for winter.
plan.svolta: He decided to build a new nut ball, using dry leaves and thin branches.
plan.finale: Pippo filled his new ball with the nuts he found and felt ready for winter!

scoiattolo.text:
Squirrel Pipkin lived in a big apple tree. The tree was full of red and green fruits. Pipkin loved to climb among the branches and pick apples. But one day, Pipkin noticed that something wasn't right. He couldn't make acorns anymore! His glands had disappeared.

He was very sad. Without acorns, how would he fill his little home? How could he share his treasures with the other squirrels? Pipkin was worried. He looked everywhere but he couldn't find anything.

Then, Squirrel Pipkin had an idea. He decided to organize a treasure hunt! He wanted to ask for help from the birds in the garden. “Little birds, little birds,” shouted Pipkin, “will you help me find my glands?” The birds listened carefully and replied, “Of course we’ll help you!”

The robin, the most lively of all, pointed the way. “Follow the stream!” he said. A blue jay sang again: “Turn right!” Squirrel Pipkin followed the birds to a little bucket hidden under a tree root. The bucket was full of magic hazelnuts!

With the hazelnuts, Pipkin’s glands came back right away. He was so happy! He thanked the birds and continued to collect acorns for the winter. Squirrel Pipkin understood that even when things seem difficult, with a little courage you can always find the solution.

plan.problema: Pippo has lost all his glands to produce nuts!
plan.svolta: He decided to organize a treasure hunt, asking for help from the garden birds.
plan.finale: The birds guided him to a bucket full of magic hazelnuts that brought back his joy and his glands!

shark.text:
Squalo was a little blue rubber shark, very happy. He lived in the Blue Pool and loved to play among the bubbles of air. One day, while making swirls with his tail fin, a leaf hit him! The leaf flew away, but Squalo got stuck in a tangle of other floating leaves.

It was all around him: green, yellow, and brown. He couldn't see the pool anymore, he couldn't find his place. “Oh no!” exclaimed Squalo. “I’m lost!” He looked through the leaves, he moved forward and backward, but nothing. He was always surrounded by the floating leaves.
