Squalo decided to swim faster. He concentrated with all his strength, but he only found himself bumping into another leaf! “Oh dear!” thought Squalo. “This is difficult!” He felt a little frustrated. 

Then he had an idea. Squalo used his tail fin like a little propeller. He started moving it up and down, creating small currents of water. The currents pushed Squalo towards the edge of the pool. Faster and faster!

Finally, with one last effort, Squalo reached the edge of the Blue Pool. He was free! A little red fish greeted him. Squalo smiled. He had learned that even when things are difficult, you have to keep trying and never give up. Perseverance always helps you reach your goals.

plan.problema: Shark got lost among the floating leaves and couldn't find his place.
plan.svolta: He decided to swim faster, but he only ended up bumping into another leaf!
plan.finale: Finally, using his tail fin as a small propeller, he managed to create currents that pushed him towards the edge of the pool.

shark.text:
Shark was a little rubber shark. He loved the sunny pool. It was his favorite place. Every day he curled up among the green leaves of the umbrella and waited for the warm sun. Today, though, there was a problem. The umbrella was gone! It had been moved to make room for a new water game. Shark was very sad. He hadn’t found a comfortable place to rest.

Shark slowly moved across the pool floor. He tried to find a shady spot, but the sun was shining too bright. He tried to spray water on the colorful blocks. But it only made splashes! The water didn’t help him find a cool and sheltered place. He felt frustrated.

A boy was building towers of blocks near the pool. “Hello!” said the boy. Shark swam closer. The boy offered Shark blocks to spray with water, but that didn’t solve anything.

Suddenly, a ray of sunshine hit Shark directly. It was a warm and bright ray that clearly showed him: his favorite place under the new umbrella! The shade was cool and protective. Shark quickly moved towards that spot. He curled up among the green leaves, happy to be cool. The sun warmed his back.

Shark realized that sometimes you have to wait for the right moment to find what you really like. Patience had found its perfect place.

plan.problema: Shark has lost his umbrella and can’t find a good place to rest.
plan.svolta: He tried to spray water on the colorful blocks, but they only made splashes!
plan.finale: A ray of sunshine illuminated him, showing his favorite spot under the new umbrella.

shark.text:
Squalo was a big blue rubber shark. He lived in the Play Pool, a place full of colors and laughter. Squalo loved to play among the floating shapes and stacked building blocks. He was a great shark, always ready for an adventure.

One day, Squalo noticed that something wasn't right. His glitter, the ones that made him shine with a thousand colors, were gone! “Oh no!” he exclaimed. “Where did all my glitter go?”

Squalo started to look everywhere. He looked under the chairs of the Play Pool, but the glitter was too small to be seen. "They're too hidden here," thought Squalo. He looked behind the big rubber castle, and there was nothing there either. He was very sad.

Squalo tried to think. What could he do? Then he had an idea! He used his tail fin, the long and powerful one, to create a whirlpool in the pool. The water spun faster and faster.

And then, miraculously, the glitter reappeared! They shone with a thousand colors, as if nothing had happened. Squalo swam happily in circles, joyful and full of light. The Play Pool was even more beautiful with all his glitter. 

A little teddy bear, Bruno, watched him smile. “You were very clever, Squalo!” said Bruno.

Squalo continued to play, happy to have his colors back. Perseverance had done its job. With a little effort, even the most difficult things can be solved.

plan.problema: Shark has lost all his glitter!
plan.svolta: He tried to look under the chairs, but they were too small to see.
plan.finale: Then he had an idea: he used his fin to create a whirlpool and the glitter started to shine again!

shark.text:
Squalo was a little toy shark. He lived in the swimming pool at home. He loved to swim among the water plants and watch the little red fish jump out of the water. One day, Squalo noticed something strange. He couldn’t see the fish anymore!

“Oh no!” thought Squalo. “Where did they go? I’ve lost my eye!”

Looking around the swimming pool, Squalo searched for his eye. It was small and blue. He must have lost it when he fell to the edge of the pool? He didn’t know.

Squalo tried to look for it among the floating leaves. He took a big leaf with his shark mouth. But the leaf was too small! It itched a little too. He couldn’t see anything.

Then, Squalo noticed something on the bottom of the swimming pool. It was a small, shiny stone. The sun hit it and it shone like a star. Squalo approached the stone carefully. He used it to look at the little red fish.

It was perfect! The stone was smooth and shiny, and it allowed Squalo to see all the little fish swimming around him. Now he could play and have fun as always. 

Squalo curled up happily in the swimming pool, with his new special eye. The sunlight shone on the shiny stone, making it a perfect day for a little shark.

plan.problema: Shark lost his eye and can’t see the fish anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to use a big leaf as an eye, but it was too small and it itched.
plan.finale: Then he found a shiny stone that glittered in the sun and became his special new eye!
plan.morale: Even when something is missing, you can always find a solution.

shark.text:
Squalo Leo was a little plastic shark. He lived in Luca’s swimming pool. He loved to swim and play among the colorful building blocks that filled the bottom. One day, while having fun jumping, something went wrong. Shark Leo found himself surrounded by lots of floating leaves! They were green and dark, and he couldn’t see where he was.

“Oh no!” thought Shark Leo. “I’m lost! I can’t find my place among the building blocks!” He moved carefully, but the leaves trapped him. He didn’t feel the sunlight anymore and he felt a little scared. Luca was sitting on the other side of the pool and was watching him play.

Shark Leo decided to do something. He decided to swim faster! He tried to distinguish the colorful building blocks, the red, the orange, and the yellow. He swam, swam, swam, trying to find a landmark. 

Suddenly, Shark Leo heard a noise: laughter! It was Luca’s laughter. Following the sounds, Shark Leo moved towards the voice. He saw the colorful building blocks and finally found his place next to the red ones. He was happy!

Finally, thanks to his determination, Shark Leo returned to watch over the pool with pride. Luca was happy to have found him. Shark Leo understood that even when things seem difficult, you should never give up and keep looking.

plan.problema: Shark Leo got lost among the floating leaves and can’t find his way back!
plan.svolta: He decided to swim faster, trying to distinguish the colorful blocks of his kingdom.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the sound of Luca’s laughter, Shark Leo returned to guard the pool with pride.

shark.text:
Squalo was a little blue rubber shark. He had arrived at the new swimming pool that morning. The pool was big and full of crystal-clear water. Squalo loved to float. Then, suddenly, Squalo found himself deep down in the pool! The water was cold and dark. He couldn’t see the surface anymore.

“Oh no!” shouted Squalo. “I’m lost!” He felt all alone and a little scared. A little red fish, Peppe, was watching him curiously. Squalo tried to swim upwards, but he was too heavy. The water was too thick.

Squalo thought. He thought about what he could do. Then he had an idea! He used his big bite and… *puff*! A big bubble of air came out of his mouth. *Puff, puff, puff*. Squalo made lots of bubbles! The bubbles pushed him upwards, towards the light.

Squalo kept making bubbles, faster and faster. The bubbles were like little friends helping him to come up. Finally, a big bubble took him out of the water, right near the children who were playing! A surprised child took him in his hand and looked at him with a smile.

Squalo felt happy to be back. He had used his bite to solve the problem. He remembered that even when things seem difficult, you must never give up. Determination can lead to amazing results.

plan.problema: Shark is lost in the deep end of the pool!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his big bite to make bubbles and find the light.
plan.finale: The bubbles took him out, right near the surface where the children were playing.

shark.text:
Squalo was a little plastic shark who lived in the Blue Pool. He loved to play among the bubbles and jump in the water. But one day, something bad happened. Squalo realized he didn’t have his glass eye anymore! It was made of clear crystal and allowed him to see the pool. Without the eye, he didn’t know where home was!

Squalo was very sad. “Oh no, oh no!” he cried. “How am I going to know where my friends are?” He looked around the Blue Pool, but everything seemed confused. He couldn’t see the edge of the pool or the little fish house that lived nearby.

Then Squalo decided to take a trip. He swam slowly, looking among the floating leaves. The leaves were many and green, but no glass eye! He pushed with his snout and turned around a pink plastic star. Then, suddenly, he heard something under him.

Squalo bent down and saw a small glass eye stuck between the leaves. It was right there, near the star! He picked it up carefully and attached it back to his body. 

Squalo could see the Blue Pool again! He immediately took a few happy turns, happy to be back home. Squalo was so happy with his glass eye that he decided to always come back to play in the Blue Pool. Perseverance can lead you to find even the most lost things.

plan.problema: Shark has lost his glass eye and can’t see his home anymore!
plan.svolta: He decided to take a swim, searching among the floating leaves to find the lost object.
plan.finale: Finally, he found the glass eye stuck under a plastic star and hurried home happy.

shark.text:
Squalo was a big rubber shark. He lived in the sunny pool, where the sun warmed the water and children laughed around. Squalo loved to play hide-and-seek among the floating leaves. He was a great shark for this game!

---

One day, however, something wasn't right. Squalo noticed right away that something was missing. “Oh no!” said Squalo. “I’ve lost my rubber eye!” The eye was small and pink, and it was important for seeing well. Without the eye, Squalo couldn’t find the floating leaves.

---

Squalo began to look everywhere. First, he tried to look under the pool chairs. “Maybe it fell here,” thought Squalo. But the eye was too small to be seen between the chairs. Then he checked behind the cover that covered the pool. Nothing!

---

Squalo felt a little sad. He gave up and lay down on the surface of the water, waiting. The sun continued to warm the water and the children still played around. Squalo closed his eyes for a moment.

---

Suddenly, he felt a ray of sunshine hitting something white. “There it is!” shouted Squalo. He moved quickly and found his rubber eye! It shone in the sunlight, like a little treasure.

---

Squalo was very happy. He started playing hide-and-seek again among the floating leaves, seeing everything thanks to his found eye. The sun continued to shine on the sunny pool.

plan.problema: Shark has lost his rubber eye!
plan.svolta: He tried to look under the chairs, but the eye was too small to see.
plan.finale: Suddenly, he heard a ray of sunshine hitting something white and he found it there, shining in the light!

shark.text:
Squalo was a little plastic shark. He was new, just because his family had just built a new pool. 

The pool was big and blue, full of cool water. Squalo loved to float in the water, but that morning he had gotten lost.

He had found himself surrounded by green and smooth water plants. There were so many that he couldn’t see the edge of the pool anymore. He couldn’t find his place next to the water polo net, where he was supposed to be. Squalo made little movements with his tail, but he kept moving deeper among the leaves. He was scared.

“I have to do something,” thought Squalo. So he decided to go on an exploring trip. He swam straight towards the end of the pool, passing over stones and building blocks. He went forward, he went backward, trying to figure out where he was.

Suddenly, he heard noises. They were little laughs. Small laughs of children having fun in the pool. Squalo followed the noises with his eyes. He saw a blue figure, the water polo net! It was right there, next to him.

Squalo swam quickly to the net and leaned against it. He was happy to be back in his place. The family was laughing and playing around the pool. Squalo understood that even when things seem difficult, if you don’t give up, you always find the solution. And sometimes, you just have to listen to the right noises to find your way back.

plan.problema: Shark is lost among the water plants and can't find his place.
plan.svolta: He decided to take an exploratory swim to the end of the pool.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the noise of the children’s laughter, he found his position next to the basketball net.

shark.text:
Squalo was a little rubber shark. He loved the children’s pool more than anything. Every day, after snack time, he would find himself there playing. But one afternoon, something went wrong. Squalo found himself in a giant aquarium! There was no friend, the slippery slide, nor the fountain that sprayed cool water.

Squalo was very sad. He wanted to go back to his favorite beach, where the water was warmer and the sunbeams shone brighter. He looked everywhere, but he couldn’t find it. “Oh no!” said Squalo, “I’m lost!”.

Then, Squalo decided to swim faster. He opened his mouth wide and moved like a lightning bolt! But he only found himself making circles. He swam around the aquarium, without finding his beach. He was tired and a little frustrated.

Suddenly, he saw a bright blue starfish watching him. “Can I help you?” asked the starfish. Squalo explained his problem. The starfish swam near Squalo, pointing him in the right direction. Together, they reached a corner of soft, golden sand.

Squalo cooled off in the warm water and, smiling, thought: “How wonderful to be back in my favorite place!”. The starfish wished Squalo good luck for his courage. Squalo understood that, even when things seem difficult, you should never give up.

plan.problema: Shark got lost in his aquarium and couldn't find his favorite beach.
plan.svolta: He decided to swim faster, but he only ended up doing circles!
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a friendly starfish, Shark finally found his sandy spot and cooled off.

sheep.text:
Bauccio was a very soft woolly lamb. He lived in the Flowery Meadow, a meadow full of colorful flowers and green grass. Every day, Bauccio played with the other lambs, skipping and nibbling the grass.

---

One afternoon, while he was playing, Bauccio wandered too far from the group. When he looked around, he didn't see his sisters and brothers anymore. He was all alone! Bauccio was scared. He didn't know where he was and how to get home. The lambs were far away, hidden among the hills.

---

Bauccio decided to do something. He thought, “If I want to go back, I must follow something.” So, he started to move towards the stream that flowed through the meadow. The water was cool and clear. Bauccio followed the stream, hoping it would take him to his meadow.

---

A little white rabbit, named Poldo, saw him running and greeted him. “Where are you going, lamb?” asked Poldo. “I’m lost from my group!” replied Bauccio. Poldo showed him the way, and Bauccio continued to follow the stream.

---

Finally, he heard familiar sounds. They were the voices of the lambs calling his name! Bauccio ran fast, fast, fast. And then... he saw it! His group of lambs was there, waiting for him. Bauccio happily skipped among them, cuddling with them. He was happy to be home. 

---

Bauccio understood that even when things seem difficult, if you don’t lose hope, you can always find your way back.

plan.problema: Woolly got lost from his sheep group and doesn’t know how to get back home.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the stream, hoping it would lead him to the meadow where his family lived.
plan.finale: Finally, he heard the sheep calling him and ran happily to them.

sheep.text:
Peppa was a fluffy white teddy bear. She lived in the Flower Garden, a place full of colorful and fragrant flowers. The daisies were her favorites, she loved them so much that sometimes she got lost among them.

One day, Peppa was happily playing among the yellow daisies. She started to jump and run, following the wind. Suddenly, she realized she didn't know where she was anymore. She was surrounded by a sea of white and yellow flowers, and she couldn't find her little house made of grass threads.

“Oh no!” said Peppa, with her ears drooping. “I’m lost! I can’t find my way home.” She sat down on a small bush of red roses and started to cry a little. A red ladybug flew past her. The ladybug greeted her with a “Hello!”.

Peppa decided to do something. She heard a distant sound, the babbling of a stream. “Maybe,” thought Peppa, “the stream will take me to my place.” She stood up and started to move towards the sound of water. She walked slowly, following the stream flowing between colorful pebbles.

After a while, the stream had brought her right in front of her little house made of grass threads! She was happy. She jumped into her house and fell asleep, dreaming of daisies. 

Peppa learned that even when things seem difficult, taking a moment to stop and think calmly can help you find the right way.

plan.problema: Peppa got lost among the daisies and couldn't find her way home.
plan.svolta: She decided to follow the sound of the stream, hoping it would lead her to her place.
plan.finale: The stream had brought her right in front of her little house made of grass!

sheep.text:
Bauccio was a fluffy lamb, soft and white like snow. He lived in the Flowery Meadow, a meadow full of yellow daisies and golden stars. Bauccio loved to play in the tall grass, jump on the bushes, and make bubbles with the wind.



One day, while playing hide-and-seek with the other lambs, Bauccio found himself alone. He couldn't see his friends anymore! He was lost. The Flowery Meadow seemed enormous now without them. “Mommy? Daddy?” cried Bauccio, but his voice didn't go anywhere. Only the wind blew through the grass.



Bauccio felt sad and a little scared. He tried to run in all directions, but every time he found himself in the same meadow. He couldn't find his sheep family! It was all confusing.



Then, Bauccio had an idea. He heard a distant sound, gurgling and flowing. It was the sound of the stream that ran through the Flowery Meadow. “Maybe I can follow this sound,” thought Bauccio. So, he moved towards the stream, walking quickly through the grass.



Finally, after so much searching, Bauccio saw his sheep friends! There were many, all white and soft like him. He jumped among them happily, bouncing with joy. “I did it!” thought Bauccio. 



The sun shone on the Flowery Meadow and Bauccio realized that even when things seem difficult, if you don't give up, you always find your way back home.

plan.problema: Bartholomew got lost and can’t find his sheep family anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to shout, but no one could hear him, so he decided to follow the sound of the stream.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the sound of the water, he saw his sheep friends and splashed among them happily!
plan.morale: Never give up, perseverance pays off.

sheep.text:
Bauccio was a little fleece lamb who was very happy. He lived in the Garden of Roses and loved to be there watching the beautiful, fragrant roses. Every day he felt the sun on his soft wool. But that day, Bauccio felt cold. Very cold!

“Oh no!” said Bauccio. “I’ve lost my favorite wool! I can’t stay warm anymore.” He looked everywhere, under the red and yellow roses. He looked among the white flower bushes. But nothing, his wool was gone.

Bauccio had an idea. He rolled up among the roses, hoping his wool would come back on its own. He got covered in dust! It was all gray and dirty. “What a terrible thing!” thought Bauccio, wiping himself with a small petal.

Just at that moment, a kind lady with a bag full of honey approached. The lady of the bees was a friend of the roses. She saw Bauccio sad and asked him what had happened. Bauccio explained that he had lost his wool.

The lady of the bees smiled. She took a small pink silk ribbon and gave it to Bauccio. She tied it gently around his tummy. Immediately, Bauccio felt warm and happy! “Thank you, thank you!” said Bauccio to the lady of the bees.

The lady of the bees replied, “Sometimes it just takes a little help to find happiness.” Bauccio curled up happily among the roses, wrapped in his new pink silk ribbon. It was the perfect place to stay warm and happy.

plan.problema: Bartholomew lost his favorite wool and can't keep warm anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to roll in the roses, but he only got covered in dust!
plan.finale: The lady of the bees gave him a little silk ribbon and Bartholomew felt happy right away.
plan.morale: Even a little help can make a difference.

sheep.text:
Bauccio was a very soft teddy lamb. He lived in the Flowery Meadow, a big meadow full of colorful flowers. Every day Bauccio hopped and skipped among the flowers, happy. One afternoon, while playing bubblegum with the wind, something changed. 

Bauccio noticed that he couldn’t hear his family anymore. The sheep that surrounded him had disappeared! He was all alone, a little lamb all by himself in the Flowery Meadow. Bauccio was scared. He looked everywhere, but nobody could see him. “Mommy? Daddy? Where are you?” he cried with his fluffy voice.

He decided he had to do something. He started to walk, trying to figure out how to go back. He saw a sparkling stream and thought, “Maybe the stream will bring me closer to other animals!” He followed the stream, jumping from one rock to another.

At some point, he heard faint sounds. At first, he didn't understand what they were, but then, louder and louder, he heard tiny bleats calling to him. Bauccio ran quickly towards the sound and saw lots of sheep! They were his sisters and his brothers.

He joined the happy flock and hopped and skipped with them. He was so happy to be back home. Bauccio understood that even when you get lost, if you try hard, you can always find your way back to the people you love.

plan.problema: Barnaby got lost in the big meadow and can’t find his sheep family!
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the stream, hoping it would lead him to other animals.
plan.finale: Finally, he heard the faint bleats of his brothers and sisters and ran towards their happy flock.

sheep.text:
Peppa was a stuffed sheep. She lived in the Flowery Meadow. It was a meadow full of colorful flowers and soft grass. Peppa loved to play there with the butterflies and the little squirrels. One day, she was hopping happily when she noticed that her mummy wasn't there anymore. “Mummy?” called Peppa, but nobody answered.

She realized she had gotten lost in the meadow. It was a very big meadow and the flowers all looked the same. Peppa was scared. She looked for her mummy everywhere, but she couldn't find her. Tears streamed down her fluffy face.

Then, Peppa had an idea. She saw a little stream flowing between the flowers. She thought, “Maybe the stream will take me closer to Mummy!”. So, she started hopping along the bank of the stream. It was tiring, but Peppa didn’t give up.

The stream took her deeper and deeper into the meadow. At one point, she heard a familiar voice: “Peppa! Where are you?” She turned around and saw her mummy calling her. Peppa ran to her, happy to see her again. She hugged her tightly with her fluffy little hooves.

Peppa’s mummy smiled. She was happy to have found her. Peppa understood that sometimes, following your instincts can take you where you want to go. And even when you feel lost, you must never give up.

plan.problema: Peppa got lost in the meadow and can’t find her mummy anymore.
plan.svolta: She decided to follow the stream, hoping it would lead her closer to her mummy.
plan.finale: The stream had led her right next to her mummy, happy to see her.
plan.morale: Follow your instincts and don’t give up.

sheep.text:
Bauccio was a little teddy bear who was very happy. He lived in the Flowery Garden, a place full of colors and smells. His favorite patch of grass was among the tulips, where the sun shone right above his head. Bauccio loved to play there, rolling in the soft grass.

One day, however, something went wrong. Bauccio got lost! He found himself in a corner of the Flowery Garden that was very different. There were no tulips, there was no patch of grass. It was just tall grass and strange flowers. Bauccio was sad. He wanted to go home.

Then Bauccio decided to do something. He tried to follow the smell of the flowers. He thought the smell would lead him to his favorite patch of grass. But instead, he only arrived in a big rose bush! The roses were beautiful, but they weren't his place.

Just when Bauccio was feeling very desperate, he saw a white rabbit. The rabbit had black eyes and long ears. “Hello!” said the rabbit. “Did you lose something?” asked Bauccio. “Of course, I lost something! I got lost from my tulip patch!”

The rabbit smiled. Then, slowly, he began to guide Bauccio through the garden. They walked together, and the rabbit was very kind. After a while, they saw the tulips! Bauccio jumped happily into his favorite patch of grass. He was so happy to be home. The rabbit said goodbye and ran away. Bauccio thought: “Friendship can always bring you home.”

plan.problema: Barnaby got lost from his favorite meadow among the tulips!
plan.svolta: He tried to follow the scent of the flowers, but he only arrived at a rose bush!
plan.finale: A friendly rabbit gently guided him back to the tulip meadow.

sheep.text:
Bauccio was a very happy woolly lamb. He lived in the Flower Garden, among red roses and tall sunflowers. He loved the garden, he loved the sun, and especially he loved the fluffy clouds that drifted across the blue sky.

---

One day, Bauccio noticed that the clouds weren't there anymore. He was scared! He had lost his favorite cloud, the white and fluffy one that looked like a big cotton ball.

---

Bauccio started to run through the garden, trying to call to the cloud. "Hello, cloud!" Bauccio would shout, but no one could hear him. The wind carried away his words. He was getting sadder and sadder and more worried.

---

A red ladybug, named Lila, saw Bauccio wiggling about. “Bauccio, why are you so down?” Lila asked.

---

“I’m lost from my cloud!” Bauccio replied with a trembling voice. "No one can hear me!"

---

Bauccio thought for a while. Then he had an idea! He focused and started to jump, jumping as high as he could, using his woolly little legs. He jumped up and down, trying to reach the sky.

---

Finally, with a big jump, Bauccio landed among the fluffy clouds. His favorite cloud was there, waiting for him! He was happier than ever. 

---

Bauccio realized that even when things seem difficult, you have to keep trying and never give up. After all, he had arrived just where he wanted to go.

plan.problema: Barnaby got lost from his favorite cloud!
plan.svolta: He tried to call the cloud, but nobody could hear him.
plan.finale: Then he used his little paws to take a big jump and finally returned among the soft clouds.

sheep.text:
Peppino was a teddy bear lamb. He was soft and white like snow. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers. The birds sang and the butterflies flew around him. Peppino loved this garden very much.

---

One day, Peppino was playing among the red and fragrant roses. He was looking for his friend bunny Leo. Leo was always happy and he liked to jump among the flowers. But suddenly, Peppino got lost! The roses were tall and dense, they had swallowed him up. He couldn’t see Leo anymore.

---

He was scared. He huddled under a lavender bush and began to cry. “Leo? Where are you, Leo?” he shouted, but no one answered. The secret garden seemed very big and dangerous without his friend.

---

Peppino decided to do something. He closed his eyes, took a deep breath, and said: “Leo! Leo!” He shouted as loud as he could, with all his strength. He hoped the bunny could hear his voice among so many noises in the garden.

---

After a while, Peppino stopped to listen. He heard a little “hello” coming from a direction. He looked around and saw Leo waiting for him behind a big green leaf. Leo was smiling and hopping happily to see his friend again.

---

Peppino ran to Leo and hugged him tightly. Together, they went back to playing in the secret garden. They remembered that even when you get lost, you have to stay calm and look patiently. And in the end, patience always leads to finding.

plan.problema: Peppino got lost among the roses and couldn't find his friend bunny, Leo.
plan.svolta: He decided to shout as loud as he could, 'Leo! Leo!' hoping the bunny could hear his voice.
plan.finale: After a while, he heard a little 'hello' and saw Leo waiting for him behind a big green leaf.
plan.morale: Patience is important for solving problems.

sheep.text:
Bauccio was a patchwork lamb who was very happy. He lived in the garden of Grandma Rosa. The garden was full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Bauccio loved to be there, watching the butterflies. But more than anything, Bauccio adored his wool. It was soft and white wool, perfect for making cozy nests.

One day, while happily skipping among the flowers, Bauccio found himself in the tall meadow. The meadow was much taller than him! And he realized immediately: he was lost. He was looking for his favorite wool, but he couldn't find it. He was desperate!

Bauccio tried to shout for help, “Hello, can anyone hear me!” He did everything he could, but no one heard him. The wind was blowing strongly and carried away his voices. Bauccio felt a little sad.

Then, he heard a sound. A sweet and refreshing noise: the sound of the stream. Bauccio decided to follow the stream. He moved slowly, following the sound with his little patchwork feet. The stream led him to a pile of soft, fluffy wool. It was his wool!

Bauccio ran towards the wool and skipped happily like never before. He made a big nest and rested. Grandma Rosa, who was watering the plants, smiled seeing Bauccio so happy. 

Bauccio had learned an important thing: sometimes, you have to wait and use good sense to find what you are looking for.

plan.problema: Barnaby got lost in the tall meadow and can’t find his favorite wool anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to shout for help, but nobody could hear him, so he decided to follow the sound of the stream.
plan.finale: The stream brought him right to his pile of soft, fluffy wool, happier than ever!
plan.morale: Patience helps to find the solution.

snake.text:
Serpente was a very special teddy bear. He lived in a secret garden, full of fragrant flowers and lush plants. Every day he loved to slither among the red and yellow roses, playing hide-and-seek with the butterflies.

One afternoon, Serpente got lost. He had gotten trapped between the thorny branches of the roses. He tried to find his mirror, a little heart-shaped mirror that he always held close. But he couldn't find it anymore! He was disoriented and a little scared.

Serpente slithered back and forth, trying to find his way. The roses were so many, all the same, and he felt more and more alone. He decided then to slither under the fragrant lavender bushes. He hoped that a little perfume would help him find his mirror.

There he met a little red ladybug, who was looking at him curiously. The ladybug said to him, "Maybe you should look in new places." Serpente thanked the ladybug and continued to look.

Then, suddenly, he saw something shiny! A drop of water was sparkling on a green leaf. The sun reflected the light on the drop, creating a little mirror. Serpente approached cautiously. He saw his reflection! He smiled very happily.

He had finally found his mirror. He was so happy to have found it. Serpente realized that even when things seem difficult, with a little patience and perseverance, you can always find the solution. And Serpente knew that sometimes, you just have to wait for the right moment to see what awaits you.

plan.problema: The Snake was lost among the roses and couldn't find his mirror.
plan.svolta: He decided to crawl under the lavender bushes, hoping to find a reflected glance.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the reflection of a drop of water on a leaf, he saw his mirror and smiled.

snake.text:
Sarpione was a very special teddy bear snake. He never slept on the sofa or the chair. Sarpione lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of big and small leaves, colorful flowers, and tall trees. He was the king of the leaf wood!

One day, Sarpione was exploring. He wanted to find a particularly shiny leaf to play with. He had gone away from his nest and got lost. The leaves were everywhere! Everything looked the same. Sarpione felt a little scared.

He tried to slither forward, then backward. He tried to turn to the right and to the left. But every time he only discovered new dark corners of the garden. The sun struggled to shine through the leaves, making everything even more confusing. A little snail, Luna, watched him from a distance, but didn't know what to do to help Sarpione.

Sarpione stopped. He took a deep breath and thought. Then, with a quick dart, he moved diagonally! He found a crack between two big stones. He immediately came out of the leaf wood. He saw his brothers and sisters waiting for him. They joined him, happy to see him again.

Sarpione was happy. He had found the right way. Patience, even when there seemed to be no solution, can lead to the desired result.

plan.problema: Sarpione is lost among the leaves and can't find his nest.
plan.svolta: He tried to crawl in every direction, but only discovered new dark corners of the garden!
plan.finale: With a quick flash, he found the exit from the leafy thicket and rejoined his family of snakes.

snake.text:
Serpent was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. His favorite place was right in the center of the garden, next to a stone fountain. One day, Serpent found himself completely alone. He was lost among the red and white roses.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Serpent. “Where is my mirror? I left it here nearby and now I can’t find it.” His mirror was small, sparkly, and he liked it very much because it made him look even more beautiful. He looked under the leaves, under the flowers, but nothing. It was all red around him.

Serpent decided to do something. “I have to move!” he thought. So he began to crawl quickly, trying to follow the sweet smell of honey that came from a little bee. The crawling took him past a lavender bush and near a big geranium.

He continued to crawl, faster and faster, following that smell. Then, suddenly, he saw something shiny under an old tree. It was his mirror! He picked it up with his little paws and looked at it. The reflection made him smile. “I did it!” said Serpent, happier than ever. 

Serpent settled down under the tree, satisfied with his found mirror. He had learned that even when things seem difficult, if you keep looking with determination, you always find the solution.

plan.problema: The snake was lost among the roses and couldn't find his mirror.
plan.svolta: He decided to crawl faster, trying to follow the scent of honey.
plan.finale: Finally, he found the sparkling mirror under an old tree and looked at himself with satisfaction.

snake.text:
Serpent was a very silly plush snake. He loved to play in the secret garden. The garden was full of fragrant roses and colorful flowers. Serpent moved among the bushes, unrolling his body along the leaves.

One day, Serpent had so much fun crawling among the roses. When he realized it, he was completely lost! The secret garden seemed like a maze. Red roses, yellow roses, and pink roses surrounded him from all sides. Serpent couldn’t find his way back to his little house.

Serpent was scared. He curled up, trying to figure out what to do. A little stone gnome, sitting on a rock, looked at him with his little blue eyes. “Don’t worry, Serpent,” said the gnome. “Try to focus.”

Serpent took a deep breath and decided to crawl faster. He followed the tracks of the sun shining through the roses. He clenched his teeth and moved with all his strength. The sunlight guided him, showing him the right direction.

Finally, after so much searching, Serpent saw something familiar: a cozy little house under a big lavender bush. It was his home! Serpent happily crawled towards his shelter. He snuggled among the leaves and felt safe. 

Serpent learned that, even when things seem difficult, if you focus and don’t give up, you always find your way home.

plan.problema: The snake was lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his way home.
plan.svolta: He decided to crawl faster and more focused, following the tracks of the sun.
plan.finale: Finally, the snake saw his cozy little house under a large lavender bush.

snake.text:
Serpentino was a plush snake, emerald green and with sparkling black eyes. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of fragrant roses and colorful flowers. He was the king of the garden, even though he didn’t know it!

One day, Serpentino had ventured far away from his usual spot. He wanted to explore the rose maze, a beautiful and a little bit scary tangle. But when he had finished crawling between the red and pink petals, he realized he didn’t know where he was anymore!

He was lost! The roses all looked the same and the scent made his head spin. Serpentino tried to move forward, then backward, but every time he ended up even more confused. He had tried to crawl along every blade of grass, but only he got even more confused!

A little ladybug, Cecilia, was watching him from a distance. “Serpentino, maybe you should look for a gap,” said Cecilia with her cheerful voice.

Serpentino listened to Cecilia and started to look around. He saw a small opening under a fragrant lavender bush. That was exactly what he needed! With a nice slide, Serpentino found himself outside, near the warm sun. He was happy to be back in his favorite place. 

Serpentino realized that even when things seem difficult, you shouldn’t give up and keep looking. Perseverance always helps you find the right way.

plan.problema: The snake was lost in the maze of roses and couldn’t find his way out.
plan.svolta: He tried to slither along every blade of grass, but only he got more confused!
plan.finale: The snake discovered a small opening under a lavender bush and, with a lovely slide, he returned to the sun.

snake.text:
Smeraldo was a very silly plush snake. He loved to be in the secret garden behind the old house. It was a place full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. Smeraldo loved to slither among the leaves and play with the sun.

---

One day, Smeraldo had gone too far from the red roses. He was lost! The roses were very tall, and Smeraldo couldn’t see where he was going. He couldn’t see his nest, a little cozy place made of moss and dry leaves. He was very worried. “Oh no, oh no!” Smeraldo slithered, trying to find his way back.

---

Smeraldo decided he had to do something quickly. He squeezed his little muscles and started to slither as fast as he could. He smelled a lovely scent: the scent of herbs. He tried to follow the scent, slithering between the basil and mint plants.

---

Suddenly, Smeraldo heard a noise: the sound of the stream running near the garden. The sound guided him! He squeezed his eyes shut and saw a big sunflower. Under the sunflower, there was his little nest. It was perfect!

---

Smeraldo crawled into his warm, soft nest. He felt happy to be back home. The sound of the stream had made all the difference. Smeraldo learned that if you try a little harder, even difficult things can be solved.

plan.problema: Emerald got lost among the roses and couldn't find his nest.
plan.svolta: He decided to crawl faster, trying to follow the scent of the herbs.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the sound of the stream, he found his little nest under a large sunflower.

snake.text:
Serpent was a very special teddy bear. He lived in a secret garden, full of fragrant roses and colorful flowers. Serpent loved to slither among the plants, exploring every corner of his little world.

One day, while he was having fun, Serpent found himself in a strange situation. He had ended up in a maze made of roses! The rose walls were tall and dense, and he couldn't find his way out. “Oh no!” thought Serpent, “I’m lost!”.

He wriggled among the roses, looking for a passage, but every time he found himself facing a red wall. He was frustrated and a little scared. Then, Serpent had an idea! “Maybe if I move faster,” he thought. 

So, Serpent began to slither as fast as he could. He stretched and shortened, trying to pass over the rose walls. With lots of energy, he managed to pass over one wall after another.

Finally, after so much effort, Serpent reached something different: a hidden gate among the plants! It was small and rusty, but it was there. Serpent pushed it with his body and came out of the secret garden. He found himself in a flowery meadow, full of daisies and sunflowers.

Serpent felt happy and proud. He had overcome his difficulty thanks to perseverance. Now he knew that if you really try, you can always find a solution.

plan.problema: The Snake was lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his way out.
plan.svolta: He decided to crawl faster, hoping to pass the rose walls.
plan.finale: He finally managed to reach a hidden gate and emerged into the flowered meadow.

snake.text:
Serpent was a very special teddy bear. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of fragrant roses and colorful flowers. Serpent loved to slither among the plants, but that day he had gotten lost. The garden was a maze! Red roses, white roses, and pink roses surrounded him from all sides. He couldn’t find his way out.

“Oh no!” said Serpent. “I’m lost! I want to go back to my nest of dry leaves.” He tried to slither forward, then backward, but every time he found himself in another corner of the maze. A little blue butterfly, named Stella, flew around him, but she couldn’t help him to find his way.

Serpent thought: “Maybe I should do something different.” So, he made a decision: he started to slither backward. It was a strange movement for a snake, but Serpent did it with determination. He slithered and slithered, following his new direction.

Suddenly, he slid! A little slide rolled him to one side of the maze. And then… there! Serpent came out of the maze right in front of his nest of dry leaves, full of soft, warm feathers. He was so happy! He curled up there, pleased with his adventure. 

Serpent learned that even when things seem difficult, continuing to try can lead to the best solution. Perseverance helped Serpent get home.

plan.problema: The Snake was lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his home.
plan.svolta: He decided to slide backwards, hoping to discover a new path.
plan.finale: Finally, with one last tumble, he came out of the maze right in front of his nest of dry leaves.

snake.text:
Serpent lived in the Secret Garden. He was a teddy bear snake, soft and green, with shiny black eyes. He loved to slither among the flowers and hide under the leaves. One day, Serpent saw a leaf. It was the biggest leaf on the tree, the one that shone in the sun. He wanted to reach it!

Serpent rolled up and started to slither upwards. He moved slowly, but he didn’t give up. The tree was tall and the leaf seemed very far away. Serpent kept pushing with his little plastic feet.

Then, an idea! Serpent rolled himself up, trying to become smaller and more agile to climb the tree more easily. But something went wrong. He got stuck in a rose bush! He was stuck, completely wrapped around the thorns.

Mrs. Rose, an old turtle who lived in the garden, saw Serpent in trouble. “Don’t give up!” she said in a calm voice. Serpent tried hard and, with one last wiggle, he managed to get free from the rose bush.

With a graceful movement, Serpent slithered upwards and reached the highest leaf on the tree. The leaf was cool and fragrant. Serpent felt happy. He smiled with a little smile. He had learned that even if things are difficult, you should never stop trying.

plan.problema: The Snake cannot reach the highest leaf of the tree.
plan.svolta: He rolled himself up, trying to become smaller and more agile, but ended up stuck in a rose bush!
plan.finale: With a final leap, he managed to free himself and, with an elegant movement, reached the highest leaf, celebrating with a small smile.

snake.text:
Serpent was a very curious stuffed snake. He lived in a secret garden full of fragrant roses. It was his favorite place in the whole world! One day, Serpent decided to explore the rose maze that was right in the center of the garden. The roses were so big and colorful, it seemed like a magical place.

Serpent went into the maze, trying to follow the path. But it was complicated! The roses repeated, the paths crossed, and Serpent got lost very quickly. “Oh no!” exclaimed Serpent, “I’m lost!”. He was really worried.

Serpent tried to crawl straight, hoping to find a way out. But every time he tried to go in a straight line, he always ended up trapped between prickly rose bushes. It was frustrating! A little bird, a yellow sparrow, watched him fly and chirped: “Come on Serpent, don’t give up!”.

Serpent thought about what to do. He saw a big flat stone near a bush. He huddled under the stone and started to crawl with all his might. Suddenly, he felt the ground loosen! Serpent pushed with all his strength, and with a great leap, he came out of the tunnel that was under the stone.

He was free! He was out of the rose maze. Serpent rested for a moment, then continued to explore the secret garden, happy with his adventure. Perseverance can lead to overcoming even the most difficult obstacles.

plan.problema: Snake is lost in the rose maze!
plan.svolta: He tried to crawl straight, but only found more bushes!
plan.finale: Snake discovered a tunnel under a stone and, with a bit of momentum, escaped the maze.

stitch.text:
Stitch lived on Treasure Island. He was a little plush robot, always ready for an adventure. Stitch loved making knots on the ropes he found washed up on the beach. He used his favorite thread to tie shells and make little nets.

One day, Stitch noticed a problem. His thread was gone! There was nothing left to use for making knots. He was very frustrated. “Oh no!” said Stitch. “How will I tie the ropes now?”

Stitch looked everywhere. He looked under the rocks, inside the crab holes, but he couldn’t find the thread. He decided to try a new idea. He gathered the biggest shells and used them to tie the ropes. It worked… a little. But it was uncomfortable! The shells were too heavy and the ropes were too stiff.

Then, Stitch saw something in the tall grass: a small piece of bamboo string. It was thin and flexible. He took it and started making perfect knots. Every knot was well-made and secure. Stitch smiled. “There!” he exclaimed. “This is perfect!”

A seagull, who often watched Stitch from above, cawed: “Good job, Stitch!”

Stitch continued to make knots, happy to have found a solution to his problem. He had learned that even when things seem difficult, with a little patience, you always find solutions. Stitch knew that the next knot would be even better than the last one.

plan.problema: She’s lost her favorite string and can’t tie knots anymore!
plan.svolta: She decides to use seashells to tie the ropes, but they’re too big and awkward.
plan.finale: She finds a small piece of bamboo string and makes lots of perfect knots, as happy as always.

stitch.text:
Stitch was a little blue plush toy. He lived on Treasure Island. He was very active and loved to explore the island. One day, Stitch noticed that something wasn't right. All his buttons were missing! They had disappeared somewhere.

Stitch tried to look for them among the rocks and in the reeds. But his buttons were gone. Without his buttons, Stitch couldn't get back to his little house. He was very sad. He didn't know where they had gone.

“Oh no!” said Stitch. “If I don’t find my buttons, I’ll never be able to come home.”

Stitch decided to go to the beach. He saw lots of colorful seashells. They were red, yellow, and green. He thought, "Maybe here I can find something to replace my buttons!" He started to collect the prettiest seashells. 

Suddenly, Stitch found a big, shiny pearl! It was white and bright. Stitch had an idea. Using the pearl, he made a new special button, very beautiful and shiny.

Stitch was happy! With his new button, he felt complete again. He ran home and his little house was waiting for him. Stitch snuggled up warm and smiled. He had learned that even when things seem difficult, if you don’t give up, you always find a solution.

plan.problema: Stitch has lost all his buttons and can’t get home anymore.
plan.svolta: He decides to look among the colorful shells on the beach, hoping to find something to replace his lost buttons.
plan.finale: He finds a large, glittering pearl that he uses to create a new special button and finally goes home happy.

stitch.text:
Stitch was a little alien made of fabric. He lived on a desert island, a place full of tall palm trees and white sand. Stitch loved to play, but especially he loved his red hat with white spots. It was his favorite hat!

---

One day, Stitch noticed that his hat was gone. He looked everywhere: under the palm trees, between the rocks, on the beach. He shouted, “Hat! Hat!” but nobody answered. Stitch was sad. He didn’t want to play anymore.

---

The wind was blowing hard and carrying away dry leaves. Stitch thought the wind had blown his hat away! Then, Stitch decided to do something. He picked up big palm leaves and started to build a little fort. He looked at them carefully, trying to make them fit together well.

---

An old parrot, Pipo, landed on a nearby palm tree. He watched Stitch build his fort with curiosity. “What are you doing, little alien?” asked Pipo. Stitch replied, “I’m waiting for the wind to bring back my hat!”

---

Stitch spent the day in his fort, watching the wind and hoping. The wind kept blowing, but the hat didn’t come back. Stitch gave up and, with a smile, he kept waiting. 

---

At the end of the day, Stitch was still there, calm inside his palm tree fort. He realized that sometimes, to find what you’re missing, you just have to be patient. And so, Stitch waited for the next morning, ready to face a new day on the desert island.

plan.problema: He’s lost his favorite hat and doesn’t know how to get happy again.
plan.svolta: He tried to look everywhere, but the wind blew the hat away to another part of the island!
plan.finale: Then he decided to build a fort with the palm trees to wait for the wind to bring back his hat and find his peace of mind.

stitch.text:
Stitch lived on Treasure Island. He was a strange toy, made of green and brown fabric, with bright yellow eyes. Stitch loved to explore the island, running between the palm trees and jumping on the rocks. One day, however, Stitch noticed a problem: all his buttons were missing! They had vanished into thin air.

Stitch was very sad. Without his buttons, he couldn't get back to his spaceship. The spaceship was ready to leave and Stitch absolutely had to get on board! He had no way to communicate with his planet.

Then Stitch had an idea. He started using his stitches to create little friends. He imagined a little parrot, made only of green fabric. Then he made a brown monkey, just like the monkeys he saw on the island. And he even made a white rabbit, imitating the rabbit that hopped between the plants.

Stitch had so many new friends! The little animals of Treasure Island helped him find his spaceship. The parrot flew in front of the ship, the monkey ran around, and the rabbit hopped to encourage Stitch.

Stitch got on the spaceship and waved goodbye to Treasure Island. He looked back as the ship took off, smiling. He had solved his problem thanks to his imagination and his new friends. Stitch knew that even when things seem difficult, finding a creative way to solve problems can lead to great surprises.

plan.problema: He’s lost all his buttons and can’t get back to his planet!
plan.svolta: He decides to use his stitches to create new little friends, imitating all the animals he meets on the island.
plan.finale: He reaches his spaceship thanks to his new friends and says goodbye to Treasure Island.

stitch.text:
Stitch was a very special toy. He lived on a desert island, full of palm trees and old abandoned boats. Stitch loved to explore the island, but he also had something he loved very much: a small, shiny blue pin. It was his favorite pin!

One day, Stitch noticed that the pin was not in its place. He looked everywhere. He looked under the palm trees, pushed the old boats, and checked inside the wooden boxes. But the pin wasn't there! Stitch was very worried. He didn't know where he had put his pin. It was really frustrating.

“I have to find it!” thought Stitch. Then he had an idea. Stitch had a very special nose, different from the others. He could smell even the weakest smells. “Maybe I can smell the smell of the pin,” he said to himself.

Stitch began to sniff with his nose. He smelled the scent of wood, salt, and leaves. Then, suddenly, he smelled a familiar scent: the scent of his blue pin! He followed the smell and found himself in front of the tallest tree on the island.

And there, hanging on a branch, was his pin! Stitch was so happy. He took it in his hands and smiled. He had found his pin thanks to his perseverance. 

Stitch realized that even when things seem difficult, continuing to look with effort can lead to great results.

plan.problema: Stitch has lost his favorite brooch and can’t find his place.
plan.svolta: After searching under the palm trees and inside the old boats, Stitch decides to use his nose to sniff the scent of the brooch.
plan.finale: Thanks to his special sense of smell, Stitch finds the brooch hanging on the tallest tree on the island!

stitch.text:
Stitch lived on a desert island. He was a soft, purple cloth toy, full of energy and always ready to play. Stitch loved to make little knots with his favorite threads. He used them to create little bunches of knots, which he then tied up again, making an endless circle.

One day, Stitch noticed that his best thread was missing! He looked everywhere: under the palm trees, among the rocks, in the little stream. But the thread was gone. Stitch was very sad. Without that thread, he couldn't make his favorite knots.

Stitch tried to use a piece of his own purple hair to tie knots. It was soft, but too rough! When he tried to make a knot, the hair would fray and the thread wouldn't form well. Stitch was frustrated. He sat down in the sand and thought.

Then, he had an idea! He saw a strong olive branch lying near him. He took the branch with his strong hands and started to work. He cut the branch into thin strips and, with patience, he wove the strips to create a new thread.

After a lot of work, Stitch had created a perfect thread! It was strong and flexible, just what he needed for his knots. He tied a little knot, then another, and another one. Stitch was happy. He had overcome the difficulty with his perseverance. 

Stitch continued to make his knots, satisfied with his new olive thread. The sand of the desert island shone under the sun, while Stitch created new bunches of knots without stopping.

plan.problema: He lost his favorite thread for tying his little knots.
plan.svolta: He tried to use a tuft of his own fur, but it was too rough and the knot didn't form well.
plan.finale: Finally, he found a sturdy olive branch and patiently turned it into a perfect thread for his knots.

stitch.text:
Stitch was a special stuffed owl. He lived on Treasure Island in a little house made of sand and coral. Stitch loved to play among the rocks and watch the sea. But one day, Stitch noticed a big problem! He had lost all his buttons. They had disappeared mysteriously during a game with the wind.

Stitch didn't feel complete anymore. He was an owl without buttons! “Oh no!” he exclaimed, spinning around and taking little sad steps. He wanted to be perfect again like before.

Then Stitch had a brilliant idea. He decided to collect colorful seashells to recreate his buttons. He found red, yellow, blue, and green seashells. He picked them up one by one and started gluing the seashells to his sides.

A little crab named Carlo saw Stitch working. Carlo was very kind and helped Stitch find the prettiest seashells. Together they built little seashell mosaics to decorate Stitch’s house.

Stitch felt happy! He had new seashells and a new friend. He was perfect, not just because he had his buttons, but because he had a real friend. Stitch realized that Treasure Island was even more beautiful when you shared your things with others.

plan.problema: He lost all his buttons and doesn't feel complete anymore!
plan.svolta: He decided to collect new colorful shells to recreate his buttons.
plan.finale: With the shells, Stitch finally felt happy and perfect, finding new friends among the island inhabitants.

stitch.text:
Stitch was a little plush alien, and he lived on Treasure Island. It was a place full of rocks and strange plants, just the way he wanted it to be. Stitch especially loved his secret corner under a big palm tree. That’s where he rested after his adventures.

One day, Stitch noticed a problem. He had lost his compass! Without it, he didn’t know how to find his favorite spot anymore. He turned around, he moved, but everything seemed the same. He was very sad. “Oh no!” said Stitch, “How will I get home?”

Then he had a brilliant idea. Stitch had lots of colorful buttons attached to his body: red, blue, yellow, and green. He started pressing the buttons one at a time, walking slowly. Every time he pressed a button, he marked the path with a little sign in the sand.

An old seagull named Captain, who lived on the island, watched Stitch with curiosity. “What are you doing, little alien?” asked Captain. Stitch replied, “I’m making a map!”

Stitch continued to press the buttons and follow his colorful footprints. After a while, he smelled a familiar scent: his favorite plant! And there, under the palm tree, was his secret corner. Stitch was very happy. He had found a clever solution. 

Stitch settled down on his soft blanket and thought, “It was nice to invent this game!”

plan.problema: He lost his compass and can’t find his favorite corner anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his colorful buttons to mark the path, creating a trail to follow.
plan.finale: Finally, he found his corner, happy and satisfied with his new method.

stitch.text:
Stitch was a little fabric alien, and he lived on Treasure Island. It was his favorite place in the whole world! He had a big trunk full of sparkling jewels, shiny gold coins, and colorful beads. Stitch loved his favorite brooch very much: a small silver star that twinkled when it caught the sunlight.

One day, Stitch noticed that the star was gone! He looked everywhere in the trunk, but he couldn’t find it. He was very sad because he didn’t know where it had gone to hide his special place. “Oh no!” said Stitch, “I can’t find my brooch and I can’t go back to my place!”

Stitch thought for a little while. Then he had an idea! He used his pincers, the ones he used to grab little treasures, and he started to carefully sift through the trunk. Movement after movement, he moved the gold coins, examined the beads, and checked every corner. 

After a while, his pincers stopped on something soft under a huge pile of gold coins. With a little tug, Stitch pulled out his silver star! It was there, hidden right under the sparkle of the coins. 

Stitch ran straight to his trunk and put the brooch back in its special place. He felt happy and content. “I did it!” thought Stitch. Stitch’s patience had helped him to find what he was missing.

plan.problema: She lost her favorite brooch and can’t find her place in the trunk.
plan.svolta: She decides to use her pliers to make a meticulous search among the glittering treasures.
plan.finale: She finds it hidden under a pile of gold coins, happy to return to its place.

stitch.text:
Stitch lived on Happy Island. He was a soft blue toy, with big eyes and a smiling face. Stitch loved to jump, run, and do somersaults. But today, Stitch wasn't smiling. He didn't have his buttons anymore! They had all gone away, one by one. Without his buttons, Stitch couldn't show his smile.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Stitch. “How will I smile?” He sat down on a mossy rock, thinking. A little bird, Tweetie, watched him curiously.

Stitch had an idea! He decided to collect colorful flowers to make new buttons. He found red roses, yellow sunflowers, and purple violets. He started to attach them to his body, but the wind was blowing hard. The flowers fell away, one after another. Stitch felt sad.

Then, he saw an old felt hat abandoned under a tree. “Maybe I can use it!” thought Stitch. He cut pieces from the hat and turned them into new buttons. They were all wobbly and silly, but Stitch didn't care. He attached them to his body and looked in the reflection of a puddle of water.

Stitch was even sillier than before! He smiled at all his new decorations. Tweetie chirped happily. Stitch realized that even when things go wrong, you can always find a way to fix them. And with his creativity, Stitch continued to smile on Happy Island.

plan.problema: Stitch has lost all his buttons and can’t smile anymore!
plan.svolta: He decides to collect colorful flowers to make new buttons, but they blow away in the wind.
plan.finale: He finds an old felt hat and uses it to make new buttons, becoming even sillier!

tartaruga.text:
Tito was a very special turtle. He wasn’t just a plastic toy; he could talk and move! He lived in a secret garden, full of colorful flowers and tall trees. It was his favorite place in the whole world.

One day, Tito was exploring the rose maze. The roses were so fragrant and beautiful! He got carried away with excitement and got lost. He couldn’t find his little house anymore, a small wooden house with a red roof. He was very worried.

“I need to find my little house!” thought Tito. So he decided to crawl faster, hoping to reach the exit of the maze. But the smell of the roses was too strong! Every time he moved, he was drawn to another fragrant flower and got even more lost. He made a big circle!

Suddenly, Tito heard something familiar. He had tied a little bell to his tail when he played with his friends. The bell made a sweet and gentle sound. Tito followed the sound and crawled, crawled, crawled. 

After a while, he saw a wooden house with a red roof! It was his little house! Tito was happy. He curled up under the nearest tree and rested. He had learned that sometimes it’s necessary to slow down and focus to reach your goal.

plan.problema: Tito had gotten lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his little house.
plan.svolta: He decided to crawl faster, but the scent of the roses distracted him and he got lost even more.
plan.finale: Tito found his little house thanks to the sweet sound of the bell he had tied to his tail.

tartaruga.text:
Titto was a very special turtle. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Titto loved sunflower seeds a lot, especially the golden ones. He had a golden seed that he wanted to plant near the red rose, the most beautiful flower in the garden.

One morning, Titto noticed that his favorite seed was gone. He had left it right next to the red rose and now it had disappeared! Titto started looking everywhere: under the leaves, among the yellow flowers, near the lavender bush. But he couldn't find the golden seed.

Titto felt a little sad. He didn’t want to give up on planting his seed. He thought maybe it had fallen somewhere and nobody had seen it. So, he decided to dig a little deeper into the soft ground. He dug with his small legs, making little holes in the green grass.

Finally, after a lot of searching, Titto felt something under the earth! It was his golden seed! He pulled it out with joy and took it near the red rose. Carefully, he dug a small hole and planted the seed. 

A little bunny, a white bunny, was watching him curiously. Titto felt happy. He had found his seed and he had planted it right where he wanted. Titto realized that sometimes you have to be patient and keep looking to get what you want. Patience made all the difference.

plan.problema: Tito the turtle can't find his favorite seed to plant.
plan.svolta: He decided to dig deeper, hoping it had fallen under a bush.
plan.finale: Finally, he found the seed and planted it with joy near the red rose.

tartaruga.text:
Titto was a very special turtle. He wasn't just a plastic toy. Titto could talk and move! He lived in a secret garden, a place full of colorful flowers and lush plants. It was his favorite place.

One day, while sliding among the giant daisies, Titto got lost. The daisies were so big and white that everything looked the same. Titto felt a little scared. “Oh no!” he said, “I’m lost!” He tried to go back, but he was getting more and more into trouble.

Titto decided to try to crawl under a rose bush. The smell of the roses was really sweet! But as he moved, the wind pushed him away, and Titto rolled far, among the green leaves. He was desperate. He didn’t know what to do.

Suddenly, Titto had an idea. His shell was shiny like a pearl. He gathered all his energy and tried to reflect the sunlight. The light shone brightly!

And then, the two little bears who were playing in the secret garden saw something shiny. “Titto!” they shouted happily. They found him right away thanks to his shiny shell. Titto was happy to be back home. 

He settled back among the giant daisies, more careful than before. Perseverance did its magic, and Titto knew that even when he gets lost, there’s always a way to go back.

plan.problema: Tito got lost among the giant daisies!
plan.svolta: He tried to crawl under a rose bush, but only the scent made him roll away!
plan.finale: Thanks to his shiny shell, Tito reflected the sunlight and his bear friends found him right away.

tartaruga.text:
Tito was a wooden turtle. He had a brown shell and blue glass eyes. He lived in the Secret Garden. It was a place full of fragrant roses and colorful flowers. Tito loved his garden, but that morning he had gotten lost.

He had entered the rose maze to play, and now he couldn't find his little house anymore. The little house was small, with red roofs and yellow windows. It was his favorite home! Tito felt a little sad. He turned around and around, but the roses all looked the same.

“I need to do something,” thought Tito. “I can’t just keep going fast!” So, Tito decided to slow down. He made his way along the narrowest path between the roses. He closed his eyes and smelled the air. He was looking for the smell of his little house. He smelled a sweet smell of wood and flowers.

Tito followed the smell, slowly. He walked calmly, concentrating on every step. At one point, he saw something. It was a colorful little house at the corner of the garden! There was also a small red stone next to the door. Tito had left that stone there as a marker for his little house.

Tito was happy! He had found his home. He settled down on his little rug and rested a little. It had been a long journey, but with patience, he had found the right way. Tito knew that sometimes, when you are patient, you can always solve your problems.

plan.problema: Tito had gotten lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his little house.
plan.svolta: He decided to take a slower turn, following the narrowest path and sniffing the air to see if he could smell the scent of his home.
plan.finale: Finally, Tito saw his colorful little house at the corner of the garden, where he had left a small stone as a marker.

tartaruga.text:
Tizio was a very special turtle. He didn’t just stay on a table or be held in someone’s hand. Tizio lived in the Secret Garden. He was a little brown turtle with black little eyes and a small smile on his shell.

One day, Tizio got lost. The garden was full of roses, lots and lots of red, pink, and white roses that made a real maze. Tizio wanted to go back to his happy little house, a small wooden house with a red roof. But he couldn’t find it! Everything looked the same, all the roses confused him.

Tizio turned around, he moved forward and backward, but every time he ended up in a different place in the maze. “Oh no,” said Tizio, “I’m lost!”

Then Tizio decided to follow the brightest path. It was a ray of sunshine shining through the roses. But after a few steps, he found himself in a dead end. There was no way out, just roses and roses. Tizio was very sad.

Suddenly, a white butterfly flew towards him. The butterfly, who was called Luna, smiled at Tizio. “I’ll help you,” said Luna. “Follow my flight!” And Luna led him through a hidden path among the roses.

Finally, Tizio saw his happy little house! It was right there, next to the pond with the water lilies. Tizio was happy and thanked Luna for her help. From that day on, Tizio learned that even when you are lost, you have to keep looking and never give up. Tizio knew that with a little patience, every road leads to its destination.

plan.problema: Tom got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his little house.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the brightest path, but he found himself in a dead end.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a friendly butterfly, Tom finally found the way to return to his smiling little house.

tartaruga.text:
Toby was a wooden turtle. He had a brown shell and blue glass eyes. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of fragrant flowers and tall trees. Toby loved to explore the garden, but sometimes he got lost among the big leaves.

---

One day, Toby was chasing a yellow butterfly when he found himself surrounded by green leaves. The leaves were everywhere! Toby couldn't see where he had been put. He was lost! He didn't know how to get back to his place near the stone fountain.

---

Toby tried to crawl under every bush. He climbed every rock. But under every bush there was only grass and earth. Toby was very sad. “I can’t find my way,” he thought, with his little legs moving frantically.

---

A little bird, Pipette, was watching him from a branch. “Maybe you should look up,” chirped Pipette. Toby raised his head and saw a ray of sunshine shining between the leaves. The ray of sunshine lit a small path made of white stones.

---

Toby began to crawl along the path, following the ray of sunshine. The path was narrow and winding, but Toby didn’t give up. Finally, the path led him right next to the stone fountain! Toby was happy. He was home. Toby settled down on his place, content and satisfied with his little journey. Perseverance can help even a little turtle find its way.

plan.problema: Toby got lost among the leaves and couldn't find his way back.
plan.svolta: He tried to crawl under every bush, but only grass and dirt awaited him.
plan.finale: A ray of sunshine illuminated a small path made of stones, guiding him home.

tartaruga.text:
Titto the turtle was a little tired. He was in the Secret Garden and he loved that place very much. There were colorful flowers, butterflies flying, and lots of little insects. But today Titto couldn’t find his home. The grass was very tall, green, and soft, and Titto felt lost.

Titto tried to crawl under the leaves, but the grass always blocked him. He didn’t understand where his little hiding place was, the one between the fragrant violets. He was frustrated! He turned this way, then that way, trying to figure out what to do.

Suddenly, Titto had an idea. He saw a big red mushroom with white spots. “Maybe I can see better from here!” he thought. So, with all his little legs, he started to climb the mushroom. It was tiring, but Titto didn’t give up.

From the bottom of the mushroom, Titto saw a little squirrel collecting nuts. “Hey you!” shouted Titto. The squirrel, named Pipì, listened carefully. Then, he pointed with his paw: “Look among the violets! There’s a little hole, that’s where you live!”.

Titto ran quickly and, finally, he found his little hiding place between the violets. It was just like he remembered! He felt happy and pleased to be back home. Titto settled down on his favorite stone and closed his eyes for a while. Patience had helped Titto find his way.

plan.problema: Tito can't find his house under the tall grass.
plan.svolta: He decides to climb a big mushroom for a better view.
plan.finale: Finally, with the help of a little squirrel, he finds his sheltered corner among the violets.

tartaruga.text:
Titto was a special turtle. He could talk and he could move! He lived in a secret garden full of fragrant flowers. There were giant marigolds, so big that Titto felt small. One day, Titto wanted to explore the garden. He went towards the most beautiful marigolds and… he got lost!

He was surrounded by colorful petals, pink, yellow, and white. He couldn’t find his way out. Titto tried to crawl faster, but the petals trapped him. Every time he tried to move, he got tangled and became even more confused. “Oh no!” thought Titto. “I’m really lost!”

Suddenly, he heard a rustling among the leaves. It was Leo, a lively squirrel. Leo had seen Titto in trouble. “Titto! What are you doing here?” asked Leo. Titto explained that he had gotten lost among the giant marigolds and couldn’t find his way back.

Leo thought for a moment. Then, he pointed to a small hidden path under the root of a big tree. “Follow this path,” said Leo, “you’ll get back to your wooden house!” Titto crawled quickly along the path and in a little while he found his wooden house again. He was happy! He thanked Leo for helping him. 

Titto realized that sometimes, even when things seem difficult, having a friend can make all the difference. Titto went back to live in his secret garden, always knowing that friendship is the most precious treasure.

plan.problema: Tito the turtle is lost among the giant daisies!
plan.svolta: He tried to crawl faster, but only got stuck in the colorful petals.
plan.finale: Thanks to his squirrel friend, Tito found a secret path to return to the wooden house.

tartaruga.text:
Titto was a wooden turtle, a little bit wobbly but very happy. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of fragrant flowers and tall trees. Every day, Titto loved to sit on the stone bench, right next to the big bush of red roses.

---

One afternoon, while the sun shone brightly in the sky, Titto had let the wind carry him away. The roses had attracted him with their scents, and in a moment, he was lost! He was surrounded by soft petals and fresh leaves, but he couldn’t find his bench.

---

Titto was disoriented. He looked around, but everything seemed the same. The roses were so big and tall that they were hiding him. “Oh no!” thought Titto. “I’m lost!”

---

He decided to crawl under every emerald green leaf. He began to move slowly, looking for a clue to get back. He slid between the flowers, climbed up small bushes, and always turned back into the maze of leaves. A little squirrel, Leo, watched him curiously.

---

Then, suddenly, Titto felt the warmth of the sun on his shell. The sun shone brightly, and following its light, Titto moved quickly towards a specific point. And there, right in front of him, was his stone bench!

---

Titto rested happily, satisfied with his little journey. Patience had helped Titto find his place.

plan.problema: Tito got lost among the roses and couldn't find his place on the bench.
plan.svolta: He decided to crawl under every leaf, hoping to find a clue to get back.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the sun that guided him, Tito found his bench and rested happily.
plan.morale: Patience helps to find the solution.

tartaruga.text:
Titto was a blue plastic turtle. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of flowers and tall grass. Titto loved his secret garden very much. Every day he enjoyed rolling amongst the daisies, but sometimes he got lost.

---

One afternoon, while he was playing, Titto found himself surrounded by a sea of white daisies. There were so many that he couldn’t see his toy box anymore! He was lost, right in the middle of the secret garden. “Oh no!” said Titto, with his squeaky voice. “I can’t find my place!”

---

Titto decided to do something. He saw a little stream running between the plants. He thought, “Maybe the stream will take me back!” So he started rolling towards the stream, pushed by the gentle wind. The stream was full of clear water and gurgled softly.

---

Suddenly, a yellow butterfly landed near Titto. The butterfly flew forward, right towards the toy box! Titto rolled quickly behind it. And there, next to the toy box, were his friends: a teddy bear and a rabbit.

---

“Titto!” they shouted all together, happy to see him. Titto curled up happily next to his friends. The butterfly flew away, but its presence had been important. Titto realized that even when things seem difficult, you have to keep trying your best. Sometimes all it takes is a little help to find the right way.

plan.problema: Tito got lost among the daisies and couldn't find his place in the toy box.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the stream running through the garden, hoping it would lead him back.
plan.finale: Finally, a butterfly brought him right next to the toy box, where his friends were waiting anxiously.

tigre.text:
Tigro was a teddy bear tiger. He lived in a secret garden full of fragrant roses. Tigro loved to play among the roses, but today he felt a little sad. He couldn’t find his friends, the butterflies. The butterflies always flew too quickly!

“Where are you?” thought Tigro. He looked among the big red and pink buds. “Butterflys, are you here?” he called, but he didn’t hear an answer. The butterflies were hiding well among the roses, it was difficult to see them. Tigro was a little frustrated.

Tigro decided to change his strategy. He realized that maybe the problem was his hurry. “Maybe I should take a slower walk,” he thought. So, he sat down on a green leaf and began to gently sniff every flower. He was looking for the sweet scent of the butterflies.

The smell was leading him! A special scent led Tigro to a large white rose bush. And there they were! The butterflies were sitting on a colorful gem, sparkling in the sun. Tigro ran towards them and the butterflies flew away happily.

Tigro and the butterflies took a lovely walk in the secret garden, laughing and playing together. Tigro realized that when you take the time to observe, even the most difficult problems can be solved. Patience made the difference on this special day.

plan.problema: The Tiger couldn't find his butterfly friends among the roses.
