plan.svolta: He decided to take a slower turn, gently sniffing each flower to follow their sweet scent.
plan.finale: Finally, the Tiger found the butterflies that had settled on a colorful gem, and together they took a lovely tour of the garden.

tigre.text:
Tigger the teddy tiger was a little bit sad. He lived in the Flower Garden, among the red roses and tall sunflowers. Tigger loved the garden, but that evening he couldn’t sleep. He had lost his favorite rattle, small and golden. The sound of the rattle always made him fall asleep.

Tigger looked around. “I must find it!” he said. He started to look everywhere. First, he looked under the fragrant roses, but the smell was so strong that he couldn’t hear the little sound of the rattle. He looked among the yellow tulips and blue violets, but nothing.

“Maybe it fell here,” thought Tigger, pointing to the flower basket full of dry leaves. It was a big basket, used by the gardener to collect fallen petals. “I’ll look inside there!”

Tigger climbed into the basket and started to rummage through the leaves. Suddenly, he heard a light sound: “tinkle, tinkle!”. The rattle was right there, hidden under a leaf! It had rolled down during the barbecue with his toy friends.

The little tiger picked up his rattle and hugged it tightly. The tinkling calmed him down immediately. He lay down on the green lawn of the Flower Garden, next to a fragrant red rose, and closed his eyes. 

Tigger fell asleep soon, happy to have his rattle nearby. And so, he learned that waiting patiently could lead to finding what he was looking for. The Flower Garden was a wonderful place to sleep, especially when you had a little golden friend.

plan.problema: Tiger has lost his favorite rattle and can't sleep.
plan.svolta: He tried to look under the roses, but it was too fragrant to find the little sound!
plan.finale: Then he discovered the rattle was hidden in the flower basket, where it had rolled during a picnic with the other toys.

tigre.text:
Tigger the teddy tiger was happy in the Flower Garden. He loved to run among the yellow tulips and the red roses. He had a favorite little red ball, soft and cuddly. He always kept it with him.

One day, Tigger was playing near the lavender bush. When he stood up for another run, his ball was gone! “Oh no!” exclaimed Tigger. He looked everywhere under the wisteria vines and among the white lily petals. But the ball was missing.

Tigger was a little upset. He turned and turned, checking every corner of the garden. It was a big mess! The butterflies fluttered around him, but Tigger didn’t notice them. He had to find his ball.

Suddenly, Tigger had an idea. “Wait!” he said. He focused. His red ball had a special smell, a little bit of rubber and a pinch of fresh flowers. Tigger began to follow the smell, sniffing carefully.

The smell led him to the big cherry tree, the tallest in the garden. Tigger crouched among the leaves. And there, hidden among the dry leaves, was his red ball!

Tigger jumped happily and took his ball. He was so happy to have found it. A little blue butterfly landed on Tigger’s head.

Tigger learned that even when things seem lost, with a little patience and the right method, everything can be put right again. And this made him understand how important it is never to give up.

plan.problema: The tiger lost his favorite ball among the colorful flowers.
plan.svolta: After searching under every flower, the tiger decided to use his sense of smell to track the scent of the ball.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to his good nose, he found the ball hidden among the leaves of the big cherry tree.

tigre.text:
Leo the tiger was happy in his secret garden. The garden was full of colorful flowers and big plants. Leo loved to be there, watching the bees buzz and the birds sing. But that day Leo felt lonely. There were no other tigers to play with.

“I miss having friends,” thought Leo. “I would love to see the butterflies that sometimes fly here.” The butterflies were beautiful and colorful, he loved watching them flutter among the flowers. But he couldn’t find them. It was all quiet and empty.

Leo sat down on a bush of red roses. Then he had an idea! “Maybe if I take a big jump, the butterflies see me!” he thought. So Leo jumped forward, among the fragrant flowers. He gripped his paws tightly and made his loudest screech: “Uuuuuhhh… Uuuuuuuhhh…”

Suddenly, a little sparkle caught his attention. A yellow butterfly was coming towards Leo! Then other butterflies arrived: one blue, one white, and one purple. The butterflies flew around Leo, touching his soft fur with their light wings.

Leo played with the butterflies all afternoon. They jumped together, screeched, and fluttered among the flowers. He was happy to have so many new friends. He realized that sometimes, when you do something unexpected, you find wonderful surprises. Leo and the butterflies knew that the best thing is to share a day full of play.

plan.problema: Leo couldn't find his butterfly friends and he felt lonely.
plan.svolta: He decided to make a big jump between the flowers, hoping to attract their attention with his chirping.
plan.finale: The butterflies, curious about the sound, flew to him to play together all afternoon.
plan.morale: Friendship is found by playing and sharing.

tigre.text:
Tigger the teddy tiger was a little bit sad. He lived in the secret garden, a place full of colorful flowers and big plants. Tigger loved his garden, but that evening he couldn't sleep. He didn't have his favorite rattle, the one made of red bells that made "tinkle, tinkle" when he shook it.

Tigger tried to make little purrs, to count the stars and even to watch the butterflies. But nothing helped! The rattle was gone. He was very angry. "I have to find it!" thought Tigger.

He decided to look for the rattle under every flower in the garden. He went to the white lily, then the yellow tulip and the red rose. But it was too big to see well what was under the flowers. Tigger curled up and looked carefully, but he couldn't find his rattle.

A little squirrel, Pip, saw him looking. "I saw you hanging it on the tree!" said Pip. Tigger ran to the biggest tree in the garden and... there it was! His favorite rattle was hanging on the branch. 

Tigger took it between his paws and shook it. “Tinkle, tinkle!” the rattle made a happy sound. Tigger felt tired right away and closed his eyes. The tinkling was gently rocking him to sleep. 

Finally, Tigger was sleeping peacefully in the secret garden. He had been patient and in the end he had found what he was looking for. And he knew that sometimes, waiting a little longer can bring a great joy.

plan.problema: Tiger has lost his favorite rattle and can’t sleep.
plan.svolta: He decided to look for the rattle under every flower in the garden, but it was too big to see well.
plan.finale: Finally, he found it hanging on the tree, and its tinkling put him to sleep immediately.

tigre.text:
Tigger was a teddy bear tiger. He lived in the secret garden.
The secret garden had lots of big and small flowers, tall trees, and green bushes.
Tigger loved his garden very much.
His favorite scarf was a special scarf.
It was made of colorful feathers, pink, blue, and yellow.
Tigger always wore it when he played.

One day, Tigger noticed that the scarf was gone. “Oh no!” said Tigger.
“Where did my scarf go?” He felt very sad.
He looked first under the big sunflower.
Then he checked between the leaves of an apple tree.
Tigger looked everywhere.

He started to look patiently, but the scarf wasn’t there yet!
Tigger was a little discouraged.
He sat down on a smooth stone and waited.
Suddenly, he heard a light sigh.
Tigger turned around and saw a red ladybug moving near him.
And what was attached to the ladybug’s neck?
His colorful feather scarf!

The ladybug had simply chosen to wear the scarf as an accessory.
Tigger thanked the ladybug and got his scarf back.
Tigger was happy.
Now he could go back to playing in the secret garden with his favorite scarf.
It was important to be patient when you’re looking for something, because unexpected solutions can appear.

plan.problema: Tiger had lost his favorite scarf, the one made of colorful feathers.
plan.svolta: He started to look under every flower and between the leaves, but the scarf was gone!
plan.finale: Suddenly, he heard a sigh and found the scarf hanging from the neck of a ladybug.

tigre.text:
Tigro was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and sweet smells. It was a special garden, just for him. Tigro loved to play among the red roses and yellow tulips. He had a favorite paw, his right one, with a small white spot. He loved it because he used it to make little purrs.

One day, Tigro noticed something. “Oh no!” he exclaimed. “My right paw is gone!” He looked everywhere in the secret garden. He looked between the white lilies and the orange daffodils. But the paw wasn’t there. It was gone! Tigro felt very sad.

He tried to look under every flower, but he was too small to see well. The petals of the irises were as tall as him. “I don’t find anything,” he said with a sigh. He sat down on a smooth stone and began to wiggle. 

Suddenly, he heard a buzzing. A little gentle bee landed on his nose. “I’m helping you,” said the bee. “Look under the big sunflower!” Tigro followed the bee and… there it was! His right paw, hidden under the warm sunshine of the giant sunflower.

Tigro jumped for joy and took his paw. He was happy to have found it. The bee smiled and flew away. Tigro sat down on the stone, happy and relaxed. It was important never to give up, even when things seem difficult to find.

plan.problema: The tiger had lost his favorite paw among the flowers!
plan.svolta: He tried to look under every flower, but he was too small to see well.
plan.finale: A kind bee led him to the hidden paw under a big sunflower!

tigre.text:
Tigro was a very happy teddy bear. He lived in the secret garden, a place full of flowers and tall trees. Tigro loved to run among the plants, but he also had a favorite thing: a red ball, a balloon that looked just like a big ball.

One day, Tigro looked for his red ball, but it wasn't there! He looked everywhere, under the trees and near the blackberry bush, but he couldn't see the ball. Tigro was very sad. He didn't want to play without his favorite ball.

Tigro decided to ask for help. He saw some white butterflies flying around a big sunflower. “Butterflies, butterflies,” said Tigro, “I’ve lost my red ball! Can you help me?”

The butterflies, with their colorful wings, replied: “We will fly high and look for it!” And they did. They flew over the meadow, over the little pond, and then they landed near the fragrant rose bush. 

“Look here, Tigro,” whispered a white butterfly. Under the rose bush, right among the red petals, was the red ball! Tigro ran to grab his ball right away.

Tigro thanked the butterflies for helping him. He was happy to have his ball back. He went back to running in the secret garden, knowing that asking for help can lead to big surprises.

plan.problema: The tiger couldn't find his favorite ball, a red balloon.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the butterflies flying around the big sunflower.
plan.finale: The butterflies led him to the hidden ball under a fragrant rose bush.
plan.morale: Asking for help is always a good idea.

tigre.text:
Leo the tiger was a little tired. He was in the Secret Garden and didn’t want to play anymore. The garden was full of fragrant roses, but Leo had gotten lost. The roses were so many, all the same, that they formed a maze. Leo couldn’t find his favorite corner, the one under the big tree where the sunlight made him doze off.

He turned and turned, but the roses seemed to get more and more numerous. “Oh no!” said Leo. “I’m really lost!” He tried to remember how he had gotten there, but he couldn’t understand what he had done. He was frustrated.

Then, Leo had an idea. He saw that one part of the path was much brighter than the others. He decided to follow the brighter path. He hoped it would take him out of the flowery forest and help him find his place. 

He walked for a while, passing between the roses, always following the light. At one point, he stopped. There it was! Finally, Leo found his secret corner under a big apple tree, full of colorful leaves that shimmered in the sunlight. It was just like he remembered.

A white butterfly flew around Leo and gently placed one of its paws on his head. Then it flew away. Leo curled up under the tree, happy and content. 

It was nice to find what you were looking for, even if it took a little while to do so.

plan.problema: Leo got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his favorite corner.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the brightest path, hoping it would lead him out of the flowered forest.
plan.finale: Finally, Leo found his secret corner under a large apple tree, full of colorful leaves.

tigre.text:
Tigro was a very special teddy bear. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and lush plants. Tigro loved to play among the roses and under the tall trees. One day, Tigro noticed a big problem. His shiny sapphires were gone! They were little blue twins that he had received as a gift.

Tigro began to look everywhere. He looked behind the lavender bush, under the fountain, and even inside the vase with the bellflowers. But none of his sapphires were anywhere. “Oh no!” said Tigro, upset. “Where had they gone?”

Then he had an idea. He decided to look among the white daisies, which grew in a small area of the garden. The daisies were beautiful and smelled nice. But the sapphires were too small to hide inside their petals. Tigro got a little tired, but he didn’t give up.

Finally, while exploring near a fern bush, he heard something under a green leaf. He pulled out the sapphires! They were there, hidden right under the fern leaf. Tigro picked them up carefully and took them to his golden drawer, where he put them back in their place. Everything was perfect again.

Tigro lay on the lawn, happy. He had learned that even when things seem difficult, looking patiently and carefully can lead to finding what we have lost.

plan.problema: The tiger has lost all his shiny sapphires!
plan.svolta: He decided to look among the daisies, but they were too small to hide the precious jewels.
plan.finale: The tiger found the sapphires hidden under a fern leaf and returned them to his golden drawer.

ucello.text:
Uccello was a cloth bird. A blue bird, with soft wings and black button eyes. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of fragrant flowers and tall trees. Uccello loved to fly among the lilies and chirp happily.

One day, Uccello had too much fun chasing a yellow butterfly. When he realized he was lost, the Secret Garden seemed like a maze. Red roses, white roses, pink roses… they all looked the same! Uccello couldn’t find his little wooden house with the red roof anymore. He was very scared.

Uccello thought he had to do something. He decided to sing a happy song. “Tweet, tweet, fly away, I want to go back to my little house, there!” Uccello chirped loudly. The flowers around him seemed to move slightly.

Suddenly, a small, smiling gnome popped out from behind a big rose. He had a red hat and a kind smile. “Are you looking for your little house?” asked the gnome. Uccello nodded vigorously. “Follow the path of daisies,” said the gnome, pointing with his hand.

Uccello followed the path of daisies and, in just a few minutes, he saw his little wooden house with the red roof. He was so happy! He ran inside and rested a little. Uccello realized that singing a happy song had made all the difference. 

Uccello was happy to be back home. Kindness, even that of a little bird, can help to overcome difficulties.

plan.problema: The little bird got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find its nest.
plan.svolta: It decided to sing a happy song to attract the flowers' attention and ask for help.
plan.finale: A small, smiling gnome showed him the right path, and the little bird returned happily to its nest.

ucello.text:
Uccello was a little cloth bird, soft and colorful. He lived in a secret garden full of fragrant roses. The roses were tall and red, some white, others pale pink. Uccello loved to fly among the branches, watching the bees buzzing around the flowers.

 

One day, Uccello had too much fun chasing a yellow butterfly. The butterfly took him to the heart of the secret garden, to a place full of roses. When Uccello tried to go back, he realized he was lost. The maze of roses was enormous and everything looked the same! He couldn’t find his nest anymore.

 

Uccello was sad and a little scared. He sat down on a red rose and began to cry. “Oh no, oh no!” Uccello exclaimed. “I don’t know how to get home!”

 

Then Uccello took a deep breath and decided to do something. He remembered his happiest song, the one he sang when he was happy. Uccello began to sing: “Tweet, tweet, light flight, towards the sun, towards the sky!”

 

The sound of Uccello’s voice spread through the secret garden. A Mama Uccello, who had followed the singing, found him among the roses. Mama Uccello ran to him and hugged him happily. Then she offered him a clean feather to wipe away his tears.

 

Uccello was so happy to be back home. He snuggled up to Mama Uccello and realized that even when you get lost, if you are patient and keep looking, you always find your way back happily.

plan.problema: The little bird got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find its nest anymore.
plan.svolta: It decided to sing its happiest song, hoping the sound would guide it home.
plan.finale: The singing reached Mama Bird, who welcomed it with a happy hug and a clean feather.

ucello.text:
Ucello lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees.
She was a cloth bird, soft and blue, with big button eyes.
Ucello loved to fly among the rose bushes and play with the butterflies.
But one day, Ucello noticed a problem.
She had lost her most beautiful feather, the one that shimmered like the summer sky.

Without that feather, Ucello couldn't fly well.
She jumped little, had trouble getting up from the ground, and felt sad.
“Oh no!” thought Ucello. “How will I learn to fly again?”

She decided to ask for help from the old gnome who lived under a big apple tree.
The gnome was wise and kind.
“Ucello,” said the gnome, “sometimes our energy gets lost.
Try to sing a happy song, maybe you’ll find your joy!”

Ucello followed the gnome’s advice.
She closed her eyes and began to sing with all her might.
She sang of flowers, of the sun, of a gentle breeze.
While she sang, Ucello felt a light touch beneath her.
She opened her eyes and there, next to her blue feather, was her shimmering feather!

Ucello smiled.
She took her feather and took off into flight.
She flew higher than ever, dancing among the flowers of the secret garden.
Ucello realized that even when there are problems, a little bit of joy can make a difference.
And Ucello flew happily, happier and happier.

plan.problema: The bird had lost her prettiest feather and couldn't fly well.
plan.svolta: She decided to ask for help from the old gnome in the garden, who suggested she sing a happy song to find her energy.
plan.finale: Singing with all her might, the bird found her feather and flew higher than ever before.

ucello.text:
Uccello was a very silly cloth bird. He lived in a secret garden, full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. Uccello loved to fly, but lately he couldn’t do it very well. He had lost his most beautiful feather, the one blue with silvery streaks. Without it, his flight was wobbly and unbalanced.

Uccello felt sad. He looked everywhere: under the rose bushes, among the leaves of the big apple tree. Nothing! The feather wasn’t there. “Oh no!” said Uccello, frustrated. “If I don’t find my feather, I won’t be able to fly well anymore.”

A little squirrel, Leo, saw him sitting on the ground. “What’s wrong, Uccello?” asked Leo curiously. Uccello explained his problem to him. Leo suggested looking among the daisies, because maybe the feather had hidden among their white petals. Uccello ran to the daisies and began to dig with his little cloth feet. But he only found himself covered in dust! It was a difficult situation.

Uccello thought, thought, thought. Then he had a brilliant idea. He collected small stones and began to build a little ramp next to a lavender bush. With patience, Uccello built the ramp, making sure it was smooth enough for him to slide forward quickly.

Uccello climbed onto the ramp and, with a little flap of his wings, he took off into the air! He flew high, fast, and perfectly. The blue feather was still in place. Uccello smiled happily. He had solved the problem thanks to his perseverance. Determination can help you achieve your goals, even the smallest ones.

plan.problema: The bird had lost her most beautiful feather and couldn't fly well.
plan.svolta: She decides to look among the daisies, but she only got covered in dust!
plan.finale: She solves the problem by building a small ramp with stones to take a perfect flight.

ucello.text:
Uccello was a cloth bird, colored blue and yellow. He lived in a secret garden full of fragrant roses. It was a beautiful place, but also a little complicated. Uccello loved to fly among the flowers, flap his wings, and watch the butterflies.

One day, while he was playing, Uccello found himself trapped in a maze of roses. The roses were so big and so fragrant that Uccello couldn’t find his way out. He turned around and around, looked to the right and to the left, but every time he found only more roses. He was very sad.

Uccello felt lost. He didn’t know what to do. Then he had an idea: “If he flies around the biggest rose,” thought Uccello, “maybe he will see something different of the maze.” So, Uccello began to fly in a circle around the biggest red rose in the garden.

The wind was blowing lightly through the trees’ leaves. Uccello felt a push and he found himself turning faster and faster. The wind carried him among the branches, made him dance with the green leaves. And suddenly, Uccello saw a small open space! It was the exit of the maze.

Uccello landed happily on the wooden bench near the entrance. He rested a little, then he was ready to fly back into the secret garden. Uccello understood that even when things seem difficult, with a little courage and perseverance, you can always find the right way.

plan.problema: The bird is lost in the maze of roses and cannot find his way out.
plan.svolta: He decided to fly around the biggest rose, hoping to see a different part of the maze.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the wind that pushed him through the leaves, the bird found the exit and landed happily on the bench.

ucello.text:
Uccello was a cloth bird blue. He lived in a secret garden full of fragrant roses. The roses were big and red and some were white and delicate. Uccello loved to fly among the roses, but that day he had gotten lost.

He had gotten too close to a particularly beautiful rose, and when he tried to move away, he couldn't find his nest anymore. The nest was small and cozy, hidden among the green leaves near the big apple tree. Uccello was very worried.

He looked around, but everything seemed the same: red roses, white roses, green leaves. He couldn't recognize anything. He started to cry, a little cloth blue cry.

Then Uccello made a decision. He decided to sing the loudest song he knew. He closed his eyes and started to chirp: “Chirp-chirp-chirp! Chirp-chirp-chirp!” His voice was a little shaky at first, then it became stronger and stronger.

Suddenly, a little red ladybug with black spots stopped to look at him. The ladybug had shiny antennae that sparkled in the sun. It pointed its antennae upwards and made a little movement with its head.

Uccello followed the direction indicated by the ladybug, and after a few steps, he saw his nest! It was right there, among the green leaves near the apple tree. Uccello was so happy.

The ladybug walked away smiling. Uccello understood that even when you get lost, you must never give up and keep looking. Perseverance can lead to the solution of any problem.

plan.problema: The bird is lost among the roses and can’t find its nest anymore.
plan.svolta: It decided to sing the loudest song it knew, hoping that its voice would guide it home.
plan.finale: The song attracted the attention of a ladybug who pointed the way with its shiny antennae.

ucello.text:
Ucello lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers.
He was a soft cloth bird, blue like the summer sky.
Ucello loved to fly high, above the roses and sunflowers.
But one morning, Ucello noticed a problem.
He had lost his favorite feather, the white and fluffy one that gave him more strength to fly in the air.

Ucello tried to push with his wings, but he couldn't fly very high anymore.
He was sad and disappointed. “Oh no!” exclaimed Ucello, “If I don’t have my feather, I can’t fly well!”
He looked everywhere: under the lavender bush, among the maple leaves, but nothing.

Then, Ucello had an idea. He went to a group of daisies, big and sunny. “Maybe my feather fell here!” he thought.
But the daisies were too small to hold such a big feather.
Ucello tried to look for it among them, but without success.

Then, Ucello saw a beautiful hibiscus flower, red and fragrant.
He approached carefully and, looking closely, noticed something white stuck between the petals.
It was his feather! Ucello tried a little and finally managed to free it.

Ucello raised his wings and flew high again, higher than ever.
He was happy and grateful. The breeze tickled his feathers as he smiled.
Ucello realized that even if he sometimes got angry, with a little patience he could always find the solution to his problem.
He flew around the secret garden, happy with his regained freedom.

plan.problema: The bird had lost her favorite feather and couldn't fly high anymore.
plan.svolta: She decided to look among the daisies, but they were all too small to hold such a big feather.
plan.finale: She found the feather stuck in the hibiscus flower and flew away with joy.

ucello.text:
Little Bird lived in a secret garden. She was a cloth bird, soft and colorful. Little Bird loved to fly among the flowers. She had so many beautiful feathers, but one was special: her brightest feather. The feather sparkled in the sun and allowed her to fly very high.

One day, Little Bird noticed that she couldn’t fly anymore. She was sad. Her brightest feather was gone! Little Bird looked everywhere: under the lavender bush, among the red roses, but the feather wasn’t there.

She decided to use her beak to look. She started to search among the white daisies. She only found a little bit of yellow pollen! The pollen was fun to touch, but it didn’t find her feather. Little Bird felt even sadder.

She continued to look, concentrating. Little Bird was about to look among the roses, when suddenly she heard something light under a fragrant rose bush. It was her feather! The feather sparkled just like before.

Little Bird spread her wings and flew up right away. She flew higher than ever! The wind tickled her feathers. Little Bird was happy. She had found her feather thanks to her determination.

It was a beautiful day in the secret garden. Little Bird understood that even when things seem difficult, you shouldn’t give up.

plan.problema: The bird had lost its brightest feather and could no longer fly high.
plan.svolta: It decided to use its beak to search among the daisies, but it only found pollen!
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to its determination, it found the shimmering feather under a rose bush and could fly again.

ucello.text:
Uccello was a cloth bird who was very happy. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Uccello loved to sing, but one day he noticed that he couldn't do it anymore. His voice had disappeared! He was sad because he didn't want to play anymore.

Uccello tried to shriek, but all that came out was a little sigh. He tried to move his wings, but he couldn't fly with the same enthusiasm. He sat on a rose bush and he felt very lonely. A crocodile named Tito, who lived in the pond of the secret garden, told him: "Maybe you need to look for something!"

Uccello decided to explore the secret garden. He walked among the flowers, looked under the leaves, and searched for clues. He saw a blue butterfly, a slow snail, and a curious rabbit. But he didn't find anything that could help him sing.

Then, right in the center of the garden, Uccello saw a special flower. It was a yellow flower with soft, fragrant petals. Uccello approached and, with his little beak, gently touched the flower. Immediately, a melodious voice filled the secret garden. Uccello could sing again!

He was so happy that he flew in circles, singing a cheerful song. Tito the crocodile was smiling. Uccello realized that with a little effort and courage, you can always find your joy. And Uccello continued to sing, making the secret garden even more beautiful.

plan.problema: The bird had lost her voice and couldn't sing anymore.
plan.svolta: She decided to explore the secret garden, searching for clues to find her voice.
plan.finale: She found a special flower that, when she touched it with her beak, returned her melodious voice.

ucello.text:
Uccello was a blue cloth bird. He lived in a secret garden full of fragrant roses. It was a magical place, with lots of colorful flowers and tall trees. Uccello loved to fly among the roses, but sometimes he had too much fun.

One day, while playing hide-and-seek among the branches, Uccello got lost. The roses were so big and fragrant that they had swallowed him up! He couldn’t find his nest, a small space between the ferns. He was scared.

Uccello tried to call his mom, the robin, but no one answered. Then he decided to sing loudly, hoping someone would hear him and help him. But instead of an answer, only the butterflies fluttered around him, attracted by his song.

Uccello was desperate. He didn’t know what to do. Then, he looked up and noticed a ray of sunshine filtering through the leaves. The ray of sunshine lit up a small path among the roses. Uccello decided to follow it.

The path was narrow and full of thorns, but Uccello went on patiently. He followed the ray of sunshine, step by step, until he saw his cozy nest, hidden among the ferns. Mom Robin was waiting for him, happy to see him again. Uccello snuggled into the nest and felt safe.

Uccello realized that even if you sometimes get lost, patience can help you find your way. The sun always guides those with a calm heart.

plan.problema: The bird is lost among the roses and cannot find its nest.
plan.svolta: He tried to sing loudly, but only the butterflies answered!
plan.finale: Then he discovered that a ray of sunshine illuminated the path and followed it to his cozy nest.

unicorn.text:
Stellina was a special unicorn. She lived in the Flowery Meadow, a meadow full of colorful and fragrant flowers. Stellina loved her meadow because her sparkle made everything bright and happy. Every day, her light spread golden glows over all the daisies and sunflowers.

But one day, something had changed. Stellina noticed that her sparkle wasn't shining anymore. It had become weak, almost invisible. “Oh no!” exclaimed Stellina, with her voice as sweet as the wind. “I can’t shine on the meadow anymore! I must find my lost sparkle.”

Stellina began to look everywhere. She jumped between the flowers, climbed small hills, and tried to sing to call back her light. Then, she tried to dance with the butterflies that fluttered around her. But as she danced, her sparkle faded even more! It was as if the dance was consuming it.

A little red ladybug named Romeo approached Stellina. “Maybe,” said Romeo, “your sparkle is hidden in a special place.” Stellina followed Romeo and noticed a yellow flower with a deep purple corolla. She approached the flower and gently touched it.

Suddenly, her sparkle returned to shine brighter than ever! It was as if that flower had kept her light. Stellina understood immediately: the flower needed her sparkle to be happy. Stellina and Romeo stayed there, next to the yellow flower, seeing the light spread out again in the Flowery Meadow. Kindness makes sparkle.

plan.problema: Stellina lost her sparkle and can’t shine the meadow anymore.
plan.svolta: She tried to dance with the butterflies, but her sparkle faded even more!
plan.finale: Then she discovered that her sparkle was hidden in a special flower and brought it back to its true light.

unicorn.text:
Stardust was a special unicorn. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and little green plants. Stardust loved to play among the leaves and daisies. You could touch him, pet him, and even ride him in the meadow. But something wasn't right.

Stardust had lost his sparkle! Usually, his coat was full of a thousand colors that shone in the sun. Now, it was gray and dull. The little plants in the garden had closed up and weren't smiling anymore. Stardust felt sad because he couldn't make anyone happy.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Stardust. “I must find my sparkle!” He wandered among the flowers, trying to remember what had made him shine before. Then, he had an idea. He decided to sing a sweet and gentle song to find his light. But his singing was too shy, almost imperceptible. No one in the garden seemed to notice it.

Suddenly, a warm ray of sunshine hit Stardust. The sun kissed him with its light. A golden glow began to spread from him, lighting up the whole garden. The plants opened up and laughed with joy. Stardust’s coat returned to shining like a thousand stars.

Stardust realized that the kindness inside him was the real source of his beauty. And so, the secret garden became even more magical and bright. 
The light of Stardust reminded everyone that a good heart is always beautiful.

plan.problema: Stardust has lost her sparkle and can’t make the little plants happy anymore.
plan.svolta: She decided to sing a sweet song to find her lost light, but the sound was too shy.
plan.finale: Suddenly, a ray of sunshine hit Stardust and filled the whole garden with new brightness!

unicorn.text:
Stella Rainbow was a very special unicorn. She lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of flowers and tall trees. Stella loved her favorite rainbow – the one with the brightest colors – very much. One day, while galloping among the fragrant roses, she got lost.

The roses were so many! All the same, all red and pink. Stella couldn’t understand where her rainbow had gone. She was very sad. She looked everywhere, but she couldn’t see it anymore. Her sparkling horn was almost dimmed with worry.

Stella thought, thought, thought. Then she had an idea! She focused and started to sprinkle star dust from her horn. The star sparkles shone like little fireworks. The star dust fell to the ground, creating a little bright path.

A little garden gnome, Pip, saw Stella and asked her what she was doing. “I’m looking for my rainbow!” exclaimed Stella Rainbow. Pip helped Stella follow the star dust path. The path became clearer and clearer. 

Finally, the star dust created a sparkling path to the rainbow, which shone brighter than ever. It was even more beautiful than before! Stella Rainbow smiled happily. She had found her rainbow thanks to her perseverance. It was a wonderful day for an rainbow unicorn.

plan.problema: Stella got lost among the roses and couldn't find her favorite rainbow.
plan.svolta: She decided to use her horn to sprinkle stardust, hoping it would light the way.
plan.finale: The stardust created a shimmering path to the rainbow, which shone brighter than ever.

unicorn.text:
Stellino was a very special unicorn. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Stellino loved his garden because it was his favorite place in the whole world. But today something wasn't right. The garden, which was so lively before, had become gray. Every flower, every leaf, everything seemed dull.

Stellino noticed that his own sparkle, the thing that made him so magical, had disappeared! He wasn't shining anymore. He was sad and felt very empty. He looked everywhere: under the fragrant flowers, behind the big roses, but nothing. His light was nowhere to be found.

Then he saw some little butterflies. They were beautiful and colorful, fluttering around the flowers. Stellino decided to dance with them. He jumped and twirled, trying to make silly dance steps. But his sparkle didn’t come back. He stayed gray like the rest of the garden.

Stellino stopped, a little discouraged. Then he started to sing a sweet song, a song he loved very much. It was a song full of joy and of hope. While he sang, he felt something change inside him. A little light began to shine on his horn. Then it became bigger and bigger, brighter and more brilliant! The secret garden was immediately back to its bright colors. Stellino was happy again. His light shone brighter than ever. It was a light full of joy.

plan.problema: Starshine had lost his sparkle and the garden had become gray.
plan.svolta: He tried to dance with the butterflies, but his sparkle hadn't returned.
plan.finale: He began to sing a sweet song and his light reappeared bright.

unicorn.text:
Stellina was a special unicorn. She lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and tall plants. Stellina loved to run among the bushes, but sometimes she got lost. One day, while playing hide-and-seek among the roses, she noticed that she couldn't see her favorite rainbow anymore. It was a rainbow made of glitter and stardust, which she loved the most.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Stellina. “I don’t know where it is! It’s gone!” She looked everywhere: under the trees, behind the big geraniums, but the rainbow wasn't there. She was very sad. Stellina felt a little scared and lonely in the garden.

Suddenly, Stellina heard a sweet sound. A light buzzing. It was the sound of butterflies! Stellina decided to follow them. The butterflies flew away, away, towards a corner of the garden that Stellina didn't know very well.

Stellina ran following the butterflies, and then she heard another sound: the sound of streams. The water flowed happily and crystal clear. Following the sound, Stellina found herself in a small clearing. And there, shining as always, was her rainbow!

Stellina jumped for joy. She was so happy to have found it. The garden seemed even more beautiful with the rainbow shining around her. Stellina realized that she shouldn't give up and that, by following her thoughts, she could always find what she was looking for. And so, perseverance brought Stellina happiness.

plan.problema: Stellina got lost in the garden and couldn't find her favorite rainbow.
plan.svolta: She decided to follow the sound of the butterflies, hoping they would lead her to the rainbow.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the sound of the streams, she found the rainbow and filled with joy.

unicorn.text:
Stella the unicorn lived in a secret garden. It was a place full of fragrant roses and colorful flowers. Stella loved her garden very much, but one morning something wasn't right. She had gotten lost! The roses were so many and so big that Stella got lost among their petals.

She had lost her sparkle. Usually, when she walked, her horn would shine with a thousand colors, like a confused rainbow. But now it had become gray and dull. Stella was sad. She tried to move forward, then backward, but she couldn't find her way.

She tried to shout for help, “Help! Someone hear me!” but her voice was too weak to be heard among the roses. Nobody answered. Stella felt even more alone.

Then she had an idea. She used her horn, the one she usually used to shine, to sweep away the fallen leaves from the trees. She swept and swept, trying to see better. The leaves piled up around Stella, but she still couldn't figure out where the pond was.

Then, a ray of sunshine hit her horn! Stella’s horn began to shine brighter than ever. The colors of the rainbow began to dance on its surface. And, through the sparkling light, Stella saw the path to the pond. It was there, right in front of her! Stella felt happy and relieved. 

The sun continued to shine on her horn, lighting up the whole secret garden.

plan.problema: Stella got lost among the roses and can’t find her sparkle anymore.
plan.svolta: She tried to shout for help, but no one heard her, so she decided to use her horn to sweep away the leaves and see better.
plan.finale: A ray of sunshine hit her horn, making it shine even brighter and revealing the path to the lagoon.

unicorn.text:
Stella the unicorn lived in a secret garden. It was a place full of colors and smells. The roses were huge, some redder than others, some white like snow. Stella loved to run among the roses, but sometimes she got lost.

---

One day, while skipping happily, Stella found herself completely surrounded by roses. There were so many that she couldn't see where they were going! She was lost. Her problem was simple: she couldn't find her favorite cloud, a soft and white cloud like whipped cream. The cloud was always there, just when Stella danced with the sunbeams.

---

Stella tried to call the roses. “Help! I’m lost!” she shouted. But the roses didn’t answer. They were too busy blooming and welcoming the sun. Stella felt a little sad. What should she do?

---

Then, Stella had an idea. She used her sparkling horn to create a little ray of light. A bright beam cut through the roses. The light revealed the cloud! It was right above her, floating silently in the sky.

---

Stella started to dance with the sunbeams, happy and content. Her horn shone with joy. She felt light as a feather. And as she danced, she realized that even if she sometimes gets lost, she always finds her way in the end.

plan.problema: Stella got lost among the roses and couldn't find her favorite cloud.
plan.svolta: She tried to call the flowers, but none of them listened, so she decided to use her horn to create a little ray of light.
plan.finale: The light illuminated the cloud floating right above her, and Stella happily returned to dance with the sunbeams.

unicorn.text:
Stella was a special unicorn. She lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and lush plants. Stella especially loved her rainbow, a little shimmer of colors that shone when the sun was shining.

One day, while playing hide-and-seek among the fragrant roses, Stella got lost. The roses were so beautiful and so many, all alike! She couldn't find her rainbow anymore. She was all confused and sad. “Oh no!” she exclaimed, trying to find it.

Stella tried to call for help, but no one could hear her. Only the song of the little birds and the rustling of the leaves answered her cry. Then Stella had an idea. She used her horns to blow away the dry leaves. It was hard work, but Stella didn’t give up.

With every puff of sparkling dust, Stella could see a little better. Finally, after so much searching, she noticed something special: a waterfall of cool water falling on a smooth stone. Behind the waterfall, just as she had always dreamed, shone her rainbow!

Stella jumped for joy. She had found her rainbow thanks to her perseverance. The cool waterfall had turned into a little mirror to reflect the colors. Stella understood that even when things seem difficult, you should never give up. And so, with her rainbow safe, Stella continued to play in the Secret Garden.

plan.problema: Stella got lost among the roses and couldn't find her favorite rainbow anymore.
plan.svolta: She tried to call for help, but no one could hear her, so she decided to use her horns to sweep away the leaves and see better.
plan.finale: Finally, with a final puff of sparkling dust, Stella found her hidden rainbow behind a waterfall of cool water.

unicorn.text:
Stellina the unicorn lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees.
She was a special unicorn, with a mane soft as silk and a horn that shone in the sunlight.
Stellina loved to play among the roses and jump on the green grass.

But one day, something had changed. Stellina noticed that her horn wasn’t sparkling anymore!
It was gone! Without her horn, the secret garden seemed sad and gray.
Stellina felt very down. She couldn’t make the sun shine in the garden.

Stellina decided to ask for help. She went to the old apple tree, the biggest tree in the secret garden.
The tree had seen many things and knew all the secrets of the forest. “Apple tree,” said Stellina, “I’ve lost my sparkling horns! Can you help me?”

The apple tree thought for a while. Then, with a kind smile, it pointed to a hidden waterfall behind a lavender bush.
“Look there, Stellina,” said the tree. “Your horns were taken away by the stream.”

Stellina ran to the waterfall and saw her sparkling horns playing in the water. The stream had brought them back!
The secret garden was immediately shining brightly again. Stellina jumped for joy, happy to have found her horn.

Stellina learned that even when things seem lost, if you wait a little while and look patiently, the solution can always arrive.

plan.problema: Stellina has lost her sparkling horns and can’t light the garden anymore.
plan.svolta: She decided to ask for help from the old apple tree, who knew all the secrets of the forest.
plan.finale: The tree, with a gentle smile, pointed to Stellina a waterfall where the horns had been returned by the current.

unicorn.text:
Stellina the unicorn lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. She was a special unicorn because her horns shimmered with a thousand colors when the sun shone. Stellina loved to play among the flowers, jump on the soft grass, and light up the garden with her light.

But one day, something had changed. Stellina looked around and noticed that she wasn't shimmering anymore. The horns had become gray and dull. The garden seemed sad and gloomy without her light. Stellina felt very melancholy. She didn’t understand why she had lost her sparkle.

She tried to jump, to run, and even to do a few spins around the big tree in the garden, but nothing worked. Her shimmer was gone! Then, Stellina decided to do something different. She sat on a rose bush and began to sing a song. It was a sad song about the moon and the faraway stars.

But the song didn’t make her horns shine. In fact, it seemed to make them even grayer! Stellina realized that her sadness had stolen her sparkle.

Then, a little ray of sunshine hit Stellina’s horns. The sun had arrived and was lighting up the garden with all its strength. Stellina’s horns began to shine brighter and brighter! They shimmered with a thousand colors, more luminous than ever before. The secret garden was once again full of light and joy. Stellina understood that joy was the key to finding her magic.

plan.problema: Stellina has lost her sparkle and can’t light the garden anymore.
plan.svolta: She decided to sing a happy song to find her light, but the song was too sad.
plan.finale: When a little ray of sunshine hit her horns, Stellina shone brighter than ever!

zebra.text:
Zebra Stella was a very happy teddy bear. She lived in the Flower Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and delicious smells. Every day, Zebra Stella loved to be there, watching the butterflies fly and listening to the birds sing.

But today, something wasn't right. Zebra Stella looked carefully and noticed a problem: her white spots had disappeared! The black stripes seemed bigger than usual. She was very sad. She wasn't a normal zebra when her spots were missing. 

“Oh no!” said Zebra Stella, raising her little paw. “How will I be beautiful?”

She decided to take a walk along the lawn. She moved slowly, trying to see better. She passed by the red roses and the yellow sunflowers. A little squirrel, Pipì, waved to her with his head, but Zebra Stella was too worried to talk.

She continued to walk, hoping that her stripes would settle back on their own. The sun shone brightly in the sky and the wind blew gently. 

Then, suddenly, Zebra Stella felt a warm ray of sunshine on her fur. She stretched and stretched. And looking around, she saw her white spots return to their place! The black and white stripes were perfect again.

Zebra Stella smiled happily. She had become even more beautiful than usual. She had learned that sometimes all it takes is a little patience to find your own beauty.

plan.problema: Stella the Zebra can’t find her black and white spots!
plan.svolta: She decided to take a walk across the meadow, hoping her stripes would sort themselves out.
plan.finale: Finally, she found a sunbeam and stretched, finding her lovely black and white line.
plan.morale: Sometimes a little patience is all it takes.

zebra.text:
Zelda the zebra was happy in her secret garden. It was a special place, full of colorful flowers and tall plants. Zelda loved to run among the daisies and play with the butterflies. But today Zelda had a problem. She couldn’t find her white stripes for her little dress!

She looked everywhere. Under the tree, behind the rock, in the rose bush… nothing! The white stripes were important: they made her dress perfect. Zelda felt a little sad. She was a zebra with a dress without stripes!

She decided to ask for help. She walked to the stream that ran through the secret garden. The stream whispered secrets to the stones. “Oh, stream,” said Zelda, “will you help me find my white stripes?” The stream kept gurgling, but then it made a little splash.

Zelda listened carefully. The stream pointed to a waterfall far away. “Follow my whisper,” said the stream. Zelda ran to the waterfall and saw something strange: lots of bubbles floating on the water! Zelda’s white stripes from her dress were trapped inside the bubbles!

Zelda followed the bubbles to the waterfall, where the stripes were released. Zelda smiled happily. Her dress was perfect again! Patience had helped Zelda find what she was looking for. It was a wonderful day in the secret garden.

plan.problema: Zelda can't find her white stripes for her dress!
plan.svolta: She decided to ask for help from the stream, which whispered secrets to the stones.
plan.finale: The stream showed her a waterfall where the stripes had been carried by bubbles and Zelda smiled happily.

zebra.text:
Zebra Leo loved the Secret Garden very much. It was a place full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. Leo spent his days wandering among the bushes, jumping on the green lawns. But today something wasn’t right. He was lost!

He had ended up in the middle of many red and pink roses. The roses were beautiful, but they had swallowed him up. He couldn’t see his friend, Coco, a soft plush rabbit. Coco was always there nearby when Leo played. He had looked everywhere, but Coco wasn’t there.

Leo began to feel a little sad. He sat down on a smooth stone and took a big sigh. Then he had an idea! His little bell was attached to his tail. He rang the bell loudly, loudly. “Bling, bling!” The sound was funny and strange.

Suddenly, a little blue bird arrived to fly. The bird landed on a branch and looked at Leo with his black eyes. Leo continued to ring the bell. The bird followed the sound with its eye. It flew away, then came back and pointed with its beak in a direction.

Leo ran in that direction and, surprise! He saw Coco under a big apple tree. Coco was waiting for him, with his ears down and a smile. Leo hopped happily towards his friend.

The blue bird flew away, happy with his help. Zebra Leo realized that sometimes, even a small sound can make a difference. The kindness of that bird had brought him back to his best friend.

plan.problema: Leo had gotten lost among the roses and couldn't find his friend, a teddy bear.
plan.svolta: He decided to call for help, making silly noises and ringing his little bell.
plan.finale: A little bird, attracted by the sound, led him to the teddy bear who was waiting under a big tree.

zebra.text:
Zelia the zebra was very happy in the secret garden. The flowers were so colorful and they smelled sweet. Zelia loved to run between the soft petals, jump over the big leaves, and play with the butterflies. But one day, while chasing a blue butterfly, she got lost.

Zelia found herself in the middle of lots of red, yellow, and purple flowers. She couldn’t see her place in the secret garden anymore. She was very scared. She tried to go forward, but every time she ended up among the flowers. Zelia felt sad and a little lost. She wanted to go back, where the sunshine was warmer.

Zelia thought about what to do. She decided to try to call for help. She shouted loudly: “Help! I’m here!” She repeated the loud cry many times, hoping someone had heard her. The wind blew lightly among the flowers and carried away a little of its sound.

Suddenly, she heard a little bird coming closer. The bird landed on a yellow flower and looked at Zelia with its little black eyes. Then, with its beak, it pointed to a little house decorated with daisies. Zelia understood!

She went towards the little house and, finally, she returned to her place in the secret garden. She was happy to be home. The bird flew away, but Zelia knew that even a little help can make a difference when you try to find it.

plan.problema: Zelia had gotten lost among the colorful flowers and couldn’t find her way back.
plan.svolta: She decided to try to call for help, shouting a loud and repeated ‘Help! I’m here!’
plan.finale: A little bird, attracted by the sound, pointed at her with its beak towards a decorated little house.

zebra.text:
Zebra Leo loved the Flower Garden very much. It was a place full of beautiful colors and smells. Red roses, yellow tulips, tall sunflowers, and so many other flowers bloomed in the sun. Leo loved to roll on the green grass around the flowers.

One day, while he was playing, Leo noticed that he couldn't see his friend teddy bear Bruno anymore. Bruno was always with him in the Flower Garden! Leo looked everywhere, under the roses and among the tulips, but Bruno wasn't there. He was lost! Leo was worried.

“Oh no!” said Leo. “I can’t find Bruno. I’m too small to see well among all these big flowers.” He felt a little sad.

Leo thought for a moment. Then he had an idea. He decided to use his white and black stripes to make a sign in the green grass. He started to move back and forth, making a long drawing with his stripes on the grass. “Bruno! Bruno!” shouted Leo.

Finally, after a while, he heard a voice. “Leo! Leo, I’m here!” It was Bruno running towards him. He hugged him tightly, tightly. Leo was very happy. He had found his friend thanks to patience and his stripes. 

Zebra Leo relaxed and watched Bruno smile. He understood that sometimes, you have to wait a little while to find the right solution.

plan.problema: Leo got lost among the big, colorful flowers and couldn't find his teddy bear anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his white and black stripe to create a visible signal in the green meadow.
plan.finale: His teddy bear, seeing the stripe, ran to him immediately for a happy hug.

zebra.text:
Zelia was a teddy bear zebra. She lived in a secret garden, full of flowers and big trees. Zelia loved her garden very much. But one morning there was a problem. Her colorful dots were gone! They were small, shiny, and she loved them so much. Zelia had scattered them all over the garden when the wind had blown them away.

Zelia began to look for them. She looked under the trees, behind the rose bushes, and among the green leaves. She looked carefully, but the dots didn’t help her. “Where are they?” Zelia wondered, moving around a little. A little bird, Pipì, was watching her fly from a branch. Pipì chirped: "Maybe they are hidden!"

Zelia had an idea. She decided to use her soft fur to collect the dots. She rubbed against the plants and flowers, hoping to find something shiny. But she only collected green leaves and colorful petals! There were no dots. Zelia was a little sad.

Then, while she was relaxing under a big tree, she noticed a waterfall of white bellflowers. Zelia approached carefully and... there! The last dots were hidden among the bellflowers, shining in the sunlight. Zelia picked them all up and put them back in her little bag.

Zelia smiled. She had found her dots! It had been a long search, but in the end, she had managed to do it. Zelia knew that finding things takes time and patience. And, with a big smile, she continued to play in her secret garden.

plan.problema: Zelia couldn't find her colored dots, scattered everywhere in the garden.
plan.svolta: She decided to use her soft fur to collect the dots, but she only collected leaves and flowers!
plan.finale: Zelia, with a big smile, found the last dots hidden under a waterfall of bellflowers.

zebra.text:
Zita the zebra loved the Flower Garden very much. It was a place full of wonderful colors and smells. Red roses, yellow sunflowers, blue violets, and so many other fragrant flowers. Zita spent her days exploring the garden, skipping between the soft petals.

One day, while playing hide-and-seek with a bell, Zita got lost. She found herself surrounded by a sea of flowers that were so fragrant she couldn’t find her friend Croco, the crocodile. Croco had always been her playmate in the Flower Garden.

Zita called for help, but her voice was too weak to be heard by all the colors of the garden. Nobody listened. She was sad and a little scared. She didn’t know what to do.

Then Zebra Zita made a brave decision. She decided to start skipping! She skipped hard, she skipped fast, she skipped with all her might. The sound of her feet beating on the ground was clear and cheerful. 

Suddenly, a big smile appeared among the flowers. It was Croco! He had heard the sound of Zita’s little feet and ran straight to her. “Zita! Where did you go?” he shouted happily to see her.

Zita skipped joyfully around Croco, so happy to be found. The Flower Garden was even more beautiful with her two friends together. 

Thanks to her courage, Zita had found the way to return to Croco. And this shows that even when things seem difficult, a little bit of courage can lead to the best solution.

plan.problema: Zita had gotten lost among the fragrant flowers and couldn't find her friend the crocodile, Croco anymore.
plan.svolta: She decided to call for help, but her voice was too weak to be heard by all the colors of the garden.
plan.finale: Zita began to hop joyfully, and the sound of her paws attracted Croco's attention, who ran to her immediately, happy to see her.

zebra.text:
Zebra Stella was a little bit scared. She was in the Secret Garden, a beautiful place full of colorful flowers. But Stella had gotten lost. She had ended up among the red and pink roses, fragrant and big. She couldn’t find her place, her little wooden house.

The house was small, with a red door and a blue roof.

Stella moved slowly, trying to figure out where she was. The roses surrounded her, but they couldn’t help her. Stella shouted: “Help! I’m lost!” But nobody answered. It was all quiet.

Then, Zebra Stella had an idea. She called the sunflowers, the tall and yellow ones that looked at the sun. “Sunflowers, sunflowers!” she shouted. But the sunflowers were too busy following the sun and didn’t listen to her. They didn’t answer her voice.

Zebra Stella was a little sad. She was about to give up when she smelled a sweet and strong scent. It was the scent of violets, small and blue, that grew near the old tree. The scent was so strong that Zebra Stella followed it.

She moved among the violets, sniffing the air. And then, there it was! Her little wooden house under the old tree, just like she remembered. Zebra Stella ran to it and climbed inside, happy to be home. She settled down on her favorite cushion. She had overcome a small problem. 

Zebra Stella realized that even when things seem difficult, continuing to look is important. After so much patience, she had found her way.

plan.problema: Stella the Zebra was lost among the roses and couldn’t find her way back.
plan.svolta: She tried to call the sunflowers, but nobody answered.
plan.finale: Thanks to the scent of the violets, she finally found her little wooden house under an old tree.

zebra.text:
Zebra Stella was happy in the Secret Garden. The garden was full of colorful flowers: pink, yellow, blue, and orange. Zebra Stella loved to jump among the lilies and roll in the soft grass. But one day, while playing hide-and-seek with a whirligig, she got lost.

She was surrounded by so many flowers! Every flower was beautiful, but it wasn't her place. Zebra Stella felt very confused. She couldn't find her favorite spot near the big rose bush anymore.

Zebra Stella thought she had to do something. Then she had an idea. She used her white and black stripes to make a giant sign in the meadow. She drew a long, long, long line! She hoped someone would see it and help her find her way home.

A little blue bird landed on a flower near Zebra Stella. He watched her carefully with his little black eyes. Then, the bird flew away, pointing the way with his beak. Zebra Stella followed the bird, and in a short time, she arrived at the rose bush!

It was right there where she needed to be. She was so happy to be going home. Zebra Stella understood that even when you get lost, you have to be patient and never give up. 

Zebra Stella knew that with a little perseverance, she would always find the right way.

plan.problema: Stella the Zebra got lost among the colorful flowers and couldn't find her way back.
plan.svolta: She decided to use her black and white stripes to make a giant sign in the grass, hoping someone would see it.
plan.finale: A little bird recognized her and flew home, showing her the way.

zebra.text:
Zebra Zita lived in the Secret Garden. She was a patchwork zebra, soft and a little bit wobbly, but very happy. She loved to run among the roses and hide behind the trees. One day, Zita noticed a problem: she couldn't find her white and black stripes anymore! They were her favorite costume, the one that made her feel like a real elegant zebra.

Zita looked everywhere, under the leaves, among the flowers, but the stripes were gone. “Oh no!” exclaimed Zita. “How will I be able to go to the zebra party?” She huddled sadly under a lavender bush. 

She decided she needed to ask for help. Running towards the pond in the Secret Garden, she saw the shining lighthouse. It was a small lighthouse, but with a very bright light. “Lighthouse!” called Zita. “Could you help me find my stripes?”

The lighthouse shone and blinked. Zita approached the pond and carefully watched the glow. The lighthouse seemed to be pointing to a precise spot in the garden. Zita ran towards the biggest sunflower, the one that almost reached the sky.

And there, under the big sunflower, were Zita’s white and black stripes! They had been hidden among the yellow petals. Zita straightened up happily and carefully smoothed out her stripes. 

The lighthouse continued to shine, lighting up the Secret Garden with its special light. Zita realized that even when things seem difficult, looking patiently can lead to the best solution.

plan.problema: Zita can’t find her black and white stripes for her costume!
plan.svolta: She decided to ask for help from the shining lighthouse by the pond, hoping it could light up her lost stripes.
plan.finale: The lighthouse, with a special glow, revealed that the stripes were hidden under a big sunflower!

block house.text:
Casa Blocks lived in a sunny garden. It was a house made of colorful blocks, tall and a little wobbly. Casa Blocks loved the warm sun on its brick face. But Casa Blocks felt a little cold. It felt very lonely. There was no one to play with.

One day, Casa Blocks had an idea! It decided to build something big, a giant castle! It started piling up its blocks as fast as it could. It made tall towers and thick walls. But the castle was too tall! No one could see it through the trees in the garden. The squirrels jumped over it, the butterflies flew around it, but no one saw its castle.

Casa Blocks felt even more lonely. Then, with a sigh, it decided to take down the castle. It removed the blocks one by one and put them back on the grass. Casa Blocks wanted to make something small, something cozy.

It made a small door and a small window. Then, it saw two red ladybugs arrive. The ladybugs came up to Casa Blocks and entered its new house. They played together, laughing and building small towers with blocks. Casa Blocks was no longer lonely. It was happy!

The sunlight shone on the garden and on Casa Blocks, which smiled happily next to its new friends.

plan.problema: The Block House felt lonely and had no one to play with.
plan.svolta: He tried to build a giant castle, but it was too tall to be seen by his garden friends!
plan.finale: So he took the castle apart and made a small, cozy door, inviting the ladybugs to come in and play with him.

block house.text:
Casa Blocks was a little house made of colorful building blocks. It lived in a sunny garden, full of yellow and green flowers. Casa Blocks loved the sun and the butterflies that flew around it. But sometimes, Casa Blocks felt lonely. It wanted someone to play with, someone to build and laugh with.

“I wish I had a friend,” said Casa Blocks, whispering among its blocks. “But I’m just a little house.”

Then Casa Blocks decided to do something. It started to build a very tall tower! It used all its red and blue blocks, trying to make it the tallest in the garden. But when it got to the top, everything crashed down! The blocks fell down with a thud.

Casa Blocks felt even sadder. “I can’t do it!” it thought. Then it had an idea! It started to create little rooms inside itself. It made a cozy nest for the bees, with yellow and brown blocks. It created a special house for the ladybugs, with red and white blocks.

The bees and the ladybugs moved into Casa Blocks and started to play. Casa Blocks was no longer alone. It laughed happily while it saw the bees flying in the garden and the ladybugs landing on its blocks. It was a little house full of friends, just like it had always wanted.

Casa Blocks realized that having someone to share the sun and the games was the best thing in the world. And so, the block house continued to smile in the garden.

plan.problema: The Block House felt lonely and wanted a friend to play with.

plan.finale: Then he had the idea to create small rooms for the insects and soon the bees and ladybugs settled inside his house.

block house.text:

block house.text:

Casa Blocks loved the sun and butterflies. But Casa Blocks felt lonely.
It wanted someone to play with, someone to build with together.

It started to move its blocks, one after another.
It created a huge maze around itself. A maze full of turns, bridges, and little rooms.

“Oh no,” said Casa Blocchi. “I feel so lonely.” The sun shone high in the sky, but Casa Blocchi didn’t see it. It felt very bad because it couldn’t add anything to its little house.

Casa Blocchi tried to use its biggest blocks to build a new room. But it was a mistake! The blocks were too heavy and the walls fell down right away. “It doesn’t work!” exclaimed Casa Blocchi, and it shrank a little.

Then, Casa Blocchi had an idea. It started to put its smallest blocks one at a time. It placed them very carefully on the grass. It was patient. It took a red block, then a blue one, and finally a yellow one. It made small, bright rooms. Each room was perfect.

A ladybug passed by Casa Blocchi’s house. “What a lovely little house!” said the ladybug. “You’ve done a fantastic job!” Casa Blocchi smiled. It had figured out how to do it.

Casa Blocchi continued to build, slowly but carefully. It made perfect, bright rooms. Its little house was full of life and color. At the end of the day, Casa Blocchi felt happy and satisfied. 

Patience really does allow you to do great things.

plan.problema: The Block House felt lonely and couldn't build new rooms.

Block Creative found himself all alone on the dusty attic. Dust covered him in a gray veil. It was scattered on the dark wooden floor. All his friend pieces were gone. He felt sad and confused. He didn't know how to be whole again.

“Oh no,” said Block Creative, “I’m broken! And now I can’t do anything.” He tried to stand up, but it was too difficult. Every attempt made him slide down again.

Suddenly he had an idea. “Maybe if I move, I’ll find more pieces!” Block Creative began to roll. He rolled quickly towards the edge of the stairs. With a little jump, he found himself falling down the stairs. 

He arrived at the bottom and saw a girl. The girl’s name was Sofia. Sofia picked up all the scattered pieces. “How lovely!” said Sofia. “Can I build something big?” Block Creative, along with other pieces, was used to build a very tall tower. Sofia smiled happily as she built. 

Block Creative was finally whole again and was helping to create something wonderful. The tower grew taller and taller. It was nice to work with Sofia to create something special. 

Sofia finished the tower, as tall as the dusty attic. It was a beautiful thing to share.

building block.text:
Blocky Magic lived in the dusty attic. He was a building block in a strange shape, with lots of little grooves. The attic was full of other blocks, big and small, colorful and gray. Blocky Magic loved to be at the top of the tower his grandma was building.

One day, Blocky Magic noticed he was missing. He couldn’t find his place among the others. He was sad! The tower seemed incomplete without him. “Where did I go?” he thought. He looked everywhere, but nothing.

Blocky Magic tried to push the biggest blocks around him. “Help me!” he shouted. But the blocks were too heavy and they didn’t move. They didn’t want to help him get back to the top of the tower. Blocky Magic was almost without hope.

A little red block, named Rosso, was watching everything. “Maybe you need more strength,” said Rosso. Blocky Magic thought about it. He concentrated all his energy and pushed with all his might. One more push! And another one still! Finally, with one last effort, Blocky Magic reached the top of the tower.

Grandma smiled seeing his perfect place. The tower was complete! Blocky Magic felt happy and proud. He had overcome a difficulty with perseverance. Every block had its important part in building. And Blocky Magic knew that, sometimes, just a little effort is enough to reach your goals.

building block.text:
Mattoncino lived in the corner of play. It was a corner full of colors and shapes, where the blocks loved to build towers and castles. Mattoncino was a red block, the favorite of everyone. But one day, Mattoncino couldn't stand up anymore. He kept falling, with a soft thump on the wooden floor. He felt very sad.

“I can’t do it,” said Mattoncino, crying. “I am too small and wobbly.” A little plastic star, Stella, shyly approached Mattoncino. "Maybe if you try to make a bigger base, you can stand up!"

Mattoncino thought about Stella’s words. He decided to try something new. He gently took another blue block and placed it carefully next to Mattoncino. Then he took another, yellow, and then one green. He placed the blocks slowly, one at a time, trying to create a stronger base underneath him.

It was tiring, but Mattoncino didn’t give up. He continued to place the blocks patiently. Slowly but surely, Mattoncino’s tower began to grow. It became taller and more stable. 

Finally, after a lot of effort, Mattoncino reached the height he wanted. He was happy! He shone again, full of joy. His red surface reflected the sunlight of the corner of play. Mattoncino realized that with a little effort and perseverance, even the most difficult things can be solved. And so, Mattoncino continued to grow, becoming the tallest block in the whole corner of play.

plan.problema: He couldn't stand up and he felt sad.
plan.svolta: He decided to try to gently stack more blocks, forming a more stable base.
plan.finale: Finally, he reached the desired height and was happy to shine again.

building block.text:
Blocky Happy lived in the Toy Workshop. He was a bright yellow building block, always ready to make new shapes. He loved to be on top of the tall table, watching all the other toys. One day, while he was having fun imagining castles and houses, he slipped! He fell from a very tall table and landed with a thump.

Blocky Happy couldn't stand up anymore. He was all wobbly, and his angles were wrong. He felt sad and incomplete. He didn’t know what to do. “Oh no!” thought Blocky Happy, “I can’t build anything anymore!”

He decided to ask for help. He went up to Blocky Blue, a big and serious block that lived next to the table. “Blocky Blue,” said Blocky Happy, “I fell down and I can’t stand up! Can you help me?”

Blocky Blue listened carefully. Then, calmly, he suggested to Blocky Happy to build a tower, putting the blocks one on top of the other in an orderly way. Together, they built slowly, placing each block carefully. Blocky Happy followed Blocky Blue’s advice, and soon the tower became tall and stable.

Blocky Happy felt much better! He had rebuilt himself, strong and confident. He could finally stand up, happy to be able to play again. Working together had done a miracle.

building block.text:
Block Builder lived in the Creative Lab. He was a red building block, strong and full of energy. He loved building tall towers, taller and taller. One day, Block Builder was building the tallest tower of all. He fitted lots of other building blocks one on top of the other, with force.

Suddenly, he noticed that he couldn’t move anymore! He was stuck at the top of the tower. He couldn’t slide down, he couldn’t turn around. “Oh no!” exclaimed Block Builder. “I’m stuck too tightly!” His red face turned even redder with frustration.

A little robotic, called Rusty, came closer and said: “Don’t worry, Block Builder! Try to slide slowly on a smooth surface.” Block Builder followed Rusty’s advice. He started to move very carefully, a little bit at a time. The movement was slow, almost imperceptible.

Then, Rusty turned on a small fan. A gentle puff of wind hit Block Builder. With a little push, the red building block came loose from the tower! He slid onto the smooth table, happy and delighted.

Block Builder started building tall and fragile towers again right away. Every time he tried to create something new, he did it calmly and patiently. Building towers was a fun and relaxing game. Block Builder learned that, even when things seem difficult, patience can lead to success.

plan.problema: It had stuck too tightly and it couldn’t move anymore!

Miss Stella, the lab assistant, watched Block Builder carefully. “Maybe if you try to straighten yourself with a strong push,” she said, “you can go back to being straight.”

Block Builder thought about what Miss Stella said. He focused and began to push against the wooden table. He pushed hard, hard, hard! It was difficult at first, but then he felt a little movement. Slowly, slowly, Block Builder straightened up.

Finally, he was straight! With great excitement, Block Builder began to stack the blocks even higher than the previous tower. The tower became taller and more beautiful. It was the tallest tower he had ever made! Block Builder realized how important it is never to give up. Every little effort can lead to big results.

Suddenly, he saw a small pebble rolling near him. “Could you help me?” asked Block Creative. The pebble came closer and with its smooth surface, it helped Block Creative to put himself back together.

Piece by piece, Block Creative put himself back together. With the help of the pebble, they built a beautiful tower: tall, strong, and full of color. Mattoncino turned around and started building the tower from another part. He started putting the bricks one on top of the other with more care, very calmly. After so much trying, he finally managed to finish the tower! It was beautiful, tall, and very stable.

Mattoncino smiled happily. He had learned that even when things seem difficult, if you have patience and cleverness, you can always find a solution. The tower was a beautiful memory of his success.

plan.problema: He was stuck and couldn't finish the tall tower!
plan.svolta: He decided to turn 180 degrees to find another solution.
plan.finale: Finally, with a little patience and ingenuity, he managed to build a beautiful and stable tower.

building block.text:
Red Block lived in the Creative Workshop. He was a red building block, strong and full of energy. He loved building tall, tall towers, the tallest in the world! Every day he tried to beat his previous tower. But today was different.

Red Block had gotten stuck. He couldn’t move. His top part was stuck and he couldn’t finish the tower. He was very frustrated. “Oh no!” said Red Block, “I can’t be the tallest building block anymore!”

He tried to slide on a smooth surface. He tried to match his shapes with those of the other building blocks. But it was too smooth! Red Block rolled away, ending up against a corner of the workshop. “Uff!” exclaimed Red Block. “I can’t do it alone.”

At that moment, he saw Pencil drawing on a big piece of paper. Pencil was quiet and focused. Red Block decided to ask for help. “Pencil,” said Red Block, “could you help me?”

Pencil nodded with a little pencil stroke. Together, Pencil and Red Block thought quickly. Then, Pencil used his tip to draw a small hammer on the paper. Red Block leaned on the hammer and Pencil pushed him gently.

Red Block flattened again! He was straight like so many times. Together, they solved the problem. Red Block started building his tower again, taller than ever, with the help of his friend Pencil. 
Working together makes every challenge easier to face.

plan.problema: Red Block got stuck and can't finish the world's tallest tower!
plan.svolta: He tried to slide, but it was too smooth and he rolled away.
plan.finale: Then he asked for help from the pencil that was drawing and together they made a forge to flatten him and make him straight again.

castello.text:
Castello was a very big wooden castle. He lived in the dusty attic, full of old boxes and cobwebs. Castello loved to be there, watching the world through his towers. But one morning there was a problem. His wooden soldiers were all scared! They were hiding behind every corner, under every balcony. They were terrified!

“Oh no!” said Castello. “I can’t command an army if my soldiers are hiding!” He tried to shout orders, but the soldiers didn’t answer. It seemed that fear had paralyzed them. Castello felt sad and a little angry.

Then he had an idea! It was one of his favorite things: chess music. He took his little chess piano and began to play. The notes filled the dusty attic, cheerful and rhythmic. He played loudly, then softly, changing tempo and melody.

Incredibly, the wooden soldiers began to move! First slowly, then faster and faster. They danced with the notes, jumping and spinning. The fear disappeared completely. They bravely fought around Castello, ready to defend him.

Castello smiled. The music had done a miracle! He was happy and peaceful again. The soldiers were back to being brave soldiers. The castle was full of laughter and joy. Joy can overcome fear, making everything more beautiful.

plan.problema: His wooden warriors were all scared and had hidden in every corner!
plan.svolta: He decided to organize a grand concert with his chess music, hoping the rhythm would distract him.
