plan.finale: The chess music made the wooden warriors dance, who returned to fight valiantly and the castle returned serene.

castello.text:
Castello Ruggenti was a very old wooden castle.
It lived in the playroom, next to the checkered rug and the bookshelf full of books.
Castello Ruggenti loved being there, but lately he felt lonely.
He wanted to invite someone to play with him!

“I wish I had some friends,” thought the castle.
“I would like someone to visit me.”
But nobody found him. The teddy bears always slept on the chair, the toy cars zoomed up and down the floor, but nobody stopped to look at Castello Ruggenti.

Then he had an idea! “I will build a very tall tower!” he exclaimed.
He started moving his colorful building blocks one by one. Red, blue, yellow, green… he piled them higher and higher, creating a giant, bright tower.
The tower was so tall that it almost touched the ceiling of the playroom.

After a lot of work, the tower was finished.
It was beautiful! Suddenly, a little teddy bear came closer to the tower.
Then a stuffed dog arrived, followed by a doll with wide eyes.
Everyone started playing around Castello Ruggenti and his tower.

They laughed, they built sandcastles (pretend ones, of course), and they told stories.
Castello Ruggenti didn't feel lonely anymore.
He was happy to have so many friends to play with.
The playroom was full of laughter and joy.
Castello Ruggenti realized that having someone around makes life much more fun.

plan.problema: The Castle felt lonely and wanted to invite friends, but nobody could find it.
plan.svolta: It decided to build a giant tower of colorful blocks to attract attention.
plan.finale: The friends, attracted by the new building, began to play around the Castle, filling it with laughter and joy.

castello.text:
Castle Robusto was a very big wooden castle.
It lived in the Flower Garden, among red roses and yellow sunflowers.
It was a strong and sturdy castle, with tall towers and thick walls.
Castle Robusto loved to be there, watching the butterflies fly.

One day, Castle Robusto noticed a problem. “Oh no!” he said. “The little wooden pawns have disappeared! They’ve gotten lost between my walls.”
The pawns were many, all colorful and perfect for building.
Nobody knew where they had gone.

Castle Robusto tried to do something. He tried to push with his towers, hoping the pawns would move.
But it only made dry leaves fall from his balcony.
The leaves fell everywhere, but the pawns didn’t reappear.

The wind was blowing hard in the Flower Garden.
Castle Robusto had an idea. He started to make his flags spin.
The flags were big and colorful, tied to the towers.
The wind made them spin, spin, spin!

And something magical happened! While the flags were spinning, the little wooden pawns began to reappear.
One at a time, until they were all in the tallest tower of the castle.
Castle Robusto was very happy. He had found all his little friends.

Castle Robusto rested, content with his work.
The wind continued to blow and the flags danced.
Sometimes, finding what you’re looking for just takes a little time and patience.

plan.problema: The little wooden pawns got lost among my walls!
plan.svolta: I tried to push with my towers, but I only made dry leaves fall.
plan.finale: Then, I used the wind to make my flags rotate and the pawns reappeared in the highest tower!

castello.text:
Castle Rust lived in the playroom. It was a wooden castle, a little old and with some scratches. Its color had turned gray because of the weather and all the imaginary adventures it had lived through. Castle Rust felt very lonely. No one visited him anymore. There was no one who imagined battles or parties inside his walls.

“I wish I had a friend,” thought Castle Rust, as the wind whistled through his towers. “I wish I had someone to play with.”

One day, Castle Rust had an idea. He decided to throw a surprise party! He used his colorful blocks to build a grand entrance, a magnificent entrance full of color. It was the best way to get attention.

While he was working, Poldo the teddy bear, an old friend of Castle Rust, saw him. “What are you doing?” asked Poldo. “It looks like fun!”

Castle Rust smiled. Soon, other toys arrived: the porcelain doll, the remote control car, and the electric train. Everyone wanted to join Castle Rust’s party. They had so much fun building block castles, organizing small battles, and telling stories.

Castle Rust didn’t feel lonely anymore. He was surrounded by his friends and the playroom was full of laughter. Castle Rust realized that having friends was the most important thing in the world. And he knew that a happy heart is always better than a new castle.

plan.problema: The Castle Rust felt lonely and no one visited it.
plan.svolta: He decided to organize a surprise party, building a large entrance with colorful blocks.
plan.finale: All his toy friends arrived at the party and the Castle Rust didn't feel lonely anymore.

castello.text:
Castello Rocco was a very big wooden castle.
It lived in the Secret Garden, under the shade of the big apple tree.
It was a strong castle with lots of towers, but it felt lonely.
No one visited it anymore. Days went by and Castello Rocco stayed still, watching the butterflies dance.

“I wish I had someone to play with,” thought Castello Rocco. “I wish I could hear laughter!”
So he made a decision. He decided to have a big party! 

Castello Rocco called all his friends: small stuffed dragons that he had in a corner of the garden.
He invited them to a party with apple pie and snacks. At first, only a few dragons arrived.
Then, one by one, more dragons appeared. There was Blue Dragon, Green Dragon, and even Orange Dragon!

The dragons flew around Castello Rocco, playing and joking.
They climbed the castle towers, chased the butterflies, and giggled.
The Secret Garden filled with happy chaos. 

Castello Rocco didn't feel lonely anymore.
He was surrounded by his dragon friends.
The party continued until sunset, with everyone playing together happily.
Castello Rocco realized that having friends was much better than being alone. 

The Secret Garden shone with laughter and colors, a place full of joy.

plan.problema: The Rocco Castle felt lonely and no one visited it.
plan.svolta: He decided to organize a big party with lots of little plush dragons to attract attention.
plan.finale: All the dragons joined the Rocco Castle, creating a cheerful confusion and filling the garden with laughter.

castello.text:
Castle Red was a very big castle. It lived in the playroom. It was made of red wood and had tall, narrow towers. Castle Red loved being there, but he felt lonely. There was no one to play with. There weren't children to fight against his plastic soldiers or to build bridges with his building blocks.

“I wish I had some friends,” thought Castle Red. “I would like someone to visit me.” He felt sad and quiet. His bell, hanging on the main door, never rang.

Then, Castle Red had an idea! He decided to have a party. He called all his friends: the little teddy bear Bruno, the princess doll Sofia, and the soldier Carlo. “It will be a big party!” he shouted. “We will dance and sing!”

Castle Red started to play music with a small phone shell. Bruno started to dance, Sofia sang sweet melodies, and Carlo took soldier steps. The playroom filled with laughter and joy. Castle Red felt happier than ever. He had so many friends around him.

The music and laughter filled the room, and Castle Red finally felt happy and surrounded by friendship. Together, all the toys had discovered how wonderful it was to share a moment of carefree fun.

plan.problema: The Red Castle felt lonely and wanted its inhabitants to play with him.
plan.svolta: He decided to organize a big party, inviting all the dolls in the room to dance and sing.
plan.finale: Music and laughter filled the room, and the Red Castle finally felt happy and surrounded by friendship.

castello.text:
Castle Strong lived in a dusty attic. He was a wooden castle, very big and full of towers. Every day he dreamed of welcoming brave little dragons who would visit him. But today he wasn’t happy. His towers were upside down! They had fallen to the ground and none of his little dragons could get to the castle.

“Oh no, oh no!” said Castle Strong. “How will my dragons play here if I can’t welcome them?” He felt very sad. He tried to shout loudly to ask for help, but the attic was too big and quiet.

Castle Strong tried to use his walls to line up the towers. He pushed with all his might, but the walls were too stiff. They didn’t move even a centimetre! “I can’t do it!” thought Castle Strong. He began to feel frustrated.

Then, suddenly, Castle Strong had an idea. He began to vibrate slowly at first, then more and more. His walls began to move slowly. The towers retreated gently and, little by little, they found their correct place.

A little mouse, who lived in the attic, watched the scene with curiosity. “How lovely!” said the mouse. “It seems you took your time.” Castle Strong felt happy. His towers were straight again and his dragons could finally get to the castle. Everything was back to normal. 

Castle Strong realized that sometimes, to solve a problem, you just have to wait for the right moment and do things calmly. Patience can help even the biggest objects.

plan.problema: My towers have turned upside down and I can’t get my little dragons to the castle anymore!
plan.svolta: I tried to use my walls to realign the towers, but they were too stiff and I couldn’t move.
plan.finale: Then I started to vibrate slowly and the towers retreated gently, finding their correct place!

castello.text:
Castle Strong was a very strong wooden castle.
It lived in the Flower Garden, among red roses and yellow sunflowers.
It was a castle that could talk and move a little bit.
One day, Castle Strong found himself all alone.
His friends, the children who had built it with him, had gone away for the summer.

“Oh no!” said Castle Strong. “I feel very sad. There’s no one to play with.”
The sun was shining, the birds were singing, but Castle Strong didn’t care.
He was just an abandoned castle in the garden.

Castle Strong thought about what to do.
Then he had an idea!
He started to move slowly, pushing his wooden walls towards the most beautiful flowers in the garden.
He built a long path made of yellow tulips and blue violets.
The path was very twisty and full of bright colors.

A little girl, Sofia, was walking in the Flower Garden with her grandmother.
She saw the colorful path and went up to Castle Strong.
“How lovely!” exclaimed Sofia.
She started to run along the path, laughing happily.
Her grandmother followed her, smiling.

Soon, other children arrived to explore the path.
They built little flower houses around Castle Strong and surrounded him with joy.
Castle Strong finally felt happy.
He realized that even a lonely castle can become friends with everyone with a little kind gesture.

plan.problema: The Strong Castle found itself all alone, without anyone to play with.
plan.svolta: He decided to build a long and winding flower path to attract the children’s attention.
plan.finale: The children, curious about the colorful path, explored it and began to play around the Strong Castle, making him happy.

castello.text:
Castello Forte was a very strong wooden castle.
It lived in the playroom, among many other toys.
It had tall towers and shiny battlements.
Castello Forte loved to just sit still, watching the children play.

One day, something changed.
The children stopped playing there.
No one touched it anymore.
Castello Forte found himself all alone.
He was sad.
There was no one to fight with or to build a castle with.
Just the silence of the playroom.

Castello Forte thought, “I must do something!”
So, he took all his pieces of wood and started to build.
He built a giant wall around himself.
It was tall and strong!
He hoped that the wall would attract someone’s attention.
No one looked at it.
The wall was just a big wall.

Castello Forte felt even more alone.
Then, suddenly, a little girl came into the playroom.
Her name was Sofia.
Sofia sat down near Castello Forte and started to tell him fantastic stories of brave princesses and good dragons.
Castello Forte listened carefully, smiling.

Sofia talked to him for a long time, inventing incredible adventures.
Castello Forte felt happier than ever before.
He realized that even a lonely castle could be happy if it had someone to share its stories with. 

Castello Forte and Sofia played together, and the playroom seemed brighter and full of joy.

plan.problema: The Stronghold Castle found himself all alone, without anyone to play with!
plan.svolta: He decided to build a giant wall around himself to attract attention.
plan.finale: Suddenly, a little girl entered the playroom and began to tell him funny stories, making him happy.

castello.text:
Castle Strong was a very special castle. It was made of wood and stone, and it could talk! It lived in the playroom, next to the drawing table and the building blocks box. Castle Strong loved his little knights, the ones made of plastic that climbed on his walls.

One day, Castle Strong noticed a problem. He was stuck in his own courtyard! The mud had gripped him tightly and he couldn't move. His knights were outside, waiting to play, but he couldn’t welcome them. “Oh no!” said Castle Strong, with his deep and a little rough voice.

Castle Strong thought, thought, thought. Then he had an idea! He decided to take apart his tallest tower. Carefully, he began to remove the small pieces of wood. He used the tower as a lever, pushing it with force against the hard mud. It was hard work, but Castle Strong didn’t give up.

Finally, after a lot of effort, he managed to make a movement. The tower moved slightly and the mud began to slide away. Castle Strong pushed again, with all his energy. With one last effort, he pulled himself completely out of the mud! 

His warrior knights welcomed him happily, ready for new adventures. Castle Strong smiled, happy to have them finally back among his walls. The playroom was full of laughter and courage. Castle Strong realized that with patience and determination, even the biggest obstacles can be overcome.

plan.problema: The Stronghold Castle got stuck in its own courtyard, unable to host its little knights.
plan.svolta: He decided to take apart his tallest tower and use it as a lever to free himself from the mud.
plan.finale: With one last effort, the Stronghold Castle pulled itself out of the mud and happily welcomed its warrior friends.

colosseo.text:
Colosseo was a giant made of plastic. He lived in a big playroom, full of toy trains, dolls, and building blocks. But Colosseo felt lonely. No one looked at him anymore. The other toys were always being played with, but he stayed there, still on a little table.

“I wish I were important,” Colosseo thought. He had seen lots of stories about brave gladiators and epic battles. He wished he could be a real gladiator! 

One day, Colosseo made a decision. “I’ll put on a show!” he shouted, trying to move his small arms. He started to copy the movements of the gladiators he had seen in the stories. He jumped up and down, pretending to fight with a small piece of wood he found on the floor.

A little girl, Sofia, came into the playroom. She saw Colosseo putting on his show. She was amazed by the giant who moved so well. She smiled and clapped her hands every time he moved. Other children arrived, drawn to Colosseo’s bravery. Everyone was surprised!

Colosseo continued to put on his show, with enthusiasm and determination. Finally, everyone was looking at him and liking him. He felt happy and important. He had shown that even a simple toy can do great things if you put in the effort. 

Sofia came up to Colosseo and said, “You’re fantastic!” Colosseo understood that joy comes when you dedicate yourself bravely to what you love.

plan.problema: The Colosseum felt lonely and no one looked at him.
plan.svolta: He decided to put on a big show, imitating the gladiator battles he had seen in a thousand stories!
plan.finale: The children were enchanted by his courage and his movements, and the Colosseum finally felt appreciated.

colosseo.text:
Colosseo was a giant plastic statue. He lived in the playroom, among the toy trains and dolls. Every day he waited excitedly for someone to use him to make his gladiators fight. Colosseo loved to see the little warriors engaged in brave duels.

But one afternoon, something didn’t go right. When Colosseo pressed the button to start the battle, nothing happened. The gladiators stayed still. “Oh no!” exclaimed Colosseo. “I can’t make them fight anymore!” He was very frustrated.

A little girl, Sofia, came closer and said, “Maybe something is blocking you?” Colosseo thought. He decided to do something important. With great care, he began to take apart his walls, one brick at a time. It was a slow and delicate job.

Sofia helped him, placing the bricks in a corner. Colosseo was focused. Finally, he found a small piece of wood stuck between two stones. He pulled it out carefully. 

Colosseo realigned the piece of wood carefully and pressed the button. The gladiators moved! They began to fight with passion. Colosseo was very happy. He had solved the problem thanks to his patience. 

Sofia smiled. “Good job, Colosseo!” she said. Colosseo, satisfied, went back to waiting for the next duel, remembering that even the biggest problems can be overcome with calmness and dedication.

plan.problema: The Colosseum has stopped and can’t fight its gladiators anymore!
plan.svolta: He decided to carefully take apart his walls to see if anything was stuck.
plan.finale: He managed to free a small piece of wood, which, by carefully aligning it, got the gladiators working again!

colosseo.text:
Colosseo was a plastic giant. He lived in Leo’s garden. 
He was a strong giant, with tall towers and a floor full of cracks. 
But Colosseo felt very lonely. 
Every day he watched the other toys: the dolls, the toy cars, the stuffed animals. 
Nobody wanted to fight with him. 
“I’m too serious,” thought Colosseo. 
“Nobody wants me for the battles.”

He had become sad and quiet. 
He sat there, in the grass under the tree, waiting for something that didn’t arrive. 
Leo played hide-and-seek, but he didn’t come near Colosseo. 
Leo’s cat, Micio, looked at him curiously, but then he went back to sleep.

Colosseo had an idea! 
He decided to have a party. 
He started to collect all the little colorful flags that he found in the garden. 
He attached them to his towers and his floor. 
He made small spaces for the fights, but this time with lots of colors. 
“Maybe if there’s fun,” thought Colosseo, “someone will want to join me.”

After a while, the dolls arrived. 
Then the toy cars. 
Finally, Micio came closer and started to play with the flags. 
All the toys joined Colosseo’s party. 
He was happy! 
He realized it was better to share the fun than to fight alone.

Colosseo smiled. 
His party was a success. 
And while everyone laughed and had fun, Colosseo realized that true joy is when you share it with others.

plan.problema: The Colosseum felt lonely and sad because nobody wanted to fight with him.
plan.svolta: He decided to organize a big party with lots of small, colorful flags, hoping to attract the attention of the other toys in the garden.
plan.finale: All the toys joined the party and the Colosseum realized that it was better to share fun than to fight.

colosseo.text:
Colosseo was a plastic Colosseum. He lived in the playroom, among toy trains and soldiers. Colosseo loved to imagine brave battles. He always looked for his plastic friends to make them fight. But often there wasn't anyone! He felt very lonely.

“I wish I had friends to play with,” thought Colosseo, “but no one calls me.” He had sat on his wooden pedestal, watching the train go back and forth. The train said to him: "Hello Colosseo! What are you doing?"

Colosseo had an idea. He decided to build a little wall around himself. He wanted to create his own little fortress, hoping that the loneliness would disappear. He put colorful blocks one on top of the other, concentrating on his work. The wall was ready in a short time.

But when he finished, he felt even more lonely. The wall separated him from all the other toys. No one came close to him. “This doesn’t work,” said Colosseo with a sigh.

Then, a little teddy bear, Bruno, came closer. “Why are you sitting here all alone, Colosseo? We could play together!” Colosseo realized that friendship is built by sharing and inviting everyone to play together.

So, Colosseo started to organize fun races for his playmates. The trains ran, the soldiers fought, and Bruno laughed happily. Colosseo was no longer alone. 

He realized that the real battle wasn't the one between plastics, but the one to have real friends.

plan.problema: The Colosseum felt lonely and couldn't organize brave battles with his plastic friends.
plan.svolta: He decided to build a small wall around himself, hoping that the loneliness would disappear, but the wall made him feel even more isolated.
plan.finale: He realized that friendship is built by sharing and inviting everyone to play together, so he started to organize fun races for his fellow players.

colosseo.text:
Colosseo was a plastic giant. He lived in a big playroom, full of toy trains, dolls, and building blocks. Colosseo loved being there, but he felt very lonely. Nobody wanted to fight with him. The other toys preferred to race or build castles.

Colosseo dreamed of seeing people around him, maybe children shouting when they hit him. But nobody seemed interested in him. He was a giant who just wanted to have friends.

One day, Colosseo had an idea. “I’ll organize a race!” he thought. “I’ll make them throw balls at me!” He took all the colorful pebbles he had in his box and spread them on the playroom floor. 

Giulia, a girl with red braids, saw Colosseo. She started to throw balls at him. Then other children joined the game. Everyone wanted to see who could hit Colosseo more often.

Colosseo was so happy! He could finally have fun and have playmates. The children’s laughter filled the playroom. He was full of energy and enthusiasm. 

Colosseo realized that to be happy, it wasn’t just about fighting. It was about sharing his time with others. And so, Colosseo and all the children in the playroom played together for a long time.

plan.problema: The Colosseum felt lonely and no one wanted to fight with him.
plan.svolta: He decided to organize a big ball throwing race, hoping to attract attention.
plan.finale: All the children enjoyed throwing them at the Colosseum, making him happy and full of friends.

colosseo.text:
Colosseo was a giant plastic colosseum. A beautiful colosseum, with tall towers and red stones. But he felt very lonely in the playroom. It was full of cars, dolls, and balls. Nobody looked at him. Colosseo wanted to be important.

“I wish someone would see me,” he thought. “I wish someone would ask me something.” But nobody touched him, nobody stared at him. Only the children ran and laughed around him, without noticing the big colosseum there.

Colosseo made a decision. “I’ll put on a show!” he shouted out loud, trying to make his voice heard. He started to shake, pretending to be fighting. He imagined the gladiators he had seen in his dreams, with their armor and their swords. He moved back and forth, simulating a big battle.

A boy, Leo, stopped in front of Colosseo. He was curious about the giant that seemed to be dancing all by himself. Then other children arrived. Everyone wanted to see the little colosseum putting on a show. They came closer, gently touched him, and admired him.

Colosseo felt a warmth inside of him. He wasn't lonely anymore. He was surrounded by people who were looking at him with interest and wonder. The playroom seemed brighter and full of joy. Colosseo realized that sharing his actions made everyone happy. And so, the little colosseum continued his shows, always surrounded by the admiration of the children.

plan.problema: The Colosseum feels lonely and no one looks at it.
plan.svolta: He decided to organize a small show, imitating the gladiator battles he had seen in his dreams.
plan.finale: The children, curious about his actions, began to surround him admiring his courage and his greatness.

colosseo.text:
Colosseo was a giant of wood. A beautiful colosseum, but very lonely. It was in a big playroom full of trains, dolls, and building blocks. Colosseo felt sad. Nobody really looked at him. The other toys seemed more important, the ones that ran or made sounds.

Colosseo wanted so much to be the center of attention. He wanted to make someone laugh. “I wish I could do something special,” thought Colosseo. “But what?”

Suddenly, he had an idea! Colosseo decided to organize a historical reenactment. With an effort, he made some small wooden blocks fall from his tiers. The blocks fell with a dull thud on the floor. It was almost as if gladiators were fighting!

A boy, Marco, came up to Colosseo. He smiled seeing the blocks falling. Then other children arrived. They sat around Colosseo and giggled when the blocks simulated a fight. Colosseo felt a warmth inside him. He was happy!

Marco took one of the blocks and made it fall again, right next to Colosseo. The colosseum leaned slightly as a greeting. Finally, Colosseo was part of the fun. He felt important and not lonely anymore.

plan.problema: The Colosseum felt lonely and no one looked at him.
plan.svolta: He decided to organize a grand historical reenactment, making 'fall' small wooden blocks from his tiers to entertain everyone.
plan.finale: The children approached, laughing at the small simulations of battles and the Colosseum finally felt part of the party.

colosseo.text:
Colosseo was a plastic giant. He lived in the garden, next to the old rose bush. He was a sturdy Colosseum, with tall towers and an arena where gladiators fought, at least in his mind. But Colosseo felt lonely.

Every day, the garden cats watched him pass by, but they didn’t say anything. The dog, Rocco, sniffed his base, then ran off to play. No one seemed interested in his big show. Colosseo wished he could organize a real fight, with races and honors, but no one looked at him.

One day, Colosseo had an idea. He took his colorful sand grains that were in his base. He started to build a giant sculpture. It was a representation of an epic battle, with gladiators in armor and wild animals. The sculpture became bigger and bigger, as tall as the rose bush!

Colosseo’s mom, seeing his creation, called the children of the garden. The children approached curiously. They were amazed by the sculpture. They sat around Colosseo and admired him. 

Colosseo was filled with joy. He realized that his creativity made a difference. Finally, someone was looking at him and appreciating him. The garden was full of laughter and children dreaming of gladiator battles. Colosseo knew he was special, because even the simplest things can create something wonderful.

plan.problema: The Colosseum felt lonely and wanted to organize a big show, but no one was looking at him.
plan.svolta: He decided then to make a giant sculpture with his sand grains to attract the attention of the children in the garden.
plan.finale: The children were enchanted by the sculpture and the Colosseum was filled with joy, finally knowing he was admired.

colosseo.text:
Colosseo was a giant plastic statue. He lived in the playroom of a shopping mall. He was big and red, full of little figures of gladiators. Colosseo had towers that you could make go up and down with a simple gesture. But Colosseo felt lonely.

Every day he saw lots of children come in and out. Some looked at him, but nobody touched him or really played with him. Colosseo wanted to have fun with the children, but nobody seemed to want to use him. He felt sad and a little frustrated. He didn’t understand why he couldn’t make anyone smile.

One day, Colosseo had an idea. He decided to put on a show all by himself! He took his little figures of gladiators and started making them fight. The gladiators clashed on a small area that he had inside him. Colosseo made sword noises and shouts, as if it were a real battle.

A girl, Sofia, came into the playroom. She saw Colosseo busy with his show. Sofia was fascinated. She smiled and applauded the tiny gladiators. Other children also came to watch Colosseo. Everyone was happy to see Colosseo having fun and creating a little world of adventure.

Colosseo realized right away that his strength wasn’t just in his big, red appearance, but in the joy he could bring to others. And so, Colosseo continued to play with his gladiators, sharing his fun with everyone who wanted to see him. It was beautiful to see the children happy together.

plan.problema: The Colosseum felt lonely and couldn't make the children happy.
plan.svolta: He decided to organize a small show, simulating battles with his miniature figures.
plan.finale: The children were fascinated and the Colosseum realized that his strength was in creating joy.

colosseo.text:
Colosseo was a giant plastic colosseum. He lived in a big playroom full of toys. He was a beautiful colosseum, with his statues and his arches. But Colosseo felt very lonely. No one looked at him anymore. The other toys ran and jumped, but no one stopped to admire him.

Colosseo let out a big sigh. “How sad,” he thought. “I wish someone would see me.” He felt like he didn't have a purpose. He spent his hours still, staring at the playroom floor. Sometimes, a little girl would come in and quickly look at all the toys, but then she ran away without noticing him.

Then Colosseo had an idea! He decided to put on a show. He used his statues to create little scenes of battles. The gladiators moved, the wolves howled, and the audience (that’s the other toys) applauded. He was a real plastic colosseum putting on an ancient drama!

A boy came into the playroom with his mom. He saw Colosseo putting on his show. He stood with his mouth open, amazed by those little moving figures. His mom looked too, smiling. Other children came closer to see what was happening.

Colosseo was surrounded by children who admired him and listened to him. He was no longer lonely. He was happy to have brought joy to everyone with his little show. Creativity made the difference. Colosseo realized that even a plastic colosseum can be important if he knows how to express himself.

plan.problema: The Colosseum felt lonely and no one looked at it.
plan.svolta: He decided then to organize a small show with his statues, attracting the attention of the children.
plan.finale: The children were enchanted and the Colosseum was no longer alone.

dollhouse.text:
Casa Bambola was sitting on the dusty attic. The dust danced in the sunbeams that filtered through the window. Casa Bambola loved the attic, a quiet place where it could think and dream. But today there was a big mess!

The dolls, all small and with colorful dresses, were scattered everywhere. Sofia, the red doll, was trying to sleep on the rug. Marco, the blue boy, had fallen asleep on a box. And Giulia, the princess in silk, couldn't find her bed!

“Oh no!” said Casa Bambola, with a little sigh. “I can’t make beautiful rooms if the dolls don’t have a place to sleep!”

Casa Bambola decided to do something. It moved slowly, rearranging its furniture. It took small pieces of fabric and used them to create soft beds. Then it found empty boxes that became perfect bedside tables for the dolls.

With patience and care, Casa Bambola put everything back in its place. Sofia had her bed with a red blanket, Marco a small blue sofa, and Giulia a princess bedroom with a golden bedside table.

All the dolls happily settled in, smiling at Casa Bambola who welcomed them. They felt cuddled and protected. The attic had become a magical place, full of order and tranquility. Every object had its own space, and this made everything more beautiful.

plan.problema: The dolls couldn't find their sleeping places!
plan.svolta: She decided to organize the furniture carefully, creating little beds and nightstands.
plan.finale: All the dolls settled happily, smiling at the Dollhouse that welcomed them.

dollhouse.text:
Doll House was on the dusty attic. It was a wooden house, with many rooms and small windows. The dolls who lived inside the house were very worried. “Where have our dresses gone?” asked Sofia, a doll with a flower dress. Even Giulia, with her princess dress, was sad. No one knew where all their beautiful things had disappeared to.

Doll House felt the sadness of the dolls. “Don’t worry,” said Doll House. “I will help you find them.” The house decided to go on an exploring trip. It opened every door, opened every window. It examined the living room, the kitchen, and the bedroom. It even checked the bathroom!

Then, Doll House had an idea. It gently moved the sofa in the living room. Under the sofa, there were many dresses! Doll House opened a drawer of the bedside table and there it found the princess dresses. It opened a wardrobe in the bedroom and inside it had the flower dresses. Everything was in its place!

A little mouse, Pipistrell, watched the scene with curiosity. “Wow! How wonderful!” said Pipistrell.

Doll House smiled. It had solved the mystery. It was important to put things back where they belong. Every object had its own space and when everything was in order, there were no more worries. Doll House felt happy and the dolls were happy. The dusty attic seemed much brighter.

plan.problema: The dolls didn’t know where their dresses had gone!
plan.svolta: He decided to take an exploratory walk, opening every door and window in the house.
plan.finale: He found the dresses hidden inside the furniture, solving the mystery with a smile.

dollhouse.text:
Casa Bambola si trovava sulla soffitta polverosa. Era un posto pieno di ombre e di vecchi oggetti dimenticati. Casa Bambola amava la sua soffitta, anche se a volte era un po’ spaventosa.

Dentro, le bambole della stanza erano tutte spaventate. Non volevano giocare insieme. La principessa Amelia si nascondeva dietro il divanetto in velluto rosso. Il soldatino Carlo dormiva sul letto di piume. E la bambola di pezza Rosa era seduta in un angolo, con lo sguardo perso nel vuoto.

Casa Bambola si sentiva triste per loro. Voleva che si divertissero! Così, decise di fare qualcosa. Provò ad aprire le finestre più piccole della soffitta. Cercava di far entrare la luce del sole, sperando che potesse riscaldare i cuoricini delle bambole. Ma le bambole rimasero chiuse e silenziose. Non sorridevano.

Casa Bambola si sentiva ancora più giù di morale. Poi ebbe un’idea! Ricordò che le bambole amavano le storie e il tè. Prese una piccola teiera di plastica bianca e alcune tazze colorate. Le posizionò sul tavolo in legno intarsiato. Invitò le bambole a sedersi intorno.

“Facciamo un piccolo tè!” esclamò Casa Bambola. Lentamente, la principessa Amelia si alzò dal divanetto. Il soldatino Carlo aprì gli occhi e si avvicinò al tavolo. E anche la bambola di pezza Rosa sorrise timidamente. Insieme, le quattro bambole bevvero il tè e raccontarono storie divertenti. Ridacchiavano e giocavano felici.

Casa Bambola era contentissima. Era bello vedere le bambole così felici insieme. Capì che a volte, basta un po’ di compagnia per far tornare il sorriso sul volto di qualcuno. La soffitta polverosa non sembrava più così spaventosa.

plan.problema: The dolls in my room were all scared and didn’t want to play together.
plan.svolta: I tried to open the windows to let in the sunlight, but the dolls stayed closed and silent.
plan.finale: Then I had a little tea with plastic teapots and colorful cups, and the dolls started to laugh and play happily!

dollhouse.text:
Casa Bambola was located on the dusty attic. It was a wooden house, full of small rooms and doll furniture. Casa Bambola loved her attic, but lately she felt sad. The dolls that lived inside her didn't have a place to play anymore. The kitchen was too small, the living room too cramped.

“Oh no,” said Casa Bambola with a faint voice. “I feel lonely. My dolls are unhappy.”

A little mouse, Pipì, was watching Casa Bambola from his wooden desk. Pipì was a quiet and curious friend. He saw that Casa Bambola really seemed sad. 

“What’s happening?” asked Pipì with his squeaky voice.

“I don’t have enough space for everyone,” replied Casa Bambola, squeezing her little doors. “The dolls don’t have anywhere to play!”

Casa Bambola had an idea! She decided to organize a big party. She invited all the furniture: the puff sofa, the rocking chair, even the table lamp. She told them they would create a new space for the dolls. Everyone offered to help. The puff sofa stretched a little, the rocking chair moved a small table. 

The party was a success! Some birds arrived to sing and play with the dolls. Casa Bambola was full of friends, laughter, and colors. Finally, she had become a real house, full of joy. Pipì fell asleep on the window, smiling. 

Casa Bambola realized that having friends made everything better.

plan.problema: The dolls no longer have a room to play in and the Dollhouse feels lonely.
plan.svolta: She decided to organize a big party, inviting all the animals of her furniture to make room.
plan.finale: The Dollhouse filled with friends and laughter, finally becoming a house full of joy.

dollhouse.text:
Doll House was on the dusty attic. The dust was everywhere, on the miniature furniture and the walls painted a faded blue. Doll House wasn’t a normal house. It was alive! It could move, open the windows, and even talk.

“Oh no!” said Doll House with a tiny voice. “The dolls are all scattered around the attic and nobody can get in! They’re too sad.”

There were six dolls: Sofia, Lucia, Martina, Giulia, Elena, and Beatrice. They were all sitting alone, huddled in a dark corner. Doll House felt terribly guilty. It wanted them all to play together.

It noticed a small screwdriver next to an old trunk. “Maybe…” thought Doll House. It gently took the screwdriver. It was cold and light in its little wooden hands. It went to the lock of the main door. It had to be very careful.

With slow and precise movements, Doll House used the screwdriver to open the lock. It turned, turned, with so much attention. It heard a slight click and then… the door opened!

The dolls shouted with joy! Sofia started to dance, Lucia sang a happy little song, Martina told fantastic stories. Elena and Beatrice ran around the room, happy to be all together. Doll House smiled. It was the most beautiful thing it had ever seen. The dolls held hands and laughed together.

Doll House realized that when everyone works together, things become much more fun.

plan.problema: The dolls have no one to play with because the door is closed!
plan.svolta: He decided to use a small screwdriver to carefully open the lock, being careful not to cause any damage.
plan.finale: Finally, the door opened and the dolls could dance and sing together, happy to be all together again.

dollhouse.text:
Doll House was a special house. It lived in the attic, in a place full of dust and cobwebs. It was made of wood and had many small rooms. Doll House could talk! And today, it was very worried.

“Oh no, oh no!” said Doll House with a sweet voice. “The dolls don’t know where to put their things! The bedroom is a mess, the kitchen is full of pans, and the living room has cushions everywhere.”

A little doll named Lila was complaining: “I can’t find my pink dress!” And a soldier, Marco, added: “And I don’t know where to put my shoes!” Doll House felt the confusion. It was really frustrating for everyone.

Doll House had an idea! It focused and with its little feet, it moved quickly through the rooms. It took colorful pieces of paper: red, yellow, blue, and green. It started to write labels. “Bedroom – Lila,” said Doll House. “Kitchen – Pans,” it wrote. And so on for all the rooms and all the objects.

The dolls followed Doll House’s instructions. It put Lila’s pink dress in the red drawer, the soldier’s shoes in a green corner, and arranged the cushions on the yellow sofa.

Finally, everything was in its place! The dolls happily settled into the house, each in its place, and Doll House shone with order. The sunlight coming through the window reflected on its colorful walls. It was a wonderful sight. Everything was so perfect and quiet. Doll House was beautiful when everything was in its place.

plan.problema: The dolls in the house were all mixed up and didn’t know where to put their things.
plan.svolta: He decided to make colorful labels for every room and every object, so everyone would know where to keep their things.
plan.finale: Finally, the dolls happily settled into the house, each in its place, and the dollhouse shone with order.

dollhouse.text:
Casa Bambole was located in the dusty attic. It was a wooden house, with small windows and a sloping roof. Casa Bambole could talk and move, but it was always alone. Its dolls, all dressed in silk and lace, were sitting on the sofa in the living room, but they didn't laugh. It seemed they felt sad.

“Oh, how I wish I had someone to play with!” whispered Casa Bambole. “My dolls are so quiet.” The dolls responded with a sigh. No one was keeping them company.

Casa Bambole had an idea! It decided to organize a party. It called the teaspoon, a small silver spoon, and the dancing pot, an old copper pot. “Come and join my party!” said Casa Bambole.

The teaspoon began to dance on the table, while the pot played a cheerful melody. The dolls began to move, to laugh, and to dance together. It was a fun party! The house full of laughter and movement seemed brighter.

Casa Bambole felt happy. It saw the dolls smiling, and this made it even happier. The dolls remained happy and sad, but mostly together, creating a joyful atmosphere. It was nice to have friends, even if they were made of wood and metal. The dusty attic seemed less dark.

plan.problema: The dolls feel lonely and have no one to play with.
plan.svolta: They decided to organize a party with the household objects, inviting the teacup and the pot to dance.
plan.finale: All the dolls stayed happy and sad, but mostly together, creating a joyful atmosphere.

dollhouse.text:
Casa Bambole was in the Play Corner. It was a little wooden house, with colorful windows and a red roof. Casa Bambole really loved its residents: the cloth dolls, the porcelain princesses, and the plastic knight.

One day, the dolls started running around the Play Corner. They were making so much noise! Then, suddenly, they stopped and started to complain. “We don’t know where to sleep!” shouted Princess Sofia. The knight Arturo added: “There isn’t enough space for everyone!”

Casa Bambole felt worried. It tried to help. It tried to organize the beds according to the size of the dolls, but it was a disaster! The beds fell over, the blankets got tangled, and the dolls weren’t happy.

“It’s not working!” exclaimed Casa Bambole. It thought for a little while. Then it had a brilliant idea. It opened a new door in the living room. It was a small door, but perfect! It made a little bed for Princess Sofia near the window. For the knight Arturo, it made a cozy corner with a soft rug. The cloth doll, Stella, also found a special place under the dining table.

All the dolls were happy and content. Casa Bambole felt satisfied. It had been a creative and fun solution. The sunlight came through the windows and lit up the Play Corner. Each doll had its own space, perfect for resting after a day full of games. The dolls slept peacefully and happily, and Casa Bambole knew that its house was always a magical place. Creativity always finds the right solution.

plan.problema: The dolls are mixed up and don’t know where to sleep!
plan.svolta: He tried to organize the beds according to the size of the dolls, but it was too messy.
plan.finale: Then he simply opened a new door and created a new space for each doll, making the house even cozier.

dollhouse.text:
House Doll was on the dusty attic. It was a house made of wood and paper, full of dolls dressed in silk and velvet. House Doll was all alone. The dolls were quiet, sitting on her armchairs or standing in front of her little tea table. The loneliness made her sad. Her rose garden, small but beautiful, had become gray and dull.

“There’s no one left to play with,” sighed House Doll. “It hurts me so much to see my roses so sad.”

She tried to make her windows turn, hoping to attract attention. She turned and turned the little glass windows, but no one noticed her. No one looked at her on the dusty attic. She was truly alone.

Then she had an idea! House Doll moved slowly, rearranging her furniture. She arranged her little fireplace so that the afternoon sunlight could enter and create light and shadow games on the walls. The dolls, now placed on a flower rug, appeared as small mysterious figures illuminated by the light.

Suddenly, she heard footsteps. Two children entered the attic. They approached with their eyes wide at the sight of the little show that House Doll had created. They stayed there for hours, admiring the lights and shadows. 

House Doll felt happy. The roses in her garden returned to bloom in a deep red. The dusty attic was no longer a lonely place. House Doll’s smile lit up the whole room. She realized that even a small creative gesture can bring joy and transform the world.

plan.problema: The dolls have no one to play with, and loneliness is making my rose garden very sad.
plan.svolta: I tried to make my windows turn to get attention, but nobody noticed me!
plan.finale: Then I used my furniture to create a little light and shadow show, and soon many children came to admire it.

dollhouse.text:
House Doll was on the dusty attic. It was a big house, made of wood and paper, with lots of small rooms. House Doll loved its inhabitants: the cloth dolls. But lately, it was worried. The dolls didn’t know where to sleep! The rooms were too small for everyone. The lace doll curled up in a corner, the soldier lay on a chair, and the princess had lost her canopy bed because there wasn’t enough space.

House Doll was upset. “I can’t do anything about it,” it thought. So, it made a decision. It decided to straighten the beds. It started with the lace doll’s bed. It made it a little wider, adjusting the felt mattress. Then, it moved on to the soldier, making the chair more spacious. Finally, it took care of the princess, moving the canopy bed to a wider corner.

House Doll worked calmly and carefully. It straightened the beds one at a time, without rushing. The little dolls settled comfortably in their new places. The lace doll lay down on her wool bed, the soldier curled up on her mesh bed, and the princess fell asleep in her canopy bed.

Everyone was sleeping peacefully. House Doll felt happy. The dusty attic had become a quiet and cozy place. When the sun began to set, the dolls were already asleep. House Doll knew that with patience and calmness, even the most difficult things can become easy.

plan.problema: The dolls didn’t know where to sleep because the rooms were too small!
plan.svolta: He decided to straighten the beds carefully, one at a time, to make more space.
plan.finale: Finally, all the dolls found their places and fell asleep happily.

eiffel tour.text:
The Eiffel Tower was a special toy. It lived in the playground and loved to watch the sun in the morning. It was tall and strong, made of shiny metal and with two big arms that reached up to the sky. Every day, the Eiffel Tower waited excitedly for the dawn.

But one day something didn't go right. The Eiffel Tower got stuck! It couldn't move anymore. The sun was behind it and it couldn't see the world. It was very sad. “Oh no!” thought the Eiffel Tower. “I can’t see anything!”

It tried to turn its arms, but it was too heavy to turn itself. There was no way to move. The Eiffel Tower felt a little scared. It saw Fido, the playground dog, playing with a red ball. “Fido,” called the Eiffel Tower, “could you help me?”

Fido sniffed the Eiffel Tower and then started to wag his tail. Running towards the red ball, he grabbed it and pulled it away. The ball was stuck behind it and was stopping the Eiffel Tower from turning! Once the ball was taken away, the Eiffel Tower moved gently.

The sun shone again on the top of the Eiffel Tower. It was happy! Fido wagged his tail excitedly. The Eiffel Tower understood that friendship can do amazing things. 
The Eiffel Tower and Fido became the best friends in the playground, always ready to help each other.

plan.problema: The Eiffel Tower got stuck and can’t see the sun anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to turn his arms, but he was too heavy to turn himself, so he asked for help from the dog Fido.
plan.finale: Fido wagged his tail and pulled away the ball that was blocking the Eiffel Tower, freeing it!

eiffel tour.text:
Tower Eiffel was a special toy. She was tall and golden, and she loved the playground very much. Every day the children watched her as they ran and laughed. But that day, Tower Eiffel felt sad. Suddenly, she couldn’t see her friends’ sandcastle anymore! The castle was huge, made of yellow sand and with very tall towers.

Tower Eiffel tried to turn around. She tried to move a little, but her base was too heavy. It was as if she was stuck in the playground ground. Tower Eiffel felt frustrated. She couldn’t see the sandcastle and none of her friends seemed to notice her problem.

Then, she saw some children playing with a shovel and pushing her. “Hello children!” said Tower Eiffel. “I’m stuck! I can’t see your sandcastle anymore.” The children came closer. Anna and Marco looked carefully at Tower Eiffel.

“We can help you!” exclaimed Marco. Together, the children gently pushed Tower Eiffel. They pushed her a little at a time, slowly, very slowly. With patience, Tower Eiffel’s base moved a little. Finally, Tower Eiffel was able to turn around and see the sandcastle! All the friends were very happy.

Tower Eiffel was so happy. Thanks to the children, she had found her favorite view again. The golden tower smiled at the sandcastle, knowing that even the hardest challenges can be overcome when you help each other.

plan.problema: The Eiffel Tower got stuck and can’t see her friends’ sandcastle anymore!
plan.svolta: She tried to turn around, but her base was too heavy to move on her own and decided to ask for help from the children playing.
plan.finale: The children helped the Eiffel Tower take a little step at a time until she could see the sandcastle again!

eiffel tour.text:
Torre Eiffel was a special toy. He loved to be in the playground. The other children looked at him and laughed. Torre Eiffel just wanted to see the sun every morning. It was his favorite game.

One day, however, something went wrong. Torre Eiffel got stuck! He couldn't move anymore. He couldn't see the sun rising on the horizon. “Oh no!” said Torre Eiffel, with a little metallic thump. “I can’t see the sun anymore!”

Torre Eiffel tried to turn quickly. He made a big effort, but nothing. Then he started to creak his parts, hoping someone would help him. But no one was there for him. Only a little teddy bear was sitting near his foot.

“Maybe if I move slowly,” thought Torre Eiffel. He started to turn very slowly. One turn… then another. Suddenly, he made a big smile! With an elegant and smooth movement, Torre Eiffel started to turn faster and faster. Finally, he was in his perfect position to admire the sun shining high in the sky.

The little teddy bear watched him with smiling eyes. Torre Eiffel stopped for a moment and gave one last look at the sun, then continued to make his slow and quiet rotations. Every day, Torre Eiffel was always able to see the sun. And he knew that if you never give up, you always find the solution.

plan.problema: The Eiffel Tower got stuck and couldn’t see the sun anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to turn around and creak his parts, but nothing worked.
plan.finale: Suddenly he made a big smile and, with an elegant movement, he began to rotate slowly, finding his perfect position to admire the sun!

eiffel tour.text:
Torre Eiffel was a very tall and golden toy. He loved to be in the Land of Fairytales Park. The park was full of candy houses, lemonade rivers, and chocolate waterfalls! One day, Torre Eiffel was near the biggest waterfall when… he got lost! He was surrounded by mountains of dark chocolate. He didn’t recognize anything.

Torre Eiffel was very worried. He tried to call for help with his bell, but the sound was too small to reach anyone. No one could hear him among the chocolate waterfalls. He felt lonely and a little scared. “Help! Help!” he shouted with all his might, but no one answered.

Then, Torre Eiffel saw a little green figure sitting on a giant mushroom. It was a very kind elf. The elf had gathered all the lost toys: teddy bears, toy cars, and dolls. They were all in the center of the Land of Fairytales Park.

The elf helped Torre Eiffel find his place among the other toys. Torre Eiffel felt much happier right away. With his new friends, Torre Eiffel watched the chocolate waterfalls and laughed. 

Working together had solved the problem. All the toys were back home, and the Land of Fairytales Park was even more beautiful than before.

plan.problema: The Eiffel Tower was lost among the chocolate waterfalls!
plan.svolta: He tried to call for help with his bell, but nobody heard him.
plan.finale: Then he discovered that a little elf had gathered all the lost toys and arranged them in the center of the park!

eiffel tour.text:
The Eiffel Tower was a very special toy. She loved to turn and show her beautiful views to the children in the playground. Every day, the children would sit beside her to watch the cars and other toys.

But one day, the Eiffel Tower got stuck! She couldn't move anymore. She was very sad because she couldn't show her world to the children. “Oh no!” she thought. “How will the children have fun without me?”

She decided she had to do something. Then, she started to turn quickly around the playground, looking for a small piece that was lost. It was a little blue plastic piece and she needed it for her mechanism. The little Sofia, a girl who was playing nearby, watched the Eiffel Tower with curiosity. “Maybe you lost it near the swing?” she said.

The Eiffel Tower followed Sofia’s advice and indeed, under the swing, she found the piece! With a little ‘click’, the Eiffel Tower started to turn majestically. The children shouted with joy and ran to admire her beautiful colors. The Eiffel Tower smiled. She was happy to be able to entertain everyone again. 

Patience, even when things seem difficult, can lead to the most beautiful solution.

plan.problema: The Eiffel Tower got stuck and can no longer show its beautiful views to the children.
plan.svolta: He decided to take a quick ride around the playground to find a small piece lost, necessary for his mechanism.
plan.finale: He found the piece under a swing and, with a slight 'click', the Eiffel Tower resumed turning majestically, lighting up everyone’s smiles.

eiffel tour.text:
Tower Eiffel was a special toy. He loved being at the playground. He saw lots of children running and laughing. He really liked watching them play on the swings and build sandcastles.

One day, Tower Eiffel noticed that he couldn’t see the children anymore. Everything around him was gray. “Oh no!” he thought. “I’m lost!” He couldn’t see any of his little friends. He felt a little sad.

Tower Eiffel tried to do something. He stretched his longest arm, but it was too short! He couldn’t get close enough to the children to see their smiles. He was frustrated. A little teddy bear, Leo, watched him with concern.

“Maybe if you use your top,” Leo suggested. Tower Eiffel focused. He stretched his top all the way up to the sky. The top was tall and big! And indeed, the children saw Tower Eiffel right away.

Everyone ran to him. They hugged him around with their arms. Tower Eiffel felt happy. He had found a way to say hello to his friends. It was nice to be seen again. 

Tower Eiffel’s top continued to wave a giant hello to the children who were laughing and playing. His top was so big, and all the children were hugging it.

plan.problema: The Eiffel Tower got lost and couldn't see the children playing anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to use his arm to reach out, but it was too short!
plan.finale: Then he used his top to give a giant wave to the children, and they ran to hug him.

eiffel tour.text:
Tower Eiffel was a special toy. He was tall, made of shiny metal, and loved watching the children play in the playground. Every day he saw the swings, the bouncy castle, and the slide. He really liked watching them.

But Tower Eiffel had a little problem. He was too short! He couldn’t see the children playing near the sandbox very well. Sometimes he felt a little sad because he couldn’t join in their fun.

One day, a little dog named Leo ran towards him. “Tower Eiffel, are you sad?” Leo barked. Tower Eiffel replied, “I want to see the children, but I’m too low!”

Then Tower Eiffel had an idea. He walked over to the big tree in the playground. It was the tallest tree he knew. “Maybe I can climb to the top,” he thought. And so he did! He climbed and climbed until he reached the highest branch. 

Finally, Tower Eiffel could see all the children. They were laughing, running, and having fun. The children, seeing Tower Eiffel at the top of the tree, ran to welcome him with shouts of joy and applause. Tower Eiffel smiled. He was happy to be part of their game.

The view was wonderful for everyone. And he knew that sometimes, to see the most beautiful things, you have to lift yourself up a little.

plan.problema: The Eiffel Tower can’t see the children playing in the park because it’s too low.
plan.svolta: They decide to climb to the top of the big tree to be noticed.
plan.finale: Seeing the Eiffel Tower on top of the tree, the children run to welcome it with shouts of joy and applause.
plan.morale: Friendship is built by sharing the view.

eiffel tour.text:
The Eiffel Tower was a very tall toy. It lived in the Flower Garden, among red roses and yellow sunflowers. It loved the garden so much, but it especially loved looking at the sky. One day, while marveling at a cloud shaped like a rabbit, the Eiffel Tower realized it was lost!

It was surrounded by fragrant flowers, but it couldn't find its way up. It didn't know how to return to the sky, where it loved to be and shine. It was a little sad and confused. “Oh no!” said the Eiffel Tower, “I’m lost!”

Then it had an idea. The Eiffel Tower had special antennas that could make light. So, it started flashing, flash, flash! It sent bright signals into the flower-filled garden. A little green crocodile, Leo, was watching the flowers when he saw the light of the Eiffel Tower.

Leo walked up to the Eiffel Tower and followed its bright glow. The Eiffel Tower flashed more and more brightly as Leo followed it among the white daisies and purple tulips. Finally, the Eiffel Tower reached the top of the hill! It stood there majestic, tall, and shining.

The brightest butterfly in the garden followed the light signal of the Eiffel Tower. The Eiffel Tower was happy to be back home. Looking at the blue sky, it understood that even when things seem difficult, if you don’t give up, you always find the solution.

plan.problema: The Eiffel Tower got lost among the flowers and can't find her way to the sky!
plan.svolta: She decided to use her antennas to send out a bright signal, hoping someone would guide her.
plan.finale: Finally, a brilliant butterfly followed the light of the Eiffel Tower to the top of the hill, where it stood majestic!

eiffel tour.text:
The Eiffel Tower was a shiny metal toy. She loved to be in the Park of Sculptures. The statues were big and strange, some smiled, and others seemed thoughtful. The Eiffel Tower enjoyed watching them all.

---

One day, while the wind was blowing hard, the Eiffel Tower noticed she was alone. “Oh no!” she cried. “I don’t know where I am anymore! I’m lost among all these statues!” She turned and turned, but she couldn’t recognize her place in the park. The statues were too tall, too big. She couldn’t see the green grass or the children playing anymore.

---

The Eiffel Tower was very sad. Then she had an idea. “Maybe I can use my tower!” she thought. So, she began to climb, slowly but with determination, onto the tallest statue in the park, a sculpture of a knight. It was a little difficult, but the Eiffel Tower didn’t give up.

---

From the top of the statue, the Eiffel Tower looked far away. She saw the horizon! And then… she saw the Park of Sculptures! She immediately recognized her favorite corner, near the big oak tree. The Eiffel Tower quickly came down and went home. She was happy to be there again.

---

The Eiffel Tower learned that even when things seem difficult, you have to keep trying. And so, her perseverance helped her to always find her special place in the park.

plan.problema: The Eiffel Tower got lost among the big sculptures and can’t see her place anymore!
plan.svolta: She decided to use her turret to climb the tallest statue and look for the horizon.
plan.finale: Finally, from the top of the statue, she saw her beloved park and returned immediately to her favorite corner.
plan.morale: Perseverance helps to find your way.

eiffel tour.text:
Tower Eiffel was a special toy. She lived in a beautiful, flowery garden. She was made of shiny metal and loved to show her sparkle. Every evening, when the sun went down, she lit up with a thousand colors. But one evening something wasn't right. Tower Eiffel was still. She didn't want to shine anymore!

“Oh no!” exclaimed Tower Eiffel. “I can’t make my sparkle anymore! It’s terrible!” She tried to wiggle with all her plastic legs, but nothing. The magic of the glow was gone. She was very sad.

A little ladybug, named Lila, came up to Tower Eiffel. “What’s happening?” asked Lila, curious. “I can’t shine anymore!” replied Tower Eiffel. Lila looked up and saw a giant butterfly sitting on her mirror. The butterfly was so big that it completely blocked Tower Eiffel’s reflection.

Tower Eiffel thought quickly. She picked up a small flower petal from the ground and, with great care, she hit it on the butterfly. The butterfly got scared and flew away. Immediately after, the sun hit Tower Eiffel and the tower lit up with a thousand colors! Her sparkle was back.

Tower Eiffel smiled. “Thank you, Lila!” she said. “You were very kind.” Lila nodded happily. The little ladybug understood that even a simple gesture can make a big difference. And Tower Eiffel, shining as always, continued to show her sparkle in the flowery garden.

plan.problema: The Eiffel Tower has stopped and can’t sparkle anymore!
plan.svolta: She tried to shake hard, but the magic of the glow was gone.
plan.finale: Then she discovered that a butterfly had covered her mirror, and with a gentle tap of a snowflake, she brought it back to light!

fattoria.text:
Fattoria Vivente was a special farm. It wasn’t just wood and hay, but it talked! It lived in a big Italian countryside, among fields of golden wheat and ancient trees. It had lots of animal friends: Pippo the donkey, Rosetta the cow, and Gnocchetto the piglet.

But one day, Fattoria Vivente noticed that something wasn’t right. The animals were too sad. They didn’t want to eat their hay or their feed anymore. It seemed like joy had left them. “Oh no!” thought Fattoria Vivente, “I must do something!”

Then she had a brilliant idea. She decided to organize a party! She took her tools – shovels, rakes, and hoes – and started to build a giant rainbow in the field. She used the hay to create the colors and her little wheels to make everything sparkle.

Some bird friends also arrived, singing and flying around the rainbow. Pippo the donkey, initially suspicious, came closer to watch the party. Gnocchetto the piglet started to roll in the colorful hay.

The animals, curious about the fun, began to laugh and appreciate their little houses on the farm. Rosetta the cow joined the game too! Fattoria Vivente smiled happily. The countryside was full of laughter and joy. 

The party continued until sunset, with the animals playing together and having a lot of fun. It was lovely to see her friends so happy. Fattoria Vivente realized that sometimes, just a little bit of play is enough to find happiness. And when we are happy, our friends are too.

plan.problema: His animals were too sad and didn't want to eat anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to organize a party with lots of surprises, creating a giant rainbow with his tools.
plan.finale: The animals, curious about the fun, started to laugh and appreciate their houses.

fattoria.text:
Living Farm was a special farm. It wasn’t just wood and hay, but it talked! It lived in a beautiful Italian countryside, among fields of golden wheat and ancient olive trees. It had lots of animal friends: a lazy piglet, a chatty hen, and a gentle horse.

But lately, Living Farm was worried. His animals were sad. The piglet didn’t want to eat his feed anymore, the hen didn’t lay eggs, and the horse didn’t gallop happily anymore. None of them seemed to want to do anything!

Living Farm thought he had to do something. “I must make them smile!” he exclaimed. So he had a brilliant idea. He decided to organize a party! He invited all the farm animals and, with the help of the passing farmer, decorated the meadow with colorful flower garlands and silly banners.

Putting on cheerful music with his violin, Living Farm danced and sang. The animals, initially hesitant, were caught up in the joy. The piglet started to laugh, the hen started to dance, and the horse started to jump happily. Everyone ate with gusto, full of energy!

Living Farm smiled. Seeing his friends so happy filled him with joy. The Italian countryside seemed even more beautiful and full of color. When the party was over, all the animals were back to playing and working together, happier than ever. It was clear that a laugh can do miracles.

plan.problema: His animals were too sad and didn't want to eat anymore!
plan.svolta: He decided to organize a party full of music and colors to cheer them up.
plan.finale: The animals, struck by the joy of the party, returned to be happy and to eat with pleasure.

fattoria.text:
Fattoria Vivente was a special farm. It lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and tall trees. It was made of wood and fabric, with cows, little sheep, and tiny chickens. Fattoria Vivente loved its secret garden very much.

One day, Fattoria Vivente noticed that something wasn't right. The little sheep, who were usually always hungry, didn't want to eat hay anymore! The farm felt sad. The cows chewed slowly and the chickens didn't chirp. It was all quiet and gray.

Fattoria Vivente tried to do many things. She shouted: “Eat, little sheep! The hay is good!” But the little sheep remained impassive, with their eyes lost in the meadow. Fattoria Vivente felt increasingly down.

Then, Fattoria Vivente had an idea. She focused and began to sing a happy song, a song that the chicken Rosetta had taught her. She sang loudly and with enthusiasm, but the little sheep didn’t react. Even the little pig, Pippo, remained still.

Then, Fattoria Vivente had another idea! Using her little wooden hands, she began to create a small stream of fresh water. The water flowed between the colorful pebbles and made some leaves slide. Immediately, the little sheep approached the stream and began to drink and eat the hay!

All the little sheep were happy and Fattoria Vivente felt happy again. The cows chewed quickly and the chickens chirped. The Secret Garden was full of colors and joy again. 

Fattoria Vivente realized that sometimes, a small kind gesture can make a difference. And she knew this well, because when she was happy, the secret garden shone even more brightly.

plan.problema: The little sheep no longer wanted to eat hay, and the farm became sad!
plan.svolta: The farm tried to sing a happy song, but the sheep remained impassive.
plan.finale: Then the farm had the idea to create a small stream of fresh water, and all the sheep began to eat happily!

fattoria.text:
Fattoria Vivace was a happy farm. It lived in a beautiful Italian countryside, full of green fields and big trees. It loved to play with its animal friends. The cows were its favorites. Every day, Fattoria Vivace prepared the best hay in the world for them. It was a fragrant hay, made with fresh grass and wildflowers.

But one day, something strange happened. The cows didn’t want to eat the hay anymore! They made sad “moo” sounds and refused to come near their food. Fattoria Vivace was worried. “What’s happening?” it asked itself. “How can I help my friends?”

Fattoria Vivace thought, thought, thought. Then it had an idea! With a little jump, it moved all the bales of hay to a different spot in the field. It was right next to the stream. After that, it took a handful of fragrant flowers – marigolds and lavender – and tried to sprinkle the hay with them. The air filled with a lovely scent!

A little pig, Rocco, arrived to see what was happening. He started to sniff the fragrant hay with the flowers. Then, he looked carefully at Fattoria Vivace and its bovine friends. The cows, curious about the new smell, started to come closer. They tried a little hay sprinkled with flowers. Immediately, they started to eat with pleasure again.

Fattoria Vivace smiled happily. It had solved the problem! The change had made everything go back to normal. Maybe, sometimes, a new beginning is exactly what you need to find joy again.

plan.problema: The cows didn't want to eat their favorite food anymore!
plan.svolta: Farm, with a little jump, moved all the hay to a different spot in the field and tried to dust it with a handful of fragrant flowers.
plan.finale: The cows, curious about the new smell, began to approach and taste the hay, returning immediately to eat with pleasure.

fattoria.text:
Farm Lively was a very special farm. It was made of wood and earth, and it could talk! It lived in a beautiful Italian countryside, with green fields and big trees. It had lots of animal friends: cows, sheep, chickens, pigs… Everyone loved to play with it.

But one day, Farm Lively noticed that his animals were very sad. The cows weren't eating well anymore, the sheep had lost their wool, and the chickens weren't laying eggs. There was no food for anyone! “Oh no!” said Farm Lively. “What can I do?”

Then he had a brilliant idea. He called together all his farmer friends: Mr. Rossi, Mrs. Bianchi… Together they decided to organize a big party. They made cookies and apples, plates full of milk and grain.

They also invited the birds in the sky and the insects on the ground. The birds brought nuts and seeds, the insects gave them honey and pollen. Everyone shared the harvest and had so much fun! Farm Lively was very happy. He saw his animal friends smile again.

The farm became full of joy and prosperity again. The fields were full of abundant harvests, the animals were eating well, and everyone was singing happily. It was a wonderful day for Farm Lively and for his Italian countryside. Everyone joined in with joy and the farm became full of joy and prosperity once more.

plan.problema: His animals were all very sad because there was no more food for them.
plan.svolta: He decided to organize a big party with all his farmer friends, inviting also the birds and insects to share the harvest.
plan.finale: Everyone joined in with joy and the farm returned to being full of joy and prosperity.

fattoria.text:
Fattoria Vivace was a special farm. It lived in the Blooming Country, a place full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Fattoria Vivace loved its life among the green fields. It had friends like the Sun, the Wind, and the little birds that sang.

---

One day, Fattoria Vivace noticed that something wasn't right. The farm’s cows didn’t want to eat their hay anymore! They were all sitting down, looking sad and without an appetite. Fattoria Vivace was very worried. The whole farm seemed a little dull, its colors had become less bright.

---

“I must do something!” thought Fattoria Vivace. Then it had a brilliant idea. It decided to organize a big party! It called all its toy friends: the horse Pippo, the sheep Bianca, and the pig Rocco. Together they prepared lots of candies, built an obstacle course, and organized a dance with music.

---

The cows, seeing so much joy, began to approach. Pippo the horse invited them to play, Rocco the pig played his trumpet, and Bianca the sheep did beautiful dances. The cows had a lot of fun! Starting to eat the hay with pleasure.

---

The Blooming Country sparkled with joy. Fattoria Vivace was happy, the cows were happy, and all the toys were happy. The music filled the air, creating a magical atmosphere. 

---

Fattoria Vivace realized that happiness is found when you share moments of fun with friends. And so, the farm continued to live happily and full of joy, always ready for a new party.

plan.problema: The cows no longer wanted to eat their hay, and the farm was sad.
plan.svolta: She decided to organize a party with lots of toys to entertain the cows and encourage them to eat.
plan.finale: Thanks to the music and the fun, the cows returned to eating happily, and the farm sparkled with joy.

fattoria.text:
Fattoria Vivace loved the Blooming Country. It was a special farm, full of green meadows and yellow fields. Every day, Fattoria Vivace moved among her friends: the cows, the pigs, and the farm animals.

---

One morning, Fattoria Vivace noticed that something wasn’t right. The little sheep were gone! There were no more fluffy white wool scattered across the meadows. “Oh no!” said Fattoria Vivace. “Where have my sheep gone?”

---

Fattoria Vivace looked everywhere. She looked among the flowers, under the trees, and behind the barns. But the sheep weren’t there. She was very worried. 

---

Then, Fattoria Vivace had an idea! She started her tractor, a red tractor. She began to play her happy music, a song that made all the farm animals dance. “Play my music!” said Fattoria Vivace. “Maybe the sheep will hear it and come to me!”

---

Fattoria Vivace made a complete circle of the Blooming Country, playing her music louder and louder. Suddenly, she heard a faint baa. She followed the sound, running through the fields.

---

And there, under a big apple tree, she saw the sheep! They had been sleeping and they had fallen asleep right there. 

---

Fattoria Vivace was so happy! She gathered the sheep and brought them back to their place. The Blooming Country was immediately full of fluffy white wool again. Fattoria Vivace realized that even when things seem difficult, with a little patience, you always find the solution.

plan.problema: The little sheep were lost and couldn't find them in the fields!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his tractor to make a complete tour of the farm, playing his cheerful music.
plan.finale: He heard a bleating in the distance and, following the sound, discovered the sheep hidden under a large apple tree!

fattoria.text:
Fattoria Vivace loved the Italian countryside. It was a special farm, it could move and talk! It had a red barn, a green thumb, and lots of red and white cows. That morning, Fattoria Vivace woke up with a big rumble. “What’s happening?” he asked himself.

He saw the cows huddled in their pen. They were very sad. They didn’t want to eat their favorite food: fresh, fragrant hay. “Oh no,” said Fattoria Vivace, “the cows don’t want to eat!”

The farmer, an old gentleman named Antonio, tried to dust the hay, to talk to the cows, but nothing worked. The cows remained sitting, with their horns down and their eyes dull. Fattoria Vivace scratched his wooden head. What could he do?

Suddenly, Fattoria Vivace had an idea! He remembered his bell, which he always wore around his neck. He rang it loudly. “Ding dong!” The sound echoed through the countryside. The cows moved. They raised their ears and started to move their noses.

Fattoria Vivace rang his bell even louder. “Ding, ding, ding!” And then something magical happened. The cows walked up to the hay, they ate it with pleasure and gusto.

Fattoria Vivace rang his bell all day long. The cows were happy and started to eat well again. The countryside was full of joy. When the sun began to set, Fattoria Vivace realized that a beautiful song can do miracles. And now, the cows knew that joy makes everything taste better.

plan.problema: The cows were too sad and didn't want to eat their favorite food.
plan.svolta: The farm realized that the cows just needed a little happy music to be happy again!
plan.finale: The farm started to ring its bell and the cows, tickled by the sound, happily ate.

fattoria.text:
Fattoria Vivace was a special farm. It lived in a beautiful Tuscan countryside, among green hills and stone houses. It was made of wood and felt, with a painted smile on its face. It loved its job: watching its animals and making sure they were happy.

One day, Fattoria Vivace noticed that something wasn't right. The cows, its favorite cows, no longer wanted to eat their special food, a mix of hay and fresh grass. They stayed there, with a sad look, not touching anything. “What’s wrong?” thought Fattoria Vivace.

It looked around the farm. The pig, Pippo, grunted quietly. The chicken, Camilla, no longer made her cheerful clucking sounds. Fattoria Vivace knew what she had to do. She had to organize something fun!

She decided to put on a little show for all the animals. She invited Pippo to do his silly acrobatics, Camilla to fly around the henhouse, and the cows to do some cute dances. Fattoria Vivace rang her little bell and everyone started to dance and play.

The animals had so much fun! Riding and jumping, they forgot about their appetite. They started to eat the special food with pleasure. The farm returned to normal immediately, full of joy and the smell of hay. Fattoria Vivace smiled satisfied: sometimes, a little bit of joy is all that’s needed to solve the problems.

plan.problema: The cows no longer wanted to eat their favorite food!
plan.svolta: He decided to organize a small show with all the farm animals to remind them how good it was.
plan.finale: The animals, amused by the show, began to eat with pleasure and the farm returned to normal.

fattoria.text:
Fattoria Vivace loved her Italian countryside. The wooden stalls, the red and white cows, the sheep with their soft wool – everything was perfect. Fattoria Vivace had the job of taking care of the animals, but one day something didn’t go as it should. The sun was shining too brightly!

The cows were complaining: “It’s too hot! We can’t eat the grass anymore!” The sheep said: "We wish we could cool down!" Fattoria Vivace was worried. She knew that the animals needed to rest and eat to grow well. But the sun was too scorching.

Fattoria Vivace thought, and thought, and thought. Then she had an idea! “I’ll build a sunshade!” she told herself. She started moving her stalls and bales of hay. She used the cows as helpers, and the sheep as assistants. With a lot of patience, she built a big sunshade over the cows’ and sheep’s enclosure.

The sunshade was enormous! It offered cool and pleasant shade. The cows curled up happily in the shade and the sheep skipped around. Fattoria Vivace smiled.
