The animals were happy and the farm was full of life and color again. The sun continued to shine, but now the animals knew how to protect themselves. 

Fattoria Vivace straightened up, satisfied with her work. She realized that even the most difficult things can be solved with calmness and perseverance.

plan.problema: The farm can’t grow its animals because the sun is too hot!
plan.svolta: He decided to build a small giant umbrella to protect the cows and sheep from the sun.
plan.finale: With the umbrella, the animals were happy and the farm was full of life and color again.

ingranaggi meccanici.text:
In great secret, Gears lived in Grandpa Leo’s workshop. It was a world made of oil, tools, and wonderful machines. Gears loved to turn, straighten himself, and make the noises that the other parts of the typewriter did.

One day, everything changed. The typewriter was still. It wasn’t working anymore! Gears felt a strong sadness. “What’s happening?” he thought. He tried to turn faster, but instead of a smooth movement, it made only an unpleasant screech.

Grandpa Leo entered the workshop. “Oh no!” he said. “The typewriter isn’t writing anymore! Gears, you have to do something.” Grandpa Leo began to look around, carefully taking apart the typewriter. 

Gears felt helpless. He tried to understand what had happened, but it was all confusing. Then, he remembered a piece of advice from his grandpa: “Sometimes, you just have to be patient.” Gears took a deep breath and began to move slowly. With great care, he gently aligned each and every gear.

A light sound was heard. Then, the sound of a letter falling on the paper. The typewriter started writing again “Hello!”. Gears felt happy and satisfied. Grandpa Leo smiled: “Good job, Gears!”. 

Gears realized that speed doesn’t always solve problems. It was necessary to take the time to find the right solution.

plan.problema: The gears got stuck and the typewriter doesn’t work anymore!
plan.svolta: Gear tried to turn faster, but the noise was just a screech!
plan.finale: Then, with great care, he carefully aligned each and every gear, and the typewriter went back to writing ‘Hello!’

ingranaggi meccanici.text:
Ingranio was a lively little mechanical gear. He lived in Grandpa Leo’s workshop, a place full of tools and the smell of oil. Ingranio loved to spin, spin, spin, helping Grandpa Leo fix old machines. But one day, something didn’t go right. Ingranio got stuck! He couldn’t move anymore, he was still in his mechanism.

“Oh no!” thought Ingranio. “I can’t help Grandpa Leo if I’m stuck.” Grandpa Leo was scratching his head, worried. “I need to find a way to unlock you,” he said. Ingranio decided to do something himself. With a lot of effort, he started to take himself apart. Taking out one gear after another, he tried to figure out where the problem was. It was all a tangle!

It was a long and difficult job. Ingranio got help from a small screwdriver that Grandpa Leo had given him. With patience, he collected all the pieces and started to put each gear back together one by one. Every time, he tried to spin, but still nothing!

Finally, after a lot of work, Ingranio was complete again. With one last spin, he felt his perfect movement again. He spun fast and smoothly, as always. Grandpa Leo smiled: “Good job, Ingranio! You were patient and you solved it!” Ingranio helped Grandpa Leo fix the machine, and together they worked perfectly again. Ingranio’s perseverance made all the difference.

plan.problema: He couldn’t turn properly, stuck in his mechanism!
plan.svolta: He decided to take himself completely apart to try and figure out where the problem was, and, with patience, he rebuilt each gear one by one.
plan.finale: Finally, with a perfect final turn, he started working again as before, happy to help Nonno Leo repair an old car!

ingranaggi meccanici.text:
Mechanic lived in Leo’s workshop. He was a special gear, made of shiny metal and full of little teeth. Mechanic loved to spin the old red car when Leo made him. But one day, something went wrong. His teeth had come loose! He couldn’t make the car go anymore.

Mechanic was very sad. He tried to tighten the teeth with all his might, but nothing worked. It was as if he had lost a little bit of his magic. He felt still and quiet in Leo’s workshop. Leo noticed his problem right away. “What’s wrong, Mechanic?” Leo asked, approaching.

Mechanic then thought: “We need to find some small screws to fix the teeth!” So, he began to move slowly, searching among the tools scattered on the workbench. He looked to the right and to the left, but he didn’t find any screws that could match his loose teeth. It was frustrating!

Leo, seeing how disappointed Mechanic was, smiled. He took a small spare screw from his drawer and offered it to Mechanic. “Try this one,” Leo said. Mechanic took the screw and gently pushed it between the loose teeth. Immediately, the teeth locked!

Mechanic began to spin the red car quickly, making a little happy buzzing sound. Leo laughed with joy seeing Mechanic working perfectly again. Mechanic realized that sometimes, even the most difficult things can be solved with a little patience and the help of someone. And patience can do miracles.

plan.problema: Mechanic’s teeth had come loose and he couldn’t make the old car turn anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to look through Leo’s tools for small screws to fix the teeth, but he couldn’t find any that matched.
plan.finale: Seeing his sadness, Leo gave him a small spare screw and Mechanic started turning the car with joy!
plan.morale: Patience is key to solving problems.

ingranaggi meccanici.text:
Gear Leo lived in the Secret Workshop. He was a very special mechanical gear, made of shiny metal and full of teeth. The Secret Workshop was a room full of tools and spare parts, where the sun came in through a tall window. Leo loved to spin quickly, making the other little machines and small motors move.

One day, however, he got stuck! He couldn’t move even one centimetre. The sun couldn’t get in very well into the Secret Workshop, becoming all grey. Gear Leo was very worried. It was his job to make light!

“I must solve this problem,” thought Gear Leo. He decided then to take himself apart completely. With patience, he took out his teeth one by one. He looked at them carefully, trying to understand why he couldn’t spin. A little mechanic, an old screwdriver called Rusty, helped him collect the pieces.

After a lot of searching, Gear Leo found a tiny piece of metal stuck between his teeth. He removed it very carefully and… *ding!* He spun quickly again! The sunlight came back into the Secret Workshop, lighting everything up. 

Gear Leo felt happy and pleased. He had learned that even the biggest problems can be solved with calmness and perseverance. The sun shone even brighter, as if to thank Gear Leo for his patience.

plan.problema: Leo had gotten stuck and couldn't turn anymore, blocking the sun from lighting the room!
plan.svolta: He decided to take himself completely apart, carefully studying every single piece to figure out where the obstruction was.
plan.finale: After removing a tiny speck, Leo turned around quickly, restoring the light and the sun to the Secret Workshop!

ingranaggi meccanici.text:
Ingranaggio Leo lived in the secret workshop. He was a very special mechanical gear, made of shiny metal and full of teeth. Leo loved to spin quickly, making a bright light that filled the workshop. But one day, something went wrong. Gear Leo got stuck! He couldn’t move even an inch.

The workshop became dark and cold. The only light came from the window, but it wasn’t enough to light up all the tools scattered on the floor. Gear Leo tried to push, to pull, to use force, but nothing. He was completely still.

Then, Gear Leo decided to take himself apart. Very carefully, he began to separate his teeth. “Maybe this is the problem,” he thought. He looked at every gear he took off. He saw a small rusty gear and another with a few crooked teeth.

Gear Leo took his time. He gently realigned the teeth of the gears, one by one. Then, he poured a few drops of oil on the moving parts. The movement became smoother. With one last turn, Gear Leo started to spin quickly! His bright light filled the secret workshop and lit up every corner. Everything was like before, quiet and full of energy.

plan.problema: Leo had gotten stuck and couldn't turn anymore, preventing the sun from lighting the room.
plan.svolta: He decided to take it apart calmly to figure out the problem, carefully observing each individual gear.
plan.finale: After aligning the teeth and lubricating the parts, Leo turned it quickly again, lighting up the workshop with his bright light.

ingranaggi meccanici.text:
Ingranaggio Leo lived in Grandpa Bruno’s workshop. He was a little, shiny mechanical gear, full of teeth. He loved to spin and make the old train machine work. One day, however, something went wrong. Ingranaggio Leo got stuck! He couldn’t move anymore. The train machine was stopped.

Grandpa Bruno came closer with his apron full of grease. “What’s happening, Leo?” he asked. “I can’t spin!” replied Ingranaggio Leo, a little frustrated. He tried to push with his little hands, but he was too heavy. He just got dirty with grease and didn’t do anything but slow him down.

The old grandpa scratched his head. “Wait a minute,” he said. He took his little mechanic tool, a tiny screwdriver. Carefully, Ingranaggio Leo used it to clean the stuck teeth. A little spin, then another. Slowly, slowly, Ingranaggio Leo started to spin again. The train machine started to move!

Grandpa Bruno smiled. “Good job, Leo!” he said. “Sometimes, to solve problems, you have to be patient and do things calmly.” Ingranaggio Leo felt happy to have solved his problem. He was glad that Grandpa Bruno was always there to help him.

plan.problema: Leo got stuck and couldn’t make the toy train move anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to push with his little hands, but it was too heavy and he just got greasy!
plan.finale: Nonno Bruno suggested he take a gentle trip with his little mechanic tool to free the gears.

ingranaggi meccanici.text:
Ingranesino lived in Grandpa Bruno’s workshop. He was a special toy, made only of mechanical gears, and he loved to go around the big pendulum clock. His job was important: every time Grandpa Bruno started him up, the clock ticked with precision.

One day, Ingranesino got stuck! He couldn’t make the big clock turn anymore. It was frustrating! He felt heavy and still. Grandpa Bruno entered the workshop. “What’s wrong, Ingranesino?” Grandpa Bruno asked with a smile. “I can’t move!” replied Ingranesino.

Ingranesino decided to do something. He decided to carefully take apart each gear, one at a time, to find the one that was stuck. It was a difficult job. Each gear was small and you had to be precise. Grandpa Bruno helped him to position the gears on the workbench.

After a long time, Ingranesino found a small nail! The nail had fallen between two of the gears and it was preventing them from turning correctly. Ingranesino had a tiny wrench. Using the wrench, he gently pushed the nail out of its place. 

Immediately, Ingranesino could go around the big clock again. Grandpa Bruno smiled satisfied. “Good job, Ingranesino!” he said. Ingranesino continued to make the clock tick with precision. His little wrench was always ready for any situation. 

After a long day of work, Ingranesino stopped and thought: perseverance can solve even the most difficult problems.

plan.problema: Cogsworth got stuck and can’t make the big clock turn anymore!
plan.svolta: He decided to carefully take apart each gear, one at a time, to find the one that was stuck.
plan.finale: After a lot of patience, he found a small nail that was preventing it from turning correctly and removed it with his tiny key!

ingranaggi meccanici.text:
Mechanic was a special mechanical gear. He lived in an abandoned workshop, full of rusty tools and dust. He was made of many metal teeth that fit together to make things move. Mechanic loved to turn, producing a sweet, metallic sound when his teeth worked together.

One day, however, something went wrong. A gear nearby had broken into a thousand pieces. Mechanic’s other teeth had come loose and he couldn’t turn properly anymore. He had become a still, pile of rusty metal. He felt a great frustration; he couldn’t do his job.

In that dark room, there was also an old wrench abandoned in a corner. Mechanic saw it and had an idea. He carefully took a small piece of metal that had fallen between his teeth. It was a piece of screw! With great force, he pushed the metal into the mechanism, trying to repair the broken tooth.

He took a deep breath and continued to push. He felt the resistance, but he didn’t give up. Then, with a satisfying click, Mechanic started to turn again! The metallic sound returned, louder and clearer than ever. Mechanic was able to move and do his job. 

The old wrench lay beside him, silent but pleased with its little help. Mechanic continued to turn, happy with his small victory. 
It was wonderful to see the mechanism working perfectly again.

Ruggine was a mechanical gear. He lived in the Silvana Workshop, among wrenches and hammers. He was made of shiny metal and had many teeth that he loved to make turn. Every day, when the old Mr. Silvano turned on the lamp, Ruggine made the grandfather clock tick-tock.



One day, however, something went wrong. Ruggine tried to make a turn, but his teeth were stuck! He couldn't make the clock turn anymore. It was frustrating. “Oh no!” thought Ruggine. “I must find the solution.”



Mr. Silvano, noticing the problem, said, "Maybe it’s just a small gear that got stuck." Ruggine decided to do something brave. He took himself apart completely! Removing piece by piece his teeth and levers. He desperately searched for the stuck piece.



Among the tools, he saw a small nail. With great care, Ruggine used the nail to loosen the stuck gear. Then, slowly, he began to put himself back together.



Once put back in place, the clock finally showed the right hours! Ruggine smiled happily. The ticking of the clock was regular and pleasant. 



Ruggine realized that with calmness and patience, even the most difficult problems can be solved. And when Mr. Silvano looked at him, he said, "Good Ruggine, now always follow the right hour.”

He had many different shapes: some were round, others with teeth, and others shaped like spirals. Geary loved to spin and make all of Grandpa Leo’s machines work.

One day, everything changed. The regular ticking of Grandpa Leo’s special clock stopped. The gears that powered the clock stopped turning. Grandpa Leo scratched his head and said, “Oh no! What can I do?” Geary felt very upset. If the clock didn’t work, the other machines would become slow or stop working.

Geary started to spin frantically, trying to figure out what had happened. He tried to push some gears, he made them slide against each other. Sometimes he got stuck, other times he heard a little “click”. Grandpa Leo watched him patiently.

Then, with a sudden gear movement, Geary was able to make the main lever of the mechanism work! A light sound filled the workshop and Grandpa Leo’s clock started ticking regularly again. 

Grandpa Leo smiled. “You did it, Geary!” he said happily. Geary felt happy and proud to have helped. He had learned that even small tasks require time and attention. The clock continued to tick, a steady rhythm like patience.

Lego Blue was a very special Lego brick. He could move and talk! He lived in a dusty attic, full of old furniture and dusty boxes. The attic was his world, even though it was sometimes a little sad.

One day, Lego Blue noticed a problem. He had started to build a very tall tower, the tallest he had ever made. But it was missing a piece! A small red brick with an arm. Without that piece, the tower couldn’t finish. Lego Blue was very worried.

“Oh no!” said Lego Blue. “If I don’t find it, my tower will always be half way!” He felt frustrated and a little angry. He decided to do something.

He started to move, pushing with force an old chair. Then he moved a wooden chest full of old clothes. He looked, looked, looked for the red brick. The attic was full of old and dusty things, but Lego Blue didn’t give up.

Finally, behind an old cardboard box, he saw it! The small red brick with the arm shone in the sunlight coming through the attic window. Lego Blue ran to grab it and put it on the tower. The tower became even taller! It was the tallest tower ever.

A little spiderweb, that lived among the beams of the floor, watched Lego Blue with a smile. “You had a lot of patience,” said the spiderweb. “And sometimes, those who are patient can reach their goals.”

Lego Blue smiled happily. His tower was perfect and he had learned a big lesson.

plan.svolta: He decided to explore every corner of the attic, moving the old furniture with force to search for the lost piece.

Mattoncino was a bright red brick. He lived in the corner of the attic, among cardboard boxes and old books. He loved to be there, watching the sun come in through the window. His best friend was the big Lego Castle, a huge castle with tall towers and thick walls.

One day, Mattoncino noticed that the Castle wasn’t there. “Where are you?” asked Mattoncino, but no one answered. He was very worried. The Castle was his best friend, and he had to find it!

Mattoncino started to move, trying to reach the Castle. But the Castle was so high! Mattoncino tried to push with all his little bricks, but he couldn’t climb high enough. He was frustrated and sad.

Suddenly, Mattoncino had an idea. He huddled close to the wooden ceiling, which was smooth and slightly sloped. “If I let myself be pushed,” thought Mattoncino, “maybe I can slide down and reach the Castle!”

A ray of sunshine hit Mattoncino and a little piece of dust rose up. Another brick, small and blue, came towards Mattoncino. “Can I help you?” asked the blue brick. Mattoncino nodded excitedly. The blue brick gently pushed Mattoncino towards the ceiling.

Mattoncino slid down, down, down, and finally landed right next to the Lego Castle! “I did it!” exclaimed Mattoncino happily. They joined together immediately, the two brick friends, to build a new tower for the castle. 
It was nice to have a friend to play with all the time.

He tried to push against his Lego brothers, the red brick Bruno and the blue brick Bernardo. “Please, pull me out!” he said. But Bruno was too busy building a bridge and Bernardo was trying to build a tower. Nobody wanted to help him. Lego Mattia felt sadder and lonelier.

Suddenly, while he was complaining, a small red piece rolled down from the box. It rolled, rolled, rolled until it stopped right next to Lego Mattia! The red piece pushed the Lego brick, and with one push, Lego Mattia was pulled out of the box!

He was happy to go back to the Play Corner. His Lego brothers came closer and they started building a beautiful castle together. All the bricks worked as a team to make it bigger and more fun. Lego Mattia realized that when everyone works together, even the hardest things become easy.

Block Lego tried to try to fit every piece in order. He tried to remember where each brick belonged. But he was too confused! The more he looked, the more pieces ended up being scattered. The situation became even messier and Block Lego felt even down.

Then he had a brilliant idea. Instead of trying to find his specific place, he decided to build something big! He started connecting the bricks one by one, creating walls, towers, and battlements. He built a huge castle, with a fort, a tall tower, and a drawbridge.

Puzzle Little lived in the dusty attic. He was a very big puzzle, made of lots and lots of colorful pieces. Puzzle Little loved to be there, watching the sun come in through the tall window. One day, while a strong breeze was scattering the dust, something strange happened.

Puzzle Little found himself surrounded only by his pieces! They were scattered everywhere: under the old chest, behind a rusty gramophone, everywhere. He didn’t know what to do. He couldn’t remember what his complete puzzle looked like. He was confused and sad. “Oh no!” said Puzzle Little. “I don’t know how to put myself back together anymore!”

A old porcelain doll, who had lived in the attic forever, watched him calmly. “Puzzle Little,” said the doll, “you must look for the smallest pieces one by one.” Then she added: “Start from the edge, it’s the best way.”

Puzzle Little followed the doll’s advice. He began to collect the edge pieces, little by little. He looked for the colors and shapes, remembering how they had to fit together. It took a long time. Puzzle Little was patient and kept looking.

Finally, after hours of work, Puzzle Little was able to put all the pieces in order! The puzzle became complete again, just like before. Puzzle Little smiled with joy. He was happy to be back in his original shape. Now he knew that with calmness and patience, you can always achieve success.

---

---

---

Puzzle Leo followed the butterfly’s advice. He tried to put the bigger pieces together, but none of them seemed to fit correctly. He was frustrated.

---

The butterfly flew closer and with a little flutter of wings, gently pushed the last piece into place. The lion picture was complete again! Puzzle Leo smiled. “Thank you!” he said. “I did it!”

---

The butterfly flew away, leaving Puzzle Leo happy and content in the dusty attic. Puzzle Leo realized that sometimes all you need is a little patience to find the right way.

puzzle.text:
Puzzle Piccolo lived in the Creative Workshop. He was a special puzzle, he could move and talk! The workshop was full of colors and shapes, but Puzzle Piccolo had a big problem. His pieces had scattered everywhere. They were under the desk, behind the easel, even inside a box of paint!

“Oh no!” exclaimed Puzzle Piccolo. “I must find them all to complete the picture! It’s a very cute teddy bear and I promised I would finish it.”

The old Craftsman, who worked in the workshop, watched Puzzle Piccolo with a smile. He said, "Don't get discouraged, little friend. Look patiently."

Puzzle Piccolo decided to take an exploratory walk. He moved slowly, one piece at a time. He slid on the wood, rolled on the carpet, and squeezed between the legs of the chair. It was a long and tiring job. 

Sometimes he would stop to rest, but then he would start looking again. With great care, he picked up a yellow piece, then a blue one, a red one, and so many other colors. Every time he found a piece, he put it in its right place.

Finally, after a long time, Puzzle Piccolo had collected all the pieces! With patience and care, he began to put the picture of the teddy bear back together. Piece by piece, the teddy bear took shape. 

When the last piece was in place, Puzzle Piccolo smiled. The teddy bear was complete and beautiful. He had learned that with a little patience and perseverance, even the most difficult things can be solved. The satisfaction of finishing the puzzle was great.

Puzzle Red lived in the attic. He was a red puzzle, made of lots of little pieces. The attic was dusty and full of old things. Puzzle Red loved to be there, but lately he felt very sad. His pieces were scattered everywhere! He couldn't find all the little bits to put the picture back together.

“Oh no!” said Puzzle Red. “I can’t do it anymore. There are so many and they are all the same!” He huddled under an old box, trying to hide from the dust. It was really a big mess.

Suddenly, Puzzle Red thought: “Maybe someone can help me?” He decided to ask for help from the old teddy bear, Bruno. Bruno lived under the bed in the living room. He was a very big and wise teddy bear.

Puzzle Red climbed down the stairs and ran towards the living room. He found Bruno sitting there, still. “Bruno, please, help me!” said Puzzle Red. Bruno listened to him carefully. Then, with his little arm, he started to pick up Puzzle Red’s pieces, grouping them by color: red, blue, yellow, and green.

Together, Puzzle Red and Bruno rebuilt the picture. It was a beautiful castle with tall towers and strong walls. When the last piece was put in, the castle appeared complete. Puzzle Red felt happy. 

“Thank you, Bruno!” said Puzzle Red. “I would never have done it on my own.”

Puzzle found himself completely lost. His colors were everywhere, but none of them knew where his place was. It was frustrating! He couldn't put himself back together anymore. He tried to group them, but only they got even more mixed up. “Oh no!” thought Puzzle, “I have to do something!”

Puzzle tried to push all the pieces together, hoping they would put themselves together. But it didn't work. The pieces slid and rolled, becoming even more messy. He felt a little sad and confused. 

Then, suddenly, a ray of sunshine came through the window. It hit his colorful edges with a golden light. Puzzle closed his eyes and waited. A moment later, the pieces began to move slowly towards their right place. One by one, they clicked perfectly! 

Puzzle finally put himself back together, complete and happy. He let out a big sigh of relief. From that day on, Puzzle learned that even the most confusing situations can be solved with calmness and patience. And so, the sun continued to shine on the corner of the room.

Cubby lived in a corner of the room. He was a plastic cube, a Rubik’s Cube. Cubby liked to be there, watching the things that passed by. One day, however, something had gone wrong. His colors were no longer lined up! Red was next to blue, yellow was near green, and everything seemed confused.

Cubby felt very frustrated. He tried to put the pieces back in place, but every time he only made things worse. He mixed up even more! He had become a disaster of colors. Cubby wanted to return to his original shape, the perfect and square one he remembered.

Then, he made a decision. He decided to turn each face slowly, very slowly. He turned the red face, then the blue face, the yellow face, the green face, and the white face. He was trying to understand how to move the pieces without creating new mistakes. It was a difficult job and it required a lot of attention.

Cubby kept turning, turn after turn. Sometimes it seemed like he was going forward, other times he got even more confused. But he didn’t give up. He continued to turn calmly and patiently. After a long time, finally, he found the right combination! 

He turned one face, then another, and another one still. The colors began to match. The pieces aligned perfectly. Cubby finally became square! He was happy and satisfied with himself. He had learned that even when things seem difficult, with patience and perseverance, you can achieve success. And as he returned to his perfect shape, Cubby thought: “It’s nice to see how everything gets solved.”

A little Lego robot, called Rix, told him: “Don’t worry, Cubetto! Try to focus on one face at a time.”

Cubetto listened to Rix. He decided to rotate each face slowly, very slowly. First the red face, then the blue face, then the yellow face and so on. It was hard work and Cubetto struggled. Sometimes he got stuck and had to try again. But he didn’t give up.

He continued to turn and slide his colors, patiently. After many attempts, finally, everything went back to its place! The colors were perfectly aligned, one next to the other. Cubetto smiled satisfied. His shape was perfect again.

Cubetto smiled and continued to turn slowly, to make sure his colors didn’t mix up again. Patience had made magic.

Liberty was a big, strong statue. She lived in a secret garden, a place full of colorful flowers and sweet smells. Liberty loved her garden, but lately she felt very sad. No one looked at her anymore. The children didn’t play there, and the adults didn’t sit and watch the landscape.

Liberty’s sadness reflected on the flowers. The red roses stopped blushing, the violets became less bright, and the tulips didn’t stand up straight towards the sun anymore. Liberty wanted so much to make the flowers smile, but she couldn’t. She was too quiet, too far away.

“I wish someone would see me,” Liberty thought. “I wish someone would understand how much I miss joy.” Then, she made a decision. With a slow and majestic movement, she raised the arm that holds the lantern. She carried it higher and higher, towards the sky.

The sun was setting, painting the sky orange and pink. A beam of light, strong and warm, hit Liberty’s lantern. The whole statue began to shine! The metal glittered like gold, reflecting the colors of the sunset.

The flowers in the garden woke up. The roses blushed red again, the violets regained their intense color, and the tulips stood up straight towards the light. Liberty laughed, a deep laugh that vibrated in the air. Her beauty lit up the whole secret garden. 

Liberty’s light was so beautiful that it did good for everyone who looked at it.

“I wish someone would see me,” sighed Liberta. “I wish they would know who I am.” Her bronze eyes seemed full of sadness. The squirrels ran around her, but none of them stopped to admire her. 

A boy, Leo, was building a fort with building blocks. He sat down next to Liberta and started to talk. He talked about dinosaurs and how to build the tallest tower. Liberta listened patiently.

Suddenly, Liberta had an idea! She used all her energy to shine. She started to change color: red, blue, green, yellow, orange. It was like a waterfall of colorful light spilling over the playground. The children stopped to admire her.

Leo went over and asked an old gentleman sitting on a bench: “Mr. Rossi, who is this statue?” Mr. Rossi smiled. “This is Liberta,” he explained. “She is a symbol of freedom and friendship for all countries.” The children listened carefully, fascinated by Liberta’s story.

Liberta shone even brighter, happy to share her story. From that day on, every child who went to the playground knew who Liberta was and her meaning. The colorful light gradually faded, leaving only a bright memory in the minds of the children. Discovering new stories is like receiving a special gift.

Liberty felt warmed inside. The boy smiled at her and looked at her with eyes full of wonder. At that moment, Liberty realized that even a small act of kindness could make a difference. She felt special, happy, and no longer alone. 

The golden statue slowly lowered her arm. Liberty thanked the boy with her eyes. Friends are important, because they make our lives more beautiful.

plan.problema: Liberty felt lonely and no one looked at her with such care anymore.
plan.svolta: She decided to raise her arm in a friendly gesture, hoping someone would notice her.
plan.finale: A boy ran to her, offering her a flower and smiling, and Liberty finally felt special.

statue of liberty.text:
Liberty was a big and beautiful statue. She lived in a secret garden, full of fragrant flowers and tall trees. Liberty loved that place, but lately she felt very sad. No one looked at her anymore. The children didn’t come to visit her. She just wanted to be seen, she wanted to attract attention.

“I wish someone would notice me,” she sighed, the wind tousling her bronze clothes. “I’m here, but no one sees me.”

One day, Liberty had an idea. She decided to light up at night! She found a small magic lantern in the garden and put it on her head. She lit it with a flick, hoping the glow would be strong enough to be seen from far away. But the glow was too weak. No one could see her in the darkness.

Suddenly, a little bird arrived flying. It was a pigeon named Pippo. Pippo began to sing a sweet and cheerful song. His voice echoed in the secret garden. 

The children from the next house, who were playing in their houses, heard the music. They came to the garden and saw Liberty lit by the lantern. They were so happy to find her there! Pippo continued to sing, attracting the attention of all the children.

Liberty felt much happier. She realized that it didn’t take big things to be noticed. A kind gesture, like the song of the pigeon, was enough. 

Beauty reveals itself with a kind gesture.

plan.problema: Liberty felt sad because no one looked at her and didn't know how to get attention.
plan.svolta: She decided to light herself up at night with a magic lantern, but the glow was too weak to be seen from far away.
plan.finale: Then, a little bird flew around her and began to sing, attracting the attention of the children next door.
plan.morale: Beauty reveals itself with a kind gesture.

statue of liberty.text:
Liberty was a big, serious statue. She lived in the playground, next to the sandcastle and the orange swing. She was made of shiny bronze and always looked towards the sea. But Liberty felt lonely. All the children looked at her, but nobody wanted to play with her. “I’m too serious,” she thought. “Nobody wants me.”

The other statues in the park were fun: a smiling teddy bear, a princess dancing, a pirate with a parrot. But Liberty was different. She always seemed ready to give an important advice. Nobody called her to run or build castles.

One day, Liberty had an idea. She closed her eyes and concentrated. She started to shine! First a little, then with strength. Her eyes, her arms, her dress, everything became of a thousand different colors: red, yellow, blue, green, purple! She created a beautiful rainbow in the playground.

The children saw the rainbow and they approached Liberty. They were amazed by her bright colors. They immediately started to build sandcastles around her, using the shells they had found on the beach. A boy, Tommaso, offered her a little flower.

Liberty smiled. She was happy! Finally she had friends. The children surrounded her and watched her as she illuminated with a thousand colors. Liberty was the happiest statue in the world. Sharing that special moment had created a beautiful friendship.

plan.problema: Liberty felt lonely and no one wanted to play with her because she seemed too serious.
plan.svolta: She decided to light herself up with a thousand colors, creating a rainbow in the park to attract the attention of all the children.
plan.finale: The children were enchanted and began to build castles around her, making her the happiest statue in the world.

statue of liberty.text:
Liberty was a big, golden statue. She lived in the playground, near the sandcastle and the red swing. She was a beautiful statue, but she felt very lonely. No one looked at her anymore. The children ran too fast to notice her, or they always played somewhere else.

“I wish I had a friend,” sighed Liberty. “I would like someone to see me.” She felt like a faraway star in the sky, invisible and forgotten. The sun warmed her golden surface, but it couldn’t warm her stone heart.

One day, she decided to do something. She slowly raised her giant arm towards the children playing. She wanted to say “Hello!” to everyone. But no one seemed to notice her. The children laughed and ran, too busy building castles or throwing the ball.

Liberty felt even sadder. Then, a little boy, with red hair and scraped knees, stopped right in front of her. He crouched down and looked up. “I’m looking at the Statue! You’re beautiful!” he shouted with a loud voice.

Liberty smiled. She was happy to be seen. She realized that having the attention of others was a special gift. From that day on, the children came to look at her, to tell her their stories, and to make new friends. Liberty had found her place in the playground. It was nice to know that someone took the time to admire her beauty.

plan.problema: The Statue of Liberty felt lonely and no one looked at her.
plan.svolta: She decided to raise her arm to wave to all the children, but no one seemed to notice her.
plan.finale: A boy ran towards her, shouting: 'I’m looking at the Statue! You’re beautiful!'

statue of liberty.text:
Liberta was a big, golden statue. She lived in a secret garden, full of fragrant roses and tall trees. Once, many children used to look at her. They admired her arm pointing to the sky. But lately, nobody looked at her with much attention. Liberta felt very lonely.

“I wish someone would see me,” she sighed. Her rocks were cold and silent. There was no one to talk to her. The sun warmed her metal, but it didn’t warm her stone heart. Liberta felt sad and a little dirty, because the wind had collected leaves and dust on her white dress.

One day, she decided to do something. With a great effort, Liberta raised her arm to the sky. She did it slowly, hoping someone would notice her. The wind messed up her clothes, but she didn’t give up. She wanted to be seen, she wanted to shine.

After a long time, a curious child came to the secret garden. He was small and had his eyes full of wonder. He sat next to Liberta and began to tell her stories of freedom and of courage. He talked about men who had fought for their ideals, and women who had fought for rights.

Liberta listened carefully, happy to finally have someone to talk to. The child looked at her with admiration, noticing every detail of her appearance. He realized how beautiful and important Liberta was. From that day on, the child often returned to the secret garden to tell Liberta stories.

plan.problema: Liberty felt alone and no one looked at her with such care anymore.
plan.svolta: She decided to raise her arm to the sky, hoping someone would notice her beauty and splendor.
plan.finale: A curious child approached and began to tell her stories of freedom and courage.

tamgram.text:
Tamgram was a special tamgram. He was made of colorful plastic and had lots of shiny eyes. He lived in a secret garden, a place full of fragrant flowers and lush plants. Tamgram loved to play among the red roses and the yellow sunflowers.

One day, Tamgram found himself lost. He had ended up among the big roses! He couldn’t see the sun anymore. He felt a little sad because he wasn’t seeing the light. He tried to move, but the leaves covered his face.

Tamgram tried to call his friends, the flowers. “Hello tulip! Hello lily!” he shouted, but nobody answered. Only the wind blew through the petals. Tamgram felt a little more lonely.

Then, Tamgram noticed a small crack in the stone wall that surrounded the secret garden. It was hidden behind a large fern. Tamgram made an effort and squeezed through the crack. 

Suddenly, Tamgram found himself in a corner of the garden. The sunlight hit him! He could see the flowers, he could see the sun, he could see everything! A white butterfly flew near him.

Tamgram was happy to be back to seeing the light. He settled among the leaves and smiled. Tamgram understood that even when things seem difficult, you should never give up.

plan.problema: Tamgram got lost among the roses and couldn't see the sun anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to call his friends flowers, but none of them answered.
plan.finale: Tamgram discovered a small crack in the stone wall and found himself in a corner full of light!

tamgram.text:
Tamgram was a colorful tamgram. He had lots of little, smiling arms.
He lived in a secret garden, full of fragrant flowers and lush plants.
Tamgram loved his garden very much. Every day he enjoyed watching the butterflies dance among the petals.

One day, Tamgram found himself surrounded by red and pink roses.
The roses were beautiful, but Tamgram couldn't see the sun anymore!
It was all dark between the leaves and the flowers.
Tamgram was a little scared. He didn't know where he had ended up.

He tried to move his arms up to reach the sunlight, but only the leaves moved with the wind.
He was frustrated. He turned around the roses, looking for a way out, but he couldn't find anything.

Then, Tamgram noticed a small tunnel under a lavender plant.
It was narrow and dark, but Tamgram decided to try it.
He squeezed into the tunnel and made his way slowly.
He pushed with his little legs and his arms.

Finally, he came out right there, in a corner of the secret garden where the sun shone brightly.
Tamgram was happy again. He was happy to be able to see the light again.
Tamgram realized that even when things seem difficult, with a little patience and perseverance, you can always find a solution.

plan.problema: Tamgram got lost among the roses and can’t see the sun anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to push his little arms up, but only the leaves moved.
plan.finale: Then he discovered a little tunnel under a lavender plant and came out right where the sun was shining.

tamgram.text:
Tamgram was a very special tambourine. He wasn’t just a metal toy, he could talk and move! He lived in a secret garden, full of fragrant flowers and tall trees. Tamgram loved that garden, especially when the sun shone brightly in the sky.

---

One day, while he was playing loudly to make the butterflies fly, Tamgram found himself surrounded by red and white roses. The roses were beautiful, but Tamgram couldn’t see the sun anymore! It was all dark between the petals. He didn’t understand how he’d gotten inside.

---

Tamgram tried to shout: “Help! I’m lost!” but his voice was too weak to be heard. Nobody listened. He felt sad and a little scared. He really wanted to go back to the meadow, where the sun warmed his plates.

---

So Tamgram decided to do something different. He started to dance! He did a happy polka, with his metal feet tapping on the ground. He jumped up and down, turned around the roses, and made a big mess.

---

Suddenly, a ray of sunshine lit up the secret garden. Tamgram reappeared in the meadow, surrounded by a group of little bees who were looking at him curiously. He was happy! He had solved his problem with joy and dance.

---

Tamgram continued to play his polka, while the sun shone brighter and brighter. It was a wonderful day for a special tambourine.

plan.problema: Trampy got lost among the roses and can’t see the sun anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to shout, but his voice was too weak to be heard by anyone.
plan.finale: So, with a big smile, he started to dance a cheerful polka and suddenly he reappeared in the sunlit meadow.

tamgram.text:
Tamgram was a very special tambourine. He had lots of little colorful parts and made fun sounds when you banged on him. He lived in the Rose Garden, right next to Leo’s little house. Leo loved Tamgram and they played together every afternoon.

---

One day, Tamgram was taking a little trip among the fragrant roses. The wind was strong and one of his colorful parts flew away! Tamgram was all alone, surrounded by red, pink, and white roses. He was very worried. He couldn’t find Leo.

---

“Leo? Leo!” shouted Tamgram, but nobody answered. He felt sad and a little scared. Then he had an idea! Tamgram started putting his colorful pieces in a row, one after the other, creating a little path through the roses. It was a yellow path, then a blue path, then a red path… he hoped Leo could follow it.

---

While he waited, a white butterfly landed on his head. The butterfly flew away and took with it Leo’s message: “I’m looking for you!”. Tamgram kept banging his tambourine to make a loud sound, hoping Leo could hear him.

---

Suddenly, he heard footsteps approaching. “Tamgram!” shouted Leo, running towards the tambourine. He hugged him tightly and happily. Tamgram was happy to be found. Together, they sat among the roses, banging on the tambourine. 

---

They realized that patience and the idea of creating a path had worked wonderfully. It was nice to work together to solve problems.

plan.problema: Tamgram got lost among the fragrant roses and couldn't find his friend, Leo.
plan.svolta: He decided to create a path with his small colored pieces, hoping Leo could follow it.
plan.finale: Leo, seeing the path, ran to Tamgram and hugged him happily.

tamgram.text:
Tamgram was a very special tambourine. He didn’t just make noise, he shone with a thousand colorful stars! He lived in a secret garden full of fragrant flowers and lush plants. Tamgram loved to dance among the sunflowers and make friends with the butterflies.

One day, while he was playing loudly, he got completely lost. He was surrounded by red and white roses, purple lavender, and yellow poppies. But his stars were no longer visible! Tamgram couldn't see anything. He was very sad.

He tried to move quickly, to roll among the flowers, but nothing. The petals touched him, but they didn't let him see the stars. Then, with a great effort, Tamgram tried to jump over the rose bush. But only the thorns irritated his plastic! “Ouch!” exclaimed Tamgram.

A little brown squirrel, named Noce, heard him crying. Noce was very curious and approached Tamgram. He saw that the tambourine couldn't see his stars. Then, Noce found a tiny mirror and showed it to Tamgram.

Tamgram looked into the mirror and… surprise! His stars shone again! He was so happy to see them again. He thanked Noce for his help. 

Tamgram played again, this time with more sweetness. Noce and Tamgram became good friends, and together they continued to play in the secret garden.

plan.problema: Tamgram got lost among the flowers and can’t see his colorful stars anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to jump over the rose bush, but only the thorns irritated his plastic!
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a little squirrel, Tamgram found his mirror and finally saw his stars shining again.

tamgram.text:
Tamgram was a very special tambourine. He lived in the Flower Garden, among red roses and yellow tulips. Tamgram loved to make the flowers dance with his cheerful sounds and bright color. But one day, something strange happened. Tamgram’s color had become duller, almost gray. He couldn’t shine like before.

“Oh no!” said Tamgram, with a voice that sounded like a little bell. “I can’t make the flowers dance anymore! I’ve become sad and faded.”

Tamgram tried to make louder sounds, but it didn’t help. His color was getting paler and paler. Then, he had an idea: he decided to take a lovely walk around the flowers in the garden. He wanted to dance and make his light shine to cheer them up.

But the sun was too strong! Tamgram moved quickly, but every time he touched the petals of the flowers, his color faded even more. “Help!” cried Tamgram, getting weaker and weaker. “I can’t stop!”

A white butterfly, with delicate and colorful wings, landed near Tamgram. The butterfly made a little flutter of its wings and gently stroked the tambourine with its wings. It was a light and gentle cuddle.

Immediately, Tamgram’s color returned to shining! It was brighter than ever. Tamgram was happy and started to make the flowers dance with enthusiasm. The butterfly smiled and flew away.

Tamgram realized that even when things seem lost, a small kind gesture can make a difference. And now, Tamgram shone brightly again in the Flower Garden, ready to bring joy to all his friends.

plan.problema: Tamgram had lost his sparkle and couldn't shine like before.
plan.svolta: He tried to take a lovely walk around the flowers, but the sun was too strong and made him fade even more!
plan.finale: Thanks to a gentle cuddle from a butterfly, Tamgram recovered his bright light.
plan.morale: Kindness makes things go back to normal.

tamgram.text:
Tamgram was a special tamgram. He had so many different shapes and he shone with a thousand colors. He lived in a secret garden full of big flowers and tall trees. Tamgram loved to play there very much, especially hide-and-seek with his glitter friends. They were little sparkling spheres that followed him everywhere.

One day, Tamgram noticed that his glitter friends were gone. He looked everywhere among the roses and sunflowers. But the glitter had disappeared! Tamgram was very worried. He didn't know where they had gone.

“Glitter! Glitter!” shouted Tamgram, but his voice was too weak to be heard. Nobody answered. Tamgram felt sad and lonely in the secret garden.

Suddenly, a talking flower said to him, “Don’t give up, Tamgram!” Another flower added, “We know where your friends are.” The talking flowers pointed to the pond with the jade nymph. 

Tamgram then used his bright sound, the one he made when he moved quickly. The sound shone brightly and attracted the attention of his glitter friends. The glitter rose into the sky and returned quickly to Tamgram. 

Tamgram was happy! He got better together with his friends and they continued to play in the secret garden. Tamgram learned that even when things seem difficult, you should never lose hope.

plan.problema: Tamgram got lost and couldn't find his glitter friends.
plan.svolta: He tried to shout, but his voice was too weak to be heard.
plan.finale: Then he used his bright sound to attract the attention of the talking flowers who guided him to his friends.

tamgram.text:
Tamgram was a colorful tambourine, full of stars and moons. He lived in the Secret Garden, a magical place behind the old oak tree. Tamgram loved to dance among the plants, but one morning something wasn't right. He was alone, lost among the bushes of red and yellow roses.

Tamgram was lost! He couldn't find his friend, the sunbeam. The sunbeam always lit him up when he danced, making his shapes even more beautiful. Tamgram tried to call out: “Help! Who can hear me?” But his voice was too small to be heard. It was like a whisper lost in the wind.

Tamgram thought about what to do. Then he had an idea! Tamgram started to tap his tambourine, but not with a cheerful rhythm. He started to make a little “brrrrr… brrrrr…” repeatedly. The sound was strange and unexpected.

The noise attracted the attention of a red ladybug. The ladybug ran to tell the sunbeam, who was playing among the leaves. The sunbeam, curious about the “brrrrr…”, approached calmly. Tamgram continued to tap his tambourine.

The sunbeam, seeing Tamgram lost among the roses, lit up the path towards the child who was waiting for him, sitting on the grass watching the garden. Tamgram was happy to be with his friend again. Tamgram continued to tap his tambourine, and every sound was a little secret of joy.

plan.problema: Tamgram got lost among the roses and can’t find his friend, the sunbeam.
plan.svolta: He tried to shout, but his voice was too small to be heard, so he decided to use his special sound: a little ‘brrrrr’ to get attention.
plan.finale: The sunbeam, curious about the noise, came closer and lit the way to the child who was waiting for him.

tamgram.text:
Tamgram was a colorful tambourine. He had bells and ribbons. He lived in a secret garden full of fragrant flowers. Tamgram loved to make his bells ring and dance. One day, while he was walking among the roses, he got lost.

Tamgram couldn’t see the sun anymore! The roses were so tall that they almost covered him completely. It was all gray and dark. Tamgram was scared. He didn’t know how to go back. He tried to take one step forward, then another, but the roses always seemed to be more and more.

Tamgram tried to shout, “Help! I’m lost!”, but his voice was too small. The children who were playing nearby didn’t hear him. They were too busy building sandcastles. Tamgram felt sad and frustrated. He didn’t know what to do.

Then, Tamgram had an idea. He took a bouncy jump! He rolled down a hill of soft earth. Tamgram let out his ribbons and he was right next to the little pond. The sun shone there brighter than anywhere else in the secret garden.

A little dragonfly, Zephyrino, flew towards him. “Hello Tamgram! Were you hiding?” said Zephyrino with a smile. Tamgram found his courage and started to make his bells ring. The sound echoed in the fresh air of the secret garden. Tamgram was happy to be back in the sun. 

Tamgram’s perseverance brought him exactly where he wanted to go. And, while he danced with the wind among the roses, he realized that every little effort can lead to big results.

plan.problema: Trampy got lost among the roses and can't see the sun anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to shout, but his voice was too small to be heard by the children playing nearby.
plan.finale: Then, with an agile jump, he rolled down a dirt hill and found himself right next to the small pond where the sun shone brightest.

tamgram.text:
Tamgram was a special tamgram. He was made of colorful plastic and had lots of shiny eyes. He lived in a secret garden full of fragrant roses. Tamgram loved to run among the bushes, jump on the green meadows, and cuddle with the bees.

One day, Tamgram was playing hide-and-seek with a blue butterfly. The butterfly flew away and Tamgram found himself alone, surrounded by red and pink roses. He couldn’t find his house anymore! He was a little scared. He couldn’t see his soft sofa or the box where he rested when it was cold.

Tamgram tried to shout for help, but the wind was blowing too strong. The wind carried away his words and made him feel even more alone. Nobody could hear him.

Then Tamgram did something different. He started to curl up against the rose petals. He snuggled gently, trying to protect himself from the wind. He watched the sky patiently. The sun began to shine.

Tamgram noticed that the sunlight reflected on the petals of the roses. The light guided him to a bright spot. Tamgram followed the light and, in a few minutes, he found himself in front of his house! He was happy to be back. 

Tamgram realized that sometimes, to find the way, you just have to stand still and wait. And so, Tamgram went back into his box, ready for a new adventure in the secret garden. Calm always helps to find the solution.

plan.problema: Tamgram got lost among the roses and couldn't see his house anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to shout, but the wind was blowing too strong to hear him.
plan.finale: With patience, he began to huddle against the rose petals, waiting for the sun to guide him to the light.
plan.morale: Calm helps to find the solution.

braccio robot.text:
Braccio Robot lived in the Creative Workshop. He was a very special robot arm, made of shiny metal and with red eyes that twinkled. Braccio loved helping to create fantastic drawings. That day he wanted to draw a huge rainbow!

But then, unfortunately, something went wrong. Braccio got stuck. He couldn’t move his arm to reach the tubes of color. He was very sad. “Oh no!” said Braccio. “How will I draw the rainbow?”

Mrs. Lila, Braccio’s creator, gave him an idea. “Try to use your mechanical arm to suck up the pigments directly from the tubes!” she suggested. Braccio followed the advice. He began to stretch and retract his arm to collect the color. But he collected too much! A little red, a little yellow, a little blue… they sprayed everywhere. The floor of the workshop was full of colors!

Braccio realized he had to be more careful. With small movements and patience, he began to collect every single drop of color. Drop by drop, the wall of the workshop became more and more colorful. In the end, a beautiful rainbow shone on the wall. 

Braccio Robot was happy. He had overcome his difficulty with effort and perseverance. His mechanical arm had done wonders! With the rainbow completed, Braccio understood that even difficult things can be solved if you really try hard.

plan.problema: Brachio’s arm got stuck and he can’t reach the colors to draw a rainbow anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his mechanical arm to suck up the pigments directly from the tubes, but he sprayed too much everywhere!
plan.finale: With patience and small movements, Brachio collected every drop of color, finally creating a beautiful rainbow on the wall.

braccio robot.text:
Braccio Robot was a very special robot arm. He lived in the Creative Workshop, a place full of old typewriters, colorful tubes, and shiny gears. Braccio Robot loved to move, turn around, and try to do all the things he could.

---

One day, in the workshop, a bright red ball was hung from the ceiling. It was a new and fun ball! Braccio Robot wanted to reach it, but his arm wasn’t long enough. He tried to stretch, he twisted, but the ball was too high. “Oh no!” said Braccio Robot, a little frustrated.

---

He looked around and saw a row of typewriters. A small machine, called Pip, watched him curiously. Braccio Robot had an idea. He decided to use his arm to climb on the typewriters! He made his way between the keys, he grabbed the feet and tried to hit the ball with a bigger movement.

---

He went back, tried again and again. Every time, he tried to be more precise, more strong. Braccio Robot didn’t give up. With one last effort, he raised his arm to the maximum and hit the ball! The red ball fell with a thump, lighting up the whole workshop.

---

Pip shouted: “Good job, Braccio Robot!” Braccio Robot stopped for a moment, happy to have reached his goal. He had learned that even when things seem difficult, continuing to try can lead to success.

---

And so, Braccio Robot continued to move and explore the Creative Workshop, always with a lot of determination.

braccio robot.text:
Braccio Robot lived in the Creative Workshop. He was a robot arm made of shiny metal and with colorful sensors. Braccio loved helping to create paintings full of colors. But one day, something went wrong. Braccio couldn’t move anymore!

He couldn’t reach the tubes full of colorful paint that were on the table. It was so frustrating! Braccio tried to stretch his arm as far as possible, but it was too short. He didn’t even reach the middle of the red tube.

Braccio made small movements, trying to figure out what had happened. Then he decided to turn around on himself, to see if the situation improved. But the mechanism was too tight! It only made strange, metallic noises, a sound that made him feel even worse.

A little helper, Mr. Rossi, the blacksmith of the workshop, was working in a corner. He noticed Braccio Robot in trouble. Mr. Rossi took out a small wrench from his toolbox and showed it to Braccio. “Try to turn it here,” said Mr. Rossi.

Braccio Robot followed the advice. With a little “click,” his motors started working again! Braccio moved again, fast and precise. He immediately started reaching the colorful tubes and painting with enthusiasm, creating wonderful paintings. 

Braccio Robot kept moving, happy to be able to help. He had learned that even when things seem difficult, you must never give up. And so, Braccio Robot returned to creating beautiful paintings in the Creative Workshop.

plan.problema: Brachio’s arm got stuck and he couldn’t reach the colorful tubes to paint them anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to turn himself around, but the mechanism was too tight and he was just making strange noises.

braccio robot.text:
Braccio Robot lived in the colorful kitchen. He was a special robot arm, made of shiny metal and with blue eyes that twinkled. Braccio Robot really loved helping in the kitchen. The cook, Signora Rosa, always smiled at him.

One day, Signora Rosa had made a delicious cake, full of fresh strawberries. She put it on top of the cupboard, so it would be taller and everyone could see it. But Braccio Robot couldn't reach it! He moved back and forth, but his arms were too short.

“Uff!” said Braccio Robot, turning his metal body. “I can’t get there! How do I take the cake to Signora Rosa?” He thought for a little while and then had an idea. He carefully took a red book from the shelf. He slowly lifted it up, making it slide upwards. The book made a little staircase.

Braccio Robot continued to move the book, lifting it higher and higher. The staircase became longer and finally reached right in front of the cake. With a final, precise and gentle movement, Braccio Robot grabbed the cake. It was a little wobbly, but he held it firmly.

Braccio Robot walked towards Signora Rosa, who was waiting for him with a big smile. He gave her the cake. Signora Rosa thanked Braccio Robot and hugged him. Braccio Robot was happy to have helped.

Patience can do miracles, especially when you need to find the right solution for every problem.

plan.problema: Braccio Robot couldn't reach the cake sitting on top of the cupboard.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his arm to gently lift a book, creating an improvised staircase to the cake.
plan.finale: With a final precise movement, Braccio Robot grabbed the cake and delivered it to the smiling cook.

braccio robot.text:
Braccio Robot was in the Creative Workshop. He was a robot arm, made of shiny metal and with little blue eyes that twinkled. Braccio Robot loved to help build. Today he had to collect the small colorful pieces for a super tall tower!

But something had gone wrong. Braccio Robot had gotten stuck. His arm wouldn’t move anymore! He couldn’t grab the first piece of wood, then the piece of plastic, and finally the little red cube. He was frustrated. “Oh no!” said Braccio Robot. “I can’t build the tower!”

A little piece of paper star, Luna, was drawing nearby. “Braccio Robot, what’s happening?” asked Luna.

Braccio Robot tried to turn his arm forward and backward. It was still stuck. It didn’t move at all! Then Braccio Robot had an idea. He used his little inside motor and zoomed around, really, really fast! The arm began to move.

Braccio Robot moved slowly, then faster. He grabbed the piece of wood, then the piece of plastic, and finally the red cube. He could do everything! With patience and determination, Braccio Robot kept collecting the pieces.

Finally, the tall tower was complete! It was beautiful, with lots of different colors. Braccio Robot felt happy. He had overcome an obstacle thanks to his courage to try. 

Braccio Robot realized that even when things seem difficult, if you try to do something, you might always succeed.

braccio robot.text:
Braccio Robot lived in the Creative Workshop. He was a very special robot arm, made of shiny metal and with red eyes that twinkled. Braccio Robot loved to help build new and fantastic things. Today, his mission was to collect the pieces for a beautiful castle.

But suddenly, something went wrong. Braccio Robot tried to lift a piece of wood, but his arm wouldn’t move! It was stuck. He couldn’t pick anything up anymore. “Oh no!” said Braccio Robot with a metallic voice and a little worry.

He turned his arm in every possible direction. He made small movements, but nothing. His arm was still as still as a statue. Braccio Robot started to think. Then, he pulled out his little hammer, the one he used to knock away imperfections on the constructions.

With great care, Braccio Robot gently tapped the arm’s mechanism. One hit! Another hit! And then, with a final, determined hit, the mechanism unlocked. Braccio Robot could move his arm again.

He quickly collected all the castle pieces: tall towers, solid walls, and a drawbridge. He put everything together carefully, happy to have completed his mission. Braccio Robot stopped for a moment to look at his beautiful castle. Perseverance, even when things seem difficult, can lead to great results.

plan.svolta: He tried to turn his arm, but nothing, it was still stuck, so he decided to use his little hammer to try and unlock it.
plan.finale: With a well-aimed blow, the mechanism unlocked and Braccio Robot collected all the castle pieces!

braccio robot.text:
Braccio Robot lived in the Secret Laboratory. He was a very special robot arm, made of shiny metal and colorful wires. Braccio Robot loved to move, to pick up things, and to do little experiments. One day, however, something went wrong. Braccio Robot got stuck! He couldn’t hold anything anymore. He was sad.

“Oh no!” said Braccio Robot, trying to move his arm. But nothing happened. He tried to grab a small screwdriver, but his arm stayed still. “I can’t do anything!” thought Braccio Robot.

Professor Straniero, who had built Braccio Robot, entered the laboratory. He looked at Braccio Robot carefully and said, “Let’s try to understand what’s happening.” Braccio Robot tried to turn all his gears, turning and rotating every piece. But nothing seemed to work. He was always stuck.

Suddenly, a ray of sunlight entered through the big window of the laboratory. The ray hit Braccio Robot and made a small loose screw in his arm shine. The screw was almost invisible! Professor Straniero took the screw with a pair of tweezers and put it back in place.

Right after that, Braccio Robot moved again! He held the screwdriver between his metal fingers. “I did it!” shouted Braccio Robot. Professor Straniero was smiling. Braccio Robot was happy and free to move. 

Braccio Robot realized that sometimes, even a little help can make a difference.

plan.problema: Brachio’s arm has stuck and he can’t pick up things anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to turn all his gears, but nothing seems to work.
plan.finale: Suddenly, a beam of light made a tiny loose screw shine, and Brachio started moving again!
plan.morale: Sometimes all you need is a little help.

braccio robot.text:
Braccio Robot was in the Flowery Garden. He was a shiny metal arm robot, with two strong pincers and a small motor that made him move. Braccio Robot loved the garden, especially for helping Princess Lily to collect the little flowers for her crown.

---

One day, Braccio Robot stopped suddenly. He couldn’t move anymore! His pincers were stuck and he couldn’t even pick up a single rose petal. Princess Lily was very sad. “Braccio Robot, you must help!” said the princess.

---

Braccio Robot thought. He had to do something. He decided to take himself apart. He used his pincers to loosen the bolts that held him together. It was a difficult job and Braccio Robot tried very hard. Princess Lily watched carefully, offering small tools.

---

After trying so much, Braccio Robot felt a little scratch in the motor. He used his pincers to gently tighten that spot. Then, with one last effort, the motor started working again! Braccio Robot moved again, smooth and fast. He quickly picked up a beautiful little flower for Princess Lily.

---

Princess Lily smiled happily. Braccio Robot was ready to help again. With lots of perseverance, he had solved his problem. Braccio Robot went back to working without stopping, knowing that every little step counts. He always remembered that with effort and determination, you can overcome any obstacle.

plan.problema: Braccio got stuck and couldn't collect the little flowers for Princess Lily anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to take himself apart with his pincers, hoping to understand what had gone wrong and how to fix him.
plan.finale: He managed to tighten a small scratch in the engine, and with one final effort, he became perfectly functional to help the princess.

braccio robot.text:
Braccio Robot was in the creative workshop. He was a robot arm, made of shiny metal and with bright dots for eyes. Braccio Robot loved to do new things and help build toy cars and Lego castles. Today he had a special mission: to reach a colorful ball. The ball was hanging from the ceiling, right above the work table.

Braccio Robot stretched, reaching his arm up high. But the ball seemed very far away! Braccio Robot tried to move to the side, but he couldn’t get closer. He was frustrated. “I have to reach that ball!” thought Braccio Robot.

Then he had an idea. He decided to use his arm to give small pushes, hoping that the ball would move. But every push made him fall down! He fell onto the floor with a little thump. He was tired and a little disappointed. A small screwdriver, Pip, came up to Braccio Robot and said, “Don’t give up!”

Braccio Robot took a deep breath. He straightened up slowly. Then, with a precise movement, he reached his arm up high. He pointed the metal tip of his hand towards the ball. With a final, well-aimed hit, he hit the ball which rolled to the ground.

Braccio Robot smiled. He had reached his goal! He was happy to have completed his mission. The creative workshop seemed even brighter now. Braccio Robot snuggled up contentedly, ready for the next adventure. Everything needs the right time to be done well.

plan.finale: He straightened up and with a precise movement, he stretched his arm up and hit the ball that rolled to the ground.
plan.morale: Patience is key to achieving your goals.

With a little movement, the table shifted a bit. The red ball reappeared! Braccio Robot gently picked it up and brought it back to the top of the building block tower. To celebrate, Braccio Robot made a little happy movement, spinning his mechanical arm around himself.

Dr. Rossi, the creator of Braccio Robot, was smiling. He had watched everything carefully. Braccio Robot had solved the problem with patience and a little bit of cleverness. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and discover new solutions.

macchina bolle di sapone.text:
Bubbly Magic was a special machine. It was a machine for making bubble solution! It lived in the Flowery Garden, among red roses and tall sunflowers. Every day Bubbly Magic prepared to create her bubbles, but she had a little problem. The bubbles broke right away after they were born. They disappeared with a puff of wind or a drop of rain. It was frustrating for Bubbly Magic!

One day, while spraying soap, she met Zephyr, a blue butterfly who loved to fly among the flowers. “Why are you so sad, Bubbly Magic?” asked Zephyr. “My bubbles don’t last!” replied Bubbly Magic, a little angry.

Bubbly Magic thought about what to do. Maybe the soap was too concentrated? Or maybe the air was too dry? Then she had an idea! She remembered that her water tank was almost empty. “Maybe,” she said, “I need more water!” So, Bubbly Magic poured fresh water into her tank.

She sprayed soap and water together. The first bubble was born, big and bright! Then she made another one, even bigger. The bubbles became light as feathers and floated gently in the colorful sky. Zephyr flew around the bubbles, happy to see them. Bubbly Magic smiled. Finally, she had figured out the secret! 

The bubbles were beautiful and strong, a real show in the Flowery Garden. Bubbly Magic continued to make bubbles, and every time she made them calmly and patiently. Success always comes to those who don’t work too hard.

plan.problema: The bubbles popped too soon and couldn't make them last long.
plan.svolta: He decided to try adding more water to his tank, thinking it was the cause of the problem.
plan.finale: Finally, the bubbles became big, light, and strong, floating gently in the colorful sky.

The flowers in the garden noticed Bubbly’s sadness. “We can’t smile without bubbles!” said a red rose. The tulips lowered their heads, and even the blue violets seemed duller. Bubbly was very worried. She didn’t want her friends to be sad.

She thought about what to do. She tried to spray more soap, but nothing! She tried spinning around, but still nothing. Then she had an idea. She filled herself with fresh water from the small pond near the lavender bush. She started making bigger and faster circles, hoping the moisture would help.

A little squirrel, Leo, watched her curiously. “What are you doing, Bubbly?” asked Leo.

Bubbly continued to spray, concentrating, trying to figure out what was missing. Suddenly, unexpectedly, the bubbles started to form again, creating a rainbow of colors around the happy flowers.

The flowers burst into laughter and their petals seemed to shine even brighter. Bubbly felt happy. She had learned that even when things seem difficult, you need to be patient and keep trying. And in the end, the solution always arrived.

orologio.text:
Clock was a very nice clock. He lived on the desk in the bedroom. He was always there, still, looking at the world with his hand. Clock loved his job, telling the time. But one day, something strange happened. The ticking, the sound that was his special sound, was gone!

Clock felt very sad. He couldn’t tell the time anymore. No one knew how many hours had passed. He tried to move his hand with his fingers, but nothing. It was stuck! Then, Clock decided to do something bigger. He tried to beat his heart, to shake his body hard. But the ticking didn’t come back.

“Oh no!” thought Clock. “Maybe I need to turn completely.” So, Clock focused and began to move slowly. First a little, then faster and faster. He did everything he could to make a whole circle around his face.

Finally, after a lot of effort, Clock made a whole turn! With a sweet “tick-tock,” the ticking came back. Clock was happy! His voice echoed in the room: “Tick-tock, tick-tock, I’m back at work!” A little teddy bear, Leo, came closer and smiled at Clock.

Clock stopped for a moment, then he started his regular ticking again. His hand now pointed to the right time. He was happy to be back doing what he loved. Clock had learned an important lesson: sometimes, even the smallest things need time and patience to work well again.

plan.problema: The Clock has stopped and can't tell the time anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to beat harder, but the ticking was gone.
plan.finale: Finally, he made a little full circle, and the ticking returned with a sweet 'tick-tock'.

orologio.text:
Orario lived in the White Room. He was a wall clock, made of wood and with blue hands. Every day, Orario ticked the hours for all the toys in the room. But one day, something changed. The hands stopped! He didn’t know how long it was passing.

Orario was very worried. “I can’t tell anyone what time it is!” he thought. He tried to move, but he was too heavy. He felt stuck. The little girl who had put him there, Sofia, came in and out of the White Room. Orario watched her play with her dolls, but she didn’t understand his problem.

Orario tried to swing his face. He tried to move up and down, but he was too heavy to move. He couldn’t do anything! Suddenly, he felt a little vibration. A small white feather had fallen onto his face and hit him. The feather had blocked him completely!

Orario calmed down. He realized he had to find a way to get free. He took a deep breath and, with all his strength, gently shook his body. The hands started to move slowly. Then, faster! Orario was able to tick the hours again.

Sofia entered the White Room and smiled seeing Orario working again. “How lovely!” she said. Orario felt happy and pleased. He had learned that sometimes all it takes is a little help to solve problems.

plan.problema: The time has stopped and doesn't know how long it is anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to swing his hand, but it was too heavy to move.
plan.finale: Then he discovered that a small feather had hit him and blocked him, and he gently shook him to free him.
plan.morale: Sometimes it just takes a little help to solve the problems.

orologio.text:
Clock lived in the clock shop. He was a pocket watch, made of shiny brass and with hands that moved slowly. The other clocks in the shop were his friends. There were big clocks, small clockwork clocks, pendulum clocks... they all talked!

One day, Clock noticed that he wasn't ticking anymore. His hands were stuck at noon. “Oh no!” he exclaimed. “I’m stopped! And that’s a big problem!” The other clocks started to worry. “What’s happening to Clock?” they asked, in quiet, a little scared voices.

Clock decided to do something. He moved around frantically, spinning his hands quickly. “Maybe if I move stronger, the mechanism unlocks!” he thought. But when he spun his hands, they just went further! The hands were now pointing to three o’clock in the afternoon.

An old clockmaker, called Master Bruno, watched the scene. “Maybe,” he said, “you should make the hands go for a little spin.” Clock followed the master’s advice and, with an effort, the hands started to move in a wobbly way.

Master Bruno took a small wooden hammer. With a gentle tap, he hit the back of Clock. Suddenly, the hands stopped, then they started their regular movement, ticking with a sweet, constant sound. All the clocks in the shop rang with joy. 

Clock was able to tell the time again without problems. From that day on, Clock learned that even the most complicated things can be solved with calmness and attention. Time flowed regularly, just as it should be.

plan.problema: The clock stopped and couldn't tell the time anymore, scaring all the other clocks!
plan.svolta: He decided to take a quick spin between the hands to unlock the mechanism, but he had only made himself go even further.
plan.finale: With a small hammer blow, the clock returned to its position and started ticking regularly again.

orologio.text:
Clock lived in the White Room. He was a wall clock, made of wood and with golden hands. Clock loved to tell the dolls what time it was. The dolls were sitting on the rug, playing, and Clock would say, “It’s time to sleep!” or “It’s time for lunch!”.

But one day, Clock noticed a terrible problem. He didn’t know how to tell the time anymore! The hands seemed confused and didn’t want to move correctly. The dolls looked at him with their porcelain eyes, waiting for Clock to speak.

Clock tried to do something. He decided to turn his face backwards. He wanted to go back in time! But it kept running too fast! The hands danced frantically and Clock felt more and more frustrated. 

“I need to slow down!” thought Clock. He tried to concentrate, to make a little tick with his second hand. A little tick... and finally, Clock stopped! It was exactly right. The hands rested gently and Clock told the dolls, “It’s time for bed.”

The dolls smiled. His story was calm and reassuring. Clock felt happy, he had solved his problem. It was important to do things with calmness and patience. 

Clock realized that even the most complicated machines need a little help to work well.
