orologio.text:
Clock was a wall clock in Grandma and Grandpa’s room. It was a blue clock, with golden hands. Clock loved watching the time go by. Every day, he repeated: “Tick, tock, tick, tock”.

Grandma was making tea. “Let’s have tea at five o’clock today,” she said. Clock stopped. He didn’t make tick, tock. He was still. Grandma scratched her head. “Oh no! Tea time is lost!”

Clock felt very upset. He wanted to start ticking again. He tried to move, but nothing. Then, suddenly, he started spinning very, very fast! The hands moved so quickly that they pointed to the ceiling. Clock was scared. He tried to slow down.

“Tick, tock, tick, tock… slower, Clock, slower,” Grandma repeated, trying to calm Clock down. 

Clock focused, and slowly, he started to go slower. The hands finally showed the right time: five! Grandma smiled and made a nice hot cup of tea with sugar. Clock felt the smell of the tea and started ticking quietly again. “Tick, tock, tick, tock”. 

Grandma drank a cup of tea and said, “Sometimes, things just need a little time to find their rhythm.”

plan.problema: The clock stopped and Grandma says tea time is lost!
plan.svolta: He started spinning very fast, pointing towards the ceiling, hoping to find his rhythm.
plan.finale: Finally he slowed down, pointing to the right time and Grandma made a good hot tea.

orologio.text:
Orario lived in the Toy Workshop. He was a special clock, made of wood and shiny metal. He loved to tell the hours, with his regular ticking. All the toys in the workshop loved Orario, because he was always precise.

---

One day, Orario noticed that something wasn’t right. His hour hand was stuck! It was frozen on the number eleven. The other toys were scared. “Orario is broken!” cried Berta, the rag doll. Everyone seemed very worried.

---

Orario also felt a little sad. He couldn’t tell the hours correctly anymore. He tried to move, but nothing. He had become a still clock. He decided to do something: he thought that if he took himself apart, he might find the problem.

---

With great care, Orario began to separate his parts. But it was very complicated! His inner mechanism was full of tiny and difficult gears to handle. He couldn’t understand what had gone wrong.

---

Then, a little helper arrived: a small, shiny key. The key entered a small hole in the mechanism and... *click!* The hour hand started to move again. Orario started ticking with precision.

---

All the toys in the workshop cheered. Orario was back in his place, happy to tell the hours. The patience and help of a small key had solved the problem.

plan.problema: The clock had stopped and couldn't tell the time correctly anymore, scaring all the toys!
plan.svolta: He decided to take himself apart gently to figure out what was wrong, but his mechanism was too complicated.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a small key, Orario started ticking and chiming the hours accurately!

orologio.text:
Clock lived in the clock shop. He was a little blue clock, with lots of sparkly gears. He spent his days watching the other hands move very quickly. Every day, Clock told the time with a precise tick-tock. But one day, something changed.

Clock stopped! He couldn’t move his minute hand anymore. Everything was still. “Oh no!” thought Clock. “I can’t tell the time! This is terrible!” The old Clockmaker, who had cared for Clock since he was born, came closer with a small screwdriver. “Don’t worry, Clock,” said the Clockmaker. “Maybe you just need a little push.”

Clock decided to take a fast trip around the other hands. He moved as fast as he could, trying to find his rhythm again. He passed the big red hand, then the yellow and the green. But nothing! His minute hand stayed still.

Suddenly, a little golden hand gently approached Clock. It touched him softly, and in an instant, his minute hand started moving again. Clock’s tick-tock started again. The Clockmaker smiled. “Good job, Clock,” he said. “You just needed a little friendly hand.”

Clock continued to tell the time, always with precision. Every tick-tock was a small step forward, and in the end, Clock realized that even when things seem difficult, persevering always helps to find the solution. And so, the little blue clock continued to live in the clock shop, happy and precise.

plan.problema: The little Clock stopped and can’t tell the time anymore!
plan.svolta: He decided to take a quick spin around the other hands, hoping to find his rhythm again.
plan.finale: Finally, a small golden hand gently touched him, returning him to his place and making the regular ticking start again.

orologio.text:
Clock was a wooden wall clock. He lived in Leo’s bedroom, among the books and colorful drawings. Every day, Clock showed the time with precision. But one morning, something didn’t go right. His hands stopped halfway!

Clock was very worried. “Oh no!” he said, his voice a quiet tick-tock. His friends, Leo’s stuffed animals – the lion Bruno and the bear Poldo – looked at him with wide eyes. “What’s happening, Clock?” asked Bruno with his deep voice.

Clock felt very sad. He couldn’t tell Leo when it was time to go to school or to play. He decided to do something. He tried to move, but the hands didn’t want to turn. Then he had an idea! “Maybe I need to go for a spin!” thought Clock and began to roll quickly around the wooden table.

He rolled and rolled, getting stuck on the table’s little legs, falling down and starting again. The stuffed animals watched him curiously. After many attempts, suddenly, the hands started to move! Clock smiled, a bright wooden smile. 

The hands marked the time calmly and regularly. Bruno and Poldo sniffed happily. Clock felt finally in his place, ready to show the time for Leo. It was just a fast spin that solved the problem. Clock understood that with effort and perseverance, even the most difficult things can be overcome.

plan.problema: The clock stopped and can’t tell the time anymore, scaring the stuffed animals.
plan.svolta: He decided to try to make a quick lap around the table, hoping to get his hands moving again.
plan.finale: After many attempts, the hands finally started moving and the clock smiled contentedly.

orologio.text:
Clock lived in the White Room. He was a wall clock, made of painted wood and with little golden hands. Clock loved his place, watching the clouds go by in the sky. Every day, he ticked slowly, slowly, telling the time to all the toys in the room.

But one day, something went wrong. Clock stopped! The hands didn't move anymore. “Oh no!” thought Clock. “I can’t tell the time anymore! I’ve become a timeless clock.” It was a terrible thing.

Clock tried to swing hard, up and down, but nothing. It didn’t work. He pulled his hands with all his might, but they stayed still. The White Room seemed quieter than ever.

Then, a ray of sunshine came through the window. The sun hit his bright face. Clock felt a little shake and, magically, the hands started moving again! “Tick-tock, tick-tock,” said Clock with joy. 

The little girl, Sofia, came into the White Room and smiled seeing Clock working again. Clock felt happy. It was nice to be useful again. 

The sun continued to shine on the White Room, and Clock ticked regularly, always ready to tell the time. Sometimes, even a little help is enough to get back to his place.

plan.problema: The clock stopped and can’t tell the time anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to swing really hard, but that didn’t work.
plan.finale: A ray of sunshine hit the face and, magically, it started ticking again!
plan.morale: Sometimes all it takes is a little help.

orologio.text:
Clock lived in a workshop full of clocks. Big clocks, small clocks, round clocks and square clocks. Clock loved his place among the other clocks. Every day, Clock prepared to tell the time.

But one morning, something had gone wrong. Clock wasn't working anymore! His hands were still, frozen. He didn't know where to point to the hours anymore. “Oh no!” thought Clock. “How will I tell the time?” He was very worried.

Clock tried to shake his hands to make them move again. But he had gotten greasy! His metal face was full of greasy spots and Clock felt a little frustrated. An old clockmaker, Mr. Rossi, watched him from a distance with a smile.

Suddenly, a small gear, tiny and shiny, began to roll out of his body. Clock saw it fall onto the wooden floor. Mr. Rossi quickly came closer and picked up the gear. He put it back in its place very carefully.

Then, Clock started ticking! Tick-tock, tick-tock. The hands began to move, first slowly and then faster and faster. Clock was happy to be working again. Mr. Rossi smiled. “Sometimes,” he said, “you just have to wait for things to go back to where they belong.” Clock ticked happily, knowing that everything has its own time.

plan.problema: The Clock had stopped and didn't know how to tell the time anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to shake with the hands, but he had only gotten greasy!
plan.finale: A small gear rolled out and, returning to its place, the Clock started ticking happily again.

robot aspirapolvere.text:
Sparky was a very curious vacuum cleaner robot. He lived in Grandpa Leo’s attic and spent his days cleaning. The attic was full of old things: boxes, furniture covered in blankets, and especially, piles and piles of dusty books.

One day, Sparky was exploring a particularly dark corner when, accidentally, he rolled off an old chair. He ended up under a huge pile of books! He couldn’t move. His wheels were stuck and he couldn’t get back to his charging station, his favorite place.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Sparky. “I’m trapped!” He tried to push the books away, but it was too heavy. He decided then to use his powerful air jet to blow the books away one at a time. But every time he did, he lifted a thick cloud of dust! The attic became even darker and harder to see.

A little mouse, Pippo, came up to Sparky. “Maybe you should be more careful,” said Pippo in a shy voice.

Sparky listened to Pippo’s advice. Then, with one last effort, he coordinated his movements: he sprayed air and gently slid the books one at a time. Slowly, slowly, the pile moved. Sparky finally freed his wheels and, with a little “beep,” he quickly returned to his charging base, full of energy.

Sparky rested a little, ready for the next adventure in the attic. It had been a good job, done with calmness and determination.

plan.problema: Sparky got stuck under a pile of old books and can't get back to his charging station!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his powerful air jet to blow the books away one by one, but he only ended up creating another dust swirl.
plan.finale: Sparky, with one final coordinated effort, managed to slide the books gently and finally returned to his base fully charged!
plan.morale: Patience is important for solving problems.

robot aspirapolvere.text:
Robby was a very special vacuum cleaner robot. He lived in Leo’s bedroom. Robby loved to clean and always did his job. One day, while looking for some scattered pieces, he found himself in a big mess! A huge pile of Lego blocks had knocked him over.

Robby was stuck under the red, yellow, and blue blocks. He couldn’t move. His wheels were stuck and wouldn’t turn anymore. Robby tried to push with all his might, but nothing! He tried to shake his wheels, hoping they would unlock, but it was useless.

Leo was inside the room and watched Robby. “Don’t worry, Robby!” said Leo. Robby had an idea. He remembered he had a water jet! It was a special function to clean under furniture. 

Robby activated the water jet and pointed it at the blocks. The cold water made the pieces slide. One, two, three… Robby moved! He finally managed to get free from the pile of Lego.

Robby ran quickly to his base, full of energy. Leo was happy to see Robby back in his place. Robby realigned himself and started cleaning Leo’s bedroom right away. He had shown that even when things seem difficult, with a little determination, you can always find a solution.

plan.problema: Robby got stuck under a pile of blocks and couldn’t get back to his base!
plan.svolta: Robby tried to turn, to wiggle his wheels, but nothing worked, so he decided to use his water jet to loosen the blocks.
plan.finale: Thanks to the water jet and his determination, Robby managed to free himself and happily returned to his base!

robot aspirapolvere.text:
Rudi was a very special vacuum cleaner robot. He lived in Leo’s bedroom. Rudi loved to clean, especially when the room was a little messy. But one morning, he had run into a big problem. A huge pile of Lego bricks had blocked him!

Rudi couldn’t move. He was surrounded by colors and shapes. He felt frustrated. He tried to suck up the bricks, but they only flew higher! They had ended up on the chandelier, the desk, and even on Leo’s sleeping head.

Leo woke up with a little “beep” coming from Rudi. “Rudi, what happened?” Leo asked, stretching out his arms to reach the flying bricks. Rudi pointed to the pile with his antenna.

Leo smiled kindly. He started to pick up the bricks one at a time, putting the smaller ones aside and the bigger ones in a basket. He worked slowly and carefully. 

Rudi watched him. He saw that Leo was patient and didn’t get angry. After a while, all the bricks were on the floor. Rudi finally freed his body. He got back to normal and started to clean the floor right away, making little swirls of dust. He was happy to be back at work!

Leo sat on the rug and watched Rudi clean. The bedroom was clean and tidy again. And Rudi continued to do his job calmly and precisely. Sometimes, it’s necessary to slow down to solve problems.

plan.problema: Rudi got stuck under a pile of building blocks and can’t get out!
plan.svolta: Rudi tried to suck up the blocks, but he just made them fly even higher!
plan.finale: Leo kindly tidied up the blocks, freeing Rudi and making him happily return to cleaning.

robot aspirapolvere.text:
Sparky was a very special vacuum cleaner robot. He lived in Leo’s bedroom. Sparky loved to clean and do his rounds. Every day he explored the floor, picking up crumbs and dust. But one day something didn’t go as usual.

Sparky was moving quickly under the play table when, suddenly, he bumped into one of the table legs. A small piece of wood hit him hard and Sparky ended up rolling, getting completely stuck under the table! He couldn’t move anymore. The wheels were stuck between the pieces of wood.

Sparky tried to push, to turn, but nothing. He was really trapped. Leo entered the bedroom and scratched his head. “Oh no, Sparky! How will you get back to your base?” Leo said with a sigh. 

Sparky thought quickly. He remembered having a powerful water jet. He decided to use it! He aimed the water jet at the small pieces of wood that were holding him stuck. The water loosened them, one at a time. With one last effort, Sparky freed himself!

Sparky quickly returned to his base, full of energy and ready for a new adventure. He recharged quickly, lighting up with green light. He had learned that even when things seem difficult, you always have to find a way to overcome them. No matter how challenging it is, you can always try again!

plan.problema: Sparky got stuck under the game table and can’t get back to his base!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his powerful water jet to loosen the small pieces of wood that were trapping him.
plan.finale: With one last effort, Sparky broke free and immediately returned to his base, full of energy!

robot aspirapolvere.text:
Robbie was a very good vacuum cleaner robot. He lived in Leo’s bedroom. Robbie loved to clean and make everything perfect. Every morning, when Leo woke up, Robbie started work right away.

But that morning, there was a big problem! Under the desk, there was a huge pile of Lego building blocks. Robbie tried to go over it, but he got completely stuck! He couldn’t move and he couldn’t clean the floor. He was frustrated.

Robbie tried to curl up, hoping to find a way through. He bent and stretched, but all he did was make strange noises and, unfortunately, he broke a small arm! “Oh no!” thought Robbie. His broken arm prevented him from turning and going forward.

Leo heard the noise. He entered the bedroom and saw Robbie in trouble. “Don’t worry, Robbie,” said Leo. He took a roll of colorful tape and carefully repaired Robbie’s broken arm. 

Robbie felt better right away! Thanks to the tape, he could finally turn and push forward. He quickly cleaned the whole bedroom: under the desk, next to the bed, and even behind the chair. Everything was shiny and clean. Leo smiled happily seeing Robbie working so well.

Robbie, with his repaired arm, continued to do his job, happy to have finally cleared out Leo’s bedroom. With a little help, even the biggest problems can be solved.

plan.problema: Robbie got stuck under the pile of building blocks and can’t clean the floor!
plan.svolta: He tried to curl up and push forward, but all he did was make noise and broke a little arm.
plan.finale: Leo fixed Robbie with a piece of tape and he finally cleaned the whole room!
plan.morale: Everything works out with a little help.

robot aspirapolvere.text:
Robby was a very special vacuum cleaner robot. He lived in Leo’s bedroom. Every day, Robby took care of keeping the room clean, picking up all the scattered building blocks. It was an important job! But one morning, something had gone wrong.

A huge pile of Lego constructions had started to grow on the floor. Robby, trying to clean it up, had ended up under the pile. His wheels got stuck and he couldn’t move! He couldn’t even get back to his base, that red little house where he charged.

Robby tried to push himself with all his strength. He shouted: “Help! I need to get out!” But the blocks were too heavy. Robby was a vacuum cleaner robot, not a superhero! He felt frustrated and a little sad. 

Then he had an idea. He remembered that he had a powerful water jet. With a little buzzing sound, he activated his jet. Blue water sprayed on the blocks! The blocks loosened a little. Robby pushed again, this time with more energy. 

The water helped! Slowly, slowly, Robby managed to free himself. His wheels turned and finally Robby got back to his base, happier than ever. The red little house was waiting for him.

Robby charged quickly. He was happy to have solved his problem. He was proud of his determination. And he thought: “If something seems difficult to you, always try to find a solution!”

plan.problema: Robby got stuck under a pile of building blocks and can’t get back to his base!

plan.finale: Thanks to the water jet and his determination, Robby managed to free himself and happily returned to his base!

robot aspirapolvere.text:
Roby was a very special vacuum cleaner robot. He lived in Leo’s bedroom. He was made of blue plastic and had bright eyes that blinked when he started to work. Roby loved to clean, but one morning there was a big problem.



Leo’s bedroom was full, completely full! There were toys of all kinds: teddy bears, dinosaurs, princesses, and even a little green alien. The toys were scattered everywhere, covering the floor and reaching the table. Roby had gotten lost in this sea of toys! He couldn’t move, he was stuck.



Roby tried to turn around and move quickly. But the toys blocked his way everywhere. A teddy bear blocked his path, a dinosaur covered his view, and a princess had collapsed right in front of him. Roby felt frustrated.



Then he had an idea! He started to make small, focused circles. He moved slowly, trying to avoid every toy. First the circle of the teddy bear, then the circle of the dinosaur, and finally the circle of the princess. With patience and care, Roby finally cleared his space.



Leo’s bedroom was clean and tidy again. Roby stopped, his bright eyes blinked faster than ever. He had learned that even difficult things can be solved with calmness and method. Roby went back to doing his job, ready to clean every little corner of Leo’s bedroom.

plan.problema: Roby got lost in a sea of scattered dolls!
plan.svolta: He tried to turn and move quickly, but the dolls blocked him everywhere.
plan.finale: Roby decided to make small, focused circles to avoid all the dolls and found his free space!

robot aspirapolvere.text:
Spazzolino was a very active vacuum cleaner robot. He lived in Luca’s bedroom. Every day, Spazzolino cleaned with enthusiasm, collecting dust and small toys. But that morning, something had gone wrong. Spazzolino had gotten lost!

He had ended up in a maze of games. There were cars, Lego building blocks, plush toys, and many other objects scattered on the floor. Spazzolino spun around aimlessly, making little noises and trying to find his way. He couldn’t find the way to get back to his place near the door.

Spazzolino tried to move under the bed. He looked behind the wardrobe. But every time he ended up in another corner of the room. He was a little scared, but he didn’t give up. 

Then, Spazzolino had an idea! He had an ultrasound sensor. This sensor allowed Spazzolino to see objects far away. He started using his sensor to locate the brightest Lego pieces. The Legos had fallen from a tall tower and they shone in the sunlight. Spazzolino followed their tracks, moving slowly and carefully.

The sensor guided him towards a small space between the toys. And there, he saw Luca! Luca was very happy to take back his robot friend. Spazzolino immediately recharged with his energy. 

Luca hugged Spazzolino and said, “You were very good at finding me!”. Spazzolino returned to his place, ready for another cleaning. After all, even robots need to persevere to reach their goals.

plan.problema: Toothbrush got lost in a maze of scattered toys in the bedroom!
plan.svolta: After searching under the bed and behind the wardrobe, Toothbrush decided to use his sonic sensor to locate the brightest Lego fragments and follow their tracks.
plan.finale: Toothbrush found Luca, very happy to take back his robot friend!

robot aspirapolvere.text:
Robi was a very special vacuum cleaner robot. He lived in Leo’s bedroom. Robi loved doing his job and always cleaning everything up. But one morning there was a problem! Leo had spent the whole day building a very tall tower with Lego. Then, Leo had gone away and Robi found himself in the middle of a sea of Lego bricks scattered everywhere.

Robi turned around on his four wheels, trying to do something. He was completely lost! The Lego bricks were everywhere: under the table, behind the chair, even inside the laundry basket. Robi felt a strong frustration. “I must clean!” he thought.

Robi had an idea. He decided to use his powerful jet to lift the bricks and group them together. He pressed the button and… puff! A jet of water swept away some Lego bricks, but it also made others fall to the ground! Robi stopped for a moment.

Robi took a deep breath and started again. With small movements, calmly and patiently, he picked up the Lego bricks one by one and moved them to the special box. It was a long job, but Robi didn’t give up. After a long time, every single piece was in its place. Leo’s bedroom was perfect!

Leo entered the room and exclaimed: “Wow, Robi you did a great job!” Robi stopped and waited for Leo to sit on the carpet and play. Robi knew he had overcome a big challenge. And this made him feel very satisfied. Perseverance can lead to achieving your goals.

plan.problema: Robi got lost in a sea of Lego scattered all over his bedroom!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his powerful jet to lift the bricks and group them, but he made more fall!
plan.finale: With patience and small movements, Robi managed to put every single Lego piece in order, making Leo’s bedroom perfect.

robot aspirapolvere.text:
Roby was a very special vacuum cleaner robot. He lived in a colorful kitchen, full of yellow and red furniture. Roby loved to do the cleaning, but that morning he had a problem. A bag full of cookies had fallen to the floor and Roby had made his way through the sugary crumbs.

He was lost! He was surrounded by mountains of chocolate and strawberry cookies. The walls were made of empty cereal boxes. Roby couldn’t find his way out. It was a real sweet and sticky labyrinth.

Roby thought for a moment. He had an ultrasound sensor, designed to avoid obstacles while cleaning. “Maybe I can use it!” exclaimed Roby. He activated and began to move slowly, making little buzzing sounds. The sensor scanned the room, mapping every corner and every cookie.

Roby followed the sensor’s instructions, climbing over mountains of cookies and climbing onto boxes. He continued to move with determination. Then, suddenly, a final buzz brought him out of the labyrinth. 

He was back in the colorful kitchen! Roby stopped, ready to collect the fallen cookies. His battery was full and his work was about to begin again. He had shown that he was a brave and intelligent vacuum cleaner robot. Roby returned to his mission with renewed enthusiasm.

plan.problema: Roby got lost in a maze of scattered cookies!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his ultrasound sensor to map the room and find the exit.
plan.finale: With a final buzz, Roby emerged victorious, ready to collect the fallen cookies.

robot on wheels.text:
Robi was a robot on wheels. He lived in the White Room. Robi loved to spin and make “Beep! Beep!”. He was always happy to move. But today there was a problem. Robi had gotten lost! He was surrounded by lots of toys: plushies, cars, and building blocks. He couldn’t find his charger.

“Oh no!” said Robi. “I have to find it! Without it, I can’t go back to charging my batteries.” Robi started to spin. He spun around and around, fast, fast. But every time he spun, he bumped into the red building block tower. “Boom!” said Robi when he bumped into it. It was frustrating!

The girl, Sofia, was watching Robi. “Try to spin slower,” said Sofia. “And maybe pay attention to the tower.” Robi followed the advice. He spun slower, trying not to bump into the tower. But he kept bumping into it.

Robi felt a little sad. He didn’t want to give up. He focused all his strength and spun one more time. And just then, he saw it! The charger was there, under his soft cushion. Robi ran to get it and plugged it in right away. 

“I did it!” exclaimed Robi. He was happy to be working perfectly again. Robi continued to spin happily in the White Room, ready for new adventures. Sometimes, even when things seem difficult, it just takes a little bit of optimism and perseverance to find the solution!

plan.problema: Robi got lost among the toys and couldn't find his charger!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his wheels to go round and round, but he always ended up bumping into a building block tower.
plan.finale: Thanks to his optimism and determination, Robi found the charger under his pillow!

robot on wheels.text:
Robi was a robot on wheels. He loved to move and make “beep boop!”. He lived in Grandpa Ernesto’s attic, a room full of old things. 

There were boxes of all colors, dusty books, and even an old cowboy hat. Robi spent his days exploring that place, but this time something went wrong.

He had gotten himself into a huge tangle! Boxes everywhere, tall and short, packed together. Robi wanted to go back to his charger, the thing that gave him energy to keep moving. But he couldn’t find the way anymore. It was all confusing!

Robi tried to push the boxes. He pushed hard, with all his wheels. But only more boxes fell on top of him! One after another, the boxes piled up even more. Robi was desperate. He didn’t know what to do.

Then, he had an idea! Instead of pushing, he would use his wheels to gently move each box. Slowly, slowly, calmly and carefully, he started to move the boxes one by one. He pushed them towards the wall, then towards the center of the attic.

After a while, Robi saw the charger! It was right behind the last box he had moved. He plugged it in right away and made a happy “beep boop!”. The attic was quiet again. Robi knew that finding the right way took time and patience. And sometimes, the simplest solution is the one we forget.

plan.problema: Robi got lost in a tangle of boxes and can’t find his charger anymore.
plan.svolta: Robi tried to push the boxes, but more fell on top!
plan.finale: Then he had the idea to use his wheels to gently move each box and find the right way.

robot on wheels.text:
Robi was a robot on wheels. He had red wheels and blue sensors. He lived in Luca’s bedroom. Robi loved to spin and make silly noises. Sometimes he enjoyed pushing his metal body against the walls.

---

One day, Robi found himself in a strange place. He was surrounded by boxes of all shapes and sizes. A big blue box, a small yellow box, a brown box full of books. Robi was lost! He couldn’t find his way out.

---

Robi tried to push his wheels against the boxes. He made “clack, clac, clack”. But only he got stuck and made noise. His wheels weren’t good for this cardboard maze. Robi was a little frustrated.

---

Luca came into the bedroom to look for Robi. “Where are you, Robi?” asked Luca. Robi flashed his blue sensors to answer. Then, suddenly, Luca looked under his favorite teddy bear, Bruno. And there was Robi!

---

Luca laughed with delight. “Robi, you were hiding!” he said. Robi made “beep beep” happily to be found. Luca sat down and continued to play with Bruno. 

---

Robi learned that sometimes you have to slow down and look around. After a little while, Robi settled down next to Luca, ready for new adventures. It only took a little bit longer to find his place.

plan.problema: Robi got lost in a maze of boxes!
plan.svolta: He tried to push the wheels, but only got stuck and made noise.
plan.finale: Luca found Robi hidden under his favorite teddy bear, laughing.

robot on wheels.text:
Rudy was a very special wheeled robot. He lived in a colorful little box, full of toys. He was made of shiny metal and had wheels that made him move very quickly. Rudy loved to spin around and do somersaults in the box.

One day, while he was having fun zooming around, he found himself in a strange place. It was as if he had fallen into a maze! All around him were lots of boxes of all shapes and sizes. Rudy was lost! He didn’t know how to get back.

Rudy tried to move his wheels straight, but he just ended up bumping into other boxes. He spun and spun, back and forth, but the maze seemed bigger and bigger. A little teddy bear, Leo, watched him curiously.

Rudy didn’t give up. He decided to use his wheels in a different way. He spun quickly around himself and then tried to move straight again. With a good push, Rudy pushed himself with force. The wheels spun as fast as they could!

Finally, with one last effort, Rudy came out of the maze! He was free! He stopped to rest and looked at his colorful box. He was happy to be back home. 

Rudy realized that even when things seem difficult, if you never stop trying, you always find the solution.

plan.svolta: He decided to use his wheels to turn and turn, but he only ended up getting stuck!
plan.finale: Finally, with a good push of the pedal, he got out of the maze!

robot on wheels.text:

Suddenly, Ruggine had an idea. He used his little mechanical arms to grab some blocks and move them gently. He moved the blocks one at a time, trying to create a little passage. It was hard work, but Ruggine didn't give up.

He was happy to be free and to be able to spin back in the Creative Workshop. Dr. Leo, who worked in the workshop, smiled seeing Ruggine move again.
