Then, Lollipop made a decision. “I have to go for a ride!” he said out loud. He started to roll quickly among the toys. He waved to the ice tower, the sandcastle, and the swing. He still called the gummy bear, but without success. 

Finally, Lollipop stopped under a swing. And there, hidden among the seats, he saw him! The gummy bear was surprised to see Lollipop. Together they laughed loudly, rolling all over the playground. They spent the day playing and laughing. 

Lollipop realized that friendship is a precious treasure. He felt happy to have his friend nearby. Lollipop’s hand squeezed the gummy bear, and the two friends laughed together all day long.

plan.problema: The lollipop got lost among the many colors of the park and couldn’t find his friend, the gummy bear.
plan.svolta: After trying to call all the children, he decided to take a quick tour to explore every corner of the park.
plan.finale: Finally, he found the gummy bear hidden under a swing and they laughed together all day long.

lollipop.text:
Lollipop was a very happy lollipop. He loved to play in the playground. Every day he ran and had fun on the slides and water games. Lollipop had a little wooden house where he loved to rest when it was hot.

One afternoon, Lollipop decided to explore the new sand maze that had just been built. It was a big maze with narrow paths. Lollipop went deep into the maze, running here and there, but soon he got lost! He couldn't find his way out anymore.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Lollipop. “I’m completely lost!” He tried to find his bearings, but everything looked the same. The sun was shining brightly in the sky, but it was too big to help Lollipop understand where to go. The sun had moved and now Lollipop didn’t know which direction to take.

Just when he was about to lose hope, Lollipop saw a bright red ladybug. “Hello!” said Lollipop to the ladybug. “I’m lost in the sand maze. Can you help me?” The ladybug landed on a pebble and pointed with its little leg along a narrow path. “Follow this path,” said the ladybug, “it’s the shortest!”

Lollipop followed the ladybug’s instructions and soon he found his little wooden house. He was happy! He had solved his problem with a little help. Lollipop settled down on his house, thinking how important it was to ask for advice when you are in trouble.

plan.problema: The Lollipop got lost in the sand maze and couldn't find his way.
plan.svolta: He tried to follow the sun, but it was too big and it had moved!
plan.finale: Then he met a ladybug who showed him the shortest path, and soon he was back at his wooden house.
plan.morale: Even with a little help, you can solve every problem.

lollipop.text:
Lollipop was a bright lollipop. He loved to play in the playground. He had lots of friends: the swing, the sandbox, and the wooden castle. But today Lollipop felt sad. He was lost! Among the colors of the games, the rainbow slides, and the Tibetan bridges, he couldn’t find his favorite flavor: strawberry.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Lollipop, spinning around. “I can’t find my taste! There are so many colors here!” He tried to move between the platforms, but the more he looked, the less he knew where he was.

Suddenly, Lollipop had an idea. He rolled towards the green meadow and plunged into the soft hay. But as he made his way, he noticed something strange. His bright colors were becoming gray! It was as if the color was disappearing.

“Help!” cried Lollipop, frightened. He moved faster and faster. He saw a boy sitting at the ice cream stand. The boy was smiling and had a fresh strawberry in his hand. 

Lollipop ran to him, and the boy offered him the strawberry. As soon as the lollipop tasted that sweet and pink flavor, he felt happier than ever before. His life was full of colors again. 

The boy smiled at Lollipop and said, “You were lost, weren’t you?” 

Lollipop felt better in the boy’s hands, finally finding his favorite flavor.

plan.problema: The Lollipop got lost among so many colors and can’t find his favorite flavor, strawberry.
plan.svolta: Trying to sink into the green meadow, he noticed his colors were turning gray!
plan.finale: Running towards the ice cream stand, he found a boy who offered him a fresh strawberry and rediscovered his flavor.
plan.morale: Hope is always the last resort.

lollipop.text:
Lollipop was a very special lollipop. He had a bright red heart and a star-shaped tip, but he could also move! He lived at the playground, among the slides and water games. Lollipop loved to play, but he especially loved his friend, Gnome Grey, who lived near the castle sand tower.

One day, Lollipop was playing hide-and-seek with Gnome Grey. They ran between the swings and the suspension bridges. Suddenly, while looking for a good hiding place, Lollipop lost his balance and rolled into the sand maze! It was a disaster! He couldn't find Gnome Grey.

Lollipop tried to move with his legs, but he was too heavy. He tried to climb the highest sand hill, but he always slid down. He was very sad and worried about his friend.

Then Lollipop had an idea. He focused and shouted: "Wind! Wind!". The gentle wind began to spin around him. “Can you help me?” asked Lollipop. The wind whispered: “Follow the direction of the sun, little lollipop”.

Lollipop followed the wind’s directions, and in a moment, he saw Gnome Grey waiting for him with a big smile. Lollipop ran to hug him. He was so happy to have him back! 

The sun shone brightly in the sky, and all the children were laughing at the playground. Lollipop understood that even when things seem difficult, asking for help can lead to a wonderful solution.

plan.problema: The lollipop got lost in the sand maze and can’t find his friend, a gnome.
plan.svolta: After climbing a sand dune without success, he decided to ask for help from the wind.
plan.finale: The wind showed him the right way and he found the gnome smiling.

lollipop.text:
Lollipop was a very special lollipop. He wasn't just sugar and glue, but a real friend. He lived in the playground, among the slides and swings. Every day he enjoyed watching the children play. One day, Lollipop noticed that something wasn't right. He had disappeared! He was in the middle of a sea of colors: red of the swing, yellow of the slide, blue of the pond. He couldn't find his place anymore.

Lollipop was scared. He tried to call someone, but no one could hear him. He tried to ask for help from the swings, which moved up and down quickly. “Help! I’m lost!” shouted Lollipop. But the swings didn't understand what he meant. They just made “ting… ting… ting…”

The sun began to rise in the sky. Its rays shone brightly. Lollipop felt sadder and smaller. Suddenly, a ray of sunshine hit his bright color. The bright yellow of Lollipop caught the attention of a child. 

The child approached carefully and picked up Lollipop in his hands. “How lovely! A yellow lollipop!” he exclaimed happily. The child smiled at Lollipop and hugged him tightly. Lollipop felt much better. He understood that even just a little joy could bring comfort. 

The sun continued to shine, and the child played with Lollipop all afternoon. A kind smile can open the doors to new friendships.

plan.problema: Lollipop got lost among the colors of the games.
plan.svolta: He tried to ask for help from the swings, but no one understood him.
plan.finale: Finally, the sun reflected his bright color, attracting the attention of a child who picked him up with joy.

lollipop.text:
Lollipop was a giant lollipop, bright red. He lived at the playground. He loved to swing and slide down the slide. One day, Lollipop noticed that he wasn't alone. Around him there were lots of other toys: yellow balls, blue trains, and colorful blocks. But none of them had his color!

“Oh no!” said Lollipop. “I’m lost! I can’t find my red friends anymore!” It was all so confusing and full of colors. Lollipop felt a little sad. He tried to call someone, but nobody heard him.

Lollipop decided to ask for help from the butterflies. They flew around him, but none of the butterflies knew the red lollipop. “You don’t know me?” asked Lollipop, a little disappointed. The butterflies just fluttered their wings and flew away.

Then, a group of children arrived at the playground. There were two girls and one boy. They looked at the toys. One of the girls, Sofia, pointed to Lollipop with excitement. “Look! What a beautiful red lollipop!” she exclaimed. The other children picked him up and brought him back to his place among the other red toys.

Lollipop felt much better. He was happy to be back home. He thanked the children with a smile. He knew that kindness, even just noticing something beautiful, could do great things. And indeed, the next day, all the children greeted him and sat near him to play.

plan.problema: The Lollipop got lost among so many colors of his friends.
plan.svolta: He tried to ask for help from the butterflies, but none of them recognized him.
plan.finale: Finally, a group of children noticed his bright color and returned him to his place.

lollipop.text:
Lollipop was a very happy lollipop. He lived at the playground and loved watching the children play. He was made of bright red hard candy and had a little colorful stick. Lollipop enjoyed rolling near the slides, zooming with the swings, and hearing the sound of laughter.

One day, Lollipop noticed that he was no longer where he was supposed to be. He was surrounded by a pile of dry leaves and a little bit of sand. He had gotten lost! He didn't understand how he had gotten there. He tried to move, but it was difficult to roll through all that mud.

Lollipop tried to shout for help, but his voice was too small. No one could hear him. He was sad and a little scared. The other playground toys looked at him, but no one knew what to do.

Suddenly, Lollipop saw a little blue bird. The bird flew up and down and landed near him. The bird, with its chirping, attracted the attention of a child who was playing with the big swing. The child saw Lollipop and ran to him.

The child picked up Lollipop and put him right next to his place near the swing. Lollipop was happy! He was back home. The bird flew away, waving goodbye to Lollipop. 

Lollipop felt much better. He had learned that even when things seem difficult, you should never give up. And so, Lollipop continued to smile at the playground, knowing that he had overcome a small problem. Perseverance made the difference.

plan.problema: The lollipop was lost among the slides and swings.
plan.svolta: He tried to shout, but his voice was too small to be heard.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a little bird, he found his place near the big swing.

martello.text:
Martello was a very special hammer. He lived in the Flower Garden and loved watching the butterflies. He was made of shiny metal and had a big, red head. One day, Martello noticed something strange. The garden had become too dark. The sun wasn’t sending out its bright rays anymore!

The roses had lost their color, the flowers were hiding, and the little birds weren’t singing anymore. It was all gray and quiet. Martello wanted to help. “I must do something!” he thought. He tried to hit a rock with his head, but it didn’t work. It was useless.

Then, he saw a big, old tree in the garden. He decided to try and hit the tree, hoping the sun would return. Martello hit it hard and… the leaves fell down, one after another. But the light didn’t come back. Only the leaves were falling.

A little ladybug came up to Martello. “Maybe the sun’s rays are trapped!” said the ladybug. Martello thought for a moment. He saw a golden bell on a garland hanging from a wisteria branch. Carefully, he hit the bell with his head. 

A sweet, clear sound filled the air. Immediately, the sun’s rays began to return, one by one. The Flower Garden became full of light and colors again. The flowers smiled, and the birds sang again. Martello was happy. He solved the problem with his kindness. The most important thing is that a small gesture can do a lot of good.

plan.problema: The sun had lost its rays and the garden had become too dark.
plan.svolta: Martello tried to hit a tree, but only the leaves fell down without bringing back the light.
plan.finale: Then, with a gentle tap on the bell of a garland, he freed the trapped rays!

martello.text:
Martello loved the Flower Garden. Every day he sat among the geraniums and roses, watching the flowers dance in the wind. He was a wooden hammer, strong and with a shiny head. He liked to listen to the singing of the birds and the buzzing of the bees.

A sunny afternoon, Martello saw something sad. The most beautiful flower in the garden, a bright yellow tulip, had fallen to the ground. Its emerald green leaf had fallen off and lay beside the broken stem. Martello felt a strange worry.

“Oh no!” said Martello. “I must do something for the tulip!” He tried to grab the leaf with his head, but it was too small and slipped away into the soil. The leaf was light as a feather and kept moving further and further away.

Martello thought for a moment. Then he had an idea! He used his strong handle to create a small wooden beam. Carefully, he placed the beam under the leaf and gently supported it. The beam was like a little bridge. 

A ladybug, Lila, approached shyly. “What are you doing, Martello?” she asked.

“I am trying to bring the leaf back to its place,” replied Martello, calmly. Slowly, with extreme delicacy, the leaf returned to rest on the tulip. 

Martello stopped for a moment, watching the flower and its leaf. Then he looked again at the garden, waiting for the wind to stop blowing. It was important to be patient.

plan.problema: The smallest, most beautiful flower in the garden had fallen and its little leaf had fallen off!
plan.svolta: Martello tried to put the leaf back on, but it was too small and it slipped away!
plan.finale: Martello used his handle to make a small beam and gently supported the leaf, returning it to the flower.

martello.text:
Martello was a very strong hammer. He lived in Leo’s garden and loved to play among the flowers and plants. His favorite place was under the big oak tree, the tallest in the garden.

One day, Martello decided to help clean the garden. He wanted to make all the leaves fall from the oak tree. But the leaves were big and stuck to the branch! Martello repeatedly hit the wood with all his strength. It made “dack, dack, dack,” but the leaves didn’t want to come down. He was frustrated.

Leo came up to him. “Martello, maybe you’re using too much energy,” said Leo smiling. “Try to hit more slowly and carefully.”

Martello listened to Leo. He took a deep breath and hit the branch once. A small branch broke off and fell gently to the ground. Martello hit it again, this time with a stronger but also lighter blow. Another leaf slid down. Then another, and another.

Soon, the leaves began to fall one by one, forming a soft carpet around the oak tree. Leo was happy to see Martello working calmly and precisely. 

Martello stopped to rest. He felt satisfied. He had learned that sometimes, strength isn’t enough. You have to use the right combination of energy and patience.

Leo collected the fallen leaves and put them in a bag. Martello watched him smile.

plan.problema: The little hammer was having trouble making the leaves fall from the big oak tree.
plan.svolta: After hitting the branch repeatedly, he realized he needed the right amount of force and not just lots of energy!
plan.finale: With a gentle but firm blow, the leaves began to fall one by one, forming a soft carpet around the oak tree.
plan.morale: Patience is key to solving problems.

martello.text:
Martello was a strong, red hammer. He lived in the Flower Garden, among the fragrant geraniums and bluebells. He loved to watch the roses, big and bushy. But one day he noticed a problem. The roses were too tall! They hid all the ladybugs.

Martello was very disappointed. The ladybugs loved to play among the petals of the roses, but there were no more empty spaces. He wanted to help, he had to do something. He walked up to the tallest rose and thought, “I need to swing!”

Martello tried to swing, but he only made a leaf fall, which rolled across the lawn. A little scared squirrel jumped from branch to branch. Martello felt a little surprised and disappointed. He realized it wasn't so easy to solve the problem.

Martello thought again. He looked at the leaves around the roses. They were big and green. He decided to do something different. Carefully, he pulled the biggest leaves one by one. He gently moved them to the side. 

The roses opened a little, and the sun shone on the colorful ladybugs who began to play among the petals. The ladybugs moved happily, and Martello smiled. He was happy to have found the right solution.

Martello continued to watch the ladybugs all afternoon. The Flower Garden was a wonderful and quiet place. Martello learned that sometimes, even the strongest swings don’t help; patience can lead to true beauty.

plan.problema: The roses were too tall and hid the ladybugs!
plan.svolta: Hammer tried to swing, but he only made a leaf fall and scared a little squirrel.
plan.finale: Then, with care, he pulled back the biggest leaves to let the colorful ladybugs shine!

martello.text:
Martello was a very special hammer. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Martello loved to be there, watching the butterflies and listening to the birds sing. One day, he heard a sad voice. “Oh no!” it said. It was the little wooden bridge that crossed a stream. The bridge had fallen apart!

Martello went up to the stream. The bridge looked very sad. No one knew what to do to fix it. Martello wanted to help, but he didn’t know how. He tried to use his hammer to hit the wood and try to put it back together. But it only made it splinter even more! “Oh no!” Martello said again, frustrated.

He thought, and thought, and thought. He saw some big stones near the stream. An idea popped into his head! He picked up the stones and put them under the broken bridge to support it. The bridge wasn’t complete yet, but at least it wasn’t falling down anymore.

Suddenly, he heard a scratch. It was Scattino, the squirrel of the secret garden. Scattino had brought some wooden beams! Together, Martello and Scattino placed the beams on the bridge. They fixed it quickly and well. The bridge was ready to be crossed again.

Martello felt happy. He had learned that sometimes you need a little help to solve problems. Scattino and Martello smiled, knowing that together they were much stronger. It was nice to see everyone working together to reach a goal.

plan.problema: The little wooden bridge had fallen down and no one knew how to fix it.
plan.svolta: Hammer tried to use his hammer to hit the wood, but it only made it splinter even more!
plan.finale: Then he had the idea to look for big stones and use them to support the bridge until a friendly squirrel arrived with some wooden beams.

martello.text:
Martello was a very friendly hammer. He lived in Nonna Emilia’s secret garden. It was a place full of colorful flowers and lush plants. Martello loved to play there, but one morning he had found himself in a tricky situation. He had lost his head!

He had made his way through the fragrant roses and yellow tulips, but the more he looked, the more he felt lost. His head wasn’t anywhere. “Oh no!” thought Martello, “I must find it!”. He looked under the white lily, tried to peek between the sunflower leaves, but nothing.

Then, Martello squeezed himself into a very tall lavender bush. It was tight and he couldn’t move. A little squirrel, Leo, greeted him from above. “Do you need help?” asked Leo, but Martello said, “I can’t do anything, I’ve lost my head!”.

Martello had an idea! He started to use his handle to pull himself out of the bush. He tapped and pushed with all his might. After many attempts, he realized he had to try using the handle in a different way. With a strong hit, he struck the ground right next to the lavender bush.

And so, with one final well-placed hit, his head came back to its place! Martello aligned perfectly with his handle. He was happy! He had solved his problem with patience and determination. 

Martello realized that even when things seem difficult, with calmness and perseverance, you always find solutions.

plan.problema: The little hammer has gotten lost among the flowers and can’t find his head!
plan.svolta: After trying to hammer on every flower, he decided to use his handle to pull himself out of the tallest bush.
plan.finale: Finally, with one last well-placed blow, he found his head and happily aligned with the handle!

martello.text:
Martello loved the Flower Garden. He was a wooden hammer, red and strong, and he really liked to be there among the sunflowers and roses. The other toys enjoyed running and jumping, but Martello preferred to watch.

One day, he noticed something strange. The yellow and blue butterflies were flying around the flowers, but they couldn’t reach the tallest ones! They struggled among the low petals, never reaching the lilies and daisies. Martello felt worried for them.

Martello tried to hammer strongly against the trunk of a big sunflower. The wood shook, but it only pushed the leaves down. The butterflies flew even higher, desperately searching for a solution.

He thought, thought, thought. Then, he had an idea! Using his gentle point, Martello began to cut small wooden ramps on the trunks of the tallest flowers. He was creating little steps to help the butterflies climb. 

A little snail, named Leo, watched him with curiosity. “What are you doing, Martello?” he asked.

Martello continued to work, creating ramps one after another. The butterflies, initially hesitant, began to approach and, with a little flight, climbed onto the ramps. Finally, they could enjoy the most beautiful flowers!

Martello felt happy. He had solved the problem with patience and cleverness. The sunlight shone on the Flower Garden, and the butterflies danced around him. He always remembered that the best solution comes when you put in effort and calm.

plan.problema: The butterflies couldn't reach the tallest flowers!
plan.svolta: Hammer tried to hit with force, but only pushed the leaves down!
plan.finale: Then, using his delicate point, he cut little ramps to help the butterflies climb.

martello.text:
Martello lived in the Flower Garden. He was a wooden hammer, strong and with a shiny red head. He loved to be there, among the yellow tulips and red roses. One day, he saw something sad. The little blue flower, the gentlest in the garden, had fallen to the ground, lying on its side.

“Oh no!” said Martello. “I can’t leave it like that! I must straighten it.” He tried to use his head to push the flower, but nothing. The flower moved a little, and then it fell down again. It was too fragile to be pushed with force.

A ladybug, Cuddle, approached shyly. “Maybe if you gently press it…” suggested Cuddle. Martello tried to use his head again, but this time the flower squashed a little more. Martello felt like he was hurting the flower.

He thought, he thought… and then he had an idea. With great care, he used the tip of his handle to get to the flower. He pushed with a lot of, a lot of attention, centimetre by centimetre. The flower moved slowly, slowly. Martello was patient.

Finally, the flower was standing up again! It was a little wobbly, but it was balanced. Martello was happy. He had learned that even small and delicate things need to be straightened with calmness and care. 

Martello settled down beside the blue flower, watching it smile in the sun. With great care, the hammer always knows how to help his little friends of the Flower Garden.

plan.problema: The little flower that was favorite in the garden had fallen and the hammer couldn't straighten it.
plan.svolta: Hammer tried to gently push the flower with his head, but only squashed it a little more.
plan.finale: With great care, Hammer used the tip to lift the flower and straighten it slowly, bringing it back into balance.
plan.morale: Patience helps to solve small problems.

martello.text:
Martello was a very special hammer. He lived in a secret garden full of flowers and tall trees. Every day he loved to play with colorful blocks, building very tall towers. But one day, something bad happened. His points disappeared! They had fallen somewhere and he didn't know where they were.

Martello was very sad. Without the points, he couldn't hammer the blocks to stand up anymore. The tower he was building had immediately collapsed. “Oh no!” said Martello with a little thump. “I can’t build my tower anymore!”

Then, Martello had an idea. He decided to dig in the ground with his strong handle. He dug and dug, under the green ferns and rose bushes. Finally, he found lots of stones! They were pebbles of different sizes and colors.

A little ladybug, Lila, watched him as he collected the stones. “What are you doing, Martello?” asked Lila. Martello replied: “I’m trying to build a new tower!”

Martello used the pebbles to create an even taller and more colorful tower than ever before. The stones were different from each other, creating a fun and original effect. The tower was beautiful! 

Martello realized that even when things go wrong, you can always find a creative solution. Martello’s perseverance led him to create something even more beautiful than he had imagined.

plan.problema: The little hammer has lost its points and can’t build the block tower anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to dig in the ground with his handle to find stones to replace the missing points.
plan.finale: He found a series of colorful pebbles that, together, formed an even more beautiful and original tower!

martello.text:
Martello was a special hammer. He lived in the Flower Garden and loved watching the butterflies. He was a strong hammer, with a dark wooden handle and a shiny steel head. One day, he heard a quiet sob.

“Oh no!” said a little voice. “I’ve lost my key!”

Martello went to the little gnome, Pip, who was sitting among the red tulips. Pip was very sad. “My key is gone! It was in my little house and there were lots of yummy sweets inside!”

Martello decided to help. “Don’t worry, Pip,” said Martello. “I’ll find your key.” He started looking around the wooden house, but the key was too small to see among the leaves and stones. 

Martello tried to look under the flowers, but the key was too small to see. He thought it might have fallen into a hole. So, Martello went to a big mossy rock. He focused and started to gently tap with his hammer.

He hit a stone, then another. The sound of the hammer echoed in the garden. Suddenly, the key rolled out from under the rock! Pip ran to grab it. “Thank you, Martello!” he exclaimed happily. “You were very clever!”

Martello felt happy. He had solved the problem with patience and care. The Flower Garden was becoming a peaceful place again. The key was safe back in Pip’s little house, full of delicious sweets. Sometimes, patience is the most powerful thing.

plan.problema: The little gnome had lost his key to open the drawer full of sweets!
plan.svolta: Hammer tried to look under the flowers, but the key was too small to be seen.
plan.finale: Thanks to his little hammer, Hammer gently hit a stone and the key rolled out from the rock!

metro da misura.text:
Metro was a measuring tape who was very curious. He lived in the Flower Garden, among fragrant roses and tall sunflowers. Every day, Metro moved around the garden, exploring every corner. Sometimes he touched the big leaves, other times he measured the distance between the colorful tulips.

One day, Metro noticed a small yellow flower, hidden in the grass. It was the smallest flower in the garden and it seemed sad. The sun shone brightly in the sky, but the little flower couldn't reach it. Its leaves were too low.

Metro went up to the flower. “Why are you so down?” asked Metro. “I just want to take a little bit of sunshine!” replied the little flower in a faint voice.

Metro decided to help. He stretched out his ends, trying to get closer to the shiny leaves. But his tips were too far away! It was a difficult job. The shiny leaves shone far away, almost impossible to reach.

Metro recovered and tried again. He bent slightly, with his whole body. His ends finally reached the leaves of the little flower. The small flower stretched towards the light. With one last effort, Metro straightened up.

The yellow flower was happy! It had taken the sunshine and was shining again. Metro stopped, satisfied. He had been patient and had helped the little flower find what it wanted. The sun continued to shine in the Flower Garden. Patience can do miracles.

plan.problema: The smallest flower in the garden couldn’t reach the sun.
plan.svolta: Metro decided to stretch as far as he could, but his ends remained too far from the shiny leaves.
plan.finale: With one last effort, Metro bent slightly and the smallest leaf finally enjoyed the sun.

metro da misura.text:
Metro Mattia was a special measuring tape. He could talk and move in the Flower Garden. He was made of shiny metal and had a long handle that kept stretching out. He loved exploring every corner of the garden, measuring the plants and trees.

---

One day, Metro Mattia noticed a problem. There was a beautiful rose, Mr. Rosino, but he was too small to reach the sun. The sun was shining high in the sky, and Mr. Rosino was complaining: “I’m so thirsty! I wish I could feel the warmth of the sun!”

---

Metro Mattia decided to help. He started to stretch, extending his handle to the fullest. He tried to reach the sun, but he was too short. His metal creaked with the effort. “I can’t do it,” thought Metro Mattia, a little disappointed.

---

Just at that moment, a gentle butterfly, called Lila, landed on Mr. Rosino’s petal. Lila had colorful wings and sweet eyes. “Can I help you, Metro Mattia?” asked Lila.

---

Metro Mattia carefully measured the distance between the flower and where the sun shone the brightest. He discovered that only a little bit of soil was needed to create a small hill. With Lila’s help, Metro Mattia moved the soil and they built a little hill around Mr. Rosino.

---

The flower rose up in height and finally reached the sun. It began to bloom, becoming red and fragrant. Mr. Rosino was happy! 

---

Metro Mattia smiled. He realized that sometimes you have to wait a little while to see the results. And so, in the Flower Garden, the flower bloomed happily.

plan.problema: The Rose flower wasn't tall enough to reach the sun!
plan.svolta: He decided to stretch as far as he could, but he was too short to reach the light.
plan.finale: With the help of a kind butterfly, Metro Mattia measured precisely how much earth was needed to make a little hill and the flower bloomed happily!

metro da misura.text:
Metro Felice was a very special measuring stick. He lived in the Flower Garden and could move all by himself. Every day he enjoyed measuring the tall and short plants, the big and small stones. He was a happy measuring stick, indeed!

---

One morning, Metro Felice noticed a little pink flower sitting right by the edge of the garden. The flower looked sad. “What’s wrong?” asked Metro Felice. The flower replied, “I can’t reach the sun! I’m too far away!”

---

Metro Felice went closer to the flower. He measured the distance between the flower and the sunbeam. It was very, very long! He decided then to stretch as far as he could. He pulled back and stretched out, but it was still too short. He couldn’t even touch the sun, not even by a centimeter.

---

A ladybug, who often played in the garden, watched Metro Felice with curiosity. “Maybe if you measure the distance very carefully,” suggested the ladybug, “you can find a solution.”

---

Metro Felice focused. He carefully measured the distance between the flower and the sun, counting every centimeter. Then he thought, “We have to do something more!” He pointed to the children playing in the garden. “Measure! Build a little ramp for the flower!”

---

The children understood right away. With care and patience, they built a little ramp of earth and stones. The pink flower, thanks to the ramp, was finally able to reach the sun. It was happy and smiling. Metro Felice felt satisfied. He had helped the flower to have some sun.

---

The sun slowly set in the Flower Garden. Metro Felice returned to his place, ready for new measurements. After a long time, he realized that sometimes the hardest things just need a little step at a time and lots of patience.

plan.problema: The smallest flower in the garden couldn’t reach the sun!
plan.svolta: It decided to stretch as far as possible, but it was too short to reach the sun.
plan.finale: Using its flexible body, it measured the distance accurately and suggested to the children to build a small ramp for the flower.

metro da misura.text:
Metro Magical was a special measuring stick. He lived in the Flower Garden and could move all by himself! He was always ready to help the plants. Today, Metro Magical felt a deep sadness. He saw Rose, the pink flower, who was complaining.

“I’m too small!” she was sobbing. “I can’t reach the sun! I’m so thirsty.”

Metro Magical carefully approached Rose. He tried to stretch, stretch, but his tip didn’t even reach the base of the flower. It was frustrating for Metro Magical. He wanted to help Rose shine.

“I need to do something!” thought Metro Magical and he rolled with force towards the sun. He moved quickly, but it was still too far away. The sun seemed so high! A little beetle, Leo, watched him curiously.

Metro Magical continued to move, trying to reach Rose. Then he had an idea. He used his beam to measure the ground around Rose. He measured and measured, looking carefully. “The ground is too hard,” said Metro Magical. “Rose needs more soil!”

Metro Magical suggested adding some moist compost to Rose’s soil. Leo helped to spread the soil around the flower. After a while, Rose began to grow! Her leaves became greener and her petals began to shine. 

Metro Magical stopped beside Rose, satisfied. He solved the problem calmly and patiently. The sunlight finally reached her completely. He realized that everything needs its own time to grow.

plan.problema: The Rose was too small and couldn't reach the sun!
plan.svolta: Metro Magic rolled forward with force towards the sun, but he was still too far away.
plan.finale: Thanks to his long range, Metro Magic measured the soil and suggested adding some soil to help Rose grow faster!

metro da misura.text:
Metro Micio was a very special measuring tape. He lived in the Flower Garden and could move all by himself. He was made of blue plastic and had lots of markings to measure with. Sometimes he rolled up and sometimes he stretched out, just like cats!

In the Flower Garden there were lots of colorful flowers: red roses, yellow tulips, and red poppies. But there was also a very small flower, a white lily, that was the saddest of all. The lily couldn’t reach the sun. Its leaves were resting on the ground and the sun only warmed it a little.

Metro Micio noticed the problem. “Oh no!” he thought. “The lily needs light!” He slowly walked towards the white flower. He tried to use his markings to push the sun closer, but it was too difficult. The sun was too far away!

Then Metro Micio had a brilliant idea. He rolled around the flower, stretching out with all his measurements. He got very long, very long, almost as long as the sun itself! With patience and care, Metro Micio moved slowly, aligning his tip towards the sun.

The sun shone brightly and the white lily stretched towards the light. The flower smiled and thanked Metro Micio for his help. “Thank you, thank you!” said the lily. “Now I’m happy!”

Metro Micio relaxed a little. He was happy to have helped the little flower. He slowly pulled back and returned to measuring distances in the Flower Garden. Everything needs its own time to reach what it wants.

plan.problema: The smallest flower in the garden couldn’t reach the sun.
plan.svolta: Metro Micio rolled around the flower, stretching out all his measures to bring the sun closer!
plan.finale: The flower smiled and stretched towards the light, thanking Metro Micio for his help.

metro da misura.text:
Metro Leo was a special measuring tape. He lived in the Flower Garden and loved to explore every corner. He was made of shiny metal and had a red knob that turned. One day, Rose, the beautiful rose of the garden, complained.

“I’m so sad!” said Rose. “I can’t reach the sun! My stem is too short.”

Metro Leo walked over to Rose. He measured how long the distance was between the flower and the sun. It was quite a lot! Metro Leo stretched, and stretched even more. He was trying to reach the sun, but it wasn’t enough. His red knob turned quickly, but he couldn’t take a step big enough for Rose.

A little ladybug, Cilla, flew nearby and watched the situation. “Maybe,” said Cilla, “you could use your shorter parts to help Rose straighten up?”

Metro Leo thought about it. It was a good idea! He used his smaller sections to support Rose’s stem and make it bend slightly towards the sun. Slowly, slowly, Rose moved closer to the sunlight. The sun warmed her, and she smiled.

Metro Leo continued to work patiently, adjusting the stem a little bit each time. Finally, Rose was right next to the sun! She was happy and grateful. Metro Leo stopped, pleased with his work. He had learned that even small steps can lead to big results. Patience is a valuable virtue when you need to help a friend.

plan.problema: The Rose didn’t manage to reach the sunlight because her stem was too short.
plan.svolta: Leo, the meter, stretched to the limit, but it wasn’t enough for the flower to take a step!
plan.finale: Then, Leo had the idea of using his shorter parts to help Rose straighten up and get closer to the light.

metro da misura.text:
Metro Mario was a very special ruler. He lived in the Flower Garden and loved to measure everything. The tallest flowers, the biggest leaves, the longest stones. He was always ready to help, with his precise point.

One day, a pink lady arrived in the garden. It was a beautiful rose, but the garden was small. The new rose wanted to grow, but there wasn’t any space! Metro Mario worried. “I must do something!” he thought.

Metro Mario stretched, stretched, and stretched. He was trying to measure the space needed for the rose. He wanted the rose to have plenty of space for its roots. But as he stretched, his point got stuck in the hard ground. It was stuck! He couldn’t move.

A little ladybug, called Cicciola, saw Metro Mario in trouble. “What’s happening?” she asked. Metro Mario explained his problem. Cicciola thought for a little while and then said, “Wait!”

Then, a little ray of sunshine hit Metro Mario’s point. The sun warmed the earth around his point and… *click!* The point came loose! Metro Mario was okay and continued to measure carefully. 

The rose finally had the space to grow strong and bushy. Its leaves were green and its roses smelled so sweet. Metro Mario was happy, his mission was complete. The garden was blooming thanks to the patience of a little ruler.

plan.problema: The garden was too small for the new rose that wanted to grow!
plan.svolta: It decided to stretch as much as possible, but its tip got stuck in the ground.
plan.finale: Thanks to a little ray of sunshine, it managed to free itself and the rose found space to bloom abundantly.

metro da misura.text:
Misurino was a very special measuring tape. He lived in the Flower Garden, among fragrant roses and tall sunflowers. Misurino loved his job: measuring everything that came along. But one day he noticed he had a problem.

The leaves on the trees were all so different! Some were as big as a child’s hand, others as small as a finger. Still others had strange shapes, long or round. Misurino wanted to help the trees understand which leaves were similar to others, but he couldn’t do a simple thing: match the leaves.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Misurino, clutching his metal handle. “It’s too difficult! I can’t find a way to sort these leaves.”

A little ladybug, Lila, watched him curiously. “Maybe you should try measuring each leaf more carefully,” suggested Lila.

Misurino thought about it. He decided to double his effort. He gathered his courage and began to measure every single leaf in the Flower Garden. He measured the length and width of each leaf, taking his time not to miss a small detail. He was very patient.

Misurino spent hours in the garden, measuring, comparing, and taking notes. Then, with great joy, he realized he had finally found a solution! Thanks to his accurate measurements, he was able to sort all the leaves by their length and width. The longest leaves were lined up, the shortest leaves lined up, creating a beautiful rainbow of shapes on the ground.

Misurino felt happy and satisfied with his work. He had shown that with patience and attention, even difficult things can be solved. The sun set over the Flower Garden, illuminating the rainbow of leaves created by Misurino.

plan.problema: He couldn't match the leaves of different trees, each one was too different from the others.
plan.svolta: He decided to double his effort and measure each leaf with extreme precision, slowing down his pace to not miss a detail.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to his accurate measurements, he was able to classify all the leaves by their length and width, creating a beautiful rainbow of shapes.

metro da misura.text:
Metro was a measuring tape who was very curious. He lived in the Flower Garden, among the red tulips and yellow daisies. Every day he moved around the garden, touching big and small plants. He loved to smell the flowers and watch the ants running.

---

One afternoon, Metro heard a whimper. The biggest flower in the garden, a white lily, had moved away from its pot. It had ended up near the rose bush! Metro tried to measure the distance between the flower and the pot, but it was too far to be accurate. He couldn’t say how much space there was to cover.

---

“Oh no!” thought Metro. “I must help the lily get back home.” He stopped for a moment, then he had an idea. He took a piece of paper and started to draw. He used his zero and his numbers to create a white line on the paper. The line started from the lily and went all the way to the pot.

---

A ladybug, curious, came close to Metro. “What are you doing?” asked the ladybug. Metro explained his plan to the little insect. “The flower will follow this line!” said Metro with enthusiasm. The lily, curious, started to walk following the paper path. Slowly, slowly, it got closer to the pot.

---

When it arrived near the pot, the lily smiled and was happy to return among its leaves. Metro was happy. He had solved the problem with patience and creativity. The Flower Garden seemed even more beautiful than before. 

---

Metro continued to move around the garden, always ready to help his new friends. And so, nature shows that one small step at a time can lead to big results.

plan.problema: The biggest flower in the garden had moved away from its pot, and Metro couldn't measure the distance to bring it back.
plan.svolta: Metro decided to use his zeros and numbers to create a paper path for the flower to follow.
plan.finale: The flower, curious, followed the paper path to its pot and returned happily among its leaves.

metro da misura.text:
Metro Leo was a special measuring tape. He lived in the Flower Garden and could move all by himself! He had a blue plastic body and a yellow knob that turned smoothly. Every day, Metro Leo loved to explore the garden with his friends, the flowers.

One morning, Metro Leo saw a tulip that was particularly tall. It was the biggest of all in the garden! But the tulip wasn't happy. The sun was shining high in the sky, but the tulip couldn't reach it. Its leaves were low and its stem was too short.

Metro Leo walked up to the tulip. “What’s wrong?” asked Metro Leo. “I can’t reach the sun!” replied the tulip with a sad voice.

Metro Leo stood next to the stem of the tulip. He rolled around the stem, trying to lift it a little, but it was too heavy. The tulip didn't move at all. A little ladybug was watching the scene with curiosity.

Metro Leo thought, thought, and thought. He kept turning slowly, pushing with all his strength. Then, with one last push, Metro Leo managed to move the tulip so that it could feel the light! The tulip lifted up slightly and smiled.

“Thank you, Metro Leo!” said the happy tulip. Metro Leo stopped, pleased with his work. The sun was finally shining on the tall tulip. 

Metro Leo understood that sometimes, even the hardest things can be done with a little patience and effort. And so, every day, Metro Leo continued to help the flowers in the Flower Garden reach the sun.

plan.problema: The tallest tulip couldn’t reach the sun!
plan.svolta: Leo rolled around the stem of the tulip, trying to lift it a little, but it was too heavy.
plan.finale: Then, with one last push, Leo managed to move the tulip so that he could feel the light!
plan.morale: Patience helps to achieve your goals.

microfono.text:
Microphone Mattia lived in a creative workshop full of colors and shapes. He was a special microphone, able to speak and move on his own. The other toys loved him very much, but lately Mattia felt sad. He couldn’t make funny sounds anymore! The teddy bear was unhappy, the doll smiled little, and the train didn’t make its characteristic chugs anymore.

“Oh no!” said Mattia. “I can’t be heard anymore! Everyone is sad because I can’t make silly noises.” The building robot turned his head, worried. 

Mattia thought for a while. Then he had a strange idea. “Maybe… maybe I should try something completely new!” And so, he closed his beak and started to bite his wires. He made strange sounds, as if he were chewing gummy candies! 

A laboratory bunny, Pipì, approached curiously. “What’s that sound, Mattia?” Pipì asked, hopping excitedly. The other toys gathered around Mattia, laughing and joking. The teddy bear started to dance and the doll began to spin around herself. 

Mattia realized that it doesn’t matter what you do, the important thing is to try! Creativity has no limits and the strangest sound can bring so much joy. Mattia continued to make his silly noises, and everyone in the creative workshop had a lot of fun.

plan.problema: Mattia can’t make silly sounds and all the other children are sad.
plan.svolta: He decides to try singing a funny melody, using only his teeth!
plan.finale: The animals in the lab have a lot of fun with his strange sounds and Mattia realizes that creativity has no limits.

microfono.text:
Microphone Mattia lived in a music studio full of colorful instruments. There were keyboards, violins, and guitars. But Microphone Mattia loved making noise the most. He was a special microphone because he could talk!

One day, Miss Giulia, a very nice musician, wanted to record a song for the fish in her aquarium. “You should make some fun sounds, Microphone Mattia!” she said. Microphone Mattia got ready to make a big whistle. He tried to press the button with force, but nothing good came out. It just made a “plop!” sound.

“It’s not working,” he said sadly. “I can’t make the fish happy!” Miss Giulia encouraged him: “Try to move your mouth while you press the button.” Microphone Mattia thought about it. He realized that maybe, to make the sounds of the fish, he needed to use his throat!

So, he closed his eyes and pretended to be swimming. He pressed the button with a big movement of his throat. And a magical thing happened! Small squeaks and whistles came out, like the sounds fish make when they are happy. The fish in the aquarium moved quickly and jumped for joy.

Microphone Mattia was very happy. He had learned to make new and exciting sounds. Miss Giulia smiled: “Good job, Microphone Mattia, you did a great job!” 
It was nice to discover new things and see the results of your hard work.

plan.problema: He can't make the right sounds for the fish song!
plan.svolta: He realizes he needs to use his throat to sing like a fish.
plan.finale: Finally, he learns to make squeaks and trills that make the fish happy.
plan.morale: Sometimes you have to try new things.

microfono.text:
Luca’s bedroom was full of colorful toys. In the middle of the rug was Microphone Max. Max was a special microphone because he could talk! “Hello Luca!” he always said. He was happy when Luca used him to sing.

One day, Luca wanted to sing with his friend Leo. Luca took Max and started to sing loudly. But the sound coming out of the microphone was very weak. “I can’t make the loud sounds!” said Max sadly. Luca tried to push the power button, but nothing changed.

Max felt a little down. He wanted to help Luca sing well. So he decided to try something new. He started to tap on his metal body. “Tap loudly, Max!” exclaimed Luca. But the sound that came out remained squeaky and weak.

Leo entered the bedroom. Seeing Max sad, he asked, “What’s happening, Max?” Max explained the problem. Leo thought for a moment and said, “Maybe you should bring your mouth closer to the microphone!” Luca followed Leo’s advice. He brought his mouth close to Max and started to sing.

Suddenly, the sound coming out of the microphone was powerful and clear! Luca and Leo laughed happily. Max was very happy to have helped his friends sing. 

Max realized that together you can always do something beautiful. Singing with friends makes everything more fun!

plan.problema: Max couldn’t make the loudest sounds to sing with his friend Leo.
plan.svolta: He decided to try banging on the body of the microphone, but the sound remained weak and squeaky.
plan.finale: Leo suggested Max bring his mouth closer to the microphone, and suddenly the sound was powerful and clear!

microfono.text:
Microphone Mattia lived in the wooden house. He was a special microphone, because he could talk and move all by himself! He loved to sing, but he had a little problem. When he tried to make loud and clear sounds, he couldn’t always do it. His voices were weak, almost whispers. Mattia felt sad. He really wanted to make his voice heard, full of energy.

The house was full of colorful toys: a teddy bear, a toy train, and a building box. But Mattia preferred to be there, near the window. One afternoon, while complaining to himself, he heard a light breeze come in through the open window.

“Maybe,” thought Mattia, “I need to try something different.” He decided to talk to the wind, making the gentlest sounds he could produce. He pushed his handle up and down, making little noises. The wind blew lightly, as if listening very carefully.

Suddenly, the wind answered with a gentle puff. A sweet and vibrant sound came out of Mattia, louder and clearer than before! It was wonderful! Mattia continued to talk to the wind, and every time his sound became even more powerful. He had found the right strength to let his vibrant sounds come out.

The wind calmed down, and Mattia felt happy and satisfied. The wooden house seemed even cozier. Everything needs its own time to find the right way to express itself.

plan.problema: Mattia can’t make loud and clear sounds when he tries to sing.
plan.svolta: He decided to try to speak with the wind, making the softest sounds he could produce.
plan.finale: The wind answered with a gentle breath, helping him to find the right strength to let his vibrant sounds come out.

microfono.text:
Microphone Max lived in the music lab. He was a special microphone, because he could talk and move! He loved helping the musicians create new songs. One day, Leo arrived, a little boy who wanted to sing for the school event.

---

“Hello Max!” said Leo. “I want to sing my favorite song, but your microphone isn’t working!”

---

Max felt sad. He couldn’t make his voice sound. It was like something was blocking him. “Oh no!” exclaimed Max. “I must help Leo to sing!”

---

Leo sat in front of the microphone and started to sing, but there was no sound. Max thought, thought, thought. Then he had an idea! He decided to try to make a louder sound, emitting a high buzz that hit Leo’s ear!

---

Leo burst out laughing. “What a strange sound, Max!” he said, smiling. Immediately, Leo’s voice started to sound through the microphone. Leo’s song was beautiful, and all the other children listened carefully. 

---

Max felt happy. He had helped his friend to shine! The music lab was full of laughter and music. Max realized that together, they could do wonderful things.

plan.problema: Max can’t make his voice sound, and he must help little Leo to sing for the event.
plan.svolta: He decided to try to make a louder sound, emitting a high buzz that hit Leo’s ear!
plan.finale: Leo laughed with joy and Max felt happy to have helped his friend to shine.

microfono.text:
Microphone Max lived in Grandpa’s house. He was a bright red microphone, loved by everyone. Every day, Microphone Max enjoyed making lots of sounds: “Hello!”, “Good job!”, “Woohoo!”. But today something wasn’t right. He couldn’t make any sounds anymore. He was stuck!

“Oh no!” exclaimed Microphone Max, trying to speak, but only silence greeted him. Grandpa was sitting in the armchair, reading the newspaper. “Grandpa, help me!” shouted Microphone Max, but Grandpa didn’t hear him. He was very frustrated.

Microphone Max tried to shake himself really hard, up and down. He tried to make strange movements with his foot. But nothing! He always remained silent. He thought maybe he needed a special song.

“Maybe if I sing really loud, it will unlock me,” thought Microphone Max. He closed his eyes and began to sing his favorite song, “The Sun.” He sang with all his might, trill after trill, getting higher and higher. Grandpa’s house seemed to vibrate with his singing.

Suddenly, with a beautiful, clear, and loud trill, Microphone Max started working perfectly again! He began to make laughter explode, repeating “Hello!”, “Good job!”, and “Woohoo!”. Grandpa smiled seeing him back to doing what he loved. 

Microphone Max realized that even when things seem difficult, a little courage and determination can make a difference. And he knew exactly what he had to do to have fun again.

plan.problema: Max got stuck and couldn’t make any sounds!
plan.svolta: He tried to shake himself, but nothing, so he decided to sing a very loud song to unlock himself.
plan.finale: With a lovely trill, Max started working perfectly and began to make exploding laughter!
plan.morale: Sometimes all it takes is a little courage and determination.

microfono.text:
Microphone Max lived in Luca’s bedroom. He was a bright red microphone, full of energy. He loved to sing, but he had a little problem. When he tried to make loud sounds for his favorite song, “The Singing Cat,” the sound came out weak and confused. He didn’t feel good!

Luca was sad. “I can’t sing loudly, Max!” he said. Microphone Max felt frustrated. He really wanted to make his voice clear and powerful. He thought it was a shame he couldn’t use it to sing that happy song. 

Suddenly, Microphone Max had an idea. “Maybe,” he thought, “if I move my foot, the sound becomes louder!” The foot was a small little leg that allowed the microphone to turn. He moved it up and down, but nothing. The sound stayed weak.

Microphone Max tried again. He focused all his energy and continued to move the foot, with one last, big effort. And there it was! A powerful and happy sound burst from the microphone. It was so loud that Luca jumped from his chair with joy! “We did it, Max!” shouted Luca. 

Microphone Max was happy. He had learned that even when things seem difficult, you shouldn’t give up. With a little patience and a little extra effort, you can reach your goal. Luca continued to sing with Microphone Max, and the two friends remained happy forever.

plan.problema: Max couldn’t make loud and clear sounds to sing his favorite song.
plan.svolta: He decided to try moving his little foot, hoping it would help to amplify the sound.
plan.finale: Finally, with one last effort, Max made a powerful and cheerful sound, making Luca jump for joy!

microfono.text:
Microphone Max was a special microphone. He lived in Leo’s creative workshop. He was red and shiny, with lots of colorful buttons. Microphone Max loved to talk, but sometimes he had trouble being heard.

Leo had tried to sing with him, to tell jokes, even to make silly sounds. But Microphone Max’s voice didn’t come out clearly to Leo. It seemed like the sound got lost in the workshop. He was very disappointed.

“Oh no,” thought Microphone Max. “I don’t want to be useless!” He decided to do something different. He focused and tried to understand why he couldn’t make his voice heard. Then, he had an idea!

Microphone Max decided to try singing a happy melody. He started with a loud and clear sound, like a little bird singing. He sang up, he sang down, he sang fast, he sang slow. He tried to reach Leo with his voice.

Leo was sitting in a corner of the workshop, watching Microphone Max. At first he seemed sad, but as Microphone Max continued to sing, his sound became stronger and happier. 

Finally, Leo smiled. “What a lovely song, Microphone Max!” he said with enthusiasm. Microphone Max felt happy. He had overcome the difficulty and made his voice heard! Perseverance can really lead to success.

plan.problema: He couldn't make his voice heard to the boy Leo.
plan.svolta: He decided to try singing a cheerful melody, hoping that the louder sound could reach Leo.
plan.finale: Finally, Leo smiled and said, 'What a lovely song, Microphone Max!'

microfono.text:
Microphone Max lived in Sofia’s bedroom. He was a bright red microphone, always ready to make silly noises. Sofia loved him very much. She often tried to sing songs with him, but something wasn’t working. Microphone Max couldn’t make the sounds come out! It seemed like his strings were tired.

Sofia sat on the rug, pointing at the microphone. “Say ‘meow’ Max!” she would say. But Max stayed silent. Sofia tried to say “Woof woof” and “Tick tock,” but nothing. She was very sad. Microphone Max felt her disappointment. He wanted to make Sofia happy so much.

Suddenly, Microphone Max had an idea. He tried his best to shout: “Hello!” with all his strings. A loud, clear sound filled the bedroom. Sofia turned around quickly, surprised. She smiled.

Microphone Max repeated “Hello!” even louder! This time, the microphone started to make funny noises. It made sounds of cars speeding by, of animals talking, and even the sound of an alarm clock ringing at dawn. Sofia laughed a lot.

Sofia played with Microphone Max all afternoon. She was happy, and he was happy. She realized that sometimes, to make things work, you just have to be more enthusiastic.

Microphone Max realized that a smile can do miracles.

plan.problema: He couldn’t make the fun sounds for little Sofia.
plan.svolta: He realized he needed more enthusiasm and started shouting ‘Hello!’ with all his strings.
plan.finale: Sofia laughed a lot and Max could finally make lots of silly and cheerful sounds.

microfono.text:
Microphone Max lived in the Rose Garden. He was a bright red microphone, with a wooden stand and a small silver bell. He loved to sing and talk to the wind among the smells of the roses. But one morning something wasn't right. Microphone Max didn't make any sound. His bell was still.

“Oh no!” he exclaimed. “I can’t say ‘Hello!’ or ‘Good job!’ anymore.” He was very sad. He tried to push the button with his hand, but nothing. He tried to shake himself hard, turning himself around, but that didn't help either. The silence was deafening in the Rose Garden.

“I have to do something,” thought Microphone Max. Then he had an idea. He used his only sound, a little “beep” that he made when he turned on. “Beep! Beep!” he repeated. But no one answered.

Then a little ladybug, named Lila, came up to him. “Maybe you need light,” said Lila. “Sometimes things get better with a ray of sunshine.”

Microphone Max looked up. A warm, golden ray of sunshine hit his stand. Just as the light touched him, Microphone Max made one last “beep” louder than all the others. Then, the silver bell tinkled happily. 

“I did it!” said Microphone Max, happy. He was ready to talk and sing in the Rose Garden again. The ladybug Lila smiled. With a little patience, even the smallest problems can disappear.

plan.problema: Max is stuck and can't make any sounds!
plan.svolta: He tried to shake himself, but nothing, so he decided to call for help with his only sound, a little 'beep'.
plan.finale: A ray of sunshine hit the microphone and, with a final 'beep', Max started working perfectly.
plan.morale: Problems get solved with a little patience.

occhiali.text:
Glasses was a special pair of glasses. He lived in the playground and loved watching everything that happened. But there was a small problem. Glasses couldn’t see the colors! The red toys looked gray, yellow was just a shade of beige, and blue… well, blue was simply dark.

He was very sad. Seeing all those colors so dull made him feel a little melancholy. A deflated red balloon slumped to the ground near him. “Oh no,” thought Glasses, “I can’t even appreciate the sadness of a red balloon!”

Then, a smiling girl, Sofia, was sliding down the biggest slide in the playground. Glasses slowly moved upwards, holding onto the edge of the slide. He climbed, climbed, climbed! He was a little scared, but he wanted to try something new.

Once at the top, Glasses had a fantastic view. The whole playground was before him: the children playing, the green and leafy trees, the sun shining. And, incredibly, the colors! The red of the balloon, the yellow of the swings, the blue of the pond… everything was so bright and alive!

Glasses felt happier than ever before. He had finally understood what it meant to see the world with all its shades and joys.

plan.problema: He couldn't see the bright colors of the toys!
plan.svolta: They moved up high, on the biggest slide, for a new perspective.
plan.finale: Finally, he could admire the world with all its shades and joys!
plan.morale: Sometimes all it takes is a change of perspective.

occhiali.text:
Glasses was a very nice pair of sunglasses. He lived at the playground, near the castle tower and the big swing. Glasses loved to watch everything that happened. He saw the children running, the fairies playing with the leaves, and the birds flying high.

But one day, something didn't go right. Suddenly, the world seemed confused. The colors were faded and the shapes mixed together. He couldn't see well anymore! “Oh no!” thought Glasses. “I can’t see anything!”. He was very sad.

A little kitten, Miao, came up to Glasses. “What’s happening?” meowed Miao. “Can’t you see?”

Glasses started to move. He jumped forward and backward, he spun around. He moved quickly, then slowly, like a little dancer. He tried to concentrate. He felt a little strange, but he kept moving. 

Suddenly, with a flash, everything became clear! Glasses could see even better than before. The colors were bright and everything was sharp. The playground looked wonderful. Miao meowed with joy.

Glasses put himself on the nose of the castle tower, ready to watch the world with new eyes. He understood that sometimes it just takes changing your position a little to see things in a different way.

plan.problema: The glasses weren't seeing well and everything seemed confused!
plan.svolta: He started to jump and spin to unlock his focus.
plan.finale: Suddenly, he started to see everything clearly and brightly.
plan.morale: Sometimes all it takes is changing your perspective.

occhiali.text:
Occhiali was a very special pair of glasses. He lived in the playground, right next to the slide tower. Every day he saw lots of children playing and having fun. But Occhiali had a little problem. He couldn’t see the colors of the toys very well! The red of the ball, the yellow of the artificial sun, the blue of the swing… everything seemed gray.

“Oh no!” thought Occhiali. “I wish I could see all these beautiful colors!” He felt a little sad because he couldn’t fully enjoy the joy of the playground. A little dog, Rocco, looked at him curiously: “Why are you so serious, Occhiali?” asked the dog.

Occhiali blinked a little. He had an idea! He started to slowly turn a small wheel that he had on his bridge. He turned it up and down, back and forth. It was a slow and gentle movement. At first, nothing happened. Then, suddenly, the colors exploded!

The red of the ball was intense, the yellow of the artificial sun was bright, the blue of the swing was vivid. Occhiali felt happy like never before. He had finally seen all the wonderful colors of the playground.

“I did it!” exclaimed Occhiali, smiling. He was ready for a new adventure, full of colors and fun. He settled on his pedestal, ready to see the world with new eyes. With patience, even the most difficult things can find their solution.

plan.problema: He couldn't see the bright colors of the toys!
plan.svolta: He squinted and decided to turn the wheel to adjust his view.
plan.finale: Finally, everything was vivid and wonderful, ready for a new adventure!

occhiali.text:
Sunglasses was a little pair of sunglasses. He lived in the Flower Garden. He loved to look at the flowers, but there was a problem. He couldn't see the colors very well! The reds of the tulips looked gray. The yellow of the daisies appeared dull. Even the blue of the lily wasn't vibrant enough.

Sunglasses felt a little sad. He wanted to understand why he didn't see the colors right. A butterfly, named Iris, that was flying around the flowers, noticed his sadness. “What’s wrong, Sunglasses?” asked Iris.

“I can’t see the colors,” replied Sunglasses with a sigh. “They all look dull.”

Sunglasses thought for a moment. Then he decided to do something. He moved slowly. He began to roll on a green leaf. He rolled onto another, then onto a third. He tried to get as close as possible to the petals of the flowers. It was hard work!

Every time he moved, even just a little, the colors became a little clearer. The red of the tulip looked a little brighter, the yellow of the daisy a little more luminous. Finally, after so much rolling, Sunglasses got close to a sunflower.

Finally, thanks to his little movement, he could admire the vibrant beauty of the garden. The colors were so intense and beautiful! He was happy. 

Sunglasses realized that sometimes, to really see something special, you just have to wait for the right moment and take a small step at a time.

plan.problema: The glasses couldn't see the bright colors of the flowers.
plan.svolta: He decided to move slowly, rolling on the leaves to get as close as possible to the petals.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to his little movement, he could admire the vibrant beauty of the garden.

occhiali.text:
Occhialetti was a pair of very special glasses. He lived in the Flowered Garden, a place full of red roses, yellow tulips, and blue violets. But Occhialetti had a little problem. He couldn’t see the colors of the flowers! Everything seemed gray, dull, as if someone had put a filter on everything.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Occhialetti. “I can’t enjoy this beautiful garden!” He sat down on a wooden bench, near a tall sunflower. He tried to concentrate, but the colors were always gray. 

Then Occhialetti decided to move. He started to slide on the lawn, trying to look at the garden from different angles. He moved towards the roses, then towards the tulips, but nothing! The colors remained gray. 

A little green crocodile, Leo, came up to Occhialetti. “Try looking there!” said Leo, pointing to a spot in the garden.

Occhialetti followed his advice and found himself right in front of a puddle of sunlight filtering through the trees. Suddenly, the Flowered Garden burst with a thousand colors! The roses seemed red more beautiful than before, the yellow tulips shone like the sun, and the blue violets were even deeper.

Occhialetti smiled. He realized that by looking at the garden from a different point, he had found the key to seeing all its colors. Everything needs the right view to be fully appreciated.

plan.problema: He couldn't see the colors of the flowers, everything was gray!
plan.svolta: He decided to move and to look at the garden from different angles to find a point where the colors could return.
plan.finale: Finally, he found a pool of sunlight and, suddenly, the garden burst with a thousand colors!

occhiali.text:
Glasses was a pair of sunglasses who was very happy. He lived at the playground, near the castle tower and the red swing. Glasses loved to watch the children play. But today something wasn't right. He couldn't see the colors very well! The swings shone red and yellow, but to Glasses they looked gray. Even the blue tunnel was just a dark hole.

“How strange!” said Glasses. “I can’t enjoy the playground!” He saw a little girl sitting on the swing, laughing happily. The little girl touched her face and then looked at Glasses. “Maybe you need to be cleaned,” said the little girl smiling.

Glasses felt a little sad. He tried to poke his lenses with a small stone, but it didn't work. Suddenly, while he was moving to find a solution, his nose came off! It fell to the ground and Glasses picked it up gently.

Glasses’ nose had an idea. He put it back in place, smoothing it gently with his top. With great care, he reattached the nose. “There you go!” exclaimed Glasses.

And then something wonderful happened! The colors exploded before his eyes. The red swing shone like a ruby. The blue tunnel was a deep ocean. The sun was shining high in the sky. All the games at the playground looked even more beautiful. Glasses smiled, happy to be able to see everything.

plan.problema: He couldn't see the bright colors of the swings!
plan.svolta: It fell off his nose and, after carefully licking it, he reattached it, and finally he could see everything!
plan.finale: The sun was shining and all the games seemed even more beautiful.
plan.morale: Sometimes all it takes is a little help.

occhiali.text:
Eyeglasses was a pair of special glasses. He lived in the Flower Garden and loved to be there, near the daisies and tulips. But Eyeglasses had a little problem: he couldn't see the flowers very well! The colors were faded, blurry. It seemed like the garden was painted only in grays.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Eyeglasses, turning his head from side to side. “I wish I could see all these beautiful flowers.”

A little hug from the wind brought him closer to a fragrant red rose. Eyeglasses thought: “If I lean on the stem, I might get closer to the petals and maybe I’ll see better!” But the rose was too tall! Eyeglasses was too far away to see the real colors. 

A little squirrel, Leo, was watching him curiously. “What’s happening, Eyeglasses?” asked Leo.

Eyeglasses frowned. He tried to concentrate, but the flowers remained blurry. Suddenly, a bright ray of sunshine hit the glasses. A golden glow spread across the whole garden. 

Suddenly, the colors exploded! The tulips became a bright yellow, the roses ruby red, the violets deep blue. Eyeglasses was very happy. He had finally seen the beauty of the Flower Garden. It was a wonderful and precious gift.

plan.problema: He couldn't see the colorful flowers of the garden!
plan.svolta: He decided to lean on the stem of a rose to get closer to the petals, but it was too far away.
plan.finale: A ray of sunshine hit his glasses and everything became clear and wonderful.

occhiali.text:
Glasses was a pair of blue sunglasses. He lived at the playground. He loved to watch the children playing. But Glasses had a little problem. He couldn’t see the swings very well! The colors were so bright, the red and yellow of the seats, the blue of the sky reflected… it was all blurry for him.

“What a shame!” thought Glasses. The other toys at the park looked at him with curiosity. “I can’t see the colors!” Glasses would say, squinting his eyes tighter. He wanted to understand why he couldn’t enjoy the view of the playground.

Then Glasses decided to do something. He moved slowly towards the nearest swing. He turned around, looking for a place to look at the world better. He was looking for something that could help him see the colors clearly. 

A child was coming down the slide. Glasses got closer and, just as he passed near the slide, something changed. Everything became clear! The colors of the swings, the green of the grass, the yellow of the sun… Glasses could see them all clearly and happily.

“How wonderful!” exclaimed Glasses. He had found the solution right there, with a little slide. Now he could see everything as it really was. The other toys applauded. 

Glasses realized that sometimes to see things in a different way, you just have to change your point of view.

plan.problema: The glasses couldn't see the bright colors of the swings!
plan.svolta: He decided to go around the swing, looking for a better place to look at the world.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to a small slide, he saw all the colors clearly and joyfully.
plan.morale: Sometimes all it takes is a new perspective.

occhiali.text:
Glasses was a pair of very curious glasses. He lived at the playground, near the swing and the sandcastle. He loved to look at the world, but one morning something wasn't right. Everything seemed gray to him. The red flowers were just indistinct shapes, the white clouds were just shades of ash.

“How strange,” thought Glasses. “I can’t see the colors! I don’t see the red of the tulips, I don’t see the yellow of the sun.” He felt sad and a little frustrated. A little squirrel, Pipì, watched him curiously.

Glasses decided to do something. He started to move slowly, rotating his lens to the right and to the left. He did this very carefully, trying to focus a little light on each flower, on each leaf. It was slow and difficult work. Pipì watched him scamper on the lawn, waiting.

Glasses tried hard, moved slowly, slowly, more and more slowly. He imagined he was collecting the light and turning it into colors. Then, suddenly, with a little snap, something magical happened! The red of the tulips exploded like a fire, the yellow of the sun shone brightly, the white clouds became soft and perfect.

Glasses felt happy. He had discovered that sometimes, to see the beauty of the world, you just have to be patient and observe calmly. Pipì jumped happily around Glasses. The playground had become a wonderful place, full of colors.

plan.problema: The glasses couldn't see the colors of the flowers and the clouds, everything seemed gray to him.
plan.svolta: He decided to slowly slide his lenses, trying to focus the light on every detail.
plan.finale: Finally, with a small click, the colors returned bright, making the world incredibly beautiful.

occhiali.text:
Occhiali was a very nice pair of sunglasses. He lived at the playground, near the castle tower and the red swing. Occhiali loved to look at the world, but suddenly something wasn't right. Everything seemed gray! The bright colors of the park, the children’s laughter, the deep green of the grass, were gone.

“Oh no!” said Occhiali. “I can’t see anything anymore!” He tried to concentrate, but his vision was just a shade of gray. A little black kitten was hopping around and meowing, but even he seemed dull. 

Occhiali decided to do something. He moved carefully on the horse-shaped carousel. “Maybe if I click loudly,” thought Occhiali, “the reflected sunlight will bring the colors back!” And he clicked with all his might. A dull sound and then… a yellow flower, growing next to the fountain, fell to the ground.

Occhiali was sad. The flower was beautiful! Then, suddenly, a ray of sunshine hit his lens directly. The lens immediately filled with a thousand sparkling colors: red, blue, green, yellow… everything shone again! The colors of the park had returned to be intense and vibrant. The black kitten was happily hopping.

Occhiali realized that sometimes all it takes is a little help to find the beauty.

plan.problema: The glasses don't see the bright colors of the park anymore, everything looks gray.
plan.svolta: He decided to creak loudly, hoping that the reflected sunlight would bring back the color, but only he dropped a flower.
plan.finale: A ray of sunlight hit the glasses and its lens suddenly filled with a thousand sparkling colors!
plan.morale: Sometimes all it takes is a little help.

padella.text:
Padella Bruno was a very happy pan. He lived in a bright kitchen, full of colors and smells. Every morning, when the sun came through the window, Bruno was ready for new adventures. He loved to be on the warm stove, next to the pots and pans.

One day, however, something strange happened. While trying to make a nice “toc toc” with his bottom, Bruno got stuck! He was inside a drawer in the kitchen cabinet. The drawer was small and tight. Bruno couldn't move. He was frustrated.

He tried to sway back and forth, hoping to make some space. But the drawer didn’t want to open any more. He remained stuck, everything black around him. “Oh no!” said Bruno, with a little thump.

He bumped into a little spoon, Ladybug. Ladybug was always kind and ready to help. “What’s happening, Bruno?” asked Ladybug. Padella Bruno explained his problem. Ladybug had an idea! She started to spin quickly around the drawer, pushing with her handle.

Finally, thanks to Ladybug’s strength, Bruno was able to slide out of the drawer and ended up on the warm stove. He was happy to be free! He realized that together they could do better things. 

Padella Bruno settled down next to his friends the pots and pans and knew that a little help can turn into a great adventure.

plan.problema: Bruno found himself stuck in the drawer, too tight to move!
plan.svolta: He tried to swing back and forth, but the drawer wouldn't open any further.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a little spoon, Bruno managed to slide out and back to the stove!

padella.text:
Paddinella was a shiny, red pan. She lived in a bright kitchen, full of colors and smells. Her home was the countertop, near the stove. Paddinella loved to make delicious tomato pudding. That was the best thing she did!

One day, however, Paddinella found herself completely empty. There were no more tomatoes. “Oh no!” she exclaimed. “Where did they go?” She felt very sad and confused. She didn’t know how to get her delicious tomatoes back into the pudding.

Paddinella tried to shout for help, but nobody listened. She was too small to be heard. Then she had an idea! She took her sturdy handle and started to spin around the table. She spun and spun, hoping that someone would see her and understand her problem.

The sound of the handle banging on the wood reached the ears of Mom. Mom turned around and saw Paddinella spinning frantically. She smiled. “What’s happening, Paddinella?” she asked. Running into the kitchen, she filled Paddinella with new, red, juicy tomatoes.

Paddinella was so happy! She had everything she needed to make her favorite pudding again. Mom hugged her gently. “It’s always better to ask for help,” she said. And Paddinella understood that sometimes, a small gesture can solve a big problem.

plan.problema: Paddinella had found her bowl completely empty and didn't know how to get her delicious cherry tomatoes back into pudding.
plan.svolta: After trying to shout for help, she decided to use her handle to go around the table, hoping someone would see it.
plan.finale: Mom, hearing the noise, ran into the kitchen and filled Paddinella with new cherry tomatoes, happy to have helped him.
