plan.morale: Asking for help is always a good idea.

padella.text:
Ball was a shiny pan. He lived in a bright kitchen, full of colors and smells. The sunlight came through the window and lit everything up. Ball loved his kitchen! It was always clean and tidy.

One day, while the cook was making a sauce, Ball found himself at the bottom of the pan. He was very, very small. He was so scared! He didn’t want to come out of there. He felt so frightened that he huddled in his favorite corner.

The cook saw Ball and took a wooden spoon. He started making rhythmic movements: up, down, up, down. Ball tried to move with the spoon, but he was still too shy. He couldn’t jump out of the pan.

The cook smiled and started to sing a happy song. It was a fun song with lots of rhythms. “Sing, sing, do the ball, up, down, what a ball! Sing, sing, do the ball, what a joy!” Ball listened to the song and, suddenly, he felt braver.

He made a big effort and with a jump, he climbed back to the top of the pan! He was happy to be back in his place. The cook smiled satisfied. 

Ball was ready for a new meal, full of flavors and fun. He understood that sometimes, it just takes a little push to overcome your fears.

plan.problema: Ball curled up at the bottom of the pan, too scared to jump out.
plan.svolta: Ball tried to make rhythmic movements with the spoon, but Ball was still too shy.
plan.finale: The cook sang a happy song and Ball, amused, climbed back to the top of the pan, ready for a new meal!

padella.text:
Paddinello the pan lived in a bright kitchen. The light came in through the big windows and made everything sparkle. Paddinello loved his kitchen because it was full of colors and smells. Today there was an important party and Paddinello had to cook his cherry tomatoes for all the guests.

Paddinello started to warm up on the stove. He tried to make a steady fire, but the cherry tomatoes weren't getting soft. “Oh no!” said Paddinello. “I can’t cook them! The party is about to start and I don’t have anything to offer!”

Paddinello thought, thought, thought. He decided to try a trick. He added a little bit of hot water inside himself. Immediately, the steam started to rise. But the steam was just boiling the cherry tomatoes! They were getting smaller and harder. Paddinello was desperate.

A little gentle spoon came into the kitchen. “Don’t worry, Paddinello,” said the spoon. “Add a little bit of cold water and stir gently.” Paddinello followed the spoon’s advice. Slowly, slowly, slowly, the pan started to warm up calmly. The cherry tomatoes softened and took a beautiful sweet red color.

All the guests loved Paddinello’s cherry tomatoes. It was the best dish of the party! Paddinello was happy. He had learned that sometimes you have to wait, be patient, and do things calmly. And this made him even happier to be a pan in the bright kitchen.

plan.problema: Paddington can't cook his cherry tomatoes for the party!
plan.svolta: He decided to try using some hot water, but the steam was just making the tomatoes boil!
plan.finale: Finally, with the help of a kind spoon, Paddington managed to cook the tomatoes gently and everyone loved them.

padella.text:
Paddinella was a shiny, red pan. He lived in a bright kitchen, full of colors and smells. The corners of the kitchen were decorated with little kitchen tools. Paddinella loved his life. Every day he waited to help make delicious dishes.

One afternoon, the cook, a nice little girl named Sofia, put him inside with some potatoes. “I need to fry the potatoes!” thought Paddinella. He started to get hot with a big flame. But the potatoes didn’t want to fry! They stuck to the bottom of the pan and turned brown.

Paddinella got angry. He tried to do something, but it didn’t work. Then he thought, “Maybe if I stir faster…” He took a spoon and started stirring frantically. But the potatoes kept sticking to the bottom! It was frustrating.

The cook Sofia came up to Paddinella and said, “Try using a small fire, Paddinella!” Paddinella followed the advice. He lowered the flame and started to move the pan slowly with the spoon. The potatoes started to jump up and down, creating a beautiful dance of colors.

Paddinella was happy! He had learned to help Sofia perfectly. He understood that it wasn’t enough to do things quickly, but he had to be patient and gentle. 

Finally, after many tries, Paddinella was frying the potatoes with grace and precision. The cook smiled happily. Paddinella understood that learning something new also takes time and attention.

plan.problema: He can’t make the potatoes jump in the pan!
plan.svolta: He decided to try using a spoon to stir faster, but the potatoes kept sticking to the bottom.
plan.finale: Finally, he realized he had to use a small fire and move the pan gently, so the potatoes jumped perfectly!

padella.text:
Paddinella was a bright red frying pan. She lived in a colorful kitchen, full of pots and spoons. She was always happy to make lovely dishes for her friends, the ingredients. But one day, Paddinella found herself all alone. All the ingredients had suddenly become grumpy and didn't want to be put in her pan!

“But what’s happening?” Paddinella mumbled, but her surface was cold and silent. She couldn’t warm up anymore. She was sad and thought she wouldn't do anything anymore. The little tomato, Rosso, sitting on the counter, seemed particularly chilly.

Paddinella had an idea! She started to shake her bottom frantically, up and down, making a big, nice noise. “Rummmmmm… rummmmmm…” she repeated. Suddenly, a little blue spark shone from inside. Paddinella warmed up right away! Her surface became red like always.

The ingredients, curious, came closer. The little tomatoes, the carrots, and the onions surprised, got up enthusiastically to participate in the big dinner. Paddinella was happy to cook them. Together they prepared a delicious sauce for pasta. 

Paddinella realized that sometimes, even when you feel alone and without hope, it just takes a little courage to find a solution. And so, with her big noise, she solved the problem and made everyone play together again in the colorful kitchen.

plan.problema: Little Paddinella was all alone and her friends, the ingredients, didn’t want to be cooked!
plan.svolta: She decided to make a big noise by grinding empty and, surprisingly, her spark made her work again!
plan.finale: The little tomatoes, carrots, and onions got up enthusiastically to participate in the big dinner.

padella.text:
Paddinella was a shiny, red pan. He lived in a bright kitchen, full of colors and smells. The kitchen was always cozy, with the sun shining through the window and making the objects sparkle. Paddinella loved his kitchen!

One day, Paddinella realized a problem. He was completely empty! There was nothing inside him. “Oh no!” he thought. “How will I make a nice scrambled egg for his friends?” Paddinella’s friends were the spices and the butter that lived on the table next to him.

Paddinella tried to shout for help, but nobody heard him. He was too small in the big kitchen. Then he had an idea! He grabbed his sturdy handle and started to swirl energetically in the air. He spun around and around, back and forth, using all his strength. He was trying to create a little magic.

Paddinella kept swirling, not giving up. He wasn’t discouraged at all! Suddenly, something happened. Tiny crumbs and pieces of bread reappeared inside the pan. They were back! Paddinella was ready for a delicious scrambled egg.

The butter smiled: “Good job, Paddinella!” he said. “You did very well!” Paddinella felt happy and proud of himself. He had learned that, even when things seem difficult, you always have to keep trying. And in the end, everything works out.

plan.problema: Paddinella found herself completely empty and didn't know how to make a nice pancake for her friends.
plan.svolta: After trying to shout for help, she decided to use her handle to vigorously mix the air, hoping to create some magic.
plan.finale: Suddenly, small crumbs and pieces of bread reappeared inside the pan, ready for a delicious pancake!

padella.text:
Ball was a shiny, red pan. He lived in a bright kitchen, full of colors and smells. The pots and stoves were his friends. Ball loved to help make cakes and cookies. One day, while waiting for Mommy to finish washing the dishes, he found himself in the drawer of tools.

The drawer was full of spoons, ladles, and spatulas. It was very tight! Ball couldn't move. He was stuck! He felt the wood of the utensils touching him and the plastic of the ladles touching him. “Oh no!” thought Ball. “I’m trapped!”

He started to spin frantically, trying to sink between the utensils. He tried to go forward, but only got smaller and more frustrated. Every time he turned, he ended up getting stuck on a spoon or a ladle. “I can’t do it!” cried Ball, with a metallic voice.

Mommy, hearing the noise, opened the drawer. She saw Ball in trouble. With one last brave effort, Ball focused and managed to wobble. He rolled quickly, pushed by a little burst of strength. Finally, Ball came out of the drawer, rearranging his happy smile. He straightened out on the bottom of the drawer, happy to be free. Mommy took him and put him back on the stove, ready for new adventures. Ball understood that even when things seem difficult, with a little courage you can always find a way out.

plan.problema: The ball had gotten stuck in the drawer of utensils, too tight to move!
plan.svolta: He started to spin frantically, trying to sink between the cutlery, but only got smaller and more frustrated.
plan.finale: Finally, with one last brave effort, he managed to tip over and roll out of the drawer, restoring his happy smile!
plan.morale: Perseverance is the key to success.

padella.text:
Paddinella was a shiny, red pan. She lived in the cheerful kitchen, full of colorful pots and spoons. Paddinella loved her life among the dishes. One day, she felt lonely. There wasn't anyone to make a good omelet with. “Oh no,” said Paddinella, “I must make a delicious little omelet for my friends!”

Paddinella began to move. She turned her bottom with the handles, trying to warm herself up. Then, she added some chopped potatoes and some red onions. She also took three hard-boiled eggs. But the omelet wasn't good. It was too flat and without flavor.

Paddinella stopped, thoughtful. “What’s missing?” she asked. A little green tomato, named Verdi, replied, "It's missing the joy, Paddinella!" Paddinella understood right away. She began to go up and down, quickly turning her bottom. She made happy gurgles, like a little stream.

The potatoes began to jump, the onions to swirl, and the hard-boiled eggs to move in rhythm with her. Verdi joined the dance, doing somersaults around the pan. Paddinella continued to go up and down, faster and happier. The cheerful kitchen was full of movement and laughter.

The omelet, finally, became perfect: golden and fragrant. Together, Paddinella and her friend ingredients, had created something special. Everything, when done together, is better.

plan.problema: Paddinella found herself alone and didn't know how to make a delicious fritter for her friends.
plan.svolta: After trying to mix with the levers, she realized she was missing a special ingredient: joy!
plan.finale: Paddinella started to go up and down, making happy gurgling sounds, and her ingredient friends (potatoes, onions, eggs) started to dance happily.

padella.text:
Ball was a shiny, red pan. He lived in a bright kitchen, full of colors and smells. The kitchen was always clean and tidy, with a white table and blue walls. Ball loved to be there, next to the oven and the stove.

One day, Ball noticed that something wasn't right. All the ingredients for the cake had fallen to the floor! There were cookies scattered everywhere, flour spreading on the floor, and broken eggs near the table. Ball was very worried. He had to make the cake for Grandma Rosa’s birthday!

He tried to curl up to reach the furthest cookies, but he couldn't move them. He tried to push the flour with his bottom, but it was too heavy. It was a big mess! Ball felt frustrated.

Then, he had an idea. His long handle could be useful! He stretched the handle towards the cookies, then towards the flour, and finally towards the broken eggs. With patience and courage, Ball reached every ingredient one at a time. He carefully picked them up with his bottom and brought them back to the table.

Grandma Rosa, seeing Ball at work, smiled. “Good job, Ball!” she said. “You did a great job!” Ball felt happy and proud of himself. 

Thanks to his determination, all the ingredients were back in their place. The cake for Grandma Rosa was a success! Ball understood that even when things seem difficult, with a little courage you can overcome any obstacle.

plan.problema: The Ball noticed that all the cake ingredients had fallen to the floor!
plan.svolta: It tried to curl up and push the cookies, but it couldn't collect them all.
plan.finale: Thanks to its long handle, it managed to reach every ingredient and bring them back to the table.

piano.text:
Piano Vivente lived in the White Room. He was a wooden piano, but he wasn’t a normal piano. Piano Vivente could talk and move! He loved to make his melodies, those sweet notes that filled the room. Every morning, Piano Vivente started his day with a happy song.

But one day, something went wrong. While he was playing a particularly beautiful melody, he got stuck. He couldn’t move his keys anymore! He was sad, very sad. “Oh no!” said Piano Vivente. “I can’t play anymore!”

Piano Vivente tried to shake himself with all his might. He made strange noises, a little like he was trying to unlock his music. But it didn’t work. He was frustrated. Then, he had an idea. Piano Vivente started to slowly roll each key up, one at a time, with patience and calmness.

The keys slid across the wooden floor of the White Room. Piano Vivente was focused, he never stopped. After a while, one of the keys made a little “click!” and it unlocked! Piano Vivente could play again. He started to make a sweet song, more beautiful than ever.

Leo, the cat of the White Room, enters the scene, watching with curiosity the music. He approaches Piano Vivente and purrs, happy with the joy.

Piano Vivente played for a long time, until it was time to sleep. His melody faded slowly, leaving only silence in the White Room. Patience was the key to bringing the music back into Piano Vivente’s world.

plan.problema: The piano has stopped and can’t make its melodies anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to shake himself, but he only made strange noises. Then, with all his keys, he started making them roll slowly upwards.
plan.finale: Finally, one key unlocked and the piano was able to play a sweet song again.

piano.text:
Piano Rosso lived on the attic. It was a bright red floor, but that attic was full of dust. The dust made Piano Rosso a little sad. Sometimes he felt lonely and lost.

---

One day, Piano Rosso found himself in a maze. There were old chests, stacked chairs, and wobbly boxes. He couldn’t find his place anymore! He rolled from side to side, but everything seemed the same. He was very confused. “Oh no!” said Piano Rosso. “I don’t know how to get back.”

---

Piano Rosso tried to roll to the right, then to the left, then straight. But every time he ended up in another dead end. He felt more and more lonely and scared.

---

Suddenly, Piano Rosso saw Bruno. Bruno was an old teddy bear. He was sitting on a chair, still for a long time. “Bruno,” said Piano Rosso, “I’m lost! I don’t know where my place is.”

---

Bruno looked at him with his big eyes. Then, slowly, Bruno stood up and pointed to a small space under a box full of old photos. “Look here, Piano Rosso,” said Bruno.

---

Piano Rosso rolled quickly in that direction. And there it was! It was exactly his place, next to the old grandfather clock. Piano Rosso was happy. He had finally come home.

---

From that day on, Piano Rosso and Bruno became good friends. They kept each other company in the dusty attic. Together they were always happier. Piano Rosso understood that even when you are lost, asking for help can lead to a solution.

plan.problema: The Red Plane had gotten lost in a maze of furniture and couldn't find its place anymore.
plan.svolta: After trying to roll in every direction, he realized he had to ask for help from the old teddy bear, Bruno.
plan.finale: Bruno, with his plush wisdom, pointed to a small space under a box full of old photos, and the Red Plane finally returned home.

piano.text:
Piano Vivo was a wooden floor very special. He lived in Luca’s bedroom and loved to make new shapes. But that day, Piano Vivo couldn’t do anything! He was so confused that his shapes would disappear right after he started them. “Oh no!” exclaimed Piano Vivo, but no one heard him.

Luca had left his colorful building blocks scattered on the rug. Piano Vivo looked at them carefully. He tried to make a simple square, but the red piece slid away, the blue mixed with the yellow, and everything became a big mess. He was frustrated!

“Maybe I need a break,” thought Piano Vivo. So he decided to take a quick spin around the bedroom. He climbed onto the bedside table, looked at the colorful books, then slid under the desk. He saw a blue teddy bear and a red ball.

Piano Vivo got inspired by the colors and shapes of the toys. He took a yellow block, then a red one, then a blue one. He started to build. He made a square, then a rectangle, then a triangle! Piano Vivo smiled more and more.

Luca entered the bedroom and saw Piano Vivo building a very tall tower with the colorful building blocks. It was a beautiful tower! Piano Vivo felt happy and satisfied. He had found his inspiration everywhere, even among Luca’s toys. 

Piano Vivo now knew that everything can be a source of ideas if you look at it carefully.

plan.problema: The plan was so confusing that he couldn’t form any shapes!
plan.svolta: He decided to take a quick trip around his bedroom, trying to find inspiration among the colors and shapes of the toys.
plan.finale: He finally managed to create a beautiful tower with lots of colorful building blocks, smiling contentedly.

piano.text:
Piano was a wooden piano. He lived in Sofia’s bedroom. He was a friendly and a little clumsy piano. He loved to listen to the stories of Princess Sofia. But Piano had a problem. He couldn’t climb stairs!

Sofia was sitting on the rug, wearing her princess dress. She looked very sad. “Oh no,” said Piano, “if I can’t help Sofia climb, she’ll be even sadder.”

Piano tried to move on his own, but he was too heavy. He couldn’t even take one step on the first step of the stairs. He was frustrated! He was looking for a solution, thinking with his keys.

Then he had an idea! He started to press his keys up and down. But he only made a small movement, as if he were tired. Sofia looked at him with wide eyes. “Maybe,” said Sofia, “I should help him!”

But Piano didn’t want to be helped. He wanted to find his own way. Then Sofia had another idea! She picked up Piano and made him roll on the rug. Piano slid, stopped, then slid again more quickly. 

Finally, with a big movement, he reached the top of the stairs! Sofia jumped on him happily. Piano was happy. He had solved his problem. 

Sofia smiled at Piano and said, “If you think in a creative way, even difficult things can become easy.”

plan.problema: The toy couldn’t climb the stairs and Princess Sofia was sad.
plan.svolta: She decided to use her keys to push herself up and down, but it only made a small movement!
plan.finale: Sofia had the idea of rolling the toy on the carpet, and she finally reached the top of the stairs.
plan.morale: A little ingenuity solves the problems.

piano.text:
Plan Vivo was a special plan. It wasn’t a normal plan, because it could talk and move on its own. It lived in the Room of Colors, a room full of strange shapes and bright colors. There were pink circles, green squares, blue triangles, and so many others.

One day, Plan Vivo found himself lost. He had gotten lost among all those figures! He couldn’t find his straight line anymore. Everything was confused, his veins had twisted. “Oh no!” said Plan Vivo, “I’m lost!”.

He decided to take a walk. He tried to follow the straightest path he could, but every time he ended up crossing with something. For example, a very tall tower made of red blocks! It was so big that Plan Vivo felt small and awkward. 

Suddenly, a yellow teddy bear named Leo rolled down from the tower. “Hello!” said Leo. “Can I help you?” Plan Vivo explained his problem. Leo thought for a little while and then, gently, he pushed Plan Vivo softly.

Plan Vivo felt himself straightening out slowly. His veins were aligned again. Finally, he was straight again! He found himself back in his place on the table, next to the pink circle. 

“Thank you, Leo!” said Plan Vivo with a smile. The pink circle shone brightly. Plan Vivo felt happy and satisfied. After so much difficulty, he had found his straight line. And he knew that even if things seem complicated, with a little patience and help, you can always get back to your place.

piano.text:
Piano Vivente was a special piano. He lived in the Music Lab, among the flutes and the trumpets. He was a piano made of dark wood, with shiny white and black keys. Piano Vivente loved to play. Every day he composed little melodies, always new and wonderful.

One day, however, something changed. Piano Vivente found himself completely silent. His keys were no longer vibrating. He couldn’t make even one chord! He was very sad. “Oh no!” said Piano Vivente. “How will I play my notes?”

Piano Vivente tried to tap his keys with a small hammer. He hit them hard, but nothing. The lab was full of sounds, but Piano Vivente didn’t make any sound. “Maybe,” he thought, “I must find a way to move on my own.”

Piano Vivente sat quietly on his stand. He closed his eyes and imagined the notes he loved to play. He tried to concentrate, to feel the rhythm of the music in his mind. Suddenly, he began to vibrate slightly. A delicate, almost imperceptible sound came from his keys. Piano Vivente was playing a sweet melody!

Mrs. Emilia, who worked in the Music Lab, approached smiling. “Good job, Piano Vivente!” she said. “You learned not to give up!”

Piano Vivente continued to play his melody, louder and more joyful. Perseverance had paid off. The sound of the piano filled the entire Music Lab.

plan.problema: The Living Piano had become completely silent and didn't know how to make its notes sound again.
plan.svolta: After trying to hit it with a hammer, he realized he had to find a way to move on his own.
plan.finale: The Living Piano began to vibrate slightly and, with a delicate sound, started to play a sweet melody.

piano.text:
Piano was a very special piano. He lived in a bright room full of colors. He loved his white and black keys. Every day he dreamed of making music. But today something wasn't right. Piano felt lost. He was confused, he couldn't play his favorite melody.

The notes, his friends, were scattered everywhere! Some lay on the floor, others were sitting on the legs of the table. None of them seemed to know where to go. Piano was upset, pressing keys at random. But only a strange and unpleasant sound came from his strings.

“Oh no!” thought Piano. “I must find the order of my notes.” He felt very sad. He decided to do something. With great effort, he slid slowly under the bed. It was dark and dusty, but Piano hoped he would find the solution to his problem there.

Slowly, Piano moved among the shadows. At one point, he heard one of his notes whisper: “Here! We are here!” Piano leaned forward and gently picked up the lost keys. One by one, he put them correctly on his surface.

Immediately, the room filled with sweet music. Piano played happily and joyfully. The melody that he loved so much returned to flow from his notes. Piano was happy. He had found a way to solve his problem with patience and attention. The room rang with a beautiful sound, just as he wanted.

plan.problema: The plan got lost among the notes and can’t play the melody anymore.
plan.svolta: He decides to slide under the bed, hoping to find the order of the keys.
plan.finale: He manages to find the right notes and fills the room with sweet music!

piano.text:
Piano Rosso lived on the dusty attic. It was a beautiful red piano, with lots of colorful keys. He loved to make the rag dolls lying beside him dance. He made them spin, jump, and do dance steps.

But one day, Piano Rosso got stuck! He couldn't move anymore. It was as if he had become heavy and still. “Oh no!” thought Piano Rosso. “I can’t make the rag dolls dance! They are very sad.” The dolls looked at him with a sad expression.

Piano Rosso tried to push with all his keys. But his movement was too slow. It seemed like every key needed an eternity to move. He felt frustrated and a little angry. The dust on the attic seemed to grow, making everything more difficult.

Then, suddenly, a ray of sunshine came through the attic window. The ray hit Piano Rosso’s keys with a bright light. And then something happened! Piano Rosso immediately felt lighter and more agile. His keys began to move quickly.

Piano Rosso made the rag dolls dance, and they laughed happily. The keys spun, jumped, and did dance steps as if nothing had happened. Piano Rosso was very happy! The sunlight had solved his problem. 

From that day on, every time the light came into the dusty attic, Piano Rosso made sure the rag dolls had a lovely party. The sun and patience can really do miracles.

plan.svolta: He tried to push with all his keys, but his movement was too slow.
plan.finale: Suddenly, a ray of sunshine hit the keys and the red piano started moving quickly again!
plan.morale: Patience and light can solve any problem.

Piano Vivente was a special piano. He wasn’t just a wooden and metal toy. He could talk! He lived in a bright living room, with its white walls and a big window that let in lots of light. Piano Vivente loved the room, but he felt lonely.

Every day he tried to play, but he couldn’t make a beautiful melody. The notes came out uncertain, without harmony. “I wish I could make wonderful music,” thought Piano Vivente, “but I don’t know how!”

One day, a tabby cat named Leo sat beside him. Leo looked at him curiously and then began to move his tail slowly. Piano Vivente had an idea! He decided that he would learn to beat the rhythm with his keys, just like Leo did.

But it was too fast! Piano Vivente’s fingers moved so quickly that the sound was confused and messy. “Oh no!” said Piano Vivente, “It’s a mess!”

Then, he calmed down. He closed his eyes and began to focus on his heart. He felt the regular, slow, and constant beat. Piano Vivente began to press the keys calmly, following the rhythm of his heart. 

The room filled with a sweet song. It was simple, but full of love. Leo the cat listened, enchanted. Piano Vivente continued to play, more and more slowly and with lots of patience. The music became more and more beautiful. In the end, Piano Vivente understood that patience can lead to beauty.

Piano Vivo lived in the Playroom. It was a wooden piano, red and lively. It had lots of white and black keys. Piano Vivo loved to play scales, going up and down, up and down!

One day, Piano Vivo had stopped right in the middle of the stairs. He couldn’t move anymore. “Oh no!” said Piano Vivo. “I’m stuck!” He tried to push himself with his keys, but nothing. He felt confused. The keys only made him spin around!

The Playroom was full of toys: trains, dolls, and building blocks. Leo, the teddy bear cat, watched Piano Vivo with his blue eyes. “Maybe if you try to do something different,” meowed Leo.

Piano Vivo thought. He thought very hard. Then he had an idea! He started to move his legs up and down, slowly, slowly. The wooden legs moved slowly. And then… the stairs worked again! Piano Vivo climbed to the top with a big smile.

Piano Vivo went down again, playing the scales a little more slowly this time. He understood that sometimes, to solve problems, you need to be patient and try different things. 

Piano Vivo rested on his red stool. The Playroom was quiet and peaceful. Piano Vivo knew that calmness always helps to find the solution.

One day, Pinza Forte heard a whimper. He went closer and saw the tallest rose in the garden, a beautiful red rose, broken off from its stem! The leaves were on the ground and the rose looked sad. “Oh no!” thought Pinza Forte. “I must do something!”

Pinza Forte tried to stretch his mechanism to straighten the broken stem. He was trying to be gentle, but the stem was too fragile. With a little push, it broke even further! Pinza Forte felt frustrated. A little beetle, Leo, was watching him curiously.

Pinza Forte calmed down. He thought about what to do. He began to move the clamp slowly, with great care. He gently grabbed the broken stem and pushed it towards the ground. He held it steady, using all his strength, but in a gentle way.

The stem stabilized. The rose was back in its place, supported by Pinza Forte who held it firmly on the ground. Leo applauded with his wings. Pinza Forte felt satisfied. He had solved the problem with patience and care. 

Now the red rose was happy again in the Flower Garden. Pinza Forte understood that sometimes, to solve a problem, you need to slow down and act calmly. And so, Pinza Forte continued to watch over the garden, always ready to help those who needed it.

pinza attrezzo.text:

One day, she saw a gentle flower, a little sunflower, that had fallen off its pot. The sunflower was sad because it couldn't get back.

“Oh no!” said Pinza Paziente. “I must help the sunflower!” She carefully approached the flower and tried to catch it with her point. She was trying to hold it tight, but the sunflower was too light. It fell to the ground! 

Pinza Paziente was a little angry. She tried to hold it even tighter, hoping the sunflower wanted to come back. But every time she held it, the flower fell down again. It was frustrating! A red ladybug passed by and watched Pinza Paziente with curiosity.

Pinza Paziente took a deep breath. She realized she had to be more gentle. She began to loosen her grip, slowly, very slowly. The point of the clamp approached the sunflower with sweetness. Slowly, slowly, the flower began to turn back towards the pot.

Finally, the sunflower was back in its place! Pinza Paziente smiled satisfied. She had learned that patience and gentleness are more important than strength. The Flower Garden was happy again. 

Pinza Paziente thought: “Sometimes, even the most difficult problems can be solved with a small step at a time.”

pinza attrezzo.text:
Pinza Leo was a very brave clamp tool. He lived in the Flower Garden, a place full of colors and scents. He loved to explore among the flowers and plants, but especially he loved to help. One day, while venturing near the old pergola, Pinza Leo found himself stuck! A climbing vine had gripped him tightly, his mechanism was blocked.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Pinza Leo. He tried to pull himself out with force, but the more he strained, the tighter the vine seemed to hold him. The leaves brushed against his nose and the grassy wire tickled his metal feet. He was in trouble.

Then, Pinza Leo had an idea! He remembered that his mechanism was designed to grasp and cut. Concentrating, he began to move the clamp back and forth, trying to catch the vine’s wire. With precise movements, he tried to make a small cut.

After several attempts, Pinza Leo made one last move. A dry sound echoed through the Flower Garden as the grassy wire broke. Pinza Leo was free! He felt happy and proud of his victory. A small daisy, peeking from nearby, nodded in approval.

Pinza Leo rested a little, then returned to explore the Flower Garden. He had learned that even when things seem difficult, you shouldn’t give up and use your intelligence to find a solution. With perseverance, even the biggest problems can be overcome.

Pizza Mario was a special pizza. It was made of soft dough and yummy red sauce. It had lots of gooey cheese pieces and some black olives. 

It lived in a bright kitchen, full of colors and smells. The kitchen was big and had a long table where you could eat.

One day, Pizza Mario felt very lonely. No one wanted to eat him! He was sitting on the table, near the fridge, and he felt sad. There was no one to talk to. “What a shame,” thought Pizza Mario. “Nobody wants me!”

He tried to make a funny smile. He used his cherry tomatoes to make two yellow hearts. But nobody noticed. Mom was making bread and Dad was reading the newspaper. Nobody looked at Pizza Mario.

Suddenly, a sweet voice said: “Mario, you are perfect just the way you are!” A little girl, Sofia, was playing with her toys. She saw Pizza Mario on the table and smiled. “You are the happiest pizza I’ve ever seen!” she exclaimed.

Everyone around started to clap. Mom, Dad, even Sofia! Everyone loved Pizza Mario just as he was, with his smiling cherry tomatoes and his gooey cheese. Pizza Mario felt happier than ever. He realized that being a little different was wonderful. 

From that day on, nobody worried about changing Pizza Mario. And he continued to live in the bright kitchen, happy and carefree. Every now and then he would say: “Being unique is the most important thing.”

plan.svolta: He tried to make a funny smile with his cherry tomatoes, but nobody noticed.
plan.finale: Suddenly, a little voice said: 'Mario, you are perfect as you are!', and everyone applauded his joy.

Pizza Mario was a special pizza. He was made of giant mozzarella and smiling cherry tomatoes. He lived in a happy kitchen, among sparkling pots and colorful plates. Every day, Pizza Mario waited to be eaten, but he loved to be there, near the fridge.

---

One afternoon, the fridge door clicked shut. Pizza Mario felt immediately scared. It was all dark and cold! He had forgotten something! He was afraid of being locked inside forever. “Oh no!” he thought. “No one sees me! No one hears me!”

---

Pizza Mario tried to make a big whistle, like children do. But the sound came out too weak, almost imperceptible. No one really heard it. He felt even more lonely and scared. His edge began to tremble.

---

Just at that moment, Mom came into the kitchen. “I’ll look for some ice cream,” she said, opening the fridge. She saw Pizza Mario and smiled. “Oh, look! Here you were!” With a big smile, Mom took Pizza Mario out of his box. She put him on a plate with a star-shaped napkin.

---

“I found you!” Mom said. Pizza Mario felt happy and content. He understood that he didn’t have to be afraid to ask for help, because someone would always be there for him. Mom looked at him with affection while sipping a glass of milk.

The cook, Nonna Rosa, saw his problem. She took some tape and tried to fix the broken slice. But the heat from the oven was too strong! The tape melted immediately. “Oh no, another failure!” exclaimed Pizza Bruno, desperate.

Then he had a brilliant idea! He shrunk, he reshaped himself with his slices and created a perfect heart shape. It was red, white, and yellow, just like a real pizza! Nonna Rosa looked at him with wide eyes and said, “Pizza Bruno, you are wonderful!” Everyone in the happy kitchen admired the new Pizza Bruno in the shape of a heart.

It was a success! The kitchen was filled with laughter and joy. Pizza Bruno realized that even when things go wrong, you can always find a creative solution. And so, the happiest pizza in the kitchen continued to smile.

The birthday cake, with its sweetness, replied: “What fun!” Pizza Mario was happy. He had made the cake smile! The bright kitchen seemed even more joyful and full of friends.

Pizza Mario was a special pizza. He was made of soft dough and topped with fresh tomato and gooey mozzarella. He lived in a colorful kitchen, full of shiny pots and pans and gleaming trays. His mission was to bring joy to children. Every day, Pizza Mario would pretend to be ordered for a birthday or party, ready to make everyone smile.

One day, while rolling on the table, he accidentally bumped into the edge of the tray. “Oh no!” exclaimed Pizza Mario. “I’m broken! I can’t finish my mission.” His shape had become irregular, with a missing piece and a part that looked like almost two pizzas joined together.

Pizza Mario tried to put himself back together on his own. He took a little bit of strawberry jam and tried to stick the missing piece. But the jam was too sticky! The pizza became even stranger, with pink spots and a completely silly shape.

Mom Baker, seeing Pizza Mario’s sadness, came closer. She took a little bit of fresh mozzarella and gently straightened him out. With love and patience, Pizza Mario became a perfect pizza again. 

“See, Pizza Mario,” said Mom Baker smiling, “even when things break, with a little help and courage, you can put them back together.” Pizza Mario felt his doughy heart swell with joy. He understood that no matter how ruined he was, he could always start bringing happiness again.

plan.problema: Mario's pizza broke and he can’t finish his mission to bring joy to the children.
plan.svolta: He tried to fix himself with a little jam, but he got even stranger!
plan.finale: The mommy cook used her love and some mozzarella to put it back together perfectly.
plan.morale: The courage to always start again.

pizza.text:
Pizza Mario was a special pizza. He was made of soft mozzarella and had a delicious smell. He lived in the happy kitchen, among the baking trays and pots. He loved to be there, watching the cooks’ movements.

One day, Pizza Mario found himself on the floor! He had rolled over and all his cherry tomatoes were scattered everywhere. “Oh no!” he exclaimed. “All my cherry tomatoes are gone!” It was a disaster. He had to collect them all.

Pizza Mario tried to use his mozzarella hands to grab them, but it was impossible. The cherry tomatoes were too small and they slipped away every time he tried to take them. He felt frustrated and sad. He didn’t know what to do.

Then, he saw some colorful cookies on the tray next to him. “Hello!” said Pizza Mario. “Could you help me? I’ve lost all my cherry tomatoes!” The cookies, a little chocolate cookie named Biscottino, immediately offered to help. Together, they started collecting the cherry tomatoes one by one and putting them in a line.

Biscottino was good at guiding the cherry tomatoes and Pizza Mario was very good at gently pushing those that slipped away. After a while, they had gathered all the cherry tomatoes into a perfect line, just like Pizza Mario liked it. 

“Thank you, Biscottino!” said Pizza Mario smiling. “I could never have done it on my own!” The two friends looked at each other and realized that together they could do anything.

Pizza Mario straightened up carefully and he immediately felt better. He was happy to be standing again, with his cherry tomatoes in the right place. 

It was wonderful to work together.

plan.problema: Pizza Mario overturned and lost all his cherry tomatoes!
plan.svolta: He tried to collect the cherry tomatoes with his mozzarella hands, but they were too small and slippery.
plan.finale: Then he had an idea: he asked for help from the cookies that were on the baking sheet and together they grouped the cherry tomatoes into a perfect line!

pizza.text:
Pizza Mario was a special pizza. He was made of soft dough and full of good tomatoes.
He lived in a bright kitchen, full of colors.
The kitchen had a big table and lots of cupboards full of kitchen tools.
But Pizza Mario felt lonely. No one wanted to eat him.

“Oh no,” said Pizza Mario, “I’m so sad! Everyone looks at me, but nobody wants to taste my pizza!”
He huddled on the table, his slices seemed smaller than they were.
A little girl, Sofia, would sometimes come into the kitchen to help her mom prepare meals.
But she just walked past Pizza Mario without stopping.

Pizza Mario had an idea! He decided to make funny faces with his cherry tomatoes.
He stretched them into a smiling face, then made wink and pupils.
But Sofia didn’t laugh. Not even her mom.

“Maybe,” thought Pizza Mario, “I should try something different.”
He took some mozzarella and some basil.
With these ingredients, he started to draw on the table.
He created strange shapes, then straight and curved lines.
Slowly, the table turned into a beautiful rainbow!

Sofia gasped. “How lovely!” she exclaimed.
Her mom smiled. Everyone admired Pizza Mario’s artwork.
The toy pizza maker was happy.
He had discovered that creating new things could bring so much joy.
Creativity makes life more colorful and full of surprises.

plan.problema: Mario the pizza found himself alone and sad because nobody wanted to eat him.
plan.svolta: He tried to make funny faces with his cherry tomatoes, but nobody laughed!
plan.finale: Then he decided to use his toppings to draw a beautiful rainbow on the table and everyone admired his artistic talent.
plan.morale: Creativity is the key to happiness.

pizza.text:
Pizza Mario was a special pizza. It was made of soft dough, sweet tomato, and gooey mozzarella. It lived in a happy kitchen, full of colors and delicious smells. Every day it enjoyed watching the plates and pots, dreaming of being the star of a lovely meal.

But one afternoon, Pizza Mario found himself all alone on the table. Nobody wanted to eat him. Dad said, “No, thank you, Mario, we already ordered pizza.” Mom smiled kindly, but she kept choosing other options. Even the little dog, Fido, sniffed curiously, then wagged his tail and walked away. Pizza Mario felt sad. He was a lonely pizza, without anyone to share his taste with.

Suddenly, Pizza Mario had an idea! He took his black olives, the big, shiny ones, and arranged them to make a big smile. Then, carefully, he sprinkled a pinch of grated Parmesan on top of his pizza. It was a beautiful sight!

Mom, who was preparing the side dish, stopped to watch Pizza Mario. She smiled and said, “Mario is perfect for our lunch!” Dad agreed right away, and everyone enjoyed Pizza Mario with gusto. It was really delicious! 

Fido also wanted a little piece. Everyone was happy to have appreciated the goodness of the pizza. Pizza Mario finally felt like part of a family, full of smiles and good humor. The happy kitchen was even happier thanks to that olive smile.

plan.problema: Mario the pizza found himself alone and sad because nobody wanted to eat him.
plan.svolta: He decided to make a big smile with his black olives and a dusting of Parmesan to attract attention.
plan.finale: Finally, Mom thought, 'Mario is perfect for our lunch!' and everyone happily appreciated his goodness.

pizza.text:
Pizza Mario was a special pizza. He was made of golden dough and topped with giant tomatoes and gooey mozzarella. He lived in a colorful kitchen, full of shiny trays and sparkling pots. Pizza Mario loved his kitchen because it was a place full of good smells.

But that evening, Pizza Mario felt lonely. Nobody wanted to eat him. The oven was empty and his friends, the french fries, watched him from a distance. Pizza Mario was sad. He sat on the marble countertop, with his curled edge, and said nothing.

He tried to make a cheerful little bump, as if inviting everyone to try him. He hopped on his tray, making little “poofs!” to try to make someone smile. But nobody laughed. Nobody touched him. It was all silent in the colorful kitchen.

Suddenly, a little girl came into the kitchen. She had red hair and bright eyes. She walked up to Pizza Mario and asked, “Can I have a piece of pizza?”

Pizza Mario lit up with joy! His mozzarella shone brighter than ever. The little girl took a small piece and ate it with pleasure. Pizza Mario felt a warmth in his doughy heart. He realized that sometimes, just a little kindness is enough to make a difference. 

The colorful kitchen was full of joy again. Pizza Mario understood that when you are kind to others, they become happy too.

plan.problema: Mario the pizza found himself alone and sad because nobody wanted to eat him.
plan.svolta: He tried to do a cheerful little kick, but nobody laughed.
plan.finale: Suddenly, a girl asked: 'Can I have a piece of pizza?' and Mario lit up with joy!

pizza.text:
Pizza Mario was a very happy pizza. He lived in a colorful kitchen full of shiny pots and pans. He had his own pink table and a little yellow stool beside it. Every day, Pizza Mario loved to roll on the floor and pretend to be eaten.

One day, however, something went wrong. While he was taking a quick spin, a corner of Pizza Mario broke off! He couldn't smile like before. His joy was gone. He was sad and quiet.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Pizza Mario. “I’m broken!” He tried to put himself back together, but he tried to use ketchup to glue the broken corner. But the ketchup was too sticky! It made a big mess all over his pink table.

The cook, a friendly blue teacup named Tea, saw Pizza Mario sad. “What’s wrong?” asked Tea. “Why are you so down?”

Pizza Mario explained his problem. Tea thought for a moment and then had an idea! “Maybe,” said Tea, “you could ask for help from someone!”

So Pizza Mario asked his friends: “Would you like to help me to be whole again?” Everyone said yes! They took him into pieces and together they made lots of new happy pizzas. Each pizza was different from the other, but they were all full of joy. Pizza Mario realized that even when something breaks, with the help of others, you can become whole and happy again.

plan.problema: Mario’s pizza broke and he can’t finish being happy anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to put it back together with ketchup, but he only made a mess!
plan.finale: Then he had the idea of wondering if someone wanted to help him be whole again, and everyone chopped him up to make new happy pizzas.
plan.morale: Collaboration is the key to happiness

sassofono.text:
Sassophone was a very nice saxophone. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. It was a special garden, where the sun always shone brightly. Sassophone loved to play, but one morning something wasn't right. He tried to make sounds, but instead he only felt a strange silence. “Oh no!” said Sassophone. “I’ve forgotten how to play the happy notes!”

He was sad. No one wanted to play with him if he couldn't do his favorite music. A little blue butterfly, named Lila, landed on his horn. “What’s wrong, Sassophone?” she asked. “Can’t you play anymore?”

Sassophone explained his problem. Lila thought for a little while. “Listen,” said Lila, “the little birds are singing a beautiful melody! Maybe you can learn from them.”

Sassophone closed his eyes and listened carefully. The birds chirped, trilled, and made many different sounds. Sassophone tried to imitate their rhythms with his horn. At first he made strange noises, but then, slowly, he was able to produce a funny, happy melody!

The other residents of the secret garden stopped to listen. The gnome, the bees, even the ladybug, smiled. Sassophone played even louder, creating a fun music that filled the garden with joy. 

Sassophone realized how important it was to listen carefully to learn new things and create something beautiful. He was so happy to be able to play again!

plan.problema: The saxophone had forgotten how to play happy notes!
plan.svolta: He decided to listen carefully to the song of the birds, trying to imitate their rhythms.
plan.finale: He managed to reproduce a funny and joyful melody that made all the inhabitants of the secret garden smile.

sassofono.text:
Sassophone was a very happy saxophone. He lived in the playground, under the shade of a big tree. He loved to play and make beautiful notes. Every day he tried to make them, but something wasn't going right. He couldn't make his cheerful, lively sounds anymore. He was sad.

“Oh no,” said Sassophone with his whistling voice. “I can’t have the notes I like!”

A little squirrel, Arturo, was playing nearby. He listened to Sassophone and came closer. “Maybe,” suggested Arturo, “you could try playing in a different way?”

Sassophone thought about it. He decided to do something new. He started to slow down the sound of his saxophone. He played slowly, then made long pauses between the notes. It was a strange rhythm, never heard before.

At first, the children in the playground didn't understand. Then, slowly, they started to listen. The squirrels stopped to hear. Arturo nodded his head excitedly. Sassophone continued to play his new rhythm. It was beautiful and relaxing.

All the squirrels in the playground stopped to listen to it with pleasure, creating a special, quiet music. Sassophone had learned that even a slow sound could be wonderful.

plan.problema: He couldn't play the happy notes he loved.
plan.svolta: He decided to learn a new rhythm, slowing down the sound and adding pauses.
plan.finale: All the squirrels in the park stopped to listen to him with pleasure, creating special music.

sassofono.text:
Sassofono was a very special saxophone. He lived in a secret garden, full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Every day, Sassofono dreamed of playing happy music for the little birds. But today, he couldn’t do it. His sound was strange, sad, and without a rhythm.

The birds in the garden were angry. “Sassofono, why don’t you play our song?” they chirped. “We want to hear a happy melody!” Sassofono felt very guilty. He didn’t know what to do to play well again. He was all confused and a little bit sad.

Sassofono tried to push the keys with his fingers, but nothing. He tried to move on the bench where he sat, but that didn’t help either. Then, he had an idea. He decided to try moving his little finger, that small finger he used to make special sounds.

Sassofono moved his finger slowly, with patience. He pushed and released the key, one after the other. The garden was silent, everyone was waiting. With one last push, Sassofono made a sweet melody, light and happy. The birds returned to sing happily, flying around the saxophone.

Sassofono felt very happy. He had learned that even when things seem difficult, with calmness and perseverance, you can always find the right solution. Music filled the secret garden again, a sweet reminder of the power of patience.

plan.problema: The saxophone couldn’t play a happy melody and all the little birds were angry.
plan.svolta: He decided to try moving his thumb, hoping it would help him find the right note.
plan.finale: With one last squeeze, the saxophone made a sweet melody and the birds went back to singing happily.

sassofono.text:
Sassophone was a very nice saxophone. He lived in the playground, under the shade of a big tree. He loved the playground and all his toy friends. Every day, after the rain, Sassophone got ready to play his happy notes.

But that morning, something wasn't right. When Sassophone pushed his mechanism, instead of a sweet melody, it only made a dull sound. He couldn't make the notes he loved! He was very sad. “Oh no!” he thought. “I can’t play anymore!”

A little music box, sitting near Sassophone, said, “Maybe you should try something new?” Sassophone thought about it for a little while. Then he had an idea. He decided to concentrate all his sound into one chord. He closed his eyes and, pushing the mechanism with force, he made a powerful and joyful sound.

The sound filled the air. It was strong and beautiful! The children in the playground stopped to listen. They turned towards Sassophone, smiling. Sassophone kept playing that one chord, louder and happier. 

Finally, all the children were gathered around him, happy to listen to his special sound. The playground was full of joy. Sassophone had learned that even when things go wrong, if you try hard, you can find happiness. And that happiness spread throughout the playground.

plan.problema: The saxophone couldn't make the cheerful notes it loved!
plan.svolta: It decided to learn a new melody, concentrating all its sound in one chord.
plan.finale: The powerful and joyful sound filled the playground, attracting the attention of all the happy children.

sassofono.text:
Sassophone was a very special saxophone. He lived in a secret garden, full of roses and sunflowers. It was a quiet garden, with a small pond and an old tree. Sassophone loved that place. He loved the smell of the flowers and the song of the birds.

But lately, something wasn’t right. Sassophone couldn’t make the happy notes he loved. His notes were unpleasant and full of sadness. The whole garden seemed sad with him. The sunflowers didn’t seem to smile anymore, and the roses had lost their color.

Sassophone decided to try to play louder, hoping that a powerful sound would solve the problem. He played with all his might, but the sound was still unpleasant! None of the flowers in the garden seemed to appreciate it.

A little ladybug, called Lila, came up to Sassophone. “Maybe,” said Lila, “you need to play softly and with a rhythm.”

Sassophone followed Lila’s advice. He played slowly, creating a delicate rhythm. The notes became clearer and more harmonious. The flowers in the garden began to move, the sunflowers stretched towards the sun, and the roses regained their bright color.

Sassophone played with sweetness, creating a relaxing melody for the whole secret garden. It was a beautiful sound and full of joy. The little ladybug Lila danced happily around him. 

Sassophone realized that patience and gentleness lead to the greatest beauty.

plan.problema: The saxophone couldn't make happy notes and the garden was sad.
plan.svolta: He decided to try to play louder, but the sound remained unpleasant.
plan.finale: He discovered that he had to play softly and with a rhythm to make the flowers in the garden smile.

sassofono.text:
Sassofono lived in the Flowery Garden. He was a little blue saxophone with many golden keys. He loved to be there, next to the red tulips and the yellow roses. One day, Sassofono heard bees buzzing around him. The bees were very sad.

“I can’t play a happy melody,” said Sassofono. “I want to make the bees smile!” He tried to make high, bouncy sounds, but the bees moved away even further. It seemed like they didn’t understand what was happening to him.

Sassofono was a little frustrated. He thought, “Maybe I should try something different.” So, he took a deep breath and tried to make lower sounds, like a gentle rumble. But that didn’t work either! The bees flew away even faster, worried.

“They don’t understand!” thought Sassofono. Then, suddenly, he had an idea. He closed his eyes and focused. Slowly, with a sweet and light sound, he began to play a lullaby. It was a delicate sound, like the wind through the leaves.

The bees approached timidly. Then, one by one, they began to fly around Sassofono’s keys, happy and content. They buzzed happily, following his music. Sassofono smiled. He had learned that sometimes all it takes is a little patience to find the right melody. Beauty is born when you are willing to wait.

plan.problema: The saxophone couldn't play a cheerful melody to make the bees smile.
plan.svolta: It decided to try to make lower sounds, like a gentle rumble, but the bees moved away even faster.
plan.finale: Finally, with a sweet and light sound, the saxophone composed a lullaby that made the bees fly around its keyboard, happy and content.

sassofono.text:
Sassophone was a very special saxophone. He lived in a secret garden, full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Every day, Sassophone dreamed of playing happy music for all the garden’s residents. But today, he couldn’t do it. His notes were gray and sad.

A little blue butterfly had hidden among the roses. She was sad because she couldn’t hear the music. “Oh, Sassophone,” she sighed, “I wish you would play again!”

Sassophone tried to push his keys, but nothing! He tried to move his body, but still nothing. He was frustrated. He decided to do something different. He tried to breathe air through the saxophone’s hole, hoping it would help him play. But only a little whistle came out!

Sassophone was almost without hope. Then, suddenly, a ray of sunshine hit his shiny body. Sassophone began to vibrate and wiggle. His music became louder and more beautiful. A joyful melody filled the secret garden.

The blue butterfly came out of her hiding place and began to flutter around Sassophone. She was happy! Sassophone’s music had brought joy back to the garden. 

Sassophone continued to play, and every note was a little gift for the garden. Sassophone’s patience had brought forth a wonderful melody.

plan.problema: The saxophone couldn't play happy notes and the sad butterfly had hidden.
plan.svolta: It decided to try to breathe in through the hole, but only a little whistle came out!
plan.finale: Suddenly, a ray of sunshine hit the saxophone, making it vibrate and filling the garden with a joyful melody, attracting the butterfly again.

sassofono.text:
Sassofono was a special saxophone. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. He was a saxophone who loved to play, but one morning something wasn't right. He couldn't make happy notes. It seemed like the sound had disappeared.

The sun in the secret garden seemed sad too, with its gray clouds. Sassofono tried to push the keys, but nothing. He tried to move his mouth, but no chords came out. He was very worried.

A little blue butterfly landed on his mouthpiece. “Maybe,” said the butterfly, “you should try to move a little. Imagine flying like me!”

Sassofono thought about it. He decided to make small movements with his mechanical body, imitating the butterfly’s flight. He moved forward and backward, up and down, trying to find the lost sound. He was a little clumsy, but he didn’t give up.

Then, with a final, determined tap on his metal mouth, the notes sounded again! A sweet and bright sound filled the secret garden. The sun smiled and the flowers opened up more than usual. 

Sassofono continued to play, happy. The blue butterfly danced around him. Finally, the music had found its place in the secret garden. With a final smile, he knew that with effort and courage, even the biggest problems can be solved.

plan.problema: The saxophone couldn't play the cheerful notes and the sun seemed sad.
plan.svolta: He decided to try to make small movements with his mechanical toy, imitating the flight of a bird, hoping that the music would come out again.
plan.finale: Finally, with one last tap, the notes sounded again, lighting up the garden and making the sun smile.

sassofono.text:
Sassofono lived in a secret garden. He was a golden saxophone, very friendly and always ready to play. He loved to play cheerful melodies among the flowers and the trees. But one day, something changed. Sassofono couldn't make any sound. He was stuck!

“Oh no!” exclaimed Sassofono. “I can’t make music anymore! It’s terrible!” He tried to move, to push the keys with his finger, but nothing worked. Every attempt proved useless. He felt sad and frustrated in his secret garden.

A little beetle, called Tito, approached Sassofono. “What’s happening?” asked Tito with his squeaky voice.
“I’m stuck!” replied Sassofono. “I can’t play anymore.” He tried to stretch the keys, and shorten them, but nothing seemed to work. It was a real mess.

Then, suddenly, the sun began to shine in the secret garden. A ray of golden light hit Sassofono’s body. The saxophone trembled slightly and, suddenly, he felt free! The keys moved easily and a sweet sound filled the air.

Sassofono played a beautiful melody, happy to be able to play again. Tito listened to him with wonder. The sun continued to shine on the secret garden, illuminating everything with its light. Sassofono realized that even the biggest problems can be solved with patience and a little bit of light.

plan.problema: The saxophone had stopped and couldn't make music anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to stretch the keys, but nothing seemed to work.
plan.finale: Suddenly, a ray of sunshine hit his golden body, freeing him from the block!
plan.morale: Patience and light solve every problem.

sassofono.text:
Sassofono was a saxophone who was a little bit sad. He lived in a secret garden, a place full of red roses and tall trees. But lately, the garden wasn’t happy. Everything seemed gray and quiet. Sassofono knew why: he wasn’t playing well anymore. His notes weren’t as cheerful as before.

Sassofono sat on a stone bench, his wooden mouth a little droopy. “I don’t understand,” he said to himself, “where did I put my sound?” A little blue butterfly, Lila, fluttered around him, but she didn’t seem interested.

Sassofono decided to try to play louder. He pushed his metal and wooden body with all his might. But nothing! The sound stayed silent. He was very disappointed.

“Maybe,” he thought, “I need to do something different.” So, Sassofono closed his eyes and took a deep breath. Slowly, he began to play a simple melody. One note at a time, with sweetness. The sound was still a little faint, but it was starting to change.

Suddenly, the petals of the roses became brighter. The trees seemed to stretch their arms towards the sky. And Lila the blue butterfly began to dance around Sassofono, making little chirps. The garden was full of colors and laughter again.

Sassofono played for a little while longer, calmly and patiently. Then, he stopped and smiled. His music had brought joy to the secret garden. And he knew that the most important thing is to take the time to do things with care.

plan.problema: The saxophone couldn't make happy notes and the garden was sad.
plan.svolta: He decided to try to play louder, but the sound was still dull.
plan.finale: When he played slowly and sweetly, the garden filled with colors and laughter.

sega.text:
Sega Mattia was a special saw. He wasn’t just a wooden toy; he talked and moved all by himself in the workshop. 

The workshop was full of wooden boards of every shape and size. It was his kingdom, where he spent most of his time cutting and making shells.

One day, Sega Mattia was working on a beautiful pine board. He was trying to make a little perfect square for a gift. But suddenly, with a big pull, he had gone too far inside! 

The wood held him tight, it was impossible to move. He was trapped!

Sega Mattia tried to use his handle to push, but it only made him snap even tighter. The wood was hard and didn’t want to give way. Sega Mattia began to feel a little sad. He couldn’t cut anymore, he couldn’t do his job.

Just at that moment, he heard a noise. It was the old drill, a trusted friend of the workshop. “What’s happening, Sega Mattia?” asked the drill with its metallic voice. 

Sega Mattia explained his problem. The drill came closer and, gently, began to turn the bit. With a small movement, Sega Mattia freed himself from the wood!

Sega Mattia thanked the drill with joy. Then, he went back to his pine board and started cutting right away. He cut fast and precisely, happy to be free again. 

Sega Mattia realized that even when things seem difficult, with a little help and perseverance, you can always find the solution. And so, he continued to cut with joy, always ready for new challenges.

plan.problema: Saw Mattia got stuck in the wood, too tight to move!
plan.svolta: He tried to use his handle to push, but it only snapped even tighter.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of the old drill, Saw Mattia is finally free and returns to cutting with joy!

sega.text:
Sega Piccolo lived in a wooden workshop. He was a small saw, but a very brave one. He loved to cut wood to create fun shapes. He had a favorite handle, one shaped like a shining star. He adored it because it made him feel stronger and more confident.

One day, Sega Piccolo noticed that his star was missing! It was gone! “Oh no!” he said. “How will I cut the shapes if I don’t have my star?” He felt sad and a little confused. He looked everywhere: under the workbench, behind the lathe, but nothing. The star was missing.

The old carpenter, Nonno Leo, was watching him smiling. “Maybe,” he said, “you should look among the scattered pieces of wood here.” Sega Piccolo nodded and began to look. There were planks of various sizes, wood scraps, nails, and hammers. He began to touch each piece, hoping to find his star.

After a while, he noticed something strange under a large cover. He carefully moved the cover and… there it was! His star-shaped star shone in the sunlight coming through the window. Sega Piccolo took it in his teeth and put it into his handle.

“I did it!” he exclaimed happily. He could immediately return to cutting shapes, faster and with more energy. Sega Piccolo realized that, even when things seem lost, with a little patience you can find them. And so, he returned to work, ready for new adventures.

plan.problema: Saw, Piccolo has lost his favorite handle, the star-shaped one!
plan.svolta: He decided to look among the scattered pieces of wood in the workshop, hoping to find it.
plan.finale: Finally, he found it under a lid, happy to be able to cut shapes again!
plan.morale: Patience is the key to finding what is missing.

sega.text:
Sega Piccolo was a little saw, made of shiny wood. He lived in a big workshop full of planks, nails, and hammers. He was the most curious saw in the world! He loved to cut small pieces of wood to make hearts, stars, and silly shapes.

One day, Sega Piccolo noticed that something wasn't right. “Oh no!” he exclaimed. “I’ve lost my favorite screwdriver!” It was a small, orange screwdriver with a precise tip. Without it, Sega Piccolo couldn't cut perfectly. His cuts were crooked and uncertain.

Sega Piccolo decided to look for his screwdriver. He moved slowly among the wooden planks, being careful not to drop anything. He shifted the base a little, examining behind a pile of nails. The old carpenter, Nonno Bruno, watched him from a distance with a smile. “Be patient, Sega Piccolo,” said Nonno Bruno.

After a lot of searching, Sega Piccolo noticed something under a pile of planks. It was his orange screwdriver! He grabbed it with joy and put it in his slot. Immediately, he started cutting a perfect little square. 

Sega Piccolo felt happy and confident. He had found the solution to his problem thanks to patience. Nonno Bruno smiled at him. “Good job, Sega Piccolo,” he said. “Sometimes, you just have to look carefully.” Sega Piccolo continued to cut his hearts and stars with precision, knowing that patience would always help him find what he was looking for.

plan.problema: Piccolo has lost his favorite screwdriver, without which he can’t cut properly.
plan.svolta: He decided to explore every corner of the workshop in search of the lost object, moving carefully not to damage anything.
plan.finale: Finally, under a pile of planks, he found his screwdriver and started cutting accurately again.

sega.text:
Sega Piccola lived in a wooden workshop full of tools and the smells of freshly cut wood. She was a little saw, red and shiny, and she was very good at cutting wood. Today she had an important job: to cut a piece for the sailor’s boat.

But suddenly, Sega Piccola got stuck! She couldn’t move her blade anymore. It was as if it were stuck in the wood. “Oh no!” she exclaimed, but she couldn’t really speak, she was just a saw. She tried to push with all her might, but nothing. The piece of wood remained there, untouched.

The old carpenter, Mr. Bruno, came up to Sega Piccola and said, “Don’t give up! There must be a way.” Sega Piccola decided to go around the table of the workshop. She passed by the planes, the hammers, and the axes. She was looking for something that could help her.

Then she had an idea! She decided to go around the table of the workshop, hoping to find a way to unlock her cut. She turned and turned, until, with a little tap on her handle, she was free! The blade moved again, fast and precise.

Sega Piccola could continue to cut the wood for the sailor’s boat with precision. Mr. Bruno smiled. Sega Piccola had shown that even a little helper can overcome difficulties with effort and patience. And so, the piece for the boat was cut to perfection.

plan.problema: Little Saw has gotten stuck and can’t cut the piece of wood for the boat anymore!
plan.svolta: He decided to go around the table in the workshop, hoping to find a way to unlock his cut.

sega.text:
Sega Mattia lived in the wood workshop. He was a special saw, he could talk and move on his own. His house was full of tools: hammers, chisels, nails, all made of wood. One day, the old carpenter, Nonno Bruno, put a giant cookie in front of him, made of dark chocolate. “Cut it for me, Sega Mattia,” said Nonno Bruno with a smile.

Sega Mattia walked up to the cookie and started to cut. But the cookie was too soft! The blade slipped away without making a cut. Sega Mattia tried to push harder, but it didn't help. The cookie kept deforming under his blade. He was frustrated. He couldn’t cut the cookie and he felt a little down.

“I need to think,” thought Sega Mattia. Then he had an idea! He took a piece of cardboard from the toolbox. He placed it on top of the cookie, right where the blade was slipping. With the cardboard, he was able to apply pressure and cut with more force. The blade finally found a way through the chocolate!

Sega Mattia cut the cookie in two perfect slices. He was happy! The chocolate smelled deliciously. Nonno Bruno smiled seeing Sega Mattia so happy. “Good job, Sega Mattia,” he said. “You were patient and you found the right solution.”

Sega Mattia settled down on his workbench, satisfied with his success. He understood that sometimes to get what you want, you have to slow down a little and find the best method. The cookie was cut perfectly, making Sega Mattia happy.

plan.problema: Mattia couldn't cut the cookie, it was too soft!
plan.svolta: He decided to use a piece of cardboard to apply pressure and cut with more force.
plan.finale: The cookie was cut perfectly, making Mattia happy.

sega.text:
Sega Mattia lived in a wooden workshop full of boards and tools. He was a special saw, made of shiny metal and with a warm wooden handle. Sega Mattia loved to cut wood to create new and fun shapes. One day, while he was cutting a beautiful pine board, something went wrong.

Suddenly, Sega Mattia found himself stuck! His cut had become too deep and his blade was trapped inside the wood. He was very scared. It was dark between the wood fibers and he couldn't move anymore. “Oh no!” thought Sega Mattia, “I can’t cut anymore!”

Sega Mattia tried to wiggle with all his might. He made a big effort, but only his handle vibrated. He hadn't moved a millimeter. The fear squeezed him tighter and tighter. A little hammer, called Marco, was watching the scene closely.

“Sega Mattia, what’s happening?” asked Marco with his metallic voice. “Try to push with the handle!” suggested Marco. Sega Mattia listened to Marco and made one last concentrated effort. With a decisive snap, he pulled the blade out of the wood! 

Sega Mattia was free and could cut the wood again with joy. He cut a small heart-shaped cookie to celebrate his victory. Sega Mattia realized that even when things seem difficult, with a little perseverance you can always find the solution.

plan.problema: Sega Mattia got stuck in the wood and couldn't cut anymore, and he was very scared of being inside.
plan.svolta: He tried to creak with force, but it only vibrated his handle and didn't move.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a small hammer, Sega Mattia managed to free himself from the wood and returned to cutting with joy.

sega.text:
Sega Stella was a special saw. She lived in a wood workshop full of the smell of pine and resin. She was a saw that could talk and move on her own! She had a shiny, red blade, and she loved cutting wood to create beautiful shapes.

But one day, Sega Stella noticed a problem. Her blade had become too short! She couldn't cut the beautiful shapes of trees and animals that she liked so much anymore. She was sad and frustrated. “I can’t do what I love!” she thought.

Sega Stella decided to ask for help. She went to a small piece of brown wood, her friend Peppino. “Peppino, do you know how to make my blade long again?” asked Sega Stella. Peppino replied, “Maybe you should ask the other pieces of wood!”

Sega Stella ran around the workshop. She talked to a square piece of wood, a thin board, and even a small nail. All together, and very carefully, they began to gently move Sega Stella. They moved her back and forth, slowly, very slowly.

After a long time, Sega Stella’s blade began to lengthen! Her shiny surface shone like before. She was happy! “We did it!” she exclaimed. 

Sega Stella’s blade shone again, ready to create new wooden wonders. With patience and with the help of her friends, even the most difficult things can be solved.

plan.problema: Her blade had become too short to cut the beautiful shapes!
plan.svolta: She decided to ask all the wooden pieces how to make it long, and with a little help, she gently stretched them out.
plan.finale: Stella’s blade shone brightly again, ready to create new wooden wonders!

sega.text:
Sega Piccolo lived in the garage. He was a little saw, made of wood, and he could talk! The garage was full of dust, old tools, and forgotten boxes. Sega Piccolo loved his place, even though sometimes he felt a little lonely.

Every day, Sega Piccolo tried to cut the little stick. It was a brown, rough stick that Nonno Mario had given him. But every time he tried to cut it, nothing! The stick always stayed whole. Sega Piccolo got a little upset. “I can’t do it!” he said in a clumsy voice.

He tried hard, turned the handle, but the stick wouldn’t break. It was frustrating. He started to look around the garage, searching for a solution. He saw an old hammer leaning against a corner.

Then he had an idea! Sega Piccolo decided to use his handle to push the stick along the floor. He started to make little circles, pushing the stick with the handle while he turned. He turned and turned, faster and faster. 

The stick started to move! At one point, with a little “cut,” it broke in two. Sega Piccolo smiled happily. It was the first time he had ever been able to cut something! The hammer lay nearby, silent.

Sega Piccolo realized he shouldn’t ever give up. Even when things seem difficult, with a little effort you can always find a solution. And this made him understand that perseverance always pays off.

plan.problema: Sega Piccolo can't cut the stick, no matter how hard he tries!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his handle to push the stick along the path, making a little circle.
plan.finale: The stick finally broke with a little ‘cut’ and Sega Piccolo smiled satisfied.

sega.text:
Stella was a special saw. She wasn't a normal saw, no! Stella saw could talk and move on her own in the wood workshop. The workshop was full of wooden boards, knives, and hammers. It was her world.

One day, while moving between the boards, Stella saw that something wasn't right. Her star, the bright one she had on her head, was lost! She couldn't find her perfect shape anymore. She was sad and confused. “Oh no!” thought Stella saw. “I have to do something!”

The old hammer, Boris, watched her with curiosity. “What are you doing, Stella saw?” asked Boris. Stella saw replied: "I've lost my star! I don't know where it is!"

Stella saw decided to try cutting the wood in a different way. She focused and started moving forward and backward. Then, she made a decision: she made a long diagonal cut through a thick board. The wood broke with a loud noise. Stella saw continued to cut, more and more slowly, trying to follow her star’s path.

Finally, with a final precise cut, Stella saw cut off the last piece of wood. Her star reappeared, shining as always! Stella saw was happy and satisfied. She had solved her problem with patience and attention.

Stella saw stopped and looked at herself in the wooden mirror. She was happy with her perfect shape. And she knew that calm and concentration can lead to wonderful results.

plan.problema: The Star has lost her shape in the wood and can’t find it again!
plan.svolta: She decided to make a long diagonal cut, hoping to create a new path for her search.
plan.finale: Finally, with a final precise cut, the Star found her perfect shape, shining as always.

sega.text:
Sega Piccolo lived in the carpenter’s workshop. He was a small saw, made of wood, with a brown handle and a sharp blade. He loved cutting wood more than anything in the world. Every day, the old carpenter, Nonno Elia, gave him pieces of wood to make little objects.

But that day was different. Sega Piccolo tried to cut a piece of pine, but the blade kept slipping away! He couldn’t fit into the narrow space of the wood. “Oh no!” said Sega Piccolo, frustrated. “I can’t do it! I’m a saw and I can’t cut!” He stopped, still, with the blade pointing down.

Nonno Elia smiled. “Don’t give up, Sega Piccolo!” he said. Sega Piccolo thought, thought, thought. Then he had an idea. He started to go around the wood, looking for a narrower corner, a place where his blade could do its work. He moved forward and backward, slowly, with patience.

Finally, he found a small space! Sega Piccolo positioned himself carefully and, with a final, strong cut, he cut the wood perfectly in half. A beautiful sound of wood breaking echoed in the workshop. Sega Piccolo was happy! He felt powerful and capable. 

Nonno Elia took him in his hand and said: “Good job, Sega Piccolo! You showed that you are a good worker!” Sega Piccolo understood that sometimes you have to change your approach to solve problems. And so, with a smile, he went back to cutting wood, always with lots of energy. After all, perseverance can lead to wonderful results.

plan.problema: Piccolo couldn’t cut the wood and felt very frustrated.
plan.svolta: He decided to go around the wood, looking for a narrower angle where he could do his magic.
plan.finale: Finally, with a decisive final cut, Piccolo cuts the wood perfectly, finding his joy of cutting!

spazzola.text:
Spazzolino was a very special toy. He lived in the Bear Workshop, a place full of colors and sweet smells. Spazzolino loved his job: making the little bear pellets shiny. But one morning, something wasn’t right. It was all covered in fluff! He couldn’t brush the bears anymore, they looked dull and faded.

Spazzolino felt a little sad. He tried to spin around quickly, but the fluff was everywhere. Mr. Bruno, the pellet maker, looked at him with concern. “You need to find the right cleaner,” said Mr. Bruno. “The one that melts the fluff.”

Spazzolino decided to take a little trip around the workshop. He slid between the machines, explored the shelves full of colors and smells. He saw a little drop of honey on Mr. Bruno’s table. It looked so sweet and bright! Spazzolino approached carefully.

With great delicacy, he took the drop of honey and began to clean the first bear. Then the second, and the third. The fluff melted like snow in the sun. The little bears began to shine again! Spazzolino was happy.

Mr. Bruno smiled. “Good job, Spazzolino,” he said. “You found the solution!” Spazzolino continued to clean the bears with the honey drop, until they were all bright and shiny. 

After so much work, Spazzolino rested. Patience had brought the solution to the problem.

plan.problema: Toothbrush had gotten covered in fluff and couldn't make the little bear pellets shiny anymore!
plan.svolta: He decided to take a trip around the workshop, looking for the best cleaner to dissolve the fluff.
plan.finale: He found a drop of honey and, with care, used it to clean every single bear, making them sparkle!
