spazzola.text:
Spazzolino was a happy toy. He lived in the Secret Garden, a magical place full of flowers and plants. Spazzolino loved his job: cleaning the little pebbles that lived among the petals. But one day, he noticed something bad. He was completely full of dry leaves and dust! He couldn't make the pebbles shiny anymore.

“Oh no!” said Spazzolino. “I have to do something! I have to clean the pebbles!” He tried to move, but he was too heavy. His bristles were sticky and dirty. He was sad and frustrated.

Spazzolino had an idea. He decided to go around the fountain to collect the dirt faster. He started to run, but suddenly he stopped! He was trapped in a rose bush. The thorns pricked him and he couldn't move.

A little red ladybug, named Rosa, saw Spazzolino in the bush. “What’s happening?” asked Rosa. Spazzolino explained his problem. Rosa, with her strength and agility, gently pushed the roses away from Spazzolino. 

In a moment, Spazzolino was free! He quickly cleaned the pebbles and made them shiny again. He was happy to be able to go back to doing his job in the Secret Garden. Spazzolino realized that even when obstacles seem big, with a little courage you can overcome them.

plan.problema: Spazzolino had found himself full of leaves and dust, unable to make his little teacups shine.
plan.svolta: He decided to take a turn around the fountain to collect dirt faster, but he got stuck in a rose bush!
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a friendly ladybug, Spazzolino was able to free himself and return ready to act.

spazzola.text:
Spazzolino was a happy toothbrush. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. It was a magical garden, but after the rain, it also became a little sticky. Spazzolino felt very bad. “Oh no!” he exclaimed. “I’m all sticky and dirty! I don’t like it at all!”

A little beetle, Leo, was watching him closely. “What’s wrong, Spazzolino?” Leo asked. “It seems like you have a bad cold!”
Spazzolino wriggled. He tried to brush away the mud on the green leaves and the yellow flowers. But every time he touched the mud, it became even stickier! It was a difficult situation. Spazzolino tried to brush with all his bristles, but it didn’t help at all.

He thought for a while. Then he understood something important. “Wait!” said Spazzolino. “The mud is too sticky to brush away now. It must be dry!” He sat down on a smooth stone and waited. The sun began to shine, warming the secret garden. The mud began to dry slowly.

After a while, Spazzolino tried to brush again. This time, his bristles moved easily. He removed all the mud and dirt! The secret garden was immediately beautiful and clean again. “I did it!” said Spazzolino happily. 

Spazzolino realized that sometimes you just have to wait for things to sort themselves out. It was better to be patient a little to do his job at his best.

plan.problema: He felt everything was sticky and dirty after the rain!
plan.svolta: He tried to brush away the mud, but only made it stickier.
plan.finale: He realized he needed to wait for the sun to dry the garden and the mud so he could clean it properly.

spazzola.text:
Spazzolino was a very special toy. He was a red rubber brush and had a happy smile. He lived in the flower garden, a place full of colors and smells. The other toys loved him, but Spazzolino had an important job: to clean the grass blades!

---

One day, while he was moving among the colorful petals of the sunflower, Spazzolino got lost. He had ended up in the middle of many pink, purple, and yellow petals. He couldn’t reach the grass blades he loved to clean anymore. “Oh no!” said Spazzolino, “I can’t do my job!”

---

Spazzolino tried to go forward, but he was too far away. He tried to jump, but the petals were too soft. Then, he made a decision: to climb the biggest yellow flower! With all his little brushes, he stuck to the sunflower stem. But he slid down with a thump! Spazzolino landed gently on the grass.

---

A butterfly, named Lila, saw Spazzolino and wanted to help him. “Maybe the wind can help you!” exclaimed Lila. The gentle wind began to blow. Spazzolino let himself be carried by the wind towards the grass blades. He happily began to clean them of dust and dry leaves.

---

Spazzolino had finally reached his goal! He cleaned and cleaned, making the grass blades shiny and new. He was happy to have finished his job. The wind disappeared, leaving Spazzolino satisfied. 

---

Spazzolino realized that with effort and determination, you can always achieve what you set your mind to.

plan.problema: Spazzolino got lost among the colorful petals and can’t reach the blades of grass anymore!
plan.svolta: He decided to climb the biggest yellow flower, but he tumbled down with a thump!
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of the gentle wind, Spazzolino flew to the blades of grass and cleaned them with joy.

spazzola.text:
Spazzolino was a wonderful toothbrush. He was a bright red color and had a little smile painted on his handle. He lived in the toy laboratory, a place full of colors and sounds. There, many other toys lived: teddy bears, toy cars, and rag dolls.

One day, Spazzolino noticed a big problem. He was completely full of bristles! Many bristles had come out during playtime and now he couldn’t clean the dolls properly anymore. His bristles were all tangled and dirty. “Oh no!” said Spazzolino, “I can’t help anymore!”

Mrs. Robotic, a little robot who supervised the laboratory, came to him. “What’s wrong, Spazzolino?” she asked. “I’ve gotten full of bristles!” replied Spazzolino sadly. Mrs. Robotic suggested he take a trip around the laboratory. "Maybe you’ll find some string you can use to clean the bristles!"

Spazzolino started to move, rolling between the toy cars and sliding under the plush toys. He patiently looked for something useful. Then, he saw a beautiful blue wool thread! It was long and soft. Spazzolino took the thread and began to work. Carefully, he sorted each and every bristle, one at a time. He worked tirelessly, day after day.

Finally, after so much effort, all his bristles were clean and perfect! He was ready to help the dolls again. Spazzolino was happy and satisfied with his work. And he knew that with patience and perseverance, even the biggest problems can be solved.

plan.problema: Spazzolino had filled with loose bristles and couldn’t clean the other dolls anymore!
plan.svolta: He decided to take a tour around the workshop to find some thread to use as a new brush.
plan.finale: He found a blue wool thread and, with patience, cleaned every wig, returning it to perfection.

spazzola.text:
Spazzolino was a happy toy. He lived in the Flower Garden, among fragrant roses and tall sunflowers. Every day he loved to clean the green leaves and colorful petals. It was his favorite job! But one day, something bad happened.

Spazzolino had found himself completely full of dry leaves and dirt. He couldn't clean the dirt away anymore. His bristles were so full that they couldn't clean properly. He was sad and frustrated. He couldn't do his job!

“Oh no!” said Spazzolino, trying to move but without success. He decided then to use his teeth to brush away the leaves. He tried to push with force, but it was too slow. He got tired right away and the leaves remained there, stuck to his bristles.

A little beetle, Leo, came close to Spazzolino. “Maybe if you wait,” said Leo, “the sun will help you.” Spazzolino waited. The sun began to warm in the sky.

Then, a ray of sunshine hit the leaves! The leaves began to tremble and move. They flew away, one by one, carried by the wind. Spazzolino immediately felt lighter and cleaner. His bristles were perfect again. He shone like new!

Spazzolino was happy again. He had waited patiently and in the end he had achieved what he wanted. Perseverance can make a difference, even when things seem difficult.

plan.problema: Spazzolino found himself full of leaves and dirt, he couldn't do his job anymore!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his teeth to brush away the leaves, but he was too slow and got tired very quickly.
plan.finale: A ray of sunshine hit the leaves, making them fly away and Spazzolino shone clean again.

spazzola.text:
Spazzolino was a wonderful toothbrush. He loved the flower garden. 
It was full of red roses, yellow tulips, and blue violets. 
But Spazzolino felt very sad. 
All the flower petals were sticky and dirty. 
They couldn’t shine!

“Oh no,” thought Spazzolino. “It’s a disaster here! 
I wish I could clean them.” He moved slowly, 
but he couldn’t do much. The petals were too many 
and too sticky. A little green crocodile, Coco, 
watched him curiously.

Spazzolino made a decision. “I must find a way 
to clean these flowers!” He decided to take a quick 
walk among the green leaves. He desperately 
looked for a drop of fresh water. 
He wanted to wash away the dirt and make the 
petals shine again.

He turned and turned, he squeezed between the bushes, 
but he couldn’t find the water. Then, suddenly, 
he saw a small, sparkling drop on a leaf. 
Spazzolino ran towards it and with one final, 
energetic swipe, he removed the last bit of dust.

The flowers smiled again! Their petals shone like 
colorful gems. Coco the green crocodile jumped for 
joy. Spazzolino felt very happy. He had done a 
good job. He was very pleased with his effort. 
Spazzolino continued to clean, and every flower 
became more beautiful than before.

plan.problema: Spazzolino felt sad because all the flower petals were sticky and dirty.
plan.svolta: He decided to take a quick spin among the leaves, hoping to find a drop of water to clean the petals.
plan.finale: With one final energetic swipe, Spazzolino removed the last bit of dust and the flowers smiled again!

spazzola.text:
Spazzolino was a blue toothbrush. He lived in Leo’s bedroom. He was a little bit sad. No one used him anymore. Mom and Leo had bought a new toothbrush shaped like a dinosaur. Spazzolino felt invisible under the bedside table. He didn’t have any teeth to clean.

“How boring,” thought Spazzolino. “No one pays attention to me.” He curled up on the rug, trying not to be noticed. His handle was a little red from sadness.

One day, while wandering near the bedside table, Spazzolino found something strange: a small box full of star dust! It was sparkly and shiny. “Maybe I can do something,” said Spazzolino. With a little effort, he covered himself with all the star dust. He became as bright as a shooting star!

Mom came into the bedroom to check on Leo. She saw Spazzolino sparkling and smiled. “Oh, look what a wonder!” she exclaimed. She took Spazzolino and began to clean his teeth. Spazzolino felt happy. He was important again! Mom used Spazzolino every day after that.

Leo started to use him too, when Mom wasn’t using him. Spazzolino was really happy. The bedroom was always cleaner and smelled of cocoa butter. Every morning, Spazzolino felt important and useful. 

It was nice to know that even a small gesture can make the world big.

plan.problema: He felt invisible and no one used him anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to make a sparkling costume with the star dust he found on the bedside table.
plan.finale: Mom, seeing him so bright, started using him every day to clean his teeth and Toothbrush felt happy and important.
plan.morale: Even small gestures can make a difference.

spazzola.text:
Spazzolino lived in the attic. It was a dusty attic, full of old chests and forgotten furniture. Spazzolino loved the attic, even though sometimes he felt a little lonely. But one day, something went wrong. A huge tangle of dust and cobwebs piled up around him. It was so thick that he couldn't move!

Spazzolino tried to wiggle his legs, but nothing. He tried to turn around himself, but that didn't work either. The dust covered his whole body and the cobwebs kept him stuck. He felt frustrated and a little scared.

Then, Spazzolino had an idea. “Maybe I can use myself to solve the problem!” he thought. He took a deep breath and started moving his handle with small circular movements. He brushed away the most stubborn strands of dust, one at a time. It was tiring, but Spazzolino didn't give up.

A little mouse, Pipistrello, was watching him curiously from a corner. “You’re doing a great job, Spazzolino!” said the mouse. 

With patience and courage, Spazzolino kept moving. Finally, after a lot of effort, the attic was bright again. He could turn around freely, happy to have brought order back. He felt proud of his determination. Spazzolino realized that even when things seem difficult, with a little courage you can overcome any obstacle.

plan.problema: It had piled up a tangle of dust and cobwebs, and he couldn't move anymore!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his own handle to pull out the most stubborn strands, making small circular movements.
plan.finale: Finally, the attic was bright again, and Spazzolino could turn around freely, happy to have restored order.

spazzola.text:
Spazzolino was a very special brush. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and tall grass. Spazzolino loved his job: brushing away the grass that grew too fast. But one day, something went wrong.

---

After spending hours cleaning the garden, Spazzolino found himself completely full of leaves! The leaves were stopping him from moving well. He couldn’t brush away the tall grass anymore and he felt very frustrated. “Oh no!” thought Spazzolino. “I can’t do my job anymore!”

---

At that moment, he saw a friend: Rubber Crocodile, sitting on a stone. “Rubber Crocodile, I need your help!” said Spazzolino. The crocodile listened carefully and then suggested: “Try to make little rotations, Spazzolino. Maybe that will loosen the leaves!”

---

Spazzolino followed the crocodile’s advice. He started to turn around himself, slowly at first, then faster and faster. His bristles moved in a circle, loosening the leaves one by one. Finally, all the leaves were free!

---

Spazzolino felt a great relief and shone like new. He was ready to clean the Secret Garden again. Spazzolino understood that even when things seem difficult, with a little effort, you can overcome obstacles.

plan.problema: Toothbrush had found himself full of leaves and couldn't brush the tall grass anymore!
plan.svolta: He then decided to ask for help from the rubber crocodile, who suggested making small rotations to loosen the leaves.
plan.finale: Toothbrush, with circular movements, finally freed all the leaves and shone again!

tamburo.text:
Tambour was a happy drum. He lived in the Flowery Garden, among fragrant roses and tall sunflowers. Every day he played his lively rhythms, to make all the flowers smile. But there was one very sad flower: a little white daisy. It was always flat, as if it had lost its joy.

Tambour wanted to help her. He tried to make fast and full rhythms, hoping that the daisy would straighten up. But the daisy continued to flatten, as if it were even sadder. Tambour was a little frustrated. “Maybe I should beat harder!” he thought.

Tambour began to play with all his strength. He tapped on the hard wood, making his body vibrate. But the daisy didn't stand up. It remained flat and silent. Tambour stopped, a little disappointed.

Then, he tried something different. He began to play a slow and sweet rhythm. A delicate sound, almost a whisper. The wood vibrated slowly, creating calm sound waves. The daisy listened.

Then, a magical thing happened! The daisy stood up on its little toes, stretching its white petals towards the sky. A little smile lit up its face. Tambour continued to play that slow and sweet rhythm, and the daisy danced with him in the Flowery Garden.

The sun shone brightly, and the air smelled of flowers. That day, Tambour realized that even the most difficult things need time to become beautiful again.

plan.problema: He couldn't make a beat that made even the saddest flower in the garden smile.
plan.svolta: He decided to try to beat harder, but the flower kept drooping.
plan.finale: When he played a slow and sweet rhythm, the flower smiled and stood up on its tiptoes.

tamburo.text:
Tambour lives in a secret garden. He is a bright red drum, with soft leather skin and a strong body. He loves his place among the fragrant flowers and tall trees. Every day he wished to make music, but something wasn't right.

The butterflies of the garden often visited him. They liked to watch Tambour, but they didn’t seem to appreciate his music. The butterflies flew away, with confused wings. Tambour felt sad. He wanted the butterflies to smile!

One day, Tambour decided to beat the drum louder. He tapped quickly, repeatedly. The sound was clumsy and noisy. The butterflies flew away even further, frightened by the sudden noise.

Tambour stopped. He thought about how the butterflies loved sweet sounds. Then, he tried to beat slowly, calmly. He tapped a simple, repeating rhythm. The sound was gentle and melodious.

The butterflies returned. They landed on Tambour, dancing around his red body. He created a sweet melody that made them happy. The butterflies’ wings moved in harmony with the rhythm.

Tambour realized that patience was important. A slow, regular sound could create something beautiful. The butterflies danced around him, happy and content with his new rhythm. The secret garden was full of music and joy. Tambour felt satisfied and peaceful.

plan.problema: He couldn't make the right music to make the butterflies smile.
plan.svolta: He decided to beat louder, but the sound was too clumsy and the butterflies flew away confused.
plan.finale: He learned to rhythm slowly, creating a sweet melody that made the butterflies dance around him happily.

tamburo.text:
Tambour lives in Aunt Rosa’s garden. He is a colorful drum, with soft skins and a wooden body. Every day, Tambour loved to beat on his drums, but lately he couldn’t make happy rhythms. His skins seemed too weak.

One day, Tambour noticed that the little birds in the garden had also become silent. They weren’t chirping anymore, they weren’t singing. He was sad. No one seemed to want to listen to him or dance with him.

“I have to do something!” thought Tambour. He sat in the center of the lawn and tried to beat softly, softly. But the sound was too faint to attract the birds’ attention.

Then, Tambour had an idea! “Maybe I should try to beat louder!” he shouted, and he began to bang with all his strength on the skins. He felt the wood vibrating and the skins resonating with a powerful sound. 

The sound spread through the garden. A vibrant and energetic rhythm! The birds listened to this new sound and began to approach Tambour. First one, then others, all the birds in the garden began to sing and dance around the happy drum.

Tambour beat even louder, full of joy. He was happy to have found a way to bring the music back to Aunt Rosa’s garden. And he knew that with a little effort, he could also realize his dreams.

plan.problema: He couldn’t make cheerful rhythms, and all the little birds had gone silent.
plan.svolta: He decided to try to beat harder, using his skins to create a louder sound!
plan.finale: Finally, the vibrant rhythm attracted the birds who began to sing and dance around the happy drum.

tamburo.text:
Tambour lived in the Flowery Garden. He was a bright red drum, with soft leather skin and a sturdy body. Every day, Tambour listened to the wind. The wind whispered secrets among the fragrant flowers.

But Tambour had a problem. He couldn't beat the right rhythm for the wind's melody. The wind sang a sweet and slow song, but Tambour only made confused sounds. It seemed his rhythm was wrong!

Tambour tried to use more strength. He tapped with all his jaws, trying to imitate the sounds of the wind. But instead of a melodious sound, only a dull, irregular thump came out. It was frustrating for Tambour.

A little blue bird perched on his body. He had bright black eyes and soft feathers. The bird began to sing a sweet and gentle song, just like the melody of the wind.

Suddenly, Tambour understood! He began to vibrate stronger, following the rhythm of the bird’s voice. The sound that came out was clear, harmonious, and perfect. The melody of the wind and the bird’s song joined in a musical dance.

Tambour continued to play, together with the bird, and the Flowery Garden became even more magical. The air vibrated with so much joy.

plan.problema: He couldn't make the right rhythm for the melody of the wind.
plan.svolta: He decided to try to vibrate louder, but the sound was just a dull, irregular thump.
plan.finale: When a little bird perched on him, starting to sing a sweet song, Drum found the perfect rhythm.

tamburo.text:
Tambour lives in Sofia’s bedroom. He is a red and fun tambourine, full of energy. He loves making rhythms – happy rhythms that make everyone smile. But one morning, something wasn’t right. Tambour couldn’t beat like he usually did. The sound was strange, slow, and without joy.

“Oh no,” said Tambour, “I can’t make happy rhythms anymore!” Sofia was drawing on her rug, but Tambour felt sad. He wanted to make noise, he wanted to dance with his sounds.

He decided to try something different. He started beating very, very hard! But the sound that came out was too loud and out of tune. “Ugh!” exclaimed Tambour, “This doesn’t work.” Sofia came closer to him, curious. “What’s happening, Tambour?” she asked.

“I was trying to make a louder rhythm,” explained Tambour, “but the sound is terrible!” Sofia thought for a moment and then had an idea. She took Tambour in her hands and started beating with him. Slowly, slowly, the two of them sounded better and better. The rhythm became cheerful and playful.

Sofia started to dance around Tambour, laughing and moving with enthusiasm. Tambour felt Sofia’s joy and finally could make the perfect rhythm. It was a beautiful sound, full of happiness. 

Sofia smiled while dancing with Tambour, and together they created a special music for the bedroom.

plan.problema: The drum couldn’t make the cheerful rhythms it loved.
plan.svolta: It decided to try to beat harder, but the sound was too dull and out of tune!
plan.finale: Sofia listened to it smiling and began to dance with Drum, creating a perfect rhythm together.

tamburo.text:
Tambour was a special drum. He lived in a secret garden, full of fragrant roses and tall trees. He was a red drum, with white skin and a golden bell. But Tambour was sad. He never made a sound. He tapped softly, softly, softly, and no one wanted to dance with him.

The butterflies watched him. The squirrels watched him. Even little frog Gertrude watched him, but she didn’t hop. “It’s too quiet,” she said. “There’s no rhythm.”

Tambour felt very lonely. He thought, “If no one listens to me, how can I be heard?” Then he had an idea! He started to tap louder. First he made a slow rhythm, then a fast rhythm, then a strange rhythm. He tapped up and down, back and forth, creating new sounds that no one had ever heard before.

Tambour tapped with all his strength, creating a joyful sound full of energy. Suddenly, the flowers in the garden began to move. The roses bent, the daisies turned, the hydrangeas swayed. Everyone danced to the rhythm of the drum!

Tambour smiled. He was happy. He had found a way to bring joy to the secret garden. And as the flowers danced, Tambour realized that creativity can do miracles.

plan.problema: It was too quiet and nobody wanted to dance with him.
plan.svolta: He decided to beat louder, creating always new and unexpected rhythms.
plan.finale: The flowers of the garden began to dance to the rhythm of his drum, happy and content.

tamburo.text:
Tamburo was a very happy drum. He lived in the Flowered Garden, among fragrant roses and tall sunflowers. Every morning, Tamburo prepared to play. He loved to create lively and joyful rhythms. But something wasn't right. No one wanted to listen! The little birds sang, the bees buzzed, but no one stopped to appreciate his sound.

Tamburo was sad. He tried to beat him louder, hoping someone would hear him. The sound became increasingly clumsy and confused. The butterflies, frightened by the noise, flew away. Tamburo felt terrible.

One day, Tamburo had an idea. He tried to slow down, to beat softly, softly. The sound was sweet, almost a whisper. A little snail came out of its shell and began to listen. Then the bunny arrived, curious to understand what was happening.

Tamburo realized he had to learn to control the volume. He began to play slowly, modulating the sound, making it more delicate. The Flowered Garden was filled with rhythm and harmony. The birds sang together with him, the bees buzzed rhythmically, and even the butterflies returned to rest and listen to him.

Tamburo played happily, creating rhythms that made all the inhabitants of the Flowered Garden smile. Every sound was a little gift of peace. And Tamburo understood that with calmness and patience, even the simplest sounds can become beautiful and harmonious.

plan.problema: He couldn't make a cheerful rhythm, and no one wanted to listen.
plan.svolta: He decided to try to beat faster, but the sound was too loud and scared the butterflies.
plan.finale: He learned to modulate the volume and create delicate rhythms, making all the garden inhabitants happy.

tamburo.text:
Tambour lives in the creative workshop. He is a wooden drum, with brown skin and a small red handle. The other instruments – brushes, paints, pencils – say hello to him every morning. But Tambour felt a little sad.

That day, Tambour wanted to make cheerful rhythms, full of joy. He tried to beat his walls with the stick, but he couldn’t do it well. The sound was dull and confused, without any melody. “Oh no!” thought Tambour. “I can’t play the way I wanted!”.

Tambour tried to beat harder, hoping that the rhythm would become clearer. But the result was even worse! The sound was too dull and confused, a big mess of noises. Tambour felt frustrated.

Suddenly, a small wrench fell from the table nearby. An old mechanical woman picked it up. “Here,” she said, “maybe this will help you”. The woman gently placed the wrench in Tambour’s hands. 

Immediately, Tambour began to vibrate! The sound was perfect, clear and full of rhythm. Tambour was playing cheerfully and happily, just as he had always dreamed. It was wonderful! The wrench, with its precise weight, gave him the right strength to create the rhythms he wanted. 

Tambour continued to play all afternoon, creating beautiful melodies. The creative workshop was full of music and joy. 

The perfect rhythm arrived only after a little bit of trying.

plan.problema: He couldn't make the cheerful rhythms he had in mind.
plan.svolta: He decided to try to beat harder, but the sound was too dull and confused.
plan.finale: When a small wrench fell into his hands, the Drum began to vibrate with perfect rhythm!

tamburo.text:
Tambour lived in the Flowery Garden. He was a colorful drum, with blue leather skin and golden handles. Every day he enjoyed beating on his drums, but today something wasn't right. The little birds in the garden were singing a happy song, a special song for summer. But Tambour couldn't make the right rhythm! His rhythm was too heavy, too slow.

"Oh no!" said Tambour, frustrated. "I must find the perfect rhythm for their song." He tried to beat harder, he tried to beat softer, but nothing worked. The little birds stopped singing, a little disappointed.

Then Tambour had an idea. He saw a bright green leaf falling from the tree. He took the leaf between his handles and began to sway it gently. *Tick-tac, tick-tac*. The sound was light, like the beating of the birds' wings.

Tambour continued to make this little rhythm with the leaf. *Tick-tac, tick-tac*. He imagined that the leaf was a bird flying. And slowly, very slowly, Tambour's drum rhythm changed. It became lighter, faster, more like the song of the little birds.

And suddenly, the perfect rhythm reappeared! Tambour was beating the right rhythm and the little birds responded with an even louder song, full of joy. The Flowery Garden filled with music and color. Tambour was happy. He had learned that even when things seem difficult, you must continue to try, to find new solutions. And in the end, success always arrives.

plan.problema: He couldn't make the right rhythm for the birds' song.
plan.svolta: He decided to try to make small taps with a leaf, imitating the sound of wings flying.
plan.finale: The perfect rhythm reappeared and the birds sang even louder in joy.

tamburo.text:
Tambour was a special drum. He lived in a music workshop full of violins, pianos, and flutes. Tambour loved his place, but he had a little problem. When he played, he never made happy and fun rhythms. Just flat sounds, like a tired sigh.

“I wish I could make music that makes people smile,” sighed Tambour. The old Music Master, sitting at his harmonium, listened to him carefully. “Maybe you need to beat harder, Tambour,” suggested the Master. “Try to think of something exciting!”

Tambour thought about it. Closing his eyes, he imagined he was a lion! A big lion roaring in the savanna. He started beating on his drum with all his strength. One strong hit, then another even stronger. The sound was powerful and full of energy.

Suddenly, the workshop filled with music. The other instruments began to vibrate to Tambour’s rhythm. The violin played a cheerful melody, the piano followed the rhythm with bright chords, and even the flute joined the party. All the instruments danced around Tambour, happy and content. 

Tambour continued to beat hard, feeling proud of his new sound. He realized that when you put passion into it, even the most difficult things become easy and fun. The music filled the whole workshop with joy. And Tambour knew that sometimes, it just takes a little enthusiasm to make your melody shine.

plan.problema: He couldn't make cheerful and fun rhythms, only flat sounds.
plan.svolta: He decided to beat louder and with more rhythm, imagining he was a lion roaring!
plan.finale: The music filled the lab and all the instruments danced happily around him.

trapano.text:
Trapano Leo lived in Grandpa’s workshop. He was a shiny red drill, always ready for an adventure. Grandpa had lots of things to fix and build. Trapano Leo loved to help Grandpa, making holes in wood for every project.

One day, Grandpa was building a small box for Elia’s colorful buttons, Grandpa’s grandson. Trapano Leo got to work right away, drilling into a piece of hard wood. He spun and spun, with lots of energy! But suddenly, something changed. His movement became harder, almost impossible. Trapano Leo was stuck inside the wood!

He couldn't turn anymore. He felt tight and frustrated. He tried to push with his blades, hoping to free himself. But the more he pushed, the tighter he got. It was a mess! Grandpa came over to Trapano Leo worried.

“Don’t worry,” said Grandpa. “I have a solution.” Grandpa took a small bottle and poured a few drops of special oil on the drill’s teeth. Then, with great care, he turned the handle.

Suddenly, Trapano Leo started to turn freely! He could go back to making his holes with energy. Grandpa smiled. “See, Leo?” he said. “Sometimes all it takes is a little help to solve problems.” 

Trapano Leo continued to work very happily, thinking that patience was a great resource.

plan.problema: Leo got stuck in the wood and can’t turn anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to push with his blades, but it only made him even tighter.
plan.finale: Grandpa used a little oil to lubricate it and Leo could turn freely!

trapano.text:
Trapano Leo lived in a wooden workshop. He was a very active drill and loved to work. Every day he tried to do something new, to build small objects with wood. Today he wanted to make a box for his favorite toys.

He had chosen a large piece of wood, the biggest he had found. He started to drill, with lots of energy. The drill bit entered the wood and Leo turned the handle quickly. But then... it got stuck! The bit was stuck in the hard wood. He couldn’t move anymore.

Trapano Leo was desperate. He tried to push with force, but nothing worked. He tried to turn the handle faster, but it only made a loud and unpleasant noise. It was frustrating! A little hammer, called Marco, watched him. “Maybe you need to be more gentle,” said Marco.

Trapano Leo thought for a moment. Then, with great care, he took the hammer and made a small tap on the drill bit. With a click, the bit came out of the wood! Trapano Leo could finally continue to work. He turned the handle slowly and carefully, finishing of drilling the whole box.

The box was beautiful, perfect for his toys. He was happy with his work. Now he knew that even when things get difficult, it’s important not to lose patience and to find the right solution.

plan.problema: Leo got stuck in the biggest piece and couldn't continue his work!
plan.svolta: He tried to turn the handle faster, but it only made noise!
plan.finale: Then, with a little hammer blow, he unlocked the drill and could finish his project.

trapano.text:
Trap was a special drill. He lived in a wooden workshop full of tools and the smell of fresh wood. He spent his days spinning and making “tick-tac-tick-tac,” loving his job. One day, a boy opened an old box full of nails. Trap, curious, came closer and with his tip entered the box to give a few taps.

Immediately, something went wrong! Trap’s tip got stuck. He couldn’t move anymore. He was trapped! He tried to turn around, but nothing. His strength wasn’t enough. He felt small and frustrated.

Suddenly, Trap started spinning very fast. His blades moved frantically, trying to break the wood of the box. But he was only making dust! Dust everywhere. It was a mess! The dust hid his sight and made everything more difficult.

An old hammer, who was repairing a saw, watched Trap carefully. “Don’t give up!” said the hammer. “Keep trying!”

Trap listened to the hammer and focused. He used all his strength, spinning and spinning with determination. With a final, determined movement, he managed to loosen his grip. Finally, Trap came out of the box! He was free! 

He stopped for a moment, then started spinning again, happy to be back in his workshop. Perseverance, even when it seems difficult, can lead to surprising results.

plan.problema: The drill got stuck inside an old box full of nails!
plan.svolta: It started spinning very fast, trying to break the wood with its blades, but it only made more dust.
plan.finale: Thanks to its strength and determination, it managed to loosen its grip and come out of the box with a final, decisive movement.

trapano.text:
Trap was a very curious drill. He lived in a big wooden workshop, full of tools and planks. He loved making holes, one after another, with precision and speed. But today, something wasn't going right. He felt stuck!

It happened when he wanted to make a big hole in a piece of solid wood. He gave a strong blow, perhaps too strong, and he got stuck inside! He couldn't turn anymore. His wheels were still and his motor didn't make any noise. He was frustrated.

“Oh no!” thought Trap. “I have to get out of here!” He tried to turn around, but nothing. He tried to make more gentle movements, but it was useless. The wood was too hard. So he decided to use his smallest bit, the one he used for smaller holes. He started to force the wood with strength, but it only made more dust! The dust filled his crevices and made it even harder to move.

The old carpenter, Mario, came to Trap. “Don’t give up!” he said. “Try to apply all your energy in one decisive blow.”

Trap listened to Mario’s advice. He took a deep breath and gave one last strong blow, concentrating all his strength. He felt a dull sound and suddenly he was free! He turned and turned, making perfectly uniform holes. He was happy to be back to work. From that day on, Trap always remembered the importance of never giving up, even when things seem difficult. And so, with determination, he continued to make holes all day long.

plan.problema: The drill got stuck inside a big piece of wood and couldn’t spin anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his smallest bit to try to force the wood, but it only made more dust!
plan.finale: With a final, strong hit, the drill finally freed itself and was able to make perfect holes again.

trapano.text:
Trapano Leo lived in a woodworking shop. He was a special drill, he could talk and move on his own! He spent his days doing small jobs, drilling pieces of wood to create funny shapes. But today he had a big challenge ahead.

An old carpenter had given him a huge piece of wood, really, really big. Trapano Leo wanted to drill it to create a perfect hole for a little wooden gnome. But when he tried to use his bit, it got stuck! It was as if it had gripped the wood with a strong clamp. He couldn't turn the handle anymore.

Trapano Leo started turning the handle faster and faster. He turned and turned, but nothing happened. Only a lot of dust rose and filled the workshop. It was frustrating! The carpenter, an old gentleman with glasses, watched him quietly.

“Maybe,” said the carpenter, “you need to be more gentle.”

Trapano Leo thought about it. He took a deep breath and, with great care, tapped the bit of his clamp with a small hammer. Just one light tap, that’s all it needed! Immediately, the clamp loosened. Trapano Leo could finally drill the wood. The hole was perfect for the wooden gnome.

The carpenter smiled. “Good job, Leo,” he said. “You learned an important lesson.”

Trapano Leo stopped turning the handle, satisfied with his work. He realized that sometimes, even when you’re impatient, you have to do things calmly and patiently. After all, a good job takes time and attention.

plan.problema: Leo got stuck in the biggest piece and couldn't drill!
plan.svolta: He tried to turn the handle faster, but all it made was a lot of dust.
plan.finale: With a gentle tap on the tip, Leo freed his bite and finally finished the job.

trapano.text:
Trap was a very busy drill. He lived in a wooden workshop full of tools. He had his little house next to a pile of screws and nails. Every day he enjoyed making holes in pieces of wood.

One day, Trap was working on a big brown wooden cube. It was a perfect cube, big and strong. Suddenly, while he was making a nice hole, the tip got stuck! Trap was trapped inside the cube. He couldn't move, he couldn't get free. He was very frustrated.

“Oh no!” said Trap. “I can’t make holes anymore! I’m stuck in here!” He tried to turn the handle with all his might, but the cube was too hard and the drill didn't move. It was a difficult situation. He didn't know what to do.

Just at that moment, a little helper arrived: a shiny, new wrench. The wrench saw Trap in trouble and said, “Don’t worry, I’ll help you!” With patience and with strength, the wrench began to take apart the wooden cube, piece by piece.

Finally, after a while, the cube crumbled and Trap was free! He felt happy and light. He immediately started making holes in the pieces of wood, but this time he knew that even a little helper can make a difference. Trap realized that together they always do better.

plan.problema: The little drill got stuck inside a big wooden cube, unable to free itself.
plan.svolta: He then decided to turn the handle with all his strength, but the cube was too hard and the drill didn't move.
plan.finale: A small helper, a wrench, disassembled the cube and freed the drill, which returned to making holes happily.

trapano.text:
Trap was a very busy drill. He lived in a wooden workshop full of colorful blocks and tools. He loved making holes in the blocks, one after the other. It was his favorite job!

One day, Trap was working as usual. He was trying to make a hole in a bright red block. But suddenly, something went wrong. His motor stopped turning and he couldn't make any more holes. He was stuck!

Trap was very frustrated. He tried to push the handle with force, but nothing. The drill remained still like a statue. “Oh no!” Trap thought. “I can’t make my holes!”

Then, a little hammer, who lived in the workshop, came up to Trap. “Try turning the handle faster,” said the hammer. “Maybe that will solve the problem!”

Trap followed the hammer’s advice. He turned the handle quickly, but still nothing. The drill remained still.

Then, Trap calmed down. He took a deep breath and began to turn the handle slowly, with great care. Tooth by tooth, he made a small hole in the red block. Then another, and another still.

After a while, Trap had made lots of perfect holes! He was happy to have solved the problem. He had learned that sometimes, to do things well, you have to be patient and use his teeth carefully. 

Trap continued to work, happy with his good work done. Every hole was perfect because it had been made with patience.

plan.problema: The drill got stuck and can’t make holes in the building blocks anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to turn the handle quickly, but the drill remained still.
plan.finale: Then he learned to use his teeth carefully and patiently, and finally he made lots of perfect holes.
plan.morale: Patience is important for solving problems.

trapano.text:
Trapano Leo loved the wood workshop. It was full of boards, nails, and glue. Trapano Leo was a special drill – a drill that could talk! “How lovely!” he always said. That day, Trapano Leo wanted to make a perfect hole in a red board.

He had tied the string to the board and started turning the handle. His motor made “ding-dong, ding-dong!” and the drill bit hit the wood. But suddenly, with a little click, Trapano Leo found himself stuck! His bit was inside the wood and he couldn't move anymore.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Trapano Leo. “I’m trapped! I need to get out!” He tried to turn the handle faster, hoping to force the wood. But his motor stopped immediately, without making a hole. He was frustrated. The string was pinching his legs.

A little hammer, a workshop helper, came to Trapano Leo. “Don’t give up!” said the hammer. “Try with small taps!”

Trapano Leo listened to the hammer and started turning the handle very slowly. With each small turn, he gently tapped the wood. After a while, he heard a slight “crack.” Then another. And another! Slowly, with patience, Trapano Leo created a tiny crack in the wood. The crack widened and finally Trapano Leo managed to free himself.

“I did it!” said Trapano Leo, happy to be out. He was a little dusty with wood shavings, but pleased to have overcome his difficulty. Trapano Leo understood that even when things seem difficult, with calmness and perseverance, you can always find solutions.

plan.problema: Leo got stuck inside a piece of wood and can’t get out!
plan.svolta: He tried to turn the handle faster, but the drill stopped before it made a hole!
plan.finale: With patience and small blows, Leo finally drilled the wood creating a tiny crack through which he managed to free himself.

trapano.text:
Drill was a very happy drill. He lived in a wooden workshop full of planks and tools. His favorite job was making holes in the planks. He loved to hear the sound of his motor when he spun quickly. One day, Drill set to work to create a little insect house.

But then, something went wrong. When he tried to drill a wooden plank, he got stuck! He couldn't move anymore. He was very frustrated. “Oh no!” thought Drill. “I can’t make holes if I’m stuck!”

Drill turned the handle with all his might, but the drill remained still. Nobody helped him. The old carpenter, Grandpa Elia, watched Drill from a distance. He noticed right away that something was wrong. He came closer and said, “It seems like you need a little help, little friend.”

Grandpa Elia took a small bottle of drill oil and dripped a few drops into Drill’s head. Then, he gently turned the handle. Drill started to move! Making perfect holes was possible again.

Drill made lots of holes in the plank, creating a beautiful insect house. He was happy and content. He had learned that sometimes, even if you are strong, a little help is needed to overcome problems. 

Finally, Drill stopped turning the handle, satisfied with his work.

plan.problema: The drill has jammed and can’t make holes anymore!
plan.svolta: He decided to turn the handle with all his might, but the drill remained still.
plan.finale: He discovered he needed a little oil to work properly and finally started making perfect holes!
plan.morale: Sometimes a little help is needed.

trapano.text:
Trapano Leo was a very lively drill. He lived in a wood workshop full of tools and pieces of wood of all shapes and sizes. Every day, Leo enjoyed making small holes in the wood, but he also loved to explore.

---

One day, Leo found a huge piece of wood, a massive plank meant to become a big table. It was so interesting! Leo decided to make a hole in the center of the table to see what was inside. But when he tried to pull himself out, he was stuck! His bit was stuck in the wood and he couldn't move anymore.

---

“Oh no!” exclaimed Drill Leo. “I’m trapped!” He tried to turn, to push, but nothing worked. It was all very tight. The old carpenter, Grandpa Bruno, came closer with a smile. “Don’t worry, Leo,” said Grandpa Bruno. “Find a solution.”

---

Drill Leo thought about what to do. He remembered his sharpest bit, the one he used to make the smallest and most precise holes. He decided to use it to dig. With many energetic blows, Drill Leo began to dig a passage in the plank. Wood dust flew everywhere.

---

After many efforts, with a final strong blow, Drill Leo opened a perfect passage! He came out of the wooden box, happy and ready for new adventures. He rested a little and then prepared to make more holes, always with lots of energy.

---

Persistence, even when things seem difficult, can lead to the best solution.

plan.problema: Leo got stuck inside a big piece of wood, he can’t escape!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his sharpest point to dig a new exit and free himself.
plan.finale: With a final energetic blow, Leo opened a perfect gap and came out of the wooden box, happy and ready for new adventures.

trofeo.text:
Trofeo Leo was a golden trophy. One day, it was found in the secret garden. It was a beautiful place, full of colorful flowers and tall trees. But Trofeo Leo felt sad. Nobody wanted him to win anymore. There wasn't anyone who looked at him with admiration. The garden had become too quiet.

Leo stroked his shiny surface, but nothing seemed to work. “I don’t care about anything anymore,” he thought. “Nobody appreciates the victory.” A little squirrel, Pipì, was watching him from a branch. Pipì was curious and wanted to understand why the trophy seemed so down.

Then Trofeo Leo had an idea. He took a deep breath (well, a metal breath!) and began to vibrate. His sound, usually used to celebrate victories, now used it happily. He began to play with the wind that was dropping leaves from the trees. The leaves fell like small musical notes.

Leo continued to vibrate, creating a special rhythm. Pipì began to scamper following the sound. Then, the birds in the garden began to chirp in harmony with Leo. Together, they created a magical music in the secret garden. 

Trofeo Leo was happy! Finally, someone appreciated his voice. The garden was full of laughter and movement. Everyone joined in the rhythm, making Trofeo Leo important and happy. The joy of shared sound filled the garden.

plan.problema: Leo felt sad because nobody wanted to win with him anymore, and the garden had become too quiet.
plan.svolta: He decided to create a small concert with falling leaves and the chirping of birds, playing his metallic sound cheerfully.
plan.finale: Everyone in the garden joined in the rhythm of Leo, making him happy and important.

trofeo.text:
Trofeo Leo was a special trophy. It wasn’t just made of shiny metal, but it could talk and move in the playground. It was sitting on the red bench, near the bouncy tower, when it felt sad. No one wanted to join its race. The children preferred to run after butterflies or climb the swing.

“What a shame,” said Trofeo Leo with its metal voice. “I wish someone would want to win with me.” It felt lonely, even though it was the prize for the fastest. A little boy, Tommaso, walked by and looked at Trofeo Leo. “Isn’t this trophy nice?” asked Tommaso.

Trofeo Leo decided to do something. With a big effort, it stood up from the bench and jumped very high. It was trying to get the children’s attention. It jumped up and down, trying to shine brighter than the sun. The children looked at it in amazement.

Then, some of them started to laugh. But it wasn’t a mean laugh. It was a happy laugh! A boy threw a candy towards Trofeo Leo. Then another and another one. Everyone gave it candies. They understood that Trofeo Leo was a prize for children who behaved well in the playground. 

Trofeo Leo smiled. It was happy to have the children around it. Sharing the candies with them made it very happy. The other children, seeing Trofeo Leo’s joy, decided to play together in a more friendly way. Happiness was contagious and everyone was having fun.

plan.problema: Leo felt sad because no one wanted to win his race.
plan.svolta: He decided to take a very big jump, hoping to attract the children’s attention.
plan.finale: The children laughed and threw him candies, recognizing his value as a prize for good behavior.

trofeo.text:
Leo’s trophy was a special trophy. It wasn’t just shiny metal, but it could move and talk! It was in the playground, near the bouncy tower. Leo loved to play hide-and-seek, even though he couldn’t run.

One day, a group of children had built a huge sand maze. Leo’s trophy, excited, had come to explore. But then, it got lost! The sand dunes all looked the same, and Leo couldn’t figure out where he was. It was all confusing and a little bit scary.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Leo’s trophy. “I don’t know how to get out of here!” He tried to follow his own body, but the sand was too soft and it moved with him.

Then, he had an idea! He leaned against a smooth stone surface. He saw his reflection and understood something. He decided to use his reflections to find the shortest path. He walked back and forth, leaning against all the smooth surfaces of the maze, following his mirror image.

After a while, he saw a light! He moved quickly in that direction and finally reached the exit of the maze. A final flash of light accompanied him as he moved away from the playground. Leo’s trophy was happy to be back in his original spot, near the bouncy tower. Perseverance had helped Leo’s trophy reach his goal.

plan.problema: Leo got lost in the sand maze and couldn't find his way out.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his reflection to find the shortest path, relying on the smooth surfaces of the maze.
plan.finale: Finally, Leo reached the exit with a final flash of light.

trofeo.text:
Trofeo Brillante was in the playground, right next to the sand tower. It was a very special trophy, made of shiny metal and with little gems inside. Now, however, Trofeo Brillante was worried. He was lost! He had rolled down from the sand tower and found himself trapped in the maze the children were building.

The sand dunes were high and confusing. Trofeo Brillante couldn’t understand where he was. He tried to take one step forward, then another, but every time he ended up in a dead end. “Oh no,” thought Trofeo Brillante, “I must find my place! My place is near the tower.”

He decided to go around the maze completely. He rolled forward and backward, faster and faster. The children playing around him watched him curiously. A boy, Leo, came up to Trofeo Brillante and said, “Maybe you should go around the other side!”

Trofeo Brillante listened to Leo and followed his advice. He kept turning, concentrating on the maze. Suddenly, a ray of sunshine hit his shiny metal. The sun shone on him perfectly! Trofeo Brillante realized that he was right there, near the base of the sand tower, exactly where he belonged.

Leo smiled and helped Trofeo Brillante back onto the tower. From that day on, Trofeo Brillante always stayed at the top of the sand tower, ready for new adventures. After so much searching, success arrived thanks to Trofeo Brillante’s determination.

plan.problema: The Bright Trophy was lost in the sand maze and cannot find its place.
plan.svolta: He decided to make a complete turn around the maze, hoping to recognize a familiar shape.
plan.finale: Suddenly, a ray of sunshine hit its shiny metal and illuminated it perfectly, revealing its correct position.

trofeo.text:
Trofeo Brillante was a special trophy. It was made of gold and had lots of stars inside. 
It lived in the playground, near the sand tower. 
One day, while the breeze made it wobble, it found itself trapped in a strange place: the sand maze!

“Oh no!” exclaimed Trofeo Brillante. “I don’t know where I am! I’m lost!” 
The maze was full of tall, narrow dunes. 
It couldn’t understand which way was right to get back to its place with the other trophies. 
All the trophies were lined up next to the tower, ready for the competitions.

Trofeo Brillante felt a little sad. 
It tried to move, but the sand was too soft. 
A little rabbit, Leo, was watching it curiously. 
“Maybe you can use your shine,” said Leo. 
Trofeo Brillante thought about it. 
Then, it leaned up to the sun. 
Its gold shone brightly and the sunlight rays reflected on the sand.

Trofeo Brillante followed its reflections. 
It tried to figure out where the ray ended. 
Finally, it saw a small empty space right next to the tower! 
It tried hard and moved slowly. 
It was exactly in its place!

“I did it!” shouted Trofeo Brillante happily. 
All the other trophies cheered for it. 
They celebrated it with a big applause. 
From that day on, Trofeo Brillante continued to shine, always ready for the competitions. 
Trofeo Brillante’s perseverance made all the difference.

plan.problema: The Bright Trophy has been lost in the sand maze and can’t find its place!
plan.svolta: He decided then to use his reflection to find the right spot, trying to orient himself with the rays of the sun.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to its brilliance, he found his place among the other trophies, celebrated by all the games.

trofeo.text:
Leo’s trophy was a special trophy. It wasn’t just shiny metal; it could talk and move in the Flower Garden. It was sitting on a stone bench, watching the children play. But today, something wasn’t right. No one wanted to join the rock-throwing race. Everyone was a little sad.

“What a shame,” said Leo’s trophy with his metallic voice, a little raspy. “There was so much excitement just this morning.” He felt sad himself. He didn’t understand why nobody wanted to win! It was a trophy for winning, after all.

Then, he had an idea. Leo’s trophy crouched in the sun. His shiny metal began to reflect the light in a thousand colors: gold, silver, and blue. The sunbeams danced around him, creating a magical show in the Flower Garden.

A little girl, Sofia, stopped to admire Leo’s trophy. “Wow!” she exclaimed. The other children came closer, enchanted by the light coming from the trophy. Smiling, they started to throw the rocks with even more energy.

Leo’s trophy felt a warmth spreading inside him. He was happy! The garden was full of laughter and races. His brightness lit everything up. Sofia threw the rock as far as she could, and she shouted with joy. 

Leo’s trophy shone even brighter, reflecting the sunlight and the children’s smiles. Beauty can inspire joy.

plan.problema: Leo felt sad because no one wanted to win the stone-throwing race.
plan.svolta: He decided to shine with his colors, reflecting the sun to give the children courage.
plan.finale: The children, enchanted by the light, began to throw stones with enthusiasm and Leo felt a smile light up the garden.

trofeo.text:
Trofeo Brillante was a special trophy. It was made of gold and had lots of little diamonds sparkling on it. It lived in the playground, near the slide tower. But for a little while, it hadn't played with anyone anymore. No one looked at it anymore. It felt very lonely.

“How sad,” thought Trofeo Brillante. “No one notices me.” The sun was shining and the children were running, but no one noticed the trophy sparkling on the sandbox. It was almost sad that it couldn’t shine.

One day, the wind was blowing very hard. The autumn leaves were falling from the trees in the park. Trofeo Brillante had an idea! He collected the most beautiful leaves: the red, yellow, and orange ones. He stuck them onto his gold with wet sand. It became even more sparkly, full of wonderful colors.

A boy, Leo, was playing alone near Trofeo Brillante. He saw the trophy shining so much. “Wow!” exclaimed Leo. “You are beautiful!” Together they started to look at Trofeo Brillante and to laugh. Then other children came closer. Everyone wanted to see the trophy full of colorful leaves.

Trofeo Brillante was happy! He didn't feel lonely anymore. He had discovered that beauty can be found even in small things and that friendship comes from what makes us unique. The other children were happy to have met him.

plan.problema: The Bright Trophy felt lonely and no one looked at him anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to change his fur with colorful leaves falling from the park trees, becoming even more sparkling!
plan.finale: All the other children saw the Bright Trophy and surrounded him to admire him and feel lucky to meet him.

trofeo.text:
Leo’s trophy was a special trophy. It wasn’t just shiny metal, but it could move and talk! 
It lived at the playground, near the tallest tower. 
Every day it saw children running, jumping, and playing. 
But Leo’s trophy felt sad. 
Nobody wanted to compete with him for the best prize, 
the one that was given to the winner of the swings.

“I always win,” thought Leo’s trophy, “and nobody asks me to do something new.” 
It would curl up under the red bench, watching the children laugh. 
A little Marco was sitting nearby, lost in his drawings.

An idea popped into Leo’s trophy’s head. 
It decided to organize a race! “It will be a quiz race!” it shouted with its metal voice. 
“You have to guess the hidden colors in the clouds.”

Marco looked up, curious. 
Leo’s trophy pointed to the white and gray clouds floating in the sky. 
“Guess if they are blue or gray!” he said. 
The children came closer, laughing and trying to guess the colors. 
Marco helped too, explaining what makes blue blue and gray gray.

Soon everyone was playing together with Leo’s trophy. 
It was a fun game, and everyone was happy and laughing. 
Leo’s trophy finally felt appreciated and happy. 
It realized that the real joy wasn’t winning a competition, 
but sharing a moment with others. 
Marco smiled at Leo’s trophy, and together they watched the children play.

plan.problema: Leo felt sad because nobody wanted to compete with him for the best prize.
plan.svolta: He decided to organize a quiz contest about colors, asking the children to guess the hidden colors in the clouds.
plan.finale: The children loved the game and Leo finally felt appreciated and happy.

trofeo.text:
Leo’s trophy was a special trophy. It was made of shiny brass and had a smiling lion on its tip. Leo could move, even if slowly. He was in the playground, right next to the kangaroo tower.

It was his birthday, but nobody was celebrating. Leo felt lonely. There weren't any children around him, nor were there laughter or shouts of joy. Just the sound of the swings and the singing of birds. He was very sad. He wanted someone to share his special day with.

Leo thought, “I must do something!” He decided to try to shine as brightly as possible. He tried, making his reflections sparkle in the afternoon sun. He was trying to attract someone’s attention. Nobody seemed to notice him. He was even more alone.

Suddenly, a little girl, Sofia, came to the playground. She had her eyes full of curiosity. She saw Leo’s trophy shimmering and ran to him. “What a beautiful trophy!” exclaimed Sofia. “Let’s play together?”

Leo felt happier than ever before. Finally, he had a friend to celebrate his birthday with. They had fun rolling Leo and making him shine in the sunlight. 

Sofia and Leo’s trophy understood that the most important thing is to have someone to share your moments with, and that even a small trophy can become a great friend.

plan.problema: Leo found himself alone in the playground, without anyone to celebrate his birthday.
plan.svolta: He decided to try to shine as brightly as possible, hoping someone would notice him and call him to play.
plan.finale: Finally, a girl ran towards him, happy to play with the glittering trophy.

trofeo.text:
Leo’s trophy lay in the playground, next to the fountain. It was a golden trophy, shiny and heavy. It had a little crown of stars set into its base. But Leo the trophy felt very lonely. No one wanted to compete with him for the victory. They always asked him: “No, thank you, Leo, we prefer to play hide-and-seek!”

Leo was sad. He didn’t like being left alone. He dreamed of seeing children smile while they lifted him high. He felt like a trophy with no one who really appreciated him.

One day, Leo the trophy had an idea! He decided to put on a show. He started to spin his golden body, making his stars shine. He imagined happy music and began to spin faster, then slower. It was like dancing!

A little girl, Sofia, came closer. She was curious about the sparkling movement of Leo the trophy. Then other children arrived. They sat around him, laughing and watching in amazement. 

Leo the trophy continued to spin, happier than ever. The children surrounded him, applauding his funny movements. He was finally surrounded by friendship. Leo the trophy realized that the real joy is found when you share a moment of carefree fun with others.

plan.problema: Leo felt sad because nobody wanted to compete with him for the victory.
plan.svolta: He decided to organize a small dance show, spinning his glittering body to the imaginary music.
plan.finale: The children surrounded him, laughing and applauding his funny movement, making him happy again.

utensili cucina.text:
Tools Cook was a very friendly knife. He lived in the Happy Kitchen, full of shiny pots and colorful plates. Tools Cook loved to help prepare the best recipes in the world. But one morning, there was a big problem! The ingredients for Grandma’s birthday cake had disappeared. “Oh no!” exclaimed Tools Cook. “Where did they go?”

Mrs. Pan, a large and gentle frying pan, came closer. “Don’t worry, Tools Cook,” she said. “Let’s look for them together.” Tools Cook began to move carefully between the pots and stoves. He found a small sugar crumb. “Here’s a clue!” he thought.

He followed the crumb, which led him towards the kitchen table. It got smaller and moved quickly. Tools Cook looked under the table and… there they were! The chocolate cookies, the cake ingredients, were hidden between the legs of the table.

Tools Cook picked up the cookies with his handle and returned them to their place in the pantry. Mrs. Pan smiled. “You did a great job, Tools Cook!” she said. “One small step for the cake, one giant step for happiness!”

Tools Cook settled back among the spices, thinking that sometimes, even the smallest things can help you solve the biggest mysteries.

plan.problema: The ingredients for the birthday cake had disappeared mysteriously!
plan.svolta: She decided to follow the tracks left by a small crumb, moving carefully between the pots.
plan.finale: She found the cookies hidden under the table and returned them to their place, solving the little riddle.
plan.morale: Patience is the key to finding solutions.

utensili cucina.text:
Utensili Cucina was a very special knife. He lived in a colorful toy kitchen. He had a spatula, a spoon, and a sieve who were his best friends. One day, Utensili Cucina noticed a problem. The ingredients for the most special cake in the world were gone! The recipe said: flour, eggs, sugar… and lots of butter!

“Oh no!” said Utensili Cucina. “Where did they go?” He started to look through the bowls and trays. None of his friends knew where the ingredients were. Suddenly, he saw a little sugar flake rolling towards the table.

“Wait!” shouted Utensili Cucina. He followed the sugar flake and discovered a secret tunnel under the table! It was narrow and dark, but Utensili Cucina was brave and he went through it. At the end, he arrived in a small room. There he found Utensili Cucina’s grandma, who was eating cookies. Grandma had hidden the cookies in a wooden box.

Utensili Cucina took the cookies and used them to create the most delicious cake he could imagine. It was so good that all of his friends wanted a piece! Utensili Cucina smiled happily. The toy kitchen was full of laughter and the smell of cake. Utensili Cucina understood that sometimes, exploring is the best thing to do.

plan.problema: The ingredients for the most special cake in the world had disappeared mysteriously!
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the tracks left by a small sugar flake, discovering a secret tunnel under the table.
plan.finale: He found the cookies hidden in a wooden box and used them to create the most delicious cake he could imagine.

utensili cucina.text:
Utensili Cucin was a very enthusiastic cook. He lived in a beautiful toy kitchen, full of colors and imaginary smells. He had a wooden spoon, a big ladle, a pointed knife, and a colorful spatula. He was always ready to make a delicious cake!

One day, Utensili Cucin noticed that something wasn't right. His pots and pans were gone! There was no more little pot for broth, nor the big pan for pasta. “Oh no!” exclaimed Utensili Cucin. “I can’t make the cake without my tools!”

He looked around frantically, searching among the baking sheets and rolling pins. He shouted: “Where did you go?” But no one answered. Then, Utensili Cucin tried to make a big jump, to see if the pots were hidden somewhere. But the pots remained there, hidden behind a pile of kitchen towels.

Mrs. Fork, a pink little fork, suggested he look carefully among the dishes. Utensili Cucin focused and noticed a small, narrow tunnel between the dishes and the pots. He crawled inside, driven by curiosity, and… surprise! The pots were all there, happy to return to work.

Utensili Cucin put them back in their place carefully. The cake would be ready in a moment. Utensili Cucin realized that sometimes, to find things, you have to be patient and observe every detail carefully. Patience and curiosity can lead to the solution of every mystery.

plan.problema: The pots and pans disappeared mysteriously, leaving the cook without tools to make the cake!
plan.svolta: Cooking Utensils tried to make a big wiggle, but the pots remained hidden behind a pile of dish towels.
plan.finale: Finally, he found a small tunnel and all the dishes and pots reappeared, happy to return to work!
plan.morale: Patience and curiosity are essential for solving mysteries.

utensili cucina.text:
Utensili Cuochi was a very special knife. He lived in the Happy Kitchen, full of colors and laughter. He was made of shiny metal and loved to help make cakes. One day, Utensili Cuochi noticed something wasn't right. “Oh no!” he exclaimed. “The ingredients for the most special cake in the world have disappeared!”

Mrs. Spatola, a little red spatula, ran to him. “Don’t worry, Utensili Cuochi,” she said. “Maybe it’s just a little mistake.” But the ingredients were nowhere to be found! Utensili Cuochi checked everything: the worktop, the big bowl, even the fridge. Nothing.

Then, suddenly, Utensili Cuochi heard a strange noise. He looked carefully and saw a little blue bowl slide under the table. The bowl was far too big and blocked the way to the drawer where the secret spices were!

Utensili Cuochi, with all his strength, gently pushed the bowl back. He moved it a little and… puff! The ingredients for the cake magically appeared on the worktop: flour, sugar, eggs, and cocoa.

Mrs. Spatola smiled. “How wonderful!” she said. Utensili Cuochi felt happy. He had solved a big problem with a little help. The most special cake in the world was saved! And Utensili Cuochi understood that even the smallest things can make a difference.

plan.problema: The ingredients for the most special cake in the world had disappeared mysteriously!
plan.svolta: She noticed that a small bowl had slid under the table and blocked the passage to the drawer where the spices were kept.
plan.finale: She managed to move the bowl back into place, and the ingredients magically reappeared!
plan.morale: A little help can solve big problems.

utensili cucina.text:
“Oh no!” exclaimed Utensili Cuochi. He was a set of kitchen utensils, but he could talk and move in his toy kitchen. The boots, the pots, the spoons, everything was scattered across the countertop! The picnic cake had to be ready in a hurry, but no one knew where to put the tools.

“I need to make the cake!” said Utensili Cuochi, trying to pick up a whisk. The little saucepan, Pippo, helped him grab the spoon. “It’s not fair,” continued Utensili Cuochi. “We all need to have a job.”

Utensili Cuochi had an idea. He sat in the middle of the countertop and said, “We need to make a circle! The whisk will mix the batter, the spatula will spread it, the spoon will measure the ingredients, and the saucepan will hold the mixture.”

Pippo followed Utensili Cuochi’s instructions. They all worked together quickly. The cake was fragrant and golden. The other utensils joined the circle, happy to contribute.

Finally, the cake was ready! The children playing nearby ran to taste it. Everyone was very happy. Utensili Cuochi smiled. It had been nice to work together to make something good. 

Each utensil knew its place and everyone had contributed with joy.

plan.problema: The utensils were scattered everywhere and couldn't make the picnic cake!
plan.svolta: He decided to arrange the utensils in a circle, explaining to each his specific task.
plan.finale: The cake was ready and all the children were happy to taste it together.

utensili cucina.text:
Utensili Cuochi was very excited. The toy kitchen was full of promises of sweet treats. Today he was going to make an apple pie! He stretched his spoon towards the bowl, ready to pour in the flour. But then he stopped. Something wasn't right. The ingredients for the apple pie had disappeared!

“Oh no!” exclaimed Utensili Cuochi. He checked under the stove, behind the cupboard, and even inside the toy fridge. Nothing. No eggs, no butter, no flour. Just a little teddy bear, Bruno, watched him curiously.

Utensili Cuochi thought about what to do. Then he tried to use his knife to cut the apples. But the knife was too big! He tried to slice them, but the apples crumbled and he couldn't make small pieces. “This is difficult,” he said.

He remembered the spoon. Maybe it could work? He tried to cut the apples with the spoon, but he couldn't make clean cuts. The apples remained a messy tangle. Utensili Cuochi got a little angry, then he had an idea! He took his spatula and began to mash the apples patiently. Mash, mash, mash…

Finally, after a lot of work, he got perfect flour for the pie! Bruno applauded him. Utensili Cuochi smiled. He solved the problem thanks to his perseverance and a little bit of imagination. The pie wouldn’t be perfect, but it was still good. And Utensili Cuochi understood that even when things seem difficult, with effort you can always find solutions.

plan.problema: The ingredients for the apple pie had disappeared mysteriously!
plan.svolta: She realized that her knife was too big and tried to use a spoon, but she couldn't cut the apples well.
plan.finale: With a lot of patience and a little pinch of imagination, she managed to mash the apples with the spatula, creating perfect flour for the pie!
plan.morale: Perseverance helps to find creative solutions.

utensili cucina.text:
Utensili Cucin was a very active set of kitchen tools.
He lived in the toy kitchen, a small kitchen but full of colors.
He had a yellow spatula, a blue spoon, and a red knife always ready for action.
But one morning, there was a big mess!

The pots and pans were all confused.
They didn’t know where to put the ingredients: flour, sugar, and eggs.
“Oh no!” exclaimed Utensili Cucin.
“This isn’t right. The kitchen must be tidy!”

He tried to ask for help from the spoon, but he was too busy tickling the whisk.
The spoon was laughing loudly and the whisk was shaking wildly.
Utensili Cucin got a little angry.
He had to do something!

He thought carefully. Then, he took his yellow spatula and started to guide the pots and pans.
One after the other, he lined them up.
“Little blue pot, go here!” said Utensili Cucin.
“Red pan, you go there instead!”

With patience and kindness, Utensili Cucin guided them to the corner with the ingredients.
Suddenly, everything went back to its perfect place!
The pots were where they needed to be, and so were the pans.
The toy kitchen was tidy again.

Utensili Cucin smiled happily.
He was happy to see everything in the right order.
Everything in its place makes life easier and more peaceful.

plan.problema: The pots and pans were confused and didn't know where to put the ingredients!
plan.svolta: Utensili Cucin tried to ask for help from the spoon, but he was too busy tickling the whisk.
plan.finale: Utensili Cucin organized them in a line and led them to the ingredients corner, immediately finding his perfect order.

utensili cucina.text:
Utensili Cuochi was a measuring spoon who was especially excited. He lived in the toy kitchen, full of colorful pots and pans. He was the oldest of the utensils and loved to help prepare imaginary lunches. But one morning, there was a big problem!

The doll Sofia was having a birthday and they needed to make the most beautiful cake in the world. Utensili Cuochi, along with spatulas, whisks, and bowls, had immediately started to work. They were trying to mix the ingredients, but everything went wrong. The flour fell everywhere, the egg broke, and the mixture always looked like a disaster!

“We can’t do it!” shouted Utensili Cuochi, frustrated. “This cake will never be perfect!” A little whisk, Francy, tried to reassure him: "Maybe if we tried to do things the right way..."

Utensili Cuochi understood. He remembered that Mama Cook always follows the instructions. So, he took a bowl and carefully started to follow the directions on the cake box. The spatula and spoon worked together, mixing the ingredients with precision. Everything went perfectly!

The creamy, soft, and fragrant cake was finally ready. Utensili Cuochi felt happy. Francy and all the other utensils were proud of their work. The cake for Sofia was truly beautiful!

Utensili Cuochi realized that when you follow the rules, even the most difficult things become easy. And the perfect cake was a demonstration of this fact.

plan.problema: The tools couldn't make the most beautiful cake for the doll's birthday!
plan.svolta: She decided to try to follow the instructions carefully, joining the spatula and spoon with precision.
plan.finale: The cake was perfect and all the tools felt proud of their work.
plan.morale: Following the rules leads to success.

utensili cucina.text:
Utensili Cucin was a very active spoon. He lived in the toy kitchen, full of trays and pans. He loved to help make sweet treats for the dolls. One day, the doll Penelope was about to have a party and they needed to make a special cake for her birthday.

“I need to get the cake there in time!” thought Utensili Cucin. He started to take the ingredients: flour, sugar, eggs. But he was a little stressed! He was trying to mix everything, but the eggs broke and the flour fell everywhere.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Utensili Cucin. “I can’t do it well!” He then tried to use the whisk to beat the egg whites. The whisk spun quickly and… puff! The flour flew in all directions, it stuck to the cake and became a disaster!

Mrs. Spatola, an old wooden spatula, arrived at that point. “Calm down Utensili Cucin,” she said. “Try to use the right spoon for the batter.” Utensili Cucin followed the advice. He mixed slowly and calmly. The flour mixed well with the other ingredients.

After a while, a delicious golden cake appeared on the tray. Penelope was so happy! Utensili Cucin felt satisfied. He had learned that even when things go wrong, patience and the right method can do miracles. Utensili Cucin thought: “Sometimes, it’s better to slow down a little to get a good result.”

plan.problema: The poor Utensili Cucin couldn't bake the birthday cake for doll Penelope!
plan.svolta: He decided to try mixing with the whisk, but the flour flew everywhere and everything got sticky!
plan.finale: With calmness and using the right spoon, Utensili Cucin managed to create a delicious cake for Penelope.

utensili cucina.text:
Utensili Cuochi was a very active cook. He lived in the Happy Kitchen, full of colors and smells. He had a red spatula, a yellow whisk, a blue spoon, and a green frosting. He was always ready to make delicious cakes!

One day, Mrs. Cake, a little white cake tin, needed ingredients to make a special cake. Utensili Cuochi was preparing everything with enthusiasm. But then... oh no! A big mess! The flour was scattered on the table, the eggs rolled on the mat, and the sugar had fallen under the table. The cake ingredients had scattered everywhere!

Utensili Cuochi started to move frantically. He began to roll the whisks back and forth, hoping to put things back in their place. The blue spoon tried to collect the sugar, but it was too heavy. The red spatula scratched against the table, without results.

Then, he had an idea! He started to make big sweeps with the spatula, pushing everything towards the center of the Happy Kitchen. The yellow whisk helped to put the eggs back in their container. The blue spoon collected the sugar and gently put it in the flour.

Finally, after many efforts, Utensili Cuochi tidied everything up perfectly! The ingredients were in their place, ready for the cake. Mrs. Cake was very happy. 

Utensili Cuochi felt proud of his work. He knew that when things are well organized, everything becomes easier and faster. And with a big smile, he made a delicious cake for everyone.

plan.problema: The cake ingredients had scattered everywhere!
plan.svolta: He started making the whisks and spoons roll, hoping to put the objects back in order.
plan.finale: Finally, with a big swipe of spatula, he tidied everything up perfectly!

xilophono.text:
Xilophone lived in the attic. He was a colorful xylophone, with his yellow, red, and blue keys. The attic was full of dust and old things. Xilophone was very lonely. No one had touched him for a long time.

Xilophone felt sad. He wasn't making any sounds and he didn't have anyone to talk to. Every sound he should have made stayed inside him, a little secret. He wanted so much to be listened to, but he was too shy.

One day, Xilophone made a decision. He decided to tap his sticks with all his might! He shook his body, and the keys clicked quickly. But the sound that came out was quiet and confused. It was like a faint sigh, almost imperceptible.

Xilophone felt even worse. He thought that no one would ever appreciate him. Suddenly, a little light came in through the attic window. A ray of sunshine hit Xilophone's body and made his colors shine. The keys seemed to dance in the light.

The light attracted the attention of a kitten, Micio, who lived with his grandmother downstairs. Micio climbed up to the attic and, slowly, began to tap Xilophone with his paws. The sound was cheerful and full of joy!
