Xilophone understood right away what he had to do. He played for Micio, and Micio responded with his game. It was beautiful. 

The grandmother heard the sound and came up to the attic. She smiled at Xilophone and played with him and Micio. They all had a lot of fun.

plan.problema: The xylophone was too sad because no one played it.
plan.svolta: He decided to hit the sticks harder, but the sound remained quiet and confused.
plan.finale: Then, a ray of sunshine came through the window and made its colors shine, inviting someone to play it.

xilophono.text:
Xilo was a special xylophone. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Every day, Xilo loved to make his notes. He played happy and loud, making the garden happy. But one day, something didn't go right. Xilo couldn't make his notes anymore. It seemed like the sound had disappeared.

The sun in the secret garden seemed sad. It was low in the sky and its light was weak. The butterflies didn't fly around the flowers. The birds sang only a few notes. Xilo felt very down. He wanted to play again!

Xilo made a decision. He decided to go around the meadow, looking for a place where the sound could resonate louder. He moved his small wooden sticks carefully. He walked through the rose bushes and passed by the fountain. A little frog was hopping on the stone.

Finally, Xilo reached the water of the pond. The water was calm and reflected the sky. Xilo gripped his sticks and made a sound. *Dì-dì-dì!* The note sounded clear and strong. Xilo smiled. His notes returned bright like crystals. The sun in the secret garden smiled again, lighting everything with its warm light. The birds started to sing and the butterflies flew around the flowers. 

Xilo played all day, making the secret garden an even happier place. The music of the xylophone was like a ray of sunshine.

plan.problema: Xilo couldn't play his cheerful notes and the sun seemed sad.
plan.svolta: He decided to walk around the meadow, looking for a place where the sound could resonate louder.
plan.finale: When he reached the lake water, his notes returned bright and the sun smiled again.

xilophono.text:
Xilo was a special xylophone. He lived in a creative workshop full of colors and shapes. He was made of light wood and had lots of metal cylinders of different colors.

Xilo loved to play, but lately something wasn’t going right. He couldn’t make the most beautiful melodies he knew anymore. His sound had become a little quiet, almost sad.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Xilo, clutching his cylinders tightly. “I must find my rhythm again! I want to play like before.”

In the workshop there was also an old guitar, which made little noises. “What’s happening, Xilo? Are you worried?” asked the guitar.

Xilo thought for a while. Then he decided to do something new. He started to turn around on the table he was leaning against, hitting his cylinders in different ways. Sometimes he hit them hard, other times he hit them gently. He tried with his finger, then with a small stick. He was looking for the perfect rhythm.

After a while, Xilo stopped. He made a gentle and precise hit with the stick, playing the red, blue, and yellow cylinders slowly. A joyful melody began to spread through the workshop. The guitar started to play louder, a small violin emitted cheerful notes.

Xilo continued to play, always calmly and carefully. Finally he had found the perfect sound! With a gentle and precise hit, Xilo played a joyful melody that made all the instruments in the workshop smile. It was lovely to hear the music come back full of life. And Xilo understood that when you are patient, beautiful things always happen.

plan.problema: Xilo couldn’t play the most beautiful melodies, and the sound had become a little dull.
plan.svolta: He decided to go around the table, striking his cylinders in different ways to find the perfect rhythm.
plan.finale: Finally, with a delicate and precise hit, Xilo reproduced a joyful melody that made all the instruments in the workshop smile.

xilophono.text:
Xilo was a special xylophone. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and lush plants. He was made of warm wood and had many golden keys that shone in the sun.

Xilo loved his place in the garden, but sometimes he felt sad.

One day, a family of ladybugs arrived in the secret garden. The ladybugs were small and cute, but they seemed very unhappy. Xilo wanted to help them smile.

He tried to tap his keys, making the melody he knew well, but the ladybugs didn't seem to appreciate it. It seemed like their sadness wouldn't disappear.

Xilo felt a little frustrated. He thought, "I have to do something different!" So he decided to try tapping the keys faster, then slower. He created different rhythms, high and low. He experimented with his fingers, searching for the right melody.

The ladybugs watched Xilo carefully. They moved a little faster, their little eyes shining with curiosity. Finally, Xilo found the perfect rhythm! The cheerful sound of the xylophone made the ladybugs fly in a whirlwind of joy! They flew up and down, dancing happily around Xilo.

The ladybugs thanked Xilo with little chirps. Xilo felt very happy. He had learned that, with a little patience and perseverance, even the most difficult problems can be solved. And so, the secret garden resonated with laughter and music.

plan.problema: He couldn't play the right tune to make the ladybugs smile.
plan.svolta: He decided to try hitting the keys faster and slower, trying to create different rhythms.
plan.finale: Finally, the cheerful sound of the xylophone made the ladybugs fly in a whirlwind of joy!

xilophono.text:
Xilo was a special xylophone. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and lush plants. Xilo loved to play his notes, happy and lively. But one day something didn’t go well. His notes didn’t come out anymore. It seemed like the sound had disappeared.

The sun in the secret garden seemed sad too. It was gray and low in the sky. Xilo felt a great sadness. He couldn’t make his favorite melodies, the ones that made all the flowers smile.

Xilo thought for a while. Then he decided to do something. He started to move, gently sliding his wooden bars. He decided to go around the biggest rose in the garden, the one with the red and fragrant petals. He hoped that his sound could refresh the garden and maybe even the sun.

Xilo went around and around, carefully sliding his wooden bars. The rose looked at him curiously. When Xilo reached the rose, he felt a change. The sun smiled! It became yellow and bright. And Xilo, suddenly, started to play with joy. His notes filled the secret garden with happiness.

The butterfly Lila, who lived among the roses, came to Xilo and said, “What beautiful music!” Xilo played even louder, happy to be able to make his melodies again. The secret garden was beautiful again and full of color. 

Xilo realized that even a small kind gesture could make a difference. And he thought that a laugh can light up even the grayest day.

plan.problema: Xilo couldn't play his cheerful notes and the sun seemed sad.
plan.svolta: He decided to go around the biggest rose, hoping that his sound could refresh the garden.
plan.finale: When he reached the rose, the sun smiled and Xilo began to play with joy!
plan.morale: Kindness makes the smile come back.

xilophono.text:
Xilo was a colorful xylophone. He lived in the playroom, among the building blocks and constructions. He loved to make music, but lately something wasn't going right. His little hammers didn't sound harmonious anymore. They seemed confused and disorganized.

Nobody wanted to listen to him. The children were too busy playing with the other toys. Xilo felt sad and a little lonely. He tried to hit the hammers quickly, then slowly, but nothing worked. The sound was always confused.

One day, he decided to try something different. He used the tip of his hand to hit the hammers. He thought that maybe this way he would find the right rhythm. But even in that case, the sound was still a big mess! There was no harmony, no melody.

Xilo sat down and thought for a long time. Then, suddenly, he understood something important. He had to be gentle, patient. He had to play each hammer with sweetness. He concentrated all his energy and began to hit the hammers slowly, one at a time.

The sound that came out was beautiful! It was a concert full of clear and harmonious notes. The children in the playroom stopped to listen. They smiled and applauded Xilo. 

Xilo played for them all evening. Every note was a little gift, every sound a shared joy. The playroom filled with music and happiness. Xilo realized that patience can create wonderful things. The concert ended with a final, sweet chord.

plan.problema: Xilo couldn't make his little boats sound harmonious, and nobody wanted to listen.
plan.svolta: He decided to try tapping the boats with the tip of his hand, but the sound was still confused and without rhythm.
plan.finale: Suddenly, Xilo realized he had to be gentle and patient, playing each boat with sweetness, creating a beautiful concert.

xilophono.text:
Xilo was a special xylophone. He lived in the Flower Garden, among the red tulips and yellow roses. He was made of colored wood and had many keys that made different sounds when you hit them with sticks. But Xilo felt very sad.

Nobody seemed to listen to him. The wind blew, but his sounds didn’t travel as far anymore. The birds sang, but nobody slowed down to hear his music. Xilo longed to be listened to. He had become a little dull and quiet.

One day, Xilo thought, “I have to do something!” He focused and took his sticks in his hands. He started to beat them with all his strength, trying to create a faster and happier rhythm. Bang, bang, bang! He played loud and clear, as if he wanted to say: “Listen to me!”

Suddenly, a little grasshopper, Leo, came closer to Xilo. Leo was curious about the new and joyful sound. Xilo continued to play with enthusiasm, creating a lively melody that filled the garden.

Suddenly, the butterflies began to approach the Flower Garden. They flew around Xilo, following the cheerful sound of his sticks. The butterflies danced and fluttered, happy to listen to Xilo’s music. It was a wonderful picture: the butterflies and the tulips, all in harmony. 

Xilo finally felt happy. He realized that when you play with your heart, others can also feel the joy of music. And music makes everyone happy!

plan.problema: Xilo felt sad because no one listened to him and his sounds didn’t go far anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to try to beat his sticks with more force and rhythm, creating a cheerful and lively melody.
plan.finale: Suddenly, the butterflies approached the garden, following the joyful sound of Xilo.

xilophono.text:
Xilo was a special xylophone. He lived in a creative workshop full of colors and instruments. He was made of shiny wood and had many white keys arranged in rows.

Xilo loved to make music! Every time someone touched him, he produced beautiful sounds: do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, si.

But one day, something happened. Xilo stopped making his sounds. He was stuck! He couldn’t make the keys slide and create those happy notes. Xilo was very sad. He felt useless. No one touched him because he didn’t make any sound.

Xilo tried to shake himself really hard, but all he made were strange and annoying noises. It wasn’t his melodious sound. It was an unpleasant and confused sound. Xilo felt even worse. 

The Mechanical Lady, a kind woman with big glasses, saw Xilo sad. She approached him gently. She took a soft cloth and used it to clean Xilo’s keys. With patience and care, she removed the dust and small bits that had accumulated.

Then, she gently shook Xilo. And suddenly, Xilo laughed with joy! The keys started to move and produce beautiful sounds: do, re, mi… Xilo was happy! The workshop filled with happy notes.

The Mechanical Lady smiled. Xilo understood that sometimes, to be happy again, you just need a little patience and gentleness. And so, Xilo continued to play, creating music for every day.

plan.problema: Xilo got stuck and can’t make his beautiful sounds anymore!
plan.svolta: He tried to shake it hard, but it only made strange noises and not his melodious sound.
plan.finale: The mechanical lady, with delicacy, cleaned his blades and Xilo laughed with joy, filling the room with cheerful notes.

xilophono.text:
Xilofono lived in a secret garden. He was a special xylophone, made of colorful wood and full of sound keys. Every morning, the sun kissed the roses and Xilofono eagerly waited to play. But one morning something wasn't right. When Xilofono hit his sticks, the sounds were confused, muted. They didn't make the cheerful, bright melodies he loved so much.

Xilofono felt sad. He tried to tap the sticks softer, then louder. But the sound remained unpleasant and uncertain. A little blue butterfly, Lila, fluttered around him. “What’s wrong, Xilofono?” asked Lila with her light voice.

Xilofono sighed. "I can't play well!" he said. He decided to try something else. Suddenly, Xilofono began to move his sticks in an irregular, fast and then slow way. He didn't follow a precise rhythm. 

And then something magical happened. The notes resonated clear and joyful like bells in the wind. The sounds mixed together creating a new and fun melody. Xilofono was playing happily! He realized that when he enjoyed experimenting, his sound became even more beautiful. 

Lila danced around him, happy to listen to this improvised music. Xilofono continued to tap the sticks playfully, and the secret garden filled with wonderful sounds. It was a perfect day to create his own melody.

plan.problema: The little xylophone couldn't make its cheerful, bright melodies.
plan.svolta: It decided to try to move its sticks faster, but the sound was still confused and unpleasant.
plan.finale: When suddenly it began to beat the sticks in an irregular, playful way, the notes sounded clear and joyful like bells in the wind.

xilophono.text:
Xilo was a special xylophone. He lived in a creative workshop full of colors and shapes. He was made of smooth wood and had six plastic sticks of different colors. Xilo loved to make music, but lately something wasn't going right.

When the sticks slipped, the sounds he made were mixed up. Sometimes they sounded sad, other times angry. It was very frustrating for him! Mr. Rossi, the toy maker, was watching him carefully. “Maybe it’s just a small problem,” said Mr. Rossi, but Xilo knew it wasn’t simple.

Xilo thought, thought, and thought. He didn’t understand why his sounds were so wrong. Then he had an idea! He decided to turn around the table where he was sitting. He slowly slid the sticks, one at a time, in new and unexpected directions. He turned right, then left, then right again.

He continued to move the sticks, faster and faster. As he turned, the sounds became clear and beautiful. Xilo made one last quick turn and… voilà! He produced a cheerful and bright melody that filled the whole creative workshop. Mr. Rossi smiled very happily.

Xilo realized that changing a little bit the way he did things could solve any problem. Every sound, every shape, has its own unique value.

plan.problema: Xilo couldn’t make the right melodies and the sounds seemed confused.
plan.svolta: He decided to go around the table, sliding his sticks in new and unexpected directions.
plan.finale: Finally, with a final quick turn, he produced a clear and cheerful melody that filled the workshop!

ambulanza.text:
Ambulance Leo was happy at the playground. It was a shiny red ambulance, ready to always do good. The other toys greeted him with a smile. Leo loved to run all over the field, sliding on the colorful sand and jumping on the wooden bridges.

Suddenly, he heard a little whimper. It was Bear, a soft brown teddy bear, who was in trouble. Bear had fallen into a deep hole! He couldn’t reach the edge. Ambulance Leo moved closer with his lights shining on the hole. “Oh no, Bear!” said Ambulance Leo.

Ambulance Leo tried to do a little climb using his wheels to push the bear out. But Bear was too heavy! He couldn’t move him even an inch. He was frustrated.

Then, Ambulance Leo had an idea. He called his friends, the other toy ambulances, the ‘sirens’. The sirens arrived quickly and started to work right away. Together, they used their wheels and their lights to plan a solution.

They made together a strong cardboard ramp using the pieces of the playground. Slowly, but with patience, they helped Bear up the ramp. The bear reached the edge and was so happy! Ambulance Leo was pleased. He had solved a problem thanks to the help of his friends.

Ambulance Leo stopped to watch the sirens laughing happily, they had all worked together to save Bear. It was a perfect day at the playground.

plan.problema: A little plush teddy bear fell into a deep hole and couldn't get out.
plan.svolta: Leo made a ramp with wheels and tried to push the bear out of the hole, but it was too heavy!
plan.finale: Leo called his friends 'mermaids' (other toy ambulances) and together they made a ramp to help the bear climb out.

ambulanza.text:
I am Ambo, a toy ambulance. I love to play in the playground! I am red and shiny, and I have very bright lights. Today I’m here with lots of other toys, but there’s a serious situation. A little girl, Sofia, has fallen to the ground. She hurt her knee and can’t get up.

“Oh no!” I said, my horn made a short sound. “I must do something!” But Sofia was scared. She was crying and didn’t want to move. I tried to make the ambulance sound, a “beep beep”, but she was too scared to walk. She was still, sitting on the ground.

I thought, I thought… Then I did something different. I started flashing my lights quickly, back and forth! Then I honked my horn loudly, loudly, loudly! “Beep beep beep!” The sound echoed in the playground.

Sofia looked at my flashing lights and my horn. She smiled a little. She took a few wobbly steps, then she started to run! She got up quickly, without any more fear. “Thank you, Ambo!” she said, happy.

I am happy. I helped Sofia. The sun was shining brightly in the playground sky. It was nice to see a little girl so happy after a small accident. Sometimes it just takes a little courage to overcome your fear.

plan.problema: Sofia fell down and can't get up!
plan.svolta: I tried to make the ambulance sound, but Sofia was too scared to walk.
plan.finale: I started flashing the lights and honking the horn loudly, until she smiled and got up running!
plan.morale: Sometimes it just takes a little courage.

ambulanza.text:
Ambulance Leo was a very special ambulance. He lived at the playground and loved to help all his friends. He was bright red and had a siren that sounded when he was happy. One day, while driving on the path, he heard a little cry.

“Help! Help!” cried the cry. Ambulance Leo came closer and saw a little teddy bear sitting on the edge of the pond. The teddy bear had fallen in and couldn’t get out! He was very scared.

Ambulance Leo rushed to help him. He tried to reach the teddy bear with his mechanical arm, but the water was too deep. The arm stopped, turning pale. “I can’t do it,” thought Ambulance Leo.

A boy, Marco, was playing on the slide near the pond. He saw Ambulance Leo in trouble and ran to help him. Marco suggested: “Leo, use the slide! You could pull the teddy bear down!”

Ambulance Leo had an idea. He bravely climbed into the pond and, with the help of the slide, Marco was able to pull the happy and content teddy bear out. The teddy bear hugged Ambulance Leo, thanking him. 

“It was wonderful to work together!” said the teddy bear. Ambulance Leo felt proud. He had learned that even with a little help, you can overcome difficulties. All his friends at the playground were waiting for his next adventure.

plan.problema: A little teddy bear fell into the pond and couldn't get out!
plan.svolta: Leo bravely climbed into the pond, but the water was too deep and his mechanical arms froze.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a friendly slide, Leo managed to pull out the happy teddy bear!

ambulanza.text:
Ambulance Leo was a special ambulance. It was bright red and had a big bell. He loved to play at the playground. Every day he ran between the swings and the slides. Today, Ambulance Leo heard a big noise. A little cry came from nearby.

He saw Pippo, a very small boy, on the ground. He had hurt himself and couldn't get back up. “Oh no!” said Ambulance Leo. He had to do something! He started to open his hood to the little Pippo.

But Pippo was scared. The bell of Ambulance Leo rang loudly, too loudly. Pippo cried even louder and didn't want to be touched. Ambulance Leo quickly understood what to do. He stopped ringing the bell.

Instead, Ambulance Leo used his whistle. A soft and gentle sound. The whistle was much quieter than the bell. Pippo calmed down. The whistle reassured him.

Ambulance Leo went up to the boy again. He touched him gently and asked, “Do you feel better?” Pippo smiled. He stood up and ran to play with the other children. Everyone was laughing happily. Ambulance Leo was happy. He had helped Pippo overcome his fear. 

Ambulance Leo continued his tour at the playground, always ready to help anyone who needed it, remembering that sometimes, a small gesture of calm is all that’s needed.

plan.problema: Little Pippo fell down and can’t get back up!
plan.svolta: Leo realized that his bell was too loud and was scaring Pippo, so he started using only the sweet sound of his whistle.
plan.finale: Pippo, calmed by Leo’s whistle, stood up smiling and ran to play with the other children.

ambulanza.text:
Ambulance Leo was a very special ambulance. He lived at the playground and loved to help all his plush friends. He had flashing red lights and the sound of the emergency indicator that said “beep beep”. One afternoon, while he was exploring the swing, he heard a little cry.

Ambulance Leo went closer and saw a little teddy bear, Ursy, sitting in the sand with his foot bent in a strange way. “Oh no!” said Ambulance Leo. “Ursy is hurt!”

Ambulance Leo tried to do magic, as he always did. He tried to use his helper arm to gently support Ursy, but he was too small and the teddy bear kept falling. “I need to find a way,” thought Ambulance Leo.

A boy, Marco, was playing nearby. Ambulance Leo had an idea! He used his platform to gently lift Ursy off the ground. With great care, he carried him towards Marco.

Marco quickly came over and took Ursy in his hands. He gave him a little hug and told Ursy’s mommy that he was okay. Mommy smiled and thanked Ambulance Leo for the help.

Ambulance Leo felt a great satisfaction. He was happy to have been able to help his friend Ursy. He adjusted his lights, ready for the next adventure at the playground. Every time someone needed help, Ambulance Leo was there, ready to answer the call. And he knew that when you help a friend, everyone becomes happier.

plan.problema: A little teddy bear hurt his foot!
plan.svolta: Leo tried to use his spare arm to support the teddy bear, but it was too small and the teddy bear kept falling.
plan.finale: Leo thought of using his step to gently lift the teddy bear and call for help from a child!
plan.morale: Helping friends is always the right thing to do.

ambulanza.text:
Ambulance Leo was a very special ambulance. It was red, shiny, and loved to run in the playground. Every day it played among the sandcastles and the swings. One afternoon, it heard a little cry. “Oh dear, it’s Pippo!” exclaimed Ambulance Leo.

Pippo was sitting on the ground, with his face screwed up in a frown. He had lost his favorite cars, all scattered under the swing. Ambulance Leo came closer and tried to help him pick them up, but there were too many! He was frustrated. He couldn’t do anything to help Pippo.

Ambulance Leo worried. He was trying to be helpful, but no one could hear him. He tried to activate his alarm, the one that makes a sound when he calls for help. But the sound was too quiet. No one was answering. “I can’t believe it!” thought Ambulance Leo.

Then, he took a deep breath and started to sound his siren as loud as he could. “Wooooo! Wooooo!” shouted Ambulance Leo. The sound became louder and louder. Suddenly, Marco, a boy who was playing nearby, raised his head. “What’s happening?” asked Marco.

Ambulance Leo continued to sound his siren and Marco ran towards him. He ran quickly among the cars and got them all back for Pippo. Pippo smiled very happily. Ambulance Leo felt proud. He had done well not to give up. 

Marco returned to Ambulance Leo with the cars in his hand. “You were very good!” said Marco. Ambulance Leo knew that, even when things seem difficult, a little bit of courage and perseverance can make a difference.

plan.problema: Little Pippo fell down and lost his favorite cars!
plan.svolta: Leo, frustrated, activated his alarm to call for help, but nobody heard him.
plan.finale: Then, Leo started playing his siren louder, attracting Marco’s attention who picked up the cars!

ambulanza.text:
Ambulance Leo was in the playground. It was a shiny red ambulance, with flashing blue lights when it moved. Leo loved to run with the children, but this time he was standing near the slide tower.

Suddenly, he heard a quiet sob. He went closer and saw a little teddy bear, Bruno, lying still in a corner. Bruno couldn’t get up on his own. He seemed sad and scared.

“Oh no!” said Ambulance Leo. “I must help Bruno!” He started to move his wheels, going towards the teddy bear. But every time he sounded his powerful siren, Bruno curled up even more, terrified.

Leo quickly understood the problem. The siren was too loud! It was scaring Bruno. He immediately lowered the siren’s volume and tried to speak softly to the teddy bear: “Don’t be afraid, Bruno. I’m here to help you.”

With slow and gentle movements, Ambulance Leo approached Bruno. He carefully took him with his blue lights. “Stand up, little friend,” said Leo, “I’ll help you.”

Slowly, with some support from Leo, Bruno was able to get up. He immediately started to play with the other teddy bears and the children in the playground. Everyone was happy. Ambulance Leo smiled satisfied. He was happy to have been able to help his new friend. 

Kindness can do miracles, even when you speak softly.

plan.problema: A small teddy bear fell in a corner of the park and couldn't get back up.
plan.svolta: Leo noticed that his mermaid was too loud and was scaring the bear, so he lowered the volume and tried to speak softly to the bear.
plan.finale: The bear, reassured, stood up with a little help from Leo and went back to play with his friends.

ambulanza.text:
Ambulance Leo was a very special ambulance. He could even talk! He loved to play at the playground and help anyone who needed it. That day, Ambulance Leo was near the castle tower when he heard a little cry. “Oh no!” said Ambulance Leo. “Something is wrong.”

He saw Pippo, a little teddy bear, lying in a deep hole. He had fallen in there all by himself! Ambulance Leo quickly rushed over. He tried to pull Pippo out, but the hole was too narrow and too deep. Ambulance Leo froze. He couldn’t move.

“Help! Help!” shouted Ambulance Leo, making his sirens sound. No one could see him among the playground games. The sun was shining brightly and the crowd of children was too far away to hear his sirens. Ambulance Leo felt a little sad.

Then, Ambulance Leo used his little mechanical arm. He gently lowered it into the hole. Carefully, he grabbed Pippo with his metal hands. He pulled him out of the hole and returned him to Max, a big dog who was playing nearby.

“Thank you, Ambulance Leo!” barked Max happily. Ambulance Leo felt happy to have helped Pippo. He had done the right thing. 

Ambulance Leo went back to driving around the playground, ready to help anyone in need. A kind gesture always does good for friends.

plan.problema: A little teddy bear, Pippo, fell into a hole!
plan.svolta: Leo got stuck in the hole too deep and called for help with his sirens, but no one could see him.
plan.finale: Then Leo used his little mechanical arm to gently extract Pippo from the hole and return him to his friend dog, Max.

ambulanza.text:
Ambulance Leo was a special ambulance. It was red and shiny and it could even talk! It spent its days at the playground, ready to lend a hand. Today the sun was shining bright and the children were laughing happily. Ambulance Leo listened to their laughter, happy to be part of all this fun.

Suddenly, a little cry reached him. It was Bruno, a white teddy bear, who had gotten lost. Bruno had fallen in a corner of the playground and couldn't get back on his own. He looked sad and scared. Ambulance Leo wanted to help him right away.

Ambulance Leo tried to squeeze into the corner with its flashing lights, hoping to reassure Bruno. But Bruno was so scared that he hid under a tall bush. Ambulance Leo felt frustrated. He didn't know what to do.

Then Ambulance Leo took his whistle. He blew, blow, blow, blow! The sound attracted the attention of some children who were playing nearby. The children ran to Bruno and pulled him out of the bush. “Oh, poor teddy bear!” they exclaimed.

Ambulance Leo felt a great joy. He had helped Bruno find his friend, another little bear who was playing near the fountain. The little bear ran to hug Bruno and thanked Ambulance Leo for saving him. 

Ambulance Leo felt happy and satisfied. He knew he had done the right thing. He was always ready to lend a hand, and it’s nice when others are happy.

plan.problema: A little teddy bear, Bruno, fell in a corner of the park and couldn't get back on his own.
plan.svolta: Leo tried to crawl into the corner with his flashing lights, but Bruno got scared and hid under a bush.
plan.finale: Leo used his whistle to call for help and a group of children found him and brought Bruno back to his friend.
plan.morale: Helping friends is always the right thing to do.

ambulanza.text:
I am Ambo, a toy ambulance! I love to run in the playground. Today the sun is shining and there are lots of children. I see Leo running happily. Leo has a favorite red ball. He chases it among the sandcastles and the swings.

Suddenly, Leo falls down! He rubs his knees and cries. “I’ve lost my ball!” he says with a shaky voice. I feel sad for him. I want to help him right away.

I start flashing my red and blue lights. I look for the red ball among the toys, but it’s too small! It’s hiding between the tunnel and the slide. My lights can’t find it. I’m a little frustrated.

Then I hear a voice: “Hello Ambo! I’m Marco, the firefighter!” Marco listens to me and says, “Can we help Leo?” Together we look for the ball. Marco has a very powerful flashlight. He uses it to look under the swing. 

And there it is! The red ball is hidden right under the swing, tucked between the legs. Leo smiles and picks up his ball. “Thank you Ambo and thank you Marco!” he says happily.

Ambo stops for a moment to watch Leo playing with his ball again. It’s nice to see Leo happy. Marco shakes hands with Ambo. Together they solved the problem.

plan.problema: Little Leo fell and lost his favorite ball!
plan.svolta: Both tried to find the ball with their flashing lights, but it was too small and was hiding among the toys.
plan.finale: Both called for help from a firefighter friend and together they found the ball under a swing!

camion da lavoro.text:
Camionetto was a very strong work truck. He lived in Leo’s garden. He loved to make his races and carry heavy things. One day, Camionetto wanted to reach the red ball that was lying near the rose bush.

He quickly got closer, but then… *creak!* He got stuck in the mud! His tire was trapped and he couldn’t move. Camionetto felt a little frustrated. He couldn’t reach the red ball.

Leo was playing nearby and saw the problem. “Don’t worry, Camionetto,” said Leo. Camionetto thought: “I must find a solution!” He decided to go around the mud. He started to move slowly, looking for an easier path. 

Camionetto clenched his teeth (well, if a truck could have teeth!). He passed the strawberry bush and then the small pond. Finally, he found a narrow path that took him straight towards the red ball.

With his mechanical arm, Camionetto picked up the ball and brought it back to Leo. The red ball rolled happily on the ground. Camionetto felt proud of himself. He had overcome a difficult obstacle with patience and determination.

Camionetto continued to go around the garden, ready for every new challenge. The toughest road always leads to what you want.

plan.problema: The truck got stuck in the mud and couldn’t reach the ball.
plan.svolta: He decided to go around the mud, looking for an easier path to the ball.
plan.finale: Finally, he managed to go around the mud and retrieve the ball with his mechanical arm.

camion da lavoro.text:
Camionetto was a very strong work truck. He lived at the playground and loved to run on all the surfaces. One day, Camionetto was having so much fun that he went too far. He ended up inside a deep hole full of mud! The mud was squeezing his wheels and he couldn't move. “Oh no!” exclaimed Camionetto. “I’m stuck!”

A little squirrel, Leo, came closer curiously. “Are you lost?” asked Leo. “I’m not lost,” replied Camionetto, “I’m stuck!” The mud was really sticky. Camionetto tried to pull with all his might, but nothing worked.

Camionetto thought: “I need to find a way to get out.” So he decided to go around the hole. He was looking for a wider, drier path. Camionetto moved slowly, carefully looking at every inch of the playground. 

Finally, after a lot of searching, he saw a fence! With a big effort, Camionetto managed to pass between the wooden planks. He came out of the hole, muddy but happy. “I did it!” shouted Camionetto. He felt proud of his courage and his perseverance.

Camionetto rested a little on the sand, watching the playground. He was happy to have overcome the difficulty. Next time, he promised himself, he would be more careful where he went. Camionetto knew that even when things seem difficult, with effort and determination, you can always find a solution.

plan.problema: The truck got stuck in the deep mud and couldn't get out.
plan.svolta: It decided to go around the mud, looking for a wider, drier path.
plan.finale: Finally, it found a fence and, coming out of the hole, the truck felt proud of its courage.

camion da lavoro.text:
Rusty was a bright red work truck. He lived at the playground. He loved to run among the games and make noises when he moved. One day, Rusty heard a big commotion. He got closer and saw a strange scene. The children had finished playing with the Lego bricks. They had scattered them everywhere! The park had become a big mess: Lego towers had fallen down, pieces were spread all over the ground, a real chaos!

Rusty tried to collect the Lego bricks with his bucket. He raised his arm and picked up a couple of bricks, but then he had to lower his bucket right away. There were so many bricks! Rusty got very tired very quickly. He hadn’t managed to do almost anything.

A boy, Marco, was watching Rusty. “You seem a little down,” said Marco. Rusty made a little noise with the engine and nodded. Marco had an idea. “Let’s call the other children!” he exclaimed.

Rusty made a big noise, like to say “Help!”. The first children came to Rusty. Together, they started to collect the Lego bricks. One child took the big pieces, another took the small ones. Rusty loaded the bricks into his bucket and deposited them in an organized pile.

In a little while, the playground was clean and perfect again. The children were happy to have helped Rusty. Rusty felt much better. He was happy to have so many friends who had supported him. Together, they did a great job.

plan.problema: The children had scattered their building blocks everywhere and the park became a big mess!
plan.svolta: Rusty tried to collect all the blocks with his bucket, but there were too many for him and he got tired quickly.
plan.finale: Then he called for help from the children who were playing and together they collected all the blocks and put them back in order perfectly!

camion da lavoro.text:
Cemento was a very strong construction truck. He lived in a big, new building. He was always ready to help! Today there was a lot of activity. Bricks were being carried and placed one on top of the other. Cemento moved quickly, spreading cement on every surface.

Suddenly, a loud thump! A pile of bricks had fallen to the ground, in the middle of the construction site. No one knew what to do. Cemento came closer and tried to pick up the bricks one by one. But they were so heavy! Cemento tried to grab them with his mechanical arm, but he couldn’t. It was too tiring.

A little bricklayer, Leo, came up to Cemento. “Maybe you can roll them?” he suggested. Cemento had an idea. He started to roll the bricks one at a time, gently pushing them with his wheel. One brick, then another, and another. Slowly, slowly, the bricks lined up.

Cemento continued to work patiently. Leo helped him push the bigger bricks. Together, they built a beautiful brick wall. The wall was red and smooth, perfect for the new building! 

Cemento felt very satisfied. He had learned that even difficult things become easy when you help each other. Cemento watched Leo smile and thought: “It’s nice when everyone works together to reach a goal.”

plan.problema: A pile of bricks has fallen and no one knows how to put them back!
plan.svolta: Cement tried to push all the bricks, but they were too heavy for him.
plan.finale: Then, with a little ingenuity, he rolled the bricks one at a time to the right place, forming a beautiful wall!

camion da lavoro.text:
Max was a very strong construction truck. He lived on the building site of a new house. He was always ready to help. His friends were the tires that turned around him. Max loved his job.

One day, he heard a little cry. “Help! I’m lost!” It was a blue brick, small and lost. He had hidden himself among the piles of sand. The builder needed the brick to finish building the house.

Max got to work right away. He tried to dig with his shovel, but only spread more sand everywhere. It was difficult to find the brick in that big amount of sand. Max felt a little frustrated. 

Then, he had an idea! He used his strong light to look for it. Max’s light was very bright and could see through the sand. With his long and strong mechanical arm, he dug carefully. Finally, he saw the blue brick! He picked it up gently and brought it back to its place.

The tires scratched their tires excitedly. “Good job, Max!” they shouted all together. Max felt happy. He had solved the problem thanks to his strength and his light. 

Max realized that, even if sometimes it’s difficult to find the solution on your own, working with friends makes everything easier. And so, the tires continued to turn around Max, ready for the next challenge on the building site.

plan.problema: The little blue building block had gotten lost among the piles of sand!
plan.svolta: Max tried to dig with the shovel, but only spread more sand everywhere.
plan.finale: Thanks to its powerful light and its mechanical arm, Max found the block and brought it back to its place, celebrated by his friend tires.

camion da lavoro.text:
Camionetto was a very strong work truck. He loved to play at the playground with all the other toys. Today he wanted to reach the new wooden castle, the one they had just built. Camionetto quickly got closer, but then… he got stuck! He got stuck in the sticky mud. He couldn’t move anymore.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Camionetto. “I can’t get to the castle! All my friends are waiting for me there.” He tried to push with all his wheels, but the mud was too hard. And then, while he was pushing, a little jack broke. Camionetto felt a big disappointment. His jack was important for helping the other toys!

A boy, Leo, was watching Camionetto. “Maybe you can use your big tires,” said Leo. “You could lift a rock and make a path.”

Camionetto thought about what Leo suggested. Then, with strength, he used his big tires to lift a big rock. He moved it a little, then he moved it again. Slowly, slowly, he made a little path in the mud. 

Camionetto finally managed to get through! He reached the castle and waved to all his friends. He was happy to have arrived. Camionetto stopped next to the castle, watching the children’s laughter. Leo’s patience made all the difference.

plan.problema: The truck got stuck in the mud and can't reach the new castle!
plan.svolta: He tried to push with all the wheels, but only a small jack broke!
plan.finale: So, he used his heavy tires to lift gently a big rock and create a gap.

camion da lavoro.text:
Ruggine was a strong, red work truck. He lived on the building site of a new house. He was always ready for action. Today was a hot day and the sun shone brightly in the sky. Ruggine loved to carry sand, stones, and sometimes even colorful building blocks.

Suddenly, a little blue block fell into a deep hole. The hole was full of dirt and dust. Ruggine tried to fit into the hole with his truck bed, but it was too narrow. He tried to use his bucket to pick up the block, but he couldn't. It was a small problem, but Ruggine wanted to solve it right away!

Then, Ruggine had an idea: he climbed onto the truck hood. It was very high! He thought that from there he could reach the block. But no, it was too high. His wheels couldn't reach the bottom of the hole. Ruggine was a little frustrated.

Then, he stopped and thought. His mechanical arm, the one he used to lift stones, could be useful! Carefully, Ruggine stretched his mechanical arm towards the hole. He moved it slowly, gently, as if he were taking a flower. And then... he caught it! The little blue block was safe.

Ruggine brought the block back to the top of the new building. He was happy to have helped. The construction team smiled seeing him working so hard. Ruggine felt proud of his work and his determination.

plan.problema: A small building block has fallen into a deep hole and Rusty can’t reach it.
plan.svolta: Rusty climbed onto the hood, but it’s too high to reach the block!
plan.finale: Then he had the idea to use his mechanical arm to gently grab the block and bring it back up.

camion da lavoro.text:
Rusty was a strong, red work truck. He lived at the playground, among the many children who used him to play. Rusty loved his job, even though it was just to make others have fun. One afternoon, while lying next to the sandbox, he heard a quiet sob.

A little teddy bear, named Biscuit, had fallen into the pond! Biscuit was floating on the surface of the water, and no one could reach him. Rusty rolled to the edge, but it was too far. His wheels didn't reach the water.

Rusty thought quickly. “I have to do something!” he said to himself. Using his tires, he started to make small sand stairs towards the pond. It was hard work! But the stairs were too wobbly and risked collapsing with every movement.

Rusty took control of the situation. He focused. He started to lift his tires, pointing them upwards. He made smaller, stronger steps, much taller! But it wasn’t enough to reach Biscuit.

Then, with a strong pull of his hook, Rusty pulled with all his strength. The hook hit the water and Biscuit was pulled out! Rusty brought the teddy bear back to his place among the toys. A little cat smiled from far away.

Rusty felt happy and satisfied. He had solved the problem, despite the difficulties. The sun was setting at the playground, and Rusty continued to do his job, ready for any new challenge. No matter how difficult it is, you must never lose hope.

plan.problema: A small teddy bear fell into the pond and Rusty couldn't reach it.
plan.svolta: Rusty made some steps with his tires to get higher, but they were too wobbly!
plan.finale: With a strong blow of his shovel, Rusty pulled the bear out of the water and brought it back to its place.

camion da lavoro.text:
Ruggine was a very strong work truck. He lived at the playground, under the shade of the big oak tree. He was always ready for action, but that day he seemed a little sad. The children’s tower blocks were scattered everywhere! They were yellow, red, and blue, and no one was picking them up. The towers seemed too big to rebuild.

Ruggine felt helpless. “We need to do something,” he thought. So, he used his helper arm, the biggest and sturdiest one. He started to collect the biggest blocks, one at a time. He carefully carried them towards the tallest tower. It was a tower made of red and white blocks and it looked a little abandoned.

Ruggine made “vroooom” as he moved, bringing the blocks little by little. One block, then another, and another! The children were watching him with curiosity. Then, a boy smiled. He picked up a yellow block and put it on the tower. Another boy picked up a blue block and added it.

Ruggine kept working, helped by the children who were now collecting the blocks with him. They laughed as they built the tower taller and taller. It was a fun job! Ruggine felt happy. He realized that helping others is wonderful.

When the tower was finally finished, all the children were happy. Ruggine stopped next to the tower and watched the children playing together, laughing and building. He realized that working together makes everything more fun.

plan.problema: The building blocks of the children’s towers were scattered everywhere and no one seemed to want to collect them.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his auxiliary arm to group the larger blocks and then he carried them one by one to the tallest tower.
plan.finale: The children, seeing the truck helping, began to collect the blocks and build the tower together with Rust, laughing happily.

camion da lavoro.text:
Camionetto was a very strong work truck. He loved to play in the playground. Every day he returned to his favorite spot near the sand tower. One day, while zooming along happily, he tripped into a muddy puddle. Suddenly he got stuck! He couldn't move anymore. It was really awful to be stuck and not be able to go home.

A little teddy bear, Leo, watched him with concern. “Camionetto, what’s happening?” Leo asked. Camionetto tried to turn around, but his wheels got stuck in the mud. It was really difficult! Then he had an idea: “If I move my back wheels,” he thought, “maybe I can get free!”

Camionetto started to move his back wheels with all his might. But instead of clearing the mud, he spun around and rolled further and further away! It was frustrating. Camionetto felt a little sad. But he didn’t give up. He focused all his strength and tried to make a little effort.

With one final, big push, he finally unlocked the wheels. Camionetto moved slowly but with determination and returned to his favorite spot near the sand tower. He was happy to be home again. Leo greeted him with a smile. Camionetto knew that even if things seem difficult, a little determination can make all the difference.

plan.problema: The truck got stuck in the mud and couldn’t get back to its place!
plan.svolta: It decided to use its back wheels to sweep away the mud, but it only made it roll further.
plan.finale: With a lot of effort and a little push, it finally managed to free itself and return to its favorite corner.

camion dei pompieri.text:
Fireman Red was a very brave fire truck.
He lived in Rose Park and was always ready for action.
He loved to run through the meadows and make friends with all the park’s residents.
One day, Fireman Red heard a sad cry.

He went to the meadow where the roses lived.
The roses were very sad.
All of them had lost their leaves!
They seemed really desperate.
“What’s wrong?” asked Fireman Red to the roses.
“We look so ugly without our leaves!” they replied in a faint voice.

Fireman Red immediately thought of what to do.
He used his powerful water jet to gently wet the roses.
But the water didn’t do anything!
The roses remained sad and wet.
Then, Fireman Red had another idea.
He raised his ladder and began to collect the fallen leaves.

With great care, he picked up one leaf after another and gently placed them on the rose branches.
The roses smiled right away!
Their petals shone with joy.
A little squirrel, who was watching the scene, jumped happily.
Fireman Red was happy.
He had helped his friends. 

Fireman Red continued to work with his ladder until all the roses had their leaves back.
The roses thanked the brave fire truck.
They felt beautiful and happy again.
Fireman Red rested a little under a tree, satisfied with his help.
A smile lit up his red body.
Helping your friends is always a great thing to do.

plan.problema: A group of flowers had lost their leaves and looked very sad.
plan.svolta: Firefighter Red, with his powerful water jet, gently sprayed the flowers, but only wet them!
plan.finale: Then, using his ladder, he collected the fallen leaves and gently placed them on the flowers’ branches, which immediately smiled.

camion dei pompieri.text:
Romeo was a very special fire truck. He lived in the Flower Garden and loved to play there. He was bright red and had a big, powerful scoop. Romeo moved carefully among the roses and geraniums, always ready for action.

One day, Romeo noticed something strange. A group of colorful flowers – yellow tulips, white daisies, and red poppies – lay on the sidewalk. Their petals were closed and still! It seemed like they couldn’t open them anymore.

Romeo immediately thought about what to do. “I must help them!” he exclaimed, and began to spray water from his hoses. He aimed the spray at the tulips, then at the daisies, and finally at the poppies. But every time Romeo sprayed, the flowers ran even further away! They were confused and scared.

Romeo stopped for a moment to think. What was wrong? Then he had an idea. Slowly, with his scoop, he began to gently stroke the petals of the flowers. He passed the scoop over every tulip, every daisy, every poppy.

And voilà! The flowers woke up. They smiled and slowly began to open their colorful petals. The Flower Garden was full of beauty again. Romeo felt happy and satisfied. He had learned that sometimes, the best way to solve a problem is with patience. 

After that day, Romeo continued to play in the Flower Garden, knowing that even the most beautiful roses need the right time to bloom.

plan.problema: A group of colorful flowers had fallen asleep on the pavement, unable to open their petals!
plan.svolta: Romeo tried to spray water on the flowers with his hose, but he only made them run away even further!
plan.finale: Romeo realized that he needed to gently stroke them with his nozzle and, voilà, the flowers woke up smiling.

camion dei pompieri.text:
Firefighter Rosso was a very active fire truck. He loved to play at the playground. His wheels turned quickly and his siren sounded loud. Today, at the playground, there was a boy playing with a red ball.

Suddenly, the boy noticed a problem. The ball was stuck at the top of the swing! No one could reach it because it was too high. The boy was upset. Firefighter Rosso felt his frustration and decided to help.

Firefighter Rosso activated his telescopic ladder. The ladder extended upwards, pointing right at the ball. But… it slipped! The ladder was a little unstable and Firefighter Rosso rolled down, landing on the ground with a thump.

A little dog, Leo, watched the scene closely. Leo barked happily seeing Firefighter Rosso in trouble. Then, Firefighter Rosso had an idea! He concentrated all his strength and jumped up, just like a superhero. With a happy jump, he grabbed the red ball!

Firefighter Rosso rolled the ball to the boy who was watching him. The boy smiled with joy. Firefighter Rosso felt proud of his help. He had solved the problem with effort and determination. 
His ladder was a little dented, but Firefighter Rosso knew that even small efforts can lead to big results.

plan.problema: The ball was stuck at the top of the swing and no one could get it down!
plan.svolta: Firefighter Red activated his telescopic ladder to reach the ball, but he slid down!
plan.finale: With a happy jump, Firefighter Red grabbed the ball and rolled it to the surprised boy.

camion dei pompieri.text:
Rosso Bravo was a very active fire truck. He loved to play at the playground, especially when there was something to do. Today, the playground was full of children laughing and playing. Rosso Bravo watched everything with his bright lights.

Suddenly, he heard someone crying. He went closer and saw a red balloon, tied to the highest swing in the playground. The balloon swayed slowly, but it didn't come down. It was stuck at the top! A sad little boy was watching the balloon.

Rosso Bravo went to the swing. He tried to use his telescopic arm to reach the balloon, but it was too far away. Every time he tried to grab it, the balloon slipped away, higher and higher. Rosso Bravo was having a hard time staying calm.

A little rabbit, Pipistrello, came up to Rosso Bravo. “Maybe you could use your powerful water pump?” Pipistrello suggested.

Rosso Bravo thought for a moment. Then, he turned on his powerful water pump. He created a gentle stream of water that softly hit the balloon. The water slowly brought it down. The balloon slid down, until it touched the ground.

The boy smiled and took his balloon back. Rosso Bravo felt happy. He had solved the problem with patience and a little bit of water. Rosso Bravo continued to play at the playground, knowing that even difficult things can be overcome with calmness. Patience always helps to find the right solution.

plan.problema: A balloon was swinging and got stuck at the top of the swing!
plan.svolta: Rosso Bravo tried to use his telescopic arm, but the balloon was too far away and slipping away.
plan.finale: So, Rosso Bravo used his powerful water pump to create a gentle jet that brought the balloon back!

camion dei pompieri.text:
Fireman Red was a very active fire truck. He loved to run in the playground. Today there was a group of children playing on a bouncy castle. Colorful balls were flying everywhere. Suddenly, one red ball fell into the pond! Then five more fell in. No one could get them back.

Fireman Red felt the children’s frustration. “Oh no!” he said. “I have to do something!” He walked towards the pond. His ladder slowly extended towards the water. Fireman Red was very careful. He took one ball at a time, with great calmness. It was a slow job, but an important one.

Sofia, a little girl playing in the playground, watched Fireman Red carefully. “You are very good!” she said. Fireman Red continued to work. Using his ladder and his strength, he retrieved all the balls from the pond. One by one, he brought them back to the group of children.

Finally, all the balls were back. The children laughed happily. They started bouncing again, using the balls that Fireman Red had saved. Fireman Red stopped for a moment, satisfied with his work. Patience and attention had made all the difference. The balls were ready for more fun.

plan.problema: The balls are finished in the pond and no one can get them!
plan.svolta: Firefighter Red climbs with his ladder into the water and, carefully, he recovers one by one the balls.
plan.finale: All the balls have come back, happy and ready for a new game!

camion dei pompieri.text:
I am Rocco, a red fire engine! I’m at the playground and I love to run among the children. Today there’s a big commotion, lots of laughter and shouts. I see Leo, a boy with a bright yellow balloon. The balloon floats high in the sky, right above the tallest tree in the park.

Suddenly, the wind blows hard and… puff! The balloon flies away and gets caught in the branches of the tree. Leo is very sad. He tries to reach it, but it’s too far away. “Oh no!” cries Leo.

I, Rocco, start my engine and try to get closer to the tree. I try to climb it with my wheels, but the tree is too slippery. I slide down and end up rolling across the lawn! I feel a little unwell.

“Siren!” I shout loudly. My siren sounds loud and clear. Some children come closer. They are Marco, Sofia, and Davide. They see Rocco in trouble and understand the problem with the balloon. Together, with ropes and sticks, they manage to reach the balloon and bring it back to Leo!

Leo is very happy. He smiles and thanks everyone. Rocco feels proud to have helped. All the children laugh and play together at the playground. 

They understand that even a fire engine can be useful for solving problems, especially when there are many friends ready to help. Working together makes everything easier.

plan.problema: Leo’s balloon ended up at the top of the tallest tree!
plan.svolta: Rocco tried to climb the tree, but it was too slippery and he fell down.
plan.finale: Then he called for help with his siren, and the children in the park helped to retrieve the balloon!

camion dei pompieri.text:
Rocco was a very special fire truck. He lived in the playground and loved making new friends. He was bright red and had a big siren that sounded when he moved. Today the sun was shining brightly and the children were playing happily. Rocco watched everything, happy to be there.

Suddenly, he heard a little cry. “Help!” he shouted. Rocco went closer and saw a red balloon, hanging from a tree. A little squirrel, called Nastro, was under the tree and he looked very scared of the balloon. It was too high for him!

Rocco thought quickly. “I must do something!” he said. He tried to use his hose, pointing the water towards the balloon. But the water made the balloon fly even higher! Nastro got even more scared and jumped away.

Rocco didn’t give up. He remembered his ladder. It was a little heavy, but that’s exactly what he needed. Very carefully, Rocco extended the ladder upwards. Slowly, carefully, he reached the balloon. He gently took the string and untied it. The balloon floated down to the ground.

Nastro ran back immediately, running towards Rocco and jumping happily. He thanked Rocco with little chirps. Rocco felt very happy to have helped his new friend. 

Rocco understood that sometimes you have to wait a little while to find the right solution. And so, the fire truck continued to watch the playground, ready to help anyone who needed it.

plan.problema: A balloon was hanging from the trees and a little squirrel looked scared!
plan.svolta: Rocco tried to use his hose to make the balloon fall, but the water made it fly even higher!
plan.finale: Rocco used his ladder to reach the balloon and gently untied it, making the squirrel smile.

camion dei pompieri.text:
Firefighter Rosso was a very brave fire truck. He lived at the playground. He was always ready for action! That day there were lots of children playing on the bouncy castle and running around. Firefighter Rosso watched everything with his bright headlights.

Suddenly, a little girl shouted: “Oh no! The balloons have flown away!” The colorful balloons were attached to the playground tower. The strong wind had made them fall and now they were stuck in the tallest trees. Everyone wanted to help them get back up.

Firefighter Rosso moved quickly. He tried to use his telescopic arm to grab the balloons, but they were too far away. The balloons slipped away every time Firefighter Rosso tried to reach them. It was frustrating! A little bird was sitting on a branch nearby and watching Firefighter Rosso.

Then, Firefighter Rosso had a brilliant idea. “Wait!” he thought. He took his ladder and slowly extended it upwards. The ladder reached right next to the balloons. Carefully, Firefighter Rosso lowered the ladder and the balloons gently slid to the ground.

All the children clapped! The balloons were safe back on the playground tower. Firefighter Rosso stopped for a moment to admire the children’s smiles. He was happy to have helped. His ladder, with patience and calmness, had found the right solution.

plan.problema: A group of balloons has flown away from the tower and are now stuck in the trees!
plan.svolta: Firefighter Red tried to use his telescopic arm to grab the balloons, but they were too high and slipped away.
plan.finale: Then he had the idea to use his ladder to reach the balloons and make them fall gently to the ground!

camion dei pompieri.text:
Rocco was a very special fire truck. He lived at the playground and loved to play there every day. He was bright red and had big wheels that went “beep beep” when he moved. One afternoon, Rocco heard a little cry.

“Help! Help!” he shouted. Rocco looked around and saw Leo, a white bunny, sitting under the swing. Leo was very scared. A red balloon was stuck at the top of the swing and Leo couldn’t reach it.

Rocco was brave. “Don’t worry, Leo!” he said. Then Rocco tried to use his hose to reach the balloon, but the water was so strong it flew away! Rocco landed to the side, a little confused.

“Oh no!” thought Rocco. He had to do something. Then Rocco used his long ladder and stretched it towards the balloon. Carefully, he reached that spot and freed the balloon. The balloon popped with a little sound.

Leo hopped with joy! “Thank you, Rocco!” said Leo. Rocco felt happy. He had helped a friend in need. Then, Rocco went back to his place at the playground. He was happy to have done a good thing. 

Rocco continued to play with the other toys at the playground, knowing that even small things can make a big difference when it comes to helping others.

plan.problema: A balloon was stuck at the top of the swing and a little rabbit, Leo, was very scared!
plan.svolta: Rocco tried to use his hose to reach the balloon, but the water made it fly away!
plan.finale: So Rocco used his long ladder to reach the balloon and freed Leo from the terror.
plan.morale: Helping others is always a good thing.

camion dei pompieri.text:
Rocco was a special fire truck. He lived in the Flower Garden and loved to help everyone. He was made of shiny metal and had a big siren that said “beep beep!”. One day, while the sun was shining bright, Rocco heard a little cry.

“Help! Help!” said a tiny voice. Rocco looked around and saw a blue butterfly, trapped in the geranium pot. Its wings were marked and the butterfly seemed very scared. “I must do something!” thought Rocco.

Rocco tried to use his hose, pointing the water towards the pot. He sprayed a strong jet of water! But the sprayed water pushed the butterfly even further away, making it fly away in a panic. Rocco felt a little sad.

A ladybug, Lila, approached shyly. “Maybe… maybe you should use something more gentle,” said Lila, looking at the pot. Rocco had an idea! He took a small olive branch with his paw and gently extended it towards the butterfly.

With a lot of patience, Rocco pushed the branch under the butterfly’s wings, freeing it from the pot’s grip. The blue butterfly hovered in the air for a moment, looked at Rocco and then flew away happily. 

Rocco felt very happy. He had been good at helping someone. The Flower Garden was quiet again. Rocco understood that even small actions can make a difference. Kindness always does good.

plan.problema: A butterfly was trapped in the geranium vase!
plan.svolta: Rocco tried to use his hose, but the sprayed water pushed the butterfly further away.
plan.finale: With patience and a small branch, Rocco gently freed the butterfly which flew away happily.

drone.text:
Zeta was a special drone. He flew in the playground and loved to explore every corner. He was small, white and blue, with colorful lights that shone when he turned. Zeta could also see everything thanks to his camera.

One day, while flying higher than usual, he got lost. The wind carried him far away among the slides and water games. Zeta had gone too far from his favorite place: a small corner under the biggest tree. And the problem was this: he couldn't find the sunbeam that perfectly lit him up. It was a special beam, warm and golden, that made him feel happy.

Zeta thought, “I have to do something!” He activated his camera and started to turn slowly. He was looking for familiar shapes, like the children playing or the swings. But he got lost among the green trees and the yellow grass. Instead, he noticed bright colors: red of a balloon, blue of a swing, green of the leaves. He decided to follow these colors!

He flew fast, turning around the trees, following every light and color. Then, suddenly, he saw something familiar: a sunbeam filtering through the leaves. The beam was exactly what he was looking for! Zeta flew straight towards it, until he found his perfect place, lit by the warm sun. He was happy and stopped there, watching the children play. Zeta had learned that even when you get lost, with a little patience and observation, you can always find what you want.

plan.problema: Zeta got lost during his exploration of the park and can't find his favorite sunbeam.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his camera to look for familiar shapes and chase the bright colors among the trees.
plan.finale: Zeta finally spotted the sunbeam, lighting up a small corner of the park and finding his perfect spot.

drone.text:
Zeta was a special drone. He could fly high and take beautiful photos. He was at the playground, a place full of children who were laughing and playing. Zeta loved watching them as he zoomed past the slides and bouncy castles.

Suddenly, Zeta realized he was all alone. He didn't hear the boy who had made him fly anymore. “Oh no,” thought Zeta. “I’m lost!” He tried to make a sound, a little beep to call him, but no one answered.

Zeta tried to fly up high, hoping to see his pilot in the crowd. He tried to concentrate, to be as high as possible. But a strong breeze took him and pushed him away, very far from the playground. Zeta found himself on a green field, much further than usual.

“I have to do something,” said Zeta. Then, he started to emit a flashing red signal, flashing faster and faster. The boy who had lost Zeta was playing near the swing. He saw the red glow and ran towards him. He found him immediately, happy to have Zeta back in his hands. 

Zeta was back at the playground, next to the boy who loved him. He was happy to be home again. Zeta’s patience had made all the difference.

plan.problema: Zeta got lost and couldn't find his pilot.
plan.svolta: He tried to fly high, hoping to see the boy, but the wind carried him away too quickly.
plan.finale: Zeta started emitting a red flashing signal that attracted the boy's attention, who recovered him happily.

drone.text:
Zeta was a special drone. He could fly high and fast in the playground. He had colorful lights and a little cheerful sound that he made when he moved. Zeta loved to explore the playground, but one morning something wasn't right. He had gotten stuck between the tall trees! The trees were so big and the branches stretched towards the sky. Zeta couldn't see his owner.

“Oh no!” said Zeta. “I need to find him!” He tried to fly forward, then backward, but it was all the same. Just green trees and leaves rustling in the wind. He was very scared.

Zeta decided to try something different. He flew towards the big sandcastle, the one with the tallest tower. He thought that maybe his owner had come closer. But when he arrived, he saw only swings! The swings were swinging up and down, a little too fast for Zeta.

“Maybe I need to go higher,” thought Zeta. He focused all his energy and started to climb, higher and higher. He flew over the big swing, the biggest of all. And then... he saw him! His owner was running happily, calling “Zeta! Zeta!”

His owner ran towards him and took him in his arms. Zeta was happy. He was back home. Zeta realized that waiting a little while and thinking carefully before acting made all the difference. Sometimes, the right time is the time needed to solve problems.

plan.problema: Zeta got lost among the tall trees and couldn't find his owner.
plan.svolta: He tried to go around the big castle, but he only saw more swings!
plan.finale: Zeta flew high above the giant swing and saw his owner calling him with joy.
