drone.text:
Zeta was a special drone. He had colorful wings and a little red light on his nose. He was at the playground, ready to have fun. He flew up and down, doing some light acrobatics. Suddenly, he noticed he was all alone. There was no Leo, the boy who had brought him there.

“Leo? Leo, where are you?” asked Zeta, but no one answered. He was lost! The playground seemed much bigger when there wasn’t a friend to guide him. He saw lots of children, but none of them recognized him. He could only hear the laughter and the sound of the swings, but he couldn’t find Leo.

Zeta tried to make some flashing signals, flashing his red light brighter. But no one saw him. The children were running too fast, too far away to notice. Zeta felt a little sad and scared.

Then he had an idea. He started to fly in smaller and smaller circles. His red light flashed frantically, trying to attract attention. Spin, spin, spin… And then, he saw him! Leo, with his eyes wide open, was following Zeta’s little shining circles.

“Zeta!” shouted Leo, running towards the drone. Zeta flew right to him, and together they went back to playing on the swings. Leo sat on the grass and smiled at Zeta. He was happy to have found him. 

Zeta realized that even when things seem difficult, with a little patience and a small signal, you can always find the way to come back together.

plan.problema: Zeta got lost and couldn't find his owner, Leo.
plan.svolta: Zeta tried to emit glowing signals but nobody saw him, so he started flying in smaller circles to attract attention.
plan.finale: Leo, following Zeta’s small glowing circles, found his drone friend and they returned to play together.
plan.morale: Patience is key to solving problems.

drone.text:
Zeta was a special drone. He flew in the playground, fast and agile. He loved zooming between the slides and the swings. One day, while taking a particularly tight turn, he found himself in a new place. He was surrounded by very tall trees. He couldn’t see his owner anymore.

Zeta was scared. He moved back and forth, but he didn’t recognize anything. He tried to call out, but no sound came from his little speaker. It was just a silence full of leaves.

Then, Zeta tried to do something different. He made a high sound, like a very loud whistle. Immediately, the birds answered! They chirped and flew away, but they didn’t help him find his friend. Just the birds.

Zeta stopped to think. Then, he remembered something: he had a camera! He pointed the camera down and started looking for movements among the branches of the trees. And there, in the green, he saw a boy. A boy with blonde hair who was calling him.

Zeta started flying in a circle around the boy, following his calls. The boy shouted: “Zeta! I’m here!” Zeta got closer and closer, until he gently landed on his hands. He was happy to be found. 

The sun was setting, painting the sky pink and orange. Zeta realized that you should never give up, even when things seem difficult. After so much patience, he had found the way to go home.

plan.problema: Zeta got lost among the tall trees and couldn't find his owner.
plan.svolta: He tried to make a high sound, but only the birds answered!
plan.finale: Zeta used her camera to spot the child who was looking for him and flew in a circle to approach.

drone.text:
Zeta was a special drone. He could fly high and see the whole playground. He was also able to talk! “Bip boop,” he said, to say hello to the other toys. But today Zeta felt lonely. He had gone too far from his friend Leo while exploring the swing. Now he couldn’t see him anymore.

“Leo? Leo!” shouted Zeta, but the wind carried away his words. The playground was full of children laughing and playing. The slides were colorful, and the sand in the play area was warm. But Zeta felt lost. He didn’t know where Leo was.

Zeta tried to fly in a circle, hoping to see his friend among the tall trees. The view was too confusing: green leaves and branches waving. He also heard the children’s laughter, but he couldn’t figure out where Leo was. It was frustrating!

Suddenly, a group of little birds landed on his body. “Bip boop,” said Zeta, hoping they understood his problem. The birds did a few circles and then pointed with their beaks towards the fountain. 

Zeta followed the birds and suddenly he saw Leo! He was sitting near the inflatable castle and he called out: “Zeta! Zeta!”. Leo ran to hug him. Zeta was happy to be found. The birds flew away, saying “Chip chip!”. 

It was nice to be with his friend again. Zeta understood that sometimes, even when you are lost, someone can help you find your way. A little help can make a big difference.

plan.problema: Zeta got lost and couldn't find his owner, Leo.
plan.svolta: He tried to fly in a circle, but the view was too confusing with the tall trees and the children's laughter.
plan.finale: Thanks to a group of little birds who guided him, Zeta saw Leo calling him among the games.

drone.text:
Volante was a special drone. He loved to fly in the playground. He had colorful lights that shone when he moved. It was his favorite ray of light! But one day, Volante got lost. He couldn’t find it anymore. He felt a little sad.

Volante started to spin around the castle tower. Then he flew near the swing. He made a few circles above the Tibetan bridge. But there was no ray of light! Only dry leaves were falling from the trees. Volante felt more and more confused.

“I need to find something to help me,” thought Volante. So, he flew towards the fountain. There he met a duck shell named Pip. Pip knew the playground like the back of his hand. “I heard that your ray of light is near the old bench,” he said. “I saw you shining weakly while you were telling me a story.”

Volante followed Pip’s instructions and flew towards the bench. And there it was! His ray of light was there, right under the sun. It started to shine brightly, brighter than ever. Volante felt happy. 

Thanks to Pip’s help, Volante found his ray of light. From that day on, Volante always continued to explore the playground with courage and determination. Perseverance made all the difference.

plan.problema: Flyer has lost his favorite ray of light and can't find it.
plan.svolta: He tried to go around the swing, but all he saw were leaves falling from the trees!
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a duck shell he knew, Flyer shone brightly again.

drone.text:
Zefiro was a special drone. He could fly high and see the whole playground. He was full of energy and excitement. He loved exploring every corner, but this time he got lost. Zefiro was among the tallest slides in the world! They were so big that he seemed like a tiny flying insect.

“Oh no!” said Zefiro, spinning around to get his bearings. “I can’t find my landing spot. It’s everywhere!” He tried to fly forward, then backward. But the slides were too high and the playground was too vast. Zefiro felt a little scared.

Then he had an idea. Zefiro had a camera! He pointed it down and started filming. He was looking for something familiar, something he remembered. He saw a piece of green grass and a small giant jar full of candies. It was the lawn next to the jar!

Zefiro followed the image with his camera. He flew slowly, looking for that view. The wind pushed him here and there, but Zefiro didn’t give up. His camera kept pointing towards the giant jar.

Finally, Zefiro landed gently right next to the lawn. He saw lots of children laughing and playing. He was happy to be back in the right place. Zefiro understood that even when things seem difficult, with a little patience you can always find the solution.

plan.problema: Zephyr got lost among the very tall slides and couldn't find his landing spot anymore.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his camera to look for a familiar image of the lawn near the giant jar.
plan.finale: Zephyr followed the image and landed softly right next to the lawn, surprised by the sight of the children laughing.
plan.morale: Patience helps to find the solution.

drone.text:
Zeta was a special drone. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and sweet smells. Zeta could fly high and low, spin around himself, and even do little acrobatics. He was the garden’s favorite drone.

One day, Zeta was exploring among the red roses and yellow tulips. He was looking for his favorite sunbeam, the one that warmed him just as it came near. But the flowers were so many and so tall! Zeta got lost. He couldn’t find the sun anymore. He was sad and a little scared.

Zeta tried to spin around, hoping to see the sunbeam. He spun fast, he spun slow, but only confused the white daisies. The daisies moved away, puzzled, while Zeta kept spinning without success. He was frustrated!

Suddenly, a gentle breeze lifted him up. The wind pushed Zeta forward, among the fragrant flowers. And then... Zeta saw a busy bee collecting pollen from the flowers. The bee came close to Zeta and gently carried him towards the sunlight.

Zeta found his favorite sunbeam again. He felt it warming his little blades. He was happy! The secret garden seemed even more beautiful when Zeta was near the sun. 

The wind whispered among the flowers, and Zeta understood that sometimes, even if you get angry, waiting a little while can lead to the right solution.

plan.problema: Zeta got lost among the flowers and couldn't find his favorite sunbeam anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to spin around, but only got the daisies confused!
plan.finale: A puff of wind pushed him towards a busy bee who brought him closer to the sun.

drone.text:
Zeta was a special drone. He could fly high and low, make spirals, and even smile thanks to the colorful lights on his body. He was at the playground, ready for fun. But then… he got lost! Zeta found himself in the middle of a maze of swings that were swaying and slides that were calling.

“Oh no!” said Zeta. “I don’t know where I am! Everything looks the same!” He tried to find his way around, spinning himself. He flew between the slides, approached the swings, but couldn’t find the exit. 

Zeta had an idea: “Maybe the bell helps me!” So he started following the sound of the bell of one of the rides. But the more he flew, the more confusing the maze became. The bell seemed to come from everywhere!

A boy was sitting in the sand and playing with a bucket. “Hello Zeta,” said the boy. “Try to look where the sun is shining!” 

Zeta followed the advice. The sunlight reflected on the wet sand, creating a clear line. Zeta flew along that line and… surprise! He saw the little house for children, his starting point. It was close!

Zeta landed happily in the little house, smiling. He had learned that sometimes, you just have to wait and look carefully to find the right way. Patience did good for Zeta.

plan.problema: Zeta got lost in the slide and swing maze!
plan.svolta: He tried to follow the sound of the bell, but he only got more confused.
plan.finale: Thanks to the sun reflecting on the sand, Zeta found the right path to return to the children’s house.
plan.morale: Patience helps to find the way.

elicottero telecomandato.text:
Vito was a remote-controlled helicopter. He lived in the Flower Garden and loved to fly. He was full of energy and wanted to play. One day, while zooming between the red tulips and the yellow roses, he noticed that Leo, his owner, was gone. 

Vito felt confused. The flowers were so tall! The white lily towered over him, and the bluebell almost swallowed him completely. He couldn’t see anything beyond the fragrant petals. “Leo? Leo!” he shouted, but no one answered. He was lost.

Vito was scared. He tried to move slowly, but it didn’t work. He always got stuck between the clumps of soil and the flower stems. He decided to try something different. He concentrated all his energy and spun faster, faster than ever. 

He flew in circles, speeding up and slowing down. The other flowers seemed like little colored spots. Suddenly, he saw a figure among the green leaves. It was Leo! Leo was calling him, smiling. Vito, with one last burst of speed, flew towards him.

Leo found him while he was joyfully circling around a giant lily and hugged him tightly. Vito was happy. He finally felt safe. From that day on, Vito continued to fly in the Flower Garden, always ready for new adventures. Perseverance, even when things seem difficult, can lead to wonderful results.

plan.problema: Vito got lost among the tall flowers and couldn't find his owner, Leo.
plan.svolta: He decided to try to turn faster, hoping to see a familiar figure among the plants.
plan.finale: Leo found him while he was spinning joyfully over a giant lily and hugged him tightly.

elicottero telecomandato.text:
I am Russo, a remote-controlled helicopter. I love flying to the playground! It’s my favorite place. Today the sun was shining bright and the air was cool. I moved back and forth, making circles in the blue sky. Suddenly I noticed something strange. A little teddy bear, my favorite, was missing!

“Oh no!” I shouted. “Where did you go, Bear?” I looked everywhere: under the sandbox, near the bouncy castle, but nothing. Bear wasn’t there anymore. 

I decided to fly higher, hoping to see him from up there. I lifted off the ground and looked around. But he was too far away! At first I moved quickly, but then I found myself bouncing between the trees, making a big mess. It was hard to control myself.

Suddenly I saw a colorful butterfly, named Lila. “Can I help you, Russo?” she asked. “I have a good view from here.” Together we looked everywhere in the playground. Finally, under the swing, I saw Bear! He was there, still, just like he loved it.

Lila helped me land gently and I flew back happily. Bear was safe with me. I did a circle around the playground to thank her. From that day on, Russo always flies carefully and remembers to look patiently for what he’s missing. Perseverance can lead to the discovery of the most precious things.

plan.problema: He’d lost his favorite helicopter, a little teddy bear.
plan.svolta: He tried to fly higher to look for it, but it was too far away and he found himself spinning among the trees.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a friendly butterfly, he found the teddy bear under a swing and was able to fly happily again.

elicottero telecomandato.text:
Raptor was a remote-controlled helicopter. He lived in the Flowery Garden, among the fragrant roses and colorful flowers. He was a very lively helicopter, he loved to fly up and down, doing acrobatics in the sky. One day, while he was making a particularly fast trip, he had found himself inside the rose maze! The roses were tall and fragrant, and Raptor couldn't find his way out anymore.

Everything around him was red. He couldn't understand where he was. He felt only small and lost among the thorny branches. A bee, Beatrice, flew nearby, but didn't know how to help him. “I don’t know how to get out!” Raptor shouted, trying to make a faster turn to see better.

Raptor thought about what to do. He decided to use his most powerful rotor! He began to spin very fast, producing a loud noise and a powerful wind. He wanted to create a current of air that would push him out of the maze. He spun faster and faster, hoping for a miracle.

The wind made him spin wildly, as fast as a tornado. Raptor found himself circling among the roses, but he couldn't get out. He was even more confused than before! The wind had made him spin and spin, without him being able to find his way out.

Raptor stopped, exhausted. He realized that maybe he had been too impulsive. He kept spinning, but he couldn't find the solution. Finally, he noticed that perseverance had helped him think creatively.

plan.problema: Raptor got lost in the rose maze!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his strongest rotor to create a strong wind and hope it would push him out of the maze.
plan.finale: The wind spun him around wildly, but Raptor found himself even more confused among the roses!
plan.morale: Perseverance helps you find your way.

elicottero telecomandato.text:

---

plan.finale: Thanks to his powerful beam, a boy saw Ray Blue and brought him to safety.

elicottero telecomandato.text:
I am Russo, a remote-controlled helicopter. I live in the playground. I love to fly and do tricks! But today I’m not happy. Something very important is missing. I always had a little teddy bear attached to my main rotor. It was my favorite companion. Suddenly, I saw it disappear!

I looked around. The slides, the rope bridges, the colorful sand… there was no more teddy bear. I was desperate. “I have to find it!” I shouted, but no one answered me. Only the wind blowing through the trees.

I decided to try to fly higher. I pressed the button to go up and I went up, up, up! I wanted to see the teddy bear from above. But I was too fast! I got lost among the green leaves of the trees. It was difficult to orient myself.

Then I had an idea. I activated my powerful flashing light. A bright red beam that pulsed in the sky. And indeed, I saw it! The teddy bear was hanging from a high branch of a tree, right there!

I checked the controls and I made a perfect flight. I landed gently near the bear. I recovered it with a precise movement. I was so happy! I tied it back to my main rotor. 

The sun was setting in the playground, but Russo was content. He had found his friend and had shown how capable he was of flying. Perseverance, even for a remote-controlled helicopter, can lead to great results.

plan.problema: He had lost his favorite helicopter, a little teddy bear, which he always tied to the rotor.
plan.svolta: He tried to fly higher to try to see the bear, but he was too fast and got lost among the trees.
plan.finale: Thanks to his powerful flashing light, he spotted the bear hanging from a high branch, and he recovered it with a perfect flight.

elicottero telecomandato.text:
Russo was a remote-controlled helicopter. He lived in the Flower Garden, among red roses and tall sunflowers. Russo loved to fly, but that day it was very hot and his engine seemed a little weak. Suddenly, he realized he was completely alone. The flowers were so big and colorful that he couldn’t see where his pilot was.

“Oh no!” shouted Russo. “I can’t find Marco! I’m lost in the petals!” He looked around, spinning around, but everything was a sea of colors. He didn’t hear Marco’s voice, nor did he see him. He was very scared.

Russo thought quickly. He had to do something. He remembered that he had a small red light on his helicopter. He decided to turn it on and make it flash. Using the remote control, he moved up and down, trying to attract Marco’s attention. The red light pulsed frantically in the garden.

A little while later, a ray of sunshine hit Russo’s light. “Russo! I’m here!” he heard a distant voice. Marco was walking among the flowers, following the flashing glow of the helicopter.

Russo flew towards Marco and reached him right away. Together, they found themselves outside the Flower Garden, happy to be back home. Russo was happy to have found Marco thanks to his light. The pilot thanked his helicopter for its persistence. The light that had emitted, with patience and determination, had done the miracle.

plan.problema: Russo got lost among the tall flowers and couldn't find his pilot.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his helicopter to emit a flashing signal, hoping the pilot would see him.
plan.finale: The pilot, seeing the flashing light, found Russo and they both went home happily.

elicottero telecomandato.text:
Raggio Blu was a bright blue remote-controlled helicopter. He lived at the playground and loved to fly. Every day, Raggio Blu enjoyed zooming between the tall, tall trees. One afternoon, while circling above the sandcastle, something changed. Raggio Blu found himself completely surrounded by huge trees. He couldn’t see his owner anymore!

“Oh no!” said Raggio Blu with his metal voice. “I’m lost! I need to find Marco.” He tried to go forward, but it was too difficult. The trees were too tall and the branches blocked his flight. Raggio Blu tried to make a faster turn, hoping to attract Marco’s attention. Instead, with a sudden thump, he sent a flurry of colorful leaves flying!

Raggio Blu was frustrated. “It’s not working!” he thought. He tried to focus and control the remote control with more care. Then he had an idea. He tried to make one last turn, trying to be precise. With an effort, Raggio Blu executed a perfect circle! His helicopter gently bumped Marco’s red hat.

Marco turned around and smiled. “Raggio Blu!” he shouted happily. Raggio Blu was back home. He was happy to be with his friend. Raggio Blu’s persistence made all the difference.

elicottero telecomandato.text:
I am Russo, a remote-controlled helicopter. I’m here at the playground, and I love to fly! But today there’s a problem. There are lots of children playing, running, and laughing. I’ve gotten lost! I can’t see my pilot anymore. I feel lonely and a little scared.

I try to make some noise, but it’s hard. My rotors are spinning fast, but nobody hears me. The other helicopters make strange noises, but I don’t. I’m too small. 

I tried to make a loud sound with my rotors, hoping my pilot would recognize me. But only I scared some little birds that were flying around. The birds flew away, and I was even more alone.

I felt sad. I really wanted to go back, close to my pilot. I moved slowly on a bench, watching all the children play. I didn’t want to interrupt their fun, but I needed help.

Then, a little girl came closer. She was sitting on the swing and saw me. She smiled and said, “Look, a helicopter! How wonderful!” She reached out to take me. 

Thanks to the courage of my rotors, I caught her attention. The little girl picked me up and brought me back towards my pilot. My pilot hugged me happily to find me again. 

Now I’m back home, close to my pilot. It was a little strange day, but in the end, everything was okay. Sometimes, help comes from where you least expect it.

plan.problema: The Russo got lost among so many children and couldn’t find his pilot.
plan.svolta: He tried to make a loud sound with his propellers, but only scared some little birds.
plan.finale: Thanks to the courage of his propellers, he managed to attract the attention of a girl who brought him back.
plan.morale: Help comes from the most unexpected places.

elicottero telecomandato.text:
I am Russo, a remote-controlled helicopter. I live in the Flower Garden. I love to fly here so much. But today I’m not happy. There’s a big problem! Mrs. Gazzerini told me she’d lost my favorite flower. It was small, red, and beautiful. She had planted it just for me.

I started to turn around the yellow roses and the purple tulips. I made a lovely swirl among the white bellflowers. But I couldn’t find it! I was very worried. Mrs. Gazzerini said, “Don’t worry, Russo, you’ll find your flower!”

I decided to try to fly higher. I wanted to see the Flower Garden from above, maybe then I’d see the red flower. I pressed the remote control and started to go up, up, up! But then… I found myself spinning around the big apple tree. It was enormous!

I kept flying, using all my strength. My powerful engine made a big noise. Suddenly, look! I saw a little red dot among the tall grass of the lawn. It was the flower!

With great care, I lowered my rotor and gently carried the red flower to the lawn, near Mrs. Gazzerini. Mrs. Gazzerini was so happy to see it again.

Russo stopped for a moment, looked at the flower, and then started to make little circles in the air. He was happy to have solved the problem. Patience can lead to the right solution.

plan.problema: The little red flower that Mrs. Gazzerini had planted for him was lost.
plan.svolta: He tried to fly higher, hoping to see the flower from up there, but he found himself spinning around the big apple tree!
plan.finale: Thanks to his powerful engine, he finally spotted the flower and gently carried it into the meadow.

elicottero telecomandato.text:

formula 1.text:
Formula Rossa was a bright red Formula 1 car. She lived on the sand track, a beautiful place where cars could go super fast. Every day, Formula Rossa dreamed of having big races, but she didn't always succeed.

One afternoon, Formula Rossa found herself in a corner of the track. She was stuck! She didn't want to start, she was too shy to challenge other cars. It seemed like no one wanted to push her.

Formula Rossa tried to push herself with all her wheels. She spun and spun, but she didn't move. She stayed there, still, in her little corner. A little beetle, Leo, watched her curiously. 

“Don’t worry,” said Leo, “try to make little jumps!” Formula Rossa thought: “A jump? But I’m a racing car!” However, she followed Leo’s advice and made a small jump with her front wheels. 

Surprise! With a nice burst, Formula Rossa sped off at full speed! She zoomed along the track, leaving the sand behind and overcoming every obstacle. She was happy and ready for a big race. 

Formula Rossa realized that sometimes you have to be brave enough to try new things, even if they seem difficult. And with a little determination, you can always achieve your goals.

plan.problema: The Formula Rossa had gotten stuck in a corner of the track, too shy to speed!
plan.svolta: He tried to push himself with all his wheels, but nothing, he was still stuck.
plan.finale: Then he realized he needed to make small jumps, and with a great flash, he sped off at full speed!

formula 1.text:
Formula Rossa was a super-fast racing car. She loved to race on the sandy track. She was made of shiny red plastic and had big wheels that made beautiful tracks in the ground. Every day Formula Rossa prepared for a new race.

One afternoon, Formula Rossa started with energy. She ran fast along the straight track. Suddenly, something changed. The speed disappeared! Formula Rossa was stuck in the middle of the straight, far from the finish line. It was a really big problem.

Formula Rossa tried to push with her wheels, but she didn’t go anywhere. She just slid back into the sand. She was frustrated and a little sad. A little dog named Max came closer and said, "Come on, Formula Rossa, don’t give up!”

Formula Rossa thought a lot. She decided to do something different. She focused all her strength and tried to push with her wheels even stronger. Then, a bright ray of sunshine hit her engine. The light revealed a small crack hidden. With a little “click,” the engine restarted!

Formula Rossa started running super-fast, passing the finish line. She was happy and pleased. She had shown that even when things seem difficult, with courage and determination, you can always find a solution. The sun was setting, lighting up the golden sand of the track.

plan.problema: The Formula Rossa got stuck in the middle of the straight, too far from the finish line!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his tires to push himself forward with force, but he only slid backward!
plan.finale: Thanks to his courage and determination, a ray of sunshine illuminated a small crack in the engine, which restarted immediately!

formula 1.text:
Car Race was ready for the race. The indoor track was small but fast. Car Race loved to race there, around the cardboard pillars and between the colorful boxes. Today there was a special race!

Suddenly, Car Race found himself stuck in the straight. He couldn’t move! He was just standing still, with no chance to get back to the starting line. “Oh no!” thought Car Race. “I have to do something!”

He decided to go really fast around the last corner. He wanted to unlock the engine and get back in the race. But he was too fast! Car Race lost control. He ended up off the track, crashing into a pile of books. 

A little teddy bear, Bruno, came up to Car Race. “Don’t worry,” said Bruno. “Look, there’s a little space here.” Car Race used the bear as support and managed to find the road again. With an effort, he got back on the track and started running again.

The race continued and Car Race reached the finish line! He was happy he had done it. He had learned that even when things go wrong, you have to be brave. 

Car Race stopped for a moment, then started zooming around the indoor track. No matter how difficult it is, if you really believe it, you can always find the solution.

plan.problema: The Race Car got stuck on the straight and couldn’t get back to the start.
plan.svolta: He decided to go really fast around the last corner to get unstuck, but he lost control and ended up off the track!
plan.finale: Thanks to his courage, he found a small bump that helped him find the way and get back to the race.

formula 1.text:
Car Race was very happy. It was a super-fast sports car, made of red and black plastic. It loved to race around this big sandy track. The sand was warm and golden under the sun. Car Race ran fast, fast, fast!

One day, while it was approaching the tightest turn on the track, something unexpected happened. Car Race got stuck! Its wheels couldn't move. It was jammed! It couldn't run straight anymore.

Car Race tried to push itself with all its wheels. It pushed and pushed, but it was too stuck. The sand was very sticky and didn't want to let it go. “Oh no!” thought Car Race.

Then, it had an idea! Instead of pushing, it decided to go around the turn. It made small circles, slowly, but with determination. The sand moved a little, and Car Race started to move.

With one last effort, which made its wheels shake, Car Race sped off super-fast! It zoomed towards the finish line, cutting it by just a few millimeters! It was fantastic! Car Race was happy and proud of itself. 

The sand settled back in place, ready for a new race. After a while, the grains of sand seemed to say, “Sometimes, you just have to wait for the right moment.”

plan.problema: The race car got stuck in the tightest turn!
plan.svolta: He tried to push with all his wheels, but he was too stuck, so he decided to go around the turn.
plan.finale: With one last effort, the race car sped away and crossed the finish line!

formula 1.text:
Formula Rossa was a really fast racing car. She loved to race on the sandy track. The sand was warm and soft under her tires. Formula Rossa loved to feel the wind rushing through her wheels. She was ready for a great race!

Suddenly, Formula Rossa stopped. She was right in the middle of the tightest turn on the track. Her wheels were stuck in the sand. She couldn't move. “Oh no!” thought Formula Rossa. “I’m stuck!”

Formula Rossa tried to push herself with all her wheels. She pushed hard, turned the steering wheel, but nothing. She was still stuck. The sand was high around her and she couldn't go forward. A little beetle, Leo, came closer, curious. “What’s happening?” asked Leo.

Formula Rossa thought: “I have to do something!” She closed her eyes, imagined she was the fastest car in the world. Then, she made a big zoom with her engine! The engine roared and Formula Rossa sped off very quickly. She went around the turn and zoomed away, leaving Leo watching her go further and further.

Formula Rossa continued to race on the sandy track, fast and happy. Every time she met a little obstacle, she gave it her all to get past them. The sand was no longer a problem for Formula Rossa. 

Victory is always within reach of those who believe in themselves.

plan.problema: The Formula Rossa got stuck right in the middle of the turn!
plan.svolta: She tried to push with all her wheels, but nothing, she was still stuck.
plan.finale: Then she made a big surge with the engine and sped off, overtaking the obstacle!

formula 1.text:
Formula Rossa was a fantastic race car. It was made of shiny red plastic and had big, black wheels. It lived on the sand track, a place full of tight turns and long straightaways. Formula Rossa loved to race on that track.

One day, Formula Rossa was about to have its fastest race. It was coming to the final straight when... it stopped! It wouldn't go forward anymore. It was stuck right before the finish line. “Oh no!” thought Formula Rossa. “I’m stuck!”

A little turtle, Tito, who lived near the track, came up to Formula Rossa. “It looks like you need some help,” said Tito with his calm voice. “Try to accelerate really hard!” suggested Tito.

Formula Rossa thought: “Maybe he’s right.” It found courage and accelerated like never before. The racing tires warmed up quickly. Formula Rossa sped down the straightaway, very fast! The engine started working perfectly again.

With one last effort, Formula Rossa crossed the finish line. It was victorious! It did a little jump of joy and stopped for a moment, taking a deep breath. It had won the race thanks to its courage. Tito applauded with enthusiasm. 

Formula Rossa realized that even when things seem difficult, if you have the courage to try, you can always find a solution. It was a wonderful feeling and Formula Rossa knew that it would be even happier to race again.

plan.problema: The Formula Rossa stalled right before the final straight!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his crazy tires for a fast lap and unlock the engine.
plan.finale: The Formula Rossa passed the finish line victorious, celebrating with a little jump of joy.

formula 1.text:
F1 Racer was a super-fast racing car. He loved to race on the sand of the track. He was made of shiny metal and had big wheels that zoomed really fast. That day the sun was shining high in the sky and the sand was warm under his tires.

F1 Racer started with excitement, but in a moment he got stuck! The sand around him was high and it kept him prisoner. He couldn’t move anymore, he couldn’t get going again. He was very frustrated.

“Oh no!” exclaimed F1 Racer. He tried to push himself with all his wheels, spinning around himself. But only he got heavier in the sand. The more he spun, the more difficult it was to move. His speed disappeared.

Stumbling nearby was a little squirrel named Ribbon. Ribbon watched F1 Racer with curiosity. “Why are you in trouble?” asked Ribbon. F1 Racer explained his problem. Ribbon thought for a moment and then, with a strong hit of his tail, pushed F1 Racer!

The little push was enough. F1 Racer’s wheels moved and he finally started to race on the sand track. “Thank you, Ribbon!” shouted F1 Racer happily. He ran really fast to thank his friend. 

F1 Racer continued his race, smiling at the sight of the little squirrel watching him. The race had been even more fun with a friend ready to help. It was nice to have someone to share the excitement of racing with.

plan.problema: He got stuck in the deep sand and couldn’t get free.
plan.svolta: He tried to push himself with all his wheels, but only got heavier.
plan.finale: A little squirrel gave him a push with his tail and he got back on track!

formula 1.text:
Formula Rossa was a super-fast racing car. She lived on the sand track, a place full of curves and sunshine. Formula Rossa loved to race! She loved to feel the sand under her wheels and see the wind between her tires. That day, she wanted to have a special race.

But then, something bad happened. Formula Rossa stopped right in the middle of a curve! She couldn't turn anymore. Her wheels were stuck and wouldn't move. She was very frustrated. “Oh no!” she exclaimed. “I can’t do the curves anymore!”

Formula Rossa tried to push with all her wheels. She made a big effort, but she kept going straight, straight, straight! She couldn't change direction. A little squirrel, Leo, watched her curiously. 

“Maybe,” thought Formula Rossa, “I need to do something different.” Then she understood! She took the steering wheel with her hands and started to turn it quickly. And unbelievably, Formula Rossa started to curve again! She was fast and agile on the sand track once more.

Formula Rossa raced happily all afternoon. She had learned an important lesson: even when a problem seems big, with calmness and strategy, you can always find the right solution. 

Winning isn’t important, but the pleasure of overcoming every difficulty is.

plan.problema: The Formula Rossa has stopped and can’t make any turns!
plan.svolta: He tried to push himself with all his wheels, but he kept going straight.
plan.finale: Then he discovered he needed to turn the steering wheel to turn quickly again!
plan.morale: With patience and strategy, he overcomes every obstacle.

formula 1.text:
Formula Rossa was a super-fast race car. She loved to race on the sandy track. Every day she tried to do the fastest race possible. She was a Formula 1 made of shiny red plastic and with wheels that hissed when she went fast.

One day, during an important race, something bad happened. Formula Rossa got stuck! She was standing in the middle of the sandy track, still as a statue. She didn’t understand why she couldn’t move. The engine was turning but the car didn’t go anywhere.

Formula Rossa tried to push herself with all her wheels. She gave gas and made the engine go faster and faster, but nothing! She just kept standing still. She was really frustrated.

Then, a small grain of sand landed right under one of her wheels. Formula Rossa saw it. Very carefully, she pushed the grain of sand. The sand made a little groove and, suddenly, the wheel could turn!

Formula Rossa sped up and raced to the finish line. She crossed the finish line with great joy! She was happy to have solved the problem with cleverness. 

The sand, small but important, had helped Formula Rossa find her way. With calmness and a little help, even the biggest challenges can be overcome.

plan.problema: The Formula Rossa got stuck in the middle of the race, not knowing how to start again!
plan.svolta: He tried to push with all his wheels, but only made the engine run faster!
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a small grain of sand that he found, the Formula Rossa was able to find its way and cross the finish line!
plan.morale: Patience and ingenuity solve every problem.

formula 1.text:
Formula Rossa was a very fast racing car. She loved to race on the sand of the track. She was made of shiny red plastic and had big, black wheels. Every day, Formula Rossa raced on the track, trying to make the fastest possible turn.

One afternoon, while speeding along, something went wrong. Formula Rossa got stuck! She couldn't move anymore. She was standing in the middle of the sand track. “Oh no!” said Formula Rossa, but she couldn't move.

She tried to speed up, pressing the imaginary pedal with all her might. But nothing, she didn't move! Then, she tried to turn the wheels with force, pushing and pulling. It was too difficult! The wheels were stuck in the sand. Formula Rossa started to feel a little scared.

Suddenly, she thought, “I can’t do anything unless I try!” She pressed the imaginary pedal with all her energy. This time, the wheels started to turn! Formula Rossa sped away faster than ever, leaving a trail of sand behind her. She was so happy!

A little crab, Leo, was watching her curiously. “Good job, Formula Rossa!” said Leo. “You showed you are brave.”

Formula Rossa continued to race on the track, speeding along and having a wonderful time. And as she raced, she remembered that even if things seem difficult, you always have to try! The sand was waiting for her, ready for another race.

plan.problema: The Formula Rossa got stuck in the middle of the track and can't move anymore!
plan.svolta: She tried to accelerate, but nothing! Then she tried to turn the wheels hard, but it was too difficult.
plan.finale: Thanks to her courage, the Formula Rossa was able to get over the panic and started speeding off very fast!

gru.text:
Gruetto was a big, red crane. He lived at the playground. Gruetto loved to move, lift things, and watch the children play. The playground was full of slides, swings, and a sandbox. But today there was a problem.

A bright yellow balloon had gotten lost. It had ended up at the top of the tallest tree in the park. No one could reach it with a rope or a branch. The children tried, but the tree was too tall and the balloon was too light to be grabbed.

Gruetto looked up. His mechanical arm moved slowly. Then, suddenly, Gruetto understood something. His bucket, that big shovel at the top, could be perfect! With great care, Gruetto raised his bucket to the balloon. He gently took the yellow balloon and slowly lowered it to the ground.

A child smiled seeing the balloon. He took it with a happy hug. “Thank you, Gruetto!” the child said.

Gruetto felt very happy. He had been patient and had used his strength to help. The sun set over the playground, painting the sky pink. Gruetto returned to moving quietly, ready to help always. Sometimes, patience is the most powerful weapon.

plan.problema: A balloon fell to the top of the tallest tree and no one can get it down.
plan.svolta: Gruetto, with his mechanical arm, noticed that he could use his scoop to gently collect the balloon.
plan.finale: The balloon was delivered to the smiling child, and Gruetto felt proud of his help.

gru.text:
Gruetto was a toy crane. He loved to be at the playground. He was a big and strong crane with a mechanical arm that moved up and down. The other children looked at him and laughed. Gruetto watched them play on the swings and in the sandcastles.

One day, a boy had flown a bright red balloon. The wind had been strong and the balloon had landed at the top of the tallest tree in the playground. No one could get it. The children pointed at the tree and got upset.

Gruetto wanted to help! With his mechanical arm, he climbed the tree. He tried to grab the balloon, but he slipped down with a thump! He overturned a pile of dry leaves that had fallen from the top of the tree. The leaves fell everywhere and made everything even more confusing.

A thoughtful boy, Leo, had an idea. “Gruetto,” he said, “use the rope! Gently pull the balloon towards us!” Gruetto understood right away. He took the rope that Leo had given him and, carefully and slowly, began to pull the balloon down. The balloon moved slowly and ended up right in the hands of the happy children.

They shouted with joy and thanked Gruetto for his help. Gruetto was happy. He had used his strength and his cleverness to solve a difficult problem. With his mechanical arm, Gruetto continued to move back and forth, ready to help always. Perseverance shows that even the biggest challenges can be overcome with patience and courage.

plan.problema: A balloon fell to the top of the tallest tree and nobody can get it down.
plan.svolta: Gruetto, with his mechanical arm, climbed the tree but slid down, overturning a pile of leaves!
plan.finale: Thanks to his ingenuity, Gruetto used a rope to gently pull the balloon down to the ground, where happy children took it.

gru.text:
Gruetto was a crane. A big, strong crane made of shiny metal and with a super powerful mechanical arm. He lived at the playground, near the lion tower and the giant swing. Gruetto loved watching the children play.

---

One day, he saw a problem. Lots of red, yellow, and blue balloons were stuck at the top of the swing. Nobody could reach them! The children were running and jumping, but the balloons stayed there, impossible to get. Gruetto felt the children’s frustration. He wanted to help.

---

Gruetto was brave. He stretched his mechanical arm towards the swing, trying to catch the balloons. But, oh no! The arm slipped away and the balloons flew even higher. Gruetto was a little disappointed.

---

Then he had an idea. “Wait!” thought Gruetto. He touched with his clamp that opened and closed, a small but effective one. Slowly, with great care, he took each balloon one at a time. He brought them down, one by one, returning them to the smiling children.

---

The children applauded Gruetto. They gave him big smiles and thanked the kind crane. Gruetto felt happy to have helped. It was nice to see the children happy.

plan.problema: The balloons are stuck at the top of the swing and no one can reach them!
plan.svolta: Gruetto found his courage, extended his mechanical arm, and tried to grab the balloons, but he slipped away!
plan.finale: He then thought of using the clamp to gently grab each balloon and return them to the happy children.
plan.morale: Helping others is always a good idea.

gru.text:
Gruetto was a toy crane. He lived in the playground. He was big and sturdy, with a very strong mechanical arm. Gruetto loved watching the children having fun. Today there were lots of happy children, running and laughing.

But Gruetto noticed a problem. Many balloons were stuck at the top of the swing. They were red, yellow, and blue, but nobody could get them down. The children tried with small steps, but the balloons slid away. He was worried about them!

Gruetto felt frustrated. He tried to throw a rope from his mechanical arm, hoping to reach the balloons. The wind took the rope and carried it away, towards the fountain. Gruetto frowned. He had to do something different!

He thought, he thought… then he had a great idea. Gruetto slowly extended his mechanical arm towards the swing. He moved his arm very calmly and carefully. With a gentle movement, he slid all the balloons down to the ground. The balloons fell gently to the ground.

The children ran to help him collect the balloons. They were laughing with joy. “Thank you Gruetto!” they shouted. Marco, a boy playing nearby, smiled seeing the crane working. 

Gruetto felt happy to have helped. He had learned that even if things seem difficult, with calmness and patience you always find a solution. And so, Gruetto continued to watch the children, ready to help when he needed to.

plan.problema: The balloons are stuck at the top of the swing and no one can reach them!
plan.svolta: Gruetto, frustrated, tried to throw a rope to reach the balloons, but the wind carried it away.
plan.finale: Then he had the idea to extend his mechanical arm and, with a gentle movement, slid all the balloons down to the ground where the children happily collected them.

gru.text:
Gruetto was a toy truck. He lived at the playground. He was big and strong, with a long chain and a sturdy arm. Gruetto loved his job: helping! But today there was a problem. A bright red balloon was stuck at the top of the swing. No one could reach it. The children tried, but the balloon was too high and it kept sliding away.

Gruetto felt helpless. He really wanted to help. “I have to do something!” thought Gruetto. He went towards the swing, looking at the balloon with his plastic eyes. A boy, Leo, was trying to reach the balloon with a stick, but it was too short.

Gruetto crouched under the swing and tried to gently lift the balloon, but he made it swing even more! Gruetto stopped right away. “I can’t do that,” he thought. He took a deep breath and began to move the chain very slowly. He lifted and lowered his arm calmly, trying not to scare the balloon.

The movement was slow, but steady. Gruetto focused only on the balloon. Slowly, slowly, the balloon began to slide down, guided by the gentle force of the chain. The boy Leo watched with wide eyes. 

Finally, the balloon reached the ground and Leo picked it up happily. Gruetto straightened up satisfied. He had solved the problem! Gruetto’s patience had made all the difference. Leo thanked Gruetto with a big smile. Gruetto knew that even the most difficult things can be done if you try and are patient.

plan.problema: A balloon was stuck at the top of the swing and no one could get it down.
plan.svolta: Gruetto, with his strong chain, huddled under the swing and tried to gently lift the balloon, but he made it swing even more!
plan.finale: Thanks to his patience and slow movement, Gruetto managed to slide the balloon down, where a happy child took it.

gru.text:
Gru Forte was a strong crane and a friend of the Flower Market. Every day, Gru Forte watched the bright colors of the flowers and listened to the laughter of the butterflies. He was a special toy, able to move and talk.

One morning, the Flower Market was in a mess. A huge sunflower, the biggest of all, had broken off its stem and lay on the ground, blocking the path of the beautiful flowers. Gru Forte felt the need to do something. “I must help!” he said with his metal but gentle voice.

Gru Forte tried to lift the sunflower with his arm, but it was too heavy and kept slipping away. The sunflower was enormous! A little hummingbird, Leo, landed on the sunflower and watched Gru Forte with his little black eyes. “It’s difficult,” said Leo.

Gru Forte thought about what to do. He saw strong willow branches near the market. “Maybe I can use these!” he exclaimed. Carefully, Gru Forte attached a branch to the sunflower and then another. Using the branches like ropes, he gently pulled the sunflower towards a safe meadow, with Leo pointing the way.

The sunflower was finally moved to a place where it could shine without blocking the flowers. Gru Forte felt proud of his work and Leo’s help. Returning to the Flower Market, Gru Forte realized that even difficult things become easier when you help each other.

plan.problema: A huge sunflower fell and blocks the path to the flowers!
plan.svolta: Gru Strong tried to lift the sunflower with his arm, but it was too heavy and slipping away!
plan.finale: Then Gru Strong found sturdy willow branches and used them as ropes to gently pull the sunflower to a safe meadow.

gru.text:
Gruetto was a toy crane. He lived at the playground. Gruetto loved to make “brum brum” and lift light things. Today there were lots of happy children. But there was a problem! A pile of colorful balloons were stuck at the top of the swing. No one could reach them. The children tried to jump, to run, but the balloons stayed there, high and slippery.

Gruetto felt a little frustrated. He wanted to help! He was a crane, he was made to lift! He crouched down near the slides. “I need to find a way,” thought Gruetto. Then, with a lot of effort, he made his way through the slides, moving slowly. He used his big arm to lift the balloons one at a time. One balloon, then another, and another.

Sofia, a girl with red pigtails, watched Gruetto in amazement. “You’re fantastic!” she shouted. The other children came closer, helping Gruetto to put the balloons on the ground. Everyone received a colorful balloon: red, yellow, blue, and green.

The children laughed happily. It was a party of colors and joy. Gruetto was happy. He had done a good thing! He stopped for a moment, satisfied with his work. Seeing the children so happy made him even happier. 

Gruetto understood that even when things seem difficult, if you work together with others, you can achieve wonderful results.

plan.problema: The balloons are stuck at the top of the swing and no one can reach them!
plan.svolta: Gruetto pushed his way between the slides, using his arm to lift the balloons a little bit at a time.
plan.finale: Finally, all the children could take a colorful balloon and were very happy.

gru.text:
Gruetto was a toy truck. He loved the playground! It was a sunny day and full of laughter. Gruetto moved slowly between the slides and the sandcastles. A boy was blowing up a bright red balloon. The wind started to blow hard, and… puff! The balloon flew away, ending up at the top of the tallest tree in the playground.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Gruetto. “That balloon is so beautiful! No one can reach it.” The children tried to climb on the swing to get to the tree, but it was too difficult. They tried to throw ropes, but the wind immediately tangled them up. Gruetto felt frustrated. He wanted to help.

Gruetto began to slowly approach the tree. His mechanical arm moved very carefully. He had to be gentle, the balloon could escape at any moment. Gruetto stopped right in front of the branch where the balloon was hanging. With one last effort, he stretched out his arm and tried to grab it.

Finally, with a well-placed hit, Gruetto managed to make the balloon fall gently into the happy hands of a girl. The girl smiled. “Thank you, Gruetto!” she said. Gruetto felt happy. He had solved the problem! 

Gruetto watched the girl running to show the balloon to her mom. Patience and attention can do miracles.

plan.problema: A balloon has fallen to the top of the tallest tree and nobody can get it down.
plan.svolta: Gruetto, using his strong arm, cautiously approaches the tree, trying to grab the balloon without letting it escape.
plan.finale: Finally, with a well-aimed hit, Gruetto manages to make the balloon fall gently into the happy hands of a little girl.

gru.text:
Gruetto the crane was at the Fiorario Market, full of colors and smells. Gruetto loved watching the sellers and buyers. Today there was a big commotion! People were running, some were shouting, and some children were laughing until their bellies hurt. Gruetto wanted to do something helpful.

Suddenly, he heard Mr. Rossi complain: “Oh no! Oh no! Where did I put it? My flower cart is gone!” Mr. Rossi was a kind seller and loved his colorful flowers. He was very worried.

Gruetto moved quickly. He tried to find the cart among the crowd, but it was hidden under a pile of baskets full of apples. Gruetto tried to lift the cart with his hook, but it was too heavy and slipped away without success. Mr. Rossi was despairing.

Gruetto thought for a while. Then he had an idea! He used his long, flexible rope, the one he used to pull the ropes of the games. He slowly and carefully unrolled it. Gently, he attached the rope to the edge of the cart. The cart moved upwards, slowly but surely.

Gruetto gently pushed the cart until it was back in its place, right in front of Mr. Rossi’s stall. Mr. Rossi smiled and thanked Gruetto with a big hug. “You’re fantastic!” he said. 

Gruetto felt happy to have helped. Gruetto’s patience had made the difference that day. Calmness can lead to the solution of the most complex problem.

plan.problema: Mr. Rossi had lost his flower cart in the market chaos!
plan.svolta: Gruetto tried to lift the cart with his clamp, but it was too heavy and slipping away.
plan.finale: Using his long and flexible rope, Gruetto managed to gently hook the cart and bring it back to its place, delighting Mr. Rossi.

gru.text:
Max was a strong, red crane. He lived at the local market, among fruit and vegetable stalls. Every day he helped Mr. Rossi move things. Max loved his job. Sometimes, he took care of transporting mushrooms from the field to the merchant’s stalls.

---

One day, Max had to collect some big mushrooms for Mr. Rossi. He approached the stall and saw a huge pile of red, juicy apples. He thought, “How lovely, I can help to tidy them up!” He started to stack the apples, but one of the piles was unstable. Suddenly, Max found himself trapped under the pile! The apples crushed him, he couldn't move. He was really in trouble.

---

Max felt frustrated. “Oh no!” he thought. He tried to use his arm to lift a cardboard that had fallen near. With great care, he lifted it and moved it to the side. Then, with a precise movement, he used his arm to gently push the apples to the side. The apples moved, Max was free!

---

Finally free from the pile, Max felt happy. Mr. Rossi was there waiting for him. Max delivered the mushrooms to the merchant with pride. Mr. Rossi smiled and said, “Good job Max, you’re always a great help!” Max was satisfied with his work. 

---

Max returned to lifting goods at the market, ready for new challenges. Max’s patience had helped him overcome a nice problem.

plan.problema: Max got stuck under a pile of apples, unable to reach the mushrooms he wanted to move.
plan.svolta: Frustrated, Max used his arm to gently lift a cardboard box and then, with a precise movement, moved the apples to the side.
plan.finale: Finally free, Max delivered the mushrooms to Mr. Rossi, satisfied with his work!

jetski.text:
Jet was a special jetski. He could talk and move in the Blue Lake. He really loved his dock near the old wooden dock. Every day, he waited to hear the sound of the boats passing by. It was the best place in the lake!

One afternoon, Jet found himself alone. He had lost his dock! “Oh no!” said Jet, with a little squeak. He looked everywhere, but he couldn’t find it. The Blue Lake seemed enormous and full of other boats. Jet was scared.

“I need to do something,” thought Jet. He decided to go faster! He wanted someone to see him and help him get back. Jet sped across the water, making a little foam. But the faster he went, the further he got away from the old dock.

A white seagull, named Argo, was flying above him. Argo had seen Jet running and wanted to help. “Wait!” shouted Argo, “I’ll take you back!” Jet followed the seagull, who gently circled around the lake. Argo guided him with small flights, showing him the right direction.

Finally, Jet saw the old dock! He was happy and stopped to rest there. Argo waved goodbye to Jet before flying away. Jet felt safe and happy. The Blue Lake seemed like a wonderful place. 
Jet realized that sometimes, even those you least expect can offer you the help you need.

plan.problema: Jet got lost from his favorite spot near the old pier.
plan.svolta: He decided to take a faster ride to attract the attention of passersby, but only then did he move further and further away from the pier.
plan.finale: A friendly seagull gently guided him to his familiar pier, and Jet rested happily.
plan.morale: Help can come from where you least expect it.

jetski.text:
Jetski Blue was a very happy jetski. He loved to run on the water of the Blue Lake. Every day, Jetski Blue enjoyed zooming and making water bubbles. One day, while running very fast, a strong wind pushed him far, too far.

Suddenly, Jetski Blue realized he was surrounded by many floating islands. They were small and round, some green, others white. He had become trapped in a big maze! Jetski Blue was very worried. He didn’t know how to get back to the Blue Lake.

“Oh no!” said Jetski Blue, “I’m lost!” He tried to move on his own, but the islands were too close and he got confused. He saw a little yellow bird sitting on one of the islands. The little bird looked at him curiously.

Jetski Blue had an idea. He used his powerful engine! He started the engine at full speed and began to go around each floating island. He spun fast, fast, fast! The sound of his engine echoed on the water.

Finally, after many turns, the sound of the engine helped Jetski Blue find the right way. He raced towards the exit of the maze and found the Blue Lake again. Jetski Blue promised not to go too far away from the lake. He was happy to be home. 

Jetski Blue understood that, even when things seem difficult, with a little courage and perseverance, you can always find your way out.

plan.problema: Jetski got lost in the maze of floating islands!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his powerful engine to make a fast ride around each island, hoping to find the way out.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the sound of his engine, he found the way home and promised not to go too far from the lake.

jetski.text:
Jet was a special jetski. He could talk and move in the Blue Lake. The lake had the bluest water in the world and was full of white water lilies. Jet loved to zoom across the water, but that morning he had had too much fun. He had made some fast and sudden turns. Now he didn’t remember where he was!

He had ended up in a maze of narrow and twisty canals. The walls were tall and green, with trees growing out of the water. Jet felt lost. “Oh no!” he cried. “I can’t get back to the beach!” He spun around and around, but he couldn’t figure out where he had been. The sun was starting to set on the horizon.

Suddenly, Jet heard a happy sound. It was the sound of fish giggling. The fish were swimming up and singing happily. “Let’s follow the giggles!” thought Jet. So he pushed towards that sound, zigzagging between the canals. The fish were leading him with their joyful giggles.

After a while, the sound got louder. And then… the shore! Jet finally reached the beach, happy to be back in a familiar place. A little seahorse, who had seen him along the way, waved to Jet with a flick of his fin.

Jet stopped for a moment to rest, ready for a new adventure in the Blue Lake. After so much effort, Jet realized that even when things seem difficult, if you don’t give up, you always find your way.

jetski.text:
Jetski Blu was a bright blue jetski. He lived in the Blue Lake, a beautiful lake full of reflections. Jetski Blu loved to zoom across the water, make pretty curves, and play with the waves. One day, while having fun racing fast, something went wrong. Jetski Blu found himself in a strange place: a maze of floating islands!

The islands were all different from each other, some big, some small. Some had green trees, others had sand houses. Jetski Blu was scared. He didn’t know how to get back home to the Blue Lake. He tried to turn around the islands, but he kept getting lost.

“I have to do something!” thought Jetski Blu. So he decided to use his powerful engine. He started making a fast circle around each island. He went around the sand houses, zoomed between the green trees, and looked carefully at every corner. 

A little yellow fish, named Leo, watched him curiously. “Maybe if you go straight, you’ll find the way!” Leo said. Jetski Blu thanked the little fish and kept circling fast.

Suddenly, a ray of sunshine hit Jetski Blu right in the middle. The ray was bright and clear, and it pointed in a precise direction. Jetski Blu followed the ray of sunshine and, incredibly, he finally found a path that took him out to sea.

Jetski Blu reached the Blue Lake, happy and content. He was home! Jetski Blu’s perseverance allowed him to overcome the difficulty. And so, you can also reach your goals if you never give up.

plan.problema: Jetski got lost in the maze of floating islands!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his powerful engine to take a fast ride on every island, hoping to find his way out.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to a ray of sunshine that guided him, he found the path to the open sea!

jetski.text:
Jetski was a very special jetski. He could talk and move on his own! He lived in the Blue Lake, a beautiful lake with crystal-clear water. Jetski loved to zoom across the water, but he also enjoyed exploring his canals sometimes.

One day, while he was playing, Jetski went too far into a network of narrow and winding canals. Suddenly, he realized he was lost! He couldn’t find his way back to the shore of the Blue Lake. The canals seemed like an endless maze. Jetski was scared, but he tried not to panic.

He thought about what to do. Then, he made a brave decision. He used his most powerful engine! The engine made a big noise and shot out a huge cloud of white, foamy bubbles. Jetski pushed straight towards the cloud, hoping it would guide him towards the sunlight.

The cloud of bubbles floated in the water. Jetski followed the bubbles until he was right by the beach. Suddenly, a group of seagulls flew nearby and pointed him in the right direction with their calls.

The seagulls led him to the shore of the Blue Lake. Jetski was happy to be back! He rested a little on the sand and then got ready for another adventure. Jetski realized that, even when things seem difficult, it’s important to be brave and never give up.

plan.problema: Jetski got lost in the maze of canals and couldn't find his way back to the shore.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his strongest engine to create a foam cloud that would guide him towards the sunlight.
plan.finale: The foam brought him right out to the beach where a group of seagulls showed him the way.
plan.morale: Never give up, even when things get difficult.

jetski.text:
Jet was a bright blue jetski. He lived at Azure Lake and loved to zoom across the water. Every day he played with his family: the green rowboats, Papa Rowboat, and Mama Rowboat. They were always together, happy to do circles on the lake.

One afternoon, Jet was chasing a shimmering reflection. He had so much fun going fast, but suddenly he realized he was all alone. He couldn’t see his family anymore! He was scared. “Oh no!” thought Jet. “I’m lost!”

Jet felt very sad. He tried to call the rowboats, but the wind was blowing too strong. He couldn’t hear them. Then, Jet decided to do something. He decided to follow the beam of sunlight. The sun was shining high in the sky and projecting a bright ray onto the water.

Jet pushed towards the shimmering light. The light was warm and inviting. He kept moving, guided by the sun. Suddenly, between the clouds of water vapor, Jet saw something! It was his family: the green rowboats were waiting for him with excitement.

“Jet!” shouted the rowboats. “We were so lost!” Jet quickly rushed over and joined his family. He was happy to be back home. From that day on, Jet learned to always listen to his parents’ instructions. It’s important to stay close when you’re having fun.

plan.problema: Jet got lost from his boat family and can’t find them.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the ray of sunshine to see if it led him to his friends.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the sparkling light, Jet saw his family waiting for him with excitement.

jetski.text:
Jetski Rosso was a very fast jetski. He lived at Lake Azure with lots of other floating toys. There were boats, rowboats, and even a big balloon. Jetski Rosso loved to zoom across the water and do tricks.

One day, after a big birthday party, Jetski Rosso found himself all alone. He couldn’t see his family anymore! He was scared. He didn’t know where they were. Lake Azure seemed very big all by itself. “Oh no!” thought Jetski Rosso. “I’m lost!”

Jetski Rosso desperately tried to find his friends. He tried to remember if he had run to the right or to the left, but he didn’t remember anything. It was all confusing.

Then he had an idea. He heard distant laughter. It was the laughter of children playing on the shore of Lake Azure. Jetski Rosso decided to follow the laughter. “Maybe they’ll bring me home!” he thought. He pushed himself with all his might in the water, trying to get closer to the laughter.

The children looked at him. They saw Jetski Rosso so sad and alone. They immediately understood what was happening. With great care, they pushed him towards the play area, where his floating family was waiting. The boat mom ran to hug him. The rowboat bounced happily, and even the balloon inflated with joy. Jetski Rosso was finally home. Everyone was happy to see him. 

The kindness of the children brought Jetski Rosso back where he belonged.

plan.problema: Jetski had lost his family of floating toys and didn't know how to find them.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the sound of the children's laughter watching him from the shore, hoping they would take him back.
plan.finale: Seeing Jetski so sad, the children gently pushed him towards the play area where his family waited joyfully.

jetski.text:

One day, Jet was having fun speeding across the water when, suddenly, he realized he was lost. He didn’t recognize the shores anymore. Everything looked the same: blue water and white clouds.

Jet tried to turn around, but he couldn’t find his way. He was scared. “Where have I ended up?” Jet thought, with a little mechanical hiccup. He tried to remember the path, but he had gotten confused. He didn’t understand how to get back to his favorite beach.

Suddenly, he heard noises. They were happy laughter. Jet approached cautiously and saw some children sitting on the lake shore. They were having a lot of fun throwing stones into the water. Jet had an idea! He decided to follow the sound of the laughter.

Jet moved towards the laughter, getting stronger and stronger. As he got closer, he also recognized the shape of the shore. It was exactly his beach shore! With renewed energy, Jet let the current carry him quickly home. Finally, he was home. Jet gave in to the current, happy to be back in his place. 

Jet realized that listening to your instincts can help you find the right way.

jetski.text:
Jet was a special jetski. He could talk and move in the Blue Lake. The lake was full of crystal-clear water and little fish that hopped between the water lilies. Jet loved the Blue Lake because that’s where his little house was.

One day, Jet was having fun zooming across the water. Suddenly, a wave surprised him and pushed him far away from the shore. When Jet realized he was alone, he understood that he was lost. He didn’t recognize anything anymore! He was very worried.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Jet. “I don’t know how to get back home! I’m completely lost.” He tried to turn around the lake, but everything looked the same. The mountains around him seemed enormous and the sun was high in the sky.

Jet decided to try something. He listened carefully. He heard a distant sound, a continuous noise. “Maybe it’s the sound of the waves,” he thought. “If I follow the waves, they will take me back to the shore!” Jet started to swim, trying to follow the sound of the water.

A white seagull was flying nearby. The seagull, who was called Leo, saw Jet in trouble and flew beside him. “I’ll take you!” said Leo. And with a fast flight, he brought him back to his corner of the Blue Lake, right where he had his little house.

Jet was happy! He rested a little on the sand and he felt very pleased. The lake seemed even more beautiful than before. Jet understood that even when things seem difficult, if you try your best, you always find the right way.

jetski.text:
Jet was a special jetski. He lived at Lake Azure and loved to zoom across the water. Every day he played at making slalom between the floating lily pads. Jet had a very important friend: a little pink seashell, which he often attached to his nose.

---

One morning, after a lovely ride, Jet noticed that the seashell was gone! “Oh no!” shouted Jet. “Where did you go?” He looked everywhere, under the waves and among the reeds. But the seashell had disappeared. Jet was very worried. He didn't want to be alone at Lake Azure.

---

Jet felt sad and a little lost. He decided then to zoom as fast as possible, making a loud whistle: “Yesiiii!” The whistle echoed across the water. Jet hoped the seashell could hear it. Nobody answered.

---

Suddenly, he heard a sound! “Jet! I’m here!” It was the seashell. Jet sped up even more and reached it in just a few seconds. They hugged happily.

---

The sun shone on Lake Azure and Jet was happy. He had found his friend thanks to his determination. Jet continued to zoom, knowing that even when things seem difficult, if you don’t give up, you always find the solution.

Rex was a shiny, red police car. He lived at the playground. Rex loved to make “vroooom” and use his siren. Today the sun was shining bright and the children were playing happily.

Suddenly, Rex heard a cry. It was Leo, a boy with teary eyes. “My red balloon! It fell into the pond!” said Leo. Rex quickly came closer. The red balloon was floating on the water. It was right there, near the fountain.

Rex decided to save the balloon. He turned on his siren as loud as he could and started moving towards the pond. But it was too far! And the water was freezing cold. Rex stopped, frustrated. He couldn’t reach the balloon by himself.

A girl named Sofia ran towards him. “Rex, we can help you!” said Sofia. The other children at the playground gathered around Rex. Together they thought of a solution. They found pieces of wood and built a small bridge.

With patience and teamwork, the bridge reached the edge of the pond. Rex, with his little paw, pushed the red balloon onto the shore. Leo was so happy! He thanked all the children and Rex. 

Rex stopped for a moment, satisfied. The other children were smiling together. It was wonderful to see so many friends helping each other. Rex knew he had done a good thing.

plan.svolta: Rex tried to reach the balloon with his siren, but it was too far and the water was too cold.
plan.finale: He called for help and together with the children in the park they built a small wooden bridge to get it back.

A boy, Leo, was sitting near Blitz with a big smile. Leo was holding a box full of red, yellow, and blue balloons. Suddenly, Leo’s smile disappeared. “Oh no!” he exclaimed. “My balloons are all scattered on the ground! I don’t know how they got there!”

Blitz went over to Leo. He started looking for the balloons everywhere: under the slides, behind the swings, and between the rocking chairs. But the balloons were everywhere! They were scattered on the lawn, trapped between the roots of the trees, and even on top of the slide. Blitz tried to pick them up with his little mechanical hands, but it was too difficult.

Then, Blitz had a brilliant idea! He used his powerful suction beam, the one he used to catch the bad guys in his games. He pointed the beam at the balloons and… puff! All the balloons gathered together, in order by color, in a big pile.

Blitz felt happy. Putting things in order was much easier and more fun! With the balloons in order, Leo could go back to playing with a smile. It was nice to see the happiness in the boy’s eyes. Everything was in its place, and that made everything perfect.

Rex stopped for a moment and took a deep breath. Then, with his horn, he started to call out to Bruno: “Bruno, Bruno, where are you?”. Carefully, Rex checked every corner of the maze. He looked under the swings, behind the boxes, inside the tunnels.

monster truck.text:
Rocco was a really special monster truck. He had huge tires and a shiny red body. He lived at the playground, and he loved to run on every surface. One day, Rocco found himself in front of the new slide. It was very tall and made of smooth wood.

“How wonderful!” thought Rocco, and he slid down the slide. But when he got to the bottom, he couldn’t move anymore! He was stuck. His wheels were stuck between the wooden planks. Rocco tried to turn, but nothing. He was really in trouble.

A little stone gnome, who lived near the playground, was watching him with concern. “Don’t give up, Rocco!” said the gnome.

Rocco thought for a while. Then he had an idea! He used his strong back leg and hit it hard against the side of the slide. “BOOM!” The wood shook. Rocco tried again, with even more force. “BOOM!” Another hit!

With one last, determined effort, Rocco hit the edge of the slide with all his power. A dull sound and then… Rocco was free! He roared with joy, full of energy. He zoomed quickly towards the swing, ready for a new adventure. He was having a wonderful time, without thinking about the problem he had had before. The race had begun and Rocco kept running happily.

Rocco was a super strong monster truck. He had big, black wheels and a shiny red hood. He loved to run in the playground, zooming between the slides and the water play areas. But today, something bad happened. Rocco got stuck! The mud was very deep, sticky, and gray. He couldn't move at all.

“Oh no!” Rocco shouted. “I’m stuck! I can’t get out!” A little bird was sitting on a nearby swing and watched Rocco with curiosity. Rocco tried to push, to jump, but the mud held him tight. It was really frustrating.

Rocco thought for a moment. Then he had an idea! “Use my tire!” he shouted. With strength, Rocco began to hit the mud with his huge tire. He hit it back and forth, digging a slow but safe path. The mud rose up, creating a little channel.

Rocco continued to work, driven by his determination. Every hit was stronger than the last. Finally, after a lot of effort, Rocco got past the last pile of mud! With a final, big screech of the wheels, Rocco found himself on the golden sand of the playground, warm and soft under his big wheels. He was free! Rocco had fun zooming on the sand, happy to have overcome the difficulty. Perseverance, even for a monster truck, can lead to victory.

One day, Ruggine decided to go on a more adventurous ride. He quickly raced towards the pile of sand near the kids’ tower. He tried to make a big jump, but he miscalculated! He found himself stuck, completely buried in the yellow sand.

Rusty was a bright red motorcycle. He lived in the playground and loved to zoom along the white track. Every day he tried to make beautiful curves, but he especially loved to feel the wind between his tires. One day, while running towards the top of the hill, something went wrong.



Rusty found himself trapped! He was stuck in a big pile of yellow sand. His wheels couldn't move. There was no way to get back on the track. Rusty was desperate.

He zoomed happily towards the track, feeling the wind again. The white track was waiting for him. Rusty kept running, faster than ever. He didn’t let a little trouble stop him from having fun.

Ranger was a bright red motorcycle. He loved to race in the playground. He was very fast and fun! One day, Ranger found himself going faster than usual. He wanted to explore every corner of the park. Suddenly, Ranger realized he was completely lost.

There were so many colorful slides, swings that banged, and wobbly Tibetan bridges. Ranger couldn't find his place among all those games! “Oh no!” thought Ranger. “I’m lost!” He tried to turn right, then left, but everything looked the same.

Ranger tried to shout for help, but no one could hear him. The children were laughing and having fun, but Ranger couldn't make himself heard. Then Ranger had an idea! He noticed that the children’s laughter was very loud. He decided to follow the sound of the laughter.

Ranger squeaked his tires on the playground ground. He followed the noise of the laughter, getting closer and closer. Finally, Ranger saw a big soccer field full of children playing soccer. The children saw Ranger and recognized him right away!

“Here you are, Ranger!” they shouted, all happy. Ranger was glad to be back with his friends. Ranger rejoined his fellow players, happy to have found his way back. Ranger understood that sometimes, when you get lost, all you need to do is follow a sound to find your way again.

It was the balloon! It was tied to a high branch of the tree. Ruggine pushed with all her might and managed to reach the balloon. She hugged him happily. The balloon was happy to see his friend again.

---

Ruggine and the red balloon stayed there, together, under the shade of the tree. It was nice to have a friend to play with all the time.

Muletto Rosso thought about it. He decided to try something different. “Maybe I can climb!” he exclaimed. He started moving his wheels faster, trying to grab onto the roots of the tree. The wheels squeaked against the bark and Muletto Rosso made his way slowly upwards.

It was tiring, but Muletto Rosso didn't give up. With one last effort, he managed to reach the green ball! He pushed it with his wheels and began to spin around the ball, making a lovely circle. Then, slowly, he went back towards the Flowery Garden.

Muletto Rosso stopped next to the ladybug, satisfied with his work. The Flowery Garden was happy again. Muletto Rosso realized that even when things seem difficult, with a little patience and effort, you can always find a solution.

Just when Red Tractor was about to give up, a gentle butterfly flew nearby. The butterfly had colorful wings and a sweet smile. It looked carefully at Red Tractor and, with a light touch of its wings, gently moved the grass around the tractor’s wheels.

Immediately, a small space was created! Red Tractor was able to free his wheels and to be free again to go around in the Flower Garden. He thanked the butterfly with a smile.

plan.finale: Finally, thanks to his strength and courage, he found the way to return to his place among the other playsets.

muletto.text:
