Muley was a very happy little truck. He loved to drive around in the Flower Garden. The garden was full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Muley loved to explore every corner, lifting stones and leaves with his bucket. Today the sun was shining brightly and Muley was having a wonderful time.

Suddenly, Muley bumped into a rose bush. It was a big bush and full of prickly branches. In a moment, Muley got stuck! He couldn't move anymore. He was just stuck between the branches. “Oh no!” said Muley, “I can’t turn around anymore!”

Muley thought he had to do something. He decided to use his bucket to gently lift the branches of the bush. He tried to push and pull, but only he scared a lot of butterflies! The butterflies flew away frightened. Muley was a little sad.

A little squirrel, named Cloud, noticed Muley’s difficulty. “Maybe you should make small movements,” suggested Cloud. Muley followed the advice. Slowly, with patience, he lifted and lowered his bucket. He removed one branch at a time, being careful not to get hurt.

Finally, after many attempts, Muley got free! He was free to drive around in the Flower Garden again. Muley continued his happy drive, happy to have overcome the obstacle. With a lot of determination, Muley had reached his goal. Perseverance always has a reward.

plan.problema: The forklift got stuck in the rose bush, and can’t go on its route anymore!
plan.svolta: It decided to use its bucket to gently lift the branches of the bush, but it only scared the butterflies.
plan.finale: With patience and small movements, it finally freed itself and resumed its happy route through the garden.

muletto.text:
Red Mule lived in the Flower Garden. He was a bright red mule and he loved to do his acrobatic tricks. Every day he tried to lift the big colorful flower pot that Mrs. Emilia had put there to make them shine in the sun.

One afternoon, Red Mule got to work. He tried to lift the pot, but… stuck! His big wheel was stuck in the soft ground. He couldn’t move anymore and the pot remained still. “Oh no!” thought Red Mule. “I can’t do my job!”

Mrs. Emilia, sitting on the swing, watched the problem. “Maybe if you try to go around the pot,” she suggested. Red Mule understood. He moved slowly, making his wheels roll on the green grass. He was looking for an angle, a point where he could find a strong branch to unlock his wheel.

That’s when he saw a small fallen tree right next to the pot. Red Mule approached carefully and used his strong arm to push the tree under the pot. With an effort, he managed to move his wheel! Finally, free from the ground, the flower pot could be lifted back to the sun.

The petals of the flowers lit up with a new and bright light. Red Mule felt happy and proud. He had shown that with lots of strength and determination, even difficulties can be overcome. After making the flowers shine, he rested satisfied.

plan.problema: The forklift got stuck in the ground and can’t lift the flower pot anymore!
plan.svolta: It decided to go around the pot, looking for an angle where it could find a beam to unlock it.
plan.finale: Thanks to its strength and determination, it finally managed to free itself and make the petals of the flowers shine!

muletto.text:
Muletto Leo loved Nonna Rosa’s garden. It was a place full of colorful flowers and soft grass. Muletto Leo loved to go around the lawn, lift up the stones, and wave with his wheel. Today he was especially excited because Nonna Rosa had put out some new flowers: fragrant roses!

Suddenly, while trying to pass near the rose bush, Muletto Leo got stuck! His big wheels were trapped between the thorny branches. He couldn't move anymore. He was right in the middle of the red and pink petals, a real disaster for a little truck!

Muletto Leo tried to push, to pull, to turn his wheel with all his might. But the bush was too narrow. The roses held him stuck. Nonna Rosa was picking tomatoes in the garden and heard Muletto Leo complaining.

“Oh, poor Leo!” exclaimed Nonna Rosa. She walked to the bush with a pair of scissors. With gentle movements, she cut the lower branches that held Muletto Leo’s wheels.

In an instant, Muletto Leo was free! He felt immediately lighter and happier. He lifted his wheel and started going around the garden, fast and content. The sun was shining and the scent of the roses was even stronger. Muletto Leo realized that sometimes, even when things seem difficult, with a little patience you can always find solutions.

plan.problema: Leo got stuck in the rose bush and can’t move anymore!
plan.svolta: He decided to spin the wheel with all his might, but the bush was too tight.
plan.finale: Grandma Rosa kindly freed Leo with a pair of scissors, and he happily went around the garden.

muletto.text:
Muley was a very strong little truck. He lived in the Flower Garden, among the red tulips and yellow daisies. He loved to drive around the field, lift up the stones, and make “brum brum.” One day, while he was having fun exploring, he made a mistake. He got stuck inside the rose bush!

It was a bush full of thorns and a strong, sweet smell. Muley couldn’t move anymore. He was trapped! He tried to pull himself back with his wheels, but nothing. The thorns hurt him, and he was frustrated. “Oh no!” said Muley, “I’m in a big mess!”

He decided to try to turn the steering wheel with more force, hoping to unlock his wheels. But only he got hurt even more! The thorns pricked him all over. He felt sad and a little scared.

Just at that moment, a gentle breeze began to blow in the Flower Garden. The wind lifted the leaves and gently pushed Muley. The air current pushed him out of the rose bush!

Muley found himself free and happy. He slowly moved away from the bush, making “brum brum” with joy. A red ladybug was hopping nearby, looking at him curiously, and then it went away. Muley realized that even a little help can make a difference when you’re in trouble.

plan.problema: The forklift got stuck in the rose bush and can't get out!
plan.svolta: He decided to try turning the steering wheel with more force, but only hurt himself even more!
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of the wind, which pushed him gently, the forklift finally managed to free himself from the bush.
plan.morale: Patience and help can solve any problem.

muletto.text:
Muletto was a very strong little donkey. He lived in Leo’s garden, among the roses and the green lawn. He loved to take his walks around the big apple tree. One day, while he was having fun rolling the red ball, something went wrong. His big arm sank into the ground! He was stuck, completely still.

“Oh no!” said Muletto. “I can’t pull the ball out anymore! It’s right here inside.” He tried to push with all his strength, but nothing. The ball stayed still, hidden in the dark hole. Leo came closer and looked at the donkey, puzzled. “Maybe if you try to pull harder,” said Leo.

Muletto pulled and pulled, but the ball didn’t move. Then, he thought for a moment. He noticed that there was a big lavender bush right next to the hole. “Wait!” shouted Muletto. “Maybe I can go around the hole and reach the ball with my arm!”

Muletto started to turn, faster and faster, going around the lavender bush. He stretched out his arm, made a huge effort, and finally… he grabbed it! With a big push, he pulled the red ball out of the ground.

Leo clapped: “Good job, Muletto!” Muletto stopped, satisfied. He rested for a moment, then he started his walks around the apple tree again. Every time he was near the hole, he remembered his adventure and knew that he could overcome any difficulty with a little determination.

plan.problema: The forklift got stuck in the ground and can’t pull the ball out anymore!
plan.svolta: He decided to go around the hole, looking for a way to reach the ball with his arm.
plan.finale: Thanks to his strength and perseverance, he finally managed to grab the ball and pull it out of the ground!

muletto.text:
Muletto Leo loved the Flower Garden very much. It was a garden full of colorful flowers and green grass where he could do a thousand things. Muletto Leo was a special little forklift, because he could talk! And he knew how to build beautiful wooden dollhouses.

One day, however, something went wrong. When Muletto Leo tried to build a house for Princess Sofia, he noticed that his tools were missing! There was no longer his hammer, there was no longer his small pincet, and not even his little chisel. He was desperate! Without the tools, he couldn't build the dollhouses.

Muletto Leo started to look everywhere in the Flower Garden. He looked under the red tulips, behind the yellow roses, and even inside the lavender bush. But none of his tools were anywhere.

Then, an idea popped into his mind! He saw a small blue bucket near the grass. “Maybe,” thought Muletto Leo, “I can use this bucket as a cart to carry the building blocks!” And so he started to fill the bucket with colorful building blocks and began to build the house for Princess Sofia.

Princess Sofia and the doll Marco watched in amazement. The houses were beautiful, a little different from the others, but perfect! Both were smiling with joy. Muletto Leo had solved his problem in a creative and fun way.

The dolls had received beautiful houses built with the bucket and building blocks, happy and smiling.

plan.problema: The Mule Leo has lost all his tools and can’t build dollhouses anymore!
plan.svolta: After searching everywhere, Leo decided to use a small bucket as a cart to carry the building blocks.
plan.finale: The dolls received beautiful houses built with the bucket and building blocks, happy and smiling!

muletto.text:
Red Mule was a very strong mule. He loved to play in the Flower Garden. He liked to climb the dirt hills and go around the colorful flowers. One day, while he was having fun sliding down a hill, something went wrong. Red Mule got stuck! He had ended up in a sticky mud pile.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Red Mule. “I can’t move anymore! I’m trapped!” He tried to pull himself up, but the mud was too heavy. He couldn’t climb back up on his own.

A ladybug, named Camilla, approached shyly. “What’s wrong, Red Mule?” asked Camilla.

Red Mule explained his problem. Then he had an idea. He decided to use his teeth to grab the branches of the nearest trees. He was trying to pull himself up with the branches, but every time he took a step forward, he slid back down! The mud was too sticky.

The sun was starting to set. Red Mule was feeling a little down. Suddenly, a strong gust of wind began to blow through the trees. The wind pushed Red Mule upwards! With one last effort, the wind helped him reach the top of the hill.

Red Mule stopped to rest, looking at the Flower Garden that stretched out below him. He felt proud of himself. The wind gave him a push when he needed it most. Red Mule knew that with a little courage and the help of others, he could overcome any difficulty.

plan.problema: The forklift got stuck in the mud and can’t get back up!
plan.svolta: It decided to use its teeth to grab the branches of the trees and pull itself up, but it kept slipping away!
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of the wind, the forklift finally reached the top of the hill.

rocket.text:
Rocket was a colorful race, full of bright lights. He lived in the Flower Garden, near the big apple tree. Every evening, Rocket waited for the dark to return and play among the stars. But one night, something went wrong.

He found himself alone, in the middle of the fragrant flowers. He couldn't find his place in the dark sky. “Help! Help!” Rocket shouted, but no one could hear him. No one answered his call. His light began to fade, becoming weaker and weaker.

He was very sad. He felt lost and scared. He tried to shout even louder, but the wind in the garden was too strong to hear his voices. 

A little rabbit, Pipolo, saw him sitting near the red rose. Pipolo went up to Rocket and whispered: “Listen!”

Rocket closed his eyes and listened. At first, he only heard the rustling of the leaves. Then, he heard a sweet and clear song. It was the song of the little birds flying in the garden. The wind carried their voices to Rocket.

Thanks to the song of the birds, Rocket knew where to go. He followed the wind upwards and began to climb in the night sky. His light began to shine brightly again. 

Finally, Rocket was back among the stars. He was happy and glad to be home. The wind whispered: "Friends are important."

plan.problema: Rocket got lost and couldn't find his place among the stars.
plan.svolta: He tried to shout loudly, but no one heard him and his light had faded.
plan.finale: Then, thanks to the kindness of the wind, Rocket heard the song of the little birds who brought him back to the night sky.

rocket.text:
Rockets was a toy spaceship. He was made of shiny metal and had little antennas. He lived in a secret garden, full of colorful flowers and fragrant plants. Every day Rockets waited with joy for the sun to warm him up.

 

One afternoon, Rockets had gotten lost. He had wandered too far from his friends, the red roses. The roses were so tall and fragrant that Rockets pushed his way through their branches. Now he couldn’t find his blue cardboard box anymore.

 

Rockets tried to move, but the thorns of the roses made him step back. He tried to reach the edge of the garden, where he knew the box was. But it was too far! Then, Rockets had an idea: he tried to push the biggest rose. The rose was enormous and red like fire. Unfortunately, when Rockets pushed it, only petals fell everywhere.

 

A little squirrel, named Leo, was collecting hazelnuts nearby. He saw Rockets in trouble and came closer. “Can I help you?” asked Leo. Rockets explained his problem. Together, Leo pushed the biggest rose with all his strength and Rockets could finally reach the edge of the garden.

 

Leo guided Rockets through the roses to the blue box. Rockets jumped inside happily. He was safe and ready for a new adventure. Thanks to the help of Leo, Rockets was back home.

plan.problema: Rockets got lost among the roses and can’t find his way back to his box.
plan.svolta: He tried to push the biggest rose, but only made petals fall everywhere!
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a little squirrel, Rockets happily returned to his box, ready for a new adventure.

rocket.text:
Rockets was a very special race. He wasn’t just a toy. Rockets could move and talk! He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of colorful flowers and tall trees. His main goal was to return to the bear’s little house, where he felt at home.

---

One day, Rockets was exploring the garden when he found himself in a maze of red and white roses. The roses smelled nice, but they were confusing! He couldn’t find his way back to the bear’s little house. He was lost!

---

Rockets tried to move forward, then backward, but he didn’t know where he was going. He decided to use his powerful engine to make a little test run and see if he could find the little house. But, oh no! Rockets bumped into an old wooden bench and, with a thump, he knocked over a vase full of fragrant flowers. The petals scattered everywhere confused him even more.

---

A little squirrel, Leo, ran to him to help Rockets pick up the flowers. Leo suggested that Rockets wait. Then, suddenly, a ray of sunshine shone through the leaves. The ray pointed straight towards the bear’s little house!

---

Rockets followed the bright ray, and in a few moments, he was right in front of the bear’s little house. He rested happily, pleased with his journey. Rockets’ perseverance led him to success.  In conclusion, even if a small step is wrong, it can lead to a big result.

plan.problema: Rocket got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his way back to the bear's house.
plan.svolta: He then decided to use his engine for a little test run, but he ended up crashing into an old bench and overturning a vase full of flowers.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to a ray of sunshine that guided him, Rocket found the bear's house and rested happily.

rocket.text:
Rocket was a toy rocket. He loved to be in the Flower Garden. The garden was full of colorful and fragrant flowers. The daisies were his favorites. Rocket loved to roll amongst them, but sometimes he got lost.

---

One day, Rocket found himself surrounded by a sea of white daisies. He couldn’t find his place on the picnic table anymore. “Oh no!” said Rocket. “I’m lost!” He tried to move, but the daisies were too big and they were smothering his little body.

---

Rocket thought about what to do. He had a small antenna on his helmet. Maybe he could use the antenna to ask for help! He tried to move the antenna, but it was stuck. He couldn’t unlock it. It was frustrating!

---

A ladybug, named Lila, came up to Rocket. “What’s wrong?” asked Lila. “Can’t you get your antenna to work?”

---

“It’s stuck!” replied Rocket with a sigh. Lila suggested he try to move it slowly up and down. Rocket followed Lila’s advice. He moved the antenna, slowly, slowly, slowly… After a while, he felt a little click! The antenna unlocked.

---

Rocket activated the antenna. A bright glow came out of his helmet. The glow pointed directly towards the picnic table. Rocket moved quickly and, thanks to the glow, he was back on his place right away. He was happy to be home! With patience and determination, Rocket had solved his problem. The sun shone brightly in the sky, lighting up the Flower Garden.

plan.problema: Rocket got lost among the daisies and couldn't find his place on the picnic table.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his little antenna to send a bright signal, but the antenna was stuck!
plan.finale: With patience, Rocket managed to unlock the antenna and, thanks to the glow, he immediately returned to the picnic table.

rocket.text:
Rocket was a bright red toy rocket. He lived in the Flower Garden, among fragrant roses and tall sunflowers. Every day, Rocket loved to explore the garden, rolling on the white daisies.

One afternoon, while having fun zooming between the flowers, something strange happened. Rocket found himself surrounded by a sea of daisies! There were so many, so white and fragrant, that he couldn’t see his box anymore. He was lost!

Rocket tried to push with all his little wheels. He tried to go straight towards his landmark. But he only made his way through the colorful flowers. He always got stuck, tangled among the soft petals. He began to feel a little sad and frustrated.

He bumped into an old tree and saw a blue butterfly with shimmering wings. The butterfly was called Stella. Stella was very kind and wanted to help Rocket. Gently, Stella flew around Rocket, showing him the right direction.

Rocket followed Stella’s instructions and, slowly but surely, he was able to find his way back. Finally, with a little jump, he returned to his box. He was happy! He curled up inside, glad to be home.

The butterfly Stella waved goodbye to Rocket and flew away. Rocket realized that even when things seem difficult, with a little calm and patience, you can always find the right way.

plan.problema: The little Rocket got lost among the daisies and can’t get back to his box anymore.
plan.svolta: Rocket tried to push with all his little wheels, but he only made his way through the colorful flowers!
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a kind butterfly, Rocket happily returned to his box next to the old tree.

rocket.text:
Razzo was a really special rocket. He lived in a secret garden, full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Razzo loved to explore the garden, but this time he found himself in big trouble. He was stuck! A huge bush had swallowed him completely. Razzo was too big to move on his own.

He got a little bit angry. He tried to push, to pull, but the bush wouldn’t give way. Razzo felt frustrated. He wanted to go back to exploring the garden! Then he had an idea: “I have to use my engine!” he thought.

Razzo turned on his powerful engine and started to push. But instead of moving the bush, the ground around the bush was lifted into the air! Razzo stopped, disappointed. It wasn’t working.

Suddenly, he heard a noise. A little squirrel, with a bushy, brown tail, appeared among the leaves. “Hello!” said the squirrel. “I saw that you were in trouble. Can I help you?” The squirrel pulled a small wooden shovel out of his pocket. “Use this,” he said.

Razzo came closer and, with the help of the small shovel, together with Razzo and the squirrel, they started to dig around the bush. In just a few minutes, the giant bush was free! Razzo thanked the squirrel. “Thank you very much!” he said.

The squirrel smiled. Razzo realized that sometimes, even a little help can make a difference. And so, Razzo went back to exploring the secret garden, knowing that together you can overcome any obstacle.

plan.problema: The rocket had gotten stuck under a big bush, too big to move on its own.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his powerful engine to blow away the small bushes around him, but only the dirt was lifted!
plan.finale: A friendly squirrel offered him a small shovel and together they solved the problem.

rocket.text:
Rocket was a toy spaceship. He lived in the Flower Garden, a place full of colors and smells. Rocket loved to explore, but sometimes he had too much fun. One day, while flying among the red tulips and yellow roses, he found himself in the middle of a flower maze.

“Oh no!” said Rocket. “I’m lost! I can’t find the way out.” The petals of the lilies brushed against him, but he couldn’t move quickly. He was stuck in the same spot. The daisies all looked the same.

Rocket thought he had to do something. He used his engine to create a small swirl of air. It spun and spun, the air circling around him. It was hard to see clearly, but he could understand better where he had arrived.

Suddenly, Rocket bumped into a bright yellow flower. He crashed against the petal! And then… he saw the way out of the maze. There was a path between the blue hydrangeas.

Rocket smiled. “I did it!” He continued to fly along the path, happy to be back in the Flower Garden. He learned that even when it seems impossible to find the solution, you shouldn’t give up and keep trying. Rocket returned to explore the garden with enthusiasm.

plan.problema: Rocket got lost in the flower maze and couldn't find his way out.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his engine to make a small whirlwind of air and see better where he had arrived.
plan.finale: The whirlwind made him bump into a yellow flower, revealing the way out of the maze.

rocket.text:
Rocket was a very special toy rocket. He lived in a secret garden full of fragrant roses and colorful flowers. Rocket loved to be there, watching the bees fly among the petals. One day, however, he found himself lost. The roses were so tall and many, all the same! He couldn’t see the sun, not even a little.

“Oh no!” said Rocket. “I can’t find my way to the sun. I’m completely lost!” He turned around and around, but he couldn’t figure out where the exit was. A little yellow flower, a daisy, looked at him curiously. “What’s happening, Rocket?” asked the daisy.

Rocket thought for a moment. Then he had an idea! He used his rockets to do a little test flight. He shot up into the air, high, high above the roses. It was wonderful to see the garden from up there! Everything seemed so small and far away.

Looking carefully, Rocket saw something strange. A little secret path, hidden among the roots of the roses, wound its way towards the light. With courage, Rocket followed the path. He moved quickly, using his rockets to push himself forward.

Soon, Rocket was near the sun and his flower friends. He was happy to be back in his place. He rested a little, thinking how important it was never to give up. Perseverance can lead you to find the right way.

plan.problema: Rocket got lost among the roses and couldn't find his way to the sun.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his rockets to do a little test flight, launching himself into the air for a better view of the garden.
plan.finale: Thanks to the view from above, Rocket saw a secret path that brought him closer to the sun and his flower friends.

rocket.text:
Rocket was a bright red rocket. He lived in the secret garden behind the old house. He loved to run among the plants and do little flights. One day, while speeding towards the pond, something went wrong. He found himself trapped in a rose bush!

“Oh no!” exclaimed Rocket. “I’m stuck! I can’t move. The thorns are pricking me and I can’t see the way.” He was frustrated. He tried to push with his wheels, but it was too hard. The bush was full of fragrant roses, but for Rocket it was a huge problem.

Rocket thought quickly. “I have to do something!” So he decided to do a frantic spin. He turned around himself as fast as he could, hoping that the impact would throw him off enough to get him out of the bush. He spun and spun, faster and faster. But he failed miserably. He fell to the ground with a thud.

A blue butterfly, named Lila, landed near Rocket. She was kind and gentle. Lila approached and began to touch the thorns of the bush with her wings. Slowly, slowly, one of the thorniest roses moved. Rocket was freed!

“Thank you, Lila!” said Rocket smiling. Lila flew away, leaving behind a sparkling trail. Rocket rested, satisfied and happy. 
The butterfly had known how to help the rocket find its way.

plan.problema: The Rocket got stuck in the rose bush and can't find his way out.
plan.svolta: He decided to do a wild whirl, hoping the impact would throw him out of the bush.
plan.finale: The whirl failed miserably, but a gentle cuddle from a butterfly freed him from the thorniest rose.
plan.morale: Patience and help can solve any difficulty.

rocket.text:
Rocket was a very special spaceship. He didn’t just stay on a table or a shelf. Rocket could move! He lived in Aunt Rosa’s garden, next to lots of colorful flowers. Every evening, when the sun went down, Rocket looked at the stars and dreamed of flying even higher.

One day, however, something had gone wrong. The wind had caught Rocket and, without meaning to, he had ended up far, far away. He couldn’t find his place among the stars. He was sad and confused. “I wish I could shine again!” Rocket thought.

He decided to take a bigger jump, launching himself with all his might towards the sky. But the jump was too long! He ended up in the middle of Aunt Rosa’s red tulips. They were tall and soft, and Rocket felt a little clumsy. He couldn’t move well between the petals.

Aunt Rosa found him there, among the tulips. She gently picked him up with her kind hands and brought him to the astronomical observatory. There, under the starry sky, Rocket felt different right away. The light of the stars reached him, and Rocket shone again, brighter than ever. Aunt Rosa smiled.

Rocket realized that even when things seem difficult, you have to keep trying. Because sometimes, a little jump can lead to big surprises.

plan.problema: Rocket got lost and couldn’t find his place among the stars.
plan.svolta: He decided to jump higher, launching himself with all his might towards the sky, but he ended up in the middle of the tulips!
plan.finale: Aunt Rosa gently picked him up and brought him back to the observatory, where Rocket finally shone again.

ruspa.text:
Rusta was a red and strong bulldozer. She loved to play in the secret garden. It was a special place, full of colorful flowers and tall plants. Rusta loved to climb among the grass and roll down from the little hills of dirt.

---

One day, while exploring near an old tree, Rusta found herself in a bad situation. A big stone had fallen in front of her, and it had blocked her. Rusta couldn't move! She was stuck under the stone, and she couldn't get free.

---

Rusta tried to push with her wheels, but the stone was too heavy. She tried to climb, but the ground was too slippery. She felt a little sad and frustrated. “Oh no,” thought Rusta, “I need to find a solution!”

---

Then, Rusta had an idea! She used her strongest arm to try to push the stone. But the stone was still too heavy. Rusta tried harder, using all her energy. She kept pushing and pushing…

---

With one last, big effort, Rusta finally managed to lift the stone! The stone flew away, and Rusta found herself free. She rolled happily on the lawn, happy to be back to playing in her secret garden. She was so happy as always.

plan.problema: Rusta got stuck under a big stone and couldn't get out.
plan.svolta: She decided to use her arm to push the stone, but it was too heavy!
plan.finale: With one last effort, Rusta managed to lift the stone and return free, as happy as always.

ruspa.text:
Ruspa was a very curious bulldozer. She loved to explore and discover new places. One day, she found herself in the Secret Garden. It was a magical place full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Ruspa wanted to go see the old tree with the gnarled roots.

Ruspa walked up to the tree, but then… she got stuck! Her wheels were trapped between the roots. She couldn't move anymore. It was a big problem. Ruspa tried to push, pull, and turn, but nothing. She stayed there still, frustrated.

“I have to do something!” thought Ruspa. She decided to use her arm to dig strongly and free herself. But every time she tried to move her arm, she dropped dirt everywhere! The dirt covered everything around her, making the situation even more difficult.

Suddenly, she heard a small crackle. A little squirrel, Leo, was watching her with curiosity. “Can I help you?” asked Leo. Ruspa had an idea! Leo offered her a pinecone. Ruspa used the pinecone as a lever and, with a little force, she managed to free the wheels.

Ruspa felt happy! She moved again in the Secret Garden, exploring every corner. She thanked Leo for the help. From that day on, Ruspa learned that even the most difficult problems can be solved with a little patience and maybe, with the help of a friend. Everything has its own time, and forcing things never leads to the best solution.

plan.problema: Ruspy got stuck between the roots of a tree and couldn’t get back out.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his arm to dig with force, but all he did was drop dirt everywhere!
plan.finale: A little squirrel offered Ruspy a pinecone which he used as a lever to finally free himself.
plan.morale: Patience is the key to success.

ruspa.text:
Ruspolino the digger was very happy. He was in the secret garden, a place full of flowers and lush plants. The garden was a little hidden, behind an old oak tree, and only a few birds knew it. Ruspolino loved his garden!

---

One day, while exploring a corner near the rose bush, he found himself in a big mess. Lots of colorful threads, red, blue, yellow, and green, were tangled around him. It was as if someone had decided to make a thread nest with their colors! Ruspolino couldn't move properly. He was completely stuck.

---

Ruspolino tried to roll, to push, but nothing worked. The threads kept him prisoner. He started to wiggle a little. Then, he had an idea! His little claw was strong and sturdy. He decided to use his claw to untangle the threads, one at a time.

---

With patience, Ruspolino began to gently pull. Each thread loosened slowly. It was a long and tiring job, but Ruspolino didn't give up. He continued to pull, calmly and carefully.

---

Finally, after a long time, all the threads were free! Ruspolino felt free and happy. With a big smile, he settled down in a corner of the garden, near the fountain. The sunshine warmed him, and he was happy to be back to playing in his secret garden. It had been a wonderful afternoon full of patience and determination.

plan.problema: Ruspolino had gotten lost in a tangle of colorful threads!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his claw to patiently untangle each thread, one at a time.
plan.finale: Finally, with a big smile, Ruspolino freed all the threads and settled himself in a corner of the garden.

ruspa.text:
Rups was a very special bulldozer. He lived in a secret garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees. Rups loved to explore that magical place. He was always ready to go on adventures among the plants, to slide on the wet ground, and to make new discoveries.

---

One day, while playing in the maze of tall grass, Rups got lost. The grass was so high that he couldn't see the path anymore. He was very worried. “Where am I?” he thought. He tried to go back, but every road seemed the same as the other. Suddenly, Rups noticed something: he was missing his little cone! The cone was important to him, he used it to push the grass and make small piles.

---

Rups decided to use his scoop. The scoop was very strong and useful. He grabbed a long blade of grass and followed that path. The grass was tall and dense, but Rups didn’t give up. He continued to follow the blade of grass with his scoop, pushing himself through the grass. After a while, he saw a small gap!

---

Rups squeezed through the gap and finally found his cone again. He was happy to be able to rest it beside him. Rups put his cone back on and started making small piles of dirt. His scoop always helped him to reach his goals. Rups realized that, even when things seem difficult, you have to keep trying and never give up. With patience and determination, everything gets solved.

plan.problema: Rups got lost in the maze of tall grass and couldn't find his little cone.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his pincer to grab a blade of grass and follow that path until he found a gap.
plan.finale: Finally, Rups found his cone again, happy to be able to rest it beside him.

ruspa.text:
Ruspolino the digger loved the secret garden. It was a magical place full of fragrant flowers and lush plants. Ruspolino spent his days exploring every corner, rolling in the tall grass, and sliding on the stones.

One day, Ruspolino saw a colorful ball hanging from a tall tree. The ball was bright and inviting. Ruspolino really wanted to reach it! But it was too far away. His wheels couldn't make that little extra step. He was frustrated.

Ruspolino stopped, thought a little, and then had an idea. “Maybe I can try to make some jumps!” he exclaimed. Ruspolino started pushing with his legs, trying to make higher jumps. He jumped up and down, but the ball remained out of reach.

Ruspolino didn't give up. He focused all his strength and made a big leap! He used his wheels to give himself an extra push, and finally, with one last effort, he grabbed the colorful ball.

Ruspolino ran happily to his friend crocodile, who was waiting for him under the tree. He returned the ball with a big smile. The crocodile thanked Ruspolino for his help. Ruspolino was happy to have solved the problem and to have brought the ball back to his friend.

Perseverance made the difference.

plan.problema: Ruspolino couldn't reach the colorful ball hanging from the tree.
plan.svolta: He decided to try making higher jumps, using his legs to push himself upwards.
plan.finale: Finally, with a big leap, he grabbed the ball and brought it back to his crocodile friend!

ruspa.text:
Ruspa was a very curious bulldozer. She loved to explore the secret garden behind the house. It was a place full of colors and smells, with tall trees and fragrant flowers. Ruspa loved to wiggle between the stones, dig little holes, and collect pebbles.

One day, while having fun making a particularly tight turn, Ruspa found himself trapped in the rose bush! The thorny branches surrounded him on all sides, making it impossible to free himself alone. He was a little scared, but he tried to move calmly.

Ruspa decided to use his arm to gently push the thorny branches and escape. But as he pushed, a small gear broke! Ruspa let out a soft groan. He was very frustrated. He could no longer move correctly.

Luckily, a ladybug named Stella was watching him. “Don’t give up!” said Stella. “Look for something to fix the gear.” Ruspa wandered through the secret garden and found an abandoned box under a lavender bush. Inside, he discovered a little special toy oil.

With a lot of patience, Ruspa poured the oil on the broken gear and gently repositioned it. Then, with one last effort, he managed to free himself from the rose bush! He was happy and pleased. Perseverance had done its magic. Ruspa continued to explore the secret garden, more careful than ever.

plan.problema: Ruspy got stuck in the rose bush, too tight for him to free himself.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his arm to gently push the thorny branches, but he’d broken a small gear!
plan.finale: With a lot of patience and some toy oil found in an old box, Ruspy managed to fix himself and get out of the bush.

ruspa.text:
Ruspo was a shiny red bulldozer. He loved his secret garden where he lived. It was a place full of fragrant flowers and tall plants. One day, Ruspo decided to explore a new corner of the garden. He enjoyed rolling amongst the dry leaves. 

Suddenly, Ruspo found himself in a maze made of red and yellow roses. The roses were so big and fragrant that they had tricked him! He couldn’t find his box anymore. He was lost!

Ruspo tried to turn right, then left. He tried to climb a bush, but it was too difficult. He decided to do something different. He used his body to dig a tunnel through the roots of the plants. He wanted to get to the other side of the maze!

But digging, he dug deeper and deeper and only got more confused. The roots were tangled and Ruspo didn’t know where he was. A little stone gnome, Silvano, watched him with curiosity.

Ruspo, however, thought quickly. He remembered that the box was near the big tree. Using his body to push and roll, he managed to reach the tree. And right there, next to the base of the trunk, was his box!

Ruspo climbed into the box and rested among his toy friends. He was happy to be back home. Perseverance had helped him find his place.

plan.problema: The janitor got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his way back to his box.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his body to dig a tunnel through the roots of the plants, but he only got more confused.
plan.finale: Thanks to his cleverness, the janitor managed to reach his box and finally rest among his toy friends.

ruspa.text:
Rusta was a big, yellow bulldozer. She loved to explore the secret garden behind the house. It was a place full of fragrant flowers and tall grass. Rusta moved quickly, sliding between the plants and lifting small stones with her bucket.

One day, while looking for a red ball, Rusta took one step too far. She slid on wet mud and rolled down, ending up under a big terracotta pot. The pot was enormous! Rusta tried to move, but she was stuck. She couldn't get out. She was frustrated.

Rusta sat down near the pot. She thought she had to find a solution. She decided to take a long walk around the pot. She went around and around, examining every inch of the big pot. She noticed the cracks in the mud and the small holes in the terracotta. She was looking for a weak spot, a small space to use to free herself.

Suddenly, Rusta saw a small crack near the bottom of the pot. With a strong push, she used her bucket and grabbed the edge of the pot. She pulled with all her strength. And then… Rusta found herself outside! She was a little dirty with mud, but she was free. She stood up right away and started to explore the secret garden.

Rusta continued her adventure, lifting stones and collecting flowers. Every problem seemed easier to solve with patience and determination. Rusta realized that even when things seem difficult, you shouldn't give up. And so, she prepared for the next discovery in the secret garden.

plan.problema: Rusta had found herself trapped under a large terracotta pot, unable to free herself.
plan.svolta: She decided to take a long and patient walk around the pot, looking for a weak point or a small space to use.
plan.finale: Finally, with a decisive snap, she managed to grasp the edge of the pot and pull herself out, immediately recovering for another adventure.

ruspa.text:
Ruspo was a happy bulldozer. He lived in the Secret Garden, a place full of fragrant roses and colorful flowers. His little house was built in an old tree trunk, right next to a pond with lots of white water lilies.

---

One day, Ruspo was exploring the garden when he noticed he had lost something important: his little blue bracelet, which he had received as a gift. It had fallen among the roses and now he couldn’t find it. The rose maze was very confusing!

---

Ruspo decided to make a series of small holes in the ground. He wanted to dig to find a secret passage that would take him back to the bracelet. He dug, dug, dug… but his blades got stuck in the dirt and always ended up falling. He was just making a lot of little holes!

---

A blue butterfly, Luna, was flying around Ruspo. “Don’t give up!” said Luna. “Try to be more patient.”

---

Ruspo listened to Luna. He started to dig calmly and carefully. He dug deeper, little by little, with a lot of patience. Finally, he managed to dig a hole big enough to grab his little blue bracelet.

---

With the bracelet held tight between his wheels, Ruspo returned to his flower house. He was happy and pleased. He had learned that even when things seem difficult, if you are patient and don’t give up, you can always find the solution.

plan.problema: The janitor got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his little bracelet.
plan.svolta: He decided to make a series of small holes, hoping to find a passage to bring him back to the bracelet, but he only made his spikes fall into the ground.
plan.finale: Finally, with patience and determination, he managed to dig a hole big enough to grab the bracelet and return to his flower house.

ruspa.text:
Rusolino was a digger made of brass, shiny and strong. He loved to be in the Secret Garden, digging among the dry leaves and discovering little colorful stones. One day, while exploring a hidden corner, he found himself inside the toy box. It was a big box, full of dolls, soldiers, and toy trains.



Rusolino realized right away that he was lost! The walls of the box were too tight to move. He tried to turn around, but he couldn't. He tried to crawl, but the box was too high. He was frustrated. He didn't know how to get out of that cardboard hole.



“I need to find a way!” Rusolino thought. He focused and remembered when he dug in the garden. He remembered how powerful his arm was. He decided then to make a long jump! He threw his body straight towards the lid of the box, with all his strength.



The lid rattled and broke! Rusolino was free! He found himself back in the Secret Garden, just a few centimeters from a vine leaf. He took one last stretch, happy to be back. Aunt Sofia, the little girl who had left him there, was watching the digger with a smile.



Rusolino continued to explore the garden, paying more attention to where he put his metal feet. And he knew that even when things seem difficult, with a little effort, you can always find a solution.

plan.problema: Rusty got lost inside the toy box and can't get out!
plan.svolta: He tried to turn and to crawl, but the box was too tight, so he decided to make a long jump!
plan.finale: With one last stretch, he managed to push the lid of the box and to free himself!

saetta mcqueen.text:
Saetta McQueen loved to run. The playground was his favorite place. The slides, the swings, and all the children laughing made him happy. But today, something wasn't right. Saetta McQueen was lost! He had ended up among the colorful slides, a tangle of plastic and wood. He couldn't find his way to the red house where he usually waited.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Saetta McQueen. “I don’t know where I am anymore! Everything looks the same!” He felt a little scared. A small teddy bear, Bruno, approached cautiously. “What’s wrong, Saetta?” asked Bruno with his sweet voice.

Saetta McQueen thought for a moment. Then he had an idea! He decided to use his engine! He started the engine at full speed and made a big noise: "Vroooom! Vroooom!". The noise was so loud that it attracted the attention of all the toys on the playground.

“It’s Saetta McQueen!” shouted some plastic soldiers. “There he is!” said a rag doll. All the toys gathered around him, happy to have found him. They helped him get back to the starting point, near the red house.

Saetta McQueen smiled. He was happy to be home. He had learned that even when you get lost, with a little courage and a big noise, you can always find the right way.

plan.problema: Lightning lost himself among the slides and couldn't find his way back.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his engine to make a big noise and attract the attention of his toy friends.
plan.finale: All the toys in the park recognized him and helped him get back to the starting point, as happy as ever.

saetta mcqueen.text:
Saetta McQueen loved to race in the playground. He was a fast red car, a true champion! But today there was a problem. Saetta had gotten lost. He was among the tallest slides in the world! They were so big he couldn’t see the other side of the playground.

“Oh no!” said Saetta McQueen. “I’m completely lost!” He tried to make a few turns, but every time he ended up crashing into the rough wood of the slide. He was a little scared. He didn’t hear the voices of his friends.

Then Saetta McQueen made a decision. He decided to use his strongest engine! He turned and turned, making a great fast lap around the slide. He was trying to recognize the colors of his friends: Leo, who had the blue car, and Sofia, with her yellow car.

He continued to run, focused. The sound of his engine sounded louder and louder. Suddenly, a small shout reached him. “Saetta!” It was the voice of Leo! Leo was pointing at Saetta McQueen with his hand. “There he is!” said Leo. 

Saetta McQueen was safe! He stopped to smile. He had found his place in the playground thanks to his courage and his speed. His race had brought him back among his friends.

plan.problema: Lightning got lost among the very tall slides!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his strongest engine to go fast and try to recognize the colors of his friends.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to his distinctive sound, his voice was heard by Leo who pointed him out immediately.
plan.morale: Never give up and trust your help.

saetta mcqueen.text:
Saetta McQueen was a fast red car. He loved to race in the playground. It was full of swings, slides, and a sandbox. Saetta McQueen adored zooming among all the toys.

One day, Saetta McQueen found himself in a strange situation. He was lost! There were too many swings going up and down and too many children sliding quickly. He couldn't find his place near the plastic fountain. It was all so confusing.

“Oh no!” said Saetta McQueen, with a little frown. “I’m completely lost!” He tried to turn around, but he always found himself in the middle of the slides. He felt a little sad and a little scared. A small red ball, Pip, looked at him curiously.

Saetta McQueen made a decision. He used his engine to make a big noise! “Vroooom! Vroooom!” The sound was loud and powerful. All the toys in the playground stopped to listen.

The noise attracted the attention of the children playing in the park. “Look!” they shouted. “There’s Saetta McQueen there!” The children found him right away and carefully brought him back to the plastic fountain.

Saetta McQueen was happy to be back home. He had learned that even when things seem difficult, you have to keep looking and make noise if necessary! Every little effort can lead to success.

plan.problema: Lightning got lost among the swings and slides!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his motor to make a big noise and attract the attention of the other toys.
plan.finale: Thanks to the loud sound, the children found him right away and brought him back to his place.

saetta mcqueen.text:
Saetta McQueen was a very fast red car. He loved to race on the playground, especially on his race track. One day, while speeding along at top speed, he found himself in a new place. It was full of colorful slides and swings that swayed in the air. Saetta McQueen didn’t recognize anything.

He was completely lost! He was looking for his race track, but it was too big to see everything. The slides looked like mountains and the swings were tall clouds. Saetta McQueen felt a little scared. He didn’t know how to get home.

“I have to do something!” thought Saetta McQueen. He took a deep breath and started his engine at full speed. “Vroom! Vroom! Vroom!” The sound was loud, very loud. The other toys on the playground stopped to listen.

A little blue truck, Leo, came up to Saetta McQueen. “What are you doing?” asked Leo. Saetta McQueen explained his problem. Leo understood right away what he had to do. “I’ll race to find your race track!” said Leo and he sped off quickly. 

After a while, Leo came running back. “I found it!” he shouted. A small red car, Pippo, followed him closely. Together with the three of them, Saetta McQueen returned to his race track, happy and content. 

Saetta McQueen realized that even if you get lost, with the help of your friends, everything goes back to normal.

plan.problema: Lightning McQueen got lost among the slides and swings, and couldn't find his track.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his engine to make a big noise and attract the attention of his toy friends.
plan.finale: Finally, a little red car saw him and raced to help him get back to his track.

saetta mcqueen.text:
Saetta McQueen loved to race in the playground. He was a fast and noisy red car, made for fun! One day, Saetta McQueen found himself in a new place: the sand maze. It was huge, full of tall dunes and narrow passages.

Saetta McQueen wanted to explore, so he started to run. Running, running, he realized he was lost! He couldn't find the way out anymore. “Oh no!” said Saetta McQueen, “I’m completely stuck!”

He looked around frantically. He saw a little teddy bear sitting on a dune. The teddy bear greeted him with a smile. Saetta McQueen had an idea: he would use his headlights to light the way! He turned on his headlights at full power. But the light was too bright. The other toys were scared and hid.

Saetta McQueen realized he had to be more careful. He slowed down, slowing down a lot. He started to slowly approach each corner of the maze. He looked calmly, without hurry. He examined every single grain of sand, every little hole. 

Finally, after a long time, Saetta McQueen found the exit! A little sigh of relief came from his wheels. He stopped, made a little sound, and approached each corner gently until he found the exit of the maze.

plan.problema: Lightning got lost in the sand maze and couldn't find his way out.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his headlights to light the path, but the light was too bright and scared the other toys.
plan.finale: Lightning slowed down, made a small sound, and approached each corner gently until he found the exit of the maze.

saetta mcqueen.text:
Saetta McQueen loved to race. Especially in the playground. He was a fast red car, made of plastic and a desire for adventure. That day, Saetta McQueen had decided to face the new sand maze. It was huge, full of curves and narrow paths.

At first, everything was going well. Saetta McQueen zoomed through the dunes, scaring a few squirrels that passed by. But then, he got lost! The sand walls were all the same, gray and tall. Saetta McQueen couldn't find the exit anymore. He was a little frustrated.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Saetta McQueen. “I’m stuck in here!” He sat down on the sand, thinking about what to do. Then he had an idea: his engine was very powerful! He decided to try using his engine to create small whirlwinds in the sand.

Saetta McQueen sped up and turned the wheels. The sand rose around him in small clouds. He kept making whirlwinds, getting stronger and stronger. And suddenly, one of the whirlwinds pushed him away! It was as if the engine was guiding him to a precise point.

Finally, after many attempts, a small whirlwind took him out of the maze and towards the exit! Saetta McQueen cheered. He was happy to be free. He stopped for a moment to rest, then continued to run in the playground. Saetta McQueen learned that even when things seem difficult, with perseverance you can always find a way out.

plan.problema: Lightning got lost in the sand maze and can’t find his way out.
plan.svolta: He decides then to use his engine to make small whirlwinds in the sand, hoping to find the right direction.
plan.finale: Finally, a small whirlwind brings him out of the maze and towards the exit!

saetta mcqueen.text:
Saetta McQueen was a super-fast red car. He lived at the playground. He loved to run on the tall, sandy dunes and zoom along the track. One day, while having fun making some beautiful turns, he noticed that his friend, the fire truck Romeo, wasn’t there anymore.

“Romeo? Where are you?” shouted Saetta McQueen. But no one answered. He was all confused. He was standing among the colorful slides and the tall wooden towers. He didn’t recognize anything! “Oh no!” thought Saetta McQueen. “I’m lost!”

He decided he had to do something. He took his little flashlight, the one he always carried with him. He turned it on and started to light the way. He looked carefully at every corner, under the slides and behind the towers. “I’ll look, I’ll look!” said Saetta McQueen.

He continued to walk slowly, shining his flashlight everywhere. Suddenly, he heard a loud sound: “Pipì-pipì! Pipì-pipì!”. Those were Romeo’s sirens! Saetta McQueen ran towards the sound as fast as he could.

Finally, he saw Romeo, the fire truck, smashing sand with his mechanical arm. “Romeo!” shouted Saetta McQueen and ran to him right away to celebrate their newfound friendship. He was so happy to be back with him.

Saetta McQueen realized that even when things seem difficult, if you try and don’t give up, you always find the solution in the end.

plan.problema: Lightning got lost among the slides and can’t find his friend, the fire truck!
plan.svolta: He decides to use his flashlight to light the way and carefully look in every corner.
plan.finale: Finally, he hears the sirens of the fire truck and runs towards the sound, finding him happy.
plan.morale: Perseverance helps to achieve your goals.

saetta mcqueen.text:
Saetta McQueen loved to run. He loved to zoom along his racetrack, feeling the wind in his wheels. That morning he was at the playground, a place full of colors and fun. There were very tall slides, really high swings, and a big wooden castle.

Saetta McQueen got carried away with excitement and decided to slide down the tallest slide. He was so fast that he didn't notice he had ended up in a corner of the playground, between the slides. He was lost! He couldn't see his racetrack, he couldn't hear the sound of the wheels on the concrete. It was all gray and confusing.

Saetta McQueen felt a little scared. The plastic mountains seemed enormous. He tried to find his way, but he couldn't figure out where he was. He saw a little teddy bear sitting on a bench. The teddy bear looked at him with his round eyes.

Then Saetta McQueen had an idea! He used all his engine to make a big noise: “Vroooom, vrooom!” The sound was loud and powerful. The children playing around turned to hear where the sound was coming from. A boy ran towards him, followed by two others.

“Saetta McQueen! Here you are!”, said the boy. Saetta McQueen immediately saw his racetrack, right next to the swing. He was so happy! He started up right away and began to run fast.

Saetta McQueen realized that even when things seem difficult, a little bit of courage can make a difference. He was so happy to be back zooming on his racetrack.

plan.problema: Lightning got lost among the very tall slides and can’t find his track.
plan.svolta: He decides to use his engine to make a lot of noise, hoping his friends will hear him and help him find his way.
plan.finale: Thanks to the noise of his engine, Lightning finally finds his track and is very happy to go fast again!

saetta mcqueen.text:
Saetta McQueen loved the playground. He was a super-fast red car, made for running and having fun. That day the sun was shining brightly in the sky and Saetta was ready for a big adventure. Running among the children, he found himself near the tallest tower, the one that seemed to touch the clouds.

Suddenly, everything seemed much bigger. The slides were so high! Saetta McQueen realized he was lost. He couldn't find his place next to the tower. “Help!” shouted Saetta, but no one heard him. It was too far away.

Desperate, Saetta started to roll down a slide. A long, fast descent! He ended up in the middle of a big maze made of sand. The sand got into his gears and he felt a little stuck.

Saetta McQueen thought there was no way out. Then, he remembered how strong his engine was. With a huge effort, he sped up! He zoomed off like a rocket, making a quick circle around the sand maze. It was amazing how he could move even when things seemed impossible.

Finally, Saetta McQueen found his place next to the tallest tower. He was happy and excited. The sun continued to shine and the other toys greeted him. Saetta understood that even if things seem difficult, with a little courage and determination, you can always find the right way.

plan.problema: Lightning got lost among the super tall slides!
plan.svolta: He tried to shout for help, but no one could hear him and he rolled down a slide, ending up in the sand maze.
plan.finale: Thanks to his powerful engine, Lightning made a fast lap around the maze, finding his spot near the tallest tower!

saetta mcqueen.text:
Saetta McQueen loved the playground. He was a super-fast red car and full of energy. But today there was a problem! Saetta McQueen had gotten lost. Among all the toys – trains, dolls, balls – he couldn't find his friends anymore.

It was all so big! The swings made him swing back and forth, the sandcastle seemed enormous, and the slides were a maze. Saetta McQueen felt a little sad. “Oh no!” he said. “I need to find my way back.”

He thought about what to do. Saetta McQueen had an idea! He used his turbo engine, the one that made him go super fast. With a big roar, he started zooming among the toys. He turned and turned, trying to figure out where he was going. 

A little teddy bear, Bruno, helped him. “Look over there!” shouted Bruno. “Do you see lots of other red cars? They are your friends!” Saetta McQueen followed his advice.

And indeed, soon after, he saw a group of red cars waiting for him. They gathered around him happily. Saetta McQueen was back in his place! He was happy and glad to be with the others. 

Saetta McQueen realized that even when things seem difficult, you need to be brave and never give up.

plan.problema: Lightning McQueen got lost among so many toys in the park!
plan.svolta: He decided to use his turbo engine to go for a fast ride and find his way.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to his courage and speed, he found his place among his friends.

toy boat.text:
Little Boat Leo was a small toy, a little wooden boat with bright colors. He lived at the Blue Pond, a quiet place with water so clear it looked like shining blue. Every day, Little Boat Leo loved to sail on the pond, making little waves with his oars.

One afternoon, while he was taking a particularly long trip, something went wrong. Little Boat Leo pushed too far and ended up running aground in the deepest part of the pond. He was stuck! He couldn't get back to the shore. “Oh no!” cried Little Boat Leo, with a small voice and a little bit scared.

He tried to push with his little oars, but the water was too strong. The current was pulling him away, further and further away from the lakeside. Little Boat Leo felt sad and alone. He only saw blue water around him.

Then, a big green leaf floated near him. The leaf seemed friendly. With a little courage, Little Boat Leo gently pushed towards the leaf. The leaf moved calmly and pushed him gently.

Slowly, slowly, Little Boat Leo returned to the lakeside. Finally, he reached the shore, tired but happy. He settled in his favorite spot, near the mossy rock. Safe at last, Little Boat Leo thought that sometimes, it just takes a little patience and a small help to find your way. And so, Little Boat Leo continued to sail in the Blue Pond, always careful of the currents and ready to accept help when he needed it.

plan.problema: The little boat, Leo, got stuck too deep and can’t get back home!
plan.svolta: Leo tried to push with all his little oars, but the current was too strong and kept pulling him further away.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to the help of a floating leaf that pushed him gently, Leo was safely back on the lakeside.
plan.morale: Patience and a little help can solve any problem.

toy boat.text:
Pondermodel was a little toy, a colorful wooden sailboat. He loved to be on Lake Garda, watching the mountains reflected in the calm water. Every day he tried to float near the shore, but sometimes the current carried him far away.

A day, Pondermodel drifted too far. The breeze pushed him away from the sunny lakeside and he found himself alone, very far from the shore. There was no longer the sound of boats and the laughter of tourists. It was all silent.

Pondermodel tried to push himself with his little fins. The fins spun quickly, but Pondermodel was tired. He couldn't make much progress. The lake seemed enormous and the sun began to set. He felt a little scared.

Suddenly, he saw a turtle shell approaching. The turtle was big and friendly. “Hello Pondermodel,” said the turtle with a sweet voice. “Can I help you?”

Pondermodel explained his problem. The turtle, with its strong legs, gently pushed Pondermodel towards the shore. Slowly, but surely, Pondermodel was getting closer to land. They finally arrived on the warm, golden sand.

Pondermodel was happy! He thanked the turtle a thousand times. The turtle smiled and went off to find other adventures. Pondermodel, near the shore of Lake Garda, realized how wonderful it was to have a friend. He was happy to be back home, knowing that together you can overcome even the biggest difficulties.

plan.problema: The Fishboat had sailed too far from the shore and now couldn't get back.
plan.svolta: He tried to push himself with his little fins, but he was too tired to go far.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a friendly turtle shell, the Fishboat returned to the shore, happy and content.
plan.morale: Problems are solved with the help of friends.

toy boat.text:
Peschereccio was a little wooden boat who was very happy. He loved being at the Azure Lake. The water was always calm and blue, like the sky. The floating water lilies were his friends. One day, Peschereccio drifted too far from the shore. A current pushed him away, away, away!

Suddenly, Peschereccio realized he was surrounded by lots of white and pink water lilies. He couldn’t see the shore anymore. He was lost! “Oh no!” exclaimed Peschereccio, but nobody answered. He felt lonely and a little scared.

Peschereccio tried to use his little paddle to go back. He pushed hard, hard, hard, but the water swirled around him without Peschereccio moving an inch. The paddle just made the water spin like a merry-go-round.

A little bird, a kingfisher, watched Peschereccio from his rock. He looked at him for a while and then flew away. Peschereccio didn’t give up. He kept pushing with his paddle.

Then, a ray of sunshine hit the water lilies. The sun made the water sparkle around Peschereccio. The water lilies moved a little and pushed him towards the edge of the lake. Peschereccio finally reached the shore! He was happy to be back home. 

Peschereccio understood that, even when things seem difficult, you should never stop trying. And so, Peschereccio continued to sail in the Azure Lake with courage and determination.

plan.problema: The Fishing Boat was lost among the floating water lilies and couldn't return to the shore.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his little paddle to push against the reeds, but it only made the water swirl without moving.
plan.finale: Finally, a ray of sunshine hit the water lilies and guided him to the edge of the lake.

toy boat.text:
Peschereccio was a little wooden boat who was very happy. He lived in the Lake of Lullabies, a quiet and peaceful place, full of white water lilies and green reeds. Every day Peschereccio waited to go for a ride, to see the little fish dance on the water.

One day, while he was moving away from the shore, the wind changed direction. Peschereccio was carried away, away, away! He found himself in the middle of a maze of tall and complicated reeds. He couldn’t find his way back to the shore anymore. It was all so confusing!

Peschereccio tried to row with his little paddles, but he moved very slowly. He tried to go fast, but he only moved further and further away from where he had started. A little blue fish, Leo, watched him curiously. “Maybe if you try to put in more effort,” said Leo.

Peschereccio followed the fish’s advice and made his paddles spin quickly. He felt like a rocket! But, incredibly, he found himself even further away from the shore. He was desperate.

Then, suddenly, the gentle wind blew softly. It took him gently and pushed him towards the shore. Peschereccio floated slowly, until he touched the cool water of the shore. He was home again! He stopped there, patiently waiting for the next adventure, knowing that even the biggest challenges can be overcome with a little courage and perseverance.

plan.problema: The little boat was lost in the maze of reeds and couldn't return to the shore.
plan.svolta: It decided to use its small propellers to float faster, but it only got further away from its starting point.
plan.finale: Thanks to the gentle wind, the little boat was gently brought back to the shore, where it patiently waited for the next adventure.

toy boat.text:
Battello was a little toy boat shaped like a sailboat. He loved to be at the Blue Pond, where the water was always calm and sparkling. Every day, Battello floated gently, enjoying the sunshine and the water lilies that popped up from the bottom.

---

One day, a strong current carried him far, far away. Battello found himself alone, in the middle of the pond. He couldn't see the shore! He was scared. “Oh no,” thought Battello, “I’m lost!”

---

Battello decided to do something. He used his little motor to turn and make curves. He wanted to get home quickly. But the more he turned, the further he got from the shore! The fish looked at him curiously, but they didn't help him. Battello felt more and more alone.

---

Suddenly, a sweet sound rang in the air: the bell on top of Battello’s boat tinkled. A little duck, curious about the noise, came closer. “Are you, little Battello?” asked the duck. “I recognized you by your bell!”

---

The duck calmly guided Battello through the calm waters towards the shore. Finally, Battello touched the sand! He was happy to be home. He rested a little, next to his fish friends, and thought that even the smallest movement can lead to the right solution if done with patience.

plan.problema: The Boat got lost in the lagoon and can’t find its way home.
plan.svolta: It decided to use its little engine to make curves, but it found itself even further from the fish friends.
plan.finale: Thanks to the gentle sound of the bell on its top, a duck recognized it and guided it to the shore.

toy boat.text:
Peschereccio was a little wooden boat who was very happy. He loved to be on Lake Azzurro. The water was always calm and blue, just like the sky. The water lilies floated peacefully, with their fragrant flowers. Peschereccio loved to zoom across the water, leaving a little ripple behind him.

One day, Peschereccio drifted too far from the shore. The water lilies were so beautiful and inviting! He was carried away by the current and suddenly… he couldn’t get back. He was surrounded by so many tall, green water lilies. He couldn’t see the shore of Lake Azzurro anymore.

Peschereccio tried to push himself with all his might, but he was just spinning in circles! He spun and spun, without getting anywhere. He felt a little sad and confused. A little water bird, a duckling, watched him curiously.

Then Peschereccio called for help. He shouted loudly: “Help! I’m lost!” Suddenly, a gentle breeze arrived from the sky. It was the gentle wind. The gentle wind took Peschereccio in his invisible arms and gently pushed him towards the shore.

Peschereccio was immediately back on the beach, near his home. He felt relieved and happy. He thanked the gentle wind for helping him. He realized that sometimes, even if you are alone, asking for help can make a difference. Peschereccio went back to zooming across Lake Azzurro, knowing that even a little boat can have big friends.

plan.problema: The Fishing Boat was lost among the water lilies and couldn't return to the shore.
plan.svolta: He tried to push himself with all his strength, but he was only going in circles!
plan.finale: Then he asked for help from the gentle wind, which carried him gently home.

toy boat.text:
Little Boat Leo was a small wooden boat. He loved to be at Lake Azure. The lake was full of clear water and white water lilies that floated peacefully. Little Boat Leo had small, colorful oars, perfect for sailing.

One day, Little Boat Leo drifted too far from the shore. The water lilies were so beautiful! He wanted to explore every corner of the lake. Suddenly, he realized he was surrounded by many tall, green water lilies. He couldn't find his way back anymore. He was lost!

Little Boat Leo tried to push himself with his small oars. But he only got dragged further into the middle of the water lilies. He felt a little sad and confused. A blue dragonfly, flying over the lake, looked at him for a moment.

Then Little Boat Leo had an idea. He called out with his loudest voice: “Gentle Wind! Help me, please!” The gentle wind, soft and sweet, heard Little Boat Leo’s request. It began to push the little boat towards the shore, slowly.

Little Boat Leo followed the wind, happy and grateful. Soon, the water lilies became fewer and he saw the shore of Lake Azure. He was home! Little Boat Leo stopped on the shore, near the other water lilies, ready for a new adventure. 

He realized that even a small boat can reach its goals if it asks for help.

plan.problema: The little boat, Leo, got lost among the water lilies and couldn't get back to the shore.
plan.svolta: Leo tried to push himself with his little oars, but he only got carried further away!
plan.finale: Then he realized he needed to ask the gentle wind for help, which slowly brought him back home.

toy boat.text:
Barchetto Leo was a little wooden boat. He loved to be at Lake Azure. The lake was full of white and pink water lilies. Barchetto Leo enjoyed floating on the calm water. One day, while he was playing, he got too close to a group of water lilies. The water lilies were big and dense!

Right away, Barchetto Leo found himself trapped. He was inside the maze of water lilies. He couldn’t find his way out anymore. “Oh no!” cried Barchetto Leo. “I’m lost!”

Barchetto Leo thought of using the wind to get back to the shore. He started to move, pushed by the light wind. But the wind only carried him to a corner of the lake! He was even further from the main shore. Barchetto Leo was sad and a little worried.

Suddenly, he felt something cool that tickled his hull. It was a small wave of water, a gentle hug from Lake Azure. The wave approached Barchetto Leo and gently pushed him towards his path. 

Barchetto Leo followed the wave, and in a moment, he found his way back to the shore. He was happy to be back in the right place. Barchetto Leo continued to float, happy with his adventure in the maze of water lilies. Perseverance had guided him out of danger.

plan.problema: The little boat, Leo, got lost in the maze of water lilies and couldn't find his way out.
plan.svolta: He decided to use the wind to push towards the nearest shore, but the wind only carried him to a corner of the lake!
plan.finale: Thanks to a splash of cool water, Leo finally found his way home.

toy boat.text:
Peschereccio was a little wooden boat. He loved to be in the quiet little lake. The water was calm and clear. Every day Peschereccio floated peacefully, watching the water lilies that popped up from the center of the lake.

---

One day, while the sun was shining brightly, Peschereccio found himself in a strange situation. There were so many water lilies, big and floating. In a moment, Peschereccio got lost among them. He couldn't see the shore anymore. Everything around him was green.

---

Peschereccio tried to push himself with all his might. The water swirled around him in a confused way. But he couldn't go back. He felt a little scared. A little frog, named Tito, was watching him from a water lily. “Don’t worry!” jumped Tito.

---

Peschereccio continued to float, doing nothing. The water of the lake was sweet and calm. Slowly, Peschereccio let himself be carried by the current. The current gently pushed him towards the edge of the lake.

---

Finally, Peschereccio reached the shore! He was happy to be back among the rocks and the grass. He rested a little, watching Tito jump on the water lily. 

---

Peschereccio realized that sometimes, to go back, you don't have to do anything. Sometimes, you just have to wait and let things happen naturally.

plan.problema: The rowboat got lost among the floating water lilies and couldn’t return to the shore.
plan.svolta: He tried to push himself with all his might, but it only made the water swirl in a confused way.
plan.finale: Then he simply let himself be carried by the current to the edge of the lake.
plan.morale: Sometimes it’s just patience and acceptance.

toy boat.text:
Barchetto Leo was a little wooden boat. He loved to be in the Flowered Pond. The water lilies floated quietly and the water was always clear. One day, Barchetto Leo got too close to the center of the pond. A current pushed him away from the shore. Immediately he found himself trapped in the mud! It was sticky and dark mud.

Barchetto Leo tried to move. He turned his little propellers with all his might, but the mud was too strong. He couldn't go anywhere. The sun was beginning to set and the water in the pond became cooler. A little frog, Rana Rosa, hopped nearby. “Don’t worry, Barchetto Leo!” said Rana Rosa. “Try to use the water lilies!”

Barchetto Leo understood. He began to gently push the water lilies towards the mud. The water lilies slipped between the planks of his body and helped him move slowly. It was a long and patient job. Barchetto Leo kept pushing the water lilies, little by little.

After a long time, Barchetto Leo reached the shore! He was happy and tired. He huddled on the warm sand and watched Rana Rosa hopping around him. The sun was setting, painting the sky pink and orange. Barchetto Leo knew that everything needs its own time.

plan.problema: The little boat, Leo, got stuck in the mud, too far from the shore!
plan.svolta: Leo tried to push himself with all his little propellers, but the mud was too sticky.
plan.finale: He then learned to use the water lilies as little sculptures to move slowly towards the shore.

toy car.text:
Ruggine was a red toy car. He loved to race in the playground. It was a sunny day and lots of children were laughing. Ruggine zoomed past the colorful slides and the swings that went up and down.

Suddenly, Ruggine realized he was all alone. He looked around and didn’t see his friends anymore. “Oh no!” said Ruggine. “I’m lost! There are too many slides and swings!” He was confused. He didn’t know where he was.

Ruggine decided to try to crawl under a tall swing. He tried to roll between the legs, but it was too high. Ruggine got scared and rolled away, ending up on a small hill.

A red ball, big and smooth, was playing nearby. The red ball came closer to Ruggine. “I saw you fall!” said the red ball. “Can I help you?” Ruggine crawled towards the ball. The ball gently pushed him down.

With the help of the ball, Ruggine finally reached his place next to the sandcastle. He was happy to be back there. The children were laughing and playing. Ruggine settled down next to the tower of the castle. 

Ruggine rested for a little while before continuing to have fun in the playground. He realized that, even when things seem difficult, with a little help you can always find your way back.

plan.problema: Rusty got lost among the slides and swings!
plan.svolta: He tried to crawl under a swing, but it was too high and it made him roll away.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a red ball, Rusty managed to return to his original position near the sandcastle.

toy car.text:
Rayo was a red car. He had shiny wheels and a little horn. He lived at the playground. He was the favorite toy of the sun and the wind. But today Rayo felt sad. He was lost! There were so many other toys: balls, building blocks, dolls… And Rayo couldn't find his friend Bruno the teddy bear.

“Bruno? Bruno!” shouted Rayo, but nobody answered. His battery was almost empty and he felt more and more alone. He decided to do something. “Maybe if I look up high I’ll see Bruno!” thought Rayo. So, Rayo started to spin quickly around the swing. He tried to look up, but he was too small. He couldn't see anything beyond the swing sheet.

Rayo stopped for a moment. “I have to be patient,” he told himself. He kept moving, spinning and taking small jumps. Then, suddenly, he saw something brown under the dollhouse! It was Bruno the teddy bear! Rayo ran quickly towards the teddy bear and hugged him with his wheels.

Bruno was happy to see his friend again. Together, the two friends went back to play together on the swing. The sun was shining and the playground seemed even more fun. Rayo realized that even when you lose something, if you don’t give up, you’ll always find it in the end. Perseverance can lead to great satisfaction.

plan.problema: Rayo got lost among so many other toys and couldn't find his teddy bear friend.
plan.svolta: He decided to take a quick spin around the swing to try to see Rayo from above, but he was too small to see him well.
plan.finale: Rayo finally found the teddy bear under the dollhouse and the two friends returned to play together.

toy car.text:
Ruggine was a little red toy car. He loved to run in the Flowery Garden. The garden was full of fragrant roses and colorful flowers. Ruggine had a little wooden house right next to the pond.

One day, while he was running, Ruggine got lost. He ended up in a maze made of roses. The roses were tall and big, all the same. He couldn’t find his way out. “Oh no!” said Ruggine. “I don’t know how to get back to my little house.”

Ruggine thought about using his little engine to make a quick spin around the maze. He sped up! But he kept turning and turning, without finding the right way. Finally, he ended up in a dead end, a narrow way with no exit. He was frustrated.

Suddenly, a red ladybug landed on his door. “Hello Ruggine,” said the ladybug. “Can I help you?” Ruggine explained his problem. The ladybug looked carefully and said, “Look to the right, after that yellow rose!”

Ruggine followed the ladybug’s instructions. He walked along a narrow path between the roses and, finally, he returned to his little house. He was happy! Ruggine stopped for a moment and looked at the ladybug. “Thank you very much!” he said.

The ladybug smiled. “You’re welcome,” she replied. Ruggine was glad to be home. He had learned that even when things seem difficult, with a little help and perseverance, you can always find the right way.
