plan.problema: Rusty got lost in the maze of roses and couldn't find his way back to his little house.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his small engine to go for a quick ride around the maze, but he ended up going in a dead end.
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a friendly ladybug, Rusty finally found the right path and went home happy.

toy car.text:
Ruggine was a red toy car. He loved the playground very much. It was a place full of colors and fun. Every day Ruggine ran and zoomed between the slides, swings, and Tibetan bridges.

One afternoon, Ruggine had gone too far. He found himself in front of the tallest slides in the park. They were so big that he couldn't see his little wooden house where he lived. He was lost! Ruggine tried to run back, but the slides were too high and the sand mountains too big.

“Oh no!” said Ruggine. “I can’t get back!”

Then he had an idea. He went up to the big water pipe and decided to use his little wheels to climb. He rolled up, he rolled down, but he slid away with a big thump! Ruggine ended up on the ground, a little dented but not disappointed.

Just at that moment, some green leaves came closer. The leaves were light and soft. They started to gently push Ruggine up. The leaves pushed him gently, one leaf after another.

Ruggine followed the leaves to his little house. He was happy! The house was small but cozy. Ruggine settled back in his place and thought how important it was never to give up. 

After a long journey, Ruggine realized that even when things seem difficult, with a little effort you can always find the right way.

plan.problema: Rusty got lost among the tall slides and couldn't find his way back to his little house.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his small wheels to climb the water pipe, but he slid down with a big splash!
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a group of leaves that gently pushed him, Rusty finally reached his little house.

toy car.text:
Rudi was a red toy car. He lived in the playground and loved to run on every surface. Today, though, he felt a little sad. He was lost! Among the tall swings and colorful slides, Rudi couldn't find his place in the garage. All the other toys had disappeared from sight.

“Oh no,” thought Rudi. “I’m so big!” He moved slowly between the tree trunks and the children’s legs. He couldn’t do anything to find his way. It was frustrating!

Rudi had an idea. With all his might, he began to push his wheels. The wheels completely deflated. Rudi became much smaller and more agile. Now he could move quickly between the slides and the swings. 

With his new speed, Rudi moved back and forth. Suddenly, he saw a white rabbit hopping. It was Pippo, his favorite friend. “Pippo! Help me!” shouted Rudi.

Pippo followed Rudi with his eyes and led him to the garage. There, Rudi found his place next to his other toy cars. His dad was there waiting for him. 

Rudi felt happy. He had overcome a difficult problem thanks to his perseverance. Rudi realized that even when things seem complicated, if you don’t give up, you can always find the solution.

plan.problema: Rudy got lost among the many swings and slides, unable to find his place.
plan.svolta: He decided to deflate his wheels to become smaller and move faster among the objects.
plan.finale: Thanks to his speed, he saw his friend rabbit, Pip, who helped him find his way back to his garage.

toy car.text:
Speedy was a shiny red toy car. He loved to run in the playground. Every day he enjoyed zooming across the bridges and swings. Today, however, something bad had happened. Speedy had gotten stuck! His wheels were stuck in a black manhole cover. He couldn’t move anymore.

Speedy tried to push himself with all his wheels. He spun and spun, but he didn’t go anywhere. He always ended up back where he started. The manhole cover was too heavy! Speedy slid backwards every time he tried to move forward. “Oh no!” Speedy thought. “I’m really stuck here!”

A little boy, Leo, saw Speedy in the manhole cover. Leo was a kind boy and he had good ideas. Leo sat next to Speedy and started to push. He pushed hard, but Speedy didn’t move yet. Then Leo had an idea! 

Leo ran towards a small stream that passed near the playground. Carefully, he made the water flow over the manhole cover. The cold, powerful water pushed Speedy away from the manhole cover. Speedy quickly returned to his starting point, shiny and bright as always. 

Speedy rested a little. He was happy to be free and to be able to run in the playground again. He realized that sometimes, even if you try very hard, you need help to overcome obstacles. Speedy knew that next time he would be even more careful about where he put his wheels.

plan.problema: Speedy got stuck in the drain and couldn’t move anymore.
plan.svolta: He tried to push himself with all his wheels, but he was too heavy and slid back.
plan.finale: A small stream washed him away, bringing him back to his starting point, sparkling.

toy car.text:
Macchinino was a little red toy car. He loved to race in the playground. The playground had a big sandy maze, full of narrow paths and curves. Macchinino really enjoyed exploring it.

---

One day, Macchinino entered the maze with lots of energy. But then, oh no! He got lost. He couldn’t find his way out anymore. Everything looked the same: sand, dunes, and confusing paths. He was a little scared.

---

Macchinino tried to roll straight, hoping to reach the exit. Instead, he just rolled over himself! He turned from side to side without making any progress. “Oh no!” thought Macchinino. “I don’t know what to do anymore.”

---

A little squirrel, Leo, was watching him. Leo came up to Macchinino and said, “Try using your engine!” Macchinino understood. He used all his strength and started his little engine.

---

Macchinino rolled fast! With a nice spin, he passed the last path and came out of the sandy maze. He was happy! He stopped to look at the playground, full of children playing. Macchinino had learned an important lesson: even when things seem difficult, you have to keep trying. 

---

No matter how stubborn you are, if you never gave up, you will always find your way out.

plan.problema: Machinino is lost in the sand maze!
plan.svolta: He tried to roll straight, but only rolled over himself!
plan.finale: Thanks to his little engine, Machinino made a fast turn and got out!

toy car.text:
Ruggine was a red toy car. He was a small, sturdy car, made of shiny metal. He lived at the playground. He really liked to run between the swings and the slides. Ruggine especially loved to play with the red ball. The ball was big and soft, and they had so much fun rolling it to each other.

One day, while running fast, Ruggine found himself alone. He was surrounded by lots of children playing, but he couldn't see his friend. “Oh no!” said Ruggine. “I’m lost! I can’t find the red ball!” Ruggine looked everywhere, but the ball had disappeared between the swings and the slides. It was so big and noisy.

Ruggine decided to do something. He heard a happy sound: “tinkle, tinkle.” It was the bell of a swing that was moving up and down. Ruggine thought, “Maybe the sound will lead me to the ball!” So, Ruggine started to run following the bell. The bell guided him between the swings and the slides.

Finally, Ruggine saw the red ball bouncing near the fountain. Ruggine ran quickly to the ball and hugged it. “I did it!” exclaimed Ruggine happily. The ball replied, “I’m happy to see you too!”

Ruggine realized that, even when things seem difficult, you have to keep looking. After so much effort, Ruggine had found his friend. Perseverance, even for a little toy car, can lead to happiness.

plan.problema: Rusty got lost among the swings and slides, unable to find his friend, the red ball.
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the sound of the swing bell, hoping it would lead him to the ball.
plan.finale: Finally, he saw the red ball bouncing near the fountain and ran to reach it, happy to have found his friend.

toy car.text:
Macchinino was a little red toy car. He loved to play in the playground. He was a fast and brave car. Today, Macchinino was in front of the big sand maze. It was a fun place, full of narrow paths and curves.

Macchinino started to run into the maze. He wanted to get to the end! But it was more complicated than he thought. Every time he tried to make a tight turn, he got stuck. He felt a little bit hurt and he stopped. Macchinino felt frustrated. He couldn’t find the way out.

A little bird was sitting on a bench in the playground. He watched him with curiosity. “Maybe you should try going straight,” chirped the bird. Macchinino thought about what he said.

Then, Macchinino tried to go straight. Pushing with all his wheels. The wind started to blow. A little push helped him to move. Macchinino pushed and pushed, with a little bit of patience. Slowly, the sand loosened around his wheels.

Finally, after a lot of effort, Macchinino came out of the maze! He was happy. He had overcome the challenge. Macchinino went back to running in the playground, stronger and more determined than before. He realized that, even when things are difficult, with a little perseverance you can reach your goals.

plan.problema: Little Machine has gotten lost in the sand maze!
plan.svolta: He tried to make tight turns, but he just hurt himself more and got stuck.
plan.finale: With a little patience and a push from the wind, Little Machine managed to get out of the maze!

toy car.text:
Auto Rossa was a bright red car. She loved to race in the playground. Every day she returned to her favorite spot, near the sand tower. Today, however, something wasn't right. Auto Rossa had found herself trapped! The sand was very, very high. It surrounded her on all sides.


It was a big problem. Auto Rossa tried to move, but her wheels stopped immediately. The sand was too sticky. She tried to push with all her wheels, but it only made the sand roll even higher. She couldn’t go anywhere.


A little rabbit, Pippo, was watching her curiously. “It looks like you need some help,” Pippo said with a sweet voice. Auto Rossa thought about what to do. Then she had an idea! She used her little mirror to see better. 


She looked around and saw a narrow path between the sand dunes. It was a little dark, but it seemed like the way out. Very carefully, Auto Rossa began to push along that path. Slowly, slowly, she overcame the obstacle.


Finally, Auto Rossa was free! She reached her favorite spot near the sand tower. She was happy and excited. After a little running, Auto Rossa realized that even when things seem difficult, with a little effort, you can always find a solution.

plan.problema: The Red Car got stuck in the deep sand!
plan.svolta: It tried to push itself with all its wheels, but only made the sand roll!
plan.finale: Then, using its little mirror, it saw a narrow passage and went through it carefully.

toy plane.text:
Aereo Mattia was a colorful toy airplane. He lived in the Flower Garden, among the fragrant roses and flowers of all colors. Mattia loved to fly up and down, but one day something wasn't right. He had gotten lost!

He had ended up among the big red and white roses. He couldn’t see his landing strip anymore, the one made of gravel that was on the other side of the garden. Mattia tried to push with his wings, but it wasn't enough. The roses were swallowing him up, he was getting farther and farther away from his home.

“Oh no!” thought Mattia. “I have to do something!” So he made a decision: he would use his little engine to turn closer to the green leaves of the roses. He was trying to find his way around, watching where the rays of the sun went between the leaves. He was a little scared, but he didn't want to give up.

He got closer and closer, crawling between the branches and dodging the thorns. Finally, with a little jump, he landed gently on the gravel landing strip. He was happy! He had found his landing strip. 

A brown ladybug passed by Mattia, waving to him with its head. Mattia smiled and got ready for a new flight. After so much effort, he had learned that even if things seem difficult, you always have to keep trying. And in the end, even the smallest airplane can find its way home.

plan.problema: The airplane Mattia got lost among the roses and can’t find his landing strip.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his small engine to take a closer flight, approaching the leaves to get oriented better.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to his determination, Mattia landed gently on the gravel runway, happy to be back home.

toy plane.text:
Airplane Flyer was a bright blue toy airplane. He loved to be in the Flowery Garden. It was full of fragrant flowers and lush plants. Airplane Flyer had a small propeller that spun very quickly. With that propeller, he could do beautiful loops.

One day, Airplane Flyer found himself in a lovely problem. He was stuck! Two giant roses, red and yellow, had knocked him down among their big leaves. He couldn’t take off. He was frustrated. He tried to push himself, but nothing worked. He remained still, right there.

A little ladybug, Gina, came up to Airplane Flyer. “Why are you so sad?” Gina asked with her cheerful voice. Airplane Flyer explained his problem. He thought for a little while and then had an idea! He decided to use his propeller to lift a small pebble. He spun the propeller as fast as he could, pushing the pebble upwards.

The pebble rose into the air for a moment, but it wasn’t enough. Airplane Flyer continued to spin the propeller with all his strength. With one last, big effort, the propeller spun even faster. And then, suddenly, Airplane Flyer lifted high above the garden!

He smiled looking at the colorful flowers that surrounded him. He was so happy to be free. Airplane Flyer flew in circles, waving to the tulips and daisies. He realized that with a little courage and lots of perseverance, even the biggest obstacles can be overcome.

plan.problema: The airplane found itself stuck between two giant roses and couldn’t take off!
plan.svolta: It decided to lift a small pebble with its propeller to try to create enough thrust to take flight.
plan.finale: Finally, with one last effort, the airplane soared high above the garden, waving to the colorful flowers.

toy plane.text:
Aereo Volante was a colorful toy airplane. He lived in the Flower Garden. He loved to fly among the fragrant flowers. Every day he went around the garden, flying over the red roses and the yellow sunflowers.

One afternoon, Aereo Volante saw a white butterfly. The butterfly fluttered gently among the petals of the tulips. Aereo Volante wanted to play with her. He wanted to fly around the butterfly, but she was too far away. It was difficult to reach the butterfly.

Aereo Volante ran towards her. But every time he tried to speed up the engine, it slowed down even more. It was frustrating! He couldn't cover the distance. He felt a little sad.

He tried to change direction, but the butterfly was too far away. Aereo Volante thought that maybe if he concentrated and kept pushing the engine, he would succeed.

Suddenly, a bright ray of sunshine hit Aereo Volante’s wings. He felt a powerful push! He sped up quickly and flew higher and higher. He reached the white butterfly. The butterfly landed on his wings. Together they flew around the flowers, laughing happily.

A red ladybug, Clementina, passed by. “What’s happening?” asked Clementina.

Aereo Volante explained his problem. “I can’t find my place!”

Finally, after so much searching, he arrived back at his place on the table. He was happy to be home. His mom had rested him on a soft cushion.

Aereo Volante realized that when you are lost, it’s important to be patient and look for the solution calmly. And so, every time he flew, he always remembered not to hurry too much.

trattore.text:
Toby was a bright red tractor. He lived in a big Italian countryside, full of golden and fragrant fields. Toby loved to move, to feel the ground under his wheels and make “brum brum”. One day, Toby was exploring, he had gone too far from the path. The wheat field was very tall, taller than him!

Toby realized right away that he was lost. The wheat stalks surrounded him on all sides and he couldn’t see the way. He was a little scared. He tried to go back, but every time he ended up even deeper in the field. The sun was starting to set and Toby felt even more alone.

Toby made a decision. He used his powerful horn! “Brum brum! Brum brum!” he shouted loudly. But no one arrived. Only white butterflies were dancing around him, answering with a light flutter of wings. There was no help.

Just when Toby was about to give up, he heard a cheerful bark. A brown and yellow sheepdog, with a wet nose, approached Toby. The dog sniffed Toby, then began to walk slowly. Toby followed him, hoping he would take him out of the field.

The dog led Toby to the edge of the wheat field. And there, to Toby’s surprise, was his family! His mom and dad were waiting for him with a big smile. Toby was happy to be back home. Toby understood that asking for help can lead to wonderful surprises.

trattore.text:
Rosso was a bright red tractor. He loved the Italian countryside, the golden fields, and the green trees. Every day he dreamed of working, of helping to harvest the wheat. But today something wasn't right. Rosso had found himself trapped in the mud! The mud was sticky and heavy, holding him still like a stone.

Rosso tried to move. He turned the wheels with all his might, but nothing. He couldn't escape the mud. He was frustrated. He tried to push with all his wheels, but the more he pushed, the more the mud stuck. Then, a strange noise: a small gear had broken! Rosso felt a great pain in his engine.

An old farmer, Nonno Giovanni, saw Rosso in trouble. He came closer and said, “Don’t worry, Rosso, I’ll see how I can help you.” Nonno Giovanni found nearby a jar of oil and, with great care, using a small key, he began to remove the mud around Rosso’s wheels.

Rosso followed every movement with his little eyes. He was patient and waited for Nonno Giovanni to finish. After so much work, the mud was gone! Nonno Giovanni put the oil in Rosso’s engine and re-adjusted the broken gear. Rosso turned his wheels and… he moved! Rosso thanked Nonno Giovanni with a cheerful whistle. He was ready to work again. Rosso went back to making a circle around the field, happy and operational. The countryside was beautiful, and Rosso knew that he would always find the strength to overcome every obstacle.

plan.problema: The red tractor got stuck in the mud and can't move.

plan.finale: With a lot of patience and some oil he had found nearby, he removed the mud and repaired the gear, returning to operation immediately.

trattore.text:
Toro was a bright red tractor. He lived in the countryside, among the golden wheat fields of Italy. He loved to make his wheels turn and hear the engine rumble. One day, while having fun pushing the wheat with his front, something went wrong. Toro found himself stuck! He was completely trapped in the field, surrounded by stalks as tall as his hood.

“Oh no!” said Toro, “I can’t get back to the barn!” He tried to pull himself back, but the more he pushed, the more he got stuck. The wheat held him tight. A little pig, named Pippo, watched him curiously from a distance.

Toro thought he had to find a way out. He decided to go around the field. He moved his wheels slowly, searching among the tall stalks for a gap, a path. The wheat was high and dry, difficult to get over. Toro found courage and kept turning.

After a lot of searching, he finally saw it! A small path, hidden among the stalks, allowed him to move. With a great effort, Toro pushed with all his might. The wheels slipped a little, but in the end, he managed to get out of the field!

Toro stopped, panting. Pippo reached him and made a few laps around him. Toro felt happy to have overcome that difficulty. Perseverance, even when it seems impossible, always leads to success.

trattore.text:
Ruggine was a bright red tractor. He lived in a big Italian countryside, full of golden fields and green trees. He loved to run among the sunflowers and spray water on the tomatoes. Ruggine loved his job, even if sometimes he had too much fun!

One day, while exploring a new field, Ruggine found himself in a difficult situation. The mud was very sticky and it had stuck him. He couldn’t move anymore and he couldn’t get back to the barn where he lived. It was all black around him!

Ruggine tried to push himself with his powerful engine, but the mud was too strong. He just got dirtier and stuck more. A little bird, a sparrow named Pippo, was watching him from a tree branch. “Don’t give up!” chirped Pippo.

Ruggine thought, he thought hard. Then he had an idea! He hitched his trailer to his big engine and slowly pulled it through the mud. The trailer pulled Ruggine with force and finally, the tractor was able to get free from the sticky mud.

Ruggine found himself back in the field, near the barn. He waved goodbye to Pippo and said, “Thank you for encouraging me!” Ruggine went back to the barn happy and pleased. 

Perseverance helped him overcome his difficulty. And now Ruggine knows that even when things seem difficult, you have to keep trying.

Treno Leo was a bright red toy train. He lived at Old Station, a station that was a little bit wobbly but full of tracks. Treno Leo loved to run on his tracks, make pretty shapes, and listen to the whistle of the wind.

---

One day, Treno Leo went for a trip. He wanted to explore the longest tracks that reached Old Station. But he got carried away and ran too far! Suddenly, he realized he was lost. He was surrounded by lots of identical tracks, as if he had ended up in a maze.

---

Treno Leo tried to blow loud whistles, one after another. But nobody heard him. Nobody answered his whistle. He felt a little sad and scared. He didn’t know where to go. An old, rusty track seemed to be smiling at him mischievously.

---

Suddenly, a yellow light shone between the tracks. It was a small light that was moving slowly towards him. Treno Leo followed the yellow light with all his wheels. The light led him along one track and then another. Finally, he saw the track that led back to Old Station!

---

Treno Leo returned to the station, happy and pleased. Mr. Bruno, the toy train maker, was waiting for Treno Leo on the platform. Treno Leo stopped beside him and made a little whistle of joy. Perseverance brought him home. It’s always better not to give up ever.

treno.text:
Treno Leo was a bright red train. He lived at Piccolo Station. Every day he waited to leave for new adventures. But one day something didn’t go as planned. Treno Leo found himself in an unknown place, a maze of tracks!

The tracks went everywhere, all the same. Treno Leo tried to go back, but every time he ended up on a new path. “Oh no!” said Treno Leo. “I’m lost!” He didn’t recognize anything, there was no depot to return to. It was all so confusing!

Treno Leo stopped and thought. He listened carefully. He heard a distant sound, the sound of bells coming from other trains passing in the distance. Treno Leo made a decision. “I’ll follow the sound!” he said. He moved slowly along the tracks, trying to get closer to the bells.

A little blue locomotive stopped beside him. “Where are you going, little train?” asked the locomotive with a kind tone. Treno Leo explained his situation. The locomotive replied: “Blow your whistle loudly! Someone will hear you!”

Treno Leo followed the locomotive’s advice and blew his whistle with all his might. Immediately, a whistle sound echoed from Piccolo Station. An operator ran towards Treno Leo and gently guided him along the correct track.

Treno Leo happily returned to his safe place. The depot was right there, next to his favorite rail. He was happy to be home. Treno Leo understood that asking for help can lead to wonderful solutions.

plan.problema: Leo got lost in the maze of tracks and doesn't know how to get back to his depot!
plan.svolta: He decided to follow the sound of the distant train bells to get his bearings.
plan.finale: Finally, thanks to a kind train whistle, Leo happily returned to his safe place.
plan.morale: Follow the instructions and ask for help.

treno.text:
Vito was a bright red train. He lived at Santa’s Station. Every day he waited for children and their presents. Vito loved his job! Transporting all those toys! But one day, something terrible happened.

“Oh no!” cried Vito. “Where have my wagons gone?” He looked around frantically. His wagons, the ones full of dolls and teddy bears, were gone! He couldn’t carry the presents for all the children in the world anymore. It was a disaster! Vito felt very sad and worried.

Vito decided to ask for help. He saw a giant alarm clock, the one that rang every morning at Santa’s Station. The alarm clock was huge and had a smiling face. Vito ran to it and said, “Mrs. Alarm Clock, I’ve lost all my wagons! I don’t know what to do!”

The giant alarm clock wobbled a little. Then, suddenly, it started to play the fastest tune in the world! It was a strange music, full of rhythm. The ground began to vibrate. Vito felt a strong shake under his wheels. 

And then, miraculously, Vito’s wagons returned to their place! They were there, ready to be loaded with presents. The giant alarm clock stopped playing and went back to telling the time. Vito was so happy! He realized that even if you sometimes feel alone, asking for help can lead to wonderful surprises. Together, the train and the alarm clock, were ready for a new departure.

plan.problema: Vito lost all his wagons and couldn’t carry the presents for the children.
plan.svolta: He decided to ask for help from the giant alarm clock, which played the fastest melody in the world!
plan.finale: The alarm made the ground vibrate and all the wagons returned to their place, ready to depart.

treno.text:
Treno Leo was a bright red train. He lived at Central Station. Every day he waited to make wonderful journeys. But that day, something wasn't right. Treno Leo was lost! He had rattled his carriages around and couldn't find his track.

The track was where he normally ran, a long colorful strip that waited for him. It was his favorite place. Treno Leo looked everywhere. He looked in toy boxes, under tables and behind chairs. But nothing! The track wasn't there.

Treno Leo tried to push himself with all his wheels. He tried to move quickly, but the track was too far away. He was tired and a little sad. He didn't know what to do. 

Suddenly, he heard a little “chirp”. A small blue bird landed on his roof. “What’s happening, train?” asked the bird. Treno Leo explained his problem: he was lost and couldn't find his track.

The bird flew around Treno Leo, pointing with its beak at a corner of the carriage depot. And there, right next to his depot, was his track! Treno Leo ran happily towards it. He stopped and settled among his colorful striped carriages.

Treno Leo was happy. He had found his way. The bird smiled and flew away. Treno Leo understood that, even when it seemed impossible, continuing to look could lead to the solution.

plan.problema: Leo got lost and couldn't find his track.
plan.svolta: He tried to push himself with all his wheels, but the track was too far!
plan.finale: Thanks to the help of a little bird, Leo found his track near his train depot.

treno.text:
Treno Leo was a bright red train. He lived at Central Station. Every day he waited to leave for new adventures. But today he wasn't happy. He was lost! He had ended up in a maze of tracks, long and narrow. He didn't recognize anything.

“Oh no!” said Treno Leo. “I don’t know where I am anymore!” The tracks crossed everywhere and he kept speeding along without direction. He was very confused. He saw an old train named Signor Bruno, who was carrying goods. “Signor Bruno, can you help me?” asked Treno Leo.

Signor Bruno replied: "You have to make more noise! Give a big whistle!" Treno Leo tried to blow the whistle as loud as he could. But no one could hear it. No other train seemed to notice. He kept turning, faster and faster, and more and more lost.

Treno Leo stopped for a moment. He thought that maybe, if he was kind, something would change. Then he slowed down his journey and waved to all the trains he met: a yellow train, a blue train, even a little red wagon. 

“Good morning!” shouted Treno Leo to every train. “I hope I don’t cross paths with you again!” And as he waved to a green train, he heard a familiar sound. It was his track! Treno Leo was back in his place at Central Station. All his friends were waiting for him. 

Treno Leo realized that when you are kind to others, good things happen too.

plan.problema: The little train Leo was lost in the maze of tracks!
plan.svolta: Leo tried to give a very loud whistle, but no one could hear him and he kept going forward without direction.
plan.finale: Then he decided to slow down and say hello to all the trains he met, and suddenly he arrived at his platform!

treno.text:
Treno Leo lived at Villaverde Station. He was a red train, strong and full of excitement. Every day he waited to leave for new adventures. But one morning, something had gone wrong. Treno Leo had found himself in a maze of tracks! The tracks branched everywhere, all the same, all unknown. He couldn’t find his platform, his safe place.

He was very worried. He tried to turn right, then left, but only ended up finding himself in another corner of the maze. “Oh no!” exclaimed Treno Leo, slowing down his engine. “I’m lost!”

He decided he had to do something. He took his whistle and blew with all his might. “Fiu! Fiu!” sounded Treno Leo’s whistle. He hoped someone would hear it and could help him. But nobody answered. Other trains passed quickly, not noticing his call.

Suddenly, a little toy train on wheels stopped in front of him. The train was a beautiful blue and had very small wheels. “Fiu! Fiu!” he heard Treno Leo’s whistle. The toy train recognized the sound and pointed with its little locomotive in a direction.

Treno Leo followed the toy train’s instructions and, after a while, he finally came out of the maze! He returned to his platform, happy to be home. Treno Leo realized that even when it seems like everything is lost, you should never give up. And this made him learn a great lesson.

plan.problema: Train Leo got lost in the maze of tracks and couldn't get back to his platform.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his whistle to ask for help from the other trains, but nobody seemed to hear it.
plan.finale: Finally, a little toy train recognized the sound and guided him out of the maze.

treno.text:
Rondine was a bright red train. He lived at Villaverde Station. He loved to run on the tracks and take imaginary journeys. One day, Rondine had too much fun zooming around the main platform. Suddenly, he realized he was surrounded by many tracks crossing each other. He had gotten into a maze!

Rondine tried to go back, but every time he ended up on another path. He felt sad and confused. “Oh no!” said Rondine. “I can’t find my little house anymore!” He desperately looked for a way out, but the tracks seemed endless.

Rondine thought about making a long whistle, like real trains do. But no one heard it. It was too far away and his sounds got lost among the many noises of the station. Rondine decided to do something different. He turned on all his lights! The red and white lights shone brightly, illuminating the maze.

Suddenly, a little engine answered Rondine’s whistle. It was a small engine, always ready to help. “Hey you! Are you lost?” asked the engine. Rondine nodded frantically. The engine heard Rondine’s whistle and followed it with his tracks. He led Rondine out of the maze, to the station platform.

Rondine finally felt safe, next to his little house. He was happy! He rested a little before preparing for a new journey. With lots of energy and determination, Rondine solved his problem. And so, you can overcome difficulties too if you never give up.

plan.problema: The Swallow train got lost in the maze of tracks and couldn’t get back to its little house.
plan.svolta: Swallow tried to make a long whistle, but nobody could hear it, so she decided to turn on all her lights to attract attention.
plan.finale: A little engine squeak heard Swallow and led her out of the maze, bringing her back to the station.

treno.text:
Treno Leo was a bright red train. He lived at Central Station and loved to run on his tracks. Every day, Treno Leo waited to leave for new adventures. One day, however, something strange happened. Treno Leo found himself in a dark and confusing place. He was inside a maze of tracks!

Treno Leo didn’t understand where he was. The tracks wound everywhere, curves to the right, curves to the left, getting narrower and narrower. He was very scared. Treno Leo tried to move, but he kept getting stuck. He couldn’t find his way out.

“Oh no!” exclaimed Treno Leo. “I’m lost!” Then, Treno Leo took a deep breath and decided to do something. He let out a loud whistle, a strong, strong, strong whistle! The sound echoed in Central Station.

Suddenly, a train conductor, Mr. Bianchi, came to Treno Leo. Mr. Bianchi was a kind and smiling man. With great care, he straightened the tracks that had created the maze. Treno Leo could finally run straight.

Mr. Bianchi brought Treno Leo back to Central Station. Treno Leo felt relieved and happy. He was home! From that day on, Treno Leo continued to run on his tracks, always attentive and determined. Sometimes, even when things seem difficult, it’s important never to give up.

plan.problema: The Train Leo got lost in the maze of tracks!
plan.svolta: He decided to blow a loud whistle to attract the attention of the engineers.
plan.finale: Finally, a kind engineer straightened his tracks and brought him back to the station.

treno.text:
Treno Leo was a shiny red train. He lived at Central Station. Every day he waited to start new adventures. One day, Treno Leo went too far from his platform. He found himself in a maze of tracks! It was all the same: curves, branches, other trains.



Treno Leo was scared. He didn’t know how to go back. He tried to turn right, then left, but he couldn’t find his way. “Oh no,” thought Treno Leo, “I’m lost!” Everything was gray and confusing.



Then, Treno Leo decided to do something. He pulled his whistle really hard. “Fiu! Fiu!” it sounded loud. But nobody seemed to hear the sound. Other trains passed quickly without noticing him.



Suddenly, a little blue toy train stopped next to Treno Leo. The blue train smiled and pointed in a direction with his little engine. “Go straight,” said the blue train, “and then turn left.”



Treno Leo followed the blue train’s instructions. He walked bravely, passing the curves and branches. Finally, he saw his platform! He was happy to be going home. Treno Leo stopped on his platform, happy with his adventure.



Treno Leo understood that even when things seem difficult, if you don’t give up, you always find a solution.

plan.problema: The Train Leo got lost in the maze of tracks and didn't know how to get back.
plan.svolta: He decided to use his whistle to ask for help from the other trains, but nobody seemed to hear the sound.
plan.finale: Finally, a little toy train showed him the right way and Train Leo returned to his platform.

treno.text:
Riccardo was a red train. He lived at Villaverde Station. Every day he waited for travelers, but he was special because he could talk and move on his own. One morning, Riccardo set off on an adventure. He wanted to go straight to the main line.

But then, here was a problem! Riccardo entered a long tunnel. It was so dark that he couldn’t see anything. After a long time, he realized he was lost. The tunnel was very long and he couldn’t find his line. “Oh no!” said Riccardo, “I’m lost!”.

Riccardo tried to give more strength to his wheels. He turned and turned, but the tunnel always stayed the same. It was an endless tunnel! A little bird, that was perched at the station, watched Riccardo with curiosity. “Come on Riccardo!” chirped the bird.

Riccardo thought, thought, and then, with all his courage, he gave one last push with his pedal. And something happened! Riccardo turned sharply and found himself on the right line. He was so happy, so happy that he made beautiful spirals!

Riccardo continued to travel happily, knowing that even when things seem difficult, with a little effort and perseverance, you can always find the right way.

plan.problema: Riccardo got lost in the long tunnel and couldn't find his track.
plan.svolta: He tried to give more power to his wheels, but the tunnel remained the same.
plan.finale: With one last push of the pedal, Riccardo turned and found himself on the right track, full of joy!
